Neigh.

scottature.

Difesa.

Attacca spesso per

Lastra tenuta.

Nebbioso.

Crea un Terreno
Psichico.

entries.translation_source: Boosts Speed on Electric Terrain.

Aumenta la Velocità su
Terreno Elettrico.

entries.original: "Ups Defense on Grassy Terrain."
entries.translation_source: Ups Defense on Grassy Terrain.
entries.translated:
Aumenta la Difesa su
Terreno Erboso.

Porta l{B4}Attacco al

Percepisce le mosse

alle statistiche.

Impedisce al nemico di
mangiare le Bacche.

Aumenta la Velocità ma
riduce la Difesa.

battaglia.

I colpi di tipo Buio

Le mosse di tipo pauroso
aumentano la Velocità.

Infligge colpi critici
ai nemici avvelenati.

Protegge dai problemi
mentali.

tipo Erba dagli stati
alterati.

critical-hit ratio."

entries.translated:
Il nemico viene
attaccato con un

five times."

Il nemico viene
schiaffeggiato

cinque volte.

five times."

power."

colpito da un pugno

lanciate contro il
nemico. Si guadagna
denaro dopo la lotta.

Il bersaglio viene
colpito da un pugno

bruciatura.

nemico.

squeeze the foe."

segno.

stat."

cut down thin trees
and grass."
entries.translation_source: A basic attack. It can be used to cut down thin trees and grass.
entries.translated:
Un attacco base. Può
essere usato per
abbattere alberi sottili
e l{B4}erba.

entries.original:
"Strikes the foe
with a gust of wind
whipped up by
wings."
entries.translation_source: Strikes the foe with a gust of wind whipped up by wings.
entries.translated:
Colpisce il nemico con
una raffica di vento
sollevata dalle ali.

entries.original:
"The foe is struck
with large, imposing
wings spread wide."
entries.translation_source: The foe is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito
da grandi ali imponenti
spalancate.

entries.original:
"The foe is made to
switch out with an
ally. In the wild,
the battle ends."
entries.translation_source: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.
entries.translated:
L{B4}avversario viene
costretto a scendere e a
essere sostituito da un
alleato. In natura, la
lotta termina.

entries.original:
"A 2-turn move that
hits on the 2nd
turn. Use it to fly
to any known town."
entries.translation_source: A 2-turn move that hits on the 2nd turn. Use it to fly to any known town.
entries.translated:
Una mossa a 2 turni che
colpisce al 2° turno.
Usala per volare in
qualsiasi città
conosciuta.

entries.original:
"A long body or
tentacles are used
to bind the foe for
two to five turns."
entries.translation_source: A long body or tentacles are used to bind the foe for two to five turns.
entries.translated:
Un corpo lungo o dei
tentacoli vengono usati
per intrappolare il
nemico per due-cinque
turni.

entries.original:
"The foe is struck
with a long tail,
vines, etc."
entries.translation_source: The foe is struck with a long tail, vines, etc.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito
da una lunga coda, liane
e simili.

entries.original:
"The foe is struck
with slender, whip-
like vines."
entries.translation_source: The foe is struck with slender, whip- like vines.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito
da liane sottili simili
a fruste.

entries.original:
"The foe is stomped
with a big foot.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The foe is stomped with a big foot. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
pestato da un grande
piede. Può farlo
tentennare.

entries.original:
"Two legs are used
to quickly kick the
foe twice in one
turn."
entries.translation_source: Two legs are used to quickly kick the foe twice in one turn.
entries.translated:
Le due zampe vengono
usate per colpire
rapidamente il nemico
con due calci in un solo
turno.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
by a kick fired
with muscle-packed
power."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked by a kick fired with muscle-packed power.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da un calcio
sferrato con forza
muscolare.

entries.original:
"The user jumps up
high, then kicks.
If it misses, the
user hurts itself."
entries.translation_source: The user jumps up high, then kicks. If it misses, the user hurts itself.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore salta in
alto e poi sferra un
calcio. Se manca il
bersaglio, si fa male.

entries.original:
"A quick kick from a
rolling spin.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: A quick kick from a rolling spin. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Un calcio rapido
sferrato da una
rotazione. Può far
tentennare il nemico.

entries.original:
"A lot of sand is
hurled in the foe’s
face, reducing its
accuracy."
entries.translation_source: A lot of sand is hurled in the foe’s face, reducing its accuracy.
entries.translated:
Molta sabbia viene
gettata in faccia al
nemico, riducendone la
precisione.

entries.original:
"The user sticks its
head out and rams.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The user sticks its head out and rams. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore sporge la
testa e travolge il
nemico. Può farlo
tentennare.

entries.original:
"The foe is jabbed
with a sharply
pointed horn to
inflict damage."
entries.translation_source: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
trafitto da un corno
aguzzo per infliggere
danni.

entries.original:
"The foe is jabbed
repeatedly with a
horn or beak two to
five times."
entries.translation_source: The foe is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito
ripetutamente con un
corno o un becco da due
a cinque volte.

entries.original:
"The horn is rotated
like a drill to ram.
The foe will faint
if it hits."
entries.translation_source: The horn is rotated like a drill to ram. The foe will faint if it hits.
entries.translated:
Il corno ruota come una
trivella per caricare.
Il bersaglio va KO se
colpisce.

entries.original:
"A physical attack
in which the user
charges, full body,
into the foe."
entries.translation_source: A physical attack in which the user charges, full body, into the foe.
entries.translated:
Un attacco fisico in cui
l{B4}utilizzatore si lancia
contro il nemico con
tutto il corpo.

entries.original:
"The user drops its
full body on the
foe. It may leave
the foe paralyzed."
entries.translation_source: The user drops its full body on the foe. It may leave the foe paralyzed.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si lascia
cadere con tutto il
corpo sul nemico. Può
paralizzarlo.

entries.original:
"A long body or
vines are used to
wrap the foe for
two to five turns."
entries.translation_source: A long body or vines are used to wrap the foe for two to five turns.
entries.translated:
Un lungo corpo o delle
liane avvolgono il
bersaglio per due a
cinque turni.

entries.original:
"A reckless, full-
body charge attack
that also hurts the
user a little."
entries.translation_source: A reckless, full- body charge attack that also hurts the user a little.
entries.translated:
Un attacco spericolato a
tutto corpo che ferisce
leggermente anche
l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user rampages
about for two to
three turns, then
becomes confused."
entries.translation_source: The user rampages about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
scatena per due o tre
turni, poi si confonde.

entries.original:
"A reckless, life-
risking tackle that
also hurts the user
a little."
entries.translation_source: A reckless, life- risking tackle that also hurts the user a little.
entries.translated:
Un Tackle sconsiderato e
rischioso che ferisce un
po{B4} anche
l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user wags its
tail cutely, making
the foe lower its
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe lower its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore
scodinzola in modo
adorabile, facendo
abbassare la Difesa del
nemico.

entries.original:
"The foe is stabbed
with a toxic barb,
etc. It may poison
the foe."
entries.translation_source: The foe is stabbed with a toxic barb, etc. It may poison the foe.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene punto da
un aculeo tossico, ecc.
Può essere avvelenato.

entries.original:
"The foe is stabbed
twice with foreleg
stingers. It may
poison the foe."
entries.translation_source: The foe is stabbed twice with foreleg stingers. It may poison the foe.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene punto
due volte con aculei
sulle zampe anteriori.
Può avvelenarlo.

entries.original:
"Sharp pins are shot
at the foe and hit
two to five times
at once."
entries.translation_source: Sharp pins are shot at the foe and hit two to five times at once.
entries.translated:
Aghi appuntiti vengono
sparati contro il nemico
e colpiscono da due a
cinque volte.

entries.original:
"The foe is given an
intimidating look
that lowers its
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The foe is given an intimidating look that lowers its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene fissato
con uno sguardo
intimidatorio che riduce
la sua Difesa.

entries.original:
"The user bites with
vicious fangs.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The user bites with vicious fangs. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utente morde con zanne
feroci. Può far
tentennare il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user growls in
a cute way, making
the foe lower its
Attack stat."
entries.translation_source: The user growls in a cute way, making the foe lower its Attack stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore ringhia
in modo tenero, facendo
abbassare l{B4}Attacco del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The foe is made to
switch out with an
ally. In the wild,
the battle ends."
entries.translation_source: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.
entries.translated:
L{B4}avversario viene
costretto a scendere e a
essere sostituito da un
alleato. In natura, la
lotta termina.

entries.original:
"A soothing song
in a calming voice
lulls the foe into
a deep slumber."
entries.translation_source: A soothing song in a calming voice lulls the foe into a deep slumber.
entries.translated:
Una canzone rilassante,
intonata con voce calma,
culla il nemico in un
sonno profondo.

entries.original:
"The user generates
odd sound waves.
It may confuse the
foe."
entries.translation_source: The user generates odd sound waves. It may confuse the foe.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon genera strane
onde sonore. Può
confondere il nemico.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a shock wave that
always inflicts 20-
HP damage."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a shock wave that always inflicts 20- HP damage.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da un{B4}onda
d{B4}urto che infligge
sempre 20 PS di danno.

entries.original:
"For a few turns,
it prevents the foe
from using the move
it last used."
entries.translation_source: For a few turns, it prevents the foe from using the move it last used.
entries.translated:
Per alcuni turni,
impedisce al bersaglio
di usare l{B4}ultima mossa
che ha usato.

entries.original:
"The foe is sprayed
with a harsh, hide-
melting acid that
may lower Defense."
entries.translation_source: The foe is sprayed with a harsh, hide- melting acid that may lower Defense.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
spruzzato con un acido
corrosivo che scioglie
la pelle e che può
ridurne la Difesa.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with small flames.
The foe may suffer
a burn."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with small flames. The foe may suffer a burn.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene
attaccato con piccole
fiamme. Può subire una
scottatura.

entries.original:
"The foe is scorched
with intense flames.
The foe may suffer
a burn."
entries.translation_source: The foe is scorched with intense flames. The foe may suffer a burn.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene
bruciacchiato da fiamme
intense. Può subire una
scottatura.

entries.original:
"The ally party is
protected by a
mist that prevents
stat reductions."
entries.translation_source: The ally party is protected by a mist that prevents stat reductions.
entries.translated:
La squadra alleata è
protetta da una nebbia
che impedisce le
riduzioni delle
statistiche.

entries.original:
"The foe is struck
with a lot of water
expelled forcibly
from the mouth."
entries.translation_source: The foe is struck with a lot of water expelled forcibly from the mouth.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da un getto
d{B4}acqua espulso con
forza dalla bocca.

entries.original:
"A high volume of
water is blasted at
the foe under great
pressure."
entries.translation_source: A high volume of water is blasted at the foe under great pressure.
entries.translated:
Un potente getto d{B4}acqua
viene sparato contro il
nemico ad altissima
pressione.

entries.original:
"A big wave crashes
down on the foe.
Can also be used
for crossing water."
entries.translation_source: A big wave crashes down on the foe. Can also be used for crossing water.
entries.translated:
Un{B4}enorme onda si
abbatte sul nemico. Può
essere usata anche per
attraversare l{B4}acqua.

entries.original:
"The foe is struck
with an icy beam.
It may leave the
foe with frostbite."
entries.translation_source: The foe is struck with an icy beam. It may leave the foe with frostbite.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito
da un raggio di
ghiaccio. Può lasciarlo
assiderato.

entries.original:
"A blizzard strikes
the opposing team.
It may also leave
them with frostbite."
entries.translation_source: A blizzard strikes the opposing team. It may also leave them with frostbite.
entries.translated:
Una tormenta di neve
colpisce la squadra
avversaria. Può anche
causare assideramento.

entries.original:
"A peculiar ray is
shot at the foe.
It may leave the
foe confused."
entries.translation_source: A peculiar ray is shot at the foe. It may leave the foe confused.
entries.translated:
Un raggio bizzarro viene
sparato contro il
nemico. Può confonderlo.

entries.original:
"A spray of bubbles
strikes the foe.
It may lower the
foe’s Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: A spray of bubbles strikes the foe. It may lower the foe’s Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Uno spruzzo di bolle
colpisce il bersaglio.
Può ridurne la Velocità.

entries.original:
"A rainbow-colored
attack beam.
It may lower the
foe’s Attack stat."
entries.translation_source: A rainbow-colored attack beam. It may lower the foe’s Attack stat.
entries.translated:
Un raggio d{B4}attacco dai
colori dell{B4}arcobaleno.
Può ridurre l{B4}Attacco
del nemico.

entries.original:
"A severely damaging
attack that makes
the user rest on
the next turn."
entries.translation_source: A severely damaging attack that makes the user rest on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Un attacco estremamente
dannoso che costringe
l{B4}utilizzatore a
riposare nel turno
successivo.

entries.original:
"The foe is jabbed
with a sharply
pointed beak or
horn."
entries.translation_source: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito
da un becco o da un
corno appuntito.

entries.original:
"A corkscrewing
attack with the
sharp beak acting
as a drill."
entries.translation_source: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.
entries.translated:
Un attacco a vite in cui
il becco affilato funge
da trapano.

entries.original:
"A reckless, full-
body throw attack
that also hurts the
user a little."
entries.translation_source: A reckless, full- body throw attack that also hurts the user a little.
entries.translated:
Un attacco di lancio
avventato a corpo intero
che ferisce un po{B4} anche
l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"A low, tripping kick
that inflicts more
damage on heavier
foes."
entries.translation_source: A low, tripping kick that inflicts more damage on heavier foes.
entries.translated:
Un calcio basso e di
sgambetto che infligge
più danni ai bersagli
più pesanti.

entries.original:
"A retaliation move
that counters any
physical hit with
double the damage."
entries.translation_source: A retaliation move that counters any physical hit with double the damage.
entries.translated:
Una mossa di ritorsione
che contrattacca
qualsiasi colpo fisico
infliggendo il doppio
dei danni.

entries.original:
"A gravity-fed throw
that causes damage
matching the user’s
level."
entries.translation_source: A gravity-fed throw that causes damage matching the user’s level.
entries.translated:
Un lancio guidato dalla
gravità che infligge
danni pari al livello
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The foe is slugged
at maximum power.
Can also be used
to move boulders."
entries.translation_source: The foe is slugged at maximum power. Can also be used to move boulders.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio riceve un
pugno alla massima
potenza. Può anche
essere usata per
spostare massi.

entries.original:
"An attack that
absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP."
entries.translation_source: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che assorbe
metà del danno inflitto
per ripristinare PS.

entries.original:
"A tough attack that
drains half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP."
entries.translation_source: A tough attack that drains half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
entries.translated:
Un attacco potente che
assorbe metà del danno
inflitto per recuperare
PS.

entries.original:
"A seed is planted
on the foe to steal
some HP for the 
user on every turn."
entries.translation_source: A seed is planted on the foe to steal some HP for the user on every turn.
entries.translated:
Si pianta un seme nel
bersaglio per sottrarre
PS a ogni turno e
donarli
all{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user’s body is
forced to grow,
raising the Attack
and Sp. Atk stats."
entries.translation_source: The user’s body is forced to grow, raising the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
entries.translated:
Il corpo
dell{B4}utilizzatore è
costretto a crescere,
aumentando le
statistiche Attacco e
Att. Sp.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a cutting leaf.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a cutting leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito
da una foglia tagliente.
Ha un alto tasso di
colpo critico.

entries.original:
"A 2-turn move that
blasts the foe with
absorbed energy in
the 2nd turn."
entries.translation_source: A 2-turn move that blasts the foe with absorbed energy in the 2nd turn.
entries.translated:
Una mossa a 2 turni che
travolge il bersaglio
con energia assorbita al
secondo turno.

entries.original:
"A cloud of toxic
dust is scattered.
It may poison the
foe."
entries.translation_source: A cloud of toxic dust is scattered. It may poison the foe.
entries.translated:
Una nube di polvere
tossica viene sparsa.
Può avvelenare il
nemico.

entries.original:
"Paralyzing dust is
scattered wildly.
It may paralyze
the foe."
entries.translation_source: Paralyzing dust is scattered wildly. It may paralyze the foe.
entries.translated:
Polvere paralizzante
viene sparsa con
violenza. Può
paralizzare il nemico.

entries.original:
"A sleep-inducing
dust is scattered
in high volume
around a foe."
entries.translation_source: A sleep-inducing dust is scattered in high volume around a foe.
entries.translated:
Una polvere soporifera
viene sparsa in grande
quantità attorno a un
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with petals for two
to three turns,
then gets confused."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with petals for two to three turns, then gets confused.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
con petali per due-tre
turni, poi si confonde.

entries.original:
"The foe is bound
with strings shot
from the mouth to
reduce its Speed."
entries.translation_source: The foe is bound with strings shot from the mouth to reduce its Speed.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
legato con fili sparati
dalla bocca, per ridurne
la Velocità.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a shock wave that
always inflicts 40-
HP damage."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a shock wave that always inflicts 40- HP damage.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da un{B4}onda
d{B4}urto che infligge
sempre 40 PS di danno.

entries.original:
"The foe is trapped
in an intense spiral
of fire that rages
two to five turns."
entries.translation_source: The foe is trapped in an intense spiral of fire that rages two to five turns.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
intrappolato in un
intenso vortice di fuoco
che infuria per due o
cinque turni.

entries.original:
"An electric shock
attack that may
also leave the foe
paralyzed."
entries.translation_source: An electric shock attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.
entries.translated:
Un attacco a scossa
elettrica che può anche
paralizzare il
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"A strong electrical
attack that may
also leave the foe
paralyzed."
entries.translation_source: A strong electrical attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.
entries.translated:
Un potente attacco
elettrico che può anche
paralizzare il nemico.

entries.original:
"A weak electric
shock that is sure
to cause paralysis
if it hits."
entries.translation_source: A weak electric shock that is sure to cause paralysis if it hits.
entries.translated:
Una debole scarica
elettrica che, se va a
segno, paralizza di
sicuro.

entries.original:
"A brutal lightning
attack that may
also leave the foe
paralyzed."
entries.translation_source: A brutal lightning attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.
entries.translated:
Un brutale attacco
elettrico che può anche
paralizzare il
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with a shower of
small, easily
thrown rocks."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with a shower of small, easily thrown rocks.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
attaccato con una
pioggia di piccoli sassi
facilmente scagliabili.

entries.original:
"An earthquake that
strikes all Pokémon
in battle excluding
the user."
entries.translation_source: An earthquake that strikes all Pokémon in battle excluding the user.
entries.translated:
Un terremoto che
colpisce tutti i Pokémon
in lotta tranne
l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The foe is dropped
into a fissure.
The foe faints if it
hits."
entries.translation_source: The foe is dropped into a fissure. The foe faints if it hits.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene fatto
cadere in una fessura.
Se va a segno, il nemico
sviene.

entries.original:
"An attack that hits
on the 2nd turn.
Can also be used
to exit dungeons."
entries.translation_source: An attack that hits on the 2nd turn. Can also be used to exit dungeons.
entries.translated:
Colpisce al secondo
turno. Può anche essere
usata per uscire dai
dungeon.

entries.original:
"A move that badly
poisons the foe.
Its poison damage
worsens every turn."
entries.translation_source: A move that badly poisons the foe. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
entries.translated:
Una mossa che avvelena
gravemente il nemico. Il
danno da veleno peggiora
a ogni turno.

entries.original:
"A weak telekinetic
attack that may
also leave the foe
confused."
entries.translation_source: A weak telekinetic attack that may also leave the foe confused.
entries.translated:
Un debole attacco
telecinetico che può
anche confondere il
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"A strong telekinetic
attack. It may also
lower the foe’s
Sp. Def stat."
entries.translation_source: A strong telekinetic attack. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.
entries.translated:
Un potente attacco
telecinetico. Può anche
ridurre la Difesa
Speciale del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Hypnotic suggestion
is used to make the
foe fall into a
deep sleep."
entries.translation_source: Hypnotic suggestion is used to make the foe fall into a deep sleep.
entries.translated:
Si usa un suggerimento
ipnotico per far cadere
il nemico in un sonno
profondo.

entries.original:
"The user meditates
to awaken its power
and raise its
Attack stat."
entries.translation_source: The user meditates to awaken its power and raise its Attack stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore medita
per risvegliare il
proprio potere e
aumentare l{B4}Attacco.

entries.original:
"The user relaxes
and lightens its
body to sharply
boost its Speed."
entries.translation_source: The user relaxes and lightens its body to sharply boost its Speed.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
rilassa e alleggerisce
il proprio corpo per
aumentare drasticamente
la sua Velocità.

entries.original:
"An almost invisibly
fast attack that
is certain to strike
first."
entries.translation_source: An almost invisibly fast attack that is certain to strike first.
entries.translated:
Un attacco quasi
invisibilmente rapido
che colpisce sicuramente
per primo.

entries.original:
"An attack that
becomes stronger
each time the user
is hit in battle."
entries.translation_source: An attack that becomes stronger each time the user is hit in battle.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che diventa
più forte ogni volta che
l{B4}utilizzatore viene
colpito in lotta.

entries.original:
"Use it to flee from
any wild Pokémon.
Also warps to the
last Poké Centre."
entries.translation_source: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. Also warps to the last Poké Centre.
entries.translated:
Usala per fuggire da
qualsiasi Pokémon
selvatico. Ti
teletrasporta anche
all{B4}ultimo Centro
Pokémon.

entries.original:
"An attack with a
mirage that inflicts
damage matching
the user’s level."
entries.translation_source: An attack with a mirage that inflicts damage matching the user’s level.
entries.translated:
Un attacco con un
miraggio che infligge
danni pari al livello
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user copies the
move last used by
the foe for the
rest of the battle."
entries.translation_source: The user copies the move last used by the foe for the rest of the battle.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore copia
l{B4}ultima mossa usata dal
bersaglio per il resto
della lotta.

entries.original:
"An ear-splitting
screech is emitted
to sharply reduce
the foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: An ear-splitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Un urlo stridulo
assordante riduce
drasticamente la Difesa
del nemico.

entries.original:
"The user creates
illusory copies of
itself to raise its
evasiveness."
entries.translation_source: The user creates illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore crea
copie illusorie di sé
per aumentare la sua
evasione.

entries.original:
"A self-healing move
that restores HP by
up to half of the
user’s maximum HP."
entries.translation_source: A self-healing move that restores HP by up to half of the user’s maximum HP.
entries.translated:
Una mossa curativa che
ripristina PS fino a
metà dei PS massimi
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user stiffens
all the muscles in
its body to raise
its Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore
irrigidisce tutti i
muscoli del corpo per
aumentare la sua
statistica Difesa.

entries.original:
"The user compresses
all the cells in its
body to raise its
evasiveness."
entries.translation_source: The user compresses all the cells in its body to raise its evasiveness.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore comprime
tutte le cellule del
corpo per aumentare la
sua evasività.

entries.original:
"An obscuring cloud
of smoke or ink
reduces the foe’s
accuracy."
entries.translation_source: An obscuring cloud of smoke or ink reduces the foe’s accuracy.
entries.translated:
Una nube di fumo o
inchiostro riduce la
precisione del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The foe is exposed
to a sinister ray
that triggers
confusion."
entries.translation_source: The foe is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito
da un raggio sinistro
che provoca confusione.

entries.original:
"The user withdraws
its body in its hard
shell, raising its
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user withdraws its body in its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore ritrae il
corpo nel suo guscio
duro, aumentando la sua
statistica Difesa.

entries.original:
"The user curls up
to conceal weak
spots and raise its
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
raggomitola per
nascondere i punti
deboli e aumentare la
propria Difesa.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
sturdy wall that
sharply raises its
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore crea un
muro robusto che aumenta
di molto la sua Difesa.

entries.original:
"A wall of light
cuts damage from
Sp. Atk attacks
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: A wall of light cuts damage from Sp. Atk attacks for five turns.
entries.translated:
Una barriera di luce
riduce i danni degli
attacchi di Att. Sp. per
cinque turni.

entries.original:
"Eliminates all stat
changes among all
Pokémon engaged in
battle."
entries.translation_source: Eliminates all stat changes among all Pokémon engaged in battle.
entries.translated:
Elimina tutte le
modifiche alle
statistiche di tutti i
Pokémon coinvolti in
lotta.

entries.original:
"A wall of light
cuts damage from
physical attacks
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.
entries.translated:
Una barriera di luce
riduce i danni degli
attacchi fisici per
cinque turni.

entries.original:
"The user takes a
deep breath and
focuses to raise its
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The user takes a deep breath and focuses to raise its critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore fa un
respiro profondo e si
concentra per aumentare
la probabilità di brutto
colpo.

entries.original:
"The user endures
attacks for two
turns, then strikes
back double."
entries.translation_source: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back double.
entries.translated:
Resiste agli attacchi
per due turni, poi
contrattacca infliggendo
il doppio del danno.

entries.original:
"Waggles a finger
and stimulates the
brain into using any
move at random."
entries.translation_source: Waggles a finger and stimulates the brain into using any move at random.
entries.translated:
Agita un dito e stimola
il cervello a usare una
mossa a caso.

entries.original:
"The user counters
the move last used
by the foe with the
same move."
entries.translation_source: The user counters the move last used by the foe with the same move.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore
contrattacca con la
stessa mossa usata per
ultima dal nemico.

entries.original:
"The user blows up
to inflict severe
damage, even
making itself faint."
entries.translation_source: The user blows up to inflict severe damage, even making itself faint.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si fa
esplodere per infliggere
danni enormi, arrivando
persino a svenire.

entries.original:
"A large egg is
hurled with great
force at the foe to
inflict damage."
entries.translation_source: A large egg is hurled with great force at the foe to inflict damage.
entries.translated:
Un grosso uovo viene
scagliato con grande
forza contro il
bersaglio per infliggere
danni.

entries.original:
"The foe is licked
and hit with a long
tongue. It may
also paralyze."
entries.translation_source: The foe is licked and hit with a long tongue. It may also paralyze.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene leccato
e colpito con una lunga
lingua. Può anche
paralizzarlo.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with exhaust gases.
It may also poison
the foe."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with exhaust gases. It may also poison the foe.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene
attaccato con gas di
scarico. Può anche
essere avvelenato.

entries.original:
"Toxic sludge is
hurled at the foe.
It may poison the
target."
entries.translation_source: Toxic sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.
entries.translated:
Viene scagliata melma
tossica contro il
nemico. Può avvelenare
il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The foe is clubbed
with a bone held in
hand. It may make
the foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The foe is clubbed with a bone held in hand. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito
con un osso tenuto in
mano. Può farlo
tentennare.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
an intense flame.
It may leave the
target with a burn."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with an intense flame. It may leave the target with a burn.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da una fiamma
intensa. Può anche
ustionarlo.

entries.original:
"A powerful charge
attack. It can also
be used to climb
a waterfall."
entries.translation_source: A powerful charge attack. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.
entries.translated:
Un potente attacco di
carica. Può anche essere
usato per risalire una
cascata.

entries.original:
"The foe is clamped
and squeezed by
the user’s shell for
two to five turns."
entries.translation_source: The foe is clamped and squeezed by the user’s shell for two to five turns.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene bloccato
e stritolato dal guscio
dell{B4}utilizzatore per
due o cinque turni.

entries.original:
"Star-shaped rays
that never miss are
fired at all foes in
battle."
entries.translation_source: Star-shaped rays that never miss are fired at all foes in battle.
entries.translated:
Raggi a forma di stella
che non mancano mai
vengono lanciati contro
tutti i nemici in lotta.

entries.original:
"The user raises its
Defense in the 1st
turn, then attacks
in the 2nd turn."
entries.translation_source: The user raises its Defense in the 1st turn, then attacks in the 2nd turn.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore aumenta
la propria Difesa nel
primo turno, poi attacca
nel secondo.

entries.original:
"Sharp spikes are
fired at the foe to
strike two to five
times."
entries.translation_source: Sharp spikes are fired at the foe to strike two to five times.
entries.translated:
Spine affilate vengono
lanciate contro il
bersaglio e colpiscono
da due a cinque volte.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with long tentacles
or vines. It may
lower Speed."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with long tentacles or vines. It may lower Speed.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene
attaccato con lunghi
tentacoli o liane. Può
ridurne la Velocità.

entries.original:
"Forgets about
something and
sharply raises
Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: Forgets about something and sharply raises Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Dimentica qualcosa e
aumenta molto la Difesa
Speciale.

entries.original:
"The user distracts
the foe by bending
a spoon. It may
lower accuracy."
entries.translation_source: The user distracts the foe by bending a spoon. It may lower accuracy.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore distrae
il nemico piegando un
cucchiaio. Può ridurne
la precisione.

entries.original:
"Heals the user by
up to half its full
HP. It can be used
to heal an ally."
entries.translation_source: Heals the user by up to half its full HP. It can be used to heal an ally.
entries.translated:
Cura l{B4}utilizzatore fino
alla metà dei suoi PS
massimi. Può essere
usata per curare un
alleato.

entries.original:
"A strong jumping
knee kick. If it
misses, the user is
hurt."
entries.translation_source: A strong jumping knee kick. If it misses, the user is hurt.
entries.translated:
Un forte calcio al
ginocchio con salto. Se
manca il bersaglio, il
Pokémon si fa male.

entries.original:
"The user intimidates
the foe with the
design on its belly
to cause paralysis."
entries.translation_source: The user intimidates the foe with the design on its belly to cause paralysis.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa intimorisce
il bersaglio con il
disegno sul proprio
ventre per causare
paralisi.

entries.original:
"Absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
on a sleeping foe
to restore HP."
entries.translation_source: Absorbs half the damage it inflicted on a sleeping foe to restore HP.
entries.translated:
Assorbe metà del danno
inflitto a un nemico
addormentato per
recuperare PS.

entries.original:
"The foe is sprayed
with a cloud of
toxic gas that may
poison the foe."
entries.translation_source: The foe is sprayed with a cloud of toxic gas that may poison the foe.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene
spruzzato con una nube
di gas tossico che può
avvelenarlo.

entries.original:
"Round objects are
hurled at the foe
to strike two to
five times."
entries.translation_source: Round objects are hurled at the foe to strike two to five times.
entries.translated:
Oggetti tondi vengono
scagliati contro il
bersaglio per colpirlo
da due a cinque volte.

entries.original:
"An attack that
absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP."
entries.translation_source: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che assorbe
metà del danno inflitto
per ripristinare PS.

entries.original:
"The user forces a
kiss on the foe
with a scary face
that induces sleep."
entries.translation_source: The user forces a kiss on the foe with a scary face that induces sleep.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore costringe
il bersaglio a un bacio
con un volto spaventoso
che lo induce al sonno.

entries.original:
"A 2nd-turn attack
move with a high
critical-hit ratio.
The foe may flinch."
entries.translation_source: A 2nd-turn attack move with a high critical-hit ratio. The foe may flinch.
entries.translated:
Una mossa d{B4}attacco al
secondo turno con
un{B4}elevata probabilità
di brutto colpo. Il
nemico può tentennare.

entries.original:
"The user transforms
into a copy of the
foe with even the
same move set."
entries.translation_source: The user transforms into a copy of the foe with even the same move set.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
trasforma in una copia
del bersaglio, con lo
stesso set di mosse.

entries.original:
"A spray of bubbles
hits the foe.
It may lower the
foe’s Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: A spray of bubbles hits the foe. It may lower the foe’s Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Una spruzzata di bolle
colpisce il nemico. Può
ridurne la Velocità.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a rhythmic punch
that may leave it
confused."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a rhythmic punch that may leave it confused.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da un pugno
ritmico che può anche
confonderlo.

entries.original:
"The user scatters
bursts of fine
spores that induce
sleep."
entries.translation_source: The user scatters bursts of fine spores that induce sleep.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon sparge spore
sottili che inducono il
sonno.

entries.original:
"A blast of light
that cuts the foe’s
accuracy. It also
illuminates caves."
entries.translation_source: A blast of light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It also illuminates caves.
entries.translated:
Un lampo di luce che
riduce la precisione del
bersaglio. Illumina
anche le grotte.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with an odd, hot
energy wave that
varies in intensity."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with an odd, hot energy wave that varies in intensity.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene
attaccato con un{B4}onda di
energia strana e calda
dalla potenza variabile.

entries.original:
"The user just flops
and splashes around
without having any
effect."
entries.translation_source: The user just flops and splashes around without having any effect.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si dimena
e schizza acqua in giro
senza avere alcun
effetto.

entries.original:
"The user alters its
cells to liquefy
itself and sharply
raise Defense."
entries.translation_source: The user alters its cells to liquefy itself and sharply raise Defense.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore altera le
proprie cellule per
liquefarsi e aumentare
drasticamente la Difesa.

entries.original:
"A large pincer is
used to hammer the
foe. It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: A large pincer is used to hammer the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Una grande chela viene
usata per colpire il
bersaglio. Ha un{B4}alta
probabilità di brutto
colpo.

entries.original:
"The user explodes
to inflict terrible
damage even while
fainting itself."
entries.translation_source: The user explodes to inflict terrible damage even while fainting itself.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore esplode
per infliggere danni
terribili, anche se
finisce KO.

entries.original:
"The foe is raked
with sharp claws or
scythes two to five
times."
entries.translation_source: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes two to five times.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
graffiato da artigli o
falci affilate da due a
cinque volte.

entries.original:
"The user throws a
bone that hits the
foe once, then once
again on return."
entries.translation_source: The user throws a bone that hits the foe once, then once again on return.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore lancia un
osso che colpisce il
bersaglio una volta, poi
un{B4}altra al ritorno.

entries.original:
"The user sleeps for
two turns to fully
restore HP and heal
any status problem."
entries.translation_source: The user sleeps for two turns to fully restore HP and heal any status problem.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa dorme per due
turni per ripristinare
completamente i PS e
guarire da qualsiasi
problema di stato.

entries.original:
"Large boulders are
hurled at the foe.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: Large boulders are hurled at the foe. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Grandi massi vengono
scagliati contro il
nemico. Può farlo
tentennare.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with sharp fangs.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with sharp fangs. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene
attaccato con zanne
affilate. Può farlo
tentennare.

entries.original:
"The user reduces
its polygon count
to sharpen edges
and raise Attack."
entries.translation_source: The user reduces its polygon count to sharpen edges and raise Attack.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore riduce il
numero di poligoni per
affilare i bordi e
aumentare l{B4}Attacco.

entries.original:
"The user changes
its type to match
the type of one of
its moves."
entries.translation_source: The user changes its type to match the type of one of its moves.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon cambia il
proprio tipo per
corrispondere al tipo di
una delle sue mosse.

entries.original:
"A simultaneous
3-beam attack that
may paralyze, burn,
or frostbite the foe."
entries.translation_source: A simultaneous 3-beam attack that may paralyze, burn, or frostbite the foe.
entries.translated:
Un attacco simultaneo a
3 raggi che può
paralizzare, bruciare o
causare assideramento al
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with sharp fangs
and halves the
foe’s HP."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with sharp fangs and halves the foe’s HP.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon morde il
nemico con zanne
affilate e dimezza i
suoi PS.

entries.original:
"The foe is slashed
with claws, etc.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is slashed with claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene sferzato
con artigli, ecc. Ha un
alto tasso di colpo
critico.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
decoy using one-
quarter of its full
HP."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a decoy using one- quarter of its full HP.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon crea un
sostituto usando un
quarto dei suoi PS
totali.

entries.original:
"An attack that is
used only if there
is no PP. It also
hurts the user."
entries.translation_source: An attack that is used only if there is no PP. It also hurts the user.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che può
essere usato solo se non
ci sono PP. Danneggia
anche l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"This move copies
the move last used
by the foe, then
disappears."
entries.translation_source: This move copies the move last used by the foe, then disappears.
entries.translated:
Questa mossa copia
l{B4}ultima mossa usata dal
bersaglio, poi scompare.

entries.original:
"A 3-kick attack
that becomes more
powerful with each
successive hit."
entries.translation_source: A 3-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.
entries.translated:
Un attacco a 3 calci che
diventa più potente a
ogni colpo successivo.

entries.original:
"An attack that may
take the foe’s held
item if the user
isn’t holding one."
entries.translation_source: An attack that may take the foe’s held item if the user isn’t holding one.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che può
rubare lo strumento
tenuto dal nemico se
l{B4}utilizzatore non ne
tiene uno.

entries.original:
"Ensnares the foe 
with sticky string
so it doesn’t flee
or switch out."
entries.translation_source: Ensnares the foe with sticky string so it doesn’t flee or switch out.
entries.translated:
Intrappola il nemico con
una stringa appiccicosa,
così non può fuggire né
essere sostituito.

entries.original:
"The user predicts
the foe’s action to
ensure its next
attack hits."
entries.translation_source: The user predicts the foe’s action to ensure its next attack hits.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore prevede
l{B4}azione del nemico per
assicurarsi che il suo
prossimo attacco
colpisca.

entries.original:
"A sleeping foe is
shown a nightmare
that inflicts some
damage every turn."
entries.translation_source: A sleeping foe is shown a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.
entries.translated:
A un bersaglio
addormentato viene
mostrato un incubo che
infligge danni a ogni
turno.

entries.original:
"The user makes a
fiery charge at the
foe. It may cause
a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user makes a fiery charge at the foe. It may cause a burn.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utente esegue una
carica infuocata contro
il bersaglio. Può
causare una scottatura.

entries.original:
"An attack that can
be used only while
asleep. It may
cause flinching."
entries.translation_source: An attack that can be used only while asleep. It may cause flinching.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che può
essere usato solo mentre
si dorme. Può far
trasalire.

entries.original:
"A move that works
differently for the
Ghost-type and all
the other types."
entries.translation_source: A move that works differently for the Ghost-type and all the other types.
entries.translated:
Una mossa che funziona
in modo diverso per il
tipo Spettro e per tutti
gli altri tipi.

entries.original:
"A desperate attack
that becomes more
powerful the less
HP the user has."
entries.translation_source: A desperate attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
entries.translated:
Un attacco disperato che
diventa più potente
quanto meno PS ha
l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user changes
type to make itself
resistant to the
last attack it took."
entries.translation_source: The user changes type to make itself resistant to the last attack it took.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore cambia
tipo per diventare
resistente all{B4}ultimo
attacco subito.

entries.original:
"A vortex of air is
shot at the foe.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: A vortex of air is shot at the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Un vortice d{B4}aria viene
scagliato contro il
nemico. Ha un alto tasso
di colpo critico.

entries.original:
"Cotton-like spores
cling to the foe,
sharply reducing
its Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: Cotton-like spores cling to the foe, sharply reducing its Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Spore simili a cotone si
attaccano al nemico,
riducendone
drasticamente la
Velocità.

entries.original:
"An all-out attack
that becomes more
powerful the less
HP the user has."
entries.translation_source: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
entries.translated:
Un attacco all-out che
diventa più potente
quanto meno PS ha
l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"A move that cuts
2 to 5 PP from the
move last used by
the foe."
entries.translation_source: A move that cuts 2 to 5 PP from the move last used by the foe.
entries.translated:
Una mossa che sottrae da
2 a 5 PP alla mossa
usata per ultima dal
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The opposing team is
hit with powdery snow
that may leave them
with frostbite."
entries.translation_source: The opposing team is hit with powdery snow that may leave them with frostbite.
entries.translated:
La squadra avversaria
viene colpita da neve
farinosa che può
provocare assideramento.

entries.original:
"Enables the user to
evade all attacks.
It may fail if used
in succession."
entries.translation_source: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.
entries.translated:
Permette a chi la usa di
evitare tutti gli
attacchi. Può fallire se
usata in successione.

entries.original:
"A punch thrown at
blinding speed.
It is certain to
strike first."
entries.translation_source: A punch thrown at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.
entries.translated:
Un pugno sferrato a
velocità accecante.
Colpisce sicuramente per
primo.

entries.original:
"Frightens the foe
with a scary face
to sharply reduce
its Speed."
entries.translation_source: Frightens the foe with a scary face to sharply reduce its Speed.
entries.translated:
Spaventa il bersaglio
con una faccia
terribile, riducendone
drasticamente la
Velocità.

entries.original:
"The user draws up
close to the foe
disarmingly, then
hits without fail."
entries.translation_source: The user draws up close to the foe disarmingly, then hits without fail.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
avvicina al bersaglio
con fare disarmante,
quindi colpisce senza
fallire.

entries.original:
"The user kisses
the foe with sweet
cuteness that
causes confusion."
entries.translation_source: The user kisses the foe with sweet cuteness that causes confusion.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore bacia il
nemico con una dolce
tenerezza che lo
confonde.

entries.original:
"The user maximizes
its Attack stat at
the cost of half
its full HP."
entries.translation_source: The user maximizes its Attack stat at the cost of half its full HP.
entries.translated:
Massimizza l{B4}Attacco
dell{B4}utilizzatore al
costo di metà dei suoi
PS massimi.

entries.original:
"Filthy sludge is
hurled at the foe.
It may poison the
target."
entries.translation_source: Filthy sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.
entries.translated:
Viene scagliata melma
lurida contro il nemico.
Può avvelenare il
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Mud is hurled in
the foe’s face to
inflict damage and
lower its accuracy."
entries.translation_source: Mud is hurled in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
entries.translated:
Fango viene lanciato in
faccia al bersaglio per
infliggere danni e
ridurne la precisione.

entries.original:
"Ink is blasted in
the foe’s face or
eyes to damage and
lower accuracy."
entries.translation_source: Ink is blasted in the foe’s face or eyes to damage and lower accuracy.
entries.translated:
Inchiostro viene
spruzzato sul viso o
negli occhi del
bersaglio per
danneggiarlo e ridurne
la precisione.

entries.original:
"A trap of spikes is
laid around the
foe’s party to hurt
foes switching in."
entries.translation_source: A trap of spikes is laid around the foe’s party to hurt foes switching in.
entries.translated:
Una trappola di spine
viene piazzata attorno
alla squadra del nemico
per ferire i nemici che
entrano in campo.

entries.original:
"An electric blast is
fired like a cannon
to inflict damage
and paralyze."
entries.translation_source: An electric blast is fired like a cannon to inflict damage and paralyze.
entries.translated:
Spara una scarica
elettrica come da un
cannone per infliggere
danni e paralizzare.

entries.original:
"Completely negates
the foe’s efforts to
heighten its ability
to evade."
entries.translation_source: Completely negates the foe’s efforts to heighten its ability to evade.
entries.translated:
Annienta completamente i
tentativi
dell{B4}avversario di
aumentare la sua
elusione.

entries.original:
"If the user faints,
the foe delivering
the final hit also
faints."
entries.translation_source: If the user faints, the foe delivering the final hit also faints.
entries.translated:
Se l{B4}utilizzatore
sviene, anche il nemico
che infligge il colpo
finale sviene.

entries.original:
"Any battler that
hears this faints
in three turns
unless it switches."
entries.translation_source: Any battler that hears this faints in three turns unless it switches.
entries.translated:
Qualsiasi combattente
che lo sente sviene in
tre turni, a meno che
non venga sostituito.

entries.original:
"A chilling wind is
used to attack.
It also lowers the
Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: A chilling wind is used to attack. It also lowers the Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Un vento gelido viene
usato per attaccare.
Abbassa anche la
Velocità.

entries.original:
"Enables the user to
evade all attacks.
It may fail if used
in succession."
entries.translation_source: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.
entries.translated:
Permette a chi la usa di
evitare tutti gli
attacchi. Può fallire se
usata in successione.

entries.original:
"The user strikes
the foe with a bone
in hand two to five
times."
entries.translation_source: The user strikes the foe with a bone in hand two to five times.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utente colpisce il
bersaglio con un osso in
mano da due a cinque
volte.

entries.original:
"The user locks on
to the foe, making
the next move sure
to hit."
entries.translation_source: The user locks on to the foe, making the next move sure to hit.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utente si fissa sul
bersaglio, facendo sì
che la prossima mossa
colpisca sicuramente.

entries.original:
"The user thrashes
about for two to
three turns, then
becomes confused."
entries.translation_source: The user thrashes about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si dimena
per due o tre turni, poi
si confonde.

entries.original:
"A 5-turn sandstorm
that damages all
types except Rock,
Ground, and Steel."
entries.translation_source: A 5-turn sandstorm that damages all types except Rock, Ground, and Steel.
entries.translated:
Una tempesta di sabbia
che dura 5 turni e
danneggia tutti i tipi
tranne Roccia, Terra e
Acciaio.

entries.original:
"A harsh attack that
absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP."
entries.translation_source: A harsh attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.
entries.translated:
Un attacco violento che
assorbe metà del danno
inflitto per recuperare
PS.

entries.original:
"The user endures
any hit with 1 HP
left. It may fail if
used in succession."
entries.translation_source: The user endures any hit with 1 HP left. It may fail if used in succession.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa resiste a
qualsiasi colpo
lasciandosi con 1 PS.
Può fallire se usata in
successione.

entries.original:
"The foe is charmed
by the user’s cute
appeals, sharply
cutting its Attack."
entries.translation_source: The foe is charmed by the user’s cute appeals, sharply cutting its Attack.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene irretito
dalle dolci moine
dell{B4}utilizzatore, che
ne riducono
drasticamente l{B4}Attacco.

entries.original:
"A 5-turn rolling
attack that becomes
stronger each time
it hits."
entries.translation_source: A 5-turn rolling attack that becomes stronger each time it hits.
entries.translated:
Un attacco rotolante di
5 turni che si rafforza
ogni volta che colpisce.

entries.original:
"A restrained attack
that always leaves
the foe with at
least 1 HP."
entries.translation_source: A restrained attack that always leaves the foe with at least 1 HP.
entries.translated:
Un attacco contenuto che
lascia sempre il nemico
con almeno 1 PS.

entries.original:
"A move that makes
the foe confused,
but also sharply
raises its Attack."
entries.translation_source: A move that makes the foe confused, but also sharply raises its Attack.
entries.translated:
Una mossa che confonde
il bersaglio, ma ne
aumenta anche di molto
l{B4}Attacco.

entries.original:
"Heals the user by
up to half its full
HP. It can be used
to heal an ally."
entries.translation_source: Heals the user by up to half its full HP. It can be used to heal an ally.
entries.translated:
Cura l{B4}utilizzatore fino
alla metà dei suoi PS
massimi. Può essere
usata per curare un
alleato.

entries.original:
"An electrically
charged tackle that
may also paralyze
the foe."
entries.translation_source: An electrically charged tackle that may also paralyze the foe.
entries.translated:
Un attacco fisico carico
di elettricità che può
anche paralizzare il
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"An attack that
grows stronger on
each successive
hit."
entries.translation_source: An attack that grows stronger on each successive hit.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che diventa
sempre più forte a ogni
colpo successivo.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
wings of steel.
It may also raise
the user’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da ali
d{B4}acciaio. Può anche
aumentare la Difesa
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The foe is fixed
with a mean look
that prevents it
from escaping."
entries.translation_source: The foe is fixed with a mean look that prevents it from escaping.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene fissato
con un{B4}aria minacciosa
che gli impedisce di
fuggire.

entries.original:
"If it is the other
gender, the foe is
made infatuated and
unlikely to attack."
entries.translation_source: If it is the other gender, the foe is made infatuated and unlikely to attack.
entries.translated:
Se è di sesso opposto,
il bersaglio si innamora
e difficilmente
attaccherà.

entries.original:
"While asleep, the
user randomly uses
one of the moves it
knows."
entries.translation_source: While asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.
entries.translated:
Quando dorme, l{B4}utente
usa casualmente una
delle mosse che conosce.

entries.original:
"A soothing bell
chimes to heal the
status problems of
all allies."
entries.translation_source: A soothing bell chimes to heal the status problems of all allies.
entries.translated:
Suona una campana
lenitiva che cura i
problemi di stato di
tutti gli alleati.

entries.original:
"This attack move
grows more powerful
the more the user
likes its Trainer."
entries.translation_source: This attack move grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
entries.translated:
Questa mossa d{B4}attacco
diventa più potente
quanto più
l{B4}utilizzatore ama il
suo Allenatore.

entries.original:
"The foe is given a
booby-trapped gift.
It restores HP
sometimes, however."
entries.translation_source: The foe is given a booby-trapped gift. It restores HP sometimes, however.
entries.translated:
Al bersaglio viene dato
un regalo-trappola. A
volte però ripristina i
PS.

entries.original:
"This attack move
grows more powerful
the less the user
likes its Trainer."
entries.translation_source: This attack move grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
entries.translated:
Questa mossa d{B4}attacco
diventa più potente
quanto meno
l{B4}utilizzatore ama il
suo Allenatore.

entries.original:
"It protects the
user’s party from
all status problems
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: It protects the user’s party from all status problems for five turns.
entries.translated:
Protegge il gruppo
dell{B4}utilizzatore da
tutti i problemi di
stato per cinque turni.

entries.original:
"The user adds its
HP to the foe’s HP,
then equally shares
the total HP."
entries.translation_source: The user adds its HP to the foe’s HP, then equally shares the total HP.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore somma i
suoi PS a quelli del
bersaglio, poi divide
equamente il totale dei
PS.

entries.original:
"A mystical and
powerful fire
attack that may
inflict a burn."
entries.translation_source: A mystical and powerful fire attack that may inflict a burn.
entries.translated:
Un attacco di fuoco
mistico e potente che
può provocare una
scottatura.

entries.original:
"A ground-shaking
attack against all
standing Pokémon.
Its power varies."
entries.translation_source: A ground-shaking attack against all standing Pokémon. Its power varies.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che fa
tremare il terreno
contro tutti i Pokémon
in piedi. La sua potenza
varia.

entries.original:
"The foe is punched
with the user’s full
power. It confuses
the foe if it hits."
entries.translation_source: The foe is punched with the user’s full power. It confuses the foe if it hits.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito con tutta la
potenza di chi la usa.
Se va a segno, confonde
il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"A brutal ramming
attack delivered
with a tough and
impressive horn."
entries.translation_source: A brutal ramming attack delivered with a tough and impressive horn.
entries.translated:
Un brutale attacco di
speronamento sferrato
con un corno robusto e
imponente.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
an incredible blast
of breath that may
also paralyze."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with an incredible blast of breath that may also paralyze.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da un
incredibile soffio che
può anche paralizzarlo.

entries.original:
"The user switches
out, passing along
any stat changes
to the new battler."
entries.translation_source: The user switches out, passing along any stat changes to the new battler.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
ritira, trasferendo al
nuovo combattente
eventuali modifiche alle
statistiche.

entries.original:
"Makes the foe use
the move it last
used repeatedly for
two to six turns."
entries.translation_source: Makes the foe use the move it last used repeatedly for two to six turns.
entries.translated:
Fa usare al nemico
ripetutamente l{B4}ultima
mossa usata per due-sei
turni.

entries.original:
"An attack move that
works especially
well on a foe that
is switching out."
entries.translation_source: An attack move that works especially well on a foe that is switching out.
entries.translated:
Una mossa d{B4}attacco
particolarmente efficace
contro un avversario che
si ritira.

entries.original:
"An attack that frees
the user from traps
and hazards. Also
raises Speed."
entries.translation_source: An attack that frees the user from traps and hazards. Also raises Speed.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che libera
l{B4}utilizzatore da
trappole e ostacoli.
Inoltre aumenta la
Velocità.

entries.original:
"Allures the foe to
reduce evasiveness.
It also attracts
wild Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Allures the foe to reduce evasiveness. It also attracts wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Attira il nemico
riducendone l{B4}elusione.
Attira anche i Pokémon
selvatici.

entries.original:
"An attack with a
steel-hard tail.
It may lower the
foe’s Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: An attack with a steel-hard tail. It may lower the foe’s Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Un attacco con una coda
dura come l{B4}acciaio. Può
ridurre la Difesa del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with steel claws.
It may also raise
the user’s Attack."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with steel claws. It may also raise the user’s Attack.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene
attaccato con artigli
d{B4}acciaio. Può anche
aumentare l{B4}Attacco
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"Makes the user
attack after the
foe. In return,
it will not miss."
entries.translation_source: Makes the user attack after the foe. In return, it will not miss.
entries.translated:
Fa sì che l{B4}utilizzatore
attacchi dopo il nemico.
In cambio, non fallisce
mai.

entries.original:
"Restores the user’s
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather."
entries.translation_source: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
entries.translated:
Ripristina i PS
dell{B4}utilizzatore. La
quantità di PS
recuperati varia in base
alle condizioni
atmosferiche.

entries.original:
"Restores the user’s
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather."
entries.translation_source: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
entries.translated:
Ripristina i PS
dell{B4}utilizzatore. La
quantità di PS
recuperati varia in base
alle condizioni
atmosferiche.

entries.original:
"Restores the user’s
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather."
entries.translation_source: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
entries.translated:
Ripristina i PS
dell{B4}utilizzatore. La
quantità di PS
recuperati varia in base
alle condizioni
atmosferiche.

entries.original:
"A unique attack 
that varies in type
depending on the
user.       "
entries.translation_source: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the user.
entries.translated:
Un attacco unico che
varia di tipo a seconda
del Pokémon che lo usa.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
double chops.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with double chops. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito
con due colpi di taglio.
Ha un{B4}alta probabilità
di brutto colpo.

entries.original:
"A vicious twister
attacks the foe.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: A vicious twister attacks the foe. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Un vortice violento
attacca il bersaglio.
Può farlo tentennare.

entries.original:
"A heavy rain falls
for five turns,
powering up Water-
type moves."
entries.translation_source: A heavy rain falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.
entries.translated:
Cade una forte pioggia
per cinque turni,
potenziando le mosse di
tipo Acqua.

entries.original:
"The sun blazes for
five turns, powering
up Fire-type
moves."
entries.translation_source: The sun blazes for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.
entries.translated:
Il sole brilla
intensamente per cinque
turni, potenziando le
mosse di tipo Fuoco.

entries.original:
"The foe is crunched
with sharp fangs.
It may lower the
foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The foe is crunched with sharp fangs. It may lower the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene
stritolato da zanne
affilate. Può ridurne la
Difesa.

entries.original:
"A retaliation move
that pays back the
foe’s special attack
double."
entries.translation_source: A retaliation move that pays back the foe’s special attack double.
entries.translated:
Una mossa di ritorsione
che restituisce il
doppio del danno
dell{B4}attacco speciale
del nemico.

entries.original:
"The user hypnotizes
itself into copying
any stat change
made by the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore ipnotizza
se stesso per copiare
qualsiasi variazione
delle statistiche fatta
dal nemico.

entries.original:
"A blindingly speedy
charge attack that
always goes before
any other."
entries.translation_source: A blindingly speedy charge attack that always goes before any other.
entries.translated:
Un attacco in carica
fulmineo che agisce
sempre prima di
qualsiasi altro.

entries.original:
"An ancient power is
used to attack. It
may also raise all
the user’s stats."
entries.translation_source: An ancient power is used to attack. It may also raise all the user’s stats.
entries.translated:
Si usa il potere degli
antichi per attaccare.
Può anche aumentare
tutte le statistiche
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"A shadowy blob is
hurled at the foe.
May also lower the
foe’s Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: A shadowy blob is hurled at the foe. May also lower the foe’s Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Una massa oscura viene
scagliata contro il
bersaglio. Può anche
ridurne la Difesa
Speciale.

entries.original:
"Two turns after
this move is used,
the foe is attacked
psychically."
entries.translation_source: Two turns after this move is used, the foe is attacked psychically.
entries.translated:
Due turni dopo l{B4}uso di
questa mossa, il nemico
viene attaccato
psichicamente.

entries.original:
"An attack that
lowers Defense.
It can also smash
cracked boulders.      "
entries.translation_source: An attack that lowers Defense. It can also smash cracked boulders.
entries.translated:
Riduce la Difesa. Può
anche frantumare massi
crepati.

entries.original:
"The foe is trapped
in a fast, vicious
whirlpool for two
to five turns."
entries.translation_source: The foe is trapped in a fast, vicious whirlpool for two to five turns.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
intrappolato in un
turbinio rapido e feroce
per due-cinque turni.

entries.original:
"All party Pokémon
join in the attack.
The more allies,
the more damage."
entries.translation_source: All party Pokémon join in the attack. The more allies, the more damage.
entries.translated:
Tutti i Pokémon della
squadra partecipano
all{B4}attacco. Più alleati
ci sono, maggiori sono i
danni.

entries.original:
"An attack that hits
first and causes
flinching. Usable
only on 1st turn."
entries.translation_source: An attack that hits first and causes flinching. Usable only on 1st turn.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che colpisce
per primo e fa
tentennare. Usabile solo
al primo turno.

entries.original:
"The user attacks in
an uproar that
prevents sleep for
two to five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks in an uproar that prevents sleep for two to five turns.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
con un frastuono che
impedisce di dormire per
due-cinque turni.

entries.original:
"The user charges
up power for use
later. It can be
used three times."
entries.translation_source: The user charges up power for use later. It can be used three times.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore carica
energia da usare in
seguito. Può essere
usata tre volte.

entries.original:
"The power built
using Stockpile is
released at once
for attack."
entries.translation_source: The power built using Stockpile is released at once for attack.
entries.translated:
La potenza accumulata
con Accumulo viene
liberata tutta in un
colpo per attaccare.

entries.original:
"The energy it built
using Stockpile is
absorbed to restore
HP."
entries.translation_source: The energy it built using Stockpile is absorbed to restore HP.
entries.translated:
L{B4}energia accumulata con
Accumulo viene assorbita
per ripristinare i PS.

entries.original:
"The user exhales a
heated breath to
attack. It may also
inflict a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user exhales a heated breath to attack. It may also inflict a burn.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore espira un
alito infuocato per
attaccare. Può anche
causare bruciatura.

entries.original:
"A hailstorm lasting
five turns damages
all Pokémon except
the Ice-type."
entries.translation_source: A hailstorm lasting five turns damages all Pokémon except the Ice-type.
entries.translated:
Una grandinata della
durata di cinque turni
danneggia tutti i
Pokémon tranne quelli di
tipo Ghiaccio.

entries.original:
"It enrages the foe,
making it incapable
of using the same
move successively."
entries.translation_source: It enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move successively.
entries.translated:
Incoraggia il bersaglio
all{B4}ira, rendendolo
incapace di usare la
stessa mossa in
successione.

entries.original:
"Flattery is used to
confuse the foe,
but its Sp. Atk
also rises."
entries.translation_source: Flattery is used to confuse the foe, but its Sp. Atk also rises.
entries.translated:
L{B4}adulazione confonde il
bersaglio, ma ne aumenta
anche l{B4}Att. Sp.

entries.original:
"A sinister, bluish
white flame is shot
at the foe to
inflict a burn."
entries.translation_source: A sinister, bluish white flame is shot at the foe to inflict a burn.
entries.translated:
Una sinistra fiamma
bianco-azzurra viene
scagliata contro il
bersaglio per provocare
ustione.

entries.original:
"The user faints,
but sharply lowers
the foe’s Attack
and Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: The user faints, but sharply lowers the foe’s Attack and Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore sviene,
ma riduce nettamente
l{B4}Attacco e l{B4}Att. Sp.
del nemico.

entries.original:
"An attack that is
boosted if user is
burned, poisoned,
or paralyzed."
entries.translation_source: An attack that is boosted if user is burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.
entries.translated:
Un attacco potenziato se
l{B4}utilizzatore è
bruciato, avvelenato o
paralizzato.

entries.original:
"An attack that is
executed last.
The user flinches
if hit beforehand."
entries.translation_source: An attack that is executed last. The user flinches if hit beforehand.
entries.translated:
Un attacco eseguito per
ultimo. L{B4}utilizzatore
trasalisce se viene
colpito prima.

entries.original:
"Doubly effective on
a paralyzed foe,
but it also cures
the foe’s paralysis."
entries.translation_source: Doubly effective on a paralyzed foe, but it also cures the foe’s paralysis.
entries.translated:
Doppio effetto su un
nemico paralizzato, ma
cura anche la paralisi
del nemico.

entries.original:
"The user draws
attention to itself,
making foes attack
only the user."
entries.translation_source: The user draws attention to itself, making foes attack only the user.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attira
l{B4}attenzione su di sé,
inducendo i nemici a
colpire solo
l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"An attack that
changes type
depending on the
user’s location."
entries.translation_source: An attack that changes type depending on the user’s location.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che cambia di
tipo in base al luogo in
cui si trova il Pokémon.

entries.original:
"The user charges
power to boost the
Electric move it
uses next."
entries.translation_source: The user charges power to boost the Electric move it uses next.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utente carica energia
per potenziare la mossa
di tipo Elettro che
userà per ultima.

entries.original:
"The foe is taunted
into a rage that
allows it to use
only attack moves."
entries.translation_source: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
provocato in una rabbia
che gli consente di
usare solo mosse
d{B4}attacco.

entries.original:
"A move that boosts
the power of the
ally’s attack in a
battle."
entries.translation_source: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a battle.
entries.translated:
Una mossa che aumenta la
potenza dell{B4}attacco
dell{B4}alleato in lotta.

entries.original:
"A move that tricks
the foe into
trading held items
with the user."
entries.translation_source: A move that tricks the foe into trading held items with the user.
entries.translated:
Una mossa che induce il
nemico a scambiare gli
strumenti tenuti con
l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user mimics the
foe completely and
copies the foe’s
ability."
entries.translation_source: The user mimics the foe completely and copies the foe’s ability.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon imita
completamente il
bersaglio e ne copia
l{B4}abilità.

entries.original:
"A self-healing move
that restores half
the full HP on the
next turn."
entries.translation_source: A self-healing move that restores half the full HP on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Una mossa che cura
l{B4}utilizzatore e
ripristina la metà dei
PS massimi al turno
successivo.

entries.original:
"The user randomly
picks and uses a
move of an allied
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The user randomly picks and uses a move of an allied Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sceglie casualmente e
usa una mossa di un
Pokémon alleato.

entries.original:
"The user lays roots
that restore HP on
every turn.
It can’t switch out."
entries.translation_source: The user lays roots that restore HP on every turn. It can’t switch out.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore mette
radici che recuperano PS
a ogni turno. Non può
ritirarsi.

entries.original:
"A powerful attack,
but it also lowers
the user’s Attack
and Defense stats."
entries.translation_source: A powerful attack, but it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.
entries.translated:
Un attacco potente, ma
abbassa anche le
statistiche di Attacco e
Difesa
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"Reflects back the
foe’s Leech Seed
and any status-
damaging move."
entries.translation_source: Reflects back the foe’s Leech Seed and any status- damaging move.
entries.translated:
Riflette indietro Leech
Seed del nemico e
qualsiasi mossa di stato
dannosa.

entries.original:
"A move that
recycles a used
item for use once
more."
entries.translation_source: A move that recycles a used item for use once more.
entries.translated:
Una mossa che ricicla
uno strumento usato per
usarlo di nuovo.

entries.original:
"An attack move that
gains in intensity
if the target has
hurt the user."
entries.translation_source: An attack move that gains in intensity if the target has hurt the user.
entries.translated:
Una mossa offensiva che
diventa più potente se
il bersaglio ha ferito
l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"An attack that also
breaks any barrier
like Light Screen
and Reflect."
entries.translation_source: An attack that also breaks any barrier like Light Screen and Reflect.
entries.translated:
Può anche distruggere
qualsiasi barriera come
Schermoluce e Riflesso.

entries.original:
"A huge yawn lulls
the foe into falling
asleep on the next
turn."
entries.translation_source: A huge yawn lulls the foe into falling asleep on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Uno sbadiglio enorme
culla il bersaglio
facendolo addormentare
al turno successivo.

entries.original:
"Knocks down the
foe’s held item to
prevent its use
during the battle."
entries.translation_source: Knocks down the foe’s held item to prevent its use during the battle.
entries.translated:
Fa cadere lo strumento
tenuto dal bersaglio per
impedirne l{B4}uso durante
la lotta.

entries.original:
"Gains power the
fewer HP the user
has compared with
the foe."
entries.translation_source: Gains power the fewer HP the user has compared with the foe.
entries.translated:
La potenza aumenta
quanto meno PS ha il
Pokémon rispetto al
nemico.

entries.original:
"The higher the
user’s HP, the more
powerful this
attack becomes."
entries.translation_source: The higher the user’s HP, the more powerful this attack becomes.
entries.translated:
Più alti sono i PS
dell{B4}utilizzatore, più
potente diventa questo
attacco.

entries.original:
"The user employs
its psychic power
to swap abilities
with the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user employs its psychic power to swap abilities with the foe.
entries.translated:
Usa il proprio potere
psichico per scambiare
le abilità con quelle
del nemico.

entries.original:
"Prevents foes from
using any move
that is also known
by the user."
entries.translation_source: Prevents foes from using any move that is also known by the user.
entries.translated:
Impedisce ai nemici di
usare qualsiasi mossa
conosciuta
dall{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"A self-healing move
that cures the user
of a poisoning,
burn, or paralysis."
