entries.translation_source: A self-healing move that cures the user of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.
entries.translated:
Una mossa curativa che
cura l{B4}utilizzatore da
avvelenamento,
bruciatura o paralisi.

entries.original:
"If the user faints,
this move deletes
the PP of the move
that finished it."
entries.translation_source: If the user faints, this move deletes the PP of the move that finished it.
entries.translated:
Se l{B4}utilizzatore va KO,
questa mossa elimina i
PP della mossa che l{B4}ha
messo KO.

entries.original:
"Steals the effects
of the foe’s
healing or status-
changing move."
entries.translation_source: Steals the effects of the foe’s healing or status- changing move.
entries.translated:
Ruba gli effetti della
mossa curativa o che
altera lo stato del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"An attack that may
have an additional
effect that varies
with the terrain."
entries.translation_source: An attack that may have an additional effect that varies with the terrain.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che può avere
un effetto aggiuntivo
che varia a seconda del
terreno.

entries.original:
"The user dives
underwater on the
first turn and
strikes next turn."
entries.translation_source: The user dives underwater on the first turn and strikes next turn.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
immerge sott{B4}acqua nel
primo turno e colpisce
nel turno successivo.

entries.original:
"A quick flurry of
straight-arm
punches that hit
two to five times."
entries.translation_source: A quick flurry of straight-arm punches that hit two to five times.
entries.translated:
Una rapida raffica di
pugni a braccio teso che
colpiscono da due a
cinque volte.

entries.original:
"Alters the user’s
type depending on
the location’s
terrain."
entries.translation_source: Alters the user’s type depending on the location’s terrain.
entries.translated:
Cambia il tipo del
Pokémon in base al
terreno in cui si trova.

entries.original:
"The user flashes a
light that sharply
raises its Sp. Atk
stat."
entries.translation_source: The user flashes a light that sharply raises its Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utente emette un lampo
di luce che aumenta
drasticamente il suo
Att. Sp.

entries.original:
"A burst of light
injures the foe. It
may also lower the
foe’s Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: A burst of light injures the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Un lampo di luce ferisce
il bersaglio. Può anche
ridurne la Difesa
Speciale.

entries.original:
"A flurry of down
hits the foe. It
may also lower the
foe’s Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: A flurry of down hits the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
Un turbine di piumino
colpisce il nemico. Può
anche ridurne l{B4}Attacco
Speciale.

entries.original:
"The foe is covered
with a mass of down
that sharply cuts
the Attack stat."
entries.translation_source: The foe is covered with a mass of down that sharply cuts the Attack stat.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
ricoperto da una massa
di piumino che ne riduce
drasticamente l{B4}Attacco.

entries.original:
"A wobbly dance
that confuses all
the Pokémon in
battle."
entries.translation_source: A wobbly dance that confuses all the Pokémon in battle.
entries.translated:
Una danza traballante
che confonde tutti i
Pokémon in lotta.

entries.original:
"A fiery kick with a
high critical-hit
ratio. It may also
burn the foe."
entries.translation_source: A fiery kick with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also burn the foe.
entries.translated:
Un calcio ardente con un
alto tasso di colpo
critico. Può anche
bruciare il nemico.

entries.original:
"Weakens Electric-
type attacks while
the user is in the
battle."
entries.translation_source: Weakens Electric- type attacks while the user is in the battle.
entries.translated:
Indebolisce le mosse di
tipo Elettro mentre
l{B4}utente è in lotta.

entries.original:
"A 5-turn rolling
attack that becomes
stronger each time
it rolls."
entries.translation_source: A 5-turn rolling attack that becomes stronger each time it rolls.
entries.translated:
Un attacco rotolante di
5 turni che si rafforza
ogni volta che rotola.

entries.original:
"An attack using
thorny arms.
It may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: An attack using thorny arms. It may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che usa
braccia spinose. Può far
tentennare il nemico.

entries.original:
"The user slacks off
and restores its HP
by half its full
HP."
entries.translation_source: The user slacks off and restores its HP by half its full HP.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon si rilassa e
recupera metà dei suoi
PS massimi.

entries.original:
"The user lets loose
a horribly loud
shout with the
power to damage."
entries.translation_source: The user lets loose a horribly loud shout with the power to damage.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore lancia un
urlo terribilmente forte
con potere offensivo.

entries.original:
"The foe is bitten
with toxic fangs.
It may also badly
poison the foe."
entries.translation_source: The foe is bitten with toxic fangs. It may also badly poison the foe.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene morso
con zanne tossiche. Può
anche avvelenare
gravemente il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with sharp claws.
It may also lower
the foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with sharp claws. It may also lower the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene
attaccato con artigli
affilati. Può anche
ridurne la Difesa.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a huge explosion.
The user can’t move
on the next turn."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a huge explosion. The user can’t move on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito
da una gigantesca
esplosione.
L{B4}utilizzatore non può
muoversi nel turno
successivo.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a watery cannon.
The user can’t move
on the next turn."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a watery cannon. The user can’t move on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da un cannone
d{B4}acqua. L{B4}utilizzatore
non può muoversi al
turno successivo.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a hard, fast punch.
It may also raise
the user’s Attack."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a hard, fast punch. It may also raise the user’s Attack.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito con un pugno
rapido e potente. Può
anche aumentare
l{B4}Attacco di chi la usa.

entries.original:
"An attack using a
startling shout.
It also may make
the foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: An attack using a startling shout. It also may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che usa un
grido improvviso. Può
anche far tentennare il
nemico.

entries.original:
"An attack that
varies in power and
type depending on
the weather."
entries.translation_source: An attack that varies in power and type depending on the weather.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che varia in
potenza e tipo a seconda
delle condizioni
atmosferiche.

entries.original:
"A soothing scent is
released to heal
all status problems
in the user’s party."
entries.translation_source: A soothing scent is released to heal all status problems in the user’s party.
entries.translated:
Viene rilasciata una
fragranza rilassante per
curare tutti i problemi
di stato della squadra
di chi la usa.

entries.original:
"The user feigns
crying to sharply
lower the foe’s
Sp. Def stat."
entries.translation_source: The user feigns crying to sharply lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utente finge di
piangere per ridurre
drasticamente il suo
Dif. Sp.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
razor-like wind.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with razor-like wind. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito
da un vento tagliente
come una lama. Ha un
alto tasso di colpo
critico.

entries.original:
"An intense attack
that also sharply
reduces the user’s
Sp. Atk stat."
entries.translation_source: An intense attack that also sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
Un attacco intenso che
riduce molto l{B4}Att. Sp.
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"Completely negates
the foe’s efforts to
heighten its ability
to evade."
entries.translation_source: Completely negates the foe’s efforts to heighten its ability to evade.
entries.translated:
Annienta completamente i
tentativi
dell{B4}avversario di
aumentare la sua
elusione.

entries.original:
"Boulders are hurled
at the foe. It also
lowers the foe’s
Speed if it hits."
entries.translation_source: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed if it hits.
entries.translated:
Massi vengono scagliati
contro il bersaglio. Se
colpisce, riduce anche
la sua Velocità.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with a silver dust.
It may raise all
the user’s stats."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with a silver dust. It may raise all the user’s stats.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da polvere
d{B4}argento. Può aumentare
tutte le statistiche
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"A horrible metallic
screech is used to
sharply lower the
foe’s Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: A horrible metallic screech is used to sharply lower the foe’s Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Un terribile stridio
metallico riduce di
molto la Dif. Sp. del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"A pleasant melody
is played to lull
the foe into a deep
sleep."
entries.translation_source: A pleasant melody is played to lull the foe into a deep sleep.
entries.translated:
Viene suonata una
piacevole melodia per
cullare il bersaglio in
un sonno profondo.

entries.original:
"The foe is made to
laugh, reducing its
Attack and Defense
stats."
entries.translation_source: The foe is made to laugh, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene fatto
ridere, riducendo i suoi
valori di Attacco e
Difesa.

entries.original:
"The user absorbs a
mystic power to
raise its Defense
and Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: The user absorbs a mystic power to raise its Defense and Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon assorbe un
potere mistico per
aumentare la Difesa e la
Dif. Sp.

entries.original:
"The higher the
user’s HP, the more
powerful this
attack becomes."
entries.translation_source: The higher the user’s HP, the more powerful this attack becomes.
entries.translated:
Più alti sono i PS
dell{B4}utilizzatore, più
potente diventa questo
attacco.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
a flashing beam
that may also
cause confusion."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a flashing beam that may also cause confusion.
entries.translated:
Colpito da un raggio
lampeggiante che può
anche confonderlo.

entries.original:
"The user throws a
punch from the
shadows. It cannot
be evaded."
entries.translation_source: The user throws a punch from the shadows. It cannot be evaded.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utente sferra un pugno
dalle ombre. Non può
essere schivato.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with an odd power
that may make the
foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with an odd power that may make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon attacca con
uno strano potere che
può far tentennare il
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with an uppercut
thrown skywards
with force."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with an uppercut thrown skywards with force.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon sferra un
potente montante verso
il cielo.

entries.original:
"The foe is trapped
inside a painful
sandstorm for two
to five turns."
entries.translation_source: The foe is trapped inside a painful sandstorm for two to five turns.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio resta
intrappolato in una
dolorosa tempesta di
sabbia per due a cinque
turni.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked
with ultimate cold
that causes fainting
if it hits."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with ultimate cold that causes fainting if it hits.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da un gelo
estremo che lo manda KO
se va a segno.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with muddy water.
It may also lower
the foe’s accuracy."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with muddy water. It may also lower the foe’s accuracy.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
con acqua fangosa. Può
anche ridurre la
precisione del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user shoots
seeds at the foe.
Two to five seeds
are shot at once."
entries.translation_source: The user shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot at once.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore spara
semi contro il
bersaglio. Da due a
cinque semi vengono
sparati in una volta
sola.

entries.original:
"An extremely fast
attack against one
target. It can’t be
evaded."
entries.translation_source: An extremely fast attack against one target. It can’t be evaded.
entries.translated:
Un attacco estremamente
rapido contro un singolo
bersaglio. Non può
essere evitato.

entries.original:
"Sharp icicles are
fired at the foe.
It strikes two to
five times."
entries.translation_source: Sharp icicles are fired at the foe. It strikes two to five times.
entries.translated:
Affilati ghiaccioli
vengono sparati contro
il bersaglio. Colpisce
da due a cinque volte.

entries.original:
"The user hardens
its body’s surface
to sharply raise its
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user hardens its body’s surface to sharply raise its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore indurisce
la superficie del
proprio corpo per
aumentare drasticamente
la Difesa.

entries.original:
"The user blocks the
foe’s way with arms
spread wide to
prevent escape."
entries.translation_source: The user blocks the foe’s way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore blocca la
strada al nemico con le
braccia spalancate per
impedirgli di fuggire.

entries.original:
"The user howls to
raise its team’s
spirit and boost
their Attack stats."
entries.translation_source: The user howls to raise its team’s spirit and boost their Attack stats.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore ulula per
alzare il morale della
squadra e aumentare
l{B4}Attacco.

entries.original:
"Sharp, huge claws
hook and slash the
foe quickly and
with great power."
entries.translation_source: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash the foe quickly and with great power.
entries.translated:
Artigli enormi e
affilati ghermiscono e
lacerano il nemico con
rapidità e grande
potenza.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
an enormous branch.
The user can’t move
on the next turn."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with an enormous branch. The user can’t move on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da un ramo
enorme. Chi la usa non
può muoversi nel turno
successivo.

entries.original:
"The user bulks up
its body to boost
both its Attack and
Defense stats."
entries.translation_source: The user bulks up its body to boost both its Attack and Defense stats.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore rafforza
il proprio corpo per
aumentare le statistiche
di Attacco e Difesa.

entries.original:
"The user bounces
on the foe on the
2nd turn. It may
paralyze the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user bounces on the foe on the 2nd turn. It may paralyze the foe.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore salta sul
bersaglio al 2° turno.
Può anche paralizzare il
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
hurling mud.
It also reduces the
foe’s Speed."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by hurling mud. It also reduces the foe’s Speed.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon attacca
scagliando fango. Riduce
anche la Velocità del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"An attack with a
high critical-hit
ratio. It may also
poison the foe."
entries.translation_source: An attack with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also poison the foe.
entries.translated:
Un attacco con un alto
tasso di brutti colpi.
Può anche avvelenare il
nemico.

entries.original:
"A cutely executed
attack that also
steals the foe’s
held item."
entries.translation_source: A cutely executed attack that also steals the foe’s held item.
entries.translated:
Un attacco eseguito con
grazia che ruba anche lo
strumento tenuto dal
bersaglio.

entries.original:

entries.original:
"The user hits

nemico con due colpi

entries.original:
"The user slams the

il nemico due volte di
fila con una lunga coda,
liane e simili.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself with cotton,

L{B4}utilizzatore si
protegge con il cotone,

"A nimble attack

"The user attacks

entries.original:

ally. In the wild,

entries.translated:
L{B4}avversario viene

"The user slams the

L{B4}utilizzatore travolge

ferendo leggermente
anche se stesso.

healing pulse that

L{B4}utilizzatore emette un

entries.translated:
Energia luminosa viene

abbassare la Dif. Sp.
del bersaglio.

"The user bites
the foe, eating

entries.translation_source: The user bites the foe, eating its berry if it is holding one.

L{B4}utente morde il
bersaglio e gli mangia

una.

"The user pecks

entries.translated:
Il Pokémon becca il

la Bacca se ne tiene
una.

"Sharply raises

entries.translation_source: Sharply raises Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed, but lowers Defense and Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Aumenta notevolmente

Velocità, ma riduce
Difesa e Dif. Sp.

"The user scatters

L{B4}utilizzatore sparge

entries.translated:
Infligge danni doppi a

lo sveglia anche.

next turn, hitting

L{B4}utilizzatore svanisce,

L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
con una canzone. Altri
possono unirsi,
infliggendo più danni.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
hitting the target
with its hard tail.
It hits two to five
times in a row."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by hitting the target with its hard tail. It hits two to five times in a row.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
colpendo il bersaglio
con la sua coda dura.
Colpisce da due a cinque
volte di seguito.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
throwing two steel
gears at it target.
This attack hits
twice in a row."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by throwing two steel gears at it target. This attack hits twice in a row.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
lanciando due ingranaggi
d{B4}acciaio contro il
bersaglio. Questo
attacco colpisce due
volte di fila.

entries.original:
"The type and base
power of this move
is determined by
the user’s Berry."
entries.translation_source: The type and base power of this move is determined by the user’s Berry.
entries.translated:
Il tipo e la potenza
base di questa mossa
sono determinati dalla
Bacca dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"An attack which is
not affected by the
target’s stat
changes."
entries.translation_source: An attack which is not affected by the target’s stat changes.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che non è
influenzato dai
cambiamenti delle
statistiche del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"A projectile is
thrown at the
opponent. A flying
Pokémon will fall
to the ground."
entries.translation_source: A projectile is thrown at the opponent. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground.
entries.translated:
Un proiettile viene
lanciato contro
l{B4}avversario. Un Pokémon
volante cadrà a terra.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
from a hyperspace
hole, hitting even
protected targets."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks from a hyperspace hole, hitting even protected targets.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
da un varco
iperspaziale, colpendo
anche i bersagli
protetti.

entries.original:
"A high-speed spin.
The slower the user
is than the foe, the
greater the damage."
entries.translation_source: A high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the foe, the greater the damage.
entries.translated:
Una rotazione ad alta
velocità. Più chi la usa
è lento del bersaglio,
maggiore è il danno.

entries.original:
"The target is hit
with many arms.
This hits protected
foes, and lowers
the user’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The target is hit with many arms. This hits protected foes, and lowers the user’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da molte
braccia. Colpisce anche
i nemici protetti e
riduce la Difesa
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user calls out
its underlings to
pummel the foe.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon chiama i suoi
sottoposti per assalire
il nemico. Ha un alto
tasso di colpo critico.

entries.original:
"The user calls out
its underlings to
shield its body,
raising its Defense
and Sp. Def stats."
entries.translation_source: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore chiama i
suoi sottoposti a
protezione del proprio
corpo, aumentando Difesa
e Dif. Sp.

entries.original:
"The user calls out
its underlings to
heal it. The user
regains up to half
of its max HP."
entries.translation_source: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon chiama i suoi
sottoposti per curarlo.
Il Pokémon recupera fino
a metà dei suoi PS max.

entries.original:
"If the foe is the
opposite gender of
the user, the foe’s
Special Attack is
harshly lowered."
entries.translation_source: If the foe is the opposite gender of the user, the foe’s Special Attack is harshly lowered.
entries.translated:
Se il nemico è di sesso
opposto rispetto
all{B4}utilizzatore, il suo
Attacco Speciale viene
ridotto drasticamente.

entries.original:
"A strong wind blows
away the target’s
obstacles. It also
lowers the target’s
evasiveness."
entries.translation_source: A strong wind blows away the target’s obstacles. It also lowers the target’s evasiveness.
entries.translated:
Un forte vento disperde
gli ostacoli del
bersaglio. Riduce anche
l{B4}elusione del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
opposing Pokémon
with countless
beams of light that
glow a deep blue."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep blue.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon attacca i
Pokémon avversari con
innumerevoli raggi di
luce che brillano di un
blu intenso.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
opposing Pokémon by
manifesting the
power of the land
in blades of stone."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in blades of stone.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca i
Pokémon avversari
manifestando il potere
della terra in lame di
pietra.

entries.original:
"The user uses its
psychic power to
switch changes to
its Defense and Sp.
Def with the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user uses its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the foe.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore usa il
proprio potere psichico
per scambiare le
modifiche di Difesa e
Dif. Sp. con quelle del
nemico.

entries.original:
"The user immerses
the target in
superheated steam.
This may also burn
the target."
entries.translation_source: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also burn the target.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa immerge il
bersaglio in vapore
surriscaldato. Può anche
bruciare il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user retaliates
with much greater
force against the
opponent that last
did damage to it."
entries.translation_source: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last did damage to it.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
vendica con molta più
forza contro
l{B4}avversario che gli ha
inflitto danni per
ultimo.

entries.original:
"The user tries to
cut ahead of the
target to steal and
use its intended
move with more power."
entries.translation_source: The user tries to cut ahead of the target to steal and use its intended move with more power.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore cerca di
agire prima del
bersaglio per rubare e
usare la mossa che stava
per eseguire con più
potenza.

entries.original:
"The user uses its
psychic power to
switch changes to
its Attack and Sp.
Attack with the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user uses its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Attack with the foe.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore usa il
suo potere psichico per
scambiare con il nemico
le modifiche a Attacco e
Att. Sp.

entries.original:
"The user employs
its psychic power
to switch its
Attack stat with
its Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon usa il suo
potere psichico per
scambiare il suo Attacco
con la sua Difesa.

entries.original:
"Using its psychic
power of suggestion,
the user transfers
its status problems
to the target."
entries.translation_source: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.
entries.translated:
Usando il suo potere
psichico di suggestione,
l{B4}utilizzatore
trasferisce i propri
problemi di stato al
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user powerfully
wrings the target.
The more HP the
target has, the
greater the power."
entries.translation_source: The user powerfully wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater the power.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore strizza
con forza il bersaglio.
Più PS ha il bersaglio,
maggiore sarà la
potenza.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself from damage,
and harshly lowers
the foe’s Attack if
it makes contact."
entries.translation_source: The user protects itself from damage, and harshly lowers the foe’s Attack if it makes contact.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
protegge dai danni e, se
il nemico entra in
contatto, riduce
gravemente il suo
Attacco.

entries.original:
"An odd psychic wave
attacks the target.
This attack does
physical damage."
entries.translation_source: An odd psychic wave attacks the target. This attack does physical damage.
entries.translated:
Un{B4}onda psichica
insolita attacca il
bersaglio. Questo
attacco infligge danni
fisici.

entries.original:
"The user sheds part
of its body to make
itself lighter and
sharply raise its
Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon perde parte
del suo corpo per
alleggerirsi e aumentare
molto la sua Velocità.

entries.original:
"The user whips up a
storm of diamonds
to damage the foes.
This may also raise
the user’s Defense. "
entries.translation_source: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage the foes. This may also raise the user’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon scatena una
tempesta di diamanti per
danneggiare i nemici.
Può anche aumentare la
Difesa del Pokémon.

entries.original:
"The area around the
user is swamped by
a giant sludge wave.
It may also poison
those hit."
entries.translation_source: The area around the user is swamped by a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.
entries.translated:
L{B4}area attorno
all{B4}utilizzatore viene
invasa da un{B4}enorme onda
di melma. Può anche
avvelenare i bersagli
colpiti.

entries.original:
"The user slams into
the target. The
greater the weight
difference, the
greater the damage."
entries.translation_source: The user slams into the target. The greater the weight difference, the greater the damage.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
schianta contro il
bersaglio. Maggiore è la
differenza di peso,
maggiore è il danno.

entries.original:
"Using an odd shock
wave, the user
damages same-type
Pokémon in the
surrounding area."
entries.translation_source: Using an odd shock wave, the user damages same-type Pokémon in the surrounding area.
entries.translated:
Usando un{B4}onda d{B4}urto
strana, il Pokémon
danneggia i Pokémon
dello stesso tipo
nell{B4}area circostante.

entries.original:
"The user hurls an
electric orb. The
faster the user is
than the foe, the
greater the damage."
entries.translation_source: The user hurls an electric orb. The faster the user is than the foe, the greater the damage.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore lancia
una sfera elettrica. Più
l{B4}utilizzatore è veloce
del nemico, maggiori
saranno i danni.

entries.original:
"The user turns the
foe’s power against
it. This uses the
foe’s Attack stat."
entries.translation_source: The user turns the foe’s power against it. This uses the foe’s Attack stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore rivolta
contro il nemico la sua
stessa potenza. Usa la
statistica di Attacco
del nemico.

entries.original:
"The user dances
with an odd rhythm,
making the target’s
Ability the same as
the user’s Ability."
entries.translation_source: The user dances with an odd rhythm, making the target’s Ability the same as the user’s Ability.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon danza con un
ritmo insolito, facendo
sì che l{B4}abilità del
bersaglio sia la stessa
di quella del Pokémon.

entries.original:
"The user releases a
pitch-black blast
at its target. May
also lower target’s
accuracy."
entries.translation_source: The user releases a pitch-black blast at its target. May also lower target’s accuracy.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon rilascia
contro il bersaglio un
raggio nerissimo. Può
anche ridurre la
Precisione del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
the target with a
harsh echo.
If used every turn,
power increases."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the target with a harsh echo. If used every turn, power increases.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon attacca il
bersaglio con un{B4}eco
aspra. Se usato ogni
turno, la potenza
aumenta.

entries.original:
"The user gathers
energy from the
land and damages
the opposing Pokémon
with its power."
entries.translation_source: The user gathers energy from the land and damages the opposing Pokémon with its power.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon raccoglie
energia dalla terra e
danneggia i Pokémon
avversari con la sua
potenza.

entries.original:
"The user absorbs its
target’s HP. The
user’s HP is restored
by over half the
damage."
entries.translation_source: The user absorbs its target’s HP. The user’s HP is restored by over half the damage.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon assorbe i PS
del bersaglio. I PS del
Pokémon vengono
ripristinati di oltre
metà del danno inflitto.

entries.original:
"The user employs its
psychic power to
switch stat changes
with the target."
entries.translation_source: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore impiega
il suo potere psichico
per scambiare le
modifiche alle
statistiche con il
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The foe’s crushed
with great force. The
more HP the foe has,
the stronger the
power."
entries.translation_source: The foe’s crushed with great force. The more HP the foe has, the stronger the power.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene
schiacciato con grande
forza. Più PS ha il
nemico, più potente è la
mossa.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
slicing with a long
horn. The target’s
stat changes are
ignored."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by slicing with a long horn. The target’s stat changes are ignored.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon attacca fendo
con il suo lungo corno.
I cambiamenti alle
statistiche del
bersaglio vengono
ignorati.

entries.original:
"The user slams down
with fire. The more
the user outweighs
the foe, the greater
the damage."
entries.translation_source: The user slams down with fire. The more the user outweighs the foe, the greater the damage.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
abbatte con il fuoco.
Maggiore è il suo peso
rispetto al nemico,
maggiore è il danno.

entries.original:
"The user charges its
head into its foe,
using its guard hair.
It slightly damages
the user."
entries.translation_source: The user charges its head into its foe, using its guard hair. It slightly damages the user.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore carica la
testa contro il nemico,
usando i peli di
protezione. Danneggia
leggermente
l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user fires a beam
of light at its foe.
The type changes
depending on the
Drive held."
entries.translation_source: The user fires a beam of light at its foe. The type changes depending on the Drive held.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon spara un
raggio di luce al suo
nemico. Il tipo cambia a
seconda del Drive
tenuto.

entries.original:
"The user sings an
ancient song and
attacks the hearts of
the listeners. It
may induce sleep."
entries.translation_source: The user sings an ancient song and attacks the hearts of the listeners. It may induce sleep.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore canta un
canto antico e colpisce
il cuore degli
ascoltatori. Può indurli
al sonno.

entries.original:
"The user cuts with
its long horn. The
odd power in the
horn does physical
damage to the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power in the horn does physical damage to the foe.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore colpisce
con il suo lungo corno.
L{B4}energia anomala nel
corno infligge danni
fisici al nemico.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
blowing freezing cold
air at opposing
Pokémon. This lowers
their Speed."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at opposing Pokémon. This lowers their Speed.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
soffiando aria gelida
sui Pokémon avversari.
Ciò riduce la loro
Velocità.

entries.original:
"The user surrounds
itself with abundant
electricity that can
paralyze and charges
its target."
entries.translation_source: The user surrounds itself with abundant electricity that can paralyze and charges its target.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
circonda di
un{B4}abbondante
elettricità che può
paralizzare e si lancia
contro il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
engulfing the foe in
a severe, beautiful,
blue flame. It may
burn the foe."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by engulfing the foe in a severe, beautiful, blue flame. It may burn the foe.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
avvolgendo il bersaglio
in una fiamma blu,
splendida e feroce. Può
bruciare il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"A two-turn attack
that hits the foe
with electrically
charged ice. It may
paralyze the foe."
entries.translation_source: A two-turn attack that hits the foe with electrically charged ice. It may paralyze the foe.
entries.translated:
Un attacco in due turni
che colpisce il nemico
con ghiaccio
elettrificato. Può
paralizzare il nemico.

entries.original:
"A two-turn attack
that surrounds the
foe with ultracold,
freezing wind. It
may burn the foe."
entries.translation_source: A two-turn attack that surrounds the foe with ultracold, freezing wind. It may burn the foe.
entries.translated:
È un attacco di due
turni che circonda il
nemico con un vento
ultrafreddo e gelido.
Può bruciare il nemico.

entries.original:
"The user hurls the
hot flame on its
forehead. It lowers
the user’s Def, Sp.
Def, and Speed."
entries.translation_source: The user hurls the hot flame on its forehead. It lowers the user’s Def, Sp. Def, and Speed.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore scaglia
la fiamma ardente sulla
sua fronte. Riduce
Difesa, Dif. Sp. e
Velocità
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user brings down
a huge flame. It does
more damage when
influenced by an
enormous bolt."
entries.translation_source: The user brings down a huge flame. It does more damage when influenced by an enormous bolt.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore fa cadere
una gigantesca fiamma.
Infligge più danni se è
influenzata da un
gigantesco fulmine.

entries.original:
"The user throws down
a giant bolt. It does
more damage when
influenced by an
enormous flame."
entries.translation_source: The user throws down a giant bolt. It does more damage when influenced by an enormous flame.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore scaglia
un gigantesco fulmine.
Infligge più danni se è
influenzato da una
fiamma enorme.

entries.original:
"When the user knocks
out a target with
this move, the user’s
Attack stat rises
drastically."
entries.translation_source: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user’s Attack stat rises drastically.
entries.translated:
Quando l{B4}utilizzatore
manda KO un bersaglio
con questa mossa, il suo
parametro Attacco
aumenta drasticamente.

entries.original:
"Letting out a noble
roar, the user
intimidates the
target and lowers its
Attack and Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
Emettendo un ruggito
nobile, l{B4}utilizzatore
intimorisce il bersaglio
e ne riduce l{B4}Attacco e
l{B4}Att. Sp.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
dropping off from
the sky at high speed.
This cuts the user’s
Defense and Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by dropping off from the sky at high speed. This cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon piomba dal
cielo ad alta velocità.
Ciò riduce la Difesa e
la Dif. Sp. del Pokémon.

entries.original:
"With a parting threat,
the user lowers the
foe’s Attack and Sp.
Atk stats then
switches out."
entries.translation_source: With a parting threat, the user lowers the foe’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats then switches out.
entries.translated:
Con una minaccia
d{B4}addio, l{B4}utilizzatore
riduce le statistiche
Attacco e Att. Sp. del
nemico, poi si ritira.

entries.original:
"All stat changes
affecting the target
turn topsy-turvy and
become the opposite
of them."
entries.translation_source: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of them.
entries.translated:
Tutti i cambiamenti alle
statistiche che
interessano il bersaglio
vengono capovolti e
diventano il loro
contrario.

entries.original:
"If the target has
already used its
move this turn, it
nullifies the effect
of its Ability."
entries.translation_source: If the target has already used its move this turn, it nullifies the effect of its Ability.
entries.translated:
Se il bersaglio ha già
usato la sua mossa in
questo turno, ne annulla
l{B4}effetto dell{B4}Abilità.

entries.original:
"The user attacks the
target with sound
waves of deafening
chatter. This
confuses the target."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the target with sound waves of deafening chatter. This confuses the target.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
il bersaglio con onde
sonore di
chiacchiericcio
assordante. Questo
confonde il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user tells the
foe a secret and it
loses concentration.
This lowers Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: The user tells the foe a secret and it loses concentration. This lowers Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa rivela un
segreto al bersaglio e
ne distrae la
concentrazione. Questo
abbassa l{B4}Att. Sp.

entries.original:
"The user throws stars
at the foe 2 to 5
times in a row. This
always strikes first."
entries.translation_source: The user throws stars at the foe 2 to 5 times in a row. This always strikes first.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa lancia stelle
contro il bersaglio da 2
a 5 volte di seguito.
Colpisce sempre per
primo.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
breathing a special,
hot fire. This also
lowers the target’s
Sp. Atk stat."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
respirando un fuoco
speciale e rovente.
Questo riduce anche
l{B4}Att. Sp. del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Aside from protecting
the user from attacks,
this also damages
attackers who make
contact."
entries.translation_source: Aside from protecting the user from attacks, this also damages attackers who make contact.
entries.translated:
Oltre a proteggere
l{B4}utilizzatore dagli
attacchi, danneggia
anche gli assalitori che
entrano in contatto.

entries.original:
"The user’s body
generates an impulse.
Exposing the foe to
it harshly lowers
its Sp. Atk stat."
entries.translation_source: The user’s body generates an impulse. Exposing the foe to it harshly lowers its Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
Il corpo
dell{B4}utilizzatore genera
un impulso. Esporre il
nemico a esso riduce
gravemente la sua Att.
Sp.

entries.original:
"The user holds back
when it attacks, and
the target is left
with at least 1 HP."
entries.translation_source: The user holds back when it attacks, and the target is left with at least 1 HP.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa si trattiene
quando attacca, e il
bersaglio resta con
almeno 1 PS.

entries.original:
"The foe is infested
and attacked for four
to five turns. The
target can’t flee
during this."
entries.translation_source: The foe is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can’t flee during this.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene
infestato e attaccato
per quattro o cinque
turni. Il bersaglio non
può fuggire durante
questo periodo.

entries.original:
"Striking over and
over hardens the
user’s fists.
Hitting a target
raises Attack."
entries.translation_source: Striking over and over hardens the user’s fists. Hitting a target raises Attack.
entries.translated:
Colpendo più e più
volte, chi la usa
indurisce i propri
pugni. Colpire un
bersaglio aumenta
l{B4}Attacco.

entries.original:
"This move also hits
opposing Pokémon in
the air. They are
knocked down to the
ground."
entries.translation_source: This move also hits opposing Pokémon in the air. They are knocked down to the ground.
entries.translated:
Questa mossa colpisce
anche i Pokémon
avversari in aria.
Vengono abbattuti a
terra.

entries.original:
"The user attacks with
a wave that crawls
along the ground.
Those hit can’t flee
from battle."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those hit can’t flee from battle.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
con un{B4}onda che striscia
lungo il terreno. Chi
viene colpito non può
fuggire dalla lotta.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
everything around it.
The user’s HP is
restored by half the
damage."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks everything around it. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon attacca tutto
ciò che lo circonda. I
PS del Pokémon vengono
ripristinati della metà
del danno inflitto.

entries.original:
"The user torches
everything around it
in an inferno of
scarlet flames.
It may cause burns."
entries.translation_source: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. It may cause burns.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore
incenerisce tutto ciò
che lo circonda in un
inferno di fiamme
scarlatte. Può causare
bruciature.

entries.original:
"The user emits a
shock wave from its
body. This may also
harshly lower the
target’s Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: The user emits a shock wave from its body. This may also harshly lower the target’s Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore emette
un{B4}onda d{B4}urto dal
proprio corpo. Può anche
ridurre drasticamente la
Dif. Sp. del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user smashes into
the target at high
speed. This move
always goes first."
entries.translation_source: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa si lancia ad
alta velocità contro il
bersaglio. Questa mossa
agisce sempre per prima.

entries.original:
"The user entangles
the target with its
anchor chain while
attacking. The target
cannot flee."
entries.translation_source: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target cannot flee.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore
intrappola il bersaglio
con la sua catena
d{B4}ancora mentre attacca.
Il bersaglio non può
fuggire.

entries.original:
"This move reduces
damage from physical
and special moves for
five turns during a
hailstorm."
entries.translation_source: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns during a hailstorm.
entries.translated:
Questa mossa riduce i
danni delle mosse
fisiche e speciali per
cinque turni durante una
grandinata.

entries.original:
"Aside from protecting
the user from attacks,
this also poisons
attackers who make
contact."
entries.translation_source: Aside from protecting the user from attacks, this also poisons attackers who make contact.
entries.translated:
Oltre a proteggere
l{B4}utilizzatore dagli
attacchi, avvelena anche
gli assalitori che
entrano in contatto.

entries.original:
"The user heats up its
beak and attacks.
Contact during heating
causes a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user heats up its beak and attacks. Contact during heating causes a burn.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa arroventa il
becco e attacca. Il
contatto mentre è
arroventato provoca una
bruciatura.

entries.original:
"The user swings its
body around violently
to inflict damage on
everything in its
vicinity."
entries.translation_source: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore fa
roteare violentemente il
proprio corpo per
infliggere danni a tutto
ciò che lo circonda.

entries.original:
"The user burns
itself out. After
using this move,
the user will no
longer be Fire type."
entries.translation_source: The user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon si consuma.
Dopo aver usato questa
mossa, il Pokémon non
sarà più di tipo Fuoco.

entries.original:
"The user rubs its
scales and makes a
huge noise to
attack. The user’s
Def stat goes down."
entries.translation_source: The user rubs its scales and makes a huge noise to attack. The user’s Def stat goes down.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon strofina le
sue scaglie e fa un gran
rumore per attaccare. La
sua Difesa cala.

entries.original:
"The user swings both
arms and hits the
target. The target’s
stat changes are
ignored."
entries.translation_source: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target’s stat changes are ignored.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon fa oscillare
entrambe le braccia e
colpisce il bersaglio. I
cambiamenti alle
statistiche del
bersaglio vengono
ignorati.

entries.original:
"The user uses its
body like a hammer
to attack the target
and inflict damage."
entries.translation_source: The user uses its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa si serve del
proprio corpo come di un
martello per attaccare
il bersaglio e
infliggere danni.

entries.original:
"The user strikes the
target with a burning
lash. This also
lowers the target’s
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore colpisce
il bersaglio con una
frusta ardente. Riduce
anche il parametro
Difesa del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Although this move
has great power, it
only works the first
turn the user is in
battle."
entries.translation_source: Although this move has great power, it only works the first turn the user is in battle.
entries.translated:
Sebbene questa mossa sia
molto potente, funziona
solo nel primo turno in
cui il Pokémon entra in
lotta.

entries.original:
"The user unleashes a
strong beam. The
attack’s recoil
harshly lowers the
user’s Sp. Atk stat."
entries.translation_source: The user unleashes a strong beam. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore scatena
un potente raggio. Il
contraccolpo riduce
gravemente l{B4}Att. Sp.
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user restores up
to half the max HP
of the target. It
restores more HP
on Grassy Terrain."
entries.translation_source: The user restores up to half the max HP of the target. It restores more HP on Grassy Terrain.
entries.translated:
Ripristina al bersaglio
fino a metà dei PS
massimi. Su Terreno
Erboso ripristina più
PS.

entries.original:
"The user engages its
gears to raise the
Attack and Sp. Atk
of allies with the
Plus or Minus Ability."
entries.translation_source: The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk of allies with the Plus or Minus Ability.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon mette in moto
i propri ingranaggi per
aumentare l{B4}Attacco e
l{B4}Att. Sp. degli alleati
con l{B4}abilità Plus o
Minus.

entries.original:
"The user fiercely
attacks the target
using its entire
body."
entries.translation_source: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon attacca
furiosamente il
bersaglio usando tutto
il suo corpo.

entries.original:
"The user swings
its heavy fist.
It also lowers the
user’s Speed."
entries.translation_source: The user swings its heavy fist. It also lowers the user’s Speed.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore sferra il
suo pesante pugno.
Abbassa anche la
Velocità
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user concentrates
intensely. The
attack on the next
turn always results
in a critical hit."
entries.translation_source: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
concentra intensamente.
L{B4}attacco del turno
successivo va sempre a
segno come colpo
critico.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
pelting the target
with leaves."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
tempestando il bersaglio
di foglie.

entries.original:
"The user slams into
the foe using a
full-force water
blast. This may lower
the foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The user slams into the foe using a full-force water blast. This may lower the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
abbatte sul nemico con
un getto d{B4}acqua a piena
potenza. Può ridurre la
Difesa del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user makes a
lunge at the foe,
attacking with full
force. This lowers
the foe’s Attack."
entries.translation_source: The user makes a lunge at the foe, attacking with full force. This lowers the foe’s Attack.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si lancia
contro il nemico,
attaccando con tutta la
forza. Ciò riduce
l{B4}Attacco del nemico.

entries.original:
"The user emits a
sinister ray. This
can be used on the
target regardless
of its Ability."
entries.translation_source: The user emits a sinister ray. This can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon emette un
raggio sinistro. Può
essere usato sul
bersaglio
indipendentemente dalla
sua Abilità.

entries.original:
"Cloaking itself in
high energy, the user
slams into the foe.
Its type depends on
the memory."
entries.translation_source: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the foe. Its type depends on the memory.
entries.translated:
Avvolgendosi in
un{B4}energia intensa,
l{B4}utilizzatore si
schianta contro il
nemico. Il suo tipo
dipende dalla Memoria.

entries.original:
"The user hits the
target with the
force of nature. It
halves the target’s
HP."
entries.translation_source: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target’s HP.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa colpisce il
bersaglio con la forza
della natura. Dimezza i
PS del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks the
foe with exploding
pollen puff. If
target is an ally, it
heals instead."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the foe with exploding pollen puff. If target is an ally, it heals instead.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
il nemico con una nuvola
di polline esplosivo. Se
il bersaglio è un
alleato, invece lo cura.

entries.original:
"The user boasts its
strength. The more
the user’s stats are
raised, the greater
the power."
entries.translation_source: The user boasts its strength. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the power.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore ostenta
la propria forza. Più le
statistiche
dell{B4}utilizzatore sono
aumentate, maggiore sarà
la potenza.

entries.original:
"The user shoots
powerful lasers using
prism power. The
user can’t move on
the next turn."
entries.translation_source: The user shoots powerful lasers using prism power. The user can’t move on the next turn.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon spara potenti
laser usando il potere
del prisma. Il Pokémon
non può muoversi nel
turno successivo.

entries.original:
"The user bites the
target with psychic
capabilities. This
destroys Light
Screen and Reflect."
entries.translation_source: The user bites the target with psychic capabilities. This destroys Light Screen and Reflect.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore morde il
bersaglio con capacità
psichiche. Distrugge
Schermoluce e Riflesso.

entries.original:
"The user heals the
target’s status
condition. If this
succeeds, it also
heals the user’s HP."
entries.translation_source: The user heals the target’s status condition. If this succeeds, it also heals the user’s HP.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore cura la
condizione alterata del
bersaglio. Se va a buon
fine, cura anche i PS
dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user attacks the
target by dancing
very hard. The user’s
type determines this
move’s type."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the target by dancing very hard. The user’s type determines this move’s type.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
il bersaglio danzando
con intensità. Il tipo
dell{B4}utilizzatore
determina il tipo di
questa mossa.

entries.original:
"The user attacks the
foe with a bone of
spirit. It may lower
the foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the foe with a bone of spirit. It may lower the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa attacca il
bersaglio con un osso
spirituale. Può
abbassare la Difesa del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user sets a
shell trap. If the
user is hit by a
physical move, the
trap will explode."
entries.translation_source: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon prepara una
trappola a conchiglia.
Se il Pokémon viene
colpito da una mossa
fisica, la trappola
esplode.

entries.original:
"The user regains up
to half of its max
HP. It restores
more HP in a
sandstorm."
entries.translation_source: The user regains up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP in a sandstorm.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa recupera fino
alla metà dei suoi PS
max. Ripristina più PS
durante una tempesta di
sabbia.

entries.original:
"The user stabs the
target with a sharp
horn. This attack
never misses."
entries.translation_source: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore trafigge
il bersaglio con un
corno affilato. Questo
attacco non fallisce
mai.

entries.original:
"In this two-turn move,
the user gathers
light and fills a
blade with light’s
energy to attack."
entries.translation_source: In this two-turn move, the user gathers light and fills a blade with light’s energy to attack.
entries.translated:
In questa mossa di due
turni, l{B4}utilizzatore
raccoglie luce e riempie
una lama con l{B4}energia
della luce per
attaccare.

entries.original:
"The user bursts into
song, emitting
bubbles. Any burnt
Pokémon will be
healed."
entries.translation_source: The user bursts into song, emitting bubbles. Any burnt Pokémon will be healed.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa intona una
canzone emettendo bolle.
Qualsiasi Pokémon
scottato verrà curato.

entries.original:
"The user hides in
the target’s shadow,
steals the target’s
stat boosts, and
then attacks."
entries.translation_source: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon si nasconde
nell{B4}ombra del
bersaglio, ruba i suoi
incrementi alle
statistiche e poi
attacca.

entries.original:
"The user exchanges
Speed stats with
the target."
entries.translation_source: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore scambia
la propria Velocità con
quella del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
while stitching the
target’s shadow to
the ground to
prevent escape."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks while stitching the target’s shadow to the ground to prevent escape.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon attacca
cucendo l{B4}ombra del
bersaglio al terreno per
impedirne la fuga.

entries.original:
"The user shines a
spotlight on the
target so that only
the target will be
attacked."
entries.translation_source: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only the target will be attacked.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa punta un
riflettore sul bersaglio
così che solo il
bersaglio verrà
attaccato.

entries.original:
"If the previous move
failed, frustration
doubles the power of
this move."
entries.translation_source: If the previous move failed, frustration doubles the power of this move.
entries.translated:
Se la mossa precedente è
fallita, la frustrazione
raddoppia la potenza di
questa mossa.

entries.original:
"The user drains HP
equal to the foe’s
Attack stat. It
also lowers the
foe’s Attack stat."
entries.translation_source: The user drains HP equal to the foe’s Attack stat. It also lowers the foe’s Attack stat.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon assorbe PS
pari al valore
dell{B4}Attacco del nemico.
Riduce anche l{B4}Attacco
del nemico.

entries.original:
"The user slams the
target with a meteor
force. This move
disregards the
target’s Ability."
entries.translation_source: The user slams the target with a meteor force. This move disregards the target’s Ability.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon colpisce il
bersaglio con una forza
meteorica. Questa mossa
ignora l{B4}Abilità del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user gets teary
eyed to look pitiful.
This lowers the
target’s Attack and
Sp. Atk stats."
entries.translation_source: The user gets teary eyed to look pitiful. This lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore mette gli
occhi lucidi per
sembrare pietoso. Ciò
riduce l{B4}Attacco e
l{B4}Attacco Sp. del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks the
foe’s throat to
prevent it from
using moves that emit
sound for two turns."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the foe’s throat to prevent it from using moves that emit sound for two turns.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore colpisce
la gola del bersaglio
per impedirgli di usare
mosse che emettono suoni
per due turni.

entries.original:
"The user shoots
poisonous threads to
poison the target
and lower the
target’s Speed stat."
entries.translation_source: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target’s Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon spara fili
velenosi per avvelenare
il bersaglio e ridurne
la Velocità.

entries.original:
"The user lands a
tropical kick on the
foe. It also lowers
the foe’s Attack."
entries.translation_source: The user lands a tropical kick on the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Attack.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore sferra un
calcio tropicale al
nemico. Abbassa anche
l{B4}Attacco del nemico.

entries.original:
"A strong electric
blast crashes down
on the target. This
may make the target
flinch."
entries.translation_source: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may make the target flinch.
entries.translated:
Un potente colpo
elettrico si abbatte sul
bersaglio. Può far
tentennare il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user electrifies
the ground for five
turns, powering up
Electric moves and
eluding sleep."
entries.translation_source: The user electrifies the ground for five turns, powering up Electric moves and eluding sleep.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore
elettrifica il terreno
per cinque turni,
potenziando le mosse
Elettro ed evitando il
sonno.

entries.original:
"The user turns the
ground to grass for
five turns, powering
up Grass moves and
restoring HP."
entries.translation_source: The user turns the ground to grass for five turns, powering up Grass moves and restoring HP.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore trasforma
il terreno in erba per
cinque turni,
potenziando le mosse
Erba e ripristinando PS.

entries.original:
"The user covers the
ground in mist for
five turns, halving
Dragon moves and
preventing status."
entries.translation_source: The user covers the ground in mist for five turns, halving Dragon moves and preventing status.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore ricopre
il terreno di nebbia per
cinque turni, dimezzando
le mosse di tipo Drago e
impedendo le alterazioni
di stato.

entries.original:
"The user makes the
ground weird for
five turns, boosting
Psychic moves and
blocking priority."
entries.translation_source: The user makes the ground weird for five turns, boosting Psychic moves and blocking priority.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore rende il
terreno strano per
cinque turni,
potenziando le mosse
Psico e bloccando la
priorità.

entries.original:
"When combined with
Water Pledge, its
power increases and
a vast swamp appears."
entries.translation_source: When combined with Water Pledge, its power increases and a vast swamp appears.
entries.translated:
Quando è combinata con
Water Pledge, la sua
potenza aumenta e appare
una vasta palude.

entries.original:
"When combined with
Grass Pledge, its
power increases and a
sea of fire appears."
entries.translation_source: When combined with Grass Pledge, its power increases and a sea of fire appears.
entries.translated:
Se combinata con Grass
Pledge, la sua potenza
aumenta e appare un mare
di fuoco.

entries.original:
"When combined with
Fire Pledge, its
power increases and
a rainbow appears."
entries.translation_source: When combined with Fire Pledge, its power increases and a rainbow appears.
entries.translated:
Se combinata con
Giuramento di Fuoco, la
sua potenza aumenta e
compare un arcobaleno.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
bizarre area in
which slower Pokémon
get to move first
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon crea un{B4}area
bizzarra in cui i
Pokémon più lenti si
muovono per primi per
cinque turni.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
bizarre area in
which Pokémon’s held
items lose effect
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s held items lose effect for five turns.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon crea un{B4}area
bizzarra in cui gli
strumenti tenuti dai
Pokémon perdono effetto
per cinque turni.

entries.original:
"The user creates a
bizarre area where
Pokémon’s Defense
and Sp. Def swap
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user creates a bizarre area where Pokémon’s Defense and Sp. Def swap for five turns.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon crea un{B4}area
bizzarra in cui la
Difesa e la Dif. Sp. dei
Pokémon si scambiano per
cinque turni.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself and its
allies from status
moves with a
mysterious power."
entries.translation_source: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa protegge se
stesso e i suoi alleati
dalle mosse di stato con
un potere misterioso.

entries.original:
"Using a pulled-up
mat as a shield,
the user protects
itself and its allies
from damaging moves."
entries.translation_source: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves.
entries.translated:
Usando una stuoia
sollevata come scudo,
l{B4}utilizzatore protegge
sé stesso e i suoi
alleati dalle mosse
dannose.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself and its
allies from priority
moves."
entries.translation_source: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon protegge se
stesso e i suoi alleati
dalle mosse a priorità.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself and its
allies from wide-
ranged attacks."
entries.translation_source: The user protects itself and its allies from wide- ranged attacks.
entries.translated:
Protegge se stesso e i
suoi alleati dagli
attacchi ad area.

entries.original:
"The user envelops
itself in a veil
made of water. It
regains some HP
every turn."
entries.translation_source: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa avvolge se
stesso in un velo
d{B4}acqua. Recupera alcuni
PS a ogni turno.

entries.original:
"The user raises the
Sp. Def stat of an
ally Pokémon by
using a mysterious
aroma."
entries.translation_source: The user raises the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa aumenta la
statistica Dif. Sp. di
un Pokémon alleato
usando un aroma
misterioso.

entries.original:
"The user lets out a
damaging belch at
the target. The user
must eat a held
Berry to use this."
entries.translation_source: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore emette un
rutto dannoso contro il
bersaglio. Per usarla,
l{B4}utilizzatore deve
mangiare una Bacca
tenuta.

entries.original:
"The user passes its
held item to the
target when the
target isn’t
holding an item."
entries.translation_source: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn’t holding an item.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa passa al
bersaglio lo strumento
tenuto quando il
bersaglio non ne ha uno.

entries.original:
"The user flings its
held item at the
target to attack.
Its power and effect
depend on the item."
entries.translation_source: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. Its power and effect depend on the item.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore lancia
l{B4}oggetto tenuto contro
il bersaglio per
attaccare. Potenza ed
effetto dipendono
dall{B4}oggetto.

entries.original:
"The user dives down
onto the target from
the sky. This move
is both Fighting
and Flying type."
entries.translation_source: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is both Fighting and Flying type.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si tuffa
sul bersaglio dal cielo.
Questa mossa è sia di
tipo Lotta sia di tipo
Volante.

entries.original:
"Gravity intensifies
for five turns,
preventing moves
that use flight and
negating Levitate."
entries.translation_source: Gravity intensifies for five turns, preventing moves that use flight and negating Levitate.
entries.translated:
La Gravità si
intensifica per cinque
turni, impedendo le
mosse che usano il volo
e annullando
Levitazione.

entries.original:
"The user employs its
psychic power to
average its Defense
and Sp. Def stats
with the target."
entries.translation_source: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore usa il
proprio potere psichico
per fare la media dei
propri parametri di
Difesa e Dif. Sp. con
quelli del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user prevents
the opposing team
from using any HP
recovery for five
turns."
entries.translation_source: The user prevents the opposing team from using any HP recovery for five turns.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa impedisce
alla squadra avversaria
di recuperare PS per
cinque turni.

entries.original:
"The user disperses
electrically charged
particles, changing
Normal- to Electric-
type moves."
entries.translation_source: The user disperses electrically charged particles, changing Normal- to Electric- type moves.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore disperde
particelle cariche
elettricamente,
trasformando le mosse di
tipo Normale in mosse di
tipo Elettro.

entries.original:
"The user chants an
incantation that
prevents foes from
landing critical
hits for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user chants an incantation that prevents foes from landing critical hits for five turns.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore intona un
incantesimo che
impedisce ai nemici di
sferrare colpi critici
per cinque turni.

entries.original:
"The user levitates
using electrically
generated magnetism
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore levita
grazie al magnetismo
generato elettricamente
per cinque turni.

entries.original:
"The user manipulates
magnets to up Def
and Sp. Def stats of
allies with Plus or
Minus Ability."
entries.translation_source: The user manipulates magnets to up Def and Sp. Def stats of allies with Plus or Minus Ability.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore manipola
dei magneti per
aumentare Difesa e Dif.
Sp. degli alleati con
l{B4}abilità Plus o Minus.

entries.original:
"The user covers the
target in a powder
that explodes if it
uses a Fire-type
move."
entries.translation_source: The user covers the target in a powder that explodes if it uses a Fire-type move.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa ricopre il
bersaglio di una polvere
che esplode se usa una
mossa di tipo Fuoco.

entries.original:
"The user employs its
psychic power to
average its Attack
and Sp. Atk stats
with the target."
entries.translation_source: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore usa il
proprio potere psichico
per fare la media dei
propri parametri di
Attacco e Attacco Sp.
con quelli del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user reflects
the target’s type,
making it the same
type as the target."
entries.translation_source: The user reflects the target’s type, making it the same type as the target.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore riflette
il tipo del bersaglio,
diventando dello stesso
tipo del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user’s
mysterious psychic
wave changes the
target’s Ability to
Simple."
entries.translation_source: The user’s mysterious psychic wave changes the target’s Ability to Simple.
entries.translated:
La misteriosa onda
psichica
dell{B4}utilizzatore cambia
l{B4}Abilità del bersaglio
in Semplice.

entries.original:
"The user shoots a
torrent of water at
the target and
changes the target’s
type to Water."
entries.translation_source: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target’s type to Water.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon spara un
torrente d{B4}acqua al
bersaglio e cambia il
tipo del bersaglio in
Acqua.

entries.original:
"The user makes the
target float with
psychic power. The
target is easier to
hit for three turns."
entries.translation_source: The user makes the target float with psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon fa levitare
il bersaglio con il
potere psichico. Il
bersaglio è più facile
da colpire per tre
turni.

entries.original:
"The foe is brought
trick-or-treating.
This adds Ghost type
to the target’s type."
entries.translation_source: The foe is brought trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target’s type.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
coinvolto in un dolcetto
o scherzetto. Questo
aggiunge il tipo Spettro
al tipo del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user sprays a
poisonous liquid
that lowers Attack,
Sp. Atk, and Speed
of poisoned foes."
entries.translation_source: The user sprays a poisonous liquid that lowers Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed of poisoned foes.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore spruzza
un liquido velenoso che
riduce Attacco, Attacco
Sp. e Velocità dei
nemici avvelenati.

entries.original:
"The user puts a
forest curse on the
target. The target
is now Grass type
as well."
entries.translation_source: The user puts a forest curse on the target. The target is now Grass type as well.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa lancia una
maledizione della
foresta sul bersaglio.
Il bersaglio diventa
anche di tipo Erba.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
everything around it
by making its head
explode. This also
damages the user."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks everything around it by making its head explode. This also damages the user.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
tutto ciò che lo
circonda facendo
esplodere la propria
testa. Questo danneggia
anche l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"A pillar of light
that deals physical
or special damage
based on the user’s
better stat."
entries.translation_source: A pillar of light that deals physical or special damage based on the user’s better stat.
entries.translated:
Un pilastro di luce che
infligge danni fisici o
speciali in base alla
statistica migliore del
Pokémon che la usa.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with electrically
charged fists. This
makes Normal-type
moves Electric-type."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. This makes Normal-type moves Electric-type.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
con pugni carichi di
elettricità. Questo
rende le mosse di tipo
Normale di tipo Elettro.

entries.original:
"If the target is
electrified before
its move in the turn,
the target’s move
becomes Electric."
entries.translation_source: If the target is electrified before its move in the turn, the target’s move becomes Electric.
entries.translated:
Se il bersaglio viene
elettrificato prima di
usare la sua mossa in
quel turno, la sua mossa
diventa di tipo Elettro.

entries.original:
"It prevents the
target from using
items. Its Trainer
also can’t use
items on it."
entries.translation_source: It prevents the target from using items. Its Trainer also can’t use items on it.
entries.translated:
Impedisce al bersaglio
di usare strumenti.
Anche il suo Allenatore
non può usare strumenti
su di esso.

entries.original:
"By locking down the
battlefield, the
user keeps all
Pokémon from fleeing
during the next turn."
entries.translation_source: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.
entries.translated:
Bloccando il campo di
battaglia,
l{B4}utilizzatore impedisce
a tutti i Pokémon di
fuggire durante il turno
successivo.

entries.original:
"The user fires a
powerful beam of
light from the
Eternal Flower. This
damages the user."
entries.translation_source: The user fires a powerful beam of light from the Eternal Flower. This damages the user.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon spara un
potente raggio di luce
dal Fiore Eterno. Questa
mossa danneggia il
Pokémon che la usa.

entries.original:
"The fewer PP this
move has, the
greater its power."
entries.translation_source: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its power.
entries.translated:
Meno PP ha questa mossa,
maggiore è la sua
potenza.

entries.original:
"The user helps the
target and makes it
use its move right
after the user."
entries.translation_source: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore aiuta il
bersaglio e lo fa usare
la sua mossa subito dopo
l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The user instructs
the target to use
the target’s last
move again."
entries.translation_source: The user instructs the target to use the target’s last move again.
entries.translated:
Ordina al bersaglio di
usare di nuovo l{B4}ultima
mossa usata dal
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user suppresses
the target and makes
its move go last."
entries.translation_source: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon sopprime il
bersaglio e fa sì che la
sua mossa vada per
ultima.

entries.original:
"Using Happy Hour
doubles the amount
of prize money
received after
battle."
entries.translation_source: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.
entries.translated:
Usare Happy Hour
raddoppia la quantità di
denaro premio ricevuto
dopo la lotta.

entries.original:
"The user centers
its hex nut and
strikes twice with
its arms. It may
cause flinching."
entries.translation_source: The user centers its hex nut and strikes twice with its arms. It may cause flinching.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon centra il suo
dado esagonale e
colpisce due volte con
le sue braccia. Può far
tentennare.

entries.original:
"It can only be
used after the
user has exhausted
all other moves it
knows in battle."
entries.translation_source: It can only be used after the user has exhausted all other moves it knows in battle.
entries.translated:
Può essere usata solo
dopo che il Pokémon che
la usa ha esaurito tutte
le altre mosse che
conosce in lotta.

entries.original:
"It takes the enemy
into the sky,
where it can’t
attack. It is
dropped next turn."
entries.translation_source: It takes the enemy into the sky, where it can’t attack. It is dropped next turn.
entries.translated:
Porta il nemico in
cielo, dove non può
attaccare. Viene
lasciato cadere nel
turno successivo.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon
congratulates you
on your special
day!"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon ti fa gli
auguri per il tuo giorno
speciale!

entries.original:
"The user and an
ally hold hands.
This makes them
very happy."
entries.translation_source: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon e un alleato
si tengono per mano.
Questo li rende molto
felici.

entries.original:
"The user unleashes
a strong beam that
deals double damage
to Dynamaxed targets."
entries.translation_source: The user unleashes a strong beam that deals double damage to Dynamaxed targets.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa scatena un
raggio potente che
infligge danni doppi ai
bersagli Dynamax.

entries.original:
"The user ignores
the effects of moves
and Abilities that
draw in moves."
entries.translation_source: The user ignores the effects of moves and Abilities that draw in moves.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore ignora
gli effetti di mosse e
Abilità che richiamano
le mosse.

entries.original:
"The user bites down,
preventing itself
and the target from
switching out."
entries.translation_source: The user bites down, preventing itself and the target from switching out.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore morde con
forza, impedendo a sé
stesso e al bersaglio di
mandare in campo altri
Pokémon.

entries.original:
"The user consumes
its held Berry,
then raises its
Defense sharply."
entries.translation_source: The user consumes its held Berry, then raises its Defense sharply.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore consuma
la Bacca tenuta e poi
aumenta molto la Difesa.

entries.original:
"All of the user’s
stats are raised,
but it can no longer
switch out or flee."
entries.translation_source: All of the user’s stats are raised, but it can no longer switch out or flee.
entries.translated:
Tutte le statistiche di
chi la usa aumentano, ma
non può più essere
ritirato o fuggire.

entries.original:
"Sticky tar lowers
the target’s Speed,
and makes it weaker
to Fire-type moves."
entries.translation_source: Sticky tar lowers the target’s Speed, and makes it weaker to Fire-type moves.
entries.translated:
Il catrame appiccicoso
abbassa la Velocità del
bersaglio e lo rende più
vulnerabile alle mosse
di tipo Fuoco.

entries.original:
"The user scatters
magic powder that
changes the target
into a Psychic-type."
entries.translation_source: The user scatters magic powder that changes the target into a Psychic-type.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore sparge
polvere magica che
trasforma il bersaglio
in un tipo Psico.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
twice. If there
are two targets,
each is hit once."
