entries.translation_source: The user attacks twice. If there are two targets, each is hit once.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
due volte. Se ci sono
due bersagli, ciascuno
viene colpito una volta.

entries.original:
"All Pokémon on the
field have teatime.
Each Pokémon eats
its held Berry."
entries.translation_source: All Pokémon on the field have teatime. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.
entries.translated:
Tutti i Pokémon in campo
fanno merenda. Ogni
Pokémon mangia la Bacca
che tiene.

entries.original:
"The user traps the
foe and makes its
Defense and Sp. Def
fall each turn."
entries.translation_source: The user traps the foe and makes its Defense and Sp. Def fall each turn.
entries.translated:
Intrappola il bersaglio
e fa calare Difesa e
Dif. Sp. a ogni turno.

entries.original:
"If the user moves
before the target,
the power of this
move is doubled."
entries.translation_source: If the user moves before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
entries.translated:
Se l{B4}utilizzatore si
muove prima del
bersaglio, la potenza di
questa mossa raddoppia.

entries.original:
"If the user moves
before the target,
the power of this
move is doubled."
entries.translation_source: If the user moves before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
entries.translated:
Se l{B4}utilizzatore si
muove prima del
bersaglio, la potenza di
questa mossa raddoppia.

entries.original:
"The user swaps
the effects on
either side of
the field."
entries.translation_source: The user swaps the effects on either side of the field.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore scambia
gli effetti sui due lati
del campo.

entries.original:
"The user raises
all of its stats
by using some of
its HP."
entries.translation_source: The user raises all of its stats by using some of its HP.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore aumenta
tutte le sue statistiche
consumando parte dei
suoi PS.

entries.original:
"The higher the
user’s Defense,
the more damage
it will inflict."
entries.translation_source: The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it will inflict.
entries.translated:
Più alta è la Difesa
dell{B4}utente, più danni
infliggerà.

entries.original:
"The user sharply
raises the target’s
Attack and Sp. Atk
by decorating it."
entries.translation_source: The user sharply raises the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk by decorating it.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore aumenta
molto l{B4}Attacco e l{B4}Att.
Sp. del bersaglio
decorandolo.

entries.original:
"The user plays its
drum to attack.
The target’s Speed
stat is lowered."
entries.translation_source: The user plays its drum to attack. The target’s Speed stat is lowered.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore suona il
suo tamburo per
attaccare. La Velocità
del bersaglio viene
ridotta.

entries.original:
"The user snares
the target in a
snap trap for four
to five turns."
entries.translation_source: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon imprigiona il
bersaglio in una
trappola a scatto per
quattro o cinque turni.

entries.original:
"The user launches
a fiery ball at
the target. It may
also cause a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user launches a fiery ball at the target. It may also cause a burn.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore lancia
una sfera infuocata
contro il bersaglio. Può
anche causare ustione.

entries.original:
"The user becomes a
sword and strikes.
Double damage on
Dynamaxed targets."
entries.translation_source: The user becomes a sword and strikes. Double damage on Dynamaxed targets.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
trasforma in una spada e
colpisce. Danni doppi
contro i bersagli
Dynamax.

entries.original:
"The user becomes a
shield and strikes.
Double damage on
Dynamaxed targets."
entries.translation_source: The user becomes a shield and strikes. Double damage on Dynamaxed targets.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore diventa
uno scudo e colpisce.
Danni doppi contro i
bersagli in Dynamax.

entries.original:
"Morpeko raises its
Speed and attacks.
The move’s type is
based on its form."
entries.translation_source: Morpeko raises its Speed and attacks. The move’s type is based on its form.
entries.translated:
Morpeko aumenta la
propria Velocità e
attacca. Il tipo della
mossa dipende dalla sua
forma.

entries.original:
"The user attacks the
foes by swinging its
tail wildly, lowering
their Attack."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the foes by swinging its tail wildly, lowering their Attack.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa attacca gli
avversari agitando
freneticamente la coda,
riducendo il loro
Attacco.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
the target by
poking it with a
pointed branch."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks the target by poking it with a pointed branch.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utente attacca il
bersaglio pungendolo con
un ramo appuntito.

entries.original:
"The user twangs
its guitar, which
causes an echo and
strong vibrations."
entries.translation_source: The user twangs its guitar, which causes an echo and strong vibrations.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore pizzica
la sua chitarra, creando
un{B4}eco e forti
vibrazioni.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with acid made from
tart apples. Lowers
the foe’s Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with acid made from tart apples. Lowers the foe’s Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
con acido ricavato da
mele aspre. Abbassa la
Dif. Sp. del nemico.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
dropping an apple
from above. Lowers
the foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by dropping an apple from above. Lowers the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
lasciando cadere una
mela dall{B4}alto. Abbassa
la Difesa del nemico.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with spirit-breaking
force, lowering the
target’s Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with spirit-breaking force, lowering the target’s Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
con una forza
spezza-spirito,
riducendo l{B4}Att. Sp. del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
by emitting steam.
The steam may also
confuse the target."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by emitting steam. The steam may also confuse the target.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
emettendo vapore. Il
vapore può anche
confondere il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user scatters
water that restores
the HP of itself
and its allies."
entries.translation_source: The user scatters water that restores the HP of itself and its allies.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore sparge
acqua che ripristina i
PS propri e degli
alleati.

entries.original:
"The user protects
itself, and harshly
lowers the foe’s
Defense on contact."
entries.translation_source: The user protects itself, and harshly lowers the foe’s Defense on contact.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
protegge e riduce
drasticamente la Difesa
del bersaglio se viene a
contatto.

entries.original:
"The user bows,
then uses its hair
to stab the foe.
It never misses."
entries.translation_source: The user bows, then uses its hair to stab the foe. It never misses.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
inchina, poi usa i suoi
capelli per trafiggere
il nemico. Non manca
mai.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with its thick leek.
The user must rest
on the next turn."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with its thick leek. The user must rest on the next turn.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
con il suo porro spesso.
Deve riposare al turno
successivo.

entries.original:
"Eternatus’s most
powerful attack.
The user must rest
on the next turn."
entries.translation_source: Eternatus’s most powerful attack. The user must rest on the next turn.
entries.translated:
L{B4}attacco più potente di
Eternatus.
L{B4}utilizzatore deve
riposare nel turno
successivo.

entries.original:
"It fires a beam
of steel from its
body, which also
hurts the user."
entries.translation_source: It fires a beam of steel from its body, which also hurts the user.
entries.translated:
Spara un raggio
d{B4}acciaio dal proprio
corpo, ferendo anche
l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"The move’s power
increases and damages
all opposing targets
in Psychic Terrain."
entries.translation_source: The move’s power increases and damages all opposing targets in Psychic Terrain.
entries.translated:
La potenza della mossa
aumenta e danneggia
tutti i bersagli
avversari su Campo
Psichico.

entries.original:
"The user attacks and
destroys the terrain.
The move fails if
there is no terrain."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks and destroys the terrain. The move fails if there is no terrain.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa attacca e
distrugge il terreno. La
mossa fallisce se non
c{B4}è un terreno.

entries.original:
"It hits two to five
times in a row.
Raises Speed, but
lowers Defense."
entries.translation_source: It hits two to five times in a row. Raises Speed, but lowers Defense.
entries.translated:
Colpisce da due a cinque
volte di seguito.
Aumenta la Velocità, ma
riduce la Difesa.

entries.original:
"In this two-turn move,
the user gathers
space power and
increases Sp. Atk."
entries.translation_source: In this two-turn move, the user gathers space power and increases Sp. Atk.
entries.translated:
In questa mossa a due
turni, l{B4}utilizzatore
accumula energia
spaziale e aumenta
l{B4}Att. Sp.

entries.original:
"Inflicts the more
effective of physical
or special damage.
May poison the foe."
entries.translation_source: Inflicts the more effective of physical or special damage. May poison the foe.
entries.translated:
Infligge il danno più
efficace tra fisico e
speciale. Può avvelenare
il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user explodes
and faints itself.
Its power increases
on Misty Terrain."
entries.translation_source: The user explodes and faints itself. Its power increases on Misty Terrain.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore esplode e
manda KO sé stesso. La
sua potenza aumenta su
Terreno Nebbioso.

entries.original:
"The user glides
on the ground to
attack. Hits first
on Grassy Terrain."
entries.translation_source: The user glides on the ground to attack. Hits first on Grassy Terrain.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore scivola
sul terreno per
attaccare. Colpisce per
primo su Campo Erboso.

entries.original:
"The user attacks with
earthly voltage. It
doubles in power on
Electric Terrain."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with earthly voltage. It doubles in power on Electric Terrain.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa attacca con
elettricità tellurica.
La potenza raddoppia su
Campo Elettrico.

entries.original:
"The move’s type
and power depends on
the terrain currently
used in battle."
entries.translation_source: The move’s type and power depends on the terrain currently used in battle.
entries.translated:
Il tipo e la potenza
della mossa dipendono
dal terreno attualmente
in uso in lotta.

entries.original:
"The user skitters
behind the target to
attack. It lowers the
foe’s Sp.Atk stat."
entries.translation_source: The user skitters behind the target to attack. It lowers the foe’s Sp.Atk stat.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa si infila
alle spalle del
bersaglio per attaccare.
Abbassa la statistica
Att. Sp. del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Inflicts a burn on
targets that had
their stats boosted
during the turn used."
entries.translation_source: Inflicts a burn on targets that had their stats boosted during the turn used.
entries.translated:
Infligge una bruciatura
ai bersagli che hanno
aumentato le proprie
statistiche nel turno in
cui è stata usata.

entries.original:
"The move’s power
doubles if the user’s
stats have fallen
during the turn."
entries.translation_source: The move’s power doubles if the user’s stats have fallen during the turn.
entries.translated:
La potenza della mossa
raddoppia se le
statistiche
dell{B4}utilizzatore sono
diminuite durante il
turno.

entries.original:
"The user controls
the target’s item to
attack. Fails if the
target has no item."
entries.translation_source: The user controls the target’s item to attack. Fails if the target has no item.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa controlla lo
strumento del bersaglio
per attaccare. Fallisce
se il bersaglio non ha
uno strumento.

entries.original:
"The user cloaks
itself in acidic gas.
It melts away the
target’s held item."
entries.translation_source: The user cloaks itself in acidic gas. It melts away the target’s held item.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si
avvolge in un gas acido.
Fa sciogliere lo
strumento tenuto dal
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user coaches
its ally, raising
the ally’s Attack
and Defense stats."
entries.translation_source: The user coaches its ally, raising the ally’s Attack and Defense stats.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore sprona il
proprio alleato,
aumentando i suoi valori
di Attacco e Difesa.

entries.original:
"After attacking,
the user switches
places with a
party Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: After attacking, the user switches places with a party Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Dopo aver attaccato,
l{B4}utilizzatore si
scambia di posto con un
Pokémon della squadra.

entries.original:
"A 3-kick attack
that becomes more
powerful with each
successive hit."
entries.translation_source: A 3-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.
entries.translated:
Un attacco a 3 calci che
diventa più potente a
ogni colpo successivo.

entries.original:
"The user slams
the target with its
wings. The target is
hit twice in a row."
entries.translation_source: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore colpisce
il bersaglio con le ali.
Il bersaglio viene
colpito due volte di
seguito.

entries.original:
"The user throws
scorching sand at the
target. It may also
inflict a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user throws scorching sand at the target. It may also inflict a burn.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore lancia
sabbia rovente al
bersaglio. Può anche
provocare una
scottatura.

entries.original:
"The user restores
HP and the status
of itself and its
ally in battle."
entries.translation_source: The user restores HP and the status of itself and its ally in battle.
entries.translated:
Ripristina i PS e le
condizioni di stato
dell{B4}utilizzatore e del
suo alleato in lotta.

entries.original:
"The user strikes
the foe fiercely.
It always results in
a critical hit."
entries.translation_source: The user strikes the foe fiercely. It always results in a critical hit.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore colpisce
violentemente il
bersaglio. Il colpo è
sempre critico.

entries.original:
"The user strikes
three times in a row.
It always results in
a critical hit."
entries.translation_source: The user strikes three times in a row. It always results in a critical hit.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore colpisce
tre volte di fila. È
sempre un brutto colpo.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with psychic power.
It may leave the
target with frostbite."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with psychic power. It may leave the target with frostbite.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa attacca con
poteri psichici. Può
anche causare
assideramento al
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user delivers
a fierce kick that
lowers the target’s
defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The user delivers a fierce kick that lowers the target’s defense stat.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore sferra un
calcio violento che
abbassa la Difesa del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks with
intense, dark flames.
It may also make
the foe flinch."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with intense, dark flames. It may also make the foe flinch.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa attacca con
fiamme oscure e intense.
Può anche far tentennare
il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks with
psychic power that
removes 3 PP from
the foe’s last move."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with psychic power that removes 3 PP from the foe’s last move.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa attacca con
potere psichico che
sottrae 3 PP all{B4}ultima
mossa del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"A cage made of
electricity that traps
the target for four
to five turns."
entries.translation_source: A cage made of electricity that traps the target for four to five turns.
entries.translated:
Una gabbia di
elettricità che
intrappola il bersaglio
per quattro o cinque
turni.

entries.original:
"The higher the
user’s HP, the
more powerful this
attack becomes."
entries.translation_source: The higher the user’s HP, the more powerful this attack becomes.
entries.translated:
Più i PS
dell{B4}utilizzatore sono
alti, più questa mossa
diventa potente.

entries.original:
"A frightful amount of
small ghosts are sent
to attack opposing
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: A frightful amount of small ghosts are sent to attack opposing Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Un{B4}inquietante quantità
di piccoli fantasmi
viene inviata ad
attaccare i Pokémon
avversari.

entries.original:
"The user attacks by
hurling a blizzard-
cloaked icicle lance
at opposing Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard- cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa attacca
scagliando una lancia di
ghiaccio avvolta in una
tormenta contro i
Pokémon avversari.

entries.original:
"A slash that may
poison, paralyze, or
sleep the foe. It
has a high crit ratio."
entries.translation_source: A slash that may poison, paralyze, or sleep the foe. It has a high crit ratio.
entries.translated:
Un fendente che può
avvelenare, paralizzare
o addormentare il
bersaglio. Ha un{B4}alta
probabilità di brutto
colpo.

entries.original:
"The user slams into
the foe with psychic
energy. It raises the
user’s Defense too."
entries.translation_source: The user slams into the foe with psychic energy. It raises the user’s Defense too.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa si lancia
contro il bersaglio con
energia psichica.
Aumenta anche la Difesa
di chi la usa.

entries.original:
"The user swaps its
offensive and
defensive stats."
entries.translation_source: The user swaps its offensive and defensive stats.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore scambia
le proprie statistiche
offensive e difensive.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with
an axe that leaves
behind splinters. It
has a high crit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with an axe that leaves behind splinters. It has a high crit ratio.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da un{B4}ascia che
lascia schegge. Ha un
alto tasso di colpo
critico.

entries.original:
"After dealing damage,
the user raises the
higher stats of its
offenses or defenses."
entries.translation_source: After dealing damage, the user raises the higher stats of its offenses or defenses.
entries.translated:
Dopo aver inflitto
danni, chi la usa
aumenta la statistica
più alta tra le sue
statistiche offensive o
difensive.

entries.original:
"The user rampages
and spews vicious
flames for two to
three turns."
entries.translation_source: The user rampages and spews vicious flames for two to three turns.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore va in
escandescenze e sputa
fiamme feroci per due o
tre turni.

entries.original:
"The user slams into
the target, hurting
itself a little. This
move strikes first."
entries.translation_source: The user slams into the target, hurting itself a little. This move strikes first.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa si lancia
contro il bersaglio,
ferendo un po{B4} se
stesso. Questa mossa
colpisce per prima.

entries.original:
"The user launches its
amassed chlorophyll
at the foe. This also
hurts the user."
entries.translation_source: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll at the foe. This also hurts the user.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa lancia la
clorofilla accumulata
contro il bersaglio.
Danneggia anche chi la
usa.

entries.original:
"The user hurls giant
chunks of ice at
the foe that may
cause it to flinch."
entries.translation_source: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the foe that may cause it to flinch.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore scaglia
enormi blocchi di
ghiaccio contro il
bersaglio, che potrebbe
tentennare.

entries.original:
"The user dances to
usher in victory.
This raises Attack,
Defense, and Speed."
entries.translation_source: The user dances to usher in victory. This raises Attack, Defense, and Speed.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa danza per
annunciare la vittoria.
Aumenta Attacco, Difesa
e Velocità.

entries.original:
"The user smashes into
the foe. This cuts
the user’s Defense
and Sp. Def stats."
entries.translation_source: The user smashes into the foe. This cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa si schianta
contro il bersaglio.
Questo riduce le
statistiche Difesa e
Dif. Sp. di chi la usa.

entries.original:
"Barbs that may poison
are shot at the foe.
Its power doubles if
the foe is poisoned."
entries.translation_source: Barbs that may poison are shot at the foe. Its power doubles if the foe is poisoned.
entries.translated:
Dardi appuntiti che
possono avvelenare
vengono scagliati contro
il nemico. La potenza
raddoppia se il nemico è
avvelenato.

entries.original:
"The foe is slashed
with wings of light.
This goes first and
has a high crit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is slashed with wings of light. This goes first and has a high crit ratio.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
squarciato da ali di
luce. Colpisce per primo
e ha un alto tasso di
colpo critico.

entries.original:
"The user attacks and
may inflict the foe
with frostbite. Its
power doubles if the
foe has frostbite."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks and may inflict the foe with frostbite. Its power doubles if the foe has frostbite.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon attacca e può
infliggere assideramento
al nemico. La potenza
raddoppia se il nemico è
assiderato.

entries.original:
"The user makes its
skin iron-hard to
raise its Defense
and its Speed."
entries.translation_source: The user makes its skin iron-hard to raise its Defense and its Speed.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore rende la
propria pelle dura come
il ferro per aumentare
la sua Difesa e la sua
Velocità.

entries.original:
"The foe is shot with
arrows that raise the
crit ratio and lower
the foe’s Defense."
entries.translation_source: The foe is shot with arrows that raise the crit ratio and lower the foe’s Defense.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio viene
colpito da frecce che
aumentano il tasso di
colpo critico e
abbassano la Difesa del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Myriad fireballs that
may burn hit the foe.
Its power doubles if
the foe is burned."
entries.translation_source: Myriad fireballs that may burn hit the foe. Its power doubles if the foe is burned.
entries.translated:
Miriadi di sfere di
fuoco che possono
bruciare colpiscono il
bersaglio. La loro
potenza raddoppia se il
bersaglio è bruciato.

entries.original:
"The foe is slashed.
This leaves behind
splinters. It has a
high crit ratio."
entries.translation_source: The foe is slashed. This leaves behind splinters. It has a high crit ratio.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito
con un fendente. Lascia
schegge dietro di sé. Ha
un{B4}alta probabilità di
brutto colpo.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with savagely cold
winds. This may
cause a frostbite."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with savagely cold winds. This may cause a frostbite.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
con venti gelidi e
feroci. Può causare
assideramento.

entries.original:
"The user savagely
attacks with wind
and lightning. This
may cause paralysis."
entries.translation_source: The user savagely attacks with wind and lightning. This may cause paralysis.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa attacca
selvaggiamente con vento
e fulmini. Può anche
paralizzare il
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with fierce winds
and hot sand. This
may cause a burn."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with fierce winds and hot sand. This may cause a burn.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
con venti furiosi e
sabbia rovente. Può
causare ustione.

entries.original:
"The user attacks
with love and hate.
The effects depend
on the user’s form."
entries.translation_source: The user attacks with love and hate. The effects depend on the user’s form.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore attacca
con amore e odio. Gli
effetti dipendono dalla
sua forma.

entries.original:
"The user heals its
own statuses and
restores HP. It also
raises evasiveness."
entries.translation_source: The user heals its own statuses and restores HP. It also raises evasiveness.
entries.translated:
Chi la usa cura le
proprie alterazioni di
stato e recupera PS.
Aumenta anche la sua
evasione.

entries.original:
"The user heals its
own statuses and
raises its Sp. Atk
and Sp. Def."
entries.translation_source: The user heals its own statuses and raises its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore cura le
proprie condizioni
alterate e aumenta
l{B4}Attacco Speciale e la
Difesa Speciale.

entries.original:
"Enables the user to
evade all attacks.
It may fail if used
in succession."
entries.translation_source: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.
entries.translated:
Permette
all{B4}utilizzatore di
schivare tutti gli
attacchi. Può fallire se
usata in successione.

entries.original:
"Normal-Type Dynamax
move. It lowers
the target’s Speed
stat."
entries.translation_source: Normal-Type Dynamax move. It lowers the target’s Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Normale. Riduce la
Velocità del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Fighting Dynamax
move. It raises
ally Pokémon’s
Attack stats."
entries.translation_source: Fighting Dynamax move. It raises ally Pokémon’s Attack stats.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Lotta. Aumenta le
statistiche di Attacco
dei Pokémon alleati.

entries.original:
"Flying-Type Dynamax
move. It raises
ally Pokémon’s
Speed stats."
entries.translation_source: Flying-Type Dynamax move. It raises ally Pokémon’s Speed stats.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Volante. Aumenta le
statistiche di Velocità
dei Pokémon alleati.

entries.original:
"Poison-Type Dynamax
move. It raises
ally Pokémon’s
Sp. Atk stats."
entries.translation_source: Poison-Type Dynamax move. It raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stats.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Veleno. Aumenta le
statistiche di Attacco
Speciale dei Pokémon
alleati.

entries.original:
"Ground-Type Dynamax
move. It raises
ally Pokémon’s
Sp. Def stats."
entries.translation_source: Ground-Type Dynamax move. It raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Def stats.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Terra. Aumenta le
statistiche di Difesa
Speciale dei Pokémon
alleati.

entries.original:
"Rock-Type Dynamax
move. It summons
a sandstorm that
lasts five turns."
entries.translation_source: Rock-Type Dynamax move. It summons a sandstorm that lasts five turns.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Roccia. Evoca una
tempesta di sabbia che
dura cinque turni.

entries.original:
"Bug-Type Dynamax
move. It lowers
the target’s
Sp. Atk stat."
entries.translation_source: Bug-Type Dynamax move. It lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Coleottero. Riduce
l{B4}Att. Sp. del
bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Ghost-Type Dynamax
move. It lowers
the target’s
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: Ghost-Type Dynamax move. It lowers the target’s Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Spettro. Riduce la
Difesa del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Steel-Type Dynamax
move. It raises
ally Pokémon’s
Defense stats."
entries.translation_source: Steel-Type Dynamax move. It raises ally Pokémon’s Defense stats.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Acciaio. Aumenta la
Difesa dei Pokémon
alleati.

entries.original:
"Fire-Type Dynamax
move. It causes the
sun to intensify
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: Fire-Type Dynamax move. It causes the sun to intensify for five turns.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Fuoco. Fa intensificare
il sole per cinque
turni.

entries.original:
"Water-Type Dynamax
move. It summons
rain that falls
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: Water-Type Dynamax move. It summons rain that falls for five turns.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Acqua. Evoca la pioggia
per cinque turni.

entries.original:
"Grass-Type Dynamax
move. It activates
Grassy Terrain for
five turns."
entries.translation_source: Grass-Type Dynamax move. It activates Grassy Terrain for five turns.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Erba. Attiva il Terreno
Erboso per cinque turni.

entries.original:
"Electric Dynamax
move. It activates
Electric Terrain
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: Electric Dynamax move. It activates Electric Terrain for five turns.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Elettro. Attiva il
Terreno Elettrico per
cinque turni.

entries.original:
"Psychic Dynamax
move. It activates
Psychic Terrain
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: Psychic Dynamax move. It activates Psychic Terrain for five turns.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Psico. Attiva il Terreno
Psichico per cinque
turni.

entries.original:
"Ice-Type Dynamax
move. It summons
a hailstorm for
five turns."
entries.translation_source: Ice-Type Dynamax move. It summons a hailstorm for five turns.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Ghiaccio. Invoca una
grandinata per cinque
turni.

entries.original:
"Dragon-Type Dynamax
move. It lowers
the target’s Attack
stat."
entries.translation_source: Dragon-Type Dynamax move. It lowers the target’s Attack stat.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
ड्रago. Riduce l{B4}Attacco
del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Dark-Type Dynamax
move. It lowers
the target’s
Sp. Def stat."
entries.translation_source: Dark-Type Dynamax move. It lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Buio. Riduce la Dif. Sp.
del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Fairy-Type Dynamax
move. It activates
Misty Terrain for
five turns."
entries.translation_source: Fairy-Type Dynamax move. It activates Misty Terrain for five turns.
entries.translated:
Mossa Dynamax di tipo
Folletto. Attiva il
Terreno Nebbioso per
cinque turni.

entries.original:
"G-Max Venusaur’s
signature move. It
deals damage for
four turns."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Venusaur’s signature move. It deals damage for four turns.
entries.translated:
La mossa esclusiva di
G-Max Venusaur. Infligge
danni per quattro turni.

entries.original:
"G-Max Charizard’s
signature move. It
deals damage for
four turns."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Charizard’s signature move. It deals damage for four turns.
entries.translated:
La mossa distintiva di
G-Max Charizard.
Infligge danni per
quattro turni.

entries.original:
"G-Max Blastoise’s
signature move. It
deals damage for
four turns."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Blastoise’s signature move. It deals damage for four turns.
entries.translated:
La mossa distintiva di
G-Max Blastoise.
Infligge danni per
quattro turni.

entries.original:
"G-Max Butterfree’s
signature move. It
causes paralysis,
sleep, or poison."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Butterfree’s signature move. It causes paralysis, sleep, or poison.
entries.translated:
La mossa esclusiva
Gigamax di Butterfree.
Causa paralisi, sonno o
avvelenamento.

entries.original:
"G-Max Pikachu’s
signature move.
It paralyzes the
target."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Pikachu’s signature move. It paralyzes the target.
entries.translated:
Mossa distintiva di
Pikachu Gigamax.
Paralizza il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"G-Max Meowth’s
signature move. It
confuses the foe
and creates money."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Meowth’s signature move. It confuses the foe and creates money.
entries.translated:
La mossa distintiva di
G-Max Meowth. Confonde
il nemico e crea denaro.

entries.original:
"G-Max Machamp’s
signature move. It
raises the chance
of critical hits."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Machamp’s signature move. It raises the chance of critical hits.
entries.translated:
La mossa distintiva di
G-Max Machamp. Aumenta
la probabilità di brutti
colpi.

entries.original:
"G-Max Gengar’s
signature move. It
prevents the foe
from escaping."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Gengar’s signature move. It prevents the foe from escaping.
entries.translated:
La mossa distintiva di
G-Max Gengar. Impedisce
al nemico di fuggire.

entries.original:
"G-Max Kingler’s
signature move. It
harshly lowers the
target’s Speed."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Kingler’s signature move. It harshly lowers the target’s Speed.
entries.translated:
La mossa distintiva di
G-Max Kingler. Riduce
drasticamente la
Velocità del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"G-Max Lapras’s
signature move. It
reduces damage
for five turns."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Lapras’s signature move. It reduces damage for five turns.
entries.translated:
La mossa esclusiva di
G-Max Lapras. Riduce i
danni per cinque turni.

entries.original:
"G-Max Eevee’s
signature move.
It infatuates
the target."
entries.translation_source: G-Max Eevee’s signature move. It infatuates the target.
entries.translated:
Mossa distintiva di
Eevee Gigamax. Rende il
bersaglio infatuato.

entries.original:
"G-Max Snorlax’s
signature move. It
restores Berries

flower and catching the sun’s rays, it
fills its body with power."
entries.translation_source: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun’s rays, it fills its body with power.
entries.translated: Stendendo gli ampi petali del suo fiore e catturando i raggi del sole, riempie il suo corpo di energia.

entries.original:
"The flame on its tail shows the strength
of its life force. If it is weak, the
flame also burns weakly."
entries.translation_source: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force. If it is weak, the flame also burns weakly.
entries.translated: La fiamma sulla coda mostra la forza vitale. Se è debole, anche la fiamma brucia debolmente.

entries.original:
"It is very hot-headed by nature, so it
constantly seeks opponents. It calms
down only when it wins."
entries.translation_source: It is very hot-headed by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.
entries.translated: Per natura è molto impulsivo, quindi cerca continuamente avversari. Si calma solo quando vince.

entries.original:
"Breathing intense, hot flames, it can
melt almost anything. Its breath inflicts
terrible pain on enemies."
entries.translation_source: Breathing intense, hot flames, it can melt almost anything. Its breath inflicts terrible pain on enemies.
entries.translated: Respirando fiamme intense e roventi, può sciogliere quasi qualsiasi cosa. Il suo alito infligge terribili dolori ai nemici.

entries.original:
"The shell, which hardens soon after
it is born, is resilient. If you poke it,
it will bounce back out."
entries.translation_source: The shell, which hardens soon after it is born, is resilient. If you poke it, it will bounce back out.
entries.translated: Il guscio, che si indurisce subito dopo la nascita, è resistente. Se lo tocchi, rimbalzerà verso l{B4}esterno.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon is very popular among
older people as its fur-covered tail is
a symbol of its longevity."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon is very popular among older people as its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon è molto popolare tra le persone anziane, poiché la sua coda ricoperta di pelliccia è simbolo di longevità.

entries.original:
"The rocket cannons on its shell fire
jets of water capable of punching holes
through thick steel."
entries.translation_source: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.
entries.translated: I cannoni a razzo sul suo guscio sparano getti d{B4}acqua capaci di perforare spesse lamiere d{B4}acciaio.

entries.original:
"Its feet have suction cups designed
to stick to any surface. It tenaciously
climbs trees to forage."
entries.translation_source: Its feet have suction cups designed to stick to any surface. It tenaciously climbs trees to forage.
entries.translated: I suoi piedi hanno ventose progettate per aderire a qualsiasi superficie. Si arrampica tenacemente sugli alberi per cercare cibo.

entries.original:
"It prepares for evolution by hardening
its shell as much as possible to protect
its soft body."
entries.translation_source: It prepares for evolution by hardening its shell as much as possible to protect its soft body.
entries.translated: Si prepara all{B4}evoluzione indurendo il più possibile il guscio per proteggere il suo corpo morbido.

entries.original:
"Water-repellent powder on its wings
enables it to collect honey, even in
the heaviest of rains."
entries.translation_source: Water-repellent powder on its wings enables it to collect honey, even in the heaviest of rains.
entries.translated: La polvere idrorepellente sulle sue ali gli consente di raccogliere miele, anche sotto i più forti acquazzoni.

entries.original:
"Its poison stinger is very powerful.
Its bright-colored body is intended
to warn off its enemies."
entries.translation_source: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.
entries.translated: Il suo pungiglione velenoso è molto potente. Il suo corpo dai colori vivaci serve a mettere in guardia i nemici.

entries.original:
"Although it is a cocoon, it can move
a little. It can extend its poison barb
if it is attacked."
entries.translation_source: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.
entries.translated: Anche se è un bozzolo, può muoversi un po{B4}. Può estendere il suo pungiglione velenoso se viene attaccato.

entries.original:
"It can take down any opponent with
its powerful poison stingers.
It sometimes attacks in swarms."
entries.translation_source: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.
entries.translated: Può mettere al tappeto qualunque avversario con i suoi potenti pungiglioni velenosi. A volte attacca in sciame.

entries.original:
"Common in grassy areas and forests,
it is very docile and will chase off
enemies by flapping up sand."
entries.translation_source: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.
entries.translated: Comune nelle zone erbose e nelle foreste, è molto docile e scaccia i nemici sollevando sabbia con un battito d{B4}ali.

entries.original:
"It flies over its wide territory in
search of prey, downing it with its
highly developed claws."
entries.translation_source: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
entries.translated: Sorvola il suo vasto territorio alla ricerca di prede, abbattendole con i suoi artigli altamente sviluppati.

entries.original:
"By flapping its wings with all its might,
Pidgeot can make a gust of wind
capable of bending tall trees."
entries.translation_source: By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
entries.translated: Sbattendo le ali con tutte le sue forze, Pidgeot può generare una raffica di vento capace di piegare gli alberi più alti.

entries.original:
"Living wherever there is food available,
it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles
the entire day."
entries.translation_source: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.
entries.translated: Vive ovunque sia disponibile del cibo e passa l{B4}intera giornata a rovistare senza sosta in cerca di nutrimento.

entries.original:
"Its rear feet have three toes each.
They are webbed, enabling it to swim
across rivers."
entries.translation_source: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.
entries.translated: Le zampe posteriori hanno tre dita ciascuna. Sono palmate, consentendogli di nuotare attraverso i fiumi.

entries.original:
"It flaps its short wings to flush out
insects from tall grass. It then plucks
them with its stubby beak."
entries.translation_source: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.
entries.translated: Batte le sue corte ali per far uscire gli insetti dall{B4}erba alta. Poi li afferra con il suo becco tozzo.

entries.original:
"It shoots itself suddenly high into the
sky, then plummets down in one fell
swoop to strike its prey."
entries.translation_source: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.
entries.translated: Si lancia all{B4}improvviso in alto nel cielo, poi piomba giù in un solo colpo per colpire la preda.

entries.original:
"It can freely detach its jaw to swallow
large prey whole. It can become too
heavy to move, however."
entries.translation_source: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can become too heavy to move, however.
entries.translated: Può staccare liberamente la mascella per inghiottire intere prede di grandi dimensioni. Tuttavia, può diventare troppo pesante per muoversi.

entries.original:
"To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest
wide and makes eerie sounds by expelling
air from its mouth."
entries.translation_source: To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest wide and makes eerie sounds by expelling air from its mouth.
entries.translated: Per intimidire i nemici, allarga il petto e produce suoni inquietanti espellendo aria dalla bocca.

entries.original:
"It has small electric sacs on both its
cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric
charges from the sacs."
entries.translation_source: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.
entries.translated: Ha piccole sacche elettriche su entrambe le guance. Se minacciato, sprigiona scariche elettriche da queste sacche.

entries.original:
"When its electricity builds, its muscles
are stimulated, and it becomes more
aggressive than usual."
entries.translation_source: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.
entries.translated: Quando la sua elettricità si accumula, i suoi muscoli vengono stimolati e diventa più aggressivo del solito.

entries.original:
"It burrows and lives underground.
If threatened, it curls itself up into a
ball for protection."
entries.translation_source: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.
entries.translated: Scava gallerie e vive sottoterra. Se viene minacciato, si raggomitola in una palla per proteggersi.

entries.original:
"It is adept at attacking with the spines
on its back and its sharp claws while
quickly scurrying about."
entries.translation_source: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.
entries.translated: È abile ad attaccare con le spine sul dorso e gli artigli affilati mentre si muove rapidamente.

entries.original:
"The poison hidden in its small horn is
extremely potent. Even a tiny scratch
can have fatal results."
entries.translation_source: The poison hidden in its small horn is extremely potent. Even a tiny scratch can have fatal results.
entries.translated: Il veleno nascosto nel suo piccolo corno è estremamente potente. Anche un minuscolo graffio può avere conseguenze fatali.

entries.original:
"It has a calm and caring nature.
Because its horn grows slowly, it
prefers not to fight."
entries.translation_source: It has a calm and caring nature. Because its horn grows slowly, it prefers not to fight.
entries.translated: Ha un{B4}indole calma e premurosa. Poiché il suo corno cresce lentamente, preferisce non combattere.

entries.original:
"It uses its scaly rugged body to seal
the entrance of its nest and protect
its young from predators."
entries.translation_source: It uses its scaly rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.
entries.translated: Usa il suo corpo squamoso e ruvido per sigillare l{B4}ingresso del nido e proteggere i piccoli dai predatori.

entries.original:
"It scans its surroundings by raising
its ears out of the grass. It will strike
first if it senses any danger."
entries.translation_source: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. It will strike first if it senses any danger.
entries.translated: Esamina ciò che lo circonda sollevando le orecchie dall{B4}erba. Colpirà per primo se avverte un pericolo.

entries.original:
"Quick to anger, it stabs enemies with
its horn to inject a powerful poison
when it becomes agitated."
entries.translation_source: Quick to anger, it stabs enemies with its horn to inject a powerful poison when it becomes agitated.
entries.translated: Si arrabbia facilmente e, quando si agita, trafigge i nemici con il suo corno per iniettare un potente veleno.

entries.original:
"It swings its big tail around during
battle. If its foe flinches, it will
charge with its sturdy body."
entries.translation_source: It swings its big tail around during battle. If its foe flinches, it will charge with its sturdy body.
entries.translated: Fa roteare la sua grande coda durante la lotta. Se il nemico trasale, carica con il suo corpo robusto.

entries.original:
"Its adorable behavior and cry make it
highly popular. However, this cute
Pokémon is rarely found."
entries.translation_source: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.
entries.translated: Il suo comportamento adorabile e il suo verso lo rendono molto popolare. Tuttavia, questo grazioso Pokémon è raro da trovare.

entries.original:
"With its acute hearing, it can pick up
sounds from far away. It usually hides
in quiet places."
entries.translation_source: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.
entries.translated: Grazie al suo udito finissimo, riesce a percepire suoni da molto lontano. Di solito si nasconde in luoghi tranquilli.

entries.original:
"While young, it has six gorgeous tails.
When it grows, several new tails are
sprouted."
entries.translation_source: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
entries.translated: Da piccolo ha sei splendide code. Quando cresce, ne spuntano diverse altre.

entries.original:
"Some legends claim that each of its
nine tails has its own unique type of
special mystic power."
entries.translation_source: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystic power.
entries.translated: Alcune leggende sostengono che ciascuna delle sue nove code abbia un proprio tipo unico di potere mistico speciale.

entries.original:
"It captivates foes with its huge, round
eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing
a soothing melody."
entries.translation_source: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.
entries.translated: Ipotizza i nemici con i suoi grandi occhi tondi, poi li culla nel sonno cantando una melodia rilassante.

entries.original:
"Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and
supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur
conveys an image of luxury."
entries.translation_source: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.
entries.translated: La sua pelliccia è estremamente fine, fitta e morbida. La pelliccia, squisitamente piacevole, trasmette un{B4}immagine di lusso.

entries.original:
"It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on
its ultrasonic cries for echo location to
flit about in darkness."
entries.translation_source: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.
entries.translated: Non ha occhi. Si affida invece ai suoi richiami a ultrasuoni per l{B4}ecolocalizzazione, così da svolazzare nel buio.

entries.original:
"It can drink more than 10 ounces of
blood at once. If it has too much, it
gets heavy and flies clumsily."
entries.translation_source: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.
entries.translated: Può bere più di 10 once di sangue in una volta sola. Se ne assume troppo, diventa pesante e vola in modo impacciato.

entries.original:
"Its scientific name is \qoOddium Wanderus.\qc
At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000
feet on its two roots."
entries.translation_source: Its scientific name is [quote-open-1]Oddium Wanderus.[quote-close-2] At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.
entries.translated: Il suo nome scientifico è \qoOddium Wanderus.\qc Di notte, si dice che cammini per quasi 300 metri sulle sue due radici.

entries.original:
"What appears to be drool is actually
sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings
stubbornly if touched."
entries.translation_source: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
entries.translated: Quella che sembra bava è in realtà miele dolce. È molto appiccicoso e, se toccato, si attacca ostinatamente.

entries.original:
"It has the world’s largest petals.
With every step, the petals shake out
heavy clouds of toxic pollen."
entries.translation_source: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.
entries.translated: Ha i petali più grandi del mondo. A ogni passo, i petali sollevano pesanti nubi di polline tossico.

entries.original:
"It is doused with mushroom spores when
it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms
sprout from its back."
entries.translation_source: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.
entries.translated: Alla nascita viene ricoperto di spore di funghi. Man mano che il corpo cresce, dal dorso spuntano dei funghi.

entries.original:
"It stays mostly in dark, damp places.
The preference not of the bug, but of
the big mushrooms on its back."
entries.translation_source: It stays mostly in dark, damp places. The preference not of the bug, but of the big mushrooms on its back.
entries.translated: Rimane per lo più in luoghi bui e umidi. Questa preferenza non è dell{B4}insetto, ma dei grandi funghi sulla sua schiena.

entries.original:
"Its eyes also function as radar units.
It catches and eats small bugs that
hide in darkness."
entries.translation_source: Its eyes also function as radar units. It catches and eats small bugs that hide in darkness.
entries.translated: Anche i suoi occhi funzionano come radar. Cattura e mangia piccoli insetti che si nascondono nel buio.

entries.original:
"The wings are covered with dustlike
scales. Every time it flaps its wings,
it looses highly toxic dust."
entries.translation_source: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.
entries.translated: Le ali sono ricoperte di scaglie simili a polvere. Ogni volta che batte le ali, rilascia polvere altamente tossica.

entries.original:
"It burrows through the ground at a
shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in
its wake, making it easy to spot."
entries.translation_source: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
entries.translated: Scava sottoterra a poca profondità. Lascia dietro di sé terra smossa, rendendolo facile da individuare.

entries.original:
"Its three heads bob separately up and
down to loosen the soil nearby, making
it easier for it to burrow."
entries.translation_source: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.
entries.translated: Le sue tre teste si muovono su e giù separatamente per smuovere il terreno circostante, rendendo più facile scavare.

entries.original:
"It loves anything that shines.
It especially adores coins that it picks
up and secretly hoards."
entries.translation_source: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.
entries.translated: Ama qualunque cosa luccichi. Adora in particolare le monete che raccoglie e accumula segretamente.

entries.original:
"Many adore it for its sophisticated air.
However, it will lash out and scratch
for little reason."
entries.translation_source: Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.
entries.translated: Molti lo adorano per il suo portamento sofisticato. Tuttavia, si agita e graffia per un nonnulla.

entries.original:
"It is constantly wracked by a headache.
When the headache turns intense, it
begins using mysterious powers."
entries.translation_source: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
entries.translated: È costantemente tormentato da un forte mal di testa. Quando il dolore diventa intenso, inizia a usare misteriosi poteri.

entries.original:
"When it swims at full speed using its
long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow
begins to glow."
entries.translation_source: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.
entries.translated: Quando nuota a tutta velocità usando i suoi lunghi arti palmati, la fronte in qualche modo comincia a brillare.

entries.original:
"Light and agile on its feet, and
ferocious in temperament. When angered,
it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy."
entries.translation_source: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.
entries.translated: Leggero e agile nei movimenti, e feroce di temperamento. Quando si adira, cade in una frenesia incontrollabile.

entries.original:
"It grows angry if you see its eyes and
gets angrier if you run. If you beat it,
it gets even madder."
entries.translation_source: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
entries.translated: Si infuria se guardi i suoi occhi e si arrabbia ancora di più se scappi. Se lo sconfiggi, si arrabbia ancora di più.

entries.original:
"It is extremely loyal, it will fearlessly
bark at any opponent to protect its
own Trainer from harm."
entries.translation_source: It is extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.
entries.translated: È estremamente fedele e abbaierà senza paura a qualunque avversario per proteggere il proprio Allenatore da ogni pericolo.

entries.original:
"Its magnificent bark conveys a sense
of majesty. Anyone hearing it can’t help
but grovel before it."
entries.translation_source: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can’t help but grovel before it.
entries.translated: La sua magnifica voce trasmette un senso di maestosità. Chiunque la senta non può fare a meno di prostrarsi davanti a lui.

entries.original:
"Its skin is so thin, its internal organs
are visible. It has trouble walking on
its newly grown feet."
entries.translation_source: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
entries.translated: La sua pelle è così sottile che gli organi interni sono visibili. Fatica a camminare sulle zampe appena cresciute.

entries.original:
"The spiral pattern on its belly subtly
undulates. Staring at it gradually
causes drowsiness."
entries.translation_source: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
entries.translated: Il motivo a spirale sul suo ventre ondeggia leggermente. Fissarlo provoca gradualmente sonnolenza.

entries.original:
"It can use its well-developed arms and
legs to run on the surface of the water
for a split second."
entries.translation_source: It can use its well-developed arms and legs to run on the surface of the water for a split second.
entries.translated: Può usare le sue braccia e gambe ben sviluppate per correre sulla superficie dell{B4}acqua per un istante.

entries.original:
"It sleeps for 18 hours a day.
It uses a variety of extrasensory
powers even while asleep."
entries.translation_source: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.
entries.translated: Dorme 18 ore al giorno. Usa una varietà di poteri extrasensoriali anche mentre dorme.

entries.original:
"It stares at its silver spoon to
focus its mind. It emits more alpha
waves while doing so."
entries.translation_source: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
entries.translated: Fissa il suo cucchiaio d{B4}argento per concentrare la mente. Così emette più onde alfa.

entries.original:
"It does not like physical attacks very 
much. Instead, it freely uses extra-
sensory powers to defeat foes."
entries.translation_source: It does not like physical attacks very much. Instead, it freely uses extra- sensory powers to defeat foes.
entries.translated: Non ama molto gli attacchi fisici. Invece, usa liberamente i suoi poteri extrasensoriali per sconfiggere i nemici.

entries.original:
"Though small in stature, it is powerful
enough to easily heft and throw a
number of Geodude at once."
entries.translation_source: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.
entries.translated: Anche se di bassa statura, è abbastanza forte da sollevare e lanciare con facilità diversi Geodude tutti insieme.

entries.original:
"Its formidable body never gets tired.
It helps people by doing work such as
the moving of heavy goods."
entries.translation_source: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo formidabile non si stanca mai. Aiuta le persone svolgendo lavori come il trasporto di merci pesanti.

entries.original:
"It quickly swings its four arms to rock
its opponents with ceaseless punches
and chops from all angles."
entries.translation_source: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
entries.translated: Muove rapidamente le sue quattro braccia per mettere in difficoltà gli avversari con pugni e colpi di taglio incessanti da ogni angolazione.

entries.original:
"It plants its feet deep underground to
replenish water. It can’t escape its
enemies while it’s rooted."
entries.translation_source: It plants its feet deep underground to replenish water. It can’t escape its enemies while it’s rooted.
entries.translated: Pianta i piedi in profondità sottoterra per reintegrare l{B4}acqua. Non può sfuggire ai nemici mentre è radicato.

entries.original:
"The leafy parts act as cutters for
slashing foes. It spits a fluid that
dissolves everything."
entries.translation_source: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
entries.translated: Le parti fogliose fungono da lame per sferrare fendenti ai nemici. Sputa un fluido che dissolve tutto.

entries.original:
"Acid that has dissolved many prey
becomes sweeter, making it even
more effective at attracting prey."
entries.translation_source: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.
entries.translated: L{B4}acido che ha dissolto molte prede diventa più dolce, rendendolo ancora più efficace nell{B4}attirare le prede.

entries.original:
"It drifts aimlessly in the ocean.
It is very difficult to see in water,
it may not be noticed until it stings."
entries.translation_source: It drifts aimlessly in the ocean. It is very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.
entries.translated: Deriva senza meta nell{B4}oceano. È molto difficile da vedere in acqua: potrebbe non essere notato finché non punge.

entries.original:
"It has 80 tentacles that move about
freely. They can sting, causing poisoning
and sharp, stabbing pain."
entries.translation_source: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.
entries.translated: Ha 80 tentacoli che si muovono liberamente. Possono pungere, causando avvelenamento e un dolore acuto e lancinante.

entries.original:
"At rest, it looks just like a rock.
Carelessly stepping on it will make it
swing its fists angrily."
entries.translation_source: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.
entries.translated: A riposo, sembra proprio una roccia. Se qualcuno lo calpesta distrattamente, inizierà a sferrare pugni con rabbia.

entries.original:
"Be careful while hiking on mountain
trails. Graveler may come rolling down
the path without slowing."
entries.translation_source: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. Graveler may come rolling down the path without slowing.
entries.translated: Fai attenzione quando fai escursioni sui sentieri di montagna. Un Graveler potrebbe rotolare giù per il sentiero senza rallentare.

entries.original:
"It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as
rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin
once a year to grow larger."
entries.translation_source: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.
entries.translated: È racchiuso in un guscio duro, ruvido come lastre di roccia. Cambia pelle una volta all{B4}anno per crescere di più.

entries.original:
"It is a weak runner immediately after
birth. It gradually becomes faster by
chasing after its parents."
entries.translation_source: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.
entries.translated: Appena nato è un corridore debole. Diventa gradualmente più veloce inseguendo i suoi genitori.

entries.original:
"At full gallop, its four hooves barely
touch the ground because it moves
so incredibly fast."
entries.translation_source: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.
entries.translated: Al galoppo, i suoi quattro zoccoli sfiorano appena il terreno perché si muove a una velocità incredibile.

entries.original:
"It lazes vacantly near water.
If something bites its tail, it won’t
even notice for a whole day."
entries.translation_source: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.
entries.translated: Se ne sta senza meta vicino all{B4}acqua. Se qualcosa gli morde la coda, non se ne accorge nemmeno per un intero giorno.

entries.original:
"Though usually dim witted, it seems to
become inspired if the Shellder on its
tail bites down."
entries.translation_source: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.
entries.translated: Anche se di solito è un po{B4} ottuso, sembra ispirarsi se lo Shellder sulla sua coda morde forte.

entries.original:
"It moves while constantly hovering.
It discharges Thunder Wave and so on
from the units at its sides."
entries.translation_source: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.
entries.translated: Si muove restando costantemente sospeso in aria. Emette Tuononda e simili dalle unità ai suoi lati.

entries.original:
"A linked cluster formed of several
Magnemite. It discharges powerful
magnetic waves at high voltage."
entries.translation_source: A linked cluster formed of several Magnemite. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.
entries.translated: Un grappolo collegato formato da diversi Magnemite. Scarica potenti onde magnetiche ad alta tensione.

entries.original:
"It always walks about with a plant stalk
clamped in its beak. The stalk is used
for building its nest."
entries.translation_source: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.
entries.translated: Cammina sempre tenendo stretto nel becco un fusto di pianta. Il fusto viene usato per costruire il nido.

entries.original:
"By alternately raising and lowering its
two heads, it balances itself to be more
stable while running."
entries.translation_source: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.
entries.translated: Alternando il sollevamento e l{B4}abbassamento delle sue due teste, bilancia il corpo per essere più stabile mentre corre.

entries.original:
"If one of the heads gets to eat, the
others will be satisfied, too, and they
will stop squabbling."
entries.translation_source: If one of the heads gets to eat, the others will be satisfied, too, and they will stop squabbling.
entries.translated: Se una delle teste riesce a mangiare, anche le altre si sentiranno sazie e smetteranno di litigare.

entries.original:
"The colder it gets, the better it feels.
It joyfully swims around oceans so cold
that they are filled with floating ice."
entries.translation_source: The colder it gets, the better it feels. It joyfully swims around oceans so cold that they are filled with floating ice.
entries.translated: Più fa freddo, meglio si sente. Nuota felice negli oceani così freddi da essere pieni di ghiaccio alla deriva.

entries.original:
"Its streamlined body has little drag in
water. The colder the temperature,
the friskier it gets."
entries.translation_source: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo affusolato oppone poca resistenza nell{B4}acqua. Più bassa è la temperatura, più diventa vivace.

entries.original:
"As it moves, it loses bits of its body
from which new Grimer emerge. This
worsens the stench around it."
entries.translation_source: As it moves, it loses bits of its body from which new Grimer emerge. This worsens the stench around it.
entries.translated: Mentre si muove, perde frammenti del suo corpo dai quali emergono nuovi Grimer. Questo peggiora il tanfo che lo circonda.

entries.original:
"Its body is made of a powerful poison.
Touching it accidentally will cause a
fever that requires bed rest."
entries.translation_source: Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo è fatto di un potente veleno. Toccarlo per sbaglio provoca una febbre che richiede il riposo a letto.

entries.original:
"It is encased in a shell that is harder
than diamond. Inside, however, it is
surprisingly tender."
entries.translation_source: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.
entries.translated: È racchiuso in un guscio più duro del diamante. Tuttavia, all{B4}interno è sorprendentemente tenero.

entries.original:
"Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot
be shattered, even with a bomb. The
shell opens only when it is attacking."
entries.translation_source: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.
entries.translated: Il suo guscio è estremamente duro. Non può essere frantumato, nemmeno con una bomba. Il guscio si apre solo quando attacca.

entries.original:
"With its gas-like body, it can sneak into
any place it desires. However, it can
be blown away by wind."
entries.translation_source: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.
entries.translated: Con il suo corpo simile a gas, può infiltrarsi in qualsiasi luogo desideri. Tuttavia, il vento può portarlo via.

entries.original:
"In total darkness, where nothing is
visible, Haunter lurks, silently stalking
its next victim."
entries.translation_source: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, Haunter lurks, silently stalking its next victim.
entries.translated: Nel buio totale, dove non si vede nulla, Haunter si aggira, braccando in silenzio la sua prossima vittima.

entries.original:
"It steals heat from its surroundings.
If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain
that a Gengar has appeared."
entries.translation_source: It steals heat from its surroundings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a Gengar has appeared.
entries.translated: Ruba il calore dall{B4}ambiente circostante. Se senti un brivido improvviso, è certo che è apparso un Gengar.

entries.original:
"It twists and squirms through the ground.
The thunderous roar of its tunneling
echoes a long way."
entries.translation_source: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.
entries.translated: Si contorce e si dimena nel sottosuolo. Il fragoroso boato dei suoi cunicoli riecheggia molto lontano.

entries.original:
"It remembers every dream it eats.
It rarely eats the dreams of adults
because children’s are much tastier."
entries.translation_source: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.
entries.translated: Ricorda ogni sogno che mangia. Raramente mangia i sogni degli adulti perché quelli dei bambini sono molto più gustosi.

entries.original:
"Always holding a pendulum that it swings
at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness
in anyone nearby."
entries.translation_source: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.
entries.translated: Tiene sempre in mano un pendolo che fa oscillare a ritmo costante, inducendo sonnolenza in chiunque gli stia vicino.

entries.original:
"It can be found near the sea. The large
pincers grow back if they are torn out of
their sockets."
entries.translation_source: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.
entries.translated: Si trova vicino al mare. Le grandi chele ricrescono se vengono strappate via dalle loro cavità.

entries.original:
"It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown
pincer. The pincers size makes it difficult
to aim properly. "
entries.translation_source: It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown pincer. The pincers size makes it difficult to aim properly.
entries.translated: Riesce a malapena a sollevare la sua enorme chela cresciuta a dismisura. Le dimensioni delle chele rendono difficile mirare con precisione.

entries.original:
"A life-form whose identity is unknown.
It is said to Screech or suddenly
Selfdestruct."
entries.translation_source: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to Screech or suddenly Selfdestruct.
entries.translated: Una forma di vita la cui identità è sconosciuta. Si dice che usi Stridio o che si autodistrugga all{B4}improvviso.

entries.original:
"It explodes in response to even minor
stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname
of \qoThe Bomb Ball.\qc"
entries.translation_source: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of [quote-open-1]The Bomb Ball.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated: Esplode in risposta persino a stimoli minimi. È temuto, con il soprannome di \qoSfera Bomba.\qc

entries.original:
"Even though it appears to be eggs of
some sort, it was discovered to be a
life-form more like plant seeds."
entries.translation_source: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life-form more like plant seeds.
entries.translated: Anche se sembrano uova di qualche tipo, si è scoperto che sono una forma di vita più simile a semi di piante.

entries.original:
"Its three heads think independently.
However, they are friendly and never
appear to squabble."
entries.translation_source: Its three heads think independently. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.
entries.translated: Le sue tre teste pensano indipendentemente. Tuttavia, sono amichevoli e non sembrano mai litigare.

entries.original:
"If it is sad or lonely, the skull it
wears shakes, and it emits a plaintive
and mournful sound."
entries.translation_source: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes, and it emits a plaintive and mournful sound.
entries.translated: Se è triste o si sente solo, il teschio che indossa trema e emette un suono lamentoso e mesto.

entries.original:
"It collects bones from an unknown place.
Some whisper that a Marowak graveyard
exists somewhere in the world."
entries.translation_source: It collects bones from an unknown place. Some whisper that a Marowak graveyard exists somewhere in the world.
entries.translated: Raccoglie ossa da un luogo sconosciuto. Alcuni sussurrano che esista da qualche parte nel mondo un cimitero di Marowak.

entries.original:
"If it starts kicking repeatedly, both
legs will stretch even longer to
strike a fleeing foe."
entries.translation_source: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.
entries.translated: Se inizia a scalciare ripetutamente, entrambe le gambe si allungheranno ancora di più per colpire un nemico in fuga.

entries.original:
"To increase the strength of all its
punch moves, it spins its arms just
before making contact."
entries.translation_source: To increase the strength of all its punch moves, it spins its arms just before making contact.
entries.translated: Per aumentare la potenza di tutte le sue mosse di tipo Pugno, fa ruotare le braccia poco prima del contatto.

entries.original:
"Its tongue is twice the length of its
body. It can be moved like an arm for
grabbing food and attacking."
entries.translation_source: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.
entries.translated: La sua lingua è lunga il doppio del suo corpo. Può essere mossa come un braccio per afferrare il cibo e attaccare.

entries.original:
"The poisonous gases it contains are
a little bit lighter than air, keeping it
slightly airborne."
entries.translation_source: The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air, keeping it slightly airborne.
entries.translated: I gas velenosi che contiene sono leggermente più leggeri dell{B4}aria, e questo lo mantiene un po{B4} in volo.

entries.original:
"If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the
other one deflates. It constantly mixes
its poisonous gases."
entries.translation_source: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
entries.translated: Se uno dei due Koffing gemelli si gonfia, l{B4}altro si sgonfia. Mescola continuamente i suoi gas velenosi.

entries.original:
"It is inept at turning because of its
four short legs. It can only charge
and run in one direction."
entries.translation_source: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.
entries.translated: È impacciato quando deve girarsi a causa delle sue quattro zampe corte. Può solo caricare e correre in una sola direzione.

entries.original:
"Its brain developed when it began
walking on hind legs. Its thick hide
protects it even in magma."
entries.translation_source: Its brain developed when it began walking on hind legs. Its thick hide protects it even in magma.
entries.translated: Il suo cervello si è sviluppato quando ha cominciato a camminare sulle zampe posteriori. La sua spessa pelle lo protegge persino nel magma.

entries.original:
"A kindly Pokémon that lays highly
nutritious eggs and shares them with
injured Pokémon or people."
entries.translation_source: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon gentile che depone uova molto nutrienti e le condivide con i Pokémon o le persone ferite.

entries.original:
"The vines that cloak its entire body
are always jiggling. They effectively
unnerve its foes."
entries.translation_source: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively unnerve its foes.
entries.translated: Le liane che ricoprono tutto il suo corpo tremolano senza sosta. Questo destabilizza efficacemente i suoi nemici.

entries.original:
"If it is safe, the young gets out of the
belly pouch to play. The adult keeps
a close eye on the youngster."
entries.translation_source: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.
entries.translated: Se è al sicuro, il piccolo esce dal marsupio per giocare. L{B4}adulto lo sorveglia da vicino.

entries.original:
"It maintains balance using its tail, which
is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink
from its mouth."
entries.translation_source: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.
entries.translated: Mantiene l{B4}equilibrio usando la sua coda, avvolta a spirale. Può spruzzare inchiostro dalla bocca.

entries.original:
"An examination of its cells revealed the
presence of a gene not found in Horsea.
It became a hot topic."
entries.translation_source: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in Horsea. It became a hot topic.
entries.translated: L{B4}esame delle sue cellule ha rivelato la presenza di un gene non presente in Horsea. È diventato un argomento molto discusso.

entries.original:
"During spawning season, they swim
gracefully in the water, searching for
their perfect mate."
entries.translation_source: During spawning season, they swim gracefully in the water, searching for their perfect mate.
entries.translated: Durante la stagione della deposizione, nuotano con grazia nell{B4}acqua, in cerca del partner perfetto.

entries.original:
"The horn on its head is sharp like a
drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to
make its nest."
entries.translation_source: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.
entries.translated: Il corno sulla sua testa è affilato come un trapano. Fora un masso per farne il proprio nido.

entries.original:
"At night, the center of its body
slowly flickers with the same rhythm
as a human heartbeat."
entries.translation_source: At night, the center of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.
entries.translated: Di notte, il centro del suo corpo sfarfalla lentamente con lo stesso ritmo del battito cardiaco umano.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon has a geometric body.
Because of its body, the locals suspect
that it is an alien creature."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon ha un corpo geometrico. A causa del suo aspetto, gli abitanti del posto sospettano che sia una creatura aliena.

entries.original:
"A skilled mime from birth, it gains the
ability to create invisible objects as
it matures."
entries.translation_source: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisible objects as it matures.
entries.translated: Fin dalla nascita è un mimo abile; crescendo acquista la capacità di creare oggetti invisibili.

entries.original:
"When it moves, it leaves only a blur.
If it hides in grass, its protective
coloration makes it invisible."
entries.translation_source: When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its protective coloration makes it invisible.
entries.translated: Quando si muove, lascia solo una scia indistinta. Se si nasconde nell{B4}erba, la sua colorazione protettiva lo rende invisibile.

entries.original:
"It speaks a language similar to that of
humans. However, it seems to use
dancing to communicate."
entries.translation_source: It speaks a language similar to that of humans. However, it seems to use dancing to communicate.
