entries.translated: Parla una lingua simile a quella degli esseri umani. Tuttavia, sembra usare la danza per comunicare.

entries.original:
"It loves to feed on strong electricity.
It occasionally appears around large
power plants and so on."
entries.translation_source: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.
entries.translated: Ama nutrirsi di elettricità ad alta tensione. A volte compare nei pressi di grandi centrali elettriche e simili.

entries.original:
"The scorching fire exhaled by Magmar
forms heat waves around its body, making
it hard to see the Pokémon clearly."
entries.translation_source: The scorching fire exhaled by Magmar forms heat waves around its body, making it hard to see the Pokémon clearly.
entries.translated: Il fuoco rovente esalato da Magmar crea onde di calore attorno al suo corpo, rendendo difficile vedere chiaramente il Pokémon.

entries.original:
"It swings its long pincer horns wildly
to attack. During cold periods, it hides
deep in forests."
entries.translation_source: It swings its long pincer horns wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.
entries.translated: Brandisce con furia i suoi lunghi corni a pinza per attaccare. Durante i periodi freddi, si nasconde nelle profondità delle foreste.

entries.original:
"After heightening its will to fight by 
whipping itself with its three tails,
it charges at full speed."
entries.translation_source: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.
entries.translated: Dopo aver rafforzato la propria volontà di combattere frustandosi con le sue tre code, si lancia a tutta velocità.

entries.original:
"This weak and pathetic Pokémon gets
easily pushed along rivers when there
are strong currents."
entries.translation_source: This weak and pathetic Pokémon gets easily pushed along rivers when there are strong currents.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon debole e patetico viene facilmente trascinato lungo i fiumi quando le correnti sono forti.

entries.original:
"Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados
will burn everything down, even in a
harsh storm."
entries.translation_source: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
entries.translated: Quando inizia a infuriare, un Gyarados metterà tutto a ferro e fuoco, anche in una tempesta violenta.

entries.original:
"It ferries people across the sea on
its back. It may sing an enchanting
cry if it is in a good mood."
entries.translation_source: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.
entries.translated: Traghetta le persone attraverso il mare sulla sua schiena. Se è di buon umore, può cantare un verso incantevole.

entries.original:
"Its transformation ability is perfect.
However, if made to laugh, it can’t
maintain its disguise."
entries.translation_source: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can’t maintain its disguise.
entries.translated: La sua capacità di trasformazione è perfetta. Tuttavia, se viene fatto ridere, non riesce a mantenere il travestimento.

entries.original:
"An extremely rare Pokémon that may
evolve in a number of different ways
depending on stimuli."
entries.translation_source: An extremely rare Pokémon that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon estremamente raro che può evolversi in vari modi a seconda degli stimoli.

entries.original:
"Its cell composition is similar to water
molecules. As a result, it can’t be seen
when it melts away into water."
entries.translation_source: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can’t be seen when it melts away into water.
entries.translated: La composizione delle sue cellule è simile a quella delle molecole d{B4}acqua. Di conseguenza, quando si scioglie nell{B4}acqua, non può essere visto.

entries.original:
"Every hair on its body starts to stand
sharply on end if it becomes charged
with electricity."
entries.translation_source: Every hair on its body starts to stand sharply on end if it becomes charged with electricity.
entries.translated: Ogni pelo del suo corpo si rizza di colpo se si carica di elettricità.

entries.original:
"It fluffs out its fur collar to cool
down its body temperature, which can
reach 1,650 degrees."
entries.translation_source: It fluffs out its fur collar to cool down its body temperature, which can reach 1,650 degrees.
entries.translated: Rizza il collare di pelo per abbassare la temperatura del corpo, che può raggiungere i 1.650 gradi.

entries.original:
"Using the most advanced technologies,
scientists finally succeeded in making
the first artificial Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial Pokémon.
entries.translated: Usando le tecnologie più avanzate, gli scienziati sono finalmente riusciti a creare il primo Pokémon artificiale.

entries.original:
"In prehistoric times, it swam on the
sea floor, eating plankton. Its fossils
are sometimes found."
entries.translation_source: In prehistoric times, it swam on the sea floor, eating plankton. Its fossils are sometimes found.
entries.translated: In tempi preistorici nuotava sul fondale marino nutrendosi di plancton. I suoi fossili vengono talvolta ritrovati.

entries.original:
"Despite having strong fangs and
tentacles, it went extinct when its heavy
shell made it unable to catch prey."
entries.translation_source: Despite having strong fangs and tentacles, it went extinct when its heavy shell made it unable to catch prey.
entries.translated: Nonostante le potenti zanne e i tentacoli, si è estinto quando il suo pesante guscio lo ha reso incapace di catturare le prede.

entries.original:
"On rare occasions, some have been
found as fossils which they became
while hiding on the ocean floor."
entries.translation_source: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.
entries.translated: In rare occasioni ne sono stati ritrovati alcuni come fossili, formatisi mentre si nascondevano sul fondo dell{B4}oceano.

entries.original:
"In the water, it tucks in its limbs to
become more compact, then it wiggles
its shell to swim fast."
entries.translation_source: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.
entries.translated: In acqua, ritrae gli arti per diventare più compatto, poi muove il guscio per nuotare velocemente.

entries.original:
"A vicious Pokémon from the distant past,
it appears to have flown by spreading
its wings and gliding."
entries.translation_source: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon feroce di un passato remoto; sembra che volasse spiegando le ali e planando.

entries.original:
"When its belly is full, it becomes too
lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is
safe to bounce on its belly."
entries.translation_source: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.
entries.translated: Quando ha la pancia piena, diventa troppo letargico perfino per alzare un dito, quindi è sicuro rimbalzare sulla sua pancia.

entries.original:
"The magnificent seemingly translucent
wings of this legendary bird Pokémon
are said to be made of ice."
entries.translation_source: The magnificent seemingly translucent wings of this legendary bird Pokémon are said to be made of ice.
entries.translated: Si dice che le magnifiche ali apparentemente traslucide di questo Pokémon uccello leggendario siano fatte di ghiaccio.

entries.original:
"This legendary bird Pokémon causes
savage thunderstorms by flapping its
glittering wings."
entries.translation_source: This legendary bird Pokémon causes savage thunderstorms by flapping its glittering wings.
entries.translated: Questo leggendario Pokémon uccello provoca violenti temporali sbattendo le sue ali scintillanti.

entries.original:
"This legendary Pokémon scatters
embers with every flap of its wings.
It is a thrilling sight to behold."
entries.translation_source: This legendary Pokémon scatters embers with every flap of its wings. It is a thrilling sight to behold.
entries.translated: Ogni battito d{B4}ali di questo Pokémon leggendario disperde faville. È uno spettacolo entusiasmante da ammirare.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon is full of life energy.
It continually sheds its skin and grows
steadily larger."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon è pieno di energia vitale. Perde continuamente la pelle e cresce costantemente di dimensioni.

entries.original:
"They say that if it emits an aura from
its whole body, the weather will begin
to change instantly."
entries.translation_source: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.
entries.translated: Si dice che, se emette un{B4}aura da tutto il corpo, il clima inizi a cambiare all{B4}istante.

entries.original:
"This marine Pokémon has an impressive
build that lets it freely fly over raging
seas without trouble."
entries.translation_source: This marine Pokémon has an impressive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon marino ha una corporatura impressionante che gli permette di volare liberamente sopra i mari in tempesta senza difficoltà.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon whose genetic code was
repeatedly recombined for research.
It turned vicious as a result."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon whose genetic code was repeatedly recombined for research. It turned vicious as a result.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon il cui codice genetico è stato ricombinato ripetutamente per la ricerca. Ne è risultato più feroce.

entries.original:
"Because it can use all kinds of moves,
many scientists believe Mew to be the
ancestor of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.
entries.translated: Poiché può usare ogni tipo di mossa, molti scienziati credono che Mew sia l{B4}antenato dei Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A sweet aroma gently wafts from the
leaf on its head. It is docile and loves
to soak up the sun’s rays."
entries.translation_source: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun’s rays.
entries.translated: Un dolce aroma si diffonde delicatamente dalla foglia sulla sua testa. È docile e adora assorbire i raggi del sole.

entries.original:
"A spicy aroma emanates from around
its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant
to restore health."
entries.translation_source: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.
entries.translated: Un aroma piccante emana dalla zona attorno al suo collo. L{B4}aroma agisce come stimolante per ripristinare la salute.

entries.original:
"Meganium’s breath has the power to
revive dead grass and plants. It can
make them healthy again."
entries.translation_source: Meganium’s breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.
entries.translated: Il respiro di Meganium ha il potere di far rinascere l{B4}erba e le piante morte. Può restituire loro la salute.

entries.original:
"It is timid, and always curls itself up
in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its
back for protection."
entries.translation_source: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
entries.translated: È timido e si raggomitola sempre in una palla. Se viene attaccato, fa rizzare il dorso per proteggersi.

entries.original:
"Before battle, it turns its back on
its opponent to demonstrate how
ferociously its fire blazes."
entries.translation_source: Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.
entries.translated: Prima della lotta, volta le spalle all{B4}avversario per mostrare quanto ferocemente arda il suo fuoco.

entries.original:
"If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot
that anything that touches it will
instantly go up in flames."
entries.translation_source: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.
entries.translated: Quando la sua ira raggiunge l{B4}apice, diventa così caldo che qualsiasi cosa lo tocchi prenderà fuoco all{B4}istante.

entries.original:
"This rough critter chomps at any
moving object it sees. Turning your
back on it is not recommended."
entries.translation_source: This rough critter chomps at any moving object it sees. Turning your back on it is not recommended.
entries.translated: Questo rozzo animaletto azzanna qualsiasi oggetto in movimento che vede. Voltargli le spalle non è consigliato.

entries.original:
"It opens its huge jaws wide when
attacking. If it loses any fangs while
biting, they grow back in."
entries.translation_source: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.
entries.translated: Quando attacca spalanca le sue enormi fauci. Se perde qualche zanna mentre morde, gli ricresce.

entries.original:
"Although it has a massive body, its
powerful hind legs enable it to move
quickly, even on the ground."
entries.translation_source: Although it has a massive body, its powerful hind legs enable it to move quickly, even on the ground.
entries.translated: Pur avendo un corpo massiccio, le sue potenti zampe posteriori gli permettono di muoversi velocemente, anche a terra.

entries.original:
"It stands on its tail so it can see a
long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries
loudly to warn its kind."
entries.translation_source: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.
entries.translated: Si regge sulla coda per vedere molto lontano. Se avvista un nemico, lancia forti richiami per avvertire i suoi simili.

entries.original:
"It lives in narrow burrows that fit its
slim body. The deeper the nests go,
the more maze-like they become."
entries.translation_source: It lives in narrow burrows that fit its slim body. The deeper the nests go, the more maze-like they become.
entries.translated: Vive in strette tane adatte al suo corpo snello. Più in profondità si trovano i nidi, più diventano simili a un labirinto.

entries.original:
"It has a perfect sense of rhythm.
Whatever happens, it keeps a steady
pace by tilting its head in time."
entries.translation_source: It has a perfect sense of rhythm. Whatever happens, it keeps a steady pace by tilting its head in time.
entries.translated: Ha un perfetto senso del ritmo. Qualunque cosa accada, mantiene un passo costante inclinando la testa a tempo.

entries.original:
"When it needs to think, it rotates its
head 180 degrees to sharpen its
intellectual power."
entries.translation_source: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.
entries.translated: Quando deve pensare, ruota la testa di 180 gradi per acuire il proprio intelletto.

entries.original:
"It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t
with a swarm of others. It conveys its
feelings with scent."
entries.translation_source: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
entries.translated: È così timido che non riesce a muoversi se non è con uno sciame di suoi simili. Esprime i propri sentimenti con l{B4}odore.

entries.original:
"In the daytime when it gets warm, it
curls up inside a big leaf and drifts off
into a deep slumber."
entries.translation_source: In the daytime when it gets warm, it curls up inside a big leaf and drifts off into a deep slumber.
entries.translated: Di giorno, quando fa caldo, si raggomitola dentro una grande foglia e cade in un sonno profondo.

entries.original:
"It lies still in the same pose for days
in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting
prey to wander close."
entries.translation_source: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
entries.translated: Resta immobile nella stessa posa nella sua ragnatela per giorni, aspettando che una preda ignara si avvicini.

entries.original:
"It spins string not only from its rear
but also from its mouth. It is hard to
tell which end is which."
entries.translation_source: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
entries.translated: Produce filo non solo dal posteriore, ma anche dalla bocca. È difficile capire quale sia la parte anteriore.

entries.original:
"Having four wings allows it to fly more
quickly and quietly so it can sneak up
on prey without its noticing."
entries.translation_source: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.
entries.translated: Avere quattro ali gli permette di volare più velocemente e silenziosamente, così può avvicinarsi di soppiatto alla preda senza farsi notare.

entries.original:
"It shoots positive and negative
electricity between the tips of its two
antennae and zaps its enemies."
entries.translation_source: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
entries.translated: Scaglia elettricità positiva e negativa tra le punte delle sue due antenne e fulmina i nemici.

entries.original:
"It blinds prey with an intense burst of
light, then swallows the immobilized prey
in a single gulp."
entries.translation_source: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.
entries.translated: Acceca le prede con un intenso lampo di luce, poi inghiotte la preda immobilizzata in un solo boccone.

entries.original:
"Despite its small size, it can zap even
adult humans. However, if it does so, it
also surprises itself."
entries.translation_source: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.
entries.translated: Nonostante le sue piccole dimensioni, può folgorare persino esseri umani adulti. Tuttavia, se lo fa, spaventa anche se stesso.

entries.original:
"When numerous meteors illuminate the
night sky, sightings of Cleffa strangely
increase."
entries.translation_source: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of Cleffa strangely increase.
entries.translated: Quando numerose meteore illuminano il cielo notturno, gli avvistamenti di Cleffa aumentano stranamente.

entries.original:
"Its extremely flexible and elastic body
makes it bounce continuously--anytime,
anywhere."
entries.translation_source: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo estremamente flessibile ed elastico lo fa rimbalzare continuamente, in qualunque momento e ovunque.

entries.original:
"A proverb claims that happiness will come
to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi
stand up."
entries.translation_source: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.
entries.translated: Un proverbio sostiene che la felicità arriverà a chiunque riesca a far alzare in piedi un Togepi addormentato.

entries.original:
"It grows dispirited if it is not with kind
people. It can float in midair without
moving its wings."
entries.translation_source: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.
entries.translated: Si avvilisce se non sta con persone gentili. Può fluttuare a mezz{B4}aria senza muovere le ali.

entries.original:
"Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown,
it has to hop to get around. It is always
staring at something."
entries.translation_source: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.
entries.translated: Poiché le sue ali non sono ancora del tutto sviluppate, deve saltellare per spostarsi. Fissa sempre qualcosa.

entries.original:
"They say that it stays still and quiet
because it is seeing both the past
and future at the same time."
entries.translation_source: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
entries.translated: Resta immobile e in silenzio perché vede il passato e il futuro allo stesso tempo.

entries.original:
"Its fleece grows continually. In the
summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it
grows back in a week."
entries.translation_source: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.
entries.translated: Il suo vello continua a crescere. In estate, lo perde completamente, ma ricresce in una settimana.

entries.original:
"Not even downy wool will grow on its
rubbery, nonconductive patches of
skin that prevent electrical shock."
entries.translation_source: Not even downy wool will grow on its rubbery, nonconductive patches of skin that prevent electrical shock.
entries.translated: Nemmeno la lanugine cresce sulle sue chiazze di pelle gommosa e non conduttrice, che evitano le scosse elettriche.

entries.original:
"When it gets dark, the light from its
bright, shiny tail can be seen from far
away on the ocean’s surface."
entries.translation_source: When it gets dark, the light from its bright, shiny tail can be seen from far away on the ocean’s surface.
entries.translated: Quando fa buio, la luce della sua coda brillante e scintillante si vede da lontano sulla superficie dell{B4}oceano.

entries.original:
"It is plentiful in tropical regions.
When it dances, its petals rub together
and make a pleasant ringing sound."
entries.translation_source: It is plentiful in tropical regions. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.
entries.translated: È molto comune nelle regioni tropicali. Quando danza, i suoi petali si sfregano tra loro e producono un piacevole tintinnio.

entries.original:
"The fur on its body naturally repels
water. It can stay dry, even when it
plays in the water."
entries.translation_source: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.
entries.translated: La pelliccia del suo corpo respinge naturalmente l{B4}acqua. Può restare asciutto anche quando gioca in acqua.

entries.original:
"When it plays in water, it rolls up its
elongated ears to prevent their insides
from getting wet."
entries.translation_source: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.
entries.translated: Quando gioca nell{B4}acqua, ripiega le sue orecchie allungate per impedire che si bagnino all{B4}interno.

entries.original:
"It disguises itself as a tree to avoid
attack. It hates water, so it will
disappear if it starts raining."
entries.translation_source: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.
entries.translated: Si traveste da albero per evitare gli attacchi. Odia l{B4}acqua, quindi sparisce se inizia a piovere.

entries.original:
"If Poliwag and Poliwhirl hear its echoing
cry, they respond by gathering from
far and wide."
entries.translation_source: If Poliwag and Poliwhirl hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.
entries.translated: Se Poliwag e Poliwhirl sentono il suo richiamo echeggiante, accorrono da ogni dove.

entries.original:
"Its body is so light, it must grip the
ground firmly with its feet to keep from
being blown away."
entries.translation_source: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo è così leggero che deve aggrapparsi saldamente al terreno con i piedi per non farsi portare via dal vento.

entries.original:
"It blooms when the weather warms.
It floats in the sky to soak up as much
sunlight as possible."
entries.translation_source: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
entries.translated: Fiorisce quando il clima si fa più caldo. Fluttua nel cielo per assorbire quanta più luce solare possibile.

entries.original:
"It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads
its cotton-like spores all over the world 
to make more offspring."
entries.translation_source: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.
entries.translated: Lasciandosi trasportare dai venti stagionali, diffonde le sue spore simili a cotone in tutto il mondo per produrre altra prole.

entries.original:
"It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are
out of reach. Its tail is more adept
than its real hands."
entries.translation_source: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.
entries.translated: Usa la coda per cogliere i frutti fuori portata. La sua coda è più abile delle sue vere mani.

entries.original:
"It lives by drinking only dewdrops from
under the leaves of plants. It is said
that it eats nothing else."
entries.translation_source: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.
entries.translated: Vive bevendo soltanto gocce di rugiada da sotto le foglie delle piante. Si dice che non mangi altro.

entries.original:
"In the daytime, it rushes about in a
hectic manner, but it comes to a complete
stop when the sun sets."
entries.translation_source: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.
entries.translated: Di giorno si agita freneticamente, ma si ferma del tutto quando il sole tramonta.

entries.original:
"By flapping its wings at high speed,
it can fly freely through the air.
Even sudden stops are no problem."
entries.translation_source: By flapping its wings at high speed, it can fly freely through the air. Even sudden stops are no problem.
entries.translated: Agitando le ali ad alta velocità, può volare liberamente nell{B4}aria. Anche gli arresti improvvisi non sono un problema.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon lives in cold water.
It will leave the water to search for
food when it gets cold outside."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon vive in acque fredde. Esce dall{B4}acqua per cercare cibo quando fuori fa freddo.

entries.original:
"It often bangs its head on the river
bottom as it swims but seems not to
care. Its body is always slimy."
entries.translation_source: It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care. Its body is always slimy.
entries.translated: Spesso sbatte la testa contro il fondo del fiume mentre nuota, ma sembra non curarsene. Il suo corpo è sempre viscido.

entries.original:
"It uses the fine hair that covers its
body to sense air currents and predict
its enemy’s actions."
entries.translation_source: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.
entries.translated: Usa i fini peli che ricoprono il corpo per percepire le correnti d{B4}aria e prevedere le mosse del nemico.

entries.original:
"On the night of a full moon, or when it
gets excited, the ring patterns on its
body glow yellow."
entries.translation_source: On the night of a full moon, or when it gets excited, the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.
entries.translated: Nella notte di luna piena, o quando si emoziona, i motivi ad anello sul suo corpo si illuminano di giallo.

entries.original:
"Feared and loathed by many, it is
believed to bring misfortune to all
those who see it at night."
entries.translation_source: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
entries.translated: Temuto e detestato da molti, si crede che porti sfortuna a chiunque lo veda di notte.

entries.original:
"Being bitten by Shellder gave it
intelligence comparable to that of
award-winning scientists."
entries.translation_source: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
entries.translated: Essere morso da Shellder gli ha dato un{B4}intelligenza paragonabile a quella di scienziati pluripremiati.

entries.original:
"It loves to bite and yank people’s hair
from behind without warning, just to see
their shocked reactions."
entries.translation_source: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.
entries.translated: Ama mordere e tirare i capelli alle persone da dietro, senza preavviso, solo per vedere le loro reazioni sconvolte.

entries.original:
"Its flat, thin body is always stuck on
walls. Its shape appears to have some
meaning."
entries.translation_source: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo piatto e sottile è sempre attaccato alle pareti. La sua forma sembra avere un certo significato.

entries.original:
"To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it
lives quietly in the darkness. It is never
first to attack."
entries.translation_source: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.
entries.translated: Per tenere nascosta la sua coda nerissima, vive silenziosamente nell{B4}oscurità. Non attacca mai per primo.

entries.original:
"Its tail, which also contains a small
brain, may bite on its own if it notices
an alluring smell."
entries.translation_source: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.
entries.translated: La sua coda, che contiene anche un piccolo cervello, può mordere da sola se percepisce un odore allettante.

entries.original:
"It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey
to come near. It does not move about
much on its own."
entries.translation_source: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.
entries.translated: Resta appeso e attende che le prede alate e insettoidi si avvicinino. Non si sposta molto da solo.

entries.original:
"It remains immovably rooted to its tree.
It scatters pieces of its hard shell to
drive its enemies away."
entries.translation_source: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.
entries.translated: Resta saldamente radicato al suo albero. Sparge pezzi del suo guscio duro per tenere lontani i nemici.

entries.original:
"If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with
its tail. It can hover just slightly using
its wings."
entries.translation_source: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can hover just slightly using its wings.
entries.translated: Se viene avvistato, fugge scavando con la coda. Riesce a librarsi appena usando le ali.

entries.original:
"It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots
its prey, it spreads its wings and glides
down to attack."
entries.translation_source: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.
entries.translated: Di solito si aggrappa alle scogliere. Quando avvista la preda, spiega le ali e si lancia in picchiata per attaccare.

entries.original:
"Its body has been compressed deep
under the ground. As a result, it is
even harder than a diamond."
entries.translation_source: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo è stato compresso in profondità sotto terra. Di conseguenza, è persino più duro di un diamante.

entries.original:
"Although it looks frightening, it is
actually kind and affectionate.
It is very popular among women."
entries.translation_source: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.
entries.translated: Sebbene abbia un aspetto spaventoso, in realtà è gentile e affettuoso. È molto popolare tra le donne.

entries.original:
"It can make most any Pokémon run
away simply by opening its mouth wide
to reveal its big fangs."
entries.translation_source: It can make most any Pokémon run away simply by opening its mouth wide to reveal its big fangs.
entries.translated: Può far scappare quasi qualsiasi Pokémon semplicemente spalancando la bocca per mostrare le sue grandi zanne.

entries.original:
"When faced with a larger opponent,
it swallows as much water as it can to
match the opponent’s size."
entries.translation_source: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent’s size.
entries.translated: Quando si trova davanti a un avversario più grande, ingoia quanta più acqua possibile per eguagliarne le dimensioni.

entries.original:
"It swings its eye-patterned pincers up
to scare its foes. This makes it look
like it has three heads."
entries.translation_source: It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.
entries.translated: Solleva le chele con motivi a forma di occhio per spaventare i nemici. Così sembra avere tre teste.

entries.original:
"It stores Berries inside its shell.
The Berries eventually ferment to
become delicious juices."
entries.translation_source: It stores Berries inside its shell. The Berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.
entries.translated: Conserva le Bacche dentro il suo guscio. Col tempo, le Bacche fermentano e diventano deliziosi succhi.

entries.original:
"It loves sweet honey. To keep all
the honey to itself, it hurls rivals
away with its prized horn."
entries.translation_source: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.
entries.translated: Ama il miele dolce. Per tenersi tutto il miele per sé, scaglia via i rivali con il suo prezioso corno.

entries.original:
"Its paws conceal sharp claws.
If attacked, it suddenly extends the
claws and startles its enemy."
entries.translation_source: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
entries.translated: Le sue zampe nascondono artigli affilati. Se viene attaccato, estende all{B4}improvviso gli artigli e spaventa il nemico.

entries.original:
"It lets honey soak into its paws so
it can lick them all the time. Every set
of paws tastes unique."
entries.translation_source: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
entries.translated: Lascia che il miele impregni le sue zampe così può leccarle di continuo. Ogni coppia di zampe ha un sapore unico.

entries.original:
"With its ability to distinguish any smell,
it unfailingly finds all food buried deep
underground."
entries.translation_source: With its ability to distinguish any smell, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.
entries.translated: Grazie alla sua capacità di distinguere qualsiasi odore, trova senza mai fallire tutto il cibo sepolto in profondità sottoterra.

entries.original:
"It never sleeps. It has to keep moving
because if it stopped, its magma body
would cool and harden."
entries.translation_source: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.
entries.translated: Non dorme mai. Deve continuare a muoversi perché, se si fermasse, il suo corpo di magma si raffredderebbe e si indurirebbe.

entries.original:
"The shell on its back is just skin that
has cooled and hardened. It breaks
easily with a slight touch."
entries.translation_source: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.
entries.translated: Il guscio sulla schiena è solo pelle che si è raffreddata e indurita. Si rompe facilmente al minimo tocco.

entries.original:
"If it smells something enticing, it dashes
off headlong to find the source of the
aroma."
entries.translation_source: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.
entries.translated: Se percepisce qualcosa di invitante, scatta a capofitto per trovare la fonte dell{B4}aroma.

entries.original:
"If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on
its back stand up straight. It is very
sensitive to sound."
entries.translation_source: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.
entries.translated: Quando si lancia contro un nemico, i peli sul suo dorso si rizzano. È molto sensibile ai suoni.

entries.original:
"In a south sea nation, the people live in
communities that are built on groups of
these Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: In a south sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these Pokémon.
entries.translated: In una nazione dei mari del sud, le persone vivono in comunità costruite su gruppi di questi Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad,
it clings to a Mantine’s underside
to scavenge for leftovers."
entries.translation_source: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine’s underside to scavenge for leftovers.
entries.translated: Usando la pinna dorsale come ventosa, si aggrappa al ventre di un Mantine per raccogliere gli avanzi.

entries.original:
"It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes.
If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of
a fellow Octillery."
entries.translation_source: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fellow Octillery.
entries.translated: Si intrufola istintivamente nelle cavità rocciose. Se ha sonno, ruba il nido di un altro Octillery.

entries.original:
"It always carries its food with it,
wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws
its food at the opponent."
entries.translation_source: It always carries its food with it, wherever it goes. If attacked, it throws its food at the opponent.
entries.translated: Porta sempre con sé il suo cibo, ovunque vada. Se viene attaccato, scaglia il cibo contro l{B4}avversario.

entries.original:
"Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly
out of the water and over the waves if it
builds up enough speed."
entries.translation_source: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.
entries.translated: Nuotando liberamente nei mari aperti, se accumula abbastanza velocità può balzare fuori dall{B4}acqua e sorvolare le onde.

entries.original:
"Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they
are actually hollow and light, allowing
it to fly freely in the sky."
entries.translation_source: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.
entries.translated: Le sue robuste ali sembrano pesanti, ma in realtà sono cave e leggere, il che gli permette di volare liberamente nel cielo.

entries.original:
"To corner prey, they check each other’s
location using barks that only they can
understand."
entries.translation_source: To corner prey, they check each other’s location using barks that only they can understand.
entries.translated: Per accerchiare la preda, si segnalano a vicenda la posizione con abbai che solo loro possono capire.

entries.original:
"The flames it breathes when angry
contain toxins. If they cause a burn,
it will hurt forever."
entries.translation_source: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.
entries.translated: Le fiamme che sputa quando è arrabbiato contengono tossine. Se causano una bruciatura, farà male per sempre.

entries.original:
"It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to
build its energy. It is said to cause
tornadoes as it wakes."
entries.translation_source: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.
entries.translated: Riesce a dormire in profondità sul fondale oceanico per accumulare energia. Si dice che, al risveglio, provochi tornado.

entries.original:
"As a sign of affection, it bumps with its
snout. However, it is so strong, it may
send you flying."
entries.translation_source: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.
entries.translated: Per dimostrare affetto, ti colpisce con il muso. Però è così forte che potrebbe mandarti a volare.

entries.original:
"Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard
state. An ordinary sort of attack won’t
even leave a scratch."
entries.translation_source: Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of attack won’t even leave a scratch.
entries.translated: La sua pelle si è indurita fino a diventare dura come la roccia. Un attacco normale non lascerebbe nemmeno un graffio.

entries.original:
"This manmade Pokémon evolved from
the latest technology. It may have
unprogrammed reactions."
entries.translation_source: This manmade Pokémon evolved from the latest technology. It may have unprogrammed reactions.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon artificiale si è evoluto grazie alla tecnologia più recente. Potrebbe avere reazioni non programmate.

entries.original:
"Those who stare at its antlers will
gradually lose control of their senses
and be unable to stand."
entries.translation_source: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.
entries.translated: Chi fissa i suoi palchi finisce gradualmente per perdere il controllo dei sensi e non riuscire più a stare in piedi.

entries.original:
"Once it becomes an adult, it has a
tendency to let its comrades plant
footprints on its back."
entries.translation_source: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.
entries.translated: Una volta diventato adulto, tende a lasciare che i suoi compagni gli lascino impronte sul dorso.

entries.original:
"Even though it is small, it can’t be
ignored because it will slug any handy
target without warning."
entries.translation_source: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.
entries.translated: Anche se è piccolo, non può essere ignorato perché assesterà un pugno a qualunque bersaglio a tiro senza preavviso.

entries.original:
"It launches kicks while spinning. If it
spins at high speed, it may bore its way
into the ground."
entries.translation_source: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.
entries.translated: Sferra calci mentre ruota. Se gira ad alta velocità, può scavarsi la strada nel terreno.

entries.original:
"It always rocks its head slowly
backwards and forwards as if it is
trying to kiss someone."
entries.translation_source: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.
entries.translated: Dondola sempre lentamente la testa avanti e indietro, come se stesse cercando di baciare qualcuno.

entries.original:
"Even in the most vicious storm, this
Pokémon plays happily if thunder
rumbles in the sky."
entries.translation_source: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.
entries.translated: Anche durante la tempesta più violenta, questo Pokémon gioca felice se il tuono brontola nel cielo.

entries.original:
"Each and every time it inhales and
exhales, hot embers dribble out of
its mouth and nostrils."
entries.translation_source: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.
entries.translated: Ogni volta che inspira ed espira, dalla bocca e dalle narici gli cola fuori della brace rovente.

entries.original:
"If it has just had a baby, the milk it
produces contains much more nutrition
than usual."
entries.translation_source: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.
entries.translated: Se ha appena partorito, il latte che produce contiene molti più nutrienti del solito.

entries.original:
"It has a very compassionate nature.
If it sees a sick Pokémon, it will nurse
the sufferer back to health."
entries.translation_source: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick Pokémon, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.
entries.translated: Ha un{B4}indole molto compassionevole. Se vede un Pokémon malato, lo assiste finché non torna in salute.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon races across the
land while barking a cry that sounds
like crashing thunder."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon corre attraverso le terre latrando un verso che sembra il fragore del tuono.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon that races across the land.
It is said that one is born every time a
new volcano appears."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon che corre attraverso la terraferma. Si dice che ne nasca uno ogni volta che compare un nuovo vulcano.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon races across the land.
It is said that north winds will somehow
blow whenever it appears."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.
entries.translated: Corre a gran velocità per le terre. Si dice che, ogni volta che appare, in qualche modo soffino i venti del nord.

entries.original:
"It is born deep underground. It can’t
emerge until it has entirely consumed the
soil around it."
entries.translation_source: It is born deep underground. It can’t emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.
entries.translated: Nasce nelle profondità del sottosuolo. Non può emergere finché non ha consumato del tutto il terreno attorno a sé.

entries.original:
"Even sealed in its shell, it can move
freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding
destructive power."
entries.translation_source: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.
entries.translated: Anche sigillato nel suo guscio, può muoversi liberamente. Duro e veloce, possiede un potere distruttivo straordinario.

entries.original:
"Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of
attack, so it is very eager to make
challenges against enemies."
entries.translation_source: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo non può essere danneggiato da alcun tipo di attacco, quindi è molto desideroso di lanciare sfide ai nemici.

entries.original:
"It is said to be the guardian of the seas.
It is rumored to have been seen on the
night of a storm."
entries.translation_source: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.
entries.translated: Si dice che sia il guardiano dei mari. Si racconta che sia stato avvistato nella notte di una tempesta.

entries.original:
"A legend says that its body glows in
seven colors. A rainbow is said to form
behind it when it flies."
entries.translation_source: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.
entries.translated: Si narra che il suo corpo brilli di sette colori. Si dice che, quando vola, lasci dietro di sé un arcobaleno.

entries.original:
"When Celebi disappears deep in a forest,
it is said to leave behind an egg it
brought from the future."
entries.translation_source: When Celebi disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.
entries.translated: Quando Celebi scompare nel cuore di una foresta, si dice che lasci dietro di sé un Uovo portato dal futuro.

entries.original:
"The soles of its feet are covered by
countless tiny spikes, enabling it to
walk on walls and ceilings."
entries.translation_source: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
entries.translated: Le piante dei piedi sono ricoperte da innumerevoli minuscole spine, che gli permettono di camminare su muri e soffitti.

entries.original:
"While closing in on its prey, it leaps
from branch to branch. It displays
astounding agility."
entries.translation_source: While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch. It displays astounding agility.
entries.translated: Mentre si avvicina alla preda, salta di ramo in ramo. Mostra un{B4}agilità stupefacente.

entries.original:
"The leaves that grow on its arms can
slice down thick trees. It is without
peer in jungle combat."
entries.translation_source: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
entries.translated: Le foglie che crescono sulle sue braccia possono abbattere alberi spessi. Non ha rivali nel combattimento nella giungla.

entries.original:
"It has a flame sac inside its belly
that perpetually burns. It feels warm
if it is hugged."
entries.translation_source: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.
entries.translated: Ha una sacca di fiamma all{B4}interno del ventre che brucia ininterrottamente. Se lo abbracci, lo senti caldo.

entries.original:
"During a battle, the hot flame in its
body grows. Its kicks have outstanding
destructive power."
entries.translation_source: During a battle, the hot flame in its body grows. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.
entries.translated: Durante la lotta, la fiamma ardente nel suo corpo cresce. I suoi calci hanno un potere distruttivo eccezionale.

entries.original:
"Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping
its knuckles. The stronger the foes, the
more intensely they burn."
entries.translation_source: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. The stronger the foes, the more intensely they burn.
entries.translated: Dalle sue caviglie erompono fiamme che avvolgono le sue nocche. Più forti sono i nemici, più intensamente bruciano.

entries.original:
"Its large tail fin propels it through
water with powerful acceleration.
It is strong in spite of its size."
entries.translation_source: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
entries.translated: La sua grande pinna caudale lo spinge nell{B4}acqua con una potente accelerazione. È forte nonostante le sue dimensioni.

entries.original:
"Living on muddy ground that provides
poor footing has made its legs sturdy.
It burrows into dirt to sleep."
entries.translation_source: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
entries.translated: Vivere su un terreno fangoso che offre poco appoggio ha reso le sue zampe robuste. Si scava nella terra per dormire.

entries.original:
"Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing,
they can batter down its foe. It makes
its nest on beautiful beaches."
entries.translation_source: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.
entries.translated: Le sue braccia sono dure come la roccia. Con un solo colpo possono abbattere il nemico. Costruisce il suo nido su splendide spiagge.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it
chases its chosen prey until the prey
becomes exhausted."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon dalla natura tenace, insegue la preda scelta finché questa non si stanca.

entries.original:
"It will always obey the commands of a
skilled trainer. Its behavior arises from
its living in packs in ancient times."
entries.translation_source: It will always obey the commands of a skilled trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
entries.translated: Obbedirà sempre ai comandi di un Allenatore esperto. Il suo comportamento deriva dal fatto che in passato viveva in branchi.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon with abundant curiosity.
It shows an interest in everything, so it
always zigs and zags."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigs and zags.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon molto curioso. Mostra interesse per tutto, quindi procede sempre zigzagando.

entries.original:
"Linoone always runs at full speed and
only ever in straight lines. This Pokémon
is challenged by gently curving roads."
entries.translation_source: Linoone always runs at full speed and only ever in straight lines. This Pokémon is challenged by gently curving roads.
entries.translated: Linoone corre sempre a tutta velocità e solo in linea retta. Questo Pokémon va in difficoltà sulle strade leggermente curve.

entries.original:
"It lives amidst tall grass and in forests.
When attacked, it resists by pointing its
venomous spikes at the foe."
entries.translation_source: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests. When attacked, it resists by pointing its venomous spikes at the foe.
entries.translated: Vive tra l{B4}erba alta e nelle foreste. Quando viene attaccato, si difende puntando le sue spine velenose contro il nemico.

entries.original:
"It wraps silk around the branches of
a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk
while awaiting evolution."
entries.translation_source: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
entries.translated: Avvolge di seta i rami di un albero. Beve l{B4}acqua piovana raccolta sulla sua seta in attesa dell{B4}evoluzione.

entries.original:
"Despite its appearance, it has an
aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing
with its long, thin mouth."
entries.translation_source: Despite its appearance, it has an aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing with its long, thin mouth.
entries.translated: Nonostante l{B4}aspetto, ha un carattere aggressivo. Attacca colpendo con la sua bocca lunga e sottile.

entries.translation_source: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.
entries.translated: Non dimentica mai nessun attacco subito mentre era nel bozzolo. Dopo l{B4}evoluzione, cerca vendetta.

entries.original:
"It scatters horribly toxic dust when it
senses danger. They tend to gather in the
glow of streetlamps at night."
entries.translation_source: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it senses danger. They tend to gather in the glow of streetlamps at night.
entries.translated: Quando percepisce un pericolo, sparge una polvere terribilmente tossica. Di notte tendono a radunarsi nel chiarore dei lampioni.

entries.original:
"It searches about for clean water. If it
does not drink water for too long, the
leaf on its head wilts."
entries.translation_source: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.
entries.translated: Cerca acqua pulita in giro. Se non beve acqua per troppo tempo, la foglia sulla sua testa appassisce.

entries.original:
"It lives at the water’s edge where it
is sunny. It feeds on aquatic mosses
that grow in the riverbed."
entries.translation_source: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.
entries.translated: Vive al margine dell{B4}acqua, in luoghi soleggiati. Si nutre dei muschi acquatici che crescono sul letto del fiume.

entries.original:
"If it hears festive music, all its muscles
fill with energy. It can’t help breaking
out into a dance."
entries.translation_source: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
entries.translated: Se sente musica festosa, tutti i suoi muscoli si riempiono di energia. Non può fare a meno di mettersi a ballare.

entries.original:
"If it remains still, it becomes impossible
to distinguish from real nuts. It delights
in surprising foraging Pidgey."
entries.translation_source: If it remains still, it becomes impossible to distinguish from real nuts. It delights in surprising foraging Pidgey.
entries.translated: Se resta immobile, diventa impossibile distinguerlo da vere noci. Si diverte a sorprendere i Pidgey in cerca di cibo.

entries.original:
"They live in holes bored in large trees.
The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills
listeners with dread."
entries.translation_source: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.
entries.translated: Vivono in cavità scavate in grandi alberi. Il suono del flauto di Nuzleaf riempie di terrore chi lo ascolta.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon that was feared as a forest
guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and
take preemptive action."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon temuto come guardiano della foresta. Può leggere la mente del nemico e agire in anticipo.

entries.original:
"Although it is small, it has a gutsy
spirit that makes it take on tough foes.
It flies in search of warm climates."
entries.translation_source: Although it is small, it has a gutsy spirit that makes it take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
entries.translated: Sebbene sia piccolo, ha uno spirito tenace che lo porta ad affrontare nemici tosti. Vola alla ricerca di climi caldi.

entries.original:
"If its two tail feathers are standing at
attention, it is proof of good health.
It soars elegantly in the sky."
entries.translation_source: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.
entries.translated: Se le sue due penne caudali sono tese sull{B4}attenti, è la prova di una buona salute. Si libra elegantemente nel cielo.

entries.original:
"Catching sea winds with its long wings,
it soars as if it were a glider. It makes 
its nest on cliffs."
entries.translation_source: Catching sea winds with its long wings, it soars as if it were a glider. It makes its nest on cliffs.
entries.translated: Catturando i venti marini con le sue lunghe ali, plana come se fosse un aliante. Fa il nido sulle scogliere.

entries.original:
"It is a flying transporter that carries
small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the
waves to rest its wings."
entries.translation_source: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.
entries.translated: È un trasportatore volante che porta piccoli Pokémon nel becco. Dondola sulle onde per far riposare le ali.

entries.original:
"It uses the horns on its head to sense
human emotions. It is said to appear in
front of cheerful people."
entries.translation_source: It uses the horns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.
entries.translated: Usa le corna sulla testa per percepire le emozioni umane. Si dice che appaia davanti alle persone allegre.

entries.original:
"If its Trainer becomes happy, it
overflows with energy, dancing
joyously while spinning about."
entries.translation_source: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
entries.translated: Se il suo Allenatore è felice, trabocca di energia e danza gioiosamente mentre gira su sé stesso.

entries.original:
"It unleashes psychokinetic energy
at full power when protecting a
trainer it has bonded closely with."
entries.translation_source: It unleashes psychokinetic energy at full power when protecting a trainer it has bonded closely with.
entries.translated: Scatena l{B4}energia psicocinetica alla massima potenza quando protegge un Allenatore a cui si è legato profondamente.

entries.original:
"They usually live on ponds, but after
an evening shower, they may appear on
puddles in towns."
entries.translation_source: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.
entries.translated: Di solito vivono negli stagni, ma dopo un acquazzone serale possono comparire nelle pozzanghere delle città.

entries.original:
"The antennae have distinctive patterns
that look like eyes. When it rains, they
grow heavy, making flight impossible."
entries.translation_source: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.
entries.translated: Le antenne hanno motivi distintivi che sembrano occhi. Quando piove, diventano pesanti, rendendo impossibile il volo.

entries.original:
"It prefers damp places. By day it remains
still in the forest shade. It releases
toxic powder from its head."
entries.translation_source: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.
entries.translated: Preferisce i luoghi umidi. Di giorno rimane immobile all{B4}ombra della foresta. Rilascia polvere tossica dalla testa.

entries.original:
"The seeds on its tail are made of toxic
spores. It knocks out foes with quick,
virtually invisible punches."
entries.translation_source: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.
entries.translated: I semi sulla sua coda sono fatti di spore tossiche. Mette al tappeto i nemici con pugni rapidi, quasi invisibili.

entries.original:
"If it eats just three leaves in a day,
it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps
for 20 hours a day."
entries.translation_source: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.
entries.translated: Se mangia anche solo tre foglie al giorno, è soddisfatto. Per il resto, dorme 20 ore al giorno.

entries.original:
"Its stress level rises if it cannot keep
moving constantly. Too much stress
makes it feel sick."
entries.translation_source: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.
entries.translated: Il suo livello di stress aumenta se non riesce a continuare a muoversi. Troppo stress lo fa sentire male.

entries.original:
"It is the world’s most slothful Pokémon.
However, it can exert horrifying power by
releasing pent-up energy all at once."
entries.translation_source: It is the world’s most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.
entries.translated: È il Pokémon più pigro del mondo. Tuttavia, può sprigionare una potenza terrificante liberando tutto insieme l{B4}energia accumulata.

entries.original:
"It can live underground for more than
10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the
roots of trees."
entries.translation_source: It can live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.
entries.translated: Può vivere sottoterra per più di 10 anni. Assorbe nutrienti dalle radici degli alberi.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to
be able to avoid any attack. It loves to
feed on tree sap."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon è così veloce che si dice sia in grado di schivare qualsiasi attacco. Adora nutrirsi della linfa degli alberi.

entries.original:
"A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow
appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada
evolves."
entries.translation_source: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon molto particolare che in qualche modo appare in una Poké Ball quando un Nincada si evolve.

entries.original:
"It usually murmurs, but starts crying
loudly if it senses danger. It stops when
its ear covers are shut."
entries.translation_source: It usually murmurs, but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.
entries.translated: Di solito borbotta, ma se percepisce un pericolo inizia a piangere forte. Si calma quando le coperture delle orecchie si chiudono.

entries.original:
"When it stamps its feet and bellows, it
generates ultrasonic waves that can blow
apart a house."
entries.translation_source: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.
entries.translated: Quando batte i piedi e ruggisce, genera onde ultrasoniche che possono far saltare in aria una casa.

entries.original:
"It emits a variety of sounds from the 
holes all over its body. Its loud cries
can be heard from over six miles away."
entries.translation_source: It emits a variety of sounds from the holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.
entries.translated: Emette una varietà di suoni dai fori sparsi su tutto il corpo. I suoi richiami forti si possono udire da oltre sei miglia di distanza.

entries.original:
"It toughens up by slamming into thick
trees over and over. It gains a sturdy
body and dauntless spirit."
entries.translation_source: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.
entries.translated: Si irrobustisce sbattendo ripetutamente contro gli alberi più grossi. Ottiene un corpo robusto e uno spirito impavido.

entries.original:
"It loves to match power with big-bodied
Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying
with its arm thrusts."
entries.translation_source: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
entries.translated: Ama mettere alla prova la sua forza contro Pokémon dal corpo massiccio. Può far volare un camion con le sue spinte di braccia.

entries.original:
"It battles by flinging around its tail,
which is bigger than its body. The
tail is a flotation device in water."
entries.translation_source: It battles by flinging around its tail, which is bigger than its body. The tail is a flotation device in water.
entries.translated: Combatte agitando la coda, che è più grande del suo corpo. La coda funge da dispositivo di galleggiamento in acqua.

entries.original:
"Its magnetic nose consistently faces
north. Travelers check Nosepass to
get their bearings."
entries.translation_source: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.
entries.translated: Il suo naso magnetico punta costantemente a nord. I viaggiatori consultano Nosepass per orientarsi.

entries.original:
"It is said to be difficult to earn its
trust. However, it is extremely popular
for its cute looks and behavior."
entries.translation_source: It is said to be difficult to earn its trust. However, it is extremely popular for its cute looks and behavior.
entries.translated: Si dice che sia difficile conquistare la sua fiducia. Tuttavia, è estremamente popolare per il suo aspetto e il suo comportamento teneri.

entries.original:
"The favorite of trend-conscious female
trainers, they are used in competition
for their style and fur."
entries.translation_source: The favorite of trend-conscious female trainers, they are used in competition for their style and fur.
entries.translated: È il preferito delle Allenatrici attente alle tendenze; viene usato nelle gare per il suo stile e il suo pelo.

entries.original:
"It dwells in the darkness of caves.
It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems
to nourish itself."
entries.translation_source: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.
entries.translated: Vive nell{B4}oscurità delle grotte. Usa i suoi artigli affilati per scavare gemme e nutrirsi.

entries.original:
"It uses its docile-looking face to lull
foes into complacency, then bites with its
huge, relentless jaws."
entries.translation_source: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.
entries.translated: Usa il suo volto dall{B4}aria mansueta per indurre i nemici alla compiacenza, poi morde con le sue enormi mascelle instancabili.

entries.original:
"It usually lives deep in mountains.
However, hunger may drive it to eat
railroad tracks and cars."
entries.translation_source: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
entries.translated: Di solito vive in profondità nelle montagne. Tuttavia, la fame può spingerlo a mangiare binari ferroviari e automobili.

entries.original:
"It loves iron ore. Groups of them
fight for territory by bashing one
another with their steel bodies."
entries.translation_source: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.
entries.translated: Ama il minerale di ferro. I gruppi di questi Pokémon si battono per il territorio colpendosi a vicenda con i loro corpi d{B4}acciaio.

entries.original:
"It claims an entire mountain as its own.
The more wounds it has, the more it has
battled, so don’t take it lightly."
entries.translation_source: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don’t take it lightly.
entries.translated: Rivendica per sé un{B4}intera montagna. Più ferite ha, più battaglie ha combattuto, quindi non sottovalutarlo.

entries.original:
"It meditates to heighten its inner energy
and to float in the air. It eats only one
berry each day."
entries.translation_source: It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats only one berry each day.
entries.translated: Medita per accrescere la propria energia interiore e levitare nell{B4}aria. Mangi solo una bacca al giorno.

entries.original:
"It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-
like steps, then launches a devastating
blow in the same motion."
entries.translation_source: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance- like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
entries.translated: Evita elegantemente gli attacchi con movimenti simili a una danza, poi sferra un colpo devastante nello stesso gesto.

entries.original:
"It stores static electricity in its fur
for discharging. It gives off sparks if a
storm approaches."
entries.translation_source: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.
entries.translated: Accumula elettricità statica nel pelo per scaricarla. Sprigiona scintille se si avvicina un temporale.

entries.original:
"It discharges electricity from its mane.
It creates a thundercloud overhead to
drop lightning bolts."
entries.translation_source: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
entries.translated: Scarica elettricità dalla sua criniera. Sopra di sé crea una nube temporalesca per scagliare fulmini.

entries.original:
"It cheers on friends with pom-poms
made of sparks. It shorts out its body
to create crackling noises."
entries.translation_source: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.
entries.translated: Incita gli amici con pompon di scintille. Mette in corto il proprio corpo per creare rumori crepitanti.

entries.original:
"It likes to cheer on its friends. If they
are losing, its body lets off more and
more sparks."
entries.translation_source: It likes to cheer on its friends. If they are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
entries.translated: Gli piace fare il tifo per i suoi amici. Se stanno perdendo, il suo corpo emette sempre più scintille.

entries.original:
"It communicates with others by lighting
up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s
sweet aroma."
entries.translation_source: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.
entries.translated: Comunica con gli altri illuminando il posteriore di notte. Adora il dolce aroma di Illumise.

entries.original:
"It guides Volbeat to draw signs in night
skies. There are scientists that study the
patterns it creates."
entries.translation_source: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in night skies. There are scientists that study the patterns it creates.
entries.translated: Guida Volbeat a tracciare segni nei cieli notturni. Ci sono scienziati che studiano i motivi che crea.

entries.original:
"Roselia that drink nutritionally rich
springwater are said to reveal rare
coloration when they bloom."
entries.translation_source: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.
entries.translated: Si dice che le Roselia che bevono acqua di sorgente ricca di nutrienti rivelino una colorazione rara quando fioriscono.

entries.original:
"There is nothing its stomach can’t digest.
While it is digesting, vile, overpowering
gases are expelled."
entries.translation_source: There is nothing its stomach can’t digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.
entries.translated: Non c{B4}è nulla che il suo stomaco non riesca a digerire. Mentre digerisce, emette gas pestilenziali e soffocanti.

entries.original:
"It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp.
It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from
the pores on its body."
entries.translation_source: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.
entries.translated: Può inghiottire un pneumatico intero in un solo boccone. Secreta un fluido terribilmente tossico dai pori del suo corpo.

entries.original:
"They swarm any foe that invades their
territory. Their sharp fangs can tear
out boat hulls."
entries.translation_source: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
entries.translated: Assalgono in massa qualsiasi nemico che invada il loro territorio. Le loro zanne affilate possono squarciare gli scafi delle barche.

entries.original:
"The vicious and sly gangster of the sea.
Its skin is specially textured to minimize
resistance in water."
entries.translation_source: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize resistance in water.
entries.translated: Il gangster del mare, feroce e subdolo. La sua pelle ha una texture speciale che riduce al minimo la resistenza nell{B4}acqua.

entries.original:
"On sunny days, it lands on beaches
to bounce like a ball and play.
It spouts water from its nose."
entries.translation_source: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.
entries.translated: Nelle giornate di sole, approda sulle spiagge per rimbalzare come una palla e giocare. Spruzza acqua dal naso.

entries.original:
"The biggest of all Pokémon.
It can dive to a depth of almost
10,000 feet on only one breath."
entries.translation_source: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
entries.translated: Il più grande di tutti i Pokémon. Può immergersi fino a quasi 3.000 metri con un solo respiro.

entries.original:
"Its humped back stores intensely hot
magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing
its movement."
entries.translation_source: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
entries.translated: Il suo dorso gobbuto immagazzina magma intensamente caldo. Sotto la pioggia, il magma si raffredda, rallentandone i movimenti.

entries.original:
"If angered, the humps on its back erupt
in a shower of molten lava. It lives in
the craters of volcanoes."
entries.translation_source: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.
entries.translated: Se si arrabbia, le gobbe sulla sua schiena eruttano una pioggia di lava fusa. Vive nei crateri dei vulcani.

entries.original:
"It burns coal inside its shell for energy.
It blows out black soot if it is in a
dangerous situation."
entries.translation_source: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is in a dangerous situation.
entries.translated: Brucia carbone all{B4}interno del suo guscio per ottenere energia. Espelle fuliggine nera quando si trova in una situazione pericolosa.

entries.original:
"It bounces around on its tail to keep
its heart pumping. It carries a pearl
from Clamperl on its head."
entries.translation_source: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.
entries.translated: Rimbalza sulla coda per mantenere il cuore in movimento. Porta in testa una perla di Clamperl.

entries.original:
"It can gain control over foes by doing
odd dance steps. The black pearls on its
forehead are precious gems."
entries.translation_source: It can gain control over foes by doing odd dance steps. The black pearls on its forehead are precious gems.
entries.translated: Può prendere il controllo dei nemici eseguendo strani passi di danza. Le perle nere sulla sua fronte sono gemme preziose.

entries.original:
"No two Spinda are said to have identical
patterns. It confuses foes with its
stumbling motions."
entries.translation_source: No two Spinda are said to have identical patterns. It confuses foes with its stumbling motions.
entries.translated: Si dice che non esistano due Spinda con motivi identici. Confondere i nemici con i suoi movimenti incerti è la sua specialità.

entries.original:
"It makes an inescapable conical pit and
lies in wait at the bottom for prey to
come tumbling down."
entries.translation_source: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
entries.translated: Crea una fossa conica da cui non si può fuggire e si apposta sul fondo in attesa che la preda vi cada dentro.

entries.original:
"The ultrasonic waves it generates by
rubbing its two wings together cause
severe headaches."
entries.translation_source: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.
entries.translated: Le onde ultrasoniche che genera sfregando tra loro le sue due ali causano forti mal di testa.

entries.original:
"It hides itself by kicking up desert sand
with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes
from sand."
entries.translation_source: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.
entries.translated: Si nasconde sollevando la sabbia del deserto con le ali. Le coperture rosse proteggono i suoi occhi dalla sabbia.

entries.original:
"It prefers harsh environments such as
deserts. It can survive for 30 days on
water stored in its body."
entries.translation_source: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.
entries.translated: Preferisce ambienti ostili come i deserti. Può sopravvivere per 30 giorni grazie all{B4}acqua immagazzinata nel suo corpo.

entries.original:
"It becomes active at night, seeking
prey that is exhausted from the day’s
desert heat."
entries.translation_source: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
entries.translated: Diventa attivo di notte, alla ricerca di prede esauste per il caldo desertico del giorno.

entries.original:
"For some reason, it likes to land on
people’s heads softly and act like
it’s a hat."
entries.translation_source: For some reason, it likes to land on people’s heads softly and act like it’s a hat.
entries.translated: Per qualche motivo, gli piace posarsi delicatamente sulla testa delle persone e fingersi un cappello.

entries.original:
"It flies gracefully through the sky.
Its melodic humming makes you feel
like you’re in a dream."
entries.translation_source: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.
entries.translated: Vola graziosamente nel cielo. Il suo canticchiare melodioso fa sentire come in un sogno.

entries.original:
