"If it comes across a Seviper, its fur
bristles and it assumes its battle pose.
Its sharp claws are its best weapon."
entries.translation_source: If it comes across a Seviper, its fur bristles and it assumes its battle pose. Its sharp claws are its best weapon.
entries.translated: Se incontra un Seviper, il suo pelo si rizza e assume la sua posa di lotta. I suoi artigli affilati sono la sua arma migliore.

entries.original:
"Constant polishing makes the edge
of the blade on its tail extremely sharp.
It’s Zangoose’s archrival."
entries.translation_source: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It’s Zangoose’s archrival.
entries.translated: La continua lucidatura rende il filo della lama sulla sua coda estremamente affilato. È l{B4}arcirivale di Zangoose.

entries.original:
"Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar
cycle. It brims with power when exposed
to the light of the full moon."
entries.translation_source: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar cycle. It brims with power when exposed to the light of the full moon.
entries.translated: La sua salute fluttua con il ciclo lunare. Sprigiona potenza quando è esposto alla luce della luna piena.

entries.original:
"It absorbs solar energy during the day.
Always expressionless, it can sense what
its foe is thinking."
entries.translation_source: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.
entries.translated: Assorbe energia solare durante il giorno. Sempre impassibile, riesce a percepire cosa sta pensando il suo avversario.

entries.original:
"It coats its entire body with a slimy
fluid so it can squirm and slip away
if grabbed."
entries.translation_source: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.
entries.translated: Si ricopre tutto il corpo di un fluido vischioso per divincolarsi e scivolare via se viene afferrato.

entries.original:
"It claims a large swamp to itself.
If a foe comes near it, it sets off
tremors by thrashing around."
entries.translation_source: It claims a large swamp to itself. If a foe comes near it, it sets off tremors by thrashing around.
entries.translated: Si appropria di un grande pantano. Se un nemico si avvicina, scatena tremori dibattendosi.

entries.original:
"No matter how dirty the water in the
river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a
strong will to survive."
entries.translation_source: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.
entries.translated: Non importa quanto l{B4}acqua del fiume sia sporca, si adatta e prospera. Ha una forte volontà di sopravvivere.

entries.original:
"Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all
Pokémon that enter its territory with its
pincers and throws them out."
entries.translation_source: Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all Pokémon that enter its territory with its pincers and throws them out.
entries.translated: Ama combattere e con le sue chele pizzica tutti i Pokémon che entrano nel suo territorio, scacciandoli via.

entries.original:
"It moves while spinning around on its
single foot. Although some Baltoy have
been seen spinning on their heads."
entries.translation_source: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Although some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.
entries.translated: Si muove ruotando su un solo piede. Alcuni Baltoy sono stati persino visti girare sulla testa.

entries.original:
"It appears to have been born from clay
dolls made by ancient people. It uses
telekinesis to float and move."
entries.translation_source: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.
entries.translated: Sembra essere nato da bambole di argilla create da antichi popoli. Usa la telecinesi per levitare e muoversi.

entries.original:
"It became extinct roughly 100 million
years ago. It was regenerated from a
fossil using advanced techniques."
entries.translation_source: It became extinct roughly 100 million years ago. It was regenerated from a fossil using advanced techniques.
entries.translated: Si è estinto circa 100 milioni di anni fa. È stato rigenerato da un fossile usando tecniche avanzate.

entries.original:
"It lives in warm seas. Its heavy
body weighs it down so it won’t
get washed away in rough weather."
entries.translation_source: It lives in warm seas. Its heavy body weighs it down so it won’t get washed away in rough weather.
entries.translated: Vive nei mari caldi. Il suo corpo pesante lo appesantisce, così non viene trascinato via dal maltempo.

entries.original:
"An ancestral Pokémon that lived in
the ocean. Over time, its eight feet
transformed into wings."
entries.translation_source: An ancestral Pokémon that lived in the ocean. Over time, its eight feet transformed into wings.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon ancestrale che viveva nell{B4}oceano. Col tempo, i suoi otto piedi si sono trasformati in ali.

entries.original:
"Its enormous, retractable claws can
cut through almost anything. Its entire
body is clad in sturdy plates."
entries.translation_source: Its enormous, retractable claws can cut through almost anything. Its entire body is clad in sturdy plates.
entries.translated: Le sue enormi artigli retrattili possono tagliare quasi qualsiasi cosa. L{B4}intero corpo è ricoperto da robuste placche.

entries.original:
"Ridiculed for its shabby appearance,
it is ignored by researchers. It lives in
ponds choked with weeds."
entries.translation_source: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance, it is ignored by researchers. It lives in ponds choked with weeds.
entries.translated: Deriso per il suo aspetto trasandato, viene ignorato dai ricercatori. Vive in stagni invasi dalle erbacce.

entries.original:
"It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and
its beauty will calm any hostile emotions
you’re feeling."
entries.translation_source: It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.
entries.translated: Si dice che anche solo intravedere un Milotic e la sua bellezza plachi qualsiasi emozione ostile tu stia provando.

entries.original:
"It has the ability to change its form into
the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, 
depending on the weather."
entries.translation_source: It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, depending on the weather.
entries.translated: Ha la capacità di trasformarsi nel sole, nella pioggia o in una nube di neve, a seconda del tempo.

entries.original:
"It changes body color to blend in with
its surroundings. It also changes color if
it is happy or sad."
entries.translation_source: It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.
entries.translated: Cambia il colore del corpo per confondersi con l{B4}ambiente circostante. Cambia colore anche se è felice o triste.

entries.original:
"It loves to feed on feelings like envy
and malice. Its upright horn catches
the emotions of people."
entries.translation_source: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.
entries.translated: Ama nutrirsi di sentimenti come l{B4}invidia e la malizia. Il suo corno eretto cattura le emozioni delle persone.

entries.original:
"A doll that became a Pokémon over its
grudge of being thrown away.
It seeks the child who disowned it."
entries.translation_source: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge of being thrown away. It seeks the child who disowned it.
entries.translated: Una bambola che è diventata un Pokémon per il rancore di essere stata gettata via. Cerca il bambino che l{B4}ha rinnegata.

entries.original:
"It loves the crying of children. It
startles bad kids by passing through
walls and making them cry."
entries.translation_source: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.
entries.translated: Adora il pianto dei bambini. Spaventa i bambini cattivi passando attraverso i muri e facendoli piangere.

entries.original:
"Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens
its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it
were a black hole."
entries.translation_source: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo è completamente vuoto. Quando apre la bocca, risucchia tutto come se fosse un buco nero.

entries.original:
"It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of
fruit around its neck is delicious.
The fruit grows twice a year."
entries.translation_source: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.
entries.translated: Vive nelle giungle tropicali. Il grappolo di frutti attorno al suo collo è delizioso. I frutti crescono due volte l{B4}anno.

entries.original:
"Its cries echo inside its hollow body
to emerge as beautiful notes for
startling and repelling foes."
entries.translation_source: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.
entries.translated: I suoi versi riecheggiano nel suo corpo cavo per emergere come note meravigliose che spaventano e respingono i nemici.

entries.original:
"It appears when it senses an impending
natural disaster. As a result, it was
mistaken as a doom-bringer."
entries.translation_source: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.
entries.translated: Appare quando percepisce un{B4}imminente catastrofe naturale. Per questo motivo, fu scambiato per un messaggero di sventura.

entries.original:
"It tends to move in a pack. Individuals
squash against one another to toughen
their spirits."
entries.translation_source: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.
entries.translated: Tendono a muoversi in branco. I singoli individui si schiacciano l{B4}uno contro l{B4}altro per temprare il loro spirito.

entries.original:
"In the snow country, certain folklore
says a house will prosper if a Snorunt
lives there."
entries.translation_source: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.
entries.translated: Nel paese della neve, un certo folclore dice che una casa prospererà se vi vive uno Snorunt.

entries.original:
"It has a body of ice that won’t melt,
even with fire. It can instantly freeze
moisture in the atmosphere."
entries.translation_source: It has a body of ice that won’t melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
entries.translated: Ha un corpo di ghiaccio che non si scioglie nemmeno col fuoco. Può congelare all{B4}istante l{B4}umidità nell{B4}atmosfera.

entries.original:
"They can’t swim well yet, and they move
much faster by rolling. When they’re
happy, they clap fins."
entries.translation_source: They can’t swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they’re happy, they clap fins.
entries.translated: Non sanno ancora nuotare bene e si muovono molto più velocemente rotolando. Quando sono felici, battono le pinne.

entries.original:
"It touches new things with its nose to
test for smell and feel. It plays by
spinning Spheal on its nose."
entries.translation_source: It touches new things with its nose to test for smell and feel. It plays by spinning Spheal on its nose.
entries.translated: Tocca le cose nuove con il naso per testarne l{B4}odore e la consistenza. Gioca facendo girare Spheal sul naso.

entries.original:
"It shatters ice with its big tusks.
Its thick blubber repels not only the
cold, but also enemy attacks."
entries.translation_source: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
entries.translated: Frantuma il ghiaccio con le sue grandi zanne. Il suo spesso strato di grasso lo protegge non solo dal freddo, ma anche dagli attacchi nemici.

entries.original:
"It makes a single pearl during its
lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify
psychic power."
entries.translation_source: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
entries.translated: Produce una sola perla nel corso della sua vita. Si dice che la perla amplifichi il potere psichico.

entries.original:
"It lives deep in the sea where no light
ever filters down. It lights up its small
fishlike tail to attract prey."
entries.translation_source: It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down. It lights up its small fishlike tail to attract prey.
entries.translated: Vive nelle profondità del mare, dove non filtra mai alcuna luce. Illumina la sua piccola coda simile a quella di un pesce per attirare le prede.

entries.original:
"Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant.
With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed
that grows between rocks."
entries.translation_source: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.
entries.translated: La sua forma natatoria è di un{B4}eleganza squisita. Con la sua bocca sottile, si nutre delle alghe che crescono tra le rocce.

entries.original:
"A rare Pokémon discovered during a
deep-sea exploration. It has not
changed in over 100 million years."
entries.translation_source: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.
entries.translated: Un raro Pokémon scoperto durante un{B4}esplorazione in acque profonde. Non è cambiato da oltre 100 milioni di anni.

entries.original:
"During the spawning season, countless
Luvdisc congregate at coral reefs,
turning the waters pink."
entries.translation_source: During the spawning season, countless Luvdisc congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.
entries.translated: Durante la stagione riproduttiva, innumerevoli Luvdisc si riuniscono nelle barriere coralline, tingendo le acque di rosa.

entries.original:
"It longingly hopes for wings to grow
so it can fly. It practices by leaping
off cliffs every day."
entries.translation_source: It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly. It practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
entries.translated: Spera ardentemente che gli crescano le ali per poter volare. Si esercita saltando ogni giorno dalle scogliere.

entries.original:
"Its armored body makes all attacks bounce
off. The armor is too tough, however,
making it heavy and somewhat sluggish."
entries.translation_source: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo corazzato fa rimbalzare tutti gli attacchi. La corazza è però troppo resistente, il che lo rende pesante e un po{B4} lento.

entries.original:
"As a result of its long-held dream of
flying, its cellular structure changed,
and wings grew out."
entries.translation_source: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
entries.translated: Per effetto del suo sogno di volare coltivato a lungo, la sua struttura cellulare è cambiata e sono spuntate le ali.

entries.original:
"It uses magnetic waves to converse
with its kind. All the cells in its body
are magnetic."
entries.translation_source: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.
entries.translated: Usa onde magnetiche per comunicare con i suoi simili. Tutte le cellule del suo corpo sono magnetiche.

entries.original:
"When two Beldum fuse together, a
magnetic nervous system places their
brains in union."
entries.translation_source: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.
entries.translated: Quando due Beldum si fondono, un sistema nervoso magnetico unisce i loro cervelli.

entries.original:
"With four linked brains, it’s more
intelligent than a supercomputer.
It uses calculations to analyze foes."
entries.translation_source: With four linked brains, it’s more intelligent than a supercomputer. It uses calculations to analyze foes.
entries.translated: Con quattro cervelli collegati, è più intelligente di un supercomputer. Usa i calcoli per analizzare i nemici.

entries.original:
"It is entirely composed of rocks with no
sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery
even to modern scientists."
entries.translation_source: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.
entries.translated: È composto interamente di rocce, senza alcuna traccia di cervello o cuore. È un mistero persino per gli scienziati moderni.

entries.original:
"It is said to have slept in a glacier
for thousands of years. Its body
can’t be melted, even by magma."
entries.translation_source: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can’t be melted, even by magma.
entries.translated: Si dice che abbia dormito in un ghiacciaio per migliaia di anni. Il suo corpo non può essere sciolto, neppure dal magma.

entries.original:
"It is sturdier than any kind of metal.
It hardened due to pressure underground
over tens of thousands of years."
entries.translation_source: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.
entries.translated: È più resistente di qualsiasi metallo. Si è indurito a causa della pressione sotterranea esercitata per decine di migliaia di anni.

entries.original:
"Its body is covered with a down that
can refract light in such a way that
it becomes invisible."
entries.translation_source: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo è ricoperto da una lanugine che può rifrangere la luce in modo tale da renderlo invisibile.

entries.original:
"It has a docile temperament and dislikes
fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can
fly faster than a jet plane."
entries.translation_source: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.
entries.translated: Ha un temperamento docile e non ama combattere. Raccogliendo le zampe anteriori, può volare più veloce di un jet.

entries.original:
"A mythical Pokémon said to have
swelled the seas with rain and tidal
waves. It battled with Groudon."
entries.translation_source: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon leggendario di cui si dice che abbia ingrossato i mari con pioggia e maremoti. Ha combattuto contro Groudon.

entries.original:
"It had been asleep in underground
magma ever since it fiercely fought
Kyogre long ago."
entries.translation_source: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.
entries.translated: Dormiva nel magma sotterraneo da quando, molto tempo fa, combatté ferocemente contro Kyogre.

entries.original:
"It flies in the ozone layer, way up high
in the sky. Until recently, no one had
ever seen it."
entries.translation_source: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.
entries.translated: Vola nello strato di ozono, molto in alto nel cielo. Fino a poco tempo fa, nessuno l{B4}aveva mai visto.

entries.original:
"It is said to make any wish come true.
It is awake for only seven days out of
a thousand years."
entries.translation_source: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.
entries.translated: Si dice che possa esaudire qualsiasi desiderio. Rimane sveglio solo per sette giorni ogni mille anni.

entries.original:
"An alien virus that fell to earth on a
meteorite underwent a DNA mutation to
become this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteorite underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
entries.translated: Un virus alieno caduto sulla Terra su un meteorite ha subito una mutazione del DNA ed è diventato questo Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Made from soil, the shell on its back
hardens when it drinks water. It lives
along lakes."
entries.translation_source: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
entries.translated: Fatto di terra, il carapace sulla schiena si indurisce quando beve acqua. Vive lungo i laghi.

entries.original:
"A Grotle that lives in the forest is
said to have its own secret
springwater."
entries.translation_source: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.
entries.translated: Si dice che un Grotle che vive nella foresta abbia una sorgente d{B4}acqua segreta tutta sua.

entries.original:
"Ancient people imagined that beneath
the ground, a gigantic Torterra
dwelled."
entries.translation_source: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.
entries.translated: Gli antichi immaginavano che sotto terra vivesse una gigantesca Torterra.

entries.original:
"Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas
made in its belly. Even rain can’t
extinguish the fire."
entries.translation_source: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.
entries.translated: La sua parte posteriore infuocata è alimentata dal gas prodotto nel suo ventre. Perfino la pioggia non riesce a spegnere il fuoco.

entries.original:
"To intimidate attackers, it stretches
the fire on its tail to make itself
appear bigger."
entries.translation_source: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
entries.translated: Per intimidire gli aggressori, allunga il fuoco sulla coda per sembrare più grande.

entries.original:
"It tosses its enemies around with
agility. It uses all its limbs to fight
in its own unique style."
entries.translation_source: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.
entries.translated: Scaglia i nemici con agilità. Usa tutti i suoi arti per combattere con uno stile tutto suo.

entries.original:
"Because it is very proud, it hates
accepting food from people. Its thick
down guards it from cold."
entries.translation_source: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
entries.translated: Poiché è molto orgoglioso, odia accettare cibo dalle persone. La sua folta peluria lo protegge dal freddo.

entries.original:
"Because every Prinplup considers itself
to be the most important, they can
never form a group."
entries.translation_source: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.
entries.translated: Poiché ogni Prinplup si ritiene il più importante, non riescono mai a formare un gruppo.

entries.original:
"It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it
will decimate anything that threatens
its pride."
entries.translation_source: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.
entries.translated: Evita le dispute inutili, ma annienterà qualsiasi cosa minacci il suo orgoglio.

entries.original:
"They flock in great numbers. Though
small, they flap their wings with great
power."
entries.translation_source: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
entries.translated: Si radunano in gran numero. Pur essendo piccoli, sbattono le ali con grande potenza.

entries.original:
"It lives in forests and fields.
Squabbles over territory occur when
flocks collide."
entries.translation_source: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.
entries.translated: Vive nelle foreste e nei campi. Gli scontri per il territorio avvengono quando gli stormi si scontrano.

entries.original:
"It has a savage nature. It will
courageously challenge foes that are
much larger."
entries.translation_source: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
entries.translated: Ha una natura selvaggia. Sfida con coraggio avversari molto più grandi.

entries.original:
"With nerves of steel, nothing can
perturb it. It is more agile and active
than it appears."
entries.translation_source: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
entries.translated: Con nervi d{B4}acciaio, nulla può turbarlo. È più agile e attivo di quanto sembri.

entries.original:
"It makes its nest by damming streams
with bark and mud. It is known as an
industrious worker."
entries.translation_source: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
entries.translated: Costruisce il suo nido sbarrando i corsi d{B4}acqua con corteccia e fango. È noto come un lavoratore instancabile.

entries.original:
"When its antennae hit each other, it
sounds like the music of a xylophone."
entries.translation_source: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.
entries.translated: Quando le sue antenne si urtano, suona come la musica di uno xilofono.

entries.original:
"It signals its emotions with its
melodies. Scientists are studying these
melodic patterns."
entries.translation_source: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.
entries.translated: Comunica le proprie emozioni con le sue melodie. Gli scienziati stanno studiando questi schemi melodici.

entries.original:
"All of its fur dazzles if danger is
sensed. It flees while the foe is
momentarily blinded."
entries.translation_source: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
entries.translated: Tutta la sua pelliccia abbaglia quando percepisce un pericolo. Fuga mentre il nemico è momentaneamente accecato.

entries.original:
"It rests its forelegs on others to
communicate with rhythmic electric
pulses from its claws."
entries.translation_source: It rests its forelegs on others to communicate with rhythmic electric pulses from its claws.
entries.translated: Appoggia le zampe anteriori sugli altri per comunicare con impulsi elettrici ritmici emessi dalle sue zampe.

entries.original:
"It can see clearly through walls to
track down its prey and seek its lost
young."
entries.translation_source: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.
entries.translated: Può vedere chiaramente attraverso i muri per rintracciare le prede e cercare i propri piccoli smarriti.

entries.original:
"It lives alongside clear ponds. It
scatters pollen that induces harsh
sneezing and runny noses."
entries.translation_source: It lives alongside clear ponds. It scatters pollen that induces harsh sneezing and runny noses.
entries.translated: Vive accanto a stagni limpidi. Sparge polline che provoca forti starnuti e il naso che cola.

entries.original:
"It attracts prey with a sweet aroma,
then downs it with thorny whips hidden
in its arms."
entries.translation_source: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
entries.translated: Attira le prede con un dolce aroma, poi le abbatte con fruste spinose nascoste nelle sue braccia.

entries.original:
"It lived in jungles around 100 million
years ago. Its skull is as hard as
iron."
entries.translation_source: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
entries.translated: Viveva nelle giungle circa 100 milioni di anni fa. Il suo cranio è duro come il ferro.

entries.original:
"Its powerful headbutt has enough power
to shatter even the most durable things
upon impact."
entries.translation_source: Its powerful headbutt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
entries.translated: La sua poderosa testata ha una forza sufficiente a frantumare perfino le cose più resistenti all{B4}impatto.

entries.original:
"It is outstandingly armored. As a
result, it can eat grass and berries
without having to fight."
entries.translation_source: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.
entries.translated: È dotato di un{B4}armatura eccezionale. Di conseguenza, può mangiare erba e bacche senza dover combattere.

entries.original:
"When attacked, they form a wall with
their shield like faces to protect their
young."
entries.translation_source: When attacked, they form a wall with their shield like faces to protect their young.
entries.translated: Quando vengono attaccati, formano un muro con i loro volti simili a scudi per proteggere i piccoli.

entries.original:
"If its cloak is broken in battle, it
quickly remakes the cloak with materials
nearby."
entries.translation_source: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.
entries.translated: Se il suo mantello si rompe in lotta, lo ricrea rapidamente con materiali trovati nei dintorni.

entries.original:
"It is said that a Wormadam that evolves
on a cold day will have a thicker
cloak."
entries.translation_source: It is said that a Wormadam that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.
entries.translated: Si dice che un Wormadam che si evolve in una giornata fredda abbia un manto più spesso.

entries.original:
"It flutters around at night and steals
honey from the Combee hive."
entries.translation_source: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.
entries.translated: Svolazza di notte e ruba il miele dall{B4}alveare di Combee.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon formed by three others. It
busily carries sweet floral honey to
Vespiquen."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to Vespiquen.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon formato da altri tre. Trasporta diligentemente miele floreale dolce a Vespiquen.

entries.original:
"It raises grubs in the holes in its
body. It secretes pheromones to control
Combee."
entries.translation_source: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control Combee.
entries.translated: Alleva larve nei buchi del suo corpo. Secreta feromoni per controllare i Combee.

entries.original:
"It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with
electric cheek pouches. It shoots
charges from its tail."
entries.translation_source: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.
entries.translated: È uno dei Pokémon dotati di sacche elettriche sulle guance. Spara scariche dalla coda.

entries.original:
"It swims by rotating its two tails like
a screw. When it dives, its flotation
sac collapses."
entries.translation_source: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.
entries.translated: Nuota ruotando le sue due code come una vite. Quando si tuffa, la sua sacca galleggiante si sgonfia.

entries.original:
"It is a common sight around fishing
ports. It is known to rescue people and
carry off prey."
entries.translation_source: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
entries.translated: È una presenza comune nei porti di pesca. Si dice che salvi le persone e trascini via le prede.

entries.original:
"The small ball is not only full of
nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try
to peck it off."
entries.translation_source: The small ball is not only full of nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.
entries.translated: La piccola sfera non è solo ricca di nutrienti, è anche gustosa. Gli Starly cercano di beccarla via.

entries.original:
"It blooms during times of strong
sunlight. It tries to make up for
everything it endured as a bud."
entries.translation_source: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
entries.translated: Fiorisce quando la luce del sole è intensa. Cerca di compensare tutto ciò che ha sopportato da bocciolo.

entries.original:
"Its shape and coloration vary,
depending on its habitat."
entries.translation_source: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.
entries.translated: La sua forma e la sua colorazione variano a seconda dell{B4}habitat.

entries.original:
"When its natural enemy attacks, it
oozes purple fluid and escapes."
entries.translation_source: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.
entries.translated: Quando il suo nemico naturale attacca, trasuda un liquido viola e fugge.

entries.original:
"It is very difficult to dodge the
consecutive strikes of its two tails."
entries.translation_source: It is very difficult to dodge the consecutive strikes of its two tails.
entries.translated: È molto difficile schivare i colpi consecutivi delle sue due code.

entries.original:
"Stories go that it grabs the hands
of small children and drags them
away to the afterlife."
entries.translation_source: Stories go that it grabs the hands of small children and drags them away to the afterlife.
entries.translated: Si racconta che afferri le mani dei bambini piccoli e li trascini via nell{B4}aldilà.

entries.original:
"It grabs people and Pokémon and
carries them off somewhere.
Where do they go? Nobody knows."
entries.translation_source: It grabs people and Pokémon and carries them off somewhere. Where do they go? Nobody knows.
entries.translated: Afferra persone e Pokémon e li porta via da qualche parte. Dove vadano? Nessuno lo sa.

entries.original:
"Its ears are always rolled up. They can
be forcefully extended to shatter even
a large boulder."
entries.translation_source: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
entries.translated: Le sue orecchie sono sempre arrotolate. Possono essere distese con forza fino a frantumare anche un grande macigno.

entries.original:
"It sheds its fur twice a year. Its
winter fur is soft and fluffy."
entries.translation_source: It sheds its fur twice a year. Its winter fur is soft and fluffy.
entries.translated: Muta il pelo due volte l{B4}anno. Il suo pelo invernale è morbido e soffice.

entries.original:
"It chants incantations. While they
usually torment targets, some chants
bring happiness."
entries.translation_source: It chants incantations. While they usually torment targets, some chants bring happiness.
entries.translated: Canta incantesimi. Sebbene di solito tormentino i bersagli, alcuni canti portano felicità.

entries.original:
"Becoming active at night, it is known
to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow."
entries.translation_source: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow.
entries.translated: Diventando attivo di notte, è noto per comparire in gruppo con numerosi Murkrow al seguito.

entries.original:
"With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a
mild hypnotic state. It is a very
fickle Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a mild hypnotic state. It is a very fickle Pokémon.
entries.translated: Con il suo sguardo acuto, induce i nemici in un lieve stato ipnotico. È un Pokémon molto volubile.

entries.original:
"To make itself appear intimidatingly
beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with
its twin tails."
entries.translation_source: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.
entries.translated: Per apparire minacciosamente massiccio, si stringe la vita con forza usando le sue due code.

entries.original:
"It emits cries by agitating an orb at
the back of its throat. It moves with
flouncing hops."
entries.translation_source: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
entries.translated: Emette versi agitando una sfera nella parte posteriore della gola. Si muove con saltelli ondeggianti.

entries.original:
"It sprays a nose-curling, stinky fluid
from its rear to repel attackers."
entries.translation_source: It sprays a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear to repel attackers.
entries.translated: Spruzza dal posteriore un fluido puzzolente che fa arricciare il naso per tenere lontani gli aggressori.

entries.original:
"It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from
the tip of its tail to attack. Its range
is over 160 feet."
entries.translation_source: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
entries.translated: Spruzza un fluido dall{B4}odore ripugnante dalla punta della coda per attaccare. Ha una gittata superiore a 160 piedi.

entries.original:
"X-ray photos were taken to check its
body structure. Nothing appeared,
however."
entries.translation_source: X-ray photos were taken to check its body structure. Nothing appeared, however.
entries.translated: Sono state scattate radiografie per controllare la struttura del corpo. Tuttavia, non è emerso nulla.

entries.original:
"Ancient people believed that
petitioning Bronzong for rain was the
way to make crops grow."
entries.translation_source: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.
entries.translated: Gli antichi credevano che invocare Bronzong per far piovere fosse il modo di far crescere i raccolti.

entries.original:
"It prefers arid environments. It leaks
water from its eyes to adjust its
body’s fluid levels."
entries.translation_source: It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.
entries.translated: Preferisce gli ambienti aridi. Fa uscire acqua dagli occhi per regolare i livelli dei liquidi del suo corpo.

entries.original:
"It habitually mimics foes. Once
mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes
off this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
entries.translated: Imita abitualmente i nemici. Una volta imitato, il nemico non riesce a staccare gli occhi da questo Pokémon.

entries.original:
"It loves round white things. It carries
an egg-shaped rock in imitation of
Chansey."
entries.translation_source: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of Chansey.
entries.translated: Ama le cose bianche e tonde. Porta con sé una pietra a forma di uovo in imitazione di Chansey.

entries.original:
"Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a
result, it can cleverly mimic human
speech."
entries.translation_source: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.
entries.translated: La sua lingua è proprio come quella di un essere umano. Di conseguenza, può imitare abilmente la voce umana.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon that was formed by 108
spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an
Odd Keystone."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon formato da 108 spiriti. È legato a una fessura in una Chiave Stramba.

entries.original:
"It once lived in the tropics. To avoid
the cold, it lives in caves warmed by
geothermal heat."
entries.translation_source: It once lived in the tropics. To avoid the cold, it lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat.
entries.translated: Un tempo viveva nei tropici. Per evitare il freddo, vive in grotte riscaldate dal calore geotermico.

entries.original:
"It loves sparkly things. It seeks
treasures in caves and hoards the loot
into its nest."
entries.translation_source: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot into its nest.
entries.translated: Adora le cose scintillanti. Cerca tesori nelle caverne e accumula il bottino nel suo nido.

entries.original:
"It flies at speeds equal to a jet
fighter plane. It never allows its prey
to escape."
entries.translation_source: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.
entries.translated: Vola a velocità pari a quelle di un jet da caccia. Non permette mai alla sua preda di sfuggire.

entries.original:
"It hides food under its long body hair.
However, it forgets it has hidden the
food."
entries.translation_source: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.
entries.translated: Nasconde il cibo sotto il suo lungo pelo corporeo. Tuttavia, si dimentica di averlo nascosto.

entries.original:
"The aura that emanates from its body
intensifies to alert others if it is
afraid or sad."
entries.translation_source: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
entries.translated: L{B4}aura che emana dal suo corpo si intensifica per avvisare gli altri se è spaventato o triste.

entries.original:
"It has the ability to sense the Auras
of all things. It understands human
speech."
entries.translation_source: It has the ability to sense the Auras of all things. It understands human speech.
entries.translated: È in grado di percepire le Aure di ogni cosa. Comprende il linguaggio umano.

entries.original:
"It lives in arid places. Instead of
perspiration, it expels grainy sand from
its body."
entries.translation_source: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
entries.translated: Vive in luoghi aridi. Invece di sudare, espelle sabbia granulosa dal corpo.

entries.original:
"Surprisingly quick to anger. It holds
its mouth agape as a display of
strength."
entries.translation_source: Surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of strength.
entries.translated: Si adira sorprendentemente in fretta. Tiene la bocca spalancata come dimostrazione di forza.

entries.original:
"It lives in arid lands. It buries
itself in sand and lies in wait for
unsuspecting prey."
entries.translation_source: It lives in arid lands. It buries itself in sand and lies in wait for unsuspecting prey.
entries.translated: Vive in terre aride. Si seppellisce nella sabbia e attende in agguato prede ignare.

entries.original:
"Its body is encased in a sturdy shell.
Its head rotates 180 degrees,
eliminating blind spots."
entries.translation_source: Its body is encased in a sturdy shell. Its head rotates 180 degrees, eliminating blind spots.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo è racchiuso in un robusto guscio. La sua testa ruota di 180 gradi, eliminando i punti ciechi.

entries.original:
"Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an
eerie blubbering sound for
intimidation."
entries.translation_source: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.
entries.translated: Gonfiando i suoi sacchi veleniferi, emette un inquietante suono gorgogliante per intimidire.

entries.original:
"Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so
vile that even a scratch could prove
fatal."
entries.translation_source: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
entries.translated: I suoi artigli sulle nocche secernono una tossina così vile che anche un graffio potrebbe rivelarsi fatale.

entries.original:
"Hanging from branches using its
tentacles, it looks like a plant. It
awaits prey, mouth wide open."
entries.translation_source: Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It awaits prey, mouth wide open.
entries.translated: Appeso ai rami con i suoi tentacoli, sembra una pianta. Attende le prede, a bocca spalancata.

entries.original:
"The line running down its side can
store sunlight. It shines vividly at
night."
entries.translation_source: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
entries.translated: La linea che corre lungo il suo fianco può immagazzinare la luce solare. Brilla intensamente di notte.

entries.original:
"Lumineon swimming in the darkness of
the deep sea look like stars shining in
the night sky."
entries.translation_source: Lumineon swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.
entries.translated: I Lumineon che nuotano nell{B4}oscurità delle profondità marine sembrano stelle che brillano nel cielo notturno.

entries.original:
"Scientists discovered that the
distinctive patterns on its back differ
by region."
entries.translation_source: Scientists discovered that the distinctive patterns on its back differ by region.
entries.translated: Gli scienziati hanno scoperto che i caratteristici motivi sul suo dorso cambiano a seconda della regione.

entries.original:
"In the spring, it grows berries with
the texture of frozen treats around its
belly."
entries.translation_source: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.
entries.translated: In primavera, fa crescere intorno al ventre bacche dalla consistenza di gelati.

entries.original:
"It blankets wide areas in snow by
whipping up blizzards. It is also known
as \qoThe Ice Monster.\qc"
entries.translation_source: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as [quote-open-1]The Ice Monster.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated: Ricopre vaste aree di neve scatenando bufere. È anche noto come \qoIl Mostro di Ghiaccio.\qc

entries.original:
"It sends signals to others by carving
odd patterns in frost-covered trees and
ice."
entries.translation_source: It sends signals to others by carving odd patterns in frost-covered trees and ice.
entries.translated: Invia segnali agli altri incidendo strani motivi su alberi e ghiaccio ricoperti di brina.

entries.original:
"It evolved from exposure to a special
magnetic field. Three units generate
magnetism."
entries.translation_source: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
entries.translated: Si è evoluto a seguito dell{B4}esposizione a un particolare campo magnetico. Tre unità generano magnetismo.

entries.original:
"The long tongue is always soggy with
slobber. The saliva contains a solvent
that causes numbness."
entries.translation_source: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.
entries.translated: La lunga lingua è sempre fradicia di bava. La saliva contiene un solvente che provoca intorpidimento.

entries.original:
"From holes in its palms, it fires out
Geodude. Its carapace can withstand
volcanic eruptions."
entries.translation_source: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
entries.translated: Dai buchi nei suoi palmi, spara Geodude. Il suo carapace può resistere alle eruzioni vulcaniche.

entries.original:
"Its vines grow so profusely that, in
the warm season, you can’t even see its
eyes."
entries.translation_source: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can’t even see its eyes.
entries.translated: Le sue liane crescono così rigogliose che, nella stagione calda, non si riescono nemmeno a vedere i suoi occhi.

entries.original:
"As its electric charge amplifies, blue
sparks begin to crackle between its
horns."
entries.translation_source: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.
entries.translated: Man mano che la sua carica elettrica si amplifica, tra le sue corna cominciano a scoppiettare scintille blu.

entries.original:
"When launching 3,600 degrees F
fireballs, its body takes on a whitish
hue from the intense heat."
entries.translation_source: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.
entries.translated: Quando lancia palle di fuoco a 3.600 gradi Fahrenheit, il suo corpo assume una tonalità biancastra a causa del calore intenso.

entries.original:
"It will never appear where there is
strife. Its sightings have become rare
recently."
entries.translation_source: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
entries.translated: Non apparirà mai dove c{B4}è discordia. Le sue apparizioni sono diventate rare di recente.

entries.original:
"Its jaw power is incredible. It is
adept at biting apart foes while flying
by at high speed."
entries.translation_source: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.
entries.translated: La sua potenza delle mascelle è incredibile. Sa mordere i nemici a pezzi mentre sfreccia ad alta velocità.

entries.original:
"Just like a plant, it uses
photosynthesis. As a result, it is
always enveloped in clear air."
entries.translation_source: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
entries.translated: Proprio come una pianta, usa la fotosintesi. Di conseguenza, è sempre avvolto da aria limpida.

entries.original:
"It causes small ice crystals to form by
lowering the temperature of the
surrounding atmosphere."
entries.translation_source: It causes small ice crystals to form by lowering the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere.
entries.translated: Fa formare minuscoli cristalli di ghiaccio abbassando la temperatura dell{B4}atmosfera circostante.

entries.original:
"It observes prey while hanging inverted
from branches. When the chance presents
itself, it swoops!"
entries.translation_source: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
entries.translated: Osserva le prede mentre pende a testa in giù dai rami. Quando se ne presenta l{B4}occasione, si lancia in picchiata!

entries.original:
"A frozen one was dug up from soil
dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to
much amazement."
entries.translation_source: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.
entries.translated: Un esemplare congelato è stato dissotterrato da un terreno risalente a 10.000 anni fa. Si è risvegliato tra grande stupore.

entries.original:
"Its programming was modified to enable
work in alien dimensions. It did not
work as planned."
entries.translation_source: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.
entries.translated: La sua programmazione è stata modificata per consentirgli di lavorare in dimensioni aliene. Non ha funzionato come previsto.

entries.original:
"A master of courtesy and swordsmanship,
it fights using extending swords on its
elbows."
entries.translation_source: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
entries.translated: Maestro di cortesia e scherma, combatte usando spade estensibili sui gomiti.

entries.original:
"It freely controls three small units
called Mini-Noses using magnetic force."
entries.translation_source: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
entries.translated: Controlla liberamente tre piccole unità chiamate Mini-Nasi usando la forza magnetica.

entries.original:
"It is said to take lost spirits into
its pliant body and guide them home."
entries.translation_source: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
entries.translated: Si dice che accolga gli spiriti smarriti nel suo corpo flessibile e li guidi a casa.

entries.original:
"Legends in snowy regions say that a
woman who was lost on an icy mountain
was reborn as Froslass."
entries.translation_source: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as Froslass.
entries.translated: Le leggende delle regioni innevate narrano che una donna smarritasi su una montagna ghiacciata sia rinata come Froslass.

entries.original:
"Its body is composed of plasma. It
is known to infiltrate electronic
devices and wreak havoc."
entries.translation_source: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo è composto di plasma. È noto per infiltrarsi nei dispositivi elettronici e seminare il caos.

entries.original:
"Known as \qoThe Being of Knowledge.\qc It
is said that it can wipe out the memory
of those who see its eyes."
entries.translation_source: Known as [quote-open-1]The Being of Knowledge.[quote-close-2] It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
entries.translated: Noto come \qoL{B4}Essere della Conoscenza.\qc Si dice che possa cancellare la memoria di chi incrocia il suo sguardo.

entries.original:
"Known as \qoThe Being of Emotion.\qc It
taught humans the nobility of sorrow,
pain, and joy."
entries.translation_source: Known as [quote-open-1]The Being of Emotion.[quote-close-2] It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
entries.translated: Conosciuto come \qol{B4}Essere delle Emozioni.\qc Insegnò agli esseri umani la nobiltà della tristezza, del dolore e della gioia.

entries.original:
"Known as \qoThe Being of Willpower.\qc It
sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep
the world in balance."
entries.translation_source: Known as [quote-open-1]The Being of Willpower.[quote-close-2] It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
entries.translated: Noto come \qoL{B4}Essere della Volontà.\qc Dorme sul fondo di un lago per mantenere il mondo in equilibrio.

entries.original:
"A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh.
It is said that time flows when Dialga’s
heart beats."
entries.translation_source: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga’s heart beats.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon leggendario di Sinnoh. Si dice che il tempo scorra quando il cuore di Dialga batte.

entries.original:
"It has the ability to distort space.
It is described as a deity in
Sinnoh-region mythology."
entries.translation_source: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
entries.translated: Ha la capacità di distorcere lo spazio. Nella mitologia della regione di Sinnoh è descritto come una divinità.

entries.original:
"It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in
with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on
ceilings and walls."
entries.translation_source: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
entries.translated: Vive in grotte vulcaniche. Si aggrappa con i suoi piedi a forma di croce per strisciare su soffitti e pareti.

entries.original:
"There is an enduring legend that states
this Pokémon towed continents with
ropes."
entries.translation_source: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
entries.translated: C{B4}è una leggenda che perdura e narra che questo Pokémon trascinò i continenti con delle funi.

entries.original:
"It was banished for its violence. It
silently gazed upon the old world from
the Distortion World."
entries.translation_source: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
entries.translated: Fu bandito a causa della sua violenza. Dalla Distortion World contemplava in silenzio il vecchio mondo.

entries.original:
"On nights around the quarter moon, the
aurora from its tail extends and
undulates beautifully."
entries.translation_source: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.
entries.translated: Nelle notti intorno al primo quarto di luna, l{B4}aurora della sua coda si allunga e ondeggia meravigliosamente.

entries.original:
"It drifts in warm seas. It always
returns to where it was born, no matter
how far it may have drifted."
entries.translation_source: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
entries.translated: Deriva nei mari caldi. Torna sempre nel luogo in cui è nato, non importa quanto lontano sia stato trascinato.

entries.original:
"It is born with a wondrous power that
lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
entries.translated: Nasce con uno straordinario potere che gli consente di legarsi a qualsiasi tipo di Pokémon.

entries.original:
"To protect itself, it afflicts those
around it with nightmares. However, it
means no harm."
entries.translation_source: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.
entries.translated: Per proteggersi, tormenta chi gli sta intorno con incubi. Tuttavia, non ha cattive intenzioni.

entries.original:
"The flowers all over its body burst
into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and
senses gratitude."
entries.translation_source: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.
entries.translated: I fiori su tutto il suo corpo sbocciano se viene abbracciato con affetto e percepisce gratitudine.

entries.original:
"It is told in mythology that this
Pokémon was born before the universe
even existed."
entries.translation_source: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.
entries.translated: La mitologia racconta che questo Pokémon sia nato prima ancora che l{B4}universo esistesse.

entries.original:
"It creates an unlimited supply of
energy inside its body, which it shares
with those who touch it."
entries.translation_source: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.
entries.translated: Produce al suo interno una scorta illimitata di energia, che condivide con chi lo tocca.

entries.original:
"It is very intelligent and calm. Being
exposed to lots of sunlight makes its
movements swifter."
entries.translation_source: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
entries.translated: È molto intelligente e calmo. Se esposto a molta luce solare, i suoi movimenti diventano più rapidi.

entries.original:
"When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be
used in photosynthesis, so it always
keeps itself clean."
entries.translation_source: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.
entries.translated: Quando si sporca, le sue foglie non possono essere usate nella fotosintesi, quindi si mantiene sempre pulito.

entries.original:
"It can stop its opponents’ movements
with just a glare. It takes in solar
energy and boosts it."
entries.translation_source: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it.
entries.translated: Può fermare i movimenti dei suoi avversari con un solo sguardo. Assorbe energia solare e la potenzia.

entries.original:
"It loves to eat roasted berries, but
sometimes it gets too excited and burns
them to a crisp."
entries.translation_source: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.
entries.translated: Ama mangiare bacche arrostite, ma a volte si emoziona troppo e le brucia fino a carbonizzarle.

entries.original:
"When its internal fire flares up, its
movements grow sharper and faster. When
in trouble, it emits smoke."
entries.translation_source: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
entries.translated: Quando il fuoco interiore divampa, i suoi movimenti diventano più rapidi e precisi. Quando è in difficoltà, emette fumo.

entries.original:
"It has mastered fast and powerful
fighting moves. It grows a beard of
fire."
entries.translation_source: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
entries.translated: Ha imparato mosse di Lotta rapide e potenti. Gli cresce una barba di fuoco.

entries.original:
"The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just
used for battle--it is also used to
break open hard berries."
entries.translation_source: The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it is also used to break open hard berries.
entries.translated: La scalchop sul suo ventre non serve solo in battaglia: viene usata anche per spaccare le bacche dure.

entries.original:
"Strict training is how it learns its
flowing double-scalchop technique."
entries.translation_source: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
entries.translated: Un allenamento rigoroso è il modo in cui apprende la sua fluida tecnica del doppio fendente.

entries.original:
"In the time it takes a foe to blink, it
can draw and sheathe the seamitars
attached to its front legs."
entries.translation_source: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
entries.translated: Nel tempo in cui un nemico impiega a battere le palpebre, può sguainare e reinserire le seimitari attaccate alle zampe anteriori.

entries.original:
"Extremely cautious, one of them is
always on a lookout, but it won’t notice
a foe coming from behind."
entries.translation_source: Extremely cautious, one of them is always on a lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.
entries.translated: Estremamente cauti, uno di loro fa sempre la sentinella, ma non si accorgerà di un nemico che arriva alle sue spalle.

entries.original:
"Using luminescent matter, it makes its
eyes and body glow and stuns attacking
opponents."
entries.translation_source: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
entries.translated: Utilizzando materia luminescente, fa brillare occhi e corpo e stordisce gli avversari che attaccano.

entries.original:
"Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it’s
also smart enough to check its foe’s
strength and avoid battle."
entries.translation_source: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it’s also smart enough to check its foe’s strength and avoid battle.
entries.translated: Pur essendo un Pokémon molto coraggioso, è abbastanza intelligente da valutare la forza del nemico ed evitare la lotta.

entries.original:
"This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers,
and it also takes care of other
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: This very loyal Pokémon helps Trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon molto fedele aiuta gli Allenatori e si prende cura anche degli altri Pokémon.

entries.original:
"This extremely wise Pokémon excels at
rescuing people stranded at sea or in
the mountains."
entries.translation_source: This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon estremamente saggio eccelle nel salvare le persone bloccate in mare o in montagna.

entries.original:
"They trick people with cuteness, and
steal their valuables just to see the
looks on their faces."
entries.translation_source: They trick people with cuteness, and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.
entries.translated: Ingannano le persone con la loro tenerezza e rubano i loro oggetti di valore solo per vedere l{B4}espressione sui loro volti.

entries.original:
"Their beautiful form comes from the
muscles they have developed. They run
silently in the night."
entries.translation_source: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.
entries.translated: La loro forma elegante deriva dai muscoli che hanno sviluppato. Corrono silenziosamente nella notte.

entries.original:
"It shares the leaf on its head with
weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are
known to relieve stress."
entries.translation_source: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
entries.translated: Condivide la foglia sulla testa con i Pokémon dall{B4}aria stanca. Queste foglie sono note per alleviare lo stress.

entries.original:
"It strikes its enemies with a
thorn-covered tail. The leaf on its head
is bitter."
entries.translation_source: It strikes its enemies with a thorn-covered tail. The leaf on its head is bitter.
entries.translated: Colpisce i nemici con la coda ricoperta di spine. La foglia sulla testa è amara.

entries.original:
"Very intelligent, it roasts berries
before eating them. It likes to help
people."
entries.translation_source: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.
entries.translated: Molto intelligente, arrostisce le bacche prima di mangiarle. Gli piace aiutare le persone.

entries.original:
"It loves sweets because they become
energy for the fire burning inside its
body."
entries.translation_source: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
entries.translated: Adora i dolci perché si trasformano in energia per il fuoco che arde dentro il suo corpo.

entries.original:
"The water stored inside the tuft on its
head is full of nutrients. It waters
plants using its tail."
entries.translation_source: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants using its tail.
entries.translated: L{B4}acqua immagazzinata nel ciuffo sulla sua testa è ricca di nutrienti. Bagna le piante usando la sua coda.

entries.original:
"The high-pressure water expelled from
its tail is so powerful, it can destroy
a concrete wall."
entries.translation_source: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
entries.translated: Il getto d{B4}acqua ad alta pressione espulso dalla sua coda è così potente da poter distruggere un muro di cemento.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon appears before people and
Pokémon who are having nightmares and
eats those dreams."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon appare davanti alle persone e ai Pokémon che fanno incubi e si nutre di quei sogni.

entries.original:
"The mist emanating from their foreheads
is packed with the dreams of people and
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
entries.translated: La nebbia che emana dalla sua fronte è colma dei sogni di persone e Pokémon.

entries.original:
"These Pokémon live in cities. They are
accustomed to people. Flocks often
gather in parks and plazas."
entries.translation_source: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.
entries.translated: Questi Pokémon vivono nelle città. Sono abituati alla presenza delle persone. Gli stormi si radunano spesso nei parchi e nelle piazze.

entries.original:
"It can return to its Trainer’s location
regardless of the distance separating
them."
entries.translation_source: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
entries.translated: Può tornare alla posizione del suo Allenatore indipendentemente dalla distanza che li separa.

entries.original:
"Males swing the plumage on their heads
to threaten others, but females are
better at flying."
entries.translation_source: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.
entries.translated: I maschi agitano il piumaggio sulla testa per intimidire gli altri, ma le femmine sono più brave a volare.

entries.original:
"Its mane shines when discharging
electricity. It uses flashing manes to
communicate with others."
entries.translation_source: Its mane shines when discharging electricity. It uses flashing manes to communicate with others.
entries.translated: La sua criniera brilla quando scarica elettricità. Usa il lampeggiare della criniera per comunicare con gli altri.

entries.original:
"When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs
wild, it shoots lightning from its mane
in all directions."
entries.translation_source: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
entries.translated: Quando questo Pokémon dal carattere irascibile si scatena, spara fulmini dalla sua criniera in tutte le direzioni.

entries.original:
"Its ear is hexagonal in shape.
Compressed underground, its body is as
hard as steel."
entries.translation_source: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
entries.translated: La sua orecchia ha forma esagonale. Compresso sottoterra, il suo corpo è duro come l{B4}acciaio.

entries.original:
"Because its energy was too great to
be contained, the energy leaked and
formed orange crystals."
entries.translation_source: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
entries.translated: Poiché la sua energia era troppo grande per essere contenuta, essa fuoriuscì formando cristalli arancioni.

entries.original:
"The solar rays it absorbs are processed
in its energy core and fired as a ball
of light."
entries.translation_source: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
entries.translated: I raggi solari che assorbe vengono elaborati nel suo nucleo energetico e sparati come una sfera di luce.

entries.original:
"It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose
to learn about its surroundings."
entries.translation_source: It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
entries.translated: Emette onde ultrasoniche dal naso per conoscere ciò che lo circonda.

entries.original:
"It shakes its tail vigorously when it
emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to
reduce concrete to rubble."
entries.translation_source: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.
entries.translated: Agita vigorosamente la coda quando emette onde ultrasoniche abbastanza forti da ridurre il cemento in macerie.

entries.original:
"By spinning its body, it can dig
straight through the ground at a speed
of 30 mph."
entries.translation_source: By spinning its body, it can dig straight through the ground at a speed of 30 mph.
entries.translated: Ruotando il proprio corpo, può scavare dritto sotto terra a una velocità di 30 miglia orarie.

entries.original:
"Forming a drill with its steel claws
and head, it can cut through a steel
plate, no matter the thickness."
entries.translation_source: Forming a drill with its steel claws and head, it can cut through a steel plate, no matter the thickness.
entries.translated: Formando una trivella con gli artigli d{B4}acciaio e la testa, può tagliare una lastra d{B4}acciaio, qualunque sia il suo spessore.

entries.original:
"Using the feelers on its ears, it can
tell how someone is feeling or when an
egg might hatch."
entries.translation_source: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
entries.translated: Usando i filamenti sulle sue orecchie, può capire come si sente qualcuno o quando un uovo potrebbe schiudersi.

entries.original:
"Always carrying squared logs, they help
out with construction. As they grow,
they carry bigger logs."
entries.translation_source: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.
entries.translated: Portando sempre con sé tronchi squadrati, aiutano nei lavori di costruzione. Man mano che crescono, trasportano tronchi più grandi.

entries.original:
"With strengthened bodies, they
skillfully wield steel beams to take
down buildings."
entries.translation_source: With strengthened bodies, they skillfully wield steel beams to take down buildings.
entries.translated: Con corpi irrobustiti, maneggiano abilmente travi d{B4}acciaio per abbattere gli edifici.

entries.original:
"It is thought that Conkeldurr taught
humans how to make concrete more than
2,000 years ago."
entries.translation_source: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
entries.translated: Si ritiene che Conkeldurr abbia insegnato agli esseri umani a fare il cemento oltre 2.000 anni fa.

entries.original:
"They warn others of danger by vibrating
their cheeks to create a high-pitched
sound."
entries.translation_source: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
entries.translated: Avvertono gli altri del pericolo vibrando le guance per produrre un suono acuto.

entries.original:
"It lives in the water and on land. It
uses its long, sticky tongue to capture
prey."
entries.translation_source: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.
entries.translated: Vive nell{B4}acqua e sulla terraferma. Usa la sua lunga lingua appiccicosa per catturare le prede.

entries.original:
"By putting power into its bumps, it
creates vibrations and increases the
power of its punches."
entries.translation_source: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.
entries.translated: Concentra la forza sulle sue protuberanze, creando vibrazioni e aumentando la potenza dei suoi pugni.

entries.original:
"When it tightens its belt, it becomes
stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave
their own belts."
entries.translation_source: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
entries.translated: Quando si stringe la cintura, diventa più forte. I Throh selvatici usano liane per intrecciare le proprie cinture.

entries.original:
"Desiring the strongest karate chop,
they seclude themselves in mountains and
train without sleeping."
entries.translation_source: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
entries.translated: Desiderosi di sferrare il colpo di karate più potente, si isolano tra le montagne e si allenano senza dormire.

entries.original:
"Since this Pokémon makes its own
clothes out of leaves, it is a popular
mascot for fashion designers."
entries.translation_source: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
entries.translated: Poiché questo Pokémon si confeziona i vestiti da solo usando le foglie, è una mascotte molto amata dagli stilisti.

entries.original:
"Preferring dark, damp places, it spends
the entire day eating fallen leaves
that lie around it."
entries.translation_source: Preferring dark, damp places, it spends the entire day eating fallen leaves that lie around it.
entries.translated: Preferendo luoghi bui e umidi, passa l{B4}intera giornata a mangiare le foglie cadute che gli stanno attorno.

entries.original:
"It keeps its eggs warm with heat from
fermenting leaves."
entries.translation_source: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves.
entries.translated: Tiene al caldo le sue uova con il calore generato dalle foglie in fermentazione.

entries.original:
"Its bite injects a potent poison,
enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon
that try to prey on it."
entries.translation_source: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
entries.translated: Il suo morso inietta un veleno potente, abbastanza da paralizzare i grandi Pokémon Uccello che cercano di predarlo.

entries.original:
"Protected by a hard shell, it spins its
body like a wheel and crashes furiously
into its enemies."
entries.translation_source: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
entries.translated: Protetto da un guscio duro, fa ruotare il corpo come una ruota e si schianta furiosamente contro i nemici.

entries.original:
"Highly aggressive, it uses the claws
near its neck to dig into its opponents
and poison them."
entries.translation_source: Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponents and poison them.
entries.translated: Estremamente aggressivo, usa gli artigli vicino al collo per piantare gli artigli negli avversari e avvelenarli.

entries.original:
"When attacked, it escapes by shooting
cotton from its body to serve as a decoy
to distract the attacker."
entries.translation_source: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body to serve as a decoy to distract the attacker.
entries.translated: Quando viene attaccato, fugge sparando cotone dal suo corpo per fungere da esca e distrarre l{B4}aggressore.

entries.original:
"Like the wind, it can slip through any
gap, no matter how small. It leaves
balls of white fluff behind."
entries.translation_source: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
entries.translated: Come il vento, può infilarsi in qualsiasi fessura, per quanto piccola. Lascia dietro di sé batuffoli di lanugine bianca.

entries.original:
"The leaves on its head are very bitter.
Eating one of these leaves is known to
refresh a tired body."
entries.translation_source: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
entries.translated: Le foglie sulla sua testa sono molto amare. Mangiare una di queste foglie è noto per rinvigorire un corpo stanco.

entries.original:
"The fragrance of the garland on its
head has a relaxing effect, but taking
care of it is very difficult."
entries.translation_source: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.
entries.translated: La fragranza della ghirlanda sulla sua testa ha un effetto rilassante, ma prendersene cura è molto difficile.

entries.original:
"Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue
Basculin are always fighting each other
over territory."
entries.translation_source: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.
entries.translated: Feroci e violenti Pokémon, i Basculin rossi e blu si scontrano continuamente tra loro per il territorio.

entries.original:
"They live hidden under hot desert sands
in order to keep their body temperature
from dropping."
entries.translation_source: They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.
entries.translated: Vivono nascosti sotto le calde sabbie del deserto per evitare che la temperatura del loro corpo si abbassi.

entries.original:
"It buries some of its prey in the sand
to use as emergency meals when its
hunts are unsuccessful."
entries.translation_source: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.
entries.translated: Seppellisce parte delle sue prede nella sabbia per usarle come pasti di emergenza quando le sue battute di caccia non hanno successo.

entries.original:
"It conceals itself in sandstorms that
Flygon whip up and waits patiently for
prey to appear."
entries.translation_source: It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.
entries.translated: Si nasconde nelle tempeste di sabbia sollevate da Flygon e attende pazientemente che compaia una preda.

entries.original:
"When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into
its body and its internal fire goes
down to 1,100 degrees F."
entries.translation_source: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees F.
entries.translated: Quando dorme, ritrae gli arti nel corpo e il suo fuoco interno scende a 1.100 gradi F.

entries.original:
"When weakened in battle, it transforms
into a stone statue then sharpens its
mind and fights mentally."
entries.translation_source: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue then sharpens its mind and fights mentally.
entries.translated: Quando è indebolito in lotta, si trasforma in una statua di pietra, poi affina la mente e combatte con la forza mentale.

entries.original:
"Arid regions are their habitat. They
move rhythmically, making a sound
similar to maracas."
entries.translation_source: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.
entries.translated: Le regioni aride sono il loro habitat. Si muovono ritmicamente, emettendo un suono simile a quello delle maracas.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon can easily melt holes in
hard rocks with a liquid secreted from
its mouth."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon può sciogliere facilmente dei buchi nelle rocce dure con un liquido secreto dalla bocca.
