entries.original:
"When its boulder is broken in battles
for territory, it feels unsure and
begins to weaken."
entries.translation_source: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.
entries.translated: Quando il suo masso si rompe nelle lotte territoriali, si sente insicuro e inizia a indebolirsi.

entries.original:
"It immediately headbutts anyone that
makes eye contact with it. Its skull is
massively thick."
entries.translation_source: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.
entries.translated: Colpisce subito con una cornata chiunque incroci il suo sguardo. Il suo cranio è estremamente spesso.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes
very good care of its family, its
friends, and its turf."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon può essere maleducato, ma si prende cura con grande attenzione della sua famiglia, dei suoi amici e del suo territorio.

entries.original:
"The guardians of an ancient city, they
always fly the same route while keeping
watch for invaders."
entries.translation_source: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.
entries.translated: Custodi di un{B4}antica città, volano sempre lungo la stessa rotta sorvegliando la presenza di invasori.

entries.original:
"Each of them carries a mask that used
to be its face when it was human."
entries.translation_source: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human.
entries.translated: Ognuno di loro porta una maschera che un tempo era il suo volto, quando era umano.

entries.original:
"Grave robbers who mistake them for real
coffins and get too close end up
trapped inside their bodies."
entries.translation_source: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.
entries.translated: I saccheggiatori di tombe che li scambiano per veri sarcofagi e si avvicinano troppo finiscono intrappolati al loro interno.

entries.original:
"Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon
can dive to depths beyond half a mile."
entries.translation_source: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
entries.translated: Riportato in vita da un fossile, questo Pokémon può immergersi fino a profondità superiori a mezzo miglio.

entries.original:
"Incredible jaw strength enables them to
chew up steel beams and rocks along
with their prey."
entries.translation_source: Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.
entries.translated: La loro incredibile forza delle mascelle permette loro di masticare travi d{B4}acciaio e rocce insieme alle prede.

entries.original:
"Restored from a fossil, this ancient
bird Pokémon has wings but can’t yet
fly."
entries.translation_source: Restored from a fossil, this ancient bird Pokémon has wings but can’t yet fly.
entries.translated: Riportato in vita da un fossile, questo antico Pokémon uccello ha le ali ma non sa ancora volare.

entries.original:
"It runs better than it flies. It takes
off into the sky by running at a speed
of 25 mph."
entries.translation_source: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.
entries.translated: Corre meglio di quanto voli. Decolla verso il cielo correndo a una velocità di 25 miglia orarie.

entries.original:
"Wanting more garbage, they follow
people who litter. They always belch
poison gas."
entries.translation_source: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.
entries.translated: Cercando altra spazzatura, seguono le persone che lasciano rifiuti in giro. Emettono sempre rutti di gas velenoso.

entries.original:
"Consuming garbage makes new kinds of
poison gases and liquids inside their
bodies."
entries.translation_source: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.
entries.translated: Consumare rifiuti fa nascere nuovi tipi di gas e liquidi velenosi nel suo corpo.

entries.original:
"It changes so it looks just like its
foe, tricks it, and then uses that
opportunity to flee."
entries.translation_source: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
entries.translated: Si trasforma per assomigliare esattamente al suo avversario, lo inganna e poi approfitta dell{B4}occasione per fuggire.

entries.original:
"Stories say those who tried to catch
Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and
punished."
entries.translation_source: Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.
entries.translated: Le storie raccontano che coloro che hanno cercato di catturare Zoroark sono stati intrappolati in un{B4}illusione e puniti.

entries.original:
"Minccino greet each other by grooming
one another thoroughly with their
tails."
entries.translation_source: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.
entries.translated: I Minccino si salutano a vicenda curandosi a fondo il pelo con la coda.

entries.original:
"Their white fur is coated in a special
oil that makes it easy for them to
deflect attacks."
entries.translation_source: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
entries.translated: La sua pelliccia bianca è ricoperta di un olio speciale che gli permette di deviare facilmente gli attacchi.

entries.original:
"Their ribbonlike feelers increase their
psychic power. They are always staring
at something."
entries.translation_source: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
entries.translated: I loro tentacoli simili a nastri aumentano il loro potere psichico. Stanno sempre fissando qualcosa.

entries.original:
"According to old tales, it creates
friends for itself by controlling
sleeping children on starry nights."
entries.translation_source: According to old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling sleeping children on starry nights.
entries.translated: Secondo antiche leggende, crea amici per sé controllando bambini addormentati nelle notti stellate.

entries.original:
"Starry skies thousands of light-years
away are visible in the space distorted
by their psychic power."
entries.translation_source: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their psychic power.
entries.translated: Nello spazio deformato dal loro potere psichico sono visibili cieli stellati a migliaia di anni luce di distanza.

entries.original:
"Because their bodies are enveloped in a
special liquid, they can survive in any
environment."
entries.translation_source: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.
entries.translated: Poiché i loro corpi sono avvolti da un liquido speciale, possono sopravvivere in qualsiasi ambiente.

entries.original:
"When their two divided brains think the
same thoughts, their psychic power is
maximized."
entries.translation_source: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.
entries.translated: Quando i loro due cervelli divisi pensano gli stessi pensieri, il loro potere psichico raggiunge il massimo.

entries.original:
"When Reuniclus shake hands, a network
forms between their brains, increasing
their psychic power."
entries.translation_source: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
entries.translated: Quando i Reuniclus si stringono la mano, si forma una rete tra i loro cervelli, aumentando il loro potere psichico.

entries.original:
"When attacked, it uses its feathers to
splash water, escaping under cover of
the spray."
entries.translation_source: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
entries.translated: Quando viene attaccato, usa le piume per schizzare acqua, fuggendo sotto la copertura degli spruzzi.

entries.original:
"Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one
dancing in the middle is the leader of
the flock."
entries.translation_source: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
entries.translated: Swanna iniziano a danzare al crepuscolo. Quello che danza al centro è il leader dello stormo.

entries.original:
"It feels pleasantly cool when embraced.
This Pokémon is treasured by households
in warm regions."
entries.translation_source: It feels pleasantly cool when embraced. This Pokémon is treasured by households in warm regions.
entries.translated: Quando lo si abbraccia, trasmette una piacevole sensazione di fresco. Questo Pokémon è molto apprezzato nelle case delle regioni calde.

entries.original:
"This hearty Pokémon survived the Ice
Age. It’s incredibly popular in very hot
regions."
entries.translation_source: This hearty Pokémon survived the Ice Age. It’s incredibly popular in very hot regions.
entries.translated: Questo robusto Pokémon è sopravvissuto all{B4}Era Glaciale. È incredibilmente popolare nelle regioni molto calde.

entries.original:
"If both heads get angry simultaneously,
this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying
everything in snow."
entries.translation_source: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.
entries.translated: Se entrambe le teste si arrabbiano simultaneamente, questo Pokémon espelle una tormenta di neve, seppellendo tutto nella neve.

entries.original:
"The turning of the seasons changes the
color and scent of its fur. People use
it to mark the seasons."
entries.translation_source: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of its fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
entries.translated: Il cambiamento delle stagioni modifica il colore e il profumo del suo pelo. Le persone lo usano per segnare il passare delle stagioni.

entries.original:
"They migrate according to seasons, so
some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers
of spring."
entries.translation_source: They migrate according to seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
entries.translated: Migrano in base alle stagioni, perciò alcuni chiamano Sawsbuck l{B4}araldo della primavera.

entries.original:
"They live on treetops and glide using
the inside of a cape-like membrane while
discharging electricity."
entries.translation_source: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.
entries.translated: Vivono sulle cime degli alberi e planano usando l{B4}interno di una membrana simile a un mantello mentre scaricano elettricità.

entries.original:
"For some reason they evolve when they
receive electrical energy while they are
attacking Shelmet."
entries.translation_source: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.
entries.translated: Per qualche motivo si evolvono quando ricevono energia elettrica mentre stanno attaccando Shelmet.

entries.original:
"Wearing the shell covering they stole
from Shelmet, they defend themselves and
attack with two lances."
entries.translation_source: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
entries.translated: Indossando il guscio che hanno rubato a Shelmet, si difendono e attaccano con due lance.

entries.original:
"It lures Pokémon with its pattern that
looks just like a Poké Ball then
releases poison spores."
entries.translation_source: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.
entries.translated: Attira i Pokémon con il suo motivo che somiglia in tutto e per tutto a una Poké Ball, poi rilascia spore velenose.

entries.original:
"It moves the caps on both arms and does
a dance to lure prey. It prefers damp
places."
entries.translation_source: It moves the caps on both arms and does a dance to lure prey. It prefers damp places.
entries.translated: Muove i cappucci su entrambe le braccia e danza per attirare le prede. Preferisce i luoghi umidi.

entries.original:
"They paralyze prey with poison, then
drag them down to their lairs, five
miles below the surface."
entries.translation_source: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.
entries.translated: Paralizzano le prede con il veleno, poi le trascinano nelle loro tane, cinque miglia sotto la superficie.

entries.original:
"Jellicent is always hanging around
fancy cruise ships and tankers, hoping
to drag away its prey."
entries.translation_source: Jellicent is always hanging around fancy cruise ships and tankers, hoping to drag away its prey.
entries.translated: Jellicent si aggira sempre attorno a lussuose navi da crociera e petroliere, sperando di trascinare via la sua preda.

entries.original:
"The special membrane enveloping
Alomomola has the ability to heal
wounds."
entries.translation_source: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
entries.translated: La membrana speciale che avvolge Alomomola ha la capacità di guarire le ferite.

entries.original:
"Joltik that live in cities have learned
a technique for sucking electricity
from the outlets in houses."
entries.translation_source: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
entries.translated: I Joltik che vivono nelle città hanno imparato una tecnica per succhiare elettricità dalle prese delle case.

entries.original:
"When attacked, they create an electric
barrier by spitting out many
electrically charged threads."
entries.translation_source: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
entries.translated: Quando vengono attaccati, creano una barriera elettrica sputando fuori molti fili carichi di elettricità.

entries.original:
"They stick their spikes into cave walls
and absorb the minerals they find in
the rock."
entries.translation_source: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.
entries.translated: Infilano le loro spine nelle pareti delle grotte e assorbono i minerali che trovano nella roccia.

entries.original:
"By swinging around its three spiky
feels and shooting spikes, it can
obliterate an opponent."
entries.translation_source: By swinging around its three spiky feels and shooting spikes, it can obliterate an opponent.
entries.translated: Agitando i suoi tre tentacoli spinosi e sparando aculei, può annientare un avversario.

entries.original:
"Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. They
spin around each other to generate
energy."
entries.translation_source: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. They spin around each other to generate energy.
entries.translated: Due corpi formano una coppia inseparabile. Ruotano l{B4}uno attorno all{B4}altro per generare energia.

entries.original:
"A mini and big gear comprise its body.
If the mini gear it launches at a foe
doesn’t return, it will die."
entries.translation_source: A mini and big gear comprise its body. If the mini gear it launches at a foe doesn’t return, it will die.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo è composto da un ingranaggio piccolo e uno grande. Se l{B4}ingranaggio piccolo che lancia contro un nemico non torna indietro, morirà.

entries.original:
"The gear with the red core is rotated
at high speed for a rapid energy
charge."
entries.translation_source: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.
entries.translated: L{B4}ingranaggio con il nucleo rosso viene fatto ruotare ad alta velocità per una rapida carica di energia.

entries.original:
"While one alone doesn’t have much
power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as
powerful as lightning."
entries.translation_source: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
entries.translated: Sebbene uno solo non abbia molta potenza, una catena di molti Tynamo può essere potente quanto un fulmine.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon has a big appetite. When
it spots its prey, it attacks it and
paralyzes it with electricity."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon has a big appetite. When it spots its prey, it attacks it and paralyzes it with electricity.
entries.translated: Ha un grande appetito. Quando individua la preda, la attacca e la paralizza con l{B4}elettricità.

entries.original:
"With its sucker mouth, it sucks in
prey. Then it uses its fangs to shock
the prey with electricity."
entries.translation_source: With its sucker mouth, it sucks in prey. Then it uses its fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
entries.translated: Con la sua bocca a ventosa, risucchia la preda. Poi usa le zanne per fulminarla con l{B4}elettricità.

entries.original:
"Rumors of its origin are linked to a
UFO crash site in the desert 50 years
ago."
entries.translation_source: Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.
entries.translated: Le voci sulle sue origini sono legate al luogo di schianto di un UFO nel deserto, avvenuto 50 anni fa.

entries.original:
"It uses psychic power to control an
opponent’s brain and tamper with its
memories."
entries.translation_source: It uses psychic power to control an opponent’s brain and tamper with its memories.
entries.translated: Usa il potere psichico per controllare il cervello di un avversario e alterarne i ricordi.

entries.original:
"Its flame is usually out, but it starts
shining when it absorbs life force from
people or Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when it absorbs life force from people or Pokémon.
entries.translated: La fiamma è di solito spenta, ma inizia a brillare quando assorbe l{B4}energia vitale di persone o Pokémon.

entries.original:
"It arrives near the moment of death and
steals spirit from the body."
entries.translation_source: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.
entries.translated: Arriva quasi al momento della morte e sottrae lo spirito dal corpo.

entries.original:
"Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame
burns up the spirit, leaving the body
behind."
entries.translation_source: Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
entries.translated: Essere consumati dalla fiamma di Chandelure brucia lo spirito, lasciando dietro di sé il corpo.

entries.original:
"Its large tusks have a tendency to
break, but each time they grow back,
they grow in harder and sturdier."
entries.translation_source: Its large tusks have a tendency to break, but each time they grow back, they grow in harder and sturdier.
entries.translated: I suoi grossi denti hanno la tendenza a rompersi, ma ogni volta che ricrescono diventano più duri e robusti.

entries.original:
"Their tusks can shatter rocks.
Territory battles between Fraxure can be
intensely violent."
entries.translation_source: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.
entries.translated: Le loro zanne possono frantumare le rocce. Le lotte territoriali tra Fraxure possono essere estremamente violente.

entries.original:
"Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even
if used to cut steel beams. They are
covered in hard armor."
entries.translation_source: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. They are covered in hard armor.
entries.translated: Le sue robuste zanne restano affilate anche se usate per tagliare travi d{B4}acciaio. Sono ricoperte da una corazza dura.

entries.original:
"When it is not feeling well, its mucus
gets watery and the power of its
Ice-type moves decreases."
entries.translation_source: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
entries.translated: Quando non si sente bene, il suo muco diventa acquoso e la potenza delle mosse di tipo Ghiaccio diminuisce.

entries.original:
"It freezes its breath to create fangs
and claws of ice. Cold northern areas
are its habitat."
entries.translation_source: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice. Cold northern areas are its habitat.
entries.translated: Gela il proprio respiro per creare zanne e artigli di ghiaccio. Vive nelle fredde regioni settentrionali.

entries.original:
"They are born in snow clouds. They use
chains made of ice crystals to capture
prey."
entries.translation_source: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.
entries.translated: Nascono nelle nubi di neve. Usano catene fatte di cristalli di ghiaccio per catturare le prede.

entries.original:
"When it and Karrablast are together,
and both receive electrical stimulation,
they both evolve."
entries.translation_source: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.
entries.translated: Quando lui e Karrablast sono insieme e ricevono entrambi una stimolazione elettrica, si evolvono entrambi.

entries.original:
"Having removed its heavy shell, it
becomes very light and can fight with
ninja-like movements."
entries.translation_source: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.
entries.translated: Dopo essersi liberato del suo pesante guscio, diventa molto leggero e può combattere con movimenti da ninja.

entries.original:
"When its opponent can’t be paralyzed,
it contorts itself with unexpected speed
and flops away."
entries.translation_source: When its opponent can’t be paralyzed, it contorts itself with unexpected speed and flops away.
entries.translated: Quando il suo avversario non può essere paralizzato, si contorce con velocità inaspettata e si allontana saltellando.

entries.original:
"It takes pride in the speed at which it
uses moves. What it loses in power, it
makes up for in quantity."
entries.translation_source: It takes pride in the speed at which it uses moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.
entries.translated: Va fiero della velocità con cui usa le mosse. Quello che perde in potenza, lo compensa in quantità.

entries.original:
"They use the long fur on their arms as
a whip to strike their opponents."
entries.translation_source: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.
entries.translated: Usano il lungo pelo sulle braccia come una frusta per colpire gli avversari.

entries.original:
"It runs through the narrow tunnels
formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses
its sharp claws to catch prey."
entries.translation_source: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.
entries.translated: Corre attraverso i tunnel stretti scavati da Excadrill e Onix. Usa i suoi artigli affilati per catturare le prede.

entries.original:
"Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon
from clay. It’s been active for
thousands of years."
entries.translation_source: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It’s been active for thousands of years.
entries.translated: L{B4}antica scienza ha modellato questo Pokémon dall{B4}argilla. È attivo da migliaia di anni.

entries.original:
"Golurk were created to protect people
and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious
energy."
entries.translation_source: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.
entries.translated: I Golurk sono stati creati per proteggere le persone e i Pokémon. Funzionano grazie a un{B4}energia misteriosa.

entries.original:
"Ignoring their injuries, groups attack
by sinking the blades that cover their
bodies into their prey."
entries.translation_source: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.
entries.translated: Ignorando le ferite, i gruppi attaccano conficcando nelle prede le lame che ricoprono i loro corpi.

entries.original:
"Bisharp pursues prey in the company of
a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp
finishes off the prey."
entries.translation_source: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.
entries.translated: Bisharp dà la caccia alle prede in compagnia di un grande gruppo di Pawniard. Poi Bisharp finisce la preda.

entries.original:
"Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even
if they strike foes with a fierce
headbutt."
entries.translation_source: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
entries.translated: La sua soffice pelliccia assorbe i danni, anche quando colpisce i nemici con un violento colpo di testa.

entries.original:
"They crush berries with their talons.
They bravely stand up to any opponent,
no matter how strong it is."
entries.translation_source: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.
entries.translated: Schiacciano le bacche con i loro artigli. Affrontano coraggiosamente qualsiasi avversario, non importa quanto sia forte.

entries.original:
"The more scars they have, the more
respect these brave soldiers of the sky
get from their peers."
entries.translation_source: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.
entries.translated: Più cicatrici hanno, più rispetto guadagnano da parte dei loro pari questi coraggiosi soldati del cielo.

entries.original:
"They tend to guard their posteriors
with suitable bones they have found.
They pursue weak Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.
entries.translated: Tendono a proteggere il posteriore con ossa adatte che hanno trovato. Danno la caccia ai Pokémon deboli.

entries.original:
"It skillfully arranges the bones of its
prey to construct its nest. Most of the
bones are Cubone."
entries.translation_source: It skillfully arranges the bones of its prey to construct its nest. Most of the bones are Cubone.
entries.translated: Organizza abilmente le ossa delle sue prede per costruire il suo nido. La maggior parte delle ossa sono di Cubone.

entries.original:
"It breathes through a hole in its tail
while it burns with an internal fire.
Durant is its prey."
entries.translation_source: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
entries.translated: Respira attraverso un foro nella coda mentre arde di un fuoco interiore. Durant è la sua preda.

entries.original:
"Durant dig nests in mountains. They
build their complicated, interconnected
tunnels in mazes."
entries.translation_source: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels in mazes.
entries.translated: Durant scava nidi nelle montagne. Costruiscono i loro complicati tunnel interconnessi in veri labirinti.

entries.original:
"It tends to bite everything, and it is
not a picky eater. Approaching it
carelessly is dangerous."
entries.translation_source: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
entries.translated: Tende a mordere qualsiasi cosa e non è per niente schizzinoso. Avvicinarsi con leggerezza è pericoloso.

entries.original:
"The two heads do not get along.
Whichever head eats more than the other
gets to be the leader."
entries.translation_source: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.
entries.translated: Le due teste non vanno d{B4}accordo. Quella che mangia più dell{B4}altra diventa il capo.

entries.original:
"It responds to movement by attacking.
This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours
everything in its path!"
entries.translation_source: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!
entries.translated: Reagisce al movimento attaccando. Questo spaventoso Pokémon a tre teste divora tutto ciò che trova sul suo cammino!

entries.original:
"It protects itself with flame. Long
years ago, people believed Larvesta had
a nest on the sun."
entries.translation_source: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.
entries.translated: Si protegge con le fiamme. Moltissimi anni fa, la gente credeva che Larvesta avesse un nido sul sole.

entries.original:
"When volcanic ash darkened the
atmosphere, Volcarona’s fire provided a
replacement for the sun."
entries.translation_source: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
entries.translated: Quando la cenere vulcanica oscurò l{B4}atmosfera, il fuoco di Volcarona fece da sostituto al sole.

entries.original:
"It has a body and heart of steel. Its
glare is sufficient to make even an
unruly Pokémon obey it."
entries.translation_source: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.
entries.translated: Ha un corpo e un cuore d{B4}acciaio. Il suo sguardo basta a far obbedire persino un Pokémon indisciplinato.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon came to the defense of
Pokémon that had lost their homes in a
war among humans."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon accorse in difesa di altri Pokémon che avevano perso la casa in una guerra tra esseri umani.

entries.original:
"Legends say this Pokémon confounded
opponents with its swift movements."
entries.translation_source: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.
entries.translated: Le leggende narrano che questo Pokémon confondeva gli avversari con i suoi movimenti fulminei.

entries.original:
"In every direction it flies, creating
winds so powerful, they blow everything
away."
entries.translation_source: In every direction it flies, creating winds so powerful, they blow everything away.
entries.translated: Vola in ogni direzione, creando venti così potenti da spazzare via tutto.

entries.original:
"Countless charred remains mar the
landscape of places through which
Thundurus has passed."
entries.translation_source: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.
entries.translated: Innumerevoli resti carbonizzati deturpano il paesaggio dei luoghi attraversati da Thundurus.

entries.original:
"When Reshiram’s tail flares, the heat
energy moves the atmosphere and changes
the world’s weather."
entries.translation_source: When Reshiram’s tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world’s weather.
entries.translated: Quando la coda di Reshiram si accende, l{B4}energia termica muove l{B4}atmosfera e cambia il clima del mondo.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon appears in legends. In its
tail, it has a giant generator that
creates electricity."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon appare nelle leggende. Nella sua coda ha un gigantesco generatore che crea elettricità.

entries.original:
"Lands visited by Landorus grant
bountiful crops. It has been hailed as
\qoThe Guardian of the Fields.\qc"
entries.translation_source: Lands visited by Landorus grant bountiful crops. It has been hailed as [quote-open-1]The Guardian of the Fields.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated: Le terre visitate da Landorus producono raccolti abbondanti. È stato acclamato come \qoIl Guardiano dei Campi.\qc

entries.original:
"It can produce ultracold air. Its body
is frozen."
entries.translation_source: It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.
entries.translated: Può produrre aria ultrafredda. Il suo corpo è congelato.

entries.original:
"It crosses the world, running over the
surfaces of oceans and rivers. It
appears at scenic waterfronts."
entries.translation_source: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
entries.translated: Attraversa il mondo correndo sulla superficie di oceani e fiumi. Appare in pittoreschi luoghi panoramici sull{B4}acqua.

entries.original:
"Many famous songs have been inspired by
the melodies that Meloetta plays."
entries.translation_source: Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.
entries.translated: Molti brani famosi sono stati ispirati dalle melodie suonate da Meloetta.

entries.original:
"This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by
Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon
on its back."
entries.translation_source: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
entries.translated: Questo antico Pokémon Coleottero è stato modificato dal Team Plasma. Hanno potenziato il cannone sulla schiena.

entries.original:
"Such a thick shell of wood covers its
head and back that even a direct hit
from a truck wouldn’t faze it."
entries.translation_source: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.
entries.translated: Una corazza di legno così spessa gli ricopre la testa e il dorso che neppure l{B4}impatto diretto di un camion lo smuoverebbe.

entries.original:
"It relies on its sturdy shell to
deflect predators’ attacks. It
counterattacks with its sharp quills."
entries.translation_source: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
entries.translated: Fa affidamento sul suo robusto guscio per deviare gli attacchi dei predatori. Contrattacca con i suoi aculei appuntiti.

entries.original:
"When it takes a defensive posture with
its fists guarding its face, it could
withstand a bomb blast."
entries.translation_source: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.
entries.translated: Quando assume una postura difensiva con i pugni a protezione del volto, potrebbe resistere all{B4}esplosione di una bomba.

entries.original:
"Eating a twig fills it with energy, and
its roomy ears give vent to very hot
air."
entries.translation_source: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to very hot air.
entries.translated: Mangiare un rametto lo riempie di energia, e le sue ampie orecchie fanno uscire aria molto calda.

entries.original:
"With friction from its tail fur, it
sets the twig on its tail on fire and
launches into battle."
entries.translation_source: With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on its tail on fire and launches into battle.
entries.translated: Grazie all{B4}attrito della pelliccia sulla coda, incendia il rametto sulla coda e si lancia in battaglia.

entries.original:
"It gazes into the flame at its branch
to achieve a focused state, allowing it
to see the future."
entries.translation_source: It gazes into the flame at its branch to achieve a focused state, allowing it to see the future.
entries.translated: Fissa la fiamma sul suo ramo per raggiungere uno stato di concentrazione, che gli permette di vedere il futuro.

entries.original:
"It secretes bubbles from its chest and
back. The bubbles reduce the damage it
would take when attacked."
entries.translation_source: It secretes bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would take when attacked.
entries.translated: Secreta bolle dal petto e dalla schiena. Le bolle riducono i danni che subirebbe quando viene attaccato.

entries.original:
"Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can
scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in
a minute’s time."
entries.translation_source: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.
entries.translated: La sua rapidità è senza pari. Può scalare una torre alta più di 2.000 piedi in un minuto.

entries.original:
"It creates throwing stars out of
compressed water, that can split metal
in two."
entries.translation_source: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water, that can split metal in two.
entries.translated: Crea stelle da lancio con acqua compressa, capaci di spaccare il metallo in due.

entries.original:
"They use their large ears to dig
burrows. They will dig the whole night
through."
entries.translation_source: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
entries.translated: Usano le loro grandi orecchie per scavare tane. Scavano per tutta la notte.

entries.original:
"As powerful as an excavator, its ears
can reduce dense bedrock to rubble."
entries.translation_source: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble.
entries.translated: Potenti quanto un escavatore, le sue orecchie possono ridurre in macerie la roccia madre compatta.

entries.original:
"When it’s excited, its temperature can
double, spiking hormone production in
its body."
entries.translation_source: When it’s excited, its temperature can double, spiking hormone production in its body.
entries.translated: Quando si eccita, la sua temperatura può raddoppiare, facendo aumentare bruscamente la produzione di ormoni nel suo corpo.

entries.original:
"Its speed right after takeoff already
puts it in the top speed class of all
bird Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.
entries.translated: La sua velocità subito dopo il decollo lo colloca già tra i Pokémon uccello più veloci.

entries.original:
"When attacking prey, it can reach
speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its
prey off with a colossal kick."
entries.translation_source: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.
entries.translated: Quando attacca le sue prede, può raggiungere velocità fino a 310 miglia orarie. Finisce le prede con un calcio colossale.

entries.original:
"The powder that covers its body
regulates its temperature, so it can
live in any region or climate."
entries.translation_source: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.
entries.translated: La polvere che ricopre il suo corpo regola la sua temperatura, così può vivere in qualunque regione o clima.

entries.original:
"The beaks of birds can’t begin to
scratch its stalwart body. To defend
itself, it spews powder."
entries.translation_source: The beaks of birds can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.
entries.translated: I becchi degli uccelli non riescono nemmeno a graffiare il suo corpo possente. Per difendersi, sputa polvere.

entries.original:
"The colorful patterns on this Pokémon’s
wings depend on the climate and
topography of its habitat."
entries.translation_source: The colorful patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat.
entries.translated: I disegni colorati sulle ali di questo Pokémon dipendono dal clima e dalla topografia del suo habitat.

entries.original:
"The stronger the opponent it faces, the
more heat and power flow through its
body."
entries.translation_source: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat and power flow through its body.
entries.translated: Più forte è l{B4}avversario che affronta, più calore e potenza scorrono nel suo corpo.

entries.original:
"The male with the largest mane of fire
is the leader of the pride."
entries.translation_source: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
entries.translated: Il maschio con la criniera di fuoco più folta è il capo del branco.

entries.original:
"It draws and controls the hidden power
of flowers. The flower it holds is most
likely part of its body."
entries.translation_source: It draws and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower it holds is most likely part of its body.
entries.translated: Attira e controlla il potere nascosto dei fiori. Il fiore che tiene in mano è molto probabilmente parte del suo corpo.

entries.original:
"When the flowers of a well-tended
flower bed bloom, it appears and
celebrates with an elegant dance."
entries.translation_source: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.
entries.translated: Quando i fiori di un{B4}aiuola ben curata sbocciano, appare e festeggia con un{B4}elegante danza.

entries.original:
"Its life can span several hundred
years. It’s said to devote its entire
life to protecting gardens."
entries.translation_source: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.
entries.translated: La sua vita può durare diversi secoli. Si dice che dedichi l{B4}intera esistenza a proteggere i giardini.

entries.original:
"Thought to be one of the first Pokémon
to live in harmony with humans, it has
a placid disposition."
entries.translation_source: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
entries.translated: Si ritiene che sia stato uno dei primi Pokémon a vivere in armonia con gli esseri umani; ha un carattere tranquillo.

entries.original:
"They inhabit mountainous regions. The
leader of the herd is decided by a
battle of clashing horns."
entries.translation_source: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.
entries.translated: Abitano nelle regioni montuose. Il leader del branco viene deciso in una battaglia a colpi di corna.

entries.original:
"It grows up imitating the behavior of
Pangoro, which it looks up to as a
leader."
entries.translation_source: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.
entries.translated: Cresce imitando il comportamento di Pangoro, che considera un leader.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon boasts great physical
strength. Many Trainers are also smitten
by its lively character."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon vanta una grande forza fisica. Molti Allenatori si innamorano anche del suo carattere vivace.

entries.original:
"Historically, in the Kalos region,
these Pokémon were the designated
guardians of the king."
entries.translation_source: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon were the designated guardians of the king.
entries.translated: Storicamente, nella regione di Kalos, questi Pokémon erano i guardiani designati del re.

entries.original:
"The organ that emits its intense
psychic power is sheltered by its ears
to keep power from leaking out."
entries.translation_source: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
entries.translated: L{B4}organo che emette il suo intenso potere psichico è protetto dalle orecchie per impedirgli di disperdersi.

entries.original:
"When in danger, it raises its ears and
releases enough psychic power to grind
a 10-ton truck to dust."
entries.translation_source: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust.
entries.translated: Quando è in pericolo, alza le orecchie e libera abbastanza potere psichico da ridurre in polvere un camion da 10 tonnellate.

entries.original:
"It is born when a departed spirit
inhabits a sword. It attaches to people
and drinks their life force."
entries.translation_source: It is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches to people and drinks their life force.
entries.translated: Nasce quando uno spirito trapassato abita una spada. Si attacca alle persone e ne beve la forza vitale.

entries.original:
"The complex attack patterns of its two
swords are unstoppable, even for an
accomplished opponent."
entries.translation_source: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even for an accomplished opponent.
entries.translated: I complessi schemi d{B4}attacco delle sue due spade sono inarrestabili, anche per un avversario esperto.

entries.original:
"It can detect the innate qualities of
leadership. Whoever it recognizes is
destined to become king."
entries.translation_source: It can detect the innate qualities of leadership. Whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.
entries.translated: Sa individuare le qualità innate della leadership. Chiunque riconosca è destinato a diventare re.

entries.original:
"It emits a scent that delights those
who smell it. The fragrance changes
depending on what it has eaten."
entries.translation_source: It emits a scent that delights those who smell it. The fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
entries.translated: Emette un profumo che delizia chiunque lo senta. La fragranza cambia a seconda di ciò che ha mangiato.

entries.original:
"It devises various scents and emits
scents that its enemies dislike in order
to gain an edge in battle."
entries.translation_source: It devises various scents and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
entries.translated: Elabora vari profumi ed emette odori che i suoi nemici detestano per ottenere un vantaggio in lotta.

entries.original:
"Because it eats nothing but sweets, its
fur is as sticky sweet as cotton
candy."
entries.translation_source: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy.
entries.translated: Dato che mangia solo dolci, la sua pelliccia è appiccicosamente dolce come zucchero filato.

entries.original:
"It can distinguish the faintest of
scents. It puts its sense of smell to
use by helping pastry chefs."
entries.translation_source: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs.
entries.translated: Può distinguere persino gli odori più deboli. Usa il suo olfatto aiutando i pasticceri.

entries.original:
"It draws prey near with its blinking
lights and then wraps them up in its
long tentacles."
entries.translation_source: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles.
entries.translated: Attira le prede con le sue luci lampeggianti, poi le avvolge con i suoi lunghi tentacoli.

entries.original:
"It wields the most compelling hypnotic
powers of any Pokémon, and it forces
others to do anything."
entries.translation_source: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do anything.
entries.translated: Possiede i poteri ipnotici più potenti di tutti i Pokémon e costringe gli altri a fare qualunque cosa.

entries.original:
"Two Binacle live together on one rock.
When they fight, one of them will move
to a different rock."
entries.translation_source: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
entries.translated: Due Binacle vivono insieme su una sola roccia. Quando litigano, uno dei due si sposta su un{B4}altra roccia.

entries.original:
"When they evolve, two Binacle multiply
into seven. They fight with the power
of seven Binacle."
entries.translation_source: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
entries.translated: Quando si evolvono, due Binacle diventano sette. Combattono con la forza di sette Binacle.

entries.original:
"It looks just like rotten kelp. It
hides from foes while storing up power
for its evolution."
entries.translation_source: It looks just like rotten kelp. It hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution.
entries.translated: Sembra proprio al kelp marcio. Si nasconde dai nemici accumulando energia per l{B4}evoluzione.

entries.original:
"Tales are told of ships that wander
into seas where Dragalge live, never to
return."
entries.translation_source: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.
entries.translated: Si raccontano storie di navi che si avventurano nei mari dove vivono i Dragalge, per non fare più ritorno.

entries.original:
"They knock down flying prey by firing
compressed water from their massive
claws like shooting a pistol."
entries.translation_source: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
entries.translated: Colpisce le prede in volo sparando acqua compressa dalle sue enormi chele come se sparasse con una pistola.

entries.original:
"Their enormous claws launch cannonballs
of water powerful enough to pierce
tanker hulls."
entries.translation_source: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
entries.translated: Le sue enormi chele lanciano palle di cannone d{B4}acqua abbastanza potenti da perforare gli scafi delle petroliere.

entries.original:
"The frills on either side of its head
have cells that generate electricity
when exposed to sunlight."
entries.translation_source: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.
entries.translated: Le frange ai lati della testa hanno cellule che generano elettricità quando sono esposte alla luce del sole.

entries.original:
"It flares its frill and generates
energy. It can generate sufficient
electricity to power a skyscraper."
entries.translation_source: It flares its frill and generates energy. It can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
entries.translated: Spiega il suo collare e genera energia. Può produrre elettricità sufficiente ad alimentare un grattacielo.

entries.original:
"Its immense jaws have enough destructive
force to chew up an automobile. It lived
100 million years ago."
entries.translation_source: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force to chew up an automobile. It lived 100 million years ago.
entries.translated: Le sue enormi fauci hanno una forza distruttiva sufficiente a sminuzzare un{B4}automobile. Visse 100 milioni di anni fa.

entries.original:
"Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100
million years ago, so it behaved like a
king."
entries.translation_source: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.
entries.translated: Nulla poteva fermare questo Pokémon 100 milioni di anni fa, quindi si comportava come un re.

entries.original:
"This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land
where there were no violent predators
like Tyrantrum."
entries.translation_source: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon calmo viveva in una terra fredda dove non c{B4}erano predatori violenti come Tyrantrum.

entries.original:
"This usually quiet and kindly Pokémon
has a surface temperature of around -240
degrees Fahrenheit."
entries.translation_source: This usually quiet and kindly Pokémon has a surface temperature of around -240 degrees Fahrenheit.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon, di solito tranquillo e gentile, ha una temperatura superficiale di circa -240 gradi Fahrenheit.

entries.original:
"It sends a soothing aura from its
ribbonlike feelers to calm fights."
entries.translation_source: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
entries.translated: Invia un{B4}aura rasserenante dai suoi tentacoli simili a nastri per calmare i litigi.

entries.original:
"Although its body is small, its
proficient fighting skills enable it to
keep up with big bruisers."
entries.translation_source: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers.
entries.translated: Anche se il suo corpo è piccolo, la sua abilità nel combattere gli permette di tenere testa ai grossi picchiatori.

entries.original:
"Its upper whiskers are sensors that
survey its surroundings. Its lower
whiskers shoot electricity."
entries.translation_source: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers shoot electricity.
entries.translated: I baffi superiori sono sensori che controllano l{B4}ambiente circostante. I baffi inferiori scaricano elettricità.

entries.original:
"Born from temperatures and pressures
deep underground, it fires beams from
the stone in its head."
entries.translation_source: Born from temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
entries.translated: Nato da temperature e pressioni nelle profondità del sottosuolo, spara raggi dalla pietra nella sua testa.

entries.original:
"It’s covered in a slimy membrane that
makes any punches or kicks slide off it
harmlessly."
entries.translation_source: It’s covered in a slimy membrane that makes any punches or kicks slide off it harmlessly.
entries.translated: È ricoperto da una membrana viscida che fa scivolare via senza danni i pugni e i calci.

entries.original:
"It crawls along sluggishly. The swirly
protrusion on its back is filled with
its brain and other organs."
entries.translation_source: It crawls along sluggishly. The swirly protrusion on its back is filled with its brain and other organs.
entries.translated: Striscia lentamente. La sporgenza a spirale sulla sua schiena è piena del suo cervello e di altri organi.

entries.original:
"An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if
left to itself, loneliness overcomes it,
and it oozes gooey tears."
entries.translation_source: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon incredibilmente amichevole, ma se lasciato da solo, la solitudine lo sopraffà e fa sgorgare lacrime viscide.

entries.original:
"These key collectors threaten any
attackers by fiercely jingling their
keys at them."
entries.translation_source: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
entries.translated: Questi collezionisti di chiavi minacciano qualsiasi assalitore facendo tintinnare furiosamente le loro chiavi contro di lui.

entries.original:
"It is created when a spirit possesses
rotten tree stumps. It prefers to live
in abandoned forests."
entries.translation_source: It is created when a spirit possesses rotten tree stumps. It prefers to live in abandoned forests.
entries.translated: Si crea quando uno spirito possiede ceppi d{B4}albero marci. Preferisce vivere nelle foreste abbandonate.

entries.original:
"It can control trees at will. It will
trap people who harm the forest, so they
can never leave."
entries.translation_source: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
entries.translated: Può controllare gli alberi a suo piacimento. Intrappola le persone che danneggiano la foresta, così non possono mai andarsene.

entries.original:
"It is said to carry wandering spirits
to the place where they belong so they
can move on."
entries.translation_source: It is said to carry wandering spirits to the place where they belong so they can move on.
entries.translated: Si dice che conduca gli spiriti erranti nel luogo a cui appartengono, così possono passare oltre.

entries.original:
"It enwraps its prey in its hairlike
arms. It sings joyfully as it observes
the suffering of its prey."
entries.translation_source: It enwraps its prey in its hairlike arms. It sings joyfully as it observes the suffering of its prey.
entries.translated: Avvolge le prede con le sue braccia simili a capelli. Canta allegramente mentre osserva la sofferenza delle sue prede.

entries.original:
"It blocks opponents’ attacks with the
ice that shields its body. It uses cold
air to repair any crack."
entries.translation_source: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any crack.
entries.translated: Blocca gli attacchi degli avversari con il ghiaccio che protegge il suo corpo. Usa l{B4}aria fredda per riparare ogni crepa.

entries.original:
"The way several Bergmite huddle on its
back make it look like an aircraft
carrier made of ice."
entries.translation_source: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back make it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.
entries.translated: Il modo in cui diversi Bergmite si accovacciano sulla sua schiena lo fa sembrare una portaerei di ghiaccio.

entries.original:
"They live in pitch black caves. Their
enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves
of 200,000 hertz."
entries.translation_source: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
entries.translated: Vivono in caverne buie come la pece. Le loro enormi orecchie possono emettere onde ultrasoniche da 200.000 hertz.

entries.original:
"This hot-blooded Pokémon attacks
anything it sees with ultrasonic waves
that can crush boulders."
entries.translation_source: This hot-blooded Pokémon attacks anything it sees with ultrasonic waves that can crush boulders.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon dal sangue caldo attacca tutto ciò che vede con onde ultrasoniche in grado di frantumare massi.

entries.original:
"When the horns on its head shine in
seven different colors, it is said to be
sharing everlasting life."
entries.translation_source: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.
entries.translated: Quando le corna sulla sua testa brillano in sette colori diversi, si dice che stia condividendo la vita eterna.

entries.original:
"When its life comes to an end, it
absorbs the life energy of every living
thing and turns into a cocoon."
entries.translation_source: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon.
entries.translated: Quando la sua vita giunge al termine, assorbe l{B4}energia vitale di ogni essere vivente e si trasforma in un bozzolo.

entries.original:
"When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls
into disarray, it appears and reveals
its secret power."
entries.translation_source: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
entries.translated: Quando l{B4}ecosistema della regione di Kalos cade nel caos, appare e rivela il suo potere segreto.

entries.original:
"It can instantly create many diamonds
by compressing the carbon in the air
between its hands."
entries.translation_source: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
entries.translated: Può creare istantaneamente molti diamanti comprimendo il carbonio nell{B4}aria tra le sue mani.

entries.original:
"It gathers things it likes and passes
them through its loop to teleport them
to a secret place."
entries.translation_source: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.
entries.translated: Raccoglie le cose che gli piacciono e le fa passare attraverso il suo anello per teletrasportarle in un luogo segreto.

entries.original:
"It expels its internal steam from the
arms on its back. It has enough power to
blow away a mountain."
entries.translation_source: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
entries.translated: Espelle il vapore interno dalle braccia sulla schiena. Ha abbastanza potenza da far saltare via una montagna.

entries.original:
"It feels relaxed in tight, dark places
and has been known to use its Trainer’s
pocket or bag as a nest."
entries.translation_source: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer’s pocket or bag as a nest.
entries.translated: Si sente a suo agio in spazi stretti e bui ed è noto per usare la tasca o la borsa del suo Allenatore come nido.

entries.original:
"It throws sharp feathers called blade
quills at enemies or prey. It seldom
misses."
entries.translation_source: It throws sharp feathers called blade quills at enemies or prey. It seldom misses.
entries.translated: Lancia contro nemici o prede piume affilate chiamate aculei-lama. Raramente manca il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Although basically cool and cautious,
when it’s caught by surprise, it’s
seized by panic."
entries.translation_source: Although basically cool and cautious, when it’s caught by surprise, it’s seized by panic.
entries.translated: Pur essendo fondamentalmente calmo e prudente, quando viene colto di sorpresa va in panico.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t allow its emotions to be
easily seen. Earning its trust takes
time. It prefers solitude."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.
entries.translated: Non lascia trasparire facilmente le sue emozioni. Guadagnarsi la sua fiducia richiede tempo. Preferisce la solitudine.

entries.original:
"It boasts powerful front legs. With a
single punch, it can bend an iron bar
right over."
entries.translation_source: It boasts powerful front legs. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.
entries.translated: Sfoggia potenti zampe anteriori. Con un solo pugno può piegare una sbarra di ferro su se stessa.

entries.original:
"When its fighting spirit is set alight,
the flames around its waist become
especially intense."
entries.translation_source: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.
entries.translated: Quando il suo spirito combattivo si accende, le fiamme intorno alla sua vita diventano particolarmente intense.

entries.original:
"The balloons it inflates with its nose
grow larger and larger as it practices
day by day."
entries.translation_source: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.
entries.translated: I palloncini che gonfia con il naso crescono sempre di più mentre si allena giorno dopo giorno.

entries.original:
"It attacks by smacking its enemies with
the exploding water balloons that it
creates."
entries.translation_source: It attacks by smacking its enemies with the exploding water balloons that it creates.
entries.translated: Attacca colpendo i nemici con i palloncini d{B4}acqua esplosivi che crea.

entries.original:
"To Primarina, every battle is a stage.
It takes down its prey with beautiful
singing and dancing."
entries.translation_source: To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.
entries.translated: Per Primarina, ogni lotta è un palcoscenico. Abbatte le sue prede con un canto e una danza meravigliosi.

entries.original:
"It may look spindly, but its neck
muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a
tree 16 times per second!"
entries.translation_source: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!
entries.translated: Può sembrare esile, ma i muscoli del collo sono robustissimi. Può beccare un albero 16 volte al secondo!

entries.original:
"It can bend the tip of its beak to
produce over a hundred different cries
at will."
entries.translation_source: It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.
entries.translated: Può piegare la punta del becco per emettere, a volontà, più di cento richiami diversi.

entries.original:
"Known for forming harmonious couples,
it is brought to wedding ceremonies as a
good luck charm."
entries.translation_source: Known for forming harmonious couples, it is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.
entries.translated: Noto per formare coppie armoniose, viene portato alle cerimonie nuziali come portafortuna.

entries.original:
"It prefers to eat fresh living things
so it marches down streets in search of
prey."
entries.translation_source: It prefers to eat fresh living things so it marches down streets in search of prey.
entries.translated: Preferisce cibarsi di cose fresche e vive, così marcia per le strade in cerca di prede.

entries.original:
"Patient by nature, it loses control of
itself and pounces when it spots its
favorite meal-Rattata!"
entries.translation_source: Patient by nature, it loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal-Rattata!
entries.translated: Per natura paziente, perde il controllo e si lancia all{B4}attacco quando vede il suo pasto preferito: Rattata!

entries.original:
"Its strong jaw enables it to scrape
trees and slurp out the sap. It normally
lives underground."
entries.translation_source: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
entries.translated: La sua potente mascella gli permette di raschiare gli alberi e succhiarne la linfa. Di solito vive sottoterra.

entries.original:
"From the food it digests, it generates
electricity, and it stores this energy
in its electric sac."
entries.translation_source: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.
entries.translated: Dal cibo che digerisce genera elettricità e immagazzina questa energia nel suo sacco elettrico.

entries.original:
"It flusters opponents with acrobatic
flying maneuvers. This creates an
opening for it to attack."
entries.translation_source: It flusters opponents with acrobatic flying maneuvers. This creates an opening for it to attack.
entries.translated: Sconcerta gli avversari con acrobatiche manovre di volo. Questo gli crea un{B4}apertura per attaccare.

entries.original:
"Its hard pincers are well suited to
both offense and defense."
entries.translation_source: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense.
entries.translated: Le sue chele dure sono adatte sia all{B4}attacco sia alla difesa.

entries.original:
"It stores coldness in its pincers and
pummels its foes. It can even smash
thick walls of ice to bits!"
entries.translation_source: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!
entries.translated: Conserva il freddo nelle sue chele e malmena i nemici. Può persino ridurre in frantumi spesse pareti di ghiaccio!

entries.original:
"This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its
passionate dance moves cause its enemies
to combust in both body and mind."
entries.translation_source: This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its passionate dance moves cause its enemies to combust in both body and mind.
entries.translated: Questo Oricorio ha sorseggiato nettare rosso. I suoi passi di danza appassionati fanno combustare i nemici sia nel corpo che nella mente.

entries.original:
"Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the
heads of people who have auras
resembling those of flowers."
entries.translation_source: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.
entries.translated: Miriadi di Cutiefly svolazzano sopra le teste delle persone che hanno aure simili a quelle dei fiori.

entries.original:
"Some of Ribombee’s pollen puffs are
highly nutritious. They are sometimes
sold as supplements."
entries.translation_source: Some of Ribombee’s pollen puffs are highly nutritious. They are sometimes sold as supplements.
entries.translated: Alcuni batuffoli di polline di Ribombee sono altamente nutrienti. A volte vengono venduti come integratori.

entries.original:
"When it rubs the rocks on its neck
against you, that’s proof of its love
for you."
entries.translation_source: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that’s proof of its love for you.
entries.translated: Quando strofina contro di te le rocce sul collo, è la prova del suo affetto per te.

entries.original:
"Well equipped with claws and fangs, it
uses the sharp rocks in its mane as
weapons."
entries.translation_source: Well equipped with claws and fangs, it uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
entries.translated: Ben equipaggiato con artigli e zanne, usa come armi le rocce appuntite della sua criniera.

entries.original:
"They’re weak, so they move in schools.
However, they can also often be seen all
alone, having strayed from the school."
entries.translation_source: They’re weak, so they move in schools. However, they can also often be seen all alone, having strayed from the school.
entries.translated: Sono deboli, quindi si muovono in banchi. Tuttavia, spesso se ne può vedere anche qualcuno da solo, allontanatosi dal banco.

entries.original:
"Aside from its head, its body parts
regenerate quickly if they’re cut off."
entries.translation_source: Aside from its head, its body parts regenerate quickly if they’re cut off.
entries.translated: A parte la testa, le altre parti del suo corpo si rigenerano rapidamente se vengono tagliate.

entries.original:
"It crawls along the ocean floor on its
12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola
bits scattered in its wake."
entries.translation_source: It crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
entries.translated: Striscia sul fondo dell{B4}oceano sulle sue 12 zampe. Lascia dietro di sé una scia di frammenti di Corsola sparsi.

entries.original:
"The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves
enhances its grip and its powerful
running gait."
entries.translation_source: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
entries.translated: Il fango attaccato agli zoccoli di Mudbray ne aumenta la presa e la potente falcata in corsa.

entries.original:
"It can trudge mountain roads without
rest for three days, all the while
dragging a 10-ton load."
entries.translation_source: It can trudge mountain roads without rest for three days, all the while dragging a 10-ton load.
entries.translated: Può avanzare lungo i sentieri di montagna senza riposo per tre giorni, trascinando nel frattempo un carico da 10 tonnellate.

entries.original:
"It crawls onto the land in search of
food. Its water bubble allows it to
breathe and protects its head."
entries.translation_source: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its head.
entries.translated: Striscia sulla terraferma in cerca di cibo. La sua bolla d{B4}acqua gli permette di respirare e protegge la testa.

entries.original:
"It delivers headbutts with the bubble
on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked
into it, where they drown."
entries.translation_source: It delivers headbutts with the bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into it, where they drown.
entries.translated: Colpisce con la testa usando la bolla sulla sua testa. I Pokémon piccoli vengono risucchiati all{B4}interno, dove annegano.

entries.original:
"It loves the sunshine. When it basks in
the sunlight regularly, it grows up
with vivid coloration."
entries.translation_source: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.
entries.translated: Ama la luce del sole. Se prende spesso il sole, cresce con una colorazione vivida.

entries.original:
"For self-protection, it pretends to be
a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear
keen-edged petals."
entries.translation_source: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.
entries.translated: Per autoprotezione, finge di essere un Pokémon Coleottero. Entrambi i suoi bracci hanno petali dai margini affilati.

entries.original:
"It scatters spores that flicker and
glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls
into a deep slumber."
entries.translation_source: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
entries.translated: Diffonde spore che tremolano e brillano. Chiunque veda queste luci cade in un sonno profondo.

entries.original:
"When it starts fighting for territory
with Parasect, the entire area gets
completely coated in spores!"
entries.translation_source: When it starts fighting for territory with Parasect, the entire area gets completely coated in spores!
entries.translated: Quando inizia a lottare per il territorio con Parasect, l{B4}intera area viene completamente ricoperta di spore!

entries.original:
"It burns its bodily fluids to create a
poisonous gas. It weakens enemies and
sends them reeling with it."
entries.translation_source: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. It weakens enemies and sends them reeling with it.
entries.translated: Brucia i suoi fluidi corporei per creare un gas velenoso. Indebolisce i nemici e li manda in tilt con quello.

entries.original:
"It punishes Salandit that couldn’t
bring it food with a fierce slap of its
flame-spewing palm."
entries.translation_source: It punishes Salandit that couldn’t bring it food with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.
entries.translated: Punisce i Salandit che non sono riusciti a portargli del cibo con un feroce schiaffo del suo palmo che spruzza fiamme.

entries.original:
"Stufful hates to be hugged or touched
in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and
resist with amazing power."
entries.translation_source: Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with amazing power.
entries.translated: Stufful odia essere abbracciato o toccato in qualsiasi modo. Si dimena, si agita e resiste con una forza incredibile.

entries.original:
"It boasts tremendous physical strength.
Many people call it the most dangerous
Pokémon in Alola region."
entries.translation_source: It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many people call it the most dangerous Pokémon in Alola region.
entries.translated: Vanta una forza fisica formidabile. Molte persone lo chiamano il Pokémon più pericoloso della regione di Alola.

entries.original:
"Because of its sweet, delicious aroma,
bird Pokémon are always after it."
entries.translation_source: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it.
entries.translated: Per via del suo aroma dolce e delizioso, i Pokémon uccello gli stanno sempre addosso.

entries.original:
"It bounces around, swinging the sepals
on its head with abandon. It’s quite
painful when it smacks you!"
entries.translation_source: It bounces around, swinging the sepals on its head with abandon. It’s quite painful when it smacks you!
entries.translated: Rimbalza qua e là, agitando senza ritegno i sepali sulla testa. È piuttosto doloroso quando ti colpisce!

entries.original:
"A master of grand and beautiful kicks,
it can knock out even kickboxing
champions with a single blow."
entries.translation_source: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.
entries.translated: Maestro di calci grandiosi e bellissimi, può mettere KO persino i campioni di kickboxing con un solo colpo.

entries.original:
"Baths prepared with the flowers from
its vine have a relaxing effect so it is
a hit to many people."
entries.translation_source: Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect so it is a hit to many people.
entries.translated: I bagni preparati con i fiori della sua liana hanno un effetto rilassante, quindi riscuotono molto successo.

entries.original:
"Known for its extreme intelligence, it
will look down on inexperienced
Trainers."
entries.translation_source: Known for its extreme intelligence, it will look down on inexperienced Trainers.
entries.translated: Noto per la sua intelligenza estrema, disprezzerà gli Allenatori inesperti.

entries.original:
"They form groups of 20 individuals.
Their mutual bond is remarkable-they
will never let down a comrade."
entries.translation_source: They form groups of 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable-they will never let down a comrade.
entries.translated: Formano gruppi di 20 individui. Il loro legame reciproco è straordinario: non lasceranno mai indietro un compagno.

entries.original:
"An astonishingly cowardly Pokémon, it
whirs its legs at high speed to run away
if anything comes near it."
entries.translation_source: An astonishingly cowardly Pokémon, it whirs its legs at high speed to run away if anything comes near it.
entries.translated: Un Pokémon incredibilmente codardo, fa girare le zampe a gran velocità per scappare se qualcosa gli si avvicina.

entries.original:
"With a flashing slash of its giant
sharp claws, it cleaves seawater-or even
air-right in two."
entries.translation_source: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater-or even air-right in two.
entries.translated: Con un fendente lampeggiante dei suoi giganteschi artigli affilati, divide in due l{B4}acqua di mare, o persino l{B4}aria.

entries.original:
"Born from a sand mound playfully built
by a child, this Pokémon embodies the
grudges of the departed."
entries.translation_source: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.
entries.translated: Nato da un mucchio di sabbia costruito per gioco da un bambino, questo Pokémon incarna i rancori dei defunti.

entries.original:
"Buried beneath the castle are masses of
dried-up bones from those whose
vitality it has drained."
entries.translation_source: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.
entries.translated: Sotto il castello sono sepolti cumuli di ossa rinsecchite di coloro a cui ha sottratto la vitalità.

entries.original:
"Its body is covered with slime. If you
accidentally step on it, you’ll slip,
and it will get mad at you!"
entries.translation_source: Its body is covered with slime. If you accidentally step on it, you’ll slip, and it will get mad at you!
entries.translated: Il suo corpo è ricoperto di melma. Se per sbaglio lo calpesti, scivolerai, e lui si arrabbierà con te!

entries.original:
"There’s danger of its going on a
rampage, so its true power is sealed
away beneath its control mask."
entries.translation_source: There’s danger of its going on a rampage, so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.
entries.translated: C{B4}è il rischio che vada fuori controllo, quindi il suo vero potere è sigillato sotto la sua maschera di controllo.

entries.original:
"It destroyed its own control mask. It
has become capable of changing type by
equipping special memories."
entries.translation_source: It destroyed its own control mask. It has become capable of changing type by equipping special memories.
entries.translated: Ha distrutto la propria maschera di controllo. Ora è capace di cambiare tipo equipaggiando memorie speciali.

entries.original:
"It eats dust in the atmosphere. The
composition of the dust determines the
color of its core."
entries.translation_source: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.
entries.translated: Mangia la polvere presente nell{B4}atmosfera. La composizione della polvere determina il colore del suo nucleo.

entries.original:
"It stays asleep from the moment it’s
born. When it falls into a deep sleep,
it stops moving altogether."
entries.translation_source: It stays asleep from the moment it’s born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.
entries.translated: Rimane addormentato fin dal momento in cui nasce. Quando cade in un sonno profondo, smette del tutto di muoversi.

entries.original:
"It gushes fire and poisonous gases from
its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive
substance."
entries.translation_source: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance.
entries.translated: Sputa fuoco e gas velenosi dalle narici. Le sue feci sono una sostanza esplosiva.

entries.original:
"When it’s surprised or agitated, the 14
fur spikes on its back will stand up
involuntarily."
entries.translation_source: When it’s surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.
entries.translated: Quando viene sorpreso o si agita, i 14 aculei di pelo sulla sua schiena si drizzano involontariamente.

entries.original:
"It conceals its terrifying appearance
beneath an old rag so it can get closer
to people and Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and Pokémon.
