entries.translated: Nasconde il suo aspetto terrificante sotto uno straccio vecchio per potersi avvicinare a persone e Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Its skin is thick enough to fend off
spikes. With its robust teeth, it
crunches up and eats the spikes."
entries.translation_source: Its skin is thick enough to fend off spikes. With its robust teeth, it crunches up and eats the spikes.
entries.translated: La sua pelle è abbastanza spessa da respingere le spine. Con i suoi denti robusti, le sbriciola e le mangia.

entries.original:
"It appears in towns and plays with the
children. Drampa will protect kids when
they’re in danger."
entries.translation_source: It appears in towns and plays with the children. Drampa will protect kids when they’re in danger.
entries.translated: Appare nelle città e gioca con i bambini. Drampa protegge i bambini quando sono in pericolo.

entries.original:
"It wraps its prey in green seaweed and
sucks away their vitality. It only
likes to go after big prey."
entries.translation_source: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey.
entries.translated: Avvolge le prede nelle alghe verdi e ne succhia la vitalità. Preferisce attaccare solo prede di grandi dimensioni.

entries.original:
"They live in mountains where no trace
of humans can be detected. It grows as
it battles others."
entries.translation_source: They live in mountains where no trace of humans can be detected. It grows as it battles others.
entries.translated: Vivono nelle montagne dove non si rileva alcuna traccia umana. Crescono mentre combattono contro altri.

entries.original:
"It leaps at its prey with a courageous
shout. Its scaly punches tear its
opponents to shreds."
entries.translation_source: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
entries.translated: Si lancia sulla preda con un grido coraggioso. I suoi pugni squamosi fanno a pezzi gli avversari.

entries.original:
"It battles valiantly with its fists,
which are armored in steel scales.
Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts."
entries.translation_source: It battles valiantly with its fists, which are armored in steel scales. Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts.
entries.translated: Combatte valorosamente con i suoi pugni, rivestiti di squame d{B4}acciaio. Kommo-o è specializzato nei montanti.

entries.original:
"This guardian deity of Melemele summons
thunderclouds and stores their
lightning inside its body."
entries.translation_source: This guardian deity of Melemele summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
entries.translated: Questa divinità guardiana di Melemele richiama nubi temporalesche e immagazzina i loro fulmini nel proprio corpo.

entries.original:
"This guardian deity of Akala is
guilelessly cruel. Its flowers’ fragrant
aroma is its source of energy."
entries.translation_source: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. Its flowers’ fragrant aroma is its source of energy.
entries.translated: Questo dio guardiano di Akala è crudelmente ingenuo. Il fragrante aroma dei suoi fiori è la sua fonte di energia.

entries.original:
"The guardian deity of Ula’ula is a lazy
Pokémon. It commands plants to
immobilize its foes."
entries.translation_source: The guardian deity of Ula’ula is a lazy Pokémon. It commands plants to immobilize its foes.
entries.translated: La divinità guardiana di Ula{B4}ula è un Pokémon pigro. Comanda le piante per immobilizzare i suoi nemici.

entries.original:
"The guardian deity of Poni can control
water. It can create pure water that
will wash away any impurity."
entries.translation_source: The guardian deity of Poni can control water. It can create pure water that will wash away any impurity.
entries.translated: La divinità protettrice di Poni può controllare l{B4}acqua. Sa creare acqua pura che lava via qualsiasi impurità.

entries.original:
"Its body is gaseous and frail. It
slowly grows as it collects dust from
the atmosphere."
entries.translation_source: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo è gassoso e fragile. Cresce lentamente raccogliendo polvere dall{B4}atmosfera.

entries.original:
"As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues
to grow. Its golden shell is
surprisingly solid."
entries.translation_source: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.
entries.translated: Mentre assorbe la luce, Cosmoem continua a crescere. Il suo guscio dorato è sorprendentemente solido.

entries.original:
"In writings from the distant past, it’s
called by the name \qothe beast that
devours the sun.\qc"
entries.translation_source: In writings from the distant past, it’s called by the name [quote-open-1]the beast that devours the sun.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated: Nelle scritture del lontano passato, viene chiamato con il nome \qola bestia che divora il sole.\qc

entries.original:
"It sometimes summons unknown powers and
life-forms to this world from holes
that lead to other worlds."
entries.translation_source: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.
entries.translated: A volte evoca in questo mondo poteri e forme di vita sconosciuti da varchi che conducono ad altri mondi.

entries.original:
"A life-form from another world, it was
dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a
strong neurotoxin."
entries.translation_source: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.
entries.translated: Una forma di vita di un altro mondo, è stata soprannominata UB e si pensa produca una forte neurotossina.

entries.original:
"Buzzwole goes around showing off its
abnormally swollen muscles. It is one
kind of Ultra Beast."
entries.translation_source: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.
entries.translated: Buzzwole gira mostrando i suoi muscoli anormalmente gonfi. È una specie di Ultracreatura.

entries.original:
"One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it
has been spotted running across the land
at terrific speeds."
entries.translation_source: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.
entries.translated: Una delle pericolose Ultracreature, è stata avvistata mentre correva sulla terraferma a velocità incredibili.

entries.original:
"It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It
raided a power plant, so it energizes
itself with electricity."
entries.translation_source: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so it energizes itself with electricity.
entries.translated: È apparso dall{B4}Ultravarco. Ha razziato una centrale elettrica, quindi si ricarica con l{B4}elettricità.

entries.original:
"It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole.
Witnesses observed it flying across the
sky at high speed."
entries.translation_source: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.
entries.translated: È apparso dall{B4}Ultravarco. I testimoni lo hanno visto sfrecciare nel cielo ad alta velocità.

entries.original:
"This Ultra Beast’s body, which is as
thin as paper, is like a sharpened
sword."
entries.translation_source: This Ultra Beast’s body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.
entries.translated: Il corpo di questa Ultracreatura, sottile come carta, è simile a una spada affilata.

entries.original:
"An unknown life-form called a UB. It
may be constantly hungry-it is certainly
always devouring something."
entries.translation_source: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry-it is certainly always devouring something.
entries.translated: Una forma di vita sconosciuta chiamata UB. Potrebbe essere costantemente affamata: di certo sta sempre divorando qualcosa.

entries.original:
"Light is the source of its energy. If
it isn’t devouring light, impurities
build up in it."
entries.translation_source: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn’t devouring light, impurities build up in it.
entries.translated: La luce è la fonte della sua energia. Se non divora luce, in esso si accumulano impurità.

entries.original:
"Its mechanized body is merely a vessel.
Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an
artificial soul."
entries.translation_source: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo meccanizzato è soltanto un involucro. Il suo vero io è il suo Soul-Heart, un{B4}anima artificiale.

entries.original:
"It lurks in the shadows of others,
copying their movements and powers.
It is craven and cowering."
entries.translation_source: It lurks in the shadows of others, copying their movements and powers. It is craven and cowering.
entries.translated: Si aggira nell{B4}ombra degli altri, copiandone i movimenti e i poteri. È vile e pavido.

entries.original:
"This Ultra Beast is well enough liked
to be chosen as a first partner in its
own world."
entries.translation_source: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
entries.translated: Questa Ultracreatura è abbastanza apprezzata da essere scelta come primo compagno nel suo mondo.

entries.original:
"It stores hundreds of liters of
poisonous liquid in its body. It is one
of the organisms known as UBs."
entries.translation_source: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid in its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
entries.translated: Accumula nel suo corpo centinaia di litri di liquido velenoso. È uno degli organismi noti come Ultracreature.

entries.original:
"When stone walls started moving and
attacking, the brute’s true identity was
this mysterious life-form."
entries.translation_source: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form.
entries.translated: Quando i muri di pietra hanno iniziato a muoversi e ad attaccare, la vera identità del bruto era questa misteriosa forma di vita.

entries.original:
"It causes explosions, then takes
advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob
them of their vitality."
entries.translation_source: It causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.
entries.translated: Provoca esplosioni, poi approfitta dello stupore degli avversari per sottrargli la vitalità.

entries.original:
"It approaches its enemies at the speed
of lightning, then tears them limb from
limb with its sharp claws."
entries.translation_source: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.
entries.translated: Si avvicina ai suoi nemici alla velocità del fulmine, poi li fa a pezzi con i suoi artigli affilati.

entries.original:
"It melts particles of iron and other
metals found in the subsoil, so it can
absorb them into its molten steel body."
entries.translation_source: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its molten steel body.
entries.translated: Fonde le particelle di ferro e di altri metalli presenti nel sottosuolo, così può assorbirle nel suo corpo di acciaio fuso.

entries.original:
"Revered long ago for its capacity
to create iron from nothing, it has
come back to life after 3000 years."
entries.translation_source: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, it has come back to life after 3000 years.
entries.translated: Anticamente venerato per la sua capacità di creare ferro dal nulla, è tornato in vita dopo 3000 anni.

entries.original:
"It attacks with rapid beats of its
stick. As it strikes with amazing speed,
it gets more and more pumped."
entries.translation_source: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.
entries.translated: Attacca con rapidi colpi del suo bastone. Man mano che colpisce a una velocità straordinaria, si esalta sempre di più.

entries.original:
"The faster a Thwackey can beat out a
rhythm with its two sticks, the more
respect it wins from its peers."
entries.translation_source: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
entries.translated: Più in fretta un Thwackey riesce a battere un ritmo con i suoi due bastoni, più rispetto si guadagna tra i suoi pari.

entries.original:
"By drumming, it taps into the power of
its special tree stump. The roots of the
stump follow its direction in battle."
entries.translation_source: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
entries.translated: Tambureggiando, attinge al potere del suo ceppo speciale. Le radici del ceppo seguono le sue direttive in battaglia.

entries.original:
"It has special pads on the backs of
its feet, and one on its nose. Its
pads radiate tremendous heat."
entries.translation_source: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Its pads radiate tremendous heat.
entries.translated: Ha speciali cuscinetti sul dorso dei piedi e uno sul naso. I suoi cuscinetti irradiano un calore tremendo.

entries.original:
"Its thick and fluffy fur protects it
from the cold and enables it to
use hotter fire moves."
entries.translation_source: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
entries.translated: La sua pelliccia folta e soffice lo protegge dal freddo e gli consente di usare mosse di Fuoco più potenti.

entries.original:
"It gets pumped up when cheered on.
But if it starts showboating, it could put
itself in a tough spot."
entries.translation_source: It gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
entries.translated: Si carica quando viene incitato. Ma se inizia a fare il gradasso, potrebbe mettersi in difficoltà.

entries.original:
"When it gets wet, its skin changes
color, and this Pokémon becomes
invisible as if it were camouflaged."
entries.translation_source: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.
entries.translated: Quando si bagna, la sua pelle cambia colore e questo Pokémon diventa invisibile, come se fosse mimetizzato.

entries.original:
"Highly intelligent but also very lazy,
it keeps enemies out of its territory
by laying traps everywhere."
entries.translation_source: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.
entries.translated: È molto intelligente ma anche molto pigro, e tiene i nemici fuori dal suo territorio piazzando trappole ovunque.

entries.original:
"It picks out foes’ weak points so it
can precisely blast them with water
that shoots from its fingertips."
entries.translation_source: It picks out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips.
entries.translated: Individua i punti deboli dei nemici per poterli colpire con precisione con getti d{B4}acqua che escono dalle punte delle dita.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon becomes uneasy if its
cheeks are ever completely empty
of berries."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon si innervosisce se le sue guance restano completamente vuote di bacche.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon has strong teeth and
can chew through the toughest of
berry shells."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon ha denti robusti e può rosicchiare anche i gusci di bacca più duri.

entries.original:
"It will bravely challenge any foe, no
matter how powerful. Even suffering
a defeat increases its strength a bit."
entries.translation_source: It will bravely challenge any foe, no matter how powerful. Even suffering a defeat increases its strength a bit.
entries.translated: Sfiderà coraggiosamente qualsiasi avversario, per quanto potente. Anche subire una sconfitta aumenta un po{B4} la sua forza.

entries.original:
"The lessons of many harsh battles
have taught it how to accurately judge
an opponent’s strength."
entries.translation_source: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.
entries.translated: Gli insegnamenti di molte dure battaglie gli hanno insegnato a valutare con precisione la forza di un avversario.

entries.original:
"The black luster of its steel body
could drive terror into the heart of
any foe."
entries.translation_source: The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
entries.translated: Il lucore nero del suo corpo d{B4}acciaio potrebbe instillare terrore nel cuore di qualunque avversario.

entries.original:
"A constant collector of information,
this Pokémon is very smart. Very
strong is what it isn’t."
entries.translation_source: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon, costantemente intento a raccogliere informazioni, è molto intelligente. Ciò che non è, è molto forte.

entries.original:
"As it grows inside its shell, it uses
its psychic abilities to monitor its
surroundings and wait for evolution."
entries.translation_source: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor its surroundings and wait for evolution.
entries.translated: Mentre cresce dentro il suo guscio, usa le sue capacità psichiche per monitorare ciò che lo circonda e attendere l{B4}evoluzione.

entries.original:
"It’s famous for its high intelligence,
and the large size of its brain is proof
that it has immense psychic power."
entries.translation_source: It’s famous for its high intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it has immense psychic power.
entries.translated: È famoso per la sua grande intelligenza, e le grandi dimensioni del suo cervello sono la prova che possiede un immenso potere psichico.

entries.original:
"Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it
silently raids the food stores of others.
It survives off its ill-gotten gains."
entries.translation_source: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of others. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
entries.translated: Grazie ai morbidi cuscinetti sulle zampe, razzia in silenzio le scorte di cibo altrui. Sopravvive con i suoi guadagni illeciti.

entries.original:
"With a lithe body and sharp claws, it
goes around stealing food and eggs.
It secretly marks its future targets."
entries.translation_source: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. It secretly marks its future targets.
entries.translated: Grazie al corpo agile e agli artigli affilati, gira in cerca di cibo e uova da rubare. Segna di nascosto i suoi bersagli futuri.

entries.original:
"It anchors itself in the ground and
basks in the sun. After absorbing
enough sunlight, it blooms vividly."
entries.translation_source: It anchors itself in the ground and basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, it blooms vividly.
entries.translated: Si ancora al terreno e prende il sole. Dopo aver assorbito abbastanza luce solare, fiorisce in modo vivace.

entries.original:
"The seeds attached to its cotton fluff
are full of nutrients. It spreads them on
the wind so that others can benefit."
entries.translation_source: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that others can benefit.
entries.translated: I semi attaccati alla sua soffice lanugine di cotone sono ricchi di nutrienti. Li disperde al vento affinché altri ne possano beneficiare.

entries.original:
"If its fleece grows too long, it won’t
be able to move. Cloth made with
its wool is surprisingly durable."
entries.translation_source: If its fleece grows too long, it won’t be able to move. Cloth made with its wool is surprisingly durable.
entries.translated: Se il suo vello cresce troppo, non riuscirà a muoversi. Il tessuto fatto con la sua lana è sorprendentemente resistente.

entries.original:
"Its majestic horns are meant only to
impress the opposite gender. They
never see use in battle."
entries.translation_source: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.
entries.translated: Le sue maestose corna servono solo a impressionare l{B4}altro sesso. Non vengono mai usate in lotta.

entries.original:
"Apparently the itch of its teething
impels it to snap its jaws at anything
in front of it."
entries.translation_source: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
entries.translated: A quanto pare il fastidio dei denti che stanno spuntando lo spinge a scattare le mascelle contro qualsiasi cosa gli capiti davanti.

entries.original:
"With jaws that can shear through steel
rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon
chomps down on its unfortunate prey."
entries.translation_source: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
entries.translated: Con fauci capaci di tranciare sbarre d{B4}acciaio, questo Pokémon estremamente aggressivo azzanna la sfortunata preda.

entries.original:
"This greedy Pokémon only helps people
with their work because it wants treats.
As it runs, it crackles with electricity."
entries.translation_source: This greedy Pokémon only helps people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon avido aiuta le persone con il lavoro solo perché vuole dei premi. Mentre corre, crepita di elettricità.

entries.original:
"It sends electricity through its legs
to boost their strength. Running at
top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph."
entries.translation_source: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.
entries.translated: Invia elettricità attraverso le zampe per aumentarne la forza. Correndo alla massima velocità, supera facilmente le 50 miglia orarie.

entries.original:
"It can race around like a unicycle,
even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning
coal sustains it."
entries.translation_source: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.
entries.translated: Può sfrecciare come un monociclo, anche su terreni accidentati e rocciosi. Il carbone ardente lo alimenta.

entries.original:
"By rapidly rolling its legs, it can
easily travel at over 18 mph. It
forms coal inside its body."
entries.translation_source: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can easily travel at over 18 mph. It forms coal inside its body.
entries.translated: Muovendo rapidamente le zampe, può viaggiare facilmente a oltre 18 miglia orarie. Forma carbone all{B4}interno del proprio corpo.

entries.original:
"While engaged in battle, its mountain
of coal will burn bright red, scorching
the surrounding area with sparks."
entries.translation_source: While engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, scorching the surrounding area with sparks.
entries.translated: Quando combatte, la sua montagna di carbone si arroventa fino a diventare rosso vivo, bruciando l{B4}area circostante con scintille.

entries.original:
"As soon as it’s born, it burrows into
an apple. the flavor of the apple is
what determines its evolution."
entries.translation_source: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. the flavor of the apple is what determines its evolution.
entries.translated: Appena nato, si infila in una mela. Il sapore della mela determina la sua evoluzione.

entries.original:
"It ate a sour apple, which induced its
evolution. It stores an acid capable of
causing chemical burns in its cheeks."
entries.translation_source: It ate a sour apple, which induced its evolution. It stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns in its cheeks.
entries.translated: Ha mangiato una mela aspra, che ne ha provocato l{B4}evoluzione. Conserva nelle guance un acido in grado di causare ustioni chimiche.

entries.original:
"It ate a sweet apple, which induced
its evolution. Back in the day, children
used to have it as a snack."
entries.translation_source: It ate a sweet apple, which induced its evolution. Back in the day, children used to have it as a snack.
entries.translated: Ha mangiato una Mela Dolce, che ne ha provocato l{B4}evoluzione. Un tempo i bambini lo mangiavano come spuntino.

entries.original:
"It spews sand from its nostrils. While
the enemy is blinded, it burrows into
the ground to hide."
entries.translation_source: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
entries.translated: Sputa sabbia dalle narici. Mentre il nemico è accecato, si scava un nascondiglio sottoterra.

entries.original:
"When it contracts its body, over 220
pounds of sand sprays from its nose.
It becomes disheartened if it runs out."
entries.translation_source: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. It becomes disheartened if it runs out.
entries.translated: Quando contrae il corpo, dal naso spruzza oltre 100 chili di sabbia. Diventa scoraggiato se la sabbia finisce.

entries.original:
"This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda
whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake
and tries to swallow other Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow other Pokémon.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon vorace ingoia intero Arrokuda. A volte sbaglia e prova a ingoiare altri Pokémon.

entries.original:
"It becomes extremely sluggish after
eating its fill. That’s when Cramorant
swallows it up."
entries.translation_source: It becomes extremely sluggish after eating its fill. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.
entries.translated: Diventa estremamente lento dopo aver mangiato a sazietà. È allora che Cramorant lo ingoia.

entries.original:
"Its jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and
as strong as steel. It spins its tail fins
to surge forward at over 100 knots."
entries.translation_source: Its jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. It spins its tail fins to surge forward at over 100 knots.
entries.translated: La sua mascella è affilata come una lancia e forte come l{B4}acciaio. Fa ruotare le pinne caudali per avanzare a oltre 100 nodi.

entries.original:
"It manipulates the chemical makeup of
its poison to produce electricity. Despite
a weak voltage, it can cause paralysis."
entries.translation_source: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. Despite a weak voltage, it can cause paralysis.
entries.translated: Manipola la composizione chimica del suo veleno per produrre elettricità. Nonostante la bassa tensione, può causare paralisi.

entries.original:
"This short-tempered and aggressive
Pokémon chugs stagnant water to
absorb any toxins it might contain."
entries.translation_source: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon irascibile e aggressivo trangugia acqua stagnante per assorbirne le tossine che potrebbe contenere.

entries.original:
"It stores flammable gas in its body
and uses it to generate heat. It then
coils around its prey and cooks it."
entries.translation_source: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. It then coils around its prey and cooks it.
entries.translated: Immagazzina gas infiammabile nel corpo e lo usa per generare calore. Poi si avvolge attorno alla preda e la cuoce.

entries.original:
"This excessively hostile Pokémon has
large and very sharp fangs in addition
to its dangerous burning body. "
entries.translation_source: This excessively hostile Pokémon has large and very sharp fangs in addition to its dangerous burning body.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon estremamente aggressivo ha grandi e aguzze zanne, oltre a un corpo ardente e pericoloso.

entries.original:
"It’s very curious, but its means of
investigating things is to try to punch
them with its tentacles."
entries.translation_source: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles.
entries.translated: È molto curioso, ma il suo modo di investigare le cose è provare a prenderle a pugni con i suoi tentacoli.

entries.original:
"Searching for an opponent to test its
skills against, it emerges onto land. Once
the battle is over, it returns to the sea."
entries.translation_source: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.
entries.translated: In cerca di un avversario contro cui mettere alla prova le sue abilità, emerge sulla terraferma. Una volta terminata la lotta, ritorna al mare.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon is said to have been
born when a lonely spirit possessed
a cold, leftover cup of tea."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
entries.translated: Si dice che questo Pokémon sia nato quando uno spirito solitario ha posseduto una tazza di tè freddo avanzata.

entries.original:
"This species lives in antique teapots.
Most pots are forgeries, but on rare
occasions, an authentic work is found."
entries.translation_source: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
entries.translated: Questa specie vive in teiere antiche. La maggior parte dei recipienti sono falsi, ma di rado se ne trova uno autentico.

entries.original:
"Via the protrusion on its head, it
senses other creatures’ emotions.
It prefers areas without people."
entries.translation_source: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. It prefers areas without people.
entries.translated: Attraverso la protuberanza sulla testa percepisce le emozioni delle altre creature. Preferisce le zone prive di persone.

entries.original:
"No matter who you are, if you bring
strong emotions near this Pokémon,
it will silence you violently."
entries.translation_source: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
entries.translated: A prescindere da chi tu sia, se porti emozioni intense vicino a questo Pokémon, ti farà tacere con violenza.

entries.original:
"Known as the Forest Witch, if you are
too loud around it, you risk being torn
apart by the claws on its tentacle."
entries.translation_source: Known as the Forest Witch, if you are too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle.
entries.translated: Conosciuta come la Strega della Foresta, se fai troppo rumore vicino a lei, rischi di essere fatta a pezzi dagli artigli del suo tentacolo.

entries.original:
"It sneaks into people’s homes, taking
and feasting on the negative energy
of the frustrated occupants."
entries.translation_source: It sneaks into people’s homes, taking and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.
entries.translated: Si intrufola nelle case delle persone, sottraendo e banchettando con l{B4}energia negativa degli abitanti frustrati.

entries.original:
"With sly cunning, it lures people into
the woods. Some believe it to have
the power to make crops grow."
entries.translation_source: With sly cunning, it lures people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.
entries.translated: Con astuzia subdola, attira le persone nei boschi. Alcuni credono che abbia il potere di far crescere i raccolti.

entries.original:
"Its hairs work like muscle fibers.
When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to
foes, ensnaring them like tentacles."
entries.translation_source: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to foes, ensnaring them like tentacles.
entries.translated: I suoi peli funzionano come fibre muscolari. Quando i peli si spiegano, si attaccano ai nemici, intrappolandoli come tentacoli.

entries.original:
"It evolved after experiencing numerous
fights. While crossing its arms, it lets
out a shout that’d make anyone flinch."
entries.translation_source: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that’d make anyone flinch.
entries.translated: Si è evoluto dopo aver affrontato numerosi combattimenti. Incrociando le braccia, emette un grido che farebbe trasalire chiunque.

entries.original:
"What appears to be an iron helmet is
actually hardened hair. This Pokémon
lives for the thrill of battle."
entries.translation_source: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
entries.translated: Quello che sembra un elmo di ferro in realtà è pelo indurito. Questo Pokémon vive per il brivido della lotta.

entries.original:
"Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body
surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff
as stone if you touch it."
entries.translation_source: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.
entries.translated: Fai attenzione al corpo ectoplasmatico che avvolge la sua anima. Diventerai rigido come la pietra se lo tocchi.

entries.original:
"After deflecting attacks with its hard
leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp
leek stalk. "
entries.translation_source: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk.
entries.translated: Dopo aver respinto gli attacchi con il suo duro scudo di foglie, contrattacca con il suo affilato gambo di porro.

entries.original:
"Its amusing movements make it very
popular. It releases its psychic power
from the pattern on its belly."
entries.translation_source: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.
entries.translated: I suoi movimenti divertenti lo rendono molto popolare. Rilascia il suo potere psichico dal motivo sul ventre.

entries.original:
"Never touch its shadowlike body, or
you’ll be shown the horrific memories
behind the picture carved into it."
entries.translation_source: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
entries.translated: Non toccare mai il suo corpo simile a un{B4}ombra, o ti verranno mostrate le orribili memorie dietro l{B4}immagine incisa su di esso.

entries.original:
"They say that any patisserie visited
by Milcery is guaranteed success and
good fortune."
entries.translation_source: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.
entries.translated: Si dice che ogni pasticceria visitata da Milcery abbia successo e fortuna assicurati.

entries.original:
"It evolved from a Milcery that held
onto a Strawberry Sweet. Its flavor
depends on how it was mixed."
entries.translation_source: It evolved from a Milcery that held onto a Strawberry Sweet. Its flavor depends on how it was mixed.
entries.translated: Si è evoluto da un Milcery che si è tenuto stretto un Strawberry Sweet. Il suo sapore dipende da come è stato mescolato.

entries.original:
"The six of them work together as one.
Teamwork is also their battle strategy,
and they constantly change formation."
entries.translation_source: The six of them work together as one. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change formation.
entries.translated: I sei lavorano insieme come un{B4}unica unità. Anche la collaborazione è la loro strategia di lotta, e cambiano di continuo formazione.

entries.original:
"It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth
to scrape it off rocks. Electric current
flows from the tips of its spines."
entries.translation_source: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
entries.translated: Mangia alghe, usando i denti per staccarle dalle rocce. Una corrente elettrica scorre dalle punte delle sue spine.

entries.original:
"It eats snow that piles up on the
ground. The more snow it eats, the
bigger its spikes grow."
entries.translation_source: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger its spikes grow.
entries.translated: Mangia la neve che si accumula a terra. Più neve mangia, più crescono le sue spine.

entries.original:
"Icy scales fall from its wings
like snow as it flies over fields
and mountains."
entries.translation_source: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains.
entries.translated: Squame gelide cadono dalle sue ali come neve mentre vola sopra campi e montagne.

entries.original:
"Once a year, on a specific date and
at a specific time, they gather out of
nowhere and form up in a circle."
entries.translation_source: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.
entries.translated: Una volta all{B4}anno, in una data e a un{B4}ora precise, si radunano dal nulla e si dispongono in cerchio.

entries.original:
"It drifted in on the flow of ocean
waters from a frigid place. It keeps its
head iced constantly to stay cold."
entries.translation_source: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to stay cold.
entries.translated: È arrivato alla deriva con le correnti oceaniche da un luogo gelido. Mantiene costantemente ghiacciata la testa per restare freddo.

entries.original:
"Through its horns, it can pick up on the
emotions of creatures around it. Males
will act as valets for those they serve."
entries.translation_source: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Males will act as valets for those they serve.
entries.translated: Attraverso le sue corna, può percepire le emozioni delle creature intorno a sé. I maschi faranno da valletti a coloro che servono.

entries.original:
"As it eats the seeds stored up in its
pouches, it generates electricity while
satisfying its constant hunger."
entries.translation_source: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pouches, it generates electricity while satisfying its constant hunger.
entries.translated: Mentre mangia i semi immagazzinati nelle sue sacche, genera elettricità soddisfacendo la sua fame costante.

entries.original:
"If a job requires serious strength,
Cufant will excel at it. Its copper body
tarnishes in the rain, turning green."
entries.translation_source: If a job requires serious strength, Cufant will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning green.
entries.translated: Se un lavoro richiede una forza notevole, Cufant eccellerà nel compierlo. Il suo corpo di rame si ossida con la pioggia, diventando verde.

entries.original:
"These Pokémon live in herds. Their
trunks have incredible grip strength,
strong enough to crush giant rocks."
entries.translation_source: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks.
entries.translated: Questi Pokémon vivono in branchi. Le loro proboscidi hanno una forza di presa incredibile, abbastanza forte da schiacciare enormi rocce.

entries.original:
"The powerful muscles in its tail
generate its electricity. Its upper half
is entirely too small. "
entries.translation_source: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Its upper half is entirely too small.
entries.translated: I potenti muscoli della sua coda generano l{B4}elettricità. La sua metà superiore è decisamente troppo piccola.

entries.original:
"The shaking of its freezing upper half
is what generates its electricity. It has
a hard time walking around."
entries.translation_source: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
entries.translated: Il tremore della sua metà superiore gelida è ciò che genera l{B4}elettricità. Fa fatica a muoversi.

entries.original:
"Its mighty legs are capable of running
at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but it can’t
breathe unless it’s underwater."
entries.translation_source: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but it can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.
entries.translated: Le sue poderose zampe gli consentono di correre a oltre 40 miglia orarie, ma non può respirare se non è sott{B4}acqua.

entries.original:
"The skin on its face is impervious
to attack, but breathing difficulties
made it go extinct anyway."
entries.translation_source: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made it go extinct anyway.
entries.translated: La pelle del suo volto è impermeabile agli attacchi, ma le difficoltà respiratorie l{B4}hanno comunque portato all{B4}estinzione.

entries.original:
"Its body resembles polished metal,
and it’s both lightweight and strong.
However, its body rusts easily."
entries.translation_source: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. However, its body rusts easily.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo somiglia a metallo lucidato, ed è leggero e resistente. Tuttavia, si arrugginisce facilmente.

entries.original:
"After being reborn as a ghost, Dreepy
wanders the areas it used to inhabit back
when it was alive in prehistoric seas."
entries.translation_source: After being reborn as a ghost, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
entries.translated: Rinato come spettro, Dreepy vaga nelle aree che abitava quando era vivo nei mari preistorici.

entries.original:
"It’s capable of flying faster than 120
mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and
dotes on them until they evolve."
entries.translation_source: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they evolve.
entries.translated: È in grado di volare a una velocità superiore alle 120 mph. Combatte al fianco di Dreepy e li coccola finché non si evolvono.

entries.original:
"Apparently the Dreepy inside its horns
eagerly look forward to being launched
out at Mach speeds."
entries.translation_source: Apparently the Dreepy inside its horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.
entries.translated: Pare che i Dreepy nelle sue corna non vedano l{B4}ora di essere lanciati a velocità Mach.

entries.original:
"It has slumbered for many years. Some
say it is Zamazenta’s elder sister,
others say the two are rivals."
entries.translation_source: It has slumbered for many years. Some say it is Zamazenta’s elder sister, others say the two are rivals.
entries.translated: Dorme da molti anni. C{B4}è chi dice che sia la sorella maggiore di Zamazenta, chi invece sostiene che i due siano rivali.

entries.original:
"It slept for aeons while in the form
of a statue. It was asleep for so long,
people forgot that it ever existed."
entries.translation_source: It slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.
entries.translated: Ha dormito per eoni sotto forma di statua. È rimasto addormentato così a lungo che la gente dimenticò persino che fosse mai esistito.

entries.original:
"It was inside a meteorite that fell
20,000 years ago. The energy that
its core absorbs allows it to live."
entries.translation_source: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. The energy that its core absorbs allows it to live.
entries.translated: Si trovava all{B4}interno di un meteorite caduto 20.000 anni fa. L{B4}energia assorbita dal suo nucleo gli permette di vivere.

entries.original:
"If it pulls the long white hair on its
head, its fighting spirit heightens and
power wells up from deep in its belly."
entries.translation_source: If it pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from deep in its belly.
entries.translated: Se tira il lungo pelo bianco sulla testa, il suo spirito combattivo si intensifica e la forza sgorga dal profondo del suo ventre.

entries.original:
"Inhabiting the mountains of a distant
region, it races across sheer cliffs,
training its legs and refining its moves."
entries.translation_source: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, it races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
entries.translated: Abita le montagne di una regione lontana e corre lungo pareti a strapiombo, allenando le zampe e perfezionando le sue mosse.

entries.original:
"Once the vines on its body tear off,
they become nutrients in the soil. This
helps the plants of the forest grow."
entries.translation_source: Once the vines on its body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
entries.translated: Quando le liane sul suo corpo si strappano, diventano nutrimento per il terreno. Questo aiuta le piante della foresta a crescere.

entries.original:
"Its entire body is made of an organ that
generates electricity. It is capable of
generating a region’s worth of electricity."
entries.translation_source: Its entire body is made of an organ that generates electricity. It is capable of generating a region’s worth of electricity.
entries.translated: Tutto il suo corpo è costituito da un organo che genera elettricità. È in grado di produrre elettricità a sufficienza per un{B4}intera regione.

entries.original:
"Its body is composed of crystallized
dragon energy. It is said to contain the
power of every Dragon Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. It is said to contain the power of every Dragon Pokémon.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo è composto da energia draconica cristallizzata. Si dice che contenga il potere di ogni Pokémon Drago.

entries.original:
"Glastrier has tremendous physical
strength. The mask covering its face is
100 times stronger than diamond."
entries.translation_source: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength. The mask covering its face is 100 times stronger than diamond.
entries.translated: Glastrier ha una forza fisica tremenda. La maschera che gli copre il volto è 100 volte più resistente del diamante.

entries.original:
"As it dashes through the night, it
absorbs the life energy of sleeping
Pokémon. It craves silence and solitude."
entries.translation_source: As it dashes through the night, it absorbs the life energy of sleeping Pokémon. It craves silence and solitude.
entries.translated: Mentre sfreccia nella notte, assorbe l{B4}energia vitale dei Pokémon addormentati. Desidera silenzio e solitudine.

entries.original:
"Its every move is filled with grace and
dignity. Extremely intelligent, it is said
to see past, present, and future events."
entries.translation_source: Its every move is filled with grace and dignity. Extremely intelligent, it is said to see past, present, and future events.
entries.translated: Ogni suo movimento è pieno di grazia e dignità. Estremamente intelligente, si dice che riesca a vedere eventi passati, presenti e futuri.

entries.original:
"The fur shed from its beard retains heat
well and is a highly useful material for
winter clothing."
entries.translation_source: The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
entries.translated: La pelliccia che perde dalla barba trattiene bene il calore ed è un materiale molto utile per gli abiti invernali.

entries.original:
"A violent creature that fells towering
trees with its crude axes and shields
itself with hard stone."
entries.translation_source: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone.
entries.translated: Una creatura violenta che abbatte alberi altissimi con le sue asce rozze e si protegge con la pietra dura.

entries.original:
"Swampy terrain gave Ursaluna its burly
physique and newfound capacity to
manipulate peat at will."
entries.translation_source: Swampy terrain gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
entries.translated: Il terreno paludoso ha conferito a Ursaluna il suo fisico massiccio e la nuova capacità di manipolare la torba a piacimento.

entries.original:
"It clads itself in the souls of comrades
that perished before fulfilling their
goals of journeying upstream."
entries.translation_source: It clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream.
entries.translated: Si riveste delle anime dei compagni che sono periti prima di realizzare il loro sogno di risalire il fiume.

entries.original:
"It has virulent poison and daunting
physical prowess. Preferring solitude,
this species does not form packs."
entries.translation_source: It has virulent poison and daunting physical prowess. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
entries.translated: Possiede un veleno virulento e una notevole potenza fisica. Prediligendo la solitudine, questa specie non forma branchi.

entries.original:
"Its lancelike spikes and savage
temperament have earned it the
nickname \qosea fiend.\qc"
entries.translation_source: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname [quote-open-1]sea fiend.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated: Le sue spine simili a lance e il suo temperamento selvaggio gli sono valsi il soprannome \qodemone del mare.\qc

entries.original:
"According to legend, this Pokémon’s love
gives rise to the budding of fresh life
across the land."
entries.translation_source: According to legend, this Pokémon’s love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across the land.
entries.translated: Secondo la leggenda, l{B4}amore di questo Pokémon fa germogliare nuova vita in tutta la terra.

entries.original:
"When the sun goes down, it becomes
active. It runs around town on a chase
for good food for its boss-Raticate."
entries.translation_source: When the sun goes down, it becomes active. It runs around town on a chase for good food for its boss-Raticate.
entries.translated: Quando il sole tramonta, diventa attivo. Gira per la città alla ricerca di buon cibo per il suo boss, Raticate.

entries.original:
"It makes its Rattata underlings gather
food for it, dining solely on the most
nutritious and delicious fare."
entries.translation_source: It makes its Rattata underlings gather food for it, dining solely on the most nutritious and delicious fare.
entries.translated: Fa raccogliere il cibo ai suoi sottoposti Rattata e si nutre solo delle pietanze più nutrienti e gustose.

entries.original:
"It focuses psychic energy into its tail
and rides it like it’s surfing. Another
name for this Pokémon is \qohodad.\qc"
entries.translation_source: It focuses psychic energy into its tail and rides it like it’s surfing. Another name for this Pokémon is [quote-open-1]hodad.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated: Concentra l{B4}energia psichica nella coda e la cavalca come se stesse facendo surf. Un altro nome di questo Pokémon è \qohodad.\qc

entries.original:
"It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel
shell is very hard-so much so, it can’t
roll its body up into a ball."
entries.translation_source: It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is very hard-so much so, it can’t roll its body up into a ball.
entries.translated: Vive sulle montagne innevate. Il suo guscio d{B4}acciaio è così duro che non riesce ad arrotolare il corpo in una palla.

entries.original:
"It runs across snow-covered plains at
high speeds. It developed thick, sharp
claws to plow through the snow."
entries.translation_source: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.
entries.translated: Corre a gran velocità attraverso le pianure innevate. Ha sviluppato artigli spessi e affilati per farsi strada nella neve.

entries.original:
"In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice
shards with its six tails and sprays
them around to cool itself off."
entries.translation_source: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.
entries.translated: Quando fa caldo, questo Pokémon crea schegge di ghiaccio con le sue sei code e le spruzza tutt{B4}intorno per rinfrescarsi.

entries.original:
"It lives on mountains perpetually
covered in snow and is revered as a
deity incarnate."
entries.translation_source: It lives on mountains perpetually covered in snow and is revered as a deity incarnate.
entries.translated: Vive su montagne perennemente coperte di neve ed è venerato come una divinità incarnata.

entries.original:
"Its golden hairs function as sensors.
It pokes them out of its burrow to
monitor its surroundings."
entries.translation_source: Its golden hairs function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.
entries.translated: I suoi peli dorati funzionano da sensori. Li sporge dalla tana per tenere sotto controllo l{B4}ambiente circostante.

entries.original:
"Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so
it’s not very fast, but it has the
power to dig through bedrock."
entries.translation_source: Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it’s not very fast, but it has the power to dig through bedrock.
entries.translated: I suoi baffi metallici sono pesanti, quindi non è molto veloce, ma ha la forza di scavare attraverso la roccia madre.

entries.original:
"It’s impulsive, selfish, and fickle.
It’s very popular with Trainers who
like giving it the attention it needs."
entries.translation_source: It’s impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It’s very popular with Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.
entries.translated: È impulsivo, egoista e volubile. È molto popolare tra gli Allenatori a cui piace dedicargli l{B4}attenzione di cui ha bisogno.

entries.original:
"These daring Pokémon have coins on
their foreheads. Darker coins are harder,
and harder coins garner more respect."
entries.translation_source: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect.
entries.translated: Questi audaci Pokémon hanno monete sulla fronte. Più scure sono le monete, più dure sono, e quelle più dure guadagnano più rispetto.

entries.original:
"It has the classiest coat. The rippling
of its fur in the heat of battle has a
beauty all its own."
entries.translation_source: It has the classiest coat. The rippling of its fur in the heat of battle has a beauty all its own.
entries.translated: Ha il manto più elegante. Il fremere del suo pelo nel calore della lotta ha una bellezza tutta sua.

entries.original:
"Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand
attaches firmly to the portions of its
body that are particularly magnetic."
entries.translation_source: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.
entries.translated: Il suo corpo è una pietra magnetica. La sabbia ferrosa si attacca saldamente alle parti del suo corpo particolarmente magnetiche.

entries.original:
"Graveler’s entire body is tinged with
electricity due to the stones it likes
to eat. It’s very quick-tempered."
entries.translation_source: Graveler’s entire body is tinged with electricity due to the stones it likes to eat. It’s very quick-tempered.
entries.translated: L{B4}intero corpo di Graveler è tinto di elettricità a causa delle pietre che gli piace mangiare. È molto irascibile.

entries.original:
"Since it can’t fire boulders at a rapid
pace, it’s been known to seize nearby
Geodude and fire them from its back."
entries.translation_source: Since it can’t fire boulders at a rapid pace, it’s been known to seize nearby Geodude and fire them from its back.
entries.translated: Poiché non riesce a sparare massi con rapidità, è stato visto afferrare i Geodude vicini e lanciarli dalla sua schiena.

entries.original:
"Its small horn hides a healing power.
With a few rubs from this its horn, any
slight wound you have will be healed."
entries.translation_source: Its small horn hides a healing power. With a few rubs from this its horn, any slight wound you have will be healed.
entries.translated: Il suo piccolo corno nasconde un potere curativo. Bastano pochi sfregamenti del suo corno perché qualsiasi lieve ferita guarisca.

entries.original:
"Brave and prideful, it dashes airily
through the forest, its steps aided by
psychic powers stored in its fetlocks."
entries.translation_source: Brave and prideful, it dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by psychic powers stored in its fetlocks.
entries.translated: Coraggioso e orgoglioso, sfreccia con leggerezza attraverso la foresta, con i passi resi possibili dai poteri psichici immagazzinati nei suoi pastorali.

entries.original:
"Because it eats the seeds of a plant
that grows only in Galar, their tails have
developed a spicy flavor."
entries.translation_source: Because it eats the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.
entries.translated: Poiché mangia i semi di una pianta che cresce solo a Galar, le loro code hanno sviluppato un sapore piccante.

entries.original:
"A Shellder bite set off a chemical
reaction with the spices inside its body,
causing Slowbro to become a Poison-type."
entries.translation_source: A Shellder bite set off a chemical reaction with the spices inside its body, causing Slowbro to become a Poison-type.
entries.translated: Un morso di Shellder ha innescato una reazione chimica con le spezie all{B4}interno del suo corpo, facendo diventare Slowbro di tipo Veleno.

entries.original:
"It uses the stalks of leeks that are
larger and thicker than usual, which
made them to adapt to a unique form."
entries.translation_source: It uses the stalks of leeks that are larger and thicker than usual, which made them to adapt to a unique form.
entries.translated: Usa i gambi dei porri, più grandi e spessi del solito, il che lo ha portato ad adattarsi a una forma unica.

entries.original:
"A Grimer, which had been brought in to
solve a problem with garbage, developed
over time into this form."
entries.translation_source: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.
entries.translated: Un Grimer, portato qui per risolvere un problema con i rifiuti, col tempo si è evoluto in questa forma.

entries.original:
"The garbage it eats causes continuous
chemical changes in its body, which
produce its vivid coloration."
entries.translation_source: The garbage it eats causes continuous chemical changes in its body, which produce its vivid coloration.
entries.translated: La spazzatura di cui si nutre provoca continui cambiamenti chimici nel suo corpo, che producono la sua vivace colorazione.

entries.original:
"It swings its long neck like a whip and
smacks its opponents. This makes
Exeggutor itself dizzy, too."
entries.translation_source: It swings its long neck like a whip and smacks its opponents. This makes Exeggutor itself dizzy, too.
entries.translated: Fa oscillare il suo lungo collo come una frusta e schiaffeggia gli avversari. Questo manda in confusione anche Exeggutor stesso.

entries.original:
"Its custom is to mourn its lost friends.
Mounds of dirt by the side of the road
mark the graves of the Marowak."
entries.translation_source: Its custom is to mourn its lost friends. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.
entries.translated: La sua usanza è piangere gli amici perduti. Cumuli di terra ai lati della strada segnano le tombe dei Marowak.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon consumes particles that
contaminate the air. Instead of leaving
droppings, it expels clean air."
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.
entries.translated: Questo Pokémon consuma particelle che inquinano l{B4}aria. Invece di lasciare deiezioni, espelle aria pulita.

entries.original:
"It can radiate chilliness from the
bottoms of its feet. It’ll spend its
day tap dancing on a frozen floor."
entries.translation_source: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It’ll spend its day tap dancing on a frozen floor.
entries.translated: Può emanare freddo dalle piante dei piedi. Trascorre la giornata a ballare il tip tap su un pavimento ghiacciato.

entries.original:
"Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires
beams that can immobilize opponents as
if they had been frozen solid."
entries.translation_source: Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires beams that can immobilize opponents as if they had been frozen solid.
entries.translated: Conosciuto come Articuno, questo Pokémon spara raggi che possono immobilizzare gli avversari come se fossero congelati di colpo.

entries.original:
"One kick from its powerful legs will
pulverize a dump truck. It runs
through the mountains at over 180 mph."
entries.translation_source: One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. It runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.
entries.translated: Un solo calcio delle sue possenti zampe ridurrebbe in polvere un autocarro ribaltabile. Corre tra le montagne a oltre 180 mph.

entries.original:
"Its sinister, flame-like aura consumes
the spirit of any creature it hits. Victims
become burned-out shadows of themselves."
entries.translation_source: Its sinister, flame-like aura consumes the spirit of any creature it hits. Victims become burned-out shadows of themselves.
entries.translated: La sua sinistra aura simile a una fiamma consuma lo spirito di qualsiasi creatura colpita. Le vittime diventano ombre di se stesse, ridotte a un guscio bruciato.

entries.original:
"While chanting strange spells, Slowking
combines its internal toxins with what
it’s eaten, creating strange potions."
entries.translation_source: While chanting strange spells, Slowking combines its internal toxins with what it’s eaten, creating strange potions.
entries.translated: Mentre intona strani incantesimi, Slowking combina le sue tossine interne con ciò che ha mangiato, creando strane pozioni.

entries.original:
"Sudden climate change wiped out this
ancient kind of Corsola. It absorbs the
life force of others through its branches."
entries.translation_source: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. It absorbs the life force of others through its branches.
entries.translated: Il mutamento climatico improvviso ha spazzato via questa antica forma di Corsola. Assorbe la forza vitale degli altri attraverso i suoi rami.

entries.original:
"It moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc
upon its surroundings. It is thought to
be the oldest form of Zigzagoon."
entries.translation_source: It moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings. It is thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon.
entries.translated: Si muove a zigzag e semina il caos nell{B4}ambiente circostante. Si ritiene che sia la forma più antica di Zigzagoon.

entries.original:
"It uses its long tongue to taunt foes.
Once the opposition is enraged, it
hurls itself, tackling them forcefully."
entries.translation_source: It uses its long tongue to taunt foes. Once the opposition is enraged, it hurls itself, tackling them forcefully.
entries.translated: Usa la sua lunga lingua per stuzzicare i nemici. Quando l{B4}avversario si infuria, si lancia contro di lui con una poderosa carica.

entries.original:
"They freeze their breath to make
snowballs, using them as ammo for
playful snowball fights."
entries.translation_source: They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.
entries.translated: Congelano il proprio respiro per fare palle di neve, usandole come munizioni per giocose battaglie a palle di neve.

entries.original:
"Though it has a gentle disposition,
it’s also very strong. It stashes food
in the snowball on its head."
entries.translation_source: Though it has a gentle disposition, it’s also very strong. It stashes food in the snowball on its head.
entries.translated: Sebbene abbia un carattere mite, è anche molto forte. Conserva il cibo nella palla di neve sulla testa.

entries.original:
"Anger has reignited its atrophied
flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire all
over as it rampages indiscriminately."
entries.translation_source: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire all over as it rampages indiscriminately.
entries.translated: La rabbia ha riacceso il suo sacco di fiamme atrofizzato. Questo Pokémon sputa fuoco ovunque mentre va in escandescenze senza criterio.

entries.original:
"It’s said that this Pokémon was formed
when an ancient clay tablet was drawn
to a vengeful spirit."
entries.translation_source: It’s said that this Pokémon was formed when an ancient clay tablet was drawn to a vengeful spirit.
entries.translated: Si dice che questo Pokémon si sia formato quando un{B4}antica tavoletta d{B4}argilla fu attirata da uno spirito vendicativo.

entries.original:
"Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as
it lies in wait in the mud. When prey
gets close, it will clamp down hard."
entries.translation_source: Its conspicuous lips lure prey in as it lies in wait in the mud. When prey gets close, it will clamp down hard.
entries.translated: Le sue labbra vistose attirano la preda mentre attende immobile nel fango. Quando la preda si avvicina, la morde con forza.

entries.original:
"Born when around 10% of Zygarde’s cells
have been gathered from all over, this
form is skilled in close-range combat."
entries.translation_source: Born when around 10% of Zygarde’s cells have been gathered from all over, this form is skilled in close-range combat.
entries.translated: Nato quando circa il 10% delle cellule di Zygarde è stato radunato da ogni parte, questa forma è abile nel combattimento ravvicinato.

entries.original:
"This is Zygarde’s 100% form.
It has enough power to overwhelm
even Xerneas or Yveltal."
entries.translation_source: This is Zygarde’s 100% form. It has enough power to overwhelm even Xerneas or Yveltal.
entries.translated: Questa è la forma al 100% di Zygarde. Ha abbastanza potere da sopraffare persino Xerneas o Yveltal.

entries.original:
"This Oricorio has sipped bright yellow
nectar. Its bright, cheerful dance
melts the hearts of its enemies."
entries.translation_source: This Oricorio has sipped bright yellow nectar. Its bright, cheerful dance melts the hearts of its enemies.
entries.translated: Questo Oricorio ha sorseggiato del nettare giallo brillante. La sua danza vivace e allegra scioglie il cuore dei suoi nemici.

entries.original:
"This Oricorio has sipped pink nectar.
Its enemies’ hearts melt at the sight
of its gently swaying hips."
entries.translation_source: This Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. Its enemies’ hearts melt at the sight of its gently swaying hips.
entries.translated: Questo Oricorio ha sorseggiato nettare rosa. I cuori dei suoi nemici si sciolgono alla vista dei suoi fianchi che ondeggiano dolcemente.

entries.original:
"This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar.
Some dancers use its graceful, elegant
dancing as inspiration."
entries.translation_source: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Some dancers use its graceful, elegant dancing as inspiration.
entries.translated: Questo Oricorio ha sorseggiato del nettare viola. Alcuni ballerini usano il suo modo di ballare aggraziato ed elegante come ispirazione.

entries.original:
"They live alone without forming packs.
They only listen to orders from those
who can draw out their true power."
entries.translation_source: They live alone without forming packs. They only listen to orders from those who can draw out their true power.
entries.translated: Vivono da soli, senza formare branchi. Ascoltano gli ordini solo di coloro che sanno far emergere il loro vero potere.

entries.original:
"This strange form is the result of it
evolving at dusk. An intense fighting
spirit underlies its calmness."
entries.translation_source: This strange form is the result of it evolving at dusk. An intense fighting spirit underlies its calmness.
entries.translated: Questa strana forma è il risultato della sua evoluzione al crepuscolo. La sua calma nasconde un intenso spirito combattivo.

entries.original:
"At their appearance, even Gyarados flee.
When they team up to use Water Gun, its
power exceeds that of Hydro Pump."
entries.translation_source: At their appearance, even Gyarados flee. When they team up to use Water Gun, its power exceeds that of Hydro Pump.
entries.translated: Alla loro comparsa, persino i Gyarados fuggono. Quando si uniscono per usare Pistola ad Acqua, la sua potenza supera quella di Idropompa.

entries.original:
"This is Necrozma while it’s absorbing
the power of Solgaleo, making it very
ferocious and impossible to control."
entries.translation_source: This is Necrozma while it’s absorbing the power of Solgaleo, making it very ferocious and impossible to control.
entries.translated: Questo è Necrozma mentre assorbe il potere di Solgaleo, rendendolo molto feroce e impossibile da controllare.

entries.original:
"Lunala no longer has a will of its own.
Now under the control of Necrozma, it
continuously expels all of its energy."
entries.translation_source: Lunala no longer has a will of its own. Now under the control of Necrozma, it continuously expels all of its energy.
entries.translated: Lunala non ha più una volontà propria. Ora sotto il controllo di Necrozma, disperde continuamente tutta la sua energia.

entries.original:
"This is its form when it has absorbed
overwhelming light energy. It fires
laser beams from all over its body."
entries.translation_source: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.
entries.translated: Questa è la sua forma quando ha assorbito un{B4}enorme quantità di energia luminosa. Spara raggi laser da tutto il corpo.

entries.original:
"It functions thanks to its artificial soul.
The vivid decoration is proof that it
was presented as a gift to royalty."
entries.translation_source: It functions thanks to its artificial soul. The vivid decoration is proof that it was presented as a gift to royalty.
entries.translated: Funziona grazie alla sua anima artificiale. Le decorazioni vivaci dimostrano che fu offerto in dono alla famiglia reale.

entries.original:
"The slightest shock is sometimes
enough to get this Pokémon to spit
out the Arrokuda lodged in its throat."
entries.translation_source: The slightest shock is sometimes enough to get this Pokémon to spit out the Arrokuda lodged in its throat.
entries.translated: Il minimo scossone a volte basta a far sputare a questo Pokémon l{B4}Arrokuda rimasto incastrato in gola.

entries.original:
"This Cramorant has accidentally gotten
a Pikachu lodged in its gullet. While it
seems to be choking, it isn’t bothered."
entries.translation_source: This Cramorant has accidentally gotten a Pikachu lodged in its gullet. While it seems to be choking, it isn’t bothered.
entries.translated: Questo Cramorant si è accidentalmente ritrovato un Pikachu incastrato in gola. Anche se sembra soffocare, la cosa non lo disturba.

entries.original:
"While generating electricity, it fills
surroundings with what sounds like
the strumming of a bass guitar."
entries.translation_source: While generating electricity, it fills surroundings with what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.
entries.translated: Mentre genera elettricità, riempie l{B4}ambiente di un suono simile allo strimpellare di un basso.

entries.original:
"The swirl pattern in its body is its
weakness. If it gets stirred, the swirl
loses its shape, and it gets dizzy."
entries.translation_source: The swirl pattern in its body is its weakness. If it gets stirred, the swirl loses its shape, and it gets dizzy.
entries.translated: Il motivo a spirale sul suo corpo è il suo punto debole. Se viene agitato, la spirale perde la sua forma e si stordisce.

entries.original:
"When angered, it launches tea from
its body at the offender’s mouth. The
tea causes strong chills if swallowed."
entries.translation_source: When angered, it launches tea from its body at the offender’s mouth. The tea causes strong chills if swallowed.
entries.translated: Quando si infuria, lancia il tè dal suo corpo verso la bocca del colpevole. Se bevuto, il tè provoca forti brividi.

entries.original:
"It evolved from a Milcery that held
onto a Berry Sweet. The flavor of its
cream depends on how it was mixed."
entries.translation_source: It evolved from a Milcery that held onto a Berry Sweet. The flavor of its cream depends on how it was mixed.
entries.translated: Si è evoluto da un Milcery che teneva stretto un Dolce Bacche. Il sapore della sua crema dipende da come è stata mescolata.

entries.original:
"It evolved from a Milcery that held
onto a Clover Sweet. The flavor of its
cream depends on how it was mixed."
entries.translation_source: It evolved from a Milcery that held onto a Clover Sweet. The flavor of its cream depends on how it was mixed.
entries.translated: Si è evoluto da un Milcery che teneva stretto un Dolce Trifoglio. Il sapore della sua crema dipende da come è stata mescolata.

entries.original:
"It evolved from a Milcery that held
onto a Flower Sweet. The flavor of its
cream depends on how it was mixed."
entries.translation_source: It evolved from a Milcery that held onto a Flower Sweet. The flavor of its cream depends on how it was mixed.
entries.translated: Si è evoluto da un Milcery che teneva stretto un Dolce Fiore. Il sapore della sua crema dipende da come è stata mescolata.

entries.original:
"It evolved from a Milcery that held
onto a Love Sweet. The flavor of its
cream depends on how it was mixed."
entries.translation_source: It evolved from a Milcery that held onto a Love Sweet. The flavor of its cream depends on how it was mixed.
entries.translated: Si è evoluto da un Milcery che teneva un Love Sweet. Il sapore della sua crema dipende da come è stata mescolata.

entries.original:
"It evolved from a Milcery that held
onto a Ribbon Sweet. The flavor of its
cream depends on how it was mixed."
entries.translation_source: It evolved from a Milcery that held onto a Ribbon Sweet. The flavor of its cream depends on how it was mixed.
entries.translated: Si è evoluto da un Milcery che teneva stretto un Dolce Fiocco. Il sapore della sua crema dipende da come è stata mescolata.

entries.original:
"It evolved from a Milcery that held
onto a Star Sweet. The flavor of its
cream depends on how it was mixed."
entries.translation_source: It evolved from a Milcery that held onto a Star Sweet. The flavor of its cream depends on how it was mixed.
entries.translated: Si è evoluto da un Milcery che teneva uno Star Sweet. Il sapore della sua crema dipende da come è stata mescolata.

entries.original:
"The ice covering this Pokémon’s face
has shattered, revealing a worried
expression that many are enamored with."
entries.translation_source: The ice covering this Pokémon’s face has shattered, revealing a worried expression that many are enamored with.
entries.translated: Il ghiaccio che ricopriva il volto di questo Pokémon si è frantumato, rivelando un{B4}espressione preoccupata che affascina molti.

entries.original:
"These intelligent Pokémon touch
horns with each other to share
information between them."
entries.translation_source: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.
entries.translated: Questi Pokémon intelligenti si toccano con le corna per condividere informazioni tra loro.

entries.original:
"Intense hunger drives it to extremes
of violence. Until its hunger is appeased,
it gets up to all manner of evil deeds."
entries.translation_source: Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.
entries.translated: La fame intensa lo spinge agli estremi della violenza. Finché la sua fame non viene placata, si abbandona a ogni sorta di atti malvagi.

entries.original:
"Now armed with a weapon it used in
ancient times, this Pokémon needs only
a single strike to fell any target."
entries.translation_source: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell any target.
entries.translated: Ora armato di un{B4}arma che usava nei tempi antichi, questo Pokémon ha bisogno di un solo colpo per abbattere qualsiasi bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Now that it has equipped its shield,
it can shrug off impressive blows,
even from Dynamaxed foes."
entries.translation_source: Now that it has equipped its shield, it can shrug off impressive blows, even from Dynamaxed foes.
entries.translated: Ora che ha equipaggiato il suo scudo, riesce a resistere a colpi impressionanti, persino da avversari Dinamax.

entries.original:
"Infinite amounts of energy pour from
this Pokémon’s enlarged core, warping
the surrounding space-time."
entries.translation_source: Infinite amounts of energy pour from this Pokémon’s enlarged core, warping the surrounding space-time.
entries.translated: Dall{B4}enorme nucleo di questo Pokémon sgorgano quantità infinite di energia, alterando lo spazio-tempo circostante.

entries.original:
"This form of Urshifu strongly believes
in defeating foes by raining many blows
down on them."
entries.translation_source: This form of Urshifu strongly believes in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them.
entries.translated: Questa forma di Urshifu crede fermamente nel sconfiggere i nemici tempestandoli di colpi.

entries.original:
"This Zarude left its pack to raise a
human child. It would wrap the child
with its cloth to calm the child’s crying."
entries.translation_source: This Zarude left its pack to raise a human child. It would wrap the child with its cloth to calm the child’s crying.
entries.translated: Questo Zarude ha lasciato il suo branco per crescere un bambino umano. Lo avvolgeva nel suo panno per calmarne il pianto.

entries.original:
"It is said that this Pokémon once
moved a large forest to a new
location overnight."
entries.translation_source: It is said that this Pokémon once moved a large forest to a new location overnight.
entries.translated: Si dice che questo Pokémon una volta abbia spostato una grande foresta in una nuova posizione nel corso di una sola notte.

entries.original:
"It is said that by using its power,
this Pokémon saved the creatures
of a forest from a meteorite strike."
entries.translation_source: It is said that by using its power, this Pokémon saved the creatures of a forest from a meteorite strike.
entries.translated: Si dice che, usando il suo potere, questo Pokémon abbia salvato le creature di una foresta dall{B4}impatto di un meteorite.

entries.original:
"These Pokémon live in packs in the
snowy mountains and defend themselves
with icy breath."
entries.translation_source: These Pokémon live in packs in the snowy mountains and defend themselves with icy breath.
entries.translated: Questi Pokémon vivono in branchi sulle montagne innevate e si difendono con un alito gelido.

entries.original:
"It is said to guide virtuous people who
have lost their way on mountain paths
back down to the mountain’s base."
entries.translation_source: It is said to guide virtuous people who have lost their way on mountain paths back down to the mountain’s base.
entries.translated: Si dice che guidi le persone virtuose che si sono smarrite sui sentieri di montagna fino ai piedi della montagna.

entries.original:
"When excited, Voltorb discharges the
electric current it has stored in its
belly, then lets out a great laugh."
entries.translation_source: When excited, Voltorb discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great laugh.
entries.translated: Quando si eccita, Voltorb scarica la corrente elettrica immagazzinata nella sua pancia, poi scoppia in una gran risata.

entries.original:
