"When irritated, this Pokémon lets
loose an electric current equal to
20 lightning bolts."
entries.translation_source: When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.
entries.translated: Quando si irrita, questo Pokémon sprigiona una corrente elettrica pari a 20 fulmini.

entries.original:
"It is said to purify lost, forsaken
souls with its flames and guide
them to the afterlife."
entries.translation_source: It is said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife.
entries.translated: Si dice che purifichi le anime perdute e abbandonate con le sue fiamme e le conduca nell{B4}aldilà.

entries.original:
"Fisherman detest this troublesome
Pokémon because it sprays poison from
its spines, getting it everywhere."
entries.translation_source: Fisherman detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere.
entries.translated: I pescatori detestano questo fastidioso Pokémon perché spruzza veleno dalle sue spine, spargendolo ovunque.

entries.original:
"From the tips of its claws drips
a venom that infiltrates the nerves
of any prey caught in its grasp."
entries.translation_source: From the tips of its claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in its grasp.
entries.translated: Dalle punte delle sue artigli cola un veleno che penetra nei nervi di ogni preda stretta nella sua morsa.

entries.original:
"Hard of heart and deft of blade,
its turbulent blows crash into foes
like ceaseless pounding waves."
entries.translation_source: Hard of heart and deft of blade, its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.
entries.translated: Di cuore duro e abile con la lama, i suoi colpi turbolenti si abbattono sui nemici come onde incessanti.

entries.original:
"The leaves on its head are highly
valued for medicinal purposes when
dried in the sun and boiled."
entries.translation_source: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes when dried in the sun and boiled.
entries.translated: Le foglie sulla sua testa sono molto apprezzate a fini medicinali quando vengono essiccate al sole e fatte bollire.

entries.original:
"This Basculin differs from others in
several respects, including its
demeanor - this one is gentle."
entries.translation_source: This Basculin differs from others in several respects, including its demeanor - this one is gentle.
entries.translated: Questo Basculin si differenzia dagli altri sotto diversi aspetti, incluso il suo carattere: questo è gentile.

entries.original:
"A once-departed soul, returned to
life. It derives power from resentment,
which rises as energy atop its head."
entries.translation_source: A once-departed soul, returned to life. It derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head.
entries.translated: Un{B4}anima un tempo trapassata, tornata in vita. Trae forza dal rancore, che si alza come energia sopra la testa.

entries.original:
"Heedless of its own safety, it attacks
its nemeses with a bitter energy so
intense, it lacerates its own body."
entries.translation_source: Heedless of its own safety, it attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates its own body.
entries.translated: Senza curarsi della propria incolumità, attacca i suoi nemici con un{B4}energia amara così intensa da lacerargli il corpo.

entries.original:
"It is said to blast lakes with shock
waves, then scoops up any prey
that float to the water’s surface."
entries.translation_source: It is said to blast lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water’s surface.
entries.translated: Si dice che colpisca i laghi con onde d{B4}urto, poi raccolga qualsiasi preda che galleggi sulla superficie dell{B4}acqua.

entries.original:
"It is said its metallic shell developed
as a result of the mucus on its skin
reacting with the iron in ancient water."
entries.translation_source: It is said its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in ancient water.
entries.translated: Si dice che il suo guscio metallico si sia formato a seguito della reazione del muco sulla sua pelle con il ferro presente nell{B4}acqua antica.

entries.original:
"Able to freely control the hardness
of its metallic shell. It loathes
solitude and is extremely clingy."
entries.translation_source: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy.
entries.translated: È in grado di controllare liberamente la durezza del suo guscio metallico. Odia la solitudine ed è estremamente appiccicoso.

entries.original:
"The armor of ice covering its lower
jaw puts steel to shame and can
shatter rocks with ease."
entries.translation_source: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease.
entries.translated: L{B4}armatura di ghiaccio che ricopre la sua mascella inferiore fa impallidire l{B4}acciaio e può frantumare le rocce con facilità.

entries.original:
"The air stored inside the rachises of
Decidueye’s feathers insulates the
Pokémon against extreme cold."
entries.translation_source: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye’s feathers insulates the Pokémon against extreme cold.
entries.translated: L{B4}aria immagazzinata all{B4}interno dei rachidi delle piume di Decidueye isola il Pokémon dal freddo estremo.

entries.original:
"The best Ball with the ultimate
performance. It will catch any wild
Pokémon without fail."
entries.translation_source: The best Ball with the ultimate performance. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.
entries.translated:
La migliore Ball, dalla massima
efficacia. Catturerà senza fallire
qualsiasi Pokémon selvatico.

entries.original:
"A very high-grade Ball that offers
a higher Pokémon catch rate than
a Great Ball."
entries.translation_source: A very high-grade Ball that offers a higher Pokémon catch rate than a Great Ball.
entries.translated:
Una Ball di altissimo livello che offre
una probabilità di cattura dei Pokémon
superiore a quella di una Super Ball.

entries.original:
"A good, quality Ball that offers
a higher Pokémon catch rate than
a standard Poké Ball."
entries.translation_source: A good, quality Ball that offers a higher Pokémon catch rate than a standard Poké Ball.
entries.translated:
Una Poké Ball di buona qualità che
offre una percentuale di cattura
più alta di una Poké Ball standard.

entries.original:
"A ball thrown to catch a wild
Pokémon. It is designed in a
capsule style."
entries.translation_source: A ball thrown to catch a wild Pokémon. It is designed in a capsule style.
entries.translated:
Una sfera lanciata per catturare
un Pokémon selvatico. Ha un design
in stile capsula.

entries.original:
"A special ball that is used only in
the Safari Zone. It is finished in
a camouflage pattern."
entries.translation_source: A special ball that is used only in the Safari Zone. It is finished in a camouflage pattern.
entries.translated:
Una speciale Safari Ball usata
solo nella Zona Safari. Ha un
motivo mimetico.

entries.original:
"A somewhat different Ball that
works especially well on Water- and
Bug-type Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: A somewhat different Ball that works especially well on Water- and Bug-type Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Una Ball un po{B4} diversa che
funziona particolarmente bene sui
Pokémon di tipo Acqua e Coleottero.

entries.original:
"A somewhat different Ball that
works especially well on Pokémon
deep in the sea."
entries.translation_source: A somewhat different Ball that works especially well on Pokémon deep in the sea.
entries.translated:
Una Ball un po{B4} diversa che
funziona particolarmente bene sui
Pokémon in fondo al mare.

entries.original:
"A somewhat different Ball that
works especially well on weaker
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: A somewhat different Ball that works especially well on weaker Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Una Ball un po{B4} diversa che
funziona particolarmente bene con
i Pokémon più deboli.

entries.original:
"A somewhat different Ball that
works especially well on Pokémon
caught before."
entries.translation_source: A somewhat different Ball that works especially well on Pokémon caught before.
entries.translated:
Una Ball un po{B4} diversa che
funziona particolarmente bene sui
Pokémon catturati in precedenza.

entries.original:
"A somewhat different Ball that
becomes progressively better the
more turns there are in a battle."
entries.translation_source: A somewhat different Ball that becomes progressively better the more turns there are in a battle.
entries.translated:
Una Ball un po{B4} diversa che
diventa progressivamente migliore
quanto più turni passano in lotta.

entries.original:
"A comfortable Ball that makes a
captured wild Pokémon quickly grow
friendly."
entries.translation_source: A comfortable Ball that makes a captured wild Pokémon quickly grow friendly.
entries.translated:
Una Ball comoda che fa diventare
rapidamente amichevole un Pokémon
selvatico catturato.

entries.original:
"A rare Ball that has been
specially made to commemorate an
event of some sort."
entries.translation_source: A rare Ball that has been specially made to commemorate an event of some sort.
entries.translated:
Una Ball rara, realizzata
appositamente per commemorare un
qualche evento.

entries.original:
"A spray-type wound medicine.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon
by 20 points."
entries.translation_source: A spray-type wound medicine. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 20 points.
entries.translated:
Una medicina per ferite spray.
Ripristina i PS di un Pokémon di
20 punti.

entries.original:
"A spray-type medicine.
It heals one Pokémon from a
poisoning."
entries.translation_source: A spray-type medicine. It heals one Pokémon from a poisoning.
entries.translated:
Una medicina di tipo spray. Cura
un Pokémon dall{B4}avvelenamento.

entries.original:
"A spray-type medicine.
It heals one Pokémon of a burn."
entries.translation_source: A spray-type medicine. It heals one Pokémon of a burn.
entries.translated:
Una medicina di tipo spray. Cura
la scottatura di un Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A spray-type medicine.
It heals one Pokémon of
frostbite."
entries.translation_source: A spray-type medicine. It heals one Pokémon of frostbite.
entries.translated:
Medicina spray. Cura un Pokémon
dall{B4}assideramento.

entries.original:
"A spray-type medicine.
It awakens a sleeping Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: A spray-type medicine. It awakens a sleeping Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Una medicina di tipo spray.
Risveglia un Pokémon addormentato.

entries.original:
"A spray-type medicine.
It heals one Pokémon from
paralysis."
entries.translation_source: A spray-type medicine. It heals one Pokémon from paralysis.

Una medicina di tipo spray. Cura
un Pokémon dalla paralisi.

"A medicine that fully restores the
HP and heals any status problems

entries.translation_source: A medicine that fully restores the HP and heals any status problems of one Pokémon.

Una medicina che ripristina
completamente i PS e cura
qualsiasi problema di stato di un Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A spray-type wound medicine.

Pokémon."

Una medicina spray per le ferite.
Ripristina completamente i PS di
un Pokémon.

"A spray-type wound medicine.

by 200 points."

Una medicina per ferite spray.
Ripristina i PS di un Pokémon di
200 punti.

entries.original:
"A spray-type wound medicine.

by 50 points."

entries.translated:
Una medicina per ferite spray.
Ripristina i PS di un Pokémon di
50 punti.

entries.original:
"A spray-type medicine.
It heals all the status problems of
one Pokémon."

entries.translated:
Una medicina spray. Cura tutti i
problemi di stato di un Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A medicine that revives a fainted
Pokémon, restoring HP by half the
maximum amount."
entries.translation_source: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon, restoring HP by half the maximum amount.
entries.translated:
Una medicina che rianima un
Pokémon svenuto, ripristinandogli
metà dei PS massimi.

entries.original:
"A medicine that revives a fainted
Pokémon, restoring HP fully."
entries.translation_source: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon, restoring HP fully.
entries.translated:
Una medicina che rianima un
Pokémon svenuto, ripristinandone
completamente i PS.

entries.original:
"Water with a high mineral content.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon
by 50 points."
entries.translation_source: Water with a high mineral content. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.
entries.translated:
Acqua ricca di minerali.
Ripristina 50 PS a un Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A fizzy soda drink.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon
by 60 points."
entries.translation_source: A fizzy soda drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 60 points.

Una bibita gassata. Ripristina 60

Una bibita molto dolce. Ripristina

entries.original:

Latte altamente nutriente.

100 punti.

entries.original:
"A very bitter medicine powder.

entries.translation_source: A very bitter medicine powder. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

Una polvere medicinale molto
amara. Ripristina 50 PS di un
Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A very bitter root.
It restores the HP of one Pokémon
by 200 points."
entries.translation_source: A very bitter root. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 200 points.
entries.translated:
Una radice molto amara. Ripristina

entries.original:
"A very bitter medicine powder.
It heals all the status problems of
one Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: A very bitter medicine powder. It heals all the status problems of one Pokémon.

Una polvere medicinale molto
amara. Cura tutti i problemi di
stato di un Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A very bitter medicinal herb.
It revives a fainted Pokémon,
restoring HP fully."
entries.translation_source: A very bitter medicinal herb. It revives a fainted Pokémon, restoring HP fully.
entries.translated:
Una pianta medicinale molto
amara. Rianima un Pokémon
svenuto, ripristinandone completamente i PS.

entries.original:
"Restores a selected move’s PP by
10 points for one Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Restores a selected move’s PP by 10 points for one Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ripristina di 10 PP i PP di una
mossa scelta di un Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Fully restores a selected move’s PP
for one Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Fully restores a selected move’s PP for one Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ripristina completamente i PP di
una mossa scelta di un Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Restores the PP of all moves for
one Pokémon by 10 points each."
entries.translation_source: Restores the PP of all moves for one Pokémon by 10 points each.
entries.translated:
Ripristina i PP di tutte le mosse
di un Pokémon di 10 punti
ciascuno.

entries.original:
"Fully restores the PP of all moves
for one Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Fully restores the PP of all moves for one Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ripristina completamente i PP di
tutte le mosse di un Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Lavaridge Town’s local specialty.

entries.translation_source: Lavaridge Town’s local specialty. It heals all the status problems of one Pokémon.

La specialità locale di Lavaridge
Town. Cura tutti i problemi di
stato di un Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A blue glass flute that awakens

entries.translation_source: A blue glass flute that awakens a sleeping Pokémon.

Un flauto di vetro blu che
risveglia un Pokémon addormentato.

entries.original:
"A yellow glass flute that snaps one

entries.translation_source: A yellow glass flute that snaps one Pokémon out of confusion.

Un flauto di vetro giallo che fa
uscire un Pokémon dalla
confusione.

"A red glass flute that snaps one

entries.translation_source: A red glass flute that snaps one Pokémon out of infatuation.

Un flauto di vetro rosso che fa
uscire un Pokémon
dall{B4}innamoramento.

Un flauto di vetro nero.

livello dei Pokémon selvatici.

"A white glass flute.
When blown, it makes wild Pokémon

Un flauto di vetro bianco.
Soffiandoci sopra, abbassa il
livello dei Pokémon selvatici.

Sale puro ottenuto sott{B4}acqua. È

Una graziosa conchiglia trovata

bianche.

Un piccolo frammento rosso.
Sembra provenire da una specie di
strumento costruito molto tempo fa.

Un piccolo frammento blu. Sembra
provenire da una specie di
strumento costruito molto tempo fa.

Un piccolo frammento giallo.
Sembra provenire da una sorta di
strumento costruito molto tempo fa.

entries.original:
"A small green shard.

entries.translated:
Un piccolo frammento verde.
Sembra provenire da una specie di
strumento costruito molto tempo fa.

entries.original:
"A special Poké Ball for the
Pal Park."
entries.translation_source: A special Poké Ball for the Pal Park.
entries.translated:
Una speciale Poké Ball per il
Parco Amici.

entries.original:
"A rare Poké Ball that has been
specially crafted to commemorate
an occasion of some sort."
entries.translation_source: A rare Poké Ball that has been specially crafted to commemorate an occasion of some sort.
entries.translated:
Una rara Poké Ball realizzata
appositamente per commemorare
un{B4}occasione di qualche tipo.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It boosts the power of moves, at
the cost of some HP on each hit."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of moves, at the cost of some HP on each hit.
entries.translated:
Un oggetto da far tenere a un
Pokémon. Aumenta la potenza delle
mosse, al costo di alcuni PS a ogni colpo.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a bizarre orb that badly
poisons the holder in battle."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizarre orb that badly poisons the holder in battle.
entries.translated:
Un oggetto da tenere per un
Pokémon. È una sfera bizzarra che
avvelena gravemente chi la tiene in lotta.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It is a bizarre orb that inflicts a
burn on the holder in battle."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizarre orb that inflicts a burn on the holder in battle.
entries.translated:
Un oggetto da far tenere a un
Pokémon. È una sfera bizzarra che
provoca una scottatura a chi la tiene in lotta.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
Poison-type Pokémon regain HP,
but it damages any other type."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Poison-type Pokémon regain HP, but it damages any other type.
entries.translated:
Uno strumento da far tenere a un
Pokémon. I Pokémon di tipo Veleno
recuperano PS, ma danneggia qualsiasi altro tipo.

entries.original:
"A powder that can give or remove

Una polvere che può conferire o
rimuovere il fattore Gigamax da
alcune specie di Pokémon.

entries.translated:
Una Poké Ball speciale che facilita
la cattura dei Pokémon selvatici di
notte o in luoghi bui come le grotte.

"A remedial Poké Ball that restores

Una Poké Ball curativa che
ripristina i PS del Pokémon
catturato ed elimina qualsiasi alterazione di stato.

entries.translated:
Un oggetto da tenere da un Pokémon.
Se chi lo tiene si innamora, anche
il Pokémon avversario si innamorerà.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It extends the duration of the move
Sandstorm when used by the holder."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Sandstorm when used by the holder.
entries.translated:
Un oggetto da dare a un Pokémon. Se
tenuto da chi lo usa, prolunga la
durata della mossa Tempesta di sabbia.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It extends the duration of the move
Rain Dance when used by the holder."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Rain Dance when used by the holder.
entries.translated:
Uno strumento da far tenere a un
Pokémon. Prolunga la durata della mossa
Dance Rain quando viene usato da chi lo tiene.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It extends the duration of the move
Sunny Day when used by the holder."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Sunny Day when used by the holder.
entries.translated:
Un oggetto da dare a un Pokémon.
Se tenuto da chi lo usa, prolunga
la durata della mossa Giornodisole.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It extends the duration of the move
Hail when used by the holder."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Hail when used by the holder.
entries.translated:
Un oggetto da far tenere a un
Pokémon. Prolunga la durata della
mossa Grandine se usata da chi la tiene.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It cuts Speed in battle but allows
the holder’s Attack to grow more."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It cuts Speed in battle but allows the holder’s Attack to grow more.
entries.translated:
Un oggetto da tenere da un Pokémon. Riduce
la Velocità in lotta, ma permette
all{B4}Attacco di chi lo tiene di aumentare di più.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It cuts Speed in battle but allows
the holder’s Defense to grow more."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It cuts Speed in battle but allows the holder’s Defense to grow more.
entries.translated:
Uno strumento da far tenere a un Pokémon.
Riduce la Velocità in lotta, ma permette
alla Difesa del portatore di crescere di più.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It cuts Speed in battle but allows
the holder’s Sp. Atk to grow more."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It cuts Speed in battle but allows the holder’s Sp. Atk to grow more.
entries.translated:
Uno strumento da far tenere a un Pokémon.
Riduce la Velocità in lotta, ma permette
all{B4}Att. Sp. del portatore di crescere di più.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It cuts Speed in battle but allows
the holder’s Sp. Def to grow more."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It cuts Speed in battle but allows the holder’s Sp. Def to grow more.
entries.translated:
Uno strumento da far tenere a un Pokémon.
Riduce la Velocità in lotta, ma permette
alla Dif. Sp. del portatore di crescere di più.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It cuts Speed in battle but allows
the holder’s Speed to grow more."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It cuts Speed in battle but allows the holder’s Speed to grow more.
entries.translated:
Un oggetto da tenere da un Pokémon. Riduce
la Velocità in lotta, ma permette alla
Velocità di chi lo tiene di aumentare di più.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It cuts Speed in battle but allows
the holder’s max HP to grow more."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It cuts Speed in battle but allows the holder’s max HP to grow more.
entries.translated:
Un oggetto da tenere da un Pokémon. Riduce
la Velocità in lotta, ma permette ai PS
massimi di chi lo tiene di aumentare di più.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
The amount of HP recovered from
HP-stealing moves is boosted."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The amount of HP recovered from HP-stealing moves is boosted.
entries.translated:
Uno strumento da far tenere a un
Pokémon. La quantità di PS recuperati
con le mosse che assorbono PS viene aumentata.

entries.original:
"A vital item needed to keep a
stone tower from collapsing. Voices
can be heard from it occasionally."
entries.translation_source: A vital item needed to keep a stone tower from collapsing. Voices can be heard from it occasionally.
entries.translated:
Un oggetto fondamentale necessario per
impedire che una torre di pietra crolli. Di
tanto in tanto se ne possono sentire delle voci.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It makes the holder bloated and
slow moving."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It makes the holder bloated and slow moving.
entries.translated:
Strumento da tenere da parte di un
Pokémon. Lo rende gonfio e lento
nei movimenti.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It slightly boosts the power of
Psychic-type moves."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It slightly boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It helps keep wild Pokémon away if
the holder is the first in the party."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the first in the party.
entries.translated:
Strumento da tenere da un Pokémon. Aiuta
a tenere lontani i Pokémon selvatici se
chi lo tiene è il primo della squadra.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It slightly boosts the power of
Rock-type moves."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It slightly boosts the power of Rock-type moves.
entries.translated:
Un oggetto da far tenere a un
Pokémon. Potenzia leggermente le
mosse di tipo Roccia.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It slightly boosts the power of
Grass-type moves."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It slightly boosts the power of Grass-type moves.
entries.translated:
Strumento da tenere da un Pokémon.
Potenzia leggermente la forza
delle mosse di tipo Erba.

entries.original:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.
It slightly boosts the power of
Water-type moves."
entries.translation_source: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It slightly boosts the power of Water-type moves.
entries.translated:
Strumento da tenere da un Pokémon.
Potenzia leggermente la forza
delle mosse di tipo Acqua.

entries.original:
"A folding bicycle that is at least
twice as fast as walking."
entries.translation_source: A folding bicycle that is at least twice as fast as walking.
entries.translated:
Una bicicletta pieghevole almeno
due volte più veloce che andare a
piedi.

entries.original:
"A case for holding Coins obtained
at the Game Corner.
It holds up to 999,999,999 Coins."
entries.translation_source: A case for holding Coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 999,999,999 Coins.
entries.translated:
Una custodia per conservare le
Monete ottenute alla Sala Giochi.
Può contenere fino a 999.999.999 Monete.

entries.original:
"It checks for unseen items in the
area and makes noise and lights
when it finds something."
entries.translation_source: It checks for unseen items in the area and makes noise and lights when it finds something.
entries.translated:
Controlla la presenza di oggetti non
ancora scoperti nella zona e fa
rumore e si illumina quando ne trova uno.

entries.original:
"An old and beat-up fishing rod.
Use it by any body of water to 
fish for wild Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Una vecchia e malandata canna da
pesca. Usala in qualsiasi specchio
d{B4}acqua per pescare Pokémon selvatici.

entries.original:
"A new, good-quality fishing rod.
Use it by any body of water to 
fish for wild Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Una nuova canna da pesca di buona
qualità. Usala in qualsiasi specchio
d{B4}acqua per pescare Pokémon selvatici.

entries.original:
"An awesome, high-tech fishing rod.
Use it by any body of water to fish
for wild Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Una fantastica canna da pesca
hi-tech. Usala in qualsiasi
specchio d{B4}acqua per pescare Pokémon selvatici.

entries.original:
"A ticket required for sailing
between West and East Borrius.
It has a drawing of a ship. "
entries.translation_source: A ticket required for sailing between West and East Borrius. It has a drawing of a ship.
entries.translated:
Un biglietto necessario per
viaggiare in nave tra Borrius Ovest
e Borrius Est. Ha il disegno di una nave.

entries.original:
"A handkerchief dropped by a
regular at the Magnolia Café.
It smells faintly like a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: A handkerchief dropped by a regular at the Magnolia Café. It smells faintly like a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Un fazzoletto lasciato da un
cliente abituale del Magnolia
Café. Ha un lieve odore di Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A nifty watering pail.
Use it to promote strong growth in
BERRIES planted in soft soil."
entries.translation_source: A nifty watering pail. Use it to promote strong growth in BERRIES planted in soft soil.
entries.translated:
Un pratico annaffiatoio. Usalo per
favorire una crescita forte delle
BACCHE piantate nel terreno soffice.

entries.original:
"A device used to read an ancient
dialect known as \qoBraille.\qc It has
not been spoken in over 1000 years."
entries.translation_source: A device used to read an ancient dialect known as [quote-open-1]Braille.[quote-close-2] It has not been spoken in over 1000 years.
entries.translated:
Un dispositivo usato per leggere un
antico dialetto noto come \qoBraille.\qc
Non viene parlato da oltre 1000 anni.

entries.original:
"A sack used to collect volcanic
ash automatically during walks
over deep ash."
entries.translation_source: A sack used to collect volcanic ash automatically during walks over deep ash.
entries.translated:
Un sacco usato per raccogliere
automaticamente la cenere vulcanica
durante le passeggiate sulla cenere profonda.

entries.original:
"The key to NEW MAUVILLE, which
was constructed beneath MAUVILLE
CITY."
entries.translation_source: The key to NEW MAUVILLE, which was constructed beneath MAUVILLE CITY.
entries.translated:
La chiave di NEW MAUVILLE,
costruita sotto MAUVILLE CITY.

entries.original:
"A card that lists the Battle
Points you have earned and battle
facility prints you have received."
entries.translation_source: A card that lists the Battle Points you have earned and battle facility prints you have received.
entries.translated:
Una scheda che elenca i Punti Lotta
che hai ottenuto e le stampe delle
strutture lotta che hai ricevuto.

entries.original:
"An extremely important letter to
STEVEN from the PRESIDENT of the
DEVON CORPORATION."
entries.translation_source: An extremely important letter to STEVEN from the PRESIDENT of the DEVON CORPORATION.
entries.translated:
Una lettera estremamente
importante per ROCCO da parte
del PRESIDENTE della DEVON CORPORATION.

entries.original:
"The ticket required for sailing on a
ferry to a distant southern island.
It features a drawing of an island."
entries.translation_source: The ticket required for sailing on a ferry to a distant southern island. It features a drawing of an island.
entries.translated:
Il biglietto necessario per salpare su
un traghetto verso una lontana isola
del sud. Riporta il disegno di un{B4}isola.

entries.original:
"An orb that glows red.
It is said to contain an incredible
power from ancient times."
entries.translation_source: An orb that glows red. It is said to contain an incredible power from ancient times.
entries.translated:
Una sfera che emana una luce
rossa. Si dice contenga un potere
incredibile dai tempi antichi.

entries.original:
"An orb that glows blue.
It is said to contain an incredible
power from ancient times."
entries.translation_source: An orb that glows blue. It is said to contain an incredible power from ancient times.
entries.translated:
Una sfera che emana una luce blu.
Si dice contenga un potere
incredibile dai tempi antichi.

entries.original:
"A device used to view the hidden
stats and movesets of Pokémon.
It is not for the average Trainer."
entries.translation_source: A device used to view the hidden stats and movesets of Pokémon. It is not for the average Trainer.
entries.translated:
Un dispositivo usato per vedere le
statistiche nascoste e i set di mosse dei
Pokémon. Non è adatto a un Allenatore medio.

entries.original:
"A pair of protective goggles.
They enable a Trainer to travel
through even desert sandstorms."
entries.translation_source: A pair of protective goggles. They enable a Trainer to travel through even desert sandstorms.
entries.translated:
Un paio di occhiali protettivi.
Permettono a un Allenatore di
attraversare persino le tempeste di sabbia del deserto.

entries.original:
"A piece of the meteorite that fell
from space onto Crater Town
long ago.
          "
entries.translation_source: A piece of the meteorite that fell from space onto Crater Town long ago.
entries.translated:
Un frammento di meteorite caduto
dallo spazio su Crater Town molto
tempo fa.

entries.original:
"A key that disengages the 
Shadows’ electric barrier in
Thundercap Mt."
entries.translation_source: A key that disengages the Shadows’ electric barrier in Thundercap Mt.
entries.translated:
Una chiave che disattiva la
barriera elettrica degli Shadows a
Thundercap Mt.

entries.original:
"A card-type key that unlocks doors
with a clearance level of 2 in the
Shadows’ base."
entries.translation_source: A card-type key that unlocks doors with a clearance level of 2 in the Shadows’ base.
entries.translated:
Una chiave a scheda che sblocca
le porte con livello di
autorizzazione 2 nella base degli Shadows.

entries.original:
"A card-type key that unlocks doors
with a clearance level of 3 in the
Shadows’ base."
entries.translation_source: A card-type key that unlocks doors with a clearance level of 3 in the Shadows’ base.
entries.translated:
Una chiave a scheda che sblocca
le porte con livello di
autorizzazione 3 nella base degli Shadows.

entries.original:
"A card-type key that unlocks doors
with a clearance level of 1 in The Shadow. "
entries.translation_source: A card-type key that unlocks doors with a clearance level of 1 in The Shadow.
entries.translated:
Una chiave a scheda che sblocca le
porte con livello di accesso 1 nel
The Shadow.

entries.original:
"A key that opens the storage hold
inside the ABANDONED SHIP.
It is old and looks easily broken."
entries.translation_source: A key that opens the storage hold inside the ABANDONED SHIP. It is old and looks easily broken.
entries.translated:
Una chiave che apre il vano di
carico nella NAVE ABBANDONATA. È
vecchia e sembra rompersi facilmente.

entries.original:
"A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-
dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be
part of a plant root."
entries.translation_source: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be part of a plant root.
entries.translated:
Il fossile di un antico Pokémon che
viveva sul fondale marino. Sembra
far parte di una radice di pianta.

entries.original:
"A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-
dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be
part of a claw."
entries.translation_source: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be part of a claw.
entries.translated:
Fossile di un antico Pokémon che
vive sui fondali marini. Sembra
essere parte di un artiglio.

entries.original:
"A scope that signals the presence
of any unseeable Pokémon.
It is made by the Devon Corp."
entries.translation_source: A scope that signals the presence of any unseeable Pokémon. It is made by the Devon Corp.
entries.translated:
Un rilevatore che segnala la
presenza di qualsiasi Pokémon
invisibile. È prodotto dalla Devon Corp.

entries.original:
"A convenient container for storing
outfits. Use it to change clothes,
as well as certain colours."
entries.translation_source: A convenient container for storing outfits. Use it to change clothes, as well as certain colours.
entries.translated:
Un comodo contenitore per riporre
gli abiti. Usalo per cambiarti,
oltre che per cambiare alcuni colori.

entries.original:
"A parcel to be delivered to Prof.
Log from Bellin Town’s Pokémon
Mart.  "
entries.translation_source: A parcel to be delivered to Prof. Log from Bellin Town’s Pokémon Mart.
entries.translated:
Un pacco da consegnare al Prof.
Log dal Pokémon Mart di Bellin
Town.

entries.original:
"A shiny green orb that is said to
have a legend and has a deep
connection with the Hoenn region."
entries.translation_source: A shiny green orb that is said to have a legend and has a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
entries.translated:
Una sfera verde scintillante che,
secondo la leggenda, ha un
profondo legame con la regione di Hoenn.

entries.original:
"A pair of grimy socks found in the
Antisis City Sewers.                      "
entries.translation_source: A pair of grimy socks found in the Antisis City Sewers.
entries.translated:
Un paio di calzini sporchi trovati
nelle fogne di Antisis City.

entries.original:
"A package containing a Pokédex
for your rival."
entries.translation_source: A package containing a Pokédex for your rival.
entries.translated:
Un pacco contenente un Pokédex per
il tuo rivale.

entries.original:
"A ring which enables Pokémon
holding a Mega Stone to
Mega Evolve in battle."
entries.translation_source: A ring which enables Pokémon holding a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.
entries.translated:
Un anello che consente ai Pokémon
che tengono una Megapietra di Mega
Evolversi in lotta.

entries.original:
"A piece of amber that contains
the genes of an ancient Pokémon.
It is clear with a reddish tint."
entries.translation_source: A piece of amber that contains the genes of an ancient Pokémon. It is clear with a reddish tint.
entries.translated:
Un pezzo d{B4}ambra che contiene i
geni di un antico Pokémon. È
trasparente con una sfumatura rossastra.

entries.original:
"A card-type key that unlocks doors
with a clearance level of 1 in the
Shadows’ base."
entries.translation_source: A card-type key that unlocks doors with a clearance level of 1 in the Shadows’ base.
entries.translated:
Una chiave a scheda che sblocca
le porte con livello di
autorizzazione 1 nella base degli Shadows.

entries.original:
"A strange device that allows you to
distort the fabric of time. AM times
become PM times and vice versa."
entries.translation_source: A strange device that allows you to distort the fabric of time. AM times become PM times and vice versa.
entries.translated:
Uno strano dispositivo che permette
di distorcere il tessuto del tempo.
Le ore AM diventano PM e viceversa.

entries.original:
"A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-
dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be
part of a seashell."
entries.translation_source: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be part of a seashell.
entries.translated:
Il fossile di un antico Pokémon
che viveva sui fondali marini.
Sembra essere parte di una conchiglia.

entries.original:
"A fossil of an ancient, seafloor-
dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be
part of a shell."
entries.translation_source: A fossil of an ancient, seafloor- dwelling Pokémon. It appears to be part of a shell.
entries.translated:
Fossile di un antico Pokémon che
vive sui fondali marini. Sembra
essere parte di una conchiglia.

entries.original:
"A device used to check on the
status of Pokémon at the Route 5
Pokémon Day Care."
entries.translation_source: A device used to check on the status of Pokémon at the Route 5 Pokémon Day Care.
entries.translated:
Un dispositivo usato per
controllare lo stato dei Pokémon
alla Pensione Pokémon del Percorso 5.

entries.original:
"A motorbike with pedals that allows
faster movement than the Running
Shoes."
entries.translation_source: A motorbike with pedals that allows faster movement than the Running Shoes.
entries.translated:
Una motocicletta con i pedali che
permette di muoversi più
velocemente delle Scarpe da Corsa.

entries.original:
"A very convenient map that can be
viewed anytime. It even shows your 
present location."
entries.translation_source: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.
entries.translated:
Una mappa molto comoda che si può
consultare in qualsiasi momento.
Mostra persino la tua posizione attuale.

entries.original:
"A device that indicates Trainers
who want to battle. The battery
charges while traveling."
entries.translation_source: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. The battery charges while traveling.
entries.translated:
Un dispositivo che segnala la presenza
di Allenatori che vogliono combattere.
La batteria si ricarica mentre viaggi.

entries.original:
"Rare leaves with a horrible smell.
They are very popular among
certain groups of people."
entries.translation_source: Rare leaves with a horrible smell. They are very popular among certain groups of people.
entries.translated:
Rare foglie dal pessimo odore.
Sono molto popolari tra certi
gruppi di persone.

entries.original:
"A case that holds TMs and HMs.
It is placed in the Cube’s
sector for important items."
entries.translation_source: A case that holds TMs and HMs. It is placed in the Cube’s sector for important items.
entries.translated:
Una custodia per contenere MT e
MN. È collocata nel settore del
Cubo per gli oggetti importanti.

entries.original:
"A pouch for carrying Berries.
It is placed in the Cube’s
sector for important items."
entries.translation_source: A pouch for carrying Berries. It is placed in the Cube’s sector for important items.
entries.translated:
Una sacca per portare le Bacche. È
collocata nel settore del Cubo per
gli oggetti importanti.

entries.original:
"A machine that can be used in place
of HMs. It also mines underwater or
in the KBT Expressway (uses \btn03)."
entries.translation_source: A machine that can be used in place of HMs. It also mines underwater or in the KBT Expressway (uses [button-icon-1]).
entries.translated:
Una macchina che può essere usata al
posto delle MN. Permette anche di scavare
sott{B4}acqua o nella KBT Expressway (usa \btn03).

entries.original:
"A notebook containing research on
Pokémon moves. Inside it’s marked
\qoProperty of Prof. Log’s Aide\qc."
entries.translation_source: A notebook containing research on Pokémon moves. Inside it’s marked [quote-open-1]Property of Prof. Log’s Aide[quote-close-2].
entries.translated:
Un taccuino contenente ricerche sulle
mosse dei Pokémon. All{B4}interno è segnato
\qoProprietà dell{B4}assistente del Prof. Log\qc.

entries.original:
"A device that allows you to access
the Pokémon storage system. There
are some places where it won’t work."
entries.translation_source: A device that allows you to access the Pokémon storage system. There are some places where it won’t work.
entries.translated:
Un dispositivo che permette di
accedere al sistema di deposito dei
Pokémon. In alcuni luoghi non funziona.

entries.original:
"A device used to find Trainers
eager for battle in Borrius. It
also keeps a record of their teams."
entries.translation_source: A device used to find Trainers eager for battle in Borrius. It also keeps a record of their teams.
entries.translated:
Un dispositivo usato per trovare
Allenatori desiderosi di lottare a
Borrius. Tiene anche traccia delle loro squadre.

entries.original:
"A ticket required to board the ship
to Glimmer Isle.
It sparkles in the moonlight."
entries.translation_source: A ticket required to board the ship to Glimmer Isle. It sparkles in the moonlight.
entries.translated:
Un biglietto necessario per salire
a bordo della nave per Glimmer
Isle. Scintilla al chiaro di luna.

entries.original:
"Holding it is said to increase the
chance of getting a critical catch.
Curiously, it doesn’t shake much."
entries.translation_source: Holding it is said to increase the chance of getting a critical catch. Curiously, it doesn’t shake much.
entries.translated:
Si dice che tenerlo addosso aumenti la
probabilità di effettuare una cattura
critica. Curiosamente, non si muove molto.

entries.original:
"A jar for storing BERRY POWDER
made using a BERRY CRUSHER."
entries.translation_source: A jar for storing BERRY POWDER made using a BERRY CRUSHER.
entries.translated:
Un barattolo per conservare la
POLVERE BACCA prodotta con un
FRANTUMABACCHE.

entries.original:
"A feather that glows like the moon.
It is said to possess the power to
dispel nightmares."
entries.translation_source: A feather that glows like the moon. It is said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.
entries.translated:
Una piuma che brilla come la luna.
Si dice che abbia il potere di
scacciare gli incubi.

entries.original:
"A card needed for entering the inn
in Tarmigan Town. Oddly, the last
date marked on it was 30 years ago."
entries.translation_source: A card needed for entering the inn in Tarmigan Town. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 30 years ago.
entries.translated:
Una tessera necessaria per entrare nella
locanda di Tarmigan Town. Stranamente,
l{B4}ultima data segnata risale a 30 anni fa.

entries.original:
"The foe is infested and
attacked for four to
five turns. The target
can’t flee during this."
entries.translation_source: The foe is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can’t flee during this.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene infestato e attaccato
per quattro o cinque turni. Il bersaglio
non può fuggire durante questo periodo.

entries.original:
"Striking opponents over
and over makes the user’s
fists harder. This
increases the Atk stat."

[green]side room[black] on [green]Crystal Peak 1F[black], or\l[green]underwater[black], press \btn03 to scan for\lhidden items.

When a sparkle appears on the wall,
press \btn00 to mine there.[pause]"
entries.translation_source: The R-Button Mode has been set to Mining Scan. While in the [color-green-1]KBT Expressway[color-black-2], the [color-green-3]side room[color-black-4] on [color-green-5]Crystal Peak 1F[color-black-6], or [color-green-7]underwater[color-black-8], press [button-icon-9] to scan for hidden items. When a sparkle appears on the wall, press [button-icon-10] to mine there.[text-token-pause-11]

La modalità del pulsante R è stata impostata su Scansione Estrazione. Mentre
ti trovi nella [green]KBT Expressway[black], nella [green]stanza laterale[black] al [green]Crystal Peak 1F[black], o
[green]sott{B4}acqua[black], premi \btn03 per eseguire una scansione alla ricerca di oggetti
nascosti. Quando un bagliore appare sulla parete, premi \btn00 per estrarre lì.[pause]
