entries.original:
"I might be little, but I won’t like
it if you go easy on me!"
entries.translation_source: I might be little, but I won’t like it if you go easy on me!
entries.translated: Sono piccolo, ma non mi piacerà se vai piano con me!

entries.original:
"Oh, boo.
Nothing went right."
entries.translation_source: Oh, boo. Nothing went right.
entries.translated: Oh, che peccato. Non è andato tutto bene.

entries.original: "I lost some of my allowance\."
entries.translation_source: I lost some of my allowance[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ho perso un po{B4} della mia paghetta\.

entries.original: "Did you know that Pokémon evolve?"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that Pokémon evolve?
entries.translated: Sapevi che i Pokémon si evolvono?

entries.original:
"Oh!
I lost!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! I lost!
entries.translated: Oh! Ho perso!

entries.original:
"Only trainers who have proved
themselves worthy in battle may\lpass through here.

...

You are not worthy."
entries.translation_source: Only trainers who have proved themselves worthy in battle may pass through here. ... You are not worthy.
entries.translated:
Solo gli Allenatori che si sono
dimostrati degni in battaglia\lpossono passare di qui. ... Tu non

sei degno.

entries.original:
"Who are you?
What are you doing here?"
entries.translation_source: Who are you? What are you doing here?
entries.translated: Chi sei? Cosa ci fai qui?

entries.original: "Whoa!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa!
entries.translated: Wow!

entries.original:
"A statue with switch?
Never heard of it."
entries.translation_source: A statue with switch? Never heard of it.
entries.translated:
Una statua con un interruttore? Non
ne ho mai sentito parlare.

entries.original:
"A secret switch!

Press it?"
entries.translation_source: A secret switch! Press it?
entries.translated: Un interruttore segreto! Premilo?

entries.original: "Who wouldn’t?"
entries.translation_source: Who wouldn’t?
entries.translated: Chi non lo farebbe?

entries.original: "Not quite yet!"
entries.translation_source: Not quite yet!
entries.translated: Non ancora!

entries.original: "I can’t find Successor Maxima!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t find Successor Maxima!
entries.translated: Non riesco a trovare Successor Maxima!

entries.original: "Oh, no! I lost!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! I lost!
entries.translated: Oh, no! Ho perso!

entries.original:
"There’s a switch somewhere that
opens up a path to Maxima."
entries.translation_source: There’s a switch somewhere that opens up a path to Maxima.
entries.translated:
C{B4}è un interruttore da qualche
parte che apre un passaggio per\lMaxima.

entries.original:
"I probably won’t get anywhere if I
keep standing here."
entries.translation_source: I probably won’t get anywhere if I keep standing here.
entries.translated:
Probabilmente non arriverò da
nessuna parte se continuo a stare\lqui.

entries.original:
"The others\.
They must have been possessed."
entries.translation_source: The others[game-token-1] They must have been possessed.
entries.translated:
Gli altri\. Devono essere stati
posseduti.

entries.original: "I must have been dreaming\."
entries.translation_source: I must have been dreaming[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Devo aver sognato\.

entries.original: "[buffer1] min. [buffer2].[buffer3] sec."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] min. [buffer2-2].[buffer3-3] sec.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] min. [buffer2].[buffer3]
sec.

entries.original:
"Hey!
How are you?

Have you visited Professor Log’s
laboratory yet?"
entries.translation_source: Hey! How are you? Have you visited Professor Log’s laboratory yet?
entries.translated:
Ehi! Come va? Sei già stato nel
laboratorio del Professor Log?

entries.original: "Log Pokémon Research Lab"
entries.translation_source: Log Pokémon Research Lab
entries.translated:
Laboratorio di Ricerca Pokémon di
Log

entries.original: "[player]’s house"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]’s house
entries.translated: [player]la casa di [player]

entries.original: "[rival]’s house"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]’s house
entries.translated: [rival]casa di [rival]

entries.original:
"Aren’t you boiling in those
clothes?"
entries.translation_source: Aren’t you boiling in those clothes?
entries.translated:
Non stai morendo di caldo in quei
vestiti?

entries.original:
"I just can’t stop shopping!

There’s so much variety at the
[green]Dehara Department Store[red]!"
entries.translation_source: I just can’t stop shopping! There’s so much variety at the [color-green-1]Dehara Department Store[color-red-2]!
entries.translated:
Non riesco proprio a smettere di
fare shopping! C{B4}è così tanta\lvarietà al [green]Grande Magazzino di

Dehara[red]!

entries.original:
"Mmm\.

A park in the middle of a desert
city is so relaxing.

Dehara City is just a wonderful
oasis paradise!"
entries.translation_source: Mmm[game-token-1] A park in the middle of a desert city is so relaxing. Dehara City is just a wonderful oasis paradise!
entries.translated:
Mmm\. Un parco nel mezzo di una città
desertica è così rilassante. Dehara\lCity è proprio una meravigliosa

oasi paradisiaca!

entries.original: "Valley Cave"
entries.translation_source: Valley Cave
entries.translated: Grotta della Valle

entries.original: "You beat me."
entries.translation_source: You beat me.
entries.translated: Mi hai battuto.

entries.original:
"I pride myself on how much I know
about bugs."
entries.translation_source: I pride myself on how much I know about bugs.
entries.translated:
Vado fiero di quanto so sugli
insetti.

entries.original:
"Hi!
I like shorts!

They’re delightfully comfy and
easy to wear!"
entries.translation_source: Hi! I like shorts! They’re delightfully comfy and easy to wear!
entries.translated:
Ciao! Mi piacciono i pantaloncini!
Sono deliziosamente comodi e facili\lda indossare!

entries.original: "I don’t believe it!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t believe it!
entries.translated: Non ci credo!

entries.original:
"Are you using a Pokémon Centre’s
PC for storing your Pokémon?

Each Box can hold up to
30 Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Are you using a Pokémon Centre’s PC for storing your Pokémon? Each Box can hold up to 30 Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Usi il PC di un Centro Pokémon per
conservare i tuoi Pokémon? Ogni Box\lpuò contenere fino a 30 Pokémon.

entries.original: "Please don’t stare at me."
entries.translation_source: Please don’t stare at me.
entries.translated: Per favore, non fissarmi.

entries.original:
"Are you a Trainer?
Let’s get with it right away!"
entries.translation_source: Are you a Trainer? Let’s get with it right away!
entries.translated: Sei un Allenatore? Iniziamo subito!

entries.original:
"If I had new Pokémon, I would’ve
won!"
entries.translation_source: If I had new Pokémon, I would’ve won!
entries.translated:
Se avessi avuto nuovi Pokémon,
avrei vinto!

entries.original:
"If a Pokémon Box on the PC gets
full, just switch to another Box."
entries.translation_source: If a Pokémon Box on the PC gets full, just switch to another Box.
entries.translated:
Se un Box Pokémon nel PC si
riempie, passa semplicemente a un\laltro Box.

entries.original:
"That look you gave me\.
It’s so intriguing!"
entries.translation_source: That look you gave me[game-token-1] It’s so intriguing!
entries.translated:
Quello sguardo che mi hai lanciato\.
È così intrigante!

entries.original: "Be nice!"
entries.translation_source: Be nice!
entries.translated: Sii gentile!

entries.original:
"You can avoid battles by not
letting Trainers see you."
entries.translation_source: You can avoid battles by not letting Trainers see you.
entries.translated:
Puoi evitare le lotte non facendoti
vedere dagli Allenatori.

entries.original:
"Don’t think you can get past me so
easily."
entries.translation_source: Don’t think you can get past me so easily.
entries.translated:
Non pensare di poter passare oltre
così facilmente.

entries.original:
"Lost!
Lost! Lost!"
entries.translation_source: Lost! Lost! Lost!
entries.translated: Perso! Perso! Perso!

entries.original: "And I thought I could catch anyone."
entries.translation_source: And I thought I could catch anyone.
entries.translated:
E io che pensavo di poter catturare
chiunque.

entries.original:
"I’ll battle you with the Pokémon
I just caught."
entries.translation_source: I’ll battle you with the Pokémon I just caught.
entries.translated:
Ti sfiderò con il Pokémon che ho
appena catturato.

entries.original: "Done like dinner!"
entries.translation_source: Done like dinner!
entries.translated: Fatto e finito!

entries.original:
"Trained Pokémon are stronger than
wild ones."
entries.translation_source: Trained Pokémon are stronger than wild ones.
entries.translated:
I Pokémon allenati sono più forti
di quelli selvatici.

entries.original:
"Eek!
Did you touch me?"
entries.translation_source: Eek! Did you touch me?
entries.translated: Eek! Mi hai toccato?

entries.original: "That’s it?"
entries.translation_source: That’s it?
entries.translated: Tutto qui?

entries.original:
"Yeah!
I got a bite here!"
entries.translation_source: Yeah! I got a bite here!
entries.translated: Sì! Ha abboccato!

entries.original:
"Tch!
Just a small fry\."
entries.translation_source: Tch! Just a small fry[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Tsk! Solo un pesciolino\.

entries.original:
"Hang on!
My line’s snagged!"
entries.translation_source: Hang on! My line’s snagged!
entries.translated:
Aspetta! La mia lenza si è
impigliata!

entries.original:
"Be patient.
Fishing is a waiting game."
entries.translation_source: Be patient. Fishing is a waiting game.
entries.translated:
Abbi pazienza. La pesca è un gioco
d{B4}attesa.

entries.original: "That one got away!"
entries.translation_source: That one got away!
entries.translated: Mi è sfuggito!

entries.original:
"With a better rod, I could catch
better Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: With a better rod, I could catch better Pokémon[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Con una canna migliore, potrei
pescare Pokémon migliori\.

entries.original:
"The Fishing Flop versus Pokémon
Sun!"
entries.translation_source: The Fishing Flop versus Pokémon Sun!
entries.translated:
Il flop della pesca contro Pokémon
Sole!

entries.original: "Touch too much!"
entries.translation_source: Touch too much!
entries.translated: Toccare troppo!

entries.original:
"I guess you get to be good at
what you like.

Well, you beat me at Pokémon,
but you can’t top me at fishing."
entries.translation_source: I guess you get to be good at what you like. Well, you beat me at Pokémon, but you can’t top me at fishing.
entries.translated:
Immagino che si diventa bravi in
ciò che si ama. Beh, mi hai battuto\la Pokémon, ma a pescare non mi

superi.

entries.original:
"I love fishing, don’t get me wrong.

But it’d be best if I also had more
work."
entries.translation_source: I love fishing, don’t get me wrong. But it’d be best if I also had more work.
entries.translated:
Adoro pescare, non fraintendermi.
Però sarebbe meglio se avessi anche\lpiù lavoro.

entries.original: "It’s not easy\."
entries.translation_source: It’s not easy[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non è facile\.

entries.original:
"It’s all right.
Losing doesn’t bug me anymore."
entries.translation_source: It’s all right. Losing doesn’t bug me anymore.
entries.translated:
Va bene così. Perdere non mi
infastidisce più.

entries.original:
"Wow!
Your Badges are too cool!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Your Badges are too cool!
entries.translated:
Wow! Le tue Medaglie sono troppo
forti!

entries.original: "Not enough!"
entries.translation_source: Not enough!
entries.translated: Non basta!

entries.original:
"You got those Badges from Gym
Leaders. I know!"
entries.translation_source: You got those Badges from Gym Leaders. I know!
entries.translated:
Hai ottenuto quelle Medaglie dai
Capipalestra. Lo so!

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

This must be the way to Dehara
City!

I just know it!"
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] This must be the way to Dehara City! I just know it!
entries.translated:
Mmm\. Questa deve essere la strada
per Dehara City! Lo so e basta!

entries.original: "I can’t be lost\."
entries.translation_source: I can’t be lost[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non posso perdermi\.

entries.original:
"A beautiful trainer like me, losing
her way?

Impossible!

I know exactly where I’m going\."
entries.translation_source: A beautiful trainer like me, losing her way? Impossible! I know exactly where I’m going[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Una bella allenatrice come me che
si perde? Impossibile! So\lesattamente dove sto andando\.

entries.original: "When I whistle, I can hear an echo."
entries.translation_source: When I whistle, I can hear an echo.
entries.translated: Quando fischio, sento un{B4}eco.

entries.original:
"Ow!
That’s tragic!"
entries.translation_source: Ow! That’s tragic!
entries.translated: Ahi! Che tragedia!

entries.original: "Do you know where you’re going?"
entries.translation_source: Do you know where you’re going?
entries.translated: Sai dove stai andando?

entries.original: "You must know."
entries.translation_source: You must know.
entries.translated: Lo devi sapere.

entries.original:
"You can’t see it from up top, but
there’s a passage that goes under\lthe bridge!"
entries.translation_source: You can’t see it from up top, but there’s a passage that goes under the bridge!
entries.translated:
Da quassù non si vede, ma c{B4}è un
passaggio che passa sotto il ponte!

entries.original: "It’s getting hotter out here\."
entries.translation_source: It’s getting hotter out here[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Fa sempre più caldo qui fuori\.

entries.original: "No heat, no help."
entries.translation_source: No heat, no help.
entries.translated: Niente calore, niente aiuto.

entries.original:
"The warmer the weather, the
stronger I get!"
entries.translation_source: The warmer the weather, the stronger I get!
entries.translated:
Più il clima è caldo, più divento
forte!

entries.original:
"My psychic powers foretell my
victory!"
entries.translation_source: My psychic powers foretell my victory!
entries.translated:
I miei poteri psichici prevedono la
mia vittoria!

entries.original: "I\.I was wrong?"
entries.translation_source: I[game-token-1]I was wrong?
entries.translated: Io\.Ho sbagliato?

entries.original:
"I must hone my psychic senses
further.

Next time, I will not be wrong."
entries.translation_source: I must hone my psychic senses further. Next time, I will not be wrong.
entries.translated:
Devo affinare ulteriormente i miei
sensi psichici. La prossima volta\lnon sbaglierò.

entries.original:
"I wouldn’t want to fall into the
ocean, here."
entries.translation_source: I wouldn’t want to fall into the ocean, here.
entries.translated: Non vorrei cadere nell{B4}oceano, qui.

entries.original:
"The ocean off the coast is really
deep!"
entries.translation_source: The ocean off the coast is really deep!
entries.translated:
L{B4}oceano al largo della costa è
davvero profondo!

entries.original: "I’ll keep fishing."
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep fishing.
entries.translated: Continuerò a pescare.

entries.original:
"I could’ve sworn someone was just
pushed into the ocean\."
entries.translation_source: I could’ve sworn someone was just pushed into the ocean[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Avrei giurato che qualcuno sia
stato appena spinto nell{B4}oceano\.

entries.original: "Check ’em out!"
entries.translation_source: Check ’em out!
entries.translated: Dagli un{B4}occhiata!

entries.original: "Aren’t they cool?"
entries.translation_source: Aren’t they cool?
entries.translated: Non sono fighi?

entries.original: "I love showing off my Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I love showing off my Pokémon!
entries.translated: Adoro sfoggiare i miei Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Kurukkoo!
How do you like my birdcall?"
entries.translation_source: Kurukkoo! How do you like my birdcall?
entries.translated:
Kurukkoo! Che ne pensi del mio
verso da uccello?

entries.original: "I had to bug you!"
entries.translation_source: I had to bug you!
entries.translated: Dovevo proprio darti fastidio!

entries.original:
"I collect sea Pokémon on weekends
because the sea is so close."
entries.translation_source: I collect sea Pokémon on weekends because the sea is so close.
entries.translated:
Colleziono Pokémon marini nei
weekend perché il mare è così\lvicino.

entries.original:
"I love swimming!
What about you?"
entries.translation_source: I love swimming! What about you?
entries.translated: Adoro nuotare! E tu?

entries.original: "Belly flop!"
entries.translation_source: Belly flop!
entries.translated: Tuffo di pancia!

entries.original:
"I can beat even marine Pokémon
at swimming."
entries.translation_source: I can beat even marine Pokémon at swimming.
entries.translated:
So nuotare meglio persino dei
Pokémon marini.

entries.original: "What’s beyond the horizon?"
entries.translation_source: What’s beyond the horizon?
entries.translated: Cosa c{B4}è oltre l{B4}orizzonte?

entries.original: "Glub!"
entries.translation_source: Glub!
entries.translated: Glu!

entries.original:
"I see The Ruins of Void over
yonder!"
entries.translation_source: I see The Ruins of Void over yonder!
entries.translated: Vedo laggiù le Rovine del Vuoto!

entries.original:
"I tried diving for Pokémon, and it
worked!"
entries.translation_source: I tried diving for Pokémon, and it worked!
entries.translated:
Ho provato a tuffarmi per prendere
dei Pokémon, e ha funzionato!

entries.original: "Help!"
entries.translation_source: Help!
entries.translated: Aiuto!

entries.original:
"You can only dive where the sea is
dark."
entries.translation_source: You can only dive where the sea is dark.
entries.translated:
Puoi usare Sub solo dove il mare è
scuro.

entries.original:
"I look at the sea to forget all
the bad things that happened."
entries.translation_source: I look at the sea to forget all the bad things that happened.
entries.translated:
Guardo il mare per dimenticare
tutte le cose brutte che sono\lsuccesse.

entries.original:
"Ooh!
Traumatic!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh! Traumatic!
entries.translated: Oh! Traumatico!

entries.original:
"I’m looking at the sea to forget
the bad thing that happened!"
entries.translation_source: I’m looking at the sea to forget the bad thing that happened!
entries.translated:
Sto guardando il mare per
dimenticare la brutta cosa che è\lsuccessa!

entries.original:
"Oh, I just love your ride!
Can I have it if I win?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I just love your ride! Can I have it if I win?
entries.translated:
Oh, adoro la tua cavalcatura! Posso
averla se vinco?

entries.original: "Oh! I lost!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! I lost!
entries.translated: Oh! Ho perso!

entries.original:
"It’s still a long way to
The Ruins of Void.

I want to go back to Dresco Town."
entries.translation_source: It’s still a long way to The Ruins of Void. I want to go back to Dresco Town.
entries.translated:
Le Rovine del Vuoto sono ancora
molto lontane. Voglio tornare a\lDresco Town.

entries.original:
"Swimming’s great!
Sunburns aren’t!"
entries.translation_source: Swimming’s great! Sunburns aren’t!
entries.translated:
Nuotare è fantastico! Le scottature
no!

entries.original: "Shocker!"
entries.translation_source: Shocker!
entries.translated: Shock!

entries.original:
"My friend wanted to swim to
The Ruins of Void."
entries.translation_source: My friend wanted to swim to The Ruins of Void.
entries.translated:
Il mio amico voleva nuotare fino
alle Rovine del Vuoto.

entries.original:
"Ahoy, there!
These waters are treacherous!"
entries.translation_source: Ahoy, there! These waters are treacherous!
entries.translated:
Ehi, là! Queste acque sono
insidiose!

entries.original:
"Ooh!
Dangerous!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh! Dangerous!
entries.translated: Oh! Pericoloso!

entries.original:
"M-my legs! They cramped up!
Glub, glub\."
entries.translation_source: M-my legs! They cramped up! Glub, glub[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
L-le mie gambe! Mi sono venuti i
crampi! Glo, glo\.

entries.original:
"I swam here with my friends\.
I’m tired\."
entries.translation_source: I swam here with my friends[game-token-1] I’m tired[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Sono venuto qui a nuoto con i miei
amici\. Sono stanco\.

entries.original: "I’m exhausted\."
entries.translation_source: I’m exhausted[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sono esausto\.

entries.original:
"If I were to ride a Pokémon on
the sea, I’d like a Lapras.

Lapras is so big, I bet it
would keep me dry on water."
entries.translation_source: If I were to ride a Pokémon on the sea, I’d like a Lapras. Lapras is so big, I bet it would keep me dry on water.
entries.translated:
Se dovessi cavalcare un Pokémon sul
mare, vorrei un Lapras. Lapras è\lcosì grande che, scommetto, mi

terrebbe all{B4}asciutto sull{B4}acqua.

entries.original:
"The water is shallow here.
There are many people swimming."
entries.translation_source: The water is shallow here. There are many people swimming.
entries.translated:
L{B4}acqua qui è bassa. Ci sono molte
persone che nuotano.

entries.original: "Splash!"
entries.translation_source: Splash!
entries.translated: Splash!

entries.original:
"I wish I could ride my Pokémon.
I bet you’re not tired."
entries.translation_source: I wish I could ride my Pokémon. I bet you’re not tired.
entries.translated:
Vorrei poter cavalcare il mio
Pokémon. Scommetto che tu non sei\lstanco.

entries.original: "Check out my buff physique!"
entries.translation_source: Check out my buff physique!
entries.translated: Guarda il mio fisico scolpito!

entries.original: "Wimpy!"
entries.translation_source: Wimpy!
entries.translated: Debole!

entries.original:
"I should’ve been buffing up my
Pokémon, not me!"
entries.translation_source: I should’ve been buffing up my Pokémon, not me!
entries.translated:
Avrei dovuto potenziare i miei
Pokémon, non me!

entries.original:
"Why are you riding a Pokémon?
Can’t you swim?"
entries.translation_source: Why are you riding a Pokémon? Can’t you swim?
entries.translated:
Perché stai cavalcando un Pokémon?
Non sai nuotare?

entries.original:
"Ouch!
Torpedoed!"
entries.translation_source: Ouch! Torpedoed!
entries.translated: Ahi! Colpito da un siluro!

entries.original: "Riding a Pokémon sure looks fun!"
entries.translation_source: Riding a Pokémon sure looks fun!
entries.translated:
Andare in groppa a un Pokémon
sembra proprio divertente!

entries.original: "My boyfriend gave me big pearls."
entries.translation_source: My boyfriend gave me big pearls.
entries.translated:
Il mio ragazzo mi ha regalato perle
grandi.

entries.original:
"Oh, no!
My pearls were in them!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! My pearls were in them!
entries.translated: Oh, no! Le mie perle erano dentro!

entries.original:
"Will my pearls grow bigger inside
Cloyster?"
entries.translation_source: Will my pearls grow bigger inside Cloyster?
entries.translated:
Le mie perle cresceranno dentro
Cloyster?

entries.original: "Right now, I’m in a triathlon meet."
entries.translation_source: Right now, I’m in a triathlon meet.
entries.translated:
In questo momento sono a una gara
di triathlon.

entries.original:
"Pant\.
Pant\. Pant\."
entries.translation_source: Pant[game-token-1] Pant[game-token-2] Pant[game-token-3]
entries.translated: Ans\. Ans\. Ans\.

entries.original:
"I’m beat! But, I still have the
bike race and marathon left!"
entries.translation_source: I’m beat! But, I still have the bike race and marathon left!
entries.translated:
Sono sfinito! Però mi restano
ancora la gara in bici e la\lmaratona!

entries.original: "I’m going to stomp you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to stomp you!
entries.translated: Ti schiaccerò!

entries.original:
"Whoa!
Too much!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa! Too much!
entries.translated: Ehi! Troppo!

entries.original: "I did my best. I have no regrets!"
entries.translation_source: I did my best. I have no regrets!
entries.translated:
Ho fatto del mio meglio. Non ho
rimpianti!

entries.original: "I did my best, so I’ve no regrets!"
entries.translation_source: I did my best, so I’ve no regrets!
entries.translated:
Ho fatto del mio meglio, quindi non
ho rimpianti!

entries.original: "I love the smell of the sea!"
entries.translation_source: I love the smell of the sea!
entries.translated: Amo il profumo del mare!

entries.original:
"Whoo!
Good stuff!"
entries.translation_source: Whoo! Good stuff!
entries.translated: Yuhuu! Roba buona!

entries.original: "This air is beautiful!"
entries.translation_source: This air is beautiful!
entries.translated: Questa aria è splendida!

entries.original:
"Local Trainers come here to
practice."
entries.translation_source: Local Trainers come here to practice.
entries.translated:
Gli Allenatori locali vengono qui
per allenarsi.

entries.original: "You’re decent."
entries.translation_source: You’re decent.
entries.translated: Sei discreto.

entries.original:
"All Pokémon have weaknesses.
Even the strongest ones.

That’s why it’s best to raise
Pokémon of different types."
entries.translation_source: All Pokémon have weaknesses. Even the strongest ones. That’s why it’s best to raise Pokémon of different types.
entries.translated:
Tutti i Pokémon hanno debolezze.
Anche i più forti. Per questo è\lmeglio allevare Pokémon di tipi

diversi.

entries.original:
"I love standing here and looking at
the ocean."
entries.translation_source: I love standing here and looking at the ocean.
entries.translated:
Adoro stare qui a guardare
l{B4}oceano.

entries.original: "I’m not mad!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not mad!
entries.translated: Non sono arrabbiato!

entries.original: "Isn’t the view great?"
entries.translation_source: Isn’t the view great?
entries.translated: La vista non è splendida?

entries.original:
"Hi!
You’re going down!"
entries.translation_source: Hi! You’re going down!
entries.translated: Ehi! Ti faccio fuori!

entries.original: "My conditioning isn’t the best\."
entries.translation_source: My conditioning isn’t the best[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
La mia preparazione non è delle
migliori\.

entries.original:
"I wish I was as good
as you."
entries.translation_source: I wish I was as good as you.
entries.translated: Vorrei essere bravo quanto te.

entries.original:
"I had this feeling\.
I knew I had to battle you!"
entries.translation_source: I had this feeling[game-token-1] I knew I had to battle you!
entries.translated:
Avevo questa sensazione\. sapevo che
avrei dovuto sfidarti!

entries.original: "I knew I’d lose, too!"
entries.translation_source: I knew I’d lose, too!
entries.translated: Sapevo che avrei perso anch{B4}io!

entries.original:
"If your Pokémon gets confused,
switch it out.

That’s a good tactic."
entries.translation_source: If your Pokémon gets confused, switch it out. That’s a good tactic.
entries.translated:
Se il tuo Pokémon si confonde,
fallo rientrare. È una buona\ltattica.

entries.original: "I’m not so jealous!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not so jealous!
entries.translated: Non sono così geloso!

entries.original: "You worked hard!"
entries.translation_source: You worked hard!
entries.translated: Hai lavorato sodo!

entries.original:
"If it’s a battle you want, it’s a
battle you’ll get!"
entries.translation_source: If it’s a battle you want, it’s a battle you’ll get!
entries.translated: Se vuoi una lotta, avrai una lotta!

entries.original:
"You done got me, and real good,
too!"
entries.translation_source: You done got me, and real good, too!
entries.translated:
Mi hai battuto, e alla grande,
pure!

entries.original:
"I really should stop attacking
trainers and blaming them\."
entries.translation_source: I really should stop attacking trainers and blaming them[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dovrei davvero smetterla di
attaccare gli Allenatori e dare la\lcolpa a loro\.

entries.original:
"The weather’s gorgeous!
Perfect for a battle!"
entries.translation_source: The weather’s gorgeous! Perfect for a battle!
entries.translated:
Che bel tempo! Perfetto per una
lotta!

entries.original: "Aiyeeeeh!"
entries.translation_source: Aiyeeeeh!
entries.translated: Aiyeeeeh!

entries.original:
"Please don’t splash my face!
You’ll ruin the makeup."
entries.translation_source: Please don’t splash my face! You’ll ruin the makeup.
entries.translated:
Per favore, non schizzarmi in
faccia! Mi rovineresti il trucco.

entries.original:
"The salty tang of the sea\.
It tickles my heart."
entries.translation_source: The salty tang of the sea[game-token-1] It tickles my heart.
entries.translated:
Il sapore salato del mare\. mi
solletica il cuore.

entries.original:
"\.Sniff, sniff\.
Something smells unpleasant\."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]Sniff, sniff[game-token-2] Something smells unpleasant[game-token-3]
entries.translated: \.Sniff, sniff\. Qualcosa puzza\.

entries.original:
"Perhaps that reek is your sweaty
Pokémon’s body odor\."
entries.translation_source: Perhaps that reek is your sweaty Pokémon’s body odor[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Forse quella puzza è l{B4}odore
corporeo del tuo Pokémon sudato\.

entries.original:
"My mommy said that I can’t swim
without my float ring."
entries.translation_source: My mommy said that I can’t swim without my float ring.
entries.translated:
La mia mamma dice che non posso
nuotare senza il mio salvagente.

entries.original:
"Waaah!
Waaah!"
entries.translation_source: Waaah! Waaah!
entries.translated: Uaaah! Uaaah!

entries.original:
"This year, I’m going to finally
learn how to swim!"
entries.translation_source: This year, I’m going to finally learn how to swim!
entries.translated:
Quest{B4}anno imparerò finalmente a
nuotare!

entries.original:
"Yay, yay!
Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Yay, yay! Pokémon!
entries.translated: Evviva, evviva! Pokémon!

entries.original: "What happens now?"
entries.translation_source: What happens now?
entries.translated: E adesso che succede?

entries.original:
"Did I just win?
Or did I lose?"
entries.translation_source: Did I just win? Or did I lose?
entries.translated: Ho appena vinto? O ho perso?

entries.original:
"My boyfriend’s always busy, so I
come swimming by myself."
entries.translation_source: My boyfriend’s always busy, so I come swimming by myself.
entries.translated:
Il mio ragazzo è sempre occupato,
così vengo a nuotare da sola.

entries.original: "Awww, I knew this would happen!"
entries.translation_source: Awww, I knew this would happen!
entries.translated: Awww, sapevo che sarebbe successo!

entries.original:
"When I can’t be with my boyfriend,
I spend time with the Pokémon he\lgave me."
entries.translation_source: When I can’t be with my boyfriend, I spend time with the Pokémon he gave me.
entries.translated:
Quando non posso stare con il mio
ragazzo, passo il tempo con il\lPokémon che mi ha regalato.

entries.original: "I sensed your approach."
entries.translation_source: I sensed your approach.
entries.translated: Ho percepito il tuo avvicinamento.

entries.original: "Give up\."
entries.translation_source: Give up[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Arrenditi\.

entries.original:
"In your future, I sense that you
will meet many others.

I think you will be linked to each
other by a strange power."
entries.translation_source: In your future, I sense that you will meet many others. I think you will be linked to each other by a strange power.
entries.translated:
Nel tuo futuro, sento che
incontrerai molte altre persone.\lCredo che sarete legati l{B4}uno

all{B4}altro da un potere strano.

entries.original:
"I work to protect the environment.
In turn, nature protects me!"
entries.translation_source: I work to protect the environment. In turn, nature protects me!
entries.translated:
Lavoro per proteggere l{B4}ambiente.
In cambio, la natura protegge me!

entries.original:
"Whoa! You’re tough!
How about protecting me?"
entries.translation_source: Whoa! You’re tough! How about protecting me?
entries.translated:
Wow! Sei forte! Che ne dici di
proteggermi?

entries.original:
"From far out among the stars, our
planet is just a drop of water.

But we want to protect that drop
of water for everyone."
entries.translation_source: From far out among the stars, our planet is just a drop of water. But we want to protect that drop of water for everyone.
entries.translated:
Da lontano, tra le stelle, il
nostro pianeta è solo una goccia\ld{B4}acqua. Ma vogliamo proteggere

quella goccia d{B4}acqua per tutti.

entries.original:
"Those shoes you have are pretty
snazzy."
entries.translation_source: Those shoes you have are pretty snazzy.
entries.translated:
Le scarpe che hai sono davvero alla
moda.

entries.original:
"You’re hot stuff in spite of your
cute looks."
entries.translation_source: You’re hot stuff in spite of your cute looks.
entries.translated:
Sei davvero una bomba, nonostante
il tuo aspetto grazioso.

entries.original:
"Your mom bought those snazzy
Running Shoes for you?

She must adore you."
entries.translation_source: Your mom bought those snazzy Running Shoes for you? She must adore you.
entries.translated:
Tua mamma ti ha comprato quelle
elegantissime Scarpe da Corsa? Deve\lvolerti un gran bene.

entries.original:
"[player]!
You should take a quick rest."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You should take a quick rest.
entries.translated:
[player]! Dovresti fare una breve
pausa.

entries.original:
"Oh, good! You and your
Pokémon are looking great.

Take care now!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
entries.translated:
Oh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon state
benissimo. Abbi cura di te!

entries.original:
"There’s a movie on TV.
Four boys are walking on railroad\ltracks.

\.I better go, too."
entries.translation_source: There’s a movie on TV. Four boys are walking on railroad tracks. [game-token-1]I better go, too.
entries.translated:
C{B4}è un film in TV. Quattro ragazzi
stanno camminando sui binari del\ltreno. \.Meglio che vada anch{B4}io.

entries.original:
"There’s a movie on TV.
A girl with her hair in pigtails is\lwalking up a brick road.

\.I better go, too."
entries.translation_source: There’s a movie on TV. A girl with her hair in pigtails is walking up a brick road. [game-token-1]I better go, too.
entries.translated:
C{B4}è un film in TV. Una ragazza con
i capelli raccolti in due codini\lsta camminando lungo una strada di

mattoni. \.Meglio che vada anch{B4}io.

entries.original: "Oops, wrong side\."
entries.translation_source: Oops, wrong side[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ops, lato sbagliato\.

entries.original:
"[player] played with the Wii.

\.Okay!
It’s time to go!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] played with the Wii. [game-token-2]Okay! It’s time to go!
entries.translated:
[player] ha giocato con il Wii. \.Va
bene! È ora di andare!

entries.original:
"It’s a posted notice\.

If you’re confused, ask for help!
Talk to people!"
entries.translation_source: It’s a posted notice[game-token-1] If you’re confused, ask for help! Talk to people!
entries.translated:
È un avviso affisso\. Se sei confuso,
chiedi aiuto! Parla con la gente!

entries.original: "That’s Prof. Log’s Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: That’s Prof. Log’s Pokémon.
entries.translated: È il Pokémon del Prof. Log.

entries.original: "Press Start to open the Menu!"
entries.translation_source: Press Start to open the Menu!
entries.translated: Premi Start per aprire il menu!

entries.original:
"The Save option is on the menu.
Use it regularly."
entries.translation_source: The Save option is on the menu. Use it regularly.
entries.translated:
L{B4}opzione Salva è nel menu. Usala
regolarmente.

entries.original:
"All Pokémon types have strong and
weak points against others."
entries.translation_source: All Pokémon types have strong and weak points against others.
entries.translated:
Tutti i tipi di Pokémon hanno punti
di forza e di debolezza contro gli\laltri.

entries.original:
"It’s a new computer.

Ooh\.
Fancy."
entries.translation_source: It’s a new computer. Ooh[game-token-1] Fancy.
entries.translated:
È un nuovo computer. Oh\. Che
elegante.

entries.original:
"I study Pokémon as Prof. Log’s
Aide."
entries.translation_source: I study Pokémon as Prof. Log’s Aide.
entries.translated:
Studio i Pokémon come assistente
del Prof. Log.

entries.original:
"Prof. Log has spent many years
studying Pokémon stats.

Many Trainers come to him with
inquiries about them."
entries.translation_source: Prof. Log has spent many years studying Pokémon stats. Many Trainers come to him with inquiries about them.
entries.translated:
Il Prof. Log ha trascorso molti
anni a studiare le statistiche dei\lPokémon. Molti Allenatori vengono

da lui con domande in merito.

entries.original:
"Thanks!
Please say hi to Prof. Log for me!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks! Please say hi to Prof. Log for me!
entries.translated:
Grazie! Saluta Prof. Log da parte
mia!

entries.original:
"That guy in all black from before
was scary.

Who was he?"
entries.translation_source: That guy in all black from before was scary. Who was he?
entries.translated:
Quel tizio tutto vestito di nero di
prima faceva paura. Chi era?

entries.original:
"You should stock up on a lot of
[green]Potions[blue].

You never know when you’ll be in a
pinch and need some quick healing."
entries.translation_source: You should stock up on a lot of [color-green-1]Potions[color-blue-2]. You never know when you’ll be in a pinch and need some quick healing.

entries.original:
"Pokémon Centres heal your tired
and weary Pokémon.

They make all Pokémon completely
healthy again.

Most are free, so don’t be shy
about healing your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon Centres heal your tired and weary Pokémon. They make all Pokémon completely healthy again. Most are free, so don’t be shy about healing your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
I Centri Pokémon curano i tuoi
Pokémon stanchi e affaticati.\lRendono di nuovo tutti i Pokémon

completamente sani. La maggior
parte è gratuita, quindi non essere\ltimido nel curare i tuoi Pokémon.

entries.original:
"All Pokémon have special [green]Types[blue],
such as Fire or Water.

These determine how well they stack
up against other Pokémon.

Pokémon Types also give attacking
moves a power boost if they match\lthe Type of the move.

This is known as the Same Type
Attack Bonus, or [green]STAB[blue] for short."
entries.translation_source: All Pokémon have special [color-green-1]Types[color-blue-2], such as Fire or Water. These determine how well they stack up against other Pokémon. Pokémon Types also give attacking moves a power boost if they match the Type of the move. This is known as the Same Type Attack Bonus, or [color-green-3]STAB[color-blue-4] for short.
entries.translated:
Tutti i Pokémon hanno [green]Tipi[blue]
speciali, come Fuoco o Acqua.\lQuesti determinano quanto bene se

la cavano contro altri Pokémon. I
tipi dei Pokémon danno anche un\laumento di potenza alle mosse

offensive se coincidono con il tipo
della mossa. Questo è noto come\lBonus d{B4}Attacco dello Stesso Tipo,

o [green]STAB[blue] in breve.

entries.original:
"I just don’t know what to do.

Every few days this horrible
Pokémon has been coming into my\lhouse and stealing my food.

If I had a Pokédex, I could know
what it was and how to stop it\."
entries.translation_source: I just don’t know what to do. Every few days this horrible Pokémon has been coming into my house and stealing my food. If I had a Pokédex, I could know what it was and how to stop it[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Non so proprio cosa fare. Ogni
pochi giorni questo Pokémon\lorribile entra in casa mia e mi

ruba il cibo. Se avessi un Pokédex,
potrei sapere cos{B4}era e come\lfermarlo\.

entries.original:
"There are some items that exist
soley to be sold.

If you get one of those items, you
should sell it immediately.

I’ve even heard that there are
some maniacs out there who’ll buy\lthose items for an even higher\lamount than Poké Marts."
entries.translation_source: There are some items that exist soley to be sold. If you get one of those items, you should sell it immediately. I’ve even heard that there are some maniacs out there who’ll buy those items for an even higher amount than Poké Marts.
entries.translated:
Ci sono alcuni oggetti che esistono
solo per essere venduti. Se ne\ltrovi uno, dovresti venderlo

subito. Ho persino sentito dire che
ci sono dei maniaci là fuori che\lcomprano quegli oggetti per una

cifra ancora più alta dei Poké
Market.

entries.original:
"My grandfather survived the
meteorite lots of years ago!

He’s so cool!"
entries.translation_source: My grandfather survived the meteorite lots of years ago! He’s so cool!
entries.translated:
Mio nonno è sopravvissuto al
meteorite tanti anni fa! È\lfortissimo!

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mirskle, uses
Pokémon that can be found in\l[green]Flower Paradise[blue].

Catching some good Ice-type
Pokémon from [green]Icicle Cave [blue]can\lreally give you the edge against\lhim."
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mirskle, uses Pokémon that can be found in [color-green-1]Flower Paradise[color-blue-2]. Catching some good Ice-type Pokémon from [color-green-3]Icicle Cave [color-blue-4]can really give you the edge against him.
entries.translated:
Il Capopalestra, Mirskle, usa
Pokémon che si possono trovare in\l[green]Flower Paradise[blue]. Catturare alcuni

buoni Pokémon di tipo Ghiaccio
nella [green]Icicle Cave [blue]può davvero darti\lun vantaggio contro di lui.

entries.original:
"Repel not only keeps bugs away,
it also works on weak Pokémon.

Put your strongest Pokémon at the
left of the Pokémon List.

If your first Pokémon is strong,
Repel’s effect is boosted."
entries.translation_source: Repel not only keeps bugs away, it also works on weak Pokémon. Put your strongest Pokémon at the left of the Pokémon List. If your first Pokémon is strong, Repel’s effect is boosted.
entries.translated:
Repellente non solo tiene lontani i
Pokémon selvatici, ma funziona\lanche sui Pokémon deboli. Metti il

tuo Pokémon più forte a sinistra
nella Lista Pokémon. Se il primo\lPokémon è forte, l{B4}effetto di

Repellente viene potenziato.

entries.original:
"You should try to beat as many
Pokémon Gyms as possible.

Poké Marts will sell more items to
you if you have more badges."
entries.translation_source: You should try to beat as many Pokémon Gyms as possible. Poké Marts will sell more items to you if you have more badges.
entries.translated:
Dovresti cercare di battere il
maggior numero possibile di\lPalestre Pokémon. I Poké Mart ti

venderanno più strumenti se hai più
medaglie.

entries.original:
"This town is fairly quiet.

Not that many enjoy hanging around
a town in the middle of a forest."
entries.translation_source: This town is fairly quiet. Not that many enjoy hanging around a town in the middle of a forest.
entries.translated:
Questa città è piuttosto
tranquilla. Non sono in molti a\lvoler bighellonare in una città in

mezzo a una foresta.

entries.original:
"Yo, yo!
I am the official [green]Name Rater[blue]!

Want me to rate the nicknames of
your Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Yo, yo! I am the official [color-green-1]Name Rater[color-blue-2]! Want me to rate the nicknames of your Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Ehi, ehi! Sono il [green]Valutatore di
Nomi[blue] ufficiale! Vuoi che valuti i\lsoprannomi dei tuoi Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon’s nickname should
I see?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon’s nickname should I see?
entries.translated:
Il soprannome di quale Pokémon vuoi
vedere?

entries.original:
"[buffer1], is it?
That is a gucci nickname!

But, would you like me to give it
a swag name?

How about it?"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1], is it? That is a gucci nickname! But, would you like me to give it a swag name? How about it?
entries.translated:
[buffer1], eh? Che nick figo! Ma
vuoi che gli dia un nome più swag?\lChe ne dici?

entries.original:
"Cool. Then, what should the new
nickname be?"
entries.translation_source: Cool. Then, what should the new nickname be?
entries.translated:
Bene. Allora, quale dovrebbe essere
il nuovo soprannome?

entries.original:
"Done! From now on, this Pokémon
will be called [buffer1]!

It’s a way better name than before!
You’re so swag!"
entries.translation_source: Done! From now on, this Pokémon will be called [buffer1-1]! It’s a way better name than before! You’re so swag!
entries.translated:
Fatto! D{B4}ora in poi, questo Pokémon
si chiamerà [buffer1]! È un nome\lmolto meglio di prima! Sei così

swag!

entries.original:
"Uh huh.
Come back again."
entries.translation_source: Uh huh. Come back again.
entries.translated: Mh-mh. Torna di nuovo.

entries.original:
"Done! From now on, this Pokémon
will be called [buffer1]!

It looks the same as before, but
still feels ten times cooler!

You’re so lucky!"
entries.translation_source: Done! From now on, this Pokémon will be called [buffer1-1]! It looks the same as before, but still feels ten times cooler! You’re so lucky!
entries.translated:
Fatto! Da ora in poi, questo
Pokémon si chiamerà [buffer1]!\lSembra uguale a prima, ma è

comunque dieci volte più figo! Sei
fortunatissimo!

entries.original:
"[buffer1], is it?
That’s a swagalicious name!

Take good care of [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1], is it? That’s a swagalicious name! Take good care of [buffer1-2]!
entries.translated:
[buffer1], dici? Che nome figo! Abbi
cura di [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Really?
That’s an Egg!"
entries.translation_source: Really? That’s an Egg!
entries.translated: Davvero? È un Uovo!

entries.original:
"I’m the Fishing Dude!

I simply looove fishing!
I can’t bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Fishing Dude! I simply looove fishing! I can’t bear to go without. Tell me, do you like to fish?
entries.translated:
Sono il Tipo da Pesca! Adoro alla
follia pescare! Non potrei proprio\lfarne a meno. Dimmi, ti piace

pescare?

entries.original:
"Grand! I like your style.
I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!"
entries.translation_source: Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends. Take this and fish, young friend!
entries.translated:
Grandioso! Mi piace il tuo stile.
Penso che potremmo essere amici.\lPrendi questo e vai a pescare,

giovane amico!

entries.original:
"[player] received an Old Rod from
the Fishing Dude."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received an Old Rod from the Fishing Dude.
entries.translated:
[player] ha ricevuto una Vecchia
Canna dal Tipo della Pesca.

entries.original:
"Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.

From the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend."
entries.translation_source: Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry. From the seas to rivers, go out and land the big one, my friend.
entries.translated:
La pesca è uno stile di vita! È
come la poesia più sublime. Dai\lmari ai fiumi, esci e prendi quello

grosso, amico mio.

entries.original:
"Oh\.
That’s so disappointing\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] That’s so disappointing[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Che delusione\.

entries.original:
"Hello there, [player]!

How are the fish biting?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, [player-name-1]! How are the fish biting?
entries.translated:
Ciao, [player]! Come abboccano i
pesci?

entries.original:
"Oh, no!

I had a nice gift for you, but you
have no room for it!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! I had a nice gift for you, but you have no room for it!
entries.translated:
Oh, no! Avevo un bel regalo per te,
ma non hai spazio per prenderlo!

entries.original:
"The urge to battle with someone
you’ve tangled with before\.

Have you ever had that urge?
I’m sure you have.

I wanted to battle certain people
again over and over, too.

So, I’ve been giving these away.
Please, take one!"
entries.translation_source: The urge to battle with someone you’ve tangled with before[game-token-1] Have you ever had that urge? I’m sure you have. I wanted to battle certain people again over and over, too. So, I’ve been giving these away. Please, take one!
entries.translated:
Hai mai voluto risfidare qualcuno
già affrontato? Io sì. Per questo\ldistribuisco questi strumenti.

Prendine uno!

entries.original:
"Use that device and you’ll find
Trainers looking for a rematch.

You have to charge its battery to
use it, though."
entries.translation_source: Use that device and you’ll find Trainers looking for a rematch. You have to charge its battery to use it, though.
entries.translated:
Usa questo dispositivo e troverai
Allenatori pronti alla rivincita.\lDevi caricarne la batteria per

usarlo.

entries.original:
"How do you use the VS Seeker?
There’s nothing to it.

Use it like beep-beep-beep, and
Trainers around you will notice.

If any Trainer wants a rematch,
it will let you know immediately.

Charge its battery and use it
while you’re on a road."
entries.translation_source: How do you use the VS Seeker? There’s nothing to it. Use it like beep-beep-beep, and Trainers around you will notice. If any Trainer wants a rematch, it will let you know immediately. Charge its battery and use it while you’re on a road.
entries.translated:
Come si usa il Cercasfide? È
semplice. Usalo e gli Allenatori\lvicini ti noteranno. Se qualcuno

vuole la rivincita, lo saprai
subito. Carica la batteria e usalo\lsu una strada.

entries.original:
"Hi!
Do you have a [buffer1]?

Want to trade it for my
[buffer2]?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! Do you have a [buffer1-1]? Want to trade it for my [buffer2-2]?
entries.translated:
Ciao! Hai un [buffer1]? Vuoi
scambiarlo con il mio [buffer2]?

entries.original: "That’s too bad."
entries.translation_source: That’s too bad.
entries.translated: Che peccato.

entries.original:
"\.This is no [buffer1].

If you get one, please trade it
to me!"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]This is no [buffer1-2]. If you get one, please trade it to me!
entries.translated:
\.Questo non è un [buffer1]. Se ne
trovi uno, per favore scambiamelo!

entries.original: "Thank you!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you!
entries.translated: Grazie!

entries.original:
"How is my old [buffer2]?

My [buffer1] is doing great!"
entries.translation_source: How is my old [buffer2-1]? My [buffer1-2] is doing great!
entries.translated:
Come sta il mio vecchio [buffer2]?
Il mio [buffer1] sta benissimo!

entries.original:
"Many people in Blizzard City
enjoy the finer delicacies in life.

Roasted Pokémon for instance."
entries.translation_source: Many people in Blizzard City enjoy the finer delicacies in life. Roasted Pokémon for instance.
entries.translated:
Molte persone a Blizzard City
apprezzano le raffinate\lprelibatezze della vita. Per

esempio i Pokémon arrosto.

entries.original:
"Hello!
Welcome to Dehara Dept. Store!

The board on the wall describes
the store layout."
entries.translation_source: Hello! Welcome to Dehara Dept. Store! The board on the wall describes the store layout.
entries.translated:
Salve! Benvenuto al Grande
Magazzino di Dehara! La bacheca sul\lmuro descrive la disposizione del

negozio.

entries.original:
"2F: Trainer’s Market

Top-Grade Items for Trainers!"
entries.translation_source: 2F: Trainer’s Market Top-Grade Items for Trainers!
entries.translated:
2F: Mercato degli Allenatori,
articoli di prima qualità per\lAllenatori!

entries.original:
"Pokémon stat enhancers can
only be bought here.

HP Up increases the base HP of a
Pokémon.

Calcium raises the base Sp. Atk
stat of one Pokémon.

Zinc boosts the base Sp. Def stat
of one Pokémon.

Carbos enhances the base Speed
stat."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon stat enhancers can only be bought here. HP Up increases the base HP of a Pokémon. Calcium raises the base Sp. Atk stat of one Pokémon. Zinc boosts the base Sp. Def stat of one Pokémon. Carbos enhances the base Speed stat.
entries.translated:
Qui si vendono solo potenziatori
delle statistiche dei Pokémon. PS\lSu aumenta gli PS base di un

Pokémon. Calcio aumenta la
statistica base Att. Sp. di un\lPokémon. Zinco potenzia la

statistica base Dif. Sp. di un
Pokémon. Carbos potenzia la\lstatistica base Velocità.

entries.original:
"I’m here for Pokémon stat
enhancers.

Protein increases the base Attack
stat.

Iron increases the base Defense
stat."
entries.translation_source: I’m here for Pokémon stat enhancers. Protein increases the base Attack stat. Iron increases the base Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Sono qui per i potenziatori delle
statistiche dei Pokémon. Le\lProteine aumentano la statistica

base di Attacco. Il Ferro aumenta
la statistica base di Difesa.

entries.original: "Good night everyone."
entries.translation_source: Good night everyone.
entries.translated: Buonanotte a tutti.

entries.original:
"I’m the sprite artist!
I drew you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the sprite artist! I drew you!
entries.translated:
Sono l{B4}artista degli sprite! Ti ho
disegnato!

entries.original:
"I’m the graphic designer!

I made the cool support artwork and
logo!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the graphic designer! I made the cool support artwork and logo!
entries.translated:
Sono il grafico! Ho realizzato la
fantastica illustrazione di\lsupporto e il logo!

entries.original:
"I’m the game’s creator!

Filling up your Pokédex is tough,
but don’t quit!

When you finish, come tell me!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the game’s creator! Filling up your Pokédex is tough, but don’t quit! When you finish, come tell me!
entries.translated:
Sono il creatore del gioco!
Completare il tuo Pokédex è duro,\lma non mollare! Quando avrai

finito, vieni a dirmelo!

entries.original: "Unbound Development Room"
entries.translation_source: Unbound Development Room
entries.translated: Stanza di sviluppo di Unbound

entries.original:
"No?
Please come play sometime!"
entries.translation_source: No? Please come play sometime!
entries.translated: No? Vieni a giocare ogni tanto!

entries.original:
"Oh, I’m sorry.
You don’t have a Coin Case."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I’m sorry. You don’t have a Coin Case.
entries.translated:
Oh, mi dispiace. Non hai una Coin
Case.

entries.original:
"Whoops!
Your Coin Case is full."
entries.translation_source: Whoops! Your Coin Case is full.
entries.translated: Ops! La tua Portamonete è piena.

entries.original: "You can’t afford the coins."
entries.translation_source: You can’t afford the coins.
entries.translated: Non puoi permetterti i gettoni.

entries.original:
"Thank you.
Here are your coins!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you. Here are your coins!
entries.translated: Grazie. Ecco le tue monete!

entries.original:
"Keep this quiet.

It’s rumoured these machines are
rigged."
entries.translation_source: Keep this quiet. It’s rumoured these machines are rigged.
entries.translated:
Tienilo per te. Si dice che queste
macchine siano truccate.

entries.original:
"I think these machines have
different odds."
entries.translation_source: I think these machines have different odds.
entries.translated:
Penso che queste macchine abbiano
probabilità diverse.

entries.original: "Kid, do you want to play?"
entries.translation_source: Kid, do you want to play?
entries.translated: Ragazzino, vuoi giocare?

entries.original:
"[player] received 10 Coins
from the man."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received 10 Coins from the man.
entries.translated:
[player] ha ricevuto 10 Gettoni
dall{B4}uomo.

entries.original: "You don’t need my Coins!"
entries.translation_source: You don’t need my Coins!
entries.translated: Non hai bisogno dei miei Gettoni!

entries.original:
"Wins seem to come and go.
Nothing’s a sure thing."
entries.translation_source: Wins seem to come and go. Nothing’s a sure thing.
entries.translated:
Le vittorie sembrano andare e
venire. Nulla è sicuro.

entries.original:
"These slot games\.
Win or lose, it’s only by luck."
entries.translation_source: These slot games[game-token-1] Win or lose, it’s only by luck.
entries.translated:
Questi giochi da slot\. Che tu vinca
o perda, è solo questione di\lfortuna.

entries.original:
"Games are scary!
It’s so easy to get hooked!"
entries.translation_source: Games are scary! It’s so easy to get hooked!
entries.translated:
I giochi fanno paura! È così facile
diventarne dipendenti!

entries.original:
"What’s up?
Want some Coins?"
entries.translation_source: What’s up? Want some Coins?
entries.translated: Ciao, vuoi dei Gettoni?

entries.original:
"[player] received 20 Coins
from the nice guy."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received 20 Coins from the nice guy.
entries.translated:
[player] ha ricevuto 20 gettoni dal
bravo ragazzo.

entries.original: "You have lots of Coins!"
entries.translation_source: You have lots of Coins!
entries.translated: Hai un sacco di Gettoni!

entries.original:
"Darn! I need more Coins for the
Pokémon I want!"
entries.translation_source: Darn! I need more Coins for the Pokémon I want!
entries.translated:
Accidenti! Mi servono più Gettoni
per il Pokémon che voglio!

entries.original:
"Hey, what? You’re throwing me off!
Here are some Coins, so shoo!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, what? You’re throwing me off! Here are some Coins, so shoo!
entries.translated:
Ehi, che? Mi stai scombussolando!
Ecco alcuni Gettoni, ora via!

entries.original:
"[player] received 20 Coins
from the man."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received 20 Coins from the man.
entries.translated:
[player] ha ricevuto 20 Gettoni
dall{B4}uomo.

entries.original:
"You’ve got plenty of your own
Coins!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve got plenty of your own Coins!
entries.translated: Hai già un sacco di Gettoni tuoi!

entries.original:
"The trick is to watch the reels
closely."
entries.translation_source: The trick is to watch the reels closely.
entries.translated:
Il trucco è osservare attentamente
i rulli.

entries.original: "A Coin Case is required\."
entries.translation_source: A Coin Case is required[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Serve un Portamonete\.

entries.original:
"Oops!
Don’t have the Coin Case!"
entries.translation_source: Oops! Don’t have the Coin Case!
entries.translated: Ops! Non hai la Portamonete!

entries.original:
"A slot machine!
Want to play?"
entries.translation_source: A slot machine! Want to play?
entries.translated: Una slot machine! Vuoi giocare?

entries.original:
"OUT OF ORDER
This is broken."
entries.translation_source: OUT OF ORDER This is broken.
entries.translated: FUORI SERVIZIO Questo è rotto.

entries.original:
"OUT TO LUNCH
This is reserved."
entries.translation_source: OUT TO LUNCH This is reserved.
entries.translated: FUORI A PRANZO Questo è riservato.

entries.original:
"Someone’s keys!
They’ll be back."
entries.translation_source: Someone’s keys! They’ll be back.
entries.translated: Le chiavi di qualcuno! Torneranno.

entries.original: "A Coin Case is required\."
entries.translation_source: A Coin Case is required[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Serve un Portamonete\.

entries.original: "We exchange your Coins for prizes."
entries.translation_source: We exchange your Coins for prizes.
entries.translated: Scambiamo i tuoi gettoni con premi.

entries.original: "Which prize would you like?"
entries.translation_source: Which prize would you like?
entries.translated: Quale premio desideri?

entries.original: "So, you want the [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: So, you want the [buffer1-1]?
entries.translated: Allora vuoi [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Okay, a TM of [buffer2]
is what you want?"
entries.translation_source: Okay, a TM of [buffer2-1] is what you want?
entries.translated:
Va bene, vuoi proprio una MT di
[buffer2]?

entries.original:
"Sorry, you’ll need more Coins
than that."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, you’ll need more Coins than that.
entries.translated:
Spiacente, ti serviranno più
Gettoni di così.

entries.original: "You should make room for this."
entries.translation_source: You should make room for this.
entries.translated: Dovresti fare spazio per questo.

entries.original:
"Dehara Pokémon Gym
Leader: Galavan

Winning Trainers:
[rival]"
entries.translation_source: Dehara Pokémon Gym Leader: Galavan Winning Trainers: [text-token-rival-1]
entries.translated:
Palestra Pokémon di Dehara: Galavan
Allenatori vittoriosi: [rival]

entries.original:
"Dehara Pokémon Gym
Leader: Galavan

Winning Trainers:
[rival], [player]"
entries.translation_source: Dehara Pokémon Gym Leader: Galavan Winning Trainers: [text-token-rival-1], [player-name-2]
entries.translated:
Palestra Pokémon di Dehara: Galavan
Allenatori vincenti: [rival],\l[player]

entries.original:
"Aww man\.

I blew all of my money at the Game
Corner!

Looks like I won’t be needing this
anymore!"
entries.translation_source: Aww man[game-token-1] I blew all of my money at the Game Corner! Looks like I won’t be needing this anymore!
entries.translated:
Accidenti\. Ho speso tutti i miei
soldi al Game Corner! Sembra che\lnon mi servirà più!

entries.original:
"[player] received a Coin Case
from the guy."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received a Coin Case from the guy.
entries.translated:
[player] ha ricevuto un Portamonete
dall{B4}uomo.

entries.original: "Make room for this!"
entries.translation_source: Make room for this!
entries.translated: Fai spazio a questo!

entries.original: "I always thought I could win\."
entries.translation_source: I always thought I could win[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ho sempre pensato di poter vincere\.

entries.original:
"I could’ve sworn I saw the clerk
stealing from the cash register\."
entries.translation_source: I could’ve sworn I saw the clerk stealing from the cash register[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Avrei giurato di aver visto il
commesso rubare dalla cassa\.

entries.original:
"One day I’m going to be a ninja!

My parents strike with brute force,
but I’m going to be sneaky!"
entries.translation_source: One day I’m going to be a ninja! My parents strike with brute force, but I’m going to be sneaky!
entries.translated:
Un giorno diventerò un ninja! I
miei genitori colpiscono con la\lforza bruta, ma io sarò furtivo!

entries.original:
"Huah! Move boulders with pure
power!

Take this!"
entries.translation_source: Huah! Move boulders with pure power! Take this!
entries.translated:
Uah! Sposta i massi con la pura
forza! Prendi questo!

entries.original:
"I’m the Fishing Guru’s older
brother.

I simply looove fishing!
I can’t bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Fishing Guru’s older brother. I simply looove fishing! I can’t bear to go without. Tell me, do you like to fish?
entries.translated:
Sono il fratello maggiore del Guru
della Pesca. Adoro la pesca! Non\lsopporto di restarne senza. Dimmi,

ti piace pescare?

entries.original:
"Grand! I like your style.
I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!"
entries.translation_source: Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends. Take this and fish, young friend!
entries.translated:
Grandioso! Mi piace il tuo stile.
Penso che potremmo essere amici.\lPrendi questo e vai a pescare,

giovane amico!

entries.original:
"[player] received a Good Rod from
the Fishing Guru’s brother."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received a Good Rod from the Fishing Guru’s brother.
entries.translated:
[player] ha ricevuto una Canna
Buona dal fratello del Guru della\lPesca.

entries.original:
"Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.

A crummy Old Rod could only catch
Magikarp, yes?

But with a Good Rod, you can
catch much better Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry. A crummy Old Rod could only catch Magikarp, yes? But with a Good Rod, you can catch much better Pokémon.
entries.translated:
La pesca è uno stile di vita! È
come la più raffinata poesia. Una\lvecchia Canna Vecchia poteva

catturare solo Magikarp, sì? Ma con
una Buona Canna, puoi catturare\lPokémon molto migliori.

entries.original:
"Oh\.
That’s so disappointing\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] That’s so disappointing[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Che delusione\.

entries.original:
"Hello there, [player]!

How are the fish biting?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, [player-name-1]! How are the fish biting?
entries.translated:
Ciao, [player]! Come abboccano i
pesci?

entries.original:
"Oh, no!

I had a gift for you, but you have
no room for it!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! I had a gift for you, but you have no room for it!
entries.translated:
Oh, no! Avevo un regalo per te, ma
non hai spazio per prenderlo!

entries.original:
"Uh\.
Er, yes, I’m the Move Deleter.

I can make Pokémon forget their
moves.

Would you like me to do that?"
entries.translation_source: Uh[game-token-1] Er, yes, I’m the Move Deleter. I can make Pokémon forget their moves. Would you like me to do that?
entries.translated:
Uh\. Er, sì, sono il Cancellamosse.
Posso far dimenticare le mosse ai\lPokémon. Vuoi che lo faccia?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon should forget a
move?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should forget a move?
entries.translated:
Quale Pokémon dovrebbe dimenticare
una mossa?

entries.original: "Which move should be forgotten?"
entries.translation_source: Which move should be forgotten?
entries.translated:
Quale mossa dovrebbe essere
dimenticata?

entries.original:
"[buffer1] seems to know only one
move\."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] seems to know only one move[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[buffer1] sembra conoscere una sola
mossa\.

entries.original:
"Hm! [buffer1]’s [buffer2]?
That move should be forgotten?"
entries.translation_source: Hm! [buffer1-1]’s [buffer2-2]? That move should be forgotten?
entries.translated:
Hm! [buffer1]{B4}s [buffer2]? Quella
mossa dovrebbe essere dimenticata?

entries.original:
"It worked to perfection!

[buffer1] has forgotten
[buffer2] completely."
entries.translation_source: It worked to perfection! [buffer1-1] has forgotten [buffer2-2] completely.
entries.translated:
Ha funzionato alla perfezione!
[buffer1] ha dimenticato\lcompletamente [buffer2].

entries.original:
"Come again if there are other
moves to be forgotten."
entries.translation_source: Come again if there are other moves to be forgotten.
entries.translated:
Torna pure se ci sono altre mosse
da dimenticare.

entries.original:
"What?
No Egg should know any moves."
entries.translation_source: What? No Egg should know any moves.
entries.translated:
Cosa? Nessun Uovo dovrebbe
conoscere mosse.

entries.original:
"This town has had a problem with
nightmares for the longest time.

If you’re going to choose a place
to live, it would probably be\lbetter to live somewhere else."
entries.translation_source: This town has had a problem with nightmares for the longest time. If you’re going to choose a place to live, it would probably be better to live somewhere else.
entries.translated:
Questa città ha da sempre un
problema con gli incubi. Se vuoi\lscegliere un posto in cui vivere,

probabilmente sarebbe meglio vivere
altrove.

entries.original:
"Do you need a way back down the
mountain?

My Abra and I will be more than
happy to teleport you down.

What do you say?
Do you want to teleported?"
entries.translation_source: Do you need a way back down the mountain? My Abra and I will be more than happy to teleport you down. What do you say? Do you want to teleported?
entries.translated:
Hai bisogno di un modo per scendere
dalla montagna? Il mio Abra e io\lsaremo più che felici di

teletrasportarti giù. Che ne dici?
Vuoi farti teletrasportare?

entries.original: "Bra!"
entries.translation_source: Bra!
entries.translated: Bra!

entries.original:
"Don’t they have X Attack?

I like it because it raises the
Attack stat in battle."
entries.translation_source: Don’t they have X Attack? I like it because it raises the Attack stat in battle.
entries.translated:
Non hanno X Attacco? Mi piace
perché aumenta la statistica\lAttacco in battaglia.

entries.original:
"It never hurts to have extra items.
You never know what might happen."
entries.translation_source: It never hurts to have extra items. You never know what might happen.
entries.translated:
Avere oggetti extra non fa mai
male. Non sai mai cosa potrebbe\lsuccedere.

entries.original:
"I’m not too young for Mel!
Leave me alone!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not too young for Mel! Leave me alone!
entries.translated:
Non sono troppo giovane per Mel!
Lasciami in pace!

entries.original:
"Mel needs someone to paint his
good looks!"
entries.translation_source: Mel needs someone to paint his good looks!
entries.translated:
Mel ha bisogno di qualcuno che
dipinga il suo bell{B4}aspetto!

entries.original:
"Don’t you love this gym’s design?

It’s so good, a genius must have
come up with it!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you love this gym’s design? It’s so good, a genius must have come up with it!
entries.translated:
Non ti piace il design di questa
palestra? È così bello che\ldev{B4}essere per forza opera di un

genio!

entries.original:
"You’ve almost reached Mel!
Just a little farther!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve almost reached Mel! Just a little farther!
entries.translated: Sei quasi arrivato da Mel! Ancora un piccolo sforzo!

entries.original:
"Fallshore Pokémon Gym
Leader: Mel

Winning Trainers:
[rival]"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore Pokémon Gym Leader: Mel Winning Trainers: [text-token-rival-1]
entries.translated:
Capopalestra di Fallshore: Mel
Allenatori vincitori: [rival]

entries.original:
"Fallshore Pokémon Gym
Leader: Mel

Winning Trainers:
[rival], [player]"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore Pokémon Gym Leader: Mel Winning Trainers: [text-token-rival-1], [player-name-2]
entries.translated:
Capopalestra di Fallshore: Mel
Allenatori vincitori: [rival],\l[player]

entries.original:
"If you have the [green]Fall Badge[red], you can
buy [green]Ultra Balls[red]!

They’re way better at catching
Pokémon than Great Balls."
entries.translation_source: If you have the [color-green-1]Fall Badge[color-red-2], you can buy [color-green-3]Ultra Balls[color-red-4]! They’re way better at catching Pokémon than Great Balls.
entries.translated:
Se hai la [green]Medaglia Autunno[red], puoi
comprare [green]Ultra Ball[red]! Sono molto\lmigliori delle Mega Ball per

catturare Pokémon.

entries.original:
"I heard that a bunch of people are
up to no good on [green]Route 9[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I heard that a bunch of people are up to no good on [color-green-1]Route 9[color-blue-2].
entries.translated:
Ho sentito che un gruppo di persone
sta combinando guai sul [green]Percorso 9[blue].

entries.original:
"Every step you take, your Pokémon
become more attached to you.

If you have a Pokémon in the
Day-Care, it will get stronger too."
entries.translation_source: Every step you take, your Pokémon become more attached to you. If you have a Pokémon in the Day-Care, it will get stronger too.
entries.translated:
Ogni passo che fai, i tuoi Pokémon
si affezionano sempre di più a te.\lSe hai un Pokémon all{B4}Asilo

Pokémon, crescerà di livello anche
lui.

entries.original:
"Did you hear?

Someone took care of the
troublemakers on Route 9!"
entries.translation_source: Did you hear? Someone took care of the troublemakers on Route 9!
entries.translated:
Hai sentito? Qualcuno ha pensato ai
teppisti sul Percorso 9!

entries.original:
"Hi! 
I’m one of [green]Prof. Log’s Aides[red].

If your Pokédex has complete data
on [green][buffer1][red] species, I’m supposed to\lgive you a reward.

So, [player], let me ask you.

Have you gathered data on at least[green]
[buffer1][red] kinds of Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! I’m one of [color-green-1]Prof. Log’s Aides[color-red-2]. If your Pokédex has complete data on [color-green-3][buffer1-4][color-red-5] species, I’m supposed to give you a reward. So, [player-name-6], let me ask you. Have you gathered data on at least[color-green-7] [buffer1-8][color-red-9] kinds of Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Ciao! Sono uno degli Assistenti del
[green]Prof. Log[red]. Se il tuo Pokédex ha\ldati completi su [green][buffer1][red] specie,

dovrei darti una ricompensa.
Quindi, [player], lasciami\lchiederti. Hai raccolto dati su

almeno [green][buffer1][red] specie di Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Great! You have caught [green][buffer3][red]
kinds of Pokémon!
