entries.original:
"[player] is out of usable
Pokémon!

[player] whited out!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] is out of usable Pokémon! [player-name-2] whited out!
entries.translated:
[player] non ha più Pokémon!
[player] è KO!

entries.original:
"Hi, there!
May I help you?"
entries.translation_source: Hi, there! May I help you?
entries.translated: Salve! Posso aiutarti?

entries.original:
"There is a questionnaire.
Would you like to fill it out?"
entries.translation_source: There is a questionnaire. Would you like to fill it out?
entries.translated:
C{B4}è un questionario. Vuoi
compilarlo?

entries.original:
"Thank you for taking the time to
fill out our questionnaire.

Your feedback will be used for
future reference."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for taking the time to fill out our questionnaire. Your feedback will be used for future reference.
entries.translated:
Grazie per aver dedicato il tuo
tempo a compilare il nostro\lquestionario. Il tuo feedback verrà

usato come riferimento futuro.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello!
You know those words?

That means you must know about
the MYSTERY GIFT.

From now on, you should be
receiving MYSTERY GIFTS!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello! You know those words? That means you must know about the MYSTERY GIFT. From now on, you should be receiving MYSTERY GIFTS!
entries.translated:
Oh, salve! Conosci quelle parole?
Allora devi sapere cos{B4}è il DONO\lSEGRETO. D{B4}ora in poi, dovresti

ricevere dei DONI SEGRETI!

entries.original:
"Once you save your game, you can
access the MYSTERY GIFT."
entries.translation_source: Once you save your game, you can access the MYSTERY GIFT.
entries.translated:
Una volta salvata la partita,
potrai accedere al DONO SEGRETO.

entries.original:
"Thank you for accessing the
MYSTERY GIFT System."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for accessing the MYSTERY GIFT System.
entries.translated:
Grazie per aver acceduto al Sistema
Regalo Segreto.

entries.original: "The [buffer1] flew away!"
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] flew away!
entries.translated: [buffer1] è volato via!

entries.original: "Gyaoo!"
entries.translation_source: Gyaoo!
entries.translated: Gyaoo!

entries.original: "The water is dyed a deep blue\."
entries.translation_source: The water is dyed a deep blue[game-token-1]
entries.translated: L{B4}acqua è blu intenso\.

entries.original:
"The amount of progress you’ve made
on your Pokédex is:

[buffer1] Pokémon seen and
[buffer2] Pokémon owned.

\CC0602Prof. Log’s rating:"
entries.translation_source: The amount of progress you’ve made on your Pokédex is: [buffer1-1] Pokémon seen and [buffer2-2] Pokémon owned. [control-code-3]Prof. Log’s rating:
entries.translated:
Il tuo progresso nel Pokédex è:
[buffer1] Pokémon visti e [buffer2]\lPokémon catturati. \CC0602Valutazione del

Prof. Log:

entries.original:
"You still have lots to do.

Go into every patch of grass you
see and look for Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: You still have lots to do. Go into every patch of grass you see and look for Pokémon!
entries.translated: Hai ancora molto da fare. Entra in ogni ciuffo d{B4}erba che vedi e cerca Pokémon!

entries.original:
"It looks as if you’re getting on
the right track!

I’ve given one of my AIDES a FLASH
HM. Make sure you go get it!"
entries.translation_source: It looks as if you’re getting on the right track! I’ve given one of my AIDES a FLASH HM. Make sure you go get it!
entries.translated: Sembra che tu sia sulla strada giusta! Ho dato una MN Flash a uno dei miei AIUTANTI. Assicurati di andare a prenderla!

entries.original:
"Your Pokédex could use a bit more
volume still!

Try to catch other species of
Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Your Pokédex could use a bit more volume still! Try to catch other species of Pokémon!
entries.translated: Il tuo Pokédex potrebbe ancora usare un po{B4} più di volume! Prova a catturare altre specie di Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Good, it’s apparent that you’re
trying hard!

I’ve given one of my AIDES an
ITEMFINDER. Be sure to collect it!"
entries.translation_source: Good, it’s apparent that you’re trying hard! I’ve given one of my AIDES an ITEMFINDER. Be sure to collect it!
entries.translated: Bene, è evidente che ti stai impegnando molto! Ho dato a uno dei miei ASSISTENTI un Cercaoggetti. Assicurati di ritirarlo!

entries.original:
"Your Pokédex is coming along quite
well!

I’ve given one of my AIDES an
AMULET COIN. Be sure to get it!"
entries.translation_source: Your Pokédex is coming along quite well! I’ve given one of my AIDES an AMULET COIN. Be sure to get it!
entries.translated: Il tuo Pokédex sta procedendo davvero bene! Ho dato una MONETAMULETO a uno dei miei ASSISTENTI. Assicurati di prenderla!

entries.original:
"Ah, you’ve finally topped 50
species!

I’ve given one of my AIDES an EXP.
SHARE. Be sure to go get it!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, you’ve finally topped 50 species! I’ve given one of my AIDES an EXP. SHARE. Be sure to go get it!
entries.translated: Ah, hai finalmente superato le 50 specie! Ho dato a uno dei miei assistenti un Condividi Esp. Assicurati di andarlo a prendere!

entries.original:
"Hoho! This is turning into quite the
respectable Pokédex!"
entries.translation_source: Hoho! This is turning into quite the respectable Pokédex!
entries.translated: Oh oh! Questo sta diventando un Pokédex davvero rispettabile!

entries.original:
"Very good!

I think you’ll collect even more
Pokémon by going fishing!"
entries.translation_source: Very good! I think you’ll collect even more Pokémon by going fishing!
entries.translated: Molto bene! Penso che catturerai ancora più Pokémon andando a pescare!

entries.original:
"Wonderful! Let me guess\. You
like to collect things, don’t you?"
entries.translation_source: Wonderful! Let me guess[game-token-1] You like to collect things, don’t you?
entries.translated: Meraviglioso! Fammi indovinare\. Ti piace collezionare oggetti, vero?

entries.original:
"I’m impressed!
It must have been difficult to do!"
entries.translation_source: I’m impressed! It must have been difficult to do!
entries.translated: Sono impressionato! Dev{B4}essere stato difficile riuscirci!

entries.original:
"You’ve finally hit 100 species!
I can’t believe how good you are!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve finally hit 100 species! I can’t believe how good you are!
entries.translated: Hai finalmente raggiunto 100 specie! Non riesco a credere a quanto sei bravo!

entries.original:
"You even have the evolved forms
of Pokémon! Super!"
entries.translation_source: You even have the evolved forms of Pokémon! Super!
entries.translated: Hai persino le forme evolute dei Pokémon! Fantastico!

entries.original:
"Excellent! Trade with friends to
get some more!"
entries.translation_source: Excellent! Trade with friends to get some more!
entries.translated: Eccellente! Fai scambi con gli amici per ottenerne altri!

entries.original:
"Outstanding!
You’ve become a real pro at this!"
entries.translation_source: Outstanding! You’ve become a real pro at this!
entries.translated: Eccezionale! Sei diventato un vero professionista!

entries.original:
"I have nothing left to say!
You’re the Pokémon PROFESSOR now!"
entries.translation_source: I have nothing left to say! You’re the Pokémon PROFESSOR now!
entries.translated: Non ho più niente da dire! Adesso sei tu il PROFESSORE Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Your Pokédex is entirely complete!
Congratulations!!"
entries.translation_source: Your Pokédex is entirely complete! Congratulations!!
entries.translated: Il tuo Pokédex è completamente completato! Congratulazioni!!

entries.original:
"And your National Pokédex is:

[buffer1] Pokémon seen and
[buffer2] Pokémon owned."
entries.translation_source: And your National Pokédex is: [buffer1-1] Pokémon seen and [buffer2-2] Pokémon owned.
entries.translated:
E il tuo Pokédex Nazionale è:
[buffer1] Pokémon visti e [buffer2]\lPokémon ottenuti.

entries.original:
"I’ll be looking forward to seeing
you fill the National Pokédex!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll be looking forward to seeing you fill the National Pokédex!
entries.translated:
Non vedo l{B4}ora di vederti
completare il Pokédex Nazionale!

entries.original:
"Finally\.

You’ve finally completed the
Pokédex!

It’s magnificent!
Truly, this is a fantastic feat!"
entries.translation_source: Finally[game-token-1] You’ve finally completed the Pokédex! It’s magnificent! Truly, this is a fantastic feat!
entries.translated:
Finalmente\. Hai finalmente
completato il Pokédex! È magnifico!\lDavvero, è un{B4}impresa fantastica!

entries.original:
"It’s a Pokémon Printer!

It can put a print of your Pokémon
on the back of your Trainer Card.

It costs only $50.
Would you like to try it?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a Pokémon Printer! It can put a print of your Pokémon on the back of your Trainer Card. It costs only $50. Would you like to try it?
entries.translated:
È una Stampante Pokémon! Può
stampare l{B4}immagine del tuo Pokémon\lsul retro della tua Carta

Allenatore. Costa solo $50. Vuoi
provarla?

entries.original: "You don’t have enough money."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough money.
entries.translated: Non hai abbastanza soldi.

entries.original:
"A big smile for the photo, please!
Three\. Two\. One\.

Flash!"
entries.translation_source: A big smile for the photo, please! Three[game-token-1] Two[game-token-2] One[game-token-3] Flash!
entries.translated: Un bel sorriso per la foto, per favore! Tre\. Due\. Uno\. Flash!

entries.original:
"Your Pokémon print is ready!
Check your Trainer Card."
entries.translation_source: Your Pokémon print is ready! Check your Trainer Card.
entries.translated:
La tua foto Pokémon è pronta!
Controlla la tua Carta Allenatore.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Pokémon Cable
Club.

Which of our services do you wish
to use?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Pokémon Cable Club. Which of our services do you wish to use?
entries.translated:
Benvenuto al Club Cavo Pokémon.
Quale dei nostri servizi desideri\lusare?

entries.original:
"Which of our services do you wish
to use?"
entries.translation_source: Which of our services do you wish to use?
entries.translated:
Quale dei nostri servizi desideri
usare?

entries.original:
"Trade Pokémon with another player
using a GBA Game Link cable."
entries.translation_source: Trade Pokémon with another player using a GBA Game Link cable.
entries.translated: Scambia Pokémon con un altro giocatore usando un cavo Game Link per GBA.

entries.original:
"You may battle another Trainer
using a GBA Game Link cable."
entries.translation_source: You may battle another Trainer using a GBA Game Link cable.
entries.translated: Puoi affrontare un altro Allenatore usando un cavo Game Link per GBA.

entries.original:
"For a Double Battle, you must
have at least two Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: For a Double Battle, you must have at least two Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Per una Lotta in Doppio, devi avere
almeno due Pokémon.

entries.original:
"For trading, you must have at
least two Pokémon with you."
entries.translation_source: For trading, you must have at least two Pokémon with you.
entries.translated:
Per il commercio, devi avere con te
almeno due Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon holding the [buffer1]
Berry can’t be traded."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon holding the [buffer1-1] Berry can’t be traded.
entries.translated:
Un Pokémon che tiene la Bacca
[buffer1] non può essere scambiato.

entries.original: "Please enter."
entries.translation_source: Please enter.
entries.translated: Prego, entra.

entries.original: "I’ll direct you to your room now."
entries.translation_source: I’ll direct you to your room now.
entries.translated:
Ti accompagnerò alla tua stanza
adesso.

entries.original:
"Someone is not ready to link.

Please come back after everyone
has made preparations."
entries.translation_source: Someone is not ready to link. Please come back after everyone has made preparations.
entries.translated:
Qualcuno non è pronto per il
collegamento. Torna quando tutti\lavranno finito di prepararsi.

entries.original:
"Sorry, we have a link error\.
Please reset and try again."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, we have a link error[game-token-1] Please reset and try again.
entries.translated:
Scusa, abbiamo un errore di
connessione\. Per favore, resetta e\lriprova.

entries.original:
"The link partners appear to have
made different selections."
entries.translation_source: The link partners appear to have made different selections.
entries.translated:
I partner della connessione
sembrano aver fatto scelte diverse.

entries.original: "Please do visit again."
entries.translation_source: Please do visit again.
entries.translated: Ti prego, torna a trovarci.

entries.original:
"The number of participants is
incorrect."
entries.translation_source: The number of participants is incorrect.
entries.translated:
Il numero dei partecipanti non è
corretto.

entries.original:
"The Single Battle Mode can’t be
played by [buffer1] players."
entries.translation_source: The Single Battle Mode can’t be played by [buffer1-1] players.
entries.translated:
La Modalità Lotta Singola non può
essere giocata da [buffer1]\lgiocatori.

entries.original:
"The Double Battle Mode can’t be
played by [buffer1] players."
entries.translation_source: The Double Battle Mode can’t be played by [buffer1-1] players.
entries.translated:
La Modalità Lotta Doppia non può
essere giocata da [buffer1]\lgiocatori.

entries.original:
"There must be four players to play
this Battle Mode."
entries.translation_source: There must be four players to play this Battle Mode.
entries.translated:
Devono esserci quattro giocatori
per giocare a questa Modalità\lBattaglia.

entries.original:
"Please confirm the number of
players and start again."
entries.translation_source: Please confirm the number of players and start again.
entries.translated:
Conferma il numero di giocatori e
ricomincia.

entries.original:
"The link will be terminated if you
leave the room. Is that okay?"
entries.translation_source: The link will be terminated if you leave the room. Is that okay?
entries.translated:
Il collegamento verrà interrotto se
lasci la stanza. Va bene così?

entries.original:
"Terminating link\.
You will be escorted out of\lthe room. Please wait."
entries.translation_source: Terminating link[game-token-1] You will be escorted out of the room. Please wait.
entries.translated:
Interruzione del collegamento\.
Verrai accompagnato fuori dalla\lstanza. Attendi.

entries.original:
"This Trainer is too busy to
notice\."
entries.translation_source: This Trainer is too busy to notice[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Questo Allenatore è troppo occupato
per accorgersene\.

entries.original:
"Score! Got to look at [buffer1]’s
Trainer Card!"
entries.translation_source: Score! Got to look at [buffer1-1]’s Trainer Card!
entries.translated:
Grande! Posso dare un{B4}occhiata alla
Scheda Allenatore di [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Score! Got to look at [buffer1]’s
Trainer Card!

It’s a [buffer2] card!"
entries.translation_source: Score! Got to look at [buffer1-1]’s Trainer Card! It’s a [buffer2-2] card!
entries.translated:
Grande! Ho potuto vedere la Carta
Allenatore di [buffer1]! È una carta\l[buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Please take your seat and start
your battle."
entries.translation_source: Please take your seat and start your battle.
entries.translated:
Prego, prendete posto e iniziate la
vostra lotta.

entries.original:
"Please take your seat and start
your trade."
entries.translation_source: Please take your seat and start your trade.
entries.translated:
Prego, accomodati e avvia il tuo
scambio.

entries.original:
"The Trainer Card data will
be overwritten."
entries.translation_source: The Trainer Card data will be overwritten.
entries.translated:
I dati della Carta Allenatore
verranno sovrascritti.

entries.original: "I hope to see you again!"
entries.translation_source: I hope to see you again!
entries.translated: Spero di rivederti!

entries.original:
"I’m awfully sorry.

We’re not set up to conduct trades
with Trainers far away in another\lregion yet\."
entries.translation_source: I’m awfully sorry. We’re not set up to conduct trades with Trainers far away in another region yet[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace moltissimo. Non siamo
ancora attrezzati per effettuare\lscambi con Allenatori lontani in

un{B4}altra regione ancora\.

entries.original: "The other Trainer is not ready."
entries.translation_source: The other Trainer is not ready.
entries.translated: L{B4}altro Allenatore non è pronto.

entries.original:
"You have at least one Pokémon
that can’t be taken."
entries.translation_source: You have at least one Pokémon that can’t be taken.
entries.translated:
Hai almeno un Pokémon che non può
essere portato via.

entries.original:
"The Wireless Adapter is not
connected properly."
entries.translation_source: The Wireless Adapter is not connected properly.
entries.translated:
L{B4}Adattatore Wireless non è
collegato correttamente.

entries.original:
"Participants are asked to step up
to the reception counter."
entries.translation_source: Participants are asked to step up to the reception counter.
entries.translated:
Ai partecipanti viene chiesto di
avvicinarsi al banco della\lreception.

entries.original:
"You may trade your Pokémon here
with another Trainer."
entries.translation_source: You may trade your Pokémon here with another Trainer.
entries.translated: Puoi scambiare qui i tuoi Pokémon con un altro Allenatore.

entries.original:
"You may battle with your friends
here."
entries.translation_source: You may battle with your friends here.
entries.translated: Qui puoi combattere con i tuoi amici.

entries.original:
"Two to five Trainers can make
BERRY POWDER together."
entries.translation_source: Two to five Trainers can make BERRY POWDER together.
entries.translated: Da due a cinque Allenatori possono preparare insieme la POLVERE BACCA.

entries.original: "Cancels the selected MENU item."
entries.translation_source: Cancels the selected MENU item.
entries.translated: Annulla la voce di MENU selezionata.

entries.original:
"To use the Berry Crush service,
you must have at least one Berry."
entries.translation_source: To use the Berry Crush service, you must have at least one Berry.
entries.translated:
Per usare il servizio Schiaccia
Bacche, devi avere almeno una\lBacca.

entries.original:
"To enter the Union Room, you must
have at least two Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: To enter the Union Room, you must have at least two Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Per entrare nella Sala Unione, devi
avere almeno due Pokémon.

entries.original:
"No Pokémon holding the [buffer1]
Berry may enter the Union Room."
entries.translation_source: No Pokémon holding the [buffer1-1] Berry may enter the Union Room.
entries.translated:
Nessun Pokémon che tiene una Bacca
[buffer1] può entrare nella Sala\lUnione.

entries.original:
"This is the Pokémon Wireless Club
Union Room.

Unfortunately, your Wireless
Adapter is not connected properly.

Please do come again."
entries.translation_source: This is the Pokémon Wireless Club Union Room. Unfortunately, your Wireless Adapter is not connected properly. Please do come again.
entries.translated:
Questa è la Stanza Unione del Club
Wireless Pokémon. Purtroppo, il tuo\lAdattatore Wireless non è collegato

correttamente. Ti preghiamo di
tornare un{B4}altra volta.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Pokémon Wireless
Club Direct Corner.

You may interact directly with
your friends here.

Which room would you like to
enter?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Pokémon Wireless Club Direct Corner. You may interact directly with your friends here. Which room would you like to enter?
entries.translated:
Benvenuto al Club Wireless Pokémon,
Angolo Diretto. Qui puoi interagire\ldirettamente con i tuoi amici. In

quale stanza vuoi entrare?

entries.original: "Would you like to trade Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to trade Pokémon?
entries.translated: Vuoi scambiare i Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Which Battle Mode would you like
to play?"
entries.translation_source: Which Battle Mode would you like to play?
entries.translated:
A quale Modalità di lotta vorresti
giocare?

entries.original:
"Would you like to use the
Berry Crush System?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to use the Berry Crush System?
entries.translated: Vuoi usare il Sistema Frantabacca?

entries.original:
"There are three Battle Modes.

Single Battle is for two Trainers
with one or more Pokémon each.

Each Trainer can have one Pokémon
in battle at a time.

Double Battle is for two Trainers
with two or more Pokémon each.

Each Trainer will send out two
Pokémon in battle at a time.

Multi Battle is for four Trainers
with one or more Pokémon each.

Each Trainer can have one Pokémon
in battle at a time."
entries.translation_source: There are three Battle Modes. Single Battle is for two Trainers with one or more Pokémon each. Each Trainer can have one Pokémon in battle at a time. Double Battle is for two Trainers with two or more Pokémon each. Each Trainer will send out two Pokémon in battle at a time. Multi Battle is for four Trainers with one or more Pokémon each. Each Trainer can have one Pokémon in battle at a time.
entries.translated:
Ci sono tre modalità di lotta. La
Lotta in Singolo è per due\lAllenatori con uno o più Pokémon

ciascuno. Ogni Allenatore può avere
un Pokémon in lotta alla volta. La\lLotta in Doppio è per due

Allenatori con due o più Pokémon
ciascuno. Ogni Allenatore manda in\lcampo due Pokémon alla volta. La

Lotta Multipla è per quattro
Allenatori con uno o più Pokémon\lciascuno. Ogni Allenatore può avere

un Pokémon in lotta alla volta.

entries.original:
"Please decide which of you two
will become the Leader.

The other player must then choose
\qoJoin Group.\qc"
entries.translation_source: Please decide which of you two will become the Leader. The other player must then choose [quote-open-1]Join Group.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated:
Per favore decidete quale di voi
due diventerà il Leader del gruppo.\lL{B4}altro giocatore dovrà poi

scegliere \qoUnisciti al gruppo.\qc

entries.original:
"Please decide which of you four
will become the Group Leader.

The other players must then choose
\qoJoin Group.\qc"
entries.translation_source: Please decide which of you four will become the Group Leader. The other players must then choose [quote-open-1]Join Group.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated:
Per favore decidete quale di voi
quattro diventerà il Leader del\lgruppo. Gli altri giocatori

dovranno poi scegliere \qoUnisciti al
gruppo.\qc

entries.original:
"Please decide which of you will
become the Group Leader.

The other players must then choose
\qoJoin Group.\qc"
entries.translation_source: Please decide which of you will become the Group Leader. The other players must then choose [quote-open-1]Join Group.[quote-close-2]
entries.translated:
Per favore decidete quale di voi
quattro diventerà il Leader del\lgruppo. Gli altri giocatori

dovranno poi scegliere \qoUnisciti al
gruppo.\qc

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Pokémon Wireless
Club Union Room.

You may interact directly with
other Trainers here, some of\lwhom you may not even know.

Would you like to enter the room?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Pokémon Wireless Club Union Room. You may interact directly with other Trainers here, some of whom you may not even know. Would you like to enter the room?
entries.translated:
Benvenuto nella Sala Unione del
Club Wireless Pokémon. Qui puoi\linteragire direttamente con altri

Allenatori, alcuni dei quali
potresti non conoscere nemmeno.\lVuoi entrare nella stanza?

entries.original:
"The Trainers in the Union Room
will be those players around you\lwho have also entered the room.

You may do all sorts of things
here, such as exchanging greetings.

You may enter two Pokémon up to
Lv. 30 for a one-on-one battle.

You may take part in a chat with
two to five people.

Or, you may register a Pokémon for
trade.

Would you like to enter the room?"
entries.translation_source: The Trainers in the Union Room will be those players around you who have also entered the room. You may do all sorts of things here, such as exchanging greetings. You may enter two Pokémon up to Lv. 30 for a one-on-one battle. You may take part in a chat with two to five people. Or, you may register a Pokémon for trade. Would you like to enter the room?
entries.translated:
Gli Allenatori nella Sala Unione
saranno quei giocatori attorno a te\lche sono entrati anch{B4}essi nella

stanza. Qui puoi fare ogni sorta di
cose, come scambiare i saluti. Puoi\lfar entrare due Pokémon fino al Lv.

30 per una lotta uno contro uno.
Puoi partecipare a una chat con due\lo cinque persone. Oppure puoi

registrare un Pokémon per lo
scambio. Vuoi entrare nella stanza?

entries.original:
"I hope you enjoy your time in
the Union Room."
entries.translation_source: I hope you enjoy your time in the Union Room.
entries.translated:
Spero che ti piaccia trascorrere il
tuo tempo nella Stanza Unione.

entries.original:
"Hello!
My name is Teala.

This must be your first time
up here.

I’ll show you how the Wireless
Communication System works.

First, I need to show you this
floor of our Pokémon Centre.

Right this way, please."
entries.translation_source: Hello! My name is Teala. This must be your first time up here. I’ll show you how the Wireless Communication System works. First, I need to show you this floor of our Pokémon Centre. Right this way, please.
entries.translated:
Ciao! Mi chiamo Teala. Dev{B4}essere
la tua prima volta quassù. Ti\lmostrerò come funziona il Sistema

entries.original:

entries.translation_source: Let me explain how the Pokémon Wireless Club works. On this, the top floor, there are two rooms. First, the room on the left. It’s the Union Room. You may link up with Trainers around you who have also entered the Union Room. With them, you may do things like chat, battle, and trade. Second, the room on the right is the Direct Corner. You may trade or battle Pokémon with your friends in this room. Sometimes, you may not be able to find your friends in the Union Room or the Direct Corner. In that case, please move closer to your friends. If the Wireless Adapter isn’t connected, you may still link up using a GBA Game Link cable. If that is the case, you must go to the Direct Corner. I hope you enjoy the Wireless Communication System.

stanza a destra è l{B4}Angolo Diretto.\lIn questa stanza puoi scambiare o

far lottare i Pokémon con i tuoi
amici. A volte, potresti non\lriuscire a trovare i tuoi amici

nella Sala Unione o nell{B4}Angolo
Diretto. In tal caso, per favore\lavvicinati ai tuoi amici. Se

l{B4}Adattatore Wireless non è
collegato, puoi comunque\lconnetterti usando un cavo Game

Link GBA. In tal caso, devi andare
all{B4}Angolo Diretto. Spero che ti\ldivertirai con il Sistema di

Comunicazione Wireless.

divise in diversi gruppi comodi.\lPrima scegli un gruppo, poi scegli

È il videogioco più nuovo! Sembra
proprio divertente!

"There are obvious signs of burglary
here\."

effrazione\.

C{B4}è un Pokémon in TV! Sembra che si

protezione, è impossibile andare da
nessuna parte. Vorrei solo trovare\lun po{B4}\.

at the Game Corner.

Un astuccio per contenere le
Monete ottenute al Casinò. Può

If there is a hidden item nearby
when it is used, it emits a signal."

Un dispositivo usato per trovare oggetti.
Se nelle vicinanze c{B4}è un oggetto
nascosto quando viene usato, emette un segnale.

drawing of an award ribbon on it."

entries.translated:
Il pass necessario per entrare ai
Pokémon CONTESTS. Riporta il
disegno di un nastro premio.

Un pacco contenente componenti
meccanici di qualche tipo
realizzati dalla DEVON CORPORATION.

of stunts like jumps and wheelies."

entries.translated:
Una bicicletta pieghevole in grado
di fare acrobazie come salti e
impennate.

"A case for holding \Po\Ke\Bl\Lo\CkS made
with a BERRY BLENDER. It releases
one \Po\Ke\Bl\Lo\Ck when shaken."

Una custodia per contenere \Po\Ke\Bl\Lo\CkS
fatta con un BERRY BLENDER. Quando
viene agitata, rilascia un \Po\Ke\Bl\Lo\Ck.

"A device used to search for
life-forms in water.
It looks too difficult to use."

entries.translated:
Un dispositivo usato per cercare
forme di vita nell{B4}acqua. Sembra
troppo difficile da usare.

that reduces the foe’s accuracy.

lovely tone."

istantaneamente qualunque Pokémon.

Una chiave che aziona l{B4}ascensore

Un apparecchio che rende visibili

"Hey, all you Trainers out there!
HELLO, Trainers!

\.\.\. \.\.\. \.\.\.

HELLO, Trainers!\lIt’s me, the POKé DUDE!

"
entries.translation_source: Hey, all you Trainers out there! HELLO, Trainers! [game-token-1][game-token-2][game-token-3] [game-token-4][game-token-5][game-token-6] [game-token-7][game-token-8][game-token-9] Come on, let me hear you! HELLO, Trainers! It’s me, the POKé DUDE!
entries.translated: Ehi, tutti voi Allenatori là fuori! Ciao, Allenatori! \.\.\. \.\.\. \.\.\. Su, fatevi sentire! Ciao, Allenatori! Sono io, il POKé DUDE!

entries.original:
"Today, the POKé DUDE’s here to
tell you about how you can battle\lPokémon!

Say you’re out for a stroll when,
suddenly, a wild Pokémon appears!

It’s up to you to smartly use your
Pokémon and their moves to reduce\lthe opponent’s HP to nothing, and\lclaim victory!

I’ll show you how to do that in
person and for sure!

All righty, here goes!

Keep your eyes glued to the super
POKé DUDE SHOW!"
entries.translation_source: Today, the POKé DUDE’s here to tell you about how you can battle Pokémon! Say you’re out for a stroll when, suddenly, a wild Pokémon appears! It’s up to you to smartly use your Pokémon and their moves to reduce the opponent’s HP to nothing, and claim victory! I’ll show you how to do that in person and for sure! All righty, here goes! Keep your eyes glued to the super POKé DUDE SHOW!
entries.translated: Oggi il POKé DUDE è qui per dirvi come potete combattere contro i Pokémon! Supponiamo che tu stia facendo una passeggiata quando, all{B4}improvviso, appare un Pokémon selvatico! Sta a te usare con intelligenza i tuoi Pokémon e le loro mosse per ridurre gli PS dell{B4}avversario a zero e conquistare la vittoria! Ti mostrerò come farlo di persona e di sicuro! Va bene, eccoci qui! Tieni gli occhi incollati al super POKé DUDE SHOW!

entries.original:
"Well, did you get that?

Even if your own Pokémon’s HP
falls to zero, and it becomes\lunable to battle, not to worry!

Just take it to any Pokémon
CENTER and heal it!

All righty, be seeing you!

Remember, Trainers, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!"
entries.translation_source: Well, did you get that? Even if your own Pokémon’s HP falls to zero, and it becomes unable to battle, not to worry! Just take it to any Pokémon CENTER and heal it! All righty, be seeing you! Remember, Trainers, a good deed a day brings happiness to stay!
entries.translated: Allora, hai capito? Anche se i PS del tuo Pokémon scendono a zero e non può più combattere, non preoccuparti! Portalo semplicemente in un qualsiasi CENTRO Pokémon e fallo curare! Bene, ci vediamo! Ricordate, Allenatori, una buona azione al giorno porta felicità per sempre!

entries.original:
"Today, the POKé DUDE’s here to
tell you about status problems!

Status problems include poisoning,
paralysis, sleep, burn\.

There are a couple others, but
they really are trouble.

Get any one, and your Pokémon
may become useless in battle.

You know, it hurts the POKé DUDE
to see a Pokémon suffer\.

So, what should you do if your
Pokémon gets a status problem?

Well, you’ve got me to show you!

All righty, here goes!

Keep your eyes glued to the super
POKé DUDE SHOW!"
entries.translation_source: Today, the POKé DUDE’s here to tell you about status problems! Status problems include poisoning, paralysis, sleep, burn[game-token-1] There are a couple others, but they really are trouble. Get any one, and your Pokémon may become useless in battle. You know, it hurts the POKé DUDE to see a Pokémon suffer[game-token-2] So, what should you do if your Pokémon gets a status problem? Well, you’ve got me to show you! All righty, here goes! Keep your eyes glued to the super POKé DUDE SHOW!
entries.translated: Oggi il POKé DUDE è qui per parlarvi dei problemi di stato! I problemi di stato includono avvelenamento, paralisi, sonno, bruciatura\. Ce ne sono un paio di altri, ma sono davvero fastidiosi. Basta prenderne uno e il tuo Pokémon potrebbe diventare inutile in lotta. Sapete, al POKé DUDE fa male vedere un Pokémon soffrire\. Allora, cosa dovresti fare se il tuo Pokémon ha un problema di stato? Beh, ci sono io a mostrartelo! Va bene, eccoci qui! Tieni gli occhi incollati al super POKé DUDE SHOW!

entries.original:
"Poisoning or paralysis don’t go
away after a battle.

If a Pokémon is poisoned, it loses
HP even while you’re walking.

You should heal Pokémon of these
kinds of problems right away.

Use an item, or try to get to a
Pokémon CENTER for healing.

That wasn’t hard, was it?
All righty, be seeing you!

Remember, Trainers, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!"
entries.translation_source: Poisoning or paralysis don’t go away after a battle. If a Pokémon is poisoned, it loses HP even while you’re walking. You should heal Pokémon of these kinds of problems right away. Use an item, or try to get to a Pokémon CENTER for healing. That wasn’t hard, was it? All righty, be seeing you! Remember, Trainers, a good deed a day brings happiness to stay!
entries.translated: Avvelenamento o paralisi non spariscono dopo una lotta. Se un Pokémon è avvelenato, perde PS anche mentre cammini. Dovresti curare subito i Pokémon da questi problemi. Usa un oggetto, oppure prova a raggiungere un CENTRO Pokémon per guarire. Non era difficile, vero? Va bene, ci vediamo! Ricorda, Allenatori: una buona azione al giorno porta felicità che dura.

entries.original:
"Does everyone know about type
matchups?

Pokémon and their moves all
belong to certain types.

For example, there are such types
as GRASS and WATER.

You need to consider the type of
the move used to attack\.

And, the type of the Pokémon that
is hit by that attack.

Depending on how those two types
match up, the damage can change.

You see, it depends on whether
the type matchup is good or bad.

If you don’t know how matchups
work, battles will be tough.

So, let me demonstrate exactly
what I mean.

All righty, here goes!

Keep your eyes glued to the super
POKé DUDE SHOW!"
entries.translation_source: Does everyone know about type matchups? Pokémon and their moves all belong to certain types. For example, there are such types as GRASS and WATER. You need to consider the type of the move used to attack[game-token-1] And, the type of the Pokémon that is hit by that attack. Depending on how those two types match up, the damage can change. You see, it depends on whether the type matchup is good or bad. If you don’t know how matchups work, battles will be tough. So, let me demonstrate exactly what I mean. All righty, here goes! Keep your eyes glued to the super POKé DUDE SHOW!
entries.translated: Tutti conoscono gli abbinamenti di tipo? I Pokémon e le loro mosse appartengono tutti a certi tipi. Per esempio, ci sono tipi come ERBA e ACQUA. Devi considerare il tipo della mossa usata per attaccare\. E anche il tipo del Pokémon colpito da quell{B4}attacco. A seconda di come questi due tipi si abbinano, il danno può cambiare. Vedi, dipende dal fatto che l{B4}abbinamento sia favorevole o sfavorevole. Se non sai come funzionano gli abbinamenti, le lotte saranno difficili. Quindi, lascia che ti mostri esattamente cosa intendo. Va bene, eccoci qui! Tieni gli occhi incollati al super POKé DUDE SHOW!

entries.original:
"Is it possible to launch an attack
that will inflict heavy damage?

Does the opposing Pokémon pose
a threat to your Pokémon?

Is there any chance that it may
have disastrously tough moves?

Watch the type matchups to gain
the upper hand!

All righty, be seeing you!

Oh, for the COOL-type POKé DUDE,
AWESOME-type kids like you match\lup perfectly!

Remember, a good deed a day
brings happiness to stay!"
entries.translation_source: Is it possible to launch an attack that will inflict heavy damage? Does the opposing Pokémon pose a threat to your Pokémon? Is there any chance that it may have disastrously tough moves? Watch the type matchups to gain the upper hand! All righty, be seeing you! Oh, for the COOL-type POKé DUDE, AWESOME-type kids like you match up perfectly! Remember, a good deed a day brings happiness to stay!
entries.translated: È possibile lanciare un attacco che infligga danni pesanti? Il Pokémon avversario rappresenta una minaccia per il tuo Pokémon? C{B4}è la possibilità che abbia mosse terribilmente forti? Controlla gli abbinamenti di tipo per ottenere il vantaggio! Va bene, ci vediamo! Oh, per il POKé DUDE di tipo COOL, ragazzi di tipo FANTASTICO come te si abbinano alla perfezione! Ricorda, una buona azione al giorno porta felicità che dura.

entries.original:
"Today, the POKé DUDE’s going to
show you how to catch Pokémon!

Just imagine\. A groovy Pokémon
suddenly appearing in the wild!

Oh, you want it!
You just can’t help it!

Oh, you have to catch it!
You gotta have it!

Let me show you how you can make
it happen!

All righty, here goes!

Keep your eyes glued to the super
POKé DUDE SHOW!"
entries.translation_source: Today, the POKé DUDE’s going to show you how to catch Pokémon! Just imagine[game-token-1] A groovy Pokémon suddenly appearing in the wild! Oh, you want it! You just can’t help it! Oh, you have to catch it! You gotta have it! Let me show you how you can make it happen! All righty, here goes! Keep your eyes glued to the super POKé DUDE SHOW!
entries.translated: Oggi il POKé DUDE vi mostrerà come catturare i Pokémon! Immagina\. Un Pokémon alla moda che appare all{B4}improvviso nell{B4}erba alta! Oh, lo vuoi! Non puoi proprio farne a meno! Oh, devi catturarlo! Devi averlo! Lascia che ti mostri come puoi farlo accadere! Va bene, eccoci qui! Tieni gli occhi incollati al super POKé DUDE SHOW!

entries.original:
"If your first POKé BALL fails to
catch the Pokémon, don’t give up!

Keep throwing Poké Balls\.
It’s bound to work sometime!

All righty, be seeing you!

Remember, Trainers, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!"
entries.translation_source: If your first POKé BALL fails to catch the Pokémon, don’t give up! Keep throwing Poké Balls[game-token-1] It’s bound to work sometime! All righty, be seeing you! Remember, Trainers, a good deed a day brings happiness to stay!
entries.translated: Se la tua prima POKé BALL non riesce a catturare il Pokémon, non arrenderti! Continua a lanciare Poké Ball\. Prima o poi funzionerà di sicuro! Bene, ci vediamo! Ricordate, Allenatori, una buona azione al giorno porta felicità per sempre!

entries.original:
"Hey, everyone!
Do you all have TMs?

A TM, Technical Machine, is an
amazingly great item!

It teaches Pokémon a move that
it may not learn when leveling up!

Isn’t that just great? What a
convenient world we live in!

Open the TM Case and check out
the TMs you have.

You can check them out in detail,
too."
entries.translation_source: Hey, everyone! Do you all have TMs? A TM, Technical Machine, is an amazingly great item! It teaches Pokémon a move that it may not learn when leveling up! Isn’t that just great? What a convenient world we live in! Open the TM Case and check out the TMs you have. You can check them out in detail, too.
entries.translated: Ehi, tutti quanti! Avete le MT? Una MT, Macchina Tecnica, è un oggetto incredibilmente fantastico! Insegna a un Pokémon una mossa che potrebbe non imparare salendo di livello! Non è grandioso? In che mondo comodo viviamo! Apri la Borsa MT e dai un{B4}occhiata alle MT che hai. Puoi anche esaminarle in dettaglio.

entries.original:
"POKé DUDE: NORMAL, WATER, GRASS\.
TMs also come in types.

Check the type and teach it to
a Pokémon that matches up well.

For example, WATER PULSE is
suitable for WATER-type Pokémon.

BULLET SEED is a move that most
GRASS-type Pokémon can learn.

There’s one other thing!"
entries.translation_source: POKé DUDE: NORMAL, WATER, GRASS[game-token-1] TMs also come in types. Check the type and teach it to a Pokémon that matches up well. For example, WATER PULSE is suitable for WATER-type Pokémon. BULLET SEED is a move that most GRASS-type Pokémon can learn. There’s one other thing!
entries.translated: POKé DUDE: NORMALE, ACQUA, ERBA\. Anche le MT hanno dei tipi. Controlla il tipo e insegnala a un Pokémon che si abbini bene. Per esempio, Idropulsar è adatta ai Pokémon di tipo ACQUA. Semitraglia è una mossa che la maggior parte dei Pokémon di tipo ERBA può imparare. C{B4}è un{B4}altra cosa!

entries.original:
"Don’t just look at the type, read
the description, too.

It will contain hints about what
Pokémon might learn the move.

For example, take a move like
FOCUS PUNCH.

It doesn’t sound like anything a
bird or fish Pokémon can learn.

So, try using it on Pokémon with
arms that can throw punches!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t just look at the type, read the description, too. It will contain hints about what Pokémon might learn the move. For example, take a move like FOCUS PUNCH. It doesn’t sound like anything a bird or fish Pokémon can learn. So, try using it on Pokémon with arms that can throw punches!
entries.translated: Non limitarti a guardare il tipo, leggi anche la descrizione. Contiene indizi su quali Pokémon potrebbero imparare la mossa. Per esempio, prendiamo una mossa come FOCUS PUNCH. Non sembra certo una mossa che un Pokémon uccello o pesce possa imparare. Quindi prova a usarla su Pokémon con braccia capaci di tirare pugni!

entries.original:
"Wow, I talked a lot today!
All righty, be seeing you!

Remember, Trainers, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!"
entries.translation_source: Wow, I talked a lot today! All righty, be seeing you! Remember, Trainers, a good deed a day brings happiness to stay!
entries.translated: Wow, oggi ho parlato tantissimo! Va bene, ci rivediamo! Ricordate, Allenatori, una buona azione al giorno porta felicità che resta!

entries.original:
"A Trainer’s BAG has a bunch of
nifty, convenient features!

Take stuff in the Key Items
POCKET, for instance.

You can use a key item without
opening the BAG every time.

For example, let’s pretend I have
a TEACHY TV in my BAG.

I can register it for instant use,
and I’ll show you how!

All righty, here goes!

Keep your eyes glued to the sorta
super POKé DUDE SHOW!"
entries.translation_source: A Trainer’s BAG has a bunch of nifty, convenient features! Take stuff in the Key Items POCKET, for instance. You can use a key item without opening the BAG every time. For example, let’s pretend I have a TEACHY TV in my BAG. I can register it for instant use, and I’ll show you how! All righty, here goes! Keep your eyes glued to the sorta super POKé DUDE SHOW!
entries.translated: La BORSA di un Allenatore ha un sacco di funzioni utili e pratiche! Prendi gli oggetti nella tasca Strumenti Chiave, per esempio. Puoi usare uno strumento chiave senza aprire la BORSA ogni volta. Per esempio, supponiamo di avere una TEACHY TV nella mia BORSA. Posso registrarla per usarla all{B4}istante, e ti mostrerò come! Va bene, eccoci qui! Tieni gli occhi incollati al tipo super POKé DUDE SHOW!

entries.original:
"And now, your TEACHY TV is
registered.

How do you use it?
Well, here’s how it works.

Once an item in the Key Items
POKCET is registered, you can use\lit by pressing Select.

So, you’ve given yourself
one-touch access to TEACHY TV.

All it takes for you to see me is
pressing one button!

That kind of attention is a little
embarrassing!

All righty, be seeing you!

Remember, Trainers, a good deed
a day brings happiness to stay!"
entries.translation_source: And now, your TEACHY TV is registered. How do you use it? Well, here’s how it works. Once an item in the Key Items POKCET is registered, you can use it by pressing Select. So, you’ve given yourself one-touch access to TEACHY TV. All it takes for you to see me is pressing one button! That kind of attention is a little embarrassing! All righty, be seeing you! Remember, Trainers, a good deed a day brings happiness to stay!
entries.translated: E ora, la tua TEACHY TV è registrata. Come si usa? Ecco come funziona. Una volta registrato un oggetto nella tasca degli Strumenti Chiave, puoi usarlo premendo Select. Quindi, ti sei garantito l{B4}accesso con un solo tocco alla TEACHY TV. Tutto quello che ti serve per vedermi è premere un tasto! Un{B4}attenzione del genere è un po{B4} imbarazzante! Va bene, ci vediamo! Ricorda, Allenatori: una buona azione al giorno porta felicità che dura.

entries.translation_source: A battle, huh? All right, just give me some time.
entries.translated: Una lotta, eh? Va bene, dammi solo un po{B4} di tempo.

entries.original:
"You want to chat, huh?
Sure, just wait a little."
entries.translation_source: You want to chat, huh? Sure, just wait a little.
entries.translated: Vuoi chiacchierare, eh? Certo, aspetta un attimo.

entries.original:
"Sure thing! As my \qoGreetings,\qc
here’s my Trainer Card."
entries.translation_source: Sure thing! As my [quote-open-1]Greetings,[quote-close-2] here’s my Trainer Card.
entries.translated: Certo! Ecco la mia \qoSaluti,\qc Carta Allenatore.

entries.original:
"A battle? Of course, but I need
time to get ready."
entries.translation_source: A battle? Of course, but I need time to get ready.
entries.translated: Una lotta? Certo, ma ho bisogno di tempo per prepararmi.

entries.original:
"Did you want to chat?
Okay, but please wait a moment."
entries.translation_source: Did you want to chat? Okay, but please wait a moment.
entries.translated: Volevi chiacchierare? Va bene, ma aspetta un momento per favore.

entries.original:
"As my introduction, I’ll show you
my Trainer Card."
entries.translation_source: As my introduction, I’ll show you my Trainer Card.
entries.translated: Come presentazione, ti mostrerò la mia Carta Allenatore.

entries.original:
"Thanks for waiting!
Let’s get our battle started!\CC083C"
entries.translation_source: Thanks for waiting! Let’s get our battle started![control-code-1]
entries.translated: Grazie per l{B4}attesa! Iniziamo la nostra lotta!\CC083C

entries.original:
"All right!
Let’s chat!\CC083C"
entries.translation_source: All right! Let’s chat![control-code-1]
entries.translated: Va bene! Chiacchieriamo!\CC083C

entries.original:
"Sorry I made you wait!
Let’s get started!\CC083C"
entries.translation_source: Sorry I made you wait! Let’s get started![control-code-1]
entries.translated: Scusa se ti ho fatto aspettare! Cominciamo!\CC083C

entries.original:
"Sorry I made you wait!
Let’s chat.\CC083C"
entries.translation_source: Sorry I made you wait! Let’s chat.[control-code-1]
entries.translated: Scusa se ti ho fatto aspettare! Chiacchieriamo.\CC083C

entries.original: "The trade will be started.\CC083C"
entries.translation_source: The trade will be started.[control-code-1]
entries.translated: Lo scambio avrà inizio.\CC083C

entries.original: "The battle will be started.\CC083C"
entries.translation_source: The battle will be started.[control-code-1]
entries.translated: La lotta avrà inizio.\CC083C

entries.original: "Entering the chat\.\CC083C"
entries.translation_source: Entering the chat[game-token-1][control-code-2]
entries.translated: Accesso alla chat\.\CC083C

entries.original:
"Sorry! My Pokémon don’t seem to
be feeling too well right now.\lLet me battle you another time.

"
entries.translation_source: Sorry! My Pokémon don’t seem to be feeling too well right now. Let me battle you another time.
entries.translated: Scusa! Sembra che i miei Pokémon non stiano troppo bene in questo momento. Fammi combattere con te un{B4}altra volta.

entries.original:
"I’m terribly sorry, but my Pokémon
aren’t feeling well\.

Let’s battle another time.

"
entries.translation_source: I’m terribly sorry, but my Pokémon aren’t feeling well[game-token-1] Let’s battle another time.
entries.translated: Mi dispiace tantissimo, ma i miei Pokémon non stanno bene\. Combattiamo un{B4}altra volta.

entries.original:
"Huh? My Trainer Card\.
Where’d it go now?\lSorry! I’ll show you another time!

"
entries.translation_source: Huh? My Trainer Card[game-token-1] Where’d it go now? Sorry! I’ll show you another time!
entries.translated: Eh? La mia Carta Allenatore\. Dov{B4}è finita adesso? Scusa! Te la mostrerò un{B4}altra volta!

entries.original:
"Oh? Now where did I put my
Trainer Card?\.\lSorry! I’ll show you later!

"
entries.translation_source: Oh? Now where did I put my Trainer Card?[game-token-1] Sorry! I’ll show you later!
entries.translated: Oh? Ma dov{B4}è finita la mia Carta Allenatore?\. Scusa! Te la mostrerò più tardi!

entries.original:
"If you want to do something with
me, just give me a shout!

"
entries.translation_source: If you want to do something with me, just give me a shout!
entries.translated: Se vuoi fare qualcosa con me, basta che mi chiami!

entries.original:
"If you want to do something with
me, don’t be shy.

"
entries.translation_source: If you want to do something with me, don’t be shy.
entries.translated: Se vuoi fare qualcosa con me, non essere timido.

entries.original:
"Whoops! Sorry, but I have to do
something else.\lAnother time, okay?

"
entries.translation_source: Whoops! Sorry, but I have to do something else. Another time, okay?
entries.translated: Ops! Scusa, ma devo fare un{B4}altra cosa. Un{B4}altra volta, va bene?

entries.original:
"If you want to battle, you need
two Pokémon that are below\lLv. 30.

"
entries.translation_source: If you want to battle, you need two Pokémon that are below Lv. 30.
entries.translated: Se vuoi combattere, ti servono due Pokémon che siano sotto il Lv. 30.

entries.original:
"For a battle, you need two
Pokémon that are below Lv. 30.

"
entries.translation_source: For a battle, you need two Pokémon that are below Lv. 30.
entries.translated: Per una lotta, servono due Pokémon sotto il Lv. 30.

entries.original:
"Oh, all right.
Come see me anytime, okay?

"
entries.translation_source: Oh, all right. Come see me anytime, okay?
entries.translated: Oh, va bene. Vieni a trovarmi quando vuoi, d{B4}accordo?

entries.original:
"Oh\.
Please come by anytime.

"
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] Please come by anytime.
entries.translated: Oh\. Passa pure quando vuoi.

entries.original:
"Oh, sorry!
I just can’t right this instant.\lLet’s chat another time.

"
entries.translation_source: Oh, sorry! I just can’t right this instant. Let’s chat another time.
entries.translated: Oh, scusa! Proprio in questo momento non posso. Parliamone un{B4}altra volta.

entries.original:
"Oh, I’m sorry.
I have too much to do right now.\lLet’s chat some other time.

"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I’m sorry. I have too much to do right now. Let’s chat some other time.
entries.translated: Oh, mi dispiace. Ho troppo da fare adesso. Chiacchieriamo un{B4}altra volta.

entries.original:
"Whoa!
I can tell you’re pretty tough!

"
entries.translation_source: Whoa! I can tell you’re pretty tough!
entries.translated: Wow! Ti posso dire che sei davvero tosto!

entries.original:
"You used that move?
That’s good strategy!

"
entries.translation_source: You used that move? That’s good strategy!
entries.translated: Hai usato quella mossa? È una buona strategia!

entries.original:
"Way to go!
That was an eye-opener!

"
entries.translation_source: Way to go! That was an eye-opener!
entries.translated: Ben fatto! È stata una rivelazione!

entries.original:
"Oh! How could you use that
Pokémon in that situation?

"
entries.translation_source: Oh! How could you use that Pokémon in that situation?
entries.translated: Oh! Come hai potuto usare quel Pokémon in quella situazione?

entries.original:
"That Pokémon\.
It’s been raised really well!

"
entries.translation_source: That Pokémon[game-token-1] It’s been raised really well!
entries.translated: Quel Pokémon\. È stato cresciuto davvero bene!

entries.original:
"That’s it!
This is the right move now!

"
entries.translation_source: That’s it! This is the right move now!
entries.translated: Esatto! Questa è la mossa giusta adesso!

entries.original:
"That’s awesome!
You can battle that way?

"
entries.translation_source: That’s awesome! You can battle that way?
entries.translated: Fantastico! Si può lottare in quel modo?

entries.original:
"You have exquisite timing for
switching Pokémon!

"
entries.translation_source: You have exquisite timing for switching Pokémon!
entries.translated: Hai un tempismo impeccabile per far entrare un Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Oh, I see!
This is educational!

"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I see! This is educational!
entries.translated: Oh, capisco! È istruttivo!

entries.original:
"Don’t say anything funny anymore!
I’m sore from laughing!

"
entries.translation_source: Don’t say anything funny anymore! I’m sore from laughing!
entries.translated: Non dire più niente di divertente! Mi fa male il corpo dal ridere!

entries.original:
"Oh?
Something like that happened.

"
entries.translation_source: Oh? Something like that happened.
entries.translated: Oh? È successa una cosa del genere.

entries.original:
"Hmhm\. What?
So is this what you’re saying?

"
entries.translation_source: Hmhm[game-token-1] What? So is this what you’re saying?
entries.translated: Hmhm\. Cosa? Quindi è questo che stai dicendo?

entries.original:
"Is that right?
I didn’t know that.

"
entries.translation_source: Is that right? I didn’t know that.
entries.translated: Davvero? Non lo sapevo.

entries.original:
"Ahaha!
What is that about?

"
entries.translation_source: Ahaha! What is that about?
entries.translated: Ahaha! Che cosa vuol dire?

entries.original:
"Yes, that’s exactly it!
That’s what I meant.

"
entries.translation_source: Yes, that’s exactly it! That’s what I meant.
entries.translated: Sì, esatto! Intendevo proprio quello.

entries.original:
"In other words\.
Yes! That’s right!

"
entries.translation_source: In other words[game-token-1] Yes! That’s right!
entries.translated: In altre parole\. Sì! Esatto!

entries.original:
"I’m just showing my Trainer Card
as my way of greeting.

"
entries.translation_source: I’m just showing my Trainer Card as my way of greeting.
entries.translated: Sto solo mostrando la mia Carta Allenatore come saluto.

entries.original:
"I hope I get to know you better!

"
entries.translation_source: I hope I get to know you better!
entries.translated: Spero di conoscerti meglio!

entries.original:
"We’re showing each other our
Trainer CardS to get acquainted.

"
entries.translation_source: We’re showing each other our Trainer CardS to get acquainted.
entries.translated: Ci mostriamo le nostre Carte Allenatore per conoscerci.

entries.original:
"Glad to meet you.
Please don’t be a stranger!

"
entries.translation_source: Glad to meet you. Please don’t be a stranger!
entries.translated: Piacere di conoscerti. Non fare il misterioso, per favore!

entries.original:
"Yeahah!
I really wanted this Pokémon!

"
entries.translation_source: Yeahah! I really wanted this Pokémon!
entries.translated: Yeahah! Volevo davvero questo Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Finally, a trade got me that
Pokémon I’d wanted a long time.

"
entries.translation_source: Finally, a trade got me that Pokémon I’d wanted a long time.
entries.translated: Finalmente, uno scambio mi ha fatto ottenere quel Pokémon che desideravo da tanto tempo.

entries.original:
"I’m trading Pokémon right now.

"
entries.translation_source: I’m trading Pokémon right now.
entries.translated: Sto scambiando Pokémon adesso.

entries.original:
"I finally got that Pokémon I
wanted in a trade!

"
entries.translation_source: I finally got that Pokémon I wanted in a trade!
entries.translated: Finalmente ho ottenuto il Pokémon che volevo in uno scambio!

entries.original:
"Welcome to the TRADING BOARD.

You may register your Pokémon
and offer it up for a trade.

Would you like to register one of
your Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the TRADING BOARD. You may register your Pokémon and offer it up for a trade. Would you like to register one of your Pokémon?
entries.translated: Benvenuto alla BACHECA SCAMBI. Puoi registrare il tuo Pokémon e offrirlo in scambio. Vuoi registrare uno dei tuoi Pokémon?

entries.original:
"This TRADING BOARD is used for
offering a Pokémon for a trade.

All you need to do is register a
Pokémon for a trade.

Another Trainer may offer a party
Pokémon in return for the trade.

We hope you will register Pokémon
and trade them with many, many\lother Trainers.

Would you like to register one of
your Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: This TRADING BOARD is used for offering a Pokémon for a trade. All you need to do is register a Pokémon for a trade. Another Trainer may offer a party Pokémon in return for the trade. We hope you will register Pokémon and trade them with many, many other Trainers. Would you like to register one of your Pokémon?
entries.translated: Questa BACHECA SCAMBI serve a offrire un Pokémon per uno scambio. Tutto quello che devi fare è registrare un Pokémon per uno scambio. Un altro Allenatore potrebbe offrire in cambio un Pokémon della squadra. Speriamo che tu registri Pokémon e li scambi con molti, molti altri Allenatori. Vuoi registrare uno dei tuoi Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Please choose the type of Pokémon
that you would like in the trade.
"
entries.translation_source: Please choose the type of Pokémon that you would like in the trade.
entries.translated: Scegli il tipo di Pokémon che desideri ricevere nello scambio.

entries.original:
"Which of your party Pokémon will
you offer in trade?

"
entries.translation_source: Which of your party Pokémon will you offer in trade?
entries.translated: Quale Pokémon della tua squadra offrirai in scambio?

entries.original:
"Registration has been canceled.

"
entries.translation_source: Registration has been canceled.
entries.translated: La registrazione è stata annullata.

entries.original:
"Registration has been completed.

"
entries.translation_source: Registration has been completed.
entries.translated: La registrazione è stata completata.

entries.original:
"The trade has been canceled.

"
entries.translation_source: The trade has been canceled.
entries.translated: Lo scambio è stato annullato.

entries.original:
"Cancel the registration of your
Lv. [buffer2] [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: Cancel the registration of your Lv. [buffer2-1] [buffer1-2]?
entries.translated: Annullare la registrazione del tuo [buffer2] di liv. [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Cancel the registration of your
Egg?"
entries.translation_source: Cancel the registration of your Egg?
entries.translated: Annullare la registrazione del tuo Uovo?

entries.original:
"The registration has been canceled.

"
entries.translation_source: The registration has been canceled.
entries.translated: La registrazione è stata annullata.

entries.original:
"Would you like to ask [buffer1] to
make a trade?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to ask [buffer1-1] to make a trade?
entries.translated: Vuoi chiedere a [buffer1] di fare uno scambio?

entries.original:
"You don’t have a [buffer2]-type
Pokémon that [buffer1] wants.

"
entries.translation_source: You don’t have a [buffer2-1]-type Pokémon that [buffer1-2] wants.
entries.translated: Non hai un Pokémon di tipo [buffer2] che [buffer1] desidera.

entries.original:
"You don’t have an Egg that
[buffer1] wants.

"
entries.translation_source: You don’t have an Egg that [buffer1-1] wants.
entries.translated: Non hai un Uovo che [buffer1] vuole.

entries.original:
"You can’t make a trade for
[buffer1]’s Pokémon right now.

"
entries.translation_source: You can’t make a trade for [buffer1-1]’s Pokémon right now.
entries.translated: Non puoi fare uno scambio per il Pokémon di [buffer1] in questo momento.

entries.original:
"Your trade offer was rejected.

"
entries.translation_source: Your trade offer was rejected.
entries.translated: La tua offerta di scambio è stata rifiutata.

entries.translation_source: Egg Trade
entries.translated: Scambio Uova

entries.original:
"Thank you for using the MYSTERY
GIFT System.

By holding this WONDER CARD, you
may take part in a survey at a\lPokémon MART.

Use these surveys to invite
Trainers to the SEVII ISLANDS.

\.Let me give you a secret
password for a survey:

\qoGIVE ME
AWESOME Trainer\qc

Write that in on a survey and send
it to the WIRELESS\lCOMMUNICATION SYSTEM."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for using the MYSTERY GIFT System. By holding this WONDER CARD, you may take part in a survey at a Pokémon MART. Use these surveys to invite Trainers to the SEVII ISLANDS. [game-token-1]Let me give you a secret password for a survey: [quote-open-2]GIVE ME AWESOME Trainer[quote-close-3] Write that in on a survey and send it to the WIRELESS COMMUNICATION SYSTEM.
entries.translated: Grazie per aver usato il sistema DONO SEGRETO. Tenendo questa WONDER CARD, puoi partecipare a un sondaggio presso un Pokémon MART. Usa questi sondaggi per invitare Allenatori nelle ISOLE SEVII. \.Lascia che ti dia una password segreta per un sondaggio: \qoDATEMI UN ALLENATORE FANTASTICO\qc Scrivila in un sondaggio e inviala al SISTEMA DI COMUNICAZIONE WIRELESS.

entries.translated:
Ah, sei tu! Un Campione in erba!
Non ti avevo visto! Benvenuto alla\lPalestra di Crater Town! Iniziamo

con un po{B4} di Acqua Fresca.

entries.original:
"As you can, or can’t see, this Gym
is centred around Dark-types.

If you want to win here, you’re
going to need some powerful\l[green]Fighting[blue], [green]Bug[blue], or [green]Fairy[blue]-types.

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: As you can, or can’t see, this Gym is centred around Dark-types. If you want to win here, you’re going to need some powerful [color-green-1]Fighting[color-blue-2], [color-green-3]Bug[color-blue-4], or [color-green-5]Fairy[color-blue-6]-types. Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Come puoi vedere, o forse no,
questa Palestra è incentrata sui\ltipi Buio. Se vuoi vincere qui, ti

serviranno dei potenti tipi [green]Lotta[blue],
[green]Coleottero[blue] o [green]Folletto[blue]. Buona\lfortuna!

entries.original:
"Well done!

You managed to find your way
through the dark and take down\lVéga!

Take this, as an extra reward for
your victory."
entries.translation_source: Well done! You managed to find your way through the dark and take down Véga! Take this, as an extra reward for your victory.
entries.translated:
Ben fatto! Sei riuscito a farti
strada nel buio e a sconfiggere\lVéga! Prendi questo, come

ricompensa extra per la tua
vittoria.

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single Dark-type move in battle.

With it, you can unleash your dark
fury!

Mwahahahaha!"
entries.translation_source: That Gem I gave you can power up a single Dark-type move in battle. With it, you can unleash your dark fury! Mwahahahaha!
entries.translated:
Quella Gemma che ti ho dato può
potenziare una singola mossa di\ltipo Buio in lotta. Con essa, puoi

scatenare la tua furia oscura!
Mwahahahaha!

"To the east of here, beyond the

But it seems like you’ll need more
than the HM Surf to get there.

It looks like people are blocking
the way\."
entries.translation_source: To the east of here, beyond the watery Route 15, lies Vivill Town. But it seems like you’ll need more than the HM Surf to get there. It looks like people are blocking the way[game-token-1]

A est da qui, oltre la bagnata
Percorso 15, si trova Vivill Town.\lMa sembra che ti servirà qualcosa

in più di MN Surf per arrivarci.
Sembra che delle persone stiano\lbloccando il passaggio\.

entries.original:
"Hey, there, travelling trainer.

If you plan on challenging Mirskle,
these should help you out."
entries.translation_source: Hey, there, travelling trainer. If you plan on challenging Mirskle, these should help you out.
entries.translated:
Ehi, salve, allenatore viaggiatore.
Se hai intenzione di sfidare\lMirskle, questi dovrebbero darti

una mano.

entries.original:
"I enjoy doing nice things for
travellers.

It’s a hobby of mine."
entries.translation_source: I enjoy doing nice things for travellers. It’s a hobby of mine.
entries.translated:
Mi piace fare cose gentili per i
viaggiatori. È un mio hobby.

entries.original:
"All of the land in these parts is
broken into little chunks.

Now that I think about it, the
whole Borrius region is split into\lbig islands!"
entries.translation_source: All of the land in these parts is broken into little chunks. Now that I think about it, the whole Borrius region is split into big islands!
entries.translated:
Tutta la terra da queste parti è
spezzettata in piccoli lembi. Ora\lche ci penso, l{B4}intera regione di

Borrius è divisa in grandi isole!

entries.original:
"This statue is of the legendary
fiery bird Pokémon, Moltres.

Apparently it lives somewhere in
Cinder Volcano, lighting up the sky\lwith its flames at night."
entries.translation_source: This statue is of the legendary fiery bird Pokémon, Moltres. Apparently it lives somewhere in Cinder Volcano, lighting up the sky with its flames at night.
entries.translated:
Questa statua raffigura il
leggendario Pokémon uccello di\lfuoco, Moltres. A quanto pare vive

da qualche parte nel Cinder
Volcano, illuminando il cielo con\lle sue fiamme di notte.

entries.original:
"Look, look!

I can see Dehara City from here!"
entries.translation_source: Look, look! I can see Dehara City from here!
entries.translated:
Guarda, guarda! Da qui vedo Dehara
City!

"Grim Woods

\al Cinder Volcano
\ar Dresco Town"
