Dresco Town

entries.original:
"We just undertook a major drug
bust, but our targets got away,\lagain\.

Now we’re sulking."
entries.translation_source: We just undertook a major drug bust, but our targets got away, again[game-token-1] Now we’re sulking.
entries.translated:
Abbiamo appena portato a termine un
grosso blitz antidroga, ma i nostri\lobiettivi sono scappati di nuovo\.

Ora siamo imbronciati.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, but you can’t go in here
right now.

My grandfather is taking his daily
nap and doesn’t want anyone to\ldisturb him.

Come back later when he’s awake if
you want to talk with him."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, but you can’t go in here right now. My grandfather is taking his daily nap and doesn’t want anyone to disturb him. Come back later when he’s awake if you want to talk with him.
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace, ma non puoi entrare
qui adesso. Mio nonno sta facendo\lil suo pisolino quotidiano e non

vuole che nessuno lo disturbi.
Torna più tardi, quando sarà\lsveglio, se vuoi parlargli.

entries.original:
"Have you visited the Dresco Town
Trainer House yet?

It’s the black and blue building at
the south end of town."
entries.translation_source: Have you visited the Dresco Town Trainer House yet? It’s the black and blue building at the south end of town.
entries.translated:
Hai già visitato la Trainer House
di Dresco Town? È l{B4}edificio nero e\lblu sul lato sud della città.

entries.original:
"This is a relatively new entrance
to the SES Expressway.

So we’re still working on building
a bridge to it."
entries.translation_source: This is a relatively new entrance to the SES Expressway. So we’re still working on building a bridge to it.
entries.translated:
Questo è un accesso relativamente
nuovo alla SES Expressway. Stiamo\lancora lavorando per costruirci un

ponte.

entries.original:
"There’s this really pretty place to
the north of here called Flower\lParadise!

There are flowers everywhere!"
entries.translation_source: There’s this really pretty place to the north of here called Flower Paradise! There are flowers everywhere!
entries.translated:
C{B4}è un posto davvero bello a nord
di qui chiamato Flower Paradise! Ci\lsono fiori ovunque!

entries.original:
"It’s a statue of the Legendary
Fire Pokémon, Moltres.

It says here that Moltres was once
used as a herald to a great\ldarkness, but now it resides in\lCinder Volcano."
entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Fire Pokémon, Moltres. It says here that Moltres was once used as a herald to a great darkness, but now it resides in Cinder Volcano.
entries.translated:
È una statua del Pokémon
leggendario di tipo Fuoco, Moltres.\lQui dice che Moltres un tempo

veniva usato come araldo di una
grande oscurità, ma ora risiede nel\lVulcano Ceneri.

entries.original:
"Welcome to Flower Paradise!

Please be careful to respect the
flowers and the Pokémon that live\lin them, while you are here."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to Flower Paradise! Please be careful to respect the flowers and the Pokémon that live in them, while you are here.
entries.translated:
Benvenuti al Flower Paradise! Per
favore, fate attenzione a\lrispettare i fiori e i Pokémon che

vi abitano, mentre siete qui.

entries.original:
"Route 3

\au Flower Paradise
\ad Dresco Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 3 [game-token-1] Flower Paradise [game-token-2] Dresco Town
entries.translated:
Percorso 3 \au Flower Paradise \ad
Dresco Town

entries.original:
"Here we go!

Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!"
entries.translation_source: Here we go! Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!
entries.translated: Eccoci! Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!

entries.original:
"If you change your mind let
me know."
entries.translation_source: If you change your mind let me know.
entries.translated: Se cambi idea, fammelo sapere.

entries.original:
"Hey kid!
Listen up.

The road up ahead is frought with
trainers wanting to battle.

Some people have even dubbed it
\qoChallenge Road\qc.

But hey, I understand if you don’t
want to battle them.

So using my amazing psychic powers,
I can teleport you to the other\lside for free!

What do you say, are you in?"
entries.translation_source: Hey kid! Listen up. The road up ahead is frought with trainers wanting to battle. Some people have even dubbed it [quote-open-1]Challenge Road[quote-close-2]. But hey, I understand if you don’t want to battle them. So using my amazing psychic powers, I can teleport you to the other side for free! What do you say, are you in?
entries.translated:
Ehi ragazzo! Ascolta. La strada più
avanti è piena di Allenatori che\lvogliono combattere. Alcuni l{B4}hanno

persino soprannominata \qoChallenge
Road\qc. Ma ehi, capisco se non vuoi\laffrontarli. Quindi, grazie ai miei

incredibili poteri psichici, posso
teletrasportarti dall{B4}altra parte\lgratis! Che ne dici, ci stai?

entries.original:
"Dresco Town Pokémon Gym
Leader: Mirskle\lThe high up hippy!"
entries.translation_source: Dresco Town Pokémon Gym Leader: Mirskle The high up hippy!
entries.translated:
Capopalestra di Dresco Town
Pokémon: Mirskle L{B4}hippie di alto\lrango!

entries.original:
"Breathe it all in\.

That wonderful smell!"
entries.translation_source: Breathe it all in[game-token-1] That wonderful smell!
entries.translated:
Respiralo tutto\. Quel profumo
meraviglioso!

entries.original:
"The Darkness Badge makes all
Pokémon up to Lv. 30 obey you.

That includes even outsiders you
received in a trade.

You can also now use the [green]HM Cut[blue]
anytime outside of battle.

Use it to cut down small trees to
open up new pathways.

I want you to have my favourite
TM, as well."
entries.translation_source: The Darkness Badge makes all Pokémon up to Lv. 30 obey you. That includes even outsiders you received in a trade. You can also now use the [color-green-1]HM Cut[color-blue-2] anytime outside of battle. Use it to cut down small trees to open up new pathways. I want you to have my favourite TM, as well.
entries.translated:
La Medaglia Oscurità fa sì che
tutti i Pokémon fino al Lv. 30 ti\lobbediscano. Questo include anche

quelli ricevuti in scambio. Ora
puoi usare la [green]MN Taglio[blue] in\lqualsiasi momento fuori dalla

lotta. Usala per tagliare i piccoli
alberi e aprire nuove vie. Voglio\lche tu abbia anche la mia MT

preferita.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, this feature is
unavailable right now."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, this feature is unavailable right now.
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace, questa funzione non è
disponibile al momento.

entries.original:
"Sigh...

My poor Pokémon.

Ever since the entrance to the SES
Expressway froze over, they have\lhad nowhere to train.

Say, how would you like to battle
my Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Sigh... My poor Pokémon. Ever since the entrance to the SES Expressway froze over, they have had nowhere to train. Say, how would you like to battle my Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Sigh... I miei poveri Pokémon. Da
quando l{B4}ingresso della SES\lExpressway si è ghiacciato, non

hanno più nessun posto dove
allenarsi. Sai, ti andrebbe di\llottare contro i miei Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Well if you change your mind, feel
free to come back anytime!"
entries.translation_source: Well if you change your mind, feel free to come back anytime!
entries.translated:
Beh, se cambi idea, torna pure
quando vuoi!

entries.original: "Let’s get started then!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s get started then!
entries.translated: Allora, iniziamo!

entries.original:
"Now that the entrance to the SES
Expressway isn’t sealed anymore,\lI’ve finally been able to train!

Say, would you like to battle my
newly trained Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Now that the entrance to the SES Expressway isn’t sealed anymore, I’ve finally been able to train! Say, would you like to battle my newly trained Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Ora che l{B4}ingresso della SES
Expressway non è più sigillato,\lfinalmente sono riuscito ad

allenarmi! Senti, ti andrebbe di
sfidare i miei Pokémon appena\lallenati?

entries.original: "Thanks for battling with me!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks for battling with me!
entries.translated: Grazie per aver lottato con me!

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

Looks like ya opened up a pathway
for yurself.

Now just keep heading [green]east[blue] until
you reach [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]"
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! Looks like ya opened up a pathway for yurself. Now just keep heading [color-green-1]east[color-blue-2] until you reach [color-green-3]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-4]
entries.translated:
Uuuh! Sembra che tu abbia aperto un
varco per te. Ora continua a\ldirigerti [green]verso est[blue] finché non

raggiungi [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]

entries.original:
"Sometimes the [green]Oddish Leaves [blue]get to
me and I see things that aren’t\lreally there."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes the [color-green-1]Oddish Leaves [color-blue-2]get to me and I see things that aren’t really there.
entries.translated:
A volte le [green]Foglie di Oddish [blue]mi
danno alla testa e vedo cose che in\lrealtà non ci sono.

entries.original: "Do you know what a [green]Gem [blue]is?"
entries.translation_source: Do you know what a [color-green-1]Gem [color-blue-2]is?
entries.translated: Sai cos{B4}è una [green]Gemma [blue]?

entries.original: "[black]Krook: [green]Dile!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Krook: [color-green-2]Dile!
entries.translated: [black]Krook: [green]Dile!

entries.original: "Skull!"
entries.translation_source: Skull!
entries.translated: Teschio!

entries.original:
"TM46 teaches [green]Thief[blue].

It’s the perfect TM for sneaky
trainers."
entries.translation_source: TM46 teaches [color-green-1]Thief[color-blue-2]. It’s the perfect TM for sneaky trainers.
entries.translated:
La MT46 insegna [green]Furto[blue]. È la MT
perfetta per Allenatori furtivi.

entries.original:
"One last piece of advice.

Try to stay in the light and out of
the shadows as much as possible.

If you follow this advice, it will
not bring you to ruin.

I promise\."
entries.translation_source: One last piece of advice. Try to stay in the light and out of the shadows as much as possible. If you follow this advice, it will not bring you to ruin. I promise[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Un ultimo consiglio. Cerca di
restare alla luce e lontano dalle\lombre il più possibile. Se seguirai

questo consiglio, non ti porterà
alla rovina. Te lo prometto\.

entries.original:
"Looks like you already have
Thief\."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you already have Thief[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sembra che tu abbia già Furto\.

entries.original: "[black]Hitmontop: [green]Top!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Hitmontop: [color-green-2]Top!
entries.translated: [black]Hitmontop: [green]Top!

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Ahh\.
Right on schedule.

Tell me, [buffer1], what’s your name?

\.

[player], is it?

At last, we finally meet.

I am Zeph, the man in charge of
The Shadows.

I’ve been informed that you have
trespassed in our laboratory and\lare aware of what we have created.

This is unacceptable.

If word of our experiments got out,
it’d be the end for us.

Our secret must remain in the
shadows until we have reached our\lgoals."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Ahh[game-token-2] Right on schedule. Tell me, [buffer1-3], what’s your name? [game-token-4] [player-name-5], is it? At last, we finally meet. I am Zeph, the man in charge of The Shadows. I’ve been informed that you have trespassed in our laboratory and are aware of what we have created. This is unacceptable. If word of our experiments got out, it’d be the end for us. Our secret must remain in the shadows until we have reached our goals.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Ahh\. Proprio in orario. Dimmi,
[buffer1], qual è il tuo nome? \.\l[player], vero? Finalmente ci

incontriamo. Sono Zeph, il capo
delle Ombre. Sono stato informato\lche hai violato il nostro

laboratorio e sei a conoscenza di
ciò che abbiamo creato. Questo è\linaccettabile. Se si venisse a

sapere dei nostri esperimenti,
sarebbe la nostra fine. Il nostro\lsegreto deve rimanere tra le ombre

finché non avremo raggiunto i
nostri obiettivi.

entries.original:
"[blue]Therefore, Ivory here will be
giving you a little incentive for\lkeeping your mouth shut."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Therefore, Ivory here will be giving you a little incentive for keeping your mouth shut.
entries.translated:
[blue]Pertanto, qui Ivory ti darà un
piccolo incentivo per tenere la\lbocca chiusa.

entries.original:
"Surprise!
It’s time to battle now!"
entries.translation_source: Surprise! It’s time to battle now!
entries.translated: Sorpresa! È ora di combattere!

entries.original:
"I guess scaring you didn’t seal in
my victory."
entries.translation_source: I guess scaring you didn’t seal in my victory.
entries.translated: Immagino che spaventarti non abbia assicurato la mia vittoria.

entries.original:
"I’m camping out here to scare
anyone who passes by."
entries.translation_source: I’m camping out here to scare anyone who passes by.
entries.translated:
Sto campeggiando qui per spaventare
chiunque passi di qui.

entries.original:
"Epidimy Town

A quaint town surrounded by
mountains."
entries.translation_source: Epidimy Town A quaint town surrounded by mountains.
entries.translated:
Epidimy Town, una graziosa
cittadina circondata da montagne.

entries.original:
"Fallshore City

The waterfall capital of Borrius."
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City The waterfall capital of Borrius.
entries.translated:
Fallshore City, la capitale delle
cascate di Borrius.

entries.original:
"Tehl Town

A town where it’s always Autumn."
entries.translation_source: Tehl Town A town where it’s always Autumn.
entries.translated:
Tehl Town Una città dove è sempre
autunno.

entries.original:
"I hope I don’t slip and fall off of
this bridge."
entries.translation_source: I hope I don’t slip and fall off of this bridge.
entries.translated:
Spero di non scivolare e cadere da
questo ponte.

entries.original:
"I don’t think it’s a such a good
idea to paint in the rain.

Everything I paint gets
washed away\."
entries.translation_source: I don’t think it’s a such a good idea to paint in the rain. Everything I paint gets washed away[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Non credo sia una gran buona idea
dipingere sotto la pioggia. Tutto\lquello che dipingo viene lavato via\.

entries.original:
"A life of gambling is a life of no
regrets."
entries.translation_source: A life of gambling is a life of no regrets.
entries.translated:
Una vita dedicata al gioco
d{B4}azzardo è una vita senza\lrimpianti.

entries.original:
"I train myself everyday by running
barefoot across these stones."
entries.translation_source: I train myself everyday by running barefoot across these stones.
entries.translated:
Mi alleno ogni giorno correndo a
piedi nudi su queste pietre.

entries.original:
"I am but the first of many
trainers on this road."
entries.translation_source: I am but the first of many trainers on this road.
entries.translated:
Sono solo il primo di molti
allenatori su questa strada.

entries.original:
"Drat!
A Zubat bit me back in that cave."
entries.translation_source: Drat! A Zubat bit me back in that cave.
entries.translated:
Accidenti! Uno Zubat mi ha morso in
quella grotta.

entries.original:
"My friend has many cute Pokémon.
I’m so jealous!"
entries.translation_source: My friend has many cute Pokémon. I’m so jealous!
entries.translated: La mia amica ha tanti Pokémon carini. Sono così geloso!

entries.original:
"You came from Icicle Cave?
May I have a Swinub?"
entries.translation_source: You came from Icicle Cave? May I have a Swinub?
entries.translated:
Sei venuto dalla Grotta di
Ghiaccio? Posso avere uno Swinub?

entries.original:
"Let’s watch them set up hazards
when you’re around, Hitmontop!

We’ll dominate [green]OU Doubles[blue]!

All will fall beneath your head
spike!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s watch them set up hazards when you’re around, Hitmontop! We’ll dominate [color-green-1]OU Doubles[color-blue-2]! All will fall beneath your head spike!
entries.translated:
Guardiamo come piazzano le trappole
quando ci sei tu, Hitmontop!\lDomineremo il [green]Doppio OU[blue]! Tutti

cadranno sotto la tua punta sul
capo!

entries.original: "Pokémon Day Care"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon Day Care
entries.translated: Pensione Pokémon

entries.original:
"When Pokémon gain enough
experience, they can evolve and\lgrow stronger.

Some even learn special moves after
evolution.

However, not all Pokémon can
evolve just by battling enough.

Some require special items like
[green]Fire Stones[blue] or [green]Water Stones[blue]."
entries.translation_source: When Pokémon gain enough experience, they can evolve and grow stronger. Some even learn special moves after evolution. However, not all Pokémon can evolve just by battling enough. Some require special items like [color-green-1]Fire Stones[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Water Stones[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Quando i Pokémon accumulano
abbastanza esperienza, possono\levolversi e diventare più forti.

Alcuni imparano persino mosse
speciali dopo l{B4}evoluzione.\lTuttavia, non tutti i Pokémon

possono evolversi solo combattendo
abbastanza. Alcuni richiedono\lstrumenti speciali come

[green]Pietrafocaia[blue] o [green]Pietraidrica[blue].

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Here’s a taste of what’ll
happen to you if you spill!"
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Here’s a taste of what’ll happen to you if you spill!
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Ecco un assaggio di quello
che ti succederà se spifferi!

entries.original:
"If I had my full team on me, you
would’ve lost!"
entries.translation_source: If I had my full team on me, you would’ve lost!
entries.translated: Se avessi con me tutta la mia squadra, avresti perso!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Oh, Ivory\.

How could you and Marlon both fail
me?

I thought you were stronger than
this\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Oh, Ivory[game-token-2] How could you and Marlon both fail me? I thought you were stronger than this[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Oh, Ivory\. Come hai potuto
deludermi tu e Marlon? Pensavo\lfoste più forti di così\.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Zeph, we’re scientists.

We’re not meant to be doing this
kind of thing\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Zeph, we’re scientists. We’re not meant to be doing this kind of thing[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Zeph, siamo scienziati. Non
dovremmo fare una cosa del genere\.

entries.original: "\au Pokemon Day Care"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] Pokemon Day Care
entries.translated: \au Asilo Pokémon

entries.original:
"The bookshelf by the wall has
great books on advanced battling\ltechniques.

Right now, I’m studying up on the
various [green]Terrains [blue]and their\leffects in battle.

You should definitely check it out
if you’re aiming for the top."
entries.translation_source: The bookshelf by the wall has great books on advanced battling techniques. Right now, I’m studying up on the various [color-green-1]Terrains [color-blue-2]and their effects in battle. You should definitely check it out if you’re aiming for the top.
entries.translated:
La libreria accanto alla parete ha
ottimi libri sulle tecniche\lavanzate di lotta. In questo

momento sto studiando i vari
[green]Terreni [blue]e i loro effetti in\lbattaglia. Dovresti assolutamente

dargli un{B4}occhiata se punti al
vertice.

entries.original:
"Hah!

Those [green]Protective Pads [blue]look great
on you, Krook!

The next time we come up against a
[green]Ferrothorn [blue]holding a [green]Rocky Helmet[blue],\lit’ll be in for a real shocker!"
entries.translation_source: Hah! Those [color-green-1]Protective Pads [color-blue-2]look great on you, Krook! The next time we come up against a [color-green-3]Ferrothorn [color-blue-4]holding a [color-green-5]Rocky Helmet[color-blue-6], it’ll be in for a real shocker!
entries.translated:
Ah! Quei [green]Paracolpi [blue]ti stanno
benissimo, Krook! La prossima volta\lche ci troveremo contro un

[green]Ferrothorn [blue]che tiene uno [green]Elmo
Roccioso[blue], sarà una vera sorpresa!

entries.original:
"As you can clearly see, the Battle
Tower is a great facility.

Apparently, there are similar
facilities dotted around Borrius."
entries.translation_source: As you can clearly see, the Battle Tower is a great facility. Apparently, there are similar facilities dotted around Borrius.
entries.translated:
Come puoi vedere chiaramente, la
Torre Lotta è una grande struttura.\lA quanto pare, ci sono strutture

simili sparse per tutto Borrius.

entries.original:
"Do you see that [green]Porygon[red]?

If you talk to it, you can directly
interface with the Pokémon Storage\lSystem!

Why use a PC when a Pokémon can do
it for you?"
entries.translation_source: Do you see that [color-green-1]Porygon[color-red-2]? If you talk to it, you can directly interface with the Pokémon Storage System! Why use a PC when a Pokémon can do it for you?
entries.translated:
Vedi quel [green]Porygon[red]? Se gli parli,
puoi interfacciarti direttamente\lcon il Sistema di Deposito Pokémon!

Perché usare un PC quando un
Pokémon può farlo per te?

entries.original:
"Does battling this high up make
you feel elated?"
entries.translation_source: Does battling this high up make you feel elated?
entries.translated: Combattere così in alto ti fa sentire euforico?

entries.original: "Maybe I’m just high\."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I’m just high[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Forse sono solo molto in alto\.

entries.original:
"Huh?
I don’t do Oddish Leaves!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? I don’t do Oddish Leaves!
entries.translated: Eh? Non scambio Foglie di Oddish!

entries.original:
"I’ve been here for days, but I
can’t seem to catch anything good."
entries.translation_source: I’ve been here for days, but I can’t seem to catch anything good.
entries.translated: Sono qui da giorni, ma non riesco a catturare niente di buono.

entries.original:
"As soon as we finished the bridge
to this new entrance, the walls\lcracked open and the sea water\lstarted flooding in!

Because why would we get a day off?"
entries.translation_source: As soon as we finished the bridge to this new entrance, the walls cracked open and the sea water started flooding in! Because why would we get a day off?
entries.translated:
Non appena abbiamo finito il ponte
verso questo nuovo ingresso, le\lpareti si sono spaccate e l{B4}acqua

di mare ha cominciato a irrompere
all{B4}interno! Perché mai dovremmo\lavere un giorno libero?

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, this road is closed at
the moment.

We’re about to undertake a major
drug bust, and we can’t let anyone\lescape!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, this road is closed at the moment. We’re about to undertake a major drug bust, and we can’t let anyone escape!
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace, questa strada è chiusa
al momento. Stiamo per portare a\ltermine un{B4}importante retata

antidroga, e non possiamo lasciar
scappare nessuno!

entries.original:
"Get moving [player].

You don’t want to miss Jax taking
on The Shadows."
entries.translation_source: Get moving [player-name-1]. You don’t want to miss Jax taking on The Shadows.
entries.translated:
Muoviti [player]. Non vuoi perderti
Jax contro The Shadows.

entries.original:
"I will uncover the secrets of
Cinder Volcano!"
entries.translation_source: I will uncover the secrets of Cinder Volcano!
entries.translated:
Svelerò i segreti del Vulcano
Cinder!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Hold the [green]B-button[black] to run!

Press the [green]L-button[black] to toggle
auto-run!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Hold the [color-green-1]B-button[color-black-2] to run! Press the [color-green-3]L-button[color-black-4] to toggle auto-run!
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Tieni
premuto il [green]pulsante B[black] per correre!\lPremi il [green]pulsante L[black] per

attivare/disattivare la corsa
automatica!

entries.original: "???: [blue][buffer3]’s unconcious, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1][buffer3-2]’s unconcious, Hoopa.
entries.translated: ???: [blue][buffer3] è svenuto, Hoopa.

entries.original:
"Stop!

What did I tell you about
travelling through my Cube Space?

Just because you can’t travel
through your Rings, it doesn’t\lmean you can use my Cube without\lpermission!"
entries.translation_source: Stop! What did I tell you about travelling through my Cube Space? Just because you can’t travel through your Rings, it doesn’t mean you can use my Cube without permission!
entries.translated:
Fermati! Cosa ti ho detto sul
viaggiare attraverso il mio Cube\lSpace? Solo perché non puoi

viaggiare attraverso i tuoi Rings,
non significa che tu possa usare il\lmio Cube senza permesso!

entries.original:
"And were you responsible for
bringing these two here?"
entries.translation_source: And were you responsible for bringing these two here?
entries.translated:
E sei stato tu a portare qui questi
due?

entries.original:
"I don’t know what you wanted with
them, but you’ve been a nuisance\lever since I found you on that\lbeach 16 years ago!

I may not be your true \qoguardian\qc,
but I’m your trainer now!

And you will obey me!

These two won’t rescue you from me!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t know what you wanted with them, but you’ve been a nuisance ever since I found you on that beach 16 years ago! I may not be your true [quote-open-1]guardian[quote-close-2], but I’m your trainer now! And you will obey me! These two won’t rescue you from me!
entries.translated:
Non so cosa volessi farne, ma sei
stato una seccatura da quando ti ho\ltrovato su quella spiaggia 16 anni

fa! Potrei non essere il tuo vero
\qoguardiano\qc, ma ora sono il tuo\lAllenatore! E tu mi obbedirai!

Questi due non ti salveranno da me!

entries.original: "What a pain\."
entries.translation_source: What a pain[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Che seccatura\.

entries.original:
"Where do you think you’re going,
kid?

I’m under strict orders to keep you
locked up."
entries.translation_source: Where do you think you’re going, kid? I’m under strict orders to keep you locked up.
entries.translated:
Dove credi di andare, ragazzo? Ho
ordini severi di tenerti rinchiuso.

entries.original:
"He’s unconscious.
Better leave him alone for now."
entries.translation_source: He’s unconscious. Better leave him alone for now.
entries.translated:
È svenuto. Meglio lasciarlo stare
per ora.

entries.original:
"He’s unconscious.

What’s this?

There’s something written on his
shirt.

It’s his name!
It is\."
entries.translation_source: He’s unconscious. What’s this? There’s something written on his shirt. It’s his name! It is[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
È incosciente. Cos{B4}è questo? C{B4}è
qualcosa scritto sulla sua\lmaglietta. È il suo nome! È\.

entries.original: "Is his name [rival]?"
entries.translation_source: Is his name [text-token-rival-1]?
entries.translated: Si chiama [rival]?

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]\.

Huh? What’s going on?
Where am I?"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2][game-token-3] Huh? What’s going on? Where am I?
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]\. Eh? Che succede? Dove
sono?

entries.original:
"What’s going on?

\.

Oh, wait\.

You’re that kid from down the
road.

[player], right?

Do you know what we’re doing here?"
entries.translation_source: What’s going on? [game-token-1] Oh, wait[game-token-2] You’re that kid from down the road. [player-name-3], right? Do you know what we’re doing here?
entries.translated:
Che sta succedendo? \. Oh, aspetta\.
Sei quel ragazzino giù per la\lstrada. [player], giusto? Sai cosa

stiamo facendo qui?

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Looks like I’m here.

I’d better get moving then."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Looks like I’m here. I’d better get moving then.
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Sembra che io sia arrivato.
Farei meglio a muovermi, allora.

entries.original:
"There are so many Fire Pokémon
here!"
entries.translation_source: There are so many Fire Pokémon here!
entries.translated: Ci sono così tanti Pokémon di tipo Fuoco qui!

entries.original: "I’m just burning up with happiness!"
entries.translation_source: I’m just burning up with happiness!
entries.translated: Sono in fiamme dalla felicità!

entries.original:
"Maybe I should check if I have a
fever\."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should check if I have a fever[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Forse dovrei controllare se ho la
febbre\.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Duskull, use Shadow Sneak!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Duskull, use Shadow Sneak!
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Duskull, usa Furtivombra!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Your shadowy reign of terror
stops here and now!

I won’t let you escape from Cinder
Volcano with Moltres in hand!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Your shadowy reign of terror stops here and now! I won’t let you escape from Cinder Volcano with Moltres in hand!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]La tua oscura reggenza del
terrore finisce qui e ora! Non ti\llascerò fuggire dal Vulcano

Cenerino con Moltres in pugno!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]INSOLENT WHELP!

Who do you think you are
to threaten The Shadows!?

We’ve been ordered to assist Lady
Ivory, so don’t even think for a\lsecond that you can stop us!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]INSOLENT WHELP! Who do you think you are to threaten The Shadows!? We’ve been ordered to assist Lady Ivory, so don’t even think for a second that you can stop us!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]MUCCO INSOLENTE! Chi credi
di essere per minacciare le Ombre!?\lAbbiamo ricevuto l{B4}ordine di

assistere Lady Ivory, quindi non
pensare nemmeno per un secondo di\lpoterci fermare!

entries.original: "Ivory: [red]Well spoken, Marlon."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Well spoken, Marlon.
entries.translated: Ivory: [red]Ben detto, Marlon.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Moltres is sealed away.

I’m heading back to HQ.

You might want to take care of that
kid watching, before you join me."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Moltres is sealed away. I’m heading back to HQ. You might want to take care of that kid watching, before you join me.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Moltres è sigillato. Sto
tornando all{B4}HQ. Potresti occuparti\ldi quel ragazzino che fa la

guardia, prima di raggiungermi.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Ohh...
My head..."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Ohh... My head...
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Ohh... La mia testa...

entries.original:
"[blue]Ahh...

That hurt quite a bit.

Let’s head back to my grandfather’s
house to tell him what happened."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Ahh... That hurt quite a bit. Let’s head back to my grandfather’s house to tell him what happened.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ahh... Questo ha fatto piuttosto
male. Torniamo a casa di mio nonno\lper raccontargli cosa è successo.

entries.original:
"[blue]Wha...
How could I lose!?

I’ll retreat for now, but I won’t
forget this!

You’ll be seeing me again soon!

I guarantee it\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Wha... How could I lose!? I’ll retreat for now, but I won’t forget this! You’ll be seeing me again soon! I guarantee it[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Wha... Come ho potuto perdere!? Per
ora mi ritirerò, ma non me ne\ldimenticherò! Ci rivedremo presto!

Lo garantisco\.

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]Hmm\.

This isn’t good.

At this point, only one Legendary
bird remains, [green]Zapdos[blue].

It’s imperative that it be rescued
before The Shadows can capture it."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [color-blue-1]Hmm[game-token-2] This isn’t good. At this point, only one Legendary bird remains, [color-green-3]Zapdos[color-blue-4]. It’s imperative that it be rescued before The Shadows can capture it.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Hmm\. Non va bene. A questo
punto, resta solo un uccello\lleggendario, [green]Zapdos[blue]. È fondamentale

che venga salvato prima che le
Ombre possano catturarlo.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Understood, Grandpa.

I’ll go to it right away."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Understood, Grandpa. I’ll go to it right away.
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Ricevuto, nonno. Ci vado
subito.

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]Actually, Jax, I have a
different task for you.

To the best of my knowledge, The
Shadows are still missing the\lobject used to seal away the dark\lforce.

A friend of mine that lives on
[green]Route 9, [blue]should know its location.

Go to him and explain the sitution.

I’m sure he’ll be willing to help
us find it before The Shadows do."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [color-blue-1]Actually, Jax, I have a different task for you. To the best of my knowledge, The Shadows are still missing the object used to seal away the dark force. A friend of mine that lives on [color-green-2]Route 9, [color-blue-3]should know its location. Go to him and explain the sitution. I’m sure he’ll be willing to help us find it before The Shadows do.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]In realtà, Jax, ho un
compito diverso per te. Per quanto\lne so, Le Ombre stanno ancora

cercando l{B4}oggetto usato per
sigillare la forza oscura. Un mio\lamico che abita sul [green]Percorso 9,

[blue]dovrebbe conoscere la sua
posizione. Vai da lui e spiega la\lsituazione. Sono sicuro che sarà

disposto ad aiutarci a trovarlo
prima che Le Ombre lo facciano.

entries.original: "Jax: [blue]Okay, Grandpa."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Okay, Grandpa.
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Va bene, nonno.

entries.original:
"Arthur: [blue]Good, good.

As for you, [player], I want you
to head to [green]Thundercap Mt. [blue]and\lsave [green]Zapdos[blue].

You’ve proven yourself by defending
Jax back in Cinder Volcano, and I\lthink you’re up for the task.

You can get to [green]Thundercap Mt. [blue]
by taking the highway southeast\lfrom the next town over, [green]Crater\lTown[blue].

If you don’t hurry, the Borrius
region will be doomed."
entries.translation_source: Arthur: [color-blue-1]Good, good. As for you, [player-name-2], I want you to head to [color-green-3]Thundercap Mt. [color-blue-4]and save [color-green-5]Zapdos[color-blue-6]. You’ve proven yourself by defending Jax back in Cinder Volcano, and I think you’re up for the task. You can get to [color-green-7]Thundercap Mt. [color-blue-8] by taking the highway southeast from the next town over, [color-green-9]Crater Town[color-blue-10]. If you don’t hurry, the Borrius region will be doomed.
entries.translated:
Arthur: [blue]Bene, bene. Quanto a te,
[player], voglio che tu vada al\l[green]Monte Thundercap. [blue]e salvi [green]Zapdos[blue].

Hai dimostrato il tuo valore
difendendo Jax al Vulcano Cinder, e\lpenso che tu sia all{B4}altezza del

compito. Puoi arrivare al [green]Monte
Thundercap. [blue] prendendo l{B4}autostrada\la sud-est dalla prossima città,

[green]Città Cratere[blue]. Se non ti sbrighi,
la regione di Borrius sarà\lcondannata.

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]I’ll be heading back to [green]Frozen
Heights[blue], [player].

I’ll let your mother know what the
situation is."
entries.translation_source: Log: [color-blue-1]I’ll be heading back to [color-green-2]Frozen Heights[color-blue-3], [player-name-4]. I’ll let your mother know what the situation is.
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Tornerò a [green]Frozen Heights[blue],
[player]. Farò sapere a tua madre\lqual è la situazione.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]My Staraptor is still pretty
weak from that fight from before,\lbut I should be able to give you a\lride up to Cinder Volcano.

We don’t have much time, so let’s
head out right away."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]My Staraptor is still pretty weak from that fight from before, but I should be able to give you a ride up to Cinder Volcano. We don’t have much time, so let’s head out right away.
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Il mio Staraptor è ancora
piuttosto debole per lo scontro di\lprima, ma dovrei riuscire a darti

un passaggio fino al Cinder
Volcano. Non abbiamo molto tempo,\lquindi andiamo subito.

entries.original:
"Á
9999999999999Crater Town is an ideal place for
researchers like myself.

So much history\.

So much mystery\."
entries.translation_source: Á 9999999999999Crater Town is an ideal place for researchers like myself. So much history[game-token-1] So much mystery[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Á 9999999999999Crater Town è il
luogo ideale per ricercatori come\lme. Così tanta storia\. Così tanto

mistero\.

entries.original:
"The meteorites in Crater Town are
imbued with some sort of cosmic\lpower.

They say that if a certain
Pokémon comes in contact with\lone, strange things will happen."
entries.translation_source: The meteorites in Crater Town are imbued with some sort of cosmic power. They say that if a certain Pokémon comes in contact with one, strange things will happen.
entries.translated:
I meteoriti di Crater Town sono
impregnati di una sorta di potere\lcosmico. Si dice che se un certo

Pokémon entra in contatto con uno
di essi, accadranno cose strane.

entries.original:
"Through that cave over there is
another way to leave Crater Town.

But since you need the Darkness
Badge to access it, most people\ljust stick to the SES Expressway."
entries.translation_source: Through that cave over there is another way to leave Crater Town. But since you need the Darkness Badge to access it, most people just stick to the SES Expressway.
entries.translated:
Attraverso quella grotta laggiù c{B4}è
un altro modo per uscire da Crater\lTown. Ma dato che per accedervi ti

serve la Darkness Badge, la maggior
parte della gente si limita a\lprendere la SES Expressway.

entries.original:
"It’s a mysterious meteorite that
fell from the stars."
entries.translation_source: It’s a mysterious meteorite that fell from the stars.
entries.translated:
È un misterioso meteorite caduto
dalle stelle.

entries.original:
"There appears to be a hidden path
behind the bookshelf.

Would you like to follow it?"
entries.translation_source: There appears to be a hidden path behind the bookshelf. Would you like to follow it?
entries.translated:
Sembra esserci un passaggio segreto
dietro la libreria. Vuoi seguirlo?

entries.original: "The trash can is empty."
entries.translation_source: The trash can is empty.
entries.translated: Il cestino è vuoto.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Dresco Town Trainer
House!

Feel free to battle our five
trainers as many times as you want.

If you wish to rebattle someone,
please leave and come back in.

Enjoy your time!"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Dresco Town Trainer House! Feel free to battle our five trainers as many times as you want. If you wish to rebattle someone, please leave and come back in. Enjoy your time!
entries.translated:
Benvenuto alla Casa Allenatori di
Dresco Town! Sentiti libero di\lsfidare i nostri cinque Allenatori

tutte le volte che vuoi. Se
desideri riaffrontare qualcuno,\lesci e rientra. Divertiti!

entries.original:
"My water types will soak you to
your core!"
entries.translation_source: My water types will soak you to your core!
entries.translated: I miei tipi Acqua ti inzuppano fino al midollo!

entries.original: "You’ve dried up my water."
entries.translation_source: You’ve dried up my water.
entries.translated: Mi hai prosciugato l{B4}acqua.

entries.original:
"Hello, there.

Wait\.

Can it be\.

Are you the [buffer1] of the
legendary Arceus trainer, [green]Aros[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Hello, there. Wait[game-token-1] Can it be[game-token-2] Are you the [buffer1-3] of the legendary Arceus trainer, [color-green-4]Aros[color-blue-5]?
entries.translated:
Salve. Aspetta\. Può essere\. Sei il
[buffer1] dell{B4}allenatore\lleggendario di Arceus, [green]Aros[blue]?

entries.original: "Taste my dark fury!"
entries.translation_source: Taste my dark fury!
entries.translated: Assaggia la mia furia oscura!

entries.original:
"My rage and power only grow from
this defeat."
entries.translation_source: My rage and power only grow from this defeat.
entries.translated: La mia rabbia e la mia forza crescono solo da questa sconfitta.

entries.original:
"Hey there [buffer1]\.

How’z it hangin’?

You wanna sniff on some
Oddish Leaves?

They’re really good for the soul.
Makes it nice and mellow\."
entries.translation_source: Hey there [buffer1-1][game-token-2] How’z it hangin’? You wanna sniff on some Oddish Leaves? They’re really good for the soul. Makes it nice and mellow[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ehilà [buffer1]\. Come va? Vuoi
fiutare un po{B4} di Foglie di Oddish?\lFanno davvero bene all{B4}anima. Ti

fanno stare bello tranquillo\.

entries.original:
"[black]You sniffed on some Oddish Leaves.

The repugnant scent assails your
nostrils."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]You sniffed on some Oddish Leaves. The repugnant scent assails your nostrils.
entries.translated:
[black]Hai annusato delle foglie di
Oddish. Il fetore ripugnante ti\lassale le narici.

entries.original:
"Now, I’m guessin’ you came for a
battle?

I’m in the perfect mood to indulge
you\."
entries.translation_source: Now, I’m guessin’ you came for a battle? I’m in the perfect mood to indulge you[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Beh, immagino che tu sia qui per
una lotta? Sono nel perfetto stato\ld{B4}animo per accontentarti\.

entries.original: "My grass types will help me win!"
entries.translation_source: My grass types will help me win!
entries.translated: I miei tipi Erba mi aiuteranno a vincere!

entries.original:
"My brother caught his Pokémon
by talking a Poké Ball in\lVivill Woods.

But I heard different Pokémon
appear for different trainers."
entries.translation_source: My brother caught his Pokémon by talking a Poké Ball in Vivill Woods. But I heard different Pokémon appear for different trainers.
entries.translated:
Mio fratello ha catturato il suo
Pokémon parlando a una Poké Ball\lnella Foresta di Vivill. Però ho

sentito che Pokémon diversi
compaiono per Allenatori diversi.

entries.original:
"They say the warehouse on the hill
was abadoned after some experiment\lwent horribly wrong inside."
entries.translation_source: They say the warehouse on the hill was abadoned after some experiment went horribly wrong inside.
entries.translated:
Si dice che il magazzino sulla
collina sia stato abbandonato dopo\lche un esperimento lì dentro è

andato terribilmente storto.

entries.original:
"You came down from the mountain?

It must feel pretty warm to you
here."
entries.translation_source: You came down from the mountain? It must feel pretty warm to you here.
entries.translated:
Sei sceso dalla montagna? Qui deve
sembrarti piuttosto caldo.

entries.original:
"Normally when the road is clear,
you can visit Dewp’s Bike Shop and\lget some handy bikes!"
entries.translation_source: Normally when the road is clear, you can visit Dewp’s Bike Shop and get some handy bikes!
entries.translated:
Di solito, quando la strada è
libera, puoi andare da Dewp{B4}s Bike\lShop e prendere delle utili

biciclette!

entries.original: "I love running around on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: I love running around on the beach!
entries.translated: Adoro correre in giro sulla spiaggia!

entries.original: "Oh no, you beat me!"
entries.translation_source: Oh no, you beat me!
entries.translated: Oh no, mi hai battuto!

entries.original:
"No matter how many times I lose, I
will always play after!"
entries.translation_source: No matter how many times I lose, I will always play after!
entries.translated:
Non importa quante volte perda,
giocherò sempre ancora!

entries.original: "I’m where I love to be."
entries.translation_source: I’m where I love to be.
entries.translated: Sono dove amo stare.

entries.original:
"        It’s you!
The big [buffer1] who saved me!

You’re the best!"
entries.translation_source: It’s you! The big [buffer1-1] who saved me! You’re the best!
entries.translated: Sei tu! Il grande [buffer1] che mi ha salvato! Sei il migliore!

entries.original:
"The warehouse on the hill has sat
abandoned for as long as I can\lremember.

Apparently it goes so deep into the
ground, there were floors unused by\leven the gang that was there.

I can only imagine what treasures
they hold!"
entries.translation_source: The warehouse on the hill has sat abandoned for as long as I can remember. Apparently it goes so deep into the ground, there were floors unused by even the gang that was there. I can only imagine what treasures they hold!
entries.translated:
Il magazzino sulla collina è
abbandonato da quando me ne\lricordo. A quanto pare scende così

in profondità nel terreno che ci
sono piani rimasti inutilizzati\lpersino dalla banda che ci stava

dentro. Posso solo immaginare quali
tesori custodiscano!

entries.original:
"The SES Expressway runs from Crater
Town to Tehl Town beneath us."
entries.translation_source: The SES Expressway runs from Crater Town to Tehl Town beneath us.
entries.translated:
La SES Expressway passa da Crater
Town a Tehl Town sotto di noi.

entries.original:
"I wonder how much weight the ground
can hold up?"
entries.translation_source: I wonder how much weight the ground can hold up?
entries.translated: Chissà quanto peso può reggere il terreno?

entries.original: "Enough for a good battle!"
entries.translation_source: Enough for a good battle!
entries.translated: Abbastanza per una bella battaglia!

entries.original:
"If 100 people like me stood here,
do you the ground could support it?"
entries.translation_source: If 100 people like me stood here, do you the ground could support it?
entries.translated:
Se qui ci fossero 100 persone come
me, pensi che il terreno\lreggerebbe?

entries.original: "I love having picnics on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: I love having picnics on the beach!
entries.translated: Adoro fare picnic sulla spiaggia!

entries.original: "You ruined my picnic!"
entries.translation_source: You ruined my picnic!
entries.translated: Hai rovinato il mio picnic!

entries.original:
"If only there was someone to have a
picnic with\."
entries.translation_source: If only there was someone to have a picnic with[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Se solo ci fosse qualcuno con cui
fare un picnic\.

entries.original: "What are you looking at?"
entries.translation_source: What are you looking at?
entries.translated: Che cosa stai guardando?

entries.original: "I’m just relaxing here."
entries.translation_source: I’m just relaxing here.
entries.translated: Sto solo rilassandomi qui.

entries.original:
"Even roughnecks like me need a
break once in a while."
entries.translation_source: Even roughnecks like me need a break once in a while.
entries.translated:
Anche tipi tosti come me hanno
bisogno di una pausa ogni tanto.

entries.original:
"Wahahah! This dude’s going to catch
himself a big one!"
entries.translation_source: Wahahah! This dude’s going to catch himself a big one!
entries.translated: Wahahah! Questo tipo si prenderà un bel pescione!

entries.original: "This dude just lost one\."
entries.translation_source: This dude just lost one[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Questo tizio ha appena perso uno\.

entries.original:
"When those strange thugs marched
into town, we were all sure to lock\lour doors very quickly.

If we hadn’t, they most likely
would’ve barged right in like you,\land taken all our valuables for\ltheir nefarious plot,"
entries.translation_source: When those strange thugs marched into town, we were all sure to lock our doors very quickly. If we hadn’t, they most likely would’ve barged right in like you, and taken all our valuables for their nefarious plot,
entries.translated:
Quando quei strani teppisti sono
entrati in città, abbiamo tutti\lchiuso in fretta a chiave le porte.

Se non l{B4}avessimo fatto, molto
probabilmente sarebbero entrati di\lprepotenza proprio come te, e

avrebbero preso tutti i nostri
oggetti di valore per il loro\lsinistro complotto,

entries.original:
"This dude thinks you’re a big one.
No, you’re a big-one-to-be!"
entries.translation_source: This dude thinks you’re a big one. No, you’re a big-one-to-be!
entries.translated:
Questo tipo pensa che tu sia un
pezzo grosso. No, sei un pezzo\lgrosso in divenire!

entries.original:
"Oh, no! I’ve got this feeling I’ll hook
a big one!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! I’ve got this feeling I’ll hook a big one!
entries.translated:
Oh, no! Ho la sensazione che ne
prenderò uno grosso!

entries.original:
"I must refine the art of concealment.
I bid thee farewell."
entries.translation_source: I must refine the art of concealment. I bid thee farewell.
entries.translated:
Devo perfezionare l{B4}arte del
nascondimento. Ti saluto.

entries.original:
"I’ve been in the hot sand and
refreshed my tired bones.\lRight now I’m feeling strong!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve been in the hot sand and refreshed my tired bones. Right now I’m feeling strong!
entries.translated: Sono stato nella sabbia rovente e ho rinvigorito le mie ossa stanche. Adesso mi sento forte!

entries.original:
"Oh, my goodness.
Now, aren’t you something!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, my goodness. Now, aren’t you something!
entries.translated: Oh, cielo. Adesso sei proprio qualcosa!

entries.original:
"Well, well, I’ve lost. I can’t call
myself an Expert now, can I?"
entries.translation_source: Well, well, I’ve lost. I can’t call myself an Expert now, can I?
entries.translated:
Beh, beh, ho perso. Ora non posso
più definirmi un Esperto, vero?

entries.original:
"It’d be a handful if I hooked
your tough Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: It’d be a handful if I hooked your tough Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Sarebbe una bella scocciatura se
agganciassi i tuoi Pokémon tosti!

entries.original: "Stay safe in the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Stay safe in the Great Desert!
entries.translated: Stai attento nel Grande Deserto!

entries.original:
"There used to be a Clefairy by
the bookshelf a long time ago.

I wonder where it went?"
entries.translation_source: There used to be a Clefairy by the bookshelf a long time ago. I wonder where it went?
entries.translated:
C{B4}era una Clefairy accanto alla
libreria tanto tempo fa. Mi chiedo\ldove sia andata?

entries.original:
"How’s about I toss a free [green]TM[blue]
your way?"
entries.translation_source: How’s about I toss a free [color-green-1]TM[color-blue-2] your way?
entries.translated:
Che ne dici se ti lancio una [green]MT[blue]
gratuita?

entries.original: "Would you like to open the door?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to open the door?
entries.translated: Vuoi aprire la porta?

entries.original: "The door is open."
entries.translation_source: The door is open.
entries.translated: La porta è aperta.

entries.original: "Would you like to open the door?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to open the door?
entries.translated: Vuoi aprire la porta?

entries.original: "The door is open."
entries.translation_source: The door is open.
entries.translated: La porta è aperta.

entries.original:
"The people who live here aren’t
letting me in, so I’m forced to sit\lout here."
entries.translation_source: The people who live here aren’t letting me in, so I’m forced to sit out here.
entries.translated:
Le persone che vivono qui non mi
fanno entrare, quindi sono\lcostretto a restare qui fuori.

entries.original:
"People say that to the east of the
city is a hidden forest with a\lpowerful Pokémon inside.

But it’s probably just a rumour, so
most people tend to ignore it."
entries.translation_source: People say that to the east of the city is a hidden forest with a powerful Pokémon inside. But it’s probably just a rumour, so most people tend to ignore it.
entries.translated:
La gente dice che a est della città
c{B4}è una foresta nascosta con un\lPokémon potente al suo interno. Ma

probabilmente è solo una voce,
quindi la maggior parte della gente\ltende a ignorarla.

entries.original:
"I’m eating roasted Snover!
It’s so delicious!"
entries.translation_source: I’m eating roasted Snover! It’s so delicious!
entries.translated:
Sto mangiando Snover arrosto! È
squisito!

entries.original:
"Some guy in one of the residences
around here is giving away an item\lthat allows you to rebattle\ltrainers.

But it doesn’t really work so well
on the mountain coming up here\lsince all of those trainers are\ldead tired."
entries.translation_source: Some guy in one of the residences around here is giving away an item that allows you to rebattle trainers. But it doesn’t really work so well on the mountain coming up here since all of those trainers are dead tired.
entries.translated:
Sai, un tizio in una delle
abitazioni qui intorno sta\ldistribuendo un oggetto che ti

permette di sfidare di nuovo gli
allenatori. Ma non funziona poi\lcosì bene sulla montagna che c{B4}è

più avanti, visto che tutti quegli
allenatori sono stremati.

entries.original:
"Hey! Listen up.

Have you been travelling and
noticed some boulders in your path\lthat you just couldn’t budge?

Well there’s a guy in Epidimy Town
who is the master of teaching\lPokémon how to move big boulders.

Talk to him ASAP if you want to
move those pesky things."
entries.translation_source: Hey! Listen up. Have you been travelling and noticed some boulders in your path that you just couldn’t budge? Well there’s a guy in Epidimy Town who is the master of teaching Pokémon how to move big boulders. Talk to him ASAP if you want to move those pesky things.
entries.translated:
Ehi! Ascolta bene. Viaggiando ti
sarà capitato di vedere alcuni\lmassi sulla tua strada che proprio

non riuscivi a smuovere? Ecco, c{B4}è
un tizio a Epidimy Town che è un\lmaestro nell{B4}insegnare ai Pokémon

come spostare grossi massi. Parlaci
al più presto se vuoi spostare\lquelle seccature.

entries.original: "Try going the other way."
entries.translation_source: Try going the other way.
entries.translated: Prova a prendere l{B4}altra strada.

entries.original:
"Sorry bud, but this isn’t the right
way to go."
entries.translation_source: Sorry bud, but this isn’t the right way to go.
entries.translated:
Scusa, amico, ma questa non è la
strada giusta.

entries.original:
"The fans make the gym really
confusing."
entries.translation_source: The fans make the gym really confusing.
entries.translated:
Le ventole rendono la palestra
davvero confusa.

entries.original:
"I swear\.

Those weird guys have been blocking
off [green]Route 9[blue] for days\.

I wonder what they’re up to?"
entries.translation_source: I swear[game-token-1] Those weird guys have been blocking off [color-green-2]Route 9[color-blue-3] for days[game-token-4] I wonder what they’re up to?
entries.translated:
Lo giuro\. Quei tipi strani bloccano
[green]Percorso 9[blue] da giorni\. Mi chiedo cosa\lstiano combinando?

entries.original:
"[red]Gliscor!
Use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Gliscor! Use Rock Smash!
entries.translated: [red]Gliscor! Usa Spaccaroccia!

entries.original:
"[red]Gliscor!
Return!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Gliscor! Return!
entries.translated: [red]Gliscor! Torna!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Staraptor!
Use Aerial Ace!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Staraptor! Use Aerial Ace!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Staraptor! Usa Aeroassalto!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Tell me how to get past the
barrier on Route 9!

I don’t have time to deal with you
Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Tell me how to get past the barrier on Route 9! I don’t have time to deal with you Shadows!

Icicle Cave, prove it to me by\ldelivering [green]Log’s package [blue]to him."
entries.translation_source: Stop! Where do you think you’re going? If you think you’re ready to handle Icicle Cave, prove it to me by delivering [color-green-1]Log’s package [color-blue-2]to him.
entries.translated:
Fermo! Dove credi di andare? Se
pensi di essere pronto ad\laffrontare la Grotta Ghiacciata,

dimostramelo consegnando [green]il pacco
di Log[blue] a lui.

entries.original:
"I [green]chain[blue] my fishing so I can see
[green]Shiny[blue] Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I [color-green-1]chain[color-blue-2] my fishing so I can see [color-green-3]Shiny[color-blue-4] Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Uso la [green]pesca a catena[blue] così posso
vedere Pokémon [green]cromatici[blue].

entries.original:
"Hello there stranger!

Be careful when travelling through
Icicle Cave.

It may not seem that big, but it is
bigger than you would think!"
entries.translation_source: Hello there stranger! Be careful when travelling through Icicle Cave. It may not seem that big, but it is bigger than you would think!
entries.translated:
Salve, straniero! Fai attenzione
quando viaggi attraverso Icicle\lCave. Potrebbe non sembrare così

grande, ma è più grande di quanto
penseresti!

entries.original:
"My Rattata is the best you will
ever see!"
entries.translation_source: My Rattata is the best you will ever see!
entries.translated: Il mio Rattata è il migliore che vedrai mai!

entries.original: "My Rattata is still the best."
entries.translation_source: My Rattata is still the best.
entries.translated: Il mio Rattata è ancora il migliore.

entries.original:
"I’m going to make my Rattata even
stronger!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to make my Rattata even stronger!
entries.translated:
Renderò il mio Rattata ancora più
forte!

entries.original:
"When Pokémon evolve, they get
stronger.

But there is a benefit for not
evolving your Pokémon right away.

Pokémon that can still evolve can
utilise an [green]Eviolite[blue] to become\ltougher to beat in battle.

I have an extra, so why don’t you
take one?"
entries.translation_source: When Pokémon evolve, they get stronger. But there is a benefit for not evolving your Pokémon right away. Pokémon that can still evolve can utilise an [color-green-1]Eviolite[color-blue-2] to become tougher to beat in battle. I have an extra, so why don’t you take one?
entries.translated:
Quando i Pokémon si evolvono,
diventano più forti. Ma c{B4}è un\lvantaggio nel non far evolvere

subito i tuoi Pokémon. I Pokémon
che possono ancora evolversi\lpossono utilizzare un [green]Evolcondensa[blue]

per diventare più difficili da
battere in lotta. Ne ho uno in più,\lquindi perché non prenderne uno?

entries.original:
"Have a Pokémon that can still
evolve hold an [green]Eviolite[blue] in battle\lto double its defenses."
entries.translation_source: Have a Pokémon that can still evolve hold an [color-green-1]Eviolite[color-blue-2] in battle to double its defenses.
entries.translated:
Fai tenere in lotta a un Pokémon
che può ancora evolversi una\l[green]Eviolite[blue] per raddoppiare le sue

difese.

entries.original:
"Where the wind is ice cold, so are
my hands.

Would you like me to teach one of
your Pokémon [green]Ice Punch[blue]?

I require [green]2 [buffer1]s[blue] to share
my frosty hands."
entries.translation_source: Where the wind is ice cold, so are my hands. Would you like me to teach one of your Pokémon [color-green-1]Ice Punch[color-blue-2]? I require [color-green-3]2 [buffer1-4]s[color-blue-5] to share my frosty hands.
entries.translated:
Dove il vento è gelido, gelide sono
anche le mie mani. Vuoi che insegni\la uno dei tuoi Pokémon [green]Pugno

Ghiaccio[blue]? Mi servono [green]2 [buffer1]s[blue]
per condividere le mie mani gelide.

entries.original:
"Clerk: [blue]I’m sorry sir, I can’t do
that.

That package belongs to someone
already."
entries.translation_source: Clerk: [color-blue-1]I’m sorry sir, I can’t do that. That package belongs to someone already.
entries.translated:
Clerk: [blue]Mi dispiace, signore, non
posso farlo. Quel pacco appartiene\lgià a qualcuno.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Maybe you misheard me."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Maybe you misheard me.
entries.translated: Recluta: [blue]Forse hai sentito male.

entries.original:
"[blue]Give me that package!

I won’t ask again."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Give me that package! I won’t ask again.
entries.translated:
[blue]Dammi quel pacco! Non te lo
chiederò di nuovo.

entries.original:
"Clerk: [blue]I really can’t, sir!

As a faithful employee of Poké
Mart, it goes against what I stand\lfor to give you that package!"
entries.translation_source: Clerk: [color-blue-1]I really can’t, sir! As a faithful employee of Poké Mart, it goes against what I stand for to give you that package!
entries.translated:
Impiegato: [blue]Non posso proprio,
signore! Come fedele dipendente del\lPoké Mart, va contro ciò in cui

credo darle quel pacco!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I see.

Well, then\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]I see. Well, then[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]Capisco. Beh, allora\.

entries.original:
"[blue][buffer1]!

Grab that package!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][buffer1-2]! Grab that package!
entries.translated: [blue][buffer1]! Prendi quel pacco!

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Good work, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Good work, [buffer1-2].
entries.translated: Recluta: [blue]Ottimo lavoro, [buffer1].

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon would like to have
their hands frozen with [green]Ice Punch[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon would like to have their hands frozen with [color-green-1]Ice Punch[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Quale Pokémon vorrebbe farsi
congelare le mani con [green]Gelopugno[blue]?

entries.original:
"My hands shall remain cold for
all eternity."
entries.translation_source: My hands shall remain cold for all eternity.
entries.translated:
Le mie mani resteranno fredde per
l{B4}eternità.

entries.original:
"You do not have enough
[green][buffer1]s[blue].

I cannot share my frosty hands with
you for nothing\."
entries.translation_source: You do not have enough [color-green-1][buffer1-2]s[color-blue-3]. I cannot share my frosty hands with you for nothing[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Non hai abbastanza [green][buffer1][blue]. Non
posso condividere con te le mie\lmani gelide per niente\.

entries.original:
"That TM I gave you contains
[green]Aurora Veil[blue].

It has an effect similar to both
Reflect and Light Screen combined.

The only catch is that it can only
be used in Hail weather."
entries.translation_source: That TM I gave you contains [color-green-1]Aurora Veil[color-blue-2]. It has an effect similar to both Reflect and Light Screen combined. The only catch is that it can only be used in Hail weather.
entries.translated:
Quella MT che ti ho dato contiene
[green]Velaurora[blue]. Ha un effetto simile a\lquello di Riflesso e Schermoluce

combinati. L{B4}unico inconveniente è
che può essere usata solo quando\lc{B4}è Grandine.

entries.original: "Your loss, pal."
entries.translation_source: Your loss, pal.
entries.translated: Peggio per te, amico.

entries.original:
"My brother!

Please help me!

I was babysitting him when he ran
away down the mountain!

Please, help me find him!"
entries.translation_source: My brother! Please help me! I was babysitting him when he ran away down the mountain! Please, help me find him!
entries.translated:
Mio fratello! Ti prego, aiutami! Lo
stavo guardando io quando è\lscappato giù per la montagna! Per

favore, aiutami a trovarlo!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue][player]!

I flew here as soon as the barrier
went down.

What happened?

\.

So The Shadows got away again\."
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]! I flew here as soon as the barrier went down. What happened? [game-token-3] So The Shadows got away again[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue][player]! Sono volato qui
appena la barriera è caduta. Che\lcosa è successo? \. Quindi The

Shadows sono scappati di nuovo\.

entries.original: "[green]Moo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Moo!
entries.translated: [green]Muu!

entries.original: "Break Room"
entries.translation_source: Break Room
entries.translated: Sala pausa

entries.original:
"Fallshore City is home of the
[green]Inverse Battle House[blue] and the\l[green]Mission HQ[blue].

Isn’t that neat?
It’s so cool to live here!"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City is home of the [color-green-1]Inverse Battle House[color-blue-2] and the [color-green-3]Mission HQ[color-blue-4]. Isn’t that neat? It’s so cool to live here!
entries.translated:
Fallshore City è la casa della [green]Casa
della Lotta Inversa[blue] e del [green]QG\lMissioni[blue]. Non è fantastico? È così

bello vivere qui!

entries.original: "Go away."
entries.translation_source: Go away.
entries.translated: Vattene.

entries.original:
"Huah, fellow trainer!

I am training my body and soul by
staring at this tree intently!

You too, can train, with this!"
entries.translation_source: Huah, fellow trainer! I am training my body and soul by staring at this tree intently! You too, can train, with this!
entries.translated:
Uah, compagno Allenatore! Sto
allenando corpo e anima fissando\lintensamente quest{B4}albero! Anche tu

puoi allenarti, con questo!

entries.original:
"One day, I will be the most
focused trainer."
entries.translation_source: One day, I will be the most focused trainer.
entries.translated:
Un giorno sarò l{B4}allenatore più
concentrato.

entries.original: "Please come again!"
entries.translation_source: Please come again!
entries.translated: Torna presto!

entries.original:
"Only the uncool kids actually go
to school\."
entries.translation_source: Only the uncool kids actually go to school[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Solo i ragazzi sfigati vanno
davvero a scuola\.

entries.original:
"Hmm...
I wonder how to get that item?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm... I wonder how to get that item?
entries.translated:
Hmm... chissà come si ottiene
quell{B4}oggetto?

entries.original:
"Wow! You managed to get that item!
Good job!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! You managed to get that item! Good job!
entries.translated:
Wow! Sei riuscito a ottenere
quell{B4}oggetto! Bel lavoro!

entries.original:
"I can’t thank you enough!

My brother’s small so he can’t have
gone far.

My bet is he’s somewhere on
[green]Route 8[red] right about now.

And last I saw, he was wearing his
favourite [green]Pikachu costume[red]."
entries.translation_source: I can’t thank you enough! My brother’s small so he can’t have gone far. My bet is he’s somewhere on [color-green-1]Route 8[color-red-2] right about now. And last I saw, he was wearing his favourite [color-green-3]Pikachu costume[color-red-4].
entries.translated:
Non riesco a ringraziarti
abbastanza! Mio fratello è piccolo,\lquindi non può essere andato

lontano. Scommetto che è da qualche
parte su [green]Percorso 8[red] proprio adesso.\lE l{B4}ultima volta che l{B4}ho visto,

indossava il suo [green]costume da Pikachu[red]
preferito.

entries.original: "My parents are going to kill me!"
entries.translation_source: My parents are going to kill me!
entries.translated: I miei genitori mi uccideranno!

entries.original:
"My brother told me all about his
journey back up here!

You’re amazing!"
entries.translation_source: My brother told me all about his journey back up here! You’re amazing!
entries.translated:
Mio fratello mi ha raccontato tutto
del suo viaggio fin quassù! Sei\lincredibile!

entries.original:
"That TM is my thanks for your help!
It contains [green]Return[red]!

It’s a move that gets stronger the
more your Pokémon likes you.

It’s the perfect TM for such a nice
person like you!"
entries.translation_source: That TM is my thanks for your help! It contains [color-green-1]Return[color-red-2]! It’s a move that gets stronger the more your Pokémon likes you. It’s the perfect TM for such a nice person like you!
entries.translated:
Quella MT è il mio ringraziamento
per il tuo aiuto! Contiene [green]Ritorno[red]!\lÈ una mossa che diventa più forte

quanto più il tuo Pokémon ti vuole
bene. È la MT perfetta per una\lpersona gentile come te!

entries.original:
"It’s the amazing person who saved
my brother!

Thank you again!"
entries.translation_source: It’s the amazing person who saved my brother! Thank you again!
entries.translated:
È la persona straordinaria che ha
salvato mio fratello! Grazie\lancora!

entries.original:
"Ahhh!
Please don’t eat me!"
entries.translation_source: Ahhh! Please don’t eat me!
entries.translated: Aaaa! Per favore, non mangiarmi!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

You’re not a Pokémon.

I thought a Pokémon was going to
eat me."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] You’re not a Pokémon. I thought a Pokémon was going to eat me.
entries.translated:
Sniff\. Non sei un Pokémon. Pensavo
che un Pokémon stesse per\lmangiarmi.

entries.original:
"I will keep running and enduring
the pain."
entries.translation_source: I will keep running and enduring the pain.
entries.translated:
Continuerò a correre e a sopportare
il dolore.

entries.original:
"An obnoxiously loud episode of a
Unova Pokémon Musical is on.

Watch for too long and it might
fry your brain."
entries.translation_source: An obnoxiously loud episode of a Unova Pokémon Musical is on. Watch for too long and it might fry your brain.
entries.translated:
È in onda un episodio di un Musical
Pokémon di Unima assordante\lall{B4}eccesso. Guardalo troppo a

lungo e potrebbe friggere il tuo
cervello.

entries.original:
"Don’t you wish you could just a
break from life sometimes?"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you wish you could just a break from life sometimes?
entries.translated:
Non vorresti poterti prendere una
pausa dalla vita ogni tanto?

entries.original: "My grass types didn’t help me."
entries.translation_source: My grass types didn’t help me.
entries.translated: I miei tipi Erba non mi sono stati d{B4}aiuto.

entries.original: "Hold..."
entries.translation_source: Hold...
entries.translated: Aspetta...

entries.original: "Picture perfect!"
entries.translation_source: Picture perfect!
entries.translated: Immagine perfetta!

entries.original:
"I’m in the process of creating a
masterpiece."
entries.translation_source: I’m in the process of creating a masterpiece.
entries.translated: Sto creando un capolavoro.

entries.original:
"I love evolutions of starters from
other regions!"
entries.translation_source: I love evolutions of starters from other regions!
entries.translated:
Adoro le evoluzioni dei Pokémon
iniziali di altre regioni!

entries.original:
"Well, then, I won’t stand in your
way anymore."
entries.translation_source: Well, then, I won’t stand in your way anymore.
entries.translated:
Ebbene, allora non ti ostacolerò
più.

entries.original:
"I want to go home.

I ran away from my mean sister, but
I really miss her now\."
entries.translation_source: I want to go home. I ran away from my mean sister, but I really miss her now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Voglio tornare a casa. Sono
scappato da mia sorella cattiva, ma\ladesso mi manca davvero\.

entries.original:
"Please, take me back up to
[green]Blizzard City[blue].

I’ll follow you there."
entries.translation_source: Please, take me back up to [color-green-1]Blizzard City[color-blue-2]. I’ll follow you there.
entries.translated:
Ti prego, riportami su a [green]Blizzard
City[blue]. Ti seguirò fin lì.

entries.original:
"You see those rocks on the wall?

If you have a Pokémon that knows
[green]Rock Climb[blue], you can cruise up ’em!"
entries.translation_source: You see those rocks on the wall? If you have a Pokémon that knows [color-green-1]Rock Climb[color-blue-2], you can cruise up ’em!
entries.translated:
Vedi quei massi sul muro? Se hai un
Pokémon che conosce [green]Scalaroccia[blue],\lpuoi arrampicarti su per quelli!

entries.original:
"Na na na na na na na\.
Super Nerd!"
entries.translation_source: Na na na na na na na[game-token-1] Super Nerd!
entries.translated: Na na na na na na na\. Super Nerd!

entries.original:
"Na na na na na na na\.
He lost!"
entries.translation_source: Na na na na na na na[game-token-1] He lost!
entries.translated: Na na na na na na na\. Ha perso!

entries.original:
"I like pretending I’m meant for
something greater than just standing\lhere in this cave."
entries.translation_source: I like pretending I’m meant for something greater than just standing here in this cave.
entries.translated:
Mi piace fingere di essere
destinato a qualcosa di più grande\lche stare qui in questa grotta.

entries.original:
"This cave is pretty small,
isn’t it?"
entries.translation_source: This cave is pretty small, isn’t it?
entries.translated:
Questa grotta è piuttosto piccola,
vero?

entries.original: "Fallshore City"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City
entries.translated: Città di Fallshore

entries.original: "Would you look at that..."
entries.translation_source: Would you look at that...
entries.translated: Guarda un po{B4}...

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]You both are really
starting to get on my nerves!

Inkay!

Show [buffer1] why you don’t mess
with [black]The Shadows[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]You both are really starting to get on my nerves! Inkay! Show [buffer1-2] why you don’t mess with [color-black-3]The Shadows[color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Scagnozzo: [blue]Voi due state davvero
cominciando a darmi sui nervi!\lInkay! Mostra a [buffer1] perché non

si scherza con [black]The Shadows[blue]!

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Not bad, [player]!
You showed him!

I’ll take it from here.

Use this Potion on your Pokémon
to heal it in the meantime."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]Not bad, [player-name-3]! You showed him! I’ll take it from here. Use this Potion on your Pokémon to heal it in the meantime.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Non male, [player]! Gli
hai fatto vedere tu! Ci penso io da\lqui in poi. Usa questa Pozione sul

tuo Pokémon per curarlo nel
frattempo.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]That’s a letdown.

I really thought you’d be able to
handle him.

I guess I’ll deal with him myself.

Use this Potion on your Pokémon
to make it feel better."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]That’s a letdown. I really thought you’d be able to handle him. I guess I’ll deal with him myself. Use this Potion on your Pokémon to make it feel better.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Che delusione. Pensavo
davvero che saresti riuscito a\lgestirlo. Credo che me ne occuperò

io. Usa questa Pozione sul tuo
Pokémon per farlo stare meglio.

entries.original:
"[blue]Fine, then.
I’ll do it myself."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Fine, then. I’ll do it myself.
entries.translated: [blue]D{B4}accordo, allora. Farò da solo.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]No!
My Inkay!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]No! My Inkay!
entries.translated: Grunt: [blue]No! Il mio Inkay!

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue][buffer1]!
Move in and strike!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2][buffer1-3]! Move in and strike!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue][buffer1]! Avanza e
colpisci!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]Alright, alright, I give up!
I’ll let you through!

Please have mercy on me!
Don’t hurt me anymore! Please!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Alright, alright, I give up! I’ll let you through! Please have mercy on me! Don’t hurt me anymore! Please!
entries.translated:
Sgherro: [blue]Va bene, va bene, mi
arrendo! Ti lascio passare! Abbi\lpietà di me, ti prego! Non farmi

più male! Ti prego!

entries.original: "[blue][buffer1]! Return!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][buffer1-2]! Return!
entries.translated: [blue][buffer1]! Ritorno!

entries.original:
"[blue]I’m getting out of here now,
[player].

I’m sure you’re capable of taking
care of yourself from here on out.

If you run into any trouble, just
use your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I’m getting out of here now, [player-name-2]. I’m sure you’re capable of taking care of yourself from here on out. If you run into any trouble, just use your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
[blue]Me ne vado di qui adesso, [player].
Sono sicuro che sarai in grado di\lcavartela da solo d{B4}ora in poi. Se

incontri dei problemi, usa i tuoi
Pokémon.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh, one more thing.

As soon as you get home, we’re
going to battle.

You impressed me earlier, and I
want to see how I’ll fare against\lyou.

Until then, don’t tire yourself
out too much."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oh, one more thing. As soon as you get home, we’re going to battle. You impressed me earlier, and I want to see how I’ll fare against you. Until then, don’t tire yourself out too much.
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh, un{B4}altra cosa. Appena arrivi a
casa, combatteremo. Mi hai\limpressionato prima, e voglio

vedere come me la caverò contro di
te. Fino ad allora, non stancarti\ltroppo.

entries.original: "Missions Completed: [green][buffer3]"
entries.translation_source: Missions Completed: [color-green-1][buffer3-2]
entries.translated: Missioni completate: [green][buffer3]

entries.original:
"I wish we had our own Pokémon.

I’m always so bored at home."
entries.translation_source: I wish we had our own Pokémon. I’m always so bored at home.
entries.translated:
Vorrei che avessimo dei Pokémon
tutti nostri. A casa mi annoio\lsempre tantissimo.

entries.original:
"Wahh!

That Pokémon hurt me!"
entries.translation_source: Wahh! That Pokémon hurt me!
entries.translated: Wahh! Quel Pokémon mi ha ferito!

entries.original: "Sandslash: [green]Slash!"
entries.translation_source: Sandslash: [color-green-1]Slash!
entries.translated: Sandslash: [green]Lacerazione!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon appears to be heading
towards [green]Icicle Cave."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon appears to be heading towards [color-green-1]Icicle Cave.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon sembra dirigersi verso
[green]Icicle Cave.

entries.original:
"Hi [player]!

How are you?

I was just cooking some food for my
family."
entries.translation_source: Hi [player-name-1]! How are you? I was just cooking some food for my family.
entries.translated:
Ciao [player]! Come stai? Stavo
giusto cucinando qualcosa per la\lmia famiglia.

entries.original:
"It’s a statue of the Legendary
Ice Pokémon, Articuno.

It says here that Articuno was once
used as a herald to a great\ldarkness, but now it resides near\lFrozen Heights."
entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Ice Pokémon, Articuno. It says here that Articuno was once used as a herald to a great darkness, but now it resides near Frozen Heights.
entries.translated:
È una statua del Pokémon
leggendario di tipo Ghiaccio,\lArticuno. Qui dice che Articuno

veniva un tempo usato come araldo
di una grande oscurità, ma ora\lrisiede vicino a Frozen Heights.

entries.original:
"It’s a statue of the Legendary
Electric Pokémon, Zapdos.

It says here that Zapdos was once
used as a herald to a great\ldarkness, but now it resides in\lThundercap Mountain."
entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Electric Pokémon, Zapdos. It says here that Zapdos was once used as a herald to a great darkness, but now it resides in Thundercap Mountain.
entries.translated:
È la statua del Pokémon Leggendario
di tipo Elettro, Zapdos. Qui c{B4}è\lscritto che Zapdos un tempo veniva

usato come araldo di una grande
oscurità, ma ora vive sul Monte\lThundercap.

entries.original:
"I know, right?
Life is so stressful sometimes!"
entries.translation_source: I know, right? Life is so stressful sometimes!
entries.translated:
Lo so, vero? A volte la vita è così
stressante!
