You both even managed to acquire your very own Pokémon! I was planning on giving [text-token-rival-4] one, someday or another, but now I don’t have to! Ho ho ho!

"You are his [buffer1]!

entries.translation_source: You are his [buffer1-1]! I knew my eyesight was not deceiving me! Your father was, to put it simply, an amazing man. I’m sure if you introduced yourself to people as his [buffer1-2], you would instantly be regarded with much affection. There aren’t many people out there who have not heard of his exploits. It’s a shame he disappeared. If only someone knew what happened to him, I could finally have a sense of closure.
entries.translated:
Sei il suo [buffer1]! Sapevo che la
mia vista non mi ingannava! Tuo\lpadre era, per dirla semplicemente,

un uomo straordinario. Sono sicuro
che, se ti presentassi alle persone\lcome suo [buffer1], verresti subito

considerato con molto affetto. Non
ci sono molte persone che non hanno\lsentito parlare delle sue imprese.

È un peccato che sia scomparso. Se
solo qualcuno sapesse cosa gli è\lsuccesso, potrei finalmente avere

un senso di chiusura.

"Oh.

\.

entries.original:
"Whoever named it should have called
it Cliff Cave."
entries.translation_source: Whoever named it should have called it Cliff Cave.
entries.translated: Chiunque l{B4}abbia chiamata avrebbe dovuto chiamarla Grotto Scogliera.

entries.original:
"This place reminds of Cliff Cave
from the Johto region.

Why it’s named Thundercap Mountain
and not Cliff Cave is beyond me."
entries.translation_source: This place reminds of Cliff Cave from the Johto region. Why it’s named Thundercap Mountain and not Cliff Cave is beyond me.
entries.translated:
Questo posto mi ricorda Cliff Cave
nella regione di Johto. Perché si\lchiami Thundercap Mountain e non

Cliff Cave mi sfugge.

entries.original: "I believe I can fly\."
entries.translation_source: I believe I can fly[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Credo di poter volare\.

entries.original: "I believe I can touch the sky\."
entries.translation_source: I believe I can touch the sky[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Credo di poter toccare il cielo\.

entries.original:
"I like to pretend I can fly like my
birds.

Being grounded sucks."
entries.translation_source: I like to pretend I can fly like my birds. Being grounded sucks.
entries.translated:
Mi piace fingere di poter volare
come i miei uccelli. Restare a\lterra fa schifo.

entries.original:
"I saw you coming from a mile away!
My eyes are like a Talonflame’s!"
entries.translation_source: I saw you coming from a mile away! My eyes are like a Talonflame’s!
entries.translated: Ti ho visto arrivare da un miglio di distanza! I miei occhi sono come quelli di un Talonflame!

entries.original:
"No matter the distance, I still
lost!"
entries.translation_source: No matter the distance, I still lost!
entries.translated: Non importa la distanza, ho comunque perso!

entries.original:
"I eat lots of carrots to improve
my vision.

Maybe that’s why my skin is turning
orange..."
entries.translation_source: I eat lots of carrots to improve my vision. Maybe that’s why my skin is turning orange...
entries.translated:
Mangiando tante carote miglioro la
vista. Forse è per questo che la\lmia pelle sta diventando

arancione...

entries.original:
"Route 9, Tehl Town, Fallshore City,
Epidimy Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 9, Tehl Town, Fallshore City, Epidimy Town
entries.translated:
Percorso 9, Tehl Town, Fallshore
City, Epidimy Town

entries.original: "Not bad!"
entries.translation_source: Not bad!
entries.translated: Niente male!

entries.original:
"Heh\.

You’re just getting more and more
powerful, [player].

Just wait until the next time we
meet.

By then, I’ll be tough enough to
make you feel defeat at my hands!

Now, if you’ll excuse me, I have
important things to do."
entries.translation_source: Heh[game-token-1] You’re just getting more and more powerful, [player-name-2]. Just wait until the next time we meet. By then, I’ll be tough enough to make you feel defeat at my hands! Now, if you’ll excuse me, I have important things to do.
entries.translated:
Eh\. Stai diventando sempre più
potente, [player]. Aspetta solo la\lprossima volta che ci vedremo. Per

allora sarò abbastanza forte da
farti conoscere la sconfitta per\lmano mia! Ora, se vuoi scusarmi, ho

cose importanti da fare.

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]Well of course I was planning
on it, [rival]!

There are plenty of errands I’m too
old to run myself!

It’s just that\.well\.when your
parents left you with me, they\lasked that I watch over you until\lyou were at least 18 years old\."
entries.translation_source: Log: [color-blue-1]Well of course I was planning on it, [text-token-rival-2]! There are plenty of errands I’m too old to run myself! It’s just that[game-token-3]well[game-token-4]when your parents left you with me, they asked that I watch over you until you were at least 18 years old[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]Beh, certo che lo stavo
pianificando, [rival]! Ci sono un\lsacco di commissioni che sono

troppo vecchio per sbrigare da
solo! È solo che\.beh\.quando i tuoi\lgenitori ti hanno affidato a me, mi

hanno chiesto di prendermi cura di
te finché non avessi compiuto\lalmeno 18 anni\.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Whatever, Log.
Believe what you want."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]Whatever, Log. Believe what you want.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Come vuoi, Log. Credi
quello che ti pare.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh yeah, almost forgot.

Now that we’re outside, let me show
you how a real trainer battles!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oh yeah, almost forgot. Now that we’re outside, let me show you how a real trainer battles!
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh già, quasi dimenticavo. Adesso
che siamo fuori, lascia che ti\lmostri come combatte un vero

Allenatore!

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh yeah, almost forgot.

Now that we’re outside, let me give
you a few battling pointers."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oh yeah, almost forgot. Now that we’re outside, let me give you a few battling pointers.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ah già, quasi dimenticavo. Ora che
siamo fuori, lasciami darti qualche\lconsiglio sulle lotte.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh yeah, almost forgot.

Now that we’re outside, let’s see
how you battle!

There’s no torchickening out this
time!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oh yeah, almost forgot. Now that we’re outside, let’s see how you battle! There’s no torchickening out this time!
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh già, quasi dimenticavo. Ora che
siamo fuori, vediamo come combatti!\lStavolta niente tirarti indietro

come un fifone!

entries.original: "Not bad, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Not bad, [player-name-1]!
entries.translated: Niente male, [player]!

entries.original:
"Looks like you still have a long
way to go, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like you still have a long way to go, [player-name-1]!
entries.translated: Sembra che tu abbia ancora molta strada da fare, [player]!

entries.original:
"Log: [blue]That was a fine battle.

Very enthralling if I do say so
myself."
entries.translation_source: Log: [color-blue-1]That was a fine battle. Very enthralling if I do say so myself.
entries.translated:
Log: [blue]È stata una bella lotta. Molto
avvincente, se posso dirlo.

entries.original:
"The sand castle came alive and
attacked!"
entries.translation_source: The sand castle came alive and attacked!
entries.translated:
Il castello di sabbia ha preso vita
e ha attaccato!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] receded into the
sand."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] receded into the sand.
entries.translated:
Il [buffer1] è sprofondato nella
sabbia.

entries.original:
"Why is a beautiful trainer like me
out here?"
entries.translation_source: Why is a beautiful trainer like me out here?
entries.translated: Perché una bella Allenatrice come me è qui fuori?

entries.original: "Simply because I can be."
entries.translation_source: Simply because I can be.
entries.translated: Semplicemente perché posso.

entries.original:
"I tried taking on the Gym here, but
I couldn’t even get to the Leader!

It was so dark I had no idea where
I was going.

I couldn’t even use Flash to see
better.

That’s how dark it was."
entries.translation_source: I tried taking on the Gym here, but I couldn’t even get to the Leader! It was so dark I had no idea where I was going. I couldn’t even use Flash to see better. That’s how dark it was.
entries.translated:
Ho provato a sfidare la Palestra
qui, ma non sono riuscito nemmeno\lad arrivare al Capopalestra! Era

così buio che non avevo idea di
dove stessi andando. Non potevo\lnemmeno usare Flash per vedere

meglio. Era buio così.

entries.original:
"Grunt 1: [blue]The asset has sent word.

The target is on the move."
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [color-blue-1]The asset has sent word. The target is on the move.
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [blue]L{B4}asset ha inviato un
messaggio. Il bersaglio si sta\lmuovendo.

entries.original:
"Grint 2: [blue]Alright, then.

Let’s move into position."
entries.translation_source: Grint 2: [color-blue-1]Alright, then. Let’s move into position.
entries.translated:
Grint 2: [blue]Va bene, allora.
Mettiamoci in posizione.

entries.original:
"Epidimy Town

The town of happiness and bliss."
entries.translation_source: Epidimy Town The town of happiness and bliss.
entries.translated:
Città di Epidimy La città della
felicità e della beatitudine.

entries.original: "Afterlife"
entries.translation_source: Afterlife
entries.translated: Aldilà

entries.original:
"Hi there, young traveller.
Your Pokémon look tired.

Let me heal them for you."
entries.translation_source: Hi there, young traveller. Your Pokémon look tired. Let me heal them for you.
entries.translated:
Salve, giovane viaggiatore. I tuoi
Pokémon sembrano stanchi. Lascia\lche li curi per te.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]No one cares how it made
you feel, Log.

It only matters if our Pokémon
seem strong."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]No one cares how it made you feel, Log. It only matters if our Pokémon seem strong.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]A nessuno importa di come
ti ha fatto sentire, Log. Conta\lsolo se i nostri Pokémon sembrano

forti.

entries.original:
"Hello, [buffer1].
May I heal your Pokémon for you?"
entries.translation_source: Hello, [buffer1-1]. May I heal your Pokémon for you?
entries.translated:
Ciao, [buffer1]. Posso curare i tuoi
Pokémon per te?

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Did you actually just use
Shadow Sneak?

Do you know nothing about
immunity?

Staraptor, use Aerial Ace!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Did you actually just use Shadow Sneak? Do you know nothing about immunity? Staraptor, use Aerial Ace!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Hai davvero appena usato
Furtivombra? Non sai nulla\ldell{B4}immunità? Staraptor, usa

Aeroassalto!

entries.original:
"Whoa, man\.

Take this fine, fine, badge as
proof of your victory\."
entries.translation_source: Whoa, man[game-token-1] Take this fine, fine, badge as proof of your victory[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Accidenti, amico\. Prendi questa
bella medaglia come prova della tua\lvittoria\.

entries.original:
"Your Pokémon are looking much
better now, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: Your Pokémon are looking much better now, [buffer1-1].
entries.translated:
I tuoi Pokémon stanno molto meglio
adesso, [buffer1].

entries.original:
"We policemen are the only things
standing between the gangs and\ltotal destruction of the port."
entries.translation_source: We policemen are the only things standing between the gangs and total destruction of the port.
entries.translated:
Noi poliziotti siamo le uniche cose
che si frappongono tra le bande e\lla distruzione totale del porto.

entries.original: "\ar Antisis City Port"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] Antisis City Port
entries.translated: \ar Porto di Antisis City

entries.original:
"Do you like my sand castle?

I worked really hard to make it!"
entries.translation_source: Do you like my sand castle? I worked really hard to make it!
entries.translated:
Ti piace il mio castello di sabbia?
Ci ho lavorato davvero tanto per\lfarlo!

entries.original:
"Wahhhh!

My sand castle is gone!"
entries.translation_source: Wahhhh! My sand castle is gone!
entries.translated:
Aaaah! Il mio castello di sabbia è
sparito!

entries.original:
"Whew!

You there!

How ’bout this humidity, day after
day!"
entries.translation_source: Whew! You there! How ’bout this humidity, day after day!
entries.translated: Uff! Ehi, tu lì! Che ne dici di quest{B4}umidità, giorno dopo giorno!

entries.original:
"Whew, great! You and your Pokémon
are splendid!"
entries.translation_source: Whew, great! You and your Pokémon are splendid!
entries.translated: Uff, ottimo! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon siete splendidi!

entries.original:
"Ho ho\.sure is humid\.like a
sauna\."
entries.translation_source: Ho ho[game-token-1]sure is humid[game-token-2]like a sauna[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ho ho\.c{B4}è proprio umido\.come in una
sauna\.

entries.original:
"I’m going to perfect that art of
throwing Poké Balls!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to perfect that art of throwing Poké Balls!
entries.translated:
Perfezionerò l{B4}arte di lanciare le
Poké Ball!

entries.original:
"If you’re going to get stronger,
I’ll get stronger too."
entries.translation_source: If you’re going to get stronger, I’ll get stronger too.
entries.translated:
Se vuoi diventare più forte, lo
diventerò anch{B4}io.

entries.original:
"You’d best not send out any weak
Pokémon!

Your opponents are my partners in
life!"
entries.translation_source: You’d best not send out any weak Pokémon! Your opponents are my partners in life!
entries.translated: Faresti meglio a non mandare in campo dei Pokémon deboli! I tuoi avversari sono i miei compagni di vita!

entries.original:
"Thank you my friends, for all you
hard work."
entries.translation_source: Thank you my friends, for all you hard work.
entries.translated: Grazie, miei amici, per tutto il vostro duro lavoro.

entries.original:
"No matter what, my Pokémon will
stick with me until the end!"
entries.translation_source: No matter what, my Pokémon will stick with me until the end!
entries.translated:
A qualunque costo, i miei Pokémon
resteranno con me fino alla fine!

entries.original:
"Even when I lose, I still get some
enjoyment out of it."
entries.translation_source: Even when I lose, I still get some enjoyment out of it.
entries.translated:
Anche quando perdo, riesco comunque
a divertirmi un po{B4}.

entries.original: "Strike before being struck!"
entries.translation_source: Strike before being struck!
entries.translated: Colpisci prima di essere colpito!

entries.original: "I ran out of energy to fight!"
entries.translation_source: I ran out of energy to fight!
entries.translated: Ho esaurito le energie per combattere!

entries.original:
"If you run and run, you’ll become
one with the wind."
entries.translation_source: If you run and run, you’ll become one with the wind.
entries.translated:
Se corri e corri, diventerai
tutt{B4}uno con il vento.

entries.original:
"I’ll forget about losing and just
enjoy this snowy hike."
entries.translation_source: I’ll forget about losing and just enjoy this snowy hike.
entries.translated:
Mi dimenticherò della sconfitta e
mi godrò questa escursione sulla\lneve.

entries.original:
"No one knows the mountains better
than I, I tells ya."
entries.translation_source: No one knows the mountains better than I, I tells ya.
entries.translated:
Nessuno conosce le montagne meglio
di me, te lo dico io.

entries.original:
"You have set me free\.

I am truly grateful from the bottom
of my heart\."
entries.translation_source: You have set me free[game-token-1] I am truly grateful from the bottom of my heart[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Mi hai liberato\. Ti sono davvero
grato dal profondo del mio cuore\.

entries.original:
"Whoa\.
You look exhausted.

Did you climb all the way up the
mountain from Crater Town?"
entries.translation_source: Whoa[game-token-1] You look exhausted. Did you climb all the way up the mountain from Crater Town?
entries.translated:
Oh\. Sembri esausto. Sei salito fin
quassù sulla montagna partendo da\lCrater Town?

entries.original:
"Now that the entrance to the SES
Expressway is clear, travellers can

save their strength by coming up
through there, instead of hiking up!"
entries.translation_source: Now that the entrance to the SES Expressway is clear, travellers can save their strength by coming up through there, instead of hiking up!
entries.translated:
Ora che l{B4}ingresso alla SES
Expressway è libero, i viaggiatori\lpossono risparmiare le loro forze

passando di lì, invece di fare
tutta la salita a piedi!

entries.original:
"[blue]I’m sorry about this.

Take this for your trouble."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I’m sorry about this. Take this for your trouble.
entries.translated:
[blue]Mi dispiace per questo. Prendi
questo per il disturbo.

entries.original: "Clerk: [blue]Money\.?"
entries.translation_source: Clerk: [color-blue-1]Money[game-token-2]?
entries.translated: Commesso: [blue]Soldi\.?

entries.original:
"[blue]What?

You came to get that package too?

Well, unless you’re willing to fight
for it, get out of the way!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What? You came to get that package too? Well, unless you’re willing to fight for it, get out of the way!
entries.translated:
[blue]Cosa? Sei venuto anche tu per
prendere quel pacco? Beh, a meno\lche tu non voglia lottare per

averlo, togliti di mezzo!

entries.original: "Fight"
entries.translation_source: Fight
entries.translated: Lotta

entries.original: "Move"
entries.translation_source: Move
entries.translated: Muovi

entries.original: "[blue]I’m going to put you in your place!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I’m going to put you in your place!
entries.translated: [blue]Ti metterò al tuo posto!

entries.original:
"[blue]Did you honestly think that I would
give up the package even if I lost?

I didn’t come all this way just to
give in to some stupid kid.

Now move!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Did you honestly think that I would give up the package even if I lost? I didn’t come all this way just to give in to some stupid kid. Now move!
entries.translated:
[blue]Davvero pensavi che avrei mollato
il pacco anche se avessi perso? Non\lsono venuto fin qui solo per cedere

a qualche stupido ragazzino. Ora
spostati!

entries.original: "[blue]Get out of my way!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Get out of my way!
entries.translated: [blue]Fatti da parte!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Did you receive the
package from the Mart?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Did you receive the package from the Mart?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Hai ricevuto il pacco dal
Mart?

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Yes, I did, sir."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Yes, I did, sir.
entries.translated: Recluta: [blue]Sì, l{B4}ho fatto, signore.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Were you discreet in doing
so?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Were you discreet in doing so?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Sei stato discreto nel
farlo?

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I was, sir.

I tried not to cause too
much of a commotion.

I even paid for the package as
instructed."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]I was, sir. I tried not to cause too much of a commotion. I even paid for the package as instructed.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Ero io, signore. Ho cercato
di non creare troppo clamore. Ho\lpersino pagato il pacco come

ordinato.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Good work.

The last thing we need right now is
the police after us.

We’re too close to the end game to
be stopped now."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Good work. The last thing we need right now is the police after us. We’re too close to the end game to be stopped now.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Bel lavoro. L{B4}ultima cosa
di cui abbiamo bisogno adesso è la\lpolizia alle nostre calcagna. Siamo

troppo vicini al finale per essere
fermati ora.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Report to Zeph, and inform
him of my current status."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Report to Zeph, and inform him of my current status.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Riferite a Zeph e
informatelo del mio stato attuale.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Yes, sir!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Yes, sir!
entries.translated: Recluta: [blue]Sì, signore!

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mirskle, prefers
flowery Pokémon.

If you come prepared with a Fire or
Flying-type Pokémon, you should be\lable to take him out no sweat!

-COUGH- -COUGH-

Also, be aware, Mirskle likes to
hotbox his gym from time to time,\land this may have an effect on your\lbattling.

If you notice a \qothick fog\qc rolling
in, you’ll dodge hits easier, but\lyou’ll also have a harder time\llanding them as well!

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mirskle, prefers flowery Pokémon. If you come prepared with a Fire or Flying-type Pokémon, you should be able to take him out no sweat! -COUGH- -COUGH- Also, be aware, Mirskle likes to hotbox his gym from time to time, and this may have an effect on your battling. If you notice a [quote-open-1]thick fog[quote-close-2] rolling in, you’ll dodge hits easier, but you’ll also have a harder time landing them as well! Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Il Capopalestra Mirskle preferisce
Pokémon floreali. Se ti presenti\lcon un Pokémon di tipo Fuoco o

Volante, lo sconfiggerai senza
problemi! -TOSSE- -TOSSE- Inoltre,\lattenzione: a Mirskle piace

riempire di fumo la sua palestra di
tanto in tanto, e questo potrebbe\linfluire sulla tua lotta. Se noti

una \qonebbia fitta\qc che si avvicina,
schivare i colpi sarà più facile,\lma sarà anche più difficile

metterli a segno! Buona fortuna là
fuori!

entries.original:
"I’m impressed!

You managed to beat Mirskle even
with your eyes full of \qofog\qc!

Take this as some extra proof of
your victory here."
entries.translation_source: I’m impressed! You managed to beat Mirskle even with your eyes full of [quote-open-1]fog[quote-close-2]! Take this as some extra proof of your victory here.
entries.translated:
Sono colpito! Sei riuscito a
battere Mirskle persino con gli\locchi pieni di \qofog\qc! Prendi questo

come ulteriore prova della tua
vittoria qui.

entries.original:
"That’s a rare gemstone that can
power up a grassy move in battle\lfor you!

I’m sure it’ll help you out, champ
in the making."
entries.translation_source: That’s a rare gemstone that can power up a grassy move in battle for you! I’m sure it’ll help you out, champ in the making.
entries.translated:
Quello è una gemma rara che può
potenziare per te una mossa di tipo\lErba in battaglia! Sono sicuro che

ti aiuterà, campione in erba.

entries.original:
"Huh.

You have no space for it."
entries.translation_source: Huh. You have no space for it.
entries.translated: Eh. Non hai spazio per questo.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Leaf Badge
from Mirskle!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Leaf Badge from Mirskle!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto la Medaglia
Foglia da Mirskle!

entries.original: "Take this cool, grassy TM toooo\."
entries.translation_source: Take this cool, grassy TM toooo[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Prendi anche questa MT erbosa\.

entries.original:
"In case you were wonderin’, that
TM contains [green]Grass Knot[blue].

I knew this guy, once.

He’d always be fallin’ over. Said
it was some sorta genetic problem.

But the truth is\.

I just kept usin’ Grass Knot on
him!

It’s a good thing he wasn’t toooo
heavy, or it woulda really hurt."
entries.translation_source: In case you were wonderin’, that TM contains [color-green-1]Grass Knot[color-blue-2]. I knew this guy, once. He’d always be fallin’ over. Said it was some sorta genetic problem. But the truth is[game-token-3] I just kept usin’ Grass Knot on him! It’s a good thing he wasn’t toooo heavy, or it woulda really hurt.
entries.translated:
Nel caso te lo stessi chiedendo,
quella MT contiene [green]Nodo Erboso[blue].\lConoscevo uno come lui, una volta.

Continuava sempre a inciampare.
Diceva che era una specie di\lproblema genetico. Ma la verità è\.

Continuavo semplicemente a usare
Nodo Erboso su di lui! È una\lfortuna che non fosse troppooo

pesante, altrimenti gli avrebbe
davvero fatto male.

entries.original:
"Aww, man\.

You already have Grass Knot\."
entries.translation_source: Aww, man[game-token-1] You already have Grass Knot[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Uffa, amico\. Hai già Nodo Erba\.

entries.original:
"Everyone hide!

The popo’s here to get us again!"
entries.translation_source: Everyone hide! The popo’s here to get us again!
entries.translated:
Tutti a nascondervi! Gli sbirri
sono qui per prenderci di nuovo!

entries.original:
"Officer 1: [blue]Hey, kid!

Did you see which way the Gym
Leader ran?

He’s wanted for trafficking in
Oddish leaves!"

entries.translated:
La Palestra di Blizzard City è
l{B4}unica palestra del Borrius\loccidentale con un design esterno

unico. La disposizione interna
della Palestra non entrerebbe in\luna Palestra normale.

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of a Pokémon
called [green]Eevee[red]?

Apparently it’ll evolve if you
touch some rock around here.

I’ve also heard it’ll evolve if you
you touch some rock in [green]Grim Woods[red].

I’d love to see an Eevee some
day\."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of a Pokémon called [color-green-1]Eevee[color-red-2]? Apparently it’ll evolve if you touch some rock around here. I’ve also heard it’ll evolve if you you touch some rock in [color-green-3]Grim Woods[color-red-4]. I’d love to see an Eevee some day[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Hai mai sentito parlare di un
Pokémon chiamato [green]Eevee[red]? A quanto\lpare si evolve se tocchi qualche

pietra qui intorno. Ho sentito
anche che si evolve se tocchi una\lpietra a [green]Grim Woods[red]. Mi piacerebbe

vedere un Eevee un giorno\.

entries.original:
"That’s an Eevee!
That’s an Eevee!

You have an Eevee!

So cute!"
entries.translation_source: That’s an Eevee! That’s an Eevee! You have an Eevee! So cute!
entries.translated:
È un Eevee! È un Eevee! Hai un
Eevee! Che carino!

entries.original:
"That’s for showing me an Eevee!

It doesn’t evolve Eevee, but I
think it evolves some Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: That’s for showing me an Eevee! It doesn’t evolve Eevee, but I think it evolves some Pokémon.
entries.translated:
È per avermi mostrato un Eevee! Non
fa evolvere Eevee, ma penso che\lfaccia evolvere alcuni Pokémon.

entries.original:
"You can evolve your Eevee by
touching some rock around here or\lin [green]Grim Woods[red]."
entries.translation_source: You can evolve your Eevee by touching some rock around here or in [color-green-1]Grim Woods[color-red-2].
entries.translated:
Puoi far evolvere il tuo Eevee
toccando una certa pietra qui\lintorno o nei [green]Grim Woods[red].

entries.original:
"Ho, ho, ho!

The look on the your face is
priceless!

Don’t worry, my friend, the [green]Cut
Master[blue] told me you were coming!"
entries.translation_source: Ho, ho, ho! The look on the your face is priceless! Don’t worry, my friend, the [color-green-1]Cut Master[color-blue-2] told me you were coming!
entries.translated:
Ho, ho, ho! L{B4}espressione sulla tua
faccia è impagabile! Non\lpreoccuparti, amico mio, il [green]Maestro

Taglio[blue] mi ha detto che stavi
arrivando!

entries.original:
"Ah, ha, ha!
So I was right!

I’ve been saying that to every
person who’s walked through my door\lsince I received his call, but\lyou’re the first person to have\la look of relief on their face!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, ha, ha! So I was right! I’ve been saying that to every person who’s walked through my door since I received his call, but you’re the first person to have a look of relief on their face!
entries.translated:
Ah, ah, ah! Quindi avevo ragione!
Lo sto dicendo a chiunque sia\lentrato dalla mia porta da quando

ho ricevuto la sua chiamata, ma sei
la prima persona ad avere\lun{B4}espressione di sollievo sul

volto!

entries.original:
"That HM contains [green]Rock Smash[blue], if
it wasn’t already obvious!

You can use it to smash any cracked
rocks in your path.

Just remember, in order to use Rock
Smash, you first need to obtain\l[green]Blizzard City’s Gym Badge[blue]."
entries.translation_source: That HM contains [color-green-1]Rock Smash[color-blue-2], if it wasn’t already obvious! You can use it to smash any cracked rocks in your path. Just remember, in order to use Rock Smash, you first need to obtain [color-green-3]Blizzard City’s Gym Badge[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Quella MN contiene [green]Rock Smash[blue], se
non fosse già ovvio! Puoi usarla\lper spaccare tutte le rocce

incrinate sul tuo cammino. Ricorda
solo che, per usare Rock Smash,\ldevi prima ottenere la [green]Medaglia

della Palestra di Blizzard City[blue].

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s you!
Champ in the making!

How’re you liking the weather up
here?

Welcome to the Blizzard City Gym!

Let’s start you off with some
Fresh Water."
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s you! Champ in the making! How’re you liking the weather up here? Welcome to the Blizzard City Gym! Let’s start you off with some Fresh Water.
entries.translated:
Oh, sei tu! Un campione in
divenire! Come trovi il tempo\lquassù? Benvenuto alla Palestra di

Blizzard City! Iniziamo con un po{B4}
di Acqua Fresca.

entries.original:
"Contrary to popular belief, this
Gym is not an Ice-type gym.

It’s a [green]Flying[blue]-type Gym!

And the best way to counter
Flying-types is to clip their\lwings with [green]ice[blue], [green]rocks[blue], or\l[green]electricity[blue]!

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: Contrary to popular belief, this Gym is not an Ice-type gym. It’s a [color-green-1]Flying[color-blue-2]-type Gym! And the best way to counter Flying-types is to clip their wings with [color-green-3]ice[color-blue-4], [color-green-5]rocks[color-blue-6], or [color-green-7]electricity[color-blue-8]! Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Contrariamente a quanto si crede,
questa Palestra non è una Palestra\ldi tipo Ghiaccio. È una [green]Palestra di

tipo Volante[blue]! E il modo migliore
per contrastare i Pokémon di tipo\lVolante è tagliare loro le ali con

[green]ghiaccio[blue], [green]rocce[blue] o [green]elettricità[blue]!
Buona fortuna là fuori!

entries.original:
"Well done!

You fought bravely through the
hailstorm and came out on top!

Take this, as an extra reward for
your victory."
entries.translation_source: Well done! You fought bravely through the hailstorm and came out on top! Take this, as an extra reward for your victory.
entries.translated:
Ben fatto! Hai combattuto con
coraggio attraverso la tempesta di\lgrandine e ne sei uscito vincitore!

Prendi questo, come ricompensa
extra per la tua vittoria.

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single Flying-type move in battle.

With it, you can land a graceful,
yet still devastating blow!"
entries.translation_source: That Gem I gave you can power up a single Flying-type move in battle. With it, you can land a graceful, yet still devastating blow!
entries.translated:
La Gemma che ti ho dato può
potenziare una singola mossa di\ltipo Volante in battaglia. Con

essa, puoi sferrare un colpo
elegante, ma comunque devastante!

entries.original: "The [buffer1] is fast asleep\."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] is fast asleep[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Il [buffer1] dorme profondamente\.

entries.original: "Crah rah rah rah rah!"
entries.translation_source: Crah rah rah rah rah!
entries.translated: Crah rah rah rah rah!

entries.original: "Great Desert"
entries.translation_source: Great Desert
entries.translated: Grande Deserto

entries.original: "Vivill Town"
entries.translation_source: Vivill Town
entries.translated: Vivill Town

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] burrowed into
the snow."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] burrowed into the snow.
entries.translated:
Il [buffer1] si è interrato nella
neve.

entries.original:
"Hey there, [buffer1].

You ever been this high up off the
ground before?

When you’re up at this height, the
battles are amazing!

I don’t want to bore you with
chit-chat, so let’s get to it!"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, [buffer1-1]. You ever been this high up off the ground before? When you’re up at this height, the battles are amazing! I don’t want to bore you with chit-chat, so let’s get to it!
entries.translated:
Ehi, [buffer1]. Sei mai stato così
in alto da terra prima d{B4}ora?\lQuando sei a questa altezza, le

lotte sono incredibili! Non voglio
annoiarti con chiacchiere, quindi\landiamo al dunque!

entries.original:
"As proof of your victory against
the Blizzard City Gym Leader, take\lthe [green]Wings Badge[red]."
entries.translation_source: As proof of your victory against the Blizzard City Gym Leader, take the [color-green-1]Wings Badge[color-red-2].
entries.translated:
Come prova della tua vittoria
contro il Capopalestra di Blizzard\lCity, prendi la [green]Wings Badge[red].

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Wings Badge
from Alice!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Wings Badge from Alice!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto la Medaglia
Ala da Alice!

entries.original:
"With the Wings Badge, you can now
smash cracked rocks with grace!

Not only that, but any Pokémon up
to Lv. 50 will always obey you!

Take this TM, too!"
entries.translation_source: With the Wings Badge, you can now smash cracked rocks with grace! Not only that, but any Pokémon up to Lv. 50 will always obey you! Take this TM, too!
entries.translated:
Con la Medaglia Ali, ora puoi
frantumare le rocce incrinate con\leleganza! Non solo, ma qualsiasi

Pokémon fino al Lv. 50 ti obbedirà
sempre! Prendi anche questa MT!

entries.original:
"TM40 contains [green]Aerial Ace[red]!
It’s a move that’s sure to hit!"
entries.translation_source: TM40 contains [color-green-1]Aerial Ace[color-red-2]! It’s a move that’s sure to hit!
entries.translated:
MT40 contiene [green]Aeroassalto[red]! È una
mossa che colpisce sicuramente!

entries.original:
"Remember this!

No matter how icy or shocking the
conditions are, there will still be\lbirds flying high in the sky!"
entries.translation_source: Remember this! No matter how icy or shocking the conditions are, there will still be birds flying high in the sky!
entries.translated:
Ricordalo! Non importa quanto siano
gelide o sconvolgenti le\lcondizioni, ci saranno sempre

uccelli che volano in alto nel
cielo!

entries.original:
"I’m looking for Battle Items like
[green]X-Attack [blue]and [green]X-Speed[blue].

They raise a Pokémon’s stats in
battle.

But no matter how hard I look, I
can’t seem to find any here\."
entries.translation_source: I’m looking for Battle Items like [color-green-1]X-Attack [color-blue-2]and [color-green-3]X-Speed[color-blue-4]. They raise a Pokémon’s stats in battle. But no matter how hard I look, I can’t seem to find any here[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Sto cercando Strumenti Lotta come
[green]X-Attacco [blue]e [green]X-Velocità[blue]. Aumentano\lle statistiche di un Pokémon in

lotta. Ma per quanto cerchi, qui
non riesco a trovarne nessuno\.

entries.original:
"What’s saltier?
My tears or the lake\."
entries.translation_source: What’s saltier? My tears or the lake[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Cosa è più salato? Le mie lacrime o il lago\.

entries.original:
"[green]Route 10 [blue]has a cave that resembles
the [green]Lake Caves [blue]of [green]Sinnoh[blue].

I’ve never been in it myself, but
I’ve heard things\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Route 10 [color-blue-2]has a cave that resembles the [color-green-3]Lake Caves [color-blue-4]of [color-green-5]Sinnoh[color-blue-6]. I’ve never been in it myself, but I’ve heard things[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
[green]Percorso 10 [blue]ha una grotta che
somiglia alle [green]Grotte dei Laghi [blue]di\l[green]Sinnoh[blue]. Io non ci sono mai entrato

di persona, ma ne ho sentito
parlare\.

entries.original:
"One day there’s going to be a nice
big statue here.

It’ll make Tehl Town on par with
all those cool towns with statues."
entries.translation_source: One day there’s going to be a nice big statue here. It’ll make Tehl Town on par with all those cool towns with statues.
entries.translated:
Un giorno ci sarà una bella statua
grande qui. Renderà Tehl Town alla\lpari con tutte quelle città fighe

con le statue.

entries.original:
"My brother and his friend are so
cute!

They look almost identical!"
entries.translation_source: My brother and his friend are so cute! They look almost identical!
entries.translated:
Mio fratello e il suo amico sono
così carini! Sembrano quasi\lidentici!

entries.original:
"There are these really loud
waterfalls in my Gym, and the\lracket really hurts my head.

It kind of makes want to just Mega
Punch something!"
entries.translation_source: There are these really loud waterfalls in my Gym, and the racket really hurts my head. It kind of makes want to just Mega Punch something!
entries.translated:
Ci sono delle cascate davvero
rumorose nella mia Palestra, e il\lfrastuono mi fa davvero male alla

testa. Mi viene voglia di prendere
a Megapugno qualcosa!

entries.original:
"Oh, sorry!
I forgot to introduce myself!

I’m Mel, the Gym Leader of
[green]Fallshore City[blue].

You’re a challenger?
Then meet me at my Gym.

I’m not really in the mood to go
back right now, so if you don’t put\lup a good fight, I’m gonna loose my\lMega Punch on you!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, sorry! I forgot to introduce myself! I’m Mel, the Gym Leader of [color-green-1]Fallshore City[color-blue-2]. You’re a challenger? Then meet me at my Gym. I’m not really in the mood to go back right now, so if you don’t put up a good fight, I’m gonna loose my Mega Punch on you!
entries.translated:
Oh, scusa! Ho dimenticato di
presentarmi! Sono Mel, la\lCapopalestra di [green]Fallshore City[blue]. Sei

una sfidante? Allora vieni da me
nella mia Palestra. In questo\lmomento non ho molta voglia di

tornare indietro, quindi se non mi
offrirai una bella lotta, ti tirerò\lun Mega Punch addosso!

entries.original:
"The sea\.

Full of fury one moment, calm as a
Pokémon’s nature the next\."
entries.translation_source: The sea[game-token-1] Full of fury one moment, calm as a Pokémon’s nature the next[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Il mare\. Furioso un momento, calmo
come la natura di un Pokémon quello\ldopo\.

entries.original:
"A Gem is a special type of held
item that powers up a single attack\lin battle, then disappears\lforever.

Each Gem corresponds to specific
type, and can only power up that\ltype of move.

Every Gym Leader in Borrius has at
least one of their Pokémon holding\la Gem, so be wary.

If you’re concerned about this, you
can use the move [green]Incinerate[blue] to\lmelt their Gem first, before they\lhave a chance to use it."
entries.translation_source: A Gem is a special type of held item that powers up a single attack in battle, then disappears forever. Each Gem corresponds to specific type, and can only power up that type of move. Every Gym Leader in Borrius has at least one of their Pokémon holding a Gem, so be wary. If you’re concerned about this, you can use the move [color-green-1]Incinerate[color-blue-2] to melt their Gem first, before they have a chance to use it.
entries.translated:
Una Gemma è un tipo speciale di
strumento tenuto che potenzia un\lsingolo attacco in battaglia, per

poi scomparire per sempre. Ogni
Gemma corrisponde a un tipo\lspecifico e può potenziare solo

mosse di quel tipo. Ogni
Capopalestra di Borrius ha almeno\luno dei propri Pokémon che tiene

una Gemma, quindi fai attenzione.
Se sei preoccupato per questo, puoi\lusare la mossa [green]Incenerimento[blue] per

fondere prima la loro Gemma, prima
che abbiano la possibilità di\lusarla.

entries.original: "You must be an experienced trainer."
entries.translation_source: You must be an experienced trainer.
entries.translated: Devi essere un allenatore esperto.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]I will tolerate no screw
ups!

Last time, some kid noticed us and
tried to interfere.

I can’t have that happening again.

We don’t have the luxury of 
dealing with [buffer1] now.

Keep a low profile at all costs,
and no matter what, do not get\lnoticed!

Do I make myself clear?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]I will tolerate no screw ups! Last time, some kid noticed us and tried to interfere. I can’t have that happening again. We don’t have the luxury of dealing with [buffer1-2] now. Keep a low profile at all costs, and no matter what, do not get noticed! Do I make myself clear?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Non tollererò errori!
L{B4}ultima volta, un ragazzino ci ha\lnotati e ha cercato di interferire.

Non posso permettere che succeda di
nuovo. Non abbiamo il lusso di\loccuparci di [buffer1] adesso.

Mantenete un basso profilo a ogni
costo e, qualunque cosa accada, non\lfatevi notare! Sono stato chiaro?

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Move out."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Move out.
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]In marcia.

entries.original:
"You did well delivering Log’s
package to him.

Oh?

What’s this?

I see that Log has entrusted you
with your very own Poké Balls.

I used to be a whiz Trainer back in
my day.

I could show you a thing or two
about capturing Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You did well delivering Log’s package to him. Oh? What’s this? I see that Log has entrusted you with your very own Poké Balls. I used to be a whiz Trainer back in my day. I could show you a thing or two about capturing Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Hai fatto bene a consegnare il
pacco di Log a lui. Oh? Cos{B4}è\lquesto? Vedo che Log ti ha affidato

le tue Poké Ball personali. Una
volta ero un Allenatore\leccezionale, ai miei tempi. Potrei

insegnarti un paio di cose su come
catturare i Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Alright!
Here we go!"
entries.translation_source: Alright! Here we go!
entries.translated: Va bene! Si parte!

entries.original:
"Phew\.

That one was too close for
comfort\."
entries.translation_source: Phew[game-token-1] That one was too close for comfort[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Phew\. Quello è stato troppo vicino
per star tranquilli\.

entries.original:
"Let me tell you a secret.

The Gym Leader in Dehara City,
Galavan, uses Electric Pokémon.

He tries to catch opponents who use
Water Pokémon off guard.

But whenever he’s not up to it, he
lowers the bridge between the city\land his gym.

So if you want to battle him then,
you’ll just have to wait."
entries.translation_source: Let me tell you a secret. The Gym Leader in Dehara City, Galavan, uses Electric Pokémon. He tries to catch opponents who use Water Pokémon off guard. But whenever he’s not up to it, he lowers the bridge between the city and his gym. So if you want to battle him then, you’ll just have to wait.
entries.translated:
Ti svelo un segreto. Il
Capopalestra di Dehara City,\lGalavan, usa Pokémon Elettro. Cerca

di cogliere di sorpresa gli
avversari che usano Pokémon Acqua.\lMa quando non ne ha voglia, abbassa

il ponte tra la città e la sua
palestra. Quindi, se vuoi sfidarlo\lin quel momento, dovrai solo

aspettare.

entries.original:
"Through here is the entrance to the
Tomb of Borrius.

It is said that the ancient king,
who summoned the dark force long\lago, is burried here.

But you won’t be able to go
anywhere inside without Galavan’s\lpermission, so don’t bother trying."
entries.translation_source: Through here is the entrance to the Tomb of Borrius. It is said that the ancient king, who summoned the dark force long ago, is burried here. But you won’t be able to go anywhere inside without Galavan’s permission, so don’t bother trying.
entries.translated:
Di qui c{B4}è l{B4}ingresso alla Tomba di
Borrius. Si dice che l{B4}antico re,\lche evocò la forza oscura molto

tempo fa, sia sepolto qui. Ma non
potrai andare da nessuna parte\lall{B4}interno senza il permesso di

Galavan, quindi non perdere tempo a
provarci.

entries.original:
"It’s my job to make sure this city
stays a beautiful oasis at the edge\lof the desert.

All these trees aren’t natural to
this area.

I was responsible for planting
them!"
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to make sure this city stays a beautiful oasis at the edge of the desert. All these trees aren’t natural to this area. I was responsible for planting them!
entries.translated:
È mio compito assicurarmi che
questa città resti una splendida\loasi al confine del deserto. Tutti

questi alberi non sono originari di
questa zona. Sono stato io a\lpiantarli!

entries.original:
"Dehara City is the perfect blend
between tourism and living.

This whole area of the city is
designed to attract tourists, but\lpeople are still able to live in\lthis city in the north-eastern part\lof town."
entries.translation_source: Dehara City is the perfect blend between tourism and living. This whole area of the city is designed to attract tourists, but people are still able to live in this city in the north-eastern part of town.
entries.translated:
La Città di Dehara è il perfetto
equilibrio tra turismo e vita\lquotidiana. Quest{B4}intera area della

città è progettata per attirare i
turisti, ma le persone riescono\lcomunque a vivere in questa città

nella parte nord-orientale.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like you have
enough space in your party for my\ldear Riolu.

Come back when you’ve made space,
so I can give it to you."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like you have enough space in your party for my dear Riolu. Come back when you’ve made space, so I can give it to you.
entries.translated:
Non sembra che tu abbia abbastanza
spazio nella squadra per il mio\lcaro Riolu. Torna quando avrai

fatto spazio, così potrò dartelo.

entries.original:
"The strange creature was sucked into
the Cube!"
entries.translation_source: The strange creature was sucked into the Cube!
entries.translated:
La strana creatura è stata
risucchiata nel Cubo!

entries.original:
"You have collected [green][buffer3] percent[black]
of cells."
entries.translation_source: You have collected [color-green-1][buffer3-2] percent[color-black-3] of cells.
entries.translated:
Hai raccolto il [green][buffer3] percento[black]
delle cellule.

entries.original:
"You, there!

Trainer!

Wait!"
entries.translation_source: You, there! Trainer! Wait!
entries.translated: Ehi, tu! Allenatore! Aspetta!

entries.original:
"Is that a Super Cube in your
pocket?

\.

It is!

You’re just the person I’ve been
looking for!

Please come with me."
entries.translation_source: Is that a Super Cube in your pocket? [game-token-1] It is! You’re just the person I’ve been looking for! Please come with me.
entries.translated:
Hai una Super Cube in tasca? \. Ce
l{B4}hai! Sei proprio la persona che\lstavo cercando! Per favore, vieni

con me.

entries.original:
"[blue]Thank you for coming with me.

\.

What’s that?

It’s not like you really had a
choice?

Such nonsense.

I don’t know what you’re talking
about.

Let’s get down to business."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Thank you for coming with me. [game-token-2] What’s that? It’s not like you really had a choice? Such nonsense. I don’t know what you’re talking about. Let’s get down to business.
entries.translated:
[blue]Grazie per essere venuto con me. \.
Che cos{B4}è? Non è che avevi davvero\lscelta? Che sciocchezze. Non so di

cosa tu stia parlando. Passiamo
agli affari.

entries.original:
"[red]Recently pieces of a Pokémon known
as Zygarde have been appearing all\lover Borrius.

However, these pieces can only be
seen if you have a Super Cube with\la special feature installed."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Recently pieces of a Pokémon known as Zygarde have been appearing all over Borrius. However, these pieces can only be seen if you have a Super Cube with a special feature installed.
entries.translated:
[red]Di recente, frammenti di un Pokémon
noto come Zygarde stanno apparendo\lin tutto Borrius. Tuttavia, questi

frammenti possono essere visti solo
se hai una Super Cubo con una\lfunzione speciale installata.

entries.original:
"[blue]Zygarde is a Pokémon from Kalos
that appears when the ecosystem is\lin danger.

Why it’s appearing here, and now,
is a mystery to us.

We’re trying to find the answer to
this, but we need someone to go\land collect all of the individual\l\qocells\qc and \qocores\qc of Zygarde."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Zygarde is a Pokémon from Kalos that appears when the ecosystem is in danger. Why it’s appearing here, and now, is a mystery to us. We’re trying to find the answer to this, but we need someone to go and collect all of the individual [quote-open-2]cells[quote-close-3] and [quote-open-4]cores[quote-close-5] of Zygarde.
entries.translated:
[blue]Zygarde è un Pokémon di Kalos che
appare quando l{B4}ecosistema è in\lpericolo. Perché stia apparendo

qui, e ora, è un mistero per noi.
Stiamo cercando di trovare la\lrisposta, ma abbiamo bisogno di

qualcuno che vada a raccogliere
tutte le singole \qocellule\qc e\l\qonuclei\qc di Zygarde.

entries.original:
"[red]Do you think you’d be able to help
us with our research?

We need an experienced trainer who
plans on travelling around Borrius."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Do you think you’d be able to help us with our research? We need an experienced trainer who plans on travelling around Borrius.
entries.translated:
[red]Pensi che potresti aiutarci con la
nostra ricerca? Abbiamo bisogno di\lun allenatore esperto che abbia

intenzione di viaggiare per
Borrius.

entries.original:
"[red]Are you sure about that?

Your help would be invaluable to
us."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Are you sure about that? Your help would be invaluable to us.
entries.translated:
[red]Ne sei sicuro? Il tuo aiuto sarebbe
preziosissimo per noi.

entries.original:
"[blue]Great!

Thank you for agreeing to help!

If you could please give me your
Cube for a sec...

\.

Okay!

Your Cube has been updated to allow
you to see and collect Zygarde\lCells.

The cells can be found scattered
around both West and East Borrius.

Once you’ve collected at least 10
percent, please come see me.

But for now, good luck!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Great! Thank you for agreeing to help! If you could please give me your Cube for a sec... [game-token-2] Okay! Your Cube has been updated to allow you to see and collect Zygarde Cells. The cells can be found scattered around both West and East Borrius. Once you’ve collected at least 10 percent, please come see me. But for now, good luck!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ottimo! Grazie per aver accettato
di aiutarmi! Potresti prestarmi per\lun attimo il tuo Cube... \. Perfetto!

Il tuo Cube è stato aggiornato per
permetterti di vedere e raccogliere\lle Cellule di Zygarde. Le cellule

si possono trovare sparse in tutta
Borrius Ovest e Borrius Est. Una\lvolta che ne avrai raccolto almeno

il 10 percento, vieni a trovarmi.
Per ora, buona fortuna!

entries.original:
"Back in the day, my husband
travelled the world in search of\lrare Pokémon.

If you have the Pokémon he’s
looking for, would you please trade\lwith him?"
entries.translation_source: Back in the day, my husband travelled the world in search of rare Pokémon. If you have the Pokémon he’s looking for, would you please trade with him?
entries.translated:
Tanto tempo fa, mio marito
viaggiava per il mondo alla ricerca\ldi Pokémon rari. Se hai il Pokémon

che sta cercando, potresti fare uno
scambio con lui?

entries.original:
"Mel is always surrounding himself
with many different women.

He must feel always be feeling
really lonely\."
entries.translation_source: Mel is always surrounding himself with many different women. He must feel always be feeling really lonely[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mel è sempre circondato da donne
diverse. Deve sentirsi molto solo\.

entries.original:
"Hmm...

There have been numerous reports of
cells being spotted, lately...

What could this mean..."
entries.translation_source: Hmm... There have been numerous reports of cells being spotted, lately... What could this mean...
entries.translated:
Hmm... Di recente ci sono state
numerose segnalazioni di cellule\lavvistate... Che cosa potrebbe

significare...

entries.original:
"When you have collected at least
10 percent of cells, please report\lback to my husband."
entries.translation_source: When you have collected at least 10 percent of cells, please report back to my husband.
entries.translated:
Quando avrai raccolto almeno il 10
percento delle cellule, torna da\lmio marito, per favore.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected at
least 10 percent of the cells.

Good work!

If you haven’t already, please talk
to my husband."
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected at least 10 percent of the cells. Good work! If you haven’t already, please talk to my husband.
entries.translated:
Sembra che tu abbia raccolto almeno
il 10 percento delle cellule.\lOttimo lavoro! Se non l{B4}hai già

fatto, per favore parla con mio
marito.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected at
least 50 percent of the cells.

You’re half way there!

If you haven’t already, please talk
to my husband."
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected at least 50 percent of the cells. You’re half way there! If you haven’t already, please talk to my husband.
entries.translated:
Sembra che tu abbia raccolto almeno
il 50 percento delle cellule. Sei a\lmetà strada! Se non l{B4}hai già

fatto, parla con mio marito, per
favore.

entries.original:
"You’ve collected all of the cells!

This is a major help to our
research!

Thank you so much!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve collected all of the cells! This is a major help to our research! Thank you so much!
entries.translated:
Hai raccolto tutte le cellule! È un
grande aiuto per la nostra ricerca!\lGrazie mille!

entries.original:
"A trainer!

Thank you so much for coming to my
home!

My wife and I have something very
important that we need taken care\lof."
entries.translation_source: A trainer! Thank you so much for coming to my home! My wife and I have something very important that we need taken care of.
entries.translated:
Un allenatore! Grazie mille per
essere venuto a casa mia! Mia\lmoglie e io abbiamo qualcosa di

molto importante di cui dobbiamo
occuparci.

entries.original:
"When you have collected at least
10 percent of cells, please report\lback to me."
entries.translation_source: When you have collected at least 10 percent of cells, please report back to me.
entries.translated:
Quando avrai raccolto almeno il 10
percento delle celle, torna a\lriferirmelo.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected at
least 10 percent of the cells.

I can’t do much for you right now,
but I can quickly assemble these\lcells into a temporary Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected at least 10 percent of the cells. I can’t do much for you right now, but I can quickly assemble these cells into a temporary Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sembra che tu abbia raccolto almeno
il 10 percento delle cellule. Non\lposso fare molto per te al momento,

ma posso assemblare rapidamente
queste cellule in un Pokémon\ltemporaneo.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like you have any
space in your party for this\lPokémon.

Come back when you’ve made more
space."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like you have any space in your party for this Pokémon. Come back when you’ve made more space.
entries.translated:
Non sembra che tu abbia spazio nel
tuo gruppo per questo Pokémon.\lTorna quando avrai liberato più

posto.

entries.original:
"When you have collected at least
50 percent of cells, please report\lback to me."
entries.translation_source: When you have collected at least 50 percent of cells, please report back to me.
entries.translated:
Quando avrai raccolto almeno il 50
percento delle celle, torna a\lriferirmelo.

entries.original:
"Please be aware that this Zygarde
is only a temporary construct, and\lany stat changes will be lost when\lit is disassembled."
entries.translation_source: Please be aware that this Zygarde is only a temporary construct, and any stat changes will be lost when it is disassembled.
entries.translated:
Tieni presente che questo Zygarde è
solo una costruzione temporanea e\lche eventuali modifiche alle

statistiche andranno perse quando
verrà smontato.

entries.original:
"[player] received a Zygarde from the
scientist!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received a Zygarde from the scientist!
entries.translated:
[player] ha ricevuto uno Zygarde
dallo scienziato!

entries.original:
"He traded me his [green]Magmar[blue] holding a
[green]Magmarizer[blue], and it evolved!"
entries.translation_source: He traded me his [color-green-1]Magmar[color-blue-2] holding a [color-green-3]Magmarizer[color-blue-4], and it evolved!
entries.translated:
Mi ha scambiato il suo [green]Magmar[blue] che
teneva un [green]Magmarizer[blue], e si è\levoluto!

entries.original:
"Oh\.

My whole body aches\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] My whole body aches[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Mi fa male tutto il corpo\.

entries.original:
"I have had this Pokémon Egg for a
while, but I think it’s finally\lclose to hatching.

Which Pokémon could it be?"
entries.translation_source: I have had this Pokémon Egg for a while, but I think it’s finally close to hatching. Which Pokémon could it be?
entries.translated:
Ho questo Uovo Pokémon da un po{B4},
ma penso che stia finalmente per\lschiudersi. Che Pokémon potrebbe

essere?

entries.original:
"Log’s words echoed in your head:
[blue]Go make sure [rival] is okay!"
entries.translation_source: Log’s words echoed in your head: [color-blue-1]Go make sure [text-token-rival-2] is okay!
entries.translated:
Le parole di Log ti risuonavano in
testa: [blue]Vai a controllare che\l[rival] stia bene!

entries.original: "I’m going to catch even more cuties!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to catch even more cuties!
entries.translated:
Catturerò ancora più Pokémon
carini!

entries.original: "I lost because of the cold."
entries.translation_source: I lost because of the cold.
entries.translated: Ho perso a causa del freddo.

entries.original:
"Greetings, [player].

I am a researcher studying seasonal
form changes of Pokémon.

Since the seasons don’t change in
Borrius, I’m very interested in\llearning how certain Pokémon\lchange form in this region.

Would you like to help me with my
research?"
entries.translation_source: Greetings, [player-name-1]. I am a researcher studying seasonal form changes of Pokémon. Since the seasons don’t change in Borrius, I’m very interested in learning how certain Pokémon change form in this region. Would you like to help me with my research?
entries.translated:
Saluti, [player]. Sono un
ricercatore che studia i\lcambiamenti di forma stagionali dei

Pokémon. Poiché le stagioni non
cambiano a Borrius, sono molto\linteressato a scoprire come certi

Pokémon cambiano forma in questa
regione. Vorresti aiutarmi con le\lmie ricerche?

entries.original:
"Splendid!

I’m currently researching the
Pokémon known as [green][buffer1][blue].

To start off the research, I’d like
to study a [green][buffer1][blue] in [green][buffer2][blue] form."
entries.translation_source: Splendid! I’m currently researching the Pokémon known as [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]. To start off the research, I’d like to study a [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] in [color-green-7][buffer2-8][color-blue-9] form.
entries.translated:
Splendido! Al momento sto studiando
il Pokémon noto come [green][buffer1][blue]. Per\lcominciare la ricerca, vorrei

studiare un [green][buffer1][blue] nella forma
[green][buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"No?

If you change your mind, your help
would still be invaluable."
entries.translation_source: No? If you change your mind, your help would still be invaluable.
entries.translated:
No? Se cambi idea, il tuo aiuto
sarebbe comunque inestimabile.

entries.original:
"Have you brought me a [green][buffer1][blue] in
[green][buffer2][blue] form to study?

*Frisk* *Frisk*"
entries.translation_source: Have you brought me a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] in [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6] form to study? *Frisk* *Frisk*
entries.translated:
Mi hai portato un [green][buffer1][blue] nella
forma [green][buffer2][blue] da studiare? *Frisk*\l*Frisk*

entries.original:
"Ah, it doesn’t appear you have
brought one.

I’d like to see a [green][buffer1][blue] in
[green][buffer2][blue] form, please."
entries.translation_source: Ah, it doesn’t appear you have brought one. I’d like to see a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] in [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6] form, please.
entries.translated:
Ah, a quanto pare non ne hai
portato uno. Vorrei vedere un\l[green][buffer1][blue] in [green][buffer2][blue] forma, per

favore.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes, you have.

Please wait a moment while I study
it."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes, you have. Please wait a moment while I study it.
entries.translated:
Ah, sì, ce l{B4}hai davvero. Aspetta
un momento mentre lo studio.

entries.original:
"Interesting\.

I’ve added invaluable data to my
research.

Next, I’d like to see a [green][buffer1][blue]
in [green][buffer3][blue] form."
entries.translation_source: Interesting[game-token-1] I’ve added invaluable data to my research. Next, I’d like to see a [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] in [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-blue-7] form.
entries.translated:
Interessante\. Ho aggiunto dati
preziosissimi alla mia ricerca. Per\lprima cosa, vorrei vedere un

[green][buffer1][blue] in forma [green][buffer3][blue].

entries.original:
"I’ve done it!
I’ve completed the study!

Several key observations have led
me to the conclusion that although\lthere are no seasonal changes in\lBorrius, different forms of\lseasonal Pokémon appear in\ldifferent locations around Borrius.

Your help has been invaluable in
coming to this conclusion!

If you don’t already have this,
please, take this TM!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve done it! I’ve completed the study! Several key observations have led me to the conclusion that although there are no seasonal changes in Borrius, different forms of seasonal Pokémon appear in different locations around Borrius. Your help has been invaluable in coming to this conclusion! If you don’t already have this, please, take this TM!
entries.translated:
Ho fatto! Ho completato lo studio!
Diverse osservazioni chiave mi\lhanno portato alla conclusione che,

sebbene in Borrius non ci siano
cambiamenti stagionali, diverse\lforme stagionali di Pokémon

compaiono in luoghi diversi in
tutta Borrius. Il tuo aiuto è stato\lpreziosissimo per arrivare a questa

conclusione! Se non ce l{B4}hai già,
per favore, prendi questa MT!

entries.original:
"I passed on my findings to the
National Science Society and was\lregarded with the highest of\lhonours.

I have you to thank you for this.
I will always remember your work."
entries.translation_source: I passed on my findings to the National Science Society and was regarded with the highest of honours. I have you to thank you for this. I will always remember your work.
entries.translated:
Ho trasmesso le mie scoperte alla
National Science Society e sono\lstato insignito dei più alti onori.

Ti devo ringraziare per questo.
Ricorderò sempre il tuo lavoro.

entries.original: "Spring"
entries.translation_source: Spring
entries.translated: Primavera

entries.original: "Autumn"
entries.translation_source: Autumn
entries.translated: Autunno

entries.original:
"Battle me.

Show me you too, can be as furious
as the sea."
entries.translation_source: Battle me. Show me you too, can be as furious as the sea.
entries.translated:
Sfidami. Dimmi che anche tu puoi
essere furioso come il mare.

entries.original:
"The [green]Muscle Band[blue] can increase your
Pokémon’s physical fury."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Muscle Band[color-blue-2] can increase your Pokémon’s physical fury.
entries.translated:
La [green]Muscolbanda[blue] può aumentare la
potenza fisica del tuo Pokémon.

entries.original:
"As you witnessed, I sucessfully
captured that Pokémon by throwing\la [green]Poké Ball[blue].

However, this won’t always work.

Many times, Pokémon must be
weakened, before you’ll be able to\lcapture them."
entries.translation_source: As you witnessed, I sucessfully captured that Pokémon by throwing a [color-green-1]Poké Ball[color-blue-2]. However, this won’t always work. Many times, Pokémon must be weakened, before you’ll be able to capture them.
entries.translated:
Come hai visto, sono riuscito a
catturare quel Pokémon lanciando\luna [green]Poké Ball[blue]. Tuttavia, non

funziona sempre. Molte volte i
Pokémon devono essere indeboliti\lprima che tu possa catturarli.

entries.original: "[red]Hiyah!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Hiyah!
entries.translated: [red]Hiyah!

entries.original:
"If you would ever like to see my
skills again, please, stop by."
entries.translation_source: If you would ever like to see my skills again, please, stop by.
entries.translated:
Se mai volessi rivedere le mie
abilità, passa pure a trovarmi.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]It’s time for you to burn!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]It’s time for you to burn!
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]È ora che tu bruci!

entries.original:
"If you ever would like to see me in
action, please, stop by."
entries.translation_source: If you ever would like to see me in action, please, stop by.
entries.translated:
Se un giorno vorrai vedermi
all{B4}opera, passa pure.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]I’ve just received new
orders from Zeph.

We need to tighten security on
Route 9.

[player] escaped from him through a
portal back in Cinder Volcano.

Zeph is worried about this
happening again and disrupting the\lmission.

I’m going to find a suitable place
to set up a psychic barrier around\lthe route, but I need you three to\lstand guard at the gate."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]I’ve just received new orders from Zeph. We need to tighten security on Route 9. [player-name-2] escaped from him through a portal back in Cinder Volcano. Zeph is worried about this happening again and disrupting the mission. I’m going to find a suitable place to set up a psychic barrier around the route, but I need you three to stand guard at the gate.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Ho appena ricevuto nuovi
ordini da Zeph. Dobbiamo rafforzare\lla sicurezza sul Percorso 9.

[player] gli è sfuggito attraverso
un portale al Cinder Volcano. Zeph\lteme che succeda di nuovo,

compromettendo la missione. Troverò
un posto adatto per creare una\lbarriera psichica attorno al

percorso, ma ho bisogno che voi tre
facciate la guardia al cancello.

entries.original: "Grunts: [blue]Yes, ma’am!"
entries.translation_source: Grunts: [color-blue-1]Yes, ma’am!
entries.translated: Reclute: [blue]Sissignora!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Hmm\.

In order to set up a strong
barrier, I should head to the peak\lof Frost Mountain\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Hmm[game-token-2] In order to set up a strong barrier, I should head to the peak of Frost Mountain[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Hmm\. Per preparare una
barriera forte, dovrei andare alla\lvetta di Frost Mountain\.

entries.original: "Antisis City"
entries.translation_source: Antisis City
entries.translated: Città di Antisis

entries.original:
"The Black Emboar won’t fall so
easily!"
entries.translation_source: The Black Emboar won’t fall so easily!
entries.translated:
L{B4}Emboar Nero non cadrà così
facilmente!

entries.original:
"The Black Emboar!
Never stop, and never look back!"
entries.translation_source: The Black Emboar! Never stop, and never look back!
entries.translated:
Il Black Emboar! Non fermarti mai e
non voltarti mai indietro!

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here
right now.

He’s probably off clearing his head
somewhere."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here right now. He’s probably off clearing his head somewhere.
entries.translated:
Mel, il Capopalestra, non è qui in
questo momento. Probabilmente è\landato a schiarirsi le idee da

qualche parte.

entries.original: "Tarmigan Town"
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town
entries.translated: Cittadina di Tarmigan

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Town

The town located on the
Thundercap Highland."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town The town located on the Thundercap Highland.
entries.translated:
Tarmigan Town La città situata
sull{B4}Altopiano di Thundercap.

entries.original:
"Here at the Dream Research Lab,
we study the dreams of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Here at the Dream Research Lab, we study the dreams of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Qui al Laboratorio di Ricerca sui
Sogni studiamo i sogni dei Pokémon.

entries.original:
"In the Unova Region, a scientist
named Fennel created a device that\lallowed people to visually see the\ldreams of Pokémon.

It allowed you to go to the
Pokémon’s \qoDream World\qo and\linteract with them.

We’re trying to create a device
just like it and pass it off as our\lown invention, so don’t tell\lanybody."
entries.translation_source: In the Unova Region, a scientist named Fennel created a device that allowed people to visually see the dreams of Pokémon. It allowed you to go to the Pokémon’s [quote-open-1]Dream World[quote-open-2] and interact with them. We’re trying to create a device just like it and pass it off as our own invention, so don’t tell anybody.
entries.translated:
Nella regione di Unima, una
scienziata di nome Fennel creò un\ldispositivo che permetteva alle

persone di vedere visivamente i
sogni dei Pokémon. Ti permetteva di\landare nel Pokémon{B4}s \qoDream World\qo

e interagire con loro. Stiamo
cercando di creare un dispositivo\lidentico e spacciarlo per una

nostra invenzione, quindi non dirlo
a nessuno.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon, Darkrai, has the
unique ability to damage Pokémon\lwhile they are asleep.

My goal is to find out the reason
why it can just enter a Pokémon’s\ldream without using an attack."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon, Darkrai, has the unique ability to damage Pokémon while they are asleep. My goal is to find out the reason why it can just enter a Pokémon’s dream without using an attack.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon, Darkrai, ha l{B4}abilità
unica di danneggiare i Pokémon\lmentre dormono. Il mio obiettivo è

scoprire il motivo per cui può
entrare nei sogni di un Pokémon\lsenza usare un attacco.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon walking around this
lab all assist in the research.

They’re all special Pokémon known
for eating dreams."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon walking around this lab all assist in the research. They’re all special Pokémon known for eating dreams.
entries.translated:
I Pokémon che camminano in questo
laboratorio aiutano tutti nella\lricerca. Sono tutti Pokémon

speciali noti per nutrirsi dei
sogni.

entries.original: "Gar!"
entries.translation_source: Gar!
entries.translated: Gar!

entries.original: "Hyyyyyyyyypno..."
entries.translation_source: Hyyyyyyyyypno...
entries.translated: Hyyyyyyyyypno...

entries.original: "Sharna!"
entries.translation_source: Sharna!
entries.translated: Sharna!

entries.original: "Na!"
entries.translation_source: Na!
entries.translated: Na!

entries.original:
"I work at the facility over here
called the Dream Research Lab.

We do exactly as it sounds, we
research dreams.

But my work isn’t going so well, so
I’m taking a breather."
entries.translation_source: I work at the facility over here called the Dream Research Lab. We do exactly as it sounds, we research dreams. But my work isn’t going so well, so I’m taking a breather.
entries.translated:
Lavoro nella struttura qui vicino
chiamata Dream Research Lab.\lFacciamo esattamente ciò che

sembra: studiamo i sogni. Ma il mio
lavoro non sta andando molto bene,\lquindi mi sto prendendo una pausa.

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Town is so seculuded in
the mountains, it doesn’t have its\lown entrance to the [green]SES Expressway[red]!

If you wanna go down the mountain,
you’ll have to walk."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town is so seculuded in the mountains, it doesn’t have its own entrance to the [color-green-1]SES Expressway[color-red-2]! If you wanna go down the mountain, you’ll have to walk.
entries.translated:
Tarmigan Town è così isolata tra le
montagne che non ha un suo accesso\lalla [green]SES Expressway[red]! Se vuoi

scendere dalla montagna, dovrai
andare a piedi.

entries.original:
"I prefer swimming in a calm lake
much more than in the sea."
entries.translation_source: I prefer swimming in a calm lake much more than in the sea.
entries.translated:
Preferisco nuotare in un lago calmo
molto più che nel mare.

entries.original: "Maybe I should start wearing pants."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should start wearing pants.
entries.translated:
Forse dovrei iniziare a indossare
dei pantaloni.

entries.original: "Next time I will crush you!"
entries.translation_source: Next time I will crush you!
entries.translated: La prossima volta ti schiaccerò!

entries.original:
"I heard from a friend that under
[green]Tehl Town[red], that tiny town to the\lwest of here, is a secret\lunderground passage to [green]Route 9[red].

But there can’t actually be\.
Come on! Who’d believe that?"
entries.translation_source: I heard from a friend that under [color-green-1]Tehl Town[color-red-2], that tiny town to the west of here, is a secret underground passage to [color-green-3]Route 9[color-red-4]. But there can’t actually be[game-token-5] Come on! Who’d believe that?
entries.translated:
Ho sentito da un amico che sotto
[green]Tehl Town[red], quella cittadina\lminuscola a ovest di qui, c{B4}è un

passaggio sotterraneo segreto fino
a [green]Percorso 9[red]. Ma non può davvero\lesserci\. Dai! Chi ci crederebbe?

entries.original:
"Young trainer.

I have been carrying around this
Egg with me ever since it was laid.

However, I am willing to give it to
