Devi stare attento e prepararti a
questo se vuoi batterli. Se non sai\lcos{B4}è la Mega Evoluzione, pensala

come un mega potenziamento.

entries.original:
"Thanks, [player].
I really appreciate it.

I’m going to try to find some way
onto [green]Route 9[blue] from [green]Tehl Town[blue].

You should proabably try something
similar."
entries.translation_source: Thanks, [player-name-1]. I really appreciate it. I’m going to try to find some way onto [color-green-2]Route 9[color-blue-3] from [color-green-4]Tehl Town[color-blue-5]. You should proabably try something similar.
entries.translated:
Grazie, [player]. Te ne sono
davvero grato. Cercherò in qualche\lmodo di arrivare a [green]Percorso 9[blue] da

[green]Tehl Town[blue]. Dovresti probabilmente
provare a fare qualcosa di simile.

entries.original:
"Thirty years ago, a large meteorite
was hurtling towards Borrius.

The astronomers in Seaport City
predicted that if it wasn’t\lstopped, it would fall directly on\lValley City, this city, and end all\llife living here.

With great haste, we began our
evacuation of the city.

As we were about to make our escape
through the SES Expressway, we\lheard the news.

The meteorite was now predicted to
crush half of the region!

If we attempted to flee
underground, there would be a\llarge chance we’d be buried alive.

Chaos ensued.

All was thought hopeless\.until
HE arrived.

[green]Aros[blue], the legend.

He arrived alongside Arceus
and used a small Pokémon to\lteleport everyone to East Borrius,\lsafe from harm.

He planned to attack the meteorite
head on and smash it to bits.

Once he had transported everyone to
safety, it is said that he rode on\la Rayquaza and smashed into\lthe meteorite!

It shattered, and most of the
smaller fragments fell on\lValley City.

The city was destroyed, but Aros
had saved a region.

I will never forget the heroic act
that man performed."
entries.translation_source: Thirty years ago, a large meteorite was hurtling towards Borrius. The astronomers in Seaport City predicted that if it wasn’t stopped, it would fall directly on Valley City, this city, and end all life living here. With great haste, we began our evacuation of the city. As we were about to make our escape through the SES Expressway, we heard the news. The meteorite was now predicted to crush half of the region! If we attempted to flee underground, there would be a large chance we’d be buried alive. Chaos ensued. All was thought hopeless[game-token-1]until HE arrived. [color-green-2]Aros[color-blue-3], the legend. He arrived alongside Arceus and used a small Pokémon to teleport everyone to East Borrius, safe from harm. He planned to attack the meteorite head on and smash it to bits. Once he had transported everyone to safety, it is said that he rode on a Rayquaza and smashed into the meteorite! It shattered, and most of the smaller fragments fell on Valley City. The city was destroyed, but Aros had saved a region. I will never forget the heroic act that man performed.
entries.translated:
Trent{B4}anni fa, un grande meteorite
stava precipitando verso Borrius.\lGli astronomi di Seaport City

avevano previsto che se non fosse
stato fermato, sarebbe caduto\ldirettamente su Valley City, questa

città, e avrebbe posto fine a tutta
la vita che viveva qui. Con grande\lfretta, iniziammo l{B4}evacuazione

della città. Mentre stavamo per
fuggire attraverso la SES\lExpressway, sentimmo la notizia. Il

meteorite ora era previsto che
avrebbe schiacciato metà della\lregione! Se avessimo tentato di

fuggire sottoterra, ci sarebbe
stata una grande probabilità di\lessere sepolti vivi. Ne seguì il

caos. Tutto era considerato senza
speranza\.finché LUI arrivò. [green]Aros[blue], la\lleggenda. Arrivò insieme ad Arceus

e usò un piccolo Pokémon per
teletrasportare tutti a East\lBorrius, al sicuro dal pericolo.

Aveva in programma di attaccare il
meteorite frontalmente e di farlo a\lpezzi. Una volta trasportati tutti

al sicuro, si dice che cavalcò un
Rayquaza e si schiantò contro il\lmeteorite! Si frantumò, e la

maggior parte dei frammenti più
piccoli cadde su Valley City. La\lcittà fu distrutta, ma Aros aveva

salvato una regione. Non
dimenticherò mai l{B4}atto eroico\lcompiuto da quell{B4}uomo.

entries.original:
"[red]For some reason, the entrance to
the SES Expressway has frozen over.

It’s my job as Gym Leader of this
city, to take care of it.

Watch how I can use the move,
Rock Smash, to break the ice!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]For some reason, the entrance to the SES Expressway has frozen over. It’s my job as Gym Leader of this city, to take care of it. Watch how I can use the move, Rock Smash, to break the ice!
entries.translated:
[red]Per qualche motivo, l{B4}ingresso
della SES Expressway è ghiacciato.\lÈ mio compito, in qualità di

Capopalestra di questa città,
occuparmene. Guarda come posso\lusare la mossa, Spaccaroccia, per

rompere il ghiaccio!

entries.original:
"[red]Just face a cracked rock and select
the Pokémon you wish to break it.

I hope you understand the basics of
using Rock Smash now!

I have to get back to the Gym, so
I’ll see you again another time!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Just face a cracked rock and select the Pokémon you wish to break it. I hope you understand the basics of using Rock Smash now! I have to get back to the Gym, so I’ll see you again another time!
entries.translated:
[red]Basta avvicinarti a una roccia
crepata e selezionare il Pokémon\lche vuoi usare per spaccarla. Spero

che ora tu abbia capito le basi di
Spaccaroccia! Devo tornare in\lPalestra, quindi ci rivedremo

un{B4}altra volta!

entries.original:
"I’m going to stay rooted to this
spot for all of eternity."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to stay rooted to this spot for all of eternity.
entries.translated:
Resterò piantato in questo punto
per tutta l{B4}eternità.

entries.original:
"Hi!

Welcome to Blizzard City!"
entries.translation_source: Hi! Welcome to Blizzard City!
entries.translated: Ciao! Benvenuto a Blizzard City!

entries.original:
"Do you see that item on the table?

That is my prized possesion, the
[green]Master Ball[red].

It is a rare Poké Ball that can
capture any Pokémon without fail.

The man who gave it to me, [green]Aros[red],
said to watch over it as if my life\ldepended on it.

That is until someone shows me a
small purple Pokémon, [green]Hoopa[red].

Aros said the one who controls
Hoopa is the Guardian of Borrius\land worthy of this Ball.

Are you the Guardian of Borrius, or
just another brat?"
entries.translation_source: Do you see that item on the table? That is my prized possesion, the [color-green-1]Master Ball[color-red-2]. It is a rare Poké Ball that can capture any Pokémon without fail. The man who gave it to me, [color-green-3]Aros[color-red-4], said to watch over it as if my life depended on it. That is until someone shows me a small purple Pokémon, [color-green-5]Hoopa[color-red-6]. Aros said the one who controls Hoopa is the Guardian of Borrius and worthy of this Ball. Are you the Guardian of Borrius, or just another brat?
entries.translated:
Vedi quell{B4}oggetto sul tavolo?
Quello è il mio bene più prezioso,\lil [green]Master Ball[red]. È una rara Poké

Ball che può catturare qualsiasi
Pokémon senza fallire. L{B4}uomo che\lme l{B4}ha data, [green]Aros[red], ha detto di

sorvegliarla come se la mia vita ne
dipendesse. Finché qualcuno non mi\lmostra un piccolo Pokémon viola,

[green]Hoopa[red]. Aros ha detto che colui che
controlla Hoopa è il Guardiano di\lBorrius e degno di questa Ball. Sei

tu il Guardiano di Borrius, o solo
un altro monello?

entries.original:
"Really?
Prove it to me!

Show me the Pokémon known as
[green]Hoopa[red]!"
entries.translation_source: Really? Prove it to me! Show me the Pokémon known as [color-green-1]Hoopa[color-red-2]!
entries.translated:
Davvero? Dimostramelo! Fammi vedere
il Pokémon conosciuto come [green]Hoopa[red]!

entries.original:
"Look at my lips\.
They’re the colour of prunes!"
entries.translation_source: Look at my lips[game-token-1] They’re the colour of prunes!
entries.translated:
Guarda le mie labbra\. Hanno il
colore delle prugne secche!

entries.original:
"[buffer1]!
It’s so cuddly and pink!

You should use the [green]Oval Stone[red] to
evolve it!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1]! It’s so cuddly and pink! You should use the [color-green-2]Oval Stone[color-red-3] to evolve it!
entries.translated:
[buffer1]! È così morbido e rosa!
Dovresti usare la [green]Pietra Ovale[red] per\lfarlo evolvere!

entries.original:
"That’s not a [green][buffer1][red]!

Waaaah!
I wanna see a [green][buffer1][red]!"
entries.translation_source: That’s not a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]! Waaaah! I wanna see a [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-red-6]!
entries.translated:
Quello non è un [green][buffer1][red]! Uaaah!
Voglio vedere un [green][buffer1][red]!

entries.original:
"Everyone around here is like,
\qoevolution this\qc and \qoevolution\lthat\qc.

But I think evolution is stupid!

My personal favourite way of
preventing evolution is not by\lpressing the [green]B-button[blue] when my\lPokémon is about to evolve, but by\lhaving it hold and [green]Everstone[blue].

That way I can skip the whole
evolution thing altogether!"
entries.translation_source: Everyone around here is like, [quote-open-1]evolution this[quote-close-2] and [quote-open-3]evolution that[quote-close-4]. But I think evolution is stupid! My personal favourite way of preventing evolution is not by pressing the [color-green-5]B-button[color-blue-6] when my Pokémon is about to evolve, but by having it hold and [color-green-7]Everstone[color-blue-8]. That way I can skip the whole evolution thing altogether!
entries.translated:
Tutti qui fanno \qoquesta evoluzione\qc
e \qoquell{B4}evoluzione\qc. Ma io penso\lche l{B4}evoluzione sia stupida! Il

mio modo preferito per impedire
l{B4}evoluzione non è premere il\l[green]pulsante B[blue] quando il mio Pokémon

sta per evolversi, ma fargli tenere
una [green]Pietrastante[blue]. Così posso\lsaltare del tutto tutta questa

storia dell{B4}evoluzione!

entries.original:
"Your [green][buffer1][red] should hold the [green]Oval
Stone[red] during the [green]daytime[red]!"
entries.translation_source: Your [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] should hold the [color-green-4]Oval Stone[color-red-5] during the [color-green-6]daytime[color-red-7]!
entries.translated:
[green][buffer1][red] dovrebbe tenere la [green]Pietra
Ovale[red] durante il [green]giorno[red]!

entries.original:
"I was training my [green]Nosepass[blue] in
[green]Thundercap Mountain[blue] the other day,\lwhen all of a sudden it began to\lglow!

The next thing I knew, it had
evolved into a Probopass!

That mountain must have some weird
properties."
entries.translation_source: I was training my [color-green-1]Nosepass[color-blue-2] in [color-green-3]Thundercap Mountain[color-blue-4] the other day, when all of a sudden it began to glow! The next thing I knew, it had evolved into a Probopass! That mountain must have some weird properties.
entries.translated:
Stavo allenando il mio [green]Nosepass[blue] sul
[green]Monte Thundercap[blue] l{B4}altro giorno,\lquando all{B4}improvviso ha iniziato a

brillare! Quando me ne sono
accorto, si era evoluto in un\lProbopass! Quel monte deve avere

proprietà davvero strane.

entries.original:
"You’d never catch me outside when
it’s raining!

\.

Actually, most people here would
probably head indoors."
entries.translation_source: You’d never catch me outside when it’s raining! [game-token-1] Actually, most people here would probably head indoors.
entries.translated:
Non mi vedresti mai fuori quando
piove! \. In realtà, la maggior parte\ldella gente qui probabilmente

rientrerebbe.

entries.original:
"ËËËŒ
I make a ton of my money selling
items I find on Wild Pokémon.

My Venonat’s [green]Compoundeyes[blue] help me
lure in the ones with items, then\lI use [green]Thief[blue] to nab ’em!"
entries.translation_source: ËËËŒ I make a ton of my money selling items I find on Wild Pokémon. My Venonat’s [color-green-1]Compoundeyes[color-blue-2] help me lure in the ones with items, then I use [color-green-3]Thief[color-blue-4] to nab ’em!
entries.translated: ËËËŒ Faccio un sacco di soldi vendendo gli oggetti che trovo sui Pokémon selvatici. L{B4}[green]Insettocchio[blue] del mio Venonat mi aiuta ad attirare quelli con gli oggetti, poi uso [green]Furto[blue] per rubarglieli!

entries.original:
"I hate it when it rains.

I don’t live here, so its not like
I can go inside like everyone else\."
entries.translation_source: I hate it when it rains. I don’t live here, so its not like I can go inside like everyone else[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Odio quando piove. Non vivo qui,
quindi non è che possa entrare come\ltutti gli altri\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Splendid!

In [green]Bellin Town[blue] at the [green]Poké Mart[blue],
there is a package waiting for me.

I need you to pick it up.

I would get it myself, however,
like I said previously, I am too\lold to travel.

I have already informed the clerk
that I was not going to get it\lmyself, but he insisted that it\lmust be picked up from [green]Bellin Town[blue].

It should not be too hard for you
since you have your own Pokémon.

Ho ho ho!

If you need anything from me, I’ll
be in my lab.

It’s not that far, just down the
road.

But before you go anywhere, you
should check in with your mother.

She is likely very worried
about you.

Good luck, [player].
My studies depend on you."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Splendid! In [color-green-2]Bellin Town[color-blue-3] at the [color-green-4]Poké Mart[color-blue-5], there is a package waiting for me. I need you to pick it up. I would get it myself, however, like I said previously, I am too old to travel. I have already informed the clerk that I was not going to get it myself, but he insisted that it must be picked up from [color-green-6]Bellin Town[color-blue-7]. It should not be too hard for you since you have your own Pokémon. Ho ho ho! If you need anything from me, I’ll be in my lab. It’s not that far, just down the road. But before you go anywhere, you should check in with your mother. She is likely very worried about you. Good luck, [player-name-8]. My studies depend on you.
entries.translated:
[blue]Splendido! A [green]Bellin Town[blue] al
[green]Pokémercato[blue], c{B4}è un pacco in attesa\lper me. Ho bisogno che tu lo

ritiri. Lo prenderei io stesso, ma,
come ti ho detto, sono troppo\lvecchio per viaggiare. Ho già

informato l{B4}impiegato che non
l{B4}avrei ritirato io personalmente,\lma ha insistito che doveva essere

ritirato da [green]Bellin Town[blue]. Non
dovrebbe essere troppo difficile\lper te dato che hai i tuoi Pokémon.

Ho ho ho! Se hai bisogno di
qualcosa da me, sarò nel mio\llaboratorio. Non è così lontano,

giù per la strada. Ma prima di
andare da qualche parte, dovresti\lpassare a trovare tua madre.

Probabilmente è molto preoccupata
per te. Buona fortuna, [player]. I\lmiei studi dipendono da te.

entries.original:
"[blue]Lately, the citizens of Epidimy
Town have been complaining about\ltheir inability to visit Thundercap\lMountain.

Some strange guy is apparently
blocking the entrance and saying\lthat he’s there to keep you from\lentering.

I don’t know what’s going on, but
my head can’t handle these\lcomplaints anymore.

As this is likely your mess, meet
me in [green]Epidimy Town[blue] to help clean\lit up.

I don’t have all day, so take this
to get yourself there faster."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Lately, the citizens of Epidimy Town have been complaining about their inability to visit Thundercap Mountain. Some strange guy is apparently blocking the entrance and saying that he’s there to keep you from entering. I don’t know what’s going on, but my head can’t handle these complaints anymore. As this is likely your mess, meet me in [color-green-2]Epidimy Town[color-blue-3] to help clean it up. I don’t have all day, so take this to get yourself there faster.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ultimamente, i cittadini di Epidimy
Town si lamentano di non poter\lvisitare Thundercap Mountain. A

quanto pare, uno strano tipo sta
bloccando l{B4}ingresso e dice che è\llì per impedirti di entrare. Non so

cosa stia succedendo, ma la mia
testa non può più gestire queste\llamentele. Visto che probabilmente

è un tuo pasticcio, incontrami a
[green]Epidimy Town[blue] per aiutare a\lsistemare le cose. Non ho tutto il

giorno, quindi prendi questo per
arrivarci più velocemente.

entries.original:
"[blue]Don’t keep me waiting too long,
[player].

I’d rather get this problem solved
sooner rather than later."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Don’t keep me waiting too long, [player-name-2]. I’d rather get this problem solved sooner rather than later.
entries.translated:
[blue]Non farmi aspettare troppo,
[player]. Preferirei risolvere\lquesto problema prima possibile.

entries.original:
"Galavan likes to use both [green]Electric[blue]-
and [green]Steel[blue]-type Pokémon.

Bringing a [green]Ground[blue]-type Pokémon is
a good way to wreck him.

[green]Fire[blue]- and [green]Fighting[blue]-types are also
good against his [green]Steel[blue]-types.

Be advised, however.

An electric current runs across
the battlefield.

This means that all [green]Electric[blue]-type
moves will be powered up.

A hit from one could be
devastating!

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: Galavan likes to use both [color-green-1]Electric[color-blue-2]- and [color-green-3]Steel[color-blue-4]-type Pokémon. Bringing a [color-green-5]Ground[color-blue-6]-type Pokémon is a good way to wreck him. [color-green-7]Fire[color-blue-8]- and [color-green-9]Fighting[color-blue-10]-types are also good against his [color-green-11]Steel[color-blue-12]-types. Be advised, however. An electric current runs across the battlefield. This means that all [color-green-13]Electric[color-blue-14]-type moves will be powered up. A hit from one could be devastating! Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Galavan preferisce usare Pokémon
sia di tipo [green]Elettro[blue] che di tipo\l[green]Acciaio[blue]. Portare un Pokémon di tipo

[green]Terra[blue] è un buon modo per
sconfiggerlo. Anche i tipi [green]Fuoco[blue] e\l[green]Lotta[blue] sono efficaci contro i suoi

Pokémon di tipo [green]Acciaio[blue]. Tuttavia,
tieni presente. Una corrente\lelettrica attraversa il campo di

battaglia. Ciò significa che tutte
le mosse di tipo [green]Elettro[blue] saranno\lpotenziate. Un colpo del genere

potrebbe essere devastante! Buona
fortuna là fuori!

entries.original:
"Well done!

Not only did you manage to overcome
the Electric Terrain, but you\lalso managed to fight through\lGalavan’s surprise sandstorm!

Take these two Gems as further
recognition of your accomplishment."
entries.translation_source: Well done! Not only did you manage to overcome the Electric Terrain, but you also managed to fight through Galavan’s surprise sandstorm! Take these two Gems as further recognition of your accomplishment.
entries.translated:
Ben fatto! Non solo sei riuscito a
superare il Campo Elettrico, ma sei\lanche riuscito a farti strada

attraverso la tempesta di sabbia a
sorpresa di Galavan! Prendi queste\ldue Gemme come ulteriore

riconoscimento del tuo risultato.

entries.original:
"My Pokémon evolved from the energy
in this cave!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon evolved from the energy in this cave!
entries.translated:
I miei Pokémon si sono evoluti
grazie all{B4}energia di questa\lgrotta!

entries.original:
"Those Gems I can gave you can power
up [green]Electric[blue]- and [green]Steel[blue]-type moves,\lrespectively.

You can zap your opponent with one
Pokémon, then pummel with another!"
entries.translation_source: Those Gems I can gave you can power up [color-green-1]Electric[color-blue-2]- and [color-green-3]Steel[color-blue-4]-type moves, respectively. You can zap your opponent with one Pokémon, then pummel with another!
entries.translated:
Le Gemme che posso darti possono
potenziare mosse di tipo [green]Elettro[blue] e\l[green]Acciaio[blue], rispettivamente. Puoi

fulminare il tuo avversario con un
Pokémon, poi martellarlo con un\laltro!

entries.original:
"Champ in the making!

Welcome to the crime-ridden slums
that is Antisis City!

Have some Fresh Water straight from
my tap."
entries.translation_source: Champ in the making! Welcome to the crime-ridden slums that is Antisis City! Have some Fresh Water straight from my tap.
entries.translated:
Campione in erba! Benvenuto nelle
baraccopoli di Antisis City,\lflagellate dal crimine! Prendi un

po{B4} di Acqua Fresca direttamente
dal mio rubinetto.

entries.original:
"There are many watery routes that
you can swim in Borrius.

It puts the Hoenn region to shame!"
entries.translation_source: There are many watery routes that you can swim in Borrius. It puts the Hoenn region to shame!
entries.translated:
Ci sono molti percorsi acquatici
che puoi attraversare a nuoto in\lBorrius. Fa impallidire la regione

di Hoenn!

entries.original:
"My top speed went down when I got
trapped in that electric web!"
entries.translation_source: My top speed went down when I got trapped in that electric web!
entries.translated:
La mia velocità massima è calata
quando sono rimasto intrappolato in\lquella ragnatela elettrica!

entries.original:
"The air in this mountain is
electrifying!

It’s nothing like Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: The air in this mountain is electrifying! It’s nothing like Antisis City.
entries.translated: L{B4}aria su questa montagna è elettrizzante! Non è affatto come ad Antisis City.

entries.original:
"I’m clearly not electrified enough
to win\."
entries.translation_source: I’m clearly not electrified enough to win[game-token-1]
entries.translated: È evidente che non sono abbastanza elettrizzato per vincere\.

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt.

\al Epidimy Town
\ar Antisis City"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. [game-token-1] Epidimy Town [game-token-2] Antisis City
entries.translated:
Thundercap Mt. \al Città Epidimy \ar
Città Antisis

entries.original: "Have you seen the rare Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Have you seen the rare Pokémon?
entries.translated: Hai visto il Pokémon raro?

entries.original:
"Hmm, should I continue on?
Or should I go home?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm, should I continue on? Or should I go home?
entries.translated: Hmm, dovrei continuare? Oppure tornare a casa?

entries.original:
"It’s times like these when I wonder
what the right decision is."
entries.translation_source: It’s times like these when I wonder what the right decision is.
entries.translated: Sono momenti come questi che mi fanno chiedere quale sia la decisione giusta.

entries.original:
"Big Mo is a lover of tough,
[green]Fighting[blue]-type Pokémon.

If you have a [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or
[green]Fairy[blue]-type, you’ll win no prob!

But before you can face Big Mo,
you’ll need to clear the Antisis\lGym [green]Ring Challenge[blue].

And for that, no [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-,
or [green]Fairy[blue] types are allowed.

But honestly, as long as you’re not
using a Pokémon weak to Fighting-\lmoves, it’ll be easy to clear.

Good luck in the ring!"
entries.translation_source: Big Mo is a lover of tough, [color-green-1]Fighting[color-blue-2]-type Pokémon. If you have a [color-green-3]Flying[color-blue-4]-, [color-green-5]Psychic[color-blue-6]-, or [color-green-7]Fairy[color-blue-8]-type, you’ll win no prob! But before you can face Big Mo, you’ll need to clear the Antisis Gym [color-green-9]Ring Challenge[color-blue-10]. And for that, no [color-green-11]Flying[color-blue-12]-, [color-green-13]Psychic[color-blue-14]-, or [color-green-15]Fairy[color-blue-16] types are allowed. But honestly, as long as you’re not using a Pokémon weak to Fighting- moves, it’ll be easy to clear. Good luck in the ring!
entries.translated:
Big Mo è un amante dei Pokémon di
tipo [green]Lotta[blue]. Se hai un tipo\l[green]Volante[blue]-, [green]Psico[blue]- o [green]Folletto[blue]-,

vincerai senza problemi! Ma prima
di affrontare Big Mo, dovrai\lsuperare la [green]Sfida dell{B4}Anello[blue] della

Palestra di Antisis. E per quella,
nessun tipo [green]Volante[blue]-, [green]Psico[blue]- o\l[green]Folletto[blue] è permesso. Ma

onestamente, finché non usi un
Pokémon debole alle mosse Lotta,\lsarà facile superarla. Buona

fortuna nell{B4}anello!

entries.original:
"That guy, he just came out of
nowhere\."
entries.translation_source: That guy, he just came out of nowhere[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Quel tizio, è sbucato dal nulla\.

entries.original:
"The item is sealed behind the
elctric barrier."
entries.translation_source: The item is sealed behind the elctric barrier.
entries.translated:
L{B4}oggetto è sigillato dietro la
barriera elettrica.

entries.original:
"It’s not smart to pick a fight with
The Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: It’s not smart to pick a fight with The Shadows!
entries.translated:
Non è saggio cercare rogne con The
Shadows!

entries.original:
"Doesn’t matter.
You will be consumed."
entries.translation_source: Doesn’t matter. You will be consumed.
entries.translated: Non importa. Verrai divorato.

entries.original:
"Give up.

Life is meaningless."
entries.translation_source: Give up. Life is meaningless.
entries.translated: Arrenditi. La vita non ha senso.

entries.original: "Even you, will die."
entries.translation_source: Even you, will die.
entries.translated: Anche tu morirai.

entries.original: "So, you want to see Ivory?"
entries.translation_source: So, you want to see Ivory?
entries.translated: Quindi, vuoi vedere Ivory?

entries.original: "I’d better warn Ivory about you\."
entries.translation_source: I’d better warn Ivory about you[game-token-1]
entries.translated: È meglio che avverta Ivory di te\.

entries.original: "I feel your wrath."
entries.translation_source: I feel your wrath.
entries.translated: Sento la tua ira.

entries.original:
"You’ll never defeat all of us!
We’re invincible!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll never defeat all of us! We’re invincible!
entries.translated:
Non ci sconfiggerai mai tutti!
Siamo invincibili!

entries.original:
"Uh-oh!
I see a kid!"
entries.translation_source: Uh-oh! I see a kid!
entries.translated: Oh-oh! C{B4}è un bambino!

entries.original: "Lights out!"
entries.translation_source: Lights out!
entries.translated: Luci spente!

entries.original:
"You won’t find Ivory by just
scurrying around!"
entries.translation_source: You won’t find Ivory by just scurrying around!
entries.translated:
Non troverai Ivory semplicemente
vagando in giro!

entries.original:
"I’m Ivory’s last line of defense!

You may have been able to break
onto the route, but you won’t be\lable to break through me!"
entries.translation_source: I’m Ivory’s last line of defense! You may have been able to break onto the route, but you won’t be able to break through me!
entries.translated:
Sono l{B4}ultima linea di difesa di
Ivory! Potreste essere riusciti a\lirrompere sul Percorso, ma non

riuscirete a superare me!

entries.original: "I’d better go warn Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: I’d better go warn Ivory!
entries.translated:
È meglio che vada ad avvertire
Ivory!

entries.original:
"[red][player], I forgot to show you
something!

Please come with me to the
SES Expressway."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1][player-name-2], I forgot to show you something! Please come with me to the SES Expressway.
entries.translated:
[red][player], ho dimenticato di
mostrarti una cosa! Per favore,\lvieni con me alla SES Expressway.

entries.original:
"Oh man, I haven’t seen anyone beat
Big Mo in a while, let alone clear\lthe Ring Challenge!

Well done!
You’ve proven your toughness!

Take this Gem to improve it even
further!"
entries.translation_source: Oh man, I haven’t seen anyone beat Big Mo in a while, let alone clear the Ring Challenge! Well done! You’ve proven your toughness! Take this Gem to improve it even further!
entries.translated:
Accidenti, è da un po{B4} che non
vedevo nessuno battere Big Mo,\lfigurarsi superare la Sfida

dell{B4}Anello! Ben fatto! Hai
dimostrato la tua tempra! Prendi\lquesta Gemma per migliorarla ancora

di più!

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single Fighting-type move in battle.

If you use it, you’ll seem tougher
than you already are!"
entries.translation_source: That Gem I gave you can power up a single Fighting-type move in battle. If you use it, you’ll seem tougher than you already are!
entries.translated:
Quella Gemma che ti ho dato può
potenziare una singola mossa di\ltipo Lotta in lotta. Se la usi,

sembrerai ancora più tosto di
quanto già non sei!

entries.original:
"Maybe I should go back to
Antisis City.

I’m out of my depth in here."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should go back to Antisis City. I’m out of my depth in here.
entries.translated:
Forse dovrei tornare a Antisis
City. Qui sono fuori dalla mia\lportata.

entries.original:
"Your skill makes my rubber gear
seem useless.

Maybe I should invest in a more
expensive brand."
entries.translation_source: Your skill makes my rubber gear seem useless. Maybe I should invest in a more expensive brand.
entries.translated:
La tua abilità fa sembrare il mio
equipaggiamento di gomma inutile.\lForse dovrei investire in una marca

più costosa.

entries.original:
"When I was your age, most of the
paths here didn’t exist.

I dug through the cave with my
trusty Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: When I was your age, most of the paths here didn’t exist. I dug through the cave with my trusty Pokémon.
entries.translated: Alla tua età, la maggior parte dei sentieri qui non esisteva. Ho scavato nella grotta con il mio fidato Pokémon.

entries.original:
"When I was your age, we respected
our elders.

We didn’t mercilessly beat them."
entries.translation_source: When I was your age, we respected our elders. We didn’t mercilessly beat them.
entries.translated: Quando avevo la tua età, rispettavamo gli anziani. Non li picchiavamo senza pietà.

entries.original:
"Youngsters like you\.
No respect for their elders."
entries.translation_source: Youngsters like you[game-token-1] No respect for their elders.
entries.translated:
Giovani come voi\. Nessun rispetto
per gli anziani.

entries.original:
"Bellin Town

A quiet town nestled deep in the
mountains."
entries.translation_source: Bellin Town A quiet town nestled deep in the mountains.
entries.translated:
Bellin Town Una tranquilla
cittadina nascosta in profondità\ltra le montagne.

entries.original:
"Trainer House
Battle to your heart’s content!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer House Battle to your heart’s content!
entries.translated:
Casa Allenatori: combatti a
volontà!

entries.original:
"Did you know there is a special
Poké Ball that heals Pokémon?

When you capture a Pokémon, all
damage done to it is undone!

Here, try some!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know there is a special Poké Ball that heals Pokémon? When you capture a Pokémon, all damage done to it is undone! Here, try some!
entries.translated:
Lo sapevi che esiste una speciale
Poké Ball che cura i Pokémon?\lQuando catturi un Pokémon, tutti i

danni subiti vengono annullati!
Tieni, prendine qualcuna!

entries.original:
"Use them in good health!
Heh, heh, see what I did there?"
entries.translation_source: Use them in good health! Heh, heh, see what I did there?
entries.translated:
Usali in salute! Eheh, hai visto il
gioco di parole?

entries.original:
"That is Hoopa!
That is Hoopa!

You are the Guardian of Borrius!
Take the Master Ball!"
entries.translation_source: That is Hoopa! That is Hoopa! You are the Guardian of Borrius! Take the Master Ball!
entries.translated:
Quello è Hoopa! Quello è Hoopa! Sei
il Guardiano di Borrius! Prendi la\lMaster Ball!

entries.original:
"Then, I have no time for you.
Shoo! Shoo!"
entries.translation_source: Then, I have no time for you. Shoo! Shoo!
entries.translated:
Allora non ho tempo per te. Via!
Via!

entries.original: "Let’s go, Staraptor."
entries.translation_source: Let’s go, Staraptor.
entries.translated: Andiamo, Staraptor.

entries.original:
"Dresco Town

The archipelago of the Borrius
Region."
entries.translation_source: Dresco Town The archipelago of the Borrius Region.
entries.translated:
Dresco Town, l{B4}arcipelago della
Regione di Borrius.

entries.original:
"Cinder Volcano
Passage"
entries.translation_source: Cinder Volcano Passage
entries.translated: Passaggio del Vulcano Cinder

entries.original:
"Crater Town Pokémon Gym
Leader: Vega\lThe Double Agent."
entries.translation_source: Crater Town Pokémon Gym Leader: Vega The Double Agent.
entries.translated:
Capopalestra della Palestra Pokémon
di Crater Town: Vega, il doppio\lagente.

entries.original: "The door is locked."
entries.translation_source: The door is locked.
entries.translated: La porta è chiusa a chiave.

entries.original: "SES Expressway"
entries.translation_source: SES Expressway
entries.translated: Superstrada SES

entries.original:
"That is not Hoopa!

I have no time for you!
Shoo! Shoo!"
entries.translation_source: That is not Hoopa! I have no time for you! Shoo! Shoo!
entries.translated:
Quello non è Hoopa! Non ho tempo
per te! Via! Via!

entries.original:
"Guardian of Borrius!
It is pleasure being in your midst!"
entries.translation_source: Guardian of Borrius! It is pleasure being in your midst!
entries.translated:
Guardiano di Borrius! È un piacere
essere in mezzo a voi!

entries.original:
"Blizzard City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Alice\lThe High Flying Ice Queen."
entries.translation_source: Blizzard City Pokémon Gym Leader: Alice The High Flying Ice Queen.
entries.translated:
Capopalestra di Blizzard City:
Alice, la Regina del Ghiaccio\lVolante.

entries.original:
"Blizzard City
The chilly mountain city."
entries.translation_source: Blizzard City The chilly mountain city.
entries.translated:
Blizzard City, la gelida città di
montagna.

entries.original:
"This lighthouse was once a beacon
of hope for tourists.

But ever since Antisis City was
turned into a crime-filled slum,\ltourists have stopped coming to\lthis port."
entries.translation_source: This lighthouse was once a beacon of hope for tourists. But ever since Antisis City was turned into a crime-filled slum, tourists have stopped coming to this port.
entries.translated:
Questo faro era un tempo un faro di
speranza per i turisti. Ma da\lquando Antisis City è stata

trasformata in una baraccopoli
piena di crimini, i turisti hanno\lsmesso di venire in questo porto.

entries.original:
"There are plenty of different
healing methods available to you\lin the mansion.

It’s honestly a little redundant\."
entries.translation_source: There are plenty of different healing methods available to you in the mansion. It’s honestly a little redundant[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Nella villa hai a disposizione
molti metodi di guarigione diversi.\lA dire il vero, è un po{B4} ridondante\.

entries.original:
"I’m responsible for gathering the
daily ingredients."
entries.translation_source: I’m responsible for gathering the daily ingredients.
entries.translated:
Mi occupo di raccogliere gli
ingredienti quotidiani.

entries.original: "Which way will you choose to go?"
entries.translation_source: Which way will you choose to go?
entries.translated: Quale strada sceglierai?

entries.original:
"Hahhh!

I’ll smash you like I smash these
rocks: with my bare hands!"
entries.translation_source: Hahhh! I’ll smash you like I smash these rocks: with my bare hands!
entries.translated: Hahhh! Ti schiaccerò come schiaccio queste rocce: a mani nude!

entries.original:
"It looks like I was the one
smashed today\."
entries.translation_source: It looks like I was the one smashed today[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sembra che oggi sia stato io a essere sconfitto\.

entries.original:
"Hahhh!
I have no need for HM slaves!

I will keep smashing rocks with
my bare hands!"
entries.translation_source: Hahhh! I have no need for HM slaves! I will keep smashing rocks with my bare hands!
entries.translated:
Hahhh! Non ho bisogno di schiavi
delle MN! Continuerò a spaccare\lrocce a mani nude!

entries.original:
"No matter how fast you run, we’ll
be there to stop you!"
entries.translation_source: No matter how fast you run, we’ll be there to stop you!
entries.translated:
Non importa quanto corri veloce,
saremo lì a fermarti!

entries.original:
"Even though I lost, I’m still
very happy!

The cavern is glowing with the
fires of passion!"
entries.translation_source: Even though I lost, I’m still very happy! The cavern is glowing with the fires of passion!
entries.translated:
Anche se ho perso, sono comunque
felicissima! La caverna risplende\ldei fuochi della passione!

entries.original:
"I sense great power within you.
Power that will kneel to mine!"
entries.translation_source: I sense great power within you. Power that will kneel to mine!
entries.translated: Sento in te un grande potere. Un potere che si inginocchierà davanti al mio!

entries.original: "Oh spirits, I have failed you."
entries.translation_source: Oh spirits, I have failed you.
entries.translated: Oh spiriti, vi ho deluso.

entries.original:
"It appears I need to spend more
time honing my clairvoyance."
entries.translation_source: It appears I need to spend more time honing my clairvoyance.
entries.translated:
Sembra che debba dedicare più tempo
a perfezionare la mia\lchiaroveggenza.

entries.original:
"The last Guardian of Borrius, [green]Aros[blue],
tasked several older couples with\lguarding rare or powerful objects.

We are one such couple.

Another couple, I believe, lives on
Route 9."
entries.translation_source: The last Guardian of Borrius, [color-green-1]Aros[color-blue-2], tasked several older couples with guarding rare or powerful objects. We are one such couple. Another couple, I believe, lives on Route 9.
entries.translated:
L{B4}ultimo Guardiano di Borrius,
[green]Aros[blue], affidò a diverse coppie\lanziane il compito di custodire

oggetti rari o potenti. Noi siamo
una di quelle coppie. Un{B4}altra\lcoppia, credo, vive sulla Route 9.

entries.original: "[black]Lapras: [green]Prasss!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Lapras: [color-green-2]Prasss!
entries.translated: [black]Lapras: [green]Prasss!

entries.original:
"There was a Pokémon hiding under
the lily pad!

The Pokémon attacked!"
entries.translation_source: There was a Pokémon hiding under the lily pad! The Pokémon attacked!
entries.translated:
C{B4}era un Pokémon nascosto sotto la
ninfea! Il Pokémon ha attaccato!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] dove back into the
pond."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] dove back into the pond.
entries.translated:
Il [buffer1] si è tuffato di nuovo
nello stagno.

entries.original:
"Oh, you finally made it.

My head started hurting again while
waiting for you to show up.

I hope you can make my return to
the Gym, worth it."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you finally made it. My head started hurting again while waiting for you to show up. I hope you can make my return to the Gym, worth it.
entries.translated:
Oh, alla fine sei arrivato. Mi ha
ricominciato a far male la testa\lmentre ti aspettavo. Spero che tu

possa rendere valido il mio ritorno
alla Palestra.

entries.original:
"Well then, I guess you should take
the [green]Fall Badge[blue].

You sure earned it."
entries.translation_source: Well then, I guess you should take the [color-green-1]Fall Badge[color-blue-2]. You sure earned it.
entries.translated:
Bene allora, credo che tu debba
prendere la [green]Medaglia Autunno[blue]. Te la\lsei meritata.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Fall Badge
from Mel!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Fall Badge from Mel!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto la Medaglia
Autunno da Mel!

entries.original:
"With the Fall Badge, any Pokémon
up to Lv. 60 will obey you.

It also allows your Pokémon to
move heavy boulders with [green]Strength[blue].

Honestly, I don’t know why any
strong Pokémon can’t already do\lthis\.

But what can you do?

That’s just the way the world
works.

Anyways, take this TM to go along
with that badge. "
entries.translation_source: With the Fall Badge, any Pokémon up to Lv. 60 will obey you. It also allows your Pokémon to move heavy boulders with [color-green-1]Strength[color-blue-2]. Honestly, I don’t know why any strong Pokémon can’t already do this[game-token-3] But what can you do? That’s just the way the world works. Anyways, take this TM to go along with that badge.
entries.translated:
Con la Medaglia d{B4}Autunno,
qualsiasi Pokémon fino al Lv. 60 ti\lobbedirà. Inoltre permette ai tuoi

Pokémon di spostare massi pesanti
con [green]Forza[blue]. Onestamente, non capisco\lperché qualsiasi Pokémon forte non

possa già farlo\.. Ma che ci vuoi
fare? È così che va il mondo.\lComunque, prendi questa MT insieme

a quella medaglia.

entries.original:
"TM42 contains [green]Facade[blue].

If your Pokémon has a status
condition, this move’ll get twice\las powerful.

Even stronger than Mega Punch!

Use it, and make your enemies
regret inflicting you with status!"
entries.translation_source: TM42 contains [color-green-1]Facade[color-blue-2]. If your Pokémon has a status condition, this move’ll get twice as powerful. Even stronger than Mega Punch! Use it, and make your enemies regret inflicting you with status!
entries.translated:
MT42 contiene [green]Facciata[blue]. Se il tuo
Pokémon ha una condizione di stato,\lquesta mossa raddoppia la potenza.

Ancora più forte di Megapugno!
Usala e fai rimpiangere ai tuoi\lnemici di averti inflitto uno stato

alterato!

entries.original:
"Now that you’ve beaten me, here
comes another splitting headache\."
entries.translation_source: Now that you’ve beaten me, here comes another splitting headache[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ora che mi hai battuto, ecco
arrivare un altro gran mal di testa\.

entries.original:
"Champ in the making!
How go the battles?

Welcome to the Fallshore City Gym!

Have some Fresh Water, straight
from the ponds of this Gym."
entries.translation_source: Champ in the making! How go the battles? Welcome to the Fallshore City Gym! Have some Fresh Water, straight from the ponds of this Gym.
entries.translated:
Campione in erba! Come vanno le
lotte? Benvenuto alla Palestra di\lFallshore City! Prendi un po{B4} di

Acqua Fresca, direttamente dagli
stagni di questa Palestra.

entries.original:
"Mel?
Well, he’s just a normal guy!

Punching him or his Pokémon with
some powerful [green]Fighting[blue]-types is a\lgood way to take him down.

If you’re ready to battle, start by
sliding down the slide next to me!

But make sure you’re stocked up on
supplies first.

There’s no going back until you
reach Mel."
entries.translation_source: Mel? Well, he’s just a normal guy! Punching him or his Pokémon with some powerful [color-green-1]Fighting[color-blue-2]-types is a good way to take him down. If you’re ready to battle, start by sliding down the slide next to me! But make sure you’re stocked up on supplies first. There’s no going back until you reach Mel.
entries.translated:
Mel? Beh, è solo un tipo normale!
Colpirlo lui o i suoi Pokémon con\ldei potenti Pokémon di tipo [green]Lotta[blue] è

un buon modo per batterlo. Se sei
pronto a combattere, inizia\lscivolando giù dallo scivolo

accanto a me! Ma assicurati prima
di fare scorta di provviste. Non si\lpuò tornare indietro finché non

raggiungi Mel.

entries.original:
"Bravo!

Mel took quite a beating, didn’t
he?

I bet he’d have taken an even worse
one, had you had this Gem."
entries.translation_source: Bravo! Mel took quite a beating, didn’t he? I bet he’d have taken an even worse one, had you had this Gem.
entries.translated:
Bravo! Mel ha preso una bella
botta, non è vero? Scommetto che ne\lavrebbe presa una ancora peggiore,

se avessi avuto questa Gemma.

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single Normal-type move in battle.

Normal-type moves may not be
Super-Effective against anything,\lbut with that Gem, they can sure\lfeel like they are!"
entries.translation_source: That Gem I gave you can power up a single Normal-type move in battle. Normal-type moves may not be Super-Effective against anything, but with that Gem, they can sure feel like they are!
entries.translated:
Quella Gemma che ti ho dato può
potenziare una sola mossa di tipo\lNormale in lotta. Le mosse di tipo

Normale potrebbero non essere super
efficaci contro nulla, ma con\lquella Gemma possono sicuramente

sembrare tali!

entries.original:
"You should stock up on [green]revives[red]!

They heal a fainted Pokémon back
to half health!"
entries.translation_source: You should stock up on [color-green-1]revives[color-red-2]! They heal a fainted Pokémon back to half health!
entries.translated:
Faresti meglio a fare scorta di
[green]Rianima[red]! Riporta un Pokémon svenuto\la metà dei PS!

entries.original:
"I must study this mountain
some more.

My knowledge is insufficient."
entries.translation_source: I must study this mountain some more. My knowledge is insufficient.
entries.translated:
Devo studiare ancora questa
montagna. Le mie conoscenze non\lbastano.

entries.original:
"What a fun battle!

You got my blood flowing during my
long climb."
entries.translation_source: What a fun battle! You got my blood flowing during my long climb.
entries.translated: Che lotta divertente! Mi hai fatto scaldare durante la mia lunga salita.

entries.original:
"Be careful when climbing the rock
walls, the fall can be treacherous."
entries.translation_source: Be careful when climbing the rock walls, the fall can be treacherous.
entries.translated:
Fai attenzione quando arrampichi
sulle pareti di roccia: la caduta\lpuò essere pericolosa.

entries.original:
"Did you know?

The Dehara City Gym Leader,
Galavan, trains here regularly."
entries.translation_source: Did you know? The Dehara City Gym Leader, Galavan, trains here regularly.
entries.translated: Lo sapevi? Galavan, la Capopalestra di Dehara City, si allena qui regolarmente.

entries.original:
"Wow, you’re strong!
Do you train here too?"
entries.translation_source: Wow, you’re strong! Do you train here too?
entries.translated: Wow, sei forte! Ti alleni anche tu qui?

entries.original:
"I guess I need to train more to
match Galavan."
entries.translation_source: I guess I need to train more to match Galavan.
entries.translated:
Immagino di dovermi allenare di più
per stare al passo con Galavan.

entries.original:
"The electric barrier blocks you
from passing through."
entries.translation_source: The electric barrier blocks you from passing through.
entries.translated:
La barriera elettrica ti impedisce
di passare.

entries.original:
"The electric barrier has been
disengaged."
entries.translation_source: The electric barrier has been disengaged.
entries.translated:
La barriera elettrica è stata
disattivata.

entries.original:
"The path through this mountain is
exhausting, isn’t it?

Let me heal you up so you can
continue on, worry free!"
entries.translation_source: The path through this mountain is exhausting, isn’t it? Let me heal you up so you can continue on, worry free!
entries.translated:
Il sentiero attraverso questa
montagna è estenuante, vero? Lascia\lche ti curi così puoi continuare

senza preoccupazioni!

entries.original:
"Look!
A Trainer lost in Thundercap Mt!"
entries.translation_source: Look! A Trainer lost in Thundercap Mt!
entries.translated: Guarda! Un Allenatore perso nel Monte Thundercap!

entries.original:
"If you’re working on a Pokédex,
visit Thundercap Mountain.

All sorts of rare Electric Pokémon
live there.

It’s even said that Zapdos roosts
at the peak!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re working on a Pokédex, visit Thundercap Mountain. All sorts of rare Electric Pokémon live there. It’s even said that Zapdos roosts at the peak!
entries.translated:
Se stai compilando il Pokédex,
visita il Monte Thundercap. Lì\lvivono ogni sorta di rari Pokémon

di tipo Elettro. Si dice persino
che Zapdos nidifichi sulla cima!

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, comes out here
often with some of his closer,\l\qofriends\qc."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, comes out here often with some of his closer, [quote-open-1]friends[quote-close-2].
entries.translated:
Mel, il Capopalestra, viene spesso
qui con alcuni dei suoi amici più\lstretti, \qofriends\qc.

entries.original:
"Apparently Mel has his own private
island somewhere out in the ocean!"
entries.translation_source: Apparently Mel has his own private island somewhere out in the ocean!
entries.translated:
Pare che Mel abbia una sua isola
privata da qualche parte in mezzo\lall{B4}oceano!

entries.original:
"Are you up to no good?

\.

Just checking.

There’s no telling when a ruffian
will sneak past the gate check."
entries.translation_source: Are you up to no good? [game-token-1] Just checking. There’s no telling when a ruffian will sneak past the gate check.
entries.translated:
Stai combinando qualche marachella?
\. Controllavo solo. Non si sa mai\lquando un teppista riuscirà a

passare inosservato al controllo
del cancello.

entries.original: "Wiped out in an instant\."
entries.translation_source: Wiped out in an instant[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sconfitto all{B4}istante\.

entries.original:
"This guy with red hair just came
out of nowhere and obliterated all\lof my Pokémon before I even had a\lchance to react!"
entries.translation_source: This guy with red hair just came out of nowhere and obliterated all of my Pokémon before I even had a chance to react!
entries.translated:
Questo tizio dai capelli rossi è
spuntato dal nulla e ha annientato\ltutti i miei Pokémon prima che

avessi il tempo di reagire!

entries.translated:
Percorso 11 \al Fallshore City \ar
Epidimy Town

Percorso 2 \al Città di Dresco \ar
Grotta dei Ghiaccioli

entries.original: "Research Lab"
entries.translation_source: Research Lab
entries.translated: Laboratorio di ricerca

entries.original:
"Afterlife, Shadow Base,
Great Desert, Gurun Town"
entries.translation_source: Afterlife, Shadow Base, Great Desert, Gurun Town
entries.translated:
Afterlife, Shadow Base, Grande
Deserto, Gurun Town

"Route 5

\au Route 4
\ad Crater Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 5 [game-token-1] Route 4 [game-token-2] Crater Town
entries.translated:
Percorso 5 \au Percorso 4 \ad Crater
Town

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Town is located on the
\qoThundercap Highland\qc.

But if you came to see the
lightning storms, you’re out of\lluck.

Those only happen to the east of
here, by Epidimy Town."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town is located on the [quote-open-1]Thundercap Highland[quote-close-2]. But if you came to see the lightning storms, you’re out of luck. Those only happen to the east of here, by Epidimy Town.
entries.translated:
Tarmigan Town si trova
sull{B4}\qoAltopiano Thundercap\qc. Ma se\lsei venuto a vedere i temporali,

sei sfortunato. Succedono solo a
est di qui, vicino a Epidimy Town.

entries.original:
"My family has owned Tarmigan
Mansion for generations.

In fact, my ancestors were
responsible for the formation of\lTarmigan Town itself!

As such, I like to sit out here and
watch the town every now and then.

Don’t just sit around like me,
youngster.

Carpe diem, child!
Seize the day!"
entries.translation_source: My family has owned Tarmigan Mansion for generations. In fact, my ancestors were responsible for the formation of Tarmigan Town itself! As such, I like to sit out here and watch the town every now and then. Don’t just sit around like me, youngster. Carpe diem, child! Seize the day!
entries.translated:
La mia famiglia possiede Tarmigan
Mansion da generazioni. Anzi, i\lmiei antenati furono responsabili

della nascita stessa di Tarmigan
Town! Per questo mi piace stare\lseduto qui fuori e osservare la

città ogni tanto. Non startene
semplicemente lì a poltrire come\lme, ragazzino. Carpe diem, ragazzo!

Cogli l{B4}attimo!

entries.original:
"Someone has been experimenting
today\."
entries.translation_source: Someone has been experimenting today[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Qualcuno si è dato agli esperimenti
oggi\.

entries.original:
"Yo, wazzup fella?

Howzit goin’?

The name’s Galavan.

If ya couldn’t tell, I’m the Gym
Leader here.

I’m sure ya had a tough time
making your way across the\lshocking floor, didn’t ya?

Well, don’t fret, ’cause you
won’t have to fight at a\ldisadvantage anymore."
entries.translation_source: Yo, wazzup fella? Howzit goin’? The name’s Galavan. If ya couldn’t tell, I’m the Gym Leader here. I’m sure ya had a tough time making your way across the shocking floor, didn’t ya? Well, don’t fret, ’cause you won’t have to fight at a disadvantage anymore.
entries.translated:
Yo, che si dice amico? Come va? Mi
chiamo Galavan. Se non l{B4}avessi\lcapito, sono io il Capopalestra

qui. Sono sicuro che hai avuto
difficoltà a farti strada\lattraverso il pavimento

elettrizzante, vero? Beh, non
preoccuparti, perché non dovrai più\lcombattere in svantaggio.

entries.original:
"Ever since ancient times, the
mythical Pokémon Darkrai has\lhaunted this town.

It is said, every night when the
clock strikes one, he comes out\lto haunt the dreams of the masses.

Be wary, child!
Don’t fall into the dark void!"
entries.translation_source: Ever since ancient times, the mythical Pokémon Darkrai has haunted this town. It is said, every night when the clock strikes one, he comes out to haunt the dreams of the masses. Be wary, child! Don’t fall into the dark void!
entries.translated:
Fin dai tempi antichi, il mitico
Pokémon Darkrai infesta questa\lcittà. Si dice che ogni notte,

quando l{B4}orologio batte l{B4}una, esca
per tormentare i sogni delle masse.\lStai attento, bambino! Non cadere

nel vuoto oscuro!

entries.original:
"If I can’t slow you down, at least
this room will."
entries.translation_source: If I can’t slow you down, at least this room will.
entries.translated:
Se non riesco a rallentarti, almeno
questa stanza ci riuscirà.

entries.original: "[black]Chansey: [red]Seyyyy!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Chansey: [color-red-2]Seyyyy!
entries.translated: [black]Chansey: [red]Seyyyy!

entries.original:
"How can you climb up a mountain
with no stairs?"
entries.translation_source: How can you climb up a mountain with no stairs?
entries.translated: Come puoi arrampicarti su una montagna senza scale?

entries.original: "Think on that."
entries.translation_source: Think on that.
entries.translated: Rifletti su questo.

entries.original:
"Suprisingly, you can’t catch any
[green]Voltorb[blue] here.

I hear they’re only found in one of
the Gyms."
entries.translation_source: Suprisingly, you can’t catch any [color-green-1]Voltorb[color-blue-2] here. I hear they’re only found in one of the Gyms.
entries.translated:
Sorprendentemente, qui non puoi
catturare nessun [green]Voltorb[blue]. Ho\lsentito che si trovano solo in una

delle Palestre.

entries.original:
"I hope none of the other grunts
fell off the mountain\."
entries.translation_source: I hope none of the other grunts fell off the mountain[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Spero che nessuna delle altre
reclute sia caduta giù dalla\lmontagna\.

entries.original:
"If those tremors mean what I think
they mean\."
entries.translation_source: If those tremors mean what I think they mean[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Se quei tremori significano quello
che penso che significhino\.

entries.original:
"Now I can’t get back up the ladder,
no matter how hard I try."
entries.translation_source: Now I can’t get back up the ladder, no matter how hard I try.
entries.translated:
Adesso non riesco più a risalire la
scala, per quanto ci provi.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [red]Uh oh!

[player]’s hot on our tails!

I’d better go warn Marlon!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-red-1]Uh oh! [player-name-2]’s hot on our tails! I’d better go warn Marlon!
entries.translated:
Recluta: [red]Oh no! [player] ci sta
alle calcagna! Meglio andare ad\lavvertire Marlon!

entries.original: "I strayed from the battle plan!"
entries.translation_source: I strayed from the battle plan!
entries.translated: Mi sono allontanato dal piano di battaglia!

entries.original:
"Me? No, I’m not lost.
I live here!"
entries.translation_source: Me? No, I’m not lost. I live here!
entries.translated:
Io? No, non mi sono perso. Abito
qui!

entries.original:
"Whew\. I better take a rest\.

Groan\.

That volcano takes a lot out of
you!

Let me heal your Pokémon so you
don’t get tired too."
entries.translation_source: Whew[game-token-1] I better take a rest[game-token-2] Groan[game-token-3] That volcano takes a lot out of you! Let me heal your Pokémon so you don’t get tired too.
entries.translated:
Uff\. Meglio che mi riposi\. Groan\. Quel
vulcano ti sfinisce proprio! Lascia\lche curi i tuoi Pokémon così non si

stancheranno nemmeno loro.

entries.original: "Take care of yourself."
entries.translation_source: Take care of yourself.
entries.translated: Abbi cura di te.

entries.original:
"[blue]Quick!

Grab her now!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Quick! Grab her now!
entries.translated: [blue]Presto! Prendila ora!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I’m really sorry sir, those
people you asked me to guard\lfound some Pokémon and escaped."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]I’m really sorry sir, those people you asked me to guard found some Pokémon and escaped.
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]Mi dispiace davvero,
signore. Quelle persone che mi ha\lchiesto di sorvegliare hanno

trovato dei Pokémon e sono fuggite.

entries.original: "???: [blue]FOOL!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]FOOL!
entries.translated: ???: [blue]SCIOCCO!

entries.original:
"Auburn Waterway

\au Route 6, Valley Cave
\ad Route 10"
entries.translation_source: Auburn Waterway [game-token-1] Route 6, Valley Cave [game-token-2] Route 10
entries.translated:
Canale Auburn \au Percorso 6, Grotta
della Valle \ad Percorso 10

entries.original: "Power Grid"
entries.translation_source: Power Grid
entries.translated: Rete elettrica

entries.original: "Rest Room"
entries.translation_source: Rest Room
entries.translated: Sala relax

entries.original:
"Dream Research Lab

We study your dreams."
entries.translation_source: Dream Research Lab We study your dreams.
entries.translated:
Laboratorio di Ricerca dei Sogni
Studiamo i tuoi sogni.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]No sir, I don’t. But it was
just a small mistake.

I promise, it won’t happen again."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]No sir, I don’t. But it was just a small mistake. I promise, it won’t happen again.
entries.translated:
Recluta: [blue]No, signore, non lo
faccio. Ma è stato solo un piccolo\lerrore. Prometto, non succederà di

nuovo.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Marlon, I need you to send
someone to obtain the weekly\lsupplies from the Poké Mart.

Make sure they also obtain a
special package that is arriving\ltoday.

It’s critical for our operation to
capture specimen UNO."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Marlon, I need you to send someone to obtain the weekly supplies from the Poké Mart. Make sure they also obtain a special package that is arriving today. It’s critical for our operation to capture specimen UNO.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Marlon, ho bisogno che mandi
qualcuno a ritirare le forniture\lsettimanali dal Poké Mart.

Assicurati che ritiri anche un
pacco speciale che arriva oggi. È\lfondamentale per la nostra

operazione catturare l{B4}esemplare
UNO.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]On it."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]On it.
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Subito.

entries.original: "[blue]Grunt!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Grunt!
entries.translated: [blue]Grr!

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Yes, sir?"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Yes, sir?
entries.translated: Recluta: [blue]Sì, signore?

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1][game-token-2]
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]\.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Right away."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Right away.
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Subito.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Yes, sir!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Yes, sir!
entries.translated: Recluta: [blue]Sì, signore!

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Anything else?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Anything else?
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Altro?

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Once that grunt has obtained
that package, take it, and use it\lto capture specimen UNO."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Once that grunt has obtained that package, take it, and use it to capture specimen UNO.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Una volta che quella recluta
avrà ottenuto quel pacco, prendilo\le usalo per catturare il campione

UNO.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]As for you, I’m going to make
an example out of you.

It’s time you pay for your blunder."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]As for you, I’m going to make an example out of you. It’s time you pay for your blunder.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Per quanto ti riguarda, farò
di te un esempio. È ora che paghi\lper il tuo errore.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]No! Please!
I’m really sorry!\lI’ll do anything to fix this!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]No! Please! I’m really sorry! I’ll do anything to fix this!
entries.translated:
Grunt: [blue]No! Ti prego! Mi dispiace
davvero! Farò qualsiasi cosa per\lrimediare!

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Houndoom, incinerate this
piece of trash."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Houndoom, incinerate this piece of trash.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Houndoom, incenera questo
pezzo di spazzatura.

entries.original: "Here, take some potions."
entries.translation_source: Here, take some potions.
entries.translated: Tieni, prendi delle pozioni.

entries.original:
"But let’s see how ya do in a
sandstorm!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: But let’s see how ya do in a sandstorm! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Ma vediamo come te la cavi in una
tempesta di sabbia! Ah ah ah!

entries.original:
"Man\.

You sure zapped me silly!

Take the [green]Zap Badge[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Man[game-token-1] You sure zapped me silly! Take the [color-green-2]Zap Badge[color-blue-3]!
entries.translated:
Accidenti\. Mi hai davvero stordito!
Prendi la [green]Granpepita[blue]!

entries.original:
"But I’m too scared to go home as
long as there are trainers around\lhere who haven’t been beaten\."
entries.translation_source: But I’m too scared to go home as long as there are trainers around here who haven’t been beaten[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ma ho troppa paura di tornare a
casa finché qui in giro ci sono\lallenatori che non sono stati

sconfitti\.

entries.original:
"I hear there’s a Pokémon that has
mushrooms growing on its back.

Not around here, though.
I wonder if they taste any good?"
entries.translation_source: I hear there’s a Pokémon that has mushrooms growing on its back. Not around here, though. I wonder if they taste any good?
entries.translated:
Ho sentito dire che esiste un
Pokémon con dei funghi che crescono\lsulla schiena. Non qui intorno,

però. Chissà se sono buoni da
mangiare?

entries.original:
"Speaking of crying, I’m positive I
heard before\."
entries.translation_source: Speaking of crying, I’m positive I heard before[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
A proposito di piangere, sono certo
di averlo sentito prima\.

entries.original:
"I’m playing hide-and-seek here.
I like some underground tag, too."
entries.translation_source: I’m playing hide-and-seek here. I like some underground tag, too.
entries.translated:
Sto giocando a nascondino qui. Mi
piace anche un po{B4} l{B4}acchiapparella\lnel sottosuolo.

entries.original:
"I got separated from my friends\.

I’ve got my Pokémon with me so
I’m okay, but\."
entries.translation_source: I got separated from my friends[game-token-1] I’ve got my Pokémon with me so I’m okay, but[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Mi sono separato dai miei amici\. Ho
con me i miei Pokémon, quindi sto\lbene, ma\.

entries.original:
"Where am I? Am I lost?
Who are you?

Are you a Pokémon Trainer?"
entries.translation_source: Where am I? Am I lost? Who are you? Are you a Pokémon Trainer?
entries.translated: Dove sono? Mi sono perso? Chi sei? Sei un Allenatore Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Okay, so we’re both Trainers.
That’s a start, right?"
entries.translation_source: Okay, so we’re both Trainers. That’s a start, right?
entries.translated: Okay, quindi siamo entrambi Allenatori. È già un inizio, no?

entries.original:
"I just wanted to have a picnic in
Thundercap Mt.

I didn’t think I would get lost
in a place like this\."
entries.translation_source: I just wanted to have a picnic in Thundercap Mt. I didn’t think I would get lost in a place like this[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Volevo solo fare un picnic sul
Thundercap Mt. Non pensavo di\lperdermi in un posto come questo\.

entries.original:
"Why have a picnic here?
I don’t know.

There’s no deep meaning to it."
entries.translation_source: Why have a picnic here? I don’t know. There’s no deep meaning to it.
entries.translated:
Perché fare un picnic qui? Non lo
so. Non c{B4}è alcun significato\lprofondo.

entries.original:
"I’m not lost, I tell you!
I’m camping! That’s my story!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not lost, I tell you! I’m camping! That’s my story!
entries.translated:
Non mi sono perso, te lo dico! Sto
facendo campeggio! E questa è la\lmia storia!

entries.original:
"I’m Milo\.

I was catching Pokémon, and then
I got lost\.

I’m so scared\.

Please!
Please take me to the exit!"
entries.translation_source: I’m Milo[game-token-1] I was catching Pokémon, and then I got lost[game-token-2] I’m so scared[game-token-3] Please! Please take me to the exit!
entries.translated:
Sono Milo\. Stavo catturando Pokémon,
poi mi sono perso\. Ho tanta paura\.\lPer favore! Per favore, portami

all{B4}uscita!

entries.original: "[player] decided to go with Milo!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] decided to go with Milo!
entries.translated:
[player] ha deciso di andare con
Milo!

entries.original:
"I’ll keep your Pokémon healthy
all the time!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep your Pokémon healthy all the time!
entries.translated:
Terrò i tuoi Pokémon in salute
sempre!

entries.original:
"Oh\.
I’m so scared\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] I’m so scared[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Ho così paura\.

entries.original:
"I like useful moves like Growl and
Tail Whip.

Those are my favourites."
entries.translation_source: I like useful moves like Growl and Tail Whip. Those are my favourites.
entries.translated:
Mi piacciono le mosse utili come
Ruggito e Colpokoda. Sono le mie\lpreferite.

entries.original:
"The mountain\.
It’s so easy to get confused.

Do you know where we are?"
entries.translation_source: The mountain[game-token-1] It’s so easy to get confused. Do you know where we are?
entries.translated:
La montagna\. È così facile
confondersi. Sai dove siamo?

entries.original:
"[player], did you get to be
so good because you’re always\lwith your Pokémon?

Yes! That has to be it!
Milo will try like you!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], did you get to be so good because you’re always with your Pokémon? Yes! That has to be it! Milo will try like you!
entries.translated:
[player], sei diventato così bravo
perché sei sempre con i tuoi\lPokémon? Sì! Deve essere per forza

così! Milo proverà a fare come te!

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh! There’s the ladder!

I want to get tougher so I
won’t be such a scaredy-cat.

[player], bye-bye!
Thank you!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oh! There’s the ladder! I want to get tougher so I won’t be such a scaredy-cat. [player-name-2], bye-bye! Thank you!
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh! Ecco la scala! Voglio diventare
più forte così non sarò più un\lcodardo. [player], ciao ciao!

Grazie!

entries.original:
"It appears Milo has left something
behind\."
entries.translation_source: It appears Milo has left something behind[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sembra che Milo abbia lasciato
qualcosa indietro\.

entries.original:
"Take a look at this rock, isn’t
it fascinating?"
entries.translation_source: Take a look at this rock, isn’t it fascinating?
entries.translated: Dai un{B4}occhiata a questa roccia, non è affascinante?

entries.original:
"What, are you surprised I’m not
building a machine?"
entries.translation_source: What, are you surprised I’m not building a machine?
entries.translated: Come, sei sorpreso che non stia costruendo una macchina?

entries.original:
"People assume just because I’m a
Super Nerd, I’m required to do\lnerdy things.

I can study rocks if I want to!

Nobody can tell me who I have
to be!"
entries.translation_source: People assume just because I’m a Super Nerd, I’m required to do nerdy things. I can study rocks if I want to! Nobody can tell me who I have to be!
entries.translated:
Le persone danno per scontato che,
solo perché sono un Super Nerd,\ldebba fare cose da nerd. Posso

studiare le rocce se voglio!
Nessuno può dirmi chi devo essere!

entries.original:
"I could’ve sworn my Electric-types
were acting funny until they were\lknocked out\."
entries.translation_source: I could’ve sworn my Electric-types were acting funny until they were knocked out[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Giurerei che i miei Pokémon di tipo
Elettro si comportassero in modo\lstrano finché non venivano messi KO\.

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]No\.Electivire\.please!
Why are you acting like this?"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]No[game-token-2]Electivire[game-token-3]please! Why are you acting like this?
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]No\.Electivire\.ti prego! Perché
ti comporti così?

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.why don’t you
go back in your Poké Ball?

Yes\.come on, now\.return!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]Electivire[game-token-2]why don’t you go back in your Poké Ball? Yes[game-token-3]come on, now[game-token-4]return!
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.perché non torni
nella tua Poké Ball? Sì\.forza,\ladesso\.ritorna!

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Oh\.come on, Electivire\.
don’t knock your ball away\."
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]Oh[game-token-2]come on, Electivire[game-token-3] don’t knock your ball away[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Oh\. dai, Electivire\. non
buttare via la tua Poké Ball\.

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.that could’ve
killed me!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]Electivire[game-token-2]that could’ve killed me!
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.avrebbe potuto
uccidermi!

entries.original:
"[blue]Help!

Somebody help me!

My Electivire’s gone rogue!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Help! Somebody help me! My Electivire’s gone rogue!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aiuto! Qualcuno mi aiuti! Il mio
Electivire è impazzito!

entries.original: "Would you like to protect the nerd?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to protect the nerd?
entries.translated: Vuoi proteggere il secchione?

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Thank you!
Thank you for protecting me!

Now, please, battle my Electivire
and bring it back to its senses!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]Thank you! Thank you for protecting me! Now, please, battle my Electivire and bring it back to its senses!
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Grazie! Grazie per avermi
protetto! Ora, per favore, sfida il\lmio Electivire e riportalo in sé!

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Electivire!
Come back!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]Electivire! Come back!
entries.translated: Nerd: [blue]Electivire! Torna indietro!

entries.original: "[blue]And he’s gone\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]And he’s gone[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [blue]Ed è sparito\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Please\.you were kind enough to
protect me\.so please, chase after\lmy Electivire!

He’s the only friend I have\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Please[game-token-2]you were kind enough to protect me[game-token-3]so please, chase after my Electivire! He’s the only friend I have[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[blue]Per favore\.sei stato così gentile da
proteggermi\.quindi per favore,\linsegui il mio Electivire! È

l{B4}unico amico che ho\.

entries.original: "Electivire: [green]Vire\."
entries.translation_source: Electivire: [color-green-1]Vire[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Electivire: [green]Vire\.

entries.original: "Electivire: [green]Vire!"
entries.translation_source: Electivire: [color-green-1]Vire!
entries.translated: Electivire: [green]Vire!

entries.original:
"Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.please\.just
listen to me\.

Return to your Poké Ball!"
entries.translation_source: Nerd: [color-blue-1]Electivire[game-token-2]please[game-token-3]just listen to me[game-token-4] Return to your Poké Ball!
entries.translated:
Nerd: [blue]Electivire\.per favore\.ascoltami\.
Torna nella tua Poké Ball!

entries.original:
"[blue]I owe you one for helping my
Electivire.

I can’t give you anything here, so
meet me in the [green]Epidimy Town\lPokémon Centre [blue]if you want a\lreward for your help."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I owe you one for helping my Electivire. I can’t give you anything here, so meet me in the [color-green-2]Epidimy Town Pokémon Centre [color-blue-3]if you want a reward for your help.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ti devo un favore per aver aiutato
il mio Electivire. Qui non posso\ldarti nulla, quindi incontrami al

[green]Centro Pokémon di Epidimy [blue]se vuoi
una ricompensa per il tuo aiuto.

entries.original:
"???: [red]Epidimy Town you say\.

Then I must head there\.for the
sake of science\."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-red-1]Epidimy Town you say[game-token-2] Then I must head there[game-token-3]for the sake of science[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
???: [red]Dici Epidimy Town\. Allora devo
andarci\.per il bene della scienza\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
I didn’t expect to see you here!

Shouldn’t you be running errands
for Log or something?

\.

Oh, so you are running an errand\.

That cheapskate\.can’t do anything
himself\."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! I didn’t expect to see you here! Shouldn’t you be running errands for Log or something? [game-token-2] Oh, so you are running an errand[game-token-3] That cheapskate[game-token-4]can’t do anything himself[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
[player]! Non mi aspettavo di
vederti qui! Non dovresti stare a\lfare commissioni per Log o qualcosa

del genere? \. Oh, quindi stai
facendo una commissione\. Quel\ltaccagno\. non sa fare niente da solo\.

entries.original:
"What’s that?
Log gave you something for me?"
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Log gave you something for me?
entries.translated:
Cos{B4}è? Log ti ha dato qualcosa per
me?

entries.original:
"[player] handed the Pokedex
over to [rival]."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] handed the Pokedex over to [text-token-rival-2].
entries.translated:
[player] ha consegnato il Pokédex a
[rival].

entries.original:
"Oh, great.

Now Log’s voice’ll never stop
echoing in my head."
entries.translation_source: Oh, great. Now Log’s voice’ll never stop echoing in my head.
entries.translated:
Oh, fantastico. Ora la voce di Log
non smetterà mai di rimbalzarmi in\ltesta.

entries.original:
"Well, if Log has you filling this
out, let’s see if you’ve gotten any\lstronger because of it!"
entries.translation_source: Well, if Log has you filling this out, let’s see if you’ve gotten any stronger because of it!
entries.translated:
Beh, se Log ti ha fatto compilare
questo, vediamo se grazie a ciò sei\ldiventato più forte!

entries.original:
"Well, if Log has you filling this
out, let’s see if your Pokémon can\lbeat mine this time."
entries.translation_source: Well, if Log has you filling this out, let’s see if your Pokémon can beat mine this time.
entries.translated:
Beh, se Log ti ha fatto compilare
questo, vediamo se stavolta i tuoi\lPokémon riescono a battere i miei.

entries.original:
"Yeah, I guess I can help fill this
thing out.

If it leads to me becoming
stronger, I’ll take it.

When I find my parents they’ll be
amazed at how far I’ve come.

Next time our paths cross, the
outcome of our battle won’t be the\lsame!

I promise you that!"
entries.translation_source: Yeah, I guess I can help fill this thing out. If it leads to me becoming stronger, I’ll take it. When I find my parents they’ll be amazed at how far I’ve come. Next time our paths cross, the outcome of our battle won’t be the same! I promise you that!
entries.translated:
Sì, credo di poter aiutare a
compilare questa cosa. Se mi\lporterà a diventare più forte, lo

accetterò. Quando troverò i miei
genitori, rimarranno a bocca aperta\lper tutta la strada che ho fatto.

La prossima volta che i nostri
sentieri si incroceranno, l{B4}esito\ldella nostra battaglia non sarà lo

stesso! Te lo prometto!

entries.original: "[green]Slash!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Slash!
entries.translated: [green]Taglio!

entries.original:
"Aha!

I’ve cornered you!

After that battle, you’re too weak
to escape!

Now, return the food you stole!"
entries.translation_source: Aha! I’ve cornered you! After that battle, you’re too weak to escape! Now, return the food you stole!
entries.translated:
Ahah! Ti ho messo alle strette!
Dopo quella lotta, sei troppo\ldebole per scappare! Ora,

restituisci il cibo che hai rubato!

entries.original:
"Huh, what’s this?

Have you been stealing my food for
your friends and family?"
entries.translation_source: Huh, what’s this? Have you been stealing my food for your friends and family?
entries.translated:
Eh, cos{B4}è questo? Hai rubato il mio
cibo per i tuoi amici e la tua\lfamiglia?

entries.original:
"That cry\.

I’ve heard it somewhere before\.

Ah!

You must be one of those rare Ice-
type Sandslash that lives up here!

Have the Pokémon Rangers stopped
coming to feed you?

Now that I mention it, I haven’t
seen them around in a while\."
entries.translation_source: That cry[game-token-1] I’ve heard it somewhere before[game-token-2] Ah! You must be one of those rare Ice- type Sandslash that lives up here! Have the Pokémon Rangers stopped coming to feed you? Now that I mention it, I haven’t seen them around in a while[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Quel verso\. L{B4}ho già sentito da
qualche parte prima\. Ah! Devi essere\luno di quei rari Sandslash di tipo

Ghiaccio che vivono quassù! I
Pokémon Ranger hanno smesso di\lvenire a darti da mangiare? Ora che

ci penso, è un po{B4} che non li vedo
in giro\.

entries.original:
"Then I was right.

You’ve been hungry because your
food supply stopped coming.

Let me make you a deal then,
Sandslash.

If you become my Pokémon and help
me make an income through battling,\lI will support you, your friends,\land your family through the money\lwe make.

Does that work for you?"
entries.translation_source: Then I was right. You’ve been hungry because your food supply stopped coming. Let me make you a deal then, Sandslash. If you become my Pokémon and help me make an income through battling, I will support you, your friends, and your family through the money we make. Does that work for you?
entries.translated:
Allora avevo ragione. Avevi fame
perché la tua scorta di cibo ha\lsmesso di arrivare. Lascia che ti

faccia una proposta, Sandslash. Se
