diventi il mio Pokémon e mi aiuti a\lguadagnare attraverso le lotte,

sosterrò te, i tuoi amici e la tua
famiglia con i soldi che\lguadagneremo. Ti va bene?

entries.original: "Then it’s settled, let’s go."
entries.translation_source: Then it’s settled, let’s go.
entries.translated: Allora è deciso, andiamo.

entries.original:
"Thanks for helping track down the
food thief!

As promised, here’s your little
something."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for helping track down the food thief! As promised, here’s your little something.
entries.translated:
Grazie per aver aiutato a
rintracciare il ladro di cibo! Come\lpromesso, ecco un pensierino per

te.

entries.original:
"That TM contains [green]Hone Claws[blue].

If you plan on challenging the
[green]Dresco Gym[blue], it’ll help you a lot.

It’s very foggy and hard to see in
there\."
entries.translation_source: That TM contains [color-green-1]Hone Claws[color-blue-2]. If you plan on challenging the [color-green-3]Dresco Gym[color-blue-4], it’ll help you a lot. It’s very foggy and hard to see in there[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Quella MT contiene [green]Hone Claws[blue]. Se
hai intenzione di sfidare la\l[green]Palestra di Dresco[blue], ti sarà di

grande aiuto. Là dentro c{B4}è molta
nebbia ed è difficile vedere\.

entries.original: "Hello, good citizen!"
entries.translation_source: Hello, good citizen!
entries.translated: Salve, buon cittadino!

entries.original:
"Oh, I remember you!

You’re that [buffer1] who assisted us in
the Dresco Town Gym!

For that, you can have these
five Revives."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I remember you! You’re that [buffer1-1] who assisted us in the Dresco Town Gym! For that, you can have these five Revives.
entries.translated:
Oh, mi ricordo di te! Sei quel
[buffer1] che ci ha aiutati nella\lPalestra di Dresco Town! Per

questo, puoi avere questi cinque
Rianimatori.

entries.original:
"Say, would you like to help out by
assisting the police again?"
entries.translation_source: Say, would you like to help out by assisting the police again?
entries.translated:
Senti, ti andrebbe di dare una mano
assistendo di nuovo la polizia?

entries.original:
"Would you like to lend a hand to
the local police force?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to lend a hand to the local police force?
entries.translated:
Ti andrebbe di dare una mano alla
polizia locale?

entries.original:
"Don’t you know its rude to barge in
on someone else’s meeting?"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you know its rude to barge in on someone else’s meeting?
entries.translated:
Non sai che è maleducato irrompere
nella riunione di qualcun altro?

entries.original:
"Goon 1: [blue]Huh?
It’s some punk kid!

Let’s rough [buffer2] up and steal [buffer1]
cash!"
entries.translation_source: Goon 1: [color-blue-1]Huh? It’s some punk kid! Let’s rough [buffer2-2] up and steal [buffer1-3] cash!
entries.translated:
Scagnozzo 1: [blue]Eh? È solo un
moccioso! Picchiamo [buffer2] e\lrubiamo i soldi di [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Goon 2: [blue]Yeah, we’ll make [buffer2] cry
for [buffer1] mommy!"
entries.translation_source: Goon 2: [color-blue-1]Yeah, we’ll make [buffer2-2] cry for [buffer1-3] mommy!
entries.translated:
Ruffiano 2: [blue]Sì, faremo piangere
[buffer2] per la [buffer1] mamma!

entries.original:
"Goon 1: [blue]I wanna hear you snivel,
kid!

We’re gonna beat you so hard
you’re never gonna forget us!

The Terror Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: Goon 1: [color-blue-1]I wanna hear you snivel, kid! We’re gonna beat you so hard you’re never gonna forget us! The Terror Granbull!
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [blue]Voglio sentirti
piagnucolare, ragazzino! Ti faremo\la pezzi così forte che non ti

dimenticherai mai di noi! Il
Granbull del Terrore!

entries.original: "Cop: [blue]You’re all under arrest!"
entries.translation_source: Cop: [color-blue-1]You’re all under arrest!
entries.translated: Poliziotto: [blue]Siete tutti in arresto!

entries.original:
"Goon 2: [blue]Oh man, it’s the popo!

Scatter, boys!"
entries.translation_source: Goon 2: [color-blue-1]Oh man, it’s the popo! Scatter, boys!
entries.translated:
Goon 2: [blue]Accidenti, è la polizia!
Scappate, ragazzi!

entries.original:
"[blue]Darn\.
They got away\.

They can’t have gone far.
Let’s split up and look for them."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Darn[game-token-2] They got away[game-token-3] They can’t have gone far. Let’s split up and look for them.
entries.translated:
[blue]Dannazione\. Sono scappati\. Non
possono essere andati lontano.\lDividiamoci e cerchiamoli.

entries.original:
"Hey!
You there!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! You there!
entries.translated: Ehi! Tu lì!

entries.original:
"It’s you!
That punk kid from before!

Not so tough now, huh?

Without the police, you’re just
some pathetic wimp!

And pathetic wimps gotta cry!"
entries.translation_source: It’s you! That punk kid from before! Not so tough now, huh? Without the police, you’re just some pathetic wimp! And pathetic wimps gotta cry!
entries.translated:
Sei tu! Quel marmocchio spaccone di
prima! Adesso non fai più tanto il\lduro, eh? Senza la polizia sei solo

un patetico fifone! E i fifoni
patetici devono piangere!

entries.original: "Snivel\."
entries.translation_source: Snivel[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Piagnucola\.

entries.original:
"[black]Cop: [blue]You’re under arrest for
several felonies.

You’re coming with me."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Cop: [color-blue-2]You’re under arrest for several felonies. You’re coming with me.
entries.translated:
[black]Agente: [blue]Sei in arresto per diversi
reati gravi. Vieni con me.

entries.original:
"In Borrius, it is well known that
thugs and hoodlums are mainly\lconfined to Antisis City.

However, one of the gangs from
there, the \qoTerror Granbull\qc,\lseems to have left that area.

We’ve received several reports
lately about some of their members\lcongregating and causing trouble\lon [green]Route 10[blue].

Our police force is spread fairly
thin at the moment, and any extra\lhelp rounding up these goons would\lbe much appreciated.

I’ll ask you again.

Would you like to lend a hand to
the local police force?"
entries.translation_source: In Borrius, it is well known that thugs and hoodlums are mainly confined to Antisis City. However, one of the gangs from there, the [quote-open-1]Terror Granbull[quote-close-2], seems to have left that area. We’ve received several reports lately about some of their members congregating and causing trouble on [color-green-3]Route 10[color-blue-4]. Our police force is spread fairly thin at the moment, and any extra help rounding up these goons would be much appreciated. I’ll ask you again. Would you like to lend a hand to the local police force?
entries.translated:
In Borrius è risaputo che teppisti
e malviventi si trovano\lprincipalmente ad Antisis City.

Tuttavia, una delle gang di lì, i
\qoTerror Granbull\qc, sembra aver\llasciato quella zona. Abbiamo

ricevuto diverse segnalazioni
ultimamente riguardo ad alcuni dei\lloro membri che si radunano e

causano problemi sulla [green]Route 10[blue]. Le
nostre forze di polizia sono\lpiuttosto limitate al momento, e

qualsiasi aiuto extra per catturare
questi malviventi sarebbe molto\lapprezzato. Te lo chiedo di nuovo.

Vorresti dare una mano alla polizia
locale?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Welcome, [player].

We’ve been expecting you."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Welcome, [player-name-2]. We’ve been expecting you.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Benvenuto, [player]. Ti
stavamo aspettando.

entries.original:
"[red]I want you to watch what is about
to happen."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I want you to watch what is about to happen.
entries.translated:
[red]Voglio che tu guardi ciò che sta
per accadere.

entries.original:
"[red]Now, Harth, please be cooperative
and hand over the void stone.

If you don’t, I can’t guarantee
your wife’s safety\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Now, Harth, please be cooperative and hand over the void stone. If you don’t, I can’t guarantee your wife’s safety[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[red]Ora, Harth, per favore collabora e
consegna la pietra del vuoto. Se\lnon lo fai, non posso garantire la

sicurezza di tua moglie\.

entries.original:
"Wife: [red]Don’t do it! If you hand it
over, we’ll all be doomed!"
entries.translation_source: Wife: [color-red-1]Don’t do it! If you hand it over, we’ll all be doomed!
entries.translated:
Wife: [red]Non farlo! Se lo consegni,
saremo tutti perduti!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Silence you old hag!

Keep your head out of what doesn’t
concern you."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Silence you old hag! Keep your head out of what doesn’t concern you.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Silenzio, vecchia megera!
Tieni il naso fuori da ciò che non\lti riguarda.

entries.original:
"Harth: [blue]I’m sorry dear, but I can’t
let them harm you.

If the world ends because of my
actions, then so be it."
entries.translation_source: Harth: [color-blue-1]I’m sorry dear, but I can’t let them harm you. If the world ends because of my actions, then so be it.
entries.translated:
Harth: [blue]Mi dispiace, cara, ma non
posso lasciarli farti del male. Se\lil mondo finisce a causa delle mie

azioni, così sia.

entries.original: "[blue]Here, take it."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Here, take it.
entries.translated: [blue]Prendi questo.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Thanks, Harth.

You’ve just helped us pave the way
to doing the impossible\.

It’s too bad that you won’t live
long enough to see it."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Thanks, Harth. You’ve just helped us pave the way to doing the impossible[game-token-2] It’s too bad that you won’t live long enough to see it.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Grazie, Harth. Ci hai appena
aiutati a spianare la strada per\lfare l{B4}impossibile\. Peccato che non

vivrai abbastanza a lungo per
vederlo.

entries.original: "Harth: [blue]Wait, huh\.?"
entries.translation_source: Harth: [color-blue-1]Wait, huh[game-token-2]?
entries.translated: Harth: [blue]Aspetta, eh\.?

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Zap Badge from
Galavan!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Zap Badge from Galavan!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto la Zap Badge
da Galavan!

entries.original:
"Ah, thank you for your assistance.

When you are prepared, meet me at
the east side of [green]Route 10[blue], just up\lthe first set of stairs you see.

I recommend making sure your
Pokémon are healed up."
entries.translation_source: Ah, thank you for your assistance. When you are prepared, meet me at the east side of [color-green-1]Route 10[color-blue-2], just up the first set of stairs you see. I recommend making sure your Pokémon are healed up.
entries.translated:
Ah, grazie per il tuo aiuto. Quando
sei pronto, incontrami sul lato est\ldi [green]Percorso 10[blue], subito sopra la

prima scalinata che vedi. Ti
consiglio di assicurarti che i tuoi\lPokémon siano guariti.

entries.original:
"The power of evolution\.
It compels me to give this to you!"
entries.translation_source: The power of evolution[game-token-1] It compels me to give this to you!
entries.translated:
Il potere dell{B4}evoluzione\. Mi spinge
a darti questo!

entries.original:
"I’m not talking to you.
You’re too mean."
entries.translation_source: I’m not talking to you. You’re too mean.
entries.translated:
Non parlo con te. Sei troppo
cattivo.

entries.original:
"I may feel compelled to give you
something tomorrow, as well."
entries.translation_source: I may feel compelled to give you something tomorrow, as well.
entries.translated:
Potrei sentirmi obbligato a darti
qualcosa anche domani.

entries.original:
"Please, return as many times as
you wish.

As long as you have [green]Yellow Shards[red],
of course."
entries.translation_source: Please, return as many times as you wish. As long as you have [color-green-1]Yellow Shards[color-red-2], of course.
entries.translated:
Per favore, torna quante volte
vuoi. Naturalmente, purché tu abbia\l[green]Frammenti Gialli[red].

entries.original: "Distortion World"
entries.translation_source: Distortion World
entries.translated: Mondo Distorto

entries.original: "[green]Dollllll!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Dollllll!
entries.translated: [green]Dollllll!

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here
right now.

He’s probably off clearing his head
by the SES Expressway in Tehl Town."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here right now. He’s probably off clearing his head by the SES Expressway in Tehl Town.
entries.translated:
Mel, il Capopalestra, non è qui
adesso. Probabilmente è fuori a\lschiarirsi le idee lungo la SES

Expressway, a Tehl Town.

entries.original: "Here, take these!"
entries.translation_source: Here, take these!
entries.translated: Prendi questi!

entries.original:
"One of Professor Log’s Aides who
lives in Tehl Town will give you a\lgift if you’ve captured enough\lPokémon.

I hope those help you fill up your
Pokédex!"
entries.translation_source: One of Professor Log’s Aides who lives in Tehl Town will give you a gift if you’ve captured enough Pokémon. I hope those help you fill up your Pokédex!
entries.translated:
Uno degli Assistenti del Professor
Log che vive a Tehl Town ti farà un\lregalo se hai catturato abbastanza

Pokémon. Spero che ti aiutino a
riempire il Pokédex!

entries.original: "Hey there! Please, enjoy this gift!"
entries.translation_source: Hey there! Please, enjoy this gift!
entries.translated:
Ehi! Ti prego, goditi questo
regalo!

entries.original:
"There are a few Pokémon in this
area that only evolve via a Water\lStone."
entries.translation_source: There are a few Pokémon in this area that only evolve via a Water Stone.
entries.translated:
Ci sono alcuni Pokémon in
quest{B4}area che si evolvono solo\ltramite una Pietraidrica.

entries.original:
"Our forces will be spread thin for
the forseeable future.

If you would like to lend a hand,
it will always be appreciated."
entries.translation_source: Our forces will be spread thin for the forseeable future. If you would like to lend a hand, it will always be appreciated.
entries.translated:
Le nostre forze saranno sparse su
troppi fronti per il futuro\lprevedibile. Se vuoi darci una

mano, sarà sempre apprezzata.

entries.original:
"It’s time for a grassy battle on a
grassy island!"
entries.translation_source: It’s time for a grassy battle on a grassy island!
entries.translated: È il momento di una battaglia di tipo Erba su un{B4}isola erbosa!

entries.original: "A grassy defeat!"
entries.translation_source: A grassy defeat!
entries.translated: Una sconfitta erbosa!

entries.original:
"Good work, [player].

Now there’s one less criminal on
the loose.

Only [buffer1] left.

Keep searching while I take this
man back to the station."
entries.translation_source: Good work, [player-name-1]. Now there’s one less criminal on the loose. Only [buffer1-2] left. Keep searching while I take this man back to the station.
entries.translated:
Bel lavoro, [player]. Ora c{B4}è un
criminale in meno a piede libero.\lNe resta solo [buffer1]. Continua a

cercare mentre riporto quest{B4}uomo
in centrale.

entries.original:
"Good work, [player].

You appear to have apprehended all
of the goons.

Only their boss is still is at
large.

Let’s regroup on [green]Route 10[blue] by the
stairs to determine his location."
entries.translation_source: Good work, [player-name-1]. You appear to have apprehended all of the goons. Only their boss is still is at large. Let’s regroup on [color-green-2]Route 10[color-blue-3] by the stairs to determine his location.
entries.translated:
Ottimo lavoro, [player]. Sembra che
tu abbia catturato tutti i\lteppisti. Solo il loro capo è

ancora in fuga. Raduniamoci su
[green]Percorso 10[blue] vicino alle scale per\ldeterminarne la posizione.

entries.original:
"Hoo hah!

This little punk kid found me!

I’m gonna teach this punk kid a
little lesson!"
entries.translation_source: Hoo hah! This little punk kid found me! I’m gonna teach this punk kid a little lesson!
entries.translated:
Hoo hah! Questo ragazzino sbruffone
mi ha trovato! Gli insegnerò una\lbella lezione!

entries.original:
"Heh, looks like the little
detective has come after me.

I’ll teach you not to cross the
Terror Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: Heh, looks like the little detective has come after me. I’ll teach you not to cross the Terror Granbull!
entries.translated:
Heh, sembra che il piccolo
detective sia venuto a cercarmi. Ti\linsegnerò a non metterti contro il

Granbull del Terrore!

entries.original:
"How could a punk kid like you beat
me?"
entries.translation_source: How could a punk kid like you beat me?
entries.translated: Come ha fatto un teppistello come te a battermi?

entries.original:
"My hidden power is telling me that
you want this!"
entries.translation_source: My hidden power is telling me that you want this!
entries.translated:
Il mio potere nascosto mi dice che
vuoi questo!

entries.original:
"In Borrius, the move Hidden Power,
has a Base Power of 70.

So no matter what type it is, it’ll
always do the same amount of harm!"
entries.translation_source: In Borrius, the move Hidden Power, has a Base Power of 70. So no matter what type it is, it’ll always do the same amount of harm!
entries.translated:
A Borrius, la mossa Introforza ha
una Potenza Base di 70. Quindi,\lqualunque sia il suo tipo,

infliggerà sempre la stessa
quantità di danni!

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader Mel lives here when
he’s not on Gym duty.

I just take care of his house for
him."
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader Mel lives here when he’s not on Gym duty. I just take care of his house for him.
entries.translated:
Il Capopalestra Mel vive qui quando
non è in servizio alla Palestra. Io\lmi occupo solo della sua casa per

lui.

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe out there!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe out there!
entries.translated:
Tutto pronto! Stai al sicuro là
fuori!

entries.original:
"They say the grass is always
greener on the other side.

That’s especially true in Epidimy
Town. Just look at the grass here!"
entries.translation_source: They say the grass is always greener on the other side. That’s especially true in Epidimy Town. Just look at the grass here!
entries.translated:
Si dice che l{B4}erba sia sempre più
verde dall{B4}altra parte. È\lparticolarmente vero a Epidimy

Town. Guarda un po{B4} l{B4}erba qui!

entries.original:
"He’s sleeping peacefully on the
bench.

Better leave him alone."
entries.translation_source: He’s sleeping peacefully on the bench. Better leave him alone.
entries.translated:
Sta dormendo serenamente sulla
panchina. Meglio lasciarlo stare.

entries.original:
"Ahh\.

I love coming out here every day
and relaxing on this bench.

It’s always the most enjoyable part
of my day."
entries.translation_source: Ahh[game-token-1] I love coming out here every day and relaxing on this bench. It’s always the most enjoyable part of my day.
entries.translated:
Ah\. Adoro venire qui ogni giorno e
rilassarmi su questa panchina. È\lsempre la parte più piacevole della

mia giornata.

entries.original:
"Antisis City Port

\al Antisis City"
entries.translation_source: Antisis City Port [game-token-1] Antisis City
entries.translated:
Porto di Antisis City \al Antisis
City

entries.original:
"Epidimy town is the epitome of
bliss!

\.

\.

What? You don’t think its funny?
Sorry\.

I feel bad now\.

You know what? Take these. It’ll
help me feel better."
entries.translation_source: Epidimy town is the epitome of bliss! [game-token-1] [game-token-2] What? You don’t think its funny? Sorry[game-token-3] I feel bad now[game-token-4] You know what? Take these. It’ll help me feel better.
entries.translated:
Epidimy town è l{B4}epitome della
beatitudine! \. \. Cosa? Non lo trovi\ldivertente? Scusa\. Ora mi sento in

colpa\. Sai che c{B4}è? Prendi queste.
Mi farà sentire meglio.

entries.original:
"I wish our town had a better name
to make a joke of."
entries.translation_source: I wish our town had a better name to make a joke of.
entries.translated:
Vorrei che la nostra città avesse
un nome migliore da prendere in\lgiro.

entries.original:
"Punk kid!

Prepare to face the terrors of the
Terror Granbull!

\.

That sounded better in my head\."
entries.translation_source: Punk kid! Prepare to face the terrors of the Terror Granbull! [game-token-1] That sounded better in my head[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ragazzino punk! Preparati ad
affrontare gli orrori del Terror\lGranbull! \. Suonava meglio nella mia

testa\.

entries.original:
"I’m Lily, President of the Skiers
Club.

I’m warning you, I’m not easy to
beat!"
entries.translation_source: I’m Lily, President of the Skiers Club. I’m warning you, I’m not easy to beat!
entries.translated:
Sono Lily, presidente del Club
degli Sciatori. Ti avverto, non\lsono facile da battere!

entries.original:
"Oh yeah?

Well my Miltank is super powerful,
too!

I got it on Route 10!
You’re going down!"
entries.translation_source: Oh yeah? Well my Miltank is super powerful, too! I got it on Route 10! You’re going down!
entries.translated:
Ah sì? Beh, anche il mio Miltank è
fortissimo! L{B4}ho preso sul Percorso\l10! Ti faccio fuori!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] disappeared into the
ruins."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] disappeared into the ruins.
entries.translated:
Il [buffer1] è scomparso tra le
rovine.

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mountain can be accessed
through that hole down the stairs.

It’s really dangerous, so if you
go, make sure you have lots of\lrevives and Paralyze Heals!"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mountain can be accessed through that hole down the stairs. It’s really dangerous, so if you go, make sure you have lots of revives and Paralyze Heals!
entries.translated:
La Montagna Thundercap si può
raggiungere attraverso quel buco in\lfondo alle scale. È davvero

pericolosa, quindi se ci vai
assicurati di avere un sacco di\lRevitalizzanti e Antiparalisi!

entries.original:
"I really wanna explore Thundercap
Mountain!

But my mommy says it’s too
dangerous ’cause there are a bunch\lof bad men on the other side."
entries.translation_source: I really wanna explore Thundercap Mountain! But my mommy says it’s too dangerous ’cause there are a bunch of bad men on the other side.
entries.translated:
Voglio davvero esplorare Thundercap
Mountain! Ma la mia mamma dice che\lè troppo pericolosa perché

dall{B4}altra parte ci sono un sacco
di uomini cattivi.

entries.original:
"Great job!

You rounded up all four of those
Terror Granbull goons.

However, their leader is still at
large.

I wonder where he could be\.
Maybe back in Antisis City?"
entries.translation_source: Great job! You rounded up all four of those Terror Granbull goons. However, their leader is still at large. I wonder where he could be[game-token-1] Maybe back in Antisis City?
entries.translated:
Ottimo lavoro! Hai radunato tutti e
quattro quegli scagnozzi di Terror\lGranbull. Tuttavia, il loro capo è

ancora in fuga. Chissà dove sarà\.
Forse è tornato ad Antisis City?

entries.original:
"[black]???: [blue]Hahaha!

I, the great G-Roughs, haven’t gone
anywhere!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]???: [color-blue-2]Hahaha! I, the great G-Roughs, haven’t gone anywhere!
entries.translated:
[black]???: [blue]Ahahah! Io, il grande
G-Roughs, non sono andato da\lnessuna parte!

entries.original:
"[black]Cop: [blue]Stop!

You’re under arrest for
several felonies.

You’re coming with me."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Cop: [color-blue-2]Stop! You’re under arrest for several felonies. You’re coming with me.
entries.translated:
[black]Poliziotto: [blue]Fermo! Sei in arresto
per diversi reati gravi. Vieni con\lme.

entries.original:
"[black]G-Roughs: [blue]Hahaha!
Good luck trying!

As for you, punk kid, you did
alright beating my goons.

But you’ll find I’m not as much of
a weakling!

Let’s see what you got!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]G-Roughs: [color-blue-2]Hahaha! Good luck trying! As for you, punk kid, you did alright beating my goons. But you’ll find I’m not as much of a weakling! Let’s see what you got!
entries.translated:
[black]G-Roughs: [blue]Ahahah! Buona fortuna a
provarci! Quanto a te, ragazzino\limpertinente, hai fatto bene a

battere i miei scagnozzi. Ma
scoprirai che non sono affatto un\ldebole! Vediamo un po{B4} cosa sai

fare!

entries.original:
"Aargh!
How could you beat me?"
entries.translation_source: Aargh! How could you beat me?
entries.translated: Argh! Come hai potuto battermi?

entries.original:
"[black]G-Roughs: [blue]Hahaha!

Just because you beat me, it
doesn’t mean I’m turning myself in!

I’m hopping on the next boat to
East Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]G-Roughs: [color-blue-2]Hahaha! Just because you beat me, it doesn’t mean I’m turning myself in! I’m hopping on the next boat to East Borrius!
entries.translated:
[black]G-Roughs: [blue]Ahahah! Solo perché mi
hai battuto, non significa che mi\lconsegnerò! Sto salendo sulla

prossima nave per Borrius Est!

entries.original:
"Thanks for all your help,
[player].

I’ll radio my colleagues in
Seaport City so he can’t escape\lthrough there.

Anyway, here’s a reward for a model
citizen such as yourself."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for all your help, [player-name-1]. I’ll radio my colleagues in Seaport City so he can’t escape through there. Anyway, here’s a reward for a model citizen such as yourself.
entries.translated:
Grazie di tutto il tuo aiuto,
[player]. Avviserò via radio i miei\lcolleghi a Seaport City così non

potrà scappare di lì. Comunque,
ecco una ricompensa per un\lcittadino modello come te.

entries.original:
"I’m looking forward to solving more
cases with you in the future.

Until then, stay safe and be
vigilant."
entries.translation_source: I’m looking forward to solving more cases with you in the future. Until then, stay safe and be vigilant.
entries.translated:
Non vedo l{B4}ora di risolvere altri
casi con te in futuro. Fino ad\lallora, stai al sicuro e resta

vigile.

entries.original:
"I come here every day to pray to
Zapdos.

Zapdos saved me once, and I can
never thank it enough."
entries.translation_source: I come here every day to pray to Zapdos. Zapdos saved me once, and I can never thank it enough.
entries.translated:
Vengo qui ogni giorno a pregare
Zapdos. Zapdos mi ha salvato una\lvolta, e non potrò mai ringraziarlo

abbastanza.

entries.original:
"We girls make Mel feel
better when he’s down."
entries.translation_source: We girls make Mel feel better when he’s down.
entries.translated:
Noi ragazze facciamo sentire meglio
Mel quando è giù.

entries.original:
"I wonder if you’ll figure out the
way from here?"
entries.translation_source: I wonder if you’ll figure out the way from here?
entries.translated:
Chissà se riuscirai a trovare la
strada da qui?

entries.original:
"Mel surrounds himself with as many
beautiful women as he can to\lalleviate the stress of the\lpounding waterfall behind him."
entries.translation_source: Mel surrounds himself with as many beautiful women as he can to alleviate the stress of the pounding waterfall behind him.
entries.translated:
Mel si circonda di quante più belle
donne possibile per alleviare lo\lstress della cascata fragorosa che

gli rimbomba dietro.

entries.original:
"I may not be a woman, but I’m still
part of Mel’s fighting force!"
entries.translation_source: I may not be a woman, but I’m still part of Mel’s fighting force!
entries.translated:
Potrei non essere una donna, ma
faccio comunque parte della forza\lcombattente di Mel!

entries.original:
"You’re pretty powerful, I’m
impressed!

You should make a career change and
join our club.

\.

What\.not interested?

Then at least take this!"
entries.translation_source: You’re pretty powerful, I’m impressed! You should make a career change and join our club. [game-token-1] What[game-token-2]not interested? Then at least take this!
entries.translated:
Sei piuttosto forte, sono
impressionato! Dovresti cambiare\lcarriera e unirti al nostro club. \.

Cosa\. non ti interessa? Allora
prendi almeno questo!

entries.original:
"We have plenty of Ice Gems here at
the Skiers Club.

They always stick to the bottoms of
our skis!"
entries.translation_source: We have plenty of Ice Gems here at the Skiers Club. They always stick to the bottoms of our skis!
entries.translated:
Qui allo Skiers Club abbiamo
tantissime Gemme Ghiaccio. Si\lattaccano sempre al fondo dei

nostri sci!

entries.original:
"I’ve watched over this port ever
since the once glorious Antisis\lCity stood proud\.

This port is all that remains of
that city\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve watched over this port ever since the once glorious Antisis City stood proud[game-token-1] This port is all that remains of that city[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Veglio su questo porto da quando la
un tempo gloriosa Antisis City si\lergeva fiera\. Questo porto è tutto

ciò che resta di quella città\.

entries.original:
"Do you plan on exploring Thundercap
Mountain?

If you do, you’re going to need
these!"
entries.translation_source: Do you plan on exploring Thundercap Mountain? If you do, you’re going to need these!
entries.translated:
Hai intenzione di esplorare il
Monte Thundercap? Se sì, ti\lserviranno questi!

entries.original:
"It never hurt to be prepared for
anything!"
entries.translation_source: It never hurt to be prepared for anything!
entries.translated:
Non fa mai male essere pronti a
tutto!

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mountain is a dangerous
place!

I tried exploring it once, but oh
boy, I got smoked!

Ever since then, my lovely wife has
been giving Max Repels to any\ltravellers who talk to her."
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mountain is a dangerous place! I tried exploring it once, but oh boy, I got smoked! Ever since then, my lovely wife has been giving Max Repels to any travellers who talk to her.
entries.translated:
Il Monte Thundercap è un posto
pericoloso! Ho provato a esplorarlo\luna volta, ma cavolo, me la sono

vista brutta! Da allora, la mia
adorabile moglie distribuisce\lRepellenti Max a qualsiasi

viaggiatore che le parli.

entries.original:
"These boulders have been placed so
strategically!

It’s almost as if someone doesn’t
want people going this way\lright now\."
entries.translation_source: These boulders have been placed so strategically! It’s almost as if someone doesn’t want people going this way right now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Questi massi sono stati sistemati
in modo così strategico! È quasi\lcome se qualcuno non volesse che la

gente passasse di qui proprio
adesso\.

entries.original:
"Strength lets you move giant
boulders with raw power!

But only if you have the Fall
Badge from the Fallshore Gym!

Huah!"
entries.translation_source: Strength lets you move giant boulders with raw power! But only if you have the Fall Badge from the Fallshore Gym! Huah!
entries.translated:
Forza ti permette di spostare massi
enormi con la tua potenza bruta! Ma\lsolo se hai la Fall Badge della

Palestra di Fallshore! Huah!

entries.original: "[player] found one Master Ball!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] found one Master Ball!
entries.translated:
[player] ha trovato una Master
Ball!

entries.original:
"Thief! Put that back!
That’s my prized possesion!"
entries.translation_source: Thief! Put that back! That’s my prized possesion!
entries.translated:
Ladro! Rimettilo a posto! È il mio
prezioso possesso!

entries.original:
"Unlike Seaport City, the Antisis
Port is mainly used for the import\lof goods from other regions.

Once dropped off here, the goods
are moved along to Fallshore City\lwhere they can be distributed\lacross Borrius."
entries.translation_source: Unlike Seaport City, the Antisis Port is mainly used for the import of goods from other regions. Once dropped off here, the goods are moved along to Fallshore City where they can be distributed across Borrius.
entries.translated:
A differenza di Seaport City, il
porto di Antisis viene utilizzato\lprincipalmente per l{B4}importazione

di merci da altre regioni. Una
volta scaricate qui, le merci\lvengono trasportate a Fallshore

City, dove possono essere
distribuite in tutto Borrius.

entries.original:
"The yellow barricades are moved
routinely throughout the day to\lcorrespond to the arrivals of\ldifferent shipments.

If you want to get to an area
that’s blocked off, you’ll just\lhave to come back later."
entries.translation_source: The yellow barricades are moved routinely throughout the day to correspond to the arrivals of different shipments. If you want to get to an area that’s blocked off, you’ll just have to come back later.
entries.translated:
Le barriere gialle vengono spostate
regolarmente nel corso della\lgiornata per corrispondere agli

arrivi delle diverse spedizioni. Se
vuoi raggiungere un{B4}area sbarrata,\ldovrai semplicemente tornare più

tardi.

entries.original:
"Aye, I’m the guy who moves supplies
to Fallshore City during the day.

It’s too dangerous to move them
through Antisis City, which is why\lthis job exists."
entries.translation_source: Aye, I’m the guy who moves supplies to Fallshore City during the day. It’s too dangerous to move them through Antisis City, which is why this job exists.
entries.translated:
Eh, sono io quello che durante il
giorno sposta i rifornimenti verso\lFallshore City. È troppo pericoloso

passarli attraverso Antisis City,
ed è per questo che esiste questo\llavoro.

entries.original:
"Ya know what’s not fair?

That I have to go through a
rigourous screenin’ process just to\lbe let onto the port so I can work\levery day!

If it weren’t for those lunkheads in
Antisis City, this wouldn’t even be\lan issue."
entries.translation_source: Ya know what’s not fair? That I have to go through a rigourous screenin’ process just to be let onto the port so I can work every day! If it weren’t for those lunkheads in Antisis City, this wouldn’t even be an issue.
entries.translated:
Sai cosa non è giusto? Che io debba
passare attraverso un rigoroso\lprocesso di selezione solo per

farmi ammettere al porto così posso
lavorare ogni giorno! Se non fosse\lper quei somari di Antisis City,

non sarebbe nemmeno un problema.

entries.original:
"You know the Pokémon Miltank?
That big adorable pink cow?

I’ve always wanted one, but they’re
just so hard to catch!

Would you be willing to trade one
for my [buffer2]?"
entries.translation_source: You know the Pokémon Miltank? That big adorable pink cow? I’ve always wanted one, but they’re just so hard to catch! Would you be willing to trade one for my [buffer2-1]?
entries.translated:
Conosci il Pokémon Miltank? Quella
grossa e adorabile mucca rosa? Ho\lsempre voluto averne una, ma sono

così difficili da catturare! Ti
andrebbe di scambiarne una per il\lmio [buffer2]?

entries.original:
"Thank you so much! I’m going to
take good care of it!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you so much! I’m going to take good care of it!
entries.translated:
Grazie mille! Me ne prenderò cura
con attenzione!

entries.original:
"I was taking inventory for the
berry shipments this morning, and\las usual, we have a surplus.

Why don’t you take a berry?"
entries.translation_source: I was taking inventory for the berry shipments this morning, and as usual, we have a surplus. Why don’t you take a berry?
entries.translated:
Stavo facendo l{B4}inventario delle
spedizioni di bacche stamattina e,\lcome al solito, ne abbiamo in

eccesso. Perché non prendi una
bacca?

entries.original:
"Tropius Berries Inc. has a tendency
to send a few extra berries.

There may be some more in
tomorrow’s shipment too.

I wonder how they don’t lose
money\."
entries.translation_source: Tropius Berries Inc. has a tendency to send a few extra berries. There may be some more in tomorrow’s shipment too. I wonder how they don’t lose money[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tropius Berries Inc. ha la tendenza
a spedire qualche bacca in più.\lPotrebbero essercene altre anche

nella spedizione di domani. Mi
chiedo come facciano a non perderci\lsoldi\.

entries.original:
"Night deliveries are by far better
than day deliveries.

Why?

For starters, there’s less ocean
traffic!"
entries.translation_source: Night deliveries are by far better than day deliveries. Why? For starters, there’s less ocean traffic!
entries.translated:
Le consegne notturne sono di gran
lunga migliori di quelle diurne.\lPerché? Per cominciare, c{B4}è meno

traffico marittimo!

entries.original:
"You ever had a [green]Lava Cookie[blue] before?

If you take it, you won’t need a
Burn Heal!"
entries.translation_source: You ever had a [color-green-1]Lava Cookie[color-blue-2] before? If you take it, you won’t need a Burn Heal!
entries.translated:
Hai mai mangiato un [green]Biscotto Lava[blue]
prima? Se lo prendi, non ti servirà\lun{B4}Antiscottatura!

entries.original:
"Pardon me\.

Would you care for an [green]Old Gateau[blue]?

Oui, oui, yes, you would."
entries.translation_source: Pardon me[game-token-1] Would you care for an [color-green-2]Old Gateau[color-blue-3]? Oui, oui, yes, you would.
entries.translated:
Mi scusi\. Gradirebbe un [green]Vecchio
Gateau[blue]? Oui, oui, sì, certo che sì.

entries.original:
"Quick!

Take a [green]Casteliacone[blue] before it
melts!"
entries.translation_source: Quick! Take a [color-green-1]Casteliacone[color-blue-2] before it melts!
entries.translated:
Presto! Prendi un [green]Casteliacone[blue]
prima che si sciolga!

entries.original:
"The city of lights and biscuits\.

Have this token of Lumiose City,
the [green]Lumiose Galette[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The city of lights and biscuits[game-token-1] Have this token of Lumiose City, the [color-green-2]Lumiose Galette[color-blue-3].
entries.translated:
La città delle luci e dei biscotti\.
Accetta questo omaggio di\lLuminopoli, la [green]Galette di

Luminopoli[blue].

entries.original:
"The fact that you battled me, means
that you’re going the right way."
entries.translation_source: The fact that you battled me, means that you’re going the right way.
entries.translated:
Il fatto che tu abbia combattuto
con me significa che sei sulla\lstrada giusta.

entries.original: "5F: Medicine Box"
entries.translation_source: 5F: Medicine Box
entries.translated: 5F: Scatola delle medicine

entries.original:
"Feel the power of Mega Evolution
when you bite into this [green]Shalour\lSable[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Feel the power of Mega Evolution when you bite into this [color-green-1]Shalour Sable[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Senti il potere della
Megaevoluzione quando addenti\lquesto [green]Shalour Sable[blue]!

entries.original:
"You ever had a [green]Big Malasada[blue]
before?

I hear it’s really good for the
heart.

Try some, straight from the Alola
region!"
entries.translation_source: You ever had a [color-green-1]Big Malasada[color-blue-2] before? I hear it’s really good for the heart. Try some, straight from the Alola region!
entries.translated:
Hai mai assaggiato una [green]Grande
Malasada[blue]? Ho sentito che fa davvero\lbene al cuore. Provala,

direttamente dalla regione di
Alola!

entries.original:
"Feed the [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon with a status condition.

It’ll get all better, just like
that!"
entries.translation_source: Feed the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] to a Pokémon with a status condition. It’ll get all better, just like that!
entries.translated:
Dai [green][buffer1][blue] a un Pokémon con una
condizione di stato. Starà subito\lmeglio, proprio così!

entries.original:
"Sorry, kid, I’m only carrying local
shipments today.

If you come by any other day of the
week, I may have souvenirs from\lvarious regions to give out."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, kid, I’m only carrying local shipments today. If you come by any other day of the week, I may have souvenirs from various regions to give out.
entries.translated:
Mi spiace, ragazzo, oggi trasporto
solo spedizioni locali. Se passi in\lun altro giorno della settimana,

potrei avere souvenir di varie
regioni da distribuire.

entries.original:
"Yawn\.
These early morning are rough\.

I don’t know how you Borrian folk
do it\."
entries.translation_source: Yawn[game-token-1] These early morning are rough[game-token-2] I don’t know how you Borrian folk do it[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Sbadiglio\. Le prime ore del mattino
sono dure\. Non so come facciate voi\lgente di Borrian\.

entries.original:
"I’ve got a shipment for one\.uh\.
Swomoli?

Man\.these names are hard to read
sometimes."
entries.translation_source: I’ve got a shipment for one[game-token-1]uh[game-token-2] Swomoli? Man[game-token-3]these names are hard to read sometimes.
entries.translated:
Ho una spedizione per uno\.eh\.
Swomoli? Mannaggia\.questi nomi a\lvolte sono difficili da leggere.

entries.original:
"A fresh batch of [green]Premier Balls[blue] has
just arrived!

Why don’t you take a few?
They’ll never notice\."
entries.translation_source: A fresh batch of [color-green-1]Premier Balls[color-blue-2] has just arrived! Why don’t you take a few? They’ll never notice[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
È appena arrivato un fresco lotto
di [green]Premier Ball[blue]! Perché non ne\lprendi qualcuna? Non se ne

accorgeranno mai\.

entries.original:
"I’ve always advocated for a smaller
Poké Ball to Premier Ball ratio.

Ten to one? Are you kidding me?
Who even buys ten Poké Balls?"
entries.translation_source: I’ve always advocated for a smaller Poké Ball to Premier Ball ratio. Ten to one? Are you kidding me? Who even buys ten Poké Balls?
entries.translated:
Ho sempre sostenuto un rapporto tra
Poké Ball e Premier Ball più basso.\lDieci a uno? Stai scherzando? Chi

compra mai dieci Poké Ball?

entries.original:
"My [green]Fighting[blue]-type Pokémon!

I train them to smash the
[green]challenge rock[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: My [color-green-1]Fighting[color-blue-2]-type Pokémon! I train them to smash the [color-green-3]challenge rock[color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
I miei Pokémon di tipo [green]Lotta[blue]! Li
alleno per spaccare la [green]pietra della\lsfida[blue]!

entries.original:
"Okay, then!

Abra, use teleport!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, then! Abra, use teleport!
entries.translated: Va bene! Abra, usa Teletrasporto!

entries.original:
"If you change your mind,
come back.

We’ll be sitting here."
entries.translation_source: If you change your mind, come back. We’ll be sitting here.
entries.translated:
Se cambi idea, torna pure. Saremo
qui ad aspettarti.

entries.original:
"There’s been this locked house near
[green]Tarmigan Mansion[red] for a really long\ltime.

I think it was once a small inn for
visitors of this town.

But it closed down after the guests
started suffering from horrendous\lnightmares."
entries.translation_source: There’s been this locked house near [color-green-1]Tarmigan Mansion[color-red-2] for a really long time. I think it was once a small inn for visitors of this town. But it closed down after the guests started suffering from horrendous nightmares.
entries.translated:
C{B4}è stata per moltissimo tempo
questa casa chiusa vicino a\l[green]Tarmigan Mansion[red]. Penso che un

tempo fosse una piccola locanda per
i visitatori di questa città. Ma ha\lchiuso dopo che gli ospiti hanno

iniziato a soffrire di orrendi
incubi.

entries.original:
"Those are some hot hands ya got
there, fella!

You wannem to burn up with fiery
power?

I can teach your Pokémon [green]Fire
Punch[blue] for just [green]2 [buffer1]s[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Those are some hot hands ya got there, fella! You wannem to burn up with fiery power? I can teach your Pokémon [color-green-1]Fire Punch[color-blue-2] for just [color-green-3]2 [buffer1-4]s[color-blue-5]!
entries.translated:
Hai delle belle mani roventi,
amico! Vuoi farle ardere di potere\linfuocato? Posso insegnare al tuo

Pokémon [green]Fuocopugno[blue] per soli [green]2
[buffer1]s[blue]!

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon is raring to fire up
their hands with [green]Fire Punch[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon is raring to fire up their hands with [color-green-1]Fire Punch[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Quale Pokémon non vede l{B4}ora di
scaldarsi le mani con [green]Fuocopugno[blue]?

entries.original: "Fire power!"
entries.translation_source: Fire power!
entries.translated: Potenza di fuoco!

entries.original:
"Fizzle\.
You don’t have enough [green][buffer1]s[blue].

I can’t burn up those hands for
nothing\."
entries.translation_source: Fizzle[game-token-1] You don’t have enough [color-green-2][buffer1-3]s[color-blue-4]. I can’t burn up those hands for nothing[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Fizzle\. Non hai abbastanza
[green][buffer1]s[blue]. Non posso bruciare\lquelle mani per niente\.

entries.original:
"Listen up, youngster.

That swindler over there is
constantly extorting [green]Red Shards[blue]\lfrom youngsters, like yourself.

Here, I stole a couple from his
collection for you to enjoy."
entries.translation_source: Listen up, youngster. That swindler over there is constantly extorting [color-green-1]Red Shards[color-blue-2] from youngsters, like yourself. Here, I stole a couple from his collection for you to enjoy.
entries.translated:
Ascolta, ragazzino. Quel truffatore
laggiù estorce continuamente\l[green]Schegge Rosse[blue] ai ragazzini, proprio

come te. Tieni, gliene ho rubate un
paio dalla collezione perché tu\lpossa divertirti.

entries.original:
"I hold by the principle that it is
permitted to steal from thieves."
entries.translation_source: I hold by the principle that it is permitted to steal from thieves.
entries.translated:
Sostengo il principio che sia
permesso rubare ai ladri.

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon should learn
[green]Thunder Punch[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should learn [color-green-1]Thunder Punch[color-red-2]?
entries.translated:
Quale Pokémon dovrebbe imparare
[green]Tuonopugno[red]?

entries.original:
"The door is tightly shut.
It appears impossible to open."
entries.translation_source: The door is tightly shut. It appears impossible to open.
entries.translated:
La porta è ben chiusa. Sembra
impossibile da aprire.

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Inn\.
The text is too faded to read."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Inn[game-token-1] The text is too faded to read.
entries.translated:
Locanda di Tarmigan\. Il testo è
troppo sbiadito per essere letto.

entries.original: "It’s an ordinary statue."
entries.translation_source: It’s an ordinary statue.
entries.translated: È una statua normale.

entries.original:
"It’s a book detailing various
aspects of Mega Evolution."
entries.translation_source: It’s a book detailing various aspects of Mega Evolution.
entries.translated:
È un libro che descrive vari
aspetti della Megaevoluzione.

entries.original:
"Rumour has it, if you can fight
your way through this mansion, you\lcan learn the valuable art of\lMega Evolution."
entries.translation_source: Rumour has it, if you can fight your way through this mansion, you can learn the valuable art of Mega Evolution.
entries.translated:
Si dice che, se riesci a farti
strada combattendo attraverso\lquesta villa, puoi imparare la

preziosa arte della Megaevoluzione.

entries.original:
"Somewhere in this house resides
Successor Maxima.

If you find you her, she’ll give
you something special."
entries.translation_source: Somewhere in this house resides Successor Maxima. If you find you her, she’ll give you something special.
entries.translated:
Da qualche parte in questa casa si
trova Successor Maxima. Se la\ltrovi, ti darà qualcosa di

speciale.

entries.original:
"A switch is hidden in one of the
statues in the Mansion.

If you manage to find it, it will
open up a new passageway."
entries.translation_source: A switch is hidden in one of the statues in the Mansion. If you manage to find it, it will open up a new passageway.
entries.translated:
In una delle statue della Villa si
nasconde un interruttore. Se riesci\la trovarlo, aprirà un nuovo

passaggio.

entries.original:
"As chefs, it is our sworn duty to
prepare the finest quality food for\lthe master of this mansion.

That being Successor Maxima of
course."
entries.translation_source: As chefs, it is our sworn duty to prepare the finest quality food for the master of this mansion. That being Successor Maxima of course.
entries.translated:
Come chef, è nostro sacro dovere
preparare il cibo della migliore\lqualità per il padrone di questa

villa. Cioè Successor Maxima,
naturalmente.

entries.original:
"I got stuck on dishes duty\.
What a drag\."
entries.translation_source: I got stuck on dishes duty[game-token-1] What a drag[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Mi hanno messo a fare i piatti\. Che
scocciatura\.

entries.original:
"I’m cooking a meal fit for a king!
It’s called \qoBidoof Roussir.\qo"
entries.translation_source: I’m cooking a meal fit for a king! It’s called [quote-open-1]Bidoof Roussir.[quote-open-2]
entries.translated:
Sto preparando un pasto degno di un
re! Si chiama \qoBidoof Roussir.\qo

entries.original:
"When I was kid, I started my own
cooking show.

It was called \qoCooking With Simon\qo,
or \qoCWS\qo for short."
entries.translation_source: When I was kid, I started my own cooking show. It was called [quote-open-1]Cooking With Simon[quote-open-2], or [quote-open-3]CWS[quote-open-4] for short.
entries.translated:
Da bambino, ho iniziato il mio
personale programma di cucina. Si\lchiamava \qoCooking With Simon\qo, o

\qoCWS\qo per brevità.

entries.original:
"The Zap Badge let’s ya Surf over
both water and lava!

But not only that, any Pokémon
will also obey ya as long as it’s\lnot over level 70!

How electrifying is that?"
entries.translation_source: The Zap Badge let’s ya Surf over both water and lava! But not only that, any Pokémon will also obey ya as long as it’s not over level 70! How electrifying is that?
entries.translated:
La Medaglia Zap ti permette di
usare Surf su acqua e lava! Ma non\lsolo: qualsiasi Pokémon ti obbedirà

finché non supera il livello 70!
Non è elettrizzante?

entries.original:
"Mega Evolution was first discovered
in the Kalos Region by the renowned\lProfessor Sycamore.

Thanks to his research, Pokémon
are now able to Mega Evolve\lmid-battle.

However, a large part of Mega
Evolution still remains a mystery."
entries.translation_source: Mega Evolution was first discovered in the Kalos Region by the renowned Professor Sycamore. Thanks to his research, Pokémon are now able to Mega Evolve mid-battle. However, a large part of Mega Evolution still remains a mystery.
entries.translated:
La Megaevoluzione fu scoperta per
la prima volta nella regione di\lKalos dal rinomato Professor

Platan. Grazie alle sue ricerche,
ora i Pokémon possono Megaevolversi\ldurante la lotta. Tuttavia, gran

parte della Megaevoluzione rimane
ancora un mistero.

entries.original:
"Child, where do you think
you’re going?"
entries.translation_source: Child, where do you think you’re going?
entries.translated: Bambino, dove credi di andare?

entries.original:
"To obtain the power of
Mega Evolution?"
entries.translation_source: To obtain the power of Mega Evolution?
entries.translated: Per ottenere il potere della Megaevoluzione?

entries.original:
"Remember this: power corrupts, and
absolute power corrupts absolutely.

The same can be said about
Mega Evolution.

Be careful."
entries.translation_source: Remember this: power corrupts, and absolute power corrupts absolutely. The same can be said about Mega Evolution. Be careful.
entries.translated:
Ricorda questo: il potere corrompe,
e il potere assoluto corrompe in\lmodo assoluto. Lo stesso si può

dire della Megaevoluzione. Fai
attenzione.

entries.original:
"I need to grow even stronger to
surpass the others."
entries.translation_source: I need to grow even stronger to surpass the others.
entries.translated:
Devo diventare ancora più forte per
superare gli altri.

entries.original:
"I’d say this point in the challenge
is around the mid-point."
entries.translation_source: I’d say this point in the challenge is around the mid-point.
entries.translated:
Direi che questo punto della sfida
è circa a metà.

entries.original:
"How does it feel to know that your
opponents are growing stronger?"
entries.translation_source: How does it feel to know that your opponents are growing stronger?
entries.translated: Come ci si sente a sapere che i tuoi avversari stanno diventando più forti?

entries.original: "It must sting, mustn’t it?"
entries.translation_source: It must sting, mustn’t it?
entries.translated: Deve bruciare, vero?

entries.original:
"You’d better hope you have enough
healing items."
entries.translation_source: You’d better hope you have enough healing items.
entries.translated:
Faresti meglio a sperare di avere
abbastanza strumenti curativi.

entries.original:
"One day my dragons will soar high
in their Mega-Evolved forms!"
entries.translation_source: One day my dragons will soar high in their Mega-Evolved forms!
entries.translated:
Un giorno i miei draghi voleranno
in alto nelle loro forme\lGigamaxizzate!

entries.original:
"Unlike the other experts, I’m still
young and free!"
entries.translation_source: Unlike the other experts, I’m still young and free!
entries.translated:
A differenza degli altri esperti,
sono ancora giovane e libero!

entries.original: "You won’t make it past here."
entries.translation_source: You won’t make it past here.
entries.translated: Non passerai di qui.

entries.original: "Proceed."
entries.translation_source: Proceed.
entries.translated: Prosegui.

entries.original: "The end is nigh."
entries.translation_source: The end is nigh.
entries.translated: La fine è vicina.

entries.original:
"Whenever you’re ready to face
Maxima, just walk off the ledge.

Don’t worry, it won’t hurt."
entries.translation_source: Whenever you’re ready to face Maxima, just walk off the ledge. Don’t worry, it won’t hurt.
entries.translated:
Quando sei pronto a sfidare Maxima,
ti basta scendere dal bordo. Non\lpreoccuparti, non ti farà male.

entries.original:
"The Mega Ring lets you use the
power of Mega Evolution.

To access it, the Pokémon battling
must be holding its Mega Stone.

To Mega Evolve in battle, when you
see the Mega symbol appear, press\lthe Start Button.

Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve
and become even more powerful!

Just remember, you can only Mega
Evolve one Pokémon per battle.

The Mega Evolution’s effects will
wear off once the battle is over,\lso choose carefully.

I have faith that you’ll use this
Mega Ring to help benefit humanity.

Don’t let me down, [player].

I’m counting on you to make a
difference in the world."
entries.translation_source: The Mega Ring lets you use the power of Mega Evolution. To access it, the Pokémon battling must be holding its Mega Stone. To Mega Evolve in battle, when you see the Mega symbol appear, press the Start Button. Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve and become even more powerful! Just remember, you can only Mega Evolve one Pokémon per battle. The Mega Evolution’s effects will wear off once the battle is over, so choose carefully. I have faith that you’ll use this Mega Ring to help benefit humanity. Don’t let me down, [player-name-1]. I’m counting on you to make a difference in the world.
entries.translated:
Il Megacerchio ti permette di usare
il potere della Mega Evoluzione.\lPer accedervi, il Pokémon che lotta

deve tenere la sua Megapietra. Per
Mega Evolvere in lotta, quando vedi\lapparire il simbolo Mega, premi il

pulsante Start. Il tuo Pokémon
effettuerà la Mega Evoluzione e\ldiventerà ancora più potente!

Ricorda solo che puoi far Mega
Evolvere un solo Pokémon per lotta.\lGli effetti della Mega Evoluzione

svaniranno una volta finita la
lotta, quindi scegli con\lattenzione. Ho fiducia che userai

questo Megacerchio per aiutare
l{B4}umanità. Non deludermi, [player].\lConto su di te per fare la

differenza nel mondo.

entries.original:
"Hello there, trainer.
My name is Successor Maxima.

Making it through my mansion is no
easy feat.

There are so many ups and downs
even I get lost some times!

But in the end I always end up back
down here.

You’ve fought hard to get down
here and that is commendable.

Am I correct in assuming you’ve
come seeking the power of Mega\lEvolution?

\.\.\.

\.\.\.

I see\."
entries.translation_source: Hello there, trainer. My name is Successor Maxima. Making it through my mansion is no easy feat. There are so many ups and downs even I get lost some times! But in the end I always end up back down here. You’ve fought hard to get down here and that is commendable. Am I correct in assuming you’ve come seeking the power of Mega Evolution? [game-token-1][game-token-2][game-token-3] [game-token-4][game-token-5][game-token-6] I see[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Salve, allenatore. Mi chiamo
Successor Maxima. Superare la mia\lvilla non è impresa da poco. Ci

sono così tante salite e discese
che persino io a volte mi perdo! Ma\lalla fine torno sempre quaggiù. Hai

lottato duramente per arrivare fin
qui, e questo è encomiabile.\lSuppongo correttamente che tu sia

venuto in cerca del potere della
Mega Evoluzione? \.\.\. \.\.\. Capisco\.

entries.original:
"Then if you want the power, you’ll
have to fight me for it!"
entries.translation_source: Then if you want the power, you’ll have to fight me for it!
entries.translated:
Allora, se vuoi il potere, dovrai
combattere contro di me per\lottenerlo!

entries.original: "Ughhhhh\."
entries.translation_source: Ughhhhh[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ughhhhh\.

entries.original: "It’s a challenge rock."
entries.translation_source: It’s a challenge rock.
entries.translated: È una roccia della sfida.

entries.original:
"Would you like to have [buffer1]
smash the rock?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to have [buffer1-1] smash the rock?
entries.translated: Vuoi che [buffer1] rompa la roccia?

entries.original:
"[buffer1] tried to smash the
challenge rock.

A piece of the rock broke away!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] tried to smash the challenge rock. A piece of the rock broke away!
entries.translated:
[buffer1] ha cercato di spaccare il
masso della sfida. Un pezzo della\lroccia si è staccato!

entries.original:
"Be cautious, trainer!

You’re about to enter Antisis City!
A very dangerous place!

If you’re coming from there, well\.
this gate only really goes one way."
entries.translation_source: Be cautious, trainer! You’re about to enter Antisis City! A very dangerous place! If you’re coming from there, well[game-token-1] this gate only really goes one way.
entries.translated:
Fai attenzione, allenatore! Stai
per entrare ad Antisis City! Un\lposto davvero pericoloso! Se invece

vieni da lì, beh\. questo cancello va
davvero in una sola direzione.

entries.original:
"A bunch of softies live on the
other side of this mountain!

I eat softies for breakfast!
Sofities like you!"
entries.translation_source: A bunch of softies live on the other side of this mountain! I eat softies for breakfast! Sofities like you!
entries.translated: Un branco di smidollati vive dall{B4}altra parte di questa montagna! Io mangio gli smidollati a colazione! Smidollati come te!

entries.original: "I was eaten!"
entries.translation_source: I was eaten!
entries.translated: Mi hanno mangiato!

entries.original:
"Sometimes I walk over to Epidimy
Town and terrorize ’em, for fun.

But then that white-haired Gym
Leader always chases me away.

I give him such a headache\."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes I walk over to Epidimy Town and terrorize ’em, for fun. But then that white-haired Gym Leader always chases me away. I give him such a headache[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
A volte vado a Epidimy Town e li
terrorizzo, per divertimento. Ma\lpoi quel Capopalestra dai capelli

bianchi mi caccia sempre via. Gli
do un bel mal di testa\.

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt.
East Entrance

\ar Antisis City"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. East Entrance [game-token-1] Antisis City
entries.translated:
Thundercap Mt. Ingresso Est \ar Città
di Antisis

entries.original:
"Would you like to return to the
[green]Ruins of Void[black]?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to return to the [color-green-1]Ruins of Void[color-black-2]?
entries.translated: Vuoi tornare alle [green]Rovine del Vuoto[black]?

entries.original:
"Would you like to return to
[green]Dehara City[black]?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to return to [color-green-1]Dehara City[color-black-2]?
entries.translated: Vuoi tornare a [green]Dehara City[black]?

entries.original:
"Hello, there!

Do you happen to have one of those
rare [green]Ice-type [buffer1][blue]?

I’ve always had trouble getting my
hands on one.

If you do, would you agree to a
trade for my [green][buffer2][blue]?

It’s very useful against the Gym,
here."
entries.translation_source: Hello, there! Do you happen to have one of those rare [color-green-1]Ice-type [buffer1-2][color-blue-3]? I’ve always had trouble getting my hands on one. If you do, would you agree to a trade for my [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]? It’s very useful against the Gym, here.
entries.translated:
Salve! Per caso hai uno di quei
rari [green]di tipo Ghiaccio [buffer1][blue]? Ho\lsempre avuto difficoltà a metterci

le mani sopra. Se sì, saresti
disposto a scambiare il mio\l[green][buffer2][blue]? È molto utile contro la

Palestra, qui.

entries.original: "Many thanks."
entries.translation_source: Many thanks.
entries.translated: Molte grazie.

entries.original:
"The [buffer2] that I traded you,
has it helped you out?"
entries.translation_source: The [buffer2-1] that I traded you, has it helped you out?
entries.translated:
Il [buffer2] che ti ho scambiato, ti
è stato utile?

entries.original: "Well, if you don’t want to\."
entries.translation_source: Well, if you don’t want to[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Beh, se non vuoi\.

entries.original:
"Hmmm?
This isn’t an [green]Ice-type [buffer1][blue].

Think of me if you get one."
entries.translation_source: Hmmm? This isn’t an [color-green-1]Ice-type [buffer1-2][color-blue-3]. Think of me if you get one.
entries.translated:
Hmmm? Questo non è un [green]tipo Ghiaccio
[buffer1][blue]. Pensami se ne trovi uno.

entries.original:
"We just undertook a major drug bust
and finally apprehended the\lcriminal responsible for selling\l[green]Oddish Leaves [blue]in Borrius!

Now we’re dancing here to
celebrate."
entries.translation_source: We just undertook a major drug bust and finally apprehended the criminal responsible for selling [color-green-1]Oddish Leaves [color-blue-2]in Borrius! Now we’re dancing here to celebrate.
entries.translated:
Abbiamo appena condotto
un{B4}importante retata antidroga e\lfinalmente abbiamo arrestato il

criminale responsabile della
vendita di [green]Oddish Leaves [blue]a Borrius!\lOra balliamo qui per festeggiare.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]\.one with the wind.
One with the snow.

A howling blizzard.

A world frozen.

Heed my call!

Articuno!

Sankren fimbulvetr!

Come to me!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1][game-token-2]one with the wind. One with the snow. A howling blizzard. A world frozen. Heed my call! Articuno! Sankren fimbulvetr! Come to me!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]\.Uno col vento. Uno con la
neve. Una bufera ululante. Un mondo\lghiacciato. Ascolta la mia

chiamata! Articuno! Sankren
fimbulvetr! Vieni da me!

entries.original:
"[blue]Shadow Warriors!

Restrain it!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Shadow Warriors! Restrain it!
entries.translated: [blue]Shadow Warriors! Immobilizzatelo!

entries.original:
"[blue]Now, Articuno, it’s time for you to
become mine."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Now, Articuno, it’s time for you to become mine.
entries.translated:
[blue]Adesso, Articuno, è ora che tu
diventi mio.

entries.original:
"[blue]The mission has been completed.

Now let’s report back to Zeph."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]The mission has been completed. Now let’s report back to Zeph.
entries.translated:
[blue]La missione è stata completata. Ora
riferiamo a Zeph.

entries.original:
"[blue]You again!

What are you doing here?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You again! What are you doing here?
entries.translated: [blue]Ancora tu! Che ci fai qui?

entries.original:
"[blue]Grunts!

One of you, get rid of [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Grunts! One of you, get rid of [buffer1-2]!
entries.translated:
[blue]Compari! Uno di voi, sbarazzatevi
di [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"[red]Don’t expect any mercy from
[black]The Shadows[red]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Don’t expect any mercy from [color-black-2]The Shadows[color-red-3]!
entries.translated:
[red]Non aspettarti alcuna pietà da [black]The
Shadows[red]!

entries.original: "Squeal!"
entries.translation_source: Squeal!
entries.translated: Squittio!

entries.original:
"[red]It doesn’t matter.

I bought enough time for everyone
else to escape.

But nice try, kid.

Take this package as a consolation
prize.

We’ve taken what we needed from it."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]It doesn’t matter. I bought enough time for everyone else to escape. But nice try, kid. Take this package as a consolation prize. We’ve taken what we needed from it.
entries.translated:
[red]Non importa. Ho guadagnato
abbastanza tempo perché tutti gli\laltri potessero fuggire. Ma bel

tentativo, ragazzino. Prendi questo
pacco come premio di consolazione.\lNe abbiamo già preso ciò di cui

avevamo bisogno.

entries.original:
"I’m a lover of all things wings.

If you show me some beautiful wings
over the course of 4 different\ldays, I’ll share some of my\lbeautiful wings with you.

You wing it?"
entries.translation_source: I’m a lover of all things wings. If you show me some beautiful wings over the course of 4 different days, I’ll share some of my beautiful wings with you. You wing it?
entries.translated:
Adoro tutto ciò che ha le ali. Se
mi mostri delle ali splendide\lnell{B4}arco di 4 giorni diversi,

condividerò con te delle mie ali
splendide. Te la cavi?

entries.original:
"Wingderful!

For today, I’d like to see the
beautiful wings of a [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Wingderful! For today, I’d like to see the beautiful wings of a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3].
entries.translated:
Ali-meraviglioso! Per oggi, vorrei
vedere le belle ali di un [green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original: "That wings."
entries.translation_source: That wings.
entries.translated: Quelle ali.

entries.original:
"Let’s see those beautiful
[green][buffer1][blue] wings!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s see those beautiful [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] wings!
entries.translated:
Vediamo quelle splendide [green][buffer1][blue]
ali!

entries.original: "Those are some mighty fine wings\."
entries.translation_source: Those are some mighty fine wings[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Che ali davvero magnifiche\.

entries.original:
"What\.?

I can’t see those beautiful
[green][buffer1][blue] wings anywhere\."
entries.translation_source: What[game-token-1]? I can’t see those beautiful [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] wings anywhere[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Cosa\.? Non riesco a vedere da
nessuna parte quelle bellissime ali\l[green][buffer1][blue]\.

entries.original:
"Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice
[green][buffer1][blue] wings.

Just don’t bring them today.
I’m all winged out."
entries.translation_source: Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] wings. Just don’t bring them today. I’m all winged out.
entries.translated:
Domani vorrei vedere delle belle
[green][buffer1][blue] ali. Non portarmele oggi,\lperò. Sono stufo di ali.

entries.original:
"Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice
[green][buffer2][blue] wings.

Just don’t bring them today.
I’m all winged out."
entries.translation_source: Tomorrow I’d like to see some nice [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] wings. Just don’t bring them today. I’m all winged out.
entries.translated:
Domani vorrei vedere delle belle
[green][buffer2][blue] ali. Non portarmele oggi,\lperò. Sono stufo di ali.

entries.original:
"Wingderful!

I’ve seen all those beautiful wings
I’ve never seen before!

As promised, I’d like to share my
wings with you!"
entries.translation_source: Wingderful! I’ve seen all those beautiful wings I’ve never seen before! As promised, I’d like to share my wings with you!
entries.translated:
Wingderful! Ho visto tutte quelle
bellissime ali che non avevo mai\lvisto prima! Come promesso, vorrei

condividere le mie ali con te!

entries.original:
"After seeing all those beautiful
wings, I’m all winged out for life!"
entries.translation_source: After seeing all those beautiful wings, I’m all winged out for life!
entries.translated:
Dopo aver visto tutte quelle ali
bellissime, per tutta la vita ne\lavrò abbastanza di ali!

entries.original:
"Oh heavens\.

My daughter, I can’t find her!

We were on holiday at the [green]beach[red],
when all of sudden, she vanished!

Please, [buffer1], search for her!"
entries.translation_source: Oh heavens[game-token-1] My daughter, I can’t find her! We were on holiday at the [color-green-2]beach[color-red-3], when all of sudden, she vanished! Please, [buffer1-4], search for her!
entries.translated:
Oh cielo\. Mia figlia, non riesco a
trovarla! Eravamo in vacanza alla\l[green]spiaggia[red], quando all{B4}improvviso è

scomparsa! Ti prego, [buffer1],
cercala!

entries.original:
"Thank you, [buffer1]!

As appearances go, she resembles
any ordinary [green]female tuber[red]."
entries.translation_source: Thank you, [buffer1-1]! As appearances go, she resembles any ordinary [color-green-2]female tuber[color-red-3].
entries.translated:
Grazie, [buffer1]! A giudicare
dall{B4}aspetto, sembra una qualsiasi\lnormale [green]tuber femmina[red].

entries.original:
"Oh, dear\.

What will I do now\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear[game-token-1] What will I do now[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh, cielo\. Cosa farò adesso\.

entries.original:
"Pardon me?

You say my daughter was blown away
by a strong wind?

She cannot have been blown far!

Strong winds like those aren’t
powerful enough to carry a child\loutside of the city limits.

Please, continue to search for her!"
entries.translation_source: Pardon me? You say my daughter was blown away by a strong wind? She cannot have been blown far! Strong winds like those aren’t powerful enough to carry a child outside of the city limits. Please, continue to search for her!
entries.translated:
Mi scusi? Dice che mia figlia è
stata portata via da un forte\lvento? Non può essere stata portata

lontano! Venti forti come quelli
non sono abbastanza potenti da\ltrascinare un bambino oltre i

limiti della città. Per favore,
continua a cercarla!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

My mommy left me out here all
alone\.

I don’t think she cares about me
anymore\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] My mommy left me out here all alone[game-token-2] I don’t think she cares about me anymore[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Sniff\. La mia mamma mi ha lasciato
qui tutto solo\. Non credo che si\lpreoccupi più di me\.

entries.original:
"What’s that?

Did you say my mommy sent you to
find me?

Sniff\.

Maybe she really does care about
me\."
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Did you say my mommy sent you to find me? Sniff[game-token-1] Maybe she really does care about me[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Che c{B4}è? Hai detto che la mia mamma
ti ha mandato a cercarmi? Sniff\.\lForse in realtà ci tiene davvero a

me\.

entries.original:
"Okay\.

Please take me back to my mommy."
entries.translation_source: Okay[game-token-1] Please take me back to my mommy.
entries.translated:
Va bene\. Portami dalla mia mamma,
per favore.

entries.original:
"The little girl appears to have
been blown away."
entries.translation_source: The little girl appears to have been blown away.
entries.translated:
Sembra che la bambina sia stata
portata via dal vento.

entries.original:
"Waaaah!

This big wind blew me all the way
out here!

Lemme hold onto you so I don’t blow
away, again!"
entries.translation_source: Waaaah! This big wind blew me all the way out here! Lemme hold onto you so I don’t blow away, again!
entries.translated:
Waaaah! Questo forte vento mi ha
soffiato fin qui! Lascia che mi\laggrappi a te così non mi porti

via, di nuovo!

entries.original:
"Waaaah!

That big wind blew me away again!

I’m scared now\.
I wanna go home\."
entries.translation_source: Waaaah! That big wind blew me away again! I’m scared now[game-token-1] I wanna go home[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Waaaah! Quel vento fortissimo mi ha
spazzato via di nuovo! Adesso ho\lpaura\. Voglio andare a casa\.

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

I hate the wind\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] I hate the wind[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Sniff\. Odio il vento\.

entries.original:
"Huh?

I’m not being blown away anymore\.

Yay!

It’s over!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? I’m not being blown away anymore[game-token-1] Yay! It’s over!
entries.translated:
Eh? Non vengo più spazzato via\.
Evviva! È finita!

entries.original: "I’m\.so\.dizzy\."
entries.translation_source: I’m[game-token-1]so[game-token-2]dizzy[game-token-3]
entries.translated: Sono\.così\.stordito\.

entries.original:
"Mommy!
You found me!

I missed you so much!
I was so scared\.

This big bad wind kept blowing me
all over!

But I’m okay now, thanks to this
person!"
entries.translation_source: Mommy! You found me! I missed you so much! I was so scared[game-token-1] This big bad wind kept blowing me all over! But I’m okay now, thanks to this person!
entries.translated:
Mamma! Mi hai trovato! Mi sei
mancata tantissimo! Avevo così\lpaura\. Questo brutto, grande vento

mi soffiava via da tutte le parti!
Ma adesso sto bene, grazie a questa\lpersona!

entries.original:
"I wanna go home now, Mommy.
I’m really dizzy\."
entries.translation_source: I wanna go home now, Mommy. I’m really dizzy[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Voglio tornare a casa adesso,
mamma. Mi gira davvero la testa\.

entries.original: "Mommy, wait!"
entries.translation_source: Mommy, wait!
entries.translated: Mamma, aspetta!

entries.original:
"We forgot to give a gift to the
[buffer1] who helped me!"
entries.translation_source: We forgot to give a gift to the [buffer1-1] who helped me!
entries.translated:
Abbiamo dimenticato di fare un
regalo al [buffer1] che mi ha\laiutato!

entries.original:
"Mommy\.

What happened to you\.?"
entries.translation_source: Mommy[game-token-1] What happened to you[game-token-2]?
entries.translated: Mamma\. Cosa ti è successo\.?

entries.original:
"Aye, I do deliveries from the
Antisis Port during the day.

Without me, there’d be no
Fallshore Market!"
entries.translation_source: Aye, I do deliveries from the Antisis Port during the day. Without me, there’d be no Fallshore Market!
entries.translated:
Aye, faccio consegne dall{B4}Antisis
Port durante il giorno. Senza di\lme, non ci sarebbe il Fallshore

Market!

entries.original:
"Aye, I just finished delivering
goods to all the Poké Marts.

Soon, I’ll be heading back to
Antisis City for the night."
entries.translation_source: Aye, I just finished delivering goods to all the Poké Marts. Soon, I’ll be heading back to Antisis City for the night.
entries.translated:
Sì, ho appena finito di consegnare
la merce a tutti i Poké Mart. Tra\lpoco tornerò ad Antisis City per la

notte.

entries.original:
"But it looks like I have some
leftover items.

How about instead of tossing ’em, I
let you have ’em!"
entries.translation_source: But it looks like I have some leftover items. How about instead of tossing ’em, I let you have ’em!
entries.translated:
Ma sembra che mi siano rimasti
alcuni oggetti. Che ne dici, invece\ldi buttarli, te li lascio?

entries.original:
"Hoo boy, Trainer!

I’m in a bit of a pickle, and I’m
wondering if you can help me out.

I got to this island by digging
up from a hidden tunnel, but my\lGraveler forgot Dig when it\llearned a new move.

Now I’m stuck here with no way off
this island.

Can you help me get back home?"
entries.translation_source: Hoo boy, Trainer! I’m in a bit of a pickle, and I’m wondering if you can help me out. I got to this island by digging up from a hidden tunnel, but my Graveler forgot Dig when it learned a new move. Now I’m stuck here with no way off this island. Can you help me get back home?
entries.translated:
Oh accidenti, Allenatore! Sono un
po{B4} nei guai e mi chiedevo se puoi\ldarmi una mano. Sono arrivato su

quest{B4}isola scavando da un tunnel
segreto, ma il mio Graveler ha\ldimenticato Fossa quando ha

imparato una nuova mossa. Adesso
sono bloccato qui senza modo di\llasciare quest{B4}isola. Puoi aiutarmi

a tornare a casa?

entries.original:
"Awesome!

All you need is a Pokemon that
knows [green]Dig[blue].

Do you have one with you?"
entries.translation_source: Awesome! All you need is a Pokemon that knows [color-green-1]Dig[color-blue-2]. Do you have one with you?
entries.translated:
Fantastico! Tutto ciò che ti serve
è un Pokémon che conosca [green]Fossa[blue]. Ne\lhai uno con te?

entries.original:
"Amazing!

The last thing I’ll ask is if you’re
ready to go into the tunnel.

There is no going back until you
reach the other exit."
entries.translation_source: Amazing! The last thing I’ll ask is if you’re ready to go into the tunnel. There is no going back until you reach the other exit.
entries.translated:
Fantastico! L{B4}ultima cosa che ti
chiederò è se sei pronto a entrare\lnel tunnel. Non si torna indietro

finché non raggiungi l{B4}altra
uscita.

entries.original:
"I’m going to challenge you to a
battle before we go.

I need to be sure you’re strong
enough to survive down there."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to challenge you to a battle before we go. I need to be sure you’re strong enough to survive down there.
entries.translated:
Ti sfiderò a una lotta prima di
andare. Devo essere sicuro che tu\lsia abbastanza forte per

sopravvivere laggiù.

entries.original:
"Alrighty, let’s go!
Use Dig!"
entries.translation_source: Alrighty, let’s go! Use Dig!
entries.translated: Va bene, andiamo! Usa Dig!

entries.original:
"What are you getting at?
None of your Pokemon know [green]Dig[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: What are you getting at? None of your Pokemon know [color-green-1]Dig[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Che cosa vuoi insinuare? Nessuno
dei tuoi Pokémon conosce [green]Fossa[blue]!

entries.original:
"No?

Well I hope the rising tide won’t
drown me\."
entries.translation_source: No? Well I hope the rising tide won’t drown me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
No? Beh, spero che la marea
montante non mi anneghi\.

entries.original:
"No?

[green]Sandshrew[blue] and [green]Sandslash[blue] in the
[green]Great Desert[blue] usually know Dig."
entries.translation_source: No? [color-green-1]Sandshrew[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Sandslash[color-blue-4] in the [color-green-5]Great Desert[color-blue-6] usually know Dig.
entries.translated:
No? [green]Sandshrew[blue] e [green]Sandslash[blue] nel
[green]Grande Deserto[blue] di solito conoscono\lFossa.

entries.original:
"It’s just a tunnel, what’s there
to be scared about?"
entries.translation_source: It’s just a tunnel, what’s there to be scared about?
entries.translated:
È solo un tunnel, cosa c{B4}è da
temere?

entries.original:
"Well, we’re here!
The Lost Tunnel\.

It’s rather dank in here\.
It’s also really dark.

I don’t think even a Pokemon could
light it up.
