Well, we’d better get going!

There’s a ladder up, somewhere
around here.

I’ll keep you healed up after
every battle."
entries.translation_source: Well, we’re here! The Lost Tunnel[game-token-1] It’s rather dank in here[game-token-2] It’s also really dark. I don’t think even a Pokemon could light it up. Well, we’d better get going! There’s a ladder up, somewhere around here. I’ll keep you healed up after every battle.
entries.translated:
Bene, siamo arrivati! Il Tunnel
Perduto\. Qui dentro è piuttosto\lumido\. E anche davvero buio. Non

credo che nemmeno un Pokémon
riuscirebbe a illuminarlo. Bene,\lfaremmo meglio a muoverci! C{B4}è una

scala da qualche parte qui intorno.
Ti curerò dopo ogni lotta.

entries.original:
"Yo, I ain’t done yet!

Take this TM too!"
entries.translation_source: Yo, I ain’t done yet! Take this TM too!
entries.translated:
Ehi, non ho ancora finito! Prendi
anche questa MT!

entries.original:
"TM92 is [green]Volt Switch[blue]!

It lets you switch out when you’re
at a disadvantage!

Shows your enemies what you’re
made of!"
entries.translation_source: TM92 is [color-green-1]Volt Switch[color-blue-2]! It lets you switch out when you’re at a disadvantage! Shows your enemies what you’re made of!
entries.translated:
La MT92 è [green]Invertivolt[blue]! Ti permette
di cambiare Pokémon quando sei in\lsvantaggio! Mostra ai tuoi nemici

di che pasta sei fatto!

entries.original:
"Don’t let anything stand in your
way, [player]!

And never let any disadvantage hold
you back from realizing your goals!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t let anything stand in your way, [player-name-1]! And never let any disadvantage hold you back from realizing your goals!
entries.translated:
Non lasciare che nulla ti ostacoli,
[player]! E non lasciare mai che\lalcuno svantaggio ti impedisca di

realizzare i tuoi obiettivi!

entries.original:
"What?
An earthquake? Now?"
entries.translation_source: What? An earthquake? Now?
entries.translated: Cosa? Un terremoto? Adesso?

entries.original:
"Wow, you wiped the floor with
that Diglett!

Have you ever wondered what a
Diglett’s feet look like?"
entries.translation_source: Wow, you wiped the floor with that Diglett! Have you ever wondered what a Diglett’s feet look like?
entries.translated:
Wow, hai asfaltato quel Diglett! Ti
sei mai chiesto come siano fatti i\lpiedi di un Diglett?

entries.original:
"Again?
I hope no rocks fall on me\."
entries.translation_source: Again? I hope no rocks fall on me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Di nuovo? Spero che non mi cadano
addosso dei massi\.

entries.original:
"That was a tough Golem!

I wonder if it would get along
with my Graveler\."
entries.translation_source: That was a tough Golem! I wonder if it would get along with my Graveler[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Che Golem tosto! Chissà se andrebbe
d{B4}accordo con il mio Graveler\.

entries.original:
"A third time?
This can’t be a coincidence!"
entries.translation_source: A third time? This can’t be a coincidence!
entries.translated:
Una terza volta? Non può essere una
coincidenza!

entries.original:
"Phew, that was a tough battle!
I’m tired just from watching!

But now that you took out that
Dugtrio, the tremors should stop."
entries.translation_source: Phew, that was a tough battle! I’m tired just from watching! But now that you took out that Dugtrio, the tremors should stop.
entries.translated:
Uff, che battaglia dura! Sono
stanco solo ad aver guardato! Ma\lora che hai eliminato quel Dugtrio,

le scosse dovrebbero cessare.

entries.original:
"There’s the ladder!

I thought we would be stuck here
forever\.

Let’s get out of here."
entries.translation_source: There’s the ladder! I thought we would be stuck here forever[game-token-1] Let’s get out of here.
entries.translated:
C{B4}è la scala! Pensavo saremmo
rimasti bloccati qui per sempre\.\lAndiamo via di qui.

entries.original:
"What? A dead end!

I’m sure there’s a way out of
here\."
entries.translation_source: What? A dead end! I’m sure there’s a way out of here[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Cosa? Un vicolo cieco! Sono sicuro
che ci sia un modo per uscire di\lqui\.

entries.original: "Let me see\."
entries.translation_source: Let me see[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Fammi vedere\.

entries.original:
"Aha! Found it!

A weak spot in the wall, right
here."
entries.translation_source: Aha! Found it! A weak spot in the wall, right here.
entries.translated:
Ahah! Trovato! Un punto debole nel
muro, proprio qui.

entries.original: "Graveler, use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: Graveler, use Rock Smash!
entries.translated: Graveler, usa Spaccaroccia!

entries.original:
"[red]Now, Moltres, it’s time for you to
become ours."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Now, Moltres, it’s time for you to become ours.
entries.translated:
[red]Ora, Moltres, è tempo che tu
diventi nostro.

entries.original:
"Thanks for all your help!
Here, take this TM.

I forgot I had it this whole
time."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for all your help! Here, take this TM. I forgot I had it this whole time.
entries.translated:
Grazie di tutto il tuo aiuto!
Tieni, prendi questa MT. Mi ero\ldimenticato di averla da sempre.

entries.original:
"TM28 contains [green]Dig[blue].

We should have just used it right
away, eh?"
entries.translation_source: TM28 contains [color-green-1]Dig[color-blue-2]. We should have just used it right away, eh?
entries.translated:
La MT28 contiene [green]Fossa[blue]. Avremmo
dovuto usarla subito, eh?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]If Ivory is unable, then
Houndoom and I will have to show\lyou the meaning of pain ourselves!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]If Ivory is unable, then Houndoom and I will have to show you the meaning of pain ourselves!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Se Ivory non è in grado,
allora Houndoom e io dovremo\lmostrarti noi stessi il significato

del dolore!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Zeph, I really don’t think
you should\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Zeph, I really don’t think you should[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Zeph, davvero non credo che
dovresti\.

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]Silence, Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Silence, Ivory!
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Silenzio, Ivory!

entries.original: "[blue]Time to suffer!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Time to suffer!
entries.translated: [blue]È ora di soffrire!

entries.original:
"[blue]Enjoy your victory while you can,
because you’re about to leave this\lworld.

It’s too risky to leave you alive
at this point."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Enjoy your victory while you can, because you’re about to leave this world. It’s too risky to leave you alive at this point.
entries.translated:
[blue]Goditi la tua vittoria finché puoi,
perché stai per lasciare questo\lmondo. Lasciarti in vita, a questo

punto, è troppo rischioso.

entries.original:
"[blue]Houndoom!

Incinerate!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Houndoom! Incinerate!
entries.translated: [blue]Houndoom! Incenerisci!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Wait!

Houndoom!
Pull back!

Something’s happening!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Wait! Houndoom! Pull back! Something’s happening!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Aspetta! Houndoom! Torna
indietro! Sta succedendo qualcosa!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Grunts!

Grab [buffer1] now before [buffer2] gets away!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Grunts! Grab [buffer1-2] now before [buffer2-3] gets away!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Scagnozzi! Prendete [buffer1]
subito prima che [buffer2] scappi!

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

If that ain’t the darndest thing
I ever did see!

A [buffer1] coming outta some magic
portal!

Where’d ya come from, [buffer1]?

\.

What’s that?

Ya were tryin’ to get to
Thundercap Mt. when all of a\lsudden ya were kidnapped!

Hoooo weeee!

That sure sounds scary, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! If that ain’t the darndest thing I ever did see! A [buffer1-1] coming outta some magic portal! Where’d ya come from, [buffer1-2]? [game-token-3] What’s that? Ya were tryin’ to get to Thundercap Mt. when all of a sudden ya were kidnapped! Hoooo weeee! That sure sounds scary, [buffer1-4].
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Se non è la cosa più
strana che abbia mai visto! Un\l[buffer1] che esce da un portale

magico! Da dove vieni, [buffer1]? \.
Come? Stavi cercando di raggiungere\lThundercap Mt. quando

all{B4}improvviso sei stato rapito!
Hoooo weeee! Sembra davvero\lspaventoso, [buffer1].

entries.original:
"Well, if ya hadn’t been kidnapped,
ya’d be havin’ a lot less trouble\lgettin’ to Thundercap Mt.

Ya see, part of the ceiling
collapsed not long ago and\lblocked off the road!

And unless ya have the HM for [green]Rock
Smash[blue], you’ll be in a bit of a\lpickle gettin’ through ’em.

But\.

I’m guessin’ ya don’t or ya
wouldn’t still be talkin’ to me.

In thatta case, a friend of mine in
[green]Blizzard City[blue] can help ya out by\lgiving ya Rock Smash.

So, take this HM to help yurself
get to him."
entries.translation_source: Well, if ya hadn’t been kidnapped, ya’d be havin’ a lot less trouble gettin’ to Thundercap Mt. Ya see, part of the ceiling collapsed not long ago and blocked off the road! And unless ya have the HM for [color-green-1]Rock Smash[color-blue-2], you’ll be in a bit of a pickle gettin’ through ’em. But[game-token-3] I’m guessin’ ya don’t or ya wouldn’t still be talkin’ to me. In thatta case, a friend of mine in [color-green-4]Blizzard City[color-blue-5] can help ya out by giving ya Rock Smash. So, take this HM to help yurself get to him.
entries.translated:
Beh, se non fossi stato rapito,
faresti molta meno fatica ad\larrivare al Monte Thundercap. Vedi,

parte del soffitto è crollata poco
fa e ha bloccato la strada! E a\lmeno che tu non abbia la MN per

[green]Rocciarottura[blue], sarai in un bel
pasticcio per attraversarli. Ma\.\lImmagino che tu non ce l{B4}abbia,

altrimenti non staresti ancora
parlando con me. In tal caso, un\lmio amico a [green]Blizzard City[blue] può

aiutarti dandoti la Rocciarottura.
Quindi, prendi questa MN per\laiutarti ad arrivare da lui.

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

Looks like ya made contact with my
friend.

Now go over to those rocks and give
’em a good smashin’!"
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! Looks like ya made contact with my friend. Now go over to those rocks and give ’em a good smashin’!
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Sembra che tu abbia
fatto conoscenza con il mio amico.\lOra vai da quelle rocce e spaccale

come si deve!

entries.original:
"Use [green]Cut[blue] to get rid of that pesky
tree blocking [green]Valley Cave[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Use [color-green-1]Cut[color-blue-2] to get rid of that pesky tree blocking [color-green-3]Valley Cave[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Usa [green]Taglio[blue] per liberarti di
quell{B4}albero fastidioso che blocca\l[green]Valley Cave[blue].

entries.original:
"Mel: [blue]This is your final warning.
Move or be moved."
entries.translation_source: Mel: [color-blue-1]This is your final warning. Move or be moved.
entries.translated:
Mel: [blue]Questo è il tuo ultimo
avvertimento. Spostati o sarai\lspostato.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]I refuse to abandon my post.

I must prevent [player] from entering
Thundercap Mountain at all cost."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]I refuse to abandon my post. I must prevent [player-name-2] from entering Thundercap Mountain at all cost.
entries.translated:
Scagnozzo: [blue]Mi rifiuto di
abbandonare il mio posto. Devo\limpedire a [player] di entrare in

Thundercap Mountain a qualsiasi
costo.

entries.original:
"Mel: [blue]I don’t have time for this
right now.

My head is pounding and I have a
Gym to run."
entries.translation_source: Mel: [color-blue-1]I don’t have time for this right now. My head is pounding and I have a Gym to run.
entries.translated:
Mel: [blue]Non ho tempo per questo
adesso. Mi scoppia la testa e devo\ldirigere una Palestra.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]Arghhhhhhh\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Arghhhhhhh[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Recluta: [blue]Arghhhhhhh\.

entries.original:
"[blue]You can handle the rest from here
[player].

Whatever they’re up to, they
obviously don’t want you\linterfering.

So go nuts."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You can handle the rest from here [player-name-2]. Whatever they’re up to, they obviously don’t want you interfering. So go nuts.
entries.translated:
[blue]Puoi occuparti del resto da qui
[player]. Qualunque cosa stiano\lcombinando, è ovvio che non

vogliono che tu ti intrometta.
Quindi sbizzarrisciti.

entries.original: "[buffer1], use [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1], use [buffer2-2]!
entries.translated: [buffer1], usa [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Owww\.
My head\."
entries.translation_source: Owww[game-token-1] My head[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Ahi\. La mia testa\.

entries.original: "STOP!"
entries.translation_source: STOP!
entries.translated: FERMO!

entries.original:
"I can’t let you through!

If you get past me, I’ll be burned
alive!

You’re not getting any farther!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t let you through! If you get past me, I’ll be burned alive! You’re not getting any farther!
entries.translated:
Non posso lasciarti passare! Se mi
superi, finirò bruciato vivo! Non\landrai oltre!

entries.original:
"What’s that?

Ya don’t know what an HM is?

Hoooo weeee!

Well, an [green]HM[blue], or Hidden Machine, is
a special type of move a Pokémon\lcan learn to bypass obstacles.

When a Pokémon learns an HM, as
long as it takes a [green]single step[blue]\lknowin’ that move, it can keep\lusin’ that move in the field, even\lif it can’t in battle!

In other words, [green]yur Pokémon don’t
need to know the HM to use it[blue].

Ain’t that convenient!

Anyways, use that HM for [green]Cut[blue] to get
rid of that pesky tree blocking\l[green]Valley Cave[blue].

Then head on up to [green]Blizzard City[blue] to
get [green]Rock Smash[blue] from my friend.

Best of luck on yur quest!"
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Ya don’t know what an HM is? Hoooo weeee! Well, an [color-green-1]HM[color-blue-2], or Hidden Machine, is a special type of move a Pokémon can learn to bypass obstacles. When a Pokémon learns an HM, as long as it takes a [color-green-3]single step[color-blue-4] knowin’ that move, it can keep usin’ that move in the field, even if it can’t in battle! In other words, [color-green-5]yur Pokémon don’t need to know the HM to use it[color-blue-6]. Ain’t that convenient! Anyways, use that HM for [color-green-7]Cut[color-blue-8] to get rid of that pesky tree blocking [color-green-9]Valley Cave[color-blue-10]. Then head on up to [color-green-11]Blizzard City[color-blue-12] to get [color-green-13]Rock Smash[color-blue-14] from my friend. Best of luck on yur quest!
entries.translated:
Cosa? Non sai cos{B4}è una MN? Hooo
wee! Beh, una [green]MN[blue], o Macchina\lNascosta, è un tipo speciale di

mossa che un Pokémon può imparare
per superare gli ostacoli. Quando\lun Pokémon impara una MN, finché fa

un [green]singolo passo[blue] conoscendo quella
mossa, può continuare a usare\lquella mossa sul campo, anche se

non può in battaglia! In altre
parole, [green]i tuoi Pokémon non hanno\lbisogno di conoscere la MN per

usarla[blue]. Comodo, no? Comunque, usa
quella MN per [green]Taglio[blue] per\lsbarazzarti di quel fastidioso

albero che blocca la [green]Grotta della
Valle[blue]. Poi dirigiti verso [green]Città\lBufera[blue] per ottenere [green]Spaccaroccia[blue]

dal mio amico. Buona fortuna per la
tua missione!

entries.original:
"ÚÚ
As proof of your victory at the
Crater Town Gym, take the\l[green]Darkness Badge[blue]."
entries.translation_source: ÚÚ As proof of your victory at the Crater Town Gym, take the [color-green-1]Darkness Badge[color-blue-2].
entries.translated: ÚÚ A prova della tua vittoria alla Palestra di Crater Town, prendi la [green]Darkness Badge[blue].

entries.original:
"Come on\.

I really need your help.
Please\."
entries.translation_source: Come on[game-token-1] I really need your help. Please[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Avanti\. Ho davvero bisogno del tuo
aiuto. Per favore\.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Houndoom!

Zeph gave you to me to fulfill one
purpose!

Incinerate this old fool!"
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Houndoom! Zeph gave you to me to fulfill one purpose! Incinerate this old fool!
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Houndoom! Zeph ti ha
affidato a me per un solo scopo!\lIncenerisci questo vecchio sciocco!

entries.original:
"Wife: [red]NOOOOOO!

You killed him you vile scum!"
entries.translation_source: Wife: [color-red-1]NOOOOOO! You killed him you vile scum!
entries.translated:
Moglie: [red]NNOOOOO! Lo hai ucciso,
lurida feccia!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Incinerate her also,
Houndoom.

We have no more use for her."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Incinerate her also, Houndoom. We have no more use for her.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Inceneriscila anche tu,
Houndoom. Non abbiamo più bisogno\ldi lei.

entries.original:
"Have you ever been in the SES
Expressway?

It’s an undergound highway that
goes all around Borrius.

It a real backpacker’s paradise!"
entries.translation_source: Have you ever been in the SES Expressway? It’s an undergound highway that goes all around Borrius. It a real backpacker’s paradise!
entries.translated:
Sei mai stato nella SES Expressway?
È un{B4}autostrada sotterranea che\lgira tutt{B4}intorno a Borrius. È un

vero paradiso per chi viaggia con
lo zaino in spalla!

entries.original:
"I heard that there’s someone in
Tarmigan Town that teaches the art\lof Mega Evolution!"
entries.translation_source: I heard that there’s someone in Tarmigan Town that teaches the art of Mega Evolution!
entries.translated:
Ho sentito che a Tarmigan Town c{B4}è
qualcuno che insegna l{B4}arte della\lMegaevoluzione!

entries.original:
"Did you come up here to obtain the
power of [green]Mega Evolution[blue] from\l[green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]?

Most people who come here are
usually after it.

All this town has to offer
otherwise, is horrific nightmares."
entries.translation_source: Did you come up here to obtain the power of [color-green-1]Mega Evolution[color-blue-2] from [color-green-3]Tarmigan Mansion[color-blue-4]? Most people who come here are usually after it. All this town has to offer otherwise, is horrific nightmares.
entries.translated:
Sei salito quassù per ottenere il
potere della [green]Mega Evoluzione[blue] da\l[green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]? La maggior parte

di chi viene qui è di solito alla
sua ricerca. Tutto quello che\lquesta città ha da offrire,

altrimenti, sono incubi orribili.

entries.original:
"Hi [player]!

I can show you your Pokémon’s
specific EVs and IVs if you want."
entries.translation_source: Hi [player-name-1]! I can show you your Pokémon’s specific EVs and IVs if you want.
entries.translated:
Ciao [player]! Posso mostrarti gli
EV e gli IV specifici dei tuoi\lPokémon, se vuoi.

entries.original:
"Feel free to come back and see them
any time."
entries.translation_source: Feel free to come back and see them any time.
entries.translated: Torna pure a trovarli quando vuoi.

entries.original:
"Well if you change your mind let me
know.

I’ll be happy to show you."
entries.translation_source: Well if you change your mind let me know. I’ll be happy to show you.
entries.translated:
Beh, se cambi idea fammi sapere.
Sarò felice di mostrartelo.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]At long last, the final
piece of the puzzle is ours."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]At long last, the final piece of the puzzle is ours.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Finalmente, l{B4}ultimo pezzo
del puzzle è nostro.

entries.original:
"[blue]One with thunder, one with
lightning.

A fierce storm.

A world paralyzed.

Heed my call!

Zapdos!

Sankren thoron!

I command you!

Come forth from the stormy clouds
in which you dwell!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]One with thunder, one with lightning. A fierce storm. A world paralyzed. Heed my call! Zapdos! Sankren thoron! I command you! Come forth from the stormy clouds in which you dwell!
entries.translated:
[blue]Uno col tuono, uno con il fulmine.
Una tempesta feroce. Un mondo\lparalizzato. Ascolta la mia

chiamata! Zapdos! Sankren thoron!
Ti ordino io! Vieni fuori dalle\lnuvole tempestose in cui dimori!

entries.original: "[blue]Now, Zapdos, you will become\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Now, Zapdos, you will become[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [blue]Ora, Zapdos, tu diventerai\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]It just disintigrated
him\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]It just disintigrated him[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Si è semplicemente
disintegrato\.

entries.original:
"[blue]All remaining grunts and Shadow
Warriors, restrain Zapdos!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]All remaining grunts and Shadow Warriors, restrain Zapdos!
entries.translated:
[blue]Tutti i reclute e i Guerrieri Ombra
rimasti, trattenete Zapdos!

entries.original: "[blue]They were wiped out by Discharge\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]They were wiped out by Discharge[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [blue]Sono stati annientati da Scarica\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Well, Zapdos, you leave me no
choice\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Well, Zapdos, you leave me no choice[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [blue]Ebbene, Zapdos, non mi lasci scelta\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Heh\.
Nice try, Zapdos.

But I don’t fall as easily as the
grunts."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Heh[game-token-2] Nice try, Zapdos. But I don’t fall as easily as the grunts.
entries.translated:
[blue]Eheh\. Bel tentativo, Zapdos. Ma non
cado così facilmente come le\lreclute.

entries.original: "[blue]Krookodile! Use Stone Edge!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Krookodile! Use Stone Edge!
entries.translated: [blue]Krookodile! Usa Pietrataglio!

entries.original: "A critical hit!"
entries.translation_source: A critical hit!
entries.translated: Colpo critico!

entries.original:
"[blue]Now, Zapdos, it’s time for you to
become mine."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Now, Zapdos, it’s time for you to become mine.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ora, Zapdos, è tempo che tu diventi
mio.

entries.original:
"[blue]That took a lot longer than
expected."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]That took a lot longer than expected.
entries.translated: [blue]Ci ha messo molto più del previsto.

entries.original:
"[blue]It’s finally time to head to the
[green]Ruins of Void[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]It’s finally time to head to the [color-green-2]Ruins of Void[color-blue-3][game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[blue]È finalmente ora di dirigersi verso
le [green]Rovine del Vuoto[blue]\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I had countless guards stationed to
prevent you from showing up!

I even had the stairs destroyed!

How did you manage to get past all
of it\.?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I had countless guards stationed to prevent you from showing up! I even had the stairs destroyed! How did you manage to get past all of it[game-token-2]?
entries.translated:
[blue]Avevo schierato innumerevoli
guardie per impedire che ti\lpresentassi! Ho perfino fatto

distruggere le scale! Come hai
fatto a superare tutto questo\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Eh, It doesn’t matter anymore.
We’ve already won.

Zapdos now belongs to me.

And with this new power, I’ll
finally succeed in wiping you out!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Eh, It doesn’t matter anymore. We’ve already won. Zapdos now belongs to me. And with this new power, I’ll finally succeed in wiping you out!
entries.translated:
[blue]Eh, non importa più. Abbiamo già
vinto. Zapdos ora appartiene a me.\lE con questo nuovo potere, riuscirò

finalmente ad annientarvi!

entries.original:
"It doesn’t matter if I lose here.
We’ve already won."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t matter if I lose here. We’ve already won.
entries.translated: Non importa se perdo qui. Abbiamo già vinto.

entries.original: "Stop! How’d you get past the guard?"
entries.translation_source: Stop! How’d you get past the guard?
entries.translated: Fermo! Come hai fatto a superare la guardia?

entries.original: "I’m guessing the guard failed."
entries.translation_source: I’m guessing the guard failed.
entries.translated: Immagino che la guardia abbia fallito.

entries.original:
"I can only imagine the horrors
Zeph will instill on him\."
entries.translation_source: I can only imagine the horrors Zeph will instill on him[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Posso solo immaginare gli orrori
che Zeph gli infliggerà\.

entries.original:
"There is only one way to free the
Pokémon.

But I’m not telling you what it is!"
entries.translation_source: There is only one way to free the Pokémon. But I’m not telling you what it is!
entries.translated:
C{B4}è un solo modo per liberare i
Pokémon. Ma non vi dirò qual è!

entries.original:
"One of us has a key to release
the Pokémon.

But I’m not telling you who has it."
entries.translation_source: One of us has a key to release the Pokémon. But I’m not telling you who has it.
entries.translated:
Uno di noi ha una chiave per
liberare i Pokémon. Ma non ti dirò\lchi ce l{B4}ha.

entries.original:
"I’ve blown up the stairs so nothing
can interrupt the procedure."
entries.translation_source: I’ve blown up the stairs so nothing can interrupt the procedure.
entries.translated:
Ho fatto saltare le scale, così
nessuno può interrompere la\lprocedura.

entries.original:
"I have the key to free the
Pokémon!

But you’re not getting it!"
entries.translation_source: I have the key to free the Pokémon! But you’re not getting it!
entries.translated:
Ho la chiave per liberare i
Pokémon! Ma non la avrai mai!

entries.original: "Here, just take it!"
entries.translation_source: Here, just take it!
entries.translated: Tieni, prendilo e basta!

entries.original:
"The other grunts are gonna kill
me\."
entries.translation_source: The other grunts are gonna kill me[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Le altre reclute mi uccideranno\.

entries.original:
"There appear to be some Pokémon
sealed behind an electric barrier."
entries.translation_source: There appear to be some Pokémon sealed behind an electric barrier.
entries.translated:
Sembra che alcuni Pokémon siano
sigillati dietro una barriera\lelettrica.

entries.original:
"Would you like to disengage the
barrier and free them?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to disengage the barrier and free them?
entries.translated:
Vuoi disattivare la barriera e
liberarli?

entries.original: "[player] disengaged the barrier!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] disengaged the barrier!
entries.translated:
[player] ha disattivato la
barriera!

entries.original:
"The captive Pokémon have escaped
back into the wild."
entries.translation_source: The captive Pokémon have escaped back into the wild.
entries.translated:
I Pokémon catturati sono tornati in
libertà.

entries.original:
"You never cease to impress me,
[player].

But take a word of advice: don’t
follow me.

If you keep your head out of other
people’s business, you won’t get\lhurt.

It’s better to stay safe than to
try to play the hero\."
entries.translation_source: You never cease to impress me, [player-name-1]. But take a word of advice: don’t follow me. If you keep your head out of other people’s business, you won’t get hurt. It’s better to stay safe than to try to play the hero[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Non smetti mai di stupirmi,
[player]. Ma prendimi un consiglio:\lnon seguirmi. Se tieni il naso

fuori dagli affari degli altri, non
ti farai male. Meglio stare al\lsicuro che cercare di fare l{B4}eroe\.

entries.original:
"[player]!

What are you doing here?

Are you trying to complete your
Pokédex?

\.

So you’re trying to get Rock Smash
in order to stop The Shadows\.

Well while you’ve been running
around playing hero, I’ve gotten\lmuch more powerful.

You don’t even stand a chance
against me any more.

In fact, I’ll demonstrate my might,
here and now!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! What are you doing here? Are you trying to complete your Pokédex? [game-token-2] So you’re trying to get Rock Smash in order to stop The Shadows[game-token-3] Well while you’ve been running around playing hero, I’ve gotten much more powerful. You don’t even stand a chance against me any more. In fact, I’ll demonstrate my might, here and now!
entries.translated:
[player]! Che ci fai qui? Stai
cercando di completare il Pokédex? \.\lQuindi stai cercando di ottenere

Spaccaroccia per fermare The
Shadows\. Ebbene, mentre tu andavi in\lgiro a fare l{B4}eroe, io sono

diventato molto più potente. Ormai
non hai più alcuna possibilità\lcontro di me. Anzi, dimostrerò la

mia forza, qui e ora!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]And just in case [rival] is
following me\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]And just in case [text-token-rival-2] is following me[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]E nel caso [rival] mi
stesse seguendo\.

entries.original:
"[red]As for you, [player], I’m not going
to kill you yet.

You need to be made into an example
for anyone who is foolish enough to\lbelieve that they can take on The\lShadows.

I’m going to do what both Marlon
and Zeph have failed to do.

It’s time to meet your end in
battle!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]As for you, [player-name-2], I’m not going to kill you yet. You need to be made into an example for anyone who is foolish enough to believe that they can take on The Shadows. I’m going to do what both Marlon and Zeph have failed to do. It’s time to meet your end in battle!
entries.translated:
[red]Per quanto riguarda te, [player],
non ti ucciderò ancora. Devi\ldiventare un esempio per chiunque

sia abbastanza sciocco da credere
di poter affrontare gli Shadows.\lFarò ciò che sia Marlon che Zeph

non sono riusciti a fare. È tempo
di trovare la tua fine in\lbattaglia!

entries.original: "This is disappointing."
entries.translation_source: This is disappointing.
entries.translated: È deludente.

entries.original:
"[red]\.

I may have failed as well, but
we’re not done here, yet!

Houndoom!

I want [buffer1] ashes to stain the floor
black!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1][game-token-2] I may have failed as well, but we’re not done here, yet! Houndoom! I want [buffer1-3] ashes to stain the floor black!
entries.translated:
[red]\. Potrei aver fallito anch{B4}io, ma
non abbiamo ancora finito qui!\lHoundoom! Voglio che le ceneri di

[buffer1] macchino di nero il
pavimento!

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Houndoom!

Do it now, before [buffer2] gets
away again!"
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Houndoom! Do it now, before [buffer2-2] gets away again!
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Houndoom! Fallo ora, prima
che [buffer2] scappi di nuovo!

entries.original:
"Actually, that guy over there is my
only friend now\."
entries.translation_source: Actually, that guy over there is my only friend now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
In realtà, quel tizio laggiù è il
mio unico amico ormai\.

entries.original:
"Do you know what frustrates me the
most about this?

The police won’t even do anything
about them, because they refuse to\lbelieve me that some shadowy\lorganization even exists!

They still treat me like a kid,
despite what I’ve accomplished\.

Argh\."
entries.translation_source: Do you know what frustrates me the most about this? The police won’t even do anything about them, because they refuse to believe me that some shadowy organization even exists! They still treat me like a kid, despite what I’ve accomplished[game-token-1] Argh[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Sai cosa mi dà più fastidio di
tutta questa storia? La polizia non\lfa nemmeno niente contro di loro,

perché rifiuta di credere che
esista persino un{B4}organizzazione\lnell{B4}ombra! Mi trattano ancora come

un ragazzino, nonostante quello che
ho realizzato\. Argh\.

entries.original:
"Wait\.

I remember now\.

There is someone I can contact for
help after all\."
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1] I remember now[game-token-2] There is someone I can contact for help after all[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Aspetta\. Ricordo ora\. C{B4}è qualcuno
che posso contattare per aiuto,\ldopotutto\.

entries.original:
"While I’m doing that, you should be
heading to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]

The move [green]Strength[blue] is needed to go
anywhere inside, so you’ll need to\lbeat the [green]Fallshore Gym[blue] first.

I think I saw the Gym Leader
standing around in [green]Tehl Town[blue],\lactually\.

I’ll catch up with you again after
you rescue [green]Zapdos[blue]."
entries.translation_source: While I’m doing that, you should be heading to [color-green-1]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-2] The move [color-green-3]Strength[color-blue-4] is needed to go anywhere inside, so you’ll need to beat the [color-green-5]Fallshore Gym[color-blue-6] first. I think I saw the Gym Leader standing around in [color-green-7]Tehl Town[color-blue-8], actually[game-token-9] I’ll catch up with you again after you rescue [color-green-10]Zapdos[color-blue-11].
entries.translated:
Mentre faccio questo, dovresti
dirigerti verso [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] La\lmossa [green]Forza[blue] è necessaria per andare

ovunque all{B4}interno, quindi dovrai
battere il [green]Fallshore Gym[blue] prima.\lPenso di aver visto il Capopalestra

in giro per [green]Tehl Town[blue], in realtà\. Ti
raggiungerò di nuovo dopo che avrai\lsalvato [green]Zapdos[blue].

entries.original: "Let’s go, Starapator!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s go, Starapator!
entries.translated: Andiamo, Starapator!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon were very hard to
find.

They do not often appear in the
wild around here."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon were very hard to find. They do not often appear in the wild around here.
entries.translated: I miei Pokémon erano molto difficili da trovare. Non appaiono spesso qui in natura.

entries.original:
"It seems rarity does not indicate
exceptional strength."
entries.translation_source: It seems rarity does not indicate exceptional strength.
entries.translated: Sembra che la rarità non indichi una forza eccezionale.

entries.original:
"My dream is to one day team up with
a Fighting-type trainer.

We will be called\.
\qoBrains & Brawn\qc."
entries.translation_source: My dream is to one day team up with a Fighting-type trainer. We will be called[game-token-1] [quote-open-2]Brains & Brawn[quote-close-3].
entries.translated:
Il mio sogno è un giorno fare
squadra con un Allenatore di tipo\lLotta. Ci chiameremo\. \qoCervello e

Muscoli\qc.

entries.original:
"Notice the cliffs here\.

This is only place in West Borrius
where they’re this vertical!"
entries.translation_source: Notice the cliffs here[game-token-1] This is only place in West Borrius where they’re this vertical!
entries.translated: Nota le scogliere qui\. Questo è l{B4}unico posto nel West Borrius in cui sono così a picco!

entries.original: "All the more fun to climb!"
entries.translation_source: All the more fun to climb!
entries.translated: Ancora più divertente da scalare!

entries.original:
"When I climb down the bluffs, I
find very interesting things hidden\lin the seashells on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: When I climb down the bluffs, I find very interesting things hidden in the seashells on the beach!
entries.translated:
Quando scendo dalle scogliere,
trovo cose molto interessanti\lnascoste nelle conchiglie sulla

spiaggia!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon and I have been
running across Borrius.

We can take a kid Trainer like you!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon and I have been running across Borrius. We can take a kid Trainer like you!
entries.translated: Io e il mio Pokémon abbiamo corso in lungo e in largo per Borrius. Possiamo battere un giovane Allenatore come te!

entries.original:
"I guess we need to run less and
train more\."
entries.translation_source: I guess we need to run less and train more[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Immagino che dobbiamo correre meno e allenarci di più\.

entries.original:
"Huff\.Puff\.

Jogging and battling make a tiring
combo!"
entries.translation_source: Huff[game-token-1]Puff[game-token-2] Jogging and battling make a tiring combo!
entries.translated:
Uff\.Puff\. Fare jogging e lottare è
una combo stancante!

entries.original:
"I trained my Zangoose and Seviper
to play together nicely!"
entries.translation_source: I trained my Zangoose and Seviper to play together nicely!
entries.translated:
Ho allenato il mio Zangoose e il
mio Seviper a giocare bene insieme!

entries.original:
"I know there are bug Pokémon
around here!

One day I saw a huge [green]swarm[blue] of them
flying around!"
entries.translation_source: I know there are bug Pokémon around here! One day I saw a huge [color-green-1]swarm[color-blue-2] of them flying around!
entries.translated:
So che qui intorno ci sono Pokémon
Coleottero! Un giorno ne ho visto\lun enorme [green]sciame[blue] volare in giro!

entries.original:
"The more I run, the closer my
babies get to me!"
entries.translation_source: The more I run, the closer my babies get to me!
entries.translated: Più corro, più i miei piccoli si avvicinano a me!

entries.original:
"Wah!

Now they’re not as close anymore!"
entries.translation_source: Wah! Now they’re not as close anymore!
entries.translated: Ah! Adesso non sono più così vicini!

entries.original:
"Thank you again for helping me
before!

My family and I had a great two day
feast because of your help.

Now it’s time to prepare for next
year’s feast!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you again for helping me before! My family and I had a great two day feast because of your help. Now it’s time to prepare for next year’s feast!
entries.translated:
Grazie ancora per avermi aiutato
prima! La mia famiglia e io abbiamo\lfatto un grande banchetto di due

giorni grazie al tuo aiuto. Ora è
il momento di preparare il\lbanchetto dell{B4}anno prossimo!

entries.original:
"Cinder Volcano is dangerous.

If you don’t have your Pokémon to
protect you, you could die."
entries.translation_source: Cinder Volcano is dangerous. If you don’t have your Pokémon to protect you, you could die.
entries.translated:
Cinder Volcano è pericoloso. Se non
hai i tuoi Pokémon a proteggerti,\lpotresti morire.

entries.original:
"Never mind\.

You have enough."
entries.translation_source: Never mind[game-token-1] You have enough.
entries.translated:
Lascia perdere\. Ne hai già
abbastanza.

entries.original:
"One day my babies will use a
powerful Return and beat you up\lfor what you did to them!"
entries.translation_source: One day my babies will use a powerful Return and beat you up for what you did to them!
entries.translated:
Un giorno i miei piccoli useranno
una potente mossa Ritorno e ti\lfaranno pagare per quello che hai

fatto loro!

entries.original:
"Well, well, well\.
If it isn’t [player]!

The boss told me not to let you
into Thundercap Mountain, so you\lcan’t interfere with our plans.

Even if I did let you in, you’d be
toast without the power of Mega\lEvolution.

So don’t you see?

You should stay out here for your
own good."
entries.translation_source: Well, well, well[game-token-1] If it isn’t [player-name-2]! The boss told me not to let you into Thundercap Mountain, so you can’t interfere with our plans. Even if I did let you in, you’d be toast without the power of Mega Evolution. So don’t you see? You should stay out here for your own good.
entries.translated:
Beh, beh, beh\. Se non è [player]! Il
capo mi ha detto di non farti\lentrare in Monte Thundercap, così

non potrai interferire con i nostri
piani. Anche se ti lasciassi\lentrare, saresti spacciato senza il

potere della Megaevoluzione. Non lo
capisci? Faresti bene a restare qui\lfuori per il tuo bene.

entries.original:
"As per our arrangement, for
defeating me, take this Mega Ring."
entries.translation_source: As per our arrangement, for defeating me, take this Mega Ring.
entries.translated:
Come da accordi, per avermi
battuto, prendi questo Megacerchio.

entries.original:
"[player] received the Mega Ring from
Successor Maxima!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received the Mega Ring from Successor Maxima!
entries.translated:
[player] ha ricevuto il Megacerchio
da Successora Maxima!

entries.original:
"[player] put the Mega Ring in the
Key Items Sector."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] put the Mega Ring in the Key Items Sector.
entries.translated:
[player] ha messo il Megacerchio
nel Settore Strumenti Chiave.

entries.original:
"Oh, one last thing.

Take this Mega Stone for the
Pokémon, Lucario, from me."
entries.translation_source: Oh, one last thing. Take this Mega Stone for the Pokémon, Lucario, from me.
entries.translated:
Oh, un{B4}ultima cosa. Prendi questa
Megapietra per il Pokémon, Lucario,\lda parte mia.

entries.original:
"Sorry, it doesn’t look like you
have any space for my gift."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, it doesn’t look like you have any space for my gift.
entries.translated:
Scusa, sembra che tu non abbia
spazio per il mio regalo.

entries.original:
"I’m glad I caught up to you.

I just destroyed Successor Maxima.

Let me guess, you’ve also claimed
the power of Mega Evolution?"
entries.translation_source: I’m glad I caught up to you. I just destroyed Successor Maxima. Let me guess, you’ve also claimed the power of Mega Evolution?
entries.translated:
Sono contento di averti raggiunto.
Ho appena distrutto Successor\lMaxima. Fammi indovinare, hai

reclamato anche tu il potere della
Megaevoluzione?

entries.original:
"Of course you did, [player].

I’d expect nothing less from the
[buffer1] who beat me all those times.

Now, let’s see if you can still
beat me!"
entries.translation_source: Of course you did, [player-name-1]. I’d expect nothing less from the [buffer1-2] who beat me all those times. Now, let’s see if you can still beat me!
entries.translated:
Certo che sì, [player]. Non mi
aspettavo niente di meno da\l[buffer1] che mi ha battuto tutte

quelle volte. Ora vediamo se riesci
ancora a battermi!

entries.original:
"What are you saying, [player]?

I can clearly see that Mega Ring on
your finger!

Is it, maybe, you don’t know how
to use Mega Evolution?

Well, first you’ve gotta be able to
battle like this!"
entries.translation_source: What are you saying, [player-name-1]? I can clearly see that Mega Ring on your finger! Is it, maybe, you don’t know how to use Mega Evolution? Well, first you’ve gotta be able to battle like this!
entries.translated:
Cosa stai dicendo, [player]? Vedo
benissimo quel MegaCerchio sul tuo\ldito! Forse è che non sai come

usare la Mega Evoluzione? Beh,
prima devi essere in grado di\llottare così!

entries.original:
"That’s what I’d expect from a
wielder of Mega Evolution!"
entries.translation_source: That’s what I’d expect from a wielder of Mega Evolution!
entries.translated: È proprio quello che mi aspetto da chi usa la Megaevoluzione!

entries.original:
"Nice job, [player].

For defeating me yet again, I want
you to take this."
entries.translation_source: Nice job, [player-name-1]. For defeating me yet again, I want you to take this.
entries.translated:
Bel lavoro, [player]. Per avermi
sconfitto ancora una volta, voglio\lche tu prenda questo.

entries.original:
"That old fart Log caught up with
me a while back.

He gave that to me, and said that I
should give it to you the next time\lwe crossed paths.

He gave me my own also, but he
knows I would’ve wrecked him if\lhe hadn’t\."
entries.translation_source: That old fart Log caught up with me a while back. He gave that to me, and said that I should give it to you the next time we crossed paths. He gave me my own also, but he knows I would’ve wrecked him if he hadn’t[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Quel vecchio rincitrullito di Log
mi ha raggiunto un po{B4} di tempo fa.\lMi ha dato questo, e ha detto che

avrei dovuto dartelo la prossima
volta che ci saremmo incrociati. Ha\ldato anche uno a me, ma sapeva che

l{B4}avrei massacrato se non l{B4}avesse\.

entries.original:
"So, where are you going next,
[player]?

\.

Dehara City, huh?
I’m headed there too.

Log mentioned a guy over there who
knows how to cross water.

As you know, I’ve been looking for
my parents, and my research is\ltelling me that The Shadows were\linvolved in their disappearance.

I managed to track The Shadows to
the Ruins of Void, but I can’t get\lthere on foot or by flight yet.

If you need a way to ride the
waves too, you should find [green]Dehara\lCity’s surfing guy[blue].

See you later, [player]."
entries.translation_source: So, where are you going next, [player-name-1]? [game-token-2] Dehara City, huh? I’m headed there too. Log mentioned a guy over there who knows how to cross water. As you know, I’ve been looking for my parents, and my research is telling me that The Shadows were involved in their disappearance. I managed to track The Shadows to the Ruins of Void, but I can’t get there on foot or by flight yet. If you need a way to ride the waves too, you should find [color-green-3]Dehara City’s surfing guy[color-blue-4]. See you later, [player-name-5].
entries.translated:
Allora, dove vai adesso, [player]? \.
Dehara City, eh? Anche io sono\ldiretto lì. Log ha parlato di un

tipo laggiù che sa come
attraversare l{B4}acqua. Come sai, sto\lcercando i miei genitori, e le mie

ricerche mi dicono che The Shadows
sono coinvolti nella loro\lscomparsa. Sono riuscito a seguire

The Shadows fino alle Rovine del
Vuoto, ma non posso arrivarci a\lpiedi o in volo ancora. Se anche tu

hai bisogno di un modo per
cavalcare le onde, dovresti trovare\l[green]il tipo del surf di Dehara City[blue]. Ci

vediamo dopo, [player].

entries.original:
"Go make some more space in your Cube
for this Mega Stone."
entries.translation_source: Go make some more space in your Cube for this Mega Stone.
entries.translated:
Vai a fare un po{B4} di spazio nel tuo
Cube per questa Megapietra.

entries.original:
"Did you make space in your Cube
for the Mega Stone?"
entries.translation_source: Did you make space in your Cube for the Mega Stone?
entries.translated:
Hai fatto spazio nel tuo Cube per
la Megapietra?

entries.original:
"My Malamar’s [green]Suction Cups[blue] ability
helps me reel in Pokémon!

At least, I think it has Suction
Cups\."
entries.translation_source: My Malamar’s [color-green-1]Suction Cups[color-blue-2] ability helps me reel in Pokémon! At least, I think it has Suction Cups[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
L{B4}abilità [green]Ventose[blue] del mio Malamar
mi aiuta ad attirare i Pokémon!\lAlmeno, credo che abbia Ventose\.

entries.original: "It’s a seashell."
entries.translation_source: It’s a seashell.
entries.translated: È una conchiglia.

entries.original: "[blue]Derrrr!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Derrrr!
entries.translated: [blue]Derrrr!

entries.original:
"Sorry, kid!

A fight between some Zangoose and
Seviper took out the bridge.

It’ll take some time before we get
it fixed.

You should talk to our boss about
finding an alternative way to\lSeaport City in the meantime."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, kid! A fight between some Zangoose and Seviper took out the bridge. It’ll take some time before we get it fixed. You should talk to our boss about finding an alternative way to Seaport City in the meantime.
entries.translated:
Scusa, ragazzino! Una lotta tra
alcuni Zangoose e Seviper ha\ldistrutto il ponte. Ci vorrà un po{B4}

prima che lo ripariamo. Dovresti
parlare con il nostro capo per\ltrovare un percorso alternativo per

Seaport City nel frattempo.

entries.original:
"Oh, geez\.
Another trainer\.

Well, here you go."
entries.translation_source: Oh, geez[game-token-1] Another trainer[game-token-2] Well, here you go.
entries.translated:
Accidenti\. Un altro Allenatore\. Ecco,
tieni pure.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]It’s finally time for Zeph
to finish what he started.

He now has all three legendary
birds in his possesion.

All that’s left is for me to join
him at the Ruins of Void.

So why do I feel so much dread?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]It’s finally time for Zeph to finish what he started. He now has all three legendary birds in his possesion. All that’s left is for me to join him at the Ruins of Void. So why do I feel so much dread?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]È finalmente arrivato il
momento per Zeph di portare a\ltermine ciò che ha iniziato. Ora

possiede tutti e tre gli uccelli
leggendari. Non mi resta che\lraggiungerlo alle Rovine del Vuoto.

Allora perché provo tutto questo
terrore?

entries.original:
"[blue]No\.

I shouldn’t be feeling this way\.

Everything we’ve worked for is 
about to transpire.

I’ll even be able to see my son
again\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]No[game-token-2] I shouldn’t be feeling this way[game-token-3] Everything we’ve worked for is about to transpire. I’ll even be able to see my son again[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[blue]No\. Non dovrei sentirmi così\. Tutto
quello per cui abbiamo lavorato sta\lper realizzarsi. Riuscirò persino a

rivedere mio figlio\.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Sorry, old man.

If you’re getting cold feet now,
you could be a big problem down\lthe road.

I can’t have anything standing in
the way of the unbinding.

Your son will just have to be
fatherless forever."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Sorry, old man. If you’re getting cold feet now, you could be a big problem down the road. I can’t have anything standing in the way of the unbinding. Your son will just have to be fatherless forever.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Spiacente, vecchio. Se adesso
ti stai tirando indietro, potresti\ldiventare un grosso problema in

futuro. Non posso permettere che
qualcosa ostacoli lo scioglimento.\lTuo figlio dovrà semplicemente

restare senza padre per sempre.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]What is this, Hoopa?

I asked you to summon me a powerful
Pokémon capable of flying us to\lthe Ruins of Void, and this is what\lyou give me?

Pathetic!

This Pokémon is just so\.so\.
so nebby!

A poor excuse for a legendary
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]What is this, Hoopa? I asked you to summon me a powerful Pokémon capable of flying us to the Ruins of Void, and this is what you give me? Pathetic! This Pokémon is just so[game-token-2]so[game-token-3] so nebby! A poor excuse for a legendary Pokémon.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Che cos{B4}è questa roba, Hoopa?
Ti ho chiesto di evocarmi un\lPokémon potente capace di portarci

alle Rovine del Vuoto, e questo è
quello che mi dai? Patetico! Questo\lPokémon è proprio così\.così\. così

nebby! Una povera scusa per un
Pokémon leggendario.

entries.original:
"[blue]Stay in the bag, you useless
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Stay in the bag, you useless Pokémon.
entries.translated:
[blue]Rimani nella sacca, inutile
Pokémon.

entries.original:
"[blue]I guess we have no choice but to
leave it here, Hoopa.

Maybe some lucky trainer will find
it and decide to train the useless\lthing."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I guess we have no choice but to leave it here, Hoopa. Maybe some lucky trainer will find it and decide to train the useless thing.
entries.translated:
[blue]Immagino che non abbiamo scelta se
non lasciarlo qui, Hoopa. Forse\lqualche allenatore fortunato lo

troverà e deciderà di allenare quel
coso inutile.

entries.original:
"[blue]We don’t have any more time to
waste, Hoopa.

I know I didn’t want to go this
way, but I need you to send me\lthrough one of your rings to\lthe Ruins of Void.

I’ll go ahead, and since you can’t
travel through your own rings\lwithout a tether, latch onto my\lCube’s signal once I arrive there.

Just try to make it inconspicuous,
please.

I can’t have Zeph catching on to
our plan.

Don’t take too long, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]We don’t have any more time to waste, Hoopa. I know I didn’t want to go this way, but I need you to send me through one of your rings to the Ruins of Void. I’ll go ahead, and since you can’t travel through your own rings without a tether, latch onto my Cube’s signal once I arrive there. Just try to make it inconspicuous, please. I can’t have Zeph catching on to our plan. Don’t take too long, Hoopa.
entries.translated:
[blue]Non abbiamo più tempo da perdere,
Hoopa. So che non volevo andare in\lquesta direzione, ma ho bisogno che

tu mi mandi attraverso uno dei tuoi
anelli alle Rovine del Vuoto. Andrò\lavanti, e dato che non puoi

viaggiare attraverso i tuoi stessi
anelli senza un legame, agganciati\lal segnale del mio Cubo una volta

che arrivo lì. Cerca di farlo in
modo discreto, per favore. Non\lposso permettere che Zeph scopra il

nostro piano. Non ci mettere
troppo, Hoopa.

entries.original: "[green]Hoop!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoop!
entries.translated: [green]Evvai!

entries.original:
"There appears to be a Pokémon in
the bag.

Would you like to take it?"
entries.translation_source: There appears to be a Pokémon in the bag. Would you like to take it?
entries.translated:
Sembra che nella borsa ci sia un
Pokémon. Vuoi prenderlo?

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough space for
this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough space for this Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Non hai abbastanza spazio per
questo Pokémon.

entries.original: "You found a [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: You found a [buffer1-1]!
entries.translated: Hai trovato un [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"This mountain pass has a very
unique layout.

It descends slowly, but then dips
suddenly!"
entries.translation_source: This mountain pass has a very unique layout. It descends slowly, but then dips suddenly!
entries.translated:
Questo valico di montagna ha una
disposizione davvero unica. Scende\llentamente, ma poi precipita

all{B4}improvviso!

entries.original:
"Some man in a red hood was pushed
into the ocean.

He hasn’t resurfaced yet, either\."
entries.translation_source: Some man in a red hood was pushed into the ocean. He hasn’t resurfaced yet, either[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Un uomo con un cappuccio rosso è
stato spinto in mare. Non è ancora\lriemerso, neanche\.

entries.original:
"I could’ve sworn that that
Pokémon from the legends floated\lthrough here just now\."
entries.translation_source: I could’ve sworn that that Pokémon from the legends floated through here just now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Avrei giurato che quel Pokémon
delle leggende sia appena passato\ldi qui\.

entries.original:
"Passing through this gate can
either get you to Dehara City or\lRoute 12."
entries.translation_source: Passing through this gate can either get you to Dehara City or Route 12.
entries.translated:
Attraversare questo cancello può
portarti a Città di Dehara oppure\lal Percorso 12.

entries.original:
"Would you happen to be [player] by
any chance?

\.

I thought so.

I recognized you from this picture
I found of you, on the interwebs.

My name is Looker.

Agent Looker, of the International
Police.

I had just finished dealing with
Team Rocket in the Kanto Region,\lwhen I was deployed to deal with a\lsituation that was brewing in the\lBorrius Region.

A young man, Jax, I believe, has
informed me that you have some\levidence for crimes committed by an\lorganization calling themselves\l\qoThe Shadows\qc.

Please meet me in the [green]Dehara Game
Corner [blue]so we can discuss further.

Jax is there, as well.

Looker, out."
entries.translation_source: Would you happen to be [player-name-1] by any chance? [game-token-2] I thought so. I recognized you from this picture I found of you, on the interwebs. My name is Looker. Agent Looker, of the International Police. I had just finished dealing with Team Rocket in the Kanto Region, when I was deployed to deal with a situation that was brewing in the Borrius Region. A young man, Jax, I believe, has informed me that you have some evidence for crimes committed by an organization calling themselves [quote-open-3]The Shadows[quote-close-4]. Please meet me in the [color-green-5]Dehara Game Corner [color-blue-6]so we can discuss further. Jax is there, as well. Looker, out.
entries.translated:
Per caso saresti [player]? \. Lo
immaginavo. Ti ho riconosciuto da\lquesta foto che ho trovato di te

sull{B4}internet. Il mio nome è
Looker. Agente Looker, della\lPolizia Internazionale. Avevo

appena finito di occuparmi del Team
Rocket nella Regione di Kanto,\lquando sono stato inviato per

gestire una situazione che si stava
sviluppando nella Regione di\lBorrius. Un giovane, Jax, credo, mi

ha informato che hai delle prove
per crimini commessi da\lun{B4}organizzazione che si chiama \qoLe

Ombre\qc. Per favore, incontrami al
[green]Dehara Game Corner [blue]così possiamo\ldiscutere ulteriormente. Anche Jax

è lì. Looker, chiudo.

entries.original:
"He’s too engrossed in his slot game
to hear you from behind.

Maybe try yelling in his ear?"
entries.translation_source: He’s too engrossed in his slot game to hear you from behind. Maybe try yelling in his ear?
entries.translated:
È troppo preso dal suo gioco alle
slot per sentirti da dietro. Prova\la urlargli nell{B4}orecchio?

entries.original:
"He appears to be deeply engrossed
in a slot game."
entries.translation_source: He appears to be deeply engrossed in a slot game.
entries.translated:
Sembra profondamente assorto in un
gioco alle slot.

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Jax!
The game finally cashed out!

I just won big!"
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]Jax! The game finally cashed out! I just won big!
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Jax! Il gioco ha finalmente
pagato! Ho appena vinto un sacco!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Just now, Mr. Looker?
I cashed out ages ago!

I’ve already won it big several
times!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Just now, Mr. Looker? I cashed out ages ago! I’ve already won it big several times!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Proprio adesso, signor Looker?
Ho incassato secoli fa! Ho già\lvinto alla grande parecchie volte!

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh! [player]!

You came just in time!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oh! [player-name-2]! You came just in time!
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh! [player]! Sei arrivato proprio
in tempo!

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Ah, it is you, [player].
Sorry, I did not see you, there.

I was too wrapped up in trying to
win this slot game.

You know, there is actually a Game
Corner just like this in Kanto.

Except there it was a cover for
Team Rocket\.

Anyway, thank you for meeting me.

Let us all go outside, where it is
quieter, to discuss."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]Ah, it is you, [player-name-2]. Sorry, I did not see you, there. I was too wrapped up in trying to win this slot game. You know, there is actually a Game Corner just like this in Kanto. Except there it was a cover for Team Rocket[game-token-3] Anyway, thank you for meeting me. Let us all go outside, where it is quieter, to discuss.
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Ah, sei tu, [player].
Scusa, non ti avevo visto, lì. Ero\ltroppo preso a cercare di vincere a

questo gioco delle slot. Sai, in
realtà c{B4}è un Game Corner proprio\lcome questo a Kanto. Solo che lì

era una copertura per il Team
Rocket\. Comunque, grazie per avermi\lincontrato. Andiamo tutti fuori,

dove è più tranquillo, a
discuterne.

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Alright, [player].

Now that we are outside, tell me
everything that transpired,\lstarting from the beginning.

\.

\.

Hmm\.

With these facts, there is clear
evidence that The Shadows wish to\lrelease the dark force and cause\lchaos in Borrius.

Now, if only there were some way we
could reach the Ruins of Void\lquickly so we could stop them\."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]Alright, [player-name-2]. Now that we are outside, tell me everything that transpired, starting from the beginning. [game-token-3] [game-token-4] Hmm[game-token-5] With these facts, there is clear evidence that The Shadows wish to release the dark force and cause chaos in Borrius. Now, if only there were some way we could reach the Ruins of Void quickly so we could stop them[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]Va bene, [player]. Ora che
siamo fuori, raccontami tutto ciò\lche è successo, cominciando

dall{B4}inizio. \. \. Hmm\. Con questi
fatti, ci sono prove evidenti che\lThe Shadows vogliono rilasciare la

forza oscura e causare caos a
Borrius. Ora, se solo ci fosse un\lmodo per raggiungere le Rovine del

Vuoto rapidamente così da fermarli\.

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]What’s going on?

[player]!
Look out!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]What’s going on? [player-name-2]! Look out!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Che succede? [player]!
Attento!

entries.original: "Jax: [blue][player]!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue][player]!

entries.original:
"It is the Ruins of Void!

And those\.

Those are Shadow Grunts!"
entries.translation_source: It is the Ruins of Void! And those[game-token-1] Those are Shadow Grunts!
entries.translated:
Sono le Rovine del Vuoto! E quelli\.
Quelli sono le reclute Ombra!

entries.original:
"Are you alright?

This strange ring appeared beneath
you, back in Dehara City.

I was afraid something bad was
about to happen, so I grabbed onto\lyour shirt before you were\lteleported away.

But it looks like Looker didn’t
have the same idea\."
entries.translation_source: Are you alright? This strange ring appeared beneath you, back in Dehara City. I was afraid something bad was about to happen, so I grabbed onto your shirt before you were teleported away. But it looks like Looker didn’t have the same idea[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Stai bene? Questo strano anello è
apparso sotto di te, a Dehara City.\lAvevo paura che stesse per

succedere qualcosa di brutto, così
ti ho afferrato la maglietta prima\lche fossi teletrasportato via. Ma a

quanto pare Looker non ha avuto la
stessa idea\.

entries.original:
"Where are we, anyways?

Could this be\.
the Ruins of Void?"
entries.translation_source: Where are we, anyways? Could this be[game-token-1] the Ruins of Void?
entries.translated:
Dove siamo, comunque? Potrebbero
essere\. le Rovine del Vuoto?

entries.original:
"???: [blue]This is where we make our
stand, men.

For the sake of the unbinding, they
must not be allowed up here.

Execute Light of Ruin order number
sixty-five!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]This is where we make our stand, men. For the sake of the unbinding, they must not be allowed up here. Execute Light of Ruin order number sixty-five!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Qui faremo la nostra
resistenza, uomini. Per il bene\ldella liberazione, non devono

essere autorizzati a salire qui.
Eseguite l{B4}ordine numero\lsessantacinque di Luce della

Rovina!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]Staraptor!

Take out those Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Staraptor! Take out those Shadows!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue]Staraptor! Elimina quelle
Ombre!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue]STARAPTOR!

NOOOOOO!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]STARAPTOR! NOOOOOO!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]STARAPTOR! NOOOOOO!

entries.original:
"[blue]They just destroyed our only way
up, along with my Staraptor\.

Sniff\.

No.

I can’t focus on that right now.

I need to stay strong."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]They just destroyed our only way up, along with my Staraptor[game-token-2] Sniff[game-token-3] No. I can’t focus on that right now. I need to stay strong.
entries.translated:
[blue]Hanno appena distrutto la nostra
unica via di salita, insieme al mio\lStaraptor\. Sniff\. No. Non posso

concentrarmi su questo adesso. Devo
restare forte.

entries.original:
"[blue]It looks like an entrance to the
ruins was uncovered by the blast."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]It looks like an entrance to the ruins was uncovered by the blast.
entries.translated:
[blue]Sembra che un ingresso alle rovine
sia stato portato alla luce\ldall{B4}esplosione.

entries.original:
"[blue]You should go in and try to find
another way up to the top.

I would come along, but Staraptor
was the only Pokémon I had on me.

I’d just wear you down if you had
to protect me from wild Pokémon.

Instead, I’ll wait here and take
care of healing for you."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You should go in and try to find another way up to the top. I would come along, but Staraptor was the only Pokémon I had on me. I’d just wear you down if you had to protect me from wild Pokémon. Instead, I’ll wait here and take care of healing for you.
entries.translated:
[blue]Dovresti entrare e provare a
trovare un altro modo per salire in\lcima. Verrei anch{B4}io, ma Staraptor

era l{B4}unico Pokémon che avevo con
me. Finirei solo per stremarti se\ldovessi proteggermi dai Pokémon

selvatici. Invece, aspetterò qui e
mi occuperò di curarti.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh, and if you find Staraptor,
please, bring him back to me."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oh, and if you find Staraptor, please, bring him back to me.
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh, e se trovi Staraptor, per
favore, riportamelo.

entries.original:
"It’s an ancient switch.
Would you like to flip it?"
entries.translation_source: It’s an ancient switch. Would you like to flip it?
entries.translated:
È un antico interruttore. Vuoi
azionarlo?

entries.original:
"It’s an ancient switch.
Would you like to flip it?"
entries.translation_source: It’s an ancient switch. Would you like to flip it?
entries.translated:
È un antico interruttore. Vuoi
azionarlo?

entries.translated:
DIMOSTRA IL TUO VALORE AL GUARDIANO
DELLE ROVINE, SE DESIDERI PASSARE!

entries.translation_source: YOU HAVE PROVEN YOUR WORTH.
entries.translated: HAI DIMOSTRATO IL TUO VALORE.

entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [color-blue-1]Uh oh.
entries.translated: Recluta 1: [blue]Oh, oh.

"Grunt 2: [blue]Sir, [player] is attempting
to make [buffer1] way up here by coming\lthrough the ruins!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 2: [color-blue-1]Sir, [player-name-2] is attempting to make [buffer1-3] way up here by coming through the ruins!
entries.translated:
Grunt 2: [blue]Signore, [player] sta
cercando di farsi [buffer1] strada\lfin quassù passando attraverso le

rovine!

entries.original:
"???: [blue]It doesn’t matter.

By the time [player] gets up here,
Zeph will be ready for the\lunbinding.

However, I still need you two to
stall [player] as much as possible."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]It doesn’t matter. By the time [player-name-2] gets up here, Zeph will be ready for the unbinding. However, I still need you two to stall [player-name-3] as much as possible.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Non importa. Quando [player]
arriverà quassù, Zeph sarà pronto\lper la liberazione. Tuttavia, ho

ancora bisogno che voi due
tratteniate [player] il più\lpossibile.

"???: [blue]If I didn’t need you, Hoopa,
I’d throw your Poké Ball into the\locean for all of the\linconveniencies you’ve caused me!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]If I didn’t need you, Hoopa, I’d throw your Poké Ball into the ocean for all of the inconveniencies you’ve caused me!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Se non avessi bisogno di te,
Hoopa, lancerei la tua Poké Ball\lnell{B4}oceano per tutti gli

inconvenienti che mi hai causato!

"Grunt 1: [blue]I’ve got a bad feeling
about that Claydol\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [color-blue-1]I’ve got a bad feeling about that Claydol[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Recluta 1: [blue]Ho una brutta sensazione
riguardo a quel Claydol\.

entries.original: "Grunt 2: [blue]What the\.?"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 2: [color-blue-1]What the[game-token-2]?
entries.translated: Recluta 2: [blue]Che diavolo\.?

entries.original:
"Grunt 1: [blue]We’ve got nothing to
prove!

We’re The Shadows!

Let’s take it down!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [color-blue-1]We’ve got nothing to prove! We’re The Shadows! Let’s take it down!
entries.translated:
Sgherro 1: [blue]Non abbiamo niente da
dimostrare! Siamo The Shadows!\lButtiamolo giù!

entries.original: "Grunts: [blue]Groan\."
entries.translation_source: Grunts: [color-blue-1]Groan[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Reclute: [blue]Ugh\.

"[blue]YOU HAVE FAILED TO PROVE YOUR
WORTH!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]YOU HAVE FAILED TO PROVE YOUR WORTH!
entries.translated: [blue]NON HAI DIMOSTRATO IL TUO VALORE!

"DEFEAT THE GUARDIANS OF THE PORTAL

entries.translated:
SCONFIGGI I GUARDIANI DEL PORTALE
SE VUOI PROSEGUIRE!

entries.original:
"You gaze into the portal\.

\.

Pokémon are attempting to cross
through from the other side!

Are you ready to face them?

Be aware, once the battles begin,
there will be no chance to recover."
entries.translation_source: You gaze into the portal[game-token-1] [game-token-2] Pokémon are attempting to cross through from the other side! Are you ready to face them? Be aware, once the battles begin, there will be no chance to recover.
entries.translated:
Fissi il portale\. \. Dei Pokémon
stanno cercando di attraversarlo\ldall{B4}altro lato! Sei pronto ad

affrontarli? Tieni presente che,
una volta iniziate le lotte, non ci\lsarà alcuna possibilità di

recuperare.

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] ran back into the
portal."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] ran back into the portal.
entries.translated:
Il [buffer1] è rientrato nel
portale.

entries.original:
"Another Pokémon is making its way
through the portal!"
entries.translation_source: Another Pokémon is making its way through the portal!
entries.translated:
Un altro Pokémon si sta facendo
strada attraverso il portale!

entries.original: "YOU HAVE PROVEN YOURSELF!"
entries.translation_source: YOU HAVE PROVEN YOURSELF!
entries.translated: HAI DIMOSTRATO IL TUO VALORE!

entries.original:
"It’s a mysterious portal.

Where could it lead?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a mysterious portal. Where could it lead?
entries.translated:
È un portale misterioso. Dove
potrebbe condurre?

entries.original: "It’s Jax’s Staraptor."
entries.translation_source: It’s Jax’s Staraptor.
entries.translated: È lo Staraptor di Jax.

entries.original: "Jax: [blue][player]!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue][player]!

entries.original:
"[blue]Thank you for finding my Staraptor!

I was able to heal him in time, so
it looks like he’ll be alright.

Great job, by the way, on getting
this far.

It looks like we’re almost at the
top.

One more floor up, and we’ll be
able to stop The Shadows.

I’ll leave you to it, then.

If you need healing, I’ll be
waiting by the side entrance on\lthis floor of the ruins."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Thank you for finding my Staraptor! I was able to heal him in time, so it looks like he’ll be alright. Great job, by the way, on getting this far. It looks like we’re almost at the top. One more floor up, and we’ll be able to stop The Shadows. I’ll leave you to it, then. If you need healing, I’ll be waiting by the side entrance on this floor of the ruins.
entries.translated:
[blue]Grazie per aver trovato il mio
Staraptor! Sono riuscito a curarlo\lin tempo, quindi sembra che starà

bene. Ottimo lavoro, tra l{B4}altro,
per essere arrivato fin qui. Sembra\lche siamo quasi in cima. Un piano

ancora più su, e riusciremo a
fermare The Shadows. Ti lascio\lfare, allora. Se hai bisogno di

cure, ti aspetterò all{B4}ingresso
laterale su questo piano delle\lrovine.

entries.original:
"Grunt 1: [blue]That Claydol may have
temporarily incapacitated us, but\lwe’re still not going to let you\lthrough without a fight!

The unbinding must not be
disrupted!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [color-blue-1]That Claydol may have temporarily incapacitated us, but we’re still not going to let you through without a fight! The unbinding must not be disrupted!
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [blue]Quel Claydol può averci
temporaneamente messo fuori\lcombattimento, ma non ti lasceremo

comunque passare senza combattere!
La liberazione non deve essere\linterrotta!

entries.original:
"Grunt 2: [blue]We’re not done here, yet!

It’s my turn to take you down!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 2: [color-blue-1]We’re not done here, yet! It’s my turn to take you down!
entries.translated:
Scagnozzo 2: [blue]Non abbiamo ancora
finito qui! Tocca a me farti fuori!

entries.original: "Jax: [blue]Wait!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1]Wait!
entries.translated: Jax: [blue]Aspetta!

entries.original:
"Jax: [blue][player] has more important
things to do, than deal with you.

If you want to take someone on, why
don’t you try me on for size!"
entries.translation_source: Jax: [color-blue-1][player-name-2] has more important things to do, than deal with you. If you want to take someone on, why don’t you try me on for size!
entries.translated:
Jax: [blue][player] ha cose più
importanti da fare che occuparsi di\lte. Se vuoi prendere qualcuno di

mira, perché non provi con me?

entries.original:
"[blue][player]!

I’ll take care of these goons.

You go stop The Shadows from
carrying out their \qounbinding\qc.

We’re counting on you."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]! I’ll take care of these goons. You go stop The Shadows from carrying out their [quote-open-3]unbinding[quote-close-4]. We’re counting on you.
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Mi occupo io di questi
manigoldi. Vai a fermare The\lShadows dal portare a termine la

loro \qoliberazione\qc. Contiamo su di
te.

entries.original:
"Once we take care of you, we’re
going to finish [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Once we take care of you, we’re going to finish [player-name-1]!
entries.translated:
Una volta sistemato te, finiremo
[player]!

entries.original: "Need healing, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: Need healing, [player-name-1]?
entries.translated: Hai bisogno di cure, [player]?

entries.original:
"Okay, you’re all set, [player].

I’ll be here if you need to heal
again."
entries.translation_source: Okay, you’re all set, [player-name-1]. I’ll be here if you need to heal again.
entries.translated:
Va bene, sei a posto, [player].
Sarò qui se avrai bisogno di\lcurarti di nuovo.

entries.original:
"[player]!

I’m trying to battle these grunts,
but I can heal you quickly!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! I’m trying to battle these grunts, but I can heal you quickly!
entries.translated:
[player]! Sto cercando di
combattere questi sgherri, ma posso\lcurarti in fretta!

entries.original: "Grunt 1: [red]Some people never learn\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [color-red-1]Some people never learn[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Grunt 1: [red]C{B4}è chi non impara mai\.

entries.original:
"Grunt 2: [blue]Get moving, kid.
You’re going to want to see this\."
entries.translation_source: Grunt 2: [color-blue-1]Get moving, kid. You’re going to want to see this[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Grunt 2: [blue]Muoviti, ragazzo. Vorrai
vedere questo\.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]All preparations have been
completed, Zeph.

You can proceed with the unbinding
when ready."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]All preparations have been completed, Zeph. You can proceed with the unbinding when ready.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Tutti i preparativi sono
stati completati, Zeph. Puoi\lprocedere con lo scioglimento

quando sei pronto.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Thank you, Ivory.

Just one more thing before I am
ready to begin.

Where is Marlon?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Thank you, Ivory. Just one more thing before I am ready to begin. Where is Marlon?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Grazie, Ivory. Solo un{B4}ultima
cosa prima che io sia pronto a\lcominciare. Dov{B4}è Marlon?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]I’m sorry, Zeph, but I’m not
sure where he is.

He confirmed that he was on his way
here a while ago, but I haven’t\lheard from him since."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]I’m sorry, Zeph, but I’m not sure where he is. He confirmed that he was on his way here a while ago, but I haven’t heard from him since.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Mi dispiace, Zeph, ma non
sono sicura di dov{B4}è. Mi aveva\lconfermato che stava arrivando qui

un po{B4} di tempo fa, ma da allora
non ho più avuto sue notizie.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Hmm\.

He has been rather on edge
lately\.

I hope he hasn’t gotten cold
feet\.

It would be a shame for him to miss
what we’ve worked so hard for."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Hmm[game-token-2] He has been rather on edge lately[game-token-3] I hope he hasn’t gotten cold feet[game-token-4] It would be a shame for him to miss what we’ve worked so hard for.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Mmh\. È stato piuttosto teso
ultimamente\. Spero che non si sia\ltirato indietro\. Sarebbe un peccato

se si perdesse ciò per cui abbiamo
lavorato così duramente.

entries.original:
"[blue]Either way, with or without him, I
am now ready to begin."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Either way, with or without him, I am now ready to begin.
entries.translated:
[blue]In ogni caso, con o senza di lui,
ora sono pronto a iniziare.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]The time has come to make my
dream a reality.

Once the dark force is unbound, I
will use it to undo the tragedies\lof all those years ago\.

Then, finally, I will be able to
see his smile once again\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]The time has come to make my dream a reality. Once the dark force is unbound, I will use it to undo the tragedies of all those years ago[game-token-2] Then, finally, I will be able to see his smile once again[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]È giunto il momento di
rendere reale il mio sogno. Una\lvolta che la forza oscura sarà

liberata, la userò per annullare le
tragedie di tanti anni fa\. E allora,\lfinalmente, potrò rivedere ancora

una volta il suo sorriso\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Zapdos!

Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Zapdos! Come forth!
entries.translated: [blue]Zapdos! Vieni fuori!

entries.original:
"[blue]Moltres!

Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Moltres! Come forth!
entries.translated: [blue]Moltres! Vieni fuori!

entries.original:
"[blue]Articuno!

Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Articuno! Come forth!
entries.translated: [blue]Articuno! Vieni fuori!

entries.original:
"[blue]With these three legendary bird
Pokémon assembled here alongside\lthe Void Stone, the seal can\lbe broken."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]With these three legendary bird Pokémon assembled here alongside the Void Stone, the seal can be broken.
entries.translated:
[blue]Con questi tre Pokémon uccello
leggendari riuniti qui insieme alla\lVoid Stone, il sigillo può essere

spezzato.

entries.original:
"[blue]One with the shadows, and one with
the night.

A dark hole.

A ring of fury.

A force encapsulated.

Let that be no longer!

What was once sealed is now free!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]One with the shadows, and one with the night. A dark hole. A ring of fury. A force encapsulated. Let that be no longer! What was once sealed is now free!
