entries.translated:
[blue]Uno con le ombre, e uno con la
notte. Un buco oscuro. Un anello di\lfuria. Una forza racchiusa. Che non

sia più così! Ciò che un tempo era
sigillato è ora libero!

entries.original:
"[blue]The bottle is now free.

Once I open it, the dark force will
be mine to command."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]The bottle is now free. Once I open it, the dark force will be mine to command.
entries.translated:
[blue]La bottiglia è ora libera. Una
volta che la apro, la forza oscura\lsarà al mio comando.

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh?
Why is nothing happening?

The bottle is open\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Huh? Why is nothing happening? The bottle is open[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Eh? Perché non succede nulla? La
bottiglia è aperta\.

entries.original: "???: [blue]Heh heh heh."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Heh heh heh.
entries.translated: ???: [blue]Eh eh eh.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Who do you think you are!?

And what have you done to the
unbinding!?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Who do you think you are!? And what have you done to the unbinding!?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Chi credi di essere!? E che
cosa hai fatto al dissigillamento!?

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Who, me?

The name is Aklove.

I’m just a lowly grunt of The
Shadows."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Who, me? The name is Aklove. I’m just a lowly grunt of The Shadows.
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Io? Il nome è Aklove. Sono
solo un{B4}umile recluta di The\lShadows.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Answer my question, Grunt!

What have you done!?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Answer my question, Grunt! What have you done!?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Rispondi alla mia domanda,
recluta! Che cosa hai fatto!?

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]What have I done?

I have done nothing to interrupt
the unbinding.

In fact, I commend you on an almost
flawless execution.

However, there was one key
component you were missing."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]What have I done? I have done nothing to interrupt the unbinding. In fact, I commend you on an almost flawless execution. However, there was one key component you were missing.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Cosa ho fatto? Non ho fatto
nulla per interrompere lo\lscioglimento. Anzi, vi faccio i

complimenti per un{B4}esecuzione quasi
impeccabile. Tuttavia, c{B4}era un\lcomponente fondamentale che vi

mancava.

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]And what would that be?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]And what would that be?
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]E cosa sarebbe?

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]If you want to release the
power from the Prison Bottle, there\lneeds to be somewhere for that\lpower to go.

Or more specifically, you need the
Pokémon that used to be the dark\lforce, something you’re lacking.

Of course, you would know that had
I not erased that detail from your\lfiles.

Honestly, I knew it would be easy
to manipulate you if I infiltrated\lyour organization, but I didn’t\lthink it would be this easy!

You played right into my hands,
Zeph!

You unsealed the Prison Bottle
right in front of me!

And now I can use it to truly
finish the unbinding!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]If you want to release the power from the Prison Bottle, there needs to be somewhere for that power to go. Or more specifically, you need the Pokémon that used to be the dark force, something you’re lacking. Of course, you would know that had I not erased that detail from your files. Honestly, I knew it would be easy to manipulate you if I infiltrated your organization, but I didn’t think it would be this easy! You played right into my hands, Zeph! You unsealed the Prison Bottle right in front of me! And now I can use it to truly finish the unbinding!
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Se vuoi liberare il potere
dalla Prison Bottle, deve esserci\lun posto in cui quel potere possa

andare. O più specificamente, hai
bisogno del Pokémon che un tempo\lera la forza oscura, qualcosa che

ti manca. Naturalmente, lo sapresti
se non avessi cancellato quel\ldettaglio dai tuoi file.

Onestamente, sapevo che sarebbe
stato facile manipolarti se mi\lfossi infiltrato nella tua

organizzazione, ma non pensavo che
sarebbe stato così facile! Sei\lcaduto proprio nelle mie mani,

Zeph! Hai dissigillato la Prison
Bottle proprio davanti a me! E ora\lposso usarla per completare

veramente la liberazione!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Wha\.

How dare you make a fool of me!

You’ll pay for this!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Wha[game-token-2] How dare you make a fool of me! You’ll pay for this!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Cosa\. Come osi farmi fare la
figura dello sciocco! La pagherai!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Houndoom!

Incinerate this fool!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Houndoom! Incinerate this fool!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Houndoom! Incenerisci questo
idiota!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Hoopa!
Get rid of Houndoom!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Hoopa! Get rid of Houndoom!
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Hoopa! Liberati di
Houndoom!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]No way\.

My Houndoom\.

So then it was you who rescued
[player] all those times\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]No way[game-token-2] My Houndoom[game-token-3] So then it was you who rescued [player-name-4] all those times[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Niente affatto\. Il mio
Houndoom\. Quindi sei stato tu a\lsalvare [player] tutte quelle volte\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Actually, that was Hoopa
acting on its own accord.

It was desperate for someone to
rescue it from me.

It felt obligated to protect
[player] as [buffer2] is its true trainer.

I want nothing more than to see
[player] eliminated.

Once [buffer2]’s gone, Hoopa will finally
accept me as its true trainer\.

Only then will I be able to use
its full power, capable of moving\lentire land masses\."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Actually, that was Hoopa acting on its own accord. It was desperate for someone to rescue it from me. It felt obligated to protect [player-name-2] as [buffer2-3] is its true trainer. I want nothing more than to see [player-name-4] eliminated. Once [buffer2-5]’s gone, Hoopa will finally accept me as its true trainer[game-token-6] Only then will I be able to use its full power, capable of moving entire land masses[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]In realtà, è stato Hoopa ad
agire di sua spontanea volontà. Era\ldisperato per qualcuno che lo

salvasse da me. Si sentiva in
dovere di proteggere [player]\lpoiché [buffer2] è il suo vero

allenatore. Non voglio altro che
vedere [player] eliminato. Una\lvolta che [buffer2] se ne sarà

andato, Hoopa mi accetterà
finalmente come suo vero\lallenatore\\. Solo allora potrò usare

il suo pieno potere, capace di
muovere intere masse terrestri\\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]I concede\.

I stand no chance against a
Pokémon like that."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]I concede[game-token-2] I stand no chance against a Pokémon like that.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Mi arrendo\. Non ho alcuna
possibilità contro un Pokémon come\lquello.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]That’s a wise decision.

Now move out of my way!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]That’s a wise decision. Now move out of my way!
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]È una decisione saggia. Ora
scansati!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]I’m sorry, Ivory.

I wasn’t able to complete the
mission.

However, this isn’t the end.

We will still find a way to bring
them back\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]I’m sorry, Ivory. I wasn’t able to complete the mission. However, this isn’t the end. We will still find a way to bring them back[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Mi dispiace, Ivory. Non sono
riuscito a completare la missione.\lTuttavia, non è la fine. Troveremo

comunque un modo per riportarli
indietro\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]And now, let the main event
begin."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]And now, let the main event begin.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]E ora, che l{B4}evento
principale abbia inizio.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa, prepare yourself!

Your true power is about to be
released from the Prison Bottle!

And as your trainer, I am fully
capable of releasing it!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hoopa, prepare yourself! Your true power is about to be released from the Prison Bottle! And as your trainer, I am fully capable of releasing it!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hoopa, preparati! Il tuo vero
potere sta per essere liberato\ldalla Bottiglia Prigione! E come

tuo Allenatore, sono perfettamente
in grado di liberarlo!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]At last!

I’ve waited years for this moment!

Hoopa!

The seal on your power has finally
been broken!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]At last! I’ve waited years for this moment! Hoopa! The seal on your power has finally been broken!
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Finalmente! Ho aspettato
anni questo momento! Hoopa! Il\lsigillo sul tuo potere è stato

finalmente spezzato!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Aklove, tell me!

What is your reason for doing all
of this?

Perhaps if we have a common goal,
we can work together!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Aklove, tell me! What is your reason for doing all of this? Perhaps if we have a common goal, we can work together!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Aklove, dimmelo! Qual è il
tuo motivo per fare tutto questo?\lForse, se abbiamo un obiettivo

comune, possiamo lavorare insieme!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Fool.

We have no common goal.

I am a descendant of the king of
Kalos during the Great War.

My goal is simply to finish what he
started and destroy this region.

With this unbound Hoopa, I will
bring the Ultimate Weapon of Kalos\lhere and use it to turn Borrius\linto a region of death and\ldestruction!

Then, finally, his suffering will
be at its end\.

Now tell me, Zeph. What are your
goals?"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Fool. We have no common goal. I am a descendant of the king of Kalos during the Great War. My goal is simply to finish what he started and destroy this region. With this unbound Hoopa, I will bring the Ultimate Weapon of Kalos here and use it to turn Borrius into a region of death and destruction! Then, finally, his suffering will be at its end[game-token-2] Now tell me, Zeph. What are your goals?
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Stolto. Non abbiamo un
obiettivo comune. Sono un\ldiscendente del re di Kalos durante

la Grande Guerra. Il mio obiettivo
è semplicemente finire ciò che lui\lha iniziato e distruggere questa

regione. Con questo Hoopa Indomito,
porterò qui l{B4}Armata Finale di\lKalos e la userò per trasformare

Borrius in una regione di morte e
distruzione! Allora, finalmente, la\lsua sofferenza giungerà al termine\.

Ora dimmi, Zeph. Quali sono i tuoi
obiettivi?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]My goals?

I have but one goal.

To see those I cared about once
more."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]My goals? I have but one goal. To see those I cared about once more.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]I miei obiettivi? Ho un solo
obiettivo. Rivedere ancora una\lvolta coloro a cui tenevo.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]To use such a great power
for something like that\.

I never could’ve imagined anyone
would try that!

You are truly a strange one, Zeph."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]To use such a great power for something like that[game-token-2] I never could’ve imagined anyone would try that! You are truly a strange one, Zeph.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Usare un potere così grande
per una cosa del genere\. Non avrei\lmai immaginato che qualcuno ci

avrebbe provato! Sei davvero uno
strano tipo, Zeph.

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]I\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]I[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Io\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Enough!

Remove yourself from my presence.

The Shadows are finshed.

It’s time for Borrius to be
enveloped in The Light of Ruin.

But first\.

Grunts!

Bring [player] to me!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Enough! Remove yourself from my presence. The Shadows are finshed. It’s time for Borrius to be enveloped in The Light of Ruin. But first[game-token-2] Grunts! Bring [player-name-3] to me!
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Basta! Togliti dalla mia
presenza. Le Ombre sono finite. È\ltempo che Borrius sia avvolta dalla

Luce della Rovina. Ma prima\.
Reclute! Portatemi [player]!

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]My grunts\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]My grunts[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]I miei scagnozzi\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Are you really surprised
your grunts would join me?

You burn them alive if they disobey
you!

I promised them safety
from the coming storm if they\lworked for me instead."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Are you really surprised your grunts would join me? You burn them alive if they disobey you! I promised them safety from the coming storm if they worked for me instead.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Ti sorprende davvero che le
tue reclute si uniscano a me? Le\lbruci vive se ti disobbediscono! Ho

promesso loro salvezza dalla
tempesta in arrivo se invece\llavoravano per me.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Now, [player], it’s time you
were eliminated once and for all.

I’ve watched as you’ve been a
repeated nuisance to The Shadows.

I can’t have you becoming a
nuisance to me, as well."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Now, [player-name-2], it’s time you were eliminated once and for all. I’ve watched as you’ve been a repeated nuisance to The Shadows. I can’t have you becoming a nuisance to me, as well.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Ora, [player], è tempo che
tu venga eliminato una volta per\ltutte. Ti ho osservato mentre eri

una seccatura ricorrente per The
Shadows. Non posso permettere che\ltu diventi anche per me una

seccatura.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa!

Summon a Pokémon to eliminate
[player]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hoopa! Summon a Pokémon to eliminate [player-name-2]!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hoopa! Evoca un Pokémon per
eliminare [player]!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] flew back into the
portal."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] flew back into the portal.
entries.translated:
Il [buffer1] è tornato a volare nel
portale.

entries.original: "Aklove: [blue]Summon another, Hoopa!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Summon another, Hoopa!
entries.translated: Aklove: [blue]Evocane un altro, Hoopa!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Is that the best you’ve
got, Hoopa?"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Is that the best you’ve got, Hoopa?
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]È tutto qui quello che hai,
Hoopa?

entries.original:
"[blue]It’s over, [player].
I’ve had enough of this.

I’m going to have you incinerated.

My Hoopa won’t save you now."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]It’s over, [player-name-2]. I’ve had enough of this. I’m going to have you incinerated. My Hoopa won’t save you now.
entries.translated:
[blue]È finita, [player]. Ne ho
abbastanza di questa storia. Ti\lfarò incenerire. Il mio Hoopa non

ti salverà stavolta.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa!

Summon an incineration!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hoopa! Summon an incineration!
entries.translated: [blue]Hoopa! Evoca un incenerimento!

entries.original: "Aklove: [blue]Farewell, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Farewell, [player-name-2].
entries.translated: Aklove: [blue]Addio, [player].

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s you.

I guess your time was finally up
then, huh?

So tell me, how did you go?

\.

Incineration\.

That figures\.

Well, it’s still a better way than
drowning."
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s you. I guess your time was finally up then, huh? So tell me, how did you go? [game-token-1] Incineration[game-token-2] That figures[game-token-3] Well, it’s still a better way than drowning.
entries.translated:
Oh, sei tu. Immagino che il tuo
tempo fosse finalmente scaduto, eh?\lAllora dimmi, come è andata? \.

Incenerimento\. Immaginavo\. Beh, è
comunque un modo migliore che\lannegare.

entries.original:
"You must be wondering where we are,
am I right?

\.

I thought so.

I guess you could say this is what
people call the \qoJudgement Zone\qc.

It is here where the great creator
of the universe, Arceus himself,\lpasses judgement on those who have\lleft the world."
entries.translation_source: You must be wondering where we are, am I right? [game-token-1] I thought so. I guess you could say this is what people call the [quote-open-2]Judgement Zone[quote-close-3]. It is here where the great creator of the universe, Arceus himself, passes judgement on those who have left the world.
entries.translated:
Ti starai chiedendo dove siamo,
vero? \. Pensavo di sì. Direi che\lquesto è ciò che la gente chiama la

\qoJudgement Zone\qc. È qui che il
grande creatore dell{B4}universo,\lArceus in persona, giudica coloro

che hanno lasciato il mondo.

entries.original:
"I’ve heard that this place is
supposed to reflect your home.

\.

I don’t know what you see, but I
see the sea, everywhere I look.

The region I’m from\.

Well, as some would put it, it had
\qotoo much water\qc.

I think I may have stayed there
forever, had Zeph not convinced\lIvory and me to leave."
entries.translation_source: I’ve heard that this place is supposed to reflect your home. [game-token-1] I don’t know what you see, but I see the sea, everywhere I look. The region I’m from[game-token-2] Well, as some would put it, it had [quote-open-3]too much water[quote-close-4]. I think I may have stayed there forever, had Zeph not convinced Ivory and me to leave.
entries.translated:
Mi è stato detto che questo posto
dovrebbe riflettere casa tua. \. Non\lso cosa vedi tu, ma io vedo il

mare, ovunque guardi. La regione da
cui provengo \. Beh, come direbbero\lalcuni, aveva \qo fin troppa acqua\qc.

Credo che sarei potuto restare lì
per sempre, se Zeph non avesse\lconvinto Ivory e me ad andarcene.

entries.original:
"What do you see, [player]?

\.

Snow, huh?

Makes sense\.

Frozen Heights is the home your
father chose for you, after all."
entries.translation_source: What do you see, [player-name-1]? [game-token-2] Snow, huh? Makes sense[game-token-3] Frozen Heights is the home your father chose for you, after all.
entries.translated:
Cosa vedi, [player]? \. Neve, eh? Ha
senso\. Frozen Heights è la casa che\ltuo padre ha scelto per te,

dopotutto.

entries.original:
"You know, [player], I knew your
father well.

He was a good man.

I even had the pleasure of working
with him at one point\."
entries.translation_source: You know, [player-name-1], I knew your father well. He was a good man. I even had the pleasure of working with him at one point[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Sai, [player], conoscevo bene tuo
padre. Era un brav{B4}uomo. Ho avuto\lpersino il piacere di lavorare con

lui a un certo punto\.

entries.original:
"He used to say that even the
worst of men had the best of\lintent at some point in their\lcareer.

\.

His words echoed in my head until
the day I died."
entries.translation_source: He used to say that even the worst of men had the best of intent at some point in their career. [game-token-1] His words echoed in my head until the day I died.
entries.translated:
Diceva che persino il peggiore
degli uomini aveva avuto le\lmigliori intenzioni a un certo

punto della sua carriera. \., Le sue
parole riecheggiavano nella mia\ltesta fino al giorno in cui morii.

entries.original:
"I know you must have the impression
that I’m some sort of \qodespicable\lvillain\qc, but I can’t even begin to\ltell you how wrong that notion is.

It just seems that way because of
the things you’ve witnessed The\lShadows do."
entries.translation_source: I know you must have the impression that I’m some sort of [quote-open-1]despicable villain[quote-close-2], but I can’t even begin to tell you how wrong that notion is. It just seems that way because of the things you’ve witnessed The Shadows do.
entries.translated:
So che devi avere l{B4}impressione che
io sia una sorta di \qocattivo\lspregevole\qc, ma non posso nemmeno

iniziare a dirti quanto sia
sbagliata quella convinzione.\lSembra solo così a causa di ciò che

hai visto fare a The Shadows.

entries.original:
"We started out with good intent.

It was only some time later on when
things began to get out of hand.

When did it go all wrong\."
entries.translation_source: We started out with good intent. It was only some time later on when things began to get out of hand. When did it go all wrong[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Siamo partiti con buone intenzioni.
Solo più tardi le cose hanno\lcominciato a sfuggirci di mano.

Quando è andato tutto storto\.

entries.original: "It’s time, [player]."
entries.translation_source: It’s time, [player-name-1].
entries.translated: È il momento, [player].

entries.original: "MARLON. [player]."
entries.translation_source: MARLON. [player-name-1].
entries.translated: MARLON. [player].

entries.original:
"[black]Marlon: [blue]Arceus\.

The creator of the universe\."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Marlon: [color-blue-2]Arceus[game-token-3] The creator of the universe[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[black]Marlon: [blue]Arceus\. Il creatore
dell{B4}universo\.

entries.original:
"[black]Arceus: [blue]\.YES.

IT IS TIME FOR YOUR JUDGEMENT."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Arceus: [color-blue-2][game-token-3]YES. IT IS TIME FOR YOUR JUDGEMENT.
entries.translated: [black]Arceus: [blue]\.SÌ. È ORA DEL TUO GIUDIZIO.

entries.original:
"MARLON!

DABBLING IN THE FORBIDDEN ART.

RESSURECTION.

SIN.

YOU WILL BE RETURNED TO YOUR
WORLD, IMMORTAL UNTIL THE WORLD\lIS CLEANSED.

ONLY ONE OTHER HAS EVER ENDURED
THIS PUNISHMENT, AND TO THIS DAY\lHE STILL ROAMS THE WORLD, A\lTHOUSAND YEARS LATER!

RIGHT YOUR WRONGS!

FREE THOSE WHOSE SOULS HAVE BEEN
TRAPPED IN [green]CINDER VOLCANO[blue]!

BEFORE IT IS TOO LATE\.

THIS IS MY VERDICT!

BEGONE!"
entries.translation_source: MARLON! DABBLING IN THE FORBIDDEN ART. RESSURECTION. SIN. YOU WILL BE RETURNED TO YOUR WORLD, IMMORTAL UNTIL THE WORLD IS CLEANSED. ONLY ONE OTHER HAS EVER ENDURED THIS PUNISHMENT, AND TO THIS DAY HE STILL ROAMS THE WORLD, A THOUSAND YEARS LATER! RIGHT YOUR WRONGS! FREE THOSE WHOSE SOULS HAVE BEEN TRAPPED IN [color-green-1]CINDER VOLCANO[color-blue-2]! BEFORE IT IS TOO LATE[game-token-3] THIS IS MY VERDICT! BEGONE!
entries.translated:
MARLON! TRAFFICARE CON L{B4}ARTE
PROIBITA. RISURREZIONE. PECCATO.\lVERRETE RICONDOTTI NEL VOSTRO

MONDO, IMMORTALI FINCHÉ IL MONDO
NON SARÀ PURIFICATO. SOLO UN ALTRO\lHA MAI SOPPORTATO QUESTA PUNIZIONE,

E ANCORA OGGI, A DISTANZA DI MILLE
ANNI, VAGA ANCORA PER IL MONDO!\lRIMEDIATE AI VOSTRI ERRORI!

LIBERATE COLORO CUI LE ANIME SONO
STATE INTRAPPOLATE NEL [green]VULCANO\lDELLA CENERE[blue]! PRIMA CHE SIA TROPPO

TARDI\. QUESTA È LA MIA SENTENZA!
ANDATEVENE!

entries.original:
"[player]!

PREMATURE DEATH.

A CURSE ON YOUR SOUL.

FOR AROS, I SHALL RESTORE YOU TO
LIFE!

ONE CONDITION.

SUCCEED IN STOPPING THE ENDLESS
TORMENT OF SOULS, OR I WILL\lRETURN YOU TO ASH.

THIS IS MY VERDICT.

BEGONE!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! PREMATURE DEATH. A CURSE ON YOUR SOUL. FOR AROS, I SHALL RESTORE YOU TO LIFE! ONE CONDITION. SUCCEED IN STOPPING THE ENDLESS TORMENT OF SOULS, OR I WILL RETURN YOU TO ASH. THIS IS MY VERDICT. BEGONE!
entries.translated:
[player]! MORTE PREMATURA. UNA
MALEDIZIONE SULLA TUA ANIMA. PER\lAROS, TI RESTITUIRÒ ALLA VITA! UNA

CONDIZIONE. RIESCI A FERMARE
L{B4}ETERNO TORMENTO DELLE ANIME, O TI\lRIDURRÒ IN CENERE. QUESTO È IL MIO

VERDETTO. VATTENE!

entries.original:
"I don’t know who you are, but
you’re not getting past me like\lthat other guy did!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t know who you are, but you’re not getting past me like that other guy did!
entries.translated:
Non so chi tu sia, ma non passerai
da me come ha fatto quell{B4}altro!

entries.original:
"\.[player]?

But\.but\.but you’re supposed to
be dead!

How is this possible?

I need to warn the others!"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1][player-name-2]? But[game-token-3]but[game-token-4]but you’re supposed to be dead! How is this possible? I need to warn the others!
entries.translated:
\.[player]? Ma\.ma\.ma dovresti essere
morto! Com{B4}è possibile? Devo\lavvertire gli altri!

entries.original: "[red]No, no, no, no, no!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]No, no, no, no, no!
entries.translated: [red]No, no, no, no, no!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Véga!

How could you betray The Shadows!?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Véga! How could you betray The Shadows!?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Véga! Come hai potuto
tradire Le Ombre!?

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Marlon!?

Aklove told us he killed you!"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]Marlon!? Aklove told us he killed you!
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Marlon!? Aklove ci aveva
detto che ti aveva ucciso!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]I don’t care what this
\qoAklove\qc person told you!

What have you done with all of the
Shadow Warriors?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]I don’t care what this [quote-open-2]Aklove[quote-close-3] person told you! What have you done with all of the Shadow Warriors?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Non mi importa quello che
ti ha detto questa persona\l\qoAklove\qc! Che ne avete fatto di

tutti i Guerrieri Ombra?

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Don’t worry, Marlon.

They were moved to a more\.secure
location, long before you arrived."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]Don’t worry, Marlon. They were moved to a more[game-token-2]secure location, long before you arrived.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Non preoccuparti, Marlon.
Sono stati spostati in una\lposizione più\.sicura, molto prima

del tuo arrivo.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Tell me where they are,
Véga!

Or so help me I’ll have you turned
into one of them!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Tell me where they are, Véga! Or so help me I’ll have you turned into one of them!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Dimmi dove sono, Véga! O,
per tutto ciò che è sacro, ti farò\ltrasformare in uno di loro!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Do you think that you can
still order me around?

I’m no longer an undercover agent
of The Shadows.

Aklove had me promoted, and now I’m
an admin of the Light of Ruin!

And as of now, my first assignment
is virtually complete."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]Do you think that you can still order me around? I’m no longer an undercover agent of The Shadows. Aklove had me promoted, and now I’m an admin of the Light of Ruin! And as of now, my first assignment is virtually complete.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Pensi davvero di potermi
ancora comandare? Non sono più un\lagente sotto copertura di The

Shadows. Aklove mi ha promosso, e
ora sono un amministratore di Light\lof Ruin! E da ora, la mia prima

assegnazione è praticamente
completa.

entries.original:
"[blue]One of you!

Help me get rid of him!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]One of you! Help me get rid of him!
entries.translated:
[blue]Uno di voi! Aiutatemi a liberarmi
di lui!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]You’re going to wish you
stayed dead, Marlon!"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]You’re going to wish you stayed dead, Marlon!
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Avresti fatto meglio a
restare morto, Marlon!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [red]Sir!

[player] is still alive!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-red-1]Sir! [player-name-2] is still alive!
entries.translated:
Recluta: [red]Signore! [player] è ancora
vivo!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]I’m adept at dealing with
Dark-types, not Ghosts\."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]I’m adept at dealing with Dark-types, not Ghosts[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Sono abile a gestire i tipi
Buio, non i Fantasma\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]So you made it back too,
[player]\.

Quick, help me deal with these
\qoLight of Ruin\qc tools."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]So you made it back too, [player-name-2][game-token-3] Quick, help me deal with these [quote-open-4]Light of Ruin[quote-close-5] tools.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Quindi sei tornato anche
tu, [player]\. Svelto, aiutami a\loccuparmi di questi \qoattrezzi della

Luce della Rovina\qc.

entries.original: "How am I supposed to beat a ghost?"
entries.translation_source: How am I supposed to beat a ghost?
entries.translated: Come faccio a sconfiggere un fantasma?

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]All grunts, retreat back to
the base in [green]Vivill Town[blue]!

We’re not equipped to deal with
these\.zombies right now!"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]All grunts, retreat back to the base in [color-green-2]Vivill Town[color-blue-3]! We’re not equipped to deal with these[game-token-4]zombies right now!
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Tutti i reclute, ritiratevi
alla base a [green]Vivill Town[blue]! Non siamo\lattrezzati per affrontare

questi\.zombie adesso!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Oh no you don’t!

You’re not getting away yet!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Oh no you don’t! You’re not getting away yet!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Oh no che non vai da
nessuna parte! Non te ne andrai\lancora!

entries.original: "Véga: [blue]You can’t restrain me!"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]You can’t restrain me!
entries.translated: Véga: [blue]Non puoi trattenermi!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]There’s nowhere to run,
Véga.

One more step and you’ll be burned
alive.

So I suggest that if you want to
live, you’ll tell me where Aklove\lis keeping the Shadow Warriors."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]There’s nowhere to run, Véga. One more step and you’ll be burned alive. So I suggest that if you want to live, you’ll tell me where Aklove is keeping the Shadow Warriors.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Non c{B4}è nessuna via di
fuga, Véga. Un altro passo e\lbrucerai vivo. Quindi ti suggerisco

che, se vuoi vivere, mi dirai dove
Aklove sta tenendo i Guerrieri\lOmbra.

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Huh.

I guess I have no choice then.

\.

\.

Now if only he would hurry up\."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]Huh. I guess I have no choice then. [game-token-2] [game-token-3] Now if only he would hurry up[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Tsk. Credo di non avere
scelta allora. \. \. Adesso, se solo si\lsbrigasse\.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]What the\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]What the[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Che diavolo\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Did you see that?

He just disappeared into that
portal\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Did you see that? He just disappeared into that portal[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Hai visto? È appena scomparso
dentro quel portale\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Follow my lead, [player].

We’re going in after him."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Follow my lead, [player-name-2]. We’re going in after him.
entries.translated:
[blue]Seguimi, [player]. Entriamo dietro
di lui.

entries.original:
"[blue]On my count\.

3\.

2\.

1\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]On my count[game-token-2] 3[game-token-3] 2[game-token-4] 1[game-token-5]
entries.translated: [blue]Al mio conteggio\. 3\. 2\. 1\.

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]Oof!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Oof!
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Uff!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Heh, sorry, I just went to
get something from Aklove in Hoenn.

No need to be so violent, Marlon."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]Heh, sorry, I just went to get something from Aklove in Hoenn. No need to be so violent, Marlon.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Heh, scusa, sono appena
andato a prendere una cosa da\lAklove in Hoenn. Non c{B4}è bisogno di

essere così violento, Marlon.

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]You know, I heard an
interesting little tidbit of info\lfrom back when Aklove was a guard\lhere."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]You know, I heard an interesting little tidbit of info from back when Aklove was a guard here.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Sai, ho sentito una notizia
interessante da quando Aklove\lfaceva la guardia qui.

entries.original:
"[blue]Apparently, when Zeph was having
this cave dug out, the grunts\ldigging found the ancient Pokémon\lGroudon fast asleep beneath the\lmagma.

But instead of reporting it to
Zeph, they quickly covered it back\lup and proceeded to dig around it.

However, had they possesed the
correct object back then, maybe\lZeph never would have lost the\lupper hand."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Apparently, when Zeph was having this cave dug out, the grunts digging found the ancient Pokémon Groudon fast asleep beneath the magma. But instead of reporting it to Zeph, they quickly covered it back up and proceeded to dig around it. However, had they possesed the correct object back then, maybe Zeph never would have lost the upper hand.
entries.translated:
[blue]A quanto pare, quando Zeph stava
facendo scavare questa grotta, le\lreclute che scavavano trovarono

l{B4}antico Pokémon Groudon
addormentato profondamente sotto il\lmagma. Ma invece di riferirlo a

Zeph, lo ricoprirono in fretta e
continuarono a scavargli intorno.\lTuttavia, se all{B4}epoca avessero

posseduto l{B4}oggetto giusto, forse
Zeph non avrebbe mai perso il\lvantaggio.

entries.original:
"[blue]Groudon!

Respond to the Red Orb!

Awaken, and revert to your
primordial state!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Groudon! Respond to the Red Orb! Awaken, and revert to your primordial state!
entries.translated:
[blue]Groudon! Rispondi alla Sfera Rossa!
Risvegliati e ritorna al tuo stato\lprimordiale!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]What will you do, Marlon?

If you keep holding me here I’ll
die and your only source of info\lon the whereabouts of the Shadow\lWarriors will vanish in a puff of\lsmoke."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]What will you do, Marlon? If you keep holding me here I’ll die and your only source of info on the whereabouts of the Shadow Warriors will vanish in a puff of smoke.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Che farai, Marlon? Se
continui a tenermi qui morirò, e la\ltua unica fonte di informazioni

sulla posizione dei Guerrieri Ombra
svanirà in una nuvola di fumo.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Even if you die, Véga,
I’ll still know the location of\lyour base.

You ordered your grunts to retreat
to [green]Vivill Town[blue], did you not?

After I get Zeph from [green]Frozen
Heights[blue], I’ll head there to look\lfor the Shadow Warriors."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Even if you die, Véga, I’ll still know the location of your base. You ordered your grunts to retreat to [color-green-2]Vivill Town[color-blue-3], did you not? After I get Zeph from [color-green-4]Frozen Heights[color-blue-5], I’ll head there to look for the Shadow Warriors.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Anche se muori, Véga,
conoscerò comunque la posizione\ldella tua base. Hai ordinato ai

tuoi scagnozzi di ritirarsi a
[green]Vivill Town[blue], vero? Dopo che avrò\lpreso Zeph da [green]Frozen Heights[blue], andrò

lì a cercare i Shadow Warriors.

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Groudon!

Shake the earth!"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]Groudon! Shake the earth!
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Groudon! Fai tremare la
terra!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Can’t keep your footing,
Marlon?

In that case, until we meet again."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]Can’t keep your footing, Marlon? In that case, until we meet again.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Non riesci a stare in piedi,
Marlon? In tal caso, alla prossima.

entries.original:
"[blue][player], you need to prevent Groudon
from going on a rampage.

If you don’t, the cave will
collapse and we’ll be trapped in\lhere!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][player-name-2], you need to prevent Groudon from going on a rampage. If you don’t, the cave will collapse and we’ll be trapped in here!
entries.translated:
[blue][player], devi impedire a Groudon
di andare in escandescenze. Se non\llo fai, la caverna crollerà e

resteremo bloccati qui dentro!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] sunk into the lava and
fell into a deep slumber once more."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] sunk into the lava and fell into a deep slumber once more.
entries.translated:
Il [buffer1] sprofondò nella lava e
cadde di nuovo in un sonno\lprofondo.

entries.original:
"[blue]Not bad, [player].

I now realize why Arceus sent you
back as well.

However from here on out, I need to
do things alone.

If you come to our base in [green]Frozen
Heights [blue]too, Zeph will not agree to\lhelp me find the Shadow Warriors.

I’m grateful for your help, but
please, [player], don’t follow me to\l[green]our base in Frozen Heights[blue]."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Not bad, [player-name-2]. I now realize why Arceus sent you back as well. However from here on out, I need to do things alone. If you come to our base in [color-green-3]Frozen Heights [color-blue-4]too, Zeph will not agree to help me find the Shadow Warriors. I’m grateful for your help, but please, [player-name-5], don’t follow me to [color-green-6]our base in Frozen Heights[color-blue-7].
entries.translated:
[blue]Non male, [player]. Ora capisco
perché Arceus ha rimandato indietro\lanche te. Tuttavia, d{B4}ora in poi,

devo fare le cose da solo. Se vieni
alla nostra base a [green]Frozen Heights\l[blue]anche, Zeph non accetterà di

aiutarmi a trovare i Guerrieri
Ombra. Ti sono grato per il tuo\laiuto, ma per favore, [player], non

seguirmi a [green]la nostra base a Frozen
Heights[blue].

entries.original:
"It looks like someone left their
uniform on the floor.

Would you like to put it on?"
entries.translation_source: It looks like someone left their uniform on the floor. Would you like to put it on?
entries.translated:
Sembra che qualcuno abbia lasciato
la sua uniforme per terra. Vuoi\lindossarla?

entries.original: "You put on the clothes."
entries.translation_source: You put on the clothes.
entries.translated: Hai indossato i vestiti.

entries.original:
"Your clothes are on the ground.
Would you like to put them on?"
entries.translation_source: Your clothes are on the ground. Would you like to put them on?
entries.translated:
I tuoi vestiti sono a terra. Vuoi
indossarli?

entries.original:
"You put on the clothes and placed
Marlon’s uniform in the Cube."
entries.translation_source: You put on the clothes and placed Marlon’s uniform in the Cube.
entries.translated:
Hai indossato i vestiti e messo
l{B4}uniforme di Marlon nel Cubo.

entries.original:
"Marlon, sir!

I know what it looks like, but I
promise, I’m not slacking off!

Zeph told me to watch the news, and
keep an eye out for anyone who\llooks like they might belong to the\lLight of Ruin."
entries.translation_source: Marlon, sir! I know what it looks like, but I promise, I’m not slacking off! Zeph told me to watch the news, and keep an eye out for anyone who looks like they might belong to the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Marlon, signore! So come sembra, ma
ti assicuro che non sto\lbighellonando! Zeph mi ha detto di

guardare i notiziari, e tenere
d{B4}occhio chiunque sembri poter\lappartenere alla Luce della Rovina.

entries.original:
"With most of the other grunts gone,
our manpower has become very\llimited.

So it is essential that each of us
become as strong as possible.

Would you allow me the privilege of
battling with you, sir?"
entries.translation_source: With most of the other grunts gone, our manpower has become very limited. So it is essential that each of us become as strong as possible. Would you allow me the privilege of battling with you, sir?
entries.translated:
Con la maggior parte degli altri
scagnozzi andati via, il nostro\lpersonale è diventato molto

limitato. Quindi è essenziale che
ognuno di noi diventi il più forte\lpossibile. Mi concederebbe il

privilegio di affrontarla in lotta,
signore?

entries.original:
"Thank you for battling with me,
sir.

Now we are both more prepared for
the inevitable confrontation with\lthe Light of Ruin."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for battling with me, sir. Now we are both more prepared for the inevitable confrontation with the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Grazie per aver combattuto con me,
signore. Ora siamo entrambi più\lpreparati per l{B4}inevitabile scontro

con la Luce della Rovina.

entries.original:
"Of course, sir.

I wouldn’t expect you to waste your
time on a grunt, such as myself."
entries.translation_source: Of course, sir. I wouldn’t expect you to waste your time on a grunt, such as myself.
entries.translated:
Certamente, signore. Non mi
aspetterei che lei perda tempo con\luna recluta come me.

entries.original:
"The base has been so quiet ever
since most of the grunts pledged\lthe allegiances to the Light of\lRuin.

To be honest, sir, I was asked to
join too, but I refused.

I would have told you about the
betrayal, but they threatened to\lkill my family if I said anything.

I’m sorry sir, but I couldn’t
sacrifice my family.

You get that, right?"
entries.translation_source: The base has been so quiet ever since most of the grunts pledged the allegiances to the Light of Ruin. To be honest, sir, I was asked to join too, but I refused. I would have told you about the betrayal, but they threatened to kill my family if I said anything. I’m sorry sir, but I couldn’t sacrifice my family. You get that, right?
entries.translated:
La base è stata così silenziosa da
quando la maggior parte delle\lreclute ha giurato fedeltà alla

Light of Ruin. A dire il vero,
signore, hanno chiesto anche a me\ldi unirmi a loro, ma ho rifiutato.

Le avrei detto del tradimento, ma
mi hanno minacciato di uccidere la\lmia famiglia se avessi parlato. Mi

dispiace, signore, ma non potevo
sacrificare la mia famiglia. Lo\lcapisce, vero?

entries.original:
"Marlon, sir!

I heard rumours that you were
murdered by Aklove.

I’m glad you’re still alive.

Maybe with you around now, someone
will be able to bring Zeph back to\la good state of mind."
entries.translation_source: Marlon, sir! I heard rumours that you were murdered by Aklove. I’m glad you’re still alive. Maybe with you around now, someone will be able to bring Zeph back to a good state of mind.
entries.translated:
Signor Marlon! Ho sentito voci
secondo cui Aklove ti avrebbe\lucciso. Sono contento che tu sia

ancora vivo. Forse ora che ci sei
tu, qualcuno riuscirà a riportare\lZeph a uno stato d{B4}animo sereno.

entries.original:
"I’m using a complicated algorithm
to determine the approximate\llocation of the Light of Ruin HQ.

Once I have the results, Zeph plans
on using the information to take\lhis revenge on the Light of Ruin.

The only thing is, I don’t know how
long it will take to finish\."
entries.translation_source: I’m using a complicated algorithm to determine the approximate location of the Light of Ruin HQ. Once I have the results, Zeph plans on using the information to take his revenge on the Light of Ruin. The only thing is, I don’t know how long it will take to finish[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sto usando un algoritmo complicato
per determinare la posizione\lapprossimativa del quartier

generale di Light of Ruin. Una
volta ottenuti i risultati, Zeph ha\lintenzione di usare le informazioni

per vendicarsi di Light of Ruin.
L{B4}unico problema è che non so\lquanto tempo ci vorrà per finire\.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry about the huge mess in
the base, sir.

When most of the grunts left to
join the Light of Ruin, they just\ldropped all of their things on the\lfloor.

I’m sure some of them even left
their clearance cards behind\."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry about the huge mess in the base, sir. When most of the grunts left to join the Light of Ruin, they just dropped all of their things on the floor. I’m sure some of them even left their clearance cards behind[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace per il gran caos nella
base, signore. Quando la maggior\lparte delle reclute se n{B4}è andata

per unirsi alla Luce della Rovina,
ha semplicemente lasciato tutte le\lproprie cose per terra. Sono sicuro

che alcuni di loro abbiano persino
lasciato i loro tesserini di\laccesso\.

entries.original:
"The door requires a Key Card with
Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened."
entries.translation_source: The door requires a Key Card with Clearance Level: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3], to be opened.
entries.translated:
La porta richiede una Tessera
Chiave con livello di\lautorizzazione: [green][buffer1][black], per

essere aperta.

entries.original:
"The door requires a Key Card with
Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened.

Would you like to open the door?"
entries.translation_source: The door requires a Key Card with Clearance Level: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3], to be opened. Would you like to open the door?
entries.translated:
Per aprirsi, la porta richiede una
Key Card con livello di\lautorizzazione: [green][buffer1][black]. Vuoi

aprire la porta?

entries.original:
"It appears as if the door has been
blown apart."
entries.translation_source: It appears as if the door has been blown apart.
entries.translated:
Sembra che la porta sia stata fatta
saltare in aria.

entries.original:
"Oh, Marlon, sir!

I’ve been working on new ways to
make The Shadows’ Pokémon\lstronger.

Would you like to see them in
battle?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, Marlon, sir! I’ve been working on new ways to make The Shadows’ Pokémon stronger. Would you like to see them in battle?
entries.translated:
Oh, signor Marlon! Mi sono messo a
lavorare su nuovi modi per rendere\lpiù forti i Pokémon delle Ombre.

Vorrebbe vederli in battaglia?

entries.original:
"For spending your valuable time
battling me, I’d like to thank you\lby healing your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: For spending your valuable time battling me, I’d like to thank you by healing your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Per aver speso il tuo prezioso
tempo a combattere con me, vorrei\lringraziarti curando i tuoi

Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Of course, sir.

I’m sure you have much more,
important, business to attend to."
entries.translation_source: Of course, sir. I’m sure you have much more, important, business to attend to.
entries.translated:
Certamente, signore. Sono sicuro
che lei abbia affari molto più\limportanti a cui badare.

entries.original:
"The final batch of Shadow Warriors
that Zeph requested, are almost\lfully synthesized.

Once the process is complete, it
should give us enough fighting\lpower to take down the Light of\lRuin."
entries.translation_source: The final batch of Shadow Warriors that Zeph requested, are almost fully synthesized. Once the process is complete, it should give us enough fighting power to take down the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
L{B4}ultimo lotto di Guerrieri Ombra
richiesto da Zeph è quasi del tutto\lsintetizzato. Una volta completato

il processo, dovremmo avere
abbastanza potenza di combattimento\lper sconfiggere la Luce della

Rovina.

entries.original:
"For this final batch of Shadow
Warriors, Zeph requested that only\lthe strongest of Pokémon be used,\lto get the greatest results."
entries.translation_source: For this final batch of Shadow Warriors, Zeph requested that only the strongest of Pokémon be used, to get the greatest results.
entries.translated:
Per questo ultimo gruppo di Shadow
Warriors, Zeph ha chiesto che\lvenissero usati solo i Pokémon più

forti, per ottenere i risultati
migliori.

entries.original: "The cage is empty."
entries.translation_source: The cage is empty.
entries.translated: La gabbia è vuota.

entries.original:
"Hey, hey, kid!
It’s dangerous!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, hey, kid! It’s dangerous!
entries.translated: Ehi, ehi, ragazzo! È pericoloso!

entries.original:
"Sir!

Zeph has ordered me to stop anyone
without the proper clearance from\lentering the lab.

However, I’m sure it’s fine if I
allow you in."
entries.translation_source: Sir! Zeph has ordered me to stop anyone without the proper clearance from entering the lab. However, I’m sure it’s fine if I allow you in.
entries.translated:
Signore! Zeph mi ha ordinato di
impedire a chiunque non abbia\ll{B4}autorizzazione adeguata di

entrare nel laboratorio. Tuttavia,
sono sicuro che va bene se ti\llascio entrare.

entries.original:
"Please feel free to enter the lab,
sir."
entries.translation_source: Please feel free to enter the lab, sir.
entries.translated:
Prego, si accomodi pure nel
laboratorio, signore.

entries.original:
"I’ve been instructed by my
superiors to hand out that HM to\lany trainers coming this way.

Until the bridge is fixed, you’ll
need to use that HM for [green]Rock Climb[blue]\lif you want to go to [green]Seaport City[blue].

Just face that rock wall over
there to use it."
entries.translation_source: I’ve been instructed by my superiors to hand out that HM to any trainers coming this way. Until the bridge is fixed, you’ll need to use that HM for [color-green-1]Rock Climb[color-blue-2] if you want to go to [color-green-3]Seaport City[color-blue-4]. Just face that rock wall over there to use it.
entries.translated:
Ho ricevuto l{B4}ordine dai miei
superiori di consegnare quella MN a\ltutti gli allenatori che passano di

qui. Finché il ponte non sarà
riparato, dovrai usare quella MN\lper [green]Rock Climb[blue] se vuoi andare a

[green]Seaport City[blue]. Ti basta metterti di
fronte a quella parete rocciosa\llaggiù per usarla.

entries.original: "You’re already on this floor."
entries.translation_source: You’re already on this floor.
entries.translated: Sei già su questo piano.

entries.translation_source: F1
entries.translated: F1

entries.original: "B1F"
entries.translation_source: B1F
entries.translated: B1F

entries.original: "B2F"
entries.translation_source: B2F
entries.translated: B2F

entries.original: "B3F"
entries.translation_source: B3F
entries.translated: B3F

entries.original:
"[red]Now, Shadow Warriors!

Restrain it!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Now, Shadow Warriors! Restrain it!
entries.translated: [red]Ora, Shadow Warriors! Contenetelo!

entries.original:
"No!

I’d rather drown than be turned
into one of those\.things!"
entries.translation_source: No! I’d rather drown than be turned into one of those[game-token-1]things!
entries.translated:
No! Preferirei annegare piuttosto
che essere trasformato in una di\lquelle\.cose!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Zeph\.

What’s happened to you?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Zeph[game-token-2] What’s happened to you?
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Zeph\. Che ti è successo?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Marlon’s disappeared\.

Ivory’s left me to find her son\.

There’s no point in going on
anymore\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Marlon’s disappeared[game-token-2] Ivory’s left me to find her son[game-token-3] There’s no point in going on anymore[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Marlon è scomparso\. Ivory mi
ha lasciato per andare a cercare\lsuo figlio\. Non ha più senso andare

avanti\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Snap out of it, Zeph!

Come back to your senses!

It’s me, Marlon!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Snap out of it, Zeph! Come back to your senses! It’s me, Marlon!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Riprenditi, Zeph! Ritorna
in te! Sono io, Marlon!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Marlon?

Is that really you?

You look different\.

That scar on your face is gone\.

And where’s your uniform?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Marlon? Is that really you? You look different[game-token-2] That scar on your face is gone[game-token-3] And where’s your uniform?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Marlon? Sei davvero tu?
Sembri diverso\. Quella cicatrice sul\ltuo viso è sparita\. E la tua

uniforme dov{B4}è?

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Yes, it’s me, Zeph.

I took off my uniform after I
blasted my way in here.

It’s not like I’m going to need it
anymore\.

Based on what I heard from the
remaining grunts, The Shadows have\lessentially disbanded\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Yes, it’s me, Zeph. I took off my uniform after I blasted my way in here. It’s not like I’m going to need it anymore[game-token-2] Based on what I heard from the remaining grunts, The Shadows have essentially disbanded[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Sì, sono io, Zeph. Mi sono
tolto la divisa dopo essermi fatto\lstrada qui dentro a colpi. Non è

che mi servirà ancora\. Da quello che
ho sentito dagli scagnozzi rimasti,\lThe Shadows si sono praticamente

sciolti\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]We’re not done yet\.

We still have one more mission to
complete\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]We’re not done yet[game-token-2] We still have one more mission to complete[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Non abbiamo ancora finito\. Ci
resta ancora un{B4}altra missione da\lcompletare\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]What happened, Zeph?

Why were we abandoned?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]What happened, Zeph? Why were we abandoned?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Che è successo, Zeph?
Perché ci hanno abbandonati?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]After Aklove made a fool out
of me and carried out the\lunbinding, many grunts were\lawestruck by his power and pledged\lallegiance to the Light of Ruin.

Those fools have no idea what
they’ve done\.

They’re helping him destroy their
homes\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]After Aklove made a fool out of me and carried out the unbinding, many grunts were awestruck by his power and pledged allegiance to the Light of Ruin. Those fools have no idea what they’ve done[game-token-2] They’re helping him destroy their homes[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Dopo che Aklove mi ha fatto
fare la figura del fesso e ha\lcompiuto lo scioglimento del

vincolo, molti scagnozzi sono
rimasti sbalorditi dal suo potere e\lhanno giurato fedeltà alla Light of

Ruin. Quegli idioti non hanno idea
di ciò che hanno fatto\. Stanno\laiutando lui a distruggere le loro

case\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Why did you come back, Marlon?

You had a chance to get out of this
mess.

I know you’ve been having second
thoughts lately, so why stay?

You could have left to be with your
children again\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Why did you come back, Marlon? You had a chance to get out of this mess. I know you’ve been having second thoughts lately, so why stay? You could have left to be with your children again[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Perché sei tornato, Marlon? Avevi
la possibilità di uscire da questo\lpasticcio. So che ultimamente hai

avuto dei ripensamenti, allora
perché restare? Avresti potuto\landartene per tornare di nuovo con

i tuoi figli\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]I can’t yet.

I first must destroy all of the
Shadow Warriors we created.

Otherwise I’ll be forced to live
for eternity and watch my children\ldie before me\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]I can’t yet. I first must destroy all of the Shadow Warriors we created. Otherwise I’ll be forced to live for eternity and watch my children die before me[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Non ancora. Prima devo
distruggere tutti gli Shadow\lWarriors che abbiamo creato.

Altrimenti sarò costretto a vivere
per l{B4}eternità e guardare i miei\lfigli morire davanti a me\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]What are you saying, Marlon?

Those Shadow Warriors are the best
weapons The Shadows have left!

But either way, even if I wanted
to go along with your ridiculous\lmission, I couldn’t.

The Light of Ruin took possession
of most of them.

The only ones remaining are still
being synthesized in the lab.

But that’s what we get for storing
all of them in one place\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]What are you saying, Marlon? Those Shadow Warriors are the best weapons The Shadows have left! But either way, even if I wanted to go along with your ridiculous mission, I couldn’t. The Light of Ruin took possession of most of them. The only ones remaining are still being synthesized in the lab. But that’s what we get for storing all of them in one place[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Cosa stai dicendo, Marlon?
Quei Guerrieri Ombra sono le\lmigliori armi che gli Ombre hanno

lasciato! Ma comunque, anche se
volessi assecondare la tua ridicola\lmissione, non potrei. La Luce della

Rovina ha preso possesso della
maggior parte di loro. Gli unici\lrimasti sono ancora in fase di

sintesi nel laboratorio. Ma questo
è ciò che otteniamo per averli\lconservati tutti in un unico posto\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]I’m aware.

I was just there with [player].

We fought Véga and and the Light
of Ruin together."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]I’m aware. I was just there with [player-name-2]. We fought Véga and and the Light of Ruin together.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Lo so. Ero appena lì con
[player]. Abbiamo combattuto\linsieme Véga e la Luce della

Rovina.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue][player]!

[buffer3]’s dead!

I watched [buffer1] burn alive!

You can’t honestly expect me to
believe that you actually teamed\lup with someone who’s dead!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]! [buffer3-3]’s dead! I watched [buffer1-4] burn alive! You can’t honestly expect me to believe that you actually teamed up with someone who’s dead!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue][player]! [buffer3] è morto!
Ho visto [buffer1] bruciare vivo!\lNon puoi seriamente aspettarti che

io creda che tu abbia davvero fatto
squadra con qualcuno che è morto!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]I can explain, Zeph.

I just need you to calm down, first."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]I can explain, Zeph. I just need you to calm down, first.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Posso spiegarti, Zeph. Ho
solo bisogno che tu ti calmi prima.

entries.original:
"[blue]What the\.

Wait\.

Is that you, [player]?

I thought I told you not to come
here!

You’ve just made a really big
mistake\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What the[game-token-2] Wait[game-token-3] Is that you, [player-name-4]? I thought I told you not to come here! You’ve just made a really big mistake[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
[blue]Ma che\. Aspetta\. Sei tu, [player]? Ti
avevo detto di non venire qui! Hai\lappena commesso un grosso errore\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue][player]!?

How are you still alive?

I watched you burn up!

I thought Marlon was lying at
first, but I have no choice but to\lbelieve him now that I’ve seen\lyour face under that hood!

You’re going to pay for the damage
you’ve caused!

Everything that’s happened\.it was
all because of you!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]!? How are you still alive? I watched you burn up! I thought Marlon was lying at first, but I have no choice but to believe him now that I’ve seen your face under that hood! You’re going to pay for the damage you’ve caused! Everything that’s happened[game-token-3]it was all because of you!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue][player]!? Come sei ancora
vivo? Ti ho visto bruciare!\lAll{B4}inizio credevo che Marlon

mentisse, ma non ho scelta se non
credergli ora che ho visto il tuo\lvolto sotto quel cappuccio! La

pagherai per i danni che hai
causato! Tutto quello che è\lsuccesso\.era tutto colpa tua!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]It’s time for you to burn
again!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]It’s time for you to burn again!
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]È ora che tu bruci di nuovo!

entries.original: "Arrrrgh!"
entries.translation_source: Arrrrgh!
entries.translated: Aaargh!

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]I’ve had it with you!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]I’ve had it with you!
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Ne ho abbastanza di te!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Zeph!

Stop!

We don’t have time for fighting
right now!

[player] isn’t the enemy you should
be focusing on!

The Light of Ruin is!

Now you can either accept that
fact, or I’ll be assuming command\lof what’s left of The Shadows."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Zeph! Stop! We don’t have time for fighting right now! [player-name-2] isn’t the enemy you should be focusing on! The Light of Ruin is! Now you can either accept that fact, or I’ll be assuming command of what’s left of The Shadows.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Zeph! Fermati! Non abbiamo
tempo di litigare adesso! [player]\lnon è il nemico su cui dovresti

concentrarti! È la Luce della
Rovina! Adesso puoi accettare\lquesto fatto, oppure assumerò il

comando di ciò che resta delle
Ombre.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Thank you.

Now\.

I’ve been hearing rumours that
you’ve been planning an attack on\lthe Light of Ruin base.

Care to fill me in on the details?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Thank you. Now[game-token-2] I’ve been hearing rumours that you’ve been planning an attack on the Light of Ruin base. Care to fill me in on the details?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Grazie. Ora\. ho sentito
delle voci secondo cui stareste\lpianificando un attacco alla base

della Light of Ruin. Ti va di
spiegarmi i dettagli?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]You heard right\.

Once our scientists locate their
base, The Shadows are going to take\lthem by surprise and destroy their\lbase from within.

However, I’m still unsure as to how
long it will take to locate them\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]You heard right[game-token-2] Once our scientists locate their base, The Shadows are going to take them by surprise and destroy their base from within. However, I’m still unsure as to how long it will take to locate them[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Hai sentito bene\. Non appena i
nostri scienziati individueranno la\lloro base, The Shadows li

coglieranno di sorpresa e
distruggeranno la loro base\ldall{B4}interno. Tuttavia, non sono

ancora sicuro di quanto tempo ci
vorrà per individuarli\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Fortunately, I know where
their base is.

When I was in Cinder Volcano with
[player], Véga ordered his grunts to\lretreat to Vivill Town.

That’s most likely where they’re
hiding."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Fortunately, I know where their base is. When I was in Cinder Volcano with [player-name-2], Véga ordered his grunts to retreat to Vivill Town. That’s most likely where they’re hiding.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Per fortuna, so dov{B4}è la
loro base. Quando ero nel Cinder\lVolcano con [player], Véga ha

ordinato ai suoi scagnozzi di
ritirarsi a Vivill Town. È molto\lprobabile che si nascondano lì.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Véga, that traitor\.

I should’ve known he’d turn on
us\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Véga, that traitor[game-token-2] I should’ve known he’d turn on us[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Véga, quel traditore\. Avrei
dovuto sapere che ci avrebbe\ltradito\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I’ll need to confirm with the
scientists, but if you’re correct,\lnow would be the perfect time to\lstrike.

Aklove has taken Hoopa to Hoenn in
order to test its strength before\lhe unleashes its power here.

If we take out his base while he’s
gone, he’ll have nothing to return\lto\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I’ll need to confirm with the scientists, but if you’re correct, now would be the perfect time to strike. Aklove has taken Hoopa to Hoenn in order to test its strength before he unleashes its power here. If we take out his base while he’s gone, he’ll have nothing to return to[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Devo confermarlo con gli
scienziati, ma se hai ragione, ora\lsarebbe il momento perfetto per

colpire. Aklove ha portato Hoopa a
Hoenn per testarne la forza prima\ldi scatenarne il potere qui. Se

eliminiamo la sua base mentre lui è
via, non avrà più nulla a cui\ltornare\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Agreed.

We’ll need all the manpower we can
get for the attack, so I suggest we\lbring [player] along as well."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Agreed. We’ll need all the manpower we can get for the attack, so I suggest we bring [player-name-2] along as well.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]D{B4}accordo. Ci serviranno
tutte le braccia possibili per\ll{B4}attacco, quindi suggerisco di

portare con noi anche [player].

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]What!?

Wasn’t it enough that you allowed
[buffer1] to aid you before?

Why have you put so much faith in
[buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]What!? Wasn’t it enough that you allowed [buffer1-2] to aid you before? Why have you put so much faith in [buffer1-3]?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Cosa!? Non era abbastanza che
tu avessi già permesso a [buffer1]\ldi aiutarti? Perché hai riposto

così tanta fiducia in [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]We both died, Zeph.

We were together in the afterlife.

When Arceus restored me to life, I
learned who [player] was\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]We both died, Zeph. We were together in the afterlife. When Arceus restored me to life, I learned who [player-name-2] was[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Siamo morti entrambi, Zeph.
Eravamo insieme nell{B4}aldilà. Quando\lArceus mi ha riportato in vita, ho

scoperto chi fosse [player]\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Arceus?

As in the Pokémon that Aros
managed to capture and tame?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Arceus? As in the Pokémon that Aros managed to capture and tame?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Arceus? Intendi il Pokémon
che Aros è riuscito a catturare e\laddomesticare?

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Yes, that Arceus.

It appears that before Aros’
death, Arceus was set free and\lreturned to govern the\lJudgement Zone."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Yes, that Arceus. It appears that before Aros’ death, Arceus was set free and returned to govern the Judgement Zone.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Sì, proprio quell{B4}Arceus.
Sembra che, prima della morte di\lAros, Arceus sia stato liberato ed

sia tornato a governare la
Judgement Zone.

entries.original:
"[blue]So, how about it, [player]?

I know we haven’t really seen eye
to eye before, but are you willing\lto join our raid on the [green]Light of\lRuin base[blue] in [green]Vivill Town[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]So, how about it, [player-name-2]? I know we haven’t really seen eye to eye before, but are you willing to join our raid on the [color-green-3]Light of Ruin base[color-blue-4] in [color-green-5]Vivill Town[color-blue-6]?
entries.translated:
[blue]Allora, che ne dici, [player]? So
che finora non siamo stati proprio\lsulla stessa lunghezza d{B4}onda, ma

te la senti di unirti al nostro
assalto alla base della [green]Luce della\lRovina[blue] a [green]Vivill Town[blue]?

entries.original:
"[blue]Really?

You would, just like that?

I guess it makes sense.

They are the true threat to the
Borrius Region, after all.

However, I would still like to be
certain that I have your complete\lsupport.

Please, allow me to explain to you
the true purpose of The Shadows."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Really? You would, just like that? I guess it makes sense. They are the true threat to the Borrius Region, after all. However, I would still like to be certain that I have your complete support. Please, allow me to explain to you the true purpose of The Shadows.
entries.translated:
[blue]Davvero? Lo faresti, così, senza
esitare? Immagino abbia senso.\lDopotutto, sono la vera minaccia

per la Regione di Borrius.
Tuttavia, vorrei comunque essere\lcerto di avere il tuo pieno

sostegno. Ti prego, permettimi di
spiegarti il vero scopo di The\lShadows.

entries.original:
"[blue]I don’t blame you, [player].

Why should you trust the
organization you’ve been fighting\lto stop this entire time?

So, in that case, there is only one
thing I can do to gain your trust.

Please, allow me to explain to you
the true purpose of The Shadows."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I don’t blame you, [player-name-2]. Why should you trust the organization you’ve been fighting to stop this entire time? So, in that case, there is only one thing I can do to gain your trust. Please, allow me to explain to you the true purpose of The Shadows.
entries.translated:
[blue]Non ti do torto, [player]. Perché
dovresti fidarti\ldell{B4}organizzazione che hai

combattuto per fermare fino a ora?
Quindi, in questo caso, c{B4}è una\lsola cosa che posso fare per

guadagnarmi la tua fiducia. Ti
prego, permettimi di spiegarti il\lvero scopo di The Shadows.

entries.original:
"It all started eighteen years
ago\.

Zeph’s son had just passed away.

To comfort him, Ivory and I came to
visit from Hoenn\."
entries.translation_source: It all started eighteen years ago[game-token-1] Zeph’s son had just passed away. To comfort him, Ivory and I came to visit from Hoenn[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Tutto è iniziato diciotto anni fa\.
Il figlio di Zeph era appena venuto\la mancare. Per confortarlo, Ivory e

io venimmo a trovarlo da Hoenn\.

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Zeph\.

How are you holding up?

Marlon and I heard about your
son\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Zeph[game-token-2] How are you holding up? Marlon and I heard about your son[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Zeph\. Come la stai passando?
Marlon e io abbiamo sentito di tuo\lfiglio\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Ivory\.

Marlon\.

Thank you both for coming to visit
me\.

It’s good to see you again after
all these years\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Ivory[game-token-2] Marlon[game-token-3] Thank you both for coming to visit me[game-token-4] It’s good to see you again after all these years[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Ivory\. Marlon\. Grazie a
entrambi per essere venuti a\ltrovarmi\. È bello rivedervi dopo

tutti questi anni\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I take it you travelled by boat to
get here?

How was the journey?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I take it you travelled by boat to get here? How was the journey?
entries.translated:
[blue]Suppongo che tu sia arrivato in
barca per venire qui? Com{B4}è andato\lil viaggio?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Very pleasant.

It took a few days to arrive here,
but the journey was very nice."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Very pleasant. It took a few days to arrive here, but the journey was very nice.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Molto piacevole. Ci sono
voluti alcuni giorni per arrivare\lqui, ma il viaggio è stato molto

bello.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]If I remember correctly, you
have a son too\.right?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]If I remember correctly, you have a son too[game-token-2]right?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Se ricordo bene, hai anche un
figlio\.giusto?

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]We did\.

He caught an illness and
passed away very young\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]We did[game-token-2] He caught an illness and passed away very young[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Sì\. Ha contratto una
malattia ed è morto giovanissimo\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Have you ever thought about
trying to bring him back?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Have you ever thought about trying to bring him back?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Hai mai pensato di provare a
riportarlo indietro?

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]We did actually\.

As moleculur biologists, we figured
that if anyone could find a way it\lwould be us.

But of course, only Arceus truly
has the power to restore the dead.

We had no choice but to move on.

Then about a year ago, Ivory gave
birth to twins.

It was the happiest moment of our
lives\.

Ever since then, the voids in our
hearts have almost been filled\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]We did actually[game-token-2] As moleculur biologists, we figured that if anyone could find a way it would be us. But of course, only Arceus truly has the power to restore the dead. We had no choice but to move on. Then about a year ago, Ivory gave birth to twins. It was the happiest moment of our lives[game-token-3] Ever since then, the voids in our hearts have almost been filled[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]In effetti è stato così\.
Come biologi molecolari, pensavamo\lche se qualcuno avesse potuto

trovare un modo, saremmo stati noi.
Ma naturalmente solo Arceus ha\lveramente il potere di riportare in

vita i morti. Non abbiamo avuto
altra scelta che andare avanti. Poi\lcirca un anno fa, Ivory ha dato

alla luce due gemelli. È stato il
momento più felice delle nostre\lvite\. Da allora, i vuoti nei nostri

cuori sono stati quasi riempiti\.

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]Where are your children now?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Where are your children now?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Dove sono adesso i vostri
figli?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Our friend Euler Log is
taking care of them in Frozen\lHeights while we visit you."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Our friend Euler Log is taking care of them in Frozen Heights while we visit you.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Il nostro amico Euler Log si
sta prendendo cura di loro a Frozen\lHeights mentre veniamo a trovarti.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]A friend of mine, a Pokémon
Biologist, lives in Frozen Heights\las well.

He’s known around here as the
\qoGuardian of Borrius\qc.

He’s even managed to capture
Arceus!

I think his wife just gave birth to
a [buffer2], actually.

However, I’m having difficultly
remembering the [buffer1]’s name\.

Oh, I forgot to ask earlier, but
what are your children’s names?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]A friend of mine, a Pokémon Biologist, lives in Frozen Heights as well. He’s known around here as the [quote-open-2]Guardian of Borrius[quote-close-3]. He’s even managed to capture Arceus! I think his wife just gave birth to a [buffer2-4], actually. However, I’m having difficultly remembering the [buffer1-5]’s name[game-token-6] Oh, I forgot to ask earlier, but what are your children’s names?
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Un mio amico, un biologo
Pokémon, vive anche lui a Frozen\lHeights. Qui in zona è conosciuto

come il \qoGuardiano di Borrius\qc. È
persino riuscito a catturare\lArceus! Credo che sua moglie abbia

appena dato alla luce un [buffer2],
a dire il vero. Tuttavia, faccio\lfatica a ricordare il nome del

[buffer1]\. Oh, avevo dimenticato di
chiedertelo prima, ma come si\lchiamano i tuoi figli?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]Their names are [rival] and
Melony.

They’re the most beautiful children
in the world."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]Their names are [text-token-rival-2] and Melony. They’re the most beautiful children in the world.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Si chiamano [rival] e
Melony. Sono i bambini più belli\ldel mondo.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]With such beautiful names
to match too\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]With such beautiful names to match too[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Con nomi così belli da farci
anche da corrispondenti\.

entries.original:
"[blue]How would you like to help me with
something?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]How would you like to help me with something?
entries.translated:
[blue]In che modo vorresti aiutarmi in
qualcosa?

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Anything, Zeph.
We’re here for you."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Anything, Zeph. We’re here for you.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Qualsiasi cosa, Zeph. Siamo
qui per te.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]I want your help in bringing
my son back to life."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]I want your help in bringing my son back to life.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Voglio il tuo aiuto per
riportare in vita mio figlio.

entries.original:
"[blue]I know it can be done!

With your expertise and Aros’
control of Arceus, maybe we can\lfind a way to bring him back!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I know it can be done! With your expertise and Aros’ control of Arceus, maybe we can find a way to bring him back!
entries.translated:
[blue]So che si può fare! Con la tua
esperienza e il controllo di Aros\lsu Arceus, forse possiamo trovare

un modo per riportarlo indietro!

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]It just can’t be done,
Zeph!

Trust us, we’ve tried!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]It just can’t be done, Zeph! Trust us, we’ve tried!
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Non si può proprio fare,
Zeph! Fidati, ci abbiamo provato!

entries.original:
"It took many tries, but eventually,
Zeph convinced us to move to\lFrozen Heights and assist him.

We met up with your father soon
after.

He was more hesistant to help at
first, but he came around after a\lfew years.

By that point he had already
released Arceus.

Thus, we had no choice but to find
a more scientific approach\."
entries.translation_source: It took many tries, but eventually, Zeph convinced us to move to Frozen Heights and assist him. We met up with your father soon after. He was more hesistant to help at first, but he came around after a few years. By that point he had already released Arceus. Thus, we had no choice but to find a more scientific approach[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ci sono voluti molti tentativi, ma
alla fine, Zeph ci ha convinti a\ltrasferirci a Frozen Heights e ad

aiutarlo. Poco dopo abbiamo
incontrato tuo padre. All{B4}inizio\lera più restio ad aiutare, ma dopo

qualche anno ha cambiato idea. A
quel punto aveva già liberato\lArceus. Dunque, non avevamo altra

scelta se non trovare un approccio
più scientifico\.

entries.original: "Zeph: [blue]What’s the current status?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]What’s the current status?
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Qual è la situazione attuale?

entries.original:
"Ivory: [red]We’re ready to begin the
first trial, Zeph."
entries.translation_source: Ivory: [color-red-1]We’re ready to begin the first trial, Zeph.
entries.translated:
Ivory: [red]Siamo pronti a iniziare la
prima prova, Zeph.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Good.

Everyone, take your positions."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Good. Everyone, take your positions.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Bene. Tutti, prendete
posizione.

entries.original:
