"Zeph: [blue]Would you do us the honours,
Aros?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Would you do us the honours, Aros?
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Ci faresti gli onori, Aros?

entries.original: "Aros: [blue]Of course, Zeph."
entries.translation_source: Aros: [color-blue-1]Of course, Zeph.
entries.translated: Aros: [blue]Certo, Zeph.

entries.original:
"Aros: [blue]To start, I just place this
Pokémon here\."
entries.translation_source: Aros: [color-blue-1]To start, I just place this Pokémon here[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aros: [blue]Per iniziare, metto
semplicemente questo Pokémon qui\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Now, I place the sample ashes
beside it\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Now, I place the sample ashes beside it[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Ora, poso le ceneri del campione
accanto ad essa\.

entries.original:
"[blue]And finally, turn on the molecular
fusion device!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]And finally, turn on the molecular fusion device!
entries.translated:
[blue]E infine, accendi il dispositivo di
fusione molecolare!

entries.original:
"[blue]Once I cover it with this blanket
the fusion should be complete\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Once I cover it with this blanket the fusion should be complete[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Una volta che lo copro con questa
coperta, la fusione dovrebbe essere\lcompleta\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Haha! I did it!

I created the first human-Pokémon
hybrid!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Haha! I did it! I created the first human-Pokémon hybrid!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ahah! Ce l{B4}ho fatta! Ho creato il
primo ibrido umano-Pokémon!

entries.original:
"[blue]With more tests like this, I should
be able to bring back your son,\lZeph!

Yours as well, Marlon and Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]With more tests like this, I should be able to bring back your son, Zeph! Yours as well, Marlon and Ivory!
entries.translated:
[blue]Con altri test come questo, dovrei
riuscire a riportare indietro tuo\lfiglio, Zeph! Anche il vostro,

Marlon e Ivory!

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Aros!

No!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Aros! No!
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]Aros! No!

entries.original:
"[blue]Quick, Marlon!

Hand me the control gauntlet that
Aros made for this creature."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Quick, Marlon! Hand me the control gauntlet that Aros made for this creature.
entries.translated:
[blue]Presto, Marlon! Passami il guanto
di controllo che Aros ha fatto per\lquesta creatura.

entries.original:
"[blue]Stay, creature!

You must obey my command!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Stay, creature! You must obey my command!
entries.translated:
[blue]Resta, creatura! Devi obbedire al
mio comando!

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh, Aros\.

How could I lose you too\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oh, Aros[game-token-2] How could I lose you too[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh, Aros\. Come ho potuto perdere
anche te\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Marlon, Ivory, we can’t let this
deter us!

However, I no longer think it can
be done with just the three of us.

We’ll need more manpower if we want
to get this done."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Marlon, Ivory, we can’t let this deter us! However, I no longer think it can be done with just the three of us. We’ll need more manpower if we want to get this done.
entries.translated:
[blue]Marlon, Ivory, non possiamo
lasciarci scoraggiare! Tuttavia,\lnon credo più che possiamo farcela

solo in tre. Ci servirà più
manodopera se vogliamo portare a\ltermine questa cosa.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]But where will we get the
money to hire workers?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]But where will we get the money to hire workers?
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Ma dove troveremo i soldi
per assumere dei lavoratori?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Money is no object.

I have plenty of funds saved up
from when I sold Cube Corp.

With those funds, we can hire the
faceless drones we need\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Money is no object. I have plenty of funds saved up from when I sold Cube Corp. With those funds, we can hire the faceless drones we need[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Il denaro non è un problema.
Ho messo da parte un bel po{B4} di\lfondi da quando ho venduto Cube

Corp. Con quei fondi, possiamo
ingaggiare i droni senza volto di\lcui abbiamo bisogno\.

entries.original:
"Although Aros was gone, we
continued the trials in his memory.

However, our \qoShadow Warriors\qc
were difficult to control at first.

Some lashed out, scarring my
face\.

Despite this, we pressed on.

Over the next several years, we
continued capturing Pokémon and\lcombining them with the ashes of\lhumans.

And the more we did this, the more
our hesistancy to kill decreased.

Eventually, after determining we
wouldn’t be able to create a\lcreature that would retain its\lmemories of its former life, we\ldecided on a new approach."
entries.translation_source: Although Aros was gone, we continued the trials in his memory. However, our [quote-open-1]Shadow Warriors[quote-close-2] were difficult to control at first. Some lashed out, scarring my face[game-token-3] Despite this, we pressed on. Over the next several years, we continued capturing Pokémon and combining them with the ashes of humans. And the more we did this, the more our hesistancy to kill decreased. Eventually, after determining we wouldn’t be able to create a creature that would retain its memories of its former life, we decided on a new approach.
entries.translated:
Sebbene Aros se ne fosse andato,
continuammo le prove in sua\lmemoria. Tuttavia, i nostri

\qoGuerrieri Ombra\qc erano difficili
da controllare all{B4}inizio. Alcuni\lsi scagliarono, sfregiandomi il

viso\. Nonostante ciò, andammo
avanti. Nei successivi anni,\lcontinuammo a catturare Pokémon e

combinarli con le ceneri degli
umani. E più facevamo questo, più\lla nostra esitazione a uccidere

diminuiva. Alla fine, dopo aver
stabilito che non saremmo riusciti\la creare una creatura che

conservasse i ricordi della sua
vita precedente, decidemmo per un\lnuovo approccio.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Marlon, Ivory, I believe its
time we try something new.

In the last several years, we have
barely made any progress.

We may have managed to create a few
hundred Shadow Warriors, but they\lare all still just mindless beasts.

You both have given up so much to
help me\.

You’ve abandoned your children for
me\.

It’s time to end this so we can
all go home again.

Therefore, I suggest we begin work
on Operation Eternal Flower.

If we can find a way to bring the
Ultimate Weapon here, then we can\luse it to restore our children\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Marlon, Ivory, I believe its time we try something new. In the last several years, we have barely made any progress. We may have managed to create a few hundred Shadow Warriors, but they are all still just mindless beasts. You both have given up so much to help me[game-token-2] You’ve abandoned your children for me[game-token-3] It’s time to end this so we can all go home again. Therefore, I suggest we begin work on Operation Eternal Flower. If we can find a way to bring the Ultimate Weapon here, then we can use it to restore our children[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Marlon, Ivory, credo sia ora
di provare qualcosa di nuovo. Negli\lultimi anni abbiamo fatto a

malapena progressi. Potremmo essere
riusciti a creare qualche centinaio\ldi Guerrieri Ombra, ma sono ancora

solo bestie senza mente. Entrambi
avete rinunciato a così tanto per\laiutarmi\\. Avete abbandonato i

vostri figli per me\\. È ora di
finirla così possiamo tornare tutti\la casa. Pertanto, suggerisco di

iniziare a lavorare sull{B4}Operazione
Fiore Eterno. Se riusciamo a\ltrovare un modo per portare l{B4}Arma

Suprema qui, allora possiamo usarla
per ripristinare i nostri figli\\.

entries.original:
"[blue]And thus, we began collecting
information on the dark force of\lBorrius so we could use its power\lto bring us the Ultimate Weapon.

From there you know the rest.

\.

\.

Phew\.

Take it all in, [player].

\.

\.

Okay, now that I’ve told you
essentially everything, you should\lhave no hesitation about trusting\lus anymore."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]And thus, we began collecting information on the dark force of Borrius so we could use its power to bring us the Ultimate Weapon. From there you know the rest. [game-token-2] [game-token-3] Phew[game-token-4] Take it all in, [player-name-5]. [game-token-6] [game-token-7] Okay, now that I’ve told you essentially everything, you should have no hesitation about trusting us anymore.
entries.translated:
[blue]E così, cominciammo a raccogliere
informazioni sulla forza oscura di\lBorrius per poter usare il suo

potere per crearci l{B4}Arma Suprema.
Da lì conosci il resto. \. \. Uff\.\lAssorbi tutto, [player]. \. \. Va bene,

ora che ti ho detto sostanzialmente
tutto, non dovresti più esitare a\lfidarti di noi.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]You’re Aros’ [buffer2]\.

If I had known, I never would have
tried to have you killed!

I’m sorry, [player].

I truly am."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]You’re Aros’ [buffer2-2][game-token-3] If I had known, I never would have tried to have you killed! I’m sorry, [player-name-4]. I truly am.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Sei il [buffer2] di Aros\. Se
l{B4}avessi saputo, non avrei mai\lcercato di farti uccidere! Mi

dispiace, [player]. Davvero.

entries.original:
"[blue]Marlon\.

We can’t stay here any longer.

It’s time to rally our fighting
force and head to Vivill Town."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Marlon[game-token-2] We can’t stay here any longer. It’s time to rally our fighting force and head to Vivill Town.
entries.translated:
[blue]Marlon\\. Non possiamo restare qui
ancora a lungo. È ora di radunare\lle nostre forze combattenti e

dirigerci a Vivill Town.

entries.original:
"[blue]Marlon: Right away, Zeph.

Let’s get to Vivill Town as fast as
possible.

I doubt we’ll have much time before
Aklove returns."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Marlon: Right away, Zeph. Let’s get to Vivill Town as fast as possible. I doubt we’ll have much time before Aklove returns.
entries.translated:
[blue]Marlon: Subito, Zeph. Andiamo a
Vivill Town il più velocemente\lpossibile. Dubito che avremo molto

tempo prima che Aklove ritorni.

entries.original:
"[blue]Oh, one last thing, [player].

Keep the outfit, it looks good on
you.

Who knows, it may come in handy
someday."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oh, one last thing, [player-name-2]. Keep the outfit, it looks good on you. Who knows, it may come in handy someday.
entries.translated:
[blue]Oh, un{B4}ultima cosa, [player]. Tieni
il costume, ti sta bene. Chissà,\lpotrebbe tornarti utile un giorno.

entries.original:
"[blue]Get to [green]Vivill Town [blue]as soon as
possible.

We don’t have long.

Head [green]northeast[blue] from [green]Dehara City
[blue]to get there the quickest."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Get to [color-green-2]Vivill Town [color-blue-3]as soon as possible. We don’t have long. Head [color-green-4]northeast[color-blue-5] from [color-green-6]Dehara City [color-blue-7]to get there the quickest.
entries.translated:
[blue]Raggiungi [green]Vivill Town [blue]il prima
possibile. Non abbiamo molto tempo.\lDirigiti [green]a nord-est[blue] da [green]Dehara City

[blue]per arrivarci nel modo più rapido.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo!
You thaved me!

I was looking for berries on behalf
of Tropius Berries Inc., when all of\la thudden these boulders fell down\laround me!

But you rescued me and now I can go
home for the day!

Because of your heroic efforts, I
want you to take thome berries!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo! You thaved me! I was looking for berries on behalf of Tropius Berries Inc., when all of a thudden these boulders fell down around me! But you rescued me and now I can go home for the day! Because of your heroic efforts, I want you to take thome berries!
entries.translated:
Oh oh oh! Mi hai salvato! Stavo
cercando bacche per conto della\lTropius Berries Inc., quando

all{B4}improvviso queste rocce sono
cadute tutt{B4}intorno a me! Ma mi hai\lsalvato e ora posso tornare a casa

per oggi! Grazie al tuo eroico
intervento, voglio che tu prenda\lqualche bacca!

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo!

I’ll be back tomorrow to look for
more berries!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo! I’ll be back tomorrow to look for more berries!
entries.translated:
Oooh hoo hoo! Tornerò domani a
cercare altre bacche!

entries.original:
"Great Desert

\al Dehara City
\ar Gurun Town"
entries.translation_source: Great Desert [game-token-1] Dehara City [game-token-2] Gurun Town
entries.translated:
Grande Deserto \al Dehara City \ar
Gurun Town

entries.original:
"[blue]Now, someone take his ashes to the
lab!

Let’s at least make something
useful of this failure."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Now, someone take his ashes to the lab! Let’s at least make something useful of this failure.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ora, qualcuno porti le sue ceneri
al laboratorio! Almeno facciamo\lqualcosa di utile di questo

fallimento.

entries.original:
"Oh, sir!

Some guy with red hair blasted his
way in here!

I tried to stop him, but he just
shoved me aside."
entries.translation_source: Oh, sir! Some guy with red hair blasted his way in here! I tried to stop him, but he just shoved me aside.
entries.translated:
Oh, signore! Uno con i capelli
rossi si è fatto strada qui dentro\la forza! Ho provato a fermarlo, ma

mi ha semplicemente spinto via.

entries.original:
"You’ll never be able to beat my
super, rare, awesome, Sandslash!

I got it all the way up in Icicle
Cave!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll never be able to beat my super, rare, awesome, Sandslash! I got it all the way up in Icicle Cave!
entries.translated:
Non riuscirai mai a battere il mio
Sandslash super, raro e fantastico!\lL{B4}ho preso fin lassù in Icicle

Cave!

entries.original:
"[blue]How could you let them escape!?

They saw what we were doing in the
lab!

If they realize what we were doing
and tell anyone, our whole\loperation could be ruined!

And you think a simple apology will
make everything alright?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]How could you let them escape!? They saw what we were doing in the lab! If they realize what we were doing and tell anyone, our whole operation could be ruined! And you think a simple apology will make everything alright?
entries.translated:
[blue]Come avete potuto lasciarli
scappare!? Hanno visto quello che\lstavamo facendo nel laboratorio! Se

si rendono conto di quello che
stavamo facendo e lo dicono a\lqualcuno, tutta la nostra

operazione potrebbe andare in fumo!
E pensi che una semplice scusa\lsistemerà tutto?

entries.original:
"If you’re going north, you’ll head
towards Route 6, a grassy route.

If you’re going south, you’ll head
towards the Auburn Waterway."
entries.translation_source: If you’re going north, you’ll head towards Route 6, a grassy route. If you’re going south, you’ll head towards the Auburn Waterway.
entries.translated:
Se vai a nord, ti dirigerai verso
il Percorso 6, un percorso erboso.\lSe vai a sud, ti dirigerai verso il

Canale di Auburn.

entries.original:
"They say some of the ugliest people
shop at Poké Mart.

I heard there’s even a website
documenting them all."
entries.translation_source: They say some of the ugliest people shop at Poké Mart. I heard there’s even a website documenting them all.
entries.translated:
Dicono che alcune delle persone più
brutte facciano acquisti al Poké\lMart. Ho sentito che esiste persino

un sito web che le documenta tutte.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello there, Borrius trainer.

I moved here recently with my three
Pokémon from the Unova region.

I’ve been raising them on my own up
until this point, but lately,\lthey’ve been craving adventure.

I don’t really want to leave my
home, so I’ve been searching for\lsomeone to take them off my hands.

How would you like to take care of
them for me?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello there, Borrius trainer. I moved here recently with my three Pokémon from the Unova region. I’ve been raising them on my own up until this point, but lately, they’ve been craving adventure. I don’t really want to leave my home, so I’ve been searching for someone to take them off my hands. How would you like to take care of them for me?
entries.translated:
Oh, ciao là, Allenatore di Borrius.
Mi sono trasferito qui di recente\lcon i miei tre Pokémon della

regione di Unima. Li ho cresciuti
da solo fino a questo momento, ma\lultimamente hanno voglia di

avventura. In realtà non vorrei
lasciare la mia casa, quindi sto\lcercando qualcuno a cui affidarli.

Ti andrebbe di prendertene cura per
me?

entries.original:
"Oh, okay then.

I guess I’ll have to keep searching
for a trainer."
entries.translation_source: Oh, okay then. I guess I’ll have to keep searching for a trainer.
entries.translated:
Oh, va bene allora. Suppongo che
dovrò continuare a cercare un\lallenatore.

entries.original:
"Hello again!

How are my old friends doing?"
entries.translation_source: Hello again! How are my old friends doing?
entries.translated:
Ciao di nuovo! Come stanno i miei
vecchi amici?

entries.original:
"You received a [green]Snivy[black], [red]Tepig[black], and
[blue]Oshawott [black]from the woman!"
entries.translation_source: You received a [color-green-1]Snivy[color-black-2], [color-red-3]Tepig[color-black-4], and [color-blue-5]Oshawott [color-black-6]from the woman!
entries.translated:
Hai ricevuto da quella donna un
[green]Snivy[black], [red]Tepig[black] e un [blue]Oshawott[black]!

entries.original:
"Unless you can Surf, going this
way just leads to a dead end."
entries.translation_source: Unless you can Surf, going this way just leads to a dead end.
entries.translated:
A meno che tu non sappia Surf,
andare da questa parte porta solo a\lun vicolo cieco.

entries.original:
"Route 12

\au Dehara City
\ad Tarmigan Town\l\al Route 14"
entries.translation_source: Route 12 [game-token-1] Dehara City [game-token-2] Tarmigan Town [game-token-3] Route 14
entries.translated:
Percorso 12 \au Città di Dehara \ad
Cittadina di Tarmigan \al Percorso 14

entries.original:
"It appears to be the remains of
what used to be a Shadow Warrior.

Remove the cloak and lay it to
rest?"
entries.translation_source: It appears to be the remains of what used to be a Shadow Warrior. Remove the cloak and lay it to rest?
entries.translated:
Sembrano i resti di quello che un
tempo era un Guerriero Ombra. Togli\lil mantello e fallo riposare?

entries.original:
"You removed the cloak from the
Shadow Warrior."
entries.translation_source: You removed the cloak from the Shadow Warrior.
entries.translated:
Hai rimosso il mantello dal
Guerriero Ombra.

entries.original:
"The remains of the Shadow Warrior
fell apart, and its soul was laid\lto rest."
entries.translation_source: The remains of the Shadow Warrior fell apart, and its soul was laid to rest.
entries.translated:
I resti del Guerriero Ombra si sono
disintegrati, e la sua anima è\lstata posta a riposo.

entries.original:
"Route 5

\au Route 4, Cinder Volcano,
Grim Woods\l\al Crater Town"
entries.translation_source: Route 5 [game-token-1] Route 4, Cinder Volcano, Grim Woods [game-token-2] Crater Town
entries.translated:
Percorso 5 \au Percorso 4, Cinder
Volcano, Grim Woods \al Città Cratere

entries.original:
"Hi! Welcome to the Double Battle
House!

Feel free to battle any of the
trainers here as many times as you\lwant.

If you need an explanation
of Double Battles, please come\ltalk to me.

Enjoy battling!"
entries.translation_source: Hi! Welcome to the Double Battle House! Feel free to battle any of the trainers here as many times as you want. If you need an explanation of Double Battles, please come talk to me. Enjoy battling!
entries.translated:
Ciao! Benvenuto alla Casa Lotta
Doppia! Sentiti libero di sfidare\lqualsiasi allenatore qui tutte le

volte che vuoi. Se hai bisogno di
una spiegazione sulle Lotte Doppie,\lper favore vieni a parlare con me.

Divertiti a lottare!

entries.original:
"The guys downstairs claim they
created the world we live in.

But I just think that’s just a load
of Tauros waste."
entries.translation_source: The guys downstairs claim they created the world we live in. But I just think that’s just a load of Tauros waste.
entries.translated:
I ragazzi al piano di sotto
sostengono di aver creato il mondo\lin cui viviamo. Ma io penso solo

che siano tutte cazzate da Tauros.

entries.original:
"Let me tell ya something young
feller.

To the east of here is a vast
desert.

It is so amazing, that it is
simply called the [green]Great Desert[blue].

Words can’t even begin to describe
it!

However, it’s really difficult to
traverse without the proper gear.

So don’t think ya can just waltz
out their without preppin’ first.

Yer outfit seems a little hot
for the desert, but it’ll do ya a\lgood job of protecing yer body.

As for yer eyes, I’d recommend
getting yerself a good pair of\l[green]Go-Goggles[blue].

In fact, I’d actually be willing to
give ya mine if ya can show me how\lstrong ya are by [green]beatin’ the Gym[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Let me tell ya something young feller. To the east of here is a vast desert. It is so amazing, that it is simply called the [color-green-1]Great Desert[color-blue-2]. Words can’t even begin to describe it! However, it’s really difficult to traverse without the proper gear. So don’t think ya can just waltz out their without preppin’ first. Yer outfit seems a little hot for the desert, but it’ll do ya a good job of protecing yer body. As for yer eyes, I’d recommend getting yerself a good pair of [color-green-3]Go-Goggles[color-blue-4]. In fact, I’d actually be willing to give ya mine if ya can show me how strong ya are by [color-green-5]beatin’ the Gym[color-blue-6].
entries.translated:
Lascia che ti dica una cosa,
ragazzo. A est da qui c{B4}è un vasto\ldeserto. È così straordinario che

viene semplicemente chiamato il
[green]Grande Deserto[blue]. Le parole non\lbastano nemmeno a descriverlo!

Tuttavia, è davvero difficile
attraversarlo senza\ll{B4}equipaggiamento adatto. Quindi

non pensare di potertene andare là
fuori senza prepararti prima. Il\ltuo abbigliamento sembra un po{B4}

troppo caldo per il deserto, ma
farà un buon lavoro nel proteggere\lil tuo corpo. Per quanto riguarda i

tuoi occhi, ti consiglierei di
procurarti un buon paio di\l[green]Occhialoni[blue]. Anzi, sarei persino

disposto a darti i miei se riesci a
mostrarmi quanto sei forte [green]battendo\lla Palestra[blue].

entries.original:
"Go young feller!

Explore the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Go young feller! Explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Vai, giovanotto! Esplora il Grande
Deserto!

entries.original:
"My daughter tried venturing into
Rift Cave all by herself.

She was very lucky that someone
stopped her.

If she had gone in there\.

I shudder every time I think of
what could have happened!"
entries.translation_source: My daughter tried venturing into Rift Cave all by herself. She was very lucky that someone stopped her. If she had gone in there[game-token-1] I shudder every time I think of what could have happened!
entries.translated:
Mia figlia ha provato a inoltrarsi
nella Rift Cave da sola. È stata\lmolto fortunata che qualcuno

l{B4}abbia fermata. Se fosse entrata
lì\. Rabbrividisco ogni volta che\lpenso a ciò che sarebbe potuto

accadere!

entries.original:
"There are stories of people never
returning from Rift Cave.

They say that whole groups who have
gone down there have never been\lseen again."
entries.translation_source: There are stories of people never returning from Rift Cave. They say that whole groups who have gone down there have never been seen again.
entries.translated:
Si racconta di persone che non sono
mai tornate da Rift Cave. Si dice\lche interi gruppi scesi laggiù non

siano mai più stati visti.

entries.original:
"Hello there, deary.

From my many years as a Pokémon
expert, I have gained the ability\lto teach the move, Thunder Punch.

However, if you wish for me to
teach one of your Pokémon this\lmove, it’ll cost you a Yellow Shard.

What do you say?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, deary. From my many years as a Pokémon expert, I have gained the ability to teach the move, Thunder Punch. However, if you wish for me to teach one of your Pokémon this move, it’ll cost you a Yellow Shard. What do you say?
entries.translated:
Ciao, tesoro. Grazie ai miei molti
anni come esperto Pokémon, ho\limparato a insegnare la mossa

Tuonopugno. Tuttavia, se vuoi che
insegni questa mossa a uno dei tuoi\lPokémon, ti costerà una Scheggia

Gialla. Che ne dici?

entries.original:
"It appears that you do not have any
Yellow Shards.

You can find them popping up
occassionally in the Great Desert.

If you come back with any, I’ll be
happy to teach your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It appears that you do not have any Yellow Shards. You can find them popping up occassionally in the Great Desert. If you come back with any, I’ll be happy to teach your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
A quanto pare non hai nessun
Frammento Giallo. Puoi trovarli che\lspuntano di tanto in tanto nel

Grande Deserto. Se torni con
qualcuno, sarò felice di insegnare\lal tuo Pokémon.

entries.original:
"I’ll be here, waiting, if you
change your mind."
entries.translation_source: I’ll be here, waiting, if you change your mind.
entries.translated:
Resterò qui ad aspettare, se cambi
idea.

entries.original:
"Hi there!

My grandmother has a business of
teaching Pokémon a move in\lexchange for a Yellow Shard.

If you haven’t had a chance to find
any, let me help you out."
entries.translation_source: Hi there! My grandmother has a business of teaching Pokémon a move in exchange for a Yellow Shard. If you haven’t had a chance to find any, let me help you out.
entries.translated:
Ciao! Mia nonna ha un{B4}attività in
cui insegna una mossa ai Pokémon in\lcambio di una Scheggia Gialla. Se

non ne hai ancora trovate, lascia
che ti dia una mano.

entries.original:
"You’ll be able to shock your
enemies when you learn her move!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll be able to shock your enemies when you learn her move!
entries.translated:
Potrai fulminare i tuoi nemici
quando imparerai la sua mossa!

entries.original:
"Looks like you don’t need any after
all. You have no space."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you don’t need any after all. You have no space.
entries.translated:
Sembra che alla fine non ti serva
alcunché. Non hai spazio.

entries.original:
"Hey, check it out. I’ve got a sweet
deal for ya!

You know how Pokemon like to hide
behind stones or rocks, yeah?

Sometimes they hide cool bones,
too.

If you find a [green]Rare Bone [blue]somewhere,
you should bring it to me.

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: Hey, check it out. I’ve got a sweet deal for ya! You know how Pokemon like to hide behind stones or rocks, yeah? Sometimes they hide cool bones, too. If you find a [color-green-1]Rare Bone [color-blue-2]somewhere, you should bring it to me. I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Ehi, dai un{B4}occhiata. Ho un affare
fantastico per te! Sai come ai\lPokémon piace nascondersi dietro le

pietre o i massi, giusto? A volte
nascondono anche ossa rare. Se\ltrovi da qualche parte una [green]Rare

Bone [blue], dovresti portarmela. Ti
ripagherò bene.

entries.original:
"What’s up?
Did you find a [green]Rare Bone [blue]for me?

Looks like you did.

If you want to sell it, I’ll buy
it from you for [green]$10000[blue]."
entries.translation_source: What’s up? Did you find a [color-green-1]Rare Bone [color-blue-2]for me? Looks like you did. If you want to sell it, I’ll buy it from you for [color-green-3]$10000[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Ehi, novità? Hai trovato un [green]Osso
Raro [blue]per me? Sembra di sì. Se vuoi\lvenderlo, te lo compro per [green]$10000[blue].

entries.original:
"[black]You gave the guy a Rare Bone in
exchange for $10000."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]You gave the guy a Rare Bone in exchange for $10000.
entries.translated:
[black]Hai dato al tizio le Ossa Rare in
cambio di $10000.

entries.original:
"If you find any more Rare Bones
come see me.

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: If you find any more Rare Bones come see me. I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Se trovi altre Ossa Rare vieni a
trovarmi. Ne varrà la pena.

entries.original:
"Hey, come see me if you find a
Rare Bone, got it?

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: Hey, come see me if you find a Rare Bone, got it? I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Ehi, vieni a trovarmi se trovi un
Osso Raro, capito? Ti ricompenserò\lbene.

entries.original:
"I just simply adore ores.

Don’t you have an adorable ore that
shakes my core?"
entries.translation_source: I just simply adore ores. Don’t you have an adorable ore that shakes my core?
entries.translated:
Adoro semplicemente i minerali. Non
hai forse un minerale adorabile che\lmi smuova nel profondo?

entries.original:
"Oh, I do adore the ores!

That [green][buffer3][blue], it’s shaking me!
Will you sell it for [green]$[buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I do adore the ores! That [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-blue-3], it’s shaking me! Will you sell it for [color-green-4]$[buffer2-5][color-blue-6]?
entries.translated:
Oh, adoro i minerali! Quello
[green][buffer3][blue], mi fa tremare! Me lo\lvendi per [green]$[buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"Turned over the [green][buffer3] [blue]and
received [green]$[buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Turned over the [color-green-1][buffer3-2] [color-blue-3]and received [color-green-4]$[buffer2-5][color-blue-6]!
entries.translated:
Hai consegnato [green][buffer3] [blue]e hai
ricevuto [green]$[buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"The deal is done!
I’ve scored an ore I can adore!"
entries.translation_source: The deal is done! I’ve scored an ore I can adore!
entries.translated:
L{B4}affare è fatto! Ho trovato un
minerale che adoro!

entries.original:
"Hmmmm. You don’t seem to have any
[green][buffer3]s[blue]. Come back again."
entries.translation_source: Hmmmm. You don’t seem to have any [color-green-1][buffer3-2]s[color-blue-3]. Come back again.
entries.translated:
Mmmmmm. Non sembra che tu abbia
alcun [green][buffer3]s[blue]. Torna un{B4}altra\lvolta.

entries.original:
"Hmmm. My core won’t change.
I hope you sell it to me someday."
entries.translation_source: Hmmm. My core won’t change. I hope you sell it to me someday.
entries.translated:
Mmm. Il mio nucleo non cambierà.
Spero che un giorno me lo venderai.

entries.original:
"Never mind, looks ya already beat
it.

Great job!

Take these Go-Goggles and explore
the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Never mind, looks ya already beat it. Great job! Take these Go-Goggles and explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Lascia stare, sembra che tu l{B4}abbia
già battuto. Ottimo lavoro! Prendi\lquesti Go-Goggles ed esplora il

Grande Deserto!

entries.original:
"It’s my job to keep the torches
around here lit at night.

The desert can pretty cold once the
sun goes down.

Those torches are our only reliable
source of heat during that time."
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to keep the torches around here lit at night. The desert can pretty cold once the sun goes down. Those torches are our only reliable source of heat during that time.
entries.translated:
È compito mio tenere accese di
notte le torce qui intorno. Nel\ldeserto può fare parecchio freddo

una volta che il sole tramonta.
Quelle torce sono la nostra unica\lfonte di calore affidabile in quel

momento.

entries.original:
"It’s my job to keep the torches
around here lit at night.

The desert can pretty cold now that
the sun is down.

Those torches are our only reliable
source of heat right now."
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to keep the torches around here lit at night. The desert can pretty cold now that the sun is down. Those torches are our only reliable source of heat right now.
entries.translated:
Il mio lavoro è tenere accese le
torce qui intorno di notte. Il\ldeserto può diventare piuttosto

freddo ora che il sole è
tramontato. Quelle torce sono la\lnostra unica fonte affidabile di

calore al momento.

entries.original:
"It seems pretty odd that there’s a
forest filled with so many rare\lBug Pokémon, so close to a desert.

Well, that’s Borrius for you!"
entries.translation_source: It seems pretty odd that there’s a forest filled with so many rare Bug Pokémon, so close to a desert. Well, that’s Borrius for you!
entries.translated:
Sembra piuttosto strano che ci sia
una foresta piena di così tanti\lrari Pokémon Coleottero, così

vicina a un deserto. Beh, questa è
Borrius per te!

entries.original:
"Gurun Town

A town that has survived the sands
of time."
entries.translation_source: Gurun Town A town that has survived the sands of time.
entries.translated:
Gurun Town, una città sopravvissuta
alla prova del tempo.

entries.original: "We’re the Black Emboar, you litch!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Emboar, you litch!
entries.translated: Siamo gli Emboar Neri, litch!

entries.original:
"I’ve spent years trying to uncover
the secret of the Regi Pokémon!

I’ve had some progress lately and
discovered that Regirock must live\lin that strange rock formation in\lthe Great Desert.

Now if only there were some way to
unseal it\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve spent years trying to uncover the secret of the Regi Pokémon! I’ve had some progress lately and discovered that Regirock must live in that strange rock formation in the Great Desert. Now if only there were some way to unseal it[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ho passato anni cercando di svelare
il segreto dei Pokémon Regi!\lUltimamente ho fatto qualche

progresso e ho scoperto che
Regirock deve vivere in quella\lstrana formazione rocciosa nel

Grande Deserto. Se solo ci fosse un
modo per aprirla\.

entries.original:
"It’s a statue of the Legendary
Rock Pokémon, Regirock.

It says here that in ancient times,
Regirock helped Regigigas form and\lmove together the Borrius Region.

It now dwells somewhere in the
Great Desert."
entries.translation_source: It’s a statue of the Legendary Rock Pokémon, Regirock. It says here that in ancient times, Regirock helped Regigigas form and move together the Borrius Region. It now dwells somewhere in the Great Desert.
entries.translated:
È una statua del Pokémon
Leggendario di tipo Roccia,\lRegirock. Qui dice che

nell{B4}antichità Regirock aiutò
Regigigas a formare e muovere\linsieme la regione di Borrius. Ora

dimora da qualche parte nel Grande
Deserto.

entries.original:
"The desert ends pretty soon after
you leave the town to the south of\lhere.

However, the route itself to
Antisis and Seaport Cities is\lnot as straightforward as you\lwould think\."
entries.translation_source: The desert ends pretty soon after you leave the town to the south of here. However, the route itself to Antisis and Seaport Cities is not as straightforward as you would think[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Il deserto finisce abbastanza
presto dopo che lasci la città a\lsud di qui. Tuttavia, la strada per

le città di Antisis e Seaport non è
così lineare come penseresti\.

entries.original:
"The houses here are based off a
design found in the Unova region.

They’re from some town that boasts
of pottery made from volcanic clay.

There’s actually a maniac here as
well, who’ll buy some kind of relic\lpottery for a high price."
entries.translation_source: The houses here are based off a design found in the Unova region. They’re from some town that boasts of pottery made from volcanic clay. There’s actually a maniac here as well, who’ll buy some kind of relic pottery for a high price.
entries.translated:
Le case qui si basano su un design
trovato nella regione di Unima.\lProvengono da una città famosa per

la ceramica fatta con argilla
vulcanica. Qui c{B4}è anche un maniaco\lche compra un certo tipo di

ceramica-reliquia a un prezzo molto
alto.

entries.original:
"Just your average everyday
warehouse.

Nothing to see here."
entries.translation_source: Just your average everyday warehouse. Nothing to see here.
entries.translated:
Un normale magazzino come tanti.
Non c{B4}è niente da vedere qui.

entries.original:
"Vivill Town

The town filled with light and
prosperity."
entries.translation_source: Vivill Town The town filled with light and prosperity.
entries.translated:
Vivill Town, la città piena di luce
e prosperità.

entries.original: "The door is locked."
entries.translation_source: The door is locked.
entries.translated: La porta è chiusa a chiave.

entries.original:
"Hey there.

\.

What? You want me to say something
interesting?

Fine then\.

I’ve been having trouble with my
brother, lately.

He’s gotten himself in deep with
this gang calling themselves the\l\qoBlack Emboar\qo.

I don’t really know what it’s all
about, but I’m really worried for\lhis safety.

I haven’t spoken with him in days
so I’m afraid something bad has\lhappened to him.

\.

What’s that?

You’d be willing to check up on
him for me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey there. [game-token-1] What? You want me to say something interesting? Fine then[game-token-2] I’ve been having trouble with my brother, lately. He’s gotten himself in deep with this gang calling themselves the [quote-open-3]Black Emboar[quote-open-4]. I don’t really know what it’s all about, but I’m really worried for his safety. I haven’t spoken with him in days so I’m afraid something bad has happened to him. [game-token-5] What’s that? You’d be willing to check up on him for me?
entries.translated:
Ehi. \. Cosa? Vuoi che dica qualcosa
di interessante? Va bene allora\.\lNegli ultimi tempi ho avuto

problemi con mio fratello. Si è
cacciato nei guai con una banda che\lsi fa chiamare \qoBlack Emboar\qo. Non

so davvero di cosa si tratti, ma
sono davvero preoccupato per la sua\lsicurezza. Non parlo con lui da

giorni, quindi temo che gli sia
successo qualcosa di grave. \. Cos{B4}è?\lSaresti disposto a controllare come

sta per me?

entries.original:
"Thank you!

My brother can probably be found
in the northern SES Expressway.

I’d go myself, but I’m too weak of
a trainer.

They say these Black Emboar are
insanely vicious."
entries.translation_source: Thank you! My brother can probably be found in the northern SES Expressway. I’d go myself, but I’m too weak of a trainer. They say these Black Emboar are insanely vicious.
entries.translated:
Grazie! Probabilmente mio fratello
si trova nella SES Expressway\lsettentrionale. Andrei io stesso,

ma sono un Allenatore troppo
debole. Dicono che questi Emboar\lNeri siano incredibilmente feroci.

entries.original: "You’re the one who asked."
entries.translation_source: You’re the one who asked.
entries.translated: Sei tu che l{B4}hai chiesto.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hey! Yeah, you, the little brat
there!

Get over here!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hey! Yeah, you, the little brat there! Get over here!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ehi! Sì, tu, moccioso laggiù! Vieni
qui!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hey! Who said ya can pass through
here?

This place belongs to us, the Black
Emboar!

It’s like our Gym, kid!

So scram! Toddle off home to your
ma, ya little goody-two-shoes punk!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hey! Who said ya can pass through here? This place belongs to us, the Black Emboar! It’s like our Gym, kid! So scram! Toddle off home to your ma, ya little goody-two-shoes punk!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ehi! Chi ha detto che puoi passare
di qui? Questo posto è nostro, i\lBlack Emboar! È quasi come la

nostra Palestra, ragazzino! Quindi
fila! Tornatene a casa da mammà,\lpiccolo moccioso perbenista!

entries.original:
"[blue]Ha! Fine!

Brats like you with a future so
bright\.

Just go on back home and be nice to
your parents.

Don’t forget your baby bottle!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Ha! Fine! Brats like you with a future so bright[game-token-2] Just go on back home and be nice to your parents. Don’t forget your baby bottle!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ha! Va bene! Marmocchi come te con
un futuro così radioso\. Tornatene\lpure a casa e fai il bravo con i

tuoi genitori. E non dimenticare il
tuo biberon!

entries.original:
"[blue]What didja say, ya little creep?

I’ll teach ya to take the Black
Emboar seriously!

I’ll pummel your pretty Pokémon
right down to the ground!

With relish!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What didja say, ya little creep? I’ll teach ya to take the Black Emboar seriously! I’ll pummel your pretty Pokémon right down to the ground! With relish!
entries.translated:
[blue]Che hai detto, piccolo schifoso? Ti
insegnerò a prendere sul serio i\lBlack Emboar! Farò a pezzi i tuoi

bei Pokémon e li stenderò al suolo!
Con gusto!

entries.original:
"[blue]Don’t get all high and mighty
because you beat me!

If you really want to pick a fight
with the Black Emboar,\lgo duke it out with our leader!

He’s somewhere in this tunnel!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Don’t get all high and mighty because you beat me! If you really want to pick a fight with the Black Emboar, go duke it out with our leader! He’s somewhere in this tunnel!
entries.translated:
[blue]Non montarti la testa solo perché
mi hai battuto! Se vuoi davvero\lcercare guai con il Black Emboar,

vai a vedertela con il nostro capo!
È da qualche parte in questo\ltunnel!

entries.original:
"What do you think you’re up to,
brat?

This is the Black Emboar’s ultimate
paradise\.

A little pest like you has no
business here\.

It couldn’t be that you think you
can stand up to me, the head of the\lBlack Emboar?"
entries.translation_source: What do you think you’re up to, brat? This is the Black Emboar’s ultimate paradise[game-token-1] A little pest like you has no business here[game-token-2] It couldn’t be that you think you can stand up to me, the head of the Black Emboar?
entries.translated:
Che credi di fare, moccioso? Questo
è il paradiso supremo del Black\lEmboar\. Un piccolo fastidio come te

non ha niente da fare qui\. Possibile
che tu creda di potermi tener\ltesta, io che sono il capo del

Black Emboar?

entries.original:
"That all you got?

Nah, you got one option left--get
lost!

This is our place, the Black
Emboar.

We got no place else to go, and we
don’t want nobody gettin’ in our\lway."
entries.translation_source: That all you got? Nah, you got one option left--get lost! This is our place, the Black Emboar. We got no place else to go, and we don’t want nobody gettin’ in our way.
entries.translated:
Tutto qui? Nah, ti resta un{B4}opzione
sola: levati di torno! Questo è il\lnostro posto, il Black Emboar. Non

abbiamo nessun altro posto dove
andare, e non vogliamo che nessuno\lci intralci.

entries.original: "The floor here is electrified."
entries.translation_source: The floor here is electrified.
entries.translated: Il pavimento qui è elettrificato.

entries.original: "4F: TM Corner"
entries.translation_source: 4F: TM Corner
entries.translated: 4F: Angolo MT

entries.original:
"Whadya’ want kid?

We’re busy!"
entries.translation_source: Whadya’ want kid? We’re busy!
entries.translated:
Che vuoi, ragazzino? Siamo
occupati!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hey! Who said ya can pass through
here?

This is Black Emboar territory!

Go back from where you came from!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hey! Who said ya can pass through here? This is Black Emboar territory! Go back from where you came from!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ehi! Chi ti ha detto che puoi
passare di qui? Questa è zona dei\lBlack Emboar! Torna da dove sei

venuto!

entries.original:
"Gwa ha ha ha! Bring it!
You’ve got you share of guts, kid!

I’ll show you what the guy who
holds the Black Emboar together can\lreally do!"
entries.translation_source: Gwa ha ha ha! Bring it! You’ve got you share of guts, kid! I’ll show you what the guy who holds the Black Emboar together can really do!
entries.translated:
Gwa ha ha ha! Vieni pure! Hai il
tuo bel coraggio, ragazzo! Ti\lmostrerò cosa sa fare davvero

quello che tiene insieme il Black
Emboar!

entries.original:
"You ain’t half bad, kid\.
I like ya.

Get a loaf of this\.

From now on, our team’s name is
gonna be the Black [player]!

Yeah! We’re taking on your rough
and tough name!

It’s a wilder name for a wilder
team!

The Black [player]!
Gwa ha ha ha! That’s awesome!"
entries.translation_source: You ain’t half bad, kid[game-token-1] I like ya. Get a loaf of this[game-token-2] From now on, our team’s name is gonna be the Black [player-name-3]! Yeah! We’re taking on your rough and tough name! It’s a wilder name for a wilder team! The Black [player-name-4]! Gwa ha ha ha! That’s awesome!
entries.translated:
Non sei affatto male, ragazzino\. Mi
piaci. Ascolta un po{B4}\. Da ora in\lpoi, il nome della nostra squadra

sarà il Black [player]! Sì! Ci
prendiamo il tuo nome rude e tosto!\lÈ un nome più selvaggio per una

squadra più selvaggia! Il Black
[player]! Gwa ha ha ha! È\lfantastico!

entries.original:
"What, you want somethin’ else, kid?

\.

My bro?

Geez, that punk never quits.

It’s time I settled things once and
for all with him\."
entries.translation_source: What, you want somethin’ else, kid? [game-token-1] My bro? Geez, that punk never quits. It’s time I settled things once and for all with him[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Che vuoi ancora, ragazzino? \. Mio
fratello? Accidenti, quel teppista\lnon molla mai. È ora che la faccia

finita una volta per tutte con lui\.

entries.original:
"Leader: [blue]I’ve told you time and
time again, bro, quit tryin’ to\lmess with the Black Emboar!"
entries.translation_source: Leader: [color-blue-1]I’ve told you time and time again, bro, quit tryin’ to mess with the Black Emboar!
entries.translated:
Capo: [blue]Te l{B4}ho detto e ridetto, bro,
smettila di cercare di metterti\lcontro i Black Emboar!

entries.original:
"Brother: [blue]I can’t, James.
You’re my brother.

You mean everything to me.

And I can’t let you go down this
path any longer!"
entries.translation_source: Brother: [color-blue-1]I can’t, James. You’re my brother. You mean everything to me. And I can’t let you go down this path any longer!
entries.translated:
Fratello: [blue]Non posso, James. Sei mio
fratello. Per me sei tutto. E non\lposso lasciarti andare avanti su

questa strada oltre!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]You claim you care about me,
but you ain’t got no guts, bro.

You keep sending these trainers to
harass me ’cause you’re too scared\lto get your own hands dirty."
entries.translation_source: James: [color-blue-1]You claim you care about me, but you ain’t got no guts, bro. You keep sending these trainers to harass me ’cause you’re too scared to get your own hands dirty.
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Sostieni di tenere a me, ma
non hai fegato, amico. Continui a\lmandarmi contro questi Allenatori

perché sei troppo spaventato per
sporcarti le mani tu stesso.

entries.original: "[blue]This kid, [player]’s, got guts!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]This kid, [player-name-2]’s, got guts!
entries.translated:
[blue]Questo ragazzo, [player], ha
fegato!

entries.original:
"[blue]Let me tell ya!

No one has ever wrecked me as good
as he did!

I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar
to the Black [player], after him!

So it’s time for a fresh start.

The Black [player] and I are moving
to Antisis City!

I hear the old gang that used to
run that joint got run outta town.

Now that city is ripe for the
picking by the Black [player]!

Gwa ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Let me tell ya! No one has ever wrecked me as good as he did! I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar to the Black [player-name-2], after him! So it’s time for a fresh start. The Black [player-name-3] and I are moving to Antisis City! I hear the old gang that used to run that joint got run outta town. Now that city is ripe for the picking by the Black [player-name-4]! Gwa ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
[blue]Lascia che te lo dica! Nessuno mi
ha mai demolito come ha fatto lui!\lHo persino rinominato il Black

Emboar in Black [player], in suo
onore! Quindi è tempo di\lricominciare da capo. Il Black

[player] e io ci stiamo trasferendo
ad Antisis City! Ho sentito che la\lvecchia banda che gestiva quel

posto è stata cacciata dalla città.
Ora quella città è pronta per\lessere presa dal Black [player]!

Gwa ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"Brother: [blue]But James, you can’t just
leave me all alone!"
entries.translation_source: Brother: [color-blue-1]But James, you can’t just leave me all alone!
entries.translated:
Fratello: [blue]Ma James, non puoi
semplicemente lasciarmi tutto solo!

entries.original:
"James: [blue]I thought about making you
one of us too, but I can’t have\lsomeone who’s so weak in my gang!

Instead, I’ve decided to let [player]
join our ranks."
entries.translation_source: James: [color-blue-1]I thought about making you one of us too, but I can’t have someone who’s so weak in my gang! Instead, I’ve decided to let [player-name-2] join our ranks.
entries.translated:
James: [blue]Avevo pensato di fare di te
uno di noi, ma non posso avere\lqualcuno così debole nella mia

banda! Invece, ho deciso di far
entrare [player] nei nostri ranghi.

entries.original:
"[blue]Welcome to the Black [player], kid!

All members gotta have a bike so
take this."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Welcome to the Black [player-name-2], kid! All members gotta have a bike so take this.
entries.translated:
[blue]Benvenuto nella Black [player],
ragazzino! Tutti i membri devono\lavere una bici, quindi prendi

questa.

entries.original:
"[blue]Look us up if you ever come by
Antisis City.

We’ll welcome you with open arms."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Look us up if you ever come by Antisis City. We’ll welcome you with open arms.
entries.translated:
[blue]Vieni a trovarci se passi mai da
Antisis City. Ti accoglieremo a\lbraccia aperte.

entries.original:
"[player] received a Bicycle from the
leader of the Black [player]!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received a Bicycle from the leader of the Black [player-name-2]!
entries.translated:
[player] ha ricevuto una Bici dal
capo del Black [player]!

entries.original:
"[blue]Sorry you got caught up in all of
that.

I may have lied when I told you I
hadn’t heard from my brother.

In truth, I knew he was the leader
of the Black Emboar.

I just thought you wouldn’t have
wanted to help if you knew you’d\lbe going up against their leader.

But now he’s gone for good, and I’m
all alone for good\.

Anyways, thank you for helping me.

Please take this TM as my thanks."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Sorry you got caught up in all of that. I may have lied when I told you I hadn’t heard from my brother. In truth, I knew he was the leader of the Black Emboar. I just thought you wouldn’t have wanted to help if you knew you’d be going up against their leader. But now he’s gone for good, and I’m all alone for good[game-token-2] Anyways, thank you for helping me. Please take this TM as my thanks.
entries.translated:
[blue]Scusa se sei rimasto coinvolto in
tutto questo. Potrei averti mentito\lquando ti ho detto che non avevo

più notizie di mio fratello. In
realtà, sapevo che era il capo del\lBlack Emboar. Pensavo solo che non

avresti voluto aiutarmi se avessi
saputo che te la saresti dovuta\lvedere con il loro capo. Ma adesso

se n{B4}è andato per sempre, e anch{B4}io
sono rimasto solo per sempre\. In\logni caso, grazie per avermi

aiutato. Per favore, accetta questa
MT come ringraziamento.

entries.original:
"[player] received the TM98
from the guy!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] received the TM98 from the guy!
entries.translated:
[player] ha ricevuto la MT98 dal
tizio!

entries.original:
"If you ever see my brother again,
please let him know that I’m still\lworried about him."
entries.translation_source: If you ever see my brother again, please let him know that I’m still worried about him.
entries.translated:
Se mai rivedrai mio fratello, per
favore digli che sono ancora in\lpensiero per lui.

entries.original:
"[blue]Let me tell ya!

No one has ever wrecked me as good
as she did!

I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar
to the Black [player], after her!

So it’s time for a fresh start.

The Black [player] and I are moving
to Antisis City!

I hear the old gang that used to
run that joint got run outta town.

Now that city is ripe for the
picking by the Black [player]!

Gwa ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Let me tell ya! No one has ever wrecked me as good as she did! I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar to the Black [player-name-2], after her! So it’s time for a fresh start. The Black [player-name-3] and I are moving to Antisis City! I hear the old gang that used to run that joint got run outta town. Now that city is ripe for the picking by the Black [player-name-4]! Gwa ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
[blue]Lascia che te lo dica! Nessuno mi
ha mai demolito come ha fatto lei!\lHo persino rinominato il Black

Emboar in Black [player], in suo
onore! Quindi è tempo di\lricominciare da capo. Il Black

[player] e io ci stiamo trasferendo
ad Antisis City! Ho sentito che la\lvecchia banda che gestiva quel

posto è stata cacciata dalla città.
Ora quella città è pronta per\lessere presa dal Black [player]!

Gwa ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] rolled off into the
Gym."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] rolled off into the Gym.
entries.translated:
Il [buffer1] è rotolato dentro la
Palestra.

entries.original: "That’s one way to overcome it."
entries.translation_source: That’s one way to overcome it.
entries.translated: Questo è un modo per superarlo.

entries.original:
"If you can beat me, I’ll tell you
what that bulb does!"
entries.translation_source: If you can beat me, I’ll tell you what that bulb does!
entries.translated: Se riesci a battermi, ti dirò a cosa serve quel bulbo!

entries.original: "Now I’ll tell you."
entries.translation_source: Now I’ll tell you.
entries.translated: Adesso te lo dirò.

entries.original:
"Those light bulbs control the flow
of electricity in the Gym.

Turn them on or off, and the flow
of electricity diverts to or from\lthem."
entries.translation_source: Those light bulbs control the flow of electricity in the Gym. Turn them on or off, and the flow of electricity diverts to or from them.
entries.translated:
Quelle lampadine controllano il
flusso di elettricità nella\lPalestra. Accendile o spegnile, e

il flusso di elettricità viene
deviato verso di loro o allontanato\lda loro.

entries.original:
"I’m not paralyzed, but I seem to
be struck by you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not paralyzed, but I seem to be struck by you!
entries.translated:
Non sono paralizzato, ma sembri
avermi colpito!

entries.original:
"Just because you turned a bulb on,
it doesn’t mean you won’t need to\lturn it off later."
entries.translation_source: Just because you turned a bulb on, it doesn’t mean you won’t need to turn it off later.
entries.translated:
Solo perché hai acceso una
lampadina, non significa che poi\lnon dovrai spegnerla più tardi.

entries.original:
"Are you having trouble coping with
the electricity?"
entries.translation_source: Are you having trouble coping with the electricity?
entries.translated: Hai problemi a sopportare l{B4}elettricità?

entries.original: "Seems not!"
entries.translation_source: Seems not!
entries.translated: Pare di no!

entries.original: "Keep on pushing through the pain!"
entries.translation_source: Keep on pushing through the pain!
entries.translated: Continua a resistere al dolore!

entries.original:
"The electrified floor?

I invented it!"
entries.translation_source: The electrified floor? I invented it!
entries.translated: Il pavimento elettrificato? L{B4}ho inventato io!

entries.original: "My genius\."
entries.translation_source: My genius[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sono un genio\.

entries.original:
"Many of the Pokémon in this Gym
benefit from the electrified\lfloor.

Meaning, you’re a disadvantage!"
entries.translation_source: Many of the Pokémon in this Gym benefit from the electrified floor. Meaning, you’re a disadvantage!
entries.translated:
Molti dei Pokémon di questa
Palestra traggono vantaggio dal\lpavimento elettrificato. Quindi tu

sei in svantaggio!

entries.original:
"Galavan loves Electric types, but
he couldn’t leave Steel types out."
entries.translation_source: Galavan loves Electric types, but he couldn’t leave Steel types out.
entries.translated:
Galavan ama i tipi Elettro, ma non
poteva escludere i tipi Acciaio.

entries.original:
"Not only do I get to collect
Electric types, but I also get to\lcollect Steel types!

I love them both!"
entries.translation_source: Not only do I get to collect Electric types, but I also get to collect Steel types! I love them both!
entries.translated:
Non solo posso collezionare i tipi
Elettro, ma posso anche\lcollezionare i tipi Acciaio! Li

adoro entrambi!

entries.original:
"If you can beat the master engineer
of the Dehara Gym, you’re ready to\lface Galavan."
entries.translation_source: If you can beat the master engineer of the Dehara Gym, you’re ready to face Galavan.
entries.translated:
Se riesci a battere il capo
ingegnere della Palestra di Dehara,\lsei pronto ad affrontare Galavan.

entries.original:
"It’s a bulb of some sort.

Would you like to turn it on?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a bulb of some sort. Would you like to turn it on?
entries.translated:
È una specie di lampadina. Vuoi
accenderla?

entries.original:
"It’s a bulb of some sort.

Would you like to turn it off?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a bulb of some sort. Would you like to turn it off?
entries.translated:
È una specie di lampadina. Vuoi
spegnerla?

entries.original:
"As long as the floor is
electrified, no Pokémon on the\lground can fall asleep!"
entries.translation_source: As long as the floor is electrified, no Pokémon on the ground can fall asleep!
entries.translated:
Finché il pavimento è
elettrificato, nessun Pokémon a\lterra può addormentarsi!

entries.original:
"Oh, who might you be?

\.

[player]?

Am I correct in assuming you’re
looking for [rival]?

He came by here a while ago asking
how to get to The Ruins of Void.

I’ll tell you exactly what I told
him.

The only way I’m aware of is by
taking a boat or by or surfing\ldown Route 14.

I’m sorry if that doesn’t help you
much."
entries.translation_source: Oh, who might you be? [game-token-1] [player-name-2]? Am I correct in assuming you’re looking for [text-token-rival-3]? He came by here a while ago asking how to get to The Ruins of Void. I’ll tell you exactly what I told him. The only way I’m aware of is by taking a boat or by or surfing down Route 14. I’m sorry if that doesn’t help you much.
entries.translated:
Oh, chi potresti essere? \. [player]?
Suppongo che tu stia cercando\l[rival]? È passato di qui poco fa

chiedendo come arrivare alle Rovine
del Vuoto. Ti dirò esattamente\lquello che ho detto a lui. L{B4}unico

modo che conosco è prendere una
barca oppure nuotare lungo il\lPercorso 14. Mi dispiace se questo

non ti aiuta molto.

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of Prof. Log?

He’s an old research buddy of mine.

We used to research the history of
Borrius together.

That is until we discovered
something one day that we\lshouldn’t have\.

Ever since then he’s been studying
Pokémon stats and capture rates,\lwhile I sit here retired."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of Prof. Log? He’s an old research buddy of mine. We used to research the history of Borrius together. That is until we discovered something one day that we shouldn’t have[game-token-1] Ever since then he’s been studying Pokémon stats and capture rates, while I sit here retired.
entries.translated:
Hai mai sentito parlare del Prof.
Log? È un vecchio compagno di\lricerche. Un tempo studiavamo

insieme la storia di Borrius. Fino
a quando un giorno non scoprimmo\lqualcosa che non avremmo dovuto\. Da

[green][buffer3]s[blue]. Se trovi per me un\lingrediente gourmet, per favore

"I love the Dehara Department
Store!

I’ve been shopping here since it
opened back in the day!"

entries.translated:
Adoro il Grande Magazzino di
Dehara! Faccio acquisti qui da\lquando ha aperto, anni fa!

"Sigh\.

My wife has insisted I bring her
here ever since this store opened.

Oh!

That’s the sign she just purchased
something with my credit card.

That’s another ten years of my
life, wasted\."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1] My wife has insisted I bring her here ever since this store opened. Oh! That’s the sign she just purchased something with my credit card. That’s another ten years of my life, wasted[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Sigh\. Mia moglie insiste per farmi
portare qui da quando questo\lnegozio ha aperto. Oh! Quello è il

segno che ha appena comprato
qualcosa con la mia carta di\lcredito. Ecco altri dieci anni

della mia vita, sprecati\.
