entries.original:
"This desert hoards mysteries in
its shifting sands!"
entries.translation_source: This desert hoards mysteries in its shifting sands!
entries.translated:
Questo deserto custodisce misteri
nelle sue sabbie mutevoli!

entries.original:
"If they can find fossils in the desert,
it must have been a sea before."
entries.translation_source: If they can find fossils in the desert, it must have been a sea before.
entries.translated:
Se riescono a trovare fossili nel
deserto, deve essere stato un mare\lin passato.

entries.original:
"I smashed rocks with my fists and
found these Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I smashed rocks with my fists and found these Pokémon!
entries.translated: Ho spaccato rocce a pugni e ho trovato questi Pokémon!

entries.original: "I could not smash you."
entries.translation_source: I could not smash you.
entries.translated: Non sono riuscito a schiacciarti.

entries.original:
"Shattering rocks here can yield
valuable rewards!"
entries.translation_source: Shattering rocks here can yield valuable rewards!
entries.translated:
Frantumare le rocce qui può dare
ricompense preziose!

entries.original:
"Because of my efforts, this desert
is like a paradise for Pokémon!

It’s a true desert resort!"
entries.translation_source: Because of my efforts, this desert is like a paradise for Pokémon! It’s a true desert resort!
entries.translated:
Grazie ai miei sforzi, questo
deserto è come un paradiso per i\lPokémon! È un vero resort nel

deserto!

entries.original:
"I’m going to be a real hero one day.
I’m going to work harder to make me\land my POKéMON stronger."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to be a real hero one day. I’m going to work harder to make me and my POKéMON stronger.
entries.translated:
Un giorno diventerò un vero eroe.
Lavorerò più sodo per rendere più\lforti me e i miei POKéMON.

entries.original:
"Hmph.

I really dug myself into a hole,
haven’t I?"
entries.translation_source: Hmph. I really dug myself into a hole, haven’t I?
entries.translated:
Tsk. Mi sono davvero cacciato in un
bel pasticcio, eh?

entries.original:
"ZZZ\.

Huh\.?

Whad’ya want?"
entries.translation_source: ZZZ[game-token-1] Huh[game-token-2]? Whad’ya want?
entries.translated: ZZZ\. Eh\.? Cosa vuoi?

entries.original:
"I lost ’cause I’m still half
asleep."
entries.translation_source: I lost ’cause I’m still half asleep.
entries.translated: Ho perso perché sono ancora mezzo addormentato.

entries.original: "ZZZ\."
entries.translation_source: ZZZ[game-token-1]
entries.translated: ZZZ\.

entries.original:
"This desert’ll always keep me
fired up!"
entries.translation_source: This desert’ll always keep me fired up!
entries.translated:
Questo deserto mi terrà sempre
carico!

entries.original: "Why am I here?"
entries.translation_source: Why am I here?
entries.translated: Perché sono qui?

entries.original: "I can’t jam out in a sandstorm!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t jam out in a sandstorm!
entries.translated: Non posso suonare in mezzo a una tempesta di sabbia!

entries.original:
"I came to play music in the desert,
but sand is getting in my guitar."
entries.translation_source: I came to play music in the desert, but sand is getting in my guitar.
entries.translated:
Sono venuto a suonare musica nel
deserto, ma la sabbia mi entra\lnella chitarra.

entries.original:
"Have you found any fossils lying
around the desert?"
entries.translation_source: Have you found any fossils lying around the desert?
entries.translated: Hai trovato dei fossili in giro per il deserto?

entries.original:
"I hear they can also be found by
smashing rocks."
entries.translation_source: I hear they can also be found by smashing rocks.
entries.translated: Ho sentito che si possono trovare anche rompendo le rocce.

entries.original:
"I want to add some rare fossils to
my collection."
entries.translation_source: I want to add some rare fossils to my collection.
entries.translated:
Voglio aggiungere dei fossili rari
alla mia collezione.

entries.original: "What do you make of these rocks?"
entries.translation_source: What do you make of these rocks?
entries.translated: Cosa ne pensi di queste rocce?

entries.original: "They have to be important."
entries.translation_source: They have to be important.
entries.translated: Devono essere importanti.

entries.original:
"I’m telling you, this rock
formation has significance!

I can feel it!"
entries.translation_source: I’m telling you, this rock formation has significance! I can feel it!
entries.translated:
Ti sto dicendo che questa
formazione rocciosa ha un\lsignificato! Lo sento!

entries.original:
"This desert sure is dangerous.

If you can beat me, I heal you and
help you get through it safely!"
entries.translation_source: This desert sure is dangerous. If you can beat me, I heal you and help you get through it safely!
entries.translated:
Questo deserto è davvero
pericoloso. Se riesci a battermi,\lti guarisco e ti aiuto a

attraversarlo in sicurezza!

entries.original:
"Okay, let’s get you all fixed up!
Just leave it up to me!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, let’s get you all fixed up! Just leave it up to me!
entries.translated:
Va bene, sistemiamo tutto! Lascia
fare a me!

entries.original:
"Be careful of sandstorms as you
explore the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Be careful of sandstorms as you explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Fai attenzione alle tempeste di
sabbia mentre esplori il Grande\lDeserto!

entries.original:
"I’m studying up on how to revive
Pokémon fossils.

Apparently many can be found by
smashing rocks in the [green]Great Desert[red]\land other places around Borrius.

Do you have any you would like me
to revive for you?"
entries.translation_source: I’m studying up on how to revive Pokémon fossils. Apparently many can be found by smashing rocks in the [color-green-1]Great Desert[color-red-2] and other places around Borrius. Do you have any you would like me to revive for you?
entries.translated:
Sto studiando come rianimare i
fossili dei Pokémon. A quanto pare,\lse ne possono trovare molti

frantumando le rocce nel [green]Grande
Deserto[red] e in altri luoghi attorno a\lBorrius. Hai qualche fossile che

vorresti che rianimassi per te?

entries.original:
"\.Huh?

That doesn’t look like a fossil to
me\."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]Huh? That doesn’t look like a fossil to me[game-token-2]
entries.translated: \.Eh? A me non sembra un fossile\.

entries.original:
"That’s [buffer2], a fossil of
[buffer1].

Would you like me to revive it into
[green][buffer1][red], for you?"
entries.translation_source: That’s [buffer2-1], a fossil of [buffer1-2]. Would you like me to revive it into [color-green-3][buffer1-4][color-red-5], for you?
entries.translated:
È [buffer2], un fossile di [buffer1].
Vuoi che lo riporti in vita e lo\ltrasformi in [green][buffer1][red], per te?

entries.original: "Please give me the fossil."
entries.translation_source: Please give me the fossil.
entries.translated: Per favore, dammi il fossile.

entries.original:
"[player] handed over the [buffer2]
to the scientist."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] handed over the [buffer2-2] to the scientist.
entries.translated:
[player] ha consegnato il [buffer2]
allo scienziato.

entries.original:
"It’ll take some time to revive.
Come back later."
entries.translation_source: It’ll take some time to revive. Come back later.
entries.translated:
Ci vorrà un po{B4} per rianimarlo.
Torna più tardi.

entries.original:
"Go out there, smash some rocks, and
get your hands on some fossils!"
entries.translation_source: Go out there, smash some rocks, and get your hands on some fossils!
entries.translated:
Vai là fuori, spacca qualche roccia
e mettiti in tasca un po{B4} di\lfossili!

entries.original:
"I see\.

I’ll be here if you ever want to
revive it."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1] I’ll be here if you ever want to revive it.
entries.translated:
Capisco\. Sarò qui se vorrai mai
rianimarlo.

entries.original:
"Welcome back!

I’ve successfully revived your
fossil into a healthy [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: Welcome back! I’ve successfully revived your fossil into a healthy [buffer1-1]!
entries.translated:
Bentornato! Ho riportato in vita il
tuo fossile trasformandolo con\lsuccesso in un sano [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"They say that long ago Regirock
assisted in the construction of\lthis town.

But once the town had been built,
it disappeared into the desert,\lnever to be seen again."
entries.translation_source: They say that long ago Regirock assisted in the construction of this town. But once the town had been built, it disappeared into the desert, never to be seen again.
entries.translated:
Si dice che molto tempo fa Regirock
abbia aiutato nella costruzione di\lquesta città. Ma una volta

terminata la città, scomparve nel
deserto, per non essere mai più\lrivisto.

entries.original:
"We used to have a festival every
year to commemorate when Regirock\lfinished building this town.

But interest in it has sort of
just faded away in recent years.

No one really wants to come here
anymore so we stopped having it."
entries.translation_source: We used to have a festival every year to commemorate when Regirock finished building this town. But interest in it has sort of just faded away in recent years. No one really wants to come here anymore so we stopped having it.
entries.translated:
Un tempo avevamo un festival ogni
anno per commemorare il giorno in\lcui Regirock finì di costruire

questa città. Ma l{B4}interesse per la
cosa è andato un po{B4} svanendo negli\lultimi anni. Ormai nessuno vuole

davvero più venire qui, quindi
abbiamo smesso di farlo.

entries.original:
"One of these days you’re going to
need to cross the ocean.

When that day comes, you’ll need a
Pokémon to take you across the\lwaters.

I’ve had this Lapras for many
years, but it’s finally time for me\lto retire from a life of fishing.

Please, take it for me, and allow
it to keep swimming."
entries.translation_source: One of these days you’re going to need to cross the ocean. When that day comes, you’ll need a Pokémon to take you across the waters. I’ve had this Lapras for many years, but it’s finally time for me to retire from a life of fishing. Please, take it for me, and allow it to keep swimming.
entries.translated:
Un giorno o l{B4}altro dovrai
attraversare l{B4}oceano. Quando\larriverà quel giorno, ti servirà un

Pokémon che ti porti attraverso le
acque. Ho avuto questo Lapras per\lmolti anni, ma finalmente è giunto

il momento per me di ritirarmi da
una vita da pescatore. Ti prego,\lprendilo con te e lascialo

continuare a nuotare.

entries.original:
"But my poor Lapras\.
How will it swim?"
entries.translation_source: But my poor Lapras[game-token-1] How will it swim?
entries.translated:
Ma il mio povero Lapras\. Come farà a
nuotare?

entries.original:
"Ohhhhhhhhhhhh yeahhhhhhhhh!

Now that I’ve gotten rid of that
dead weight, it’s finally time to\lparty in East Borrius!

See you around kid!"
entries.translation_source: Ohhhhhhhhhhhh yeahhhhhhhhh! Now that I’ve gotten rid of that dead weight, it’s finally time to party in East Borrius! See you around kid!
entries.translated:
Ooooooooh sìììììììì! Ora che mi
sono sbarazzato di quel peso morto,\lè finalmente il momento di far

festa a Borrius Est! Ci si vede in
giro, ragazzino!

entries.original:
"Oh no.

You don’t have any space in your
party for my Lapras.

Hurry up and make space so I can
give it to you."
entries.translation_source: Oh no. You don’t have any space in your party for my Lapras. Hurry up and make space so I can give it to you.
entries.translated:
Oh no. Non hai spazio nella tua
squadra per il mio Lapras. Sbrigati\la fare spazio così posso dartelo.

entries.original:
"Hey, you.

I have a favour to ask you.

I’m an enthusiast.

A lover of hard things if I say so
myself.

A fellow enthusiast of mine lives
in Dehara City, but unlike him, I’m\lnot interested in buying anything\loff of you.

I just want you to collect
[green]5 Hard Stones [blue]for me.

You down?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, you. I have a favour to ask you. I’m an enthusiast. A lover of hard things if I say so myself. A fellow enthusiast of mine lives in Dehara City, but unlike him, I’m not interested in buying anything off of you. I just want you to collect [color-green-1]5 Hard Stones [color-blue-2]for me. You down?
entries.translated:
Ehi, tu. Ho un favore da chiederti.
Sono un appassionato. Un amante\ldelle cose dure, se posso dirlo io.

Un mio collega appassionato vive a
Dehara City, ma a differenza di\llui, non sono interessato a

comprarti nulla. Voglio solo che tu
raccolga [green]5 Pietradura [blue]per me. Ti\lva?

entries.original:
"I’ll have to send someone else
to do it for me, then."
entries.translation_source: I’ll have to send someone else to do it for me, then.
entries.translated:
Dovrò mandare qualcun altro a farlo
per me, allora.

entries.original:
"Great.

[green]Hard Stones [blue]occasionally appear
when you smash rocks in the\l[green]Great Desert[blue].

Find 5 and bring them to me
please."
entries.translation_source: Great. [color-green-1]Hard Stones [color-blue-2]occasionally appear when you smash rocks in the [color-green-3]Great Desert[color-blue-4]. Find 5 and bring them to me please.
entries.translated:
Perfetto. [green]Le Pietre Dure [blue]a volte
compaiono quando rompi le rocce nel\l[green]Grande Deserto[blue]. Trovane 5 e

portamele, per favore.

entries.original:
"Nice, you got them.

Let me take them from you."
entries.translation_source: Nice, you got them. Let me take them from you.
entries.translated:
Bene, li hai presi. Lasciami
prenderli da te.

entries.original: "The guy took [green]5 Hard Stones[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The guy took [color-green-1]5 Hard Stones[color-blue-2].
entries.translated: Quel tizio ha preso [green]5 Pietradura[blue].

entries.original:
"Oh, I assume you want something as
a reward, right?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I assume you want something as a reward, right?
entries.translated:
Oh, suppongo che tu voglia qualcosa
come ricompensa, giusto?

entries.original:
"You need more space if you want
this from me."
entries.translation_source: You need more space if you want this from me.
entries.translated:
Ti serve più spazio se vuoi questo
da me.

entries.original:
"You should give that [green]Pearl String
[blue]to my fellow enthusiast in [green]Dehara\lCity[blue].

He’ll pay a good deal of money for
it."
entries.translation_source: You should give that [color-green-1]Pearl String [color-blue-2]to my fellow enthusiast in [color-green-3]Dehara City[color-blue-4]. He’ll pay a good deal of money for it.
entries.translated:
Dovresti dare quella [green]Collana di
Perle [blue]al mio collega appassionato a\l[green]Dehara City[blue]. Ti pagherà una bella

somma per averla.

entries.original:
"Why are there no Ghost Pokémon
here?"
entries.translation_source: Why are there no Ghost Pokémon here?
entries.translated:
Perché qui non ci sono Pokémon
Spettro?

entries.original: "Am I going the right way?"
entries.translation_source: Am I going the right way?
entries.translated: Sto andando nella direzione giusta?

entries.original: "I must be\."
entries.translation_source: I must be[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Devo esserlo\.

entries.original: "How do I get out of here?"
entries.translation_source: How do I get out of here?
entries.translated: Come faccio a uscire di qui?

entries.original:
"I thought I had the ultimate
swarm\."
entries.translation_source: I thought I had the ultimate swarm[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Pensavo di avere lo sciame
definitivo\.

entries.original:
"You should search the mushrooms on
the ground."
entries.translation_source: You should search the mushrooms on the ground.
entries.translated: Dovresti cercare i funghi a terra.

entries.original:
"I came from Vivill Town.

For some reason its been raining a
lot there, lately."
entries.translation_source: I came from Vivill Town. For some reason its been raining a lot there, lately.
entries.translated:
Sono venuto da Vivill Town. Per
qualche motivo, ultimamente lì\lpiove molto.

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] scurried off into the
forest."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] scurried off into the forest.
entries.translated: [buffer1] si è infilato nel bosco.

entries.original:
"Vivill Woods

\au Vivill Town
\ad Gurun Town"
entries.translation_source: Vivill Woods [game-token-1] Vivill Town [game-token-2] Gurun Town
entries.translated:
Bosco di Vivill \au Vivill Town \ad
Gurun Town

entries.original:
"People used to be afraid to
leave their homes because of\lthat cloaked gang."
entries.translation_source: People used to be afraid to leave their homes because of that cloaked gang.
entries.translated:
Un tempo la gente aveva paura di
uscire di casa a causa di quella\lbanda incappucciata.

entries.original:
"Ever since the cloaked gang left
town, the sun has started shining\land the flowers are blooming again!"
entries.translation_source: Ever since the cloaked gang left town, the sun has started shining and the flowers are blooming again!
entries.translated:
Da quando la banda incappucciata ha
lasciato la città, il sole ha\lricominciato a splendere e i fiori

sono tornati a sbocciare!

entries.original:
"The sea\.

Watching the waves is so calming,
isn’t it?"
entries.translation_source: The sea[game-token-1] Watching the waves is so calming, isn’t it?
entries.translated:
Il mare\. Guardare le onde è così
rilassante, vero?

entries.original:
"I knew you’d agree with me!

Tell you what.

If you can defeat me in a battle by
the sea, I’ll let you have one of\lmy prized Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I knew you’d agree with me! Tell you what. If you can defeat me in a battle by the sea, I’ll let you have one of my prized Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Lo sapevo che avresti concordato
con me! Ti propongo questo. Se\lriesci a sconfiggermi in una

battaglia in riva al mare, ti
lascerò uno dei miei preziosi\lPokémon!

entries.original:
"You’ve made my day!

Please, take my prized Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve made my day! Please, take my prized Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Mi hai rallegrato la giornata! Per
favore, prendi il mio Pokémon più\lprezioso!

entries.original:
"You received a Ditto from the
Ace Trainer!"
entries.translation_source: You received a Ditto from the Ace Trainer!
entries.translated: Hai ricevuto un Ditto dall{B4}Allenatore Esperto!

entries.original:
"Please, let that Pokémon transform
your world."
entries.translation_source: Please, let that Pokémon transform your world.
entries.translated:
Ti prego, lascia che quel Pokémon
trasformi il tuo mondo.

entries.original:
"I see\.

That is unfortunate."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1] That is unfortunate.
entries.translated: Capisco\. È un peccato.

entries.original:
"If you want my prized Pokémon,
you’ll need to make room for it\lin your party first."
entries.translation_source: If you want my prized Pokémon, you’ll need to make room for it in your party first.
entries.translated:
Se vuoi il mio Pokémon prezioso,
dovrai prima fargli spazio nella\ltua squadra.

entries.original:
"Route 14

\au Route 13\l\al Route 6, Ruins of Void\l\ar Route 12"

entries.translated:
Percorso 14 \au Percorso 13 \al
Percorso 6, Rovine del Vuoto \ar\lPercorso 12

"Route 14

h7B Route 6\l\ar Ruins of Void, Route 12"
entries.translation_source: Route 14 h7B Route 6 [game-token-1] Ruins of Void, Route 12
entries.translated:
Percorso 14 h7B Percorso 6 \ar Ruins
of Void, Percorso 12

entries.original:
"With my fists, I am trying to
smash this rock that continuously\lreappears under my umbrella.

Aiyah!

But it is not working\."
entries.translation_source: With my fists, I am trying to smash this rock that continuously reappears under my umbrella. Aiyah! But it is not working[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Con i miei pugni sto cercando di
spaccare questa roccia che continua\la riapparire sotto il mio ombrello.

Aiyah! Ma non funziona\.

entries.original: "Aiyah! You smashed it!"
entries.translation_source: Aiyah! You smashed it!
entries.translated: Aiyah! L{B4}hai distrutto!

entries.original:
"I sunbathe here every day to
attract the attention of random men\lso I can feel good about myself."
entries.translation_source: I sunbathe here every day to attract the attention of random men so I can feel good about myself.
entries.translated:
Prendo il sole qui ogni giorno per
attirare l{B4}attenzione di uomini a\lcaso, così posso sentirmi bene con

me stessa.

entries.original:
"Scientist: [blue]What the\.?

Where did this kid come from?"
entries.translation_source: Scientist: [color-blue-1]What the[game-token-2]? Where did this kid come from?
entries.translated:
Scienziato: [blue]Che diavolo\.? Da dove è
spuntato questo ragazzino?

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Quick, scientist!

What are you standing around for?

Grab him!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Quick, scientist! What are you standing around for? Grab him!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Presto, scienziato! Che ci
stai a fare lì impalato? Prendilo!

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Quick, scientist!

What are you standing around for?

Grab her!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Quick, scientist! What are you standing around for? Grab her!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Presto, scienziato! Che ci
stai a fare lì impalato? Prendila!

entries.original:
"Now knock him out and lock him
up in the warehouse!

The boss is going to freak when he
hears about this\."
entries.translation_source: Now knock him out and lock him up in the warehouse! The boss is going to freak when he hears about this[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ora mettilo KO e rinchiudilo nel
magazzino! Il capo andrà fuori di\ltesta quando sentirà questa storia\.

entries.original:
"Now knock her out and lock her
up in the warehouse!

The boss is going to freak when
he hears about this\."
entries.translation_source: Now knock her out and lock her up in the warehouse! The boss is going to freak when he hears about this[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ora mettila KO e rinchiudila nel
magazzino! Il capo andrà fuori di\ltesta quando sentirà questa storia\.

entries.original:
"Route 4

\al Grim Woods, Cinder Volcano
Route 5\l\ar Dresco Town\l\ad Route 13"
entries.translation_source: Route 4 [game-token-1] Grim Woods, Cinder Volcano Route 5 [game-token-2] Dresco Town [game-token-3] Route 13
entries.translated:
Percorso 4 \al Grim Woods, Cinder
Volcano Percorso 5 \ar Dresco Town \ad\lPercorso 13

entries.original:
"What do you think you’re doing?

You can’t go explore the Great
Desert dressed like that!

If you don’t get the proper
eyewear, I won’t be able to let\lyou through."
entries.translation_source: What do you think you’re doing? You can’t go explore the Great Desert dressed like that! If you don’t get the proper eyewear, I won’t be able to let you through.
entries.translated:
Che cosa credi di stare facendo?
Non puoi andare a esplorare il\lGrande Deserto vestito così! Se non

ti procuri l{B4}occhialeria adatta,
non potrò lasciarti passare.

entries.original:
"Whenever I stand here, I can see
really cool things!

It’s like the water goes into the
trees!"
entries.translation_source: Whenever I stand here, I can see really cool things! It’s like the water goes into the trees!
entries.translated:
Ogni volta che sto qui, vedo cose
davvero fantastiche! È come se\ll{B4}acqua entrasse negli alberi!

entries.original:
"My big sister tries to avoid saying
bad words as much as possible.

But instead she just says things
like \qofeces\qc and \qoTauros waste\qc.

So I dunno if it’s any better than
just saying the real things\.

Now when I grow big, I’m going to
say those dumb things too!"
entries.translation_source: My big sister tries to avoid saying bad words as much as possible. But instead she just says things like [quote-open-1]feces[quote-close-2] and [quote-open-3]Tauros waste[quote-close-4]. So I dunno if it’s any better than just saying the real things[game-token-5] Now when I grow big, I’m going to say those dumb things too!
entries.translated:
Mia sorella maggiore cerca di
evitare di dire parolacce il più\lpossibile. Ma invece dice solo cose

come \qofeci\qc e \qolettame di Tauros\qc.
Quindi non so se sia davvero meglio\lche dire le cose vere\. Quando sarò

grande anch{B4}io dirò quelle
sciocchezze!

entries.original: "Nice of you to finally make it."
entries.translation_source: Nice of you to finally make it.
entries.translated:
Che gentile da parte tua essere
finalmente arrivato.

entries.original:
"While you were taking your time, I
tried scouting out the area to\llook for The Shadows, but so far\lI’ve had no luck."
entries.translation_source: While you were taking your time, I tried scouting out the area to look for The Shadows, but so far I’ve had no luck.
entries.translated:
Mentre perdevi tempo, ho provato a
perlustrare la zona per cercare The\lShadows, ma finora non ho avuto

alcuna fortuna.

entries.original:
"And it’s not like there’s even
anyone to ask.

This town is practically deserted\.

I’ve only seen one guy in a cloak
standing by a warehouse on the\lnorth end of town, but that’s it."
entries.translation_source: And it’s not like there’s even anyone to ask. This town is practically deserted[game-token-1] I’ve only seen one guy in a cloak standing by a warehouse on the north end of town, but that’s it.
entries.translated:
E non è che ci sia neppure qualcuno
da chiedere. Questa città è\lpraticamente deserta\. Ho visto solo

un tizio in un mantello, fermo
vicino a un magazzino all{B4}estremità\lnord della città, ma basta così.

entries.original:
"I’m going to head on up there.

Whoever that guy is, he’s going to
give us some answers.

Meet me there. But this time, don’t
take too long."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to head on up there. Whoever that guy is, he’s going to give us some answers. Meet me there. But this time, don’t take too long.
entries.translated:
Vado a salire lassù. Chiunque sia
quel tizio, ci darà delle risposte.\lRaggiungimi lì. Ma stavolta, non

metterci troppo.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Looks like you couldn’t
keep your balance\.

Heh, I told you we’d find a way in!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]Looks like you couldn’t keep your balance[game-token-3] Heh, I told you we’d find a way in!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Sembra che tu non sia
riuscito a mantenere l{B4}equilibrio\.\lHeh, ti avevo detto che avremmo

trovato un modo per entrare!

entries.original:
"[blue]What?

He had it coming to him."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What? He had it coming to him.
entries.translated: [blue]Cosa? Se l{B4}è meritato.

entries.original:
"[blue]Quick, let’s head inside while he’s
still unconcious."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Quick, let’s head inside while he’s still unconcious.
entries.translated:
[blue]Presto, entriamo mentre è ancora
incosciente.

entries.original:
"[blue]Man\.

What an entrance\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Man[game-token-2] What an entrance[game-token-3]
entries.translated: [blue]Accidenti\. Che entrata\.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]You, thug!

What are you doing here?"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]You, thug! What are you doing here?
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Ehi, teppista! Che ci fai
qui?

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]Standing guard against the
likes of you.

Véga told me to make sure no one,
especially [player], goes inside.

There’s an impending attack, so it
was only a matter of time before\lsomeone tried barging past me.

But I have to say, I expected more
of a fighting force."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Standing guard against the likes of you. Véga told me to make sure no one, especially [player-name-2], goes inside. There’s an impending attack, so it was only a matter of time before someone tried barging past me. But I have to say, I expected more of a fighting force.
entries.translated:
Recluta: [blue]Faccio la guardia contro
gente come te. Véga mi ha detto di\lassicurarmi che nessuno,

soprattutto [player], entri dentro.
C{B4}è un attacco imminente, quindi\lera solo questione di tempo prima

che qualcuno provasse a farsi largo
a forza. Però devo dire che mi\laspettavo una forza d{B4}attacco più

agguerrita.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]If you think this is the
full force, you’re sorely mistaken.

Just wait, any minute now,
The Shadows will show up and blow\lyou out of the way!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]If you think this is the full force, you’re sorely mistaken. Just wait, any minute now, The Shadows will show up and blow you out of the way!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Se pensi che questa sia
tutta la nostra forza, ti sbagli di\lgrosso. Aspetta e vedrai: da un

momento all{B4}altro, The Shadows
arriveranno e ti spazzeranno via!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]Heh, thanks for confirming our
suspicions about the Shadows.

But that doesn’t really matter
either way.

Even if someone did get past
me, our security measures our\limpenetrable.

Beyond this one entrance, are rows
and rows of other grunts, ready to\lkill anyone who tries to break in!

So chew on that you arrogant little
dunce."
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Heh, thanks for confirming our suspicions about the Shadows. But that doesn’t really matter either way. Even if someone did get past me, our security measures our impenetrable. Beyond this one entrance, are rows and rows of other grunts, ready to kill anyone who tries to break in! So chew on that you arrogant little dunce.
entries.translated:
Recluta: [blue]Heh, grazie per aver
confermato i nostri sospetti sulle\lOmbre. Ma non ha molta importanza

in ogni caso. Anche se qualcuno
riuscisse a superarmi, le nostre\lmisure di sicurezza sono

impenetrabili. Oltre questo singolo
ingresso, ci sono file e file di\laltre reclute, pronte a uccidere

chiunque cerchi di entrare! Quindi
pensaci, arrogante piccolo sciocco.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Then I’ll just have to
destroy them all myself!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]Then I’ll just have to destroy them all myself!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Allora dovrò distruggerli
tutti da solo!

entries.original:
"[blue]We don’t have much time, [player].

That grunt I knocked out could
come to any minute now.

We need to get moving.

The only thing is\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]We don’t have much time, [player-name-2]. That grunt I knocked out could come to any minute now. We need to get moving. The only thing is[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[blue]Non abbiamo molto tempo, [player].
Quel recluta che ho messo KO\lpotrebbe riprendere i sensi da un

momento all{B4}altro. Dobbiamo
muoverci. L{B4}unico problema è\.

entries.original:
"[blue]There’s that security door in the
way\.

Not to mention those grunts on the
other side don’t look so keen on\lletting us through without a fight."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]There’s that security door in the way[game-token-2] Not to mention those grunts on the other side don’t look so keen on letting us through without a fight.
entries.translated:
[blue]C{B4}è quella porta di sicurezza di
mezzo\. Senza contare che i grunt\ldall{B4}altra parte non sembrano

troppo disposti a lasciarci passare
senza combattere.

entries.original:
"[blue]What do you think we should we do
[player]?

Do you think we should just knock
that door down with our Pokémon\land take them all out?

Or should we try to scale the cliff
and use the Shadows’ entrance?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What do you think we should we do [player-name-2]? Do you think we should just knock that door down with our Pokémon and take them all out? Or should we try to scale the cliff and use the Shadows’ entrance?
entries.translated:
[blue]Cosa pensi che dovremmo fare
[player]? Pensi che dovremmo\lsemplicemente sfondare quella porta

con i nostri Pokémon e mandarli
tutti KO? Oppure dovremmo provare a\lscalare la scogliera e usare

l{B4}ingresso delle Shadows?

entries.original: "What do you want to do?"
entries.translation_source: What do you want to do?
entries.translated: Cosa vuoi fare?

entries.original: "Knock ’em down!"
entries.translation_source: Knock ’em down!
entries.translated: Mettili al tappeto!

entries.original: "Scale the cliff!"
entries.translation_source: Scale the cliff!
entries.translated: Arrampicati sulla scogliera!

entries.original:
"[blue]I completely agree with you,
[player].

Let’s knock ’em down!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I completely agree with you, [player-name-2]. Let’s knock ’em down!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sono completamente d{B4}accordo con
te, [player]. Abbattiamoli!

entries.original:
"[blue]I’m not a huge fan of that idea,
[player].

It would take a lot more effort
just to climb down the cliff.

And besides, we’ll miss all of the
action if we do that!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I’m not a huge fan of that idea, [player-name-2]. It would take a lot more effort just to climb down the cliff. And besides, we’ll miss all of the action if we do that!
entries.translated:
[blue]Non mi piace molto quest{B4}idea,
[player]. Ci vorrebbe molto più\limpegno solo per scendere dalla

scogliera. E poi, se lo facciamo,
ci perderemmo tutta l{B4}azione!

entries.original:
"Grunt 1: [blue]What the\.

Is that a Shadow Warrior!?"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [color-blue-1]What the[game-token-2] Is that a Shadow Warrior!?
entries.translated:
Grunt 1: [blue]Che di\. È un Guerriero
Ombra!?

entries.original: "Grunt 2: [red]Let’s get out of here!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 2: [color-red-1]Let’s get out of here!
entries.translated: Recluta 2: [red]Andiamocene da qui!

entries.original:
"Grunt 4: [blue]No, no, no!
This can’t be how I go!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 4: [color-blue-1]No, no, no! This can’t be how I go!
entries.translated: Recluta 4: [blue]No, no, no! Non può finire così per me!

entries.original:
"Grunt 4: [blue]Wait! No, Please!

I have a family, a wife, a baby
girl\.

I need to live for them!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 4: [color-blue-1]Wait! No, Please! I have a family, a wife, a baby girl[game-token-2] I need to live for them!
entries.translated:
Recluta 4: [blue]Aspetta! No, per favore!
Ho una famiglia, una moglie, una\lbambina\. Devo vivere per loro!

entries.original: "[rival]: [blue]What are these things?"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]What are these things?
entries.translated: [rival]: [blue]Che sono queste cose?

entries.original:
"[blue]Do something, [player]!

Can’t you talk to it or something?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Do something, [player-name-2]! Can’t you talk to it or something?
entries.translated:
[blue]Fai qualcosa, [player]! Non puoi
parlarci o qualcosa del genere?

entries.original:
"[blue]That was a close one, [player].

A few more seconds and we both
could have been burnt to a crisp!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]That was a close one, [player-name-2]. A few more seconds and we both could have been burnt to a crisp!
entries.translated:
[blue]È andata male, [player]. Ancora
qualche secondo e saremmo potuti\lfinire entrambi arsi vivi!

entries.original:
"[blue]Now that the path has been
cleared, let’s head down.

Hopefully we can avoid more of
those\.things\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Now that the path has been cleared, let’s head down. Hopefully we can avoid more of those[game-token-2]things[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[blue]Ora che il passaggio è stato
sgomberato, scendiamo. Speriamo di\levitare ancora quei\.cosi\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I don’t know how you got past all
of the guards, but I’m still not\lgoing to let you head downstairs!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I don’t know how you got past all of the guards, but I’m still not going to let you head downstairs!
entries.translated:
[blue]Non so come tu abbia superato tutte
le guardie, ma non ti lascerò\lcomunque scendere al piano di

sotto!

entries.original:
"[blue]I don’t really care about stopping
you anyways.

It’s your friend who needs to pay
for what he did to me!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I don’t really care about stopping you anyways. It’s your friend who needs to pay for what he did to me!
entries.translated:
[blue]Non mi importa davvero nemmeno di
fermarti. È il tuo amico che deve\lpagare per quello che mi ha fatto!

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Next time, don’t try to
mess with someone you can’t beat."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]Next time, don’t try to mess with someone you can’t beat.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]La prossima volta, non
provare a metterti con qualcuno che\lnon puoi battere.

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]Why you\.

I’ll be back!

You may have lucked out this time,
but once I get reinforcements,\lyou’ll be toast!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]Why you[game-token-2] I’ll be back! You may have lucked out this time, but once I get reinforcements, you’ll be toast!
entries.translated:
Recluta: [blue]Perché, tu\. Tornerò! Questa
volta ti è andata bene, ma quando\lavrò i rinforzi, sarai fritto!

entries.original:
"[blue]Heh, there wasn’t a chance in the
world that he could beat me.

Maybe if he had those \qorows and
rows\qo of grunts to back him up.

But solo? Nah!

Speaking of, what do you think
happened to those grunts?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Heh, there wasn’t a chance in the world that he could beat me. Maybe if he had those [quote-open-2]rows and rows[quote-open-3] of grunts to back him up. But solo? Nah! Speaking of, what do you think happened to those grunts?
entries.translated:
[blue]Eh, non c{B4}era la minima possibilità
al mondo che potesse battermi.\lForse se avesse avuto tutti quei

\qofila su fila\qo di reclute a dargli
man forte. Ma da solo? Nah! A\lproposito, secondo te che fine

hanno fatto quelle reclute?

entries.original: "              Earlier "
entries.translation_source: Earlier
entries.translated: Prima

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]This is your Admin, Véga,
speaking.

I’ll be monitoring the situation
from the command room.

All grunts, stand firm!

Once The Shadows break through the
door, annihilate them!

Their manpower is severely limited,
and we heavily outnumber them.

They stand no chance!

Envelop them in the Light of Ruin!"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]This is your Admin, Véga, speaking. I’ll be monitoring the situation from the command room. All grunts, stand firm! Once The Shadows break through the door, annihilate them! Their manpower is severely limited, and we heavily outnumber them. They stand no chance! Envelop them in the Light of Ruin!
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Parla il vostro Admin, Véga.
Monitorerò la situazione dalla sala\ldi comando. Tutti i reclute,

resistete! Una volta che The
Shadows sfonderanno la porta,\lannientateli! Le loro forze sono

gravemente limitate, e li superiamo
di gran lunga in numero. Non hanno\lalcuna possibilità! Avvolgeteli

nella Luce della Rovina!

entries.original:
"Grunt 1: [blue]The shaking is over\.

[black]Grunt 2: [red]Does this mean they’re
in?

[black]Grunt 3: [blue]Get ready everyone,
they’re coming down the stairs!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt 1: [color-blue-1]The shaking is over[game-token-2] [color-black-3]Grunt 2: [color-red-4]Does this mean they’re in? [color-black-5]Grunt 3: [color-blue-6]Get ready everyone, they’re coming down the stairs!
entries.translated: Grunt 1: [blue]Il tremore è finito\. [black]Grunt 2: [red]Vuol dire che sono dentro? [black]Grunt 3: [blue]Preparatevi tutti, stanno scendendo le scale!

entries.original: "             Currently"
entries.translation_source: Currently
entries.translated: Attualmente

entries.original:
"[blue]Well whatever happened to them,
it’s a good thing it did."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Well whatever happened to them, it’s a good thing it did.
entries.translated:
[blue]Beh, qualunque cosa sia successa
loro, è un bene che sia successa.

entries.original:
"[blue]I think we should split up [player].

Let’s find the Shadows so they can
tell us what the end game is."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I think we should split up [player-name-2]. Let’s find the Shadows so they can tell us what the end game is.
entries.translated:
[blue]Penso che dovremmo dividerci,
[player]. Troviamo gli Shadows così\lpotranno dirci qual è il loro piano

finale.

entries.original: "[red]Floette! Use Petal Blizzard!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Floette! Use Petal Blizzard!
entries.translated: [red]Floette! Usa Tempesta di petali!

entries.original: "[blue]Floette! Use Petal Blizzard!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Floette! Use Petal Blizzard!
entries.translated: [blue]Floette! Usa Tempesta di Petali!

entries.original: "[blue]Floette! Use Petal Blizzard!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Floette! Use Petal Blizzard!
entries.translated: [blue]Floette! Usa Tempesta di Petali!

entries.original: "Floette: [red]Flo!"
entries.translation_source: Floette: [color-red-1]Flo!
entries.translated: Floette: [red]Flo!

entries.original:
"We’re responsible for maintaining
the power grid.

If it were to go offline, all of
the warp panels would stop working\land everyone would be trapped."
entries.translation_source: We’re responsible for maintaining the power grid. If it were to go offline, all of the warp panels would stop working and everyone would be trapped.
entries.translated:
Siamo responsabili della
manutenzione della rete elettrica.\lSe dovesse andare offline, tutti i

pannelli warp smetterebbero di
funzionare e tutti resterebbero\lintrappolati.

entries.original:
"If one of those creatures detroys
the power grid, we’ll be doomed!

They’ll be no escape for any of us!"
entries.translation_source: If one of those creatures detroys the power grid, we’ll be doomed! They’ll be no escape for any of us!
entries.translated:
Se una di quelle creature distrugge
la rete elettrica, saremo perduti!\lNon ci sarà alcuna via di fuga per

nessuno di noi!

entries.original:
"No!

I’m too young to die!

\.

Oh, wait.
You’re not a Shadow Warrior.

Those things have overrun the base,
killing everyone they see.

If you’re not one of them, I have
no fears about taking you down!"
entries.translation_source: No! I’m too young to die! [game-token-1] Oh, wait. You’re not a Shadow Warrior. Those things have overrun the base, killing everyone they see. If you’re not one of them, I have no fears about taking you down!
entries.translated:
No! Sono troppo giovane per morire!
\. Oh, aspetta. Non sei un Guerriero\lOmbra. Quelle cose hanno invaso la

base, uccidendo tutti quelli che
vedono. Se non sei uno di loro, non\lho alcun timore di metterti al

tappeto!

entries.original:
"If I can’t beat you, there’s no way
I could beat a Shadow Warrior.

But maybe Véga can\.

I’d get him from the command
centre, but I only know the first\lletter of the password to open the\ldoor.

I’m going to need more than just [green]A
[blue]if I want to open it."
entries.translation_source: If I can’t beat you, there’s no way I could beat a Shadow Warrior. But maybe Véga can[game-token-1] I’d get him from the command centre, but I only know the first letter of the password to open the door. I’m going to need more than just [color-green-2]A [color-blue-3]if I want to open it.
entries.translated:
Se non riesco a batterti, non c{B4}è
modo che io possa battere un\lGuerriero Ombra. Ma forse Véga può\.

Mi farei portare dal centro di
comando, ma conosco solo la prima\llettera della password per aprire

la porta. Mi servirà più di una
sola [green]A [blue] se voglio aprirla.

entries.original:
"The Shadow Warrior is currently in
battle with a Floette.

Would you like to remove its
cloak?"
entries.translation_source: The Shadow Warrior is currently in battle with a Floette. Would you like to remove its cloak?
entries.translated:
Il Guerriero dell{B4}Ombra è
attualmente in lotta con una\lFloette. Vuoi rimuovere il suo

mantello?

entries.original:
"You removed the cloak from the
Shadow Warrior."
entries.translation_source: You removed the cloak from the Shadow Warrior.
entries.translated: Hai tolto il mantello al Guerriero Ombra.

entries.original:
"[blue]You just destroyed the Shadow
Warrior by removing its cloak!

The only way you could’ve known how
to defeat it so easily, is if you\lwere in league with The Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You just destroyed the Shadow Warrior by removing its cloak! The only way you could’ve known how to defeat it so easily, is if you were in league with The Shadows!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hai appena distrutto il Guerriero
Oscuro togliendogli il mantello!\lL{B4}unico modo in cui avresti potuto

sapere come sconfiggerlo così
facilmente è se fossi in combutta\lcon le Ombre!

entries.original:
"[blue]And if you’re in league with the
Shadows, then I must defeat you!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]And if you’re in league with the Shadows, then I must defeat you!
entries.translated:
[blue]E se sei in combutta con le Ombre,
allora dovrò sconfiggerti!

entries.original:
"[blue]Why don’t you do what you came to
do then, huh?

Go fight Véga, but just leave the
rest of us alone!

The second letter of the password
to the command centre is [green]K[blue]!

That’s where he is, so go!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Why don’t you do what you came to do then, huh? Go fight Véga, but just leave the rest of us alone! The second letter of the password to the command centre is [color-green-2]K[color-blue-3]! That’s where he is, so go!
entries.translated:
[blue]Perché non fai quello che sei
venuto a fare, allora, eh? Vai a\lcombattere contro Véga, ma lasciaci

in pace! La seconda lettera della
password per il centro di comando è\l[green]K[blue]! È lì che si trova, quindi vai!

entries.original:
"[blue]You\.

You’re one of them, aren’t you!

You came to attack our base!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You[game-token-2] You’re one of them, aren’t you! You came to attack our base!
entries.translated:
[blue]Tu\. Sei uno di loro, non è vero! Sei
venuto ad attaccare la nostra base!

entries.original: "[blue]I won’t let you destroy it!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I won’t let you destroy it!
entries.translated: [blue]Non ti lascerò distruggerlo!

entries.original:
"[blue]I’ll tell you one of the letters
to the password for the command\lcentre!

The third letter is [green]L[blue]!

Just please stop attacking the
base!

If not, at least leave the power
grid alone!

If it goes down, we’ll be trapped
in here!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I’ll tell you one of the letters to the password for the command centre! The third letter is [color-green-2]L[color-blue-3]! Just please stop attacking the base! If not, at least leave the power grid alone! If it goes down, we’ll be trapped in here!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ti dirò una delle lettere della
password per il centro comando! La\lterza lettera è [green]L[blue]! Ti prego,

smettila di attaccare la base! Se
non altro, lascia stare la rete\lelettrica! Se va giù, resteremo

intrappolati qui dentro!

entries.original:
"Whoever you are, you shouldn’t be
here.

Don’t you know?

Those creatures roaming around burn
up anything they see."
entries.translation_source: Whoever you are, you shouldn’t be here. Don’t you know? Those creatures roaming around burn up anything they see.
entries.translated:
Chiunque tu sia, non dovresti
essere qui. Non lo sai? Quelle\lcreature in giro bruciano qualsiasi

cosa vedano.

entries.original: "You’re no Shadow Warrior\."
entries.translation_source: You’re no Shadow Warrior[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non sei un Guerriero Ombra\.

entries.original: "If only Véga were here to help\."
entries.translation_source: If only Véga were here to help[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Se solo Véga fosse qui ad aiutare\.

entries.original:
"If you’re looking for Véga, he’s
in the [green]Command Centre[blue].

You can get there by taking the
warp panel in the [green]Research Room[blue]."
entries.translation_source: If you’re looking for Véga, he’s in the [color-green-1]Command Centre[color-blue-2]. You can get there by taking the warp panel in the [color-green-3]Research Room[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Se stai cercando Véga, si trova nel
[green]Centro di comando[blue]. Puoi arrivarci\lprendendo il pannello teletrasporto

nella [green]Sala Ricerche[blue].

entries.original:
"[red]Oh!

You just beat that Shadow Warrior!
You saved me!

How did you know how to do that?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Oh! You just beat that Shadow Warrior! You saved me! How did you know how to do that?
entries.translated:
[red]Oh! Hai appena sconfitto quel
Guerriero dell{B4}Ombra! Mi hai\lsalvato! Come facevi a sapere come

farlo?

entries.original:
"[red]Oh, you must be with The Shadows.

But it’s alright, I won’t attack
you.

You can’t be all bad if you got
rid of one of your own.

Besides, I’m very grateful for your
help."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Oh, you must be with The Shadows. But it’s alright, I won’t attack you. You can’t be all bad if you got rid of one of your own. Besides, I’m very grateful for your help.
entries.translated:
[red]Oh, devi far parte di The Shadows.
Ma va bene, non ti attaccherò. Non\lpuoi essere poi così cattivo se vi

siete liberati di uno dei vostri.
In ogni caso, sono molto grato per\lil tuo aiuto.

entries.original:
"If you need anything from me,
please feel free to ask."
entries.translation_source: If you need anything from me, please feel free to ask.
entries.translated:
Se hai bisogno di qualcosa da me,
chiedi pure.

entries.original: "Heal Pokémon"
entries.translation_source: Heal Pokémon
entries.translated: Cura Pokémon

entries.original: "Password"
entries.translation_source: Password
entries.translated: Password

entries.original: "Information"
entries.translation_source: Information
entries.translated: Informazioni

entries.original: "Nope"
entries.translation_source: Nope
entries.translated: No

entries.original:
"Sure, I can heal your Pokémon.

Please lie down on one of these
beds, first."
entries.translation_source: Sure, I can heal your Pokémon. Please lie down on one of these beds, first.
entries.translated:
Certo, posso curare il tuo Pokémon.
Per favore, sdraiati prima su uno\ldi questi letti.

entries.original:
"All set!

You and your Pokémon are
all rested up."
entries.translation_source: All set! You and your Pokémon are all rested up.
entries.translated:
Tutto pronto! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon
siete completamente riposati.

entries.original:
"Oh, you want to know what the
password for the [green]Command Centre [red]is?

Sorry, but I only know the fourth
letter.

It’s [green]O[red].

I hope that helps!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, you want to know what the password for the [color-green-1]Command Centre [color-red-2]is? Sorry, but I only know the fourth letter. It’s [color-green-3]O[color-red-4]. I hope that helps!
entries.translated:
Ah, vuoi sapere qual è la password
per il [green]Centro di Comando [red]? Scusa,\lma conosco solo la quarta lettera.

È [green]O[red]. Spero ti sia utile!

entries.original:
"The base is split into eight
different sections.

The main areas are the Power Grid,
Break Room, Cafeteria, Rest Room,\land Research Room.

Other, smaller areas include the
storage areas, the living spaces,\land the Command Centre.

The living spaces and the Command
Centre can only be accessed through\lthe Research Room.

But with the Research Room now
underwater, the living spaces as\lwell as some storage areas have\lbeen completely cut off.

However, for some reason, the
Command Centre is still accessible."
entries.translation_source: The base is split into eight different sections. The main areas are the Power Grid, Break Room, Cafeteria, Rest Room, and Research Room. Other, smaller areas include the storage areas, the living spaces, and the Command Centre. The living spaces and the Command Centre can only be accessed through the Research Room. But with the Research Room now underwater, the living spaces as well as some storage areas have been completely cut off. However, for some reason, the Command Centre is still accessible.
entries.translated:
La base è divisa in otto sezioni
diverse. Le aree principali sono la\lRete Energetica, la Sala Relax, la

Mensa, la Sala Riposo e la Sala
Ricerca. Altre aree più piccole\lincludono i magazzini, gli alloggi

e il Centro Comando. Gli alloggi e
il Centro Comando sono accessibili\lsolo attraverso la Sala Ricerca. Ma

con la Sala Ricerca ora sott{B4}acqua,
gli alloggi e alcuni magazzini sono\lstati completamente isolati.

Tuttavia, per qualche motivo, il
Centro Comando è ancora\laccessibile.

entries.original: "Grunt: [blue]No, get away from me!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]No, get away from me!
entries.translated: Recluta: [blue]No, vattene da me!

entries.original:
"Grunt: [blue]You! This is your fault!

If you and your friend hadn’t wiped
out my Granbull, I’d be able to\ldefend myself!"
entries.translation_source: Grunt: [color-blue-1]You! This is your fault! If you and your friend hadn’t wiped out my Granbull, I’d be able to defend myself!
entries.translated:
Sgherro: [blue]Tu! È colpa tua! Se tu e
il tuo amico non aveste eliminato\lil mio Granbull, sarei in grado di

difendermi!

entries.original:
"Shadow Warrior: [blue]You\.\.\.\.

Die\.\.\."
entries.translation_source: Shadow Warrior: [color-blue-1]You[game-token-2][game-token-3][game-token-4][game-token-5] Die[game-token-6][game-token-7][game-token-8]
entries.translated: Shadow Warrior: [blue]Tu\.\.\.\. Muori\.\.\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Serves you right.

But I owe you and your friend one.

If he hadn’t knocked me out
earlier, I could’ve been burnt up\lwith those other grunts before\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Serves you right. But I owe you and your friend one. If he hadn’t knocked me out earlier, I could’ve been burnt up with those other grunts before[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Ti sta bene. Però devo un favore a
te e al tuo amico. Se non mi avesse\lsteso prima, sarei potuto finire

arrostito insieme alle altre
reclute prima\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I don’t know much, but I can tell
you that the fifth letter to the\lCommand Centre password is [green]V[blue].

Now we’re even."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I don’t know much, but I can tell you that the fifth letter to the Command Centre password is [color-green-2]V[color-blue-3]. Now we’re even.
entries.translated:
[blue]Non so molto, ma posso dirti che la
quinta lettera della password del\lCentro Comando è [green]V[blue]. Ora siamo pari.

entries.original:
"Shadow Grunt: [blue]How could you betray
The Shadows, Billy?

They made you the man you are!

[black]LOR Grunt: [blue]I made myself into the
man I am, Ronald.

I chose my own path!"
entries.translation_source: Shadow Grunt: [color-blue-1]How could you betray The Shadows, Billy? They made you the man you are! [color-black-2]LOR Grunt: [color-blue-3]I made myself into the man I am, Ronald. I chose my own path!
entries.translated:
Sgherro delle Ombre: [blue]Come hai
potuto tradire le Ombre, Billy? Ti\lhanno reso l{B4}uomo che sei! [black]Sgherro

LOR: [blue]Mi sono fatto da solo, Ronald.
Ho scelto la mia strada!

entries.original:
"LOR Grunt: [blue]I lost many friends when
your ship broke through the wall!

[black]Shadow Grunt: [red]They deserved to die
for abandoning The Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: LOR Grunt: [color-blue-1]I lost many friends when your ship broke through the wall! [color-black-2]Shadow Grunt: [color-red-3]They deserved to die for abandoning The Shadows!
entries.translated:
Recluta LOR: [blue]Ho perso molti amici
quando la tua nave ha sfondato il\lmuro! [black]Recluta di Shadow: [red]Se lo

meritavano per aver abbandonato The
Shadows!

entries.original:
"The Shadow Warrior is standing,
motionless."
entries.translation_source: The Shadow Warrior is standing, motionless.
entries.translated:
Il Guerriero Ombra è in piedi,
immobile.

entries.original:
"[player], glad you could make it.

I hope you haven’t been having any
problems with the Shadow Warriors.

They were ordered to kill anyone
who isn’t a member of The Shadows,\lbut I forgot to make a specific\lmention for you.

Well, I’m sure you managed to avoid
them considering you’re here now.

Just please try and stay out of
their way.

Those six elite Shadow Warriors are
the last ones we have left."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], glad you could make it. I hope you haven’t been having any problems with the Shadow Warriors. They were ordered to kill anyone who isn’t a member of The Shadows, but I forgot to make a specific mention for you. Well, I’m sure you managed to avoid them considering you’re here now. Just please try and stay out of their way. Those six elite Shadow Warriors are the last ones we have left.
entries.translated:
[player], sono contento che tu sia
riuscito a venire. Spero che tu non\labbia avuto problemi con gli Shadow

Warriors. Avevano l{B4}ordine di
uccidere chiunque non fosse membro\ldegli Shadows, ma ho dimenticato di

fare un{B4}eccezione per te. Beh, sono
sicuro che tu sia riuscito a\levitarli, visto che sei qui ora.

Cerca solo di startene fuori dai
loro piedi. Quei sei Shadow\lWarriors d{B4}élite sono gli ultimi

che ci restano.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Get that door open,
scientist!

There’s a traiter on the other side
that needs to burn\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Get that door open, scientist! There’s a traiter on the other side that needs to burn[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Apri quella porta,
scienziato! Dall{B4}altra parte c{B4}è un\ltraditore che deve bruciare\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
We could use your assistance.

Try to help that scientist figure
out the password for the door.

If you interrogate everyone you
see, someone will spill it."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! We could use your assistance. Try to help that scientist figure out the password for the door. If you interrogate everyone you see, someone will spill it.
entries.translated:
[player]! Il tuo aiuto ci farebbe
comodo. Cerca di aiutare quello\lscienziato a scoprire la password

della porta. Se interroghi tutti
quelli che incontri, qualcuno\lfinirà per parlare.

entries.original:
"What?
You want to help?

I need [green]6 [blue]letters to open this door.

I already have 1, I just need [green]5
[blue]more.

Do you know the other letters?"
entries.translation_source: What? You want to help? I need [color-green-1]6 [color-blue-2]letters to open this door. I already have 1, I just need [color-green-3]5 [color-blue-4]more. Do you know the other letters?
entries.translated:
Cosa? Vuoi aiutarmi? Mi servono [green]6
[blue]lettere per aprire questa porta. Ne\lho già 1, me ne servono solo [green]5 [blue]in

più. Conosci le altre lettere?

entries.original: "You only know [green][buffer1] [blue]letters."
entries.translation_source: You only know [color-green-1][buffer1-2] [color-blue-3]letters.
entries.translated: Conosci solo [green][buffer1] [blue]lettere.

entries.original:
"You don’t know any of the other
letters\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t know any of the other letters[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Non conosci nessuna delle altre
lettere\.

entries.original:
"Come talk to me when you’ve
learned all [green]5[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Come talk to me when you’ve learned all [color-green-1]5[color-blue-2].
entries.translated:
Vieni a parlarmi quando avrai
imparato tutte e [green]5[blue].

entries.original: "Please enter the other [green]5 [blue]letters."
entries.translation_source: Please enter the other [color-green-1]5 [color-blue-2]letters.
entries.translated: Inserisci le altre [green]5 [blue]lettere.

entries.original: "That’s not the correct password\."
entries.translation_source: That’s not the correct password[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Quella non è la password corretta\.

entries.original: "And the last letter is E\."
entries.translation_source: And the last letter is E[game-token-1]
entries.translated: E l{B4}ultima lettera è E\.

entries.original:
"Scientist: [blue]The door is open for you,
Zeph."
entries.translation_source: Scientist: [color-blue-1]The door is open for you, Zeph.
entries.translated:
Scienziato: [blue]La porta è aperta per
te, Zeph.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Good work, scientist.

I should’ve known that arrogant
fool would make the password his\lown name\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Good work, scientist. I should’ve known that arrogant fool would make the password his own name[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Bel lavoro, scienziato. Avrei
dovuto immaginare che quel\lpresuntuoso idiota avrebbe usato il

proprio nome come password\.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]I’m back.

And I was able to figure out the
rest of the password."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]I’m back. And I was able to figure out the rest of the password.
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Sono tornato. E sono
riuscito a capire il resto della\lpassword.

entries.original:
"[blue][player]!

Looks like you finally found
The Shadows."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]! Looks like you finally found The Shadows.
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Sembra che tu abbia
finalmente trovato The Shadows.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]And he brought the password
too, [rival]."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]And he brought the password too, [text-token-rival-2].
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]E ha portato anche la
password, [rival].

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]And she brought the password
too, [rival]."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]And she brought the password too, [text-token-rival-2].
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]E ha portato anche la
password, [rival].

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]I cant believe it,
[player].

You actually got somewhere before I
did\.

I’m amazed\."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]I cant believe it, [player-name-3]. You actually got somewhere before I did[game-token-4] I’m amazed[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Non ci credo, [player].
Sei davvero arrivato da qualche\lparte prima di me\. Sono stupefatto\.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]Now isn’t the time to act
awestruck, [rival].

We have more pressing matters to
attend to."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]Now isn’t the time to act awestruck, [text-token-rival-2]. We have more pressing matters to attend to.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]Non è il momento di restare
a bocca aperta, [rival]. Abbiamo\lquestioni più urgenti a cui

pensare.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]What do you think gives you
the right to talk down to me?

I don’t even know you!

Stop treating me like I’m some kid!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]What do you think gives you the right to talk down to me? I don’t even know you! Stop treating me like I’m some kid!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Cosa ti fa pensare di
avere il diritto di parlarmi\ldall{B4}alto in basso? Nemmeno ti

conosco! Smettila di trattarmi come
se fossi un ragazzino!

entries.original: "Marlon: [blue]I\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]I[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Marlon: [blue]Io\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Enough!

If we don’t act now, Véga will
make his escape.

Once we finish the Light or Ruin
and reclaim what they stole from\lus, you can have your little chat."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Enough! If we don’t act now, Véga will make his escape. Once we finish the Light or Ruin and reclaim what they stole from us, you can have your little chat.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Basta! Se non agiamo adesso,
Véga riuscirà a fuggire. Una volta\lche avremo concluso la Luce o la

Rovina e ripreso ciò che ci hanno
rubato, potrai fare la tua\lchiacchierata.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]Give it up Véga!

It’s over!

Without Aklove to back you up,
you’re nothing!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]Give it up Véga! It’s over! Without Aklove to back you up, you’re nothing!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Lascia perdere, Véga! È
finita! Senza Aklove a coprirti le\lspalle, non vali niente!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Those are fighting words,
Zeph!

Are you sure you want to go down
that path?"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]Those are fighting words, Zeph! Are you sure you want to go down that path?
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Parole forti, Zeph! Sei
sicuro di voler imboccare quella\lstrada?

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Bring it on, Zeph.

I’m stronger now than I ever was
before.

I don’t need Aklove’s help to take
you down."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]Bring it on, Zeph. I’m stronger now than I ever was before. I don’t need Aklove’s help to take you down.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Fatti sotto, Zeph. Ora sono
più forte di quanto sia mai stato\lprima. Non ho bisogno dell{B4}aiuto di

Aklove per batterti.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]I figured you’d say that.

\.

Go! Shadow Warrior!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]I figured you’d say that. [game-token-2] Go! Shadow Warrior!
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]Immaginavo che l{B4}avresti
detto. \. Vai! Guerriero Ombra!

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]What now, Zeph?

You going to have me incinerated
like the grunts?"
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]What now, Zeph? You going to have me incinerated like the grunts?
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]E adesso, Zeph? Hai
intenzione di farmi incenerire come\lle reclute?

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]No\.

It’s too soon for you to die.

Once I recover the Shadow Warriors
you stole from me, I’m going to\lmake you watch me raze your base\land your grunts to the ground.

Only then, after watching
everything you care about burn\laway, I’ll incinerate you as well."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]No[game-token-2] It’s too soon for you to die. Once I recover the Shadow Warriors you stole from me, I’m going to make you watch me raze your base and your grunts to the ground. Only then, after watching everything you care about burn away, I’ll incinerate you as well.
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]No\. È troppo presto perché tu
muoia. Una volta recuperati i\lGuerrieri Ombra che mi hai rubato,

ti costringerò a guardarmi mentre
raso al suolo la tua base e i tuoi\lscagnozzi. Solo allora, dopo averti

fatto vedere bruciare tutto ciò a
cui tieni, incenerirò anche te.

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]Heh.

Ha ha ha ha ha ha!

You think I actually care about
these grunts?

I never bought into the Light of
Ruin’s philosophy!

I only defected so I could take my
revenge on you for turning my wife\linto a Shadow Warrior\.

\.

I hate you, Zeph.

And nothing gives me more pleasure
than watching you suffer\."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]Heh. Ha ha ha ha ha ha! You think I actually care about these grunts? I never bought into the Light of Ruin’s philosophy! I only defected so I could take my revenge on you for turning my wife into a Shadow Warrior[game-token-2] [game-token-3] I hate you, Zeph. And nothing gives me more pleasure than watching you suffer[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Eh. Ah ah ah ah ah ah! Pensi
davvero che mi importi di questi\lscagnozzi? Non ho mai creduto nella

filosofia della Light of Ruin! Ho
disertato solo per vendicarmi di te\lper aver trasformato mia moglie in

una Shadow Warrior\. \. Ti odio, Zeph.
E niente mi dà più piacere che\lvederti soffrire\.

entries.original: "Véga: [blue]It’s about time\."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]It’s about time[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Véga: [blue]È ora\.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]No!
My Shadow Warrior!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]No! My Shadow Warrior!
entries.translated: Zeph: [blue]No! Il mio Guerriero Ombra!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]First, you interrupt my
trip to Hoenn.

And now, you interrupt my search in
Kalos for the ultimate weapon\.

This better be worth it, Véga\."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]First, you interrupt my trip to Hoenn. And now, you interrupt my search in Kalos for the ultimate weapon[game-token-2] This better be worth it, Véga[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Prima interrompete il mio
viaggio a Hoenn. E ora interrompete\lla mia ricerca a Kalos dell{B4}Arma

Suprema\. Spero proprio che ne valga
la pena, Véga\.

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]I have some bad news,
Aklove.

The Shadows crashed their boat
into the cliff, shattering the wall\land flooding the Research Room."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]I have some bad news, Aklove. The Shadows crashed their boat into the cliff, shattering the wall and flooding the Research Room.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Ho cattive notizie, Aklove.
Gli Shadows hanno fatto schiantare\lla loro barca contro la scogliera,

sfondando il muro e inondando la
Sala di Ricerca.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]WHAT!?

My data on the ultimate weapon has
been detroyed!?"
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]WHAT!? My data on the ultimate weapon has been detroyed!?
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]COSA!? I miei dati
sull{B4}arma suprema sono stati\ldistrutti!?

entries.original:
"Véga: [blue]I made a partial backup
before the attack, but over half of\lthe data is now corrupt."
entries.translation_source: Véga: [color-blue-1]I made a partial backup before the attack, but over half of the data is now corrupt.
entries.translated:
Véga: [blue]Avevo fatto un backup
parziale prima dell{B4}attacco, ma\lormai più della metà dei dati è

corrotta.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]You’d better hope we still
have enough to locate the weapon\.

Or so help me\."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]You’d better hope we still have enough to locate the weapon[game-token-2] Or so help me[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Faresti bene a sperare che
ci resti ancora abbastanza per\llocalizzare l{B4}arma\. O guai a te\.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]You’re really grasping at
straws, huh, Zeph?

Was this your last ditch attempt
to take back everything I took\lfrom you?

Pathetic."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]You’re really grasping at straws, huh, Zeph? Was this your last ditch attempt to take back everything I took from you? Pathetic.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Stai proprio arrampicandoti
sugli specchi, eh, Zeph? Era questo\lil tuo ultimo disperato tentativo

di riprenderti tutto quello che ti
ho portato via? Patetico.

entries.original:
"Zeph: [blue]No\.

That was just an attempt to stop
whatever you were planning.

You took my Shadow Warriors from
me, so it was time for you to pay\."
entries.translation_source: Zeph: [color-blue-1]No[game-token-2] That was just an attempt to stop whatever you were planning. You took my Shadow Warriors from me, so it was time for you to pay[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Zeph: [blue]No\. Quello era solo un
tentativo di fermare qualunque cosa\lstessi progettando. Mi hai portato

via i miei Shadow Warriors, quindi
era giunto il momento di fartela\lpagare\.

entries.translation_source: [game-token-1][game-token-2] Save[game-token-3][game-token-4]me[game-token-5][game-token-6]

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Why don’t you go burn in
Cinder Volcano.

It’s your just reward for all the
lives you’ve reduced to ash."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Why don’t you go burn in Cinder Volcano. It’s your just reward for all the lives you’ve reduced to ash.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Perché non vai a bruciare
nel Vulcano Cinder. È la giusta\lricompensa per tutte le vite che

hai ridotto in cenere.

entries.original: "[rival]: [blue]You just\.\.killed him!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]You just[game-token-3][game-token-4]killed him!
entries.translated: [rival]: [blue]L{B4}hai appena\.\.ucciso!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]He had it coming to him.

The blood of all the people he’s
killed has been avenged."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]He had it coming to him. The blood of all the people he’s killed has been avenged.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Se l{B4}era cercata. Il sangue
di tutte le persone che ha ucciso è\lstato vendicato.

entries.original:
"Marlon: [blue]No\.

Zeph may have done many
questionable things, but his heart\lwas in the right place.

You, on the other hand, plan on
ending more lives than Zeph ever\ldid.

You are the true villain here."
entries.translation_source: Marlon: [color-blue-1]No[game-token-2] Zeph may have done many questionable things, but his heart was in the right place. You, on the other hand, plan on ending more lives than Zeph ever did. You are the true villain here.
entries.translated:
Marlon: [blue]No\. Zeph potrebbe aver fatto
molte cose discutibili, ma il suo\lcuore era nel posto giusto. Tu,

invece, hai intenzione di porre
fine a più vite di quante ne abbia\lmai tolte Zeph. Il vero cattivo qui

sei tu.

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Is that you, Marlon?

I didn’t recognize you without your
getup.

Véga told me you and [player] were
back from the dead, so this time, I\lhave a much better way of getting\lrid of you both."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Is that you, Marlon? I didn’t recognize you without your getup. Véga told me you and [player-name-2] were back from the dead, so this time, I have a much better way of getting rid of you both.
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Sei tu, Marlon? Non ti ho
riconosciuto senza il tuo\ltravestimento. Véga mi ha detto che

tu e [player] siete tornati dai
morti, quindi questa volta ho un\lmodo molto migliore per sbarazzarmi

di voi due.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]No!
I needed answers from him!

Where did you send him?

Tell me!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]No! I needed answers from him! Where did you send him? Tell me!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]No! Avevo bisogno di
risposte da lui! Dove l{B4}hai\lmandato? Dimmi!

entries.original:
"Aklove: [blue]Oh I just sent him to a
remote island in the middle of the\locean somewhere.

Even if he can’t die, that’ll still
buy me enough time to carry out my\lplan until he finds his way back.

If he finds his way back\."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Oh I just sent him to a remote island in the middle of the ocean somewhere. Even if he can’t die, that’ll still buy me enough time to carry out my plan until he finds his way back. If he finds his way back[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aklove: [blue]Oh, l{B4}ho appena mandato su
un{B4}isola remota da qualche parte in\lmezzo all{B4}oceano. Anche se non può

morire, questo mi darà comunque
abbastanza tempo per portare avanti\lil mio piano, finché non ritroverà

la strada del ritorno. Se ritroverà
la strada del ritorno\.

entries.original:
"[blue]I don’t know who you are red kid,
but I’ll give you a chance to walk\laway right now.

You haven’t irked me much yet, so I
see no reason to end your life.

It needs to go on so you can
witness my grand finale."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I don’t know who you are red kid, but I’ll give you a chance to walk away right now. You haven’t irked me much yet, so I see no reason to end your life. It needs to go on so you can witness my grand finale.
entries.translated:
[blue]Non so chi tu sia, ragazzo rosso,
ma ti darò la possibilità di\landartene adesso. Non mi hai ancora

irritato più di tanto, quindi non
vedo motivo di porre fine alla tua\lvita. Deve continuare, così potrai

assistere al mio gran finale.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]No way!

I came here to take down the
Light of Ruin, so that’s what\lI’m going to do!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]No way! I came here to take down the Light of Ruin, so that’s what I’m going to do!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Non se ne parla! Sono
venuto qui per abbattere la Light\lof Ruin, e questo è quello che

farò!

entries.original: "Aklove: [blue]Send him home, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: Aklove: [color-blue-1]Send him home, Hoopa.
entries.translated: Aklove: [blue]Mandalo a casa, Hoopa.

entries.original: "Hoopa: [green]Hoop!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa: [color-green-1]Hoop!
entries.translated: Hoopa: [green]Hoop!

entries.original: "Stay and Fight"
entries.translation_source: Stay and Fight
entries.translated: Resta e combatti

entries.original: "Run Away"
entries.translation_source: Run Away
entries.translated: Fuggi

entries.original:
"[blue]You’ve got guts, [player].

If it’s a fight you want, it’s a
fight you’ll get!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You’ve got guts, [player-name-2]. If it’s a fight you want, it’s a fight you’ll get!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hai fegato, [player]. Se vuoi una
lotta, una lotta avrai!

entries.original:
"[blue]There’s no escape for you [player]!

I’m going to get rid of you today,
one way or another!

You just need you to bear witness
to the power I posses, first!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]There’s no escape for you [player-name-2]! I’m going to get rid of you today, one way or another! You just need you to bear witness to the power I posses, first!
entries.translated:
[blue]Non hai scampo per te [player]!
Oggi ti eliminerò, in un modo o\lnell{B4}altro! Devi solo assistere al

potere che posseggo, prima!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa!

Let’s show [player] what he’s really
up against!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hoopa! Let’s show [player-name-2] what he’s really up against!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hoopa! Mostriamo a [player] con chi
ha davvero a che fare!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hoopa!

Let’s show [player] what she’s really
up against!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hoopa! Let’s show [player-name-2] what she’s really up against!
entries.translated:
[blue]Hoopa! Mostriamo a [player] contro
cosa se la deve vedere davvero!

entries.original: "Not enough power\."
entries.translation_source: Not enough power[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Potere insufficiente\.

entries.original:
"Now you see the power your enemy
truly possesses."
entries.translation_source: Now you see the power your enemy truly possesses.
entries.translated: Ora vedi il vero potere che il tuo avversario possiede.

entries.original:
"[blue]What was the point of all the
training we did in Hoenn if you\lcan’t even beat a single trainer!?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What was the point of all the training we did in Hoenn if you can’t even beat a single trainer!?
entries.translated:
[blue]A che è servito tutto l{B4}allenamento
che abbiamo fatto a Hoenn se non\lriesci nemmeno a battere un solo

Allenatore!?

entries.original:
"[blue]I can’t allow your stench to linger
any longer!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I can’t allow your stench to linger any longer!
entries.translated:
[blue]Non posso permettere che il tuo
tanfo persista ancora!

entries.original:
"[blue]Now you see.

You never stood a chance against
me.

But you’re still too much of a
threat to keep around
