entries.original:
"Just in case you’ve forgotten, the
Super Cube acts just like a bag.

But unlike those cheap bags from
Dalmart that can only hold 42\litems, the Super Cube, or as it’s\lmore commonly known, [green]Cube[red], has an\linfinite amount of space!

It works by digitizing the item’s
data put into it, so essentially,\lit’s like you’re carrying nothing\lextra at all!

Stay safe out there, honey!

Bring Prof. Log his package!"
entries.translation_source: Just in case you’ve forgotten, the Super Cube acts just like a bag. But unlike those cheap bags from Dalmart that can only hold 42 items, the Super Cube, or as it’s more commonly known, [color-green-1]Cube[color-red-2], has an infinite amount of space! It works by digitizing the item’s data put into it, so essentially, it’s like you’re carrying nothing extra at all! Stay safe out there, honey! Bring Prof. Log his package!
entries.translated:
Nel caso te lo fossi dimenticato,
il Super Cube si comporta proprio\lcome una borsa. Ma a differenza di

quelle borse economiche di Dalmart
che possono contenere solo 42\loggetti, il Super Cube, o come è

più comunemente conosciuto, [green]Cube[red],
ha una quantità infinita di spazio!\lFunziona digitalizzando i dati

dell{B4}oggetto inserito al suo
interno, quindi in pratica è come\lse non stessi portando nulla in

più! Stai al sicuro là fuori,
tesoro! Porta il pacco al Prof.\lLog!

entries.original:
"You should visit your [green]mother[blue] before
getting my package, [player].

She is likely very worried
about you."
entries.translation_source: You should visit your [color-green-1]mother[color-blue-2] before getting my package, [player-name-3]. She is likely very worried about you.
entries.translated:
Dovresti andare a trovare tua [green]madre[blue]
prima di prendere il mio pacco,\l[player]. Probabilmente è molto

preoccupata per te.

entries.original:
"Please get my package from the
[green]Bellin Town Poké Mart[blue], [player].

I need it, and only you can get it."
entries.translation_source: Please get my package from the [color-green-1]Bellin Town Poké Mart[color-blue-2], [player-name-3]. I need it, and only you can get it.
entries.translated:
Per favore ritira il mio pacco dal
[green]Bellin Town Poké Mart[blue], [player]. Mi\lserve, e solo tu puoi prenderlo.

entries.original:
"Oh, [player]!
You returned with my package!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, [player-name-1]! You returned with my package!
entries.translated:
Oh, [player]! Sei tornato con il
mio pacco!

entries.original: "[player] delivered the parcel."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] delivered the parcel.
entries.translated: [player] ha consegnato il pacco.

entries.original:
"Ah!

It’s a shipment from my friend,
Oak, in the Kanto Region!

Let’s see here\.

Poké Balls, Pokédexes, and\.huh?
Where are the Master Balls?

Did you open this package and take
anything from it, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: Ah! It’s a shipment from my friend, Oak, in the Kanto Region! Let’s see here[game-token-1] Poké Balls, Pokédexes, and[game-token-2]huh? Where are the Master Balls? Did you open this package and take anything from it, [player-name-3]?
entries.translated:
Ah! È una spedizione del mio amico,
Oak, nella regione di Kanto!\lVediamo un po{B4}\. Poké Ball, Pokédex e\.

eh? Dove sono le Master Ball? Hai
aperto questo pacco e preso\lqualcosa da dentro, [player]?

entries.original:
"You did?

Didn’t your mother ever teach you
not to open someone else’s mail?"
entries.translation_source: You did? Didn’t your mother ever teach you not to open someone else’s mail?
entries.translated:
L{B4}hai fatto? Tua madre non ti ha
mai insegnato a non aprire la posta\ldegli altri?

entries.original:
"Then where are my Master Balls?

Clearly, someone was rummaging
about in here!"
entries.translation_source: Then where are my Master Balls? Clearly, someone was rummaging about in here!
entries.translated:
Allora dove sono le mie Master
Ball? È evidente che qualcuno ha\lfrugato qui dentro!

entries.original:
"\.

Ah\.
I see.

You recovered my package from some
thugs\.

And they must have taken the
Master Balls\.

\."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] Ah[game-token-2] I see. You recovered my package from some thugs[game-token-3] And they must have taken the Master Balls[game-token-4] [game-token-5]
entries.translated:
\. Ah\. Capisco. Hai recuperato il mio
pacco da alcuni teppisti\. E devono\laver preso le Master Ball\. \.

entries.original:
"What!?

You saw them use one to capture
Articuno?

Hmm\.

If I’m correct, we could be in
grave danger\."
entries.translation_source: What!? You saw them use one to capture Articuno? Hmm[game-token-1] If I’m correct, we could be in grave danger[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Cosa!? Li hai visti usarne uno per
catturare Articuno? Hmm\. Se ho\lragione, potremmo essere in grave

pericolo\.

entries.original:
"I have one more errand for you
to run, [player].

An old friend of mine lives in
[green]Dresco Town[blue].

He’s very knowledgeable in Borrian
history.

I need you to tell him everything
that has transpired so far.

I have a theory about what is going
on, but I need him to confirm it.

You have your own Pokémon now, so
this shouldn’t be too difficult.

You can get to [green]Dresco Town[blue] by going
through [green]Icicle Cave[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I have one more errand for you to run, [player-name-1]. An old friend of mine lives in [color-green-2]Dresco Town[color-blue-3]. He’s very knowledgeable in Borrian history. I need you to tell him everything that has transpired so far. I have a theory about what is going on, but I need him to confirm it. You have your own Pokémon now, so this shouldn’t be too difficult. You can get to [color-green-4]Dresco Town[color-blue-5] by going through [color-green-6]Icicle Cave[color-blue-7].
entries.translated:
Ho un{B4}altra commissione per te,
[player]. Un mio vecchio amico vive\la [green]Dresco Town[blue]. Conosce molto bene

la storia di Borrius. Ho bisogno
che gli racconti tutto ciò che è\laccaduto finora. Ho una teoria su

quello che sta succedendo, ma ho
bisogno che la confermi. Adesso hai\lil tuo Pokémon, quindi non dovrebbe

essere troppo difficile. Puoi להגיע
a [green]Dresco Town[blue] passando per [green]Icicle\lCave[blue].

entries.original:
"Oh!
Silly me!

How can I expect you to find [green]Icicle
Cave[blue] if you don’t know the way?

This [green]Town Map[blue] should aid you
immensely!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! Silly me! How can I expect you to find [color-green-1]Icicle Cave[color-blue-2] if you don’t know the way? This [color-green-3]Town Map[color-blue-4] should aid you immensely!
entries.translated:
Oh! Che sbadata! Come posso
aspettarmi che tu trovi [green]Caverna di\lGhiaccio[blue] se non conosci la strada?

Questa [green]Mappa Città[blue] ti sarà di
grande aiuto!

entries.original:
"And you know what?

If you’re going to Dresco Town, you
should assist me with another task!

My friend, Oak, requested that I
give his Pokédex to two trainers.

It’s some sort of high-tech
encyclopedia for recording Pokémon\ldata.

Apparently, Borrius is known for
having plenty of Pokémon Kanto\ldoes not."
entries.translation_source: And you know what? If you’re going to Dresco Town, you should assist me with another task! My friend, Oak, requested that I give his Pokédex to two trainers. It’s some sort of high-tech encyclopedia for recording Pokémon data. Apparently, Borrius is known for having plenty of Pokémon Kanto does not.
entries.translated:
E sai una cosa? Se vai a Dresco
Town, dovresti aiutarmi in un altro\lcompito! Il mio amico Oak mi ha

chiesto di consegnare il suo
Pokédex a due Allenatori. È una\lspecie di enciclopedia ad alta

tecnologia per registrare i dati
dei Pokémon. Pare che Borrius sia\lnota per avere molti Pokémon che

Kanto non ha.

entries.original:
"You can’t get detailed data on
Pokémon by just seeing them.

You must catch them to obtain
complete data.

So, here are some tools for
catching wild Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You can’t get detailed data on Pokémon by just seeing them. You must catch them to obtain complete data. So, here are some tools for catching wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Non puoi ottenere dati dettagliati
sui Pokémon solo vedendoli. Devi\lcatturarli per ottenere dati

completi. Quindi, ecco alcuni
strumenti per catturare i Pokémon\lselvatici.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received 5 Poké Balls
from Log!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received 5 Poké Balls from Log!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto 5 Poké Ball da
Log!

entries.original:
"If you don’t know how to capture
Wild Pokémon, an old friend of\lmine on Route 1 can show you how."
entries.translation_source: If you don’t know how to capture Wild Pokémon, an old friend of mine on Route 1 can show you how.
entries.translated:
Se non sai come catturare Pokémon
selvatici, un mio vecchio amico su\lPercorso 1 può mostrarti come fare.

entries.original:
"Oh!

My memory seems to be going\.I
have one more thing to give you.

Please, the next time you see
[rival], give him this Pokédex."
entries.translation_source: Oh! My memory seems to be going[game-token-1]I have one more thing to give you. Please, the next time you see [text-token-rival-2], give him this Pokédex.
entries.translated:
Oh! Mi sembra che la memoria mi
stia abbandonando\. Ho ancora\lun{B4}altra cosa da darti. Per favore,

la prossima volta che vedi
[rival], dagli questo Pokédex.

entries.original:
"He’s been rather cold to me ever
since his parents left him with me\las a child, but he seems to get\lalong fine with you.

I’m sure if you give him the
Pokédex he’d be willing to assist."
entries.translation_source: He’s been rather cold to me ever since his parents left him with me as a child, but he seems to get along fine with you. I’m sure if you give him the Pokédex he’d be willing to assist.
entries.translated:
È stato piuttosto freddo con me da
quando i suoi genitori lo hanno\llasciato a me da bambino, ma con te

sembra andare d{B4}accordo. Sono
sicuro che, se gli dai il Pokédex,\lsarà disposto ad aiutarti.

entries.original:
"Please visit my friend in [green]Dresco
Town[blue], [player].

I’m counting on you."
entries.translation_source: Please visit my friend in [color-green-1]Dresco Town[color-blue-2], [player-name-3]. I’m counting on you.
entries.translated:
Per favore vai a trovare il mio
amico a [green]Dresco Town[blue], [player].\lConto su di te.

entries.original:
"[player], You need to hurry to
[green]Thundercap Mountain[blue]!

If The Shadows get there before
you, Borrius is doomed!

Head north of town and take the [green]SES
Expressway[blue] far [green]south[blue] to go quickly."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], You need to hurry to [color-green-2]Thundercap Mountain[color-blue-3]! If The Shadows get there before you, Borrius is doomed! Head north of town and take the [color-green-4]SES Expressway[color-blue-5] far [color-green-6]south[color-blue-7] to go quickly.
entries.translated:
[player], devi sbrigarti ad andare
al [green]Monte Thundercap[blue]! Se le Ombre\larrivano prima di te, Borrius è

condannato! Vai a nord della città
e prendi la [green]SES Expressway[blue] molto\l[green]south[blue] per andare più velocemente.

entries.original:
"With Zapdos now in their possesion,
all The Shadows need to do to\lrelease the dark force is bring the\lthree birds to the [green]Ruins of Void[blue].

If they succeed in doing so and
break the seal\.

I don’t even want to think about
it.

Please hurry there with Jax and
make one last attempt to stop them.

The future is in your hands,
[player]!"
entries.translation_source: With Zapdos now in their possesion, all The Shadows need to do to release the dark force is bring the three birds to the [color-green-1]Ruins of Void[color-blue-2]. If they succeed in doing so and break the seal[game-token-3] I don’t even want to think about it. Please hurry there with Jax and make one last attempt to stop them. The future is in your hands, [player-name-4]!
entries.translated:
Con Zapdos ora in loro possesso,
tutto ciò che The Shadows devono\lfare per liberare la forza oscura è

portare i tre uccelli alle [green]Rovine
del Vuoto[blue]. Se ci riuscissero e\linfrangessero il sigillo\. non voglio

nemmeno pensarci. Ti prego,
sbrigati ad andare laggiù con Jax e\lfai un ultimo tentativo per

fermarli. Il futuro è nelle tue
mani, [player]!

entries.original:
"Now that dark force has been
released, our end is near.

But until then, all we can do is
live our lives normally."
entries.translation_source: Now that dark force has been released, our end is near. But until then, all we can do is live our lives normally.
entries.translated:
Ora che quella forza oscura è stata
liberata, la nostra fine è vicina.\lMa fino ad allora, tutto ciò che

possiamo fare è vivere normalmente
la nostra vita.

entries.original:
"[player]!

You saved Borrius!
You saved us all!

Thank you!

Your father would be proud of you,
Guardian of Borrius."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You saved Borrius! You saved us all! Thank you! Your father would be proud of you, Guardian of Borrius.
entries.translated:
[player]! Hai salvato Borrius! Hai
salvato tutti noi! Grazie! Tuo\lpadre sarebbe fiero di te,

Guardiano di Borrius.

entries.original:
"Unfortunately, [player], I have no
more errands for you to run.

Have you considered taking on the
[green]Pokémon League[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately, [player-name-1], I have no more errands for you to run. Have you considered taking on the [color-green-2]Pokémon League[color-blue-3]?
entries.translated:
Purtroppo, [player], non ho più
commissioni da affidarti. Hai preso\lin considerazione l{B4}idea di

affrontare la [green]Pokémon League[blue]?

entries.original: "Long ago\."
entries.translation_source: Long ago[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Molto tempo fa\.

entries.original:
"The Borrius Region was engulfed by
a great war with the Kalos Region.

It was a brutal war, one lasting
many years.

In that time, Kalos managed to
seize the upper hand\."
entries.translation_source: The Borrius Region was engulfed by a great war with the Kalos Region. It was a brutal war, one lasting many years. In that time, Kalos managed to seize the upper hand[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
La regione di Borrius fu travolta
da una grande guerra con la regione\ldi Kalos. Fu una guerra brutale,

durata molti anni. In quel periodo,
Kalos riuscì ad avere il\lsopravvento\.

entries.original:
"On the brink of defeat, the Borrian
king summoned a dark force to help\lturn the tides of battle\."
entries.translation_source: On the brink of defeat, the Borrian king summoned a dark force to help turn the tides of battle[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sul punto di essere sconfitto, il
re di Borrius evocò una forza\loscura per aiutare a ribaltare le

sorti della battaglia\.

entries.original:
"The Kalosian army’s advantage was
lost almost instantly.

As soon as it entered the battlefield,
the dark force used its power to\lcreate portals and transport the\linvading army back to Kalos\."
entries.translation_source: The Kalosian army’s advantage was lost almost instantly. As soon as it entered the battlefield, the dark force used its power to create portals and transport the invading army back to Kalos[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Il vantaggio dell{B4}esercito
kalosiano fu perso quasi\lall{B4}istante. Non appena entrò nel

campo di battaglia, la forza oscura
usò il suo potere per creare\lportali e riportare l{B4}esercito

invasore a Kalos\.

entries.original:
"With the foreign army gone, the war
seemed at an end for Borrius.

However, their king, overcome by
his lust for power, sent the Borrian\larmy through the portals as well\."
entries.translation_source: With the foreign army gone, the war seemed at an end for Borrius. However, their king, overcome by his lust for power, sent the Borrian army through the portals as well[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Con l{B4}esercito straniero scomparso,
la guerra sembrava finita per\lBorrius. Tuttavia, il loro re,

sopraffatto dalla sua sete di
potere, mandò anche l{B4}esercito\lborriano attraverso i portali\.

entries.original:
"The war continued to rage in Kalos
for several years.

Many more men and Pokémon were
conscripted to fight and inevitably\lmet their end on the battlefield.

One such Pokémon having been a
dear friend of the Kalosian king\."
entries.translation_source: The war continued to rage in Kalos for several years. Many more men and Pokémon were conscripted to fight and inevitably met their end on the battlefield. One such Pokémon having been a dear friend of the Kalosian king[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
La guerra infuriò a Kalos per
diversi anni. Molti altri uomini e\lPokémon furono coscritti a

combattere e finirono
inevitabilmente per morire sul\lcampo di battaglia. Uno di questi

Pokémon era stato un caro amico del
re di Kalos\.

entries.original:
"Overcome with grief, the king built a
device to restore it to life, granting\lhimself immortality in the process."
entries.translation_source: Overcome with grief, the king built a device to restore it to life, granting himself immortality in the process.
entries.translated:
Sopraffatto dal dolore, il re
costruì un congegno per riportarlo\lin vita, ottenendo così

l{B4}immortalità.

entries.original:
"But this traumatic event left him
scarred and filled with anger.

Unable to forgive the world that
had hurt his precious Pokémon, he\lturned his machine into a giant\lweapon, the Ultimate Weapon.

The king became a bringer of
destruction that ended the war."
entries.translation_source: But this traumatic event left him scarred and filled with anger. Unable to forgive the world that had hurt his precious Pokémon, he turned his machine into a giant weapon, the Ultimate Weapon. The king became a bringer of destruction that ended the war.
entries.translated:
Ma questo evento traumatico lo
lasciò segnato e pieno di rabbia.\lIncapace di perdonare il mondo che

aveva ferito i suoi preziosi
Pokémon, trasformò la sua macchina\lin un{B4}arma gigantesca, l{B4}Arma

Suprema. Il re divenne un artefice
di distruzione che pose fine alla\lguerra.

entries.original:
"With the war over, what little
remained of the Borrian army\lreturned home.

The king’s Pokémon left him, and
the battlefield became silent\."
entries.translation_source: With the war over, what little remained of the Borrian army returned home. The king’s Pokémon left him, and the battlefield became silent[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Con la guerra finita, quel poco che
restava dell{B4}esercito di Borrian\ltornò a casa. I Pokémon del re lo

abbandonarono, e il campo di
battaglia cadde nel silenzio\.

entries.original: "Yet, peace was still to come."
entries.translation_source: Yet, peace was still to come.
entries.translated:
Eppure, la pace doveva ancora
arrivare.

entries.original:
"The dark force of Borrius wanted
compensation for its help.

When the king had nothing to offer
it, the dark force was enraged.

It began to destroy countless
cities and towns for sport."
entries.translation_source: The dark force of Borrius wanted compensation for its help. When the king had nothing to offer it, the dark force was enraged. It began to destroy countless cities and towns for sport.
entries.translated:
La forza oscura di Borrius voleva
un compenso per il suo aiuto.\lQuando il re non aveva nulla da

offrirle, la forza oscura si
infuriò. Cominciò a distruggere\linnumerevoli città e paesi per

divertimento.

entries.original:
"In an effort to stop its madness,
the Borrian king gathered the\llegendary Pokémon:"
entries.translation_source: In an effort to stop its madness, the Borrian king gathered the legendary Pokémon:
entries.translated:
Nel tentativo di fermare la sua
follia, il re di Borrius radunò i\lPokémon leggendari:

entries.original: "Zapdos!"
entries.translation_source: Zapdos!
entries.translated: Zapdos!

entries.original:
"Using the power of the three birds
combined with a divine bottle given\lto him by Arceus, creator of all\lPokémon, the dark force was bound."
entries.translation_source: Using the power of the three birds combined with a divine bottle given to him by Arceus, creator of all Pokémon, the dark force was bound.
entries.translated:
Usando il potere dei tre uccelli
insieme a una bottiglia divina\ldonatagli da Arceus, creatore di

tutti i Pokémon, la forza oscura fu
sigillata.

entries.original:
"It became a shadow of its former
self."
entries.translation_source: It became a shadow of its former self.
entries.translated: È diventato l{B4}ombra di se stesso.

entries.original:
"Stripped of its power, it was taken
in by the king, and supervised by\lhis progeny, until one, fateful day\."
entries.translation_source: Stripped of its power, it was taken in by the king, and supervised by his progeny, until one, fateful day[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Privato del suo potere, fu accolto
dal re e sorvegliato dalla sua\ldiscendenza, fino a un giorno

fatale\.

entries.original:
"Stripped of its power, it was taken
in by the king, and supervised by\lhis progeny, until this very day."
entries.translation_source: Stripped of its power, it was taken in by the king, and supervised by his progeny, until this very day.
entries.translated:
Privato del suo potere, fu accolto
dal re e sorvegliato dai suoi\ldiscendenti, fino a questo stesso

giorno.

entries.original: "            16 Years Ago"
entries.translation_source: 16 Years Ago
entries.translated: 16 anni fa

entries.original: "             Elsewhere"
entries.translation_source: Elsewhere
entries.translated: Altrove

entries.original:
"???: [blue]Arceus\.

I can’t go on like this\."
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]Arceus[game-token-2] I can’t go on like this[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
???: [blue]Arceus\. Non posso andare avanti
così\.

entries.original:
"This Pokémon\.

I know it’s my duty to watch over
it, but where I’m headed, it\lcannot go!"
entries.translation_source: This Pokémon[game-token-1] I know it’s my duty to watch over it, but where I’m headed, it cannot go!
entries.translated:
Questo Pokémon\. So che è mio dovere
badare a lui, ma dove sto andando,\lnon può venire!

entries.original:
"I know I told him that using its
power would be a bad idea, but I\lworry that soon, he’ll no longer\llisten to me\."
entries.translation_source: I know I told him that using its power would be a bad idea, but I worry that soon, he’ll no longer listen to me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
So che gli ho detto che usare il
suo potere sarebbe stata una\lcattiva idea, ma temo che presto

non mi ascolterà più\.

entries.original: "And that’s why I need to do this!"
entries.translation_source: And that’s why I need to do this!
entries.translated: Ed è per questo che devo farlo!

entries.original: "It’s gone\."
entries.translation_source: It’s gone[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non c{B4}è più\.

entries.original:
"Now it’s time for you to go too,
Arceus\.

I don’t want you around for what
will happen next\.

Just promise me one thing\.

Please, watch over my child\."
entries.translation_source: Now it’s time for you to go too, Arceus[game-token-1] I don’t want you around for what will happen next[game-token-2] Just promise me one thing[game-token-3] Please, watch over my child[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Adesso è ora che vada via anche tu,
Arceus\. Non ti voglio qui per quello\lche succederà dopo\. Promettimi solo

una cosa\. Per favore, veglia sul mio
bambino\.

entries.original:
"???: [blue]ARGH!

How can I fulfill Grampy’s wish if I
can’t even catch a single Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: ???: [color-blue-1]ARGH! How can I fulfill Grampy’s wish if I can’t even catch a single Pokémon!
entries.translated:
???: [blue]ARGH! Come posso esaudire il
desiderio di Grampy se non riesco\lnemmeno a catturare un solo

Pokémon!

entries.original:
"[blue]I promised Grampy I’d eradicate the
root of the suffering, but at this\lpoint, I don’t see how that’ll\leven be possible!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I promised Grampy I’d eradicate the root of the suffering, but at this point, I don’t see how that’ll even be possible!
entries.translated:
[blue]Avevo promesso al nonnino che avrei
estirpato la radice della\lsofferenza, ma a questo punto non

vedo nemmeno come potrebbe essere
possibile!

entries.original:
"[blue]Please, Arceus!

If you’re real, give me a sign that

\.

"Excellent.

Eccellente. Allora, come sai, la

usati per sigillarla vengano\lriuniti alle [green]Rovine del Vuoto[blue], il

una volta. Questo deve essere ciò\lche quei teppisti che hai

incontrato stanno cercando. Devono
voler avvolgere Borrius nelle ombre\lancora una volta. Se ho ragione,

allora il loro prossimo obiettivo
sarà\.

Arthur: [blue]Penso che Jax sia in grado

mandarlo a confrontarsi con queste\l\qoOmbre\qc e fermarle prima che

"Jax: [blue]Understood, Grampa.

Log: [blue]Beh, [player], credo sia ora
che tu torni a casa. Hai completato\lil tuo incarico, e sono sicuro che

"Arthur: [blue]Now, wait just a minute,

Jax affrontare le Ombre. Penso che

"Log: [blue]Hmm\.

[buffer1] on more complicated errands\."

[buffer2] fa esperienza, posso\lmandare [buffer1] a svolgere

"[blue]Alright, [player], I think you

[blue]Va bene, [player], credo che
dovresti seguire Jax. Dirò a tua\lmadre che ci metterai un po{B4}. Sono

"Head to [green]Cinder Volcano[blue] and watch

Vai a [green]Cinder Volcano[blue] e guarda Jax

"With all three legendary Pokémon

entries.translation_source: With all three legendary Pokémon in their grasp, The Shadows are only momemnts away from releasing the dark force. Jax is in [color-green-1]Dehara City[color-blue-2] waiting to take you to the [color-green-3]Ruins of Void[color-blue-4] and stop The Shadows from carrying out their plan.

Con tutti e tre i Pokémon

Quindi, la forza oscura è stata

Ce l{B4}hai fatta! Hai sconfitto la
Luce della Rovina e ci hai salvati!\lSei un vero Guardiano di Borrius!

Tuo padre sarebbe fiero di te.

diventare facilmente il campione.

entries.translated:
Benvenuto al Quartier Generale
delle Missioni! È la tua prima\lvolta qui, vero? Allora dimmi,

"Of course you do!

Certo che sì! Chi non lo farebbe?
Ma\. nel caso tu stia annuendo\ldistrattamente, permettimi di darti

"I see\.

Well, then in that case, allow me

entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1] Well, then in that case, allow me to give a formal explanation.
entries.translated:
Vedo\. Ebbene, allora in tal caso,
permettimi di fornirti una\lspiegazione formale.

entries.original:
"A Mission is an extra objective you
receive by accepting a request for\lhelp.

Many people out there are unable to
solve their own problems and\lrequire assistance from others.

Once you accept the Mission, the
details are automatically recorded\lin the Quest Log.

Missions can often yield great
rewards, be it items, money, or\leven new areas to explore.

If someone requests a Mission from
you, accept it immediately.

Even if you have no intention of
completing it right away, there’s\lno harm in having it registered in\lyour Quest Log.

With that being said, there are
several people here in need of\lassistance.

Look around and see if there’s
anyone you’d like to help!

And come see me when you’ve
completed at least [green]5[blue] Missions."
entries.translation_source: A Mission is an extra objective you receive by accepting a request for help. Many people out there are unable to solve their own problems and require assistance from others. Once you accept the Mission, the details are automatically recorded in the Quest Log. Missions can often yield great rewards, be it items, money, or even new areas to explore. If someone requests a Mission from you, accept it immediately. Even if you have no intention of completing it right away, there’s no harm in having it registered in your Quest Log. With that being said, there are several people here in need of assistance. Look around and see if there’s anyone you’d like to help! And come see me when you’ve completed at least [color-green-1]5[color-blue-2] Missions.
entries.translated:
Una Missione è un obiettivo extra
che ricevi accettando una richiesta\ldi aiuto. Molte persone là fuori

non sono in grado di risolvere i
propri problemi e hanno bisogno\ldell{B4}assistenza di altri. Una volta

accettata la Missione, i dettagli
vengono automaticamente registrati\lnel Registro delle Missioni. Le

Missioni possono spesso fornire
grandi ricompense, che siano\loggetti, denaro o persino nuove

aree da esplorare. Se qualcuno ti
richiede una Missione, accettala\limmediatamente. Anche se non hai

intenzione di completarla subito,
non c{B4}è nulla di male ad averla\lregistrata nel tuo Registro delle

Missioni. Detto questo, ci sono
diverse persone qui che hanno\lbisogno di assistenza. Guardati

intorno e vedi se c{B4}è qualcuno che
vorresti aiutare! E vieni a\ltrovarmi quando avrai completato

almeno [green]5[blue] Missioni.

least [green][buffer1][blue] Missions!

[buffer2]!"

Sembra che tu abbia completato
almeno [green][buffer1][blue] Missioni! Per\lquesto, ricevi\. [buffer2]!

entries.translated:
Ti ho dato tutto quello che potevo
darti! Hai superato le mie\laspettative! Qualsiasi Missione

completi da ora in poi conterà solo

entries.original: "You received a [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: You received a [buffer1-1]!

"You don’t have any space left in

Non hai più spazio nella tua

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Man, you’re only leaving
Dehara City now?

You sure are slow!

Well, while you were loitering
around, I figured out how to get\lto the Ruins of Void.

But by the time I got over there,
it was too late to do anything.

Whatever The Shadows were planning,
they’d already done.

There were some signs of a battle
in the main room and a strange pile\lof ashes on the floor.

Maybe it was used in some sort of
ritual?

\.

\.

What!?

That’s insane!

You died and came back to life!?"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]Man, you’re only leaving Dehara City now? You sure are slow! Well, while you were loitering around, I figured out how to get to the Ruins of Void. But by the time I got over there, it was too late to do anything. Whatever The Shadows were planning, they’d already done. There were some signs of a battle in the main room and a strange pile of ashes on the floor. Maybe it was used in some sort of ritual? [game-token-3] [game-token-4] What!? That’s insane! You died and came back to life!?
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Accidenti, stai lasciando
Città di Dehara solo adesso? Sei\ldavvero lento! Beh, mentre te ne

stavi lì a ciondolare, ho capito
come arrivare alle Rovine del\lVuoto. Ma quando ci sono arrivato,

era troppo tardi per fare qualcosa.
Qualunque cosa stessero\lpianificando The Shadows, l{B4}avevano

già fatta. C{B4}erano dei segni di una
battaglia nella sala principale e\luno strano mucchio di cenere sul

pavimento. Forse è stato usato in
una sorta di rituale? \. \. Cosa!? È\lpazzesco! Sei morto e sei tornato

in vita!?

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]What the\.

Who are you supposed to be?"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]What the[game-token-3] Who are you supposed to be?
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Cosa diavolo\. Chi saresti
tu?

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]\.

[player], you must be wondering
why I did not follow you into the\lportal alongside Jax.

You see, the moment that portal
appeared, I was apprehensive.

So, unlike Jax, I took a cautious
step backwards, an action which\lled to me losing track of you.

For that, I am sorry.

I assumed you had been teleported
to the Ruins of Void.

As such, I attempted to make my
way over there as well.

However, as I have no Pokémon of
my own, I was unable to reach it.

Tell me, [player], what happened to
you two on the other side of that\lportal?

\.

\.

I see\.

Then, I believe our best course of
action is to head to [green]Vivill Town[blue]\land assist The Shadows.

Once they and the Light of Ruin
clash, it will be the perfect\loppurtunity to swoop in and\larrest them all.

Go assist The Shadows with
their final mission.

Once you are victorious, I will
meet you outside with a team of\lpolice to end this madness."
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1][game-token-2] [player-name-3], you must be wondering why I did not follow you into the portal alongside Jax. You see, the moment that portal appeared, I was apprehensive. So, unlike Jax, I took a cautious step backwards, an action which led to me losing track of you. For that, I am sorry. I assumed you had been teleported to the Ruins of Void. As such, I attempted to make my way over there as well. However, as I have no Pokémon of my own, I was unable to reach it. Tell me, [player-name-4], what happened to you two on the other side of that portal? [game-token-5] [game-token-6] I see[game-token-7] Then, I believe our best course of action is to head to [color-green-8]Vivill Town[color-blue-9] and assist The Shadows. Once they and the Light of Ruin clash, it will be the perfect oppurtunity to swoop in and arrest them all. Go assist The Shadows with their final mission. Once you are victorious, I will meet you outside with a team of police to end this madness.
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]\. [player], ti starai
chiedendo perché non ti ho seguito\lnel portale insieme a Jax. Vedi,

nel momento in cui quel portale è
apparso, ero preoccupato. Quindi, a\ldifferenza di Jax, ho fatto un

passo indietro cauto, un{B4}azione che
mi ha fatto perdere le tue tracce.\lPer questo, mi dispiace. Ho

supposto che foste stati
teletrasportati alle Rovine del\lVuoto. Così, ho cercato di

raggiungere quel posto anch{B4}io.
Tuttavia, non avendo Pokémon miei,\lnon sono riuscito ad arrivarci.

Dimmi, [player], cosa è successo a
voi due dall{B4}altra parte di quel\lportale? \. \. Capisco\. Allora, credo

che la nostra migliore linea
d{B4}azione sia dirigersi a [green]Vivill\lTown[blue] e assistere le Ombre. Quando

loro e la Luce della Rovina si
scontreranno, sarà l{B4}occasione\lperfetta per piombare e arrestarli

tutti. Vai ad assistere le Ombre
nella loro missione finale. Quando\lsarai vittorioso, ti incontrerò

fuori con una squadra di polizia
per porre fine a questa follia.

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]Hey!
Don’t ignore me!

I don’t know who you are or what’s
happening, but if whatever’s going\lon has to do with The Shadows, I\lwant in!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]Hey! Don’t ignore me! I don’t know who you are or what’s happening, but if whatever’s going on has to do with The Shadows, I want in!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Ehi! Non ignorarmi! Non
so chi tu sia o cosa stia\lsuccedendo, ma se quello che sta

accadendo ha a che fare con The
Shadows, voglio entrare anch{B4}io!

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]And who might you be,
young man?"
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]And who might you be, young man?
entries.translated:
Looker: [blue]E tu chi saresti,
giovanotto?

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]I’m mad as all else!

I came this close to catching up
with The Shadows and finding my\lparents, and then they got away\lfrom me again!

Now I hear that they’re going to
Vivill Town?

Then that’s where I’m going!
To stop them once and for all!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2]I’m mad as all else! I came this close to catching up with The Shadows and finding my parents, and then they got away from me again! Now I hear that they’re going to Vivill Town? Then that’s where I’m going! To stop them once and for all!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]Sono furioso! Ero a un
passo dal raggiungere The Shadows e\ltrovare i miei genitori, e poi mi

sono sfuggiti di nuovo! Ora sento
che stanno andando a Vivill Town?\lAllora è lì che andrò io! Per

fermarli una volta per tutte!

entries.original:
"Looker: [blue]Wait, just wait!

As of now, The Shadows are our
pawns to fix a greater problem!

At least hold off on your act of
vengeance until this ordeal is\lover, understood?"
entries.translation_source: Looker: [color-blue-1]Wait, just wait! As of now, The Shadows are our pawns to fix a greater problem! At least hold off on your act of vengeance until this ordeal is over, understood?
entries.translated:
Bellocchio: [blue]Aspetta, aspetta! Per
ora, le Ombre sono i nostri\lburattini per risolvere un problema

più grande! Trattieniti almeno dal
tuo atto di vendetta finché tutto\lquesto trambusto non sarà finito,

chiaro?

entries.original:
"[rival]: [blue]\.Fine.

But as soon as this problem is
dealt with, there’s nothing you\lcan do to stop me from going after\levery last one of them!"
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1]: [color-blue-2][game-token-3]Fine. But as soon as this problem is dealt with, there’s nothing you can do to stop me from going after every last one of them!
entries.translated:
[rival]: [blue]\.Va bene. Ma appena questa
situazione sarà risolta, niente\lpotrà impedirmi di andare a caccia

di ognuno di loro fino all{B4}ultimo!

entries.original:
"[blue]Since this is officially your
\qomission\qc, I’ll be waiting for\lyou in [green]Vivill Town[blue].

And for your sake, I’ll even \qoplay
nice\qc with The Shadows until\lwe’re done.

Don’t be late, [player]."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Since this is officially your [quote-open-2]mission[quote-close-3], I’ll be waiting for you in [color-green-4]Vivill Town[color-blue-5]. And for your sake, I’ll even [quote-open-6]play nice[quote-close-7] with The Shadows until we’re done. Don’t be late, [player-name-8].
entries.translated:
[blue]Dato che questa è ufficialmente la
tua \qomissione\qc, ti aspetterò a\l[green]Vivill Town[blue]. E per il tuo bene,

farò persino \qogiocare pulito\qc con
The Shadows finché non avremo\lfinito. Non arrivare in ritardo,

[player].

Sono un elegante Collezione di

"with the battlefield electrified!

Grounded Pokémon can’t fall asleep
and have stronger Electric-moves!"
entries.translation_source: with the battlefield electrified! Grounded Pokémon can’t fall asleep and have stronger Electric-moves!

entries.original:
"with the battlefield grassy!

Grounded Pokémon have stronger
Grass-moves and heal every turn!"
entries.translation_source: with the battlefield grassy! Grounded Pokémon have stronger Grass-moves and heal every turn!

entries.original:
"with the battlefield misty!

Grounded Pokémon have stronger
Fairy-moves and can’t be afflicted\lwith status conditions!"
entries.translation_source: with the battlefield misty! Grounded Pokémon have stronger Fairy-moves and can’t be afflicted with status conditions!
entries.translated: con il terreno nebbioso! I Pokémon a terra hanno mosse di tipo Folletto più potenti e non possono subire alterazioni di stato!

entries.original:
"with the battlefield weird!

Grounded Pokémon have stronger
Psychic-moves and can’t be hit\lby priority moves!"
entries.translation_source: with the battlefield weird! Grounded Pokémon have stronger Psychic-moves and can’t be hit by priority moves!
entries.translated: con il campo di battaglia strano! I Pokémon a terra hanno mosse Psico più potenti e non possono essere colpiti dalle mosse con priorità!

entries.original:
"with strong winds blowing!

Flying-type Pokémon take less
damage from super effective moves!"
entries.translation_source: with strong winds blowing! Flying-type Pokémon take less damage from super effective moves!
entries.translated: Con forti venti che soffiano! I Pokémon di tipo Volante subiscono meno danni dalle mosse superefficaci!

entries.original:
"with intense gravity!

No Pokémon will remain airborne!"
entries.translation_source: with intense gravity! No Pokémon will remain airborne!
entries.translated: con una gravità intensa! Nessun Pokémon resterà in aria!

entries.original:
"with electromagnetism on the field!

Electric- and Steel-type Pokémon
can’t be hit by Ground-type moves!"
entries.translation_source: with electromagnetism on the field! Electric- and Steel-type Pokémon can’t be hit by Ground-type moves!
entries.translated: con l{B4}elettromagnetismo sul campo! I Pokémon di tipo Elettro e Acciaio non possono essere colpiti da mosse di tipo Terra!

entries.original:
"with the battlefield locked down!

No Pokémon will be able to switch
out!"
entries.translation_source: with the battlefield locked down! No Pokémon will be able to switch out!
entries.translated: con il campo di battaglia sotto controllo! Nessun Pokémon potrà cambiare fuori!

entries.original:
"with pixies in the air!

Fairy-type Pokémon will have their
lowest defensive stat boosted!"
entries.translation_source: with pixies in the air! Fairy-type Pokémon will have their lowest defensive stat boosted!
entries.translated: Con le fatine nell{B4}aria! La statistica difensiva più bassa dei Pokémon di tipo Folletto verrà aumentata!

entries.original:
"with negative emotions in the air!

Pokémon that aren’t part Dark-
type, Ghost-type, Psychic-type,\lor have one of the Abilities\lUnaware, Oblivious, or Magic Guard\lwill be hurt each turn!"
entries.translation_source: with negative emotions in the air! Pokémon that aren’t part Dark- type, Ghost-type, Psychic-type, or have one of the Abilities Unaware, Oblivious, or Magic Guard will be hurt each turn!
entries.translated: con emozioni negative nell{B4}aria! I Pokémon che non sono di tipo Buio, Spettro o Psico, oppure che hanno una delle Abilità Ignorante, Indifferenza o Magiscudo, subiranno danni a ogni turno!

entries.original:
"with a Power Spot active!

All Pokémon will be able to
Dynamax!

However, no Pokémon may Mega
Evolve, undergo Primal Reversion,\lUltra Burst, or use Z-Moves!"
entries.translation_source: with a Power Spot active! All Pokémon will be able to Dynamax! However, no Pokémon may Mega Evolve, undergo Primal Reversion, Ultra Burst, or use Z-Moves!
entries.translated: con un Power Spot attivo! Tutti i Pokémon potranno Dynamax! Tuttavia, nessun Pokémon potrà megaevolversi, subire il Ritorno Primordiale, eseguire Ultraesplosione o usare le mosse Z!

entries.original:
"with Pokémon swapped!

Each side will use one of the
opposing side’s Pokémon at random!"
entries.translation_source: with Pokémon swapped! Each side will use one of the opposing side’s Pokémon at random!
entries.translated: con i Pokémon scambiati! Ogni lato userà a caso uno dei Pokémon dell{B4}altro lato!

entries.original:
"with a veil protecting both sides\lof the battlefield!

No Pokémon may inflict status
conditions on another!"
entries.translation_source: with a veil protecting both sides of the battlefield! No Pokémon may inflict status conditions on another!
entries.translated: con un velo protettivo su entrambi i lati del campo di battaglia! Nessun Pokémon può infliggere alterazioni di stato a un altro!

entries.original:
"with Mist surrounding both sides\lof the battlefield!

No Pokémon may have their stats
lowered by another!"
entries.translation_source: with Mist surrounding both sides of the battlefield! No Pokémon may have their stats lowered by another!
entries.translated: con la Nebbia che circonda entrambi i lati del campo di battaglia! Nessun Pokémon può avere le proprie statistiche abbassate da un altro!

entries.original:
"with a Sea of Fire engulfing both\lsides of the battlefield!

All non-Fire-type Pokémon will be
damaged each turn!"
entries.translation_source: with a Sea of Fire engulfing both sides of the battlefield! All non-Fire-type Pokémon will be damaged each turn!
entries.translated: con un Mare di Fuoco che avvolge entrambi i lati del campo di lotta! Tutti i Pokémon che non sono di tipo Fuoco subiranno danni a ogni turno!

entries.original:
"with a Rainbow present on both\lsides of the battlefield!

All moves have their secondary
effect chance doubled!"
entries.translation_source: with a Rainbow present on both sides of the battlefield! All moves have their secondary effect chance doubled!
entries.translated: con un Arcobaleno presente su entrambi i lati del campo di battaglia! La probabilità degli effetti secondari di tutte le mosse è raddoppiata!

entries.original: "with all Pokémon confused!"
entries.translation_source: with all Pokémon confused!
entries.translated: con tutti i Pokémon confusi!

No status moves can be used!"
entries.translation_source: with all Pokémon taunted! No status moves can be used!

entries.original:
"Surprised to see someone my age?
I promise you, I’m not weak."
entries.translation_source: Surprised to see someone my age? I promise you, I’m not weak.
entries.translated: Sorprenso di vedere qualcuno della mia età? Ti assicuro che non sono debole.

entries.original:
"I guess dropping out of school
wasn’t so smart\."
entries.translation_source: I guess dropping out of school wasn’t so smart[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Immagino che lasciare la scuola non sia stata una gran mossa\.

entries.original:
"Heh, I told you I wasn’t a
pushover!"
entries.translation_source: Heh, I told you I wasn’t a pushover!
entries.translated: Heh, te l{B4}avevo detto che non ero uno che si lascia mettere i piedi in testa!

entries.original:
"I left school to be here\.

I won’t let you stand between me
and greatness!"
entries.translation_source: I left school to be here[game-token-1] I won’t let you stand between me and greatness!
entries.translated: Ho lasciato la scuola per essere qui\. Non ti lascerò metterti tra me e la grandezza!

entries.original:
"That was a good battle!
I look forward to our rematch."
entries.translation_source: That was a good battle! I look forward to our rematch.
entries.translated: È stata una bella lotta! Non vedo l{B4}ora della rivincita.

entries.original:
"You fight worse than my grandma!
Though Grandma’s a tough cookie\."
entries.translation_source: You fight worse than my grandma! Though Grandma’s a tough cookie[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Combatti peggio di mia nonna! Però la nonna è un osso duro\.

entries.original:
"I’m just a young kid, you should
go easy on me!"
entries.translation_source: I’m just a young kid, you should go easy on me!
entries.translated: Sono solo un ragazzino, dovresti andarci piano con me!

entries.original: "Waaah! I’m telling on you!"
entries.translation_source: Waaah! I’m telling on you!
entries.translated: Waaah! Faccio la spia su di te!

entries.original:
"Beaten by a little kid\.
How can you sleep at night?"
entries.translation_source: Beaten by a little kid[game-token-1] How can you sleep at night?
entries.translated: Battuto da un bambino\. Come fai a dormire la notte?

entries.original:
"The way of the Bug Catcher!
Bear witness to it!"
entries.translation_source: The way of the Bug Catcher! Bear witness to it!
entries.translated: La via del Cacciabug! Ne sarai testimone!

entries.original: "All hail Bug Catchers!"
entries.translation_source: All hail Bug Catchers!
entries.translated: Gloria ai Cercainsetti!

entries.original:
"This is the way of the Bug
Catcher!"
entries.translation_source: This is the way of the Bug Catcher!
entries.translated: Questa è la via del Cacciabug!

entries.original: "I’ll snag you with my net!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll snag you with my net!
entries.translated: Ti catturerò con la mia rete!

entries.original: "Hey! Don’t run away!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! Don’t run away!
entries.translated: Ehi! Non scappare!

entries.original: "It’s in the bag!"
entries.translation_source: It’s in the bag!
entries.translated: È fatta!

entries.original:
"I catch and raise all sorts of Bug
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I catch and raise all sorts of Bug Pokémon.
entries.translated: Catturo e alleno ogni sorta di Pokémon Coleottero.

entries.original:
"I need to raise my Pokémon some
more!"
entries.translation_source: I need to raise my Pokémon some more!
entries.translated: Devo allenare ancora un po{B4} i miei Pokémon!

entries.original: "See? I’ve raised them pretty good."
entries.translation_source: See? I’ve raised them pretty good.
entries.translated: Visto? Li ho cresciuti proprio bene.

entries.original:
"I’m on the lookout for adorable
accessories."
entries.translation_source: I’m on the lookout for adorable accessories.
entries.translated: Sono alla ricerca di accessori adorabili.

entries.original: "I wish I could dress up!"
entries.translation_source: I wish I could dress up!
entries.translated: Vorrei potermi travestire!

entries.original:
"Let me know if you find any nice
accessories!"
entries.translation_source: Let me know if you find any nice accessories!
entries.translated: Fammi sapere se trovi qualche bell{B4}accessorio!

entries.original:
"I make it a policy to wear
miniskirts!"
entries.translation_source: I make it a policy to wear miniskirts!
entries.translated: Faccio in modo di indossare le minigonne!

entries.original: "What’s your policy?"
entries.translation_source: What’s your policy?
entries.translated: Qual è la tua politica?

entries.original: "Miniskirts are the ultimate!"
entries.translation_source: Miniskirts are the ultimate!
entries.translated: Le minigonne sono il massimo!

entries.original: "Here goes!"
entries.translation_source: Here goes!
entries.translated: Si parte!

entries.original:
"How could you bully a poor little
girl?"
entries.translation_source: How could you bully a poor little girl?
entries.translated: Come puoi fare il prepotente con una povera ragazzina?

entries.original: "Caught you snoozing!"
entries.translation_source: Caught you snoozing!
entries.translated: Ti ho colto nel sonno!

entries.original: "The sea, my beautiful sea!"
entries.translation_source: The sea, my beautiful sea!
entries.translated: Il mare, il mio bellissimo mare!

entries.original:
"I want to become a big man.
Big like the sea big."
entries.translation_source: I want to become a big man. Big like the sea big.
entries.translated: Voglio diventare un grande uomo. Grande come il mare, grande.

entries.original:
"Oh\. I hear them\.

I hear the sound of waves\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] I hear them[game-token-2] I hear the sound of waves[game-token-3]
entries.translated: Oh\. Li sento\. Sento il suono delle onde\.

entries.original:
"I’m the Sailor among Sailors!
I was born on the high seas!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Sailor among Sailors! I was born on the high seas!
entries.translated: Sono il Marinaio tra i marinai! Sono nato in alto mare!

entries.original:
"Urp\. Gweh\.

So, when I get up on land, I get
no-motion sickness\."
entries.translation_source: Urp[game-token-1] Gweh[game-token-2] So, when I get up on land, I get no-motion sickness[game-token-3]
entries.translated: Burp\. Gweh\. Quindi, quando salgo a terra, non soffro il mal di movimento\.

entries.original:
"The waves rocked me to sleep!
The sea was my mother!"
entries.translation_source: The waves rocked me to sleep! The sea was my mother!
entries.translated: Le onde mi cullavano fino a farmi addormentare! Il mare era mia madre!

entries.original:
"Come on! Take a run at me! I can
take it!"
entries.translation_source: Come on! Take a run at me! I can take it!
entries.translated: Forza! Fatti sotto! Posso reggerlo!

entries.original: "Good job! Way to overcome my size!"
entries.translation_source: Good job! Way to overcome my size!
entries.translated: Ottimo lavoro! Hai superato alla grande la mia stazza!

entries.original:
"So, what’d you think?
I was too burly for you to handle?"
entries.translation_source: So, what’d you think? I was too burly for you to handle?
entries.translated: Allora, che ne dici? Ero troppo massiccio per te da gestire?

entries.original: "My Pokémon trained in forests."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon trained in forests.
entries.translated: I miei Pokémon si sono allenati nelle foreste.

entries.original: "I’m going back to the forest."
entries.translation_source: I’m going back to the forest.
entries.translated: Torno nella foresta.

entries.original: "It’s the power of the forests."
entries.translation_source: It’s the power of the forests.
entries.translated: È il potere delle foreste.

entries.original:
"The indefatigable Camper makes his
stand!"
entries.translation_source: The indefatigable Camper makes his stand!
entries.translated: L{B4}instancabile Campeggiatore prende posizione!

entries.original:
"I wish I could become your
devotee."
entries.translation_source: I wish I could become your devotee.
entries.translated: Vorrei poter diventare il tuo devoto.

entries.original:
"You can become a devotee if you’d
like."
entries.translation_source: You can become a devotee if you’d like.
entries.translated: Puoi diventare un devoto, se vuoi.

entries.original: "Hunh? Where is everyone?"
entries.translation_source: Hunh? Where is everyone?
entries.translated: Eh? Dove sono tutti?

entries.original:
"I came to camp, but I think I got
separated from my friends\."
entries.translation_source: I came to camp, but I think I got separated from my friends[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sono venuto al campo, ma credo di essermi separato dai miei amici\.

entries.original: "Hey, guys! Where are you?!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, guys! Where are you?!
entries.translated: Ehi, ragazzi! Dove siete?!

entries.original:
"I’ll battle you like I’m on a
picnic!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll battle you like I’m on a picnic!
entries.translated: Ti affronterò come se fossi a un picnic!

entries.original:
"Pretending this is a picnic won’t
let me win."
entries.translation_source: Pretending this is a picnic won’t let me win.
entries.translated: Fingere che sia un picnic non mi farà vincere.

entries.original: "Lalala!"
entries.translation_source: Lalala!
entries.translated: Lalala!

entries.original:
"Win or lose, let’s not bear any
grudges."
entries.translation_source: Win or lose, let’s not bear any grudges.
entries.translated: Che si vinca o si perda, non serbiamo rancore.

entries.original: "Oh, you! Don’t ever forget this!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, you! Don’t ever forget this!
entries.translated: Oh, tu! Non dimenticarlo mai!

entries.original: "Yay, yay, yay! We did it!"
entries.translation_source: Yay, yay, yay! We did it!
entries.translated: Sì, sì, sì! Ce l{B4}abbiamo fatta!

entries.original:
"I’ll teach you what’s fun about
battling."
entries.translation_source: I’ll teach you what’s fun about battling.
entries.translated: Ti insegnerò quanto è divertente combattere.

entries.original:
"Oh, my, that was inspiring!
You’re the greatest!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, my, that was inspiring! You’re the greatest!
entries.translated: Oh, ma che ispirazione! Sei il migliore!

entries.original: "Battling me was fun, wasn’t it?"
entries.translation_source: Battling me was fun, wasn’t it?
entries.translated: Scontrarti con me è stato divertente, vero?

entries.original:
"No one loves Pokémon more than me!
No one!"
entries.translation_source: No one loves Pokémon more than me! No one!
entries.translated: Nessuno ama i Pokémon più di me! Nessuno!

entries.original:
"Grr\.

Your love of Pokémon is stronger
than mine?"
entries.translation_source: Grr[game-token-1] Your love of Pokémon is stronger than mine?
entries.translated: Grr\. Il tuo amore per i Pokémon è più forte del mio?

entries.original:
"Fuhaha! Looks like my love for
Pokémon trumped yours!"
entries.translation_source: Fuhaha! Looks like my love for Pokémon trumped yours!
entries.translated: Fuhaha! Sembra che il mio amore per i Pokémon abbia superato il tuo!

entries.original:
"OK, show me your favorite Pokémon.
Don’t be shy now, come on."
entries.translation_source: OK, show me your favorite Pokémon. Don’t be shy now, come on.
entries.translated: Va bene, mostrami il tuo Pokémon preferito. Non essere timido, dai.

entries.original: "I see! Cute, and yet tough."
entries.translation_source: I see! Cute, and yet tough.
entries.translated: Capisco! Carino, eppure resistente.

entries.original:
"I see\.

Cute but on the weak side."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1] Cute but on the weak side.
entries.translated: Capisco\. Carino, ma un po{B4} debole.

entries.original:
"I have my Pokémon. I don’t need
anything else."
entries.translation_source: I have my Pokémon. I don’t need anything else.
entries.translated: Ho i miei Pokémon. Non mi serve nient{B4}altro.

entries.original:
"Isn’t that the same for you?
Isn’t it?"
entries.translation_source: Isn’t that the same for you? Isn’t it?
entries.translated: Non vale lo stesso per te? Non è così?

entries.original:
"With my Pokémon, I can be happy
every day."
entries.translation_source: With my Pokémon, I can be happy every day.
entries.translated: Con i miei Pokémon posso essere felice ogni giorno.

entries.original:
"I have considered every possible
outcome.

You have a 3% chance of
beating me."
entries.translation_source: I have considered every possible outcome. You have a 3% chance of beating me.
entries.translated: Ho preso in considerazione ogni possibile esito. Hai il 3% di probabilità di battermi.

entries.original: "What? You have defied the odds!"
entries.translation_source: What? You have defied the odds!
entries.translated: Cosa? Hai sfidato le probabilità!

entries.original:
"Clearly you should return to
school."
entries.translation_source: Clearly you should return to school.
entries.translated: Dovresti chiaramente tornare a scuola.

entries.original:
"I know every Pokémon’s individual
strengths and weaknesses.

The odds are not in your favour."
entries.translation_source: I know every Pokémon’s individual strengths and weaknesses. The odds are not in your favour.
entries.translated: Conosco i punti di forza e di debolezza di ogni singolo Pokémon. Le probabilità non sono a tuo favore.

entries.original: "Hmm\. I need to study more."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] I need to study more.
entries.translated: Hmm\. Devo studiare di più.

entries.original:
"You are merely a statistic,
conforming to the norm."
entries.translation_source: You are merely a statistic, conforming to the norm.
entries.translated: Sei soltanto una statistica, conformandoti alla norma.

entries.original: "You are no match for my intellect."
entries.translation_source: You are no match for my intellect.
entries.translated: Non sei all{B4}altezza del mio intelletto.

entries.original:
"You are clearly in the 97th
percentile. Impressive."
entries.translation_source: You are clearly in the 97th percentile. Impressive.
entries.translated: Sei chiaramente nel 97° percentile. Impressionante.

entries.original:
"Another match to analyze and learn
from."
entries.translation_source: Another match to analyze and learn from.
entries.translated: Un altro match da analizzare e da cui imparare.

entries.original:
"You should aspire to the Hiker’s
way of life!"
entries.translation_source: You should aspire to the Hiker’s way of life!
entries.translated: Dovresti aspirare allo stile di vita di un Escursionista!

entries.original:
"Now, come on now!
You should look up to the way I\llive!"
entries.translation_source: Now, come on now! You should look up to the way I live!
entries.translated: Su, avanti! Dovresti prendere esempio dal mio modo di vivere!

entries.original:
"You see? You love my lifestyle,
don’t you?"
entries.translation_source: You see? You love my lifestyle, don’t you?
entries.translated: Vedi? Ami il mio stile di vita, vero?

entries.original:
"Howdy! It’s a long way away from
the mountains here!"
entries.translation_source: Howdy! It’s a long way away from the mountains here!
entries.translated: Ehilà! Qui siamo ben lontani dalle montagne!

entries.original: "Hahah! Keep it coming!"
entries.translation_source: Hahah! Keep it coming!
entries.translated: Ahah! Continuate pure!

entries.original:
"Ho there!

You are a mountain standing in my
way, aren’t ya?"
entries.translation_source: Ho there! You are a mountain standing in my way, aren’t ya?
entries.translated: Ehi là! Sei una montagna che mi sbarra la strada, eh?

entries.original:
"Grrr\. My victory has disappeared
in a crevasse\."
entries.translation_source: Grrr[game-token-1] My victory has disappeared in a crevasse[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Grrr\. La mia vittoria è scomparsa in un crepaccio\.

entries.original:
"Yahoooooo! Yahoooooooo!
Hear my cry of triumph!"
entries.translation_source: Yahoooooo! Yahoooooooo! Hear my cry of triumph!
entries.translated: Yahoooooo! Yahoooooooo! Ascolta il mio grido di trionfo!

entries.original:
"Those stupid security guards won’t
let me bike freely around here\.

I’ll take out my anger on you!"
entries.translation_source: Those stupid security guards won’t let me bike freely around here[game-token-1] I’ll take out my anger on you!
entries.translated: Quelle stupide guardie di sicurezza non mi lasciano girare liberamente in bici qui\. Sfogherò la mia rabbia su di te!

entries.original: "What?! My bike is out of gas!"
entries.translation_source: What?! My bike is out of gas!
entries.translated: Cosa?! La mia bici è senza benzina!

entries.original: "Eat dust, loser!"
entries.translation_source: Eat dust, loser!
entries.translated: Mangi polvere, perdente!

entries.original: "After our battle, we should race!"
entries.translation_source: After our battle, we should race!
entries.translated: Dopo la nostra lotta, dovremmo fare una gara di corsa!

entries.original: "Noooo! Mommy!"
entries.translation_source: Noooo! Mommy!
entries.translated: Noooo! Mamma!

entries.original:
"And yet another falls prey to the
might of my bike!\lHeh heh heh."
entries.translation_source: And yet another falls prey to the might of my bike! Heh heh heh.
entries.translated: E un altro cade preda della potenza della mia bici! Eh eh eh.

entries.original:
"Can you keep up with me at a full
run?"
entries.translation_source: Can you keep up with me at a full run?
entries.translated: Riesci a starmi dietro mentre corro a tutta velocità?

entries.original:
"Ugh\.

There’s no way I can beat you."
entries.translation_source: Ugh[game-token-1] There’s no way I can beat you.
entries.translated: Ugh\. Non c{B4}è modo che io possa batterti.

entries.original:
"If you can’t beat me in a battle,
there’s no way you can beat me in\la bike race."
entries.translation_source: If you can’t beat me in a battle, there’s no way you can beat me in a bike race.
entries.translated: Se non riesci a battermi in una lotta, non c{B4}è modo che tu possa battermi in una gara in bici.

entries.original:
"Gear change!
We’re attacking at top speed!"
entries.translation_source: Gear change! We’re attacking at top speed!
entries.translated: Cambio marcia! Attacchiamo alla massima velocità!

entries.original:
"I’m taking it to a zone beyond
speed!"
entries.translation_source: I’m taking it to a zone beyond speed!
entries.translated: Mi spingo in una zona oltre la velocità!

entries.original: "Kaboom!"
entries.translation_source: Kaboom!
entries.translated: Kaboom!

entries.original:
"Come on!

We’ll run!

Together!"
entries.translation_source: Come on! We’ll run! Together!
entries.translated: Forza! Corriamo! Insieme!

entries.original: "Wait! Don’t leave me behind!"
entries.translation_source: Wait! Don’t leave me behind!
entries.translated: Aspetta! Non lasciarmi indietro!

entries.original:
"I’d rather cycle casually than go
full speed."
entries.translation_source: I’d rather cycle casually than go full speed.
entries.translated: Preferirei andare in bici con calma che a tutta velocità.

entries.original:
"You ought to take things more
casually\."
entries.translation_source: You ought to take things more casually[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Dovresti prendere le cose con più calma\.

entries.original: "Let’s take it easy."
entries.translation_source: Let’s take it easy.
entries.translated: Prendiamocela con calma.

entries.original:
"I was a thief, but I went straight
as a Trainer."
entries.translation_source: I was a thief, but I went straight as a Trainer.
entries.translated: Ero un ladro, ma come Allenatore ho preso la retta via.

entries.original: "I surrender!"
entries.translation_source: I surrender!
entries.translated: Mi arrendo!

entries.original: "Too late to surrender!"
entries.translation_source: Too late to surrender!
entries.translated: È troppo tardi per arrendersi!

entries.original:
"If a Pokémon has the ability
Pickpocket, does that make it a\lthief-type?"
entries.translation_source: If a Pokémon has the ability Pickpocket, does that make it a thief-type?
entries.translated: Se un Pokémon ha l{B4}abilità Scappamago, questo lo rende un tipo ladro?

entries.original:
"I wish there was a thief Pokémon.
I’d use that to win!"
entries.translation_source: I wish there was a thief Pokémon. I’d use that to win!
entries.translated: Magari esistesse un Pokémon ladro. Lo userei per vincere!

entries.original:
"I get this uncontrollable urge to
steal other people’s streaks."
entries.translation_source: I get this uncontrollable urge to steal other people’s streaks.
entries.translated: Mi viene questa irrefrenabile voglia di rubare le serie vincenti degli altri.

entries.original:
"I’m calling myself \qoThe Doodler\qc,
and with the simple addition of a\lsmall burglar’s mask, I achieve\lutter anonymity."
entries.translation_source: I’m calling myself [quote-open-1]The Doodler[quote-close-2], and with the simple addition of a small burglar’s mask, I achieve utter anonymity.
entries.translated: Mi faccio chiamare \qoThe Doodler\qc, e con la semplice aggiunta di una piccola maschera da ladro, ottengo un completo anonimato.

entries.original:
"A good politician is quite as
unthinkable as an honest burglar."
entries.translation_source: A good politician is quite as unthinkable as an honest burglar.
entries.translated: Un buon politico è tanto impensabile quanto un ladro onesto.

entries.original:
"We burglars know there’s more than
one way to skin a streak."
entries.translation_source: We burglars know there’s more than one way to skin a streak.
entries.translated: Noi ladri sappiamo che c{B4}è più di un modo per interrompere una serie vincente.

entries.original:
"It was me who put up the buildings
around these parts."
entries.translation_source: It was me who put up the buildings around these parts.
entries.translated: Sono stato io a costruire gli edifici da queste parti.

entries.original:
"My dream is to make a building
taller than a mountain!"
entries.translation_source: My dream is to make a building taller than a mountain!
entries.translated: Il mio sogno è costruire un edificio più alto di una montagna!

entries.original:
"So, what do you think?
Cool stuff, huh?"
entries.translation_source: So, what do you think? Cool stuff, huh?
entries.translated: Allora, che ne pensi? Roba forte, eh?

entries.original: "I’ll scrap you."
entries.translation_source: I’ll scrap you.
entries.translated: Ti farò a pezzi.

entries.original: "Think ecology. Think green."
entries.translation_source: Think ecology. Think green.
entries.translated: Pensa all{B4}ecologia. Pensa al verde.

entries.original: "I’ll recycle you."
entries.translation_source: I’ll recycle you.
entries.translated: Ti riciclerò.

entries.original:
"Out of the way!
I’ve got deliveries to make!"
entries.translation_source: Out of the way! I’ve got deliveries to make!
entries.translated: Fate largo! Devo fare delle consegne!

entries.original:
"All the delivering I do every
day\.

I’ve got deep muscle pain!"
entries.translation_source: All the delivering I do every day[game-token-1] I’ve got deep muscle pain!
entries.translated: Con tutte le consegne che faccio ogni giorno\. ho un forte dolore muscolare!

entries.original:
"What? You want me to deliver you
somewhere, too?"
entries.translation_source: What? You want me to deliver you somewhere, too?
entries.translated: Cosa? Vuoi che ti porti da qualche parte anche io?

entries.original:
"Fish, fish, fish, that’s what I
do! I’m gonna fish it all up!"
entries.translation_source: Fish, fish, fish, that’s what I do! I’m gonna fish it all up!
entries.translated: Pesco, pesco, pesco, è quello che faccio! Pescherò tutto quanto!

entries.original:
"Oh, waah!
I let that get away!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, waah! I let that get away!
entries.translated: Oh, uaaah! Me lo sono lasciato sfuggire!

entries.original:
"Kahahah!
I am at the top of my game!"
entries.translation_source: Kahahah! I am at the top of my game!
entries.translated: Kahahah! Sono al massimo della mia forma!

entries.original:
"My cohorts call me the emperor of
fishing!"
entries.translation_source: My cohorts call me the emperor of fishing!
entries.translated: I miei compagni mi chiamano l{B4}imperatore della pesca!

entries.original:
"Why the emperor of fishing?
It’s an ancient Chinese legend\."
entries.translation_source: Why the emperor of fishing? It’s an ancient Chinese legend[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Perché l{B4}imperatore della pesca? È un{B4}antica leggenda cinese\.

entries.original: "I landed another big one today!"
entries.translation_source: I landed another big one today!
entries.translated: Oggi ne ho pescato un altro grosso!

entries.original:
"My fishing-rod-handling technique
is the best.

Check it out!"
entries.translation_source: My fishing-rod-handling technique is the best. Check it out!
entries.translated: La mia tecnica nel maneggiare la canna da pesca è la migliore. Guarda qui!

entries.original:
"How I handle my fishing rod has
nothing to do with battling\."
entries.translation_source: How I handle my fishing rod has nothing to do with battling[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Il modo in cui uso la mia canna da pesca non ha nulla a che vedere con le lotte\.

entries.original:
"See it?
Surprised, I bet!"
entries.translation_source: See it? Surprised, I bet!
entries.translated: Lo vedi? Scommetto che sei sorpreso!

entries.original:
"When you get as good as me, you
can win easily, even if asleep."
entries.translation_source: When you get as good as me, you can win easily, even if asleep.
entries.translated: Quando diventi bravo quanto me, puoi vincere facilmente, anche se dormi.

entries.original: "Sssnore\."
entries.translation_source: Sssnore[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Rrrussa\.

entries.original:
"Can’t rightly say I much like
battling, I tell you."
entries.translation_source: Can’t rightly say I much like battling, I tell you.
entries.translated: Non posso certo dire che mi piaccia molto lottare, te lo dico.

entries.original:
"Grr\.

I’m so angry I could cry\."
entries.translation_source: Grr[game-token-1] I’m so angry I could cry[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Grr\. Sono così arrabbiato che potrei piangere\.

entries.original:
"I won, but\.
I’m still shaking\."
entries.translation_source: I won, but[game-token-1] I’m still shaking[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Ho vinto, ma\. sto ancora tremando\.

entries.original:
"If you want to run home to mommy,
here’s your chance, punk!"
entries.translation_source: If you want to run home to mommy, here’s your chance, punk!
entries.translated: Se vuoi scappare a casa da mammà, questa è la tua occasione, moccioso!

entries.original:
"Waah!
I want my mommy!"
entries.translation_source: Waah! I want my mommy!
entries.translated: Waaah! Voglio la mia mamma!

entries.original:
"Geheheh!
I told you!"
entries.translation_source: Geheheh! I told you!
entries.translated: Eheheh! Te l{B4}avevo detto!

entries.original:
"All right!
Let’s play a game!"
entries.translation_source: All right! Let’s play a game!
entries.translated: D{B4}accordo! Facciamo un gioco!

entries.original:
"Drat!
Came up short!"
entries.translation_source: Drat! Came up short!
entries.translated: Accidenti! Non ce l{B4}ho fatta!

entries.original: "Things didn’t work for you today."
entries.translation_source: Things didn’t work for you today.
entries.translated: Oggi le cose non ti sono andate bene.

entries.original: "I’m a rambling, gaming dude!"
entries.translation_source: I’m a rambling, gaming dude!
entries.translated: Sono un tipo girovago, appassionato di videogiochi!

entries.original: "Missed the big chance!"
entries.translation_source: Missed the big chance!
entries.translated: Hai perso la grande occasione!

entries.original:
"I’m a rambling, gaming dude!
I’m on a winning streak!"
entries.translation_source: I’m a rambling, gaming dude! I’m on a winning streak!
entries.translated: Sono un tipo girovago e appassionato di giochi! Sono in serie vincente!

entries.original:
"Competition!
I can’t get enough!"
entries.translation_source: Competition! I can’t get enough!
entries.translated: La competizione! Non ne ho mai abbastanza!

entries.original: "I had a chance!"
entries.translation_source: I had a chance!
entries.translated: Avevo una possibilità!

entries.original:
"You can’t be a coward in the world
of Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: You can’t be a coward in the world of Pokémon!
entries.translated: Non puoi essere un codardo nel mondo dei Pokémon!

entries.original:
"My beauty is what makes me
strong."
entries.translation_source: My beauty is what makes me strong.
entries.translated: La mia bellezza è ciò che mi rende forte.

entries.original: "You’re beautiful\."
entries.translation_source: You’re beautiful[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sei bellissimo\.

entries.original: "You weren’t ready for my beauty."
entries.translation_source: You weren’t ready for my beauty.
entries.translated: Non eri pronto per la mia bellezza.

entries.original:
"This may hurt a little bit, but
we’ll be done quick.

Hold still!"
entries.translation_source: This may hurt a little bit, but we’ll be done quick. Hold still!
entries.translated: Potrebbe farti un po{B4} male, ma finiremo presto. Stai fermo!

entries.original:
"Ooh, no!
That hurts!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh, no! That hurts!
entries.translated: Oh, no! Fa male!

entries.original:
"There!
Done!"
entries.translation_source: There! Done!
entries.translated: Ecco! Fatto!

entries.original:
"Lately, I’ve had a lot to worry
about\."
entries.translation_source: Lately, I’ve had a lot to worry about[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ultimamente ho avuto molte cose di cui preoccuparmi\.

entries.original: "You just added to my worries\."
entries.translation_source: You just added to my worries[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non hai fatto che aumentare le mie preoccupazioni\.

entries.original:
"Winning makes all my worries seem
trivial!"
entries.translation_source: Winning makes all my worries seem trivial!
entries.translated: Vincere fa sembrare banali tutte le mie preoccupazioni!

entries.original:
"Come to know defeat\.

Learn what it means to battle\."
entries.translation_source: Come to know defeat[game-token-1] Learn what it means to battle[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Vieni a conoscere la sconfitta\. Impara cosa significa lottare\.

entries.original: "The defeated merely slink away\."
entries.translation_source: The defeated merely slink away[game-token-1]
entries.translated: I sconfitti se ne vanno soltanto strisciando\.

entries.original:
"I see you becoming ever more
powerful\."
entries.translation_source: I see you becoming ever more powerful[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ti vedo diventare sempre più forte\.

entries.original: "Look into my eyes!"
entries.translation_source: Look into my eyes!
entries.translated: Guarda nei miei occhi!

entries.original:
"My power of suggestion failed to
charm you!"
entries.translation_source: My power of suggestion failed to charm you!
entries.translated: Il mio potere di persuasione non è riuscito ad ammaliarti!

entries.original: "You fell under my spell!"
entries.translation_source: You fell under my spell!
entries.translated: Ti sei fatto ipnotizzare dal mio incantesimo!

entries.original: "I focused my mind in silence\."
entries.translation_source: I focused my mind in silence[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ho concentrato la mente nel silenzio\.

entries.original: "\.Did it."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]Did it.
entries.translated: \.Fatto

entries.original:
"Close your eyes and count\.

Slow\.
Slower\."
entries.translation_source: Close your eyes and count[game-token-1] Slow[game-token-2] Slower[game-token-3]
entries.translated: Chiudi gli occhi e conta\. Piano\. Più piano\.

entries.original:
"Tch\.

I thought I could lull you to
sleep."
entries.translation_source: Tch[game-token-1] I thought I could lull you to sleep.
entries.translated: Tsk\. Pensavo di poterti far addormentare.

entries.original:
"That was the countdown to my
victory!"
entries.translation_source: That was the countdown to my victory!
entries.translated: Era il conto alla rovescia per la mia vittoria!

entries.original:
"My powers!
There’s no trickery about them!"
entries.translation_source: My powers! There’s no trickery about them!
entries.translated: I miei poteri! Non c{B4}è alcun trucco dietro!

entries.original: "There really is no trickery\."
entries.translation_source: There really is no trickery[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non c{B4}è davvero nessun trucco\.

entries.original: "This is psychic power!"
entries.translation_source: This is psychic power!
entries.translated: Questo è potere psichico!

entries.original: "Twirl, twirl, twirl\."
entries.translation_source: Twirl, twirl, twirl[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Gira, gira, gira\.

entries.original:
"Ooorgh\.

My head’s spinning\."
entries.translation_source: Ooorgh[game-token-1] My head’s spinning[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Uuugh\. Mi gira la testa\.

entries.original: "Are you feeling dizzy?"
entries.translation_source: Are you feeling dizzy?
entries.translated: Ti senti stordito?

entries.original:
"Oh, yeah! I’m feeling it!
I’m tuned in to your wavelength!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, yeah! I’m feeling it! I’m tuned in to your wavelength!
entries.translated: Oh, sì! Lo sento! Sono sintonizzato sulla tua stessa lunghezza d{B4}onda!

entries.original: "Tch! Losing threw off my rhythm!"
entries.translation_source: Tch! Losing threw off my rhythm!
entries.translated: Tsk! La sconfitta ha sconvolto il mio ritmo!

entries.original: "Tadaaaah!"
entries.translation_source: Tadaaaah!
entries.translated: Ta-daaaah!

entries.original:
"You should channel your feelings
into songs with sincerity, man."
entries.translation_source: You should channel your feelings into songs with sincerity, man.
entries.translated: Dovresti incanalare i tuoi sentimenti in canzoni sincere, amico.

entries.original:
"The way I feel now is kind of
folksy."
entries.translation_source: The way I feel now is kind of folksy.
entries.translated: Adesso mi sento un po{B4} alla buona.

entries.original:
"The way I feel now?
It’s rock!"
entries.translation_source: The way I feel now? It’s rock!
entries.translated: Come mi sento adesso? È rock!

entries.original: "Let’s get this session on!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s get this session on!
entries.translated: Diamo inizio a questa sessione!

entries.original:
"My dream of a world tour\.

It seems so far away\."
entries.translation_source: My dream of a world tour[game-token-1] It seems so far away[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Il mio sogno di fare un tour del mondo\. sembra così lontano\.

entries.original:
"You’re obviously short on
practice."
entries.translation_source: You’re obviously short on practice.
entries.translated: Hai chiaramente poca pratica.

entries.original:
"Howdy!
Are you a member of my fan club?"
entries.translation_source: Howdy! Are you a member of my fan club?
entries.translated: Ehilà! Sei un membro del mio fan club?

entries.original: "Oh, so you’re not a fan\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, so you’re not a fan[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Oh, quindi non sei un fan\.

entries.original:
"Lalalah\.
