My Pokémon, I send them out,\lall the girls scream and shout!"
entries.translation_source: Lalalah[game-token-1] My Pokémon, I send them out, all the girls scream and shout!
entries.translated: Lalalà\. I miei Pokémon, quando li mando in campo, tutte le ragazze urlano e fanno festa!

entries.original:
"Shard de Battle!
Shard de Battle!

Yah, yah!"
entries.translation_source: Shard de Battle! Shard de Battle! Yah, yah!
entries.translated: Shard de Battle! Shard de Battle! Yah, yah!

entries.original:
"Yah, yah!
Shard de lose!"
entries.translation_source: Yah, yah! Shard de lose!
entries.translated: Yah, yah! Shard de lose!

entries.original:
"Yah, yah!
Shard de win!"
entries.translation_source: Yah, yah! Shard de win!
entries.translated: Yah, yah! Shard per la vittoria!

entries.original: "Behold my dexterity and grace!"
entries.translation_source: Behold my dexterity and grace!
entries.translated: Ammira la mia destrezza e la mia grazia!

entries.original: "Whew! That was a jolt!"
entries.translation_source: Whew! That was a jolt!
entries.translated: Uff! Che scossa!

entries.original:
"Behold! You’ve been dazzled by my
prized Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Behold! You’ve been dazzled by my prized Pokémon!
entries.translated: Osserva! Sei stato abbagliato dal mio prezioso Pokémon!

entries.original:
"The credo of the Dragon Tamer!
Number one!"
entries.translation_source: The credo of the Dragon Tamer! Number one!
entries.translated: Il credo del Domadraghi! Numero uno!

entries.original:
"Even in defeat, roar!
Roar with your dragon!"
entries.translation_source: Even in defeat, roar! Roar with your dragon!
entries.translated: Anche nella sconfitta, ruggisci! Ruggisci con il tuo drago!

entries.original:
"In victory, roar!
Roar with your dragon!"
entries.translation_source: In victory, roar! Roar with your dragon!
entries.translated: Nella vittoria, ruggisci! Ruggisci con il tuo drago!

entries.original:
"See it! Feel it! The ultimate
power\.

Probably!"
entries.translation_source: See it! Feel it! The ultimate power[game-token-1] Probably!
entries.translated: Guarda! Sentilo! Il potere supremo\. Probabilmente!

entries.original:
"The title of the ultimate
probably!

I confer it on you!"
entries.translation_source: The title of the ultimate probably! I confer it on you!
entries.translated: Il titolo di supremo, probabilmente! Te lo conferisco!

entries.original:
"There is no defeat for me, the
ultimate\.

Probably!"
entries.translation_source: There is no defeat for me, the ultimate[game-token-1] Probably!
entries.translated: Non esiste sconfitta per me, il massimo\. Probabilmente!

entries.original: "Mighty! Like a dragon!"
entries.translation_source: Mighty! Like a dragon!
entries.translated: Potente! Come un drago!

entries.original:
"\.Urf\.

I wanted to be strong\."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]Urf[game-token-2] I wanted to be strong[game-token-3]
entries.translated: \.Urf\. Volevo essere forte\.

entries.original: "Strong, I am!"
entries.translation_source: Strong, I am!
entries.translated: Forte, sono io!

entries.original:
"Fly, fly, fly!
We’re going to rule this battle!"
entries.translation_source: Fly, fly, fly! We’re going to rule this battle!
entries.translated: Vola, vola, vola! Domineremo questa lotta!

entries.original: "We’re gonna crash!"
entries.translation_source: We’re gonna crash!
entries.translated: Ci schianteremo!

entries.original: "Zoom!"
entries.translation_source: Zoom!
entries.translated: Zoom!

entries.original:
"Now hear me!

The Bird Keeper’s credo number
one!"
entries.translation_source: Now hear me! The Bird Keeper’s credo number one!
entries.translated: Ora ascoltatemi! Il credo numero uno del Guardiagiardino!

entries.original: "Rest your wings on a loss!"
entries.translation_source: Rest your wings on a loss!
entries.translated: Riposa le ali dopo una sconfitta!

entries.original: "Soar high on a win!"
entries.translation_source: Soar high on a win!
entries.translated: Spicca il volo con una vittoria!

entries.original:
"There’s lots in life that doesn’t
go the way you want."
entries.translation_source: There’s lots in life that doesn’t go the way you want.
entries.translated: Ci sono tante cose nella vita che non vanno come vuoi.

entries.translation_source: See[game-token-1]?
entries.translated: Vedi\.?

entries.original:
"Yippee!
Things went my way!"
entries.translation_source: Yippee! Things went my way!
entries.translated: Evviva! È andata come volevo!

entries.original:
"A battle is deadly earnest!
Not a moment of inattention!"
entries.translation_source: A battle is deadly earnest! Not a moment of inattention!
entries.translated: Una lotta va presa terribilmente sul serio! Neanche un attimo di distrazione!

entries.original:
"I seemed to have let my mind
wander\."
entries.translation_source: I seemed to have let my mind wander[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sembra che mi sia distratto\.

entries.original: "Never let down your guard!"
entries.translation_source: Never let down your guard!
entries.translated: Non abbassare mai la guardia!

entries.original:
"My spirit burns, my fists are
steel, and my sweat cascades!"
entries.translation_source: My spirit burns, my fists are steel, and my sweat cascades!
entries.translated: Il mio spirito arde, i miei pugni sono d{B4}acciaio e il sudore mi cola a fiotti!

entries.original:
"I’ve fallen in defeat?
Gw-gwaaah!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve fallen in defeat? Gw-gwaaah!
entries.translated: Sono stato sconfitto? G-gwaaah!

entries.original:
"I sweated more.
That makes me the victor!"
entries.translation_source: I sweated more. That makes me the victor!
entries.translated: Ho sudato di più. Questo fa di me il vincitore!

entries.original:
"I only know how to go at full
power, even against a younger\lopponent!"
entries.translation_source: I only know how to go at full power, even against a younger opponent!
entries.translated: So andare solo a piena potenza, anche contro un avversario più giovane!

entries.original:
"Please! Let me call you Master
Trainer from now on!"
entries.translation_source: Please! Let me call you Master Trainer from now on!
entries.translated: Ti prego! Lasciami chiamarti Maestro Allenatore d{B4}ora in poi!

entries.original: "Full power is how I win!"
entries.translation_source: Full power is how I win!
entries.translated: Vinco con la massima potenza!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon have black belt-level
strength!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon have black belt-level strength!
entries.translated: I miei Pokémon hanno la forza di una cintura nera!

entries.original:
"I rarely meet anyone who’s better
than me\."
entries.translation_source: I rarely meet anyone who’s better than me[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Raramente incontro qualcuno migliore di me\.

entries.original: "You’ve been humiliated!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve been humiliated!
entries.translated: Sei stato umiliato!

entries.original:
"OK, OK!
Let’s be quick about this!"
entries.translation_source: OK, OK! Let’s be quick about this!
entries.translated: Va bene, va bene! Sbrighiamoci!

entries.original:
"Yup! Good going!
I like the way you battle!"
entries.translation_source: Yup! Good going! I like the way you battle!
entries.translated: Sì! Bel colpo! Mi piace il tuo modo di lottare!

entries.original:
"Yeah! Let’s do this again!
\.Oops. You’re out of Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Yeah! Let’s do this again! [game-token-1]Oops. You’re out of Pokémon!
entries.translated: Sì! Facciamolo di nuovo! \.Ops. Sei senza Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Hiyah!
There’s no holding anything back!"
entries.translation_source: Hiyah! There’s no holding anything back!
entries.translated: Hiyah! Nessuna trattenuta!

entries.original:
"I\. I concede! I think you’re on a
different level\."
entries.translation_source: I[game-token-1] I concede! I think you’re on a different level[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Io\. Mi arrendo! Credo che tu sia su un altro livello\.

entries.original:
"Hiyah! I put you in your place!
You better appreciate it!"
entries.translation_source: Hiyah! I put you in your place! You better appreciate it!
entries.translated: Hiyah! Ti ho rimesso al tuo posto! Faresti meglio ad apprezzarlo!

entries.original: "It’s the power of science!"
entries.translation_source: It’s the power of science!
entries.translated: È il potere della scienza!

entries.original:
"It’s inconceivable\.

How could the power of science be
defeated?"
entries.translation_source: It’s inconceivable[game-token-1] How could the power of science be defeated?
entries.translated: È inconcepibile\. Come può il potere della scienza essere sconfitto?

entries.original:
"Did you see? Were you amazed?
That’s the power of science!"
entries.translation_source: Did you see? Were you amazed? That’s the power of science!
entries.translated: Hai visto? Sei rimasto stupefatto? Questo è il potere della scienza!

entries.original:
"Charge, my Pokémon!

Demonstrate the fruits of our
experimentation!"
entries.translation_source: Charge, my Pokémon! Demonstrate the fruits of our experimentation!
entries.translated: All{B4}attacco, miei Pokémon! Dimostrate i frutti della nostra sperimentazione!

entries.original:
"What kind of experiments?
That’s classified."
entries.translation_source: What kind of experiments? That’s classified.
entries.translated: Che tipo di esperimenti? È classificato.

entries.original:
"Yes, my Pokémon proved my theory!
I’ll get my professorship now!"
entries.translation_source: Yes, my Pokémon proved my theory! I’ll get my professorship now!
entries.translated: Sì, i miei Pokémon hanno dimostrato la mia teoria! Ora otterrò la mia cattedra!

entries.original:
"I dropped my glasses.
I can’t see straight."
entries.translation_source: I dropped my glasses. I can’t see straight.
entries.translated: Ho perso gli occhiali. Non ci vedo più diritto.

entries.original:
"I guess I lost.
I can’t see enough to tell."
entries.translation_source: I guess I lost. I can’t see enough to tell.
entries.translated: Immagino di aver perso. Non riesco a vedere abbastanza per dirlo.

entries.original:
"I guess I won.
I can’t see enough to tell."
entries.translation_source: I guess I won. I can’t see enough to tell.
entries.translated: Credo di aver vinto. Non vedo abbastanza per dirlo.

entries.original:
"Steadily and surely. You build
from the little things up."
entries.translation_source: Steadily and surely. You build from the little things up.
entries.translated: Con costanza e sicurezza. Si costruisce partendo dalle piccole cose.

entries.original:
"But I did things steadily and
surely\."
entries.translation_source: But I did things steadily and surely[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ma io ho fatto le cose con costanza e sicurezza\.

entries.original: "Steadily and surely is how I won!"
entries.translation_source: Steadily and surely is how I won!
entries.translated: Ho vinto con costanza e sicurezza!

entries.original:
"You’re no good at all.
I’d better teach you."
entries.translation_source: You’re no good at all. I’d better teach you.
entries.translated: Sei proprio negato. Faresti meglio a farti insegnare.

entries.original:
"You’ve got good skills. You tried
hard, too. Excellent!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve got good skills. You tried hard, too. Excellent!
entries.translated: Hai delle buone capacità. Ti sei impegnato molto, anche. Eccellente!

entries.original:
"No, no, this won’t do at all.
Up on your feet. Never give up!"
entries.translation_source: No, no, this won’t do at all. Up on your feet. Never give up!
entries.translated: No, no, non va affatto bene. In piedi. Non arrenderti mai!

entries.original:
"Why get all intellectual about
things?

If it’s fun, why question it?"
entries.translation_source: Why get all intellectual about things? If it’s fun, why question it?
entries.translated: Perché farsi tutti questi problemi intellettuali? Se è divertente, perché porsi domande?

entries.original: "So I lost! If it’s fun, it’s cool!"
entries.translation_source: So I lost! If it’s fun, it’s cool!
entries.translated: Quindi ho perso! Se è divertente, va bene così!

entries.original:
"See, I can still win.
I don’t see a problem!"
entries.translation_source: See, I can still win. I don’t see a problem!
entries.translated: Vedi, posso ancora vincere. Non vedo alcun problema!

entries.original: "My ace Pokémon are on the go!"
entries.translation_source: My ace Pokémon are on the go!
entries.translated: I miei Pokémon di punta sono in azione!

entries.original: "I like the sense you show!"
entries.translation_source: I like the sense you show!
entries.translated: Mi piace il buon senso che dimostri!

entries.original: "You surprise me! Not too shabby!"
entries.translation_source: You surprise me! Not too shabby!
entries.translated: Mi sorprendi! Non sei niente male!

entries.original: "OK, bring it!"
entries.translation_source: OK, bring it!
entries.translated: Ok, fatti sotto!

entries.original:
"Hoh! You are tough!
Give me a rematch!"
entries.translation_source: Hoh! You are tough! Give me a rematch!
entries.translated: Oh! Sei tosto! Fammi la rivincita!

entries.original: "Hah! Too weak! Keep trying!"
entries.translation_source: Hah! Too weak! Keep trying!
entries.translated: Ah! Troppo debole! Continua a provare!

entries.original:
"I’ve caught you now.
Give up."
entries.translation_source: I’ve caught you now. Give up.
entries.translated: Ti ho preso. Arrenditi.

entries.original: "How could this be\.?"
entries.translation_source: How could this be[game-token-1]?
entries.translated: Com{B4}è possibile\.?

entries.original:
"You weren’t bad.
Let’s meet again."
entries.translation_source: You weren’t bad. Let’s meet again.
entries.translated: Non sei stato male. Incontriamoci di nuovo.

entries.original: "You need to be serious with me!"
entries.translation_source: You need to be serious with me!
entries.translated: Devi prendermi sul serio!

entries.original:
"OK\.

Quite remarkable\."
entries.translation_source: OK[game-token-1] Quite remarkable[game-token-2]
entries.translated: OK\. Davvero notevole\.

entries.original: "Oh? That’s it?"
entries.translation_source: Oh? That’s it?
entries.translated: Oh? Tutto qui?

entries.original:
"Hmhm\.

I must say I like the look in your
eyes."
entries.translation_source: Hmhm[game-token-1] I must say I like the look in your eyes.
entries.translated: Hmhm\. devo dire che mi piace il tuo sguardo.

entries.original:
"Your eyes shine brighter than any
big gemstone I keep at home!"
entries.translation_source: Your eyes shine brighter than any big gemstone I keep at home!
entries.translated: I tuoi occhi brillano più di qualsiasi grande gemma che tengo a casa!

entries.original:
"Your eyes remain unclouded in
defeat. Like jewels they are!"
entries.translation_source: Your eyes remain unclouded in defeat. Like jewels they are!
entries.translated: I tuoi occhi restano limpidi anche nella sconfitta. Sono come gioielli!

entries.original:
"When I was your age, I was quite
the daredevil, I must say."
entries.translation_source: When I was your age, I was quite the daredevil, I must say.
entries.translated: Quando avevo la tua età, ero proprio un tipo temerario, devo dire.

entries.original:
"I daresay, you’re quite the
daredevil yourself!"
entries.translation_source: I daresay, you’re quite the daredevil yourself!
entries.translated: Direi che anche tu sei piuttosto spericolato!

entries.original:
"Seeing you reminds me of my own
wild youth."
entries.translation_source: Seeing you reminds me of my own wild youth.
entries.translated: Vederti mi ricorda la mia giovinezza selvaggia.

entries.original:
"I shall regress to my childhood
for this battle."
entries.translation_source: I shall regress to my childhood for this battle.
entries.translated: Regredirò alla mia infanzia per questa lotta.

entries.original: "You’re no ordinary trainer."
entries.translation_source: You’re no ordinary trainer.
entries.translated: Non sei un Allenatore qualsiasi.

entries.original:
"You still got a long road,
young one."
entries.translation_source: You still got a long road, young one.
entries.translated: Hai ancora tanta strada da fare, giovane.

entries.original:
"I like rivers more than the sea.
Which do you prefer?"
entries.translation_source: I like rivers more than the sea. Which do you prefer?
entries.translated: Preferisco i fiumi al mare. Tu cosa preferisci?

entries.original:
"I don’t like the sea because the
salty water burns my eyes!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t like the sea because the salty water burns my eyes!
entries.translated: Non mi piace il mare perché l{B4}acqua salata mi brucia gli occhi!

entries.original:
"Water in rivers is cold,
but it feels just super."
entries.translation_source: Water in rivers is cold, but it feels just super.
entries.translated: L{B4}acqua nei fiumi è fredda, ma è proprio fantastica.

entries.original: "Go, go, go! Go, my Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Go, go, go! Go, my Pokémon!
entries.translated: Vai, vai, vai! Vai, mio Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Good effort! Way to go,
my Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Good effort! Way to go, my Pokémon!
entries.translated: Ottimo lavoro! Avanti così, mio Pokémon!

entries.original:
"That’s the way!
Way to go, my Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: That’s the way! Way to go, my Pokémon!
entries.translated: Ecco così! Bravo, mio Pokémon!

entries.original:
"I\. I can swim, really!
I don’t need my inner tube!"
entries.translation_source: I[game-token-1] I can swim, really! I don’t need my inner tube!
entries.translated: Io\. Posso davvero nuotare! Non mi serve la mia ciambella!

entries.original: "I\. I’m not lying!"
entries.translation_source: I[game-token-1] I’m not lying!
entries.translated: Io\. non sto mentendo!

entries.original: "It\. It’s true!"
entries.translation_source: It[game-token-1] It’s true!
entries.translated: È\. È vero!

entries.original:
"The beach sand is so hot!

It makes me go, \qoOuch, ouch,
ouch!\qc"
entries.translation_source: The beach sand is so hot! It makes me go, [quote-open-1]Ouch, ouch, ouch![quote-close-2]
entries.translated: La sabbia della spiaggia è così calda! Mi fa dire, \qoAhi, ahi, ahi!\qc

entries.original: "Ouch, ouch, ouch!"
entries.translation_source: Ouch, ouch, ouch!
entries.translated: Ahi, ahi, ahi!

entries.original: "I love the sea!"
entries.translation_source: I love the sea!
entries.translated: Amo il mare!

entries.original:
"I’m a girl in love with her inner
tube! Nice to meet you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m a girl in love with her inner tube! Nice to meet you!
entries.translated: Sono una ragazza innamorata del suo salvagente! Piacere di conoscerti!

entries.original:
"Good-bye!

I’m a girl in love with her inner
tube!"
entries.translation_source: Good-bye! I’m a girl in love with her inner tube!
entries.translated: Arrivederci! Sono una ragazza innamorata del mio salvagente!

entries.original:
"Thank you!

I’m a girl in love with her inner
tube!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you! I’m a girl in love with her inner tube!
entries.translated: Grazie! Sono una ragazza innamorata del suo salvagente!

entries.original:
"It’s not like I can’t swim.
I just like my inner tube."
entries.translation_source: It’s not like I can’t swim. I just like my inner tube.
entries.translated: Non è che non sappia nuotare. È solo che mi piace la mia ciambella gonfiabile.

entries.original: "Flip, flop!"
entries.translation_source: Flip, flop!
entries.translated: Gira, rigira!

entries.original: "Splish, splash!"
entries.translation_source: Splish, splash!
entries.translated: Splash, splash!

entries.original:
"Let me introduce to you my
cherished partners!"
entries.translation_source: Let me introduce to you my cherished partners!
entries.translated: Lascia che ti presenti i miei cari compagni!

entries.original:
"The effort you put in is what’s
important."
entries.translation_source: The effort you put in is what’s important.
entries.translated: L{B4}impegno che ci metti è ciò che conta.

entries.original:
"How did you find them?
My cherished partners."
entries.translation_source: How did you find them? My cherished partners.
entries.translated: Come li hai trovati? I miei cari compagni.

entries.original:
"Raising Pokémon takes a lot of
honest effort!"
entries.translation_source: Raising Pokémon takes a lot of honest effort!
entries.translated: Allevare i Pokémon richiede tanto impegno sincero!

entries.original:
"Urgwah! Look what you’ve done to
my Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Urgwah! Look what you’ve done to my Pokémon!
entries.translated: Grr! Guarda cosa hai fatto ai miei Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Yahaha! I’ve had a hands-on time
raising these Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Yahaha! I’ve had a hands-on time raising these Pokémon!
entries.translated: Yahaha! Mi sono divertito un sacco ad allevare questi Pokémon!

entries.original: "I live among Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I live among Pokémon.
entries.translated: Vivo tra i Pokémon

entries.original: "I’m just not much of a battler."
entries.translation_source: I’m just not much of a battler.
entries.translated: Non sono proprio portato per le lotte.

entries.original:
"I’ve never been much of a battler,
but\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve never been much of a battler, but[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non sono mai stato un gran combattente, però\.

entries.original:
"I’ll check how your Pokémon have
grown for you."
entries.translation_source: I’ll check how your Pokémon have grown for you.
entries.translated: Controllerò come sono cresciuti i tuoi Pokémon.

entries.original:
"This is impressive!

You’ve raised your Pokémon really
thoroughly."
entries.translation_source: This is impressive! You’ve raised your Pokémon really thoroughly.
entries.translated: Impressionante! Hai cresciuto i tuoi Pokémon in modo davvero accurato.

entries.original:
"Not good enough!

Your training style’s not up to
par."
entries.translation_source: Not good enough! Your training style’s not up to par.
entries.translated: Non abbastanza bene! Il tuo stile di allenamento non è all{B4}altezza.

entries.original:
"It’s no good to be too harsh\.
But pampering is also out\."
entries.translation_source: It’s no good to be too harsh[game-token-1] But pampering is also out[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Non va bene essere troppo severi\. Ma anche viziare troppo è fuori discussione\.

entries.original:
"Being a Pokémon Breeder is a deep
and complex challenge."
entries.translation_source: Being a Pokémon Breeder is a deep and complex challenge.
entries.translated: Essere un Allevatore di Pokémon è una sfida profonda e complessa.

entries.original:
"Balance is key for raising good
Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Balance is key for raising good Pokémon.
entries.translated: L{B4}equilibrio è la chiave per allevare bene i Pokémon.

entries.original:
"I specialize in raising cute
Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I specialize in raising cute Pokémon!
entries.translated: Mi occupo di allevare Pokémon carini!

entries.original: "Oh, but they’re so cute!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, but they’re so cute!
entries.translated: Oh, ma sono così carini!

entries.original: "Cute, yet strong! Right?"
entries.translation_source: Cute, yet strong! Right?
entries.translated: Carino, ma forte! Giusto?

entries.original:
"My love of nature and Pokémon made
a Ranger out of me!"
entries.translation_source: My love of nature and Pokémon made a Ranger out of me!
entries.translated: Il mio amore per la natura e i Pokémon ha fatto di me un Ranger!

entries.original:
"Ooh\. I still love to
battle, too."
entries.translation_source: Ooh[game-token-1] I still love to battle, too.
entries.translated: Oh\. anch{B4}io adoro ancora lottare.

entries.original: "I love to battle, too!"
entries.translation_source: I love to battle, too!
entries.translated: Anche a me piace combattere!

entries.original:
"Hi! Have you ever considered a
career as a Ranger?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! Have you ever considered a career as a Ranger?
entries.translated: Ciao! Hai mai pensato a una carriera da Ranger?

entries.original:
"Yes, you’ve got the mettle.
Being a Ranger is a lot of fun!"
entries.translation_source: Yes, you’ve got the mettle. Being a Ranger is a lot of fun!
entries.translated: Sì, hai la tempra giusta. Essere un Ranger è davvero divertente!

entries.original:
"Well, you might not make it at
your skill level."
entries.translation_source: Well, you might not make it at your skill level.
entries.translated: Beh, forse non ce la farai al tuo livello di abilità.

entries.original:
"Win or lose, a battle happens only
once!"
entries.translation_source: Win or lose, a battle happens only once!
entries.translated: Che si vinca o si perda, una lotta si combatte una sola volta!

entries.original: "I have no regrets!"
entries.translation_source: I have no regrets!
entries.translated: Non ho rimpianti!

entries.original: "Do you have any regret?"
entries.translation_source: Do you have any regret?
entries.translated: Hai qualche rimpianto?

entries.original:
"It’s my sworn duty to protect
nature and the Pokémon in it."
entries.translation_source: It’s my sworn duty to protect nature and the Pokémon in it.
entries.translated: È il mio sacro dovere proteggere la natura e i Pokémon che la abitano.

entries.original:
"It’s a challenging life, but
there’s a lot to enjoy every day."
entries.translation_source: It’s a challenging life, but there’s a lot to enjoy every day.
entries.translated: È una vita difficile, ma ogni giorno c{B4}è molto da apprezzare.

entries.original:
"It’s a rewarding career.
How does it sound to you?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a rewarding career. How does it sound to you?
entries.translated: È una carriera gratificante. Che ne pensi?

entries.original:
"The power of nature!
Let me show you!"
entries.translation_source: The power of nature! Let me show you!
entries.translated: Il potere della natura! Lascia che te lo mostri!

entries.original: "Protect the natural environment\."
entries.translation_source: Protect the natural environment[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Proteggi l{B4}ambiente naturale\.

entries.original: "This is the power of nature!"
entries.translation_source: This is the power of nature!
entries.translated: Questo è il potere della natura!

entries.original:
"I didn’t sleep while trying to
come up with this new strategy!"
entries.translation_source: I didn’t sleep while trying to come up with this new strategy!
entries.translated: Non ho dormito mentre cercavo di escogitare questa nuova strategia!

entries.original:
"Oh, but\. I really needed to
sleep tonight\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, but[game-token-1] I really needed to sleep tonight[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh, ma\. avevo davvero bisogno di dormire stanotte\.

entries.original: "My strategy worked!"
entries.translation_source: My strategy worked!
entries.translated: La mia strategia ha funzionato!

entries.original:
"You’re going to lose, but you’ll
get to enjoy a nice aroma!"
entries.translation_source: You’re going to lose, but you’ll get to enjoy a nice aroma!
entries.translated: Perderai, ma potrai goderti un bel profumo!

entries.original:
"Ah\. the scent of defeat.
What a bitter taste it leaves\."
entries.translation_source: Ah[game-token-1] the scent of defeat. What a bitter taste it leaves[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Ah\. il profumo della sconfitta. Che sapore amaro lascia\.

entries.original:
"Kyahaha! That’s what you get for
swooning to my aroma!"
entries.translation_source: Kyahaha! That’s what you get for swooning to my aroma!
entries.translated: Kyahaha! Questo ti sta bene per essere svenuto per il mio aroma!

entries.original:
"Smelling sweet scents makes me so
drowsy\."
entries.translation_source: Smelling sweet scents makes me so drowsy[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Annusare dolci profumi mi rende così assonnato\.

entries.original: "\.Yawn\. Oh, really? I lost?"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]Yawn[game-token-2] Oh, really? I lost?
entries.translated: \.Sbadiglio\. Oh, davvero? Ho perso?

entries.original:
"\.Yawn\. Oh? Are we finished
so soon?"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]Yawn[game-token-2] Oh? Are we finished so soon?
entries.translated: \.Sbadiglio\. Oh? Abbiamo finito così presto?

entries.original: "Sniff\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Annusa\.

entries.original:
"Ooohhh\. the sweet scent of
victory!"
entries.translation_source: Ooohhh[game-token-1] the sweet scent of victory!
entries.translated: Oooohhh\. il dolce profumo della vittoria!

entries.original:
"Can you smell that?
The scent of defeat!"
entries.translation_source: Can you smell that? The scent of defeat!
entries.translated: Lo senti? Il profumo della sconfitta!

entries.original:
"Exploring relics isn’t all fun
and games!"
entries.translation_source: Exploring relics isn’t all fun and games!
entries.translated: Esplorare reliquie non è solo divertimento!

entries.original: "Danger lurks everywhere in ruins!"
entries.translation_source: Danger lurks everywhere in ruins!
entries.translated: Il pericolo si nasconde ovunque tra le rovine!

entries.original:
"Your skill level says you probably
won’t make a good Ruin Maniac."
entries.translation_source: Your skill level says you probably won’t make a good Ruin Maniac.
entries.translated: Il tuo livello di abilità dice che probabilmente non diventerai un buon Maniaco delle Rovine.

entries.original:
"I travel around in search of lost
treasures."
entries.translation_source: I travel around in search of lost treasures.
entries.translated: Viaggio in giro alla ricerca di tesori perduti.

entries.original: "You sure seem to be hectic."
entries.translation_source: You sure seem to be hectic.
entries.translated: Sembri davvero agitato.

entries.original:
"The rest of the time, I fish and
tend to crops every single day."
entries.translation_source: The rest of the time, I fish and tend to crops every single day.
entries.translated: Il resto del tempo, pesco e mi occupo dei raccolti ogni singolo giorno.

entries.original:
"These mates of mine traveled the
world with me!"
entries.translation_source: These mates of mine traveled the world with me!
entries.translated: Questi miei compagni hanno viaggiato il mondo con me!

entries.original:
"Maybe it’s time we hit the road
again\."
entries.translation_source: Maybe it’s time we hit the road again[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Forse è tempo di rimetterci in viaggio\.

entries.original:
"What do you say?
Pretty tough, right?"
entries.translation_source: What do you say? Pretty tough, right?
entries.translated: Che ne dici? Piuttosto tosto, vero?

entries.original:
"My father’s one of the richest
people in Borrius."
entries.translation_source: My father’s one of the richest people in Borrius.
entries.translated: Mio padre è una delle persone più ricche di Borrius.

entries.original: "My father will hear about this!"
entries.translation_source: My father will hear about this!
entries.translated: Mio padre lo verrà a sapere!

entries.original:
"Money speaks louder than
determination, I see."
entries.translation_source: Money speaks louder than determination, I see.
entries.translated: Il denaro parla più forte della determinazione, vedo.

entries.original:
"My family supported the building
of this place, so I get the\lbest seats at all the shows."
entries.translation_source: My family supported the building of this place, so I get the best seats at all the shows.
entries.translated: La mia famiglia ha sostenuto la costruzione di questo luogo, quindi ho i posti migliori a tutti gli spettacoli.

entries.original: "I should have just watched\."
entries.translation_source: I should have just watched[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Avrei dovuto limitarmi a guardare\.

entries.original: "Well, of course. I’m rich."
entries.translation_source: Well, of course. I’m rich.
entries.translated: Beh, certo. Sono ricco.

entries.original:
"Ultimately, Pokémon is just
another brand.

You know who’ll win, right?"
entries.translation_source: Ultimately, Pokémon is just another brand. You know who’ll win, right?
entries.translated: Alla fine, i Pokémon sono solo un altro marchio. Sai chi vincerà, giusto?

entries.original:
"But how\. My\.
The Pokémon I’ve invested\."
entries.translation_source: But how[game-token-1] My[game-token-2] The Pokémon I’ve invested[game-token-3]
entries.translated: Ma come\. I miei\. I Pokémon in cui ho investito\.

entries.original:
"I’m not interested in what was an
inevitable result."
entries.translation_source: I’m not interested in what was an inevitable result.
entries.translated: Non mi interessa un risultato inevitabile.

entries.original:
"There isn’t anything that I can’t buy.
Money can buy battles!"
entries.translation_source: There isn’t anything that I can’t buy. Money can buy battles!
entries.translated: Non c{B4}è nulla che io non possa comprare. Con i soldi si comprano le lotte!

entries.original:
"I’ll give you my allowance if
you’ll let me win."
entries.translation_source: I’ll give you my allowance if you’ll let me win.
entries.translated: Ti darò la mia paghetta se mi lasci vincere.

entries.original:
"There’s nothing that money can’t
buy."
entries.translation_source: There’s nothing that money can’t buy.
entries.translated: Non c{B4}è nulla che il denaro non possa comprare.

entries.original:
"It’s fine, fine.
No need to say a word."
entries.translation_source: It’s fine, fine. No need to say a word.
entries.translated: Va bene, va bene. Non c{B4}è bisogno di dire una parola.

entries.original:
"It’s fine, fine.
No need to say a word."
entries.translation_source: It’s fine, fine. No need to say a word.
entries.translated: Va bene, va bene. Non c{B4}è bisogno di dire una parola.

entries.original:
"It’s fine, fine.
You tried your best, I know."
entries.translation_source: It’s fine, fine. You tried your best, I know.
entries.translated: Va bene, va bene. Hai fatto del tuo meglio, lo so.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

So, you’re good, huh?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] So, you’re good, huh?
entries.translated: Hmm\. Quindi sei forte, eh?

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

So, you are good.
Hmm\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] So, you are good. Hmm[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Hmm\. Allora, sei forte. Hmm\.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You’re no big deal. Hmm?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] You’re no big deal. Hmm?
entries.translated: Mmh\. Non sei niente di che. Mmh?

entries.original:
"Let us paint a picture to last an
eternity!"
entries.translation_source: Let us paint a picture to last an eternity!
entries.translated: Dipingeremo un quadro che durerà per l{B4}eternità!

entries.original:
"Perhaps I should stick to painting
landscapes\."
entries.translation_source: Perhaps I should stick to painting landscapes[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Forse dovrei limitarmi a dipingere paesaggi\.

entries.original:
"The colors of your Pokémon are
dull."
entries.translation_source: The colors of your Pokémon are dull.
entries.translated: I colori dei tuoi Pokémon sono spenti.

entries.original:
"Hmmm\. hold still right there!
I must paint that powerful pose!"
entries.translation_source: Hmmm[game-token-1] hold still right there! I must paint that powerful pose!
entries.translated: Mmm\. non muoverti proprio lì! Devo dipingere quella posa potente!

entries.original:
"What a brilliant display! I would
love to paint your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: What a brilliant display! I would love to paint your Pokémon.
entries.translated: Che dimostrazione brillante! Vorrei dipingere i tuoi Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Oh, my dears! Your vivid colors
have shone through!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, my dears! Your vivid colors have shone through!
entries.translated: Oh, miei cari! I vostri colori vivaci hanno risplenduto!

entries.original: "Art isn’t my only talent!"
entries.translation_source: Art isn’t my only talent!
entries.translated: L{B4}arte non è il mio unico talento!

entries.original:
"Aargh! I got some paint in
my eyes!"
entries.translation_source: Aargh! I got some paint in my eyes!
entries.translated: Aaagh! Mi è finita della vernice negli occhi!

entries.original:
"I guess a style change from city
skylines to battles was warranted!"
entries.translation_source: I guess a style change from city skylines to battles was warranted!
entries.translated: Immagino che un cambio di stile dai panorami cittadini alle lotte fosse opportuno!

entries.original: "May I take your order, please?"
entries.translation_source: May I take your order, please?
entries.translated: Posso prendere il vostro ordine, per favore?

entries.original:
"Ah, an excellent choice.
A win served fresh."
entries.translation_source: Ah, an excellent choice. A win served fresh.
entries.translated: Ah, un{B4}ottima scelta. Una vittoria appena servita.

entries.original:
"Ah, a fine choice.
One loss served fresh."
entries.translation_source: Ah, a fine choice. One loss served fresh.
entries.translated: Ah, una scelta ottima. Una sconfitta servita fresca.

entries.original:
"For battles and order taking,
speed is essential!"
entries.translation_source: For battles and order taking, speed is essential!
entries.translated: Per le battaglie e prendere le ordinazioni, la velocità è essenziale!

entries.original:
"Food is like battling.
Serve it while it’s hot!"
entries.translation_source: Food is like battling. Serve it while it’s hot!
entries.translated: Il cibo è come una lotta. Va servito finché è caldo!

entries.original:
"Like, chop-chop!
You got served."
entries.translation_source: Like, chop-chop! You got served.
entries.translated: Tipo, sbrigati! Ti ho servito.

entries.original:
"Ah, welcome!
I’m your server today!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, welcome! I’m your server today!
entries.translated: Ah, benvenuto! Oggi sono il tuo cameriere!

entries.original: "Thank you so much!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you so much!
entries.translated: Grazie mille!

entries.original:
"Would you care to settle your
bill?"
entries.translation_source: Would you care to settle your bill?
entries.translated: Vuole saldare il conto?

entries.original:
"My job is about serving others.
But don’t expect me to serve here."
entries.translation_source: My job is about serving others. But don’t expect me to serve here.
entries.translated: Il mio lavoro consiste nel servire gli altri. Ma non aspettarti che serva qui.

entries.original:
"Why couldn’t you serve me?
You won’t make friends that way!"
entries.translation_source: Why couldn’t you serve me? You won’t make friends that way!
entries.translated: Perché non sei riuscito a servirmi? Così non ti farai amici!

entries.original: "How may I serve you?"
entries.translation_source: How may I serve you?
entries.translated: Come posso servirti?

entries.original:
"What I really hoped to become was
a cook."
entries.translation_source: What I really hoped to become was a cook.
entries.translated: Quello che speravo davvero di diventare era uno chef.

entries.original:
"I just find it hard talking to
strangers."
entries.translation_source: I just find it hard talking to strangers.
entries.translated: Trovo solo difficile parlare con gli sconosciuti.

entries.original:
"I don’t mind this job now, mind
you."
entries.translation_source: I don’t mind this job now, mind you.
entries.translated: Questo lavoro non mi dispiace, però.

entries.original:
"I love cute customers like you!
I’ll serve you right!"
entries.translation_source: I love cute customers like you! I’ll serve you right!
entries.translated: Adoro clienti carini come te! Ti servirò come si deve!

entries.original:
"Oh, but\. I’m not done serving
you."
entries.translation_source: Oh, but[game-token-1] I’m not done serving you.
entries.translated: Oh, ma\. non ho ancora finito di servirti.

entries.original:
"Well, were you happy with the way
I served you?"
entries.translation_source: Well, were you happy with the way I served you?
entries.translated: Beh, sei stato contento di come ti ho servito?

entries.original:
"You can shake hands with me!

It would be quite the honour for
you!"
entries.translation_source: You can shake hands with me! It would be quite the honour for you!
entries.translated: Puoi stringermi la mano! Sarebbe un grande onore per te!

entries.original:
"My management team will have
something to say about this!"
entries.translation_source: My management team will have something to say about this!
entries.translated: Il mio team dirigenziale avrà qualcosa da dire al riguardo!

entries.original:
"If you’d won, I would have even
given you my autograph!"
entries.translation_source: If you’d won, I would have even given you my autograph!
entries.translated: Se avessi vinto, ti avrei persino dato il mio autografo!

entries.original: "Thanks for supporting me!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks for supporting me!
entries.translated: Grazie per il sostegno!

entries.original:
"What a horrible way to treat an
idol\."
entries.translation_source: What a horrible way to treat an idol[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Che modo orribile di trattare un idolo\.

entries.original: "Oh? You’re not my fan?"
entries.translation_source: Oh? You’re not my fan?
entries.translated: Oh? Non sei un mio fan?

entries.original: "Watch me! All eyes on me!"
entries.translation_source: Watch me! All eyes on me!
entries.translated: Guardatemi! Tutti gli occhi su di me!

entries.original:
"I became an idol because I wanted
everyone to see me!"
entries.translation_source: I became an idol because I wanted everyone to see me!
entries.translated: Sono diventata un idolo perché volevo che tutti mi vedessero!

entries.original: "Ooh\. This is what I live for\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh[game-token-1] This is what I live for[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oooh\. È per questo che vivo\.

entries.original:
"A battle, you say?
I’m never losing to you!"
entries.translation_source: A battle, you say? I’m never losing to you!
entries.translated: Una lotta, dici? Non perderò mai contro di te!

entries.original: "Urk\. We lost\."
entries.translation_source: Urk[game-token-1] We lost[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Urk\. Abbiamo perso\.

entries.original:
"Yeehah! Yippee!
I won, I won!"
entries.translation_source: Yeehah! Yippee! I won, I won!
entries.translated: Yeehah! Yippee! Ho vinto, ho vinto!

entries.original: "Kneel down before me!"
entries.translation_source: Kneel down before me!
entries.translated: Inginocchiati davanti a me!

entries.original:
"My mommy always says that to my
daddy!"
entries.translation_source: My mommy always says that to my daddy!
entries.translated: La mia mamma dice sempre così al mio papà!

entries.original:
"Hee hee hee.
Just what I wanted!"
entries.translation_source: Hee hee hee. Just what I wanted!
entries.translated: Ih ih ih. Proprio quello che volevo!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon are cute,
but they’re not very tough!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon are cute, but they’re not very tough!
entries.translated: I miei Pokémon sono carini, ma non sono molto resistenti!

entries.original:
"It’s OK. I like my Pokémon.
That’s all that matters."
entries.translation_source: It’s OK. I like my Pokémon. That’s all that matters.
entries.translated: Va bene. Mi piacciono i miei Pokémon. È tutto ciò che conta.

entries.original: "Oh? We won? Seriously?"
entries.translation_source: Oh? We won? Seriously?
entries.translated: Oh? Abbiamo vinto? Sul serio?

entries.original: "Ready, start!"
entries.translation_source: Ready, start!
entries.translated: Pronti, via!

entries.original: "Waah! Wait for me!"
entries.translation_source: Waah! Wait for me!
entries.translated: Waaah! Aspettami!

entries.original: "First across the finish line!"
entries.translation_source: First across the finish line!
entries.translated: Primo a tagliare il traguardo!

entries.original:
"I run a marathon every morning!
It’s great!"
entries.translation_source: I run a marathon every morning! It’s great!
entries.translated: Faccio una maratona ogni mattina! È fantastico!

entries.original:
"So I lost! I can still run great
marathons!"
entries.translation_source: So I lost! I can still run great marathons!
entries.translated: Così ho perso! Posso ancora correre grandi maratone!

entries.original:
"My buff physique makes for easy
wins!"
entries.translation_source: My buff physique makes for easy wins!
entries.translated: Il mio fisico prestante mi garantisce facili vittorie!

entries.original:
"I’ll run on the spot while battling
for the good of my health."
entries.translation_source: I’ll run on the spot while battling for the good of my health.
entries.translated: Farò jogging sul posto mentre lotto per il bene della mia salute.

entries.original:
"Gasp! My ankle!
I rolled my ankle!"
entries.translation_source: Gasp! My ankle! I rolled my ankle!
entries.translated: Ahi! La mia caviglia! Mi sono storto la caviglia!

entries.original: "Run! Faster!"
entries.translation_source: Run! Faster!
entries.translated: Corri! Più veloce!

entries.original:
"Little boy? Little girl?
Doesn’t matter which.

Let’s do this!"
entries.translation_source: Little boy? Little girl? Doesn’t matter which. Let’s do this!
entries.translated: Ragazzino? Ragazzina? Non importa quale. Facciamolo!

entries.original:
"Little boy? Little girl?

Doesn’t matter which, but you’re
sure tough!"
entries.translation_source: Little boy? Little girl? Doesn’t matter which, but you’re sure tough!
entries.translated: Bambino? Bambina? Non importa quale, ma sei davvero tosto!

entries.original:
"Little boy? Little girl?
Doesn’t matter which, but sorry."
entries.translation_source: Little boy? Little girl? Doesn’t matter which, but sorry.
entries.translated: Bambino? Bambina? Non importa quale, ma mi dispiace.

entries.original:
"All right, take a run at me!
My barrel chest can take it!"
entries.translation_source: All right, take a run at me! My barrel chest can take it!
entries.translated: Bene, fatti sotto! Il mio petto a botte può reggere l{B4}urto!

entries.original:
"Ooh\. Ow\. That hurt\.

It’s like you broke my barrel
chest\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh[game-token-1] Ow[game-token-2] That hurt[game-token-3] It’s like you broke my barrel chest[game-token-4]
entries.translated: Oh\. Ahi\. Che male\. È come se mi avessi sfondato il petto a botte\.

entries.original:
"What? That’s all you’ve got?
You can take a harder run at me!"
entries.translation_source: What? That’s all you’ve got? You can take a harder run at me!
entries.translated: Cosa? È tutto qui quello che hai? Puoi affrontarmi con più grinta!

entries.original:
"My favorite drink is Moomoo Milk.
Got some?"
entries.translation_source: My favorite drink is Moomoo Milk. Got some?
entries.translated: La mia bevanda preferita è il Latte Mumu. Ne hai un po{B4}?

entries.original:
"Gwaah! Moomoo Milk!
Bring me some Moomoo Milk!"
entries.translation_source: Gwaah! Moomoo Milk! Bring me some Moomoo Milk!
entries.translated: Gwaah! Latte Mumu! Portami un po{B4} di Latte Mumu!

entries.original:
"Wahaha! I get the win!
Let’s celebrate over some milk!"
entries.translation_source: Wahaha! I get the win! Let’s celebrate over some milk!
entries.translated: Wahaha! Ho vinto io! Festeggiamo con un po{B4} di latte!

entries.original: "Do your best! My beloved children!"
entries.translation_source: Do your best! My beloved children!
entries.translated: Fate del vostro meglio! Miei amati figli!

entries.original: "My Pokémon are my beloved family."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon are my beloved family.
entries.translated: I miei Pokémon sono la mia amata famiglia.

entries.original:
"Wahaha! Well done!
Mama’s proud of you!"
entries.translation_source: Wahaha! Well done! Mama’s proud of you!
entries.translated: Ahahah! Ben fatto! La mamma è fiera di te!

entries.original:
"I’m not getting any younger.
I can’t overexert myself."
entries.translation_source: I’m not getting any younger. I can’t overexert myself.
entries.translated: Non sto ringiovanendo. Non posso sforzarmi troppo.

entries.original:
"Oh, you’re good and young.
There’s a sparkle about you."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you’re good and young. There’s a sparkle about you.
entries.translated: Oh, sei bravo e giovane. C{B4}è una scintilla in te.

entries.original:
"What I lack in youth, I make up
for in experience."
entries.translation_source: What I lack in youth, I make up for in experience.
entries.translated: Ciò che mi manca in gioventù, lo compenso con l{B4}esperienza.

entries.original:
"Smell that?

That’s the smell of hay clinging
to my body."
entries.translation_source: Smell that? That’s the smell of hay clinging to my body.
entries.translated: Senti quell{B4}odore? È l{B4}odore del fieno che mi si è attaccato addosso.

entries.original:
"This smell I have is the sweet
scent of hay that Pokémon surely\llove."
entries.translation_source: This smell I have is the sweet scent of hay that Pokémon surely love.
entries.translated: Questo odore che ho è il dolce profumo del fieno che sicuramente i Pokémon adorano.

entries.original: "Whoa!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa!
entries.translated: Wow!

entries.original:
"I won’t lose to a child like you
who knows nothing of battles."
entries.translation_source: I won’t lose to a child like you who knows nothing of battles.
entries.translated: Non perderò contro un ragazzino come te che non sa nulla delle lotte.

entries.original:
"What? This child is a fast learner?
Ha ha ha\. I had no idea!"
entries.translation_source: What? This child is a fast learner? Ha ha ha[game-token-1] I had no idea!
entries.translated: Cosa? Questo bambino impara in fretta? Ah ah ah\. Non ne avevo idea!

entries.original:
"After all, you are an amateur.
No sweat.

(Whew\. That was a little too
close!)"
entries.translation_source: After all, you are an amateur. No sweat. (Whew[game-token-1] That was a little too close!)
entries.translated: In fondo, sei un dilettante. Tranquillo. (Uff\. È stato un po{B4} troppo vicino!)

entries.original:
"Argh. Cough, cough.
I don’t feel well.

Please show a little kindness."
entries.translation_source: Argh. Cough, cough. I don’t feel well. Please show a little kindness.
entries.translated: Argh. Cough, cough. Non mi sento bene. Per favore, mostrati un po{B4} gentile.

entries.original:
"You are very sharp! You did not
fall for my illness act."
entries.translation_source: You are very sharp! You did not fall for my illness act.
entries.translated: Sei molto perspicace! Non ti sei lasciato ingannare dalla mia finta malattia.

entries.original:
"I lied when I said I did not feel
well! Experts do anything to win!"
entries.translation_source: I lied when I said I did not feel well! Experts do anything to win!
entries.translated: Ho mentito quando ho detto che non mi sentivo bene! Gli esperti farebbero di tutto per vincere!

entries.original:
"I will give you a taste of an
Expert’s well-trained Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I will give you a taste of an Expert’s well-trained Pokémon.
entries.translated: Ti farò provare quanto sono forti i Pokémon ben allenati di un Esperto.

entries.original:
"You have served me a spicy defeat.

And yet defeat is also part of
life."
entries.translation_source: You have served me a spicy defeat. And yet defeat is also part of life.
entries.translated: Mi hai servito una sconfitta piccante. Eppure anche la sconfitta fa parte della vita.

entries.original:
"How were the Expert’s Pokémon?
Defeat is bitter, isn’t it?"
entries.translation_source: How were the Expert’s Pokémon? Defeat is bitter, isn’t it?
entries.translated: Com{B4}erano i Pokémon dell{B4}Esperto? La sconfitta è amara, vero?

entries.original:
"Oh, you are so cute!

Come, I promise to be nice in
this battle."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you are so cute! Come, I promise to be nice in this battle.
entries.translated: Oh, sei così carino! Avanti, prometto di essere gentile in questa lotta.

entries.original:
"Your battle is a little too cute.
Let’s play again sometime."
entries.translation_source: Your battle is a little too cute. Let’s play again sometime.
entries.translated: La tua sfida è un po{B4} troppo carina. Rifacciamola qualche volta.

entries.original:
"You are so cute, really\.

I want to see you again.
I’ll be waiting."
entries.translation_source: You are so cute, really[game-token-1] I want to see you again. I’ll be waiting.
entries.translated: Sei davvero adorabile\. Voglio rivederti. Ti aspetterò.

entries.original:
"Oh, you are still a child.
Who said you could come here?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, you are still a child. Who said you could come here?
entries.translated: Oh, sei ancora un moccioso. Chi ti ha detto che potevi venire qui?

entries.original:
"I thought you were a child.
Hee hee\. You are tough\."
entries.translation_source: I thought you were a child. Hee hee[game-token-1] You are tough[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Pensavo fossi un bambino. Ehehe\. Sei forte\.

entries.original:
"You’re not bad, but you’re
immature.

Come back when you’ve learned
something."
entries.translation_source: You’re not bad, but you’re immature. Come back when you’ve learned something.
entries.translated: Non sei male, ma sei immaturo. Torna quando avrai imparato qualcosa.

entries.original:
"Don’t call me decrepit!
A woman’s mind is always blooming."
entries.translation_source: Don’t call me decrepit! A woman’s mind is always blooming.
entries.translated: Non chiamarmi decrepita! La mente di una donna è sempre in fiore.

entries.original:
"I have pains in my eyes, my
shoulder, and my back, but my\lheart is forever young."
entries.translation_source: I have pains in my eyes, my shoulder, and my back, but my heart is forever young.
entries.translated: Ho dolore agli occhi, alla spalla e alla schiena, ma il mio cuore è sempre giovane.

entries.original:
"I’m not finished with love or
Pokémon.

I’ll stay fit and ready all my
life."
entries.translation_source: I’m not finished with love or Pokémon. I’ll stay fit and ready all my life.
entries.translated: Non ho ancora finito con l{B4}amore né con i Pokémon. Resterò in forma e pronto per tutta la vita.

entries.original:
"Join the Pokéfans.
Your life will be happy!"
entries.translation_source: Join the Pokéfans. Your life will be happy!
entries.translated: Unisciti ai Pokéfan. La tua vita sarà felice!

entries.original:
"If you join the Pokéfans, your
life will be saved!"
entries.translation_source: If you join the Pokéfans, your life will be saved!
entries.translated: Se ti unisci ai Pokéfans, la tua vita sarà salvata!

entries.original:
"If you join the Pokéfans, you will
be strong like me!"
entries.translation_source: If you join the Pokéfans, you will be strong like me!
entries.translated: Se ti unisci ai Pokéfan, diventerai forte come me!

entries.original:
"I am not a regular Pokéfan.
I am a major mega-Pokéfan!"
entries.translation_source: I am not a regular Pokéfan. I am a major mega-Pokéfan!
entries.translated: Non sono un Pokéfan qualunque. Sono un mega-Pokéfan di prim{B4}ordine!

entries.original:
"You’ll remember this!
I am a big Pokéfan!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll remember this! I am a big Pokéfan!
entries.translated: Te ne ricorderai! Sono un grande Pokéfan!

entries.original:
"I love Pokémon!
I love love Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I love Pokémon! I love love Pokémon!
entries.translated: Adoro i Pokémon! Adoro, adoro i Pokémon!

entries.original:
"I think I am a Pokéfan, therefore
I am a Pokéfan."
entries.translation_source: I think I am a Pokéfan, therefore I am a Pokéfan.
entries.translated: Credo di essere un Pokéfan, dunque sono un Pokéfan.

entries.original:
"You should remember this.
I am a Pokéfan."
entries.translation_source: You should remember this. I am a Pokéfan.
entries.translated: Dovresti ricordartene. Sono un Pokéfan.

entries.original: "The Pokéfan is power."
entries.translation_source: The Pokéfan is power.
entries.translated: Il Pokéfan è potere

entries.original:
"I took this job because I wanted to
be needed by someone."
entries.translation_source: I took this job because I wanted to be needed by someone.
entries.translated: Ho preso questo lavoro perché volevo che qualcuno avesse bisogno di me.

entries.original:
"When a patient leaves the hospital,
I feel happy but a bit sad."
entries.translation_source: When a patient leaves the hospital, I feel happy but a bit sad.
entries.translated: Quando un paziente lascia l{B4}ospedale, mi sento felice ma anche un po{B4} triste.

entries.original:
"My job is hard, but I am happy to
help people."
entries.translation_source: My job is hard, but I am happy to help people.
entries.translated: Il mio lavoro è duro, ma sono felice di aiutare le persone.

entries.original:
"Grown-ups have a lot of hobbies.
Actually, I am a uniform collector."
entries.translation_source: Grown-ups have a lot of hobbies. Actually, I am a uniform collector.
entries.translated: Gli adulti hanno molti hobby. In realtà, colleziono divise.

entries.original:
"You realized that I am a fake
Nurse!

Yes, I am just a uniform collector."
entries.translation_source: You realized that I am a fake Nurse! Yes, I am just a uniform collector.
entries.translated: Hai scoperto che sono una Finta Infermiera! Sì, sono solo una collezionista di uniformi.

entries.original:
"I am not a Nurse.
I wear this uniform just for fun."
entries.translation_source: I am not a Nurse. I wear this uniform just for fun.
entries.translated: Non sono un{B4}infermiera. Indosso questa uniforme solo per gioco.

entries.original:
"Even if you are injured, I will
treat you.

So let’s fight hard."
entries.translation_source: Even if you are injured, I will treat you. So let’s fight hard.
entries.translated: Anche se sei ferito, ti curerò. Quindi lottiamo con forza.

entries.original:
"You went too far! I will bill you
the cost of my medical expenses!"
entries.translation_source: You went too far! I will bill you the cost of my medical expenses!
entries.translated: Sei andato troppo oltre! Ti farò pagare le mie spese mediche!

entries.original:
"Sorry! I went too far. Do you
require immediate hospitalization?"
entries.translation_source: Sorry! I went too far. Do you require immediate hospitalization?
entries.translated: Scusa! Sono andato troppo oltre. Hai bisogno di un ricovero immediato?

entries.original:
"Amazing!
Against all odds, you triumphed!"
entries.translation_source: Amazing! Against all odds, you triumphed!
entries.translated: Incredibile! Contro ogni previsione, hai trionfato!

entries.original:
"Ah, pity!

Tighten your bonds, and come
challenge me again!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, pity! Tighten your bonds, and come challenge me again!
entries.translated: Ah, peccato! Rafforza i tuoi legami e tornami a sfidare!

entries.original:
"Huh, how about that.

Guess you do know what you’re doing
after all."
entries.translation_source: Huh, how about that. Guess you do know what you’re doing after all.
entries.translated: Oh, guarda un po{B4}. A quanto pare sai davvero quello che fai.

entries.original:
"How boring\.

Listen up, kid!
And listen up well!

You need a team that can handle
itself in any situation!

Keep that in mind for next time!"
entries.translation_source: How boring[game-token-1] Listen up, kid! And listen up well! You need a team that can handle itself in any situation! Keep that in mind for next time!
entries.translated: Che noia\. Ascolta bene, ragazzino! E ascolta bene! Ti serve una squadra che sappia cavarsela in qualsiasi situazione! Tienilo a mente per la prossima volta!

entries.original:
"Bravo! Bravo! Wonderful!
You’re a true rising star!"
entries.translation_source: Bravo! Bravo! Wonderful! You’re a true rising star!
entries.translated: Bravo! Bravo! Meraviglioso! Sei una vera stella nascente!

entries.original:
"Ah, too bad!

Ladies and gentlemen, boys and
girls, I hope you enjoyed the show!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, too bad! Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, I hope you enjoyed the show!
entries.translated: Ah, che peccato! Signore e signori, ragazzi e ragazze, spero che vi sia piaciuto lo spettacolo!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!

I’m Skeli, one of the developers of
Pokémon Unbound.

I’m glad you took the time to come
battle here!

Now, let’s have a fun time!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Skeli, one of the developers of Pokémon Unbound. I’m glad you took the time to come battle here! Now, let’s have a fun time!
entries.translated: Ehi, tu! Sono Skeli, uno degli sviluppatori di Pokémon Unbound. Sono contento che tu abbia trovato il tempo di venire a combattere qui! Ora, divertiamoci!

entries.original:
"Alright!
That was fun!"
entries.translation_source: Alright! That was fun!
entries.translated: Va bene! È stato divertente!

entries.original:
"I’m looking forward to battling you
again in the future!"
entries.translation_source: I’m looking forward to battling you again in the future!
entries.translated: Non vedo l{B4}ora di affrontarti di nuovo in futuro!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!
I’m Golche!

The strategies of the Trainers you
faced?

I helped make them!

Let’s see what you can do against
my strategy!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Golche! The strategies of the Trainers you faced? I helped make them! Let’s see what you can do against my strategy!
entries.translated: Ehi, tu! Sono Golche! Le strategie degli Allenatori che hai affrontato? Le ho aiutate a creare io! Vediamo cosa sai fare contro la mia strategia!

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

Looks like I’ve got some refining
to do\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] Looks like I’ve got some refining to do[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Mmh\. Sembra che abbia ancora un po{B4} di rifinitura da fare\.

entries.original:
"What a fun battle!

I look forward to battling you
again with some new tricks!"
entries.translation_source: What a fun battle! I look forward to battling you again with some new tricks!
entries.translated: Che lotta divertente! Non vedo l{B4}ora di sfidarti di nuovo con qualche nuova mossa!

entries.original:
"Don’t think it’ll be easy to beat
me!

You’re facing the legacy Pokémon
Trainer\. Thanasis!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t think it’ll be easy to beat me! You’re facing the legacy Pokémon Trainer[game-token-1] Thanasis!
entries.translated: Non pensare che sarà facile battermi! Stai affrontando l{B4}Allenatore Pokémon storico\. Thanasis!

entries.original:
"I have to admit, you really are
something special."
entries.translation_source: I have to admit, you really are something special.
entries.translated: Devo ammetterlo, sei davvero qualcosa di speciale.

entries.original:
"It seems you’re not ready to face
me just yet!"
entries.translation_source: It seems you’re not ready to face me just yet!
entries.translated: Sembra che tu non sia ancora pronto a sfidarmi!

entries.original:
"What’s up?
I’m Lixdel!

I created a large chunk of those
beautiful move animations you’ve\lbeen seeing.

Now, prepare for a flurry of those
animations!"
entries.translation_source: What’s up? I’m Lixdel! I created a large chunk of those beautiful move animations you’ve been seeing. Now, prepare for a flurry of those animations!
entries.translated: Che si dice? Sono Lixdel! Ho creato una gran parte di quelle splendide animazioni delle mosse che hai visto finora. Ora preparati a una raffica di quelle animazioni!

entries.original:
"That battle was almost as beautiful
as the animations!"
entries.translation_source: That battle was almost as beautiful as the animations!
entries.translated: Quella lotta è stata quasi bella come le animazioni!

entries.original:
"Nice!

That battle was close to being as
beautiful as the animations!"
entries.translation_source: Nice! That battle was close to being as beautiful as the animations!
entries.translated: Ottimo! Quella lotta è stata quasi bella quanto le animazioni!

entries.original:
"I, Cynthia, accept your challenge!
There won’t be any letup from me!"
entries.translation_source: I, Cynthia, accept your challenge! There won’t be any letup from me!
entries.translated: Io, Cynthia, accetto la tua sfida! Non ti darò tregua!

entries.original:
"No matter how fun the battle is, it
will always end sometime\."
entries.translation_source: No matter how fun the battle is, it will always end sometime[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Per quanto divertente sia la lotta, finirà sempre prima o poi\.

entries.original:
"Even if you lose, never lose your
love of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Even if you lose, never lose your love of Pokémon.
entries.translated: Anche se perdi, non perdere mai il tuo amore per i Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Ha ha ha ha!
Look who I ran into again!

[player]!

I’ve been lookin’ forward to
another battle with you!

Now, let’s see what you can do to
the kingpin of Antisis City!"
entries.translation_source: Ha ha ha ha! Look who I ran into again! [player-name-1]! I’ve been lookin’ forward to another battle with you! Now, let’s see what you can do to the kingpin of Antisis City!
entries.translated: Ah ah ah ah! Guarda chi ho incontrato di nuovo! [player]! Non vedevo l{B4}ora di un{B4}altra lotta con te! Ora vediamo cosa sai fare contro il boss di Antisis City!

entries.original:
"Ha ha ha ha!

They should start calling you
Big \\23!"
entries.translation_source: Ha ha ha ha! They should start calling you Big [raw-escape-1]!
entries.translated: Ah ah ah ah! Dovrebbero cominciare a chiamarti Grande \\23!

entries.original:
"Ha ha ha ha!

Looks like I’m bigger an’ better!"
entries.translation_source: Ha ha ha ha! Looks like I’m bigger an’ better!
entries.translated: Ah ah ah ah! Sembra che io sia più grande e migliore!

entries.original:
"Yo, wazzup, [player]?

Howzit goin’ these days?

I’m sure ya had no problem makin’
your way to this point.

Well, it’s time to fret, ’cause I’m
about to end your streak!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Yo, wazzup, [player-name-1]? Howzit goin’ these days? I’m sure ya had no problem makin’ your way to this point. Well, it’s time to fret, ’cause I’m about to end your streak! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated: Ehi, che si dice, [player]? Come va in questi giorni? Sono sicuro che non hai avuto problemi ad arrivare fin qui. Beh, è ora di preoccuparsi, perché sto per interrompere la tua serie! Ah ah ah!

entries.original:
"Whoa, ya sure showed me how to
battle! Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa, ya sure showed me how to battle! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated: Wow, mi hai proprio mostrato come si combatte! Ah ah ah!

entries.original:
"And you weren’t even at any
disadvantage! Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: And you weren’t even at any disadvantage! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated: E non eri nemmeno in svantaggio! Ah ah ah!

entries.original:
"You’re the opponent of Candice?

Sure thing!
I was waiting for someone tough!

But I should tell you, I’m tough,
because I know how to focus.

Pokémon, fashion, romance\.
It’s all about focus!

I’ll show you just what I mean.

Get ready to lose!"
entries.translation_source: You’re the opponent of Candice? Sure thing! I was waiting for someone tough! But I should tell you, I’m tough, because I know how to focus. Pokémon, fashion, romance[game-token-1] It’s all about focus! I’ll show you just what I mean. Get ready to lose!
entries.translated: Sei l{B4}avversario di Candice? Certo che sì! Aspettavo qualcuno tosto! Ma devo dirtelo, sono tosto anch{B4}io, perché so come concentrarmi. Pokémon, moda, romanticismo\. È tutta questione di concentrazione! Ti mostrerò esattamente cosa intendo. Preparati a perdere!

entries.original:
"You’re mighty!
You’re worthy of lots of respect."
entries.translation_source: You’re mighty! You’re worthy of lots of respect.
entries.translated: Sei formidabile! Meriti tantissimo rispetto.

entries.original:
"I sensed your will to win, but I
don’t lose!"
entries.translation_source: I sensed your will to win, but I don’t lose!
entries.translated: Ho sentito la tua voglia di vincere, ma io non perdo!

entries.original:
"For your insolence, you will feel
a world of pain!"
entries.translation_source: For your insolence, you will feel a world of pain!
entries.translated: Per la tua insolenza, proverai un mondo di dolore!

entries.original: "What? Me, lose?!"
entries.translation_source: What? Me, lose?!
entries.translated: Cosa? Io, perdere?!

entries.original:
"Ha!
That was a truly intense fight!"
entries.translation_source: Ha! That was a truly intense fight!
entries.translated: Ah! È stata davvero una lotta intensissima!

entries.original:
"It’s super effective on
\\10!"
entries.translation_source: It’s super effective on [raw-escape-1]!
entries.translated: È superefficace su \\10!

entries.original:
"It’s super effective on \\3D
\\3B and \\3C!"
entries.translation_source: It’s super effective on [raw-escape-1] [raw-escape-2] and [raw-escape-3]!
entries.translated: È superefficace su \\3D \\3B e \\3C!

entries.original:
"It’s not very effective on
\\10\."
entries.translation_source: It’s not very effective on [raw-escape-1][game-token-2]
entries.translated: Non è molto efficace su\n\\10\.

entries.original:
"It’s not very effective on \\3D
\\3B and \\3C\."
entries.translation_source: It’s not very effective on [raw-escape-1] [raw-escape-2] and [raw-escape-3][game-token-4]
entries.translated: Non è molto efficace su \\3D,\n\\3B e \\3C\.

entries.original:
"It had no effect on \\3D
\\3B and \\3C\."
entries.translation_source: It had no effect on [raw-escape-1] [raw-escape-2] and [raw-escape-3][game-token-4]
entries.translated: Non ha effetto su \\3D,\n\\3B e \\3C\.

entries.original: "[black]\CC0309A critical hit!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][control-code-2]A critical hit!
entries.translated: [black]\CC0309Brutto colpo!

entries.original:
"[black]\CC0309A critical hit[white2]\CC0306 on
\\10!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][control-code-2]A critical hit[color-white2-3][control-code-4] on [raw-escape-5]!
entries.translated: [black]\CC0309Brutto colpo[white2]\CC0306 su\n\\10!

entries.original:
"[black]\CC0309A critical hit[white2]\CC0306 on \\3D
\\3B and \\3C!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][control-code-2]A critical hit[color-white2-3][control-code-4] on [raw-escape-5] [raw-escape-6] and [raw-escape-7]!
entries.translated: [black]\CC0309Un colpo critico[white2]\CC0306 su \\3D \\3B e \\3C!

entries.original:
"It created a bizarre area in which
the Def and Sp. Def stats are swapped!"
entries.translation_source: It created a bizarre area in which the Def and Sp. Def stats are swapped!
entries.translated: Ha creato un{B4}area bizzarra in cui le statistiche Dif e Dif. Sp. si scambiano!

entries.original:
"It created a bizarre are in which
held items lose their effects!"
entries.translation_source: It created a bizarre are in which held items lose their effects!
entries.translated: Ha creato un{B4}area bizzarra in cui gli strumenti tenuti perdono i loro effetti!

entries.original: "Gravity intensified!"
entries.translation_source: Gravity intensified!
entries.translated: La gravità si è intensificata!

entries.original:
"A deluge of ions showers the
battlefield!"
entries.translation_source: A deluge of ions showers the battlefield!
entries.translated: Una pioggia di ioni si abbatte sul campo di lotta!

entries.original:
"\\13 was
brought down!"
entries.translation_source: [raw-escape-1] was brought down!
entries.translated: \\13 è stato messo KO!

entries.original:
"An electric current runs across
the battlefield!"
entries.translation_source: An electric current runs across the battlefield!
entries.translated: Una corrente elettrica attraversa il campo di battaglia!

entries.original:
"Grass grew to cover the
battlefield!"
entries.translation_source: Grass grew to cover the battlefield!
entries.translated: L{B4}erba è cresciuta a coprire il campo di battaglia!

entries.original:
"Mist swirls around the
battlefield!"
entries.translation_source: Mist swirls around the battlefield!
entries.translated: La nebbia avvolge il campo di battaglia!

entries.original: "The battlefield got weird!"
entries.translation_source: The battlefield got weird!
entries.translated: Il campo di battaglia è diventato strano!

entries.original:
"Everyone is caught up in the
happy atmosphere!"
entries.translation_source: Everyone is caught up in the happy atmosphere!
entries.translated: Tutti sono avvolti da un{B4}atmosfera felice!

entries.original: "Congratulations \\23!"
entries.translation_source: Congratulations [raw-escape-1]!
entries.translated: Congratulazioni \\23!

entries.original:
"\\0F and \\10
held hands!"
entries.translation_source: [raw-escape-1] and [raw-escape-2] held hands!
entries.translated: \\0F e \\10 si sono presi per mano!

entries.original:
"The tailwind blew from behind

entries.translation_source: Ha ha ha ha! It ain’t over yet!
entries.translated: Ah ah ah ah! Non è ancora finita!

entries.original:
"No way\. NO WAY!
Not while I’m kingpin, you don’t!

 "
entries.translation_source: No way[game-token-1] NO WAY! Not while I’m kingpin, you don’t!
entries.translated: Niente affatto\. NIENTE AFFATTO! Non finché sono io il boss, capito!

entries.original:
"Well this ain’t good, but it ain’t
over ’til it’s over!

 "
entries.translation_source: Well this ain’t good, but it ain’t over ’til it’s over!
entries.translated: Beh, non va bene, ma non è finita finché non è finita!

entries.original:
"Our time grows short, [rival]\.
So let’s make the most of it!

 "
entries.translation_source: Our time grows short, [text-token-rival-1][game-token-2] So let’s make the most of it!
entries.translated: Il nostro tempo sta per finire, [rival]\. Quindi sfruttiamolo al massimo!

entries.original:
"The mole-people never give in!
Feel our wrath, surface-dweller!

 "
entries.translation_source: The mole-people never give in! Feel our wrath, surface-dweller!
entries.translated: La gente-talpa non si arrende mai! Senti la nostra ira, abitante della superficie!

entries.original:
"Great. Just one left.
What I always wanted\.

 "
entries.translation_source: Great. Just one left. What I always wanted[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Perfetto. Ne resta solo uno. Quello che ho sempre voluto\.

entries.original:
"Ah!
But we’re not done fighting yet!

 "
entries.translation_source: Ah! But we’re not done fighting yet!
entries.translated: Ah! Ma non abbiamo ancora finito di combattere!

entries.original:
"WROOOOOAR!

 "
entries.translation_source: WROOOOOAR!
entries.translated: ROOOOAR!

entries.original:
"Let’s do this!
We can still come out on top!

 "
entries.translation_source: Let’s do this! We can still come out on top!
entries.translated: Facciamolo! Possiamo ancora spuntarla!

entries.original:
"Impossible\.

 "
entries.translation_source: Impossible[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Impossibile\.

entries.original:
"No! You won’t take\. anything else
from me!

 "
entries.translation_source: No! You won’t take[game-token-1] anything else from me!
entries.translated: No! Non mi toglierai\. nient{B4}altro!

entries.original:
"One Pokémon left\.

Now is the time when I demonstrate
how to truly battle!

"
entries.translation_source: One Pokémon left[game-token-1] Now is the time when I demonstrate how to truly battle!
entries.translated: Mi resta un solo Pokémon\. Ora è il momento di mostrarti come si combatte davvero!

entries.original:
"This is your final trial!
The last obstacle! Now, focus!

 "
entries.translation_source: This is your final trial! The last obstacle! Now, focus!
entries.translated: Questa è la tua prova finale! L{B4}ultimo ostacolo! Ora, concentrati!

entries.original:
"Impossible!

You\. you cannot do this to me!

 "
entries.translation_source: Impossible! You[game-token-1] you cannot do this to me!
entries.translated: Impossibile! Tu\. non puoi farmi questo!

entries.original:
"\\23\. \\23!
Only you would dare\.!

 "
entries.translation_source: [raw-escape-1][game-token-2] [raw-escape-3]! Only you would dare[game-token-4]!
entries.translated: \\23\. \\23! Solo tu oseresti\.!

entries.original:
"No!
This cannot be my destiny!

 "
entries.translation_source: No! This cannot be my destiny!
entries.translated: No! Questo non può essere il mio destino!

entries.original:
"The power of the Hidden Grottos!
It’s mine to command!

 "
entries.translation_source: The power of the Hidden Grottos! It’s mine to command!
entries.translated: Il potere delle Grotte Nascoste! Sono io a comandarlo!

entries.original:
"Agh\. there’s gotta be a way to turn
this around somehow!"
entries.translation_source: Agh[game-token-1] there’s gotta be a way to turn this around somehow!
entries.translated: Accidenti\. deve pur esserci un modo per ribaltare la situazione in qualche modo!

entries.original:
"Nothing’s over - not until my last
Pokémon’s down for the count!"
entries.translation_source: Nothing’s over - not until my last Pokémon’s down for the count!
entries.translated: Non è finita - non finché il mio ultimo Pokémon non è fuori combattimento!

entries.original:
"This feeling\. so, this is what being
cornered feels like\."
entries.translation_source: This feeling[game-token-1] so, this is what being cornered feels like[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Questa sensazione\. quindi, ecco come ci si sente quando si è con le spalle al muro\.

entries.original:
"The way you always manage to summon
so much strength\. it’s amazing\."
entries.translation_source: The way you always manage to summon so much strength[game-token-1] it’s amazing[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Il modo in cui riesci sempre a sprigionare così tanta forza\. è incredibile\.

entries.original:
"This is it! This is where the real
battle begins, \\23!"
entries.translation_source: This is it! This is where the real battle begins, [raw-escape-1]!
entries.translated: Eccoci! Qui comincia la vera lotta, \\23!

entries.original:
"Not yet! It’s time I showed you what
we’re really made of!"
entries.translation_source: Not yet! It’s time I showed you what we’re really made of!
entries.translated: Non ancora! È ora di mostrarti di che pasta siamo fatti!

"Your save file is incompatible with
the current version of Unbound.

Please enter the Hall of Fame on any
version before 2.0 before continuing.

If you would like to proceed anyway\.

\.your current save file will be
deleted."

roughest and toughest gang in town\luntil we showed up!

The Black [player]!"

I Black Ferrothorn erano la banda
più dura e più tosta della città\lfinché non siamo arrivati noi! I

Black [player]!

entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Ferrothorn! We own this town!
entries.translated:
Siamo i Ferrothorn Neri! Questa
città è nostra!

entries.original:
"We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
Stay out of our way!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Ferrothorn! Stay out of our way!
entries.translated:
Siamo i Black Ferrothorn! Stateci
alla larga!

entries.original:
"What do you think you’re doin’,
huh, kid?

This is Black Ferrothorn turf!
You’re not welcome here!"
entries.translation_source: What do you think you’re doin’, huh, kid? This is Black Ferrothorn turf! You’re not welcome here!
entries.translated:
Che credi di fare, eh, ragazzino?
Questo è territorio dei Black\lFerrothorn! Qui non sei il

benvenuto!

entries.original:
"Hey!
What’s goin’ on in there?

You think it’s funny to lock me
