entries.translation_source: Hey! What’s goin’ on in there? You think it’s funny to lock me out? Huh?
entries.translated:
Ehi! Che succede là dentro? Ti
sembra divertente lasciarmi fuori a\lchiave? Eh?

entries.original:
"It’s too scary to go into the city\.

There are bad people everywhere!"
entries.translation_source: It’s too scary to go into the city[game-token-1] There are bad people everywhere!
entries.translated:
È troppo spaventoso entrare in
città\. Ci sono brutte persone\lovunque!

entries.original:
"I came here with my grandson to
show him the city I grew up in, but\lhe’s much too afraid to enter it.

Sometime after I moved away, it was
overrun by hoodlums."
entries.translation_source: I came here with my grandson to show him the city I grew up in, but he’s much too afraid to enter it. Sometime after I moved away, it was overrun by hoodlums.
entries.translated:
Sono venuto qui con mio nipote per
mostrargli la città in cui sono\lcresciuto, ma ha troppa paura di

entrarci. Da qualche tempo dopo che
me ne sono andato, è stata invasa\lda teppisti.

The legend\.\CC0820 the conquerer\.\CC0820
[player]!"

entries.translated:
Non ci posso credere\. La leggenda\.\CC0820 il
conquistatore\.\CC0820 [player]!

"You wanna mess with the Black
Ferrothorn, kid?"
entries.translation_source: You wanna mess with the Black Ferrothorn, kid?
entries.translated: Vuoi metterti contro il Black Ferrothorn, ragazzo?

entries.original: "Don’t mess with us!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t mess with us!
entries.translated: Non scherzare con noi!

The Black Ferrothorn!"

entries.translated: VROOM VROOM Il Ferrothorn Nero!

Ferrothorn!

entries.translation_source: I’m a member of the Black Ferrothorn! Stare at me too long and I’ll poke you!
entries.translated:
Sono un membro del Ferrothorn Nero!
Se mi guardi troppo a lungo, ti\lpunzecchio!

entries.original:
"Those Black [player] always gettin’
in the way\.

Hey!
Quit starin’!"
entries.translation_source: Those Black [player-name-1] always gettin’ in the way[game-token-2] Hey! Quit starin’!
entries.translated:
Quei [player] Neri si mettono
sempre in mezzo\. Ehi! Smettila di\lfissarmi!

entries.original:
"We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
Ain’t nobody ever takin’ us down!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Ferrothorn! Ain’t nobody ever takin’ us down!
entries.translated:
Siamo il Black Ferrothorn! Nessuno
ci butterà mai giù!

entries.original:
"We just booted the old gang around
here outta town!

We’re set to rule it, now!
We’re the Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: We just booted the old gang around here outta town! We’re set to rule it, now! We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated:
Abbiamo appena cacciato fuori città
la vecchia gang di qui! Ora siamo\lpronti a governarla! Siamo i

Ferrothorn Neri!

entries.original:
"One day, we’re gonna boot those
Black [player] right outta town\.

Hey!
Quit starin’!"
entries.translation_source: One day, we’re gonna boot those Black [player-name-1] right outta town[game-token-2] Hey! Quit starin’!
entries.translated:
Un giorno cacceremo quei Black
[player] fuori città\. Ehi! Smettila\ldi fissare!

entries.original:
"We just booted the new gang around
here outta town!

The Black [player] is gone forever!
We’re the Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: We just booted the new gang around here outta town! The Black [player-name-1] is gone forever! We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated:
Abbiamo appena cacciato fuori dalla
città la nuova gang del posto! Il\lBlack [player] è sparito per

sempre! Siamo noi il Black
Ferrothorn!

entries.original: "The trash bin is empty."
entries.translation_source: The trash bin is empty.
entries.translated: Il cestino è vuoto.

Open it?"

entries.translated: È un cassonetto. Aprirlo?

entries.original: "The dumpster is empty."

entries.translated:
C{B4}è un Pokémon che si nutre dei
rifiuti nel cassonetto. Il Pokémon\lha attaccato!

"The [buffer1] dug deeper into
the dumpster."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] dug deeper into the dumpster.

nel cassonetto.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Antisis City
Police HQ!

Well\. actually, now it’s just
my home.

Ever since the gangs\.\CC0818 er\.\CC0818
\qorequested\qc that we leave, the\lpolice force around here has been\lbasically nonexistent.

And you can see what that has
led to.

Total anarchy and lawlessness."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Antisis City Police HQ! Well[game-token-1] actually, now it’s just my home. Ever since the gangs[game-token-2][control-code-3] er[game-token-4][control-code-5] [quote-open-6]requested[quote-close-7] that we leave, the police force around here has been basically nonexistent. And you can see what that has led to. Total anarchy and lawlessness.
entries.translated:
Benvenuto al Quartier generale
della polizia di Antisis City! Beh\.\lin realtà, ora è solo casa mia. Da

quando le bande\.\CC0818 eh\.\CC0818 \qorichiesto\qc che
ce ne andassimo, la polizia qui è\lpraticamente inesistente. E puoi

vedere a cosa ha portato tutto
questo. Anarchia e illegalità\ltotali.

entries.original:
"It’s great to see someone your age
pursuing the healthy career of\lPokémon Trainer.

You’ve made a much better choice
than by joining a gang.

Trust me, I know.

I see what goes on around here.
You want no part in that."
entries.translation_source: It’s great to see someone your age pursuing the healthy career of Pokémon Trainer. You’ve made a much better choice than by joining a gang. Trust me, I know. I see what goes on around here. You want no part in that.
entries.translated:
È bello vedere qualcuno della tua
età intraprendere la sana carriera\ldi Allenatore di Pokémon. Hai fatto

una scelta molto migliore rispetto
a entrare in una banda. Fidati, lo\lso. Vedo quello che succede qui

intorno. Non vuoi avere nulla a che
fare con quella roba.

entries.original:
"It’s a shame that someone your age
is part of a gang.

You could’ve had so much potential,
but now, you have none at all."
entries.translation_source: It’s a shame that someone your age is part of a gang. You could’ve had so much potential, but now, you have none at all.
entries.translated:
È un peccato che qualcuno della tua
età faccia parte di una banda.\lAvresti potuto avere così tanto

potenziale, ma ora non ne hai
affatto.

entries.original:
"It’s been almost\.\CC0818 too calm lately.

I just can’t take it, anymore!

I think I need some\.\CC0818 some sort of
[green]eerie pulse[blue] to shake the nerves\."
entries.translation_source: It’s been almost[game-token-1][control-code-2] too calm lately. I just can’t take it, anymore! I think I need some[game-token-3][control-code-4] some sort of [color-green-5]eerie pulse[color-blue-6] to shake the nerves[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
È stato quasi\.\CC0818 troppo calmo
ultimamente. Non ce la faccio più!\lPenso che mi serva un po{B4} di\.\CC0818 una

sorta di [green]impulso inquietante[blue] per
scuotere i nervi\.

entries.original:
"Your [buffer1] has just given me
the chills!

Its Eerie Impulse sure brings back
memories from the days when I was\la Bird Keeper.

The power of Electric-types was
what inspired me to change which\lkind of Pokémon I trained.

Since I have no more use for this,
I want you to have it."
entries.translation_source: Your [buffer1-1] has just given me the chills! Its Eerie Impulse sure brings back memories from the days when I was a Bird Keeper. The power of Electric-types was what inspired me to change which kind of Pokémon I trained. Since I have no more use for this, I want you to have it.
entries.translated:
Il tuo [buffer1] mi ha appena fatto
venire i brividi! La sua Impulso\lSpettrale mi riporta alla mente i

tempi in cui ero un addestratore di
uccelli. La potenza dei tipi\lElettro fu ciò che mi ispirò a

cambiare il tipo di Pokémon che
allenavo. Non mi serve più, quindi\lvoglio che sia tuo.

entries.original:
"[green]Acrobatics[blue] becomes a powerful
attack if your Pokémon isn’t\lholdin’ an item.

It’s not eerie at all, but it’ll
still make Fightin’-types go\lrunnin’ in terror!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Acrobatics[color-blue-2] becomes a powerful attack if your Pokémon isn’t holdin’ an item. It’s not eerie at all, but it’ll still make Fightin’-types go runnin’ in terror!
entries.translated:
[green]Acrobazia[blue] diventa un attacco
potente se il tuo Pokémon non tiene\luno strumento. Non è affatto

inquietante, ma farà comunque
fuggire i Pokémon di tipo Lotta\lterrorizzati!

entries.original:
"Antisis City is the most
crime-ridden city in Borrius.

However, because of its existence,
most lowlives in the region are\ldrawn here, causing crime rates to\ldecrease everywhere else.

That’s the main reason the police
didn’t fight back after they were\lforcibly expelled during the riots.

They won’t tell you that, though.

In order for Antisis City to keep
on existing as is, the police need\lto feign ignorance to anything\lthat’s not too serious of a crime.

But if anything starts to get out
of hand around here, that’s when\lBig Mo comes in and takes control."
entries.translation_source: Antisis City is the most crime-ridden city in Borrius. However, because of its existence, most lowlives in the region are drawn here, causing crime rates to decrease everywhere else. That’s the main reason the police didn’t fight back after they were forcibly expelled during the riots. They won’t tell you that, though. In order for Antisis City to keep on existing as is, the police need to feign ignorance to anything that’s not too serious of a crime. But if anything starts to get out of hand around here, that’s when Big Mo comes in and takes control.
entries.translated:
Antisis City è la città con più
criminalità in Borrius. Tuttavia,\lgrazie alla sua esistenza, la

maggior parte dei malviventi della
regione sono attratti qui, causando\lun calo dei tassi di criminalità in

tutti gli altri luoghi. Questa è la
ragione principale per cui la\lpolizia non ha reagito dopo essere

stata espulsa con la forza durante
i disordini. Ma non te lo diranno.\lAffinché Antisis City possa

continuare ad esistere così com{B4}è,
la polizia deve fingere di ignorare\lqualsiasi crimine non troppo grave.

Ma se le cose iniziano a sfuggire
di mano, è lì che Big Mo entra in\lazione e prende il controllo.

entries.original: "[green]Crooooak\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Crooooak[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Crooooak\.

entries.original:
"I used to be a proud member of the
Terror Granbull - the gang that\lran this joint.

We were at the top of our game
until those Black Ferrothorn\lshowed up.

They took us by surprise and
attacked our base through the\lsewers.

Now, I’m back to bein’ a nobody,
livin’ with his mama.

And since I don’t really battle
anymore, there ain’t much I can\ldo with this."
entries.translation_source: I used to be a proud member of the Terror Granbull - the gang that ran this joint. We were at the top of our game until those Black Ferrothorn showed up. They took us by surprise and attacked our base through the sewers. Now, I’m back to bein’ a nobody, livin’ with his mama. And since I don’t really battle anymore, there ain’t much I can do with this.
entries.translated:
Ero un orgoglioso membro dei Terror
Granbull - la gang che comandava\lquesto posto. Eravamo al top del

nostro gioco fino a quando quei
Black Ferrothorn sono apparsi. Ci\lhanno preso di sorpresa e hanno

attaccato la nostra base attraverso
le fogne. Ora, sono tornato a\lessere un nessuno, che vive con sua

mamma. E visto che non lotto più
molto, non posso fare molto con\lquesto.

entries.original:
"Don’t let what happened to me,
happen to you, kid!

Stay away from gangs, and stay
in school!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t let what happened to me, happen to you, kid! Stay away from gangs, and stay in school!
entries.translated:
Non lasciare che quello che è
successo a me succeda a te,\lragazzo! Stai lontano dalle bande e

resta a scuola!

entries.original:
"I was so happy for my son when he
joined the Terror Granbull.

Yes, I admit that joining a gang is
not the best of careers, but at\lleast he had one!

Now, he’s just another lowlife.

When will he ever get a real job
and leave the house again?"
entries.translation_source: I was so happy for my son when he joined the Terror Granbull. Yes, I admit that joining a gang is not the best of careers, but at least he had one! Now, he’s just another lowlife. When will he ever get a real job and leave the house again?
entries.translated:
Ero così felice per mio figlio
quando si è unito ai Terror\lGranbull. Sì, ammetto che entrare

in una gang non è la migliore delle
carriere, ma almeno ne aveva una!\lOra è solo un altro fannullone.

Quando troverà mai un vero lavoro e
uscirà di casa di nuovo?

entries.original:
"Those poozers think that Antisis
City is safe now that the Terror\lGranbull are gone!

Haw haw!

They couldn’t be more wrong!"
entries.translation_source: Those poozers think that Antisis City is safe now that the Terror Granbull are gone! Haw haw! They couldn’t be more wrong!
entries.translated:
Quei bifolchi pensano che Antisis
City sia al sicuro ora che i Terror\lGranbull se ne sono andati! Ah ah!

Non potrebbero sbagliarsi di più!

entries.original:
"My boyfriend is so strong and
tough!

There ain’t no one like him here in
the city!

Well, aside from Big Mo, of course."
entries.translation_source: My boyfriend is so strong and tough! There ain’t no one like him here in the city! Well, aside from Big Mo, of course.
entries.translated:
Il mio ragazzo è fortissimo e
tosto! Qui in città non c{B4}è nessuno\lcome lui! Be{B4}, a parte Big Mo,

naturalmente.

entries.original: "Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!"
entries.translation_source: Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!
entries.translated: Weeeeeeeeeewhoooooooo!

entries.original:
"You wanna prove you’re tough?
Huh, [buffer1]?

You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo.

He’s the biggest, toughest guy in
all of Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: You wanna prove you’re tough? Huh, [buffer1-1]? You’re gonna wanna take on Big Mo. He’s the biggest, toughest guy in all of Antisis City.
entries.translated:
Vuoi dimostrare di essere tosto?
Eh, [buffer1]? Faresti meglio ad\laffrontare Big Mo. È il più grosso

e tosto di tutta Antisis City.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You must be pretty tough if you
took down Big Mo.

That ain’t easy.

You know what, take these as a
congrats from me."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] You must be pretty tough if you took down Big Mo. That ain’t easy. You know what, take these as a congrats from me.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Devi essere piuttosto tosto se
hai sconfitto Big Mo. Non è stato\lfacile. Sai che c{B4}è? Prendi queste

come congratulazioni da parte mia.

entries.original:
"Use those Balls to catch even more
tough Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Use those Balls to catch even more tough Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Usa quelle Ball per catturare
ancora più Pokémon forti.

entries.original: "Uh\. whaddya want?"
entries.translation_source: Uh[game-token-1] whaddya want?
entries.translated: Uhm\. che vuoi?

entries.original: "Don’t come back."
entries.translation_source: Don’t come back.
entries.translated: Non tornare più.

entries.original: "[green]Kek!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Kek!
entries.translated: [green]Kek!

entries.original:
"Be cautious, Trainer!

You’re about to enter Antisis City!
A very dangerous place!

If you’re coming from there\. well\.
this gate really only goes one way."
entries.translation_source: Be cautious, Trainer! You’re about to enter Antisis City! A very dangerous place! If you’re coming from there[game-token-1] well[game-token-2] this gate really only goes one way.
entries.translated:
Fai attenzione, Allenatore! Stai
per entrare ad Antisis City! Un\lposto molto pericoloso! Se vieni da

lì\. beh\. questo cancello in pratica
va in una sola direzione.

entries.original:
"You will need to possess some sort
of valid identification if you wish\laccess to the port."
entries.translation_source: You will need to possess some sort of valid identification if you wish access to the port.
entries.translated:
Avrai bisogno di un documento
d{B4}identità valido se vuoi accedere\lal porto.

entries.original:
"Do not even think of bringing in
any illegal merchandise into\lAntisis City.

I will know if you try something."
entries.translation_source: Do not even think of bringing in any illegal merchandise into Antisis City. I will know if you try something.
entries.translated:
Non pensare nemmeno di introdurre
merce illegale ad Antisis City. Lo\lscoprirò se provi a fare qualcosa.

entries.original:
"Hi, [player]!

Feel free to come and go as
you please.

With a Trainer Card like yours,
you have more than proved your\ltrustworthiness."
entries.translation_source: Hi, [player-name-1]! Feel free to come and go as you please. With a Trainer Card like yours, you have more than proved your trustworthiness.
entries.translated:
Ciao, [player]! Sentiti libero di
entrare e uscire come preferisci.\lCon una Carta Allenatore come la

tua, hai dimostrato ampiamente di
essere degno di fiducia.

entries.original:
"Yawn\.
These early mornings are rough\.

I don’t know how you Borrian folk
do it\."
entries.translation_source: Yawn[game-token-1] These early mornings are rough[game-token-2] I don’t know how you Borrian folk do it[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Sbadiglio\. Le prime ore del mattino
sono dure\. Non so come facciate voi\lgente di Borrian\.

entries.original:
"I’ve got a shipment for one\. uh\.
Swomoli?

Man\. these names are hard to
read sometimes."
entries.translation_source: I’ve got a shipment for one[game-token-1] uh[game-token-2] Swomoli? Man[game-token-3] these names are hard to read sometimes.
entries.translated:
Ho una spedizione per uno\. eh\.
Swomoli? Cavolo\. a volte questi nomi\lsono difficili da leggere.

entries.original:
"A fresh batch of [green]Premier Balls[blue] has
just arrived!

Why don’t you take a few?
They’ll never notice\."
entries.translation_source: A fresh batch of [color-green-1]Premier Balls[color-blue-2] has just arrived! Why don’t you take a few? They’ll never notice[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
È appena arrivato un fresco lotto
di [green]Premier Ball[blue]! Perché non ne\lprendi qualcuna? Non se ne

accorgeranno mai\.

entries.original:
"I’ve always advocated for a smaller
Poké Ball to Premier Ball ratio.

Ten to one? Are you kidding me?
Who even buys ten Poké Balls?

At least you Borrian folk hand them
out for any type of Poké Ball."
entries.translation_source: I’ve always advocated for a smaller Poké Ball to Premier Ball ratio. Ten to one? Are you kidding me? Who even buys ten Poké Balls? At least you Borrian folk hand them out for any type of Poké Ball.
entries.translated:
Ho sempre sostenuto un rapporto
minore tra Poké Ball e Premier\lBall. Dieci a uno? Ma stai

scherzando? Chi mai compra dieci
Poké Ball? Almeno voi gente di\lBorrian le distribuite per ogni

tipo di Poké Ball.

entries.original:
"Night deliveries are by far better
than day deliveries.

Why?

For starters, there’s less
ocean traffic!"
entries.translation_source: Night deliveries are by far better than day deliveries. Why? For starters, there’s less ocean traffic!
entries.translated:
Le consegne notturne sono di gran
lunga migliori di quelle diurne.\lPerché? Per cominciare, c{B4}è meno

traffico marittimo!

entries.original:
"You ever had a [green]Lava Cookie[blue] before?

If you take it, you won’t need a
Burn Heal!"
entries.translation_source: You ever had a [color-green-1]Lava Cookie[color-blue-2] before? If you take it, you won’t need a Burn Heal!
entries.translated:
Hai mai mangiato un [green]Biscotto Lava[blue]
prima? Se lo prendi, non ti servirà\lun{B4}Antiscottatura!

entries.original:
"Pardon me\.

Would you care for an [green]Old Gateau[blue]?

Oui, oui, yes, you would."
entries.translation_source: Pardon me[game-token-1] Would you care for an [color-green-2]Old Gateau[color-blue-3]? Oui, oui, yes, you would.
entries.translated:
Mi scusi\. Gradirebbe un [green]Vecchio
Gateau[blue]? Oui, oui, sì, certo che sì.

entries.original:
"Quick!

Take a [green]Casteliacone[blue] before
it melts!"
entries.translation_source: Quick! Take a [color-green-1]Casteliacone[color-blue-2] before it melts!
entries.translated:
Presto! Prendi un [green]Casteliacone[blue]
prima che si sciolga!

entries.original:
"The city of lights and biscuits\.

Have this token of Lumiose City,
the [green]Lumiose Galette[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The city of lights and biscuits[game-token-1] Have this token of Lumiose City, the [color-green-2]Lumiose Galette[color-blue-3].
entries.translated:
La città delle luci e dei biscotti\.
Accetta questo omaggio di\lLuminopoli, la [green]Galette di

Luminopoli[blue].

entries.original:
"Feel the power of Mega Evolution
when you take a bite out of this\l[green]Shalour Sable[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Feel the power of Mega Evolution when you take a bite out of this [color-green-1]Shalour Sable[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Senti il potere della
Megaevoluzione quando addenti\lquesto [green]Shalour Sable[blue]!

entries.original:
"You ever had a [green]Big Malasada[blue]
before?

I hear it’s really good for
the heart.

Try some, straight from the
Alola region!"
entries.translation_source: You ever had a [color-green-1]Big Malasada[color-blue-2] before? I hear it’s really good for the heart. Try some, straight from the Alola region!
entries.translated:
Hai mai assaggiato una [green]Grande
Malasada[blue]? Ho sentito che fa davvero\lbene al cuore. Provala,

direttamente dalla regione di
Alola!

entries.original:
"Feed the [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon with a status condition.

It’ll get all better, just
like that!"
entries.translation_source: Feed the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] to a Pokémon with a status condition. It’ll get all better, just like that!
entries.translated:
Dai [green][buffer1][blue] a un Pokémon con una
condizione di stato. Starà subito\lmeglio, proprio così!

entries.original:
"Sorry, kid, I’m only carrying local
shipments today.

If you come by any other day of the
week, I may have souvenirs from\lvarious regions to give out."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, kid, I’m only carrying local shipments today. If you come by any other day of the week, I may have souvenirs from various regions to give out.
entries.translated:
Mi spiace, ragazzo, oggi trasporto
solo spedizioni locali. Se passi in\lun altro giorno della settimana,

potrei avere souvenir di varie
regioni da distribuire.

entries.original:
"I was taking inventory for the
Berry shipments this morning, and\las usual, we have a surplus.

Why don’t you take a Berry?"
entries.translation_source: I was taking inventory for the Berry shipments this morning, and as usual, we have a surplus. Why don’t you take a Berry?
entries.translated:
Stavo facendo l{B4}inventario delle
spedizioni di bacche stamattina e,\lcome al solito, ne abbiamo in

eccesso. Perché non prendi una
Bacca?

entries.original:
"Tropius Berries Inc. has a tendency
to send a few extra Berries.

There may be some more in
tomorrow’s shipment, too.

I wonder how they don’t lose
money\."
entries.translation_source: Tropius Berries Inc. has a tendency to send a few extra Berries. There may be some more in tomorrow’s shipment, too. I wonder how they don’t lose money[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tropius Berries Inc. ha la tendenza
a spedire qualche Bacca in più.\lPotrebbero essercene altre anche

nella spedizione di domani. Mi
chiedo come facciano a non\lrimetterci soldi\.

entries.original:
"Oh, drat!

I’m going to be late for my
next job!

I’ll be back tomorrow morning,
as usual!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, drat! I’m going to be late for my next job! I’ll be back tomorrow morning, as usual!
entries.translated:
Oh, accidenti! Farò tardi per il
mio prossimo lavoro! Tornerò\ldomattina, come al solito!

entries.original:
"Aye, I’m the guy who moves supplies
to Fallshore City during the day.

It’s too dangerous to move them
through Antisis City, which is why\lthis job exists."
entries.translation_source: Aye, I’m the guy who moves supplies to Fallshore City during the day. It’s too dangerous to move them through Antisis City, which is why this job exists.
entries.translated:
Eh, sono io quello che durante il
giorno sposta i rifornimenti verso\lFallshore City. È troppo pericoloso

passarli attraverso Antisis City,
ed è per questo che esiste questo\llavoro.

entries.original:
"We policemen are the only things
standing between the gangs and\ltotal destruction of the port."
entries.translation_source: We policemen are the only things standing between the gangs and total destruction of the port.
entries.translated:
Noi poliziotti siamo l{B4}unica cosa
che si frappone tra le bande e la\ldistruzione totale del porto.

entries.original:
"Are you up to no good?

\.

Just checking.

There’s no telling when a ruffian
will sneak past the gate check."
entries.translation_source: Are you up to no good? [game-token-1] Just checking. There’s no telling when a ruffian will sneak past the gate check.
entries.translated:
Hai intenzioni losche? \. Controllavo
soltanto. Non si sa mai quando un\lmalvivente passerà inosservato al

controllo del cancello.

entries.original:
"I’ve watched over this port ever
since the once glorious Antisis\lCity stood proud\.

This port is all that remains of
that city\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve watched over this port ever since the once glorious Antisis City stood proud[game-token-1] This port is all that remains of that city[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ho vegliato su questo porto da
quando la gloriosa Antisis City\lsorgeva fiera\\. Questo porto è tutto

ciò che resta di quella città\\.

entries.original:
"This lighthouse was once a beacon
of hope for tourists.

But ever since Antisis City was
turned into a crime-filled slum,\ltourists have stopped coming to\lthis port."
entries.translation_source: This lighthouse was once a beacon of hope for tourists. But ever since Antisis City was turned into a crime-filled slum, tourists have stopped coming to this port.
entries.translated:
Questo faro era un tempo un faro di
speranza per i turisti. Ma da\lquando Antisis City è stata

trasformata in una baraccopoli
piena di crimini, i turisti hanno\lsmesso di venire in questo porto.

entries.original:
"Unlike Seaport City, the Antisis
Port is mainly used for the import\lof goods from other regions.

Once dropped off here, the goods
are moved along to Fallshore City\lwhere they can then be distributed\lacross Borrius."
entries.translation_source: Unlike Seaport City, the Antisis Port is mainly used for the import of goods from other regions. Once dropped off here, the goods are moved along to Fallshore City where they can then be distributed across Borrius.
entries.translated:
A differenza di Seaport City, il
porto di Antisis è usato\lprincipalmente per importare merci

da altre regioni. Una volta
scaricate qui, le merci vengono\ltrasferite a Fallshore City, dove

possono poi essere distribuite in
tutto Borrius.

entries.original:
"The yellow barricades are moved
routinely throughout the day to\lcorrespond to the arrivals of\ldifferent shipments.

If you want to get to an area
that’s blocked off, you’ll just\lhave to come back later."
entries.translation_source: The yellow barricades are moved routinely throughout the day to correspond to the arrivals of different shipments. If you want to get to an area that’s blocked off, you’ll just have to come back later.
entries.translated:
Le barriere gialle vengono spostate
regolarmente nel corso della\lgiornata per corrispondere agli

arrivi delle diverse spedizioni. Se
vuoi raggiungere un{B4}area sbarrata,\ldovrai semplicemente tornare più

tardi.

entries.original:
"Ya know what’s not fair?

That I have to go through a
rigourous screenin’ process just to\lbe let onto the port so I can work\levery day!

If it weren’t for those lunkheads in
Antisis City, this wouldn’t even be\lan issue."
entries.translation_source: Ya know what’s not fair? That I have to go through a rigourous screenin’ process just to be let onto the port so I can work every day! If it weren’t for those lunkheads in Antisis City, this wouldn’t even be an issue.
entries.translated:
Sai cosa non è giusto? Che io debba
passare attraverso un rigoroso\lprocesso di selezione solo per

farmi ammettere al porto così posso
lavorare ogni giorno! Se non fosse\lper quei somari di Antisis City,

non sarebbe nemmeno un problema.

entries.original: "Are you a ruffian?"
entries.translation_source: Are you a ruffian?
entries.translated: Sei un teppista?

entries.original:
"Nope.
You don’t fight like one."
entries.translation_source: Nope. You don’t fight like one.
entries.translated: No. Non combatti come tale.

entries.original: "Antisis Sewers"
entries.translation_source: Antisis Sewers
entries.translated: Fogne di Antisis

entries.original:
"A sewer system running underneath
both halves of Antisis City.
Certain individuals like to convert
the sewage here into medicine
each day."
entries.translation_source: A sewer system running underneath both halves of Antisis City. Certain individuals like to convert the sewage here into medicine each day.
entries.translated:
Un sistema fognario che corre sotto
entrambe le metà di Antisis City.\lAlcune persone qui amano

trasformare ogni giorno i liquami
in medicine.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo\.
Stinky, stinky!

What a stench, what a stench!

Assail my nostrils\.
It is necessary!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo[game-token-1] Stinky, stinky! What a stench, what a stench! Assail my nostrils[game-token-2] It is necessary!
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. Puzza, puzza! Che
fetore, che fetore! Assalgimi le\lnarici\. È necessario!

entries.original:
"Boo hoo\.
Stinky, stinky!"
entries.translation_source: Boo hoo[game-token-1] Stinky, stinky!
entries.translated: Buh buh\. Puzza, puzza!

entries.original:
"Boo hoo\.
Still stinky, stinky!"
entries.translation_source: Boo hoo[game-token-1] Still stinky, stinky!
entries.translated: Uee\. Ancora puzzi, puzzi!

entries.original:
"Ahhhhh\.

The foul stench has evaporated\.
You have my gratitude."
entries.translation_source: Ahhhhh[game-token-1] The foul stench has evaporated[game-token-2] You have my gratitude.
entries.translated:
Ahhhhh\. Il fetore nauseabondo è
svanito\. Ti sono grato.

entries.original:
"’Til the sweet smelling aromas
bringeth us together again, I bid\lyou adieu."
entries.translation_source: ’Til the sweet smelling aromas bringeth us together again, I bid you adieu.
entries.translated:
Finché i dolci aromi profumati non
ci riuniranno ancora, ti saluto.

entries.original:
"Lots of toxins build up in the
sewer system.

I think I can use them to make
medicines!

So, I’m running an experiment!

If this works, I might be able to
use the venom of Poison-type\lPokémon to make different\lmedicines. How exciting!

Well, well\.

The result of today’s experiment
was\."
entries.translation_source: Lots of toxins build up in the sewer system. I think I can use them to make medicines! So, I’m running an experiment! If this works, I might be able to use the venom of Poison-type Pokémon to make different medicines. How exciting! Well, well[game-token-1] The result of today’s experiment was[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Un sacco di tossine si accumulano
nel sistema fognario. Penso di\lpoterle usare per creare medicine!

Quindi, sto facendo un esperimento!
Se funziona, potrei riuscire a\lusare il veleno dei Pokémon di tipo

Veleno per creare medicine diverse.
Che emozione! Ebbene, ebbene\. Il\lrisultato dell{B4}esperimento di oggi

è stato\.

entries.original:
"Wow! Today’s experiment was super
successful!

Here! Please accept
the [buffer1] I made!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Today’s experiment was super successful! Here! Please accept the [buffer1-1] I made!
entries.translated:
Wow! L{B4}esperimento di oggi è stato
un successo strepitoso! Tieni! Per\lfavore accetta il [buffer1] che ho

fatto!

entries.original:
"I’ll keep experimenting every day!
It’s important to keep trying.

Come back and see how it’s going!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep experimenting every day! It’s important to keep trying. Come back and see how it’s going!
entries.translated:
Continuerò a fare esperimenti ogni
giorno! È importante non smettere\ldi provare. Torna a vedere come va!

entries.original:
"Big Mo hired me to clean up
the sewers."
entries.translation_source: Big Mo hired me to clean up the sewers.
entries.translated: Big Mo mi ha assunto per ripulire le fogne.

entries.original: "I kind of enjoy it, actually."
entries.translation_source: I kind of enjoy it, actually.
entries.translated: In realtà mi piace un po{B4}.

entries.original:
"I love cleaning, so it’s like I’m
never working a day in my life!"
entries.translation_source: I love cleaning, so it’s like I’m never working a day in my life!
entries.translated:
Adoro pulire, quindi è come se non
lavorassi mai un solo giorno della\lmia vita!

entries.original:
"[green]Whirlipede[blue] infest the sewers from
time to time.

They like to cause all sorts of
trouble down here."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Whirlipede[color-blue-2] infest the sewers from time to time. They like to cause all sorts of trouble down here.
entries.translated:
[green]Whirlipede[blue] infestano le fogne di
tanto in tanto. Amano creare ogni\lgenere di guaio quaggiù.

entries.original:
"You can crawl through a pipe to go
to the sewers underneath the\lsouthern half of Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: You can crawl through a pipe to go to the sewers underneath the southern half of Antisis City.
entries.translated:
Puoi strisciare attraverso un tubo
per andare nelle fogne sotto la\lmetà meridionale di Antisis City.

entries.original:
"Since we built this sewer, all
kinds of Pokémon have shown up."
entries.translation_source: Since we built this sewer, all kinds of Pokémon have shown up.
entries.translated:
Da quando abbiamo costruito questa
fogna, sono comparsi Pokémon di\logni tipo.

entries.original:
"The Science Society sent me to
the sewers to study the smell here!"
entries.translation_source: The Science Society sent me to the sewers to study the smell here!
entries.translated: La Società Scientifica mi ha mandato nelle fogne a studiare l{B4}odore che c{B4}è qui!

entries.original:
"If I were to express my
disappointment with a scent, I’d\lput it on par with a Gloom’s."
entries.translation_source: If I were to express my disappointment with a scent, I’d put it on par with a Gloom’s.
entries.translated: Se dovessi esprimere la mia delusione con un odore, lo paragonerei a quello di un Gloom.

entries.original:
"Even odours that might seem awful to
humans might be perfume to Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Even odours that might seem awful to humans might be perfume to Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Anche odori che potrebbero sembrare
terribili agli umani potrebbero\lessere profumo per i Pokémon.

entries.original: "What a catastrophic theorem!"
entries.translation_source: What a catastrophic theorem!
entries.translated: Che teorema catastrofico!

entries.original: "Auburn Waterway"
entries.translation_source: Auburn Waterway
entries.translated: Canale Fulvo

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!
You found this old clown!

I thought the rain would wash away
my tears forever.

For that, you have my gratitude."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! You found this old clown! I thought the rain would wash away my tears forever. For that, you have my gratitude.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Hai trovato questo
vecchio clown! Credevo che la\lpioggia avrebbe lavato via per

sempre le mie lacrime. Per questo,
hai la mia gratitudine.

entries.original:
"’Til the rain bringeth us together
again, I bid you adieu."
entries.translation_source: ’Til the rain bringeth us together again, I bid you adieu.
entries.translated:
Finché la pioggia non ci riunirà di
nuovo, ti saluto.

entries.original:
"The water in this lake\.

It’s so clear!"
entries.translation_source: The water in this lake[game-token-1] It’s so clear!
entries.translated: L{B4}acqua di questo lago\. È così limpida!

entries.original: "As clear as your victory\."
entries.translation_source: As clear as your victory[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Chiaro come la tua vittoria\.

entries.original:
"I prefer swimming in a calm lake
much more than in the sea."
entries.translation_source: I prefer swimming in a calm lake much more than in the sea.
entries.translated:
Preferisco nuotare in un lago calmo
molto più che nel mare.

entries.original:
"Brr\. I’m starting to get chilly.
I could use a win to get warmed up."
entries.translation_source: Brr[game-token-1] I’m starting to get chilly. I could use a win to get warmed up.
entries.translated:
Brr\. Sto cominciando a sentire
freddo. Mi servirebbe una vittoria\lper scaldarmi.

entries.original:
"Hi, wave-riding Trainer!
How about a battle on the lake?"
entries.translation_source: Hi, wave-riding Trainer! How about a battle on the lake?
entries.translated: Ehi, Allenatore in surf! Che ne dici di una lotta sul lago?

entries.original: "You sure schooled me there."
entries.translation_source: You sure schooled me there.
entries.translated: Mi hai proprio dato una lezione.

entries.original:
"Maybe I should switch to surfing,
too\."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should switch to surfing, too[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Forse dovrei passare anch{B4}io al
surf\.

entries.original:
"There are many watery routes that
you can swim in Borrius.

It puts the Hoenn region to shame!"
entries.translation_source: There are many watery routes that you can swim in Borrius. It puts the Hoenn region to shame!
entries.translated:
Ci sono molte rotte d{B4}acqua che
puoi attraversare a nuoto a\lBorrius. Fa sembrare la regione di

Hoenn una miseria!

entries.original:
"Waah! Now! Just now!
I was just about to reel it in!"
entries.translation_source: Waah! Now! Just now! I was just about to reel it in!
entries.translated: Aah! Adesso! Proprio adesso! Stavo per tirarlo su!

entries.original:
"You need to have more respect for a
fisherman\."
entries.translation_source: You need to have more respect for a fisherman[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Devi avere più rispetto per un pescatore\.

entries.original:
"Go on.

Don’t be shy about talking to
lonely fishermen.

Just don’t you talk to me."
entries.translation_source: Go on. Don’t be shy about talking to lonely fishermen. Just don’t you talk to me.
entries.translated:
Avanti. Non essere timido a parlare
con i pescatori solitari. Però non\lparlare con me.

entries.original: "Battleground"
entries.translation_source: Battleground
entries.translated: Campo di battaglia

entries.original:
"Champ in the making!

Or should I say, Champ?

Long time no see!

Guess all my advice really helped
you out, eh?

Welcome to the Battleground!

In this club, you can battle with
the best in Borrius.

So enjoy your time here, especially
because you’re one of them!

Oh, and if you want to take part in
the [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue], come find me."
entries.translation_source: Champ in the making! Or should I say, Champ? Long time no see! Guess all my advice really helped you out, eh? Welcome to the Battleground! In this club, you can battle with the best in Borrius. So enjoy your time here, especially because you’re one of them! Oh, and if you want to take part in the [color-green-1]Leaders Gauntlet[color-blue-2], come find me.
entries.translated:
Campione in erba! O dovrei dire,
Campione? È tanto che non ci\lvediamo! Immagino che tutti i miei

consigli ti siano stati davvero
utili, eh? Benvenuto al\lBattleground! In questo club, puoi

sfidare i migliori di Borrius.
Quindi goditi il tuo tempo qui,\lsoprattutto perché sei uno di loro!

Ah, e se vuoi prendere parte al
[green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue], vieni a cercarmi.

entries.original:
"[black]Stand and face [buffer1] on the other
side of the field to begin battling."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Stand and face [buffer1-2] on the other side of the field to begin battling.
entries.translated:
[black]Mettiti di fronte a [buffer1]
sull{B4}altro lato del campo per\liniziare a combattere.

entries.original: "Are you ready to begin the battle?"
entries.translation_source: Are you ready to begin the battle?
entries.translated: Sei pronto a iniziare la lotta?

entries.original:
"Hey, Champ!

Interested in taking part in the
[green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Champ! Interested in taking part in the [color-green-1]Leaders Gauntlet[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Ehi, campione! Ti interessa
partecipare al [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue]?

entries.original:
"Hey, Champ!

If you’re interested in taking part in
the [green]Leaders Gauntlet[blue], get rid of\lthat guy following you first!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Champ! If you’re interested in taking part in the [color-green-1]Leaders Gauntlet[color-blue-2], get rid of that guy following you first!

entries.translation_source: In the [color-green-1]Classic Leaders Gauntlet[color-blue-2], you’ll be pitted against each Gym Leader, one after the other. But despite the fights being back to back, you will get a chance to save and adjust your team in between each fight. As for the Gym Leaders’ teams, they’ll be using much stronger Pokémon than when you fought them in their Gyms. They’ll also be fighting with the same battle effects as back then, so keep that in mind. If you manage to defeat a Gym Leader, and you’ve already received a Z-Crystal from them, they’ll give you their daily Gem after the battle, assuming they haven’t already given you one. If you manage to defeat all of them, you’ll win fantastic prizes! And of course, the harder your [color-green-3]Battle Difficulty[color-blue-4], the better the prizes you can win.

[green]Steelium Z[blue], [green]Electrium Z[blue]\. quei due

che non si possano usare entrambi

"[player]! You’re back!

[player]! Sei tornato! Tempismo
perfetto! Ci sono ancora qualche\lbug nel mio modo di lottare, credo,

entries.original:
"[blue]Gaaaah! Broken down again!

We gotta do this again sometime!

Here, consider this a promise from
me, because ol’ Galavan ain’t done\lwith ya yet!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Gaaaah! Broken down again! We gotta do this again sometime! Here, consider this a promise from me, because ol’ Galavan ain’t done with ya yet!
entries.translated:
[blue]Gaaaah! Di nuovo in panne! Dobbiamo
rifarlo prima o poi! Tieni,\lconsidera questo una promessa da

parte mia, perché il vecchio
Galavan non ha ancora finito con\lte!

entries.original:
"There’s a stereotype among Electric-
type Trainers\.

Apparently, ya gotta be good with
machines to even train ’em properly.

I mean, ol’ Galavan doesn’t believe
in labels, but I see their point.

Have you SEEN the damage they can
do to our tech?

We’d go broke if we couldn’t fix what
they break ourselves!

Ha ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: There’s a stereotype among Electric- type Trainers[game-token-1] Apparently, ya gotta be good with machines to even train ’em properly. I mean, ol’ Galavan doesn’t believe in labels, but I see their point. Have you SEEN the damage they can do to our tech? We’d go broke if we couldn’t fix what they break ourselves! Ha ha ha ha!

C{B4}è uno stereotipo tra gli
Allenatori di tipo Elettro\. Pare che\ltu debba essere bravo con le

macchine perfino per allenarli a
dovere. Voglio dire, il vecchio\lGalavan non crede nelle etichette,

ma capisco il loro punto. Hai VISTO
i danni che possono fare alla\lnostra tecnologia? Finiremmo in

rovina se non potessimo riparare da
soli ciò che rompono! Ah ah ah ah!

entries.original:
"Ha ha ha ha!
Look who decided to show up!

If it isn’t our latest Champion,
[player]!

Hah! If you’re here, then I guess
you’ve staked a claim on this turf\lalready, huh?

Last time I lost, I knew I had to
get out and\. let’s say, assert\lmyself elsewhere, you get me?

for Big Mo’s new base, huh?

If you’re here, then I guess you’ve staked a claim on this turf already, huh? Last time I lost, I knew I had to get out and[game-token-2] let’s say, assert myself elsewhere, you get me? But I guess I gotta keep lookin’ for Big Mo’s new base, huh? Unless[game-token-3] you wanna try taking on the kingpin, right here, right now? For real this time. The joint belongs to whoever wins. I warn ya, I’m not the same as before! Well? What’s it gonna be, squirt? Or are you quaking in yer boots already?
entries.translated:
Ha ha ha ha! Guarda chi si è fatto
vivo! Ma non è il nostro ultimo\lCampione, [player]! Hah! Se sei

qui, allora immagino che tu abbia
già messo le mani su questo\lterritorio, eh? L{B4}ultima volta che

andarmene e\. diciamo, impormi\laltrove, mi capisci? Ma immagino

che debba continuare a cercare la

il capo, qui e ora? Sul serio
stavolta. Il posto va a chi vince.\lTi avverto, non sono più quello di

prima! Bene? Che si fa, ragazzino?

entries.original:
"Grr\. you lookin’ down on me, ya
snot-nosed punk?

Well, I’m stayin’ here until ya
chase me out, got it?

\.or until the next day.
I got places to be."
entries.translation_source: Grr[game-token-1] you lookin’ down on me, ya snot-nosed punk? Well, I’m stayin’ here until ya chase me out, got it? [game-token-2]or until the next day. I got places to be.
entries.translated:
Grr\., mi stai guardando dall{B4}alto in
basso, razza di moccioso saccente?\lEbbene, io resto qui finché non mi

cacci, capito? \., oppure fino al
giorno dopo. Ho dei posti dove\landare.

entries.original:
"Heh\. sucker.

Alright, let’s take this to the
battle area already."

entries.translated:
Eheh\. pollo. Va bene, portiamola
subito nell{B4}area lotta.

entries.original:
"[blue]You’re trapped in this cage with me,
and there’s nowhere to run, punk!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You’re trapped in this cage with me, and there’s nowhere to run, punk!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sei intrappolato in questa gabbia
con me, e non hai via di fuga,\lmarmocchio!

entries.original:
"[blue]Ha! So even the kingpin can’t do a
thing against the Champion, huh?

But don’t think that’s gonna keep
Big Mo down forever!

I just need to see more of
whatever the world outside Antisis\lhas to offer!

Here. Use this Z-Crystal.

That should keep you winning\. until
I take ya down myself!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Ha! So even the kingpin can’t do a thing against the Champion, huh? But don’t think that’s gonna keep Big Mo down forever! I just need to see more of whatever the world outside Antisis has to offer! Here. Use this Z-Crystal. That should keep you winning[game-token-2] until I take ya down myself!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ah! Quindi persino il boss non può
fare nulla contro il Campione, eh?\lMa non pensare che questo terrà giù

Big Mo per sempre! Mi basta vedere
ancora di più di quello che il\lmondo fuori da Antisis ha da

offrire! Tieni. Usa questo
Cristallo Z. Dovrebbe farti\lcontinuare a vincere\. finché non

sarò io stesso a metterti KO!

entries.original:
"[blue]That’s the [green]Fightinium Z[blue]!

[green]Fighting[blue]-type attacks get all
souped up with that thing!

But, they’re pretty exhausting.

I’m Big Mo, and even I can only do
it once a battle!

But for the one moment I tap into
that Z-Crystal\.

Any poor sucker in the way gets an
[green]All-Out Pummeling[blue]!

No-holds barred!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]That’s the [color-green-2]Fightinium Z[color-blue-3]! [color-green-4]Fighting[color-blue-5]-type attacks get all souped up with that thing! But, they’re pretty exhausting. I’m Big Mo, and even I can only do it once a battle! But for the one moment I tap into that Z-Crystal[game-token-6] Any poor sucker in the way gets an [color-green-7]All-Out Pummeling[color-blue-8]! No-holds barred!
entries.translated:
[blue]Quello è il [green]Fightinium Z[blue]! Le mosse
di tipo [green]Lotta[blue] diventano\lsuperpotenti con quello! Però è

piuttosto faticoso. Io sono Big Mo,
e perfino io posso usarlo solo una\lvolta per lotta! Ma per quell{B4}unico

strada si becca un [green]All-Out
Pummeling[blue]! Senza esclusione di\lcolpi!

entries.original:
"Well, look who’s here!

I’m back for another chance to
settle the score with ya!

One more try at dethroning the
untouchable Champion!

So, you willin’ to put it all on the
line and take on the kingpin?"
entries.translation_source: Well, look who’s here! I’m back for another chance to settle the score with ya! One more try at dethroning the untouchable Champion! So, you willin’ to put it all on the line and take on the kingpin?
entries.translated:
Beh, guarda un po{B4} chi c{B4}è! Sono
tornato per un{B4}altra occasione di\lregolare i conti con te! Un altro

tentativo di spodestare
l{B4}intoccabile Campione! Allora, sei\ldisposto a metterti in gioco e

affrontare il boss?

entries.original:
"[blue]Tch\. beaten down again\.
unbelievable\.

Ha ha ha ha!
Guess I gotta keep training!

Here, a little something so you
don’t lose your edge!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Tch[game-token-2] beaten down again[game-token-3] unbelievable[game-token-4] Ha ha ha ha! Guess I gotta keep training! Here, a little something so you don’t lose your edge!
entries.translated:
[blue]Tsk\. abbattuto di nuovo\. incredibile\.
Ah ah ah ah! Suppongo che debba\lcontinuare ad allenarmi! Tieni, un

pensierino così non perdi il tuo
smalto!

entries.original:
"By the way\. I’ve been revamping my
Gym back in Antisis, lately.

Losing to ya made me realize I
needed to let more fish into\lthe pond.

extra challenge\.

like it.

Even if they don’t like me!

Ha ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: By the way[game-token-1] I’ve been revamping my Gym back in Antisis, lately. Losing to ya made me realize I needed to let more fish into the pond. It ain’t much - all it offers is an extra challenge[game-token-2] But all the visitors seem to like it. Even if they don’t like me! Ha ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
A proposito\. Ultimamente ho
rinnovato la mia Palestra ad\lAntisis. Perdere contro di te mi ha

fatto capire che dovevo far entrare
più pesci nello stagno. Non è\lgranché - offre solo una sfida

extra\. Però a tutti i visitatori
sembra piacere. Anche se non\lpiaccio io a loro! Ah ah ah ha!

entries.original:
"Howdy, sugah!
Fancy meeting ya here!

I got worried sick ’bout ya after
our Gym Battle, but I guess I\ldidn’t need to be!

Me? Ah, well\. even I need some time
away from the swamp - clear my\lhead some, see?

Plus, word is that this place here
is where the best in Borrius come\ltogether.

Must be true, if you’re here.

So, while we’re both killin’ time\.
ya fancy another round? You and I?

Last time ya seemed\. a mite
desperate, like getting my Badge\lmeant life or death.

This time, I wanna battle the real
[player].

Whaddya say? I’m itchin’ to show ya
how we’ve gotten better, too!"
entries.translation_source: Howdy, sugah! Fancy meeting ya here! I got worried sick ’bout ya after our Gym Battle, but I guess I didn’t need to be! Me? entries.translated:
Salve, tesoro! Che sorpresa
incontrarti qui! Mi sono\lpreoccupato moltissimo per te dopo

la nostra lotta in Palestra, ma a
quanto pare non ce n{B4}era bisogno!\lIo? Ah, ecco\. anche io ho bisogno di

allontanarmi dalla palude per un
po{B4} - schiarirmi un po{B4} le idee,\lcapisci? Inoltre, si dice che

questo posto sia dove i migliori di
Borrius si riuniscono. Deve essere\lvero, se sei qui. Allora, mentre

entrambi passiamo il tempo\. ti va un
altro round? Io e te? L{B4}ultima\lvolta sembravi\. un po{B4} disperato,

come se ottenere la mia Medaglia
significasse vita o morte. Questa\lvolta, voglio lottare con il vero

[player]. Che ne dici? Non vedo
l{B4}ora di mostrarti come siamo\lmigliorati anche noi!

Still, I’m here all day, so if ya

entries.translation_source: Too busy? I get it. Still, I’m here all day, so if ya change your mind[game-token-1] drop by again.
entries.translated:
Troppo occupato? Capisco. Comunque,
sono qui tutto il giorno, quindi se\lcambi idea\. ripassa pure.

entries.original:
"Aw yeah, that’s what I’m talkin’
about! Meet ya at the battle area!"
entries.translation_source: Aw yeah, that’s what I’m talkin’ about! Meet ya at the battle area!
entries.translated:
Sììì, è proprio di questo che
parlo! Ci vediamo nell{B4}area lotta!

entries.original:
"[red]Yer already in deep\. and it’s only
gonna get deeper! Get ready!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Yer already in deep[game-token-2] and it’s only gonna get deeper! Get ready!
entries.translated:
[red]Sei già messo male\. e andrà solo
peggio! Preparati!

entries.original:
"Ah, dang it! But then, I guess ya
ain’t Champion for nuthin’\."
entries.translation_source: Ah, dang it! But then, I guess ya ain’t Champion for nuthin’[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Accidenti! Ma poi, suppongo che tu
non sia Campione per niente\.

entries.original:
"[red]I got swamped again?
Well, don’t that just beat all!

Coulda sworn I trained enough to
catch up to ya, but guess not.

Alright, that settles it!
I’ll let ya have this!

Call it a present, just for being
that dang amazing - it’s my\lfavourite Z-Crystal!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I got swamped again? Well, don’t that just beat all! Coulda sworn I trained enough to catch up to ya, but guess not. Alright, that settles it! I’ll let ya have this! Call it a present, just for being that dang amazing - it’s my favourite Z-Crystal!
entries.translated:
[red]Mi hai battuto di nuovo? Beh, ti
pare poco! Giuravo di essermi\lallenato abbastanza per

raggiungerti, ma a quanto pare no.
Va bene, è deciso! Ti lascio\lquesto! Consideralo un regalo, solo

per essere così dannatamente forte:
è il mio Cristallo Z preferito!

entries.original:
"[red]Use that [green]Waterium Z[red], and it’ll turn
any [green]Water[red]-type attack into a\lpowerful [green]Z-Move[red]!

But it’s only good once a battle,
so ya gotta make the shot count.

Watching a move like [green]Hydro Vortex[red]\.

Sure am glad the swamp don’t
suffer from that sorta thing!

I mean, it’s been havin’ its own
problems as it is, lately\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Use that [color-green-2]Waterium Z[color-red-3], and it’ll turn any [color-green-4]Water[color-red-5]-type attack into a powerful [color-green-6]Z-Move[color-red-7]! But it’s only good once a battle, so ya gotta make the shot count. Watching a move like [color-green-8]Hydro Vortex[color-red-9][game-token-10] Sure am glad the swamp don’t suffer from that sorta thing! I mean, it’s been havin’ its own problems as it is, lately[game-token-11]
entries.translated:
[red]Usa quel [green]Idrium Z[red], e trasformerà
qualsiasi mossa di tipo [green]Acqua[red] in\luna potente [green]Mossa Z[red]! Ma funziona

solo una volta per lotta, quindi
devi far contare il colpo. Vedere\luna mossa come [green]Vortaggio[red]\. Sono

proprio contento che la palude non
debba subire una cosa del genere!\lVoglio dire, ha già avuto i suoi

problemi, ultimamente\.

entries.original:
"Oh, [player]! Great timing!

Last time left a li’l raincloud over
my head that won’t go away.

And the only way I’m gonna clear my
mind\. is a shot at redemption!

If y’all have time to spare today,
ya wanna throw down one more time?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, [player-name-1]! Great timing! Last time left a li’l raincloud over my head that won’t go away. And the only way I’m gonna clear my mind[game-token-2] is a shot at redemption! If y’all have time to spare today, ya wanna throw down one more time?
entries.translated:
Oh, [player]! Tempismo perfetto!
L{B4}ultima volta mi è rimasto addosso\lun nuvolone di pioggia che non

vuole andarsene. E l{B4}unico modo in
cui riuscirò a schiarirmi le idee\. è\luna possibilità di riscatto! Se

oggi avete tempo da perdere, vi va
di sfidarci ancora una volta?

entries.original:
"[red]Aw, dangit. You’re a whole lot better
than I thought, sugah.

Here, ya can have this.

Call it a promise to take ya
on again!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Aw, dangit. You’re a whole lot better than I thought, sugah. Here, ya can have this. Call it a promise to take ya on again!
entries.translated:
[red]Accidenti. Sei molto più bravo di
quanto pensassi, zucchero. Tieni,\lpuoi avere questo. Consideralo una

promessa di sfidarti di nuovo!

entries.original:
"I wonder how Mel’s doin’?

He always had a hard time lettin’
go of anythin’.

Gifts, his past, even grudges\. he
holds ’em tight.

It ain’t obvious unless ya pay
attention, though.

when I moved to Polder - gave him\lthe ol’ Gym before I left.

If he showed up here, same day as
me\. wonder what he’d say\.\lor if he’d say anythin’ at all?"
entries.translation_source: I wonder how Mel’s doin’? He always had a hard time lettin’ go of anythin’. Gifts, his past, even grudges[game-token-1] he holds ’em tight. It ain’t obvious unless ya pay attention, though. I tried to part on good terms, when I moved to Polder - gave him the ol’ Gym before I left. If he showed up here, same day as me[game-token-2] wonder what he’d say[game-token-3] or if he’d say anythin’ at all?
entries.translated:
Mi chiedo come se la passi Mel? Ha
sempre fatto fatica a lasciar\landare qualsiasi cosa. Regali, il

suo passato, perfino i rancori\. li
tiene stretti. Non è evidente a\lmeno che non ci fai caso, però. Ho

cercato di chiudere in buoni
rapporti, quando mi sono trasferito\la Polder - gli ho lasciato pure la

vecchia Palestra prima di
andarmene. Se fosse comparso qui lo\lstesso giorno in cui sono arrivato

io\. chissà cosa avrebbe detto\. o se
avrebbe detto qualcosa, poi?

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. it’s been ages\.
ages, I say, since I’ve felt such a\lstrong urge to cross paths with a\lfellow Trainer once more.

Hello again, and my heartiest
congratulations on becoming\lChampion.

And, I suppose, my most heartfelt
thanks for ridding the world of a\lmost terrible evil.

I remember when we last battled, I
was fortunate enough to catch you\lquite near the end of your quest\lto the Pokémon League.

You were much like a Butterfree,
newly emerged, with nothing left\lbut to wait for its wings to dry\land harden.

But now, I wish to see your
strength at its fullest.

What did you experience?

What ground have you tread as you
lived through those moments?

I desire another battle, so I may
observe the results.

Will you indulge this old man?"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo[game-token-1] it’s been ages[game-token-2] ages, I say, since I’ve felt such a strong urge to cross paths with a fellow Trainer once more. Hello again, and my heartiest congratulations on becoming Champion. And, I suppose, my most heartfelt thanks for ridding the world of a most terrible evil. I remember when we last battled, I was fortunate enough to catch you quite near the end of your quest to the Pokémon League. You were much like a Butterfree, newly emerged, with nothing left but to wait for its wings to dry and harden. But now, I wish to see your strength at its fullest. What did you experience? What ground have you tread as you lived through those moments? I desire another battle, so I may observe the results. Will you indulge this old man?
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. sono passati secoli\.
secoli, dico, da quando ho provato\lun desiderio così forte di

incrociare di nuovo un Allenatore
come te. Ciao di nuovo, e le mie\lpiù sentite congratulazioni per

essere diventato Campione. E,
suppongo, i miei più sentiti\lringraziamenti per aver liberato il

mondo da un male terribilissimo.
Ricordo quando ci siamo sfidati\ll{B4}ultima volta, ho avuto la fortuna

di incontrarti quasi alla fine del
tuo viaggio verso la Lega Pokémon.\lEri molto simile a un Butterfree

appena emerso, senza altro da fare
se non aspettare che le sue ali si\lasciugassero e indurissero. Ma ora,

desidero vedere la tua forza al
massimo. Cosa hai vissuto? Quale\lterreno hai calpestato mentre

vivevi quei momenti? Desidero
un{B4}altra battaglia, così potrò\losservare i risultati.

Accontenterai questo vecchio?

entries.original:
"I see\. if you change your mind,
I’ll be here all day.

I would say I’m not getting any
younger waiting, but\."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1] if you change your mind, I’ll be here all day. I would say I’m not getting any younger waiting, but[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Capisco\. se cambi idea, sarò qui
tutto il giorno. Direi che non sto\lringiovanendo mentre aspetto, ma\.

entries.original:
"Ah, you have my thanks.

Then I shall make my way to the
battle area."
entries.translation_source: Ah, you have my thanks. Then I shall make my way to the battle area.
entries.translated:
Ah, hai i miei ringraziamenti.
Allora mi dirigerò verso l{B4}area\llotta.

entries.original:
"[blue]Now, bear witness, to the tempered
resilience of my Pokémon and I!"

entries.translated:
[blue]Ora, sii testimone della resistenza

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. you never fail to

entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo[game-token-1] you never fail to impress, as always.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo\. non smetti mai di
stupire, come sempre.

entries.original:
"[blue]Goodness\. I think I’ve gotten a bit
too excited again.

But I can’t help it!

entries.original:
"Ah, [player]!

Good of you to drop by.

Have you ever heard a saying my
grandmother used to be fond of?

\qoIf humans were meant to fly,
we’d have wings like a Gligar\land feathers like a Pidgeotto.\qc

Well, I’m pretty sure I’ve got the
first part down, but\.

I might need a little bit of help
for the second.

So if you have any time today,
would you be willing to help\la nice lady out?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, [player-name-1]! Good of you to drop by. Have you ever heard a saying my grandmother used to be fond of? [quote-open-2]If humans were meant to fly, we’d have wings like a Gligar and feathers like a Pidgeotto.[quote-close-3] Well, I’m pretty sure I’ve got the first part down, but[game-token-4] I might need a little bit of help for the second. So if you have any time today, would you be willing to help a nice lady out?
entries.translated:
Ah, [player]! Buona idea farti
vedere da queste parti. Hai mai\lsentito un detto che piaceva tanto

a mia nonna? \qoSe gli umani fossero
destinati a volare, avremmo ali\lcome un Gligar e piume come un

Pidgeotto.\qc Beh, sono abbastanza
sicura di aver capito la prima\lparte, ma\. potrei aver bisogno di un

piccolo aiuto per la seconda.
Allora, se hai un po{B4} di tempo\loggi, saresti disposto ad aiutare

una simpatica signora?

entries.original:
"Ah, excellent!

Then, let me explain the problem
here.

I need the feathers necessary
to finish the wings I’ve been\lworking on.

But not just any feathers will do -
I need [green]Pretty Wings[red].

[green][buffer2][red] of them, to be exact.

I mean, I could use other wings,
but a lady’s gotta have nice\lthings, right?

So, if you could fetch me [green][buffer2][red]
of those [green]Pretty Wings[red] and bring\lthem here, there’ll be something\lnice in it for you, too!

You can find Pretty Wings being
carried by wild [green]Wingull[red]\land [green]Pelipper[red].

If you have a Pokémon with Thief,
Covet, or Knock Off, getting those\lPretty Wings will be a lot easier.

I recommend [green]Knock Off[red] the most,
because it saves you having to\ltake the item from your Pokémon.

Also, a Pokémon with [green]Compound Eyes[red]
or [green]Super Luck[red] at the front of\lyour party increases the odds of\lwild Pokémon holding items, so keep\lthat in mind!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, excellent! Then, let me explain the problem here. I need the feathers necessary to finish the wings I’ve been working on. But not just any feathers will do - I need [color-green-1]Pretty Wings[color-red-2]. [color-green-3][buffer2-4][color-red-5] of them, to be exact. I mean, I could use other wings, but a lady’s gotta have nice things, right? So, if you could fetch me [color-green-6][buffer2-7][color-red-8] of those [color-green-9]Pretty Wings[color-red-10] and bring them here, there’ll be something nice in it for you, too! You can find Pretty Wings being carried by wild [color-green-11]Wingull[color-red-12] and [color-green-13]Pelipper[color-red-14]. If you have a Pokémon with Thief, Covet, or Knock Off, getting those Pretty Wings will be a lot easier. I recommend [color-green-15]Knock Off[color-red-16] the most, because it saves you having to take the item from your Pokémon. Also, a Pokémon with [color-green-17]Compound Eyes[color-red-18] or [color-green-19]Super Luck[color-red-20] at the front of your party increases the odds of wild Pokémon holding items, so keep that in mind!
entries.translated:
Ah, eccellente! Allora, lascia che
ti spieghi il problema. Ho bisogno\ldelle piume necessarie per finire

le ali a cui sto lavorando. Ma non
vanno bene piume qualsiasi: mi\lservono [green]Belle Piume[red]. [green][buffer2][red] per

l{B4}esattezza. Voglio dire, potrei
usare altre piume, ma una signora\ldeve avere cose belle, giusto?

Quindi, se potessi procurarmi
[green][buffer2][red] di quelle [green]Belle Piume[red] e\lportarmele qui, ci sarà qualcosa di

carino anche per te! Puoi trovare
le Belle Piume addosso ai [green]Wingull[red] e\l[green]Pelipper[red] selvatici. Se hai un

Pokémon con Furto, Supplica o
Privazione, ottenere quelle Belle\lPiume sarà molto più facile. Ti

consiglio soprattutto [green]Privazione[red],
perché ti evita di dover togliere\llo strumento dal tuo Pokémon.

Inoltre, un Pokémon con [green]Insettocchi[red]
o [green]Supersorte[red] in prima posizione\lnella squadra aumenta le

probabilità che i Pokémon selvatici
tengano strumenti, quindi tienilo a\lmente!

see if we have what it takes!"

It learns [color-green-14]Knock Off[color-red-15] naturally, and when it evolves its Hidden Ability becomes [color-green-16]Super Luck[color-red-17]! This makes it a great pick for stealing [color-green-18]Pretty Wings[color-red-19] from wild [color-green-20]Wingull[color-red-21] and [color-green-22]Pelipper[color-red-23]. I’m counting on you, [buffer1-24], let’s see if we have what it takes!
