Please bring them as soon
as you can."
entries.translation_source: I still need: [color-green-1][raw-escape-2][color-red-3] Please bring them as soon as you can.
entries.translated:
Mi servono ancora: [green]\\07[red] Portameli
appena puoi.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo, it seems you’ve
brought my ingredients.

Much appreciated."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo, it seems you’ve brought my ingredients. Much appreciated.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo, sembra che tu abbia
portato i miei ingredienti. Ti\lringrazio molto.

entries.original:
"[black]The Old Lady took:
[green]\\07"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Old Lady took: [color-green-2][raw-escape-3]
entries.translated: [black]La Vecchia ha preso: [green]\\07

entries.original:
"I’m sure my [buffer2] will love
this pie.

Please, take these in exchange for
your hard work, young Trainer."
entries.translation_source: I’m sure my [buffer2-1] will love this pie. Please, take these in exchange for your hard work, young Trainer.
entries.translated:
Sono certo che la mia [buffer2]
adorerà questa torta. Per favore,\lprendi questi in cambio del tuo

duro lavoro, giovane Allenatore.

entries.original:
"I’m sure I’ll enjoy smashing this
pie into my ex-husband’s face!

Please, take these in exchange for
your hard work, young Trainer."
entries.translation_source: I’m sure I’ll enjoy smashing this pie into my ex-husband’s face! Please, take these in exchange for your hard work, young Trainer.
entries.translated:
Sono sicura che mi divertirò a
spiaccicare questa torta in faccia\lal mio ex marito! Per favore,

prendi questi in cambio del tuo
duro lavoro, giovane Allenatore.

entries.original:
"Come back again in the future
sometime.

There are no shortage of
celebrations to bake pies for."
entries.translation_source: Come back again in the future sometime. There are no shortage of celebrations to bake pies for.
entries.translated:
Torna a trovarci in futuro, prima o
poi. Non mancano le occasioni da\lcelebrare per cuocere torte.

entries.original:
"My family loved all of the pies!

I couldn’t have made such wonderful
food without your help."
entries.translation_source: My family loved all of the pies! I couldn’t have made such wonderful food without your help.
entries.translated:
Alla mia famiglia sono piaciute
tantissimo tutte le torte! Non\lavrei potuto preparare cibo così

squisito senza il tuo aiuto.

entries.original: "10 Sitrus Berries\l10 Lum Berries\l2 Kee Berries\l2 Marang Berries\l5 Moomoo Milks"
entries.translation_source: 10 Sitrus Berries 10 Lum Berries 2 Kee Berries 2 Marang Berries 5 Moomoo Milks
entries.translated:
10 Baccacedro 10 Baccalum 2 Baccaki
2 Baccamarang 5 Latte Mumu

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of [green]Ayla[red]?

She’s the one responsible for
bringing Bill’s PC to Borrius!

Thanks to her, we can store our
Pokémon somewhere!"
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of [color-green-1]Ayla[color-red-2]? She’s the one responsible for bringing Bill’s PC to Borrius! Thanks to her, we can store our Pokémon somewhere!
entries.translated:
Hai mai sentito parlare di [green]Ayla[red]? È
lei la responsabile di aver portato\lil PC di Bill a Borrius! Grazie a

lei, possiamo conservare i nostri
Pokémon da qualche parte!

entries.original:
"You know [green]Ayla[red], right, Champion?

The one responsible for bringing
Bill’s PC to Borrius?

Rumour has it, she’s been working on
a way to store Pokémon on the\lcloud and trade them across the\lglobe\.

But that can’t be true, can it?

Everyone knows you need a Link Cable
to trade!"
entries.translation_source: You know [color-green-1]Ayla[color-red-2], right, Champion? The one responsible for bringing Bill’s PC to Borrius? Rumour has it, she’s been working on a way to store Pokémon on the cloud and trade them across the globe[game-token-3] But that can’t be true, can it? Everyone knows you need a Link Cable to trade!
entries.translated:
Conosci [green]Ayla[red], vero, Campione?
Quella responsabile di aver portato\lil PC di Bill a Borrius? Si dice

che stia lavorando a un modo per
archiviare i Pokémon nel cloud e\lscambiarli in tutto il globo\. Ma non

può essere vero, no? Tutti sanno
che per scambiare ti serve un Cavo\lLink!

entries.original:
"[green]Alice[blue], the Gym Leader, likes to use
[green]Flying[blue]-type Pokémon.

I know, it’s not what you’d expect
from a Gym up here."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Alice[color-blue-2], the Gym Leader, likes to use [color-green-3]Flying[color-blue-4]-type Pokémon. I know, it’s not what you’d expect from a Gym up here.
entries.translated:
[green]Alice[blue], la Capopalestra, ama usare
Pokémon di tipo [green]Volante[blue]. Lo so, non\lè quello che ti aspetteresti da una

Palestra quassù.

entries.original:
"When Pokémon evolve, they
get stronger.

But there is a benefit to not
evolving your Pokémon right away.

Pokémon that can still evolve can
utilise an [green]Eviolite[blue] to become\ltougher to beat in battle.

I have an extra, so I’d be willing
to part with it if you can show me\la Pokémon that can still evolve."
entries.translation_source: When Pokémon evolve, they get stronger. But there is a benefit to not evolving your Pokémon right away. Pokémon that can still evolve can utilise an [color-green-1]Eviolite[color-blue-2] to become tougher to beat in battle. I have an extra, so I’d be willing to part with it if you can show me a Pokémon that can still evolve.
entries.translated:
Quando i Pokémon si evolvono,
diventano più forti. Ma c{B4}è un\lvantaggio nel non far evolvere

subito il tuo Pokémon. I Pokémon
che possono ancora evolversi\lpossono utilizzare una [green]Evolcondensa[blue]

per diventare più difficili da
battere in lotta. Ne ho una in più,\lquindi sarei disposto a cedertela

se mi mostri un Pokémon che può
ancora evolversi.

entries.original:
"Pokémon that can still evolve are
in abundance in the wild."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon that can still evolve are in abundance in the wild.
entries.translated:
In natura abbondano i Pokémon che
possono ancora evolversi.

entries.original:
"Unfortunately, that Pokémon can
evolve no longer.

Even if you were to give it an
Eviolite, it would have no effect."
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately, that Pokémon can evolve no longer. Even if you were to give it an Eviolite, it would have no effect.
entries.translated:
Purtroppo, quel Pokémon non può più
evolversi. Anche se gli dessi un\lEvolcondensa, non avrebbe alcun

effetto.

entries.original:
"There’s no guarantee that whatever
is in that Egg can evolve.

Not to mention the fact that Eggs
can’t hold items."
entries.translation_source: There’s no guarantee that whatever is in that Egg can evolve. Not to mention the fact that Eggs can’t hold items.
entries.translated:
Non c{B4}è alcuna garanzia che
qualunque cosa ci sia in quell{B4}Uovo\lpossa evolversi. Senza contare che

le Uova non possono tenere oggetti.

entries.original:
"You are correct.

Your [buffer1] can indeed still
evolve.

So, as promised\."
entries.translation_source: You are correct. Your [buffer1-1] can indeed still evolve. So, as promised[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Hai ragione. Il tuo [buffer1] può
effettivamente ancora evolversi.\lQuindi, come promesso\.

entries.original:
"Have a Pokémon that can still
evolve hold an [green]Eviolite[blue] in battle\lto increase its defenses."
entries.translation_source: Have a Pokémon that can still evolve hold an [color-green-1]Eviolite[color-blue-2] in battle to increase its defenses.
entries.translated:
Fai tenere a un Pokémon che può
ancora evolversi una [green]Mineralzeta[blue] in\llotta per aumentare le sue difese.

entries.original:
"They say some of the ugliest people
shop at Poké Mart.

I’ve heard there’s even a website
documenting them all."
entries.translation_source: They say some of the ugliest people shop at Poké Mart. I’ve heard there’s even a website documenting them all.
entries.translated:
Si dice che alcune delle persone
più brutte facciano la spesa al\lPoké Mart. Ho sentito che esiste

persino un sito web che le
documenta tutte.

entries.original:
"One of the Sinnoh Gym Leaders likes
to come here on vacation.

She likes battling, so if you find
her, make sure you’re prepared\lfor a tough fight!"
entries.translation_source: One of the Sinnoh Gym Leaders likes to come here on vacation. She likes battling, so if you find her, make sure you’re prepared for a tough fight!
entries.translated:
Una delle Capipalestra di Sinnoh
viene spesso qui in vacanza. Le\lpiace combattere, quindi se la

trovi, assicurati di essere
preparato a una dura lotta!

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of a Pokémon
called [green]Eevee[red]?

It’s a super adorable Pokémon!

I’d love to see an Eevee
some day\."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of a Pokémon called [color-green-1]Eevee[color-red-2]? It’s a super adorable Pokémon! I’d love to see an Eevee some day[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Hai mai sentito parlare di un
Pokémon chiamato [green]Eevee[red]? È un\lPokémon super adorabile! Mi

piacerebbe tantissimo vedere un
Eevee, un giorno\.

entries.original:
"That’s an Eevee!
That’s an Eevee!

You have an Eevee!

So cute!"
entries.translation_source: That’s an Eevee! That’s an Eevee! You have an Eevee! So cute!
entries.translated:
È un Eevee! È un Eevee! Hai un
Eevee! Che carino!

entries.original:
"That’s for showing me an Eevee!

That item can evolve [green]Eevee[red] into
[green]Glaceon[red]!"
entries.translation_source: That’s for showing me an Eevee! That item can evolve [color-green-1]Eevee[color-red-2] into [color-green-3]Glaceon[color-red-4]!
entries.translated:
Grazie per avermi mostrato un
Eevee! Quell{B4}oggetto può evolvere\l[green]Eevee[red] in [green]Glaceon[red]!

entries.original:
"Eevee used to evolve into [green]Glaceon[red]
by touching some rock around here.

But lately it seems all it needs
is an [green]Ice Stone[red]."
entries.translation_source: Eevee used to evolve into [color-green-1]Glaceon[color-red-2] by touching some rock around here. But lately it seems all it needs is an [color-green-3]Ice Stone[color-red-4].
entries.translated:
Eevee una volta si evolveva in
[green]Glaceon[red] toccando una certa roccia\lqui vicino. Ma ultimamente sembra

che gli basti una [green]Pietra Ghiaccio[red].

entries.original:
"Ooh, ooh, Champion!
Can you show me [green][buffer1][red] now?"
entries.translation_source: Ooh, ooh, Champion! Can you show me [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] now?
entries.translated:
Ooh, ooh, Campione! Puoi mostrarmi
[green][buffer1][red] adesso?

entries.original:
"That’s [buffer1]!
That’s [buffer1]!

You have [buffer1]!

So cute!"
entries.translation_source: That’s [buffer1-1]! That’s [buffer1-2]! You have [buffer1-3]! So cute!
entries.translated:
È [buffer1]! È [buffer1]! Hai
[buffer1]! Che carino!

entries.original:
"That [green]Eevium Z[red] is for showing me
all of Eevee’s evolutions!

You can turn [green]Eevee[red]’s [green]Last Resort[red]
into a [green]Z-Move[red] that can boost all of\lits stats if you let Eevee hold it!"
entries.translation_source: That [color-green-1]Eevium Z[color-red-2] is for showing me all of Eevee’s evolutions! You can turn [color-green-3]Eevee[color-red-4]’s [color-green-5]Last Resort[color-red-6] into a [color-green-7]Z-Move[color-red-8] that can boost all of its stats if you let Eevee hold it!
entries.translated:
Quella [green]Eevium Z[red] serve a farmi
vedere tutte le evoluzioni di\lEevee! Puoi trasformare [green]Last Resort[red]

di [green]Eevee[red] in una [green]Mossa Z[red] che può
aumentare tutte le sue statistiche\lse fai tenere l{B4}oggetto a Eevee!

entries.original:
"Ooh aww\.

I wanted to see a [buffer1]\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh aww[game-token-1] I wanted to see a [buffer1-2][game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Oooh, uffa\. Volevo vedere un
[buffer1]\.

entries.original:
"Ooh aww\.

That’s not a [buffer1]\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh aww[game-token-1] That’s not a [buffer1-2][game-token-3]
entries.translated: Oh, che peccato\. Non è un [buffer1]\.

entries.original:
"Ooh aww\.

That’s an Egg\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh aww[game-token-1] That’s an Egg[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oooh aah\. È un Uovo\.

entries.original: "Cave of Being"
entries.translation_source: Cave of Being
entries.translated: Grotta dell{B4}Essere

entries.original:
"A mysterious cave said to have a
connection to the Sinnoh region.
Unfortunately, it has remained
empty for years."
entries.translation_source: A mysterious cave said to have a connection to the Sinnoh region. Unfortunately, it has remained empty for years.
entries.translated:
Una misteriosa grotta di cui si
dice sia collegata alla regione di\lSinnoh. Sfortunatamente, è rimasta

vuota per anni.

entries.original: "Cinder Volcano"
entries.translation_source: Cinder Volcano
entries.translated: Cinder Volcano

entries.original:
"A dangerous active volcano
overlooking Routes 4 and 5.
Legends say a powerful Pokémon
roosts at the summit."
entries.translation_source: A dangerous active volcano overlooking Routes 4 and 5. Legends say a powerful Pokémon roosts at the summit.
entries.translated:
Un pericoloso vulcano attivo che
domina le Route 4 e 5. Le leggende\ldicono che un potente Pokémon

dimora sulla cima.

entries.original: "[green]Gyaoo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Gyaoo!
entries.translated: [green]Gyaoo!

entries.original: "[green]Gwogobo gwobobobo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Gwogobo gwobobobo!
entries.translated: [green]Gwogobo gwobobobo!

entries.original: "[green]Grrgggrrrrah!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Grrgggrrrrah!
entries.translated: [green]Grrgggrrrrah!

entries.original:
"[black]Volcanion filled itself with steam
and increased its size!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Volcanion filled itself with steam and increased its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Volcanion si è riempito di vapore
ed è diventato più grande!

entries.original: "[black]The [buffer1] flew away!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] flew away!
entries.translated: [black]Il [buffer1] è volato via!

entries.original: "[black]The [buffer1] dove into the magma."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] dove into the magma.
entries.translated: [black]Il [buffer1] si è tuffato nel magma.

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] receded into the magma."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] receded into the magma.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] è sprofondato nel magma.

entries.original: "Call out to [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: Call out to [buffer1-1]?
entries.translated: Vuoi chiamare [buffer1]?

entries.original: "Sankren bolganone!"
entries.translation_source: Sankren bolganone!
entries.translated: Sankren bolganone!

entries.original:
"[player]’s Red Orb suddenly
began glowing!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]’s Red Orb suddenly began glowing!
entries.translated:
[player]{B4}s Red Orb ha iniziato a
brillare all{B4}improvviso!

entries.original:
"PRESSURE IS
THE KEY."
entries.translation_source: PRESSURE IS THE KEY.
entries.translated: LA PRESSIONE È LA CHIAVE.

entries.original:
"This tablet\.
What could it be?

I’m sure the answer will reveal
itself someday soon\."
entries.translation_source: This tablet[game-token-1] What could it be? I’m sure the answer will reveal itself someday soon[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Questa tavoletta\. Cosa potrà essere?
Sono sicuro che la risposta si\lrivelerà presto\.

entries.original:
"The tablet!

I was studying it when, all of a
sudden, it collapsed before my\lvery eyes!

What could this mean?
Is it a sign?

Or, perhaps, was this your doing?"
entries.translation_source: The tablet! I was studying it when, all of a sudden, it collapsed before my very eyes! What could this mean? Is it a sign? Or, perhaps, was this your doing?
entries.translated:
La tavoletta! La stavo studiando
quando, all{B4}improvviso, è crollata\lproprio davanti ai miei occhi! Cosa

può significare? È un segno?
Oppure, forse, è stato opera tua?

entries.original:
"[black]It appears to be the remains of
what used to be a Shadow Warrior.

Remove the cloak and lay it
to rest?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]It appears to be the remains of what used to be a Shadow Warrior. Remove the cloak and lay it to rest?
entries.translated:
[black]Sembra essere i resti di quello che
un tempo era un Guerriero Ombra.\lTogliere il mantello e porlo a

riposo?

entries.original:
"[black]The cloak was removed from the
Shadow Warrior."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The cloak was removed from the Shadow Warrior.
entries.translated:
[black]Il mantello è stato rimosso dal
Guerriero Ombra.

entries.original:
"[black]The remains of the Shadow Warrior
fell apart, and its soul was laid\lto rest."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The remains of the Shadow Warrior fell apart, and its soul was laid to rest.
entries.translated:
[black]I resti del Guerriero dell{B4}Ombra si
sono disgregati, e la sua anima è\lstata posta a riposo.

entries.original:
"Be careful while exploring
the volcano.

There’s plenty of exposed magma
everywhere."
entries.translation_source: Be careful while exploring the volcano. There’s plenty of exposed magma everywhere.
entries.translated:
Fai attenzione mentre esplori il
vulcano. C{B4}è magma esposto ovunque.

entries.original:
"There’s no such thing as a
bird-type Pokémon, is there?

No wonder I can’t find the
rare Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: There’s no such thing as a bird-type Pokémon, is there? No wonder I can’t find the rare Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Non esiste una cosa come un Pokémon
di tipo uccello, vero? Non c{B4}è da\lstupirsi che non riesca a trovare i

Pokémon rari!

entries.original:
"When one is this far into the
volcano, one should ask themself:\lshould I continue on, or go home?"
entries.translation_source: When one is this far into the volcano, one should ask themself: should I continue on, or go home?
entries.translated:
Quando si è così in profondità nel
vulcano, bisogna chiedersi:\lcontinuare o tornare a casa?

entries.original:
"One does not simply decide in
an instant."
entries.translation_source: One does not simply decide in an instant.
entries.translated:
Non si può semplicemente decidere
in un istante.

entries.original: "Which way will you choose to go?"
entries.translation_source: Which way will you choose to go?
entries.translated: Quale strada sceglierai?

entries.original:
"This place is so hot.

It’s too easy to start a fire!"
entries.translation_source: This place is so hot. It’s too easy to start a fire!
entries.translated:
Questo posto è così caldo. È troppo
facile appiccare un incendio!

entries.original:
"I came here to train my Pokémon
that have a natural weakness to\lFire-types."
entries.translation_source: I came here to train my Pokémon that have a natural weakness to Fire-types.
entries.translated:
Sono venuto qui per allenare i miei
Pokémon che hanno una debolezza\lnaturale ai tipi Fuoco.

entries.original:
"All these bridges were designed
to withstand the immense heat.

That’s why they’re red, as opposed
to the normal light blue."
entries.translation_source: All these bridges were designed to withstand the immense heat. That’s why they’re red, as opposed to the normal light blue.
entries.translated:
Tutti questi ponti sono stati
progettati per resistere al calore\limmenso. Ecco perché sono rossi,

invece del normale azzurro chiaro.

entries.original:
"I have secluded myself in this cave
to train my mind and body.

Bring your worst!"
entries.translation_source: I have secluded myself in this cave to train my mind and body. Bring your worst!
entries.translated:
Mi sono isolato in questa grotta
per allenare mente e corpo. Fatti\lsotto!

entries.original: "I must not have trained enough."
entries.translation_source: I must not have trained enough.
entries.translated: Non mi sono allenato abbastanza.

entries.original:
"I will continue to train.

Someday, I will become the
ultimate warrior."
entries.translation_source: I will continue to train. Someday, I will become the ultimate warrior.
entries.translated:
Continuerò ad allenarmi. Un giorno,
diventerò il guerriero supremo.

entries.original:
"The lava here is the inspiration
for all my greatest works."
entries.translation_source: The lava here is the inspiration for all my greatest works.
entries.translated:
La lava qui è l{B4}ispirazione di
tutte le mie opere migliori.

entries.original:
"I will unravel the secrets of
Cinder Volcano!"
entries.translation_source: I will unravel the secrets of Cinder Volcano!
entries.translated:
Svelerò i segreti del Vulcano
Cinder!

entries.original:
"I’m going to stay rooted to this
spot for all of eternity."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to stay rooted to this spot for all of eternity.
entries.translated:
Resterò piantato in questo punto
per tutta l{B4}eternità.

entries.original:
"Did you know?

The Slugma in this volcano burn
hotter than the sun!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know? The Slugma in this volcano burn hotter than the sun!
entries.translated:
Lo sapevi? Gli Slugma in questo
vulcano sono più caldi del sole!

entries.original: "Ahhhhh! I’m melting!"
entries.translation_source: Ahhhhh! I’m melting!
entries.translated: Aaaah! Mi sto sciogliendo!

entries.original:
"Who in their right mind would
believe that Slugma and Magcargo\lburn hotter than the sun?

We’d all roast alive if they did!"
entries.translation_source: Who in their right mind would believe that Slugma and Magcargo burn hotter than the sun? We’d all roast alive if they did!
entries.translated:
Chi in pieno possesso delle proprie
facoltà mentali crederebbe che\lSlugma e Magcargo brucino più del

sole? Se fosse vero, saremmo tutti
arrostiti vivi!

entries.original:
"Staring out into the vast ocean of
lava just melts my heart."
entries.translation_source: Staring out into the vast ocean of lava just melts my heart.
entries.translated:
Fissare l{B4}immenso oceano di lava mi
scioglie il cuore.

entries.original:
"Sometimes I like to stare at Gems
like these to become one with the\lmagma.

You are deserving of this Gem."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes I like to stare at Gems like these to become one with the magma. You are deserving of this Gem.
entries.translated:
A volte mi piace fissare Gemme come
queste per diventare tutt{B4}uno con\lil magma. Tu sei degno di questa

Gemma.

entries.original:
"The magma is beautiful, isn’t it?

Sometimes I like to let my
[green]Fire[red]-type Pokémon take me for a\lride on it."
entries.translation_source: The magma is beautiful, isn’t it? Sometimes I like to let my [color-green-1]Fire[color-red-2]-type Pokémon take me for a ride on it.
entries.translated:
Il magma è bellissimo, vero? A
volte mi piace farmi portare a\lspasso sopra di esso da un Pokémon

di tipo [green]Fuoco[red].

entries.original:
"The fact that you are here means
you have acquired at least four\lGym Badges.

But Badges alone are not enough to
prove your worth to me.

I will challenge you to a battle
if, and only if you defeat all\lother Trainers in Cinder Volcano."
entries.translation_source: The fact that you are here means you have acquired at least four Gym Badges. But Badges alone are not enough to prove your worth to me. I will challenge you to a battle if, and only if you defeat all other Trainers in Cinder Volcano.
entries.translated:
Il fatto che tu sia qui significa
che hai ottenuto almeno quattro\lMedaglie della Palestra. Ma le

Medaglie da sole non bastano a
dimostrare il tuo valore per me. Ti\lsfiderò in battaglia solo se

sconfiggerai tutti gli altri
Allenatori nel Vulcano Ceneride.

entries.original:
"The fact that you’re here means
you have acquired at least four\lGym Badges.

Now, show me the strength of a
Trainer with four Badges!"
entries.translation_source: The fact that you’re here means you have acquired at least four Gym Badges. Now, show me the strength of a Trainer with four Badges!
entries.translated:
Il fatto che tu sia qui significa
che hai acquisito almeno quattro\lMedaglie della Palestra. Ora,

dimostrami la forza di un
Allenatore con quattro Medaglie!

entries.original: "Take this."
entries.translation_source: Take this.
entries.translated: Prendi questo.

entries.original:
"That is a gift for defeating me.

Give it to a [green]Camerupt[blue] and it will
be able to Mega Evolve in battle,\lassuming you have a Keystone."
entries.translation_source: That is a gift for defeating me. Give it to a [color-green-1]Camerupt[color-blue-2] and it will be able to Mega Evolve in battle, assuming you have a Keystone.
entries.translated:
È un regalo per avermi sconfitto.
Daglielo a un [green]Camerupt[blue] e potrà\lmegaevolversi in lotta, a patto che

tu abbia una Pietrachiave.

entries.original: "Cootes Bog"
entries.translation_source: Cootes Bog
entries.translated: Palude di Cootes

entries.original: "Hunter of the Swamp"
entries.translation_source: Hunter of the Swamp
entries.translated: Cacciatore della palude

entries.original:
"Help a scientist learn about the
Pokémon living in Cootes Bog! Use
the DexNav to help catch them all."
entries.translation_source: Help a scientist learn about the Pokémon living in Cootes Bog! Use the DexNav to help catch them all.
entries.translated:
Aiuta uno scienziato a conoscere i
Pokémon che vivono nella Palude\lCootes! Usa il DexNav per aiutarlo

a catturarli tutti.

entries.original:
"Hi, Trainer.

Oh! I see you possess a DexNav.
I have just the task for you.

Would you use your DexNav to aid
yourself in the capture of all of\lthe Pokémon that live in this area?

I want to know all about the
Pokémon that live in Cootes Bog."
entries.translation_source: Hi, Trainer. Oh! I see you possess a DexNav. I have just the task for you. Would you use your DexNav to aid yourself in the capture of all of the Pokémon that live in this area? I want to know all about the Pokémon that live in Cootes Bog.
entries.translated:
Ciao, Allenatore. Oh! Vedo che
possiedi un DexNav. Ho proprio il\lcompito che fa per te. Useresti il

tuo DexNav per aiutarti a catturare
tutti i Pokémon che vivono in\lquest{B4}area? Voglio sapere tutto sui

Pokémon che vivono nelle Paludi di
Cootes.

entries.original:
"Hi, Trainer.

If you acquire a DexNav, would you
come back and speak with me?

I have a task only capable of
being completed by a Trainer\lpossessing a DexNav."
entries.translation_source: Hi, Trainer. If you acquire a DexNav, would you come back and speak with me? I have a task only capable of being completed by a Trainer possessing a DexNav.
entries.translated:
Salve, Allenatore. Se ottieni un
DexNav, potresti tornare a\lparlarmi? Ho un incarico che solo

un Allenatore in possesso di un
DexNav può portare a termine.

entries.original:
"Perfect!

Please report back to me when your
DexNav indicates that all of the\lPokémon here have been caught."
entries.translation_source: Perfect! Please report back to me when your DexNav indicates that all of the Pokémon here have been caught.
entries.translated:
Perfetto! Torna a riferirmi quando
il tuo DexNav indica che tutti i\lPokémon qui sono stati catturati.

entries.original:
"It seems you are not as interested
in your DexNav as I am, I suppose."
entries.translation_source: It seems you are not as interested in your DexNav as I am, I suppose.
entries.translated:
Sembra che tu non sia interessato
al tuo DexNav quanto lo sono io,\lsuppongo.

entries.original:
"Your DexNav shows that you’ve
caught all of the Pokémon that\llive in the swamp!

Perfect!
This is my thanks!"
entries.translation_source: Your DexNav shows that you’ve caught all of the Pokémon that live in the swamp! Perfect! This is my thanks!
entries.translated:
Il tuo DexNav indica che hai
catturato tutti i Pokémon che\lvivono nella palude! Perfetto!

Questo è il mio ringraziamento!

entries.original: "And let me modify your DexNav, too!"
entries.translation_source: And let me modify your DexNav, too!
entries.translated:
E lasciami modificare anche il tuo
DexNav!

entries.original:
"[black]The DexNav has been upgraded to
show possible held items!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The DexNav has been upgraded to show possible held items!
entries.translated:
[black]Il DexNav è stato aggiornato per
mostrare i possibili strumenti\ltenuti!

entries.original:
"Your DexNav shows that there are
still some Pokémon here you\lhaven’t caught, yet.

Keep on hunting!"
entries.translation_source: Your DexNav shows that there are still some Pokémon here you haven’t caught, yet. Keep on hunting!
entries.translated:
Il tuo DexNav mostra che ci sono
ancora alcuni Pokémon qui che non\lhai catturato. Continua a cacciare!

entries.original:
"Finding all of the Pokémon that can
be found in the swamp is amazing!"
entries.translation_source: Finding all of the Pokémon that can be found in the swamp is amazing!
entries.translated:
Trovare tutti i Pokémon che si
possono trovare nella palude è\lincredibile!

entries.original:
"This is the path through the bog.

You can take it to get to
Crystal Peak.

If you want to take the bridge
path, go back."
entries.translation_source: This is the path through the bog. You can take it to get to Crystal Peak. If you want to take the bridge path, go back.
entries.translated:
Questa è la via attraverso la
palude. Puoi prenderla per arrivare\la Crystal Peak. Se vuoi prendere il

percorso del ponte, torna indietro.

entries.original:
"This swamp is watched over by one
of Tessy’s Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: This swamp is watched over by one of Tessy’s Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Questo pantano è sorvegliato da uno
dei Pokémon di Tessy.

entries.original:
"It’s a good thing I am not the only
one watching over this swamp."
entries.translation_source: It’s a good thing I am not the only one watching over this swamp.
entries.translated:
Meno male che non sono l{B4}unico a
vegliare su questa palude.

entries.original:
"We Rangers assist the swamp’s
protector by any means necessary."
entries.translation_source: We Rangers assist the swamp’s protector by any means necessary.
entries.translated:
Noi Ranger aiutiamo il protettore
della palude con ogni mezzo\lnecessario.

entries.original:
"This swamp has so many places
to hide, who knows what might\lbe hidden here?"
entries.translation_source: This swamp has so many places to hide, who knows what might be hidden here?
entries.translated:
In questa palude ci sono così tanti
posti dove nascondersi, chissà cosa\lpotrebbe esserci qui?

entries.original:
"This swamp is really a living being
with a powerful spirit."
entries.translation_source: This swamp is really a living being with a powerful spirit.
entries.translated:
Questa palude è in realtà un essere
vivente con uno spirito potente.

entries.original:
"The spirit of the swamp is
with you."
entries.translation_source: The spirit of the swamp is with you.
entries.translated: Lo spirito della palude è con te.

entries.original:
"We must respect the spirit of the
swamp, so don’t litter."
entries.translation_source: We must respect the spirit of the swamp, so don’t litter.
entries.translated:
Dobbiamo rispettare lo spirito
della palude, quindi non lasciare\lrifiuti in giro.

entries.original:
"I hope my method is approved by
PETP: People for the Ethical\lTreatment of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I hope my method is approved by PETP: People for the Ethical Treatment of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Spero che il mio metodo sia
approvato dalla PETP: Persone per\lil Trattamento Etico dei Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A picnic in a swamp?

Yuck!
Who’d want to do that?"
entries.translation_source: A picnic in a swamp? Yuck! Who’d want to do that?
entries.translated:
Un picnic in una palude? Bleah! Chi
vorrebbe mai farlo?

entries.original: "I’m just here to train my Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I’m just here to train my Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Sono qui solo per allenare i miei
Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Swamps: good to play with Pokémon
in, not to eat in."
entries.translation_source: Swamps: good to play with Pokémon in, not to eat in.
entries.translated:
Le paludi: ottime per giocare con i
Pokémon, non per mangiarci.

entries.original:
"More pretty flowers will make
anything pretty, even an icky\lswamp such as this one."
entries.translation_source: More pretty flowers will make anything pretty, even an icky swamp such as this one.
entries.translated:
Più fiori carini renderanno bello
qualsiasi cosa, anche una palude\ldisgustosa come questa.

entries.original:
"Just over yonder is the entrance to
Crystal Peak."
entries.translation_source: Just over yonder is the entrance to Crystal Peak.
entries.translated:
Poco più in là c{B4}è l{B4}ingresso al
Picco di Cristallo.

entries.original:
"Wow!
Go right on ahead to Crystal Peak!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Go right on ahead to Crystal Peak!
entries.translated:
Wow! Vai pure avanti fino a Crystal
Peak!

entries.original:
"Just go up that waterfall, and
you’re at the base of Crystal Peak."
entries.translation_source: Just go up that waterfall, and you’re at the base of Crystal Peak.
entries.translated:
Basta risalire quella cascata e sei
ai piedi di Crystal Peak.

entries.original: "Costume Box"
entries.translation_source: Costume Box
entries.translated: Scatola costumi

entries.original: "\btn0BPick \btn00Choose \btn01Close"
entries.translation_source: [button-icon-1]Pick [button-icon-2]Choose [button-icon-3]Close
entries.translated: \btn0BPrendi \btn00Scegli \btn01Chiudi

entries.original: "This outfit has not been unlocked.[pause]"
entries.translation_source: This outfit has not been unlocked.[text-token-pause-1]
entries.translated:
Questo outfit non è stato sbloccato
ancora.[pause]

entries.original:
"Use \btn0B to choose an outfit colour.
Confirm with \btn00. Cancel with \btn01."
entries.translation_source: Use [button-icon-1] to choose an outfit colour. Confirm with [button-icon-2]. Cancel with [button-icon-3].
entries.translated:
Usa \btn0B per scegliere il colore
dell{B4}outfit. Conferma con \btn00.\lAnnulla con \btn01.

entries.original:
"Use \btn0B to choose a trim colour.
Confirm with \btn00. Cancel with \btn01."
entries.translation_source: Use [button-icon-1] to choose a trim colour. Confirm with [button-icon-2]. Cancel with [button-icon-3].
entries.translated:
Usa \btn0B per scegliere il colore della
rifinitura. Conferma con \btn00. Annulla\lcon \btn01.

entries.original: "Locked"
entries.translation_source: Locked
entries.translated: Bloccato

entries.original: "Next Version"
entries.translation_source: Next Version
entries.translated: Prossima versione

entries.original: "Ethan"
entries.translation_source: Ethan
entries.translated: Ethan

entries.original: "Lyra"
entries.translation_source: Lyra
entries.translated: Lyra

entries.original: "Crater Town"
entries.translation_source: Crater Town
entries.translated: Crater Town

entries.original: "Crater Town D"
entries.translation_source: Crater Town D
entries.translated: Crater Town D

entries.original: "Crater Town N"
entries.translation_source: Crater Town N
entries.translated: Crater Town N

entries.original:
"Have you ever used the
KBT Expressway?

It’s an underground highway that
goes around most of West Borrius!

The acronym \qoKBT\qc is short for
King Borrius the Third.

He was the king of Borrius that
created the concept of a region-\lwide highway."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever used the KBT Expressway? It’s an underground highway that goes around most of West Borrius! The acronym [quote-open-1]KBT[quote-close-2] is short for King Borrius the Third. He was the king of Borrius that created the concept of a region- wide highway.
entries.translated:
Hai mai usato la KBT Expressway? È
un{B4}autostrada sotterranea che gira\lattorno a gran parte di West

Borrius! L{B4}acronimo \qoKBT\qc sta per
Re Borrius III. Era il re di\lBorrius che ideò il concetto di

un{B4}autostrada che attraversa
l{B4}intera regione.

entries.original:
"The meteorites in Crater Town
are imbued with some sort of\lcosmic power.

They say that if a certain Pokémon
comes in contact with one, strange\lthings will happen."
entries.translation_source: The meteorites in Crater Town are imbued with some sort of cosmic power. They say that if a certain Pokémon comes in contact with one, strange things will happen.
entries.translated:
I meteoriti di Crater Town sono
impregnati di una sorta di potere\lcosmico. Si dice che se un certo

Pokémon entra in contatto con uno
di essi, accadranno cose strane.

entries.original:
"This cave takes you out of town
to Route 6.

From there, it’s a straight shot
through Route 7, up Frost Mountain,\land up Route 8 to [green]Blizzard City[blue].

If you’re going to hike all the way
up there, make sure you have many\lPoké Balls for catching Pokémon.

Most people don’t go that way,
though, since they don’t have the\l[green]Vision Badge[blue].

Without it, they can’t cut down
that [green]Skinny Tree[blue] in front of the\lentrance."
entries.translation_source: This cave takes you out of town to Route 6. From there, it’s a straight shot through Route 7, up Frost Mountain, and up Route 8 to [color-green-1]Blizzard City[color-blue-2]. If you’re going to hike all the way up there, make sure you have many Poké Balls for catching Pokémon. Most people don’t go that way, though, since they don’t have the [color-green-3]Vision Badge[color-blue-4]. Without it, they can’t cut down that [color-green-5]Skinny Tree[color-blue-6] in front of the entrance.
entries.translated:
Questa grotta ti porta fuori città
al Percorso 6. Da lì, è una via\ldiretta attraverso il Percorso 7,

su per il Monte Gelo, e su per il
Percorso 8 fino a [green]Blizzard City[blue]. Se\lhai intenzione di fare

un{B4}escursione fino lassù,
assicurati di avere molte Poké Ball\lper catturare Pokémon. La maggior

parte delle persone non va da
quella parte, però, dato che non\lhanno la [green]Medaglia Visione[blue]. Senza di

essa, non possono abbattere
quell{B4}[green]Albero Magro[blue] davanti\lall{B4}entrata.

entries.original:
"That cave down there takes you out
of town to Route 6.

From there, it’s a straight shot
through Route 7, up Frost Mountain,\land up Route 8 to [green]Blizzard City[blue].

If you’re going to hike all the way
up there, make sure you have many\lPoké Balls for catching Pokémon.

Now that the Skinny Tree blocking
it has been cut down, it is much\lmore frequently used."
entries.translation_source: That cave down there takes you out of town to Route 6. From there, it’s a straight shot through Route 7, up Frost Mountain, and up Route 8 to [color-green-1]Blizzard City[color-blue-2]. If you’re going to hike all the way up there, make sure you have many Poké Balls for catching Pokémon. Now that the Skinny Tree blocking it has been cut down, it is much more frequently used.
entries.translated:
Quella caverna laggiù ti porta
fuori città, verso il Percorso 6.\lDa lì, è una tirata dritta

attraverso il Percorso 7, su per il
Monte Frost e su per il Percorso 8\lfino a [green]Blizzard City[blue]. Se devi fare

tutta quella salita, assicurati di
avere molte Poké Ball per catturare\li Pokémon. Ora che lo Skinny Tree

che lo bloccava è stato abbattuto,
viene usato molto più spesso.

entries.original:
"I heard there’s someone in
[green]Tarmigan Town[red] who teaches\lthe art of [green]Mega Evolution[red]!"
entries.translation_source: I heard there’s someone in [color-green-1]Tarmigan Town[color-red-2] who teaches the art of [color-green-3]Mega Evolution[color-red-4]!
entries.translated:
Ho sentito che a [green]Tarmigan Town[red] c{B4}è
qualcuno che insegna l{B4}arte della\l[green]Mega Evoluzione[red]!

entries.original:
"I heard there’s someone in
[green]Tarmigan Town[red] who teaches\lthe art of [green]Mega Evolution[red]!

But you already knew that,
didn’t you?

That [buffer1] you’re wearing
gave it away."
entries.translation_source: I heard there’s someone in [color-green-1]Tarmigan Town[color-red-2] who teaches the art of [color-green-3]Mega Evolution[color-red-4]! But you already knew that, didn’t you? That [buffer1-5] you’re wearing gave it away.
entries.translated:
Ho sentito che c{B4}è qualcuno a
[green]Tarmigan Town[red] che insegna l{B4}arte\ldella [green]Megaevoluzione[red]! Ma lo sapevi

già, vero? Quel [buffer1] che
indossi te l{B4}ha fatto capire.

entries.original:
"Didja know that if you talk to the
Gym referees before beating the\lGym Leader, they’ll give you a\lfree gift?

Didja? Didja?"
entries.translation_source: Didja know that if you talk to the Gym referees before beating the Gym Leader, they’ll give you a free gift? Didja? Didja?
entries.translated:
Lo sapevi che se parli con gli
arbitri della Palestra prima di\lbattere il Capopalestra, ti daranno

un regalo gratis? Lo sapevi? Lo
sapevi?

entries.original:
"Well, then, didja know that if you
talk to the Gym referees after\lbeating the Gym Leader, they’ll\lgive you a gift then, too?

Didja? Didja?"
entries.translation_source: Well, then, didja know that if you talk to the Gym referees after beating the Gym Leader, they’ll give you a gift then, too? Didja? Didja?
entries.translated:
Be{B4}, allora, lo sapevi che se parli
con gli arbitri della Palestra dopo\laver battuto il Capopalestra, ti

danno anche un regalo? Lo sapevi?
Lo sapevi?

entries.original: "You learn something new every day!"
entries.translation_source: You learn something new every day!
entries.translated:
Ogni giorno si impara qualcosa di
nuovo!

entries.original: "Oh, look at you, smarty pants."
entries.translation_source: Oh, look at you, smarty pants.
entries.translated: Oh, guarda un po{B4}, sapientino.

entries.original:
"Mutter\. Mutter\.

\.wait for signal\.

Whisper\. Whisper\.

\.asset on lookout\.

Mutter\. Mutter\."
entries.translation_source: Mutter[game-token-1] Mutter[game-token-2] [game-token-3]wait for signal[game-token-4] Whisper[game-token-5] Whisper[game-token-6] [game-token-7]asset on lookout[game-token-8] Mutter[game-token-9] Mutter[game-token-10]
entries.translated:
Mormora\. Mormora\. \.aspetta il segnale\.
Sussurra\. Sussurra\. \.agente di vedetta\.\lMormora\. Mormora\.

entries.original: "Major Miner"
entries.translation_source: Major Miner
entries.translated: Minatore capo

entries.original:
"Use the ADM to dig through the
collapsed doorways in the KBT
Expressway, and capture [buffer1] Carbink."
entries.translation_source: Use the ADM to dig through the collapsed doorways in the KBT Expressway, and capture [buffer1-1] Carbink.
entries.translated:
Usa l{B4}ADM per scavare attraverso
gli ingressi crollati nel KBT\lExpressway e catturare [buffer1]

Carbink.

entries.original:
"There are rumours of rare Pokémon
known as [green]Carbink[blue] appearing in\lthe KBT Expressway.

However, the rumours indicate
that they can only be found\lbehind the collapsed doorways\lthat litter the tunnel.

If only there were some way to
[green]mine[blue] through the rubble\."
entries.translation_source: There are rumours of rare Pokémon known as [color-green-1]Carbink[color-blue-2] appearing in the KBT Expressway. However, the rumours indicate that they can only be found behind the collapsed doorways that litter the tunnel. If only there were some way to [color-green-3]mine[color-blue-4] through the rubble[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Si vocifera che rari Pokémon noti
come [green]Carbink[blue] appaiano sulla KBT\lExpressway. Tuttavia, le voci

dicono che si possano trovare solo
dietro i varchi crollati che\lcostellano il tunnel. Se solo ci

fosse un modo per [green]scavare[blue] tra le
macerie\.

entries.original:
"That ADM you own, it’s just the
machine I’m searching for!

I’m looking for a way to destroy
the collapsed doorways that litter\lthe KBT Expressway, and you can\lprovide me just the method!

Please, use your [green]ADM[blue] and assist
me in my task!"
entries.translation_source: That ADM you own, it’s just the machine I’m searching for! I’m looking for a way to destroy the collapsed doorways that litter the KBT Expressway, and you can provide me just the method! Please, use your [color-green-1]ADM[color-blue-2] and assist me in my task!
entries.translated:
Quell{B4}ADM che possiedi è proprio la
macchina che sto cercando! Sto\lcercando un modo per distruggere i

passaggi crollati che costellano la
KBT Expressway, e tu puoi fornirmi\lproprio il metodo! Per favore, usa

il tuo [green]ADM[blue] e aiutami nella mia
missione!

entries.original:
"Splendid!

My task involves the following:
destroy the [green]collapsed doorways[blue]\lthat litter the [green]KBT Expressway[blue]\lusing your [green]ADM[blue] and capture\l[green]3 Carbink[blue], starting now.

In order to break down a doorway,
you’ll need to charge your ADM\lfirst.

If you charge up your ADM with [green]3
Light Clay[blue], it will be powerful\lenough to destroy the rubble!

Where do you find Light Clay?

It has a decent chance of appearing
when you mine in the walls of the\lKBT Expressway.

Once you have done that, please
return to me for a reward."
entries.translation_source: Splendid! My task involves the following: destroy the [color-green-1]collapsed doorways[color-blue-2] that litter the [color-green-3]KBT Expressway[color-blue-4] using your [color-green-5]ADM[color-blue-6] and capture [color-green-7]3 Carbink[color-blue-8], starting now. In order to break down a doorway, you’ll need to charge your ADM first. If you charge up your ADM with [color-green-9]3 Light Clay[color-blue-10], it will be powerful enough to destroy the rubble! Where do you find Light Clay? It has a decent chance of appearing when you mine in the walls of the KBT Expressway. Once you have done that, please return to me for a reward.
entries.translated:
Splendido! Il mio compito è il
seguente: distruggi le [green]porte\lcrollate[blue] che ingombrano la [green]KBT

Expressway[blue] usando il tuo [green]ADM[blue] e
cattura [green]3 Carbink[blue], a partire da\lora. Per abbattere una porta,

dovrai prima caricare il tuo ADM.
Se carichi il tuo ADM con [green]3\lCrecaluce[blue], sarà abbastanza potente

da distruggere le macerie! Dove
trovi la Crecaluce? Ha una discreta\lprobabilità di apparire quando mini

nelle pareti della KBT Expressway.
Una volta fatto ciò, per favore\ltorna da me per una ricompensa.

entries.original:
"Not very splendid.

You are the only Trainer I am aware
of that has purchased an ADM.

Without you, my purpose here
is meaningless."
entries.translation_source: Not very splendid. You are the only Trainer I am aware of that has purchased an ADM. Without you, my purpose here is meaningless.
entries.translated:
Niente di così splendido. Sei
l{B4}unico Allenatore di cui io sia a\lconoscenza ad aver acquistato un

ADM. Senza di te, il mio scopo qui
non ha alcun senso.

entries.original:
"Destroy the [green]collapsed doorways[blue]
that litter the [green]KBT Expressway[blue]\lusing your [green]ADM[blue] and capture\lat least [green][buffer1] more Carbink[blue].

In order to break down a doorway,
you’ll need to charge your ADM\lfirst.

If you charge up your ADM with [green]3
Light Clay[blue], it will be powerful\lenough to destroy the rubble!

Where do you find Light Clay?

It has a decent chance of appearing
when you mine in the walls of the\lKBT Expressway.

Once you have done that, please
return to me for a reward."
entries.translation_source: Destroy the [color-green-1]collapsed doorways[color-blue-2] that litter the [color-green-3]KBT Expressway[color-blue-4] using your [color-green-5]ADM[color-blue-6] and capture at least [color-green-7][buffer1-8] more Carbink[color-blue-9]. In order to break down a doorway, you’ll need to charge your ADM first. If you charge up your ADM with [color-green-10]3 Light Clay[color-blue-11], it will be powerful enough to destroy the rubble! Where do you find Light Clay? It has a decent chance of appearing when you mine in the walls of the KBT Expressway. Once you have done that, please return to me for a reward.
entries.translated:
Distruggi le [green]porte crollate[blue] che
ingombrano la [green]KBT Expressway[blue] usando\lil tuo [green]ADM[blue] e cattura almeno

[green][buffer1] più Carbink[blue]. Per abbattere
una porta, dovrai prima caricare il\ltuo ADM. Se carichi il tuo ADM con

[green]3 Argilla Leggera[blue], sarà abbastanza
potente per distruggere le macerie!\lDove si trova l{B4}Argilla Leggera? Ha

una discreta possibilità di
apparire quando estrai nelle pareti\ldella KBT Expressway. Una volta

fatto ciò, per favore torna da me
per una ricompensa.

entries.original:
"You and your ADM have done
wonderful work!

Please, accept this, a rare
Mega Stone!"

entries.original:
"Twenty years ago, a large meteorite
was hurtling towards Borrius.

The astronomers at Cube Corp.
predicted that if it wasn’t\lstopped, it would fall directly on\lValley City, this city, and end all\llife living here.

With great haste, we began our
evacuation of the city.

As we were about to make our escape
through the KBT Expressway, we\lheard the news.

The meteorite was now predicted to
crush half of the region!

If we attempted to flee
underground, there would be a\llarge chance we’d be buried alive.

Chaos ensued.

All was thought hopeless\. until
HE arrived.

[green]Aros[blue], the legend.

He arrived alongside a small Pokémon
he used to teleport everyone to\lEast Borrius, safe from harm.

He planned to attack the meteorite
head on and smash it to bits.

Once he had transported everyone to
safety, it is said that he rode on\la Rayquaza and smashed into\lthe meteorite!

It shattered, and most of the
smaller fragments fell on\lValley City.

The city was destroyed, but Aros
had saved a region.

I will never forget the heroic act
that man performed."
entries.translation_source: Twenty years ago, a large meteorite was hurtling towards Borrius. The astronomers at Cube Corp. predicted that if it wasn’t stopped, it would fall directly on Valley City, this city, and end all life living here. With great haste, we began our evacuation of the city. As we were about to make our escape through the KBT Expressway, we heard the news. The meteorite was now predicted to crush half of the region! If we attempted to flee underground, there would be a large chance we’d be buried alive. Chaos ensued. All was thought hopeless[game-token-1] until HE arrived. [color-green-2]Aros[color-blue-3], the legend. He arrived alongside a small Pokémon he used to teleport everyone to East Borrius, safe from harm. He planned to attack the meteorite head on and smash it to bits. Once he had transported everyone to safety, it is said that he rode on a Rayquaza and smashed into the meteorite! It shattered, and most of the smaller fragments fell on Valley City. The city was destroyed, but Aros had saved a region. I will never forget the heroic act that man performed.
entries.translated:
Venti anni fa, un grande meteorite
stava precipitando verso Borrius.\lGli astronomi della Cube Corp.

predissero che se non fosse stato
fermato, sarebbe caduto\ldirettamente su Valley City, questa

città, e avrebbe posto fine a tutta
la vita qui presente. Con grande\lfretta, iniziammo l{B4}evacuazione

della città. Mentre stavamo per
fuggire attraverso la KBT\lExpressway, sentimmo la notizia. Si

prevedeva ora che il meteorite
avrebbe schiacciato metà della\lregione! Se avessimo tentato di

fuggire sottoterra, ci sarebbe
stata un{B4}alta probabilità di essere\lsepolti vivi. Seguì il caos. Tutto

era considerato senza speranza\. fino
a quando LUI arrivò. [green]Aros[blue], la\lleggenda. Arrivò insieme a un

piccolo Pokémon che usava per
teletrasportare tutti a East\lBorrius, al sicuro. Pianificò di

attaccare il meteorite frontalmente
e di distruggerlo in pezzi. Una\lvolta che ebbe trasportato tutti in

salvo, si dice che cavalcò un
Rayquaza e si schiantò contro il\lmeteorite! Si frantumò, e la

maggior parte dei frammenti più
piccoli cadde su Valley City. La\lcittà fu distrutta, ma Aros aveva

salvato una regione. Non
dimenticherò mai l{B4}atto eroico\lcompiuto da quell{B4}uomo.

entries.original:
"Following the meteorite strike all
those years ago, two Pokémon were\ldiscovered to have landed on Earth.

One of them was a very powerful
Pokémon capable of granting any\lwish the heart desired.

At first, the townspeople and I
thought this was wonderful!

We could use it to restore our
broken city!

However, we soon learned that all
our wishes came at a cost.

Fearing an even more devastating
outcome, we locked up this Pokémon.

But now that the [buffer2] of Aros
has become Champion, I feel that it\lis fitting we bestow this Pokémon\lunto you.

Would you care to give this
Pokémon a loving home?"
entries.translation_source: Following the meteorite strike all those years ago, two Pokémon were discovered to have landed on Earth. One of them was a very powerful Pokémon capable of granting any wish the heart desired. At first, the townspeople and I thought this was wonderful! We could use it to restore our broken city! However, we soon learned that all our wishes came at a cost. Fearing an even more devastating outcome, we locked up this Pokémon. But now that the [buffer2-1] of Aros has become Champion, I feel that it is fitting we bestow this Pokémon unto you. Would you care to give this Pokémon a loving home?
entries.translated:
Dopo l{B4}impatto del meteorite tutti
quegli anni fa, si scoprì che due\lPokémon erano atterrati sulla

Terra. Uno di loro era un Pokémon
molto potente, in grado di esaudire\lqualsiasi desiderio del cuore.

All{B4}inizio, io e gli abitanti della
città pensammo che fosse\lmeraviglioso! Potevamo usarlo per

riparare la nostra città distrutta!
Tuttavia, imparammo presto che\ltutti i nostri desideri avevano un

prezzo. Temendo un esito ancora più
devastante, rinchiudemmo questo\lPokémon. Ma ora che il [buffer2] di

Aros è diventato Campione, sento
che sia giusto affidare questo\lPokémon a te. Vorresti dargli una

casa amorevole?

Market.
