Scomparsi sono ormai tutti i
cristalli blu, sì, sì. Credo che\laltri totem facciano cose simili,

sì, sì.

entries.original:
"If up go the crystals in the
totems, disappear other crystals\ldo, yes, yes!

If down go the crystals, come back
the other crystals, do, yes, yes."
entries.translation_source: If up go the crystals in the totems, disappear other crystals do, yes, yes! If down go the crystals, come back the other crystals, do, yes, yes.
entries.translated:
Se i cristalli nei totem salgono,
gli altri cristalli spariscono, sì\lsì! Se i cristalli scendono, gli

altri cristalli tornano, sì sì.

entries.original: "Learn you will not, no, no."
entries.translation_source: Learn you will not, no, no.
entries.translated: Non imparerai, no, no.

entries.original:
"It’s a strange totem with a hole
in the centre.

What could it be for?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a strange totem with a hole in the centre. What could it be for?
entries.translated:
È un totem strano con un foro al
centro. A cosa potrà servire?

entries.original: "Slide the crystal upwards?"
entries.translation_source: Slide the crystal upwards?
entries.translated: Spostare il cristallo verso l{B4}alto?

entries.original: "Slide the crystal downwards?"
entries.translation_source: Slide the crystal downwards?
entries.translated:
Spostare il cristallo verso il
basso?

entries.original:
"These crystals are just full of
wonders.

Dig in a little, and you’ll find
loads of Gems!

How about I share one with you?"
entries.translation_source: These crystals are just full of wonders. Dig in a little, and you’ll find loads of Gems! How about I share one with you?
entries.translated:
Questi cristalli sono pieni di
meraviglie. Scava un po{B4}, e\ltroverai un sacco di Gemme! Che ne

dici se te ne do una?

entries.original:
"I dig for Gems in this room with my
ADM every single day.

If you have an ADM, you should dig
in here, too!

It’s the one place in Crystal Peak
that you can!"
entries.translation_source: I dig for Gems in this room with my ADM every single day. If you have an ADM, you should dig in here, too! It’s the one place in Crystal Peak that you can!
entries.translated:
Scavo Gemme in questa stanza con il
mio ADM ogni singolo giorno. Se hai\lun ADM, dovresti scavare anche qui!

È l{B4}unico posto a Crystal Peak in
cui puoi farlo!

entries.original: "One Purple Balloon"
entries.translation_source: One Purple Balloon
entries.translated: Un palloncino viola

entries.original:
"A little girl has been snatched up
by a Drifloon! Find her, and return
her safely to her worried mother."
entries.translation_source: A little girl has been snatched up by a Drifloon! Find her, and return her safely to her worried mother.
entries.translated:
Una bambina è stata rapita da un
Drifloon! Trovala e riportala sana\le salva da sua madre preoccupata.

entries.original:
"[red]Oh heavens\.

My daughter, I can’t find her!

We were on holiday in this place
when all of a sudden, an evil\lPokémon carried her away!

I followed it out here, but I’ve
lost sight of it\.

Please, [buffer1], search for her!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Oh heavens[game-token-2] My daughter, I can’t find her! We were on holiday in this place when all of a sudden, an evil Pokémon carried her away! I followed it out here, but I’ve lost sight of it[game-token-3] Please, [buffer1-4], search for her!
entries.translated:
[red]Oh cielo\. Mia figlia, non riesco a
trovarla! Eravamo in vacanza in\lquesto posto quando,

all{B4}improvviso, un Pokémon malvagio
l{B4}ha portata via! L{B4}ho seguito fin\lqui, ma l{B4}ho perso di vista\. Per

favore, [buffer1], cercala!

entries.original:
"[red]Thank you, [buffer1]!

She was taken by one of those evil
Pokémon\. [green]Drifloon[red]!

If you find the Drifloon, you will
find my daughter!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Thank you, [buffer1-2]! She was taken by one of those evil Pokémon[game-token-3] [color-green-4]Drifloon[color-red-5]! If you find the Drifloon, you will find my daughter!
entries.translated:
[red]Grazie, [buffer1]! È stata portata
via da uno di quei Pokémon malvagi\.\l[green]Drifloon[red]! Se trovi il Drifloon,

troverai mia figlia!

entries.original:
"[red]Oh, dear\.

What will I do now\.?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Oh, dear[game-token-2] What will I do now[game-token-3]?
entries.translated: [red]Oh, cielo\. Che farò adesso\.?

entries.original:
"[red]Sniff\.

This scary balloon carried me
out here!

I wanna go home, but I’m too scared
to leave while it’s watching me\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Sniff[game-token-2] This scary balloon carried me out here! I wanna go home, but I’m too scared to leave while it’s watching me[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[red]Sniff\. Quel palloncino spaventoso mi
ha portato fin qui! Voglio tornare\la casa, ma ho troppa paura di

andarmene mentre mi sta guardando\.

entries.original:
"[red]The scary balloon carried me back
to my mommy!

But I know when we turn around it
will grab me again!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]The scary balloon carried me back to my mommy! But I know when we turn around it will grab me again!
entries.translated:
[red]Il palloncino spaventoso mi ha
riportato da mia mamma! Ma so che\lquando ci gireremo mi afferrerà di

nuovo!

entries.original: "[green]Floooooon!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Floooooon!
entries.translated: [green]Floooooon!

entries.original:
"[black]The little girl was carried off
by the Drifloon."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The little girl was carried off by the Drifloon.
entries.translated:
[black]La bambina è stata portata via da
Drifloon.

entries.original:
"[red]Oh, thank heavens you’re back!

This\. this\. evil Pokémon won’t
leave my daughter alone!

No matter what I do, it just
won’t\.\CC0820 go\.\CC0820 away\.\CC0820 urk\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Oh, thank heavens you’re back! This[game-token-2] this[game-token-3] evil Pokémon won’t leave my daughter alone! No matter what I do, it just won’t[game-token-4][control-code-5] go[game-token-6][control-code-7] away[game-token-8][control-code-9] urk[game-token-10]
entries.translated:
[red]Oh, grazie al cielo sei tornato!
Questo\. questo\. Pokémon malvagio non\llascia in pace mia figlia!

Qualunque cosa faccia, proprio non
vuole\.\CC0820 andare\.\CC0820 via\.\CC0820 urk\.

entries.original:
"[black]The Ditto was carried off
by the Drifloon.

Oh?

It looks like the Ditto dropped
something before it disappeared."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Ditto was carried off by the Drifloon. Oh? It looks like the Ditto dropped something before it disappeared.
entries.translated:
[black]Il Ditto è stato portato via dal
Drifloon. Oh? Sembra che Ditto\labbia lasciato cadere qualcosa

prima di scomparire.

entries.original: "Blazing Emeralds"
entries.translation_source: Blazing Emeralds
entries.translated: Smeraldi fiammeggianti

entries.original:
"Search far and wide for hot
emeralds hidden beneath crystals."
entries.translation_source: Search far and wide for hot emeralds hidden beneath crystals.
entries.translated:
Cerca in lungo e in largo gli
smeraldi ardenti nascosti sotto i\lcristalli.

entries.original:
"Heeyo!

I gots deez emeralds on fiya!

Deya so hot I had ta bury ’em in
the ground!

But den, oh, no!

Crystals covered dem!

Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

Find my hot, hot, emeralds for me,
pretty please?"
entries.translation_source: Heeyo! I gots deez emeralds on fiya! Deya so hot I had ta bury ’em in the ground! But den, oh, no! Crystals covered dem! Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh! Find my hot, hot, emeralds for me, pretty please?
entries.translated:
Ehi! Ho questi smeraldi in fiamme!
Sono così caldi che ho dovuto\lseppellirli nel terreno! Ma poi, oh

no! Li hanno ricoperti di
cristalli! Aaaaaaaahhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!\lTrova per me i miei smeraldi

bollenti, per favore?

entries.original:
"Heeyo!

My emeralds were all on fiya!

Now dem no longer on fiya, but
crystals everywhere!

Hide the crystals and find dem [green][buffer1]
emeralds[blue], pretty please!"
entries.translation_source: Heeyo! My emeralds were all on fiya! Now dem no longer on fiya, but crystals everywhere! Hide the crystals and find dem [color-green-1][buffer1-2] emeralds[color-blue-3], pretty please!
entries.translated:
Ehi! I miei smeraldi erano tutti in
fiamme! Ora non sono più in fiamme,\lma ci sono cristalli dappertutto!

Nascondi i cristalli e trova i miei
[green][buffer1] smeraldi[blue], per favore!

entries.original:
"Heeyo!

It’s da muffin man!

Gimme my emeralds!

Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!"
entries.translation_source: Heeyo! It’s da muffin man! Gimme my emeralds! Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!
entries.translated:
Ehi! È l{B4}uomo dei muffin! Datemi i
miei smeraldi! Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over [buffer1] emeralds
to the strange guy."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over [buffer1-3] emeralds to the strange guy.
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha consegnato [buffer1]
smeraldi allo strano tipo.

entries.original:
"Heeya!

My emeralds!

Deya no longer on fiya!

Woo! Woo! Woo!

Okee dookee, here you go."
entries.translation_source: Heeya! My emeralds! Deya no longer on fiya! Woo! Woo! Woo! Okee dookee, here you go.
entries.translated:
Ehi! I miei smeraldi! Deya non è
più in fiamme! Woo! Woo! Woo!\lOkidoki, eccoti qua.

entries.original:
"Heeyo!

Dem emeralds you don’t got all!

You only gotta [green][buffer2][blue] emerald\\07!

Dem rest are still on fiya!

Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

Bring me all [green][buffer1][blue] of dem emeralds!"
entries.translation_source: Heeyo! Dem emeralds you don’t got all! You only gotta [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] emerald[raw-escape-4]! Dem rest are still on fiya! Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh! Bring me all [color-green-5][buffer1-6][color-blue-7] of dem emeralds!
entries.translated:
Ehi! Quegli smeraldi non li hai
mica tutti! Ti mancano solo\l[green][buffer2][blue] smeraldi\\07! Gli altri sono

ancora in fiamme!
Aaaaaaaahhhhhhhhhhhhhhh! Portami\ltutti i [green][buffer1][blue] smeraldi!

entries.original: "Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!"
entries.translation_source: Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!
entries.translated: Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

entries.original:
"Watch me! Watch me!

My emeralds are on fiya!

Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!

So hot!"
entries.translation_source: Watch me! Watch me! My emeralds are on fiya! Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh! So hot!
entries.translated:
Guardami! Guardami! I miei smeraldi
sono in fiamme!\lAaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah! Che caldo!

entries.original:
"The emerald was absorbed by
the Cube!"
entries.translation_source: The emerald was absorbed by the Cube!
entries.translated:
Lo smeraldo è stato assorbito dal
Cube!

entries.original: "Emeralds Remaining: [green][buffer1][black]"
entries.translation_source: Emeralds Remaining: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3]
entries.translated: Smeraldi rimanenti: [green][buffer1][black]

entries.original: "B1F"
entries.translation_source: B1F
entries.translated: Piano interrato 1

entries.translation_source: 1F
entries.translated: 1F

entries.translation_source: 2F
entries.translated: 2º piano

entries.original:
"This emerald was found on B1F
beneath a blue crystal."
entries.translation_source: This emerald was found on B1F beneath a blue crystal.
entries.translated:
Questo smeraldo è stato trovato al
B1F sotto un cristallo blu.

entries.original:
"This emerald was found in the
large room on 1F beneath a
red crystal."
entries.translation_source: This emerald was found in the large room on 1F beneath a red crystal.
entries.translated:
Questo smeraldo è stato trovato
nella grande sala al 1F sotto un\lcristallo rosso.

entries.original:
"This emerald was found in the
large room on 1F beneath a
yellow crystal."
entries.translation_source: This emerald was found in the large room on 1F beneath a yellow crystal.
entries.translated:
Questo smeraldo è stato trovato
nella grande stanza al 1F sotto un\lcristallo giallo.

entries.original:
"This emerald was found in the
large room on 1F beneath a
blue crystal."
entries.translation_source: This emerald was found in the large room on 1F beneath a blue crystal.
entries.translated:
Questo smeraldo è stato trovato
nella grande sala al 1F sotto un\lcristallo blu.

entries.original:
"This emerald was found in the left
room on 1F beneath a blue crystal."
entries.translation_source: This emerald was found in the left room on 1F beneath a blue crystal.
entries.translated:
Questo smeraldo è stato trovato
nella stanza a sinistra al 1F sotto\lun cristallo blu.

entries.original:
"This emerald was found in the
small room on B1F beneath a
yellow crystal."
entries.translation_source: This emerald was found in the small room on B1F beneath a yellow crystal.
entries.translated:
Questo smeraldo è stato trovato
nella piccola stanza al B1F sotto\lun cristallo giallo.

entries.original:
"This emerald was found in the right
room on 1F beneath a blue crystal."
entries.translation_source: This emerald was found in the right room on 1F beneath a blue crystal.
entries.translated:
Questo smeraldo è stato trovato
nella stanza a destra al 1F sotto\lun cristallo blu.

entries.original:
"This emerald was found in the right
room on 1F beneath a red crystal."
entries.translation_source: This emerald was found in the right room on 1F beneath a red crystal.
entries.translated:
Questo smeraldo è stato trovato
nella stanza a destra al 1F sotto\lun cristallo rosso.

entries.original:
"This emerald was found in the room
at the top of the cliffside beneath
a red crystal."
entries.translation_source: This emerald was found in the room at the top of the cliffside beneath a red crystal.
entries.translated:
Questo smeraldo è stato trovato
nella stanza in cima alla\lscogliera, sotto un cristallo

rosso.

entries.original:
"[player]’s Jade Orb suddenly
began glowing!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]’s Jade Orb suddenly began glowing!
entries.translated:
[player]La Sfera di Giada di
[player] ha improvvisamente\liniziato a brillare!

entries.original: "[green]Kiyuryursheeah!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Kiyuryursheeah!
entries.translated: [green]Kiyuryursheeah!

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] flew away!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] flew away!
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] è volato via!

entries.original:
"That giant crystal at the summit is
definitely not the Ultimate Weapon\lin disguise.

No siree!"
entries.translation_source: That giant crystal at the summit is definitely not the Ultimate Weapon in disguise. No siree!
entries.translated:
Quel cristallo gigante in cima non
è assolutamente l{B4}Arma Suprema\lsotto mentite spoglie. Nossignore!

entries.original:
"[red]The Ultimate Weapon?

Never heard of it!

We’re just here to make friends
with the wild Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]The Ultimate Weapon? Never heard of it! We’re just here to make friends with the wild Pokémon!
entries.translated:
[red]L{B4}Arma Suprema? Non ne ho mai
sentito parlare! Siamo qui solo per\lfare amicizia con i Pokémon

selvatici!

entries.original: "Will you be our friend, too?"
entries.translation_source: Will you be our friend, too?
entries.translated: Vuoi essere nostro amico anche tu?

entries.original:
"[red]Okay, fine, I give.

We couldn’t care less about the
Pokémon living here.

It’s not like they’re going to be
around much longer anyway."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Okay, fine, I give. We couldn’t care less about the Pokémon living here. It’s not like they’re going to be around much longer anyway.
entries.translated:
[red]Va bene, va bene, mi arrendo. Dei
Pokémon che vivono qui non ce ne\limporta proprio nulla. Tanto non è

che resteranno in giro ancora per
molto, comunque.

entries.original:
"Aklove hired me himself.

He promised me untold riches if I
helped him, but I never got squat!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove hired me himself. He promised me untold riches if I helped him, but I never got squat!
entries.translated:
Aklove mi ha assoldato
personalmente. Mi ha promesso\lricchezze incalcolabili se l{B4}avessi

aiutato, ma non ho mai visto un
soldo!

entries.original:
"[red]Now that I’ve failed my one job,
there’s nothing left for me to do.

I should just join some other
group\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Now that I’ve failed my one job, there’s nothing left for me to do. I should just join some other group[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[red]Ora che ho fallito nell{B4}unico
compito che avevo, non mi resta più\lnulla da fare. Dovrei unirmi a

qualche altro gruppo\.

entries.original:
"I bet you don’t remember me, huh?

You saved my hide from a Shadow
Warrior back at our base!

Allow me to not return that favour!"
entries.translation_source: I bet you don’t remember me, huh? You saved my hide from a Shadow Warrior back at our base! Allow me to not return that favour!
entries.translated:
Scommetto che non ti ricordi di me,
eh? Mi hai salvato la pelle da un\lGuerriero Ombra alla nostra base!

Permettimi di non ricambiare il
favore!

entries.original: "I don’t owe you anything."
entries.translation_source: I don’t owe you anything.
entries.translated: Non ti devo niente.

entries.original:
"You think I’d be grateful for your
help, right?

Feh\."
entries.translation_source: You think I’d be grateful for your help, right? Feh[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Pensi che dovrei essere grato per
il tuo aiuto, vero? Pff\.

entries.original:
"Why didn’t you Trainers just come
up together?

It would save us a whole lot of
trouble having to deal with you\lTrainers multiple times."
entries.translation_source: Why didn’t you Trainers just come up together? It would save us a whole lot of trouble having to deal with you Trainers multiple times.
entries.translated:
Perché voi Allenatori non siete
venuti tutti insieme? Ci farebbe\lrisparmiare un sacco di fastidi

dover avere a che fare con voi
Allenatori più volte.

entries.original:
"You know that Pokémon Aklove walks
around with?

It gives me nightmares\."
entries.translation_source: You know that Pokémon Aklove walks around with? It gives me nightmares[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Conosci quel Pokémon con cui gira
Aklove? Mi fa venire gli incubi\.

entries.original:
"I’m from Hoenn.

So I’m all for decreasing the
landmass around here.

There just isn’t enough water,
y’know?"
entries.translation_source: I’m from Hoenn. So I’m all for decreasing the landmass around here. There just isn’t enough water, y’know?
entries.translated:
Vengo da Hoenn. Quindi sono tutto
per ridurre la massa terrestre da\lqueste parti. Semplicemente non c{B4}è

abbastanza acqua, sai?

entries.original:
"Aha!

Do you think Aklove left me with
nothing to use against you?

Surprise!"
entries.translation_source: Aha! Do you think Aklove left me with nothing to use against you? Surprise!
entries.translated:
Aha! Pensi che Aklove mi abbia
lasciato senza nulla da usare\lcontro di te? Sorpresa!

entries.original:
"[blue]Now stay in our prison for your
own safekeeping.

When the weapon goes off, this
mountain will be the only safe\lplace to be in Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Now stay in our prison for your own safekeeping. When the weapon goes off, this mountain will be the only safe place to be in Borrius!
entries.translated:
[blue]Resta pure nella nostra prigione,
per la tua stessa sicurezza. Quando\ll{B4}arma entrerà in funzione, questa

montagna sarà l{B4}unico posto sicuro
in cui stare a Borrius!

entries.original:
"Don’t let the ghost balloons carry
you away, child!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t let the ghost balloons carry you away, child!
entries.translated:
Non lasciare che i palloncini
fantasma ti portino via, bambino!

entries.original:
"The natural energy found here is
even stronger than electricity!"
entries.translation_source: The natural energy found here is even stronger than electricity!
entries.translated:
L{B4}energia naturale che si trova qui
è persino più forte\ldell{B4}elettricità!

entries.original:
"That giant crystal is said to have
mysteriously appeared on top of\lthis mountain centuries ago.

No one knows where it came from or
how it got there."
entries.translation_source: That giant crystal is said to have mysteriously appeared on top of this mountain centuries ago. No one knows where it came from or how it got there.
entries.translated:
Si dice che quel gigantesco
cristallo sia apparso\lmisteriosamente in cima a questa

montagna secoli fa. Nessuno sa da
dove sia venuto o come sia arrivato\llì.

entries.original:
"Try not to be shocked when you lay
your eyes on my Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Try not to be shocked when you lay your eyes on my Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Cerca di non scioccarti quando
poserai gli occhi sui miei Pokémon!

entries.original:
"A dragon Pokémon’s real power is
nothing like mine!"
entries.translation_source: A dragon Pokémon’s real power is nothing like mine!
entries.translated:
La vera forza di un Pokémon drago
non ha nulla a che vedere con la\lmia!

entries.original:
"You again?

You must really like the dragon
Pokémon I use."
entries.translation_source: You again? You must really like the dragon Pokémon I use.
entries.translated:
Ancora tu? Devi proprio amare i
Pokémon di tipo Drago che uso.

entries.original:
"I train here to make my tough
Pokémon even tougher."
entries.translation_source: I train here to make my tough Pokémon even tougher.
entries.translated:
Mi alleno qui per rendere i miei
Pokémon tosti ancora più tosti.

entries.original:
"Huff\. Puff\.

I’m climbing up the mountain just
to show my friends I can!

You’ll be good practice on the
way up!"
entries.translation_source: Huff[game-token-1] Puff[game-token-2] I’m climbing up the mountain just to show my friends I can! You’ll be good practice on the way up!
entries.translated:
Uff\. Pant\. Sto scalando la montagna
solo per mostrare ai miei amici che\lce la faccio! Sarai un buon

allenamento lungo la salita!

entries.original:
"Huff\. Puff\.
I think I’m out of energy\."
entries.translation_source: Huff[game-token-1] Puff[game-token-2] I think I’m out of energy[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ansimo\. Sbuffo\. Credo di aver finito
le energie\.

entries.original:
"Would you believe it if I told you
Crystal Peak was the tallest\lmountain in all of Borrius?"
entries.translation_source: Would you believe it if I told you Crystal Peak was the tallest mountain in all of Borrius?
entries.translated:
Mi crederesti se ti dicessi che
Crystal Peak era la montagna più\lalta di tutto Borrius?

entries.original:
"We’re representatives from
Cube Corp.!

We’re here to harness power for
our facility!"
entries.translation_source: We’re representatives from Cube Corp.! We’re here to harness power for our facility!
entries.translated:
Siamo rappresentanti della Cube
Corp.! Siamo qui per sfruttare\ll{B4}energia per il nostro impianto!

entries.original:
"The power we have wasn’t enough to
defeat you!"
entries.translation_source: The power we have wasn’t enough to defeat you!
entries.translated:
La nostra forza non è stata
sufficiente per sconfiggerti!

entries.original:
"Stop by Cube Corp. sometime!

Using the energy only found here,
we’ve been able to put together\lsome truly wonderful products!"
entries.translation_source: Stop by Cube Corp. sometime! Using the energy only found here, we’ve been able to put together some truly wonderful products!
entries.translated:
Passa da Cube Corp. ogni tanto!
Usando l{B4}energia disponibile solo\lqui, siamo riusciti a mettere

insieme dei prodotti davvero
meravigliosi!

entries.original:
"I’ve been a proud member of Cube
Corp. since way back when it was\lowned by Mr. Zeph!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve been a proud member of Cube Corp. since way back when it was owned by Mr. Zeph!
entries.translated:
Sono un fiero membro della Cube
Corp. da quando era di proprietà\ldel signor Zeph!

entries.original:
"My name is Krystal.

Yes\. my parents were very fond
of this place.

So it’s only fitting that I became
the strongest Trainer in here.

If you can defeat all of the other
Trainers in Crystal Peak, I’ll let\lyou have a go at my title."
entries.translation_source: My name is Krystal. Yes[game-token-1] my parents were very fond of this place. So it’s only fitting that I became the strongest Trainer in here. If you can defeat all of the other Trainers in Crystal Peak, I’ll let you have a go at my title.
entries.translated:
Mi chiamo Krystal. Sì\. i miei
genitori erano molto affezionati a\lquesto posto. Quindi è giusto che

io sia diventata l{B4}Allenatrice più
forte di qui. Se riesci a\lsconfiggere tutti gli altri

Allenatori di Crystal Peak, ti
lascerò provare a strapparmi il\ltitolo.

entries.original:
"My name is Krystal.

Yes\. my parents were very fond
of this place.

So it’s only fitting that I became
the strongest Trainer in here.

If you can defeat me, I’ll let you
call yourself Krystal, too!"
entries.translation_source: My name is Krystal. Yes[game-token-1] my parents were very fond of this place. So it’s only fitting that I became the strongest Trainer in here. If you can defeat me, I’ll let you call yourself Krystal, too!
entries.translated:
Mi chiamo Krystal. Sì\. i miei
genitori tenevano molto a questo\lposto. Quindi è naturale che io sia

diventata l{B4}Allenatrice più forte
qui dentro. Se riesci a\lsconfiggermi, ti lascerò chiamare

Krystal anche tu!

entries.original:
"Well done.

I confer upon you the title of
Krystal.

\.What?
You want more?

Fine\. take this, too."
entries.translation_source: Well done. I confer upon you the title of Krystal. [game-token-1]What? You want more? Fine[game-token-2] take this, too.
entries.translated:
Ben fatto. Ti conferisco il titolo
di Krystal. \.Cosa? Vuoi ancora? Va\lbene\. prendi anche questo.

entries.original:
"If [green]Absol[red] holds the [green]Absolite[red],
it can Mega Evolve and be worthy\lof even Trainers named Krystal."
entries.translation_source: If [color-green-1]Absol[color-red-2] holds the [color-green-3]Absolite[color-red-4], it can Mega Evolve and be worthy of even Trainers named Krystal.
entries.translated:
Se [green]Absol[red] tiene la [green]Absolite[red], può
megaevolversi ed essere degno\lpersino di Allenatori chiamati

Krystal.

entries.original: "[blue]Gastrodon! Use [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Gastrodon! Use [buffer1-2]!
entries.translated: [blue]Gastrodon! Usa [buffer1]!

entries.original: "[blue]Roserade! Counter with [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Roserade! Counter with [buffer1-2]!
entries.translated:
[blue]Roserade! Controattacca con
[buffer1]!

entries.original: "[buffer1]! Protect yourself!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1]! Protect yourself!
entries.translated: [buffer1]! Proteggiti!

entries.original:
"[blue]Krookodile! Let’s shake things up
with Earthquake!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Krookodile! Let’s shake things up with Earthquake!
entries.translated:
[blue]Krookodile! Diamo una scossa alle
cose con Terremoto!

entries.original:
"[red]Alakazam! Increase your Defense
with Barrier!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Alakazam! Increase your Defense with Barrier!
entries.translated:
[red]Alakazam! Aumenta la tua Difesa con
Barriera!

entries.original:
"[black]Hoopa looks like it wants to
join you!

Accept it onto your team?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Hoopa looks like it wants to join you! Accept it onto your team?
entries.translated:
[black]Hoopa sembra voler unirsi a te!
Vuoi accoglierlo nella tua squadra?

entries.original:
"[black][buffer1] happily joined your side!
It has a [green][buffer2][black] nature."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] happily joined your side! It has a [color-green-3][buffer2-4][color-black-5] nature.
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] si è unito felicemente
alla tua squadra! Ha natura\l[green][buffer2][black].

entries.original:
"Oh, [rival]\.
Why can’t you just see what I see\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, [text-token-rival-1][game-token-2] Why can’t you just see what I see[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Oh, [rival]\. Perché non riesci
semplicemente a vedere ciò che vedo\.

entries.original:
"Oh\.
Where did my daddy go?"
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] Where did my daddy go?
entries.translated: Oh\. Dove è finito papà?

entries.original:
"We’ve been assigned by the police
department to guard this rather\llarge crystal.

Don’t try anything funny, kid.
We’re keeping an eye on you."
entries.translation_source: We’ve been assigned by the police department to guard this rather large crystal. Don’t try anything funny, kid. We’re keeping an eye on you.
entries.translated:
Siamo stati assegnati dal
dipartimento di polizia a\lsorvegliare questo cristallo

piuttosto grande. Non fare il
furbo, ragazzino. Ti teniamo\ld{B4}occhio.

entries.original: "Cube Corp."
entries.translation_source: Cube Corp.
entries.translated: Cube Corp.

entries.original: "Cube Corp. Outside"
entries.translation_source: Cube Corp. Outside
entries.translated: All{B4}esterno della Cube Corp.

entries.original: "Cube Corp. Inside"
entries.translation_source: Cube Corp. Inside
entries.translated: All{B4}interno di Cube Corp.

entries.original:
"Poké Balls and Cubes are pretty
similar, right?

I mean, they’re built to make things
smaller and easier to carry.

I guess I should be grateful that
the Cube is\. well, a cube.

Can you imagine if you tried throwing
your Cube to catch a wild Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Poké Balls and Cubes are pretty similar, right? I mean, they’re built to make things smaller and easier to carry. I guess I should be grateful that the Cube is[game-token-1] well, a cube. Can you imagine if you tried throwing your Cube to catch a wild Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Poké Ball e Cubi sono abbastanza
simili, giusto? Voglio dire, sono\lcostruiti per rendere le cose più

piccole e facili da trasportare.
Suppongo che dovrei essere grato\lche il Cubo sia\. beh, un cubo.

Riesci a immaginare se provassi a
lanciare il tuo Cubo per catturare\lun Pokémon selvatico?

entries.original:
"All I wanted was to speak to
someone to fix my Cube V3\.

And somehow, I came away with this
brand-new robot arm."
entries.translation_source: All I wanted was to speak to someone to fix my Cube V3[game-token-1] And somehow, I came away with this brand-new robot arm.
entries.translated:
Volevo solo parlare con qualcuno
per sistemare il mio Cube V3\. E in\lqualche modo, sono uscito di lì con

questo nuovissimo braccio robotico.

entries.original:
"Here at Cube Corp., we believe that
with science, we should always\lshoot for the moon.

\.And if we miss, shoot for it
again.

One day, you’ll succeed in destroying
the moon once and for all."
entries.translation_source: Here at Cube Corp., we believe that with science, we should always shoot for the moon. [game-token-1]And if we miss, shoot for it again. One day, you’ll succeed in destroying the moon once and for all.
entries.translated:
Qui alla Cube Corp., crediamo che
con la scienza si debba sempre\lpuntare alla luna. \.E se manchiamo

il bersaglio, puntiamo di nuovo
alla luna. Un giorno, riuscirai a\ldistruggere la luna una volta per

tutte.

entries.original:
"Pokémon Rangers regularly protest
outside this place.

Seriously, why don’t they go back to
protecting the public, like they’re\lpaid to do?"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon Rangers regularly protest outside this place. Seriously, why don’t they go back to protecting the public, like they’re paid to do?
entries.translated:
I Ranger Pokémon protestano
regolarmente fuori da questo posto.\lSul serio, perché non tornano a

proteggere la gente, come sono
pagati per fare?

entries.original:
"Oh no\. my uniform’s colours ran in
the wash\.

I really hope they don’t mind me
taking casual wear to work\."
entries.translation_source: Oh no[game-token-1] my uniform’s colours ran in the wash[game-token-2] I really hope they don’t mind me taking casual wear to work[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Oh no\\. i colori della mia uniforme
si sono scoloriti nel lavaggio\\.\lSpero davvero che non abbiano nulla

in contrario se porto abiti casual
al lavoro\\.

entries.original:
"I paid some lady with [green]Bottle Caps[red] to
increase my Pokémon’s potential\.

And I paid money to have a scientist
at the [green]Battle Frontier[red] change my\lPokémon’s [green]Nature[red]\.

So what if I’m sacrificing their
wellbeing and happiness?

All that matters is if they can win
a battle!"
entries.translation_source: I paid some lady with [color-green-1]Bottle Caps[color-red-2] to increase my Pokémon’s potential[game-token-3] And I paid money to have a scientist at the [color-green-4]Battle Frontier[color-red-5] change my Pokémon’s [color-green-6]Nature[color-red-7][game-token-8] So what if I’m sacrificing their wellbeing and happiness? All that matters is if they can win a battle!
entries.translated:
Ho pagato una signora con [green]Bottle
Caps[red] per aumentare il potenziale\ldei miei Pokémon\. E ho pagato per

far cambiare a uno scienziato del
[green]Battle Frontier[red] la [green]Nature[red] dei miei\lPokémon\. E allora se sto

sacrificando il loro benessere e la
loro felicità? L{B4}unica cosa che\lconta è se sanno vincere una lotta!

entries.original:
"The workers at Cube Corp. are so
great, they even take time out of\ltheir busy schedules to conduct\ltours of the place!

But word is, though, there’s a secret
lab underground they don’t take\lyou to see."
entries.translation_source: The workers at Cube Corp. are so great, they even take time out of their busy schedules to conduct tours of the place! But word is, though, there’s a secret lab underground they don’t take you to see.
entries.translated:
I lavoratori della Cube Corp. sono
così bravi che si prendono persino\ldel tempo dai loro impegni per fare

visite guidate del posto! Però si
dice che ci sia un laboratorio\lsegreto nel sottosuolo che non ti

fanno vedere.

entries.original:
"All these Rangers ever do is protest
the \qoevils\qc of Cube Corp.

I’ll have you know there’s nothing
evil about Cube Corp. whatsoever!

Let me tell you, they were even so
generous as to grant us police\lofficers extra storage sectors in\lour Cubes!

Why? So we may better serve the
people, of course!

Tell me, is that really so wrong?"
entries.translation_source: All these Rangers ever do is protest the [quote-open-1]evils[quote-close-2] of Cube Corp. I’ll have you know there’s nothing evil about Cube Corp. whatsoever! Let me tell you, they were even so generous as to grant us police officers extra storage sectors in our Cubes! Why? So we may better serve the people, of course! Tell me, is that really so wrong?
entries.translated:
Tutti questi Ranger non fanno altro
che protestare contro i \qomali\qc di\lCube Corp. Ti faccio sapere che in

Cube Corp. non c{B4}è assolutamente
nulla di malvagio! Ti dirò, sono\lstati persino così generosi da

concedere a noi agenti di polizia
settori di stoccaggio extra nei\lnostri Cube! Perché? Così possiamo

servire meglio la gente,
naturalmente! Dimmi, è davvero così\lsbagliato?

entries.original:
"Now that management has had a
complete overhaul, what will\lbecome of Cube Corp.?

Will we continuously strive to
improve the lives of the Borrian\lcitizens, or was that just a lie\lfrom the very beginning?"
entries.translation_source: Now that management has had a complete overhaul, what will become of Cube Corp.? Will we continuously strive to improve the lives of the Borrian citizens, or was that just a lie from the very beginning?
entries.translated:
Ora che la dirigenza ha subito un
rinnovamento completo, che ne sarà\ldella Cube Corp.? Continueremo a

impegnarci costantemente per
migliorare la vita dei cittadini di\lBorrius, oppure era solo una bugia

fin dall{B4}inizio?

entries.original:
"There’s no Pokémon Center here at
Cube Corp., so let me heal your\lPokémon for you instead!"
entries.translation_source: There’s no Pokémon Center here at Cube Corp., so let me heal your Pokémon for you instead!
entries.translated:
Qui alla Cube Corp. non c{B4}è un
Centro Pokémon, quindi lascia che\lio curi i tuoi Pokémon al posto

tuo!

entries.original:
"While there may be no Pokémon
Center here, you’ll find no\lshortage of [green]Porygon[red] if you need\lto access the Pokémon PC.

Isn’t that convenient?

These scientists sure thought of
everything!"
entries.translation_source: While there may be no Pokémon Center here, you’ll find no shortage of [color-green-1]Porygon[color-red-2] if you need to access the Pokémon PC. Isn’t that convenient? These scientists sure thought of everything!
entries.translated:
Anche se qui non c{B4}è un Centro
Pokémon, troverai certo tanti\l[green]Porygon[red] se hai bisogno di accedere

al PC Pokémon. Comodo, no? Questi
scienziati hanno pensato proprio a\ltutto!

entries.original: "Where could my girl be\.?"
entries.translation_source: Where could my girl be[game-token-1]?
entries.translated: Dov{B4}è la mia ragazza\.?

entries.original:
"Sorry, champ!

You mind waiting a little before
heading in there?

I’m waiting for my girl to show up,
so I need all this space to keep\lan eye out for her!

I appreciate ya, Champ!"
entries.translation_source: Sorry, champ! You mind waiting a little before heading in there? I’m waiting for my girl to show up, so I need all this space to keep an eye out for her! I appreciate ya, Champ!
entries.translated:
Scusa, campione! Ti dispiace
aspettare un attimo prima di\lentrare lì dentro? Sto aspettando

che arrivi la mia ragazza, quindi
ho bisogno di tutto questo spazio\lper tenerla d{B4}occhio! Ti apprezzo,

Campione!

entries.original:
"Down with Cube Corp!
Down with Cube Corp!

I’m protesting against the evils of
Cube Corp, and especially the\lScience Society.

They’ve been running cruel
experiments on Pokémon, including\lthe ones I’m responsible for!

Hmm\.? I have [green]hard, snowy scales[blue]
stuck to my clothes?

Yes, that’s right\. I help keep one
of their imported experiments fed,\lafter their population increased\lhere in Borrius, at [green]Icicle Cave[blue].

I forget their names\. they’re some
sort of Pokémon from the [green]Alola\lregion[blue]\.

What were they called?"
entries.translation_source: Down with Cube Corp! Down with Cube Corp! I’m protesting against the evils of Cube Corp, and especially the Science Society. They’ve been running cruel experiments on Pokémon, including the ones I’m responsible for! Hmm[game-token-1]? I have [color-green-2]hard, snowy scales[color-blue-3] stuck to my clothes? Yes, that’s right[game-token-4] I help keep one of their imported experiments fed, after their population increased here in Borrius, at [color-green-5]Icicle Cave[color-blue-6]. I forget their names[game-token-7] they’re some sort of Pokémon from the [color-green-8]Alola region[color-blue-9][game-token-10] What were they called?
entries.translated:
Abbasso Cube Corp! Abbasso Cube
Corp! Sto protestando contro le\lmalvagità della Cube Corp, e in

particolare della Science Society.
Hanno condotto esperimenti crudeli\lsui Pokémon, inclusi quelli di cui

sono responsabile! Hmm\\.? Ho delle
[green]scaglie dure e innevate[blue] attaccate\lai vestiti? Sì, esatto\\. Aiuto a

nutrire uno dei loro esperimenti
importati, dopo che la loro\lpopolazione è aumentata qui a

Borrius, nella [green]Grotta Ghiacciolo[blue].
Dimentico i loro nomi\\. sono una\lspecie di Pokémon della regione di

[green]Alola[blue]\\. Come si chiamavano?

entries.original: "No\. that wasn’t it\."
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1] that wasn’t it[game-token-2]
entries.translated: No\. non era quello\.

entries.original:
"That’s it! They’re the ones!

Wait\.\CC0818 how long has it been since
I last checked on their food\lsupply\.?

That was\.

\.ack! Ages ago!

How have they managed without
me all this time!?

I can’t be wasting time here!

But first, uh\.\CC0818 thanks for
reminding me!"
entries.translation_source: That’s it! They’re the ones! Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] how long has it been since I last checked on their food supply[game-token-3]? That was[game-token-4] [game-token-5]ack! Ages ago! How have they managed without me all this time!? I can’t be wasting time here! But first, uh[game-token-6][control-code-7] thanks for reminding me!
entries.translated:
Eccolo! Sono loro! Aspetta\.\CC0818 da
quanto tempo è che non controllo la\lloro scorta di cibo\.? Era\. \.accidenti!

Secoli fa! Come hanno fatto ad
andare avanti senza di me tutto\lquesto tempo!? Non posso restare a

perdere tempo qui! Ma prima, eh\.\CC0818
grazie per avermelo ricordato!

entries.original:
"These Ice-type Sandshrew and
Sandslash aren’t native to Borrius.

Someone always has to be here, to
make sure they don’t interfere with\lthe other Pokémon in Icicle Cave\.

After all, it’s impossible to capture
the whole population now, anyway."
entries.translation_source: These Ice-type Sandshrew and Sandslash aren’t native to Borrius. Someone always has to be here, to make sure they don’t interfere with the other Pokémon in Icicle Cave[game-token-1] After all, it’s impossible to capture the whole population now, anyway.
entries.translated:
Questi Sandshrew e Sandslash di
tipo Ghiaccio non sono originari di\lBorrius. Qualcuno deve sempre stare

qui per assicurarsi che non
interferiscano con gli altri\lPokémon nella Icicle Cave\.

Dopotutto, ormai è impossibile
catturare l{B4}intera popolazione,\lcomunque.

entries.original:
"Down with Cube Corp.!
Down with the Science Society!"
entries.translation_source: Down with Cube Corp.! Down with the Science Society!
entries.translated:
Abbasso Cube Corp.! Abbasso la
Società Scientifica!

entries.original:
"We’re risking our jobs just protesting
here, I know that.

But this is about taking a stand
against injustice, against unethical\labuse of Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: We’re risking our jobs just protesting here, I know that. But this is about taking a stand against injustice, against unethical abuse of Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Stiamo rischiando il lavoro solo
protestando qui, lo so. Ma si\ltratta di prendere posizione contro

l{B4}ingiustizia, contro l{B4}abuso di
Pokémon non etico!

entries.original:
"Only Pokémon Breeders have the right
to meddle with Pokémon genetics!

Not a crazy group of scientists!

Grr\.\CC0818 just thinking about it makes my
blood boil as hot as a [green]Magma Stone[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Only Pokémon Breeders have the right to meddle with Pokémon genetics! Not a crazy group of scientists! Grr[game-token-1][control-code-2] just thinking about it makes my blood boil as hot as a [color-green-3]Magma Stone[color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Solo gli Allevatori di Pokémon
hanno il diritto di immischiarsi\lnella genetica dei Pokémon! Non un

gruppo di scienziati pazzi! Grr\.\CC0818
solo a pensarci mi fa ribollire il\lsangue caldo come una [green]Magma Stone[blue]!

entries.original:
"That Magma Stone in your Cube\.

It radiates such intense heat!

It reminds me of the days when I
was an avid Pokémon Breeder.

\.

Hold on a minute\.

Ack! That’s right!

I completely forgot about my
precious partner!

I should have picked her up from
the Day Care ages ago!

Uh\. thanks for reminding me.
Here, you can have this."
entries.translation_source: That Magma Stone in your Cube[game-token-1] It radiates such intense heat! It reminds me of the days when I was an avid Pokémon Breeder. [game-token-2] Hold on a minute[game-token-3] Ack! That’s right! I completely forgot about my precious partner! I should have picked her up from the Day Care ages ago! Uh[game-token-4] thanks for reminding me. Here, you can have this.
entries.translated:
La Pietra Magma nel tuo Cube\.
Irradia un calore così intenso! Mi\lricorda i giorni in cui ero un

appassionato Allevatore di Pokémon.
\. Aspetta un minuto\. Accidenti! È\lvero! Mi ero completamente

dimenticato della mia preziosa
compagna! Avrei dovuto andare a\lprenderla all{B4}Asilo Pokémon anni

fa! Uh\. grazie per avermelo
ricordato. Tieni, puoi avere\lquesto.

entries.original:
"You should bring that [green]Magma Stone[blue]
to [green]Cinder Volcano[blue].

I hear a rare Pokémon will appear
when it senses one in your Cube."
entries.translation_source: You should bring that [color-green-1]Magma Stone[color-blue-2] to [color-green-3]Cinder Volcano[color-blue-4]. I hear a rare Pokémon will appear when it senses one in your Cube.
entries.translated:
Dovresti portare quella [green]Pietra
Magma[blue] a [green]Cinder Volcano[blue]. Ho sentito\lche apparirà un Pokémon raro quando

ne percepirà una nel tuo Cubo.

entries.original:
"Grr\.\CC0818 I must leave for now,
Cube Corp\.

But I’ll be back, time and again,
until justice is finally served!"
entries.translation_source: Grr[game-token-1][control-code-2] I must leave for now, Cube Corp[game-token-3] But I’ll be back, time and again, until justice is finally served!
entries.translated:
Grr\.\CC0818 Devo andarmene per ora, Cube
Corp\. Ma tornerò, ancora e ancora,\lfinché giustizia non sarà

finalmente fatta!

entries.original:
"It’s only a matter of time before
the public finds out what’s been\lreally going on in there!

We know you’ve been making monsters,
and soon we’ll be able to prove it!"
entries.translation_source: It’s only a matter of time before the public finds out what’s been really going on in there! We know you’ve been making monsters, and soon we’ll be able to prove it!
entries.translated:
È solo questione di tempo prima che
il pubblico scopra cosa sta davvero\lsuccedendo lì dentro! Sappiamo che

state creando dei mostri, e presto
saremo in grado di dimostrarlo!

entries.original:
"You can’t fool us, Cube Corp!
We know what you’re up to in there!

We know you’re really run by the
Science Society!

And one day, we’ll oust you
once and for all!"
entries.translation_source: You can’t fool us, Cube Corp! We know what you’re up to in there! We know you’re really run by the Science Society! And one day, we’ll oust you once and for all!
entries.translated:
Non ci ingannerete, Cube Corp!
Sappiamo cosa state combinando lì\ldentro! Sappiamo che in realtà

siete controllati dalla Science
Society! E un giorno, vi cacceremo\luna volta per tutte!

entries.original:
"People say that [green]Master Balls[blue] are
effective, but in exchange,\lthey’re hard to produce\.

Shows what they know, because I’m
knee-deep\.\CC0818 in Balls!

In fact, I’ll let you take my many
[green]Master Balls[blue] off my hands\.

But only if you can spare me
[green][buffer2] Gems[blue] for my research."
entries.translation_source: People say that [color-green-1]Master Balls[color-blue-2] are effective, but in exchange, they’re hard to produce[game-token-3] Shows what they know, because I’m knee-deep[game-token-4][control-code-5] in Balls! In fact, I’ll let you take my many [color-green-6]Master Balls[color-blue-7] off my hands[game-token-8] But only if you can spare me [color-green-9][buffer2-10] Gems[color-blue-11] for my research.
entries.translated:
Si dice che le [green]Master Ball[blue] siano
efficaci, ma in cambio sono\ldifficili da produrre\. Dice tutto

questo chiunque, perché io sono
immerso fino al collo\.\CC0818 nelle Ball!\lAnzi, ti lascerò portarti via le

mie tante [green]Master Ball[blue]\. Ma solo se
puoi risparmiarmi [green][buffer2] Gemme[blue]\lper la mia ricerca.

entries.original: "Which Gems are you offering?"
entries.translation_source: Which Gems are you offering?
entries.translated: Quali Gemme stai offrendo?

entries.original:
"And we have a deal!
Here you go.

Don’t blow it on anything stupid,
like a Magikarp."
entries.translation_source: And we have a deal! Here you go. Don’t blow it on anything stupid, like a Magikarp.
entries.translated:
E abbiamo un accordo! Tieni. Non
sperperarlo in qualche sciocchezza,\lcome un Magikarp.

entries.original:
"I’m still knees-deep in Balls!

Bring another [green][buffer2][blue] Gems and I’ll trade
you some more Master Balls."
entries.translation_source: I’m still knees-deep in Balls! Bring another [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] Gems and I’ll trade you some more Master Balls.
entries.translated:
Sono ancora immerso fino alle
ginocchia nelle Ball! Portami altri\l[green][buffer2][blue] Gemme e ti scambierò altre

Master Ball.

entries.original:
"Come on, now\.

I’m running out of room to hide
them all\."
entries.translation_source: Come on, now[game-token-1] I’m running out of room to hide them all[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Dai, ora\. Sto finendo lo spazio per
nasconderli tutti\.

entries.original:
"Come on, now\.
That’s not a Gem!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, now[game-token-1] That’s not a Gem!
entries.translated: Forza, ora\. Non è una Gemma!

entries.original:
"Come on, now\.

You don’t have at least [green][buffer2][blue]
[green][buffer1]s[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, now[game-token-1] You don’t have at least [color-green-2][buffer2-3][color-blue-4] [color-green-5][buffer1-6]s[color-blue-7]!
entries.translated:
Su, dai\. Non hai almeno [green][buffer2][blue]
[green][buffer1]s[blue]!

entries.original:
"Upupupu\.

I recognize you\. you’re the Champion
of Borrius, aren’t you?

Have you found any of those strange
portals around Borrius yet?

And have you found strange creatures
from another dimension emerging\lfrom the other side\.

Fierce creatures, resistant to
almost every type of Poké Ball in\lyour Cube?

Well, you need a special kind of
Poké Ball to take them on - [green]Beast\lBalls[red]!

And it just so happens I know how to
create them!

All I require is the most important
raw material - [green]Iron Balls[red].

If you bring enough of those, I can
create [green]Beast Balls[red] for you."
entries.translation_source: Upupupu[game-token-1] I recognize you[game-token-2] you’re the Champion of Borrius, aren’t you? Have you found any of those strange portals around Borrius yet? And have you found strange creatures from another dimension emerging from the other side[game-token-3] Fierce creatures, resistant to almost every type of Poké Ball in your Cube? Well, you need a special kind of Poké Ball to take them on - [color-green-4]Beast Balls[color-red-5]! And it just so happens I know how to create them! All I require is the most important raw material - [color-green-6]Iron Balls[color-red-7]. If you bring enough of those, I can create [color-green-8]Beast Balls[color-red-9] for you.
entries.translated:
Upupupu\. Ti riconosco\. Sei il
Campione di Borrius, vero? Hai già\ltrovato alcuni di quei portali

misteriosi intorno a Borrius? E hai
trovato strane creature da un{B4}altra\ldimensione che emergono dall{B4}altro

lato\. Creature feroci, resistenti a
quasi ogni tipo di Poké Ball nel\ltuo Cube? Beh, hai bisogno di un

tipo speciale di Poké Ball per
affrontarle - [green]Sfere Base[red]! E guarda\lcaso, so come crearle! Tutto ciò di

cui ho bisogno è la materia prima
più importante - [green]Ferropalle[red]. Se ne\lporti abbastanza, posso creare

[green]Sfere Base[red] per te.

entries.original:
"So, have you brought any
[green]Iron Balls[red]?

I’ll make [green]Beast Balls[red] out of
them, if you want."
entries.translation_source: So, have you brought any [color-green-1]Iron Balls[color-red-2]? I’ll make [color-green-3]Beast Balls[color-red-4] out of them, if you want.
entries.translated:
Allora, hai portato delle [green]Iron
Balls[red]? Posso ricavarne delle [green]Beast\lBalls[red], se vuoi.

entries.original:
"How many Iron Balls will you
part with?"
entries.translation_source: How many Iron Balls will you part with?
entries.translated: Quante Ferropalle vuoi cedere?

entries.original:
"You’ll part with [buffer1] of the
Iron Balls?"
entries.translation_source: You’ll part with [buffer1-1] of the Iron Balls?
entries.translated: Vuoi cedere [buffer1] Palle Ferro?

entries.original:
"Upupupu\.

Thank you kindly.

There’s an art to this\. they respond
badly to the dimensions inside a\lPoké Ball\.

So, I create an alternate space for
them, and\.\CC0815 \.\CC0815 \.\CC0815\CC103100there we go!"
entries.translation_source: Upupupu[game-token-1] Thank you kindly. There’s an art to this[game-token-2] they respond badly to the dimensions inside a Poké Ball[game-token-3] So, I create an alternate space for them, and[game-token-4][control-code-5] [game-token-6][control-code-7] [game-token-8][control-code-9][control-code-10]there we go!
entries.translated:
Upupupu\. Grazie infinite. C{B4}è
un{B4}arte in tutto questo\. reagiscono\lmale alle dimensioni all{B4}interno di

una Poké Ball\. Perciò, creo per loro
uno spazio alternativo, e\.\CC0815 \.\CC0815 \.\CC0815\CC103100{D7}i\lsiamo!

entries.original:
"Upupupu\.

The portals from which those
creatures emerge tend to reappear.

I hope you’ll use those Beast Balls
for good, and tame these threats\lto our world\."
entries.translation_source: Upupupu[game-token-1] The portals from which those creatures emerge tend to reappear. I hope you’ll use those Beast Balls for good, and tame these threats to our world[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Upupupu\. I portali da cui emergono
quelle creature tendono a\lriapparire. Spero che userai quelle

Beast Ball per il bene, e che
domerai queste minacce per il\lnostro mondo\.

entries.original:
"Not interested?

How can you not find monsters from
another world fascinating?"
entries.translation_source: Not interested? How can you not find monsters from another world fascinating?
entries.translated:
Non ti interessa? Come fai a non
trovare affascinanti i mostri di un\laltro mondo?

entries.original:
"Upupupu\.

You have no Iron Balls\."
entries.translation_source: Upupupu[game-token-1] You have no Iron Balls[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Upupupu\. Non hai Palle Fero\.

entries.original:
"Bwahahaha! You there, Trainer!

If you will let me, I shall
demonstrate a feat of science many\lbelieve to be impossible!

Just give me [green][buffer2] Everstones[blue], and I will
transform them into a rare Evolution\lStone - any kind you please!"
entries.translation_source: Bwahahaha! You there, Trainer! If you will let me, I shall demonstrate a feat of science many believe to be impossible! Just give me [color-green-1][buffer2-2] Everstones[color-blue-3], and I will transform them into a rare Evolution Stone - any kind you please!
entries.translated:
Bwahahaha! Tu, Allenatore! Se me lo
permetterai, dimostrerò un{B4}impresa\lscientifica che molti ritengono

impossibile! Dammi [green][buffer2]
Pietrastanti[blue], e le trasformerò in\luna rara Pietra Evolutiva, del tipo

che preferisci!

entries.original: "Which Stone shall I make for you?"
entries.translation_source: Which Stone shall I make for you?
entries.translated: Quale Pietra posso creare per te?

entries.original:
"Then, you want me to turn your
Everstones into a [green][buffer1][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Then, you want me to turn your Everstones into a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]?
entries.translated:
Allora vuoi che trasformi le tue
Pietrastanti in [green][buffer1][blue]?

entries.original: "Into the machine they go\. and\."
entries.translation_source: Into the machine they go[game-token-1] and[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Nella macchina ci vanno\. e\.

entries.original:
"Bwahahaha! Did you see that!?

They all said an item meant to
prevent evolution could never\linduce evolution!

FOOLS! FOOLS, ALL OF THEM!

\.Oh, right.
Here, take it\. I guess."
entries.translation_source: Bwahahaha! Did you see that!? They all said an item meant to prevent evolution could never induce evolution! FOOLS! FOOLS, ALL OF THEM! [game-token-1]Oh, right. Here, take it[game-token-2] I guess.
entries.translated:
Bwahahaha! Hai visto!? Tutti
dicevano che un oggetto pensato per\limpedire l{B4}evoluzione non avrebbe

mai potuto causare l{B4}evoluzione!
STOLTI! STOLTI, TUTTI QUANTI! \.Ah,\lgiusto. Tieni, prendilo\. Immagino.

entries.original:
"If you come across any more
Everstones, I’ll be happy to tell\lconventional science to sit down\land shut up for you again."
entries.translation_source: If you come across any more Everstones, I’ll be happy to tell conventional science to sit down and shut up for you again.
entries.translated:
Se trovi altre Pietrastanti, sarò
felice di dire ancora alla scienza\lconvenzionale di sedersi e tacere

per te.

entries.original:
"Shun! Shun the non-believer!

Shuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuun!"
entries.translation_source: Shun! Shun the non-believer! Shuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuun!
entries.translated:
Scaccia! Scaccia il non credente!
Sciuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuun!

entries.original:
"So, you would hoard your
Everstones, like a fool?

What purpose would that ever
serve anyone?"
entries.translation_source: So, you would hoard your Everstones, like a fool? What purpose would that ever serve anyone?
entries.translated:
Quindi terresti le tue
Pietrastante, come un idiota? A\lcosa servirebbe mai a qualcuno?

entries.original:
"Gah! You lack the Everstones for my
grand demonstration!"
entries.translation_source: Gah! You lack the Everstones for my grand demonstration!
entries.translated:
Gah! Ti mancano le Pietrastanti per
la mia grande dimostrazione!

entries.original: "Dawn Stone"
entries.translation_source: Dawn Stone
entries.translated: Pietralba

entries.original: "Dusk Stone"
entries.translation_source: Dusk Stone
entries.translated: Pietrabuio

entries.original: "Ice Stone"
entries.translation_source: Ice Stone
entries.translated: Pietragelo

entries.original: "Moon Stone"
entries.translation_source: Moon Stone
entries.translated: Pietralunare

entries.original: "Shiny Stone"
entries.translation_source: Shiny Stone
entries.translated: Pietrabrillo

entries.original: "Sun Stone"
entries.translation_source: Sun Stone
entries.translated: Pietrasolare

entries.original:
"Hey, you! Yes, you!

Have you any [green]Star Pieces[blue] or [green]Fossils[blue]
to spare this humble researcher?

In exchange, I can offer you a
special concoction, one that\lcan raise how often a Pokémon can\luse its attacks\."
entries.translation_source: Hey, you! Yes, you! Have you any [color-green-1]Star Pieces[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Fossils[color-blue-4] to spare this humble researcher? In exchange, I can offer you a special concoction, one that can raise how often a Pokémon can use its attacks[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Ehi, tu! Sì, proprio tu! Hai per
caso [green]Pezzi Stella[blue] o [green]Fossili[blue] da\lcedere a questo umile ricercatore?

In cambio, posso offrirti un
intruglio speciale, uno che può\laumentare quante volte un Pokémon

può usare le sue mosse\.

entries.original: "What will you trade?"
entries.translation_source: What will you trade?
entries.translated: Cosa vuoi scambiare?

entries.original:
"How many [green][buffer1]s[blue] will
you trade?"
entries.translation_source: How many [color-green-1][buffer1-2]s[color-blue-3] will you trade?
entries.translated: Quanti [green][buffer1]s[blue] vuoi scambiare?

entries.original:
"So, you’re willing to part with your
[green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue], in exchange for\l[green][buffer3][blue] of my [green]PP Ups[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: So, you’re willing to part with your [color-green-1][buffer2-2] [buffer1-3]s[color-blue-4], in exchange for [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-blue-7] of my [color-green-8]PP Ups[color-blue-9]?
entries.translated:
Allora, sei disposto a separarti
dai tuoi [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue], in\lcambio di [green][buffer3][blue] dei miei [green]PP Su[blue]?

entries.original:
"Excellent! I’ll just take those,
thank you very much!"
entries.translation_source: Excellent! I’ll just take those, thank you very much!
entries.translated:
Eccellente! Prendo solo questi,
grazie mille!

entries.original:
"And now, for me to hold up my end
of the deal\. here!"
entries.translation_source: And now, for me to hold up my end of the deal[game-token-1] here!
entries.translated:
E ora, tocca a me mantenere la mia
parte dell{B4}accordo\. Tieni!

entries.original:
"If you come across more Star Pieces
or Fossils, tell me at once."
entries.translation_source: If you come across more Star Pieces or Fossils, tell me at once.
entries.translated:
Se trovi altri Pezzi Stella o
Fossili, dimmelo subito.

entries.original:
"Grr\.

\CC0600(How hard must it be to raise my
glorious Fossilised army\CC0601\.\CC0600?)

\CC0601Uh\. never mind.

If you do come across Star Pieces
or Fossils, tell me at once."
entries.translation_source: Grr[game-token-1] [control-code-2](How hard must it be to raise my glorious Fossilised army[control-code-3][game-token-4][control-code-5]?) [control-code-6]Uh[game-token-7] never mind. If you do come across Star Pieces or Fossils, tell me at once.
entries.translated:
Grr\. \CC0600(Quanto deve essere difficile
mettere in piedi il mio glorioso\lesercito fossilizzato\CC0601\.\CC0600?) \CC0601Uh\. niente,

lascia stare. Se trovi dei Pezzi
Stella o dei Fossili, dimmelo\lsubito.

entries.original:
"Nice try.

I know perfectly well that’s not a
Star Piece or a Fossil."
entries.translation_source: Nice try. I know perfectly well that’s not a Star Piece or a Fossil.
entries.translated:
Bel tentativo. So benissimo che non
è un Pezzo Stella né un Fossile.

entries.original:
"Nice try.

I know perfectly well you haven’t
enough [buffer1]s to trade."
entries.translation_source: Nice try. I know perfectly well you haven’t enough [buffer1-1]s to trade.
entries.translated:
Bel tentativo. So perfettamente che
non hai abbastanza [buffer1] da\lscambiare.

entries.original:
"Is\.\CC0818 is that\.\CC0818 a Comet Shard!?

Forget PP Ups, for each of those,
I can give you one [green]PP Max[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Is[game-token-1][control-code-2] is that[game-token-3][control-code-4] a Comet Shard!? Forget PP Ups, for each of those, I can give you one [color-green-5]PP Max[color-blue-6]!
entries.translated:
Ma\.\CC0818 è davvero\.\CC0818 un Frammento Cometa!?
Dimentica i PP Su, per ognuno di\lquelli, posso darti un [green]PP Max[blue]!

entries.original:
"So, you’re willing to part with [green][buffer1][blue]
of your [green]Comet Shards[blue], in exchange\lfor [green][buffer1][blue] of my [green]PP Maxes[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: So, you’re willing to part with [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] of your [color-green-4]Comet Shards[color-blue-5], in exchange for [color-green-6][buffer1-7][color-blue-8] of my [color-green-9]PP Maxes[color-blue-10]?
entries.translated:
Quindi sei disposto a cedere
[green][buffer1][blue] dei tuoi [green]Frammenti di\lCometa[blue], in cambio di [green][buffer1][blue] dei

miei [green]PP Max[blue]?

entries.original:
"Ah, so the Champion deigns to visit
our humble headquarters.

There is a Pokémon that we have left
with a [green]Ranger[red], in [green]Fallshore City[red].

If you can prove yourself caring
enough to tame it, please show it\lto me."
entries.translation_source: Ah, so the Champion deigns to visit our humble headquarters. There is a Pokémon that we have left with a [color-green-1]Ranger[color-red-2], in [color-green-3]Fallshore City[color-red-4]. If you can prove yourself caring enough to tame it, please show it to me.
entries.translated:
Ah, quindi il Campione si degna di
visitare la nostra umile sede. C{B4}è\lun Pokémon che abbiamo lasciato a

un [green]Ranger[red], a [green]Fallshore City[red]. Se
riesci a dimostrare di avere\labbastanza a cuore di domarlo, per

favore mostramelo.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes, there’s no mistaking it -
that is the same Pokémon that we\ltrusted to that Ranger.

Very well\. I would like for you to
have this - another of its kind."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes, there’s no mistaking it - that is the same Pokémon that we trusted to that Ranger. Very well[game-token-1] I would like for you to have this - another of its kind.
entries.translated:
Ah, sì, non c{B4}è dubbio - è lo
stesso Pokémon che avevamo affidato\la quel Ranger. Molto bene\\. Vorrei

che tu avessi questo - un altro
esemplare della stessa specie.

entries.original:
"According to these research notes
I received from the Alola Region\.

That Pokémon was modelled after the
mythical Pokémon, Arceus\.

They wanted to recreate its power
in order to fight creatures from\lanother world.

We’ve tried to do the same here in
Borrius, but our results were no\lmore successful than theirs.

The Pokémon I gave you was one of
the two we created.

But, just in case a time ever
comes when its true powers can be\lunlocked\.

Then, I can create the tools that it
needs to change its type."
entries.translation_source: According to these research notes I received from the Alola Region[game-token-1] That Pokémon was modelled after the mythical Pokémon, Arceus[game-token-2] They wanted to recreate its power in order to fight creatures from another world. We’ve tried to do the same here in Borrius, but our results were no more successful than theirs. The Pokémon I gave you was one of the two we created. But, just in case a time ever comes when its true powers can be unlocked[game-token-3] Then, I can create the tools that it needs to change its type.
entries.translated:
Secondo queste note di ricerca che
ho ricevuto dalla regione di Alola\.\lQuel Pokémon è stato modellato sul

Pokémon mitico, Arceus\. Volevano
ricrearne il potere per combattere\lcreature di un altro mondo. Abbiamo

provato a fare lo stesso qui a
Borrius, ma i nostri risultati non\lsono stati più riusciti dei loro.

Il Pokémon che ti ho dato era uno
dei due che abbiamo creato. Ma, nel\lcaso arrivi mai un momento in cui i

suoi veri poteri possano essere
sbloccati\. allora posso creare gli\lstrumenti di cui ha bisogno per

cambiare tipo.

entries.original:
"Oh, but first, find a PC or one of
our Porygon, so you can empty a\lspace in the party."
entries.translation_source: Oh, but first, find a PC or one of our Porygon, so you can empty a space in the party.
entries.translated:
Oh, ma prima, trova un PC o uno dei
nostri Porygon, così puoi liberare\luno spazio nella squadra.

entries.original:
"If you have any of Arceus’ [green]Plates[red],
I can import [green]3[red] of them into a\lMemory disk, meant to change the\ltype of the Pokémon we created."
entries.translation_source: If you have any of Arceus’ [color-green-1]Plates[color-red-2], I can import [color-green-3]3[color-red-4] of them into a Memory disk, meant to change the type of the Pokémon we created.
entries.translated:
Se hai qualcuna delle [green]Tavolette[red] di
Arceus, posso importarne [green]3[red] in un\lDisco Memoria, pensato per cambiare

il tipo del Pokémon che abbiamo
creato.

entries.original: "Which Plates will you give me?"
entries.translation_source: Which Plates will you give me?
entries.translated: Quali Lastre mi darai?

entries.original:
"If I import [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[red] into
the Memory disk, I can make you\lone [green][buffer3][red]."
entries.translation_source: If I import [color-green-1][buffer2-2] [buffer1-3]s[color-red-4] into the Memory disk, I can make you one [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-red-7].
entries.translated:
Se inserisco nel Memory Disk
[green][buffer2] [buffer1][red], posso fartene\luno [green][buffer3][red].

entries.original:
"Then, I shall import the Plate
into the Memory disk\."
entries.translation_source: Then, I shall import the Plate into the Memory disk[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Allora importerò la Lastra nel
disco Memoria\.

entries.original:
"And it is done!

One [green][buffer1][red], ready to go!"
entries.translation_source: And it is done! One [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3], ready to go!
entries.translated:
Ed è fatto! Uno [green][buffer1][red], pronto a
partire!

entries.original:
"If you have any more of Arceus’
[green]Plates[red], I can import them into\lMemory disks for you as well."
entries.translation_source: If you have any more of Arceus’ [color-green-1]Plates[color-red-2], I can import them into Memory disks for you as well.
entries.translated:
Se hai altre [green]Lastre[red] di Arceus,
posso importarle anche in dischi\lMemoria per te.

entries.original:
"If you intend to use the Pokémon as
is, that is fine with me as well."
entries.translation_source: If you intend to use the Pokémon as is, that is fine with me as well.
entries.translated:
Se intendi usare il Pokémon così
com{B4}è, per me va bene lo stesso.

entries.original:
"I cannot import that item into a
Memory disk.

Unfortunately, it is not one of
Arceus’ Plates."
entries.translation_source: I cannot import that item into a Memory disk. Unfortunately, it is not one of Arceus’ Plates.
entries.translated:
Non posso importare quell{B4}oggetto
in un disco Memoria. Purtroppo, non\lè una delle Piastre di Arceus.

entries.original:
"Unfortunately, you need at least 3
[buffer1]s if you want me to\limport them into a Memory disk."
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately, you need at least 3 [buffer1-1]s if you want me to import them into a Memory disk.
entries.translated:
Purtroppo, servono almeno 3
[buffer1] se vuoi che li importi in\lun disco Memoria.

entries.original:
"It’s mah Mega Stone Maker - mah
pride and joy, right here!

Er\.\CC0818 admittedly, it can only make
three kinds of Mega Stones, but\ldon’t ya worry!

If ye’d like, I can make one of
those Mega Stones right now!

Let’s see\. how about [green][buffer1] Grass Gems[blue]?

Gimme those, and I can use mah
MSM’s pressure chamber to convert\l’em into a [green]Sceptilite[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: It’s mah Mega Stone Maker - mah pride and joy, right here! Er[game-token-1][control-code-2] admittedly, it can only make three kinds of Mega Stones, but don’t ya worry! If ye’d like, I can make one of those Mega Stones right now! Let’s see[game-token-3] how about [color-green-4][buffer1-5] Grass Gems[color-blue-6]? Gimme those, and I can use mah MSM’s pressure chamber to convert ’em into a [color-green-7]Sceptilite[color-blue-8]!
entries.translated:
È il mio Fabbricante di Megapietre
- il mio orgoglio e la mia gioia,\leccolo qui! Er\.\CC0818 ad essere onesti,

può creare solo tre tipi di
Megapietre, ma non preoccuparti! Se\lvuoi, posso crearne una proprio

ora! Vediamo\. che ne dici di
[green][buffer1] Gemme Erba[blue]? Dammele, e\lposso usare la camera di pressione

del mio MSM per trasformarle in una
[green]Sceptilite[blue]!

entries.original:
"If ye’d like, I can make another
for ya, too!

Let’s see\. how about [green][buffer1] Fire Gems[blue]?

Give me those, and I can use my
MSM’s pressure chamber to convert\l’em into a [green]Blazikenite[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: If ye’d like, I can make another for ya, too! Let’s see[game-token-1] how about [color-green-2][buffer1-3] Fire Gems[color-blue-4]? Give me those, and I can use my MSM’s pressure chamber to convert ’em into a [color-green-5]Blazikenite[color-blue-6]!
entries.translated:
Se vuoi, posso fartene un{B4}altra
anche per te! Vediamo\. che ne dici\ldi [green][buffer1] Fire Gems[blue]? Dammi

quelle, e posso usare la camera di
pressione del mio MSM per\lconvertirle in una [green]Blazikenite[blue]!

entries.original:
"If ye’d like, I can make another
for ya, too!

Let’s see\. how about [green][buffer1] Water Gems[blue]?

Give me those, and I can use my
MSM’s pressure chamber to convert\l’em into a [green]Swampertite[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: If ye’d like, I can make another for ya, too! Let’s see[game-token-1] how about [color-green-2][buffer1-3] Water Gems[color-blue-4]? Give me those, and I can use my MSM’s pressure chamber to convert ’em into a [color-green-5]Swampertite[color-blue-6]!
entries.translated:
Se vuoi, posso fartene un{B4}altra
anche per te! Vediamo\. che ne dici\ldi [green][buffer1] Water Gems[blue]? Dammi

accessibile usando Scalaroccia sul\llato ovest del 2F.

"This person was found in Tarmigan
Mansion’s kitchen on 2F."
entries.translation_source: This person was found in Tarmigan Mansion’s kitchen on 2F.

Questa persona è stata trovata in
cucina al 2° piano della Tarmigan\lMansion.

entries.original:
"This person was found in front of
the bookshelves in the Dream
Research Lab."

entries.translated:
Questa persona si trova davanti
alle librerie del Laboratorio di\lRicerca sui Sogni.

entries.original:
"This person was found on the first
floor of the top left residence of
the group of four residences."
entries.translation_source: This person was found on the first floor of the top left residence of the group of four residences.
entries.translated:
Questa persona è stata trovata al
primo piano della residenza in alto\la sinistra del gruppo di quattro

abitazioni.

entries.original: "This person was found in the Mart."
entries.translation_source: This person was found in the Mart.
entries.translated:
Questa persona è stata trovata al
Mart.

entries.original:
"This person was found in the small
room located in the northern
section."
entries.translation_source: This person was found in the small room located in the northern section.
entries.translated:
Questa persona si trovava nella
piccola stanza situata nella\lsezione settentrionale.

entries.original:
"This person was found in the house
next to the Battleground."

entries.translated:
Questa persona è stata trovata
nella casa accanto al Campo di\lBattaglia.

entries.original:
"This person was found on the first
floor of the residence next to the
Mart."

entries.translated:
Questa persona si trovava al primo
piano della casa accanto al Mart.

entries.original:
"This person was found on the second
floor of the residence next to the
Mart."
entries.translation_source: This person was found on the second floor of the residence next to the Mart.
entries.translated:
Questa persona si trova al secondo
piano dell{B4}abitazione accanto al\lMarket.

"This person was found in a stall
on the left side of the walkway
heading up to the Battle Tower."

entries.translated:
Questa persona è stata trovata in
una bancarella sul lato sinistro\ldel passaggio che sale verso la

Torre Lotta.

"This person was found in the house
closest to the Safari Zone."

nella casa più vicina alla Zona\lSafari.

entries.original:
"This person was found next to the
Mart."

vicino al Mart.

entries.translation_source: This person was found in the western cave accessed from the large room on 1F.
entries.translated:
Questa persona si trova nella
grotta occidentale accessibile\ldalla grande stanza al 1F.

"This person was found in the house
next to the Pokémon Center."
entries.translation_source: This person was found in the house next to the Pokémon Center.
entries.translated:
Questa persona è stata trovata

"This person was found north of the
Pokémon Center after using Cut."
entries.translation_source: This person was found north of the Pokémon Center after using Cut.
entries.translated:
Questa persona è stata trovata a
nord del Centro Pokémon dopo aver\lusato Taglio.

entries.original: "Pokémon Day Care"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon Day Care
entries.translated: Pensione Pokémon

entries.original:
"The home of a lovely old couple
that will raise Pokémon for you.
Leave two Pokémon with them, and
they may find up to 100 Eggs!"
entries.translation_source: The home of a lovely old couple that will raise Pokémon for you. Leave two Pokémon with them, and they may find up to 100 Eggs!
entries.translated:
La casa di una simpatica coppia di
anziani che alleverà i Pokémon per\lte. Lascia due Pokémon con loro, e

potrebbero trovare fino a 100 Uova!

entries.original:
"I’m the Day-Care Man.

I help take care of the precious
Pokémon of Trainers.

If you’d like me to raise your
Pokémon, have a word with my wife."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Day-Care Man. I help take care of the precious Pokémon of Trainers. If you’d like me to raise your Pokémon, have a word with my wife.
entries.translated:
Sono l{B4}uomo della Pensione. Mi
prendo cura dei preziosi Pokémon\ldegli Allenatori. Se vuoi che

faccia crescere il tuo Pokémon,
parla con mia moglie.

entries.original:
"Ah, it’s you!

We were raising your Pokémon, and
my goodness, were we surprised!

Your Pokémon had an Egg!

We don’t know how it got there,
but your Pokémon had it.

You do want it, yes?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, it’s you! We were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised! Your Pokémon had an Egg! We don’t know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it. You do want it, yes?
entries.translated:
Ah, sei tu! Stavamo crescendo i
tuoi Pokémon e, cielo santo, che\lsorpresa! I tuoi Pokémon avevano un

Uovo! Non sappiamo come ci sia
finito, ma i tuoi Pokémon lo\lavevano. Lo vuoi, vero?

entries.original:
"I really will keep it.
You do want this, yes?"
entries.translation_source: I really will keep it. You do want this, yes?
entries.translated: Lo terrò davvero. Lo vuoi, sì?

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Egg from
the Day-Care Man!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Egg from the Day-Care Man!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto l{B4}Uovo
dall{B4}Uomo del Pensionato!

entries.original:
"Would you like another Egg?

I’m holding on to [green][buffer1][blue] in total."
entries.translation_source: Would you like another Egg? I’m holding on to [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] in total.
entries.translated:
Vuoi un altro Uovo? Ne sto tenendo
[green][buffer1][blue] in totale.

entries.original: "Take good care of it."
entries.translation_source: Take good care of it.
entries.translated: Prenditene cura.

entries.original:
"Fine then, I’ll keep it.
Thanks!"
entries.translation_source: Fine then, I’ll keep it. Thanks!
entries.translated: Va bene, allora, lo terrò. Grazie!

entries.original:
"Would you also like me to keep the
rest of your Eggs?

I’m holding on to [green][buffer1][blue] in total."
entries.translation_source: Would you also like me to keep the rest of your Eggs? I’m holding on to [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] in total.
entries.translated:
Vuoi che tenga anche il resto delle
tue Uova? In totale ne sto tenendo\l[green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Fine then, I’ll keep them all.
Thanks!"
entries.translation_source: Fine then, I’ll keep them all. Thanks!
entries.translated:
Va bene allora, li terrò tutti.
Grazie!

entries.original:
"Fine then, I’ll keep holding on to
your Eggs for you."
entries.translation_source: Fine then, I’ll keep holding on to your Eggs for you.
entries.translated:
Va bene allora, continuerò a
tenerti da parte le tue Uova.

entries.original:
"You have no room for it\.

May I send it to the PC instead?
The current box is Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc."
entries.translation_source: You have no room for it[game-token-1] May I send it to the PC instead? The current box is Box [quote-open-2][color-green-3][buffer1-4][color-blue-5][quote-close-6].
entries.translated:
Non hai spazio per prenderlo\. Posso
inviarlo al PC invece? La casella\lattuale è Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc.

entries.original:
"You have no room for it\.

May I send the Eggs I’m holding to
the PC instead?

I’m holding on to [green][buffer2][blue] in total, and
the current box is Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc."
entries.translation_source: You have no room for it[game-token-1] May I send the Eggs I’m holding to the PC instead? I’m holding on to [color-green-2][buffer2-3][color-blue-4] in total, and the current box is Box [quote-open-5][color-green-6][buffer1-7][color-blue-8][quote-close-9].
entries.translated:
Non hai spazio per tenerlo\. Posso
inviare al PC le Uova che sto\ltenendo invece? Ne sto tenendo

[green][buffer2][blue] in totale, e la casella
attuale è Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc.

entries.original:
"This could take me some time.

Please wait patiently for a
few moments."
entries.translation_source: This could take me some time. Please wait patiently for a few moments.
