entries.translated:
Potrebbe prendermi un po{B4} di tempo.
Attendi pazientemente per qualche\lmomento.

entries.original:
"Done.

The remaining Eggs have been sent
to the PC.

Take good care of them."
entries.translation_source: Done. The remaining Eggs have been sent to the PC. Take good care of them.
entries.translated:
Fatto. Le uova rimanenti sono state
inviate al PC. Prenditene cura.

entries.original:
"Done.

The remaining Egg has been sent
to the PC.

Take good care of it."
entries.translation_source: Done. The remaining Egg has been sent to the PC. Take good care of it.
entries.translated:
Fatto. L{B4}Uovo rimasto è stato
mandato al PC. Abbine cura.

entries.original:
"Done.

Most of the remaining Eggs have
been sent to the PC.

Unfortunately, there was not enough
space to deposit them all.

Take good care of the ones
deposited."
entries.translation_source: Done. Most of the remaining Eggs have been sent to the PC. Unfortunately, there was not enough space to deposit them all. Take good care of the ones deposited.
entries.translated:
Fatto. La maggior parte delle Uova
rimaste è stata inviata al PC.\lPurtroppo non c{B4}era spazio

sufficiente per depositarle tutte.
Abbi cura di quelle depositate.

entries.original: "Come back when you’ve made room."
entries.translation_source: Come back when you’ve made room.
entries.translated: Torna quando avrai fatto spazio.

entries.original:
"The PC is full I’m afraid.

Come back when you’ve made room."
entries.translation_source: The PC is full I’m afraid. Come back when you’ve made room.
entries.translated:
Temo che il PC sia pieno. Torna
quando avrai fatto spazio.

entries.original:
"Ah, it’s you! Good to see you.
Your [buffer1]’s doing fine."
entries.translation_source: Ah, it’s you! Good to see you. Your [buffer1-1]’s doing fine.
entries.translated:
Ah, sei tu! Piacere di rivederti.
Il tuo [buffer1] sta bene.

entries.original:
"Ah, it’s you! Your [buffer1] and
[buffer2] are doing fine."
entries.translation_source: Ah, it’s you! Your [buffer1-1] and [buffer2-2] are doing fine.
entries.translated:
Ah, sei tu! Il tuo [buffer1] e
[buffer2] stanno bene.

entries.original:
"I’m the Day-Care Lady.

We can raise Pokémon for you.

Would you like us to raise one?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Day-Care Lady. We can raise Pokémon for you. Would you like us to raise one?
entries.translated:
Sono la Signora Asilo. Possiamo
allevare Pokémon per te. Vuoi che\lne alleviamo uno?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon should we raise
for you?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should we raise for you?
entries.translated:
Quale Pokémon vuoi che alleviamo
per te?

entries.original:
"Fine, we’ll raise your [buffer1]
for a while.

Come back for it later."
entries.translation_source: Fine, we’ll raise your [buffer1-1] for a while. Come back for it later.
entries.translated:
Va bene, terremo il tuo [buffer1]
per un po{B4}. Passa a riprenderlo più\ltardi.

entries.original:
"We can raise two of your Pokémon.

Would you like us to raise one
more Pokémon for you?"
entries.translation_source: We can raise two of your Pokémon. Would you like us to raise one more Pokémon for you?
entries.translated:
Possiamo allenare due dei tuoi
Pokémon. Vuoi che ne alleniamo un\laltro per te?

entries.original: "My husband was looking for you."
entries.translation_source: My husband was looking for you.
entries.translated: Mio marito ti stava cercando.

entries.original:
"Oh, fine, then.
Come again."
entries.translation_source: Oh, fine, then. Come again.
entries.translated: Va bene, allora. Torna pure.

entries.original: "You don’t have enough money\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough money[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non hai abbastanza soldi\.

entries.original:
"Will you take back the other one,
too?"
entries.translation_source: Will you take back the other one, too?
entries.translated: Riprenderai anche l{B4}altro, vero?

entries.original:
"Fine.
Come again."
entries.translation_source: Fine. Come again.
entries.translated: Va bene. Torna pure.

entries.original: "Come again."
entries.translation_source: Come again.
entries.translated: Torna pure.

entries.original:
"Ah, it’s you!
Good to see you.

Your Pokémon can only be doing
well!"
entries.translation_source: Ah, it’s you! Good to see you. Your Pokémon can only be doing well!
entries.translated:
Ah, sei tu! Che piacere vederti. I
tuoi Pokémon non possono che stare\lbene!

entries.original:
"By level, your [buffer1] has
grown by [buffer2]."
entries.translation_source: By level, your [buffer1-1] has grown by [buffer2-2].
entries.translated:
In base al livello, il tuo [buffer1]
è cresciuto di [buffer2].

entries.original:
"Your Pokémon party is full.
Make room, then come see me."
entries.translation_source: Your Pokémon party is full. Make room, then come see me.
entries.translated:
La tua squadra Pokémon è piena. Fai
spazio, poi vieni a trovarmi.

entries.original:
"If you want your [buffer1] back,
it will cost $[green][buffer2][red]."
entries.translation_source: If you want your [buffer1-1] back, it will cost $[color-green-2][buffer2-3][color-red-4].
entries.translated:
Se vuoi riavere [buffer1], ti
costerà $[green][buffer2][red].

entries.original:
"Perfect!
Here’s your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Perfect! Here’s your Pokémon.
entries.translated: Perfetto! Ecco il tuo Pokémon.

entries.original:
"[black][player] took back [buffer1] from
the Day-Care Lady."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] took back [buffer1-3] from the Day-Care Lady.
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ritirato [buffer1] dalla
Signora della Pensione Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Oh? But you have just one
Pokémon.

Come back another time."
entries.translation_source: Oh? But you have just one Pokémon. Come back another time.
entries.translated:
Oh? Ma hai solo un Pokémon. Torna
un{B4}altra volta.

entries.original: "Will you take your Pokémon back?"
entries.translation_source: Will you take your Pokémon back?
entries.translated: Vuoi riprenderti il tuo Pokémon?

entries.original:
"If you leave me that Pokémon,
what will you battle with?

Come back another time."
entries.translation_source: If you leave me that Pokémon, what will you battle with? Come back another time.
entries.translated:
Se mi lasci quel Pokémon, con cosa
combatterai? Torna un{B4}altra volta.

entries.original: "Extreme Hyperosmia"
entries.translation_source: Extreme Hyperosmia
entries.translated: Iperosmia estrema

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show
different Pokémon bred with
Incense items."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show different Pokémon bred with Incense items.
entries.translated:
Aromi dal profumo dolce! Mostra
diversi Pokémon allevati con gli\loggetti Incenso.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Munchlax to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Munchlax to the Pokémon Breeder.
entries.translated:
Aromi dal profumo dolce! Mostra un
Munchlax all{B4}Allevatore Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Wynaut to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Wynaut to the Pokémon Breeder.
entries.translated:
Aromi dal profumo dolce! Mostra un
Wynaut all{B4}Allevatore Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Happiny to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Happiny to the Pokémon Breeder.
entries.translated:
Aromi dal profumo dolce! Mostra un
Happiny all{B4}Allevatore Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Mime Jr. to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Mime Jr. to the Pokémon Breeder.
entries.translated:
Aromi dal profumo dolce! Mostra un
Mime Jr. all{B4}Allevatore Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Chingling to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Chingling to the Pokémon Breeder.
entries.translated:
Aromi dal profumo dolce! Mostra un
Chingling all{B4}Allevatore Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Bonsly to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Bonsly to the Pokémon Breeder.
entries.translated:
Aromi dal profumo dolce! Mostra un
Bonsly all{B4}Allevatore Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Budew to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Budew to the Pokémon Breeder.
entries.translated:
Profumi deliziosi! Mostra un Budew
all{B4}Allevatore Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show an
Azurill to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show an Azurill to the Pokémon Breeder.
entries.translated:
Aromi dal profumo dolce! Mostra un
Azurill all{B4}Allevatore Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Sweet smelling aromas! Show a
Mantyke to the Pokémon Breeder."
entries.translation_source: Sweet smelling aromas! Show a Mantyke to the Pokémon Breeder.
entries.translated:
Aromi dal profumo dolce! Mostra un
Mantyke all{B4}Allevatore Pokémon.

entries.original:
"I’ve been researching the
relationship between [green]Incense[blue] and\lPokémon Breeding.

It’s slow going but would be
faster if someone helped me out.

Say\.

Would you like to help me with my
research?"
entries.translation_source: I’ve been researching the relationship between [color-green-1]Incense[color-blue-2] and Pokémon Breeding. It’s slow going but would be faster if someone helped me out. Say[game-token-3] Would you like to help me with my research?
entries.translated:
Sto studiando la relazione tra
[green]Incenso[blue] e l{B4}Allevamento Pokémon.\lSta andando piano, ma sarebbe più

veloce se qualcuno mi desse una
mano. Ehi\. Ti andrebbe di aiutarmi\lcon la mia ricerca?

entries.original:
"Sigh\.

I guess I’ll have to find someone
else to help me, then."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1] I guess I’ll have to find someone else to help me, then.
entries.translated:
Sospiro\. Immagino che dovrò trovare
qualcun altro che mi aiuti, allora.

entries.original:
"Great!

To start off, please bring me a
[green][buffer1][blue].

I’ve added limited data for
[buffer1] and [buffer2] to your\lPokédex to help you start out."
entries.translation_source: Great! To start off, please bring me a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]. I’ve added limited data for [buffer1-4] and [buffer2-5] to your Pokédex to help you start out.
entries.translated:
Fantastico! Per cominciare, portami
per favore un [green][buffer1][blue]. Ho aggiunto\ldati limitati per [buffer1] e

[buffer2] al tuo Pokédex per
aiutarti a iniziare.

entries.original:
"Have you brought me a [green][buffer1]
[blue]to study?

*Frisk* *Frisk*"
entries.translation_source: Have you brought me a [color-green-1][buffer1-2] [color-blue-3]to study? *Frisk* *Frisk*
entries.translated:
Mi hai portato un [green][buffer1] [blue]da
studiare? *Frisk* *Frisk*

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like it.

Please help me with my research,
and bring me a [green][buffer1][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like it. Please help me with my research, and bring me a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]!
entries.translated:
Non sembra. Per favore aiutami con
la mia ricerca, e portami un\l[green][buffer1][blue]!

entries.original:
"Mmm\.

Smells faintly of [green][buffer3][blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Mmm[game-token-1] Smells faintly of [color-green-2][buffer3-3][color-blue-4][game-token-5]
entries.translated: Mmm\. Sa vagamente di [green][buffer3][blue]\.

entries.original:
"The scent has assailed my
nostrils!

For that, you can have this
[buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: The scent has assailed my nostrils! For that, you can have this [buffer1-1]!
entries.translated:
L{B4}odore ha assalito le mie narici!
Per questo, puoi avere questo\l[buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Please bring me a [green][buffer1][blue] so I
can study it too!

I’ve added limited data for
[buffer1] and [buffer2] to your\lPokédex to help you continue on."
entries.translation_source: Please bring me a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] so I can study it too! I’ve added limited data for [buffer1-4] and [buffer2-5] to your Pokédex to help you continue on.
entries.translated:
Per favore portami un [green][buffer1][blue] così
posso studiarlo anch{B4}io! Ho\laggiunto dati limitati su [buffer1]

e [buffer2] al tuo Pokédex per
aiutarti a proseguire.

entries.original:
"When added on to all of the other
scents you brought me, this scent\lis overwhleming!

It must be because you’ve done it!
You helped me finish my research!

You’ve become a true master
breeder.

Please, you have to take this
rare item!"
entries.translation_source: When added on to all of the other scents you brought me, this scent is overwhleming! It must be because you’ve done it! You helped me finish my research! You’ve become a true master breeder. Please, you have to take this rare item!
entries.translated:
Se si aggiunge a tutti gli altri
profumi che mi hai portato, questo\lprofumo è travolgente! Deve essere

perché ce l{B4}hai fatta! Mi hai
aiutato a completare la mia\lricerca! Sei diventato un vero

maestro allevatore. Per favore,
devi prendere questo oggetto raro!

entries.original:
"When added on to all of the other
scents you brought me, this scent\lis overwhleming!

It must be because you’ve done it!
You helped me finish my research!

You’ve become a true master
breeder.

Please, you have to take this
specially bred Pokémon Egg!"
entries.translation_source: When added on to all of the other scents you brought me, this scent is overwhleming! It must be because you’ve done it! You helped me finish my research! You’ve become a true master breeder. Please, you have to take this specially bred Pokémon Egg!
entries.translated:
Quando viene aggiunto a tutti gli
altri odori che mi hai portato,\lquesto odore è travolgente! Deve

essere perché ce l{B4}hai fatta! Mi
hai aiutato a concludere le mie\lricerche! Sei diventato un vero

maestro allevatore. Per favore,
devi prendere questo Uovo Pokémon\lallevato apposta!

entries.original:
"You received a specially bred Egg
from the Pokémon Breeder!"
entries.translation_source: You received a specially bred Egg from the Pokémon Breeder!
entries.translated:
Hai ricevuto un Uovo allevato
appositamente dall{B4}Allevatore\lPokémon!

entries.original:
"Or, I mean I would give it you, but
you must make space for it, first!"
entries.translation_source: Or, I mean I would give it you, but you must make space for it, first!
entries.translated:
Oppure, intendo dire che te lo
darei, ma prima devi fare spazio!

entries.original:
"You’ve been a great help with my
research!

I feel like now, I can finally
be the Breeder I was meant to be."
entries.translation_source: You’ve been a great help with my research! I feel like now, I can finally be the Breeder I was meant to be.
entries.translated:
Mi sei stato di grande aiuto con le
mie ricerche! Sento che ora posso\lfinalmente essere l{B4}Allevatore che

ero destinato a essere.

entries.original:
"When I was a student in the
Pokémon Breeder’s School, I\llearned that the best way to raise\lloving Pokémon is to battle with\lthem in important battles.

You seem like an important Trainer.
Can you help me raise my Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: When I was a student in the Pokémon Breeder’s School, I learned that the best way to raise loving Pokémon is to battle with them in important battles. You seem like an important Trainer. Can you help me raise my Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Quando ero studente alla Scuola di
Allevatori Pokémon, imparai che il\lmodo migliore per allevare Pokémon

affettuosi è lottare con loro in
lotte importanti. Sembri un\lAllenatore importante. Puoi

aiutarmi a far crescere i miei
Pokémon?

entries.original: "Let’s get started!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s get started!
entries.translated: Cominciamo!

entries.original:
"I can feel my babies getting
stronger already!"
entries.translation_source: I can feel my babies getting stronger already!
entries.translated:
Sento già che i miei piccoli stanno
diventando più forti!

entries.original:
"Thank you for battling with me!

Come back tomorrow to help train
my babies again!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you for battling with me! Come back tomorrow to help train my babies again!
entries.translated:
Grazie per aver lottato con me!
Torna domani ad aiutarmi ad\lallenare di nuovo i miei piccoli!

entries.original:
"Well, I’ll still be here if you
want to help me out later!"
entries.translation_source: Well, I’ll still be here if you want to help me out later!
entries.translated:
Beh, sarò ancora qui se più tardi
vorrai darmi una mano!

entries.original:
"Sometimes, when a boy and girl
Pokémon like each other very much,\lthey lay an Egg!

And the Day-Care couple is kind
enough to hold onto [green]100[blue] of those\lEggs for you!

I wish I could breed Pokémon as
great as they can."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes, when a boy and girl Pokémon like each other very much, they lay an Egg! And the Day-Care couple is kind enough to hold onto [color-green-1]100[color-blue-2] of those Eggs for you! I wish I could breed Pokémon as great as they can.
entries.translated:
A volte, quando un Pokémon maschio
e uno femmina si piacciono molto,\ldepongono un Uovo! E la coppia

dell{B4}Asilo Pokémon è così gentile
da tenerne [green]100[blue] per te! Vorrei poter\lallevare Pokémon forti come loro.

entries.original:
"The Clefairy out in the yard was
captured by a Ranger hailing from\lCrater Town.

Where did he get it from, though?

Last I remember, there were no wild
Clefairy around here\.

No wonder the one in the yard looks
so sad\. it has no friends!"
entries.translation_source: The Clefairy out in the yard was captured by a Ranger hailing from Crater Town. Where did he get it from, though? Last I remember, there were no wild Clefairy around here[game-token-1] No wonder the one in the yard looks so sad[game-token-2] it has no friends!
entries.translated:
La Clefairy nel cortile è stata
catturata da un Ranger proveniente\lda Crater Town. Da dove l{B4}abbia

presa, però? Se ricordo bene, qui
intorno non c{B4}erano Clefairy\lselvatiche\. Non c{B4}è da stupirsi che

quella nel cortile sembri così
triste\. non ha amici!

entries.original:
"There used to be a Clefairy out in
the yard that was left by a Ranger\lhailing from Crater Town.

Where did he get it from, though?

Last I remember, there were no wild
Clefairy around here\."
entries.translation_source: There used to be a Clefairy out in the yard that was left by a Ranger hailing from Crater Town. Where did he get it from, though? Last I remember, there were no wild Clefairy around here[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
C{B4}era una volta un Clefairy nel
cortile che era stato lasciato da\lun Ranger proveniente da Crater

Town. Ma da dove l{B4}ha preso, poi?
Se non ricordo male, qui intorno\lnon c{B4}erano Clefairy selvatici\.

entries.original:
"There are some horrible Trainers
out there who breed, and breed,\land breed\. and when they’re done\lbreeding, they release any Pokémon\lthey don’t want!

How despicable!

You’re not one of those Trainers,
are you?"
entries.translation_source: There are some horrible Trainers out there who breed, and breed, and breed[game-token-1] and when they’re done breeding, they release any Pokémon they don’t want! How despicable! You’re not one of those Trainers, are you?
entries.translated:
In giro ci sono Allenatori
terribili che allevano, allevano e\lallevano\. e quando hanno finito di

allevare, liberano qualsiasi
Pokémon non vogliano! Che schifo!\lTu non sei uno di quegli

Allenatori, vero?

entries.original:
"Ugh, you again! Did you come to
leave more Pokémon with me?"
entries.translation_source: Ugh, you again! Did you come to leave more Pokémon with me?
entries.translated:
Ugh, ancora tu! Sei venuto a
lasciarmi altri Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Ugh! You are?
How despicable!

\.Well, I can’t stop you from
releasing those Pokémon, so how\labout leaving them in my care\linstead?"
entries.translation_source: Ugh! You are? How despicable! [game-token-1]Well, I can’t stop you from releasing those Pokémon, so how about leaving them in my care instead?
entries.translated:
Ugh! Sei tu? Che schifo! \.Beh, non
posso impedirti di liberare quei\lPokémon, quindi che ne dici di

lasciarli in custodia a me invece?

entries.original:
"So to confirm, you want to leave
all Pokémon in Box \qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc\lwith me?"
entries.translation_source: So to confirm, you want to leave all Pokémon in Box [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-red-4][quote-close-5] with me?
entries.translated:
Quindi, per confermare, vuoi
lasciare tutti i Pokémon nel Box\l\qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc con me?

entries.original:
"You will never see any of these
Pokémon again.

Are you absolutely SURE you want
to leave all Pokémon in Box\l\qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc with me?"
entries.translation_source: You will never see any of these Pokémon again. Are you absolutely SURE you want to leave all Pokémon in Box [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-red-4][quote-close-5] with me?
entries.translated:
Non vedrai mai più nessuno di
questi Pokémon. Sei assolutamente\lSICURO di voler lasciarmi tutti i

Pokémon nel Box \qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc?

entries.original:
"Okay, your Pokémon that were in
Box \qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc will now have a\lloving home in my care.

You’re a despicable Trainer and I
wish you would mend your ways."
entries.translation_source: Okay, your Pokémon that were in Box [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-red-4][quote-close-5] will now have a loving home in my care. You’re a despicable Trainer and I wish you would mend your ways.
entries.translated:
Va bene, i tuoi Pokémon che erano
nel Box \qo[green][buffer1][red]\qc avranno ora una\lcasa piena d{B4}affetto sotto la mia

custodia. Sei un Allenatore
spregevole e spero che tu cambi i\ltuoi modi.

entries.original:
"I didn’t think so.
You don’t look the part."
entries.translation_source: I didn’t think so. You don’t look the part.
entries.translated:
Lo pensavo anch{B4}io. Non sembri il
tipo.

entries.original: "Ugh, how despicable!"
entries.translation_source: Ugh, how despicable!
entries.translated: Uff, che schifo!

entries.original:
"Fortunately, you have no Pokémon
in Box \qo[green][buffer1][red].\qc

I won’t be needing to rescue any
Pokémon from you this time."
entries.translation_source: Fortunately, you have no Pokémon in Box [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-red-4].[quote-close-5] I won’t be needing to rescue any Pokémon from you this time.
entries.translated:
Fortunatamente, non hai nessun
Pokémon nella Casella \qo[green][buffer1][red].\qc\lNon avrò bisogno di salvare nessun

Pokémon da te questa volta.

entries.original:
"Everyone knows about Egg Moves.

They’re those special moves
Pokémon can only learn when\lbreeding with another Pokémon\lthat knows one.

But listen here.

I have a special technique that can
move Egg Moves from one Pokémon\lto another!

Provided that they’re in the same
species family, of course.

What do you say, would you like me
to move Egg Moves from one Pokémon\lto another?

It’ll only cost you $[green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Everyone knows about Egg Moves. They’re those special moves Pokémon can only learn when breeding with another Pokémon that knows one. But listen here. I have a special technique that can move Egg Moves from one Pokémon to another! Provided that they’re in the same species family, of course. What do you say, would you like me to move Egg Moves from one Pokémon to another? It’ll only cost you $[color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3].
entries.translated:
Tutti conoscono le Mosse Uovo. Sono
quelle mosse speciali che i Pokémon\lpossono imparare solo quando si

accoppiano con un altro Pokémon che
ne conosce una. Ma ascolta bene. Ho\luna tecnica speciale che può

trasferire le Mosse Uovo da un
Pokémon all{B4}altro! Purché siano\lnella stessa famiglia di specie,

ovviamente. Che ne dici, vuoi che
trasferisca le Mosse Uovo da un\lPokémon all{B4}altro? Ti costerà solo

$[green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Would you like me to move Egg Moves
from one Pokémon to another in the\lsame species family?

It’ll only cost you $[green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Would you like me to move Egg Moves from one Pokémon to another in the same species family? It’ll only cost you $[color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3].
entries.translated:
Vuoi che sposti le mosse uovo da un
Pokémon a un altro della stessa\llinea evolutiva? Ti costerà solo

$[green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon will you be
transferring Egg Moves from?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon will you be transferring Egg Moves from?
entries.translated:
Da quale Pokémon vuoi trasferire le
Mosse Uovo?

entries.original:
"So you’ll be transferring Egg Moves
from [green][buffer1][blue]?

Choose the Pokémon in the
[green][buffer2][blue] family to transfer\lmoves to."
entries.translation_source: So you’ll be transferring Egg Moves from [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]? Choose the Pokémon in the [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6] family to transfer moves to.
entries.translated:
Quindi trasferirai le Mosse Uovo da
[green][buffer1][blue]? Scegli il Pokémon della\lfamiglia [green][buffer2][blue] a cui trasferire

le mosse.

entries.original:
"So you’ll be transferring Egg Moves
from [green][buffer1][blue] to [green][buffer2][blue].

Should the new moves only fill the
remaining space [buffer2] has\lavailable in its moveset, or can\lmoves be deleted if need be?"
entries.translation_source: So you’ll be transferring Egg Moves from [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] to [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]. Should the new moves only fill the remaining space [buffer2-7] has available in its moveset, or can moves be deleted if need be?
entries.translated:
Quindi trasferirai le Mosse Uovo da
[green][buffer1][blue] a [green][buffer2][blue]. Le nuove mosse\ldovranno occupare solo lo spazio

rimanente disponibile in [buffer2]
nel suo set di mosse, oppure le\lmosse possono essere eliminate se

necessario?

entries.original:
"The transfer was a success!
[buffer1] has learned new moves.

And that’ll be $[green][buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: The transfer was a success! [buffer1-1] has learned new moves. And that’ll be $[color-green-2][buffer2-3][color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Il trasferimento è riuscito!
[buffer1] ha imparato nuove mosse. E\lsaranno $[green][buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"If you need to transfer Egg Moves,
come see me anytime!"
entries.translation_source: If you need to transfer Egg Moves, come see me anytime!
entries.translated:
Se devi trasferire delle Mosse
Uovo, vieni a trovarmi quando vuoi!

entries.original:
"I’m afraid you don’t have enough
money for my special technique."
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid you don’t have enough money for my special technique.
entries.translated:
Temo che non tu abbia abbastanza
soldi per la mia tecnica speciale.

entries.original:
"My technique is for Egg Moves,
not Eggs themselves."
entries.translation_source: My technique is for Egg Moves, not Eggs themselves.
entries.translated:
La mia tecnica serve per le mosse
uovo, non per le Uova stesse.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like [buffer1]
knows any Egg Moves.

It won’t be able to transfer any
moves unless it learns some."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like [buffer1-1] knows any Egg Moves. It won’t be able to transfer any moves unless it learns some.
entries.translated:
Non sembra che [buffer1] conosca
alcuna mossa uovo. Non potrà\ltrasferire nessuna mossa a meno che

non ne impari qualcuna.

entries.original:
"Whoops, looks like you already
chose that Pokémon.

Could you choose a different
Pokémon in [green][buffer1][blue]’s family?"
entries.translation_source: Whoops, looks like you already chose that Pokémon. Could you choose a different Pokémon in [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]’s family?
entries.translated:
Ops, sembra che tu abbia già scelto
quel Pokémon. Potresti scegliere un\lPokémon diverso della linea

evolutiva di [green][buffer1][blue]?

entries.original:
"[buffer1] and [buffer2] don’t
belong to the same species family.

My technique only works on Pokémon
that have evolutions in common.

For instance, I can transfer moves
between a Snorunt and a Glalie, or\la Glalie and a Froslass.

I cannot, however, transfer moves
from Snorunt to Vanillite, as they\lshare no evolutions."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] and [buffer2-2] don’t belong to the same species family. My technique only works on Pokémon that have evolutions in common. For instance, I can transfer moves between a Snorunt and a Glalie, or a Glalie and a Froslass. I cannot, however, transfer moves from Snorunt to Vanillite, as they share no evolutions.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] e [buffer2] non
appartengono alla stessa famiglia\levolutiva. La mia tecnica funziona

solo sui Pokémon che hanno
evoluzioni in comune. Per esempio,\lposso trasferire mosse tra uno

Snorunt e un Glalie, oppure tra un
Glalie e una Froslass. Non posso,\lperò, trasferire mosse da Snorunt a

Vanillite, perché non condividono
alcuna evoluzione.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t look like [buffer2] has
any space in its moveset to learn\lnew moves.

If you don’t want me to delete the
moves at the top of its moveset,\lthen choose moves to delete at the\l[green]Move Deleter[blue] in [green]Epidimy Town[blue]."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t look like [buffer2-1] has any space in its moveset to learn new moves. If you don’t want me to delete the moves at the top of its moveset, then choose moves to delete at the [color-green-2]Move Deleter[color-blue-3] in [color-green-4]Epidimy Town[color-blue-5].
entries.translated:
Sembra che [buffer2] non abbia
spazio nel suo set di mosse per\limparare nuove mosse. Se non vuoi

che elimini le mosse in cima al suo
set di mosse, allora scegli le\lmosse da eliminare dal

[green]Cancellamosse[blue] a [green]Epidimy Town[blue].

entries.original:
"Whoops, looks like [buffer1]
already knows the moves it was\lgoing to learn.

I guess I won’t be charging you
after all!"
entries.translation_source: Whoops, looks like [buffer1-1] already knows the moves it was going to learn. I guess I won’t be charging you after all!
entries.translated:
Ops, sembra che [buffer1] conosca
già le mosse che avrebbe dovuto\limparare. Immagino che non ti farò

pagare, dopotutto!

entries.original: "Fill Remaining Space"
entries.translation_source: Fill Remaining Space
entries.translated: Riempi lo spazio rimanente

entries.original: "Delete Old Moves"
entries.translation_source: Delete Old Moves
entries.translated: Cancella mosse vecchie

entries.original: "Dehara City"
entries.translation_source: Dehara City
entries.translated: Dehara City

entries.original: "Dehara City D"
entries.translation_source: Dehara City D
entries.translated: Dehara City D

entries.original: "Dehara City N"
entries.translation_source: Dehara City N
entries.translated: Dehara City N

entries.original:
"Whooa, [buffer1]!

If a Pokémon uses the move [green]Surf[blue],
it can catch a wave!

I’ve seen the move lying around
somewhere in the city, [buffer1]\."
entries.translation_source: Whooa, [buffer1-1]! If a Pokémon uses the move [color-green-2]Surf[color-blue-3], it can catch a wave! I’ve seen the move lying around somewhere in the city, [buffer1-4][game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Whooa, [buffer1]! Se un Pokémon usa
la mossa [green]Surf[blue], può cavalcare\lun{B4}onda! Ho visto la mossa in giro

da qualche parte in città, [buffer1]\.

entries.original:
"Whooa, [buffer1]!

If a Pokémon uses the move [green]Surf[blue],
it can catch a wave!

And if a [green]Fire[blue]-type Pokémon goes to
the volcano, it can ride on [green]lava[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Whooa, [buffer1-1]! If a Pokémon uses the move [color-green-2]Surf[color-blue-3], it can catch a wave! And if a [color-green-4]Fire[color-blue-5]-type Pokémon goes to the volcano, it can ride on [color-green-6]lava[color-blue-7]!
entries.translated:
Whooa, [buffer1]! Se un Pokémon usa
la mossa [green]Surf[blue], può cogliere\lun{B4}onda! E se un Pokémon di tipo

[green]Fuoco[blue] va nel vulcano, può cavalcare
sulla [green]lava[blue]!

entries.original: "dude"
entries.translation_source: dude
entries.translated: amico

entries.original:
"I just can’t stop shopping!

There’s so much variety at the
[green]Dehara Department Store[red]!"
entries.translation_source: I just can’t stop shopping! There’s so much variety at the [color-green-1]Dehara Department Store[color-red-2]!
entries.translated:
Non riesco proprio a smettere di
fare shopping! C{B4}è così tanta\lvarietà al [green]Grande Magazzino di

Dehara[red]!

entries.original:
"It’s my job to make sure this city
stays a beautiful oasis at the edge\lof the desert.

All these trees aren’t natural to
this area.

I planted each and every one
of ’em!"
entries.translation_source: It’s my job to make sure this city stays a beautiful oasis at the edge of the desert. All these trees aren’t natural to this area. I planted each and every one of ’em!
entries.translated:
È mio compito assicurarmi che
questa città resti una splendida\loasi al confine del deserto. Tutti

questi alberi non sono originari di
questa zona. Li ho piantati io, uno\lper uno!

entries.original:
"The history books say the ancient
king of Borrius had his castle\lbuilt in this very spot!

That makes sense - his tomb is
nearby in the Great Desert,\lafter all."
entries.translation_source: The history books say the ancient king of Borrius had his castle built in this very spot! That makes sense - his tomb is nearby in the Great Desert, after all.
entries.translated:
I libri di storia dicono che il re
antico di Borrius fece costruire il\lsuo castello proprio in questo

punto! Ha senso, in fondo la sua
tomba si trova nelle vicinanze, nel\lGrande Deserto.

entries.original:
"Mmm\.

A park at the edge of a desert city
is so relaxing.

Dehara City is just a wonderful
oasis paradise!"
entries.translation_source: Mmm[game-token-1] A park at the edge of a desert city is so relaxing. Dehara City is just a wonderful oasis paradise!
entries.translated:
Mmm\. Un parco al margine di una
città nel deserto è così\lrilassante. Dehara City è

semplicemente una splendida oasi
paradisiaca!

entries.original:
"This house over here is known as
the [green]Double Battle House[blue].

Like the other Trainer Houses, the
Trainers inside can be battled as\lmany times as you want.

It’s a great place for training up
your Pokémon if you’re thinking of\ltaking on the Gym."
entries.translation_source: This house over here is known as the [color-green-1]Double Battle House[color-blue-2]. Like the other Trainer Houses, the Trainers inside can be battled as many times as you want. It’s a great place for training up your Pokémon if you’re thinking of taking on the Gym.
entries.translated:
Questa casa qui è conosciuta come
la [green]Casa delle Doppie Lotte[blue]. Come le\laltre Case Allenatori, i Pokémon

qui dentro possono essere
affrontati quante volte vuoi. È un\lottimo posto per allenare i tuoi

Pokémon se stai pensando di sfidare
la Palestra.

entries.original:
"This cave is known as Rift Cave.

During my research, I discovered
it has many similarities with\lSinnoh’s [green]Turnback Cave[blue].

Could this mean it is somehow
connected to the mysterious\l[green]Distortion World[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: This cave is known as Rift Cave. During my research, I discovered it has many similarities with Sinnoh’s [color-green-1]Turnback Cave[color-blue-2]. Could this mean it is somehow connected to the mysterious [color-green-3]Distortion World[color-blue-4]?
entries.translated:
Questa grotta è conosciuta come
Rift Cave. Durante le mie ricerche,\lho scoperto che presenta molte

somiglianze con la [green]Grotta Ritorno[blue]
di Sinnoh. Potrebbe significare che\lè in qualche modo collegata al

misterioso [green]Mondo Distorto[blue]?

entries.original:
"Aren’t you boiling in those clothes?

What would compel you to wear
that outfit by the desert?"
entries.translation_source: Aren’t you boiling in those clothes? What would compel you to wear that outfit by the desert?
entries.translated:
Non stai bollendo in quei vestiti?
Cosa ti spingerebbe a indossare\lquell{B4}outfit nel deserto?

entries.original:
"What’s with your getup?

You couldn’t have picked a worse
thing to wear out here!

The whole cloak-and-dagger look is
sure to burn you to a crisp!"
entries.translation_source: What’s with your getup? You couldn’t have picked a worse thing to wear out here! The whole cloak-and-dagger look is sure to burn you to a crisp!
entries.translated:
Cos{B4}ha il tuo abbigliamento? Non
potevi scegliere niente di peggio\lda indossare qui fuori! L{B4}aria da

spia e cospiratore ti farà arrosto
in un attimo!

entries.original:
"That outfit you’re wearing really
gives off the aura of \qoChampion\qc,\ly’know?

There’s no one else who could pull
it off but you, Champion!"
entries.translation_source: That outfit you’re wearing really gives off the aura of [quote-open-1]Champion[quote-close-2], y’know? There’s no one else who could pull it off but you, Champion!
entries.translated:
L{B4}outfit che indossi emana davvero
l{B4}aura di \qoCampione\qc, sai? Non c{B4}è\lnessun altro che potrebbe portarlo

così bene, se non tu, Campione!

entries.original:
"Your outfit looks nice and cool!

It’s not perfect for the desert,
but you won’t boil, that’s for sure!"
entries.translation_source: Your outfit looks nice and cool! It’s not perfect for the desert, but you won’t boil, that’s for sure!
entries.translated:
Il tuo outfit è bello e fresco! Non
è perfetto per il deserto, ma di\lsicuro non ti scioglierai!

entries.original:
"Your outift is nice and silvery!

Or is that a golden sheen I
see?

Either way, you’re looking like quite
the hero in that outfit!"
entries.translation_source: Your outift is nice and silvery! Or is that a golden sheen I see? Either way, you’re looking like quite the hero in that outfit!
entries.translated:
Il tuo outfit è bello e argentato!
O forse vedo una sfumatura dorata?\lIn ogni caso, in quel costume

sembri proprio un eroe!

entries.original:
"I tried travelling through the
[green]Great Desert[red] to the east of town,\lbut the sandstorm was too strong.

It kept whipping sand in my face,
and I couldn’t see anything.

Without [green]Go-Goggles[red] to protect my
eyes, it was impossible to go\lanywhere.

I know some guy around here has a
whole collection of them, but he’s\lvery particular about who he gives\lout to."
entries.translation_source: I tried travelling through the [color-green-1]Great Desert[color-red-2] to the east of town, but the sandstorm was too strong. It kept whipping sand in my face, and I couldn’t see anything. Without [color-green-3]Go-Goggles[color-red-4] to protect my eyes, it was impossible to go anywhere. I know some guy around here has a whole collection of them, but he’s very particular about who he gives out to.
entries.translated:
Ho provato a viaggiare attraverso
il [green]Grande Deserto[red] a est della\lcittà, ma la tempesta di sabbia era

troppo forte. Continuava a
sferzarmi la sabbia in faccia e non\lriuscivo a vedere nulla. Senza

[green]Occhialini[red] per proteggere i miei
occhi, era impossibile andare da\lqualche parte. So che un tipo qui

intorno ne ha un{B4}intera collezione,
ma è molto esigente su a chi li dà.

entries.original:
"I tried travelling through the
[green]Great Desert[red] to the east of town,\lbut the sandstorm was too strong.

It kept whipping sand in my face,
and I couldn’t see anything.

If I had Go-Goggles like you, I’d
be able to explore it no problem!"
entries.translation_source: I tried travelling through the [color-green-1]Great Desert[color-red-2] to the east of town, but the sandstorm was too strong. It kept whipping sand in my face, and I couldn’t see anything. If I had Go-Goggles like you, I’d be able to explore it no problem!
entries.translated:
Ho provato ad attraversare il
[green]Grande Deserto[red] a est della città,\lma la tempesta di sabbia era troppo

forte. Mi sferzava la sabbia in
faccia e non vedevo nulla. Se\lavessi dei Go-Goggles come i tuoi,

riuscirei a esplorarlo senza
problemi!

entries.original:
"Whew.

I.\CC0818 Am.\CC0818 Parched.

I could really go for a Soda Pop
right about now\."
entries.translation_source: Whew. I.[control-code-1] Am.[control-code-2] Parched. I could really go for a Soda Pop right about now[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Uff. Io.\CC0818 Sono.\CC0818 assetato. Mi farebbe
proprio comodo una Soda Pop adesso\.

entries.original:
"Hey! That’s a Soda Pop I sense
in your Cube!

Mind sharing it with me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey! That’s a Soda Pop I sense in your Cube! Mind sharing it with me?
entries.translated:
Ehi! Sento un Soda Pop nel tuo
Cube! Ti dispiacerebbe condividerlo\lcon me?

entries.original:
"[black]You shared a Soda Pop with the
Battle Girl."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]You shared a Soda Pop with the Battle Girl.
entries.translated:
[black]Hai condiviso una Gassosa con la
Ragazza Lotta.

entries.original:
"Mmm\.\CC0820 That.\CC0818 Was.\CC0818 Sweet!

Thanks a whole bunch, Trainer!
Here, you can have this."
entries.translation_source: Mmm[game-token-1][control-code-2] That.[control-code-3] Was.[control-code-4] Sweet! Thanks a whole bunch, Trainer! Here, you can have this.
entries.translated:
Mmm\.\CC0820 Questa.\CC0818 È stata.\CC0818 deliziosa!
Grazie mille, Allenatore! Tieni,\lpuoi avere questo.

entries.original:
"Give the [green]Expert Belt[red] to a Pokémon,
and all its super effective attacks\lwill deal more damage!

Sweet, yeah?"
entries.translation_source: Give the [color-green-1]Expert Belt[color-red-2] to a Pokémon, and all its super effective attacks will deal more damage! Sweet, yeah?
entries.translated:
Dai a un Pokémon la [green]Expert Belt[red], e
tutti i suoi attacchi superefficaci\linfliggeranno più danni!

Fantastico, eh?

entries.original:
"You sure are stingy, Trainer.

That’s a habit you should drop if
you know what’s good for you."
entries.translation_source: You sure are stingy, Trainer. That’s a habit you should drop if you know what’s good for you.
entries.translated:
Sei davvero avaro, Allenatore. È
un{B4}abitudine che dovresti perdere\lse tieni alla pelle.

entries.original:
"Whenever I play with sand castles on
[green]Sundays[blue] and [green]Wednesdays[blue], they jump\lup and attack me!

It’s really scary!"
entries.translation_source: Whenever I play with sand castles on [color-green-1]Sundays[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Wednesdays[color-blue-4], they jump up and attack me! It’s really scary!
entries.translated:
Ogni volta che gioco con i castelli
di sabbia la [green]domenica[blue] e il\l[green]mercoledì[blue], saltano su e mi

attaccano! È davvero spaventoso!

entries.original:
"Do you like my sand castle?

I worked really hard to make it!"
entries.translation_source: Do you like my sand castle? I worked really hard to make it!
entries.translated:
Ti piace il mio castello di sabbia?
Ci ho lavorato davvero tanto per\lcostruirlo!

entries.original:
"Wahhhh!

My sand castle is gone!"
entries.translation_source: Wahhhh! My sand castle is gone!
entries.translated:
Wahhhh! Il mio castello di sabbia è
sparito!

entries.original:
"Galavan lowers the bridge to his
Gym while he’s out travelling.

He’ll return eventually, you just
need to be patient."
entries.translation_source: Galavan lowers the bridge to his Gym while he’s out travelling. He’ll return eventually, you just need to be patient.
entries.translated:
Galavan abbassa il ponte del suo
Gym mentre è in viaggio. Prima o\lpoi tornerà, devi solo avere

pazienza.

entries.original:
"Looks like Galavan has raised the
bridge to his Gym!

Now would be a great time to head
in there and challenge him."
entries.translation_source: Looks like Galavan has raised the bridge to his Gym! Now would be a great time to head in there and challenge him.
entries.translated:
Sembra che Galavan abbia alzato il
ponte per la sua Palestra! Ora\lsarebbe il momento perfetto per

entrarci e sfidarlo.

entries.original:
"Looks like Galavan has raised the
bridge to his Gym!

Now’s a great time for aspiring
Trainers to challenge him.

Lucky for you, you already did!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like Galavan has raised the bridge to his Gym! Now’s a great time for aspiring Trainers to challenge him. Lucky for you, you already did!
entries.translated:
Sembra che Galavan abbia alzato il
ponte della sua Palestra! Ora è un\lottimo momento per gli aspiranti

Allenatori per sfidarlo. Per
fortuna, l{B4}hai già fatto tu!

entries.original:
"Aw, jeez\.

I blew all of my money at the
Game Corner!

Looks like I won’t be needing
this anymore!"
entries.translation_source: Aw, jeez[game-token-1] I blew all of my money at the Game Corner! Looks like I won’t be needing this anymore!
entries.translated:
Accidenti\. Ho speso tutti i miei
soldi al Game Corner! Sembra che\lnon mi servirà più!

entries.original: "I always thought I could win\."
entries.translation_source: I always thought I could win[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ho sempre pensato di poter vincere\.

entries.original:
"This apartment is owned by an
illustrious businessman in\lSeaport City.

The apartment is in high demand, so
I’m afraid you will not be able to\lrent it for yourself."
entries.translation_source: This apartment is owned by an illustrious businessman in Seaport City. The apartment is in high demand, so I’m afraid you will not be able to rent it for yourself.
entries.translated:
Questo appartamento è di proprietà
di un illustre uomo d{B4}affari di\lSeaport City. L{B4}appartamento è

molto richiesto, quindi temo che
non potrai affittarlo per te\lstesso.

entries.original:
"I’m pretty lucky for scoring
this apartment!

Everyone knows it’s hard to score
an apartment owned by that guy\ldown in Seaport."
entries.translation_source: I’m pretty lucky for scoring this apartment! Everyone knows it’s hard to score an apartment owned by that guy down in Seaport.
entries.translated:
Sono stato parecchio fortunato a
trovare questo appartamento! Tutti\lsanno che è difficile ottenere un

appartamento di proprietà di quel
tizio giù a Seaport.

entries.original:
"Hey you!
Let me play with your Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Hey you! Let me play with your Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Ehi tu! Fammi giocare con i tuoi
Pokémon!

entries.original:
"[black]The little boy played with
[buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The little boy played with [buffer1-2].
entries.translated:
[black]Il ragazzino ha giocato con
[buffer1].

entries.original:
"But\. but\. but in Magnolia Town, I
play so much with the Pokémon!

They’ve all become super [green]friendly[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: But[game-token-1] but[game-token-2] but in Magnolia Town, I play so much with the Pokémon! They’ve all become super [color-green-3]friendly[color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Però\. però\. però a Magnolia Town,
gioco tantissimo con i Pokémon!\lSono diventati tutti super

[green]amichevoli[blue]!

entries.original:
"I can’t play with an Egg!

I wanna play with a Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t play with an Egg! I wanna play with a Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Non posso giocare con un Uovo!
Voglio giocare con un Pokémon!

entries.original:
"I wanna play with your Pokémon
again tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: I wanna play with your Pokémon again tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Voglio giocare di nuovo con i tuoi
Pokémon domani!

entries.original:
"If you treat your Pokémon nicely,
they will love you in return.

Oh? Let me see your Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: If you treat your Pokémon nicely, they will love you in return. Oh? Let me see your Pokémon[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Se tratti bene i tuoi Pokémon, ti
vorranno bene in cambio. Oh? Fammi\lvedere i tuoi Pokémon\.

entries.original:
"It looks really happy!
It must love you a lot."
entries.translation_source: It looks really happy! It must love you a lot.
entries.translated:
Sembra davvero felice! Deve volerti
molto bene.

entries.original:
"I get the feeling that it really
trusts you."
entries.translation_source: I get the feeling that it really trusts you.
entries.translated:
Ho la sensazione che si fidi
davvero di te.

entries.original:
"It’s friendly toward you.
It looks sort of happy."
entries.translation_source: It’s friendly toward you. It looks sort of happy.
entries.translated:
È amichevole con te. Sembra
piuttosto felice.

entries.original: "It’s quite cute."
entries.translation_source: It’s quite cute.
entries.translated: È piuttosto carino.

entries.original:
"You should treat it better.
It’s not used to you."
entries.translation_source: You should treat it better. It’s not used to you.
entries.translated:
Dovresti trattarlo meglio. Non è
abituato a te.

entries.original:
"It doesn’t seem to like you at all.
It looks mean."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t seem to like you at all. It looks mean.
entries.translated:
Non sembra gradirti affatto. Ha
un{B4}aria cattiva.

entries.original: "Pyukumuku Chucker"
entries.translation_source: Pyukumuku Chucker
entries.translated: Lanciatore di Pyukumuku

entries.original:
"Pyukumuku have been washing ashore
and are scaring away the tourists!
Throw them all back in the ocean."
entries.translation_source: Pyukumuku have been washing ashore and are scaring away the tourists! Throw them all back in the ocean.
entries.translated:
I Pyukumuku stanno arrivando a riva
e stanno spaventando i turisti!\lRimandali tutti nell{B4}oceano.

entries.original:
"The Dehara beach used to be a
popular tourist destination for\lmany tourists from East Borrius.

But their attendance has dwindled
recently ever since Pokémon known\las Pyukumuku began to wash ashore.

They’re spiky and cause injuries
to the tourists who step on them.

I’m in dire need of a Trainer to
throw them back in the ocean.

So what do you say?

Think you’ve got what it takes to
be a [green]Pyukumuku chucker[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: The Dehara beach used to be a popular tourist destination for many tourists from East Borrius. But their attendance has dwindled recently ever since Pokémon known as Pyukumuku began to wash ashore. They’re spiky and cause injuries to the tourists who step on them. I’m in dire need of a Trainer to throw them back in the ocean. So what do you say? Think you’ve got what it takes to be a [color-green-1]Pyukumuku chucker[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
La spiaggia di Dehara era una
popolare destinazione turistica per\lmolti turisti provenienti da East

Borrius. Ma la loro affluenza è
diminuita recentemente da quando i\lPokémon conosciuti come Pyukumuku

hanno iniziato ad arenarsi sulla
spiaggia. Sono spinosi e causano\lferite ai turisti che ci camminano

sopra. Ho un disperato bisogno di
un Allenatore che li rilanci\lnell{B4}oceano. Allora, che ne dici?

Credi di avere ciò che serve per
essere un [green]lanciatore di Pyukumuku[blue]?

entries.original:
"It really doesn’t take much skill!

Besides, being a Pyukumuku chucker
is fun!"
entries.translation_source: It really doesn’t take much skill! Besides, being a Pyukumuku chucker is fun!
entries.translated:
Davvero non ci vuole molta abilità!
E poi, fare il lanciatore di\lPyukumuku è divertente!

entries.original:
"Get every last Pyukumuku on the
beach diving right back to the sea!

Let’s see\.

I can still see [buffer1] Pyukumuku left on
the sand and in need of chucking."
entries.translation_source: Get every last Pyukumuku on the beach diving right back to the sea! Let’s see[game-token-1] I can still see [buffer1-2] Pyukumuku left on the sand and in need of chucking.
entries.translated:
Fai tuffare di nuovo in mare ogni
ultimo Pyukumuku sulla spiaggia!\lVediamo\. Ne vedo ancora [buffer1]

Pyukumuku sulla sabbia e da buttare
via.

entries.original:
"Good job!

You’ve got every last Pyukumuku
that was stranded on the beach\lback into the sea!

You’re a real good worker,
you know?

You have a real knack for
Pyukumuku chucking.

Now they are safe back where they
should be, and the beach is safe\lfor tourists.

And I’ve got your reward ready for
you right here.

Take it!
You’ve earned it!"
entries.translation_source: Good job! You’ve got every last Pyukumuku that was stranded on the beach back into the sea! You’re a real good worker, you know? You have a real knack for Pyukumuku chucking. Now they are safe back where they should be, and the beach is safe for tourists. And I’ve got your reward ready for you right here. Take it! You’ve earned it!
entries.translated:
Bel lavoro! Hai riportato in mare
proprio tutti gli ultimi Pyukumuku\lche erano rimasti sulla spiaggia!

Sei proprio un gran lavoratore,
sai? Hai proprio talento nel\llanciare i Pyukumuku. Ora sono al

sicuro dove devono stare, e la
spiaggia è di nuovo sicura per i\lturisti. E ho qui pronto il tuo

premio per te. Prendilo! Te lo sei
meritato!

entries.original:
"Pyukumuku are one of the most
famous Alolan Pokémon.

But a lot of tourists from
East Borrius don’t understand\ltheir appeal.

It’s a real shame."
entries.translation_source: Pyukumuku are one of the most famous Alolan Pokémon. But a lot of tourists from East Borrius don’t understand their appeal. It’s a real shame.
entries.translated:
I Pyukumuku sono uno dei Pokémon di
Alola più famosi. Ma molti turisti\ldell{B4}Est di Borrius non ne

capiscono il fascino. È un vero
peccato.

entries.original:
"[green]Puke?

Muke\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Puke? Muke[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Puke? Muke\.

entries.original:
"[black]You chucked the Pyukumuku back
into the sea\."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]You chucked the Pyukumuku back into the sea[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [black]Hai rispedito lo Pyukumuku in mare\.

entries.original:
"[black]There are no more Pyukumuku left
on the beach."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]There are no more Pyukumuku left on the beach.
entries.translated:
[black]Non ci sono più Pyukumuku sulla
spiaggia.

entries.original:
"Hi! I am a humble Maid!

My master has a big heart to match
his big belly. He’s a gourmet!

So I am looking for ingredients
that will make his heart jump\lfor joy!

Sniff, sniff\. Sniff, sniff\.

Oh, that aroma!
It smells so gourmet!

Do you have a wonderful ingredient
in your bag?

Would you consider selling it
to me?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! I am a humble Maid! My master has a big heart to match his big belly. He’s a gourmet! So I am looking for ingredients that will make his heart jump for joy! Sniff, sniff[game-token-1] Sniff, sniff[game-token-2] Oh, that aroma! It smells so gourmet! Do you have a wonderful ingredient in your bag? Would you consider selling it to me?
entries.translated:
Ciao! Sono una semplice domestica!
Il mio padrone ha un grande cuore\lda abbinare alla sua grande pancia.

È un buongustaio! Perciò sto
cercando ingredienti che facciano\lbalzare il suo cuore di gioia!

Sniff, sniff\. Sniff, sniff\. Oh, quel
profumo! Sa proprio di\lprelibatezza! Hai un ingrediente

meraviglioso nella tua borsa?
Saresti disposto a vendermelo?

entries.original:
"Sniff, sniff\. Sniff, sniff\.

Oh, that aroma!
It smells so gourmet!

Do you have a wonderful ingredient
in your bag?

Would you consider selling it
to me?"
entries.translation_source: Sniff, sniff[game-token-1] Sniff, sniff[game-token-2] Oh, that aroma! It smells so gourmet! Do you have a wonderful ingredient in your bag? Would you consider selling it to me?
entries.translated:
Sniff, sniff\. Sniff, sniff\. Oh, che
aroma! Ha un profumo così gourmet!\lHai un ingrediente meraviglioso

nella borsa? Lo venderesti a me?

entries.original:
"Oh, it smells so good!

That [green][buffer3][red] of yours is a
very rare ingredient indeed!

Would you take $[green][buffer2][red] for it?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, it smells so good! That [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-red-3] of yours is a very rare ingredient indeed! Would you take $[color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-red-6] for it?
entries.translated:
Oh, che buon odore! Quel tuo
[green][buffer3][red] è davvero un ingrediente\lrarissimo! Lo venderesti per

$[green][buffer2][red]?

entries.original:
"Merci! Thank you!

With this, I can create a superb
menu!

My master will be so surprised!"
entries.translation_source: Merci! Thank you! With this, I can create a superb menu! My master will be so surprised!
entries.translated:
Grazie! Grazie! Con questo, posso
creare un menù superbo! Il mio\lpadrone sarà così sorpreso!

entries.original:
"Hmm\. This is not quite what I’m
looking for.

I don’t think my master will be
satisfied with such a smell\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] This is not quite what I’m looking for. I don’t think my master will be satisfied with such a smell[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Mmh\. Non è proprio quello che sto
cercando. Non credo che il mio\lpadrone sarà soddisfatto di un

odore simile\.

entries.original:
"Aww\. Well, that’s okay.

If you find a gourmet ingredient
for me, please let me know!"
entries.translation_source: Aww[game-token-1] Well, that’s okay. If you find a gourmet ingredient for me, please let me know!
entries.translated:
Oh\. Va bene. Se trovi un ingrediente
gourmet per me, per favore fammelo\lsapere!

entries.original: "Choose Item"
entries.translation_source: Choose Item
entries.translated: Scegli oggetto

entries.original: "Choose Berry"
entries.translation_source: Choose Berry
entries.translated: Scegli Bacca

entries.original:
"I just simply adore ores.

Don’t you have an adorable ore that
shakes my core?"
entries.translation_source: I just simply adore ores. Don’t you have an adorable ore that shakes my core?
entries.translated:
Adoro semplicemente i minerali. Non
hai forse un minerale adorabile che\lmi smuova nel profondo?

entries.original:
"Don’t you have an adorable ore that
shakes my core?"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you have an adorable ore that shakes my core?
entries.translated:
Non hai per caso un adorabile
minerale che mi scuote nel\lprofondo?

entries.original:
"Oh, I do adore the ores!

That [green][buffer3][blue], it’s shaking me!
Will you sell it for $[green][buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I do adore the ores! That [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-blue-3], it’s shaking me! Will you sell it for $[color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]?
entries.translated:
Oh, adoro i minerali! Quel
[green][buffer3][blue], mi fa tremare! Lo vendi\lper $[green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"[black]Handed over [green][buffer1][black] of [green][buffer3][black]
and received $[green][buffer2][black]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Handed over [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-black-4] of [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-black-7] and received $[color-green-8][buffer2-9][color-black-10]!
entries.translated:
[black]Hai consegnato [green][buffer1][black] di [green][buffer3][black]
e hai ricevuto $[green][buffer2][black]!

entries.original:
"The deal is done!
I’ve scored an ore I can adore!"
entries.translation_source: The deal is done! I’ve scored an ore I can adore!
entries.translated:
L{B4}affare è fatto! Ho trovato un
minerale che adoro!

entries.original:
"Huh? What on earth is this?

You can’t shake my core with
an ore so poor!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? What on earth is this? You can’t shake my core with an ore so poor!
entries.translated:
Huh? Cos{B4}è questa roba? Non puoi
scuotere il mio nucleo con un\lminerale così misero!

entries.original:
"Hmmm. My core won’t change.
I hope you sell it to me someday."
entries.translation_source: Hmmm. My core won’t change. I hope you sell it to me someday.
entries.translated:
Mmm. Il mio nucleo non cambierà.
Spero che un giorno me lo venderai.

entries.original:
"Hey, check it out. I’ve got a sweet
deal for ya!

You know how Pokémon like to hide
behind stones or rocks, yeah?

Sometimes they hide cool bones,
too.

If you find a [green]Rare Bone[blue] somewhere,
you should bring it to me.

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: Hey, check it out. I’ve got a sweet deal for ya! You know how Pokémon like to hide behind stones or rocks, yeah? Sometimes they hide cool bones, too. If you find a [color-green-1]Rare Bone[color-blue-2] somewhere, you should bring it to me. I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Ehi, dai un{B4}occhiata. Ho un affare
niente male per te! Sai come ai\lPokémon piace nascondersi dietro

sassi o rocce, vero? A volte
nascondono anche ossa interessanti.\lSe da qualche parte trovi un [green]Osso

Raro[blue], dovresti portarmelo. Ti
ricompenserò bene.

entries.original:
"What’s up?
Did you find a [green]Rare Bone[blue] for me?

Looks like you did.

If you want to sell it, I’ll buy
it from you for $[green]10000[blue]."
entries.translation_source: What’s up? Did you find a [color-green-1]Rare Bone[color-blue-2] for me? Looks like you did. If you want to sell it, I’ll buy it from you for $[color-green-3]10000[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Come va? Hai trovato un [green]Osso Raro[blue]
per me? Sembra di sì. Se vuoi\lvenderlo, te lo compro per $[green]10000[blue].

entries.original:
"If you find any more Rare Bones
come see me.

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: If you find any more Rare Bones come see me. I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Se trovi altre Ossa Rare vieni a
trovarmi. Ne varrà la pena.

entries.original:
"Hey, come see me if you find a
Rare Bone, got it?

I’ll make it worth your while."
entries.translation_source: Hey, come see me if you find a Rare Bone, got it? I’ll make it worth your while.
entries.translated:
Ehi, vieni a trovarmi se trovi un
Osso Raro, capito? Ti ricompenserò\lbene.

entries.original:
"Ha hoo!
You have a Pokédex.

How many Pokémon have you found?"
entries.translation_source: Ha hoo! You have a Pokédex. How many Pokémon have you found?
entries.translated:
Ehi-hoo! Hai un Pokédex. Quanti
Pokémon hai trovato?

entries.original:
"Hoo ha! You’ve found [buffer1] or more!
Now we’re talking! This is for you!"
entries.translation_source: Hoo ha! You’ve found [buffer1-1] or more! Now we’re talking! This is for you!
entries.translated:
Urrà! Ne hai trovati [buffer1] o
più! Ecco che si ragiona! Questo è\lper te!

entries.original:
"Hoo ha!
You’ve only found [green][buffer2][blue].

Come show me your Pokédex again
when you’ve found at least [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: Hoo ha! You’ve only found [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3]. Come show me your Pokédex again when you’ve found at least [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6].
entries.translated:
Hoo ha! Hai trovato solo [green][buffer2][blue].
Tornami a mostrare il tuo Pokédex\lquando avrai trovato almeno

[green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"A Pokémon holding a [green]Binding Band[blue]
can do more continuous damage with\lits trapping moves.

But what’s more important is this.

Have you shown your Pokédex to a
professor?"
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon holding a [color-green-1]Binding Band[color-blue-2] can do more continuous damage with its trapping moves. But what’s more important is this. Have you shown your Pokédex to a professor?
entries.translated:
Un Pokémon che tiene una [green]Binding
Band[blue] può infliggere più danni\lcontinui con le sue mosse di

bloccaggio. Ma la cosa più
importante è questa. Hai mostrato\lil tuo Pokédex a un professore?

entries.original:
"Yawn\.

Raising so many Pokémon from the
Sinnoh region is exhausting\.

Oh!

You seem like a strong Trainer!

How would you like to raise one
for me?"
entries.translation_source: Yawn[game-token-1] Raising so many Pokémon from the Sinnoh region is exhausting[game-token-2] Oh! You seem like a strong Trainer! How would you like to raise one for me?
entries.translated:
Sbadiglio\. Allevare così tanti
Pokémon della regione di Sinnoh è\lstancante\. Oh! Sembri un Allenatore

forte! Ti andrebbe di allevarne uno
per me?

entries.original:
"Yawn\.

Raising so many Pokémon from the
Sinnoh region is exhausting\.

Which of my Pokémon would you like?"
entries.translation_source: Yawn[game-token-1] Raising so many Pokémon from the Sinnoh region is exhausting[game-token-2] Which of my Pokémon would you like?
entries.translated:
Sbadiglio\. Allevare così tanti
Pokémon della regione di Sinnoh è\lestenuante\. Quale dei miei Pokémon

vorresti?

entries.original:
"Oh, alright.

I’ll just have to keep struggling,
then."
entries.translation_source: Oh, alright. I’ll just have to keep struggling, then.
entries.translated:
Oh, va bene. Allora dovrò
continuare a sforzarmi.

entries.original:
"I’m so exhausted\.

But you’re in no state to help me
with a full party of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I’m so exhausted[game-token-1] But you’re in no state to help me with a full party of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sono così sfinito\. Ma tu non sei in
condizioni di aiutarmi con una\lsquadra completa di Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Please raise it well!

If you come back when you have [green][buffer1]
Badges[red], I’ll give you another."
entries.translation_source: Please raise it well! If you come back when you have [color-green-1][buffer1-2] Badges[color-red-3], I’ll give you another.
entries.translated:
Trattalo bene! Se torni quando
avrai [green][buffer1] Medaglie[red], te ne darò\lun altro.

entries.original:
"I have been able to get much more
rest now that I have fewer Pokémon\lto look after!

Thank you for that, Trainer!"
entries.translation_source: I have been able to get much more rest now that I have fewer Pokémon to look after! Thank you for that, Trainer!
entries.translated:
Sono riuscito a riposare molto di
più ora che devo prendermi cura di\lmeno Pokémon! Grazie per questo,

Allenatore!

entries.original: "[green]Turtwig"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Turtwig
entries.translated: [green]Turtwig

entries.original: "[lightgreen]Chimchar"
entries.translation_source: [color-lightgreen-1]Chimchar
entries.translated: [lightgreen]Chimchar

entries.original: "[blue]Piplup"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Piplup
entries.translated: [blue]Piplup

entries.original:
"[black]Oh! The Pokémon has something in
its mouth."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Oh! The Pokémon has something in its mouth.
entries.translated:
[black]Oh! Il Pokémon ha qualcosa in
bocca.

entries.original: "[green]Ooh ooh!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Ooh ooh!
entries.translated: [green]Ooh ooh!

entries.original:
"Hiya!

My grandmother has a business of
teaching Pokémon a move in\lexchange for some Yellow Shards.

If you haven’t had a chance to find
any, let me help you out."
entries.translation_source: Hiya! My grandmother has a business of teaching Pokémon a move in exchange for some Yellow Shards. If you haven’t had a chance to find any, let me help you out.
entries.translated:
Ciao! Mia nonna ha un{B4}attività in
cui insegna mosse ai Pokémon in\lcambio di alcuni Frammenti Gialli.

Se non ne hai ancora trovati,
lasciami darti una mano.

entries.original:
"You’ll be able to shock your
enemies when you learn her move!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll be able to shock your enemies when you learn her move!
entries.translated:
Potrai fulminare i tuoi nemici
quando imparerai la sua mossa!

entries.original:
"Hello there, dearie.

From my many years as a Pokémon
expert, I have gained the ability\lto teach the move, [green]Thunder Punch[red].

However, if you wish for me to
teach one of your Pokémon this\lmove, it’ll cost [green]2 Yellow Shards[red].

What do you say?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, dearie. From my many years as a Pokémon expert, I have gained the ability to teach the move, [color-green-1]Thunder Punch[color-red-2]. However, if you wish for me to teach one of your Pokémon this move, it’ll cost [color-green-3]2 Yellow Shards[color-red-4]. What do you say?
entries.translated:
Salve, tesoro. Dopo i miei lunghi
anni come esperto di Pokémon, ho\lacquisito la capacità di insegnare

la mossa [green]Tuonopugno[red]. Tuttavia, se
vuoi che insegni questa mossa a uno\ldei tuoi Pokémon, costerà [green]2

Frammenti Gialli[red]. Che ne dici?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon should learn
[green]Thunder Punch[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should learn [color-green-1]Thunder Punch[color-red-2]?
entries.translated:
Quale Pokémon dovrebbe imparare
[green]Tuonpugno[red]?

entries.original:
"Please, return as many times
as you wish.

As long as you have [green]Yellow Shards[red],
of course."
entries.translation_source: Please, return as many times as you wish. As long as you have [color-green-1]Yellow Shards[color-red-2], of course.
entries.translated:
Per favore, torna quante volte
vuoi. Naturalmente, purché tu abbia\l[green]Frammenti Gialli[red].

entries.original:
"It appears that you do not have
any Yellow Shards.

You can find them popping up
occassionally in the Great Desert.

If you come back with any, I’ll be
happy to teach your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It appears that you do not have any Yellow Shards. You can find them popping up occassionally in the Great Desert. If you come back with any, I’ll be happy to teach your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
A quanto pare non hai nessun
Frammento Giallo. Puoi trovarli che\lspuntano di tanto in tanto nel

Grande Deserto. Se torni con
qualcuno, sarò felice di insegnare\lal tuo Pokémon.

entries.original:
"I am a balloon man!

And I wish to see a balloon
Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I am a balloon man! And I wish to see a balloon Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Sono un uomo palloncino! E desidero
vedere un Pokémon palloncino!

entries.original:
"Yes! That is it!

Now, I’ll give this to you!
I’ll give you the item, Air Balloon!"
entries.translation_source: Yes! That is it! Now, I’ll give this to you! I’ll give you the item, Air Balloon!
entries.translated:
Sì! Ecco cos{B4}è! Ora te lo darò! Ti
darò l{B4}oggetto, Palloncino!

entries.original:
"A Pokémon who has an [green]Air Balloon[blue]
can float!

Until it gets hurt, it can avoid
[green]Ground[blue]-type moves.

Yes!
I am a balloon man!"
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon who has an [color-green-1]Air Balloon[color-blue-2] can float! Until it gets hurt, it can avoid [color-green-3]Ground[color-blue-4]-type moves. Yes! I am a balloon man!
entries.translated:
Un Pokémon che ha un [green]Palloncino[blue] può
fluttuare! Finché non viene ferito,\lpuò evitare le mosse di tipo [green]Terra[blue].

Sì! Sono un uomo-palloncino!

entries.original: "I am a balloon man!"
entries.translation_source: I am a balloon man!
entries.translated: Sono un uomo palloncino!

entries.original:
"No!
I wish to see a balloon Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: No! I wish to see a balloon Pokémon!
entries.translated:
No! Voglio vedere un Pokémon
pallone!

entries.original:
"Let me tell ya something, young
feller.

To the east of here is a
vast desert.

It is so amazing, that it is
simply called the [green]Great Desert[blue].

Words can’t even begin to
describe it!

However, it’s really difficult to
traverse without the proper gear.

So don’t think ya can just waltz
out there without preppin’ first.

Yer outfit seems a little hot
for the desert, but it’ll do ya a\lgood job of protecting yer body.

As for yer eyes, I’d recommend
getting yerself a good pair of\l[green]Go-Goggles[blue].

In fact, I’d actually be willing to
give ya mine if ya can show me how\lstrong ya are by [green]beatin’ the Gym[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Let me tell ya something, young feller. To the east of here is a vast desert. It is so amazing, that it is simply called the [color-green-1]Great Desert[color-blue-2]. Words can’t even begin to describe it! However, it’s really difficult to traverse without the proper gear. So don’t think ya can just waltz out there without preppin’ first. Yer outfit seems a little hot for the desert, but it’ll do ya a good job of protecting yer body. As for yer eyes, I’d recommend getting yerself a good pair of [color-green-3]Go-Goggles[color-blue-4]. In fact, I’d actually be willing to give ya mine if ya can show me how strong ya are by [color-green-5]beatin’ the Gym[color-blue-6].
entries.translated:
Lascia che ti dica una cosa,
giovanotto. A est di qui c{B4}è un\lvasto deserto. È così incredibile

che è semplicemente chiamato il
[green]Grande Deserto[blue]. Le parole non\lpossono nemmeno cominciare a

descriverlo! Tuttavia, è davvero
difficile attraversarlo senza\ll{B4}attrezzatura adeguata. Quindi non

pensare di poterlo attraversare
senza prepararti prima. Il tuo\lvestito sembra un po{B4} caldo per il

deserto, ma ti proteggerà bene il
corpo. Per quanto riguarda i tuoi\locchi, ti consiglio di procurarti

un buon paio di [green]Occhialini Go[blue]. In
effetti, sarei disposto a darti i\lmiei se mi mostri quanto sei forte

[green]sconfiggendo la Palestra[blue].

entries.original:
"Never mind, looks ya already beat
it.

Great job!

Take these Go-Goggles, and explore
the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Never mind, looks ya already beat it. Great job! Take these Go-Goggles, and explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Lascia stare, sembra che tu l{B4}abbia
già battuto. Ottimo lavoro! Prendi\lquesti Go-Goggles ed esplora il

Grande Deserto!

entries.original:
"Go young feller!

Explore the Great Desert!"
entries.translation_source: Go young feller! Explore the Great Desert!
entries.translated:
Vai, ragazzo! Esplora il Grande
Deserto!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!

I’m Skeli, the main developer of
Pokémon Unbound.

I’m glad you took the time to play
up to this point!

Keep playing, and if you defeat
the Pokémon League, I’d love\lto battle you!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Skeli, the main developer of Pokémon Unbound. I’m glad you took the time to play up to this point! Keep playing, and if you defeat the Pokémon League, I’d love to battle you!
entries.translated:
Ehi, tu! Sono Skeli, il principale
sviluppatore di Pokémon Unbound.\lSono felice che tu abbia trovato il

tempo di giocare fino a questo
punto! Continua a giocare, e se\lsconfiggi la Lega Pokémon, mi

piacerebbe molto lottare contro di
te!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!

I’m Skeli, the main developer of
Pokémon Unbound.

I’m glad you took the time to
complete the game and continue\lexploring!

You wanna have a battle?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Skeli, the main developer of Pokémon Unbound. I’m glad you took the time to complete the game and continue exploring! You wanna have a battle?
entries.translated:
Ehi, ciao! Sono Skeli, il
principale sviluppatore di Pokémon\lUnbound. Sono felice che tu abbia

trovato il tempo di completare il
gioco e continuare a esplorare! Ti\lva di fare una battaglia?

entries.original:
"Sweet!

I’m warning you, though, this isn’t
going to be easy!"
entries.translation_source: Sweet! I’m warning you, though, this isn’t going to be easy!
entries.translated:
Fantastico! Però ti avverto, non
sarà facile!

entries.original:
"Sweet!

Let’s have ourselves a
Double Battle today!

I’m warning you, though, this isn’t
going to be easy!"
entries.translation_source: Sweet! Let’s have ourselves a Double Battle today! I’m warning you, though, this isn’t going to be easy!
entries.translated:
Fantastico! Facciamo una Lotta in
Doppio oggi! Ti avverto, però, non\lsarà facile!

entries.original:
"Sure, no prob.

If you wanna battle me, I’ll still
be here."
entries.translation_source: Sure, no prob. If you wanna battle me, I’ll still be here.
entries.translated:
Certo, nessun problema. Se vuoi
sfidarmi, sarò ancora qui.

entries.original:
"Oh, you don’t have enough Pokémon
to battle me today.

On even dates I like to battle two
on two, so you’ll need more."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you don’t have enough Pokémon to battle me today. On even dates I like to battle two on two, so you’ll need more.
entries.translated:
Oh, oggi non hai abbastanza Pokémon
per combattere contro di me. Nei\lgiorni pari mi piace combattere due

contro due, quindi te ne servono di
più.

entries.original:
"That was a fun battle!
You were a tough opponent!

Come again tomorrow for another
battle!"
entries.translation_source: That was a fun battle! You were a tough opponent! Come again tomorrow for another battle!
entries.translated:
È stata una lotta divertente! Sei
stato un avversario tosto! Torna\ldomani per un{B4}altra sfida!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!
I’m Golche!

The strategies of the Trainers
you faced?

I helped design them!

If you can defeat the Pokémon
League, I’d even be willing to\lshow you my own strategies!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Golche! The strategies of the Trainers you faced? I helped design them! If you can defeat the Pokémon League, I’d even be willing to show you my own strategies!
entries.translated:
Ehi, ciao! Sono Golche! Le
strategie degli Allenatori che hai\laffrontato? Le ho aiutate a

progettare io! Se riesci a
sconfiggere la Lega Pokémon, sarei\lpersino disposto a mostrarti le mie

strategie!

entries.original:
"Hey, there!
I’m Golche!

The strategies of the Trainers
you faced?

I helped design them!

If you want, I’m willing to show
you my own strategy."
entries.translation_source: Hey, there! I’m Golche! The strategies of the Trainers you faced? I helped design them! If you want, I’m willing to show you my own strategy.
entries.translated:
Ehi, ciao! Sono Golche! Le
strategie degli Allenatori che hai\laffrontato? Le ho progettate io! Se

vuoi, sono disposto a mostrarti la
mia strategia.

entries.original:
"Time to face off against the
ultimate strategy!"
entries.translation_source: Time to face off against the ultimate strategy!
entries.translated:
È il momento di affrontare la
strategia definitiva!

entries.original:
"No pressure.

Take your time coming up against a
way to combat my strategy."
entries.translation_source: No pressure. Take your time coming up against a way to combat my strategy.
entries.translated:
Nessuna pressione. Prenditi tutto
il tempo che vuoi per trovare un\lmodo di contrastare la mia

strategia.

entries.original:
"Your strategy was something else!

Let me refine mine, and we can
battle again tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: Your strategy was something else! Let me refine mine, and we can battle again tomorrow!
entries.translated:
La tua strategia era tutta un{B4}altra
storia! Lasciami perfezionare la\lmia, e potremo combattere di nuovo

domani!

entries.original:
"I’m the legacy Pokémon Trainer\.
Thanasis!

It’s thanks to me, you were even
able to get up to this point!

I found and fixed a ton of bugs.

Not to mention, I tested the entire
battle engine from start to finish!

You’re welcome!"
entries.translation_source: I’m the legacy Pokémon Trainer[game-token-1] Thanasis! It’s thanks to me, you were even able to get up to this point! I found and fixed a ton of bugs. Not to mention, I tested the entire battle engine from start to finish! You’re welcome!
entries.translated:
Sono l{B4}Allenatore Pokémon legacy\.
Thanasis! È grazie a me se sei\lpersino riuscito ad arrivare a

questo punto! Ho trovato e corretto
un sacco di bug. Senza contare che\lho testato l{B4}intero motore di lotta

da cima a fondo! Prego!

entries.original:
"I’m the legacy Pokémon Trainer\.
Thanasis!

It’s thanks to me, you were even
able to get up to this point!

I found and fixed a ton of bugs.
