Not to mention I tested the entire
battle engine from start to finish!

Do you want to sample what the
battle engine is capable of by\lbattling Lixdel and me?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the legacy Pokémon Trainer[game-token-1] Thanasis! It’s thanks to me, you were even able to get up to this point! I found and fixed a ton of bugs. Not to mention I tested the entire battle engine from start to finish! Do you want to sample what the battle engine is capable of by battling Lixdel and me?
entries.translated:
Sono il Trainer Pokémon storico\.
Thanasis! È grazie a me se sei\lriuscito persino ad arrivare fin

qui! Ho trovato e corretto un sacco
di bug. Per non parlare del fatto\lche ho testato l{B4}intero motore di

combattimento da cima a fondo! Vuoi
provare ciò di cui è capace il\lmotore di combattimento sfidando

Lixdel e me?

entries.original:
"Unfortunately, we can’t battle you
unless you have two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately, we can’t battle you unless you have two Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Purtroppo, non possiamo affrontarti
a meno che tu non abbia due\lPokémon!

entries.original:
"The legacy Pokémon Trainer\.
Is ready to begin his battle!"
entries.translation_source: The legacy Pokémon Trainer[game-token-1] Is ready to begin his battle!
entries.translated:
Il leggendario Allenatore Pokémon\. È
pronto a iniziare la sua sfida!

entries.original:
"No?
Your loss."
entries.translation_source: No? Your loss.
entries.translated: No? Peggio per te.

entries.original:
"You see?

That battle was only possible
because I helped make sure it\lwas bug-free!

Let’s do this again some other
day."
entries.translation_source: You see? That battle was only possible because I helped make sure it was bug-free! Let’s do this again some other day.
entries.translated:
Vedi? Quella lotta è stata
possibile solo perché ho aiutato a\lfare in modo che fosse senza bug!

Rifacciamolo un altro giorno.

entries.original:
"What’s up?
I’m Lixdel!

I created a large chunk of those
beautiful attack animations you’ve\lbeen seeing."
entries.translation_source: What’s up? I’m Lixdel! I created a large chunk of those beautiful attack animations you’ve been seeing.
entries.translated:
Come va? Sono Lixdel! Ho creato
gran parte di quelle splendide\lanimazioni delle mosse che hai

visto.

entries.original:
"What’s up?
I’m Lixdel!

I created a large chunk of those
beautiful attack animations you’ve\lbeen seeing.

Do you want to experience some by
battling Thanasis and me?"
entries.translation_source: What’s up? I’m Lixdel! I created a large chunk of those beautiful attack animations you’ve been seeing. Do you want to experience some by battling Thanasis and me?
entries.translated:
Ehi, che c{B4}è? Sono Lixdel! Ho
creato una gran parte di quelle\lsplendide animazioni di attacco che

hai visto in giro. Vuoi provarne
qualcuna sfidando Thanasis e me?

entries.original:
"Sorry, you can’t battle us without
two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Sorry, you can’t battle us without two Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Spiacente, non puoi sfidarci senza
due Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Let us show you some beautiful
animations!"
entries.translation_source: Let us show you some beautiful animations!
entries.translated:
Lasciaci mostrarti delle belle
animazioni!

entries.original: "Not ready yet, huh?"
entries.translation_source: Not ready yet, huh?
entries.translated: Non sei ancora pronto, eh?

entries.original:
"That was a great battle with some
great animations!

Come back tomorrow and we can do
this again!"
entries.translation_source: That was a great battle with some great animations! Come back tomorrow and we can do this again!
entries.translated:
È stata una grande lotta con delle
animazioni fantastiche! Torna\ldomani e potremo rifarlo!

entries.original:
"Hi there, I’m Criminon!

I dedicated countless hours to a
ton of the art that you’ve seen.

I’ve sprited Trainers, Pokémon,
interfaces, and much much more.

The hardest thing that I worked on
was definitely the Costume Box.

It was so much work!

I would say my favourite thing that
I did is Cube Space!

I hope you enjoyed it!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there, I’m Criminon! I dedicated countless hours to a ton of the art that you’ve seen. I’ve sprited Trainers, Pokémon, interfaces, and much much more. The hardest thing that I worked on was definitely the Costume Box. It was so much work! I would say my favourite thing that I did is Cube Space! I hope you enjoyed it!
entries.translated:
Ciao, sono Criminon! Ho dedicato
innumerevoli ore a gran parte\ldell{B4}arte che hai visto. Ho

realizzato sprite di Allenatori,
Pokémon, interfacce e molto, molto\laltro. La cosa più difficile su cui

ho lavorato è stata senza dubbio la
Costume Box. È stato un lavoraccio!\lDirei che la mia cosa preferita che

ho fatto è Cube Space! Spero che ti
sia piaciuto!

entries.original:
"Hi there, I’m Criminon!

I dedicated countless hours to a
ton of the art that you’ve seen.

I can’t show you my favorite Pokémon
just yet, but how about you try\lthis team on for size!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there, I’m Criminon! I dedicated countless hours to a ton of the art that you’ve seen. I can’t show you my favorite Pokémon just yet, but how about you try this team on for size!
entries.translated:
Salve, io sono Criminon! Ho
dedicato innumerevoli ore a gran\lparte dell{B4}arte che hai visto. Non

posso ancora mostrarti il mio
Pokémon preferito, ma che ne dici\ldi provare questa squadra!

entries.original: "Now, watch as you get stalled out!"
entries.translation_source: Now, watch as you get stalled out!
entries.translated:
Ora guarda come ti faccio andare in
stallo!

entries.original:
"Yeah, I knew you wouldn’t be able
to handle it.

Toxic stall teams are the best!"
entries.translation_source: Yeah, I knew you wouldn’t be able to handle it. Toxic stall teams are the best!
entries.translated:
Già, sapevo che non saresti stato
in grado di reggere. I team stall\ltossici sono i migliori!

entries.original:
"I’m gonna get back to training and
toughen up my team!

I’ll show you how much better I’ll
be tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: I’m gonna get back to training and toughen up my team! I’ll show you how much better I’ll be tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Tornerò ad allenarmi e renderò la
mia squadra più forte! Ti mostrerò\lquanto sarò migliorato domani!

entries.original:
" to kick my butt.

It was a great battle, Champion!

You’re going places!

By the way, check your 6th item
slot!

\.

Haha!

Just kidding! "
entries.translation_source: to kick my butt. It was a great battle, Champion! You’re going places! By the way, check your 6th item slot! [game-token-1] Haha! Just kidding!
entries.translated: per prendermi a calci nel sedere. È stata una grande lotta, Campione! Farai strada! A proposito, controlla il tuo sesto slot oggetti! \. Ahah! Scherzavo!

entries.original: "Dr. Fuji"
entries.translation_source: Dr. Fuji
entries.translated: Dott. Fuji

entries.original:
"The name’s Fuji.

I made the maps from Seaport City
to Cootes Bog.

And not only that, I’m largely
to thank for the game being done!

Crystal Peak was the last big
obstacle in Skeli’s way, and if I\lhadn’t created the tileset for it,\lthe game never would have been\lfinished!"
entries.translation_source: The name’s Fuji. I made the maps from Seaport City to Cootes Bog. And not only that, I’m largely to thank for the game being done! Crystal Peak was the last big obstacle in Skeli’s way, and if I hadn’t created the tileset for it, the game never would have been finished!
entries.translated:
Mi chiamo Fuji. Ho realizzato le
mappe da Seaport City a Cootes Bog.\lE non solo: in gran parte devo

ringraziare me stesso per il
completamento del gioco! Crystal\lPeak è stato l{B4}ultimo grande

ostacolo sul cammino di Skeli, e se
non avessi creato il tileset per\lquella zona, il gioco non sarebbe

mai stato finito!

entries.original: "Sound Director"
entries.translation_source: Sound Director
entries.translated: Direttore del suono

entries.original:
"I’m the Sound Director!

I make sure all of the music works
properly!

Did you know a whopping 17 people
worked on the completely original\lsoundtrack and custom instruments?

I hope you’ve been enjoying all of
the music so far!"

entries.original: "Do you know what a [green]Gem[blue] is?"

entries.original:
"A Gem is a special type of held
item that powers up a single attack\lin battle.

Each Gem corresponds to a specific
Type and can only power up that\lType of move.

Gems usually disappear after use,
but like most consumable items,\lthey’re returned to you after\limportant battles, such as battles\lagainst Gym Leaders.

Most Gym Leaders in Borrius have at
least one of their Pokémon holding\la Gem, so be wary.

If you’re concerned about this, you
can use the move [green]Incinerate[blue] to\lmelt their Gem first, before they\lhave a chance to use it."
entries.translation_source: A Gem is a special type of held item that powers up a single attack in battle. Each Gem corresponds to a specific Type and can only power up that Type of move. Gems usually disappear after use, but like most consumable items, they’re returned to you after important battles, such as battles against Gym Leaders. Most Gym Leaders in Borrius have at least one of their Pokémon holding a Gem, so be wary. If you’re concerned about this, you can use the move [color-green-1]Incinerate[color-blue-2] to melt their Gem first, before they have a chance to use it.
entries.translated:
Una Gemma è uno speciale tipo di
strumento tenuto che potenzia un\lsingolo attacco in battaglia. Ogni

Gemma corrisponde a un Tipo
specifico e può potenziare solo\lmosse di quel Tipo. Le Gemme di

solito scompaiono dopo l{B4}uso, ma
come la maggior parte degli oggetti\lconsumabili, ti vengono restituite

dopo le battaglie importanti, come
le battaglie contro i Capipalestra.\lLa maggior parte dei Capipalestra

di Borrius ha almeno uno dei propri
Pokémon che tiene una Gemma, quindi\lfai attenzione. Se sei preoccupato

per questo, puoi usare la mossa
[green]Incenerimento[blue] per sciogliere la\lloro Gemma prima che abbiano la

possibilità di usarla.

entries.translation_source: You are his [buffer2-1]! I knew my eyesight was not deceiving me! Your father was, to put it simply, an amazing man. I’m sure if you introduced yourself to people as his [buffer2-2], you would instantly be regarded with much affection. There aren’t many people out there who have not heard of his exploits. It’s a shame he disappeared. If only someone knew what happened to him, I would finally have a sense of closure.

Sei il suo [buffer2]! Lo sapevo che
la mia vista non mi ingannava! Tuo\lpadre era, per dirla semplicemente,

un uomo straordinario. Sono sicuro
che se ti presentassi alle persone\lcome il suo [buffer2], riceveresti

imprese. È un peccato che sia

\."

husband travelled the world in\lsearch of rare Pokémon.

Unfortunately, his search was cut
short when he fell victim to an\luntimely illness.

If you have the Pokémon he’s
looking for, would you please\ltrade with him?

The doctor says that it could help
speed up the recovery if you do."
entries.translation_source: Back in his younger days, my husband travelled the world in search of rare Pokémon. Unfortunately, his search was cut short when he fell victim to an untimely illness. If you have the Pokémon he’s looking for, would you please trade with him? The doctor says that it could help speed up the recovery if you do.
entries.translated:
Ai tempi della sua giovinezza, mio
marito viaggiava per il mondo in\lcerca di rari Pokémon. Purtroppo,

la sua ricerca fu interrotta quando
fu colpito da una malattia arrivata\ltroppo presto. Se hai il Pokémon

che sta cercando, potresti
scambiarlo con lui? Il dottore dice\lche potrebbe aiutare ad accelerare

il recupero, se lo fai.

Pokémon with my husband!

entries.original:
"When Pokémon gain enough
experience, they can evolve and\lgrow stronger.

Some even learn special moves
immediately after evolution.

However, not all Pokémon can
evolve just by battling enough.

Some require special items like
[green]Fire Stones[blue] or [green]Link Stones[blue]."
entries.translation_source: When Pokémon gain enough experience, they can evolve and grow stronger. Some even learn special moves immediately after evolution. However, not all Pokémon can evolve just by battling enough. Some require special items like [color-green-1]Fire Stones[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Link Stones[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Quando i Pokémon accumulano
abbastanza esperienza, possono\levolversi e diventare più forti.

Alcuni imparano persino mosse
speciali subito dopo l{B4}evoluzione.\lTuttavia, non tutti i Pokémon

possono evolversi semplicemente
combattendo a sufficienza. Alcuni\lrichiedono oggetti speciali come

[green]Pietrafocaia[blue] o [green]Link Stones[blue].

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mirskle, likes to
fill his Gym with a dense fog.

Usually, this makes it harder for
attacks to land.

But if you bring a Pokémon
with the abilities [green]Keen Eye[blue] or\l[green]Infiltrator[blue], its attacks will\lland no problem.

[green]Pikipek[blue] and [green]Hoothoot[blue] on [green]Route 2[blue] can
be caught with Keen Eye, so why\ldon’t you head over there and nab\lyourself one of them?"
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mirskle, likes to fill his Gym with a dense fog. Usually, this makes it harder for attacks to land. But if you bring a Pokémon with the abilities [color-green-1]Keen Eye[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Infiltrator[color-blue-4], its attacks will land no problem. [color-green-5]Pikipek[color-blue-6] and [color-green-7]Hoothoot[color-blue-8] on [color-green-9]Route 2[color-blue-10] can be caught with Keen Eye, so why don’t you head over there and nab yourself one of them?
entries.translated:
Il Capopalestra Mirskle ama
riempire la sua Palestra di una\lfitta nebbia. Di solito, questo

rende più difficile colpire con gli
attacchi. Ma se porti un Pokémon\lcon le abilità [green]Sguardofermo[blue] o

[green]Infiltratore[blue], i suoi attacchi
colpiranno senza problemi. [green]Pikipek[blue]\le [green]Hoothoot[blue] sul [green]Percorso 2[blue] possono

essere catturati con Sguardofermo,
quindi perché non vai laggiù e ne\lprendi uno?

entries.original:
"Pokémon with the abilities [green]Keen
Eye[blue] and [green]Infiltrator[blue] can easily land\ltheir attacks in foggy weather.

I don’t think that can happen
anywhere outside of Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon with the abilities [color-green-1]Keen Eye[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Infiltrator[color-blue-4] can easily land their attacks in foggy weather. I don’t think that can happen anywhere outside of Borrius!
entries.translated:
I Pokémon con le abilità [green]Keen Eye[blue] e
[green]Infiltrator[blue] possono colpire\lfacilmente anche con la nebbia. Non

credo che questo possa accadere da
qualche parte fuori da Borrius!

entries.original:
"[green]Flower Paradise[red] is so pretty!

Everywhere you look, there are
different coloured flowers with\ldifferent Pokémon hiding in them!

I caught my [green]Cutiefly[red] up there, and
I used [green]Sweet Scent[red] to make it\leasier to hit Pokémon in the Gym!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Flower Paradise[color-red-2] is so pretty! Everywhere you look, there are different coloured flowers with different Pokémon hiding in them! I caught my [color-green-3]Cutiefly[color-red-4] up there, and I used [color-green-5]Sweet Scent[color-red-6] to make it easier to hit Pokémon in the Gym!
entries.translated:
[green]Flower Paradise[red] è così bello!
Ovunque guardi, ci sono fiori di\lcolori diversi con Pokémon diversi

che si nascondono tra di essi! Ho
catturato lì il mio [green]Cutiefly[red], e ho\lusato [green]Dolce Profumo[red] per rendere più

facile colpire i Pokémon in
Palestra!

"Like repellants, some Pokémon
Abilities like [green]Stench[blue] can also\lhelp keep wild Pokémon away."

Come i repellenti, alcune abilità
Pokémon come [green]Tanfo[blue] possono aiutare\la tenere lontani i Pokémon

selvatici.

Pokémon Gyms as possible.

Poké Marts will sell more items to
you the more Badges you have."
entries.translation_source: You should try to beat as many Pokémon Gyms as possible. Poké Marts will sell more items to you the more Badges you have.

Dovresti provare a sconfiggere il
maggior numero possibile di\lPalestre Pokémon. I Poké Mart

venderanno più oggetti man mano che
avrai più Medaglie.

never thank it enough."

Vengo qui ogni giorno a pregare
Zapdos. Zapdos mi ha salvato una\lvolta, e non potrò mai ringraziarlo

abbastanza.

and relaxing on this bench.

It’s always the most enjoyable part
of my day.

Why don’t you take a break on the
bench next to me?

I assure you, it’s very relaxing.

There’s just something magical
about sitting down on a bench\."
entries.translation_source: Ahh[game-token-1] I love coming out here every day and relaxing on this bench. It’s always the most enjoyable part of my day. Why don’t you take a break on the bench next to me? I assure you, it’s very relaxing. There’s just something magical about sitting down on a bench[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ahh\. Adoro uscire qui ogni giorno e
rilassarmi su questa panchina. È\lsempre la parte più piacevole della

mia giornata. Perché non ti prendi
una pausa sulla panchina accanto a\lme? Ti assicuro che è molto

rilassante. C{B4}è qualcosa di magico
nello stare seduti su una panchina\.

"They say the grass is always
greener on the other side.

That’s especially true in
Epidimy Town.

Just look at the grass here!"
entries.translation_source: They say the grass is always greener on the other side. That’s especially true in Epidimy Town. Just look at the grass here!

Si dice che l{B4}erba sia sempre più
verde dall{B4}altra parte. È\lparticolarmente vero a Epidimy

Town. Guarda un po{B4} l{B4}erba qui!

"Epidimy Town is the epitome
of bliss!

\.

\.

What? You don’t think it’s funny?
Sorry\.

I feel bad now\.

You know what? Take these.
It’ll help me feel better."

Epidimy Town è l{B4}emblema della
beatitudine! \. \. Cosa? Non pensi che\lsia divertente? Scusa\. Ora mi sento

in colpa\. Sai che c{B4}è? Prendi
questi. Mi faranno sentire meglio.

Vorrei che fosse più facile fare

entries.translation_source: I really wanna explore Thundercap Mt! But my mommy says it’s too dangerous ’cause there are a bunch of bad men on the other side.

Voglio davvero esplorare il Monte
Thundercap! Ma la mia mamma dice\lche è troppo pericoloso perché

dall{B4}altra parte ci sono un sacco
di cattivi.

go, make sure you have lots of\lRevives and Paralyze Heals!"
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. can be accessed through that hole down the stairs. It’s really dangerous, so if you go, make sure you have lots of Revives and Paralyze Heals!
entries.translated:
Il Monte Thundercap si può
raggiungere attraverso quel buco\lgiù per le scale. È davvero

pericoloso, quindi se ci vai
assicurati di avere un bel po{B4} di\lRevitalizzanti e Antiparalisi!

If it isn’t [player]!

Marlon told me not to let you
into Thundercap Mt., so you\lcan’t interfere with our plans.

Even if I did let you in, you’d be
toast without the power of\l[green]Mega Evolution[blue].

So don’t you see?

You should stay out here for your
own good."
entries.translation_source: Well, well, well[game-token-1] If it isn’t [player-name-2]! Marlon told me not to let you into Thundercap Mt., so you can’t interfere with our plans. Even if I did let you in, you’d be toast without the power of [color-green-3]Mega Evolution[color-blue-4]. So don’t you see? You should stay out here for your own good.
entries.translated:
Bene, bene, bene\. Se non è [player]!
Marlon mi ha detto di non lasciarti\lentrare nel Thundercap Mt., così

non puoi interferire con i nostri
piani. Anche se ti lasciassi\lentrare, saresti spacciato senza il

potere della [green]Mega Evoluzione[blue].
Quindi non lo capisci? Dovresti\lrestare qui fuori per il tuo bene.

entries.original:
"You placed yourself firmly on
the bench."
entries.translation_source: You placed yourself firmly on the bench.
entries.translated:
Ti sei seduto saldamente sulla
panca.

entries.original:
"Huh? What’s this?

It looks like someone left
something on the bench!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? What’s this? It looks like someone left something on the bench!
entries.translated:
Eh? Cos{B4}è questo? Sembra che
qualcuno abbia lasciato qualcosa\lsulla panchina!

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt. has two different
entrances: one in Epidimy Town, and\lthe other in Antisis City.

These entrances take you to the
peak where Zapdos roosts.

I don’t recommend you use the
entrance by Antisis City, though.

That place is messed up\."
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. has two different entrances: one in Epidimy Town, and the other in Antisis City. These entrances take you to the peak where Zapdos roosts. I don’t recommend you use the entrance by Antisis City, though. That place is messed up[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Thundercap Mt. ha due ingressi
diversi: uno a Epidimy Town e\ll{B4}altro ad Antisis City. Questi

ingressi ti portano alla cima dove
sosta Zapdos. Però non ti consiglio\ldi usare l{B4}ingresso vicino ad

Antisis City. Quel posto è un
casino\.

entries.original:
"I tried exploring Thundercap Mt.
through the nearby entrance once.

The opening where Zapdos is said to
roost goes really high up!

I actually got really dizzy and
fell down while climbing!

The doctor says I now suffer from
minor head trauma.

Take this item, so you don’t have
to worry about head trauma, too."
entries.translation_source: I tried exploring Thundercap Mt. through the nearby entrance once. The opening where Zapdos is said to roost goes really high up! I actually got really dizzy and fell down while climbing! The doctor says I now suffer from minor head trauma. Take this item, so you don’t have to worry about head trauma, too.
entries.translated:
Ho provato una volta a esplorare
Thundercap Mt. dall{B4}ingresso qui\lvicino. L{B4}apertura dove si dice che

Zapdos si posi va davvero molto in
alto! In realtà mi è venuto un\lfortissimo giramento di testa e

sono caduto mentre scalavo! Il
dottore dice che ora soffro di un\llieve trauma cranico. Prendi questo

oggetto, così non dovrai
preoccuparti anche tu di un trauma\lcranico.

entries.original:
"If your Pokémon wears the [green]Rocky
Helmet[red], any Pokémon that touches\lit will suffer from head trauma!"
entries.translation_source: If your Pokémon wears the [color-green-1]Rocky Helmet[color-red-2], any Pokémon that touches it will suffer from head trauma!
entries.translated:
Se il tuo Pokémon indossa [green]Elmo
Roccioso[red], qualsiasi Pokémon che lo\ltocchi subirà un trauma cranico!

entries.original:
"[black]Too bad!

There’s no room in the Cube for
a [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Too bad! There’s no room in the Cube for a [buffer2-2]!
entries.translated:
[black]Peccato! Non c{B4}è spazio per
[buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Huah!
Move boulders with pure power!

Take this!"
entries.translation_source: Huah! Move boulders with pure power! Take this!
entries.translated:
Uah! Sposta i massi con la pura
forza! Prendi questo!

entries.original:
"[green]Strength[blue] lets you move giant
boulders with raw power!

But only if you have the [green]Fall
Badge[blue] from the Fallshore Gym!

Huah!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Strength[color-blue-2] lets you move giant boulders with raw power! But only if you have the [color-green-3]Fall Badge[color-blue-4] from the Fallshore Gym! Huah!
entries.translated:
[green]Forza[blue] ti permette di spostare massi
giganteschi con la forza bruta! Ma\lsolo se hai la [green]Medaglia Autunno[blue]

della Palestra di Fallshore! Huah!

entries.original:
"One day, I’m going to be a ninja!

My parents strike with brute force,
but I’m going to be sneaky!

I’m going to hide in holes in
sand and scare Trainers!"
entries.translation_source: One day, I’m going to be a ninja! My parents strike with brute force, but I’m going to be sneaky! I’m going to hide in holes in sand and scare Trainers!
entries.translated:
Un giorno diventerò un ninja! I
miei genitori attaccano con la\lforza bruta, ma io sarò furtivo! Mi

nasconderò nelle buche nella sabbia
e spaventerò gli Allenatori!

entries.original:
"You know the Pokémon [green][buffer1][red]?
That big adorable pink blob?

I’ve always wanted one, but they’re
just so hard to catch!

Would you be willing to trade one
for my [green][buffer2][red]?"
entries.translation_source: You know the Pokémon [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]? That big adorable pink blob? I’ve always wanted one, but they’re just so hard to catch! Would you be willing to trade one for my [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-red-6]?
entries.translated:
Conosci il Pokémon [green][buffer1][red]? Quella
grossa adorabile massa rosa? Ne ho\lsempre voluto uno, ma sono così

difficili da catturare! Sarebbe
disposto a scambiarne uno con il\lmio [green][buffer2][red]?

entries.original: "That’s too bad."
entries.translation_source: That’s too bad.
entries.translated: Che peccato.

entries.original:
"In what universe is that a [buffer1],
huh?

If you get one, trade it with me."
entries.translation_source: In what universe is that a [buffer1-1], huh? If you get one, trade it with me.
entries.translated:
In quale universo quello sarebbe un
[buffer1], eh? Se ne trovi uno,\lscambialo con me.

entries.original:
"Thank you so much! I’m going to
take good care of it!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you so much! I’m going to take good care of it!
entries.translated:
Grazie mille! Me ne prenderò cura
con attenzione!

entries.original:
"My old [buffer2], has it helped you
win any battles?"
entries.translation_source: My old [buffer2-1], has it helped you win any battles?
entries.translated:
Il mio vecchio [buffer2], ti ha
aiutato a vincere qualche lotta?

entries.original:
"Do you see that item on the table?

That is my prized possession,
the [green]Master Ball[red].

It is a rare Poké Ball that can
capture any Pokémon without fail.

The man who gave it to me, [green]Aros[red],
said to watch over it as if my life\ldepended on it.

That is until someone shows me a
small purple Pokémon, [green]Hoopa[red].

Aros said the one who controls
Hoopa is the Guardian of Borrius\land worthy of this Ball.

Are you the Guardian of Borrius,
or just another brat?"
entries.translation_source: Do you see that item on the table? That is my prized possession, the [color-green-1]Master Ball[color-red-2]. It is a rare Poké Ball that can capture any Pokémon without fail. The man who gave it to me, [color-green-3]Aros[color-red-4], said to watch over it as if my life depended on it. That is until someone shows me a small purple Pokémon, [color-green-5]Hoopa[color-red-6]. Aros said the one who controls Hoopa is the Guardian of Borrius and worthy of this Ball. Are you the Guardian of Borrius, or just another brat?
entries.translated:
Vedi quell{B4}oggetto sul tavolo? È il
mio possedimento più prezioso, la\l[green]Master Ball[red]. È una rara Poké Ball

che può catturare qualsiasi Pokémon
senza fallire. L{B4}uomo che me l{B4}ha\ldata, [green]Aros[red], ha detto di custodirla

come se ne andasse della mia vita.
Finché qualcuno non mi mostra un\lpiccolo Pokémon viola, [green]Hoopa[red]. Aros

ha detto che chi controlla Hoopa è
il Guardiano di Borrius ed è degno\ldi questa Ball. Sei tu il Guardiano

di Borrius o solo un altro
moccioso?

entries.original:
"Really?
Prove it to me!

Show me the Pokémon known
as [green]Hoopa[red]!"
entries.translation_source: Really? Prove it to me! Show me the Pokémon known as [color-green-1]Hoopa[color-red-2]!
entries.translated:
Davvero? Dimostramelo! Fammi vedere
il Pokémon conosciuto come [green]Hoopa[red]!

entries.original:
"That is Hoopa!
That is Hoopa!

You are the Guardian of Borrius!
Take the Master Ball!"
entries.translation_source: That is Hoopa! That is Hoopa! You are the Guardian of Borrius! Take the Master Ball!
entries.translated:
Quello è Hoopa! Quello è Hoopa! Sei
il Guardiano di Borrius! Prendi la\lMaster Ball!

entries.original:
"Then, I have no time for you.
Shoo! Shoo!"
entries.translation_source: Then, I have no time for you. Shoo! Shoo!
entries.translated:
Allora non ho tempo per te. Via!
Via!

entries.original:
"That is not Hoopa!

I have no time for you!
Shoo! Shoo!"
entries.translation_source: That is not Hoopa! I have no time for you! Shoo! Shoo!
entries.translated:
Quello non è Hoopa! Non ho tempo
per te! Via! Via!

entries.original:
"Guardian of Borrius!
It is pleasure being in your midst!"
entries.translation_source: Guardian of Borrius! It is pleasure being in your midst!
entries.translated:
Guardiano di Borrius! È un piacere
essere in mezzo a voi!

entries.original: "[player] found one Master Ball!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] found one Master Ball!
entries.translated:
[player] ha trovato una Master
Ball!

entries.original:
"Thief! Put that back!
That’s my prized possession!"
entries.translation_source: Thief! Put that back! That’s my prized possession!
entries.translated:
Ladro! Rimettilo a posto! È il mio
bene più prezioso!

entries.original:
"The last Guardian of Borrius, [green]Aros[blue],
tasked several older couples with\lguarding rare or powerful objects.

We are one such couple.

Another couple, I believe, lives
on Route 9."
entries.translation_source: The last Guardian of Borrius, [color-green-1]Aros[color-blue-2], tasked several older couples with guarding rare or powerful objects. We are one such couple. Another couple, I believe, lives on Route 9.
entries.translated:
L{B4}ultimo Guardiano di Borrius,
[green]Aros[blue], affidò a diverse coppie\lanziane il compito di custodire

oggetti rari o potenti. Noi siamo
una di quelle coppie. Un{B4}altra\lcoppia, credo, vive sulla Route 9.

entries.original:
"I’m the Fishing Dude’s older
brother.

I simply looove fishing!
I can’t bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Fishing Dude’s older brother. I simply looove fishing! I can’t bear to go without. Tell me, do you like to fish?
entries.translated:
Sono il fratello maggiore del Tipo
della Pesca. Adoro la pesca! Non\lsopporto di restarne senza. Dimmi,

ti piace pescare?

entries.original:
"Grand! I like your style.
I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!"
entries.translation_source: Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends. Take this and fish, young friend!
entries.translated:
Grandioso! Mi piace il tuo stile.
Penso che potremmo essere amici.\lPrendi questo e vai a pescare,

giovane amico!

entries.original:
"Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.

A crummy Old Rod can only catch
Magikarp, yes?

But with a Good Rod, you can
catch much better Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry. A crummy Old Rod can only catch Magikarp, yes? But with a Good Rod, you can catch much better Pokémon.
entries.translated:
La pesca è uno stile di vita! È
come la poesia più raffinata. Una\lmisera Vecchia Canna può catturare

solo Magikarp, giusto? Ma con una
Buona Canna puoi pescare Pokémon\lmolto migliori.

entries.original:
"Oh\.
That’s so disappointing\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] That’s so disappointing[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Che delusione\.

entries.original:
"Hello there, [player]!

How are the fish biting?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, [player-name-1]! How are the fish biting?
entries.translated:
Ciao, [player]! Come abboccano i
pesci?

entries.original:
"Do you plan on exploring
Thundercap Mt.?

If you do, you’re going to
need these!"
entries.translation_source: Do you plan on exploring Thundercap Mt.? If you do, you’re going to need these!
entries.translated:
Hai intenzione di esplorare il
Monte Thundercap? Se sì, ti\lserviranno!

entries.original:
"It never hurts to be prepared
for anything!"
entries.translation_source: It never hurts to be prepared for anything!
entries.translated:
Non fa mai male essere preparati a
tutto!

entries.original:
"Thundercap Mt. is a dangerous
place!

I tried exploring it once, but oh
boy, I got smoked!

Ever since then, my lovely wife has
been giving Max Repels daily to any\ltravellers who talk to her."
entries.translation_source: Thundercap Mt. is a dangerous place! I tried exploring it once, but oh boy, I got smoked! Ever since then, my lovely wife has been giving Max Repels daily to any travellers who talk to her.
entries.translated:
Il Monte Thundercap è un posto
pericoloso! Ho provato a esplorarlo\luna volta, ma cavolo, me la sono

vista brutta! Da allora, la mia
adorabile moglie distribuisce\lRepellenti Max ogni giorno a

qualsiasi viaggiatore che le parli.

entries.original:
"Uh\.
Er, yes, I’m the Move Deleter.

I can make Pokémon forget their
moves.

Would you like me to do that?"
entries.translation_source: Uh[game-token-1] Er, yes, I’m the Move Deleter. I can make Pokémon forget their moves. Would you like me to do that?
entries.translated:
Uh\. Er, sì, sono il Cancellamosse.
Posso far dimenticare le mosse ai\lPokémon. Vuoi che lo faccia?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon should forget a
move?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should forget a move?
entries.translated:
Quale Pokémon dovrebbe dimenticare
una mossa?

entries.original: "Which move should be forgotten?"
entries.translation_source: Which move should be forgotten?
entries.translated:
Quale mossa dovrebbe essere
dimenticata?

entries.original:
"Hm! [green][buffer1][blue]’s [green][buffer2][blue]?
That move should be forgotten?"
entries.translation_source: Hm! [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]’s [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]? That move should be forgotten?
entries.translated:
Uhm! [green][buffer1][blue] di [green][buffer2][blue]? Questa
mossa va dimenticata?

entries.original:
"It worked to perfection!

[buffer1] has forgotten
[buffer2] completely."
entries.translation_source: It worked to perfection! [buffer1-1] has forgotten [buffer2-2] completely.
entries.translated:
Ha funzionato alla perfezione!
[buffer1] ha dimenticato\lcompletamente [buffer2].

entries.original:
"[buffer1] seems to know only one
move\."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] seems to know only one move[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[buffer1] sembra conoscere una sola
mossa\.

entries.original:
"What?
No Egg should know any moves."
entries.translation_source: What? No Egg should know any moves.
entries.translated:
Cosa? Nessun Uovo dovrebbe
conoscere mosse.

entries.original:
"Come again if there are other
moves to be forgotten."
entries.translation_source: Come again if there are other moves to be forgotten.
entries.translated:
Torna pure se ci sono altre mosse
da dimenticare.

entries.original:
"If you’re working on a Pokédex,
visit [green]Thundercap Mt.[red]!

All sorts of rare Electric-type
Pokémon live there.

It’s even said that Zapdos roosts
at the peak!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re working on a Pokédex, visit [color-green-1]Thundercap Mt.[color-red-2]! All sorts of rare Electric-type Pokémon live there. It’s even said that Zapdos roosts at the peak!
entries.translated:
Se stai lavorando al Pokédex,
visita [green]Thundercap Mt.[red]! Lì vivono\lPokémon di tipo Elettro di ogni

genere, anche molto rari. Si dice
persino che Zapdos si appolli sulla\lcima!

entries.original:
"A [green]Dusk Ball[blue] is one of the best
Balls you could use at night or\lin a cave.

It’s much more useful than the
inferior Ultra Ball.

Plus, it has the most excellent
name!

Dusk!
The Dusk Ball!

I believe it can even catch
and control the darkness found\lin hearts."
entries.translation_source: A [color-green-1]Dusk Ball[color-blue-2] is one of the best Balls you could use at night or in a cave. It’s much more useful than the inferior Ultra Ball. Plus, it has the most excellent name! Dusk! The Dusk Ball! I believe it can even catch and control the darkness found in hearts.
entries.translated:
Una [green]Ocaso Ball[blue] è una delle migliori
Ball che puoi usare di notte o in\luna grotta. È molto più utile della

inferiore Ultra Ball. Inoltre, ha
il nome più eccellente! Ocaso! La\lOcaso Ball! Credo che possa persino

catturare e controllare l{B4}oscurità
che si trova nei cuori.

entries.original:
"I hear Hyper Potions are diluted in
other regions to be less potent.

Whoever came up with that idea is
a thief and a crook."
entries.translation_source: I hear Hyper Potions are diluted in other regions to be less potent. Whoever came up with that idea is a thief and a crook.
entries.translated:
Sento dire che le Iperpozioni
vengono diluite in altre regioni\lper essere meno potenti. Chiunque

abbia avuto questa idea è un ladro
e un truffatore.

entries.original: "Fallshore City"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City
entries.translated: Città di Fallshore

entries.original: "Fallshore City D"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City D
entries.translated: Città Fallshore D

entries.original: "Fallshore City N"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City N
entries.translated: Città Fallshore N

entries.original:
"Heya!

Get your stat reducing items here!"
entries.translation_source: Heya! Get your stat reducing items here!
entries.translated:
Ehi! Qui trovi gli strumenti che
riducono le statistiche!

entries.original:
"Huah!

Get your stat boosting items here!"
entries.translation_source: Huah! Get your stat boosting items here!
entries.translated:
Huah! Qui trovi gli strumenti che
aumentano le statistiche!

entries.original:
"How’d you like some Moomoo Milk?

It’s the pride and joy of
Magnolia Town!

Give it to a Pokémon to restore
HP!

I’ll give it to you for just $550."
entries.translation_source: How’d you like some Moomoo Milk? It’s the pride and joy of Magnolia Town! Give it to a Pokémon to restore HP! I’ll give it to you for just $550.
entries.translated:
Che ne dici di un po{B4} di Latte
Mumu? È l{B4}orgoglio e la gioia di\lMagnolia Town! Dallo a un Pokémon

per ripristinare i PS! Te lo vendo
per soli $550.

entries.original: "And that’ll be $550!"
entries.translation_source: And that’ll be $550!
entries.translated: E saranno $550!

entries.original: "And that’ll be $6600!"
entries.translation_source: And that’ll be $6600!
entries.translated: E saranno 6600 $!

entries.original:
"Aye, I do deliveries from the
Antisis Port during the day.

Without me, there’d be no
Fallshore Market!"
entries.translation_source: Aye, I do deliveries from the Antisis Port during the day. Without me, there’d be no Fallshore Market!
entries.translated:
Aye, faccio consegne dall{B4}Antisis
Port durante il giorno. Senza di\lme, non ci sarebbe il Fallshore

Market!

entries.original:
"Aye, I just finished delivering
goods to all the Poké Marts.

Soon, I’ll be heading back to
Antisis City for the night.

But it looks like I still have
some leftover items.

How about instead of tossing ’em,
I let you have ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Aye, I just finished delivering goods to all the Poké Marts. Soon, I’ll be heading back to Antisis City for the night. But it looks like I still have some leftover items. How about instead of tossing ’em, I let you have ’em!
entries.translated:
Sì, ho appena finito di consegnare
merci a tutti i Poké Market. Fra\lpoco tornerò ad Antisis City per la

notte. Però sembra che mi siano
rimasti ancora alcuni oggetti. Che\lne dici se, invece di buttarli, li

lascio a te!

entries.original:
"Aye, I just finished delivering
goods to all the Poké Marts.

Soon, I’ll be heading back to
Antisis City for the night."
entries.translation_source: Aye, I just finished delivering goods to all the Poké Marts. Soon, I’ll be heading back to Antisis City for the night.
entries.translated:
Sì, ho appena finito di consegnare
la merce a tutti i Poké Market.\lPresto tornerò ad Antisis City per

stanotte.

entries.original:
"Whenever I’m battling in the
[green]Inverse Battle House[blue], I try to\lmake the most of the effectiveness\larrows shown when selecting a move.

It’s a lot easier than actually
knowing what’s good on what,\lya catch my drift?"
entries.translation_source: Whenever I’m battling in the [color-green-1]Inverse Battle House[color-blue-2], I try to make the most of the effectiveness arrows shown when selecting a move. It’s a lot easier than actually knowing what’s good on what, ya catch my drift?
entries.translated:
Ogni volta che combatto nella [green]Casa
delle Battaglie Inverse[blue], cerco di\lsfruttare al massimo le frecce

dell{B4}efficacia mostrate quando
selezioni una mossa. È molto più\lfacile che capire davvero cosa è

efficace contro cosa, capisci cosa
intendo?

entries.original:
"I heard from a friend that under
[green]Tehl Town[red], that tiny town to the\lwest of here, is a secret\lunderground passage to [green]Route 9[red].

But there can’t actually be\.
Come on! Who’d believe that?"
entries.translation_source: I heard from a friend that under [color-green-1]Tehl Town[color-red-2], that tiny town to the west of here, is a secret underground passage to [color-green-3]Route 9[color-red-4]. But there can’t actually be[game-token-5] Come on! Who’d believe that?
entries.translated:
Ho sentito da un amico che sotto
[green]Tehl Town[red], quella cittadina\lminuscola a ovest di qui, c{B4}è un

passaggio sotterraneo segreto fino
a [green]Percorso 9[red]. Ma non può davvero\lesserci\. Dai! Chi ci crederebbe?

entries.original:
"You’d never catch me outside when
it’s raining!

\.

Actually, most people here would
probably head indoors."
entries.translation_source: You’d never catch me outside when it’s raining! [game-token-1] Actually, most people here would probably head indoors.
entries.translated:
Non mi vedresti mai fuori quando
piove! \. In realtà, la maggior parte\ldella gente qui probabilmente

rientrerebbe.

entries.original:
"Mel’s Gym is a complicated maze of
ponds, lily pads, and waterfalls.

It originally belonged to the
Water-type Gym Leader, Tessy.

When she moved back to East
Borrius, Mel took over the Gym.

He was too busy working on his
perfectly toned body to redesign\lthe entire Gym, so now he runs his\l[green]Normal[blue]-type Gym in a place that’s\lfull of water."
entries.translation_source: Mel’s Gym is a complicated maze of ponds, lily pads, and waterfalls. It originally belonged to the Water-type Gym Leader, Tessy. When she moved back to East Borrius, Mel took over the Gym. He was too busy working on his perfectly toned body to redesign the entire Gym, so now he runs his [color-green-1]Normal[color-blue-2]-type Gym in a place that’s full of water.
entries.translated:
La Palestra di Mel è un complicato
labirinto di stagni, ninfee e\lcascate. Apparteneva

originariamente alla Capopalestra
di tipo Acqua, Tessy. Quando si è\ltrasferita di nuovo a East Borrius,

Mel ha rilevato la Palestra. Era
troppo impegnato a scolpire il suo\lcorpo perfettamente tonico per

riprogettare l{B4}intera Palestra,
quindi ora gestisce la sua Palestra\ldi tipo [green]Normale[blue] in un luogo pieno

d{B4}acqua.

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, comes out
here often with some of his\lcloser friends."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, comes out here often with some of his closer friends.
entries.translated:
Mel, il Capopalestra, viene qui
spesso con alcuni dei suoi amici\lpiù stretti.

entries.original:
"Apparently, Mel has his own private
island somewhere out in the ocean!"
entries.translation_source: Apparently, Mel has his own private island somewhere out in the ocean!
entries.translated:
Pare che Mel abbia una sua isola
privata da qualche parte\lnell{B4}oceano!

entries.original:
"The [green]Moomoo Milk[red] they sell here is
so sweet!

I buy a dozen at once each time
I come here!"
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Moomoo Milk[color-red-2] they sell here is so sweet! I buy a dozen at once each time I come here!
entries.translated:
Il [green]Latte Mumu[red] che vendono qui è
così dolce! Ne compro una dozzina\lalla volta ogni volta che vengo

qui!

entries.original:
"My umbrella always protects me
when it’s raining!"
entries.translation_source: My umbrella always protects me when it’s raining!
entries.translated:
Il mio ombrello mi protegge sempre
quando piove!

entries.original:
"There are a whole bunch of useful
items for Trainers here!

My favourites are the Berries
they sell.

They reduce Effort Values by
a whole ten points!"
entries.translation_source: There are a whole bunch of useful items for Trainers here! My favourites are the Berries they sell. They reduce Effort Values by a whole ten points!
entries.translated:
Qui ci sono un sacco di oggetti
utili per gli Allenatori! I miei\lpreferiti sono le Bacche che

vendono. Riduccono i Punti Effort
di ben dieci punti!

entries.original:
"I hate it when it rains.

I don’t live here, so it’s not like
I can go inside like everyone else\."
entries.translation_source: I hate it when it rains. I don’t live here, so it’s not like I can go inside like everyone else[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Detesto quando piove. Non vivo qui,
quindi non è che possa andare\ldentro come fanno tutti gli altri\.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

How do I get the TM contained in
that yellow Poké Ball\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] How do I get the TM contained in that yellow Poké Ball[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Hm\. Come faccio a prendere la MT
contenuta in quella Poké Ball\lgialla\.

entries.original:
"Wow!

I saw you glide up that waterfall
like an angel and grab that TM!

Good job!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! I saw you glide up that waterfall like an angel and grab that TM! Good job!
entries.translated:
Wow! Ti ho visto risalire quella
cascata scivolando come un angelo e\lprendere quella MT! Bel lavoro!

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here
right now.

He’s probably off clearing his
head somewhere."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here right now. He’s probably off clearing his head somewhere.
entries.translated:
Mel, il Capopalestra, non è qui in
questo momento. Probabilmente è\landato a schiarirsi le idee da

qualche parte.

entries.original:
"Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here
right now.

He’s probably off clearing his head
by the [green]KBT Expressway[red] in [green]Tehl Town[red]."
entries.translation_source: Mel, the Gym Leader, isn’t here right now. He’s probably off clearing his head by the [color-green-1]KBT Expressway[color-red-2] in [color-green-3]Tehl Town[color-red-4].
entries.translated:
Mel, il Capopalestra, non è qui
adesso. Probabilmente è andato a\lschiarirsi le idee vicino alla [green]KBT

Expressway[red] a [green]Tehl Town[red].

entries.original:
"My hidden power is telling me that
you want this!"
entries.translation_source: My hidden power is telling me that you want this!
entries.translated:
Il mio potere nascosto mi dice che
vuoi questo!

entries.original:
"[green]Hidden Power[blue] is a special move
that changes type depending on\lwhich Pokémon uses it."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hidden Power[color-blue-2] is a special move that changes type depending on which Pokémon uses it.
entries.translated:
[green]Introforza[blue] è una mossa speciale che
cambia tipo a seconda del Pokémon\lche la usa.

entries.original:
"I can tell you which type of
Hidden Power your Pokémon\lwill learn!

Do you want to know?"
entries.translation_source: I can tell you which type of Hidden Power your Pokémon will learn! Do you want to know?
entries.translated:
Posso dirti quale tipo di
Introforza imparerà il tuo Pokémon!\lVuoi saperlo?

entries.original:
"If [green][buffer1][blue] were to learn
Hidden Power, the move’s type\lwould be [green][buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: If [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] were to learn Hidden Power, the move’s type would be [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]!
entries.translated:
Se [green][buffer1][blue] imparasse Forza
Nascosta, il tipo della mossa\lsarebbe [green][buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"If you want to know, ask me, and
I’ll activate my hidden power!"
entries.translation_source: If you want to know, ask me, and I’ll activate my hidden power!
entries.translated:
Se vuoi saperlo, chiedimelo e
attiverò il mio potere nascosto!

entries.original:
"It’s not possible for an Egg to
use Hidden Power!"
entries.translation_source: It’s not possible for an Egg to use Hidden Power!
entries.translated:
Non è possibile che un Uovo usi
Introforza!

entries.original:
"Young Trainer.

I have been carrying around this
Egg with me ever since it was laid.

However, I am willing to give it to
a healthy young person.

Would you like to hatch the [green]Egg[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Young Trainer. I have been carrying around this Egg with me ever since it was laid. However, I am willing to give it to a healthy young person. Would you like to hatch the [color-green-1]Egg[color-red-2]?
entries.translated:
Giovane Allenatore. Porto con me
questo Uovo da quando è stato\ldeposto. Tuttavia, sono disposto a

darlo a una persona giovane e in
salute. Vuoi far schiudere il [green]Uovo[red]?

entries.original:
"Here.
Please take good care of it.

It is a very special Egg."
entries.translation_source: Here. Please take good care of it. It is a very special Egg.
entries.translated:
Ecco. Per favore, abbine molta
cura. È un Uovo molto speciale.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received an Egg from
the kindly old woman!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received an Egg from the kindly old woman!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto un Uovo dalla
gentile anziana!

entries.original:
"The Egg belongs to a special
Pokémon.

Nowadays, it is considered by
many to be a Fairy."
entries.translation_source: The Egg belongs to a special Pokémon. Nowadays, it is considered by many to be a Fairy.
entries.translated:
L{B4}Uovo appartiene a un Pokémon
speciale. Oggi, molti lo\lconsiderano un Pokémon di tipo

Folletto.

entries.original:
"As you wish, then\.

If you have a change of heart about
hatching this Egg, I will be here."
entries.translation_source: As you wish, then[game-token-1] If you have a change of heart about hatching this Egg, I will be here.
entries.translated:
Come desideri, allora\. Se cambi idea
riguardo alla schiusa di questo\lUovo, io sarò qui.

entries.original:
"Oh? You’ve too many Pokémon.
There’s no room for this Egg\."
entries.translation_source: Oh? You’ve too many Pokémon. There’s no room for this Egg[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh? Hai troppi Pokémon. Non c{B4}è
spazio per questo Uovo\.

entries.original:
"An odd Pokémon Egg obtained
as a gift."
entries.translation_source: An odd Pokémon Egg obtained as a gift.
entries.translated: Un insolito Uovo Pokémon ottenuto in regalo.

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mel, lives here
when he’s not on Gym duty or\lstaring at brightly coloured trees.

I just take care of his house for
him while he’s away."
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mel, lives here when he’s not on Gym duty or staring at brightly coloured trees. I just take care of his house for him while he’s away.
entries.translated:
Il Capopalestra Mel vive qui quando
non è in servizio in Palestra o a\lfissare alberi dai colori vivaci.

Io mi prendo solo cura della sua
casa mentre lui è via.

entries.original:
"Mel used to date Tessy, the old
Fallshore City Gym Leader.

They broke up when she moved away
to Polder Town in East Borrius, but\lshe left him her Gym as a parting\lgift.

I think that’s the real reason he
didn’t renovate the Gym after she\lleft.

It’s the one thing he has left
from her\."
entries.translation_source: Mel used to date Tessy, the old Fallshore City Gym Leader. They broke up when she moved away to Polder Town in East Borrius, but she left him her Gym as a parting gift. I think that’s the real reason he didn’t renovate the Gym after she left. It’s the one thing he has left from her[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mel usciva con Tessy, la vecchia
Capopalestra di Fallshore City. Si\lsono lasciati quando lei si è

trasferita a Polder Town, nell{B4}Est
Borrius, ma gli ha lasciato la sua\lPalestra come regalo d{B4}addio. Penso

che questo sia il vero motivo per
cui non ha ristrutturato la\lPalestra dopo che se n{B4}è andata. È

l{B4}unica cosa che gli è rimasta di
lei\.

entries.original:
"Mel is always surrounding himself
with many different women.

He must always be feeling
really lonely\."
entries.translation_source: Mel is always surrounding himself with many different women. He must always be feeling really lonely[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mel si circonda sempre di tante
donne diverse. Deve sentirsi\ldavvero molto solo\.

entries.original:
"He traded me his [green]Magmar[blue] holding a
[green]Magmarizer[blue], and it evolved!"
entries.translation_source: He traded me his [color-green-1]Magmar[color-blue-2] holding a [color-green-3]Magmarizer[color-blue-4], and it evolved!
entries.translated:
Mi ha scambiato il suo [green]Magmar[blue] che
teneva un [green]Magmarizer[blue], ed è evoluto!

entries.original:
"He traded me his [green]Electabuzz[blue], so I
used an [green]Electirizer[blue] on it like an\l[green]Evolution Stone[blue], and it evolved!"
entries.translation_source: He traded me his [color-green-1]Electabuzz[color-blue-2], so I used an [color-green-3]Electirizer[color-blue-4] on it like an [color-green-5]Evolution Stone[color-blue-6], and it evolved!
entries.translated:
Ha scambiato con me il suo
[green]Electabuzz[blue], così gli ho usato sopra\lun [green]Elettritore[blue] come una [green]Pietra

Evolutiva[blue], e si è evoluto!

entries.original:
"There are some Pokémon that can
only evolve during a trade.

But who really trades anymore,
y’know?

That fad died out years ago.

Now you can evolve those Pokémon
using a [green]Link Stone[blue]!

Here, you’ll see!"
entries.translation_source: There are some Pokémon that can only evolve during a trade. But who really trades anymore, y’know? That fad died out years ago. Now you can evolve those Pokémon using a [color-green-1]Link Stone[color-blue-2]! Here, you’ll see!
entries.translated:
Ci sono alcuni Pokémon che possono
evolversi solo durante uno scambio.\lMa chi fa ancora scambi, sai?

Quella moda è finita anni fa. Ora
puoi evolvere quei Pokémon usando\luna [green]Pietralink[blue]! Guarda, ti faccio

vedere!

entries.original:
"The [green]Link Stone[blue] can be used to
evolve certain Pokémon that only\levolve by trading normally."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Link Stone[color-blue-2] can be used to evolve certain Pokémon that only evolve by trading normally.
entries.translated:
La [green]Pietra Link[blue] può essere usata per
far evolvere alcuni Pokémon che\lnormalmente si evolvono solo

tramite scambio.

entries.original:
"Everyone around here is like,
\qoevolution this\qc and \qoevolution\lthat.\qc

But I think evolution is stupid!

My personal favourite way of
preventing evolution is not by\lpressing \btn01 when my Pokémon is\labout to evolve, but by having it\lhold an [green]Everstone[blue].

That way I can skip the whole
evolution thing altogether!

And you know what?

I’ll actually share one with you
if you can show me a Pokémon that\lhas never evolved and can’t evolve!

Do you have a Pokémon like this in
your party?"
entries.translation_source: Everyone around here is like, [quote-open-1]evolution this[quote-close-2] and [quote-open-3]evolution that.[quote-close-4] But I think evolution is stupid! My personal favourite way of preventing evolution is not by pressing [button-icon-5] when my Pokémon is about to evolve, but by having it hold an [color-green-6]Everstone[color-blue-7]. That way I can skip the whole evolution thing altogether! And you know what? I’ll actually share one with you if you can show me a Pokémon that has never evolved and can’t evolve! Do you have a Pokémon like this in your party?
entries.translated:
Tutti qua sono tipo, \qoevoluzione
questo\qc e \qoevoluzione quello.\qc Ma\lsecondo me l{B4}evoluzione è stupida!

Il mio metodo preferito per
impedire l{B4}evoluzione non è premere\l\btn01 quando il mio Pokémon sta per

evolversi, ma fargli tenere una
[green]Pietrastante[blue]. In questo modo posso\lsaltare del tutto la faccenda

dell{B4}evoluzione! E sai una cosa? Te
ne darò una se mi mostri un Pokémon\lche non si è mai evoluto e non può

evolversi! Hai un Pokémon del
genere nella tua squadra?

entries.original: "Which Pokémon is it?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon is it?
entries.translated: Quale Pokémon è?

entries.original:
"Yup, that Pokémon has never
evolved and can never evolve.

As promised, take an [green]Everstone[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Yup, that Pokémon has never evolved and can never evolve. As promised, take an [color-green-1]Everstone[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Sì, quel Pokémon non si è mai
evoluto e non potrà mai evolversi.\lCome promesso, prendi una

[green]Pietrastante[blue]!

entries.original:
"If a Pokémon holds an [green]Everstone[blue] it
won’t evolve!

If a Pokémon holds one while
breeding, it’ll pass on its nature!

Aren’t Everstones great?

If you’re looking for more, I hear
there are a whole bunch of them\lstuck in the [green]walls[blue] of the [green]KBT\lExpressway[blue].

How do you get them out, though?
I have no idea\."
entries.translation_source: If a Pokémon holds an [color-green-1]Everstone[color-blue-2] it won’t evolve! If a Pokémon holds one while breeding, it’ll pass on its nature! Aren’t Everstones great? If you’re looking for more, I hear there are a whole bunch of them stuck in the [color-green-3]walls[color-blue-4] of the [color-green-5]KBT Expressway[color-blue-6]. How do you get them out, though? I have no idea[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Se un Pokémon tiene una
[green]Pietrastante[blue] non si evolve! Se un\lPokémon ne tiene una durante

l{B4}allevamento, trasmetterà la sua
natura! Le Pietrastanti non sono\lfantastiche? Se ne vuoi altre, ho

sentito che ce n{B4}è un sacco
incastrate nelle [green]pareti[blue] del [green]KBT\lExpressway[blue]. Però come si faccia a

tirarle fuori, non ne ho idea\.

entries.original:
"I’ll stick around in the Evolution
House in case you ever bring one."
entries.translation_source: I’ll stick around in the Evolution House in case you ever bring one.
entries.translated:
Resterò nella Casa dell{B4}Evoluzione,
nel caso tu ne porti uno.

entries.original:
"Nope, I’m not looking for an Egg.

I’m looking for a Pokémon that
hasn’t evolved and can never\levolve."
entries.translation_source: Nope, I’m not looking for an Egg. I’m looking for a Pokémon that hasn’t evolved and can never evolve.
entries.translated:
Nope, non sto cercando un Uovo. Sto
cercando un Pokémon che non si è\levoluto e non potrà mai evolversi.

entries.original:
"Nope, that’s not one of the
Pokémon I’m looking for.

I’m looking for a Pokémon that
hasn’t evolved and can never\levolve."
entries.translation_source: Nope, that’s not one of the Pokémon I’m looking for. I’m looking for a Pokémon that hasn’t evolved and can never evolve.
entries.translated:
No, non è uno dei Pokémon che
cerco. Cerco un Pokémon che non si\lsia evoluto e che non possa mai

evolversi.

entries.original:
"I used a [green]Thunder Stone[blue] on my
[green]Pikachu[blue] while [green]standing[blue] on the\l[green]seashore[blue] and when [green]water was\lsplashing beneath my feet[blue], and now\lit looks like its surfing on its tail!"
entries.translation_source: I used a [color-green-1]Thunder Stone[color-blue-2] on my [color-green-3]Pikachu[color-blue-4] while [color-green-5]standing[color-blue-6] on the [color-green-7]seashore[color-blue-8] and when [color-green-9]water was splashing beneath my feet[color-blue-10], and now it looks like its surfing on its tail!
entries.translated:
Ho usato una [green]Pietratuono[blue] sul mio
[green]Pikachu[blue] mentre [green]stavo in piedi[blue] sulla\l[green]riva del mare[blue] e quando [green]l{B4}acqua

schizzava sotto i miei piedi[blue], e ora
sembra che stia surfando sulla sua\lcoda!

entries.original:
"[green][buffer1][red]![red]

I wanna see a [green][buffer1][red]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]![color-red-4] I wanna see a [color-green-5][buffer1-6][color-red-7]!
entries.translated:
[green][buffer1][red]![red] Voglio vedere un
[green][buffer1][red]!

entries.original:
"[buffer1]!
It’s so cuddly and pink!

You should use the [green]Oval Stone[red] to
evolve it!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1]! It’s so cuddly and pink! You should use the [color-green-2]Oval Stone[color-red-3] to evolve it!
entries.translated:
[buffer1]! È così morbido e rosa!
Dovresti usare la [green]Pietra Ovale[red] per\lfarlo evolvere!

entries.original:
"Your [green][buffer1][red] should hold the [green]Oval
Stone[red] during the [green]daytime[red]!"
entries.translation_source: Your [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] should hold the [color-green-4]Oval Stone[color-red-5] during the [color-green-6]daytime[color-red-7]!
entries.translated:
[green][buffer1][red] dovrebbe tenere la [green]Pietra
Ovale[red] durante il [green]giorno[red]!

entries.original:
"Waaaah!
I wanna see a [green][buffer1][red]!"
entries.translation_source: Waaaah! I wanna see a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]!
entries.translated: Waaaah! Voglio vedere un [green][buffer1][red]!

entries.original:
"That’s not a [green][buffer1][red]!

Waaaah!
I wanna see a [green][buffer1][red]!"
entries.translation_source: That’s not a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]! Waaaah! I wanna see a [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-red-6]!
entries.translated:
Quello non è un [green][buffer1][red]! Uaaah!
Voglio vedere un [green][buffer1][red]!

entries.original:
"Hiya! They call me the \qoevolution
master\qc!

I know all the ways Pokémon can
evolve!

Do you want to know how your
Pokémon evolves?"
entries.translation_source: Hiya! They call me the [quote-open-1]evolution master[quote-close-2]! I know all the ways Pokémon can evolve! Do you want to know how your Pokémon evolves?
entries.translated:
Ehilà! Mi chiamano il \qomaestro
dell{B4}evoluzione\qc! Conosco tutti i\lmodi in cui i Pokémon possono

evolversi! Vuoi sapere come si
evolve il tuo Pokémon?

entries.original:
"I get it, you’re in too much awe of
my wisdom to ask, right?"
entries.translation_source: I get it, you’re in too much awe of my wisdom to ask, right?
entries.translated:
Capisco, sei troppo in soggezione
davanti alla mia saggezza per\lchiedere, giusto?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon do you want to know
about?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon do you want to know about?
entries.translated:
Di quale Pokémon vuoi saperne di
più?

entries.original:
"An Egg\.

Doesn’t evolve!"
entries.translation_source: An Egg[game-token-1] Doesn’t evolve!
entries.translated: Un Uovo\. Non si evolve!

entries.original:
"[buffer1]\.

Doesn’t evolve!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1][game-token-2] Doesn’t evolve!
entries.translated: [buffer1]\. Non si evolve!

entries.original:
"[buffer1] can evolve one of
[green][buffer2][red] ways!

So pick a number from 1 to [buffer2].

I’ll tell you how it evolves based
on the number you choose!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] can evolve one of [color-green-2][buffer2-3][color-red-4] ways! So pick a number from 1 to [buffer2-5]. I’ll tell you how it evolves based on the number you choose!
entries.translated:
[buffer1] può evolversi in uno di
[green][buffer2][red] modi! Quindi scegli un\lnumero da 1 a [buffer2]. Ti dirò

come si evolve in base al numero
che scegli!

entries.original: "Pick a number from 1 to [buffer2]."
entries.translation_source: Pick a number from 1 to [buffer2-1].
entries.translated: Scegli un numero da 1 a [buffer2].

entries.original:
"I said one of [green][buffer2][red] ways!

That number is too large."
entries.translation_source: I said one of [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-red-3] ways! That number is too large.
entries.translated:
Ho detto una delle [green][buffer2][red]
possibilità! Quel numero è troppo\lgrande.

entries.original:
"[buffer1] will evolve if\.

\\0C"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] will evolve if[game-token-2] [raw-escape-3]
entries.translated: [buffer1] si evolverà se\. \\0C

entries.original: "It levels up to \Lv [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: It levels up to [game-token-1] [buffer2-2]!
entries.translated: Sale al \Lv [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"It levels up to \Lv [buffer2] when its
Attack is greater than its Defense!"
entries.translation_source: It levels up to [game-token-1] [buffer2-2] when its Attack is greater than its Defense!
entries.translated:
Si evolve in \Lv [buffer2] quando il
suo Attacco è maggiore della sua\lDifesa!

entries.original:
"It levels up to \Lv [buffer2] when its
Attack equals its Defense!"
entries.translation_source: It levels up to [game-token-1] [buffer2-2] when its Attack equals its Defense!
entries.translated:
Si evolve in \Lv [buffer2] quando il
suo Attacco è uguale alla sua\lDifesa!

entries.original:
"It levels up to \Lv [buffer2] when its
Attack is less than its Defense!"
entries.translation_source: It levels up to [game-token-1] [buffer2-2] when its Attack is less than its Defense!
entries.translated:
Raggiunge il \Lv [buffer2] quando il
suo Attacco è inferiore alla sua\lDifesa!

entries.original:
"It levels up to \Lv [buffer2] and there’s a
spare Poké Ball in the Cube!"
entries.translation_source: It levels up to [game-token-1] [buffer2-2] and there’s a spare Poké Ball in the Cube!
entries.translated:
Raggiunge il \Lv [buffer2] e c{B4}è una
Poké Ball di scorta nel Cube!

entries.original:
"It levels up to \Lv [buffer2] and it’s
male!"
entries.translation_source: It levels up to [game-token-1] [buffer2-2] and it’s male!
entries.translated:
Si evolve al \Lv [buffer2] ed è
maschio!

entries.original:
"It levels up to \Lv [buffer2] and it’s
female!"
entries.translation_source: It levels up to [game-token-1] [buffer2-2] and it’s female!
entries.translated:
Si evolve al \Lv [buffer2] ed è
femmina!

entries.original: "It levels up to \Lv [buffer2] at night!"
entries.translation_source: It levels up to [game-token-1] [buffer2-2] at night!
entries.translated: Si evolve a \Lv [buffer2] di notte!

entries.original:
"It levels up to \Lv [buffer2] during
the day!"
entries.translation_source: It levels up to [game-token-1] [buffer2-2] during the day!
entries.translated:
Si evolve al \Lv [buffer2] durante il
giorno!

entries.original:
"It levels up when it has high
friendship!

You’ll be able to tell it’s ready
when it has a [green]heart[red] on its\lsummary page."
entries.translation_source: It levels up when it has high friendship! You’ll be able to tell it’s ready when it has a [color-green-1]heart[color-red-2] on its summary page.
entries.translated:
Sale di livello quando ha un{B4}alta
amicizia! Sarai in grado di capire\lche è pronto quando nella pagina

riepilogo ha un [green]cuore[red].

entries.original:
"It levels up when it has high
friendship during the day!

entries.original:
"A Mission is an extra objective you
receive by accepting a request\lfor help.

Many people out there are unable to
solve their own problems and\lrequire assistance from others.

Once you accept the Mission, the
details are automatically recorded\lin the Mission Log.

Missions can often yield great
rewards, be it items, money, or\leven new areas to explore.

If someone requests a Mission from
you, accept it immediately.

Even if you have no intention of
completing it right away, there’s\lno harm in having it registered\lin your Mission Log.

With that being said, there are
several people here in need\lof assistance.

Look around and see if there’s
anyone you’d like to help!

And come see me when you’ve
completed at least [green]5[blue] Missions."
entries.translation_source: A Mission is an extra objective you receive by accepting a request for help. Many people out there are unable to solve their own problems and require assistance from others. Once you accept the Mission, the details are automatically recorded in the Mission Log. Missions can often yield great rewards, be it items, money, or even new areas to explore. If someone requests a Mission from you, accept it immediately. Even if you have no intention of completing it right away, there’s no harm in having it registered in your Mission Log. With that being said, there are several people here in need of assistance. Look around and see if there’s anyone you’d like to help! And come see me when you’ve completed at least [color-green-1]5[color-blue-2] Missions.
entries.translated:
Una Missione è un obiettivo extra
che ricevi accettando una richiesta\ldi aiuto. Molte persone sono

incapaci di risolvere i propri

accettata la Missione, i dettagli

entries.original:
"Good, that’s just the Butterfree I
was looking for.

Now, [lightgreen]release[blue] it into the wild so
it can find love."
entries.translation_source: Good, that’s just the Butterfree I was looking for. Now, [color-lightgreen-1]release[color-blue-2] it into the wild so it can find love.
entries.translated:
Bene, è proprio la Butterfree che
cercavo. Ora, [lightgreen]rilasciala[blue] nella\lnatura, così potrà trovare l{B4}amore.

entries.original:
"[black][buffer1] was released.
Bye-bye, [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] was released. Bye-bye, [buffer1-3]!
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] è stato liberato. Ciao
ciao, [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

Isn’t it beautiful?

That Butterfree will now find love
and be happy forever\."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] Isn’t it beautiful? That Butterfree will now find love and be happy forever[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Sniff\. Non è bellissimo? Quel
Butterfree ora troverà l{B4}amore e\lsarà felice per sempre\.

entries.original:
"For your heroic actions, I want
you to have my Butterfree in\lplace of the one you released."
entries.translation_source: For your heroic actions, I want you to have my Butterfree in place of the one you released.
entries.translated:
Per le tue azioni eroiche, voglio
che tu prenda il mio Butterfree al\lposto di quello che hai liberato.

entries.original:
"That Butterfree I gave you is
capable of [green]Gigantamaxing[blue]!

What’s that?

Well, use it in a [green]Hidden Grotto
Raid Battle[blue] and you’ll see!"
entries.translation_source: That Butterfree I gave you is capable of [color-green-1]Gigantamaxing[color-blue-2]! What’s that? Well, use it in a [color-green-3]Hidden Grotto Raid Battle[color-blue-4] and you’ll see!
entries.translated:
Quel Butterfree che ti ho dato è in
grado di [green]Gigantamaxing[blue]! Che cos{B4}è?\lBeh, usalo in una [green]Lotta Raid nella

Grotta Nascosta[blue] e vedrai!

entries.original:
"I want to see a [green]Butterfree[blue] that has
been trained to at least Level [green]70[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I want to see a [color-green-1]Butterfree[color-blue-2] that has been trained to at least Level [color-green-3]70[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Voglio vedere un [green]Butterfree[blue] che sia
stato allenato almeno fino al\llivello [green]70[blue].

entries.original:
"That’s not the Pokémon I’m
looking for.

I want to see a [green]Butterfree[blue] that has
been trained to at least Level [green]70[blue]."
entries.translation_source: That’s not the Pokémon I’m looking for. I want to see a [color-green-1]Butterfree[color-blue-2] that has been trained to at least Level [color-green-3]70[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Non è il Pokémon che sto cercando.
Voglio vedere un [green]Butterfree[blue] che sia\lstato allenato almeno al Livello

[green]70[blue].

entries.original:
"That Butterfree is indeed Level 70
or higher, but you didn’t train it\lyourself!

I want to see a [green]Butterfree[blue] that has
been trained to at least Level [green]70[blue]."
entries.translation_source: That Butterfree is indeed Level 70 or higher, but you didn’t train it yourself! I want to see a [color-green-1]Butterfree[color-blue-2] that has been trained to at least Level [color-green-3]70[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Quel Butterfree è effettivamente di
livello 70 o superiore, ma non\ll{B4}hai allenato tu! Voglio vedere un

[green]Butterfree[blue] allenato almeno fino al
livello [green]70[blue].

entries.original:
"But\.

If you don’t release it, how will
your Butterfree ever find love?"
entries.translation_source: But[game-token-1] If you don’t release it, how will your Butterfree ever find love?
entries.translated:
Ma\. Se non lo liberi, come farà mai
il tuo Butterfree a trovare\ll{B4}amore?

entries.original: "The Communist Revolution"
entries.translation_source: The Communist Revolution
entries.translated: La rivoluzione comunista

entries.original:
"Rise up in the name of communism!
Heal at Pokémon Centers [buffer1] times."
entries.translation_source: Rise up in the name of communism! Heal at Pokémon Centers [buffer1-1] times.
entries.translated:
Sorgi in nome del comunismo! Cura i
tuoi Pokémon nei Centri Pokémon\l[buffer1] volte.

entries.original:
"Come here, kid, quietly.

Our whole region is secretly
controlled by the bourgeoisie\land the capitalists.

We in the working class have to
band together and rise up against\lthem in the name of communism!

Their weakness is free services.

If you heal at a Pokémon Center
enough times, their machine of\loppression will crumble."
entries.translation_source: Come here, kid, quietly. Our whole region is secretly controlled by the bourgeoisie and the capitalists. We in the working class have to band together and rise up against them in the name of communism! Their weakness is free services. If you heal at a Pokémon Center enough times, their machine of oppression will crumble.
entries.translated:
Vieni qui, ragazzino, piano piano.
Tutta la nostra regione è\lsegretamente controllata dalla

borghesia e dai capitalisti. Noi
della classe lavoratrice dobbiamo\lstringerci insieme e insorgere

contro di loro in nome del
comunismo! La loro debolezza sono i\lservizi gratuiti. Se ti curi

abbastanza volte in un Centro
Pokémon, la loro macchina di\loppressione crollerà.

entries.original:
"Workers of the world unite!

All you need to do is heal [green][buffer1][red]
times at any Pokémon Center.

Other than the one in Antisis City,
they’re all in on the revolution."
entries.translation_source: Workers of the world unite! All you need to do is heal [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] times at any Pokémon Center. Other than the one in Antisis City, they’re all in on the revolution.
entries.translated:
Operai di tutto il mondo, unitevi!
Tutto ciò che dovete fare è curare\l[green][buffer1][red] volte in qualsiasi Centro

Pokémon. A parte quello di Antisis
City, sono tutti coinvolti nella\lrivoluzione.

entries.original:
"Another proletarian brainwashed by
the capitalist machine of tyranny."
entries.translation_source: Another proletarian brainwashed by the capitalist machine of tyranny.
entries.translated:
Un altro proletario plagiato dalla
macchina capitalista della\ltirannia.

entries.original:
"So far you have used our free
service [green][buffer2][red] time\\07.

In order to overthrow the
capitalist tyrants, you will\lneed to heal another [green][buffer3][red] time\\08."
entries.translation_source: So far you have used our free service [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-red-3] time[raw-escape-4]. In order to overthrow the capitalist tyrants, you will need to heal another [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-red-7] time[raw-escape-8].
entries.translated:
Finora hai usato il nostro servizio
gratuito [green][buffer2][red] volte\\07. Per\lrovesciare i tiranni capitalisti,

dovrai curarti ancora [green][buffer3][red]
volte\\08.

entries.original:
"Great work!

Now that the cogs of the capitalist
machine are broken, the workers of\lour world will unite in revolution\lagainst the bourgeoisie!

Here is a token of our
appreciation, comrade [player]."
entries.translation_source: Great work! Now that the cogs of the capitalist machine are broken, the workers of our world will unite in revolution against the bourgeoisie! Here is a token of our appreciation, comrade [player-name-1].
entries.translated:
Ottimo lavoro! Ora che gli
ingranaggi della macchina\lcapitalista sono rotti, i

lavoratori del nostro mondo si
uniranno in rivoluzione contro la\lborghesia! Ecco un segno del nostro

apprezzamento, compagno [player].

entries.original:
"The communist revolution will
always be thankful to you,\lcomrade [player]."
entries.translation_source: The communist revolution will always be thankful to you, comrade [player-name-1].
entries.translated:
La rivoluzione comunista ti sarà
sempre grata, compagno [player].

entries.original: "The Capitalist Revolution"
entries.translation_source: The Capitalist Revolution
entries.translated: La rivoluzione capitalista

entries.original:
"Rise up in the name of capitalism!
Make [buffer1] purchases from shops."
entries.translation_source: Rise up in the name of capitalism! Make [buffer1-1] purchases from shops.
entries.translated:
Sorgi in nome del capitalismo! Fai
[buffer1] acquisti nei negozi.

entries.original:
"Shush, quiet.

Did you know that the Borrius
region is secretly governed by a\lcommunist consortium, that does\lcommunist things?

We can fight the power by you
buying enough unregistered goods\lfrom Poké Marts.

All Poké Marts are in on it.
You up for a capitalist revolution?"
entries.translation_source: Shush, quiet. Did you know that the Borrius region is secretly governed by a communist consortium, that does communist things? We can fight the power by you buying enough unregistered goods from Poké Marts. All Poké Marts are in on it. You up for a capitalist revolution?
entries.translated:
Ssst, zitto. Lo sapevi che la
regione di Borrius è segretamente\lgovernata da un consorzio

comunista, che fa cose comuniste?
Possiamo combattere il potere\lcomprando abbastanza merce non

registrata dai Poké Market. Tutti i
Poké Market ne fanno parte. Te la\lsenti di fare una rivoluzione

capitalista?

entries.original:
"Long live the revolution!

If you make [green][buffer1][red] purchases from
Poké Marts, the communist system\lwill collapse, and our capitalist\lrevolution can begin."
entries.translation_source: Long live the revolution! If you make [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] purchases from Poké Marts, the communist system will collapse, and our capitalist revolution can begin.
entries.translated:
Lunga vita alla rivoluzione! Se fai
acquisti [green][buffer1][red] ai Poké Mart, il\lsistema comunista crollerà e la

nostra rivoluzione capitalista
potrà cominciare.

entries.original:
"You are just another pawn of the
communist swines."
entries.translation_source: You are just another pawn of the communist swines.
entries.translated:
Sei solo un altro pedone dei porci
comunisti.

entries.original:
"Our records show that so far you
have made [green][buffer2][red] purchase\\07.

We need another [green][buffer3][red] before our
capitalist revolution can begin."
entries.translation_source: Our records show that so far you have made [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-red-3] purchase[raw-escape-4]. We need another [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-red-7] before our capitalist revolution can begin.
entries.translated:
Dalle nostre registrazioni risulta
che finora hai effettuato [green][buffer2][red]\lacquisto\\\\07. Ci serve un altro

[green][buffer3][red] prima che possa cominciare
la nostra rivoluzione capitalista.

entries.original:
"Our records show that you have made
enough purchases.

We can now begin our capitalist
revolution.

Here, take these.

You will need them in our fight
against the communist swine."
