entries.translation_source: Our records show that you have made enough purchases. We can now begin our capitalist revolution. Here, take these. You will need them in our fight against the communist swine.
entries.translated:
I nostri registri mostrano che hai
effettuato abbastanza acquisti. Ora\lpossiamo iniziare la nostra

rivoluzione capitalista. Tieni,
prendi questi. Ti serviranno nella\lnostra lotta contro i maiali

comunisti.

entries.original:
"The great war between the
capitalists and the communists\lwill begin any moment now."
entries.translation_source: The great war between the capitalists and the communists will begin any moment now.
entries.translated:
La grande guerra tra i capitalisti
e i comunisti inizierà da un\lmomento all{B4}altro.

entries.original: "Population Control"
entries.translation_source: Population Control
entries.translated: Controllo della popolazione

entries.original:
"Capture [buffer1] Pokémon in one day to
reduce overpopulation."
entries.translation_source: Capture [buffer1-1] Pokémon in one day to reduce overpopulation.
entries.translated:
Cattura [buffer1] Pokémon in un
giorno per ridurre il\lsovraffollamento.

entries.original:
"Pokémon are evolutionarily
superior to people.

But as a consequence of this, they
have started to overpopulate.

We need to lower their wild
population before they realize that\lthey have the upper hand over us.

Can you catch [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon outside
of the Safari Zone in one day to\lslow their growth rate?"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon are evolutionarily superior to people. But as a consequence of this, they have started to overpopulate. We need to lower their wild population before they realize that they have the upper hand over us. Can you catch [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] Pokémon outside of the Safari Zone in one day to slow their growth rate?
entries.translated:
I Pokémon sono evolutivamente
superiori alle persone. Ma come\lconseguenza di ciò, hanno iniziato

a sovrappopolarsi. Dobbiamo ridurre
la loro popolazione selvatica prima\lche si rendano conto di avere il

vantaggio su di noi. Riesci a
catturare [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon al di\lfuori della Zona Safari in un solo

giorno per rallentare il loro tasso
di crescita?

entries.original:
"Hurry!

You must stop the Pokémon before
their numbers become too great."
entries.translation_source: Hurry! You must stop the Pokémon before their numbers become too great.
entries.translated:
Svelto! Devi fermare i Pokémon
prima che i loro numeri diventino\ltroppo grandi.

entries.original:
"If Pokémon multiply and take over
the world, it’s your fault!"
entries.translation_source: If Pokémon multiply and take over the world, it’s your fault!
entries.translated:
Se i Pokémon si moltiplicano e
prendono il sopravvento sul mondo,\lè colpa tua!

entries.original:
"You have caught [green][buffer2][blue] Pokémon so far,
so you still need to capture [green][buffer3][blue]\lPokémon today.

Otherwise, there will be nothing
stopping the wild Pokémon from\lbecoming the dominant life forms."
entries.translation_source: You have caught [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] Pokémon so far, so you still need to capture [color-green-4][buffer3-5][color-blue-6] Pokémon today. Otherwise, there will be nothing stopping the wild Pokémon from becoming the dominant life forms.
entries.translated:
Hai catturato finora [green][buffer2][blue]
Pokémon, quindi oggi devi ancora\lcatturare [green][buffer3][blue] Pokémon.

Altrimenti, nulla impedirà ai
Pokémon selvatici di diventare la\lforma di vita dominante.

entries.original:
"Excellent work!

After your catching spree, you have
reduced the number of wild Pokémon\lby a significant number!

They will no longer be able to
overthrow us humans, and will\lalways remain subservient to us.

Here is a reward for your help to
the species."
entries.translation_source: Excellent work! After your catching spree, you have reduced the number of wild Pokémon by a significant number! They will no longer be able to overthrow us humans, and will always remain subservient to us. Here is a reward for your help to the species.
entries.translated:
Ottimo lavoro! Dopo la tua
scorpacciata di catture, hai\lridotto il numero di Pokémon

selvatici in modo significativo!
Non potranno più spodestare noi\lumani e rimarranno sempre

sottomessi a noi. Ecco una
ricompensa per il tuo aiuto alla\lspecie.

entries.original:
"[black]All Poké Ball catch rates have
been increased by [buffer1]%!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]All Poké Ball catch rates have been increased by [buffer1-2]%!
entries.translated:
[black]Tutti i tassi di cattura delle Poké
Ball sono stati aumentati del\l[buffer1]%!

entries.original:
"Pokémon should not be allowed to
rule over humans."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon should not be allowed to rule over humans.
entries.translated:
Non si dovrebbe permettere ai
Pokémon di governare sugli esseri\lumani.

entries.original: "The Trash-Man"
entries.translation_source: The Trash-Man
entries.translated: L{B4}Uomo dei rifiuti

entries.original:
"Become part of the trash! Search
lucrative trash cans for [buffer1] items."
entries.translation_source: Become part of the trash! Search lucrative trash cans for [buffer1-1] items.
entries.translated:
Diventa parte dei rifiuti! Cerca
nei bidoni della spazzatura\lredditizi [buffer1] oggetti.

entries.original:
"I am the Trash-Man!

I live in trash!
I eat trash!

Don’t ask, that’s what I do.

I am not looking for garbage, I am
looking for the classiest pieces of\ltrash, but this requires effort.

I would rather pay you to do it
for me.

Will you search trash cans for me
to find at least [green][buffer1][blue] items?"
entries.translation_source: I am the Trash-Man! I live in trash! I eat trash! Don’t ask, that’s what I do. I am not looking for garbage, I am looking for the classiest pieces of trash, but this requires effort. I would rather pay you to do it for me. Will you search trash cans for me to find at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] items?
entries.translated:
Sono l{B4}Uomo-immondizia! Vivo
nell{B4}immondizia! Mangio immondizia!\lNon chiedere, faccio così. Non sto

cercando la spazzatura, sto
cercando i pezzi di immondizia più\lchic, ma serve impegno. Preferirei

pagare te per farlo al posto mio.
Vuoi frugare nei cestini per\ltrovarmi almeno [green][buffer1][blue] oggetti?

entries.original:
"Go out and find me the most
delectable trash out there!"
entries.translation_source: Go out and find me the most delectable trash out there!
entries.translated:
Vai fuori e trovami la spazzatura
più prelibata che ci sia!

entries.original:
"Don’t worry, I’ll just wait for
the next chump who wants to be\lhandsomely rewarded."
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry, I’ll just wait for the next chump who wants to be handsomely rewarded.
entries.translated:
Non preoccuparti, aspetterò solo il
prossimo pollo che voglia essere\lricompensato generosamente.

entries.original:
"My trash senses tell me that you
have found [green][buffer2][blue] item\\07 in the trash\lso far.

Go search more lucrative trash and
find at least [green][buffer3][blue] more item\\08!"
entries.translation_source: My trash senses tell me that you have found [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] item[raw-escape-4] in the trash so far. Go search more lucrative trash and find at least [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-blue-7] more item[raw-escape-8]!
entries.translated:
Il mio fiuto per la spazzatura mi
dice che finora hai trovato\l[green][buffer2][blue] oggetti\\07 nella spazzatura.

Vai a frugare tra rifiuti più
redditizi e trova almeno [green][buffer3][blue]\laltri oggetti\\08!

entries.original:
"That’s some fine trash you got
there!

Here is some of my garbage for you
to take off my hands."
entries.translation_source: That’s some fine trash you got there! Here is some of my garbage for you to take off my hands.
entries.translated:
Hai della bella robaccia lì! Ecco
della mia spazzatura, così me la\ltogli di torno.

entries.original:
"Trash!

You can’t take my garbage if your
party is full."
entries.translation_source: Trash! You can’t take my garbage if your party is full.
entries.translated:
Roba da buttare! Non puoi prendere
la mia spazzatura se la tua squadra\lè piena.

entries.original:
"The Trash-Man is satisfied with the
trash you have gathered for him."
entries.translation_source: The Trash-Man is satisfied with the trash you have gathered for him.
entries.translated:
L{B4}Uomo della Spazzatura è
soddisfatto della spazzatura che\lhai raccolto per lui.

entries.original: "Darwin Was Right"
entries.translation_source: Darwin Was Right
entries.translated: Darwin aveva ragione

entries.original:
"The theory of evolution is a
theorem! Evolve [buffer1] Pokémon total."
entries.translation_source: The theory of evolution is a theorem! Evolve [buffer1-1] Pokémon total.
entries.translated:
La teoria dell{B4}evoluzione è un
teorema! Fai evolvere in totale\l[buffer1] Pokémon.

entries.original:
"I believe that Arceus creates all
Pokémon, but I am also a woman of\lscience.

I am trying to figure out whether
religion or science is right.

I believe Pokémon evolution holds
the key to the answer.

Care to help?
I need [green][buffer1][red] observations."
entries.translation_source: I believe that Arceus creates all Pokémon, but I am also a woman of science. I am trying to figure out whether religion or science is right. I believe Pokémon evolution holds the key to the answer. Care to help? I need [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] observations.
entries.translated:
Credo che Arceus crei tutti i
Pokémon, ma sono anche una donna di\lscienza. Sto cercando di capire se

abbiano ragione la religione o la
scienza. Credo che l{B4}evoluzione dei\lPokémon contenga la chiave della

risposta. Ti va di aiutarmi? Mi
servono [green][buffer1][red] osservazioni.

entries.original:
"Excellent, I will need you to view
[green][buffer1][red] Pokémon evolutions, and report\lyour unbiased opinion."
entries.translation_source: Excellent, I will need you to view [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] Pokémon evolutions, and report your unbiased opinion.
entries.translated:
Ottimo, avrò bisogno che tu osservi
[green][buffer1][red] evoluzioni dei Pokémon e\lriferisca la tua opinione

imparziale.

entries.original:
"I guess some people will always
remain ignorant of the secrets of\lscience and religion."
entries.translation_source: I guess some people will always remain ignorant of the secrets of science and religion.
entries.translated:
Immagino che alcune persone
resteranno sempre ignare dei\lsegreti della scienza e della

religione.

entries.original:
"Your data is still not complete.

You need to evolve [green][buffer3][red] more
Pokémon to complete the dataset."
entries.translation_source: Your data is still not complete. You need to evolve [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-red-3] more Pokémon to complete the dataset.
entries.translated:
I tuoi dati non sono ancora
completi. Devi far evolvere altri\l[green][buffer3][red] Pokémon per completare il

dataset.

entries.original:
"Wow, you’re done!
Now, let’s look at the data.

\.

It says that there are both
scientific and religious facets to\lPokémon evolution.

Perhaps Arceus is more involved
than we know\.

Interesting, please take this
Pokémon as my thanks."
entries.translation_source: Wow, you’re done! Now, let’s look at the data. [game-token-1] It says that there are both scientific and religious facets to Pokémon evolution. Perhaps Arceus is more involved than we know[game-token-2] Interesting, please take this Pokémon as my thanks.
entries.translated:
Wow, hai finito! Ora, vediamo i
dati. \. Dice che ci sono aspetti sia\lscientifici sia religiosi

nell{B4}evoluzione dei Pokémon. Forse
Arceus è più coinvolto di quanto\lsappiamo\. Interessante, per favore

prendi questo Pokémon come
ringraziamento.

entries.original:
"But make some space in your party,
first!"
entries.translation_source: But make some space in your party, first!
entries.translated:
Ma prima fai spazio nella tua
squadra!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon I gave you is known
as Mew.

It is said to be the species all
Pokémon evolved from.

We cloned it at the Science
Society, so the version you have\lis nothing more than a copy."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon I gave you is known as Mew. It is said to be the species all Pokémon evolved from. We cloned it at the Science Society, so the version you have is nothing more than a copy.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon che ti ho dato è noto
come Mew. Si dice che sia la specie\lda cui si sono evoluti tutti i

Pokémon. Lo abbiamo clonato alla
Società Scientifica, quindi la\lversione che hai non è altro che

una copia.

entries.original: "Exp. Millionaire"
entries.translation_source: Exp. Millionaire
entries.translated: Milionario dei PE

entries.original:
"Exp. is like gold. Earn [buffer1]
in one day to become truly rich."
entries.translation_source: Exp. is like gold. Earn [buffer1-1] in one day to become truly rich.
entries.translated:
L{B4}Exp. è come l{B4}oro. Guadagna
[buffer1] in un giorno per diventare\ldavvero ricco.

entries.original:
"I’m so rich, my swimming pool has
its own swimming pool!

And yet\.\CC0820 and yet, all the money
in the world doesn’t make me happy.

True wealth lies in a more
luxurious currency - Exp. Points!

So, are you willing to show me your
drive to become truly wealthy?"
entries.translation_source: I’m so rich, my swimming pool has its own swimming pool! And yet[game-token-1][control-code-2] and yet, all the money in the world doesn’t make me happy. True wealth lies in a more luxurious currency - Exp. Points! So, are you willing to show me your drive to become truly wealthy?
entries.translated:
Sono così ricco che la mia piscina
ha una piscina tutta sua! Eppure\.\CC0820\leppure, tutto il denaro del mondo

non mi rende felice. La vera
ricchezza risiede in una valuta più\lsontuosa - i Punti Esperienza!

Allora, sei disposto a mostrare la
tua voglia di diventare davvero\lricco?

entries.original:
"Then, demonstrate your hunger for
true wealth to me.

To become truly wealthy, have your
Pokémon earn [green][buffer1][red] Exp. Points\lin total within a single day."
entries.translation_source: Then, demonstrate your hunger for true wealth to me. To become truly wealthy, have your Pokémon earn [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] Exp. Points in total within a single day.
entries.translated:
Allora, dimostrami la tua fame di
vera ricchezza. Per diventare\ldavvero ricco, fai guadagnare ai

tuoi Pokémon un totale di [green][buffer1][red]
Punti Esperienza in un solo giorno.

entries.original:
"Hmph. I should have expected no
less from a materialistic cretin."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. I should have expected no less from a materialistic cretin.
entries.translated:
Uhm. Avrei dovuto aspettarmelo da
un cretino materialista.

entries.original:
"So far, your Pokémon have earned
[green][buffer2][red] Exp. Point\\07 today.

But you must still earn another
[green][buffer3][red] Exp. Point\\08.

Only then can you rise above the
status of \qomoderately wealthy\qc."
entries.translation_source: So far, your Pokémon have earned [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-red-3] Exp. Point[raw-escape-4] today. But you must still earn another [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-red-7] Exp. Point[raw-escape-8]. Only then can you rise above the status of [quote-open-9]moderately wealthy[quote-close-10].
entries.translated:
Finora, i tuoi Pokémon hanno
guadagnato [green][buffer2][red] Punti\lEsperienza\\07 oggi. Ma devi ancora

guadagnarne altri [green][buffer3][red] Punti
Esperienza\\08. Solo allora potrai\lelevarTi oltre lo status di

\qomoderatamente benestante\qc.

entries.original:
"Incredible\.

Truly, you are the most amazingly
wealthy person I’ve ever known.

That drive\.\CC0820 that passion\.\CC0820
I know what I must do!

That’s it!

I won’t be needing my life savings
anymore!"
entries.translation_source: Incredible[game-token-1] Truly, you are the most amazingly wealthy person I’ve ever known. That drive[game-token-2][control-code-3] that passion[game-token-4][control-code-5] I know what I must do! That’s it! I won’t be needing my life savings anymore!
entries.translated:
Incredibile\. Davvero, sei la persona
più incredibilmente ricca che abbia\lmai conosciuto. Quella

determinazione\.\CC0820 quella passione\.\CC0820 So
cosa devo fare! Ecco! Non avrò più\lbisogno dei risparmi di una vita!

entries.original:
"Now I am free of materialistic
desires.

And finally\.\CC0820 finally I am truly
rich.

Most impressive, Trainer.

However, I see that your desire
for true wealth exceeds my own\.

Then, as your reward for your
drive\.\CC0818 ah, yes.

Take these Lucky Eggs."
entries.translation_source: Now I am free of materialistic desires. And finally[game-token-1][control-code-2] finally I am truly rich. Most impressive, Trainer. However, I see that your desire for true wealth exceeds my own[game-token-3] Then, as your reward for your drive[game-token-4][control-code-5] ah, yes. Take these Lucky Eggs.
entries.translated:
Ora sono libero dai desideri
materialistici. E finalmente\.\CC0820\lfinalmente sono davvero ricco.

Molto impressionante, Allenatore.
Tuttavia, vedo che il tuo desiderio\ldi vera ricchezza supera il mio\.

Allora, come ricompensa per la tua
determinazione\.\CC0818 ah, sì. Prendi\lqueste Uova Fortunate.

entries.original:
"And in addition to those, allow me
to make them even luckier!"
entries.translation_source: And in addition to those, allow me to make them even luckier!
entries.translated:
E in aggiunta a quelli, lasciami
renderli ancora più fortunati!

entries.original:
"[black]The Lucky Egg level has been
increased to \Lv [buffer2]!

Pokémon will now gain [green]\\0C[black]* the
amount of Exp. Points when held."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Lucky Egg level has been increased to [game-token-2] [buffer2-3]! Pokémon will now gain [color-green-4][raw-escape-5][color-black-6]* the amount of Exp. Points when held.
entries.translated:
[black]Il livello di Uovo Fortunato è
stato aumentato a \Lv [buffer2]! I\lPokémon ora guadagneranno [green]\\0C[black]* la

quantità di Punti Esperienza quando
lo tengono.

entries.original:
"If you desire, I can upgrade your
Lucky Eggs even more.

But I’m afraid I’ll need more than
Exp. Points to upgrade them.

Find me [green][buffer3] [buffer1][red] and I’ll
upgrade your Lucky Eggs again.

I\.\CC0818 I just realized, I still need
food, after all."
entries.translation_source: If you desire, I can upgrade your Lucky Eggs even more. But I’m afraid I’ll need more than Exp. Points to upgrade them. Find me [color-green-1][buffer3-2] [buffer1-3][color-red-4] and I’ll upgrade your Lucky Eggs again. I[game-token-5][control-code-6] I just realized, I still need food, after all.
entries.translated:
Se vuoi, posso potenziare ancora di
più le tue Lucky Egg. Ma temo che\lper potenziarle mi serviranno più

dei semplici Punti Esperienza.
Trova per me [green][buffer3] [buffer1][red] e\lpotenzierò di nuovo le tue Lucky

Egg. I\.\CC0818 Ho appena capito che mi
serve ancora da mangiare,\ldopotutto.

entries.original:
"Greetings, are you here to have
your [green]Lucky Eggs[red] upgraded?

I’ll need [green][buffer3] [buffer1][red] to raise
their luck further to [green]\Lv [buffer2][red]."
entries.translation_source: Greetings, are you here to have your [color-green-1]Lucky Eggs[color-red-2] upgraded? I’ll need [color-green-3][buffer3-4] [buffer1-5][color-red-6] to raise their luck further to [color-green-7][game-token-8] [buffer2-9][color-red-10].
entries.translated:
Salve, sei qui per far potenziare i
tuoi [green]Fortunuovi[red]? Mi serviranno\l[green][buffer3] [buffer1][red] per aumentare

ulteriormente la loro fortuna fino
a [green]\Lv [buffer2][red].

entries.original:
"No? Then could you spare any change
before you leave?"
entries.translation_source: No? Then could you spare any change before you leave?
entries.translated:
No? Allora potresti lasciarmi un
po{B4} di spiccioli prima di\landartene?

entries.original:
"I’m afraid you don’t have enough
[green][buffer1][red].

At least, not enough to keep me
fed for the week\."
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid you don’t have enough [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]. At least, not enough to keep me fed for the week[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Temo che tu non abbia abbastanza
[green][buffer1][red]. Almeno non abbastanza da\lsfamarmi per la settimana\.

entries.original:
"With an Exp. Point bonus of [green]\\0C[red]*,
there’s nothing more I can do\lfor your Lucky Eggs.

Now how will I feed myself?"
entries.translation_source: With an Exp. Point bonus of [color-green-1][raw-escape-2][color-red-3]*, there’s nothing more I can do for your Lucky Eggs. Now how will I feed myself?
entries.translated:
Con un bonus Punti Esperienza di
[green]\\0C[red]*, non posso fare altro per i tuoi\lFortunuovo. Ora come farò a

mantenermi?

entries.original:
"The [green]Inverse Trainer House[blue]
is famous.

Many people come to Fallshore
City just to battle with type\lmatchups reversed."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Inverse Trainer House[color-blue-2] is famous. Many people come to Fallshore City just to battle with type matchups reversed.
entries.translated:
La [green]Casa Allenatore Inversa[blue] è
famosa. Molte persone vengono a\lFallshore City solo per combattere

con gli abbinamenti di tipo
invertiti.

entries.original:
"Every step you take, your Pokémon
become more attached to you.

If you have a Pokémon in the
Day-Care, it will get stronger too."
entries.translation_source: Every step you take, your Pokémon become more attached to you. If you have a Pokémon in the Day-Care, it will get stronger too.
entries.translated:
A ogni passo che fai, i tuoi
Pokémon si affezionano sempre di\lpiù a te. Se hai un Pokémon

all{B4}Asilo Pokémon, anche lui
diventerà più forte.

entries.original:
"I heard that a bunch of people are
up to no good on [green]Route 9[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I heard that a bunch of people are up to no good on [color-green-1]Route 9[color-blue-2].
entries.translated:
Ho sentito che un gruppo di persone
sta combinando guai sul [green]Percorso 9[blue].

entries.original:
"Did you hear?

Someone took care of the
troublemakers on Route 9!"
entries.translation_source: Did you hear? Someone took care of the troublemakers on Route 9!
entries.translated:
Hai sentito? Qualcuno ha pensato ai
teppisti sul Percorso 9!

entries.original:
"I make a ton of my money selling
items I find on Wild Pokémon.

My Venonat’s [green]Compound Eyes[blue] helps
me lure in the ones with items,\lthen I switch out and use [green]Knock Off[blue]\lto nab ’em!"
entries.translation_source: I make a ton of my money selling items I find on Wild Pokémon. My Venonat’s [color-green-1]Compound Eyes[color-blue-2] helps me lure in the ones with items, then I switch out and use [color-green-3]Knock Off[color-blue-4] to nab ’em!
entries.translated:
Faccio un sacco di soldi vendendo
gli strumenti che trovo sui Pokémon\lselvatici. L{B4}[green]Insettocchi[blue] del mio

Venonat mi aiuta ad attirare quelli
che hanno strumenti, poi cambio\lPokémon e uso [green]Privazione[blue] per

arraffarli!

entries.original:
"If you have the [green]Fall Badge[red], you can
buy [green]Ultra Balls[red]!

They’re way better at catching
Pokémon than Great Balls."
entries.translation_source: If you have the [color-green-1]Fall Badge[color-red-2], you can buy [color-green-3]Ultra Balls[color-red-4]! They’re way better at catching Pokémon than Great Balls.
entries.translated:
Se hai la [green]Medaglia Autunno[red], puoi
comprare [green]Ultra Ball[red]! Sono molto\lmigliori delle Mega Ball per

catturare Pokémon.

entries.original: "Flower Paradise"
entries.translation_source: Flower Paradise
entries.translated: Paradiso dei Fiori

entries.original:
"A sanctuary overflowing with
flowers and Pokémon.
Rumours say a rare Pokémon
lives at the northern end."
entries.translation_source: A sanctuary overflowing with flowers and Pokémon. Rumours say a rare Pokémon lives at the northern end.
entries.translated:
Un santuario traboccante di fiori e
Pokémon. Si dice che un Pokémon\lraro viva all{B4}estremità

settentrionale.

entries.original:
"Welcome to Flower Paradise!

While you are here, please be
careful to respect the flowers and\lthe Pokémon that live in them."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to Flower Paradise! While you are here, please be careful to respect the flowers and the Pokémon that live in them.
entries.translated:
Benvenuti al Paradiso dei Fiori!
Mentre siete qui, vi preghiamo di\lfare attenzione a rispettare i

fiori e i Pokémon che vi vivono.

entries.original:
"Do you know about Gracidea
flowers?

They’re given as bouquets to
express feelings of gratitude.

In fact, some Gracidea flowers
even bloom in this very paradise!"
entries.translation_source: Do you know about Gracidea flowers? They’re given as bouquets to express feelings of gratitude. In fact, some Gracidea flowers even bloom in this very paradise!
entries.translated:
Conosci i fiori di Gracidea?
Vengono regalati in bouquet per\lesprimere gratitudine. In effetti,

alcuni fiori di Gracidea sbocciano
persino in questo stesso paradiso!

entries.original:
"Oh, Shaymin!

When it comes to Shaymin,
Gracidea flowers are important!

I have a lot of Gracidea flowers,
so let me share one with you."
entries.translation_source: Oh, Shaymin! When it comes to Shaymin, Gracidea flowers are important! I have a lot of Gracidea flowers, so let me share one with you.
entries.translated:
Oh, Shaymin! Quando si tratta di
Shaymin, i fiori di Gracidea sono\limportanti! Ho molti fiori di

Gracidea, quindi lasciami dartene
uno.

entries.original:
"Since early times, people have made
bouquets of Gracidea flowers to\lshow their feelings of gratitude.

Isn’t that interesting?

By giving a Gracidea bouquet, you
don’t have to say a word and\lsomeone will know how grateful you\lare.

Quite a delightful custom!"
entries.translation_source: Since early times, people have made bouquets of Gracidea flowers to show their feelings of gratitude. Isn’t that interesting? By giving a Gracidea bouquet, you don’t have to say a word and someone will know how grateful you are. Quite a delightful custom!
entries.translated:
Fin dai tempi antichi, le persone
hanno creato mazzi di fiori di\lGracidea per esprimere la loro

gratitudine. Non è interessante?
Regalando un mazzo di Gracidea, non\ldevi dire una parola e qualcuno

capirà quanto sei grato. Che usanza
deliziosa!

entries.original:
"Berries are wonderful, don’t you
think?

They’re food for people and
Pokémon alike, and they make\lthe world much more beautiful\lto live in!

Here, let me share with you!"
entries.translation_source: Berries are wonderful, don’t you think? They’re food for people and Pokémon alike, and they make the world much more beautiful to live in! Here, let me share with you!
entries.translated:
Le Bacche sono meravigliose, non
credi? Sono cibo sia per le persone\lsia per i Pokémon, e rendono il

mondo molto più bello da vivere!
Tieni, lascia che ne condivida un\lpo{B4} con te!

entries.original:
"If you’d like some more Berries,
come see me again tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: If you’d like some more Berries, come see me again tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Se vuoi altre Bacche, torna a
trovarmi domani!

entries.original: "Honey Gather"
entries.translation_source: Honey Gather
entries.translated: Raccoglimiele

entries.original:
"A big feast is coming up soon!
Battle Pokémon in Flower Paradise
and collect 3 Honey from them."
entries.translation_source: A big feast is coming up soon! Battle Pokémon in Flower Paradise and collect 3 Honey from them.
entries.translated:
Un grande banchetto arriverà
presto! Sfida i Pokémon nel\lParadiso dei Fiori e raccogli 3

Miele da loro.

entries.original:
"Excuse me, Trainer, would you be
able to lend me a hand, please?

You see, my family and I are having
a big feast soon, and we need lots\lof Honey for our meal.

I’ve already collected seven jars,
but I need at least three more.

I heard they could be found on wild
Combee, but I’m not having much\lluck finding them.

So how about it?

Are you able to find [green]3[red] Combee
and give me their [green]Honey[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Excuse me, Trainer, would you be able to lend me a hand, please? You see, my family and I are having a big feast soon, and we need lots of Honey for our meal. I’ve already collected seven jars, but I need at least three more. I heard they could be found on wild Combee, but I’m not having much luck finding them. So how about it? Are you able to find [color-green-1]3[color-red-2] Combee and give me their [color-green-3]Honey[color-red-4]?
entries.translated:
Mi scusi, Allenatore, potrebbe
darmi una mano, per favore? Vede,\lio e la mia famiglia presto faremo

un grande banchetto, e abbiamo
bisogno di molto Miele per il\lnostro banchetto. Ho già raccolto

sette barattoli, ma me ne servono
almeno altri tre. Ho sentito che si\lpossono trovare nei Combee

selvatici, ma non ho molta fortuna
a trovarli. Allora, che ne dice? È\lin grado di trovare [green]3[red] Combee e

darmi il loro [green]Miele[red]?

entries.original:
"Great!
Thank you for agreeing to help!

Combee can be found all over
Flower Paradise.

Although, you’d have more luck
finding them in the [blue]blue[red] flowers.

You might also want to try catching
a [green]Cutiefly[red] with [green]Honey Gather[red].

There’s a chance it’ll find Honey
after each battle, and you’ll be\lnotified if it does!"
entries.translation_source: Great! Thank you for agreeing to help! Combee can be found all over Flower Paradise. Although, you’d have more luck finding them in the [color-blue-1]blue[color-red-2] flowers. You might also want to try catching a [color-green-3]Cutiefly[color-red-4] with [color-green-5]Honey Gather[color-red-6]. There’s a chance it’ll find Honey after each battle, and you’ll be notified if it does!
entries.translated:
Fantastico! Grazie per aver
accettato di aiutare! Combee si\ltrova in tutto il Paradiso Fiorito.

Tuttavia, avresti più fortuna a
trovarli nei fiori [blue]blu[red]. Potresti\lanche provare a catturare un

[green]Cutiefly[red] con [green]Mielcovata[red]. C{B4}è una
possibilità che trovi del Miele\ldopo ogni lotta, e verrai avvisato

se ciò accade.

entries.original:
"You got them! Thank you so much!
Let me take them off your hands."
entries.translation_source: You got them! Thank you so much! Let me take them off your hands.
entries.translated:
Li hai presi! Grazie mille! Lascia
che te li tolga di mano.

entries.original:
"For helping me out, please take
this TM as a reward. I insist!"
entries.translation_source: For helping me out, please take this TM as a reward. I insist!
entries.translated:
Per avermi aiutato, prendi questa
MT come ricompensa. Insisto!

entries.original:
"Combee can be found all over Flower
Paradise, however they are more\llikely to appear in the [blue]blue[red]\lflowers.

If you catch a [green]Cutiefly[red] with [green]Honey
Gather[red], that may help as well.

And remember, I need at least [green]3
Honey[red] jars."
entries.translation_source: Combee can be found all over Flower Paradise, however they are more likely to appear in the [color-blue-1]blue[color-red-2] flowers. If you catch a [color-green-3]Cutiefly[color-red-4] with [color-green-5]Honey Gather[color-red-6], that may help as well. And remember, I need at least [color-green-7]3 Honey[color-red-8] jars.
entries.translated:
I Combee si possono trovare un po{B4}
dappertutto nel Paradiso dei Fiori,\lma è più probabile che appaiano nei

[blue]fiori blu[red]. Se catturi un [green]Cutiefly[red]
con [green]Honey Gather[red], potrebbe aiutare\lanche quello. E ricorda, mi servono

almeno [green]3 vasetti di Miele[red].

entries.original:
"That’s too bad.

I’ll have to keep looking
myself, then."
entries.translation_source: That’s too bad. I’ll have to keep looking myself, then.
entries.translated:
Peccato. Allora dovrò continuare a
cercare da solo.

entries.original:
"Thank you again for helping me
before!

My family and I had a great two-day
feast because of your help.

Now it’s time to prepare for next
year’s feast!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you again for helping me before! My family and I had a great two-day feast because of your help. Now it’s time to prepare for next year’s feast!
entries.translated:
Grazie ancora per avermi aiutato
prima! La mia famiglia e io abbiamo\lfatto un grande banchetto di due

giorni grazie al tuo aiuto. Ora è
il momento di preparare il\lbanchetto dell{B4}anno prossimo!

entries.original: "[green]Kyuu uuhn."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Kyuu uuhn.
entries.translated: [green]Kyuu uuhn.

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] fled into the
field of flowers."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] fled into the field of flowers.
entries.translated:
[black]Il/la [buffer1] è fuggito/a nel
campo di fiori.

entries.original:
"Only Trainers who have proven
themselves worthy in battle may\lpass through here.

\.

You are not worthy."
entries.translation_source: Only Trainers who have proven themselves worthy in battle may pass through here. [game-token-1] You are not worthy.
entries.translated:
Solo gli Allenatori che hanno
dimostrato di essere degni in\lbattaglia possono passare di qui. \.

Non sei degno.

entries.original:
"Only Trainers who have proven
themselves worthy in battle may\lpass through here.

\.

You are worthy."
entries.translation_source: Only Trainers who have proven themselves worthy in battle may pass through here. [game-token-1] You are worthy.
entries.translated:
Solo gli Allenatori che hanno
dimostrato di meritarselo in\lbattaglia possono passare di qui. \.

Tu sei degno.

entries.original: "You may pass."
entries.translation_source: You may pass.
entries.translated: Puoi passare.

entries.original: "Frost Mountain"
entries.translation_source: Frost Mountain
entries.translated: Monte Gelido

entries.original:
"A small mountain that is known
for connecting Route 7 to Route 8.
Despite its name, not much ice
is found inside."
entries.translation_source: A small mountain that is known for connecting Route 7 to Route 8. Despite its name, not much ice is found inside.
entries.translated:
Una piccola montagna nota per
collegare la Route 7 alla Route 8.\lNonostante il nome, al suo interno

non si trova molto ghiaccio.

entries.original:
"You see those rocks on the wall?

If you have a Pokémon that can use
[green]Rock Climb[blue], you can cruise up ’em!"
entries.translation_source: You see those rocks on the wall? If you have a Pokémon that can use [color-green-1]Rock Climb[color-blue-2], you can cruise up ’em!
entries.translated:
Vedi quelle rocce sul muro? Se hai
un Pokémon che può usare\l[green]Scalaroccia[blue], puoi salirci su alla

grande!

entries.original:
"ENGAGING FROM
BEHIND IS THE
KEY."
entries.translation_source: ENGAGING FROM BEHIND IS THE KEY.
entries.translated: ATTACCARE DA DIETRO È LA CHIAVE.

entries.original:
"[black]Aggron blew you away with its
powerful Roar!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Aggron blew you away with its powerful Roar!
entries.translated:
[black]Aggron ti ha scagliato via con il
suo potente Ruggito!

entries.original: "[black]Aggron mysteriously disappeared."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Aggron mysteriously disappeared.
entries.translated: [black]Aggron è scomparso misteriosamente.

entries.original:
"I am warning you now, we are not
called the \qoDevil Duo\qc for nothing.

This battle will not go as you
hope.

You have been warned\."
entries.translation_source: I am warning you now, we are not called the [quote-open-1]Devil Duo[quote-close-2] for nothing. This battle will not go as you hope. You have been warned[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ti sto avvertendo ora, non ci
chiamano i \qoDevil Duo\qc per niente.\lQuesta battaglia non andrà come

speri. Sei stato avvertito\.

entries.original:
"It seems my warning was
not necessary\."
entries.translation_source: It seems my warning was not necessary[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sembra che il mio avvertimento non
fosse necessario\.

entries.original:
"For your wonderful display of
battle prowess, I confer upon\lyou this special Z-Crystal."
entries.translation_source: For your wonderful display of battle prowess, I confer upon you this special Z-Crystal.
entries.translated:
Per la tua meravigliosa prova di
abilità in battaglia, ti conferisco\lquesto speciale Cristallo Z.

entries.original:
"That Mimikium Z can be used to
activate [green]Mimikyu’s[blue] signature Z-Move\lby upgrading its [green]Play Rough[blue]."
entries.translation_source: That Mimikium Z can be used to activate [color-green-1]Mimikyu’s[color-blue-2] signature Z-Move by upgrading its [color-green-3]Play Rough[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Quella Mimikium Z può essere usata
per attivare la mossa Z distintiva\ldi [green]Mimikyu[blue] migliorando la sua

[green]Carineria[blue].

entries.original:
"Many call us the \qoDevil Duo.\qc

It was a nickname conferred upon us
after defeating every opponent we\lcame across.

As such, we will only challenge the
strongest Trainers.

You are not there yet."
entries.translation_source: Many call us the [quote-open-1]Devil Duo.[quote-close-2] It was a nickname conferred upon us after defeating every opponent we came across. As such, we will only challenge the strongest Trainers. You are not there yet.
entries.translated:
Molti ci chiamano il \qoDuo
Diabolico.\qc È un soprannome che ci\lè stato conferito dopo aver

sconfitto ogni avversario
incontrato lungo il cammino. Per\lquesto, sfidiamo solo gli

Allenatori più forti. Tu non sei
ancora a quel livello.

entries.original:
"Many call us the \qoDevil Duo.\qc

It was a nickname conferred upon us
after defeating every opponent we\lcame across.

If you wish to defeat us, you must
be able to battle [green]two on two[blue] with\lonly [green]Fighting[blue]- and [green]Dragon[blue]-types."
entries.translation_source: Many call us the [quote-open-1]Devil Duo.[quote-close-2] It was a nickname conferred upon us after defeating every opponent we came across. If you wish to defeat us, you must be able to battle [color-green-3]two on two[color-blue-4] with only [color-green-5]Fighting[color-blue-6]- and [color-green-7]Dragon[color-blue-8]-types.
entries.translated:
Molti ci chiamano il \qoDuo del
Diavolo.\qc È un soprannome che ci è\lstato dato dopo aver sconfitto ogni

avversario che ci capitava davanti.
Se vuoi batterci, devi essere in\lgrado di combattere [green]due contro due[blue]

usando solo tipi [green]Lotta[blue] e [green]Drago[blue].

entries.original:
"Fu fu fu\.

Coming here is no simple feat.

You must know, however, they do
not call us the \qoDevil Duo\qc for\lnothing!

Prepare for a trip to the abyss!"
entries.translation_source: Fu fu fu[game-token-1] Coming here is no simple feat. You must know, however, they do not call us the [quote-open-2]Devil Duo[quote-close-3] for nothing! Prepare for a trip to the abyss!
entries.translated:
Fu fu fu\. Venire qui non è
un{B4}impresa da poco. Devi sapere,\lperò, che non ci chiamano i \qoDevil

Duo\qc per niente! Preparati a un
viaggio nell{B4}abisso!

entries.original: "Indeed, you were prepared\."
entries.translation_source: Indeed, you were prepared[game-token-1]
entries.translated: In effetti, eri pronto\.

entries.original:
"For your excellent showing in
battle, I present to you this\lspecial Z-Crystal."
entries.translation_source: For your excellent showing in battle, I present to you this special Z-Crystal.
entries.translated:
Per la tua eccellente prestazione
in lotta, ti dono questo speciale\lCristallo Z.

entries.original:
"If you bestow the [green]Mimikium Z[red] upon a
[green]Mimikyu[red], you may upgrade its [green]Play\lRough[red] into its signature Z-Move."
entries.translation_source: If you bestow the [color-green-1]Mimikium Z[color-red-2] upon a [color-green-3]Mimikyu[color-red-4], you may upgrade its [color-green-5]Play Rough[color-red-6] into its signature Z-Move.
entries.translated:
Se doni [green]Mimikium Z[red] a [green]Mimikyu[red], puoi
trasformare [green]Carineria[red] nella sua\lMossa Z esclusiva.

entries.original:
"Fu fu fu\.

Coming here is no simple feat.

You must know, however, they do
not call us the \qoDevil Duo\qc for\lnothing!

You, unfortunately, are not capable
of battling us, just yet."
entries.translation_source: Fu fu fu[game-token-1] Coming here is no simple feat. You must know, however, they do not call us the [quote-open-2]Devil Duo[quote-close-3] for nothing! You, unfortunately, are not capable of battling us, just yet.
entries.translated:
Fu fu fu\. Venire qui non è
un{B4}impresa da poco. Devi però\lsapere che non ci chiamano il

\qoDevil Duo\qc per niente! Tu,
purtroppo, non sei ancora in grado\ldi affrontarci.

entries.original:
"Fu fu fu\.

Coming here is no simple feat.

You must know, however, they do
not call us the \qoDevil Duo\qc for\lnothing!

If you wish to battle with us, you
must be capable of battling [green]two on\ltwo[red] with only [green]Fighting[red]- and [green]Dragon[red]-\ltypes at your side."
entries.translation_source: Fu fu fu[game-token-1] Coming here is no simple feat. You must know, however, they do not call us the [quote-open-2]Devil Duo[quote-close-3] for nothing! If you wish to battle with us, you must be capable of battling [color-green-4]two on two[color-red-5] with only [color-green-6]Fighting[color-red-7]- and [color-green-8]Dragon[color-red-9]- types at your side.
entries.translated:
Fu fu fu\. Arrivare fin qui non è
stata certo un{B4}impresa da poco.\lDevi però sapere che non ci

chiamano il \qoDuo Diabolico\qc per
niente! Se vuoi sfidarci, devi\lessere in grado di combattere [green]due

contro due[red] con solo Pokémon di tipo
[green]Lotta[red] e [green]Drago[red] al tuo fianco.

entries.original:
"A while ago, some thugs with a big
Granbull face on their backs tried\lto capture the rare blue bird that\lused to live in Frost Mountain.

But it just turned a good chunk of
them into popsicles and flew off\lsomewhere.

I wonder if it’ll come back\."
entries.translation_source: A while ago, some thugs with a big Granbull face on their backs tried to capture the rare blue bird that used to live in Frost Mountain. But it just turned a good chunk of them into popsicles and flew off somewhere. I wonder if it’ll come back[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Un po{B4} di tempo fa, alcuni teppisti
con una grossa faccia di Granbull\lsulla schiena hanno cercato di

catturare il raro uccello blu che
un tempo viveva sul Monte\lGhiacciato. Ma lui ha trasformato

in ghiaccioli un bel po{B4} di loro ed
è volato via da qualche parte.\lChissà se tornerà\.

entries.original:
"The frost-covered ground in this
cave is my inspiration."
entries.translation_source: The frost-covered ground in this cave is my inspiration.
entries.translated:
Il terreno ricoperto di brina in
questa grotta è la mia ispirazione.

entries.original:
"My brother likes to challenge
Trainers to hop themselves."
entries.translation_source: My brother likes to challenge Trainers to hop themselves.
entries.translated:
Mio fratello ama sfidare gli
Allenatori a saltare.

entries.original:
"Do you think the trek up this
mountain will be easy?"
entries.translation_source: Do you think the trek up this mountain will be easy?
entries.translated:
Pensi che la salita su questa
montagna sarà facile?

entries.original:
"My sources tell me there are at
least 20 more floors in this cave!"
entries.translation_source: My sources tell me there are at least 20 more floors in this cave!
entries.translated:
Le mie fonti mi dicono che ci sono
almeno altri 20 piani in questa\lgrotta!

entries.original:
"I won’t stop you from climbing, but
don’t forget to heal up first!"
entries.translation_source: I won’t stop you from climbing, but don’t forget to heal up first!
entries.translated:
Non ti impedirò di salire, ma non
dimenticare di curarti prima!

entries.original:
"This cave is pretty small,
isn’t it?

I don’t know why that guy down
below insists on telling Trainers\lit’s 20 floors high\."
entries.translation_source: This cave is pretty small, isn’t it? I don’t know why that guy down below insists on telling Trainers it’s 20 floors high[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Questa grotta è piuttosto piccola,
no? Non so perché quel tizio laggiù\linsista nel dire ai Allenatori che

è alta 20 piani\.

entries.original:
"Have you ever read the comics
about Crobatman?

He’s just an ordinary guy who
dresses up like a Crobat to fight\lcrime!

But between you and me, I don’t see
why he can’t just let his Pokémon\ldo the fighting for him\."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever read the comics about Crobatman? He’s just an ordinary guy who dresses up like a Crobat to fight crime! But between you and me, I don’t see why he can’t just let his Pokémon do the fighting for him[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Hai mai letto i fumetti su
Crobatman? È solo un tipo qualunque\lche si veste da Crobat per

combattere il crimine! Ma tra noi,
non vedo perché non possa\lsemplicemente lasciare che siano i

suoi Pokémon a combattere per lui\.

entries.original: "Frozen Forest"
entries.translation_source: Frozen Forest
entries.translated: Foresta Ghiacciata

entries.original:
"A hidden forest on the outskirts
of Blizzard City.
Rumour says a powerful Pokémon
appears every Thursday."
entries.translation_source: A hidden forest on the outskirts of Blizzard City. Rumour says a powerful Pokémon appears every Thursday.
entries.translated:
Una foresta nascosta alla periferia
di Blizzard City. Si dice che ogni\lgiovedì appaia un potente Pokémon.

entries.original: "Frozen Heights"
entries.translation_source: Frozen Heights
entries.translated: Alture Ghiacciate

entries.original: "Frozen Heights D"
entries.translation_source: Frozen Heights D
entries.translated: Alture Gelate D

entries.original: "Frozen Heights N"
entries.translation_source: Frozen Heights N
entries.translated: Alture Gelate N

entries.original:
"The door has been forced shut
behind you."
entries.translation_source: The door has been forced shut behind you.
entries.translated:
La porta è stata chiusa a forza
alle tue spalle.

entries.original: "[black]The door is sealed shut."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The door is sealed shut.
entries.translated: [black]La porta è sigillata.

entries.original:
"There’s something irresistable
about that sign\."
entries.translation_source: There’s something irresistable about that sign[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
C{B4}è qualcosa di irresistibile in
quel cartello\.

entries.original: "What a great read!"
entries.translation_source: What a great read!
entries.translated: Che bella lettura!

entries.original:
"North of here is the entrance to
an underground highway.

The only problem is that it’s
blocked by some skinny tree.

I just wish I knew how to get
past it."
entries.translation_source: North of here is the entrance to an underground highway. The only problem is that it’s blocked by some skinny tree. I just wish I knew how to get past it.
entries.translated:
A nord di qui c{B4}è l{B4}ingresso a
un{B4}autostrada sotterranea. L{B4}unico\lproblema è che è bloccato da un

alberello esile. Vorrei solo sapere
come superarlo.

entries.original:
"The skinny tree that was blocking
the underground highway\lmysteriously disappeared\.

Will it ever return?

That is the question I will be
haunted with for the rest of\lmy life."
entries.translation_source: The skinny tree that was blocking the underground highway mysteriously disappeared[game-token-1] Will it ever return? That is the question I will be haunted with for the rest of my life.
entries.translated:
Il sottile albero che bloccava
l{B4}autostrada sotterranea è\lscomparso\. Tornerà mai? È la domanda

che mi perseguiterà per il resto
della mia vita.

entries.original:
"Is it true?
You’re leaving home, [player]?

Then don’t forget to take any items
out of your PC before you go!"
entries.translation_source: Is it true? You’re leaving home, [player-name-1]? Then don’t forget to take any items out of your PC before you go!
entries.translated:
È vero? Stai lasciando casa,
[player]? Allora non dimenticare di\lprendere tutti gli oggetti dal PC

prima di andare!

entries.original:
"Prof. Log rarely leaves his lab.

When does he go home?
Does he even have a home?"
entries.translation_source: Prof. Log rarely leaves his lab. When does he go home? Does he even have a home?
entries.translated:
Il Prof. Log lascia raramente il
suo laboratorio. Quando va a casa?\lCe l{B4}ha almeno, una casa?

entries.original:
"Congrats on becoming the Champion,
[player]!

I bet those items in your PC really
helped you out, eh?"
entries.translation_source: Congrats on becoming the Champion, [player-name-1]! I bet those items in your PC really helped you out, eh?
entries.translated:
Complimenti per essere diventato il
Campione, [player]! Scommetto che\lquegli oggetti nel tuo PC ti sono

stati davvero utili, eh?

entries.original:
"Technology is amazing!

You can play ROM Hacks with an
in-game clock on almost any device!"
entries.translation_source: Technology is amazing! You can play ROM Hacks with an in-game clock on almost any device!
entries.translated:
La tecnologia è incredibile! Puoi
giocare alle ROM hack con un\lorologio di gioco su quasi ogni

dispositivo!

entries.original:
"Huh? What’s this?
Are you from the future?

\.

Are you crazy?

What made you think you had the
right to travel through time?

\.

Look, I get it, you made a rookie
mistake.

I can let you off easy this time.

Just this once, if you don’t want
to wait until [green][buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3][blue] for your\linternal clock to fix itself, I\lcan reset it to today’s date.

But just this once!

Are you sure you want me to reset
your clock?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? What’s this? Are you from the future? [game-token-1] Are you crazy? What made you think you had the right to travel through time? [game-token-2] Look, I get it, you made a rookie mistake. I can let you off easy this time. Just this once, if you don’t want to wait until [color-green-3][buffer1-4]/[buffer2-5]/[buffer3-6][color-blue-7] for your internal clock to fix itself, I can reset it to today’s date. But just this once! Are you sure you want me to reset your clock?
entries.translated:
Eh? Che cos{B4}è? Vieni dal futuro? \.
Sei pazzo? Cosa ti ha fatto pensare\ldi avere il diritto di viaggiare

nel tempo? \. Senti, capisco, hai
fatto un errore da principiante.\lPosso fartela passare liscia questa

volta. Solo per questa volta, se
non vuoi aspettare fino a\l[green][buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3][blue] che il

tuo orologio interno si sistemi,
posso reimpostarlo alla data di\loggi. Ma solo per questa volta! Sei

sicuro di volermi far reimpostare
il tuo orologio?

entries.original:
"Okay, doofus, your clock has been
reset.

Don’t go around messing with it
again, because I won’t be able to\lhelp you next time!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, doofus, your clock has been reset. Don’t go around messing with it again, because I won’t be able to help you next time!
entries.translated:
Va bene, zuccone, il tuo orologio è
stato reimpostato. Non andare più\lin giro a smanettarci, perché la

prossima volta non potrò aiutarti!

entries.original:
"Technology is amazing, you know,
and if you wait until [green][buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3][blue],\lyour internal clock will fix itself."
entries.translation_source: Technology is amazing, you know, and if you wait until [color-green-1][buffer1-2]/[buffer2-3]/[buffer3-4][color-blue-5], your internal clock will fix itself.
entries.translated:
La tecnologia è incredibile, lo
sai, e se aspetti fino a\l[green][buffer1]/[buffer2]/[buffer3][blue], il tuo

orologio interno si sistemerà da
solo.

entries.original: "Mom"
entries.translation_source: Mom
entries.translated: Mamma

entries.original:
"[player]!
Where have you been?

I was really worried about you!

\.

Wow\.

That sounds awfully frightening!
I’m really glad you’re safe now!

Before you do anything else, you
should take a nice, long rest."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Where have you been? I was really worried about you! [game-token-2] Wow[game-token-3] That sounds awfully frightening! I’m really glad you’re safe now! Before you do anything else, you should take a nice, long rest.
entries.translated:
[player]! Dove sei stato? Ero
davvero in pensiero per te! \. Wow\.\lSembra terribilmente spaventoso!

Sono davvero felice che ora tu sia
al sicuro! Prima di fare qualsiasi\laltra cosa, dovresti riposarti bene

per un po{B4}.

entries.original:
"Don’t you feel much better now,
sweetie?

Now you’ve got the energy to run
Prof. Log’s errand for him!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you feel much better now, sweetie? Now you’ve got the energy to run Prof. Log’s errand for him!
entries.translated:
Non ti senti molto meglio adesso,
tesoro? Ora hai l{B4}energia per\lsbrigare la commissione del Prof.

Log per lui!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

I always knew that the day would
come when you would leave home\.

It said so on TV.

If only your father could see you
now\.\CC0820 he’d be so proud!

Well, if you’re going to run
errands for Prof. Log, you’ll\lneed this!"
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] I always knew that the day would come when you would leave home[game-token-2] It said so on TV. If only your father could see you now[game-token-3][control-code-4] he’d be so proud! Well, if you’re going to run errands for Prof. Log, you’ll need this!
entries.translated:
Sniff\. Ho sempre saputo che sarebbe
arrivato il giorno in cui avresti\llasciato casa\. Lo diceva in TV. Se

solo tuo padre potesse vederti
adesso\.\CC0820 sarebbe così orgoglioso!\lBene, se andrai a fare commissioni

per il Prof. Log, ti servirà
questo!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Super Cube’s
Mission Log component from Mom!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Super Cube’s Mission Log component from Mom!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto da Mamma il
componente del Registro missioni\ldel Super Cubo!

entries.original:
"That’s a [green]Mission Log[red] function for
your Super Cube!

It keeps track of anything you’ve
been asked to do!

To use it, just open it up from
the [green]Start Menu[red].

And now that you have one, why
don’t we have it keep a record of\lProf Log’s request for you?"
entries.translation_source: That’s a [color-green-1]Mission Log[color-red-2] function for your Super Cube! It keeps track of anything you’ve been asked to do! To use it, just open it up from the [color-green-3]Start Menu[color-red-4]. And now that you have one, why don’t we have it keep a record of Prof Log’s request for you?
entries.translated:
Quella è una funzione di [green]Registro
Missioni[red] per il tuo Super Cubo!\lTiene traccia di tutto ciò che ti

viene chiesto di fare! Per usarla,
basta aprirla dal [green]Menu Start[red]. E ora\lche ne hai uno, perché non facciamo

in modo che registri la richiesta
del Prof Log per te?

entries.original:
"Oh, and before I forget, you left
a key component of your Super Cube\lon the floor of your room.

I know it wasn’t necessary before,
but now that you have your very\lown Pokémon, you’ll need it if\lyou want to use those stat boosting\litems in battle."
entries.translation_source: Oh, and before I forget, you left a key component of your Super Cube on the floor of your room. I know it wasn’t necessary before, but now that you have your very own Pokémon, you’ll need it if you want to use those stat boosting items in battle.
entries.translated:
Ah, e prima che me ne dimentichi,
hai lasciato un componente chiave\ldel tuo Super Cubo sul pavimento

della tua stanza. So che prima non
era necessario, ma ora che hai il\ltuo Pokémon personale, ne avrai

bisogno se vuoi usare quegli
oggetti che aumentano le\lstatistiche in lotta.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Super Cube’s
battle component from Mom!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Super Cube’s battle component from Mom!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto da Mamma il
componente lotta del Super Cubo!

entries.original:
"Just in case you’ve forgotten, the
Super Cube acts just like a bag.

But unlike those cheap bags from
Poké Mart that can only hold 42\litems, the Super Cube, or as it’s\lmore commonly known, [green]Cube[red], has an\linfinite amount of space!

It works by digitizing the item’s
data put into it, so essentially,\lit’s like you’re carrying nothing\lextra at all!

And not only that, you can even
automatically sort the Cube by\lpressing \btn04!

Isn’t that convenient?

Of course, if you still think the
Cube is a little cluttered even\lafter sorting, just use \btn02 and \btn03\lto move through it quickly.

Oh, and you can even use it to
store this parting gift I prepared!"
entries.translation_source: Just in case you’ve forgotten, the Super Cube acts just like a bag. But unlike those cheap bags from Poké Mart that can only hold 42 items, the Super Cube, or as it’s more commonly known, [color-green-1]Cube[color-red-2], has an infinite amount of space! It works by digitizing the item’s data put into it, so essentially, it’s like you’re carrying nothing extra at all! And not only that, you can even automatically sort the Cube by pressing [button-icon-3]! Isn’t that convenient? Of course, if you still think the Cube is a little cluttered even after sorting, just use [button-icon-4] and [button-icon-5] to move through it quickly. Oh, and you can even use it to store this parting gift I prepared!
entries.translated:
Nel caso tu abbia dimenticato, il
Super Cube si comporta proprio come\luna borsa. Ma a differenza di

quelle borse economiche del Poké
Mart che possono contenere solo 42\lstrumenti, il Super Cube, o come è

più comunemente conosciuto, [green]Cube[red],
ha uno spazio infinito! Funziona\ldigitalizzando i dati dello

strumento inserito, quindi
essenzialmente, è come se non\lstessi portando niente di extra! E

non solo, puoi anche ordinare
automaticamente il Cube premendo \btn04!\lNon è comodo? Certo, se pensi

ancora che il Cube sia un po{B4}
disordinato anche dopo\ll{B4}ordinamento, usa semplicemente \btn02

e \btn03 per spostarti velocemente. Oh,
e puoi persino usarlo per\lconservare questo regalo d{B4}addio

che ho preparato!

entries.original:
"That’s a [green]Costume Box[red]!

You can use it to change clothes at
any point in your journey.

I’ve filled it with different colours
for you to choose from, but if you\lfind more outfits, make sure you\lstore them in there as well.

Stay safe out there, honey!

Bring Prof. Log his package!"
entries.translation_source: That’s a [color-green-1]Costume Box[color-red-2]! You can use it to change clothes at any point in your journey. I’ve filled it with different colours for you to choose from, but if you find more outfits, make sure you store them in there as well. Stay safe out there, honey! Bring Prof. Log his package!
entries.translated:
Quella è una [green]Costume Box[red]! Puoi
usarla per cambiare vestiti in\lqualsiasi momento del tuo viaggio.

L{B4}ho riempita con colori diversi
tra cui scegliere, ma se trovi\laltri outfit, assicurati di

conservarli anche lì dentro. Stai
al sicuro là fuori, tesoro! Porta a\lProf. Log il suo pacco!

entries.original:
"[player]!
You should take a quick rest."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You should take a quick rest.
entries.translated:
[player]! Dovresti fare una breve
pausa.

entries.original:
"Happy birthday, [player]!
You should take a quick rest."
entries.translation_source: Happy birthday, [player-name-1]! You should take a quick rest.
entries.translated:
Buon compleanno, [player]! Dovresti
prenderti una breve pausa.

entries.original:
"Oh, good! You and your
Pokémon are looking great.

Take care now!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
entries.translated:
Oh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon state
benissimo. Abbi cura di te!

entries.original:
"[player],

I have taken your mother into
the [green]depths[black] of the [green]Ruins of Void[black].

Come alone if you ever want to
see her again.

-A"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], I have taken your mother into the [color-green-2]depths[color-black-3] of the [color-green-4]Ruins of Void[color-black-5]. Come alone if you ever want to see her again. -A
entries.translated:
[player], ho portato tua madre
nelle [green]profondità[black] delle [green]Rovine del\lVuoto[black]. Vieni da solo se vuoi

rivederla. -A

entries.original:
"It’s a trophy proving you defeated
the Battle Tower Frontier Brain in\la standard Single Battle!"
entries.translation_source: It’s a trophy proving you defeated the Battle Tower Frontier Brain in a standard Single Battle!
entries.translated:
È un trofeo che prova che hai
sconfitto il Cervello della\lFrontiera della Torre Lotta in una

normale Lotta in Singolo!

entries.original:
"It’s a trophy proving you defeated
the Battle Tower Frontier Brain in\la standard Double Battle!"
entries.translation_source: It’s a trophy proving you defeated the Battle Tower Frontier Brain in a standard Double Battle!
entries.translated:
È un trofeo che prova che hai
sconfitto il Cervello della\lFrontiera della Torre Lotta in una

normale Lotta in Doppio!

entries.original:
"It’s a trophy proving you defeated
the Battle Tower Frontier Brain in\la standard Multi Battle!"
entries.translation_source: It’s a trophy proving you defeated the Battle Tower Frontier Brain in a standard Multi Battle!
entries.translated:
È un trofeo che prova che hai
sconfitto il Cervello della\lFrontiera della Torre Lotta in una

Lotta Multi standard!

entries.original:
"[player]! Stopping by for a visit?

You should hurry on over to
[green]Redwood Village[blue]!

The sooner you beat the Gym there,
the sooner you can challenge the\lPokémon League and become the\lnew Champion."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Stopping by for a visit? You should hurry on over to [color-green-2]Redwood Village[color-blue-3]! The sooner you beat the Gym there, the sooner you can challenge the Pokémon League and become the new Champion.
entries.translated:
[player]! Sei passato per fare una
visita? Dovresti affrettarti ad\landare a [green]Redwood Village[blue]! Prima

sconfiggi la Palestra lì, prima
potrai sfidare la Lega Pokémon e\ldiventare il nuovo Campione.

entries.original:
"[player]! Stopping by for a visit?

You should hurry on over to the
[green]Pokémon League[blue]!

The sooner you get there, the
sooner you can become the new\lChampion!

Just head [green]east[blue] from [green]Gurun Town[blue]
along [green]Route 18[blue] to get there."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Stopping by for a visit? You should hurry on over to the [color-green-2]Pokémon League[color-blue-3]! The sooner you get there, the sooner you can become the new Champion! Just head [color-green-4]east[color-blue-5] from [color-green-6]Gurun Town[color-blue-7] along [color-green-8]Route 18[color-blue-9] to get there.
entries.translated:
[player]! Sei passato a trovarmi?
Faresti bene a sbrigarti verso la\l[green]Lega Pokémon[blue]! Più presto arrivi,

prima potrai diventare il nuovo
Campione! Vai semplicemente a [green]est[blue]\lda [green]Gurun Town[blue] lungo la [green]Percorso 18[blue]

per arrivarci.

entries.original:
"[black]There’s a Pokémon on the table!

But you have no room for it in
your party\."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]There’s a Pokémon on the table! But you have no room for it in your party[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[black]C{B4}è un Pokémon sul tavolo! Ma non
hai spazio in squadra per questo\lPokémon\.

entries.original:
"[player], it’s good to see you
again.

I’m just making up for lost time.

Good luck with your endeavors!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], it’s good to see you again. I’m just making up for lost time. Good luck with your endeavors!
entries.translated:
[player], è bello rivederti. Sto
solo recuperando il tempo perduto.\lBuona fortuna per i tuoi progetti!

entries.original: "Melony"
entries.translation_source: Melony
entries.translated: Melony

entries.original:
"Oh\.

You’re [player], right?

I’ve heard about you from
[rival].

He told me about how you helped
him out earlier.

It’s rare for my brother to
respect anyone, but he seems to\lrespect you."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] You’re [player-name-2], right? I’ve heard about you from [text-token-rival-3]. He told me about how you helped him out earlier. It’s rare for my brother to respect anyone, but he seems to respect you.
entries.translated:
Oh\. Tu sei [player], giusto? Ho
sentito parlare di te da [rival].\lMi ha raccontato di come lo hai

aiutato prima. È raro che mio
fratello rispetti qualcuno, ma\lsembra rispettare te.

entries.original:
"Are you looking for [rival]?

He set out on a journey to find
out what happened to our parents.

They ditched us when we were kids,
and we haven’t seen them since."
entries.translation_source: Are you looking for [text-token-rival-1]? He set out on a journey to find out what happened to our parents. They ditched us when we were kids, and we haven’t seen them since.
entries.translated:
Stai cercando [rival]? È partito
per un viaggio per scoprire cosa è\lsuccesso ai nostri genitori. Ci

hanno piantati quando eravamo
bambini e non li abbiamo più visti\lda allora.

entries.original:
"That weird guy from before followed
us back home.

I’m starting to wonder, though\.
What if he really is our dad?"
entries.translation_source: That weird guy from before followed us back home. I’m starting to wonder, though[game-token-1] What if he really is our dad?
entries.translated:
Quel tipo strano di prima ci ha
seguiti fino a casa. Però comincio\la chiedermi\. E se fosse davvero

nostro padre?

entries.original:
"It’s horrible!

My dad asked me to watch over
Zeph’s son while he and [rival]\lare out, but that man from\lCrystal Peak came by and snatched\lhim right up!

I feel terrible\."
entries.translation_source: It’s horrible! My dad asked me to watch over Zeph’s son while he and [text-token-rival-1] are out, but that man from Crystal Peak came by and snatched him right up! I feel terrible[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
È orribile! Mio papà mi ha chiesto
di sorvegliare il figlio di Zeph\lmentre lui e [rival] sono fuori,

ma quell{B4}uomo di Crystal Peak è
passato e lo ha rapito all{B4}istante!\lMi sento terribile\.

entries.original:
"That man - Zeph was finally released
from prison.

It seems he had enough money to
post bail.

Although he didn’t serve his full
sentence, when he picked up his\lson, I could tell he was trying to\lmake amends for all he had done."
entries.translation_source: That man - Zeph was finally released from prison. It seems he had enough money to post bail. Although he didn’t serve his full sentence, when he picked up his son, I could tell he was trying to make amends for all he had done.
entries.translated:
Quell{B4}uomo - Zeph è finalmente
uscito di prigione. Pare che avesse\labbastanza soldi per pagare la

cauzione. Anche se non ha scontato
tutta la pena, quando ha preso suo\lfiglio ho capito che stava cercando

di rimediare a tutto quello che
aveva fatto.

entries.original:
"Oh, by the way, [rival] left a
gift for you on the table."
entries.translation_source: Oh, by the way, [text-token-rival-1] left a gift for you on the table.
entries.translated:
Ah, a proposito, [rival] ti ha
lasciato un regalo sul tavolo.

entries.original: "Zeph Jr."
entries.translation_source: Zeph Jr.
entries.translated: Zeph Jr.

entries.original:
"When’s Daddy coming home?
I wanna play with Daddy!"
entries.translation_source: When’s Daddy coming home? I wanna play with Daddy!
entries.translated:
Quando torna papà a casa? Voglio
giocare con papà!

entries.original: "Neighbourly Assistance"
entries.translation_source: Neighbourly Assistance
entries.translated: Aiuto di vicinato

entries.original:
"Your neighbour needs your help!
Bring him an Antidote from the
Poké Mart to restore his health."
entries.translation_source: Your neighbour needs your help! Bring him an Antidote from the Poké Mart to restore his health.
entries.translated:
Il tuo vicino ha bisogno del tuo
aiuto! Portagli una Antidoto dal\lPoké Mart per ripristinare la sua

salute.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello, [player]!

I heard from your mother that
you’re finally leaving town!

This is very exciting news!

Now, might I ask you for a favour?

I’ve been feeling a little under
the weather lately, and I was\lhoping you could pick me up an\l[green]Antidote[blue] from the Poké Mart."
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello, [player-name-1]! I heard from your mother that you’re finally leaving town! This is very exciting news! Now, might I ask you for a favour? I’ve been feeling a little under the weather lately, and I was hoping you could pick me up an [color-green-2]Antidote[color-blue-3] from the Poké Mart.
entries.translated:
Oh, ciao, [player]! Ho sentito da
tua madre che finalmente lascerai\lla città! Sono notizie davvero

entusiasmanti! Ora, posso chiederti
un favore? Mi sento un po{B4} giù di\lcorda ultimamente e speravo che

potessi prendermi un [green]Antidoto[blue] al
Poké Mart.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello, [player]!

Congratulations on becoming the
Champion!

This is very exciting news!

Now, might I ask you for a favour?

I’ve been feeling a little under
the weather lately, and I was\lhoping you could pick me up an\l[green]Antidote[blue] from the Poké Mart."
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello, [player-name-1]! Congratulations on becoming the Champion! This is very exciting news! Now, might I ask you for a favour? I’ve been feeling a little under the weather lately, and I was hoping you could pick me up an [color-green-2]Antidote[color-blue-3] from the Poké Mart.
entries.translated:
Oh, ciao, [player]! Congratulazioni
per essere diventato il Campione!\lQuesta è una notizia davvero

entusiasmante! Posso chiederti un
favore? Mi sento un po{B4} sottotono\lultimamente, e speravo che potessi

procurarmi un [green]Antidoto[blue] al Poké
Mart.

entries.original:
"Oh, that’s unfortunate, [player].

I’ll have to suffer in silence, then."
entries.translation_source: Oh, that’s unfortunate, [player-name-1]. I’ll have to suffer in silence, then.
entries.translated:
Oh, che sfortuna, [player]. Allora
dovrò soffrire in silenzio.

entries.original:
"Wonderful, wonderful.

The closest Poké Mart is in
Bellin Town, and they should be\lwell stocked up with Antidotes!"
entries.translation_source: Wonderful, wonderful. The closest Poké Mart is in Bellin Town, and they should be well stocked up with Antidotes!
entries.translated:
Magnifico, magnifico. Il Poké Mart
più vicino si trova a Bellin Town e\ldovrebbero essere ben forniti di

Antidoti!

entries.original:
"Wonderful, wonderful.

I’m sure the Champion knows where
to find a simple Antidote, yes?

Hurry back now!"
entries.translation_source: Wonderful, wonderful. I’m sure the Champion knows where to find a simple Antidote, yes? Hurry back now!
entries.translated:
Meraviglioso, meraviglioso. Sono
sicuro che il Campione sa dove\ltrovare un semplice Antidoto, sì?

Sbrigati a tornare!

entries.original:
"The closest Poké Mart is in
Bellin Town, and they should be\lwell stocked up with [green]Antidotes[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: The closest Poké Mart is in Bellin Town, and they should be well stocked up with [color-green-1]Antidotes[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Il Pokémarket più vicino si trova a
Bellin Town, e dovrebbero avere una\lbella scorta di [green]Antidoti[blue]!

entries.original:
"I’m sure the Champion knows where
to find a simple [green]Antidote[blue], yes?

Hurry back now!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sure the Champion knows where to find a simple [color-green-1]Antidote[color-blue-2], yes? Hurry back now!
entries.translated:
Sono sicuro che il Campione sappia
dove trovare un semplice [green]Antidoto[blue],\lsì? Torna subito!

entries.original:
"Wonderful, [player].

I’ll take that Antidote off your
hands now."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful, [player-name-1]. I’ll take that Antidote off your hands now.
entries.translated:
Perfetto, [player]. Adesso ti
prendo io quell{B4}Antidoto di mano.

entries.original:
"This is just what I needed,
[player]!

Thank you, I really appreciate it!

You know\.\CC0818 your father would have
done the same thing for me.

No matter how minor the task, he
was always willing to lend a hand.

I can tell you’re already following
in your father’s footsteps.

And who knows?

Perhaps you may even become a great
Pokémon Trainer like he was!

The road to that point will be long
and arduous, but I have faith that\lyou can and will make it there!

Take this item to help you on
your journey.

It is a rare gemstone that can
power up a single attack in battle.

Use it wisely."
entries.translation_source: This is just what I needed, [player-name-1]! Thank you, I really appreciate it! You know[game-token-2][control-code-3] your father would have done the same thing for me. No matter how minor the task, he was always willing to lend a hand. I can tell you’re already following in your father’s footsteps. And who knows? Perhaps you may even become a great Pokémon Trainer like he was! The road to that point will be long and arduous, but I have faith that you can and will make it there! Take this item to help you on your journey. It is a rare gemstone that can power up a single attack in battle. Use it wisely.
entries.translated:
Questo è proprio ciò di cui avevo
bisogno, [player]! Grazie, lo\lapprezzo davvero! Sai\.\CC0818 tuo padre

avrebbe fatto lo stesso per me. Non
importa quanto piccolo fosse il\lcompito, era sempre disposto a dare

una mano. Posso dire che stai già
seguendo le orme di tuo padre. E\lchi lo sa? Forse potresti persino

diventare un grande Allenatore
Pokémon come lui! La strada fino a\lquel punto sarà lunga e ardua, ma

ho fiducia che tu possa farcela e
che ci riuscirai! Prendi questo\lstrumento per aiutarti nel tuo

viaggio. È una gemma rara che può
potenziare un singolo attacco in\lbattaglia. Usala saggiamente.

entries.original:
"This is just what I needed,
[player]!

Thank you, I really appreciate it!

You know\.\CC0818 your father would have
done the same thing for me.

No matter how minor the task, he
was always willing to lend a hand.

I can tell you’ve followed in his
footsteps well.

And you even became a great
Pokémon Trainer, just like he was!

I’m sure the road to this point was
long and arduous, but I always had\lfaith in you, [player]!

Now take this rare gemstone for
the troubles I put you through."
entries.translation_source: This is just what I needed, [player-name-1]! Thank you, I really appreciate it! You know[game-token-2][control-code-3] your father would have done the same thing for me. No matter how minor the task, he was always willing to lend a hand. I can tell you’ve followed in his footsteps well. And you even became a great Pokémon Trainer, just like he was! I’m sure the road to this point was long and arduous, but I always had faith in you, [player-name-4]! Now take this rare gemstone for the troubles I put you through.
entries.translated:
È proprio quello che mi serviva,
[player]! Grazie, te ne sono\ldavvero grato! Sai\.\CC0818 tuo padre

avrebbe fatto la stessa cosa per
me. Non importa quanto fosse\lpiccolo il compito, era sempre

disposto a dare una mano. Posso
dire che hai seguito bene le sue\lorme. E sei persino diventato un

grande Allenatore di Pokémon,
proprio come lui! Sono sicuro che\lla strada fin qui è stata lunga e

faticosa, ma ho sempre avuto
fiducia in te, [player]! Ora prendi\lquesta rara gemma per i problemi

che ti ho causato.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello, [player]!

How is your journey going?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello, [player-name-1]! How is your journey going?
entries.translated:
Oh, ciao, [player]! Come va il tuo
viaggio?

entries.original:
"If it isn’t our neighbour
the Champion!

How are you today, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: If it isn’t our neighbour the Champion! How are you today, [player-name-1]?
entries.translated:
Ma se non è il nostro vicino, il
Campione! Come stai oggi, [player]?

entries.original:
"Off on an adventure are we,
[player]?

In that case, let me impart a bit
of wisdom on you before you go!"
entries.translation_source: Off on an adventure are we, [player-name-1]? In that case, let me impart a bit of wisdom on you before you go!
entries.translated:
In partenza per un{B4}avventura,
[player]? In tal caso, lascia che\lti trasmetta un po{B4} di saggezza

prima che tu vada!

entries.original:
"I’m sure you already know, but with
that [green]Mission Log[red] device your mother\lgave you, you can record various\lrequests from people.

Some of these people may ask you
to complete a certain task some\lfinite number of times.

It may seem daunting at first, but
these people really just want to\lknow if you have satisfied their\lrequest at some point in your\ljourney.

So go on, keep exploring!

You’ll be amazed to see what kind
of things you can accomplish while\ltravelling.

In fact, sometimes they will even
make requests for things you have\lalready done!

In that case, you may ask them for
a reward right away.

Good luck on your journey!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sure you already know, but with that [color-green-1]Mission Log[color-red-2] device your mother gave you, you can record various requests from people. Some of these people may ask you to complete a certain task some finite number of times. It may seem daunting at first, but these people really just want to know if you have satisfied their request at some point in your journey. So go on, keep exploring! You’ll be amazed to see what kind of things you can accomplish while travelling. In fact, sometimes they will even make requests for things you have already done! In that case, you may ask them for a reward right away. Good luck on your journey!
entries.translated:
Immagino tu lo sappia già, ma con
quel [green]Mission Log[red] che ti ha dato tua\lmadre, puoi registrare varie

richieste da parte delle persone.
Alcune di queste persone potrebbero\lchiederti di completare un certo

compito un numero finito di volte.
All{B4}inizio potrebbe sembrare\lscoraggiante, ma queste persone

vogliono solo sapere se hai
soddisfatto la loro richiesta in\lqualche punto del tuo viaggio.

Quindi vai avanti, continua ad
esplorare! Rimarrai stupito di\lvedere che tipo di cose puoi

realizzare mentre viaggi. Infatti,
a volte faranno persino richieste\lper cose che hai già fatto! In tal

caso, puoi chiedere loro una
ricompensa immediatamente. Buona\lfortuna per il tuo viaggio!

entries.original:
"I’m sure you have a handle on
things, [player].

Good luck on your journey!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sure you have a handle on things, [player-name-1]. Good luck on your journey!
entries.translated:
Sono sicuro che hai tutto sotto
controllo, [player]. Buona fortuna\lper il tuo viaggio!

entries.original:
"Good luck on your journey,
[player]!

Your father would be very proud
that you’re finally leaving home!"
entries.translation_source: Good luck on your journey, [player-name-1]! Your father would be very proud that you’re finally leaving home!
entries.translated:
Buona fortuna nel tuo viaggio,
[player]! Tuo padre sarebbe molto\lorgoglioso del fatto che tu stia

finalmente lasciando casa!

entries.original:
"Congratulations on becoming
