Champion, [player]!

I had faith you would become the
new Guardian of Borrius ever since\lyou set off on your journey.

Your father would be very proud
of what you’ve become."
entries.translation_source: Congratulations on becoming Champion, [player-name-1]! I had faith you would become the new Guardian of Borrius ever since you set off on your journey. Your father would be very proud of what you’ve become.
entries.translated:
Congratulazioni per essere
diventato Campione, [player]! Ho\lsempre avuto fiducia che saresti

diventato il nuovo Guardiano di
Borrius sin da quando sei partito\lper il tuo viaggio. Tuo padre

sarebbe molto orgoglioso di ciò che
sei diventato.

entries.original:
"[player]!

My gramma told me you’re leaving
Frozen Heights!

It’ll be so lonely around here with
no one to play with\.

I’ll miss you!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! My gramma told me you’re leaving Frozen Heights! It’ll be so lonely around here with no one to play with[game-token-2] I’ll miss you!
entries.translated:
[player]! La mia nonna mi ha detto
che stai lasciando Frozen Heights!\lSarà così triste qui senza nessuno

con cui giocare\. Mi mancherai!

entries.original:
"[player]!

My gramma told me you’re the
strongest Trainer in Borrius!

Does that mean you’re coming home
forever?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! My gramma told me you’re the strongest Trainer in Borrius! Does that mean you’re coming home forever?
entries.translated:
[player]! La mia nonna mi ha detto
che sei l{B4}Allenatore più forte di\lBorrius! Significa che torni a casa

per sempre?

entries.original: "Sankren fimbulvetr!"
entries.translation_source: Sankren fimbulvetr!
entries.translated: Sankren fimbulvetr!

entries.original: "[green]Gyaoo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Gyaoo!
entries.translated: [green]Gyaoo!

entries.original: "Fullmoon Island"
entries.translation_source: Fullmoon Island
entries.translated: Isola Lunapiena

entries.original:
"Are you alright?

You seem to have taken quite the
beating!

Let me heal your Pokémon for you."
entries.translation_source: Are you alright? You seem to have taken quite the beating! Let me heal your Pokémon for you.
entries.translated:
Tutto bene? Sembri averne prese
davvero tante! Lascia che curi i\ltuoi Pokémon per te.

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon surrounded itself with
the power of the Lunar Wing and\lincreased its size!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Pokémon surrounded itself with the power of the Lunar Wing and increased its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Il Pokémon si è avvolto nel potere
della Piuma Lunare e ha aumentato\lle proprie dimensioni!

entries.original:
"[black]Cresselia flew off somewhere\.

There is something sparkling where
Cresselia once was\."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Cresselia flew off somewhere[game-token-2] There is something sparkling where Cresselia once was[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[black]Cresselia è volata via da qualche
parte\. C{B4}è qualcosa di scintillante\ldove una volta c{B4}era Cresselia\.

entries.original:
"[black]There is something sparkling where
Cresselia once was\."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]There is something sparkling where Cresselia once was[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[black]C{B4}è qualcosa che luccica dove una
volta c{B4}era Cresselia\.

entries.original: "Game Corner"
entries.translation_source: Game Corner
entries.translated: Sala Giochi

entries.original:
"Welcome to Dehara Game Corner!

Do you need some game Coins?
Would you like to buy some?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to Dehara Game Corner! Do you need some game Coins? Would you like to buy some?
entries.translated:
Benvenuto al Game Corner di Dehara!
Ti servono dei gettoni per i\lgiochi? Vuoi comprarne un po{B4}?

entries.original:
"Thank you.
Here are your Coins!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you. Here are your Coins!
entries.translated: Grazie. Ecco le tue monete!

entries.original:
"Oh, I’m sorry.
You don’t have a Coin Case."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I’m sorry. You don’t have a Coin Case.
entries.translated:
Oh, mi dispiace. Non hai una
Portamonete.

entries.original:
"Whoops!
Your Coin Case is full."
entries.translation_source: Whoops! Your Coin Case is full.
entries.translated: Ops! Il tuo Portamonete è pieno.

entries.original:
"No?
Please come play sometime!"
entries.translation_source: No? Please come play sometime!
entries.translated: No? Vieni a giocare ogni tanto!

entries.translation_source: You can’t afford the Coins.

entries.translation_source: I can exchange your Coins for prizes. Which kind of prize would you like?
entries.translated:
Posso scambiare i tuoi Gettoni con
dei premi. Che tipo di premio\ldesideri?

entries.original: "Which [buffer1] would you like?"
entries.translation_source: Which [buffer1-1] would you like?
entries.translated: Quale [buffer1] desideri?

entries.original:
"You’d like the [green][buffer1][red]?
How many would you like?"
entries.translation_source: You’d like the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]? How many would you like?
entries.translated:
Vorresti [green][buffer1][red]? Quanti ne
vorresti?

"You’d like [green][buffer3] [buffer1][red]?
That will be [green][buffer2][red] Coins."
entries.translation_source: You’d like [color-green-1][buffer3-2] [buffer1-3][color-red-4]? That will be [color-green-5][buffer2-6][color-red-7] Coins.
entries.translated:
Vorresti [green][buffer3] [buffer1][red]? Verrà
[green][buffer2][red] Gettoni.

entries.original:
"You’d like the [green][buffer1][red]?
That will be [green][buffer2][red] Coins."
entries.translation_source: You’d like the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]? That will be [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-red-6] Coins.
entries.translated:
Ti piacerebbe il [green][buffer1][red]? Saranno
[green][buffer2][red] gettoni.

entries.original: "You’d like a TM of [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: You’d like a TM of [buffer1-1]?
entries.translated: Vuoi una MT di [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, you don’t have enough
Coins for that prize."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, you don’t have enough Coins for that prize.
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace, non hai abbastanza
Monete per quel premio.

entries.original:
"Please make space in your party
before purchasing that Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Please make space in your party before purchasing that Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Per favore, liberate spazio nel
vostro gruppo prima di acquistare\lquel Pokémon.

entries.translation_source: You already own that TM.
entries.translated: Hai già questa MT.

entries.translation_source: Destiny Knot[control-code-1] [control-code-2]500 Coins

entries.original:
"I often skip school to come
pop balloons.

It’s just addicting, y’know?

It’s fun, and I get so many Coins
at the same time!"
entries.translation_source: I often skip school to come pop balloons. It’s just addicting, y’know? It’s fun, and I get so many Coins at the same time!
entries.translated:
Salto spesso la scuola per venire a
scoppiare palloncini. È proprio una\ldipendenza, capisci? È divertente,

e allo stesso tempo prendo un sacco
di Monete!

entries.original:
"This silly machine decided to lag
when I turned on my BGM!

Maybe I’ll play the old slots
instead."
entries.translation_source: This silly machine decided to lag when I turned on my BGM! Maybe I’ll play the old slots instead.
entries.translated:
Questa stupida macchina ha deciso
di rallentare quando ho acceso la\lmia BGM! Forse invece giocherò alle

vecchie slot.

entries.original: "What, you want to play?"
entries.translation_source: What, you want to play?
entries.translated: Come, vuoi giocare?

entries.original: "[black][player] received [green][buffer1][black] Coins!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received [color-green-3][buffer1-4][color-black-5] Coins!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto [green][buffer1][black]
Gettoni!

entries.original:
"Pop a [green]green[blue] balloon as soon as
you see one!

Not only will it double your Coins,
it’ll speed you up, and any Coins\lcollected while sped up will be\ldoubled too!"
entries.translation_source: Pop a [color-green-1]green[color-blue-2] balloon as soon as you see one! Not only will it double your Coins, it’ll speed you up, and any Coins collected while sped up will be doubled too!
entries.translated:
Scoppia un palloncino [green]verde[blue] appena
ne vedi uno! Non solo raddoppierà\lle tue Monete, ma ti farà anche

andare più veloce, e tutte le
Monete raccolte mentre sei\laccelerato verranno raddoppiate a

loro volta!

"[black]Oops!
Don’t have the Coin Case!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Oops! Don’t have the Coin Case!
entries.translated: [black]Ops! Non hai il Portamonete!

entries.original: "[black]You have too many Coins!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]You have too many Coins!
entries.translated: [black]Hai troppe monete!

entries.original:
"I’ve heard some regions have games
just like this one!

But I also heard that instead of
there being a goal in those\lregions, you’re just supposed to\lfly around an empty map.

Who needs that? That’s so boring!
I’d rather pop balloons any day!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve heard some regions have games just like this one! But I also heard that instead of there being a goal in those regions, you’re just supposed to fly around an empty map. Who needs that? That’s so boring! I’d rather pop balloons any day!
entries.translated:
Ho sentito che in alcune regioni ci
sono giochi proprio come questo!\lPerò ho anche sentito che, invece

di avere un obiettivo, in quelle
regioni bisogna solo volare in giro\lper una mappa vuota. Chi ne ha

bisogno? Che noia! Qualsiasi giorno
preferirei far scoppiare\lpalloncini!

entries.original:
"A friend of mine nabbed a ton of
Coins playing on one of these old\lslot machines.

Why mess with a good thing?
I’ll try the same spot, too!"
entries.translation_source: A friend of mine nabbed a ton of Coins playing on one of these old slot machines. Why mess with a good thing? I’ll try the same spot, too!
entries.translated:
Un mio amico ha fatto incetta di
Gettoni giocando su una di queste\lvecchie slot machine. Perché

rovinare una cosa che funziona?
Proverò anch{B4}io nello stesso posto!

entries.original:
"What’s up?
Want some Coins?"
entries.translation_source: What’s up? Want some Coins?
entries.translated: Ciao, vuoi dei Gettoni?

entries.original:
"Darn! Those polka dot balloons keep
sapping all my Coins!"
entries.translation_source: Darn! Those polka dot balloons keep sapping all my Coins!
entries.translated:
Accidenti! Quei palloncini a pois
continuano a prosciugarmi tutte le\lmonete!

entries.original:
"Hey, what? You’re throwing me off!
Here are some Coins, so shoo!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, what? You’re throwing me off! Here are some Coins, so shoo!
entries.translated:
Ehi, che? Mi stai scombussolando!
Ecco alcuni Gettoni, ora via!

entries.original:
"The trick is to always play on the
hardest game mode.

Yes, you may get less time, but the
speed more than makes up for it."
entries.translation_source: The trick is to always play on the hardest game mode. Yes, you may get less time, but the speed more than makes up for it.
entries.translated:
Il trucco è giocare sempre alla
modalità di gioco più difficile.\lSì, potresti avere meno tempo, ma

la velocità compensa più che
abbastanza.

entries.original:
"Oh, [player]!
I haven’t seen you in ages!

Congratulations on becoming the
Champion!

If you haven’t tried already, might
I recommend Cloud Burst?

The Altaria you fly is modeled off
of my own, I’ll have you know.

Play it and you’ll see the
resemblance, I swear it!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, [player-name-1]! I haven’t seen you in ages! Congratulations on becoming the Champion! If you haven’t tried already, might I recommend Cloud Burst? The Altaria you fly is modeled off of my own, I’ll have you know. Play it and you’ll see the resemblance, I swear it!
entries.translated:
Oh, [player]! Non ti vedevo da una
vita! Congratulazioni per essere\ldiventato Campione! Se non l{B4}hai

ancora provato, posso consigliarti
Cloud Burst? L{B4}Altaria che cavalchi\lè modellato sul mio, tanto per

dirlo. Giocalo e vedrai la
somiglianza, te lo giuro!

entries.original:
"Play Cloud Burst and you’ll see
the resemblance to my Altaria!

I come here every day just to see
it, you know."
entries.translation_source: Play Cloud Burst and you’ll see the resemblance to my Altaria! I come here every day just to see it, you know.
entries.translated:
Gioca a Cloud Burst e vedrai la
somiglianza con la mia Altaria!\lVengo qui ogni giorno solo per

vederla, sai.

entries.original:
"It’s an ancient slot machine!
Want to play?"
entries.translation_source: It’s an ancient slot machine! Want to play?
entries.translated:
È una vecchia slot machine! Vuoi
giocare?

entries.translation_source: A [color-green-1]Coin Case[color-black-2] is required[game-token-3]
entries.translated: È necessario un [green]Portamonete[black]\.

But the amount of Coins in your
Coin Case are overwhelming it!

Spend some Coins before trying
to play."
entries.translation_source: It’s an ancient slot machine! But the amount of Coins in your Coin Case are overwhelming it! Spend some Coins before trying to play.
entries.translated:
È un vecchio slot machine! Ma la
quantità di Monete nella tua Coin\lCase lo sta sopraffacendo! Spendi

un po{B4} di Monete prima di provare a
giocare.

entries.original:
"OUT OF ORDER
This is broken."
entries.translation_source: OUT OF ORDER This is broken.
entries.translated: FUORI SERVIZIO Questo è rotto.

entries.original: "A Life of No Regrets"
entries.translation_source: A Life of No Regrets
entries.translated: Una vita senza rimpianti

entries.original:
"Get popping! Play Cloud Burst and
collect 3000 Coins in a single day.
Remaining: [buffer1]"
entries.translation_source: Get popping! Play Cloud Burst and collect 3000 Coins in a single day. Remaining: [buffer1-1]
entries.translated:
Scatenati! Gioca a Cloud Burst e
raccogli 3000 Monete in un solo\lgiorno. Rimanenti: [buffer1]

entries.original:
"My mother always told me to get a
job I’d love.

But work requires effort, so I
became a Gambler.

Sometimes, I win and make money;
other times, I become indebted to\lthe Black Ferrothorn.

I want to quit, but I’m the best,
and I can’t quit while I’m number\lone.

Can you out pop me in balloons?"
entries.translation_source: My mother always told me to get a job I’d love. But work requires effort, so I became a Gambler. Sometimes, I win and make money; other times, I become indebted to the Black Ferrothorn. I want to quit, but I’m the best, and I can’t quit while I’m number one. Can you out pop me in balloons?
entries.translated:
Mia madre mi diceva sempre di
prendermi un lavoro che mi sarebbe\lpiaciuto. Ma il lavoro richiede

impegno, così sono diventato un
giocatore d{B4}azzardo. A volte vinco\le faccio soldi; altre volte, mi

indebito con il Ferrothorn Nero.
Vorrei smettere, ma sono il\lmigliore, e non posso mollare

finché sono il numero uno. Riesci a
battermi nel gioco dei palloncini?

entries.original:
"You have some spirit.

To beat my record, you’ll need to
collect at least [green][buffer1][blue] Coins in a\lsingle day by playing [green]Cloud Burst[blue].

I would spot you some Coins to
play, but I still owe the Black\lFerrothorn some money."
entries.translation_source: You have some spirit. To beat my record, you’ll need to collect at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] Coins in a single day by playing [color-green-4]Cloud Burst[color-blue-5]. I would spot you some Coins to play, but I still owe the Black Ferrothorn some money.
entries.translated:
Hai grinta. Per battere il mio
record, dovrai raccogliere almeno\l[green][buffer1][blue] Monete in un solo giorno

giocando a [green]Cloud Burst[blue]. Ti darei
qualche Moneta per giocare, ma devo\lancora dei soldi al Ferrothorn

Nero.

entries.original:
"Why, aren’t you an upright fellow,
not wanting to give in to the evils\lof gambling?"
entries.translation_source: Why, aren’t you an upright fellow, not wanting to give in to the evils of gambling?
entries.translated:
Ma guarda, che tipo onesto, a non
voler cedere ai mali del gioco\ld{B4}azzardo?

entries.original:
"Now is not the time to quit.

Your earnings of [buffer1] today are
not so far off from [green][buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Now is not the time to quit. Your earnings of [buffer1-1] today are not so far off from [color-green-2][buffer2-3][color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Non è il momento di arrendersi. I
tuoi guadagni di oggi, [buffer1],\lnon sono poi così lontani da

[green][buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"You actually out did me at my
own game\.

I guess I can quit, now that some
possibly underaged kid beat my\lrecord.

Here, take my Pokémon.

I thought it would help me fly to
new heights, but instead it just\lplunged me into deeper debt."
entries.translation_source: You actually out did me at my own game[game-token-1] I guess I can quit, now that some possibly underaged kid beat my record. Here, take my Pokémon. I thought it would help me fly to new heights, but instead it just plunged me into deeper debt.
entries.translated:
Mi hai davvero battuto nel mio
stesso gioco\. Immagino di poter\lsmettere, ora che un ragazzino

forse minorenne ha battuto il mio
record. Tieni, prendi il mio\lPokémon. Pensavo mi avrebbe aiutato

a volare verso nuove vette, ma
invece mi ha solo fatto sprofondare\lancora più a fondo nei debiti.

entries.original:
"Or, I would give it to you, if you
had more space in your party."
entries.translation_source: Or, I would give it to you, if you had more space in your party.
entries.translated:
Oppure, te lo darei, se avessi più
spazio nella tua squadra.

entries.original:
"You know, as a long-time customer,

If you’d like, I can have

entries.translation_source: You know, as a long-time customer, I have a bit of sway here. If you’d like, I can have [color-green-1]Happy Hour[color-blue-2] started for you.
entries.translated:
Sai, come cliente di lunga data,
qui ho una certa influenza. Se\lvuoi, posso far partire per te

next hour you’ll receive Coin\lpayouts from [green]Cloud Burst[blue] twice.

This means you’ll essentially earn

entries.translated:

Burst[blue]. Questo significa che
guadagnerai essenzialmente [green]il\ldoppio dei Gettoni[blue] in ogni partita!

entries.original:
"New Game \+ is a special feature that
allows you to start a new game\lwith special bonuses:

1) A team of max 6 Pokémon can
be carried over to the new game.

These 6 Pokémon are created from
the party in the previous save.

The Pokémon will be devolved to
their base species and will forget\lany moves barring Egg Moves.

Held items will be retained barring
Z-Crystals.

Additionally, stats such as EVs and
IVs will be retained.

2) If any of the following items
have been obtained in the previous\lsave, they will be carried over to\lthe new game:

Stat Scanner, Motorcycle, DexNav,
Dowsing Machine, Baby Monitor, ADM,\lTrainer Catalogue, Shiny Charm,\lOval Charm, Catching Charm, Magma\lStone, Frontier Card, Porta-PC,\lTime Turner, any unlocked item\lupgrades, and any BP earned.

3) The game’s difficulty may be
increased or decreased at any point\lwithout penalty.

4) Certain main story puzzles
solved in the previous save will\lremain solved in the new game.

5) If the Frontier Card is carried
over, then the Battle Frontier\lmay be accessed immediately upon\larrival in Seaport City.

6) Additional NPCs for modifying
IVs, EVs, and natures will be\lavailable in Crater Town until\lthe game is cleared (when not\lplaying on Sandbox Mode).

Note that some may charge BP for
their services, so make sure you\learn enough before starting the\lnew game.

7) Certain Legendary Pokémon
previously locked to the post-game\lwill now be obtainable before the\lgame is cleared."
entries.translation_source: New Game [game-token-1] is a special feature that allows you to start a new game with special bonuses: 1) A team of max 6 Pokémon can be carried over to the new game. These 6 Pokémon are created from the party in the previous save. The Pokémon will be devolved to their base species and will forget any moves barring Egg Moves. Held items will be retained barring Z-Crystals. Additionally, stats such as EVs and IVs will be retained. 2) If any of the following items have been obtained in the previous save, they will be carried over to the new game: Stat Scanner, Motorcycle, DexNav, Dowsing Machine, Baby Monitor, ADM, Trainer Catalogue, Shiny Charm, Oval Charm, Catching Charm, Magma Stone, Frontier Card, Porta-PC, Time Turner, any unlocked item upgrades, and any BP earned. 3) The game’s difficulty may be increased or decreased at any point without penalty. 4) Certain main story puzzles solved in the previous save will remain solved in the new game. 5) If the Frontier Card is carried over, then the Battle Frontier may be accessed immediately upon arrival in Seaport City. 6) Additional NPCs for modifying IVs, EVs, and natures will be available in Crater Town until the game is cleared (when not playing on Sandbox Mode). Note that some may charge BP for their services, so make sure you earn enough before starting the new game. 7) Certain Legendary Pokémon previously locked to the post-game will now be obtainable before the game is cleared.
entries.translated:
New Game \+ è una caratteristica
speciale che ti permette di\liniziare una nuova partita con

bonus speciali: 1) Una squadra di
massimo 6 Pokémon può essere\ltrasferita nella nuova partita.

Questi 6 Pokémon sono creati dal
gruppo nel salvataggio precedente.\lI Pokémon saranno ridotti alla loro

specie base e dimenticheranno
qualsiasi mossa tranne le Mosse\lUovo. Gli strumenti tenuti saranno

mantenuti tranne i Z-Cristalli.
Inoltre, statistiche come EV e IV\lsaranno mantenute. 2) Se uno

qualsiasi dei seguenti strumenti è
stato ottenuto nel salvataggio\lprecedente, sarà trasferito nella

nuova partita: Scanner Statistiche,
Moto, DexNav, Rilevatore, Baby\lMonitor, ADM, Catalogo Allenatori,

Cromaluccichio, Cromouovo, Cromo
Cattura, Magmapietra, Tessera\lFrontiera, Porta-PC, Giratempo,

qualsiasi potenziamento di
strumento sbloccato e qualsiasi BP\lguadagnato. 3) La difficoltà del

gioco può essere aumentata o
diminuita in qualsiasi momento\lsenza penalità. 4) Alcuni enigmi

della storia principale risolti nel
salvataggio precedente rimarranno\lrisolti nella nuova partita. 5) Se

la Tessera Frontiera viene
trasferita, allora il Parco Lotta\lpuò essere accessibile

immediatamente all{B4}arrivo a Seaport
City. 6) NPC aggiuntivi per\lmodificare IV, EV e nature saranno

disponibili a Crater Town fino al
termine del gioco (quando non si\lgioca in Modalità Sandbox). Nota

che alcuni potrebbero far pagare BP
per i loro servizi, quindi\lassicurati di guadagnare abbastanza

prima di iniziare la nuova partita.
7) Alcuni Pokémon Leggendari\lprecedentemente bloccati al

post-game saranno ora ottenibili
prima del termine del gioco.

entries.original:
"Welcome to Pokémon Unbound!

Before you begin playing, please
be aware that this is a non-profit
fan game.

If you paid for this game, reclaim
your money immediately!"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to Pokémon Unbound! Before you begin playing, please be aware that this is a non-profit fan game. If you paid for this game, reclaim your money immediately!
entries.translated:
Benvenuto in Pokémon Unbound! Prima
di iniziare a giocare, tieni
presente che questo è un fangame

non a scopo di lucro. Se hai pagato
per questo gioco, chiedi subito il
rimborso!

entries.original:
"In the world which you are about to
enter, you will embark on a grand
adventure with you as the hero.

The world is a big place. Take your
time exploring; there is no rush."
entries.translation_source: In the world which you are about to enter, you will embark on a grand adventure with you as the hero. The world is a big place. Take your time exploring; there is no rush.
entries.translated:
Nel mondo in cui stai per entrare,
intraprenderai una grande avventura
con te come eroe. Il mondo è un

posto enorme. Prenditi il tuo tempo
per esplorare; non c{B4}è fretta.

entries.original:
"Speak to people, and check things
wherever you go, be it towns,
roads, or caves.

The world and its people are alive.
As you grow, they will grow along
with you."
entries.translation_source: Speak to people, and check things wherever you go, be it towns, roads, or caves. The world and its people are alive. As you grow, they will grow along with you.
entries.translated:
Parla con le persone e controlla
ogni cosa ovunque tu vada, che si
tratti di città, strade o caverne.

Il mondo e le sue persone sono
vivi. Man mano che crescerai,
cresceranno insieme a te.

entries.original:
"With that in mind, you are almost
ready to enter the Borrius Region!
But first\."
entries.translation_source: With that in mind, you are almost ready to enter the Borrius Region! But first[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Con questo in mente, sei quasi
pronto per entrare nella regione di
Borrius! Ma prima\.

entries.translation_source: Choose a character.

entries.translation_source: Choose a skin tone.

entries.original: "Choose a jacket colour."

entries.original: "Choose a trim colour."

entries.translation_source: Last, but not least, what is your name?

per farti giocare. È la prima volta\lche giochi a Pokémon Unbound?

entries.translation_source: Do you enjoy challenging puzzles? This includes puzzles ranging from stealth puzzles to boulder puzzles.
entries.translated:
Ti piacciono gli enigmi
impegnativi? Questo include enigmi\lche vanno da quelli d{B4}infiltrazione

a quelli con i massi.

entries.original:
"Do you know about the common type

entries.translation_source: Do you know about the common type matchups, such as the Fairy-type being weak to the Poison-type?
entries.translated:
Conosci i comuni abbinamenti di
tipo, come il tipo Folletto debole\lal tipo Veleno?

entries.original:
"Do you know the types of the
majority of Pokémon, such as\lGliscor being the Ground- and\lFlying-types?"
entries.translation_source: Do you know the types of the majority of Pokémon, such as Gliscor being the Ground- and Flying-types?
entries.translated:
Conosci i tipi della maggior parte
dei Pokémon, come Gliscor che è di\ltipo Terra e Volante?

entries.original:
"Are you looking for a casual
gameplay experience without\lworrying too much about battles?"
entries.translation_source: Are you looking for a casual gameplay experience without worrying too much about battles?
entries.translated:
Cerchi un{B4}esperienza di gioco
tranquilla, senza preoccuparti\ltroppo delle lotte?

entries.original:
"Are you okay training a new Pokémon
for your team every so often?"
entries.translation_source: Are you okay training a new Pokémon for your team every so often?
entries.translated:
Ti va bene allenare un nuovo
Pokémon per la tua squadra ogni\ltanto?

entries.original:
"Do you know about EVs and IVs,
and like factoring them in?"
entries.translation_source: Do you know about EVs and IVs, and like factoring them in?
entries.translated:
Conosci gli EV e gli IV, e come
tenerne conto?

entries.original:
"Are you okay grinding for EVs if
the situation calls for it?"
entries.translation_source: Are you okay grinding for EVs if the situation calls for it?
entries.translated:
Ti va bene fare farming per gli EV
se la situazione lo richiede?

entries.original:
"[green][buffer1][black] is the recommended
difficulty for you.

While you are allowed to pick a
higher difficulty, doing so may\lharm your gameplay experience.

Are you okay to continue with the
[green][buffer1][black] difficulty?"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3] is the recommended difficulty for you. While you are allowed to pick a higher difficulty, doing so may harm your gameplay experience. Are you okay to continue with the [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-black-6] difficulty?
entries.translated:
[green][buffer1][black] è la difficoltà
consigliata per te. Anche se puoi\lscegliere una difficoltà più alta,

farlo potrebbe compromettere la tua
esperienza di gioco. Va bene\lcontinuare con la difficoltà

[green][buffer1][black]?

entries.original:
"[green]Expert[black] is the recommended
difficulty for you.

If you are skilled enough, you will
not need to EV train early on.

However, it will become required
later on in your adventure, in\laddition to some level of strategy\lduring your fights.

Are you okay continuing with the
Expert difficulty?"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Expert[color-black-2] is the recommended difficulty for you. If you are skilled enough, you will not need to EV train early on. However, it will become required later on in your adventure, in addition to some level of strategy during your fights. Are you okay continuing with the Expert difficulty?
entries.translated:
[green]Esperto[black] è la difficoltà consigliata
per te. Se sei abbastanza abile,\lall{B4}inizio non avrai bisogno di

allenare gli EV. Tuttavia, più
avanti nella tua avventura\ldiventerà necessario, oltre a un

po{B4} di strategia durante gli
scontri. Va bene per te continuare\lcon la difficoltà Esperto?

entries.original:
"Choose your preferred puzzle
difficulty.

A harder difficulty means harder
thought and stealth puzzles."
entries.translation_source: Choose your preferred puzzle difficulty. A harder difficulty means harder thought and stealth puzzles.
entries.translated:
Scegli il livello di difficoltà
degli enigmi che preferisci. Una\ldifficoltà maggiore significa

enigmi di logica e di furtività più
difficili.

entries.original:
"The game’s puzzle difficulty has
been set to [green][buffer1][black].

If you change it at any point using
the Options Menu, be sure to leave\lthe area for the changes to take\leffect."
entries.translation_source: The game’s puzzle difficulty has been set to [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3]. If you change it at any point using the Options Menu, be sure to leave the area for the changes to take effect.
entries.translated:
La difficoltà degli enigmi del
gioco è stata impostata su\l[green][buffer1][black]. Se la cambi in qualsiasi

momento dal Menu Opzioni,
assicurati di uscire dall{B4}area\lperché le modifiche abbiano

effetto.

entries.original:
"Choose your preferred battle
difficulty.

A higher difficulty means stronger
Trainers and smarter wild Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Choose your preferred battle difficulty. A higher difficulty means stronger Trainers and smarter wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Scegli la difficoltà di battaglia
che preferisci. Una difficoltà più\lalta significa Allenatori più forti

e Pokémon selvatici più
intelligenti.

entries.original:
"Please note this mode was designed
for players with a moderate degree\lof Pokémon battling experience.

You will not need to worry about
EVs or IVs to complete this mode,\lbut you should strategize before\lyour fights.

Are you okay to continue with the
[green]Difficult[black] Difficulty?"
entries.translation_source: Please note this mode was designed for players with a moderate degree of Pokémon battling experience. You will not need to worry about EVs or IVs to complete this mode, but you should strategize before your fights. Are you okay to continue with the [color-green-1]Difficult[color-black-2] Difficulty?
entries.translated:
Nota che questa modalità è stata
progettata per giocatori con\lun{B4}esperienza moderata nelle lotte

Pokémon. Non dovrai preoccuparti di
EV o IV per completare questa\lmodalità, ma dovresti pianificare

le tue mosse prima degli scontri.
Va bene continuare con la\ldifficoltà [green]Difficile[black]?

entries.original:
"Please note this mode was designed
to be completed with a fully EV\ltrained team.

If you have such a team, you will
likely not need to switch up your\lteam in between important battles.

Are you SURE you’re okay with the
[green]Expert[black] Difficulty?"
entries.translation_source: Please note this mode was designed to be completed with a fully EV trained team. If you have such a team, you will likely not need to switch up your team in between important battles. Are you SURE you’re okay with the [color-green-1]Expert[color-black-2] Difficulty?
entries.translated:
Nota che questa modalità è stata
progettata per essere completata\lcon una squadra completamente

allenata in EV. Se hai una squadra
del genere, probabilmente non\ldovrai cambiare squadra tra le

battaglie importanti. Sei SICURO di
voler continuare con la difficoltà\l[green]Expert[black]?

entries.original:
"[lightgreen]WARNING![black]

This game mode was designed to be
a near impossible task!

At many points it will feel like
an unfair or tedious challenge.

This was the intent!

So, if you choose this difficulty, be
prepared to lose many, many times!

And know that if you choose to
proceed, you have no one to blame\lbut yourself\.

Are you SURE you want to play with
the [green]Insane[black] difficulty?"
entries.translation_source: [color-lightgreen-1]WARNING![color-black-2] This game mode was designed to be a near impossible task! At many points it will feel like an unfair or tedious challenge. This was the intent! So, if you choose this difficulty, be prepared to lose many, many times! And know that if you choose to proceed, you have no one to blame but yourself[game-token-3] Are you SURE you want to play with the [color-green-4]Insane[color-black-5] difficulty?
entries.translated:
[lightgreen]ATTENZIONE![black] Questa modalità di
gioco è stata progettata per essere\lun compito quasi impossibile! In

molti punti sembrerà una sfida
ingiusta o noiosa. Questa era\ll{B4}intenzione! Quindi, se scegli

questa difficoltà, preparati a
perdere molte, molte volte! E sappi\lche se scegli di procedere, non hai

nessuno da incolpare se non te
stesso\. Sei SICURO di voler giocare\lcon la difficoltà [green]Insane[black]?

La difficoltà del gioco è stata
impostata su [green][buffer1][black]. Sentiti\llibero di passare da Vanilla a

to [green][buffer1][black].

Since New Game \+ is activated, this
may be changed freely at any point\lusing the [green]Options[black] Menu."
entries.translation_source: The game’s difficulty has been set to [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3]. Since New Game [game-token-4] is activated, this may be changed freely at any point using the [color-green-5]Options[color-black-6] Menu.
entries.translated:
La difficoltà del gioco è stata
impostata su [green][buffer1][black]. Poiché New\lGame \+ è attivato, può essere

modificata liberamente in qualsiasi
momento tramite il Menu [green]Opzioni[black].

entries.original:
"Additionally, do note there is a
hard level cap enabled by default,\lbut it can easily be disabled from\lthe Options Menu at any time."
entries.translation_source: Additionally, do note there is a hard level cap enabled by default, but it can easily be disabled from the Options Menu at any time.
entries.translated:
Inoltre, nota che esiste un limite
di livello rigido abilitato per\limpostazione predefinita, ma può

essere facilmente disattivato dal
Menu Opzioni in qualsiasi momento.

entries.original:
"Would you like to enable an
optional hard level cap?

After certain levels are reached,
this will prevent your Pokémon\lfrom gaining any more Exp. until\lthe next milestone is completed."
entries.translation_source: Would you like to enable an optional hard level cap? After certain levels are reached, this will prevent your Pokémon from gaining any more Exp. until the next milestone is completed.
entries.translated:
Vuoi attivare un limite massimo di
livello rigido opzionale? Raggiunti\lcerti livelli, questo impedirà ai

tuoi Pokémon di guadagnare altra
Exp. fino al completamento del\lprossimo traguardo.

entries.original:
"An optional hard level cap has
been enabled.

This can easily be disabled by
changing the [green]Exp. Gain[black] Option in\lthe Options Menu from [green]Capped Share[black]."
entries.translation_source: An optional hard level cap has been enabled. This can easily be disabled by changing the [color-green-1]Exp. Gain[color-black-2] Option in the Options Menu from [color-green-3]Capped Share[color-black-4].
entries.translated:
È stato attivato un limite di
livello massimo opzionale. Può\lessere facilmente disattivato

cambiando l{B4}opzione [green]Guadagno Exp.[black]
nel Menu Opzioni da [green]Condiv. Esp.[black].

entries.translation_source: Would you like to play a variant with stat rebalancing?

Ti andrebbe di giocare a una
variante con riequilibrio delle\lstatistiche?

entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]rebalanced variant[color-black-2] has been enabled.

La variante [green]ribilanciata[black] è stata

entries.original:
"In the rebalanced variant, all
fully evolved Pokémon, including\lsingle species lines, will have\ltheir stats barring HP scaled to\lgive an approximate base stat\ltotal of 600.

However, Shedinja will not have its
stats scaled, and the Ability Huge\lPower will not have any effect on\lscaled species."
entries.translation_source: In the rebalanced variant, all fully evolved Pokémon, including single species lines, will have their stats barring HP scaled to give an approximate base stat total of 600. However, Shedinja will not have its stats scaled, and the Ability Huge Power will not have any effect on scaled species.
entries.translated:
Nella variante ribilanciata, tutti
