experienced Trainers that leads up\lto the Pokémon League.

It is there you may challenge the
Elite Four and defend your title\lof Champion."
entries.translation_source: If you sail east of Gurun Town, you’ll approach the entrance to Victory Road. This is a challenging path for experienced Trainers that leads up to the Pokémon League. It is there you may challenge the Elite Four and defend your title of Champion.
entries.translated:
Se navighi a est di Gurun Town, ti
avvicinerai all{B4}ingresso della Via\lVittoria. È un percorso impegnativo

per Allenatori esperti che conduce
alla Lega Pokémon. È lì che potrai\lsfidare i Superquattro e difendere

il tuo titolo di Campione.

entries.original:
"Shops will give you a discount
on your birthday.

But like all good things, there’s
a catch.

Sure, the items you can buy are
cheaper, but you’ll also get less\lfor selling any back."
entries.translation_source: Shops will give you a discount on your birthday. But like all good things, there’s a catch. Sure, the items you can buy are cheaper, but you’ll also get less for selling any back.
entries.translated:
I negozi ti faranno uno sconto il
giorno del tuo compleanno. Ma come\ltutte le cose belle, c{B4}è un trucco.

Certo, gli oggetti che puoi
comprare costano meno, ma ricaverai\lanche meno quando ne rivenderai

qualcuno.

entries.original:
"Oh, dear\.
You’re looking faint!

Have you not been drinking enough
liquid?

Here, please have some of mine."
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear[game-token-1] You’re looking faint! Have you not been drinking enough liquid? Here, please have some of mine.
entries.translated:
Oh, cielo\. Sembri svenire! Non hai
bevuto abbastanza liquidi? Ecco,\lprendine un po{B4}.

entries.original:
"Oh, good, you’re looking much
better now.

Do try to be more careful while
travelling in this heat!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, good, you’re looking much better now. Do try to be more careful while travelling in this heat!
entries.translated:
Oh, bene, adesso stai molto meglio.
Cerca davvero di stare più attento\lmentre viaggi con questo caldo!

entries.original: "Dresco Town Gym"
entries.translation_source: Dresco Town Gym
entries.translated: Palestra di Paese Dresco

entries.original: "Mirskle"
entries.translation_source: Mirskle
entries.translated: Mirskle

entries.original:
"Huh?
Oh\.\CC0818 hey there, [buffer1]\.

How’z it hangin’?

Your Pokémon wanna sniff on some
uh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense?

It’s really good for the soul.
Makes it nice and mellow\."
entries.translation_source: Huh? Oh[game-token-1][control-code-2] hey there, [buffer1-3][game-token-4] How’z it hangin’? Your Pokémon wanna sniff on some uh[game-token-5][control-code-6] Rose Incense? It’s really good for the soul. Makes it nice and mellow[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Eh? Oh\.\CC0818 ehi, [buffer1]\. Come va? I
tuoi Pokémon vogliono annusare un\lpo{B4} di eh\.\CC0818 Profumo di Rose? Fa

davvero bene all{B4}anima. Rende tutto
bello e tranquillo\.

entries.original:
"[black][buffer1] sniffed on the
strange plant\.

It’s feeling tougher!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] sniffed on the strange plant[game-token-3] It’s feeling tougher!
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] ha annusato la strana
pianta\. Sembra che stia diventando\lpiù forte!

entries.original:
"Oh\. what’s this?

It’s lookin’ like Gloom wants a
sniff, too\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] what’s this? It’s lookin’ like Gloom wants a sniff, too[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Oh\. che cos{B4}è? Sembra che anche
Gloom voglia annusare\.

entries.original:
"[black]Mirskle’s Gloom sniffed on the
strange plant\.

It’s feeling tougher!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Mirskle’s Gloom sniffed on the strange plant[game-token-2] It’s feeling tougher!
entries.translated:
[black]Il Gloom di Mirskle ha annusato la
strana pianta\. Si sente più forte!

entries.original:
"Oh, you’re lookin’ to battle?
My bad.

I’m the Gym Leader, so\.

I guess I’m in the right mood to
indulge you\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you’re lookin’ to battle? My bad. I’m the Gym Leader, so[game-token-1] I guess I’m in the right mood to indulge you[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Oh, vuoi combattere? Colpa mia.
Sono il Capopalestra, quindi\.\lSuppongo di essere nel giusto umore

per accontentarti\.

entries.original:
"See, I’m the sort of guy who’s
into flowers.

You get me?

Most beautiful part of nature,
[buffer1]\.

You’ll be trippin’ just watchin’
them all! Let’s get funky!"
entries.translation_source: See, I’m the sort of guy who’s into flowers. You get me? Most beautiful part of nature, [buffer1-1][game-token-2] You’ll be trippin’ just watchin’ them all! Let’s get funky!
entries.translated:
Vedi, io sono il tipo a cui
piacciono i fiori. Mi segui? La\lparte più bella della natura,

[buffer1]\. Ti verrà da sballarti solo
a guardarli tutti! Scateniamoci!

entries.original:
"Whoa, man\.

Now that\.
That battle was somethin’ else\."
entries.translation_source: Whoa, man[game-token-1] Now that[game-token-2] That battle was somethin’ else[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Wow, amico\. Adesso sì che\. Quella
battaglia era qualcosa di pazzesco\.

entries.original:
"That’s deep, [buffer1].

Dunno if that’s the fog talkin’\.

\.but I really felt it, man.
Body and soul.

Here. Take this fine, fine Badge,
for beatin’ Mirskle, Gym Leader\lof flowers."
entries.translation_source: That’s deep, [buffer1-1]. Dunno if that’s the fog talkin’[game-token-2] [game-token-3]but I really felt it, man. Body and soul. Here. Take this fine, fine Badge, for beatin’ Mirskle, Gym Leader of flowers.
entries.translated:
È profondo, [buffer1]. Non so se sia
la nebbia che parla\. \.ma l{B4}ho sentito\ldavvero, amico. Corpo e anima.

Tieni. Prendi questa splendida
Medaglia, per aver battuto Mirskle,\lCapopalestra dei fiori.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Leaf Badge
from Mirskle!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Leaf Badge from Mirskle!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto la Medaglia
Foglia da Mirskle!

entries.original:
"That’s the [green]Leaf Badge[blue].

That useful li’l thin’ makes all
traded Pokémon up to \Lv 26 keep\llistenin’ to your fine, fine\lcommands\.

Oh, and take this cool, cool TM,
toooo\."
entries.translation_source: That’s the [color-green-1]Leaf Badge[color-blue-2]. That useful li’l thin’ makes all traded Pokémon up to [game-token-3] 26 keep listenin’ to your fine, fine commands[game-token-4] Oh, and take this cool, cool TM, toooo[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Quella è la [green]Medaglia Foglia[blue]. Quella
graziosa cosetta fa sì che tutti i\lPokémon scambiati fino al \Lv 26

continuino a obbedire ai tuoi
magnifici comandi\. Oh, e prendi\lanche questa fantastica MT, troppo\.

entries.original:
"That’s a Technical Machine.

That teaches your Pokémon a
move over and over, to as many\lfine, fine Pokémon as you want.

So don’t be shy about spreadin’
the love.

Preach it, [buffer1]!

Anyway\. that move’s [green]Grass Knot[blue].

I knew this guy once.
He’d always be fallin’ over.

Said it was some sort of
genetic problem.

Truth is\. I just kept usin’
Grass Knot on him!

Good thing he wasn’t too heavy, or
else that woulda REALLY hurt."
entries.translation_source: That’s a Technical Machine. That teaches your Pokémon a move over and over, to as many fine, fine Pokémon as you want. So don’t be shy about spreadin’ the love. Preach it, [buffer1-1]! Anyway[game-token-2] that move’s [color-green-3]Grass Knot[color-blue-4]. I knew this guy once. He’d always be fallin’ over. Said it was some sort of genetic problem. Truth is[game-token-5] I just kept usin’ Grass Knot on him! Good thing he wasn’t too heavy, or else that woulda REALLY hurt.
entries.translated:
Quella è una Macchina Tecnica.
Insegna ai tuoi Pokémon una mossa\lpiù e più volte, a quanti

splendidi, splendidi Pokémon vuoi.
Quindi non essere timido nel\ldiffondere l{B4}amore. Predicalo,

[buffer1]! Comunque\. quella mossa è
[green]Laccioerboso[blue]. Conoscevo uno di\lquesti tizi. Cadeva sempre per

terra. Diceva che era una specie di
problema genetico. La verità è\.\lcontinuavo solo a usare

Laccioerboso su di lui! Per fortuna
non era troppo pesante, altrimenti\lgli avrebbe fatto DAVVERO male.

entries.original:
"Oh, wait.

Looks like I won’t be battlin’ you,
after all.

You’re gonna need more than one
Pokémon if you wanna take me on\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, wait. Looks like I won’t be battlin’ you, after all. You’re gonna need more than one Pokémon if you wanna take me on[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh, aspetta. Sembra che non
combatterò contro di te, alla fine.\lTi servirà più di un Pokémon se

vuoi provarci con me\.

entries.original:
"Everyone hide!

The Ferrothorns are on to us!"
entries.translation_source: Everyone hide! The Ferrothorns are on to us!
entries.translated:
Tutti, nascondetevi! I Ferrothorns
ci hanno scoperti!

entries.original:
"Where’d he go?

Ain’t nobody here ’cept some punk
Trainer\."
entries.translation_source: Where’d he go? Ain’t nobody here ’cept some punk Trainer[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dov{B4}è andato? Non c{B4}è nessuno qui,
tranne qualche Allenatore teppista\.

entries.original:
"Whadda we gonna do?

Barbs ain’t gonna be happy if we
come home without ’dem boosters\."
entries.translation_source: Whadda we gonna do? Barbs ain’t gonna be happy if we come home without ’dem boosters[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Che facciamo? Barbs non sarà
contenta se torniamo a casa senza\lquei booster\.

entries.original:
"Don’t ask me, you dimwit!

It ain’t my fault this punk Leader
ripped us off!

I told ya to make sure he gave the
boosters before ya paid him!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t ask me, you dimwit! It ain’t my fault this punk Leader ripped us off! I told ya to make sure he gave the boosters before ya paid him!
entries.translated:
Non chiedere a me, stupido! Non è
colpa mia se quel capo delinquente\lci ha fregati! Ti avevo detto di

assicurarti che ci desse i booster
prima di pagarlo!

entries.original:
"Whaddabout dose nerds, den?

Now dat Antisis is ours, ain’t no
more Granbulls for dem ta give to!"
entries.translation_source: Whaddabout dose nerds, den? Now dat Antisis is ours, ain’t no more Granbulls for dem ta give to!
entries.translated:
E quelli secchioni, allora? Ora che
Antisis è nostra, non ci sono più\lGranbull da dar loro!

entries.original: "Now that ain’t a half bad idea\."
entries.translation_source: Now that ain’t a half bad idea[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ehi, non è affatto una cattiva idea\.

entries.original: "Crater Town Gym"
entries.translation_source: Crater Town Gym
entries.translated: Palestra di Paese Crater

entries.original: "Véga"
entries.translation_source: Véga
entries.translated: Véga

entries.original:
"Ah, I see a Trainer has passed
my test\.

Tell me, what is your name?

\.

[player]?
I see\. so that’s how it is\."
entries.translation_source: Ah, I see a Trainer has passed my test[game-token-1] Tell me, what is your name? [game-token-2] [player-name-3]? I see[game-token-4] so that’s how it is[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Ah, vedo che un Allenatore ha
superato la mia prova\. Dimmi, come\lti chiami? \. [player]? Capisco\.

quindi è così\.

entries.original: "Whisper\. Mutter\. Whisper\."
entries.translation_source: Whisper[game-token-1] Mutter[game-token-2] Whisper[game-token-3]
entries.translated: Sussurra\. Borbotta\. Sussurra\.

entries.original:
"Oh, pay me no mind.
I was merely talking to myself.

I am Véga, the Leader of the
Crater Town Gym.

When I first arrived here, I felt
comfort in the sombre atmosphere\lof this town.

My Pokémon and I therefore
trained here, to hone our skills\lto the apex.

Incidentally, are you afraid of
the dark?

Many people are.

Knowing exactly what you’re up
against gives people courage.

But when they stumble blindly, never
sure when the foe will approach\.

Fear destroys even the largest
armies.

Let’s see if you, too, will be
crushed by the heavy atmosphere\land my might!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, pay me no mind. I was merely talking to myself. I am Véga, the Leader of the Crater Town Gym. When I first arrived here, I felt comfort in the sombre atmosphere of this town. My Pokémon and I therefore trained here, to hone our skills to the apex. Incidentally, are you afraid of the dark? Many people are. Knowing exactly what you’re up against gives people courage. But when they stumble blindly, never sure when the foe will approach[game-token-1] Fear destroys even the largest armies. Let’s see if you, too, will be crushed by the heavy atmosphere and my might!
entries.translated:
Oh, non badare a me. Stavo solo
parlando tra me e me. Sono Véga, il\lCapopalestra della Palestra di

Crater Town. Quando sono arrivato
qui per la prima volta, ho trovato\lconforto nell{B4}atmosfera lugubre di

questa città. Io e i miei Pokémon
quindi ci siamo allenati qui, per\laffinare le nostre abilità al

massimo. A proposito, hai paura del
buio? Molte persone ne hanno.\lSapere esattamente a cosa si va

incontro dà coraggio alle persone.
Ma quando brancolano nel buio,\lsenza mai sapere quando il nemico

si avvicinerà\. La paura distrugge
anche gli eserciti più grandi.\lVediamo se anche tu verrai

schiacciato dall{B4}atmosfera pesante
e dalla mia forza!

entries.original:
"Remarkable. Both in using the
intel on your foe, that being\lmyself\.

\.and for staying steadfast even
under pressure.

For your outstanding spirit, the
[green]Vision Badge[blue] is yours."
entries.translation_source: Remarkable. Both in using the intel on your foe, that being myself[game-token-1] [game-token-2]and for staying steadfast even under pressure. For your outstanding spirit, the [color-green-3]Vision Badge[color-blue-4] is yours.
entries.translated:
Notevole. Sia per aver usato le
informazioni sul tuo avversario,\lcioè me\. \.e per aver mantenuto la tua

determinazione anche sotto
pressione. Per il tuo spirito\leccezionale, la [green]Medaglia Visione[blue] è

tua.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Vision Badge
from Véga!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Vision Badge from Véga!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto la Medaglia
Visione da Véga!

entries.original:
"The Vision Badge will allow
outsider Pokémon up to \Lv 32\lyou received in a trade to obey\lyou without question.

The HM [green]Cut[blue] may also now be used
outside of battle to remove small\ltrees blocking your path.

And as a token of goodwill, I
believe this TM will be useful\lto you."
entries.translation_source: The Vision Badge will allow outsider Pokémon up to [game-token-1] 32 you received in a trade to obey you without question. The HM [color-green-2]Cut[color-blue-3] may also now be used outside of battle to remove small trees blocking your path. And as a token of goodwill, I believe this TM will be useful to you.
entries.translated:
La Medaglia Visione ti permetterà
di obbedire senza discussioni ai\lPokémon esterni fino al \Lv 32 che

hai ricevuto tramite scambio. L{B4}MN
[green]Taglio[blue] può inoltre essere usata\lfuori dalla lotta per rimuovere i

piccoli alberi che bloccano il tuo
cammino. E come segno di buona\lvolontà, credo che questa MT ti

sarà utile.

entries.original:
"[green]Thief[blue] steals the held item of an
opposing Pokémon.

In my line of work, I find being
able to use your opponent’s\lresources is advantageous."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Thief[color-blue-2] steals the held item of an opposing Pokémon. In my line of work, I find being able to use your opponent’s resources is advantageous.
entries.translated:
[green]Furto[blue] sottrae lo strumento tenuto
da un Pokémon avversario. Nel mio\llavoro, trovo vantaggioso poter

usare le risorse dell{B4}avversario.

entries.original:
"One last word of advice.

Avoid the shadows and stay in the
light whenever possible.

Do this, and you will avoid falling
into ruin.

This I promise you\."
entries.translation_source: One last word of advice. Avoid the shadows and stay in the light whenever possible. Do this, and you will avoid falling into ruin. This I promise you[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Un ultimo consiglio. Evita le ombre
e resta alla luce ogni volta che\lpuoi. Fai così, e eviterai di

precipitare nella rovina. Te lo
prometto\.

entries.original:
"[black]NOTE!

Due to time constraints, the
following items are received here.

Normally, Véga would not appear
here and you would receive the\litems elsewhere."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]NOTE! Due to time constraints, the following items are received here. Normally, Véga would not appear here and you would receive the items elsewhere.
entries.translated:
[black]NOTA! A causa di limitazioni di
tempo, i seguenti oggetti vengono\lricevuti qui. Normalmente, Véga non

apparirebbe qui e riceveresti gli
oggetti altrove.

entries.original:
"You may have this - I no longer
have use for it."
entries.translation_source: You may have this - I no longer have use for it.
entries.translated: Puoi averlo - non mi serve più.

entries.original: "And this as well."
entries.translation_source: And this as well.
entries.translated: E anche questo.

entries.original:
"Those items can be used to control
the Legendary Pokémon Groudon and\lKyogre.

Aklove was interested in testing
Hoopa’s power against the two, but\lhe only ever trained against\lKyogre in Vivill Town.

As those two are likely running
wild, it is your responsibility to\lcontrol them.

Good luck, Guardian of Borrius."
entries.translation_source: Those items can be used to control the Legendary Pokémon Groudon and Kyogre. Aklove was interested in testing Hoopa’s power against the two, but he only ever trained against Kyogre in Vivill Town. As those two are likely running wild, it is your responsibility to control them. Good luck, Guardian of Borrius.
entries.translated:
Quegli oggetti possono essere usati
per controllare i Pokémon\lleggendari Groudon e Kyogre. Aklove

era interessato a mettere alla
prova il potere di Hoopa contro\lquei due, ma si è allenato solo

contro Kyogre a Vivill Town. Dato
che quei due probabilmente sono in\llibertà, è tua responsabilità

controllarli. Buona fortuna,
Guardiano di Borrius.

entries.original:
"I understand you’ve managed to
capture both Groudon and Kyogre.

Well done, [player].

Your heroics remind me of your
father’s when he saved Borrius\lduring the meteorite strike."
entries.translation_source: I understand you’ve managed to capture both Groudon and Kyogre. Well done, [player-name-1]. Your heroics remind me of your father’s when he saved Borrius during the meteorite strike.
entries.translated:
Capisco che sei riuscito a
catturare sia Groudon che Kyogre.\lBen fatto, [player]. Le tue imprese

mi ricordano quelle di tuo padre,
quando salvò Borrius durante\ll{B4}impatto del meteorite.

entries.original: "Blizzard City Gym"
entries.translation_source: Blizzard City Gym
entries.translated: Palestra di Blizzard City

entries.original: "Alice"
entries.translation_source: Alice
entries.translated: Alice

entries.original:
"Hey there, [buffer1].

The name’s Alice.

I found myself the Gym Leader of
Blizzard City, riding the winds\lof fortune.

Do you believe in luck?

I don’t.
But I do believe in opportunity.

Seizing and riding the winds is
how I got this far off the ground.

And I’m telling you, at this
height, the battles you get to\lsee are something else!

Okay, enough chit-chat. 
Time to take off!"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, [buffer1-1]. The name’s Alice. I found myself the Gym Leader of Blizzard City, riding the winds of fortune. Do you believe in luck? I don’t. But I do believe in opportunity. Seizing and riding the winds is how I got this far off the ground. And I’m telling you, at this height, the battles you get to see are something else! Okay, enough chit-chat. Time to take off!
entries.translated:
Ehi, [buffer1]. Mi chiamo Alice. Mi
sono ritrovata Capopalestra di\lBlizzard City, cavalcando i venti

della fortuna. Credi nella fortuna?
Io no. Ma credo nelle opportunità.\lAfferrare e cavalcare i venti è

come sono arrivata così in alto da
terra. E te lo dico, a questa\laltezza, le battaglie che puoi

vedere sono tutta un{B4}altra cosa!
Ok, basta chiacchiere. È ora di\ldecollare!

entries.original:
"Hey there, [buffer1].

The name’s Alice.

I found myself the Gym Leader of
Blizzard City, riding the winds\lof fortune.

Do you believe in luck?

I don’t.
But I do believe in opportunity.

Seizing and riding the winds is
how I got this far off the ground.

And I’m telling you, at this
height, the battles you get to\lsee are something else!"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, [buffer1-1]. The name’s Alice. I found myself the Gym Leader of Blizzard City, riding the winds of fortune. Do you believe in luck? I don’t. But I do believe in opportunity. Seizing and riding the winds is how I got this far off the ground. And I’m telling you, at this height, the battles you get to see are something else!
entries.translated:
Ehi, [buffer1]. Mi chiamo Alice.
Sono diventata Capopalestra di\lBlizzard City, cavalcando i venti

della fortuna. Tu credi nella
fortuna? Io no. Ma credo nelle\lopportunità. Afferrarle e cavalcare

i venti è il modo in cui sono
arrivata fin qui. E ti dico che, a\lquest{B4}altezza, le battaglie che

puoi vedere sono tutta un{B4}altra
cosa!

entries.original:
"Well, wouldn’t you know it?

I do believe the wind’s blowing
my way.

What about you?

Will you let the storm blow you
away as you try to resist\.

\.or can you ride that out and
make it yours?

Okay, enough chit-chat.
Time to take off!"
entries.translation_source: Well, wouldn’t you know it? I do believe the wind’s blowing my way. What about you? Will you let the storm blow you away as you try to resist[game-token-1] [game-token-2]or can you ride that out and make it yours? Okay, enough chit-chat. Time to take off!
entries.translated:
Beh, guarda un po{B4}? Credo proprio
che il vento soffi dalla mia parte.\lE tu? Lascerai che la tempesta ti

porti via mentre provi a resistere\.
\.oppure riuscirai a cavalcarla e a\lfarla tua? Basta chiacchiere. È ora

di partire!

entries.original:
"Amazing!

I thought the winds were against
my back, but I still lost!"
entries.translation_source: Amazing! I thought the winds were against my back, but I still lost!
entries.translated:
Incredibile! Pensavo di avere il
vento in poppa, ma ho perso lo\lstesso!

entries.original:
"Ah\. I suppose that is just how
it is. Never mind.

Congratulations on your victory,
truly.

Here.
The [green]Wings Badge[red] is yours."
entries.translation_source: Ah[game-token-1] I suppose that is just how it is. Never mind. Congratulations on your victory, truly. Here. The [color-green-2]Wings Badge[color-red-3] is yours.
entries.translated:
Ah\. Suppongo che sia semplicemente
così. Lascia stare. Congratulazioni\lper la tua vittoria, davvero. Ecco.

La [green]Medaglia Ala[red] è tua.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Wings Badge
from Alice!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Wings Badge from Alice!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto la Medaglia
Ala da Alice!

entries.original:
"With that Badge, you can break
rocks apart with [green]Rock Smash[red]\loutside of battle.

Not only that, all Pokémon up to
\Lv 36 will obey your commands.

Oh, and perhaps this TM will be
of some use."
entries.translation_source: With that Badge, you can break rocks apart with [color-green-1]Rock Smash[color-red-2] outside of battle. Not only that, all Pokémon up to [game-token-3] 36 will obey your commands. Oh, and perhaps this TM will be of some use.
entries.translated:
Con quella Medaglia, puoi
frantumare le rocce con [green]Rock Smash[red]\lal di fuori della lotta. Inoltre,

tutti i Pokémon fino al \Lv 36
ubbidiranno ai tuoi comandi. Ah, e\lforse questa MT ti tornerà utile.

entries.original:
"[green]Aerial Ace[red] is an attack that’s
sure to hit.

It’s useful when you’re finding
your attacks missing one too many\ltimes!

Use it if you don’t feel like
trying to walk into the winds\lin a battle.

Now then, that look tells me you
have places to be and things to do.

Don’t let me hold you up, then.
Up and at ’em!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Aerial Ace[color-red-2] is an attack that’s sure to hit. It’s useful when you’re finding your attacks missing one too many times! Use it if you don’t feel like trying to walk into the winds in a battle. Now then, that look tells me you have places to be and things to do. Don’t let me hold you up, then. Up and at ’em!
entries.translated:
[green]Aerial Ace[red] è un attacco che va
sicuramente a segno. È utile quando\li tuoi attacchi mancano un numero

di volte di troppo! Usalo se non
hai voglia di provare a camminare\lcontro i venti in battaglia. Bene

allora, quello sguardo mi dice che
hai posti in cui andare e cose da\lfare. Non voglio trattenerti,

allora. Su e via!

entries.original:
"By the way, have you met my
daughter yet?

She doesn’t really leave Blizzard
City unless I take her, since the\lweather outside’s so harsh.

That’s why she bugs everyone who
visits our house into showing her\ltheir Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: By the way, have you met my daughter yet? She doesn’t really leave Blizzard City unless I take her, since the weather outside’s so harsh. That’s why she bugs everyone who visits our house into showing her their Pokémon.
entries.translated:
A proposito, hai già conosciuto mia
figlia? In realtà non lascia mai\lBlizzard City a meno che non la

porti io, visto che fuori il tempo
è così rigido. Ecco perché assilla\lchiunque venga a trovarci affinché

le mostri i propri Pokémon.

entries.original: "sweetie"
entries.translation_source: sweetie
entries.translated: tesoro

entries.original: "Fallshore City Gym"
entries.translation_source: Fallshore City Gym
entries.translated: Palestra di Fallshore City

entries.original: "Mel"
entries.translation_source: Mel
entries.translated: Mel

entries.original:
"Howdy there, partner.
Good to see ya again so soon.

I hope my humble abode is to yer
likin’ and all.

If not, I’m sure there’s somethin’
else around ya can keep yer\leyes on\.

I mean, it’s clear ya went all
over this here town and the next,\llookin’ for li’l old me.

\.I kid, I kid.

That look there tells me yer not
battlin’ me fer fun.

Look, I ain’t one to pry.
That’s none o’ my beeswax.

But as Gym Leader, I can’t just up
and fork over a Badge to any ol’\lcowpoke.

So, let’s just get this on.

Let this handsome fella test
yer mettle!"
entries.translation_source: Howdy there, partner. Good to see ya again so soon. I hope my humble abode is to yer likin’ and all. If not, I’m sure there’s somethin’ else around ya can keep yer eyes on[game-token-1] I mean, it’s clear ya went all over this here town and the next, lookin’ for li’l old me. [game-token-2]I kid, I kid. That look there tells me yer not battlin’ me fer fun. Look, I ain’t one to pry. That’s none o’ my beeswax. But as Gym Leader, I can’t just up and fork over a Badge to any ol’ cowpoke. So, let’s just get this on. Let this handsome fella test yer mettle!
entries.translated:
Salve, compagno. Bello rivederti
così presto. Spero che la mia umile\ldimora sia di tuo gradimento e

tutto il resto. Se no, sono sicuro
che c{B4}è qualcos{B4}altro qui intorno\lche puoi tenere d{B4}occhio\. Voglio

dire, è chiaro che hai girato tutta
questa città e la successiva,\lcercando il vecchio me. \.Scherzo,

scherzo. Quello sguardo mi dice che
non stai combattendo contro di me\lper divertimento. Guarda, non sono

uno che si intromette. Non sono
affari miei. Ma come Capopalestra,\lnon posso semplicemente consegnare

una Medaglia a qualsiasi vecchio
cowboy. Quindi, iniziamo. Lascia\lche questo bel ragazzo metta alla

prova il tuo coraggio!

entries.original:
"Congrats, partner.

But I still think that if we’d
been fightin’ for style points,\lI’d win that, no problemo."
entries.translation_source: Congrats, partner. But I still think that if we’d been fightin’ for style points, I’d win that, no problemo.
entries.translated:
Complimenti, partner. Ma continuo a
pensare che, se stessimo\lcombattendo per i punti stile,

vincerei io, senza problemi.

entries.original:
"Holy moly\. thought the format
would trip ya up some, but ya\lsure showed me.

Guess the Badge is yers after all.

Here.
One [green]Fall Badge[blue], compliments of Mel."
entries.translation_source: Holy moly[game-token-1] thought the format would trip ya up some, but ya sure showed me. Guess the Badge is yers after all. Here. One [color-green-2]Fall Badge[color-blue-3], compliments of Mel.
entries.translated:
Accidenti\. pensavo che il formato ti
avrebbe messo un po{B4} in difficoltà,\lma mi hai proprio smentito. Direi

che la Medaglia è tua, dopotutto.
Tieni. Una [green]Medaglia Autunnale[blue], per\lgentile concessione di Mel.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Fall Badge
from Mel!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Fall Badge from Mel!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto la Medaglia
Autunno da Mel!

entries.original:
"With the Fall Badge, any Pokémon
up to \Lv 45 will obey ya.

It also allows ya to move heavy
boulders usin’ [green]Strength[blue].

Honestly, I don’t rightly know why
any strong Pokémon can’t already\ldo this\.

But that’s just one of the weird
ways the world works.

Anyway, take this TM to go along
with that Badge."
entries.translation_source: With the Fall Badge, any Pokémon up to [game-token-1] 45 will obey ya. It also allows ya to move heavy boulders usin’ [color-green-2]Strength[color-blue-3]. Honestly, I don’t rightly know why any strong Pokémon can’t already do this[game-token-4] But that’s just one of the weird ways the world works. Anyway, take this TM to go along with that Badge.
entries.translated:
Con la Medaglia Autunnale,
qualsiasi Pokémon fino a \Lv 45 ti\lobbedirà. Ti permette anche di

spostare massi pesanti usando
[green]Forza[blue]. Onestamente, non so proprio\lperché un Pokémon forte non possa

già farlo\. Ma è solo uno dei modi
strani in cui funziona il mondo.\lComunque, prendi questa MT da

abbinare a quella Medaglia.

entries.original:
"When ya use [green]Facade[blue], if yer Pokémon
has a status condition, it’ll get\ltwice as powerful!

Use it to make yer enemies regret
inflictin’ ya with status!

Alright, ye’d best skedaddle.

Hope ya get whatever it is yer
lookin’ for."
entries.translation_source: When ya use [color-green-1]Facade[color-blue-2], if yer Pokémon has a status condition, it’ll get twice as powerful! Use it to make yer enemies regret inflictin’ ya with status! Alright, ye’d best skedaddle. Hope ya get whatever it is yer lookin’ for.
entries.translated:
Quando usi [green]Facade[blue], se il tuo
Pokémon ha una condizione di stato,\ldiventa il doppio più potente!

Usalo per far rimpiangere ai tuoi
nemici di averti inflitto uno stato\lalterato! Va bene, faresti meglio

ad andartene. Spero che tu trovi
quello che stai cercando.

entries.original:
"Good luck out there, and remember,
I’m always here if ya need\lsomethin’ good to look at!"
entries.translation_source: Good luck out there, and remember, I’m always here if ya need somethin’ good to look at!
entries.translated:
Buona fortuna là fuori, e ricorda,
sono sempre qui se ti serve\lqualcosa di bello da guardare!

entries.original: "Dehara City Gym"
entries.translation_source: Dehara City Gym
entries.translated: Palestra di Città Dehara

entries.original: "Galavan"
entries.translation_source: Galavan
entries.translated: Galavan

entries.original:
"Yo, wazzap, fella?
Howzit goin’?

The name’s Galavan.

I’m the Gym Leader, in case ya
couldn’t tell.

How’d ya find navigatin’ my Gym?

The magnetism and electricity by
your feet givin’ ya a rough time?

Ha ha ha! That’s the point!
Invention is born out of necessity!

Machines and technology grow only
because what came before wasn’t\lquite good enough!

That’s what me and my Gym want
to test!

So how are ya gonna advance when
the most obvious weakness isn’t\luseable anymore?

I want you to show me how
ya adapt!

And I want you to show me with two
of your Pokémon at a time!

If ya don’t, I, Galavan, will zap ya
until ya can’t even twitch!"
entries.translation_source: Yo, wazzap, fella? Howzit goin’? The name’s Galavan. I’m the Gym Leader, in case ya couldn’t tell. How’d ya find navigatin’ my Gym? The magnetism and electricity by your feet givin’ ya a rough time? Ha ha ha! That’s the point! Invention is born out of necessity! Machines and technology grow only because what came before wasn’t quite good enough! That’s what me and my Gym want to test! So how are ya gonna advance when the most obvious weakness isn’t useable anymore? I want you to show me how ya adapt! And I want you to show me with two of your Pokémon at a time! If ya don’t, I, Galavan, will zap ya until ya can’t even twitch!
entries.translated:
Ehi, come butta, amico? Mi chiamo
Galavan. Sono il Capopalestra, nel\lcaso non l{B4}avessi capito. Come hai

trovato navigare nella mia
Palestra? Il magnetismo e\ll{B4}elettricità ai tuoi piedi ti

stanno dando filo da torcere? Ah ah
ah! È questo il punto! L{B4}invenzione\lnasce dalla necessità! Le macchine

e la tecnologia progrediscono solo
perché ciò che è venuto prima non\lera abbastanza buono! È questo che

io e la mia Palestra vogliamo
testare! Allora come progredirai\lquando la debolezza più ovvia non

sarà più utilizzabile? Voglio che
tu mi mostri come ti adatti! E\lvoglio che tu me lo mostri con due

dei tuoi Pokémon alla volta! Se non
lo fai, io, Galavan, ti fulminerò\lfinché non potrai più muoverti!

entries.original:
"\.

Did you hear me?

I said I want you to show me with
two of your Pokémon at a time!

One just ain’t gonna cut it!"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] Did you hear me? I said I want you to show me with two of your Pokémon at a time! One just ain’t gonna cut it!
entries.translated:
\. Mi hai sentito? Ho detto che
voglio che tu me li mostri due\lPokémon alla volta! Uno solo non

basta!

entries.original:
"Man\. ya sure zapped me silly!

Guess your machines of war turned
out better than mine.

Nothin’ else to it!
I gotta hand you this [green]Battery Badge[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Man[game-token-1] ya sure zapped me silly! Guess your machines of war turned out better than mine. Nothin’ else to it! I gotta hand you this [color-green-2]Battery Badge[color-blue-3]!
entries.translated:
Accidenti\. mi hai fulminato per
bene! Immagino che le tue macchine\lda guerra siano venute meglio delle

mie. Nient{B4}altro da dire! Devo
consegnarti questa [green]Medaglia\lBatteria[blue]!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Battery Badge
from Galavan!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Battery Badge from Galavan!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto la Medaglia
Batteria da Galavan!

entries.original:
"The Battery Badge lets ya [green]Surf[blue]
over water and lava!

But not only that, any Pokémon
will obey you as long as it’s not\lover \Lv 52!

How electrifyin’ is that?

But yo, I ain’t done yet!
Take this TM, too!"
entries.translation_source: The Battery Badge lets ya [color-green-1]Surf[color-blue-2] over water and lava! But not only that, any Pokémon will obey you as long as it’s not over [game-token-3] 52! How electrifyin’ is that? But yo, I ain’t done yet! Take this TM, too!
entries.translated:
La Medaglia Batteria ti permette di
[green]Surf[blue] sull{B4}acqua e sulla lava! Ma\lnon solo, qualsiasi Pokémon ti

obbedirà purché non superi il
livello \Lv 52! Quanto è\lelettrizzante? Ma ehi, non ho

ancora finito! Prendi anche questa
MT!

entries.original:
"If you’re at a disadvantage, use
[green]Volt Switch[blue] to get outta there!

And ya know what?
We gotta do this again sometime!

Ya ever feel like chattin’ with
ol’ Galavan, just hang around the\lPokémon Centers.

I’ll rebuild my ’mon of metal
again for that rematch!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re at a disadvantage, use [color-green-1]Volt Switch[color-blue-2] to get outta there! And ya know what? We gotta do this again sometime! Ya ever feel like chattin’ with ol’ Galavan, just hang around the Pokémon Centers. I’ll rebuild my ’mon of metal again for that rematch!
entries.translated:
Se sei in svantaggio, usa
[green]Invertivolt[blue] per filartene! E sai\luna cosa? Dobbiamo rifarlo un{B4}altra

volta, prima o poi! Se ti viene
voglia di fare due chiacchiere con\lil vecchio Galavan, resta nei

Centri Pokémon. Ricostruirò di
nuovo il mio {B4}mon di metallo per\lquel rematch!

entries.original:
"Don’t let anythin’ stand in your
way, [player]!

And never let any disadvantage hold
you back from realizin’ your goals!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t let anythin’ stand in your way, [player-name-1]! And never let any disadvantage hold you back from realizin’ your goals!
entries.translated:
Non lasciare che nulla ti ostacoli,
[player]! E non lasciare mai che un\lqualsiasi svantaggio ti impedisca

di realizzare i tuoi obiettivi!

entries.original: "Antisis City Gym"
entries.translation_source: Antisis City Gym
entries.translated: Palestra di Antisis City

entries.original: "Big Mo"
entries.translation_source: Big Mo
entries.translated: Big Mo

entries.original:
"Well, look who decided to ease
my boredom!

You’re that kid I bumped into on
Route 16, ain’tcha?

\.

So, your name’s [player]!

Hah! Then I guess I better
introduce myself properly too!

Everyone around here calls me
Big Mo!

And I’m the only thing here in
Antisis keepin’ the underworld\lunder control!

Every gang’s beneath my heel,
got that?

\\0C

Because you don’t get to where I
am by bein’ a wimp!

So come on! Let’s see what you can
do to the kingpin of Antisis City!"
entries.translation_source: Well, look who decided to ease my boredom! You’re that kid I bumped into on Route 16, ain’tcha? [game-token-1] So, your name’s [player-name-2]! Hah! Then I guess I better introduce myself properly too! Everyone around here calls me Big Mo! And I’m the only thing here in Antisis keepin’ the underworld under control! Every gang’s beneath my heel, got that? [raw-escape-3] Because you don’t get to where I am by bein’ a wimp! So come on! Let’s see what you can do to the kingpin of Antisis City!
entries.translated:
Bene, guarda chi ha deciso di
alleviare la mia noia! Sei quel\lragazzo che ho incontrato sul

Percorso 16, vero? \. Allora, il tuo
nome è [player]! Hah! Allora credo\lche sia meglio che mi presenti per

bene anche io! Tutti qui mi
chiamano Big Mo! E io sono l{B4}unico\lqui ad Antisis che tiene la

malavita sotto controllo! Ogni gang
è sotto il mio tallone, capito? \\0C\lPerché non arrivi dove sono io

facendo il fifone! Allora avanti!
Vediamo cosa puoi fare al capo di\lAntisis City!

entries.original:
"Doesn’t matter how big they get,
even they gotta lick my boots!"
entries.translation_source: Doesn’t matter how big they get, even they gotta lick my boots!
entries.translated:
Non importa quanto crescano, anche
loro dovranno leccarmi gli stivali!

entries.original:
"Gah! All that time beatin’ on the
little fish made me sloppy!

Even after I had every rule set up
to leave me holdin’ all the cards\.

Ha ha ha ha! Fine, you got me!

Even if Antisis is the pits, I
still have official standings as\lGym Leader!

And a Gym Leader gives this out to
anyone who beats ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Gah! All that time beatin’ on the little fish made me sloppy! Even after I had every rule set up to leave me holdin’ all the cards[game-token-1] Ha ha ha ha! Fine, you got me! Even if Antisis is the pits, I still have official standings as Gym Leader! And a Gym Leader gives this out to anyone who beats ’em!
entries.translated:
Dannazione! Tutto quel tempo
passato a menare le pinne ai\lpesciolini mi ha reso sbadato!

Anche dopo che avevo predisposto
ogni regola per ritrovarmi con\ltutte le carte in mano\. Ah ah ah ah!

Va bene, mi hai battuto! Anche se
Antisis è un posto da schifo, ho\lcomunque il titolo ufficiale di

Capopalestra! E un Capopalestra dà
questo a chiunque lo batta!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Ring Badge
from Big Mo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Ring Badge from Big Mo!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto la Medaglia
Anello da Big Mo!

entries.original:
"That’s the Ring Badge!

Now all traded Pokémon up to \Lv 57
will know who the real boss is!

And you also get to climb up those
rocky cliff things with the move\l[green]Rock Climb[blue]!

Tell me that ain’t useful!

Oh yeah\. I guess you can have
this.

Call it a goodwill gift from
Big Mo."
entries.translation_source: That’s the Ring Badge! Now all traded Pokémon up to [game-token-1] 57 will know who the real boss is! And you also get to climb up those rocky cliff things with the move [color-green-2]Rock Climb[color-blue-3]! Tell me that ain’t useful! Oh yeah[game-token-4] I guess you can have this. Call it a goodwill gift from Big Mo.
entries.translated:
Questa è la Medaglia Anello! Ora
tutti i Pokémon scambiati fino al \Lv\l57 sapranno chi comanda davvero! E

potrai anche scalare quelle pareti
rocciose con la mossa [green]Scalaroccia[blue]!\lDimmi tu se non è utile! Oh già\.

Suppongo che tu possa tenerla.
Consideralo un regalo di buona\lvolontà da parte di Big Mo.

entries.original:
"[green]Drain Punch[blue] hits hard AND saps the
health of your opponent!

Well, what are ya waitin’ for?

Get out. You’re too good to be
wastin’ yourself here.

There’re way bigger fish outside
these walls.

Get out there and be the king of
the pond already!

Ha ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Drain Punch[color-blue-2] hits hard AND saps the health of your opponent! Well, what are ya waitin’ for? Get out. You’re too good to be wastin’ yourself here. There’re way bigger fish outside these walls. Get out there and be the king of the pond already! Ha ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
[green]Assorbipugno[blue] colpisce duro E
prosciuga la salute del tuo\lavversario! Allora, che aspetti?

Vai via. Sei troppo forte per
sprecarti qui. Là fuori ci sono\lpesci molto più grossi di quelli

qui dentro. Vai là fuori e diventa
già il re dello stagno! Ha ha ha\lha!

entries.original:
"If you ever come back to Antisis
City, [player], just know I’ve got my\leye on you!

Ha ha ha ha!

I’ve got my eye on everyone here!
It’s my job!"
entries.translation_source: If you ever come back to Antisis City, [player-name-1], just know I’ve got my eye on you! Ha ha ha ha! I’ve got my eye on everyone here! It’s my job!
entries.translated:
Se torni mai ad Antisis City,
[player], sappi solo che ti tengo\ld{B4}occhio! Ah ah ah ah! Tengo

d{B4}occhio tutti quelli qui dentro! È
il mio lavoro!

entries.original: "Polder Town Gym"
entries.translation_source: Polder Town Gym
entries.translated: Palestra di Paese Polder

entries.original: "Tessy"
entries.translation_source: Tessy
entries.translated: Tessy

entries.original:
"Howdy! So ya got past my little
wave challenge, didja?

Name’s Tessy.

Livin’ in this here swamp taught
my Pokémon and I a whole lot\.

\.Growing and adaptin’ bein’ chiefly
two of ’em.

All my Pokémon have the power to
change their type based on the\lfirst two attacks they know!

And while you’re battlin’ me, yer
own Pokémon will do the same!

But ya already knew that, I’m sure."
entries.translation_source: Howdy! So ya got past my little wave challenge, didja? Name’s Tessy. Livin’ in this here swamp taught my Pokémon and I a whole lot[game-token-1] [game-token-2]Growing and adaptin’ bein’ chiefly two of ’em. All my Pokémon have the power to change their type based on the first two attacks they know! And while you’re battlin’ me, yer own Pokémon will do the same! But ya already knew that, I’m sure.
entries.translated:
Come va! Allora sei riuscito a
superare la mia piccola sfida\ldell{B4}onda, vero? Mi chiamo Tessy.

Vivere in questa palude ha
insegnato tanto a me e ai miei\lPokémon\. \.Crescere e adattarsi sono

due delle lezioni principali. Tutti
i miei Pokémon hanno il potere di\lcambiare il loro tipo basandosi sui

primi due attacchi che conoscono! E
mentre combatti contro di me, anche\li tuoi Pokémon faranno lo stesso!

Ma questo già lo sapevi, ne sono
sicuro.

entries.original:
"Huh\. look at that.

Picked a mighty fine time for
a shower.

But hey, ain’t nothin’ gonna
dampen the mood on this battle,\lright?

Alright!
Don’t sink too fast now, ya hear?"
entries.translation_source: Huh[game-token-1] look at that. Picked a mighty fine time for a shower. But hey, ain’t nothin’ gonna dampen the mood on this battle, right? Alright! Don’t sink too fast now, ya hear?
entries.translated:
Eh\. Guarda un po{B4}. Hai scelto
proprio un bel momento per farti\luna doccia. Ma ehi, niente rovinerà

l{B4}atmosfera di questa lotta,
giusto? Va bene! Non affondare\ltroppo in fretta, hai capito?

entries.original:
"Ya sure as heck washed me away!

I guess I gotta give ya the
[green]Swamp Badge[red] now!"
entries.translation_source: Ya sure as heck washed me away! I guess I gotta give ya the [color-green-1]Swamp Badge[color-red-2] now!
entries.translated:
Mi hai proprio spazzato via! Credo
che ora debba darti la [green]Medaglia\lPalude[red]!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Swamp Badge
from Tessy!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Swamp Badge from Tessy!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto la Medaglia
Palude da Tessy!

entries.original:
"The Swamp Badge gives you the
ability to handle traded Pokémon\lup to \Lv 61!

And it even grants yer Pokémon
the power to climb up [green]waterfalls[red]!

\.wait, ya don’t have anything
like that?

Well, ain’t that a problem.

Here, I got spares, so just take
this one."
entries.translation_source: The Swamp Badge gives you the ability to handle traded Pokémon up to [game-token-1] 61! And it even grants yer Pokémon the power to climb up [color-green-2]waterfalls[color-red-3]! [game-token-4]wait, ya don’t have anything like that? Well, ain’t that a problem. Here, I got spares, so just take this one.
entries.translated:
La Medaglia Palude ti permette di
controllare i Pokémon scambiati\lfino al \Lv 61! E concede persino ai

tuoi Pokémon il potere di scalare
[green]cascate[red]! \.Aspetta, non hai nulla del\lgenere? Be{B4}, questo è un problema.

Tieni, ne ho delle copie, quindi
prendi pure questa.

entries.original:
"[green]Waterfall[red] ain’t just for climbin’
up waterfalls, ya know?

In a battle, it might cause your
opponent to freeze up and forget\lto attack!

By the way\.

Couldn’t help but notice how
impatient y’all looked while we\lwere battlin’.

Guess ya really needed that HM for
something, huh?

I don’t rightly know what it’s
for, but I hope ya get it.

Just\. don’t get too reckless now,
okay?

Promise me yer gonna be fine."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Waterfall[color-red-2] ain’t just for climbin’ up waterfalls, ya know? In a battle, it might cause your opponent to freeze up and forget to attack! By the way[game-token-3] Couldn’t help but notice how impatient y’all looked while we were battlin’. Guess ya really needed that HM for something, huh? I don’t rightly know what it’s for, but I hope ya get it. Just[game-token-4] don’t get too reckless now, okay? Promise me yer gonna be fine.
entries.translated:
[green]Cascata[red] non serve solo per
arrampicarsi sulle cascate, sai? In\luna lotta, potrebbe far bloccare il

tuo avversario e fargli dimenticare
di attaccare! A proposito\. Non ho\lpotuto non notare quanto impaziente

sembravi mentre lottavamo. Immagino
che tu avessi davvero bisogno di\lquella MN per qualcosa, eh? Non so

esattamente a cosa serva, ma spero
che tu la ottenga. Solo\. Non essere\ltroppo avventato, ok? Promettimi

che starai bene.

entries.original:
"There ain’t nothin’ to worry about,
now!

The waves ain’t gonna wash ya
nomor’!"
entries.translation_source: There ain’t nothin’ to worry about, now! The waves ain’t gonna wash ya nomor’!
entries.translated:
Non c{B4}è niente di cui preoccuparsi,
adesso! Le onde non ti porteranno\lvia mai più!

entries.original: "Redwood Village Gym"
entries.translation_source: Redwood Village Gym
entries.translated: Palestra di Redwood

entries.original: "Benjamin"
entries.translation_source: Benjamin
entries.translated: Benjamin

entries.original: "Benjy"
entries.translation_source: Benjy
entries.translated: Benjy

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo\.

It’s been ages\. ages, I say, since
this many Trainers have come to\lchallenge me in a row.

My name is Benjamin, and it is a
pleasure to meet you.

My Pokémon and I, we share a
curious condition.

As you may have seen, Pokémon in
this Gym fight until the very end.

That represents how we live.

As long as we have even a little
strength, we can still resist\lwhatever threatens us.

That is the resilience of Bug-type
Pokémon, plain as day.

Many think Bug-types are weak,
unworthy of being the final test\lfor Trainers in the Borrian League\.

And it’s been my life’s goal to
prove them wrong!

I shall show you our resilience!

And by doing so, I swear to be a
worthy final obstacle before the\lPokémon League!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo[game-token-1] It’s been ages[game-token-2] ages, I say, since this many Trainers have come to challenge me in a row. My name is Benjamin, and it is a pleasure to meet you. My Pokémon and I, we share a curious condition. As you may have seen, Pokémon in this Gym fight until the very end. That represents how we live. As long as we have even a little strength, we can still resist whatever threatens us. That is the resilience of Bug-type Pokémon, plain as day. Many think Bug-types are weak, unworthy of being the final test for Trainers in the Borrian League[game-token-3] And it’s been my life’s goal to prove them wrong! I shall show you our resilience! And by doing so, I swear to be a worthy final obstacle before the Pokémon League!
entries.translated:
Ah ah ah ah\. È passato molto tempo\.
molto tempo, dico, da quando così\ltanti Allenatori sono venuti a

sfidarmi di fila. Mi chiamo
Benjamin, ed è un piacere\lconoscerti. Io e i miei Pokémon

condividiamo una condizione
curiosa. Come avrete visto, i\lPokémon in questa Palestra

combattono fino alla fine. Questo
rappresenta come viviamo. Finché\labbiamo anche solo un po{B4} di forza,

possiamo ancora resistere a
qualunque cosa ci minacci. Questa è\lla resilienza dei Pokémon di tipo

Coleottero, chiaro come il sole.
Molti pensano che i Coleottero\lsiano deboli, indegni di essere la

prova finale per gli Allenatori
nella Lega Borriana\. Ed è stato\ll{B4}obiettivo della mia vita

dimostrare che si sbagliano! Vi
mostrerò la nostra resilienza! E\lcosì facendo, giuro di essere un

degno ostacolo finale prima della
Lega Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Congratulations, Trainer!

You have managed to conquer all
eight Gyms in Borrius!

So please, take the [green]Time Badge[blue]!

That is proof of not only my
defeat, but also the defeat of\lall the other Gym Leaders, just\lto reach me!"
entries.translation_source: Congratulations, Trainer! You have managed to conquer all eight Gyms in Borrius! So please, take the [color-green-1]Time Badge[color-blue-2]! That is proof of not only my defeat, but also the defeat of all the other Gym Leaders, just to reach me!
entries.translated:
Congratulazioni, Allenatore! Sei
riuscito a conquistare tutte e otto\lle Palestre di Borrius! Quindi,

prendi pure la [green]Medaglia Tempo[blue]! È la
prova non solo della mia sconfitta,\lma anche della sconfitta di tutti

gli altri Capipalestra, solo per
arrivare fino a me!

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Time Badge
from Benjamin!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Time Badge from Benjamin!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto la Medaglia
Tempo da Benjamin!

entries.original:
"With the Time Badge, all Pokémon
will obey you without fail.

And should you have a suitable
vessel to provide oxygen for a\llong period of time, you may use a\lPokémon to take you underwater\lwith [green]Dive[blue].

Additionally, take this TM as a gift
for your outstanding achievement."
entries.translation_source: With the Time Badge, all Pokémon will obey you without fail. And should you have a suitable vessel to provide oxygen for a long period of time, you may use a Pokémon to take you underwater with [color-green-1]Dive[color-blue-2]. Additionally, take this TM as a gift for your outstanding achievement.
entries.translated:
Con la Medaglia del Tempo, tutti i
Pokémon ti obbediranno senza fallo.\lE se hai un mezzo adatto a fornire

ossigeno per un lungo periodo di
tempo, potrai usare un Pokémon per\lportarti sott{B4}acqua con [green]Dive[blue].

Inoltre, prendi questa MT come
regalo per il tuo straordinario\lrisultato.

entries.original:
"[green]Leech Fang[blue] saps the opponent of
vitality while restoring your own.

Your Pokémon won’t ever worry
about devolving if they can\lmaintain their strength!

Now if you’ll excuse me\. I should
rest.

Don’t fret over me, I’ll age back
to myself in time.

You should be going.
I wish all the best of luck to you!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Leech Fang[color-blue-2] saps the opponent of vitality while restoring your own. Your Pokémon won’t ever worry about devolving if they can maintain their strength! Now if you’ll excuse me[game-token-3] I should rest. Don’t fret over me, I’ll age back to myself in time. You should be going. I wish all the best of luck to you!
entries.translated:
[green]Zannalisca[blue] succhia la vitalità del
nemico mentre ripristina la tua. I\ltuoi Pokémon non dovranno mai

preoccuparsi di regredire se
riescono a mantenere la loro forza!\lOra, se vuoi scusarmi\. Dovrei

riposare. Non preoccuparti per me,
col tempo tornerò alla mia età.\lDovresti andare. Ti auguro ogni

bene e buona fortuna!

entries.original:
"My old Butterfree and I were born
on the same day.

But as time passed, we began to
notice ourselves steadily growing\lyounger.

It didn’t take long for Butterfree
to regress into a Caterpie and\lfinally fade away\.

This Gym is dedicated in memory of
my first Butterfree.

May his soul forever be at peace\."
entries.translation_source: My old Butterfree and I were born on the same day. But as time passed, we began to notice ourselves steadily growing younger. It didn’t take long for Butterfree to regress into a Caterpie and finally fade away[game-token-1] This Gym is dedicated in memory of my first Butterfree. May his soul forever be at peace[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Il mio vecchio Butterfree e io
siamo nati lo stesso giorno. Ma col\lpassare del tempo, abbiamo

cominciato a notare che diventavamo
sempre più giovani. Non ci volle\lmolto perché Butterfree regredisse

in un Caterpie e infine svanisse\.
Questa Palestra è dedicata alla\lmemoria del mio primo Butterfree.

Possa la sua anima riposare in pace
per sempre\.

entries.original:
"[black]It’s some sort of plant with oddly
shaped leaves."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]It’s some sort of plant with oddly shaped leaves.
entries.translated:
[black]È una specie di pianta con foglie
dalla forma strana.

entries.original:
"Where is all this fog coming from?

Uh\.
Beats me!"
entries.translation_source: Where is all this fog coming from? Uh[game-token-1] Beats me!
entries.translated:
Da dove viene tutta questa nebbia?
Uh\. Chi lo sa!

entries.original:
"Where does the fog come from?

Uh\.
Beats me!"
entries.translation_source: Where does the fog come from? Uh[game-token-1] Beats me!
entries.translated:
Da dove viene la nebbia? Uh\. Non ne
ho idea!

entries.original:
"I find that pressing \btn02 to view
my Pokémon’s attack details helps\lme know which moves will land in\lthis fog."
entries.translation_source: I find that pressing [button-icon-1] to view my Pokémon’s attack details helps me know which moves will land in this fog.
entries.translated:
Trovo che premere \btn02 per vedere i
dettagli delle mosse dei miei\lPokémon mi aiuti a capire quali

mosse andranno a segno in questa
nebbia.

entries.original:
"My Pokémon can see just fine with
or without fog!

We’ll show you!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon can see just fine with or without fog! We’ll show you!
entries.translated:
I miei Pokémon vedono benissimo con
o senza nebbia! Ve lo dimostreremo!

entries.original:
"I liked my chances better when the
fog was up\."
entries.translation_source: I liked my chances better when the fog was up[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mi piacevano di più le mie
possibilità quando c{B4}era la nebbia\.

entries.original:
"I find that pressing \btn02 to view
my Pokémon’s attack details helps\lme know which moves will land when\lit’s foggy in here."
entries.translation_source: I find that pressing [button-icon-1] to view my Pokémon’s attack details helps me know which moves will land when it’s foggy in here.
entries.translated:
Trovo che premere \btn02 per vedere i
dettagli delle mosse dei miei\lPokémon mi aiuti a capire quali

mosse andranno a segno quando qui
c{B4}è la nebbia.

entries.original: "With your skills, you’ll go far!"
entries.translation_source: With your skills, you’ll go far!
entries.translated:
Con le tue capacità, andrai
lontano!

entries.original:
"According to my calculations,
victory is assured 100 percent!"
entries.translation_source: According to my calculations, victory is assured 100 percent!
entries.translated:
Secondo i miei calcoli, la vittoria
è assicurata al 100 percento!

entries.original:
"It looks like my calculations
were incorrect."
entries.translation_source: It looks like my calculations were incorrect.
entries.translated:
Sembra che i miei calcoli fossero
errati.

entries.original:
"I’d better refine my calculations
for the next time we battle."
entries.translation_source: I’d better refine my calculations for the next time we battle.
entries.translated:
Farei meglio a perfezionare i miei
calcoli per la prossima volta che\lci sfideremo.

entries.original: "It’s over."
entries.translation_source: It’s over.
entries.translated: È finita.

entries.original:
"Times have changed since back in my
day."
entries.translation_source: Times have changed since back in my day.
entries.translated:
I tempi sono cambiati da quando ero
giovane.

entries.original: "Gotcha!"
entries.translation_source: Gotcha!
entries.translated: Preso!

entries.original: "Caught you!"
entries.translation_source: Caught you!
entries.translated: Ti ho preso!

entries.original: "A Trainer was spotted!"
entries.translation_source: A Trainer was spotted!
entries.translated: È stato avvistato un Allenatore!

entries.original:
"The fans make the gym really
confusing."
entries.translation_source: The fans make the gym really confusing.
entries.translated:
Le ventole rendono la palestra
davvero confusa.

entries.original:
"Haha!

I’ve got you now!"
entries.translation_source: Haha! I’ve got you now!
entries.translated: Ahah! Ora ti ho preso!

entries.original: "I don’t actually have you."
entries.translation_source: I don’t actually have you.
entries.translated: In realtà non ti ho preso.

entries.original:
"Sorry, Trainer, but this isn’t the
right way to go."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, Trainer, but this isn’t the right way to go.
entries.translated:
Spiacente, Allenatore, ma questa
non è la strada giusta.

entries.original: "Try going the other way."
entries.translation_source: Try going the other way.
entries.translated: Prova a prendere l{B4}altra strada.

entries.original:
"Bird Keepers aren’t afraid of
heights like these!"
entries.translation_source: Bird Keepers aren’t afraid of heights like these!
entries.translated:
I Bird Keeper non hanno paura di
altezze come queste!

entries.original:
"My birds will get stronger from
here on out!"
entries.translation_source: My birds will get stronger from here on out!
entries.translated:
I miei uccelli diventeranno più
forti d{B4}ora in poi!

entries.original:
"Looks like you’re charging head on
at Alice!

You’ll have to face me first!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like you’re charging head on at Alice! You’ll have to face me first!
entries.translated:
Sembra che tu stia puntando dritto
su Alice! Prima dovrai affrontare\lme!

entries.original:
"Phew\.
Good job!"
entries.translation_source: Phew[game-token-1] Good job!
entries.translated: Uff\. Bravo!

entries.original:
"Wherever you decide to go, never be
afraid to charge full speed ahead!"
entries.translation_source: Wherever you decide to go, never be afraid to charge full speed ahead!
entries.translated:
Ovunque tu decida di andare, non
aver mai paura di andare avanti a\ltutta velocità!

entries.original:
"Have you noticed?

The average beauty quotient of this
Gym is significantly higher than\lthe national average."
entries.translation_source: Have you noticed? The average beauty quotient of this Gym is significantly higher than the national average.
entries.translated:
Hai notato? Il punteggio medio di
bellezza di questa Palestra è\lsignificativamente più alto della

media nazionale.

entries.original:
"You may have won the battle, but I
am definitely ahead in my looks."
entries.translation_source: You may have won the battle, but I am definitely ahead in my looks.
entries.translated:
Forse hai vinto la lotta, ma in
bellezza sono decisamente avanti.

entries.original:
"It has been scientifically proven
that looking at attractive people,\las opposed to normal ones, reduces\lstress.

I think that’s why Mel employs us."
entries.translation_source: It has been scientifically proven that looking at attractive people, as opposed to normal ones, reduces stress. I think that’s why Mel employs us.
entries.translated:
È stato scientificamente provato
che guardare persone attraenti,\linvece di persone normali, riduce

lo stress. Credo sia per questo che
Mel ci impiega.

entries.original:
"I like the water aesthetic; it is
much prettier to look at than a\lnormal background.

I’d assume that’d just be a plain
white void for a Normal-type Gym."
entries.translation_source: I like the water aesthetic; it is much prettier to look at than a normal background. I’d assume that’d just be a plain white void for a Normal-type Gym.
entries.translated:
Mi piace l{B4}estetica acquatica; è
molto più bella da guardare di uno\lsfondo normale. Immagino che per

una Palestra di tipo Normale
sarebbe solo un vuoto bianco e\lsemplice.

entries.original:
"Mel is a very busy man.

It takes a lot of time and effort to
stand in front of waterfalls and\lwait for Trainers."
entries.translation_source: Mel is a very busy man. It takes a lot of time and effort to stand in front of waterfalls and wait for Trainers.
entries.translated:
Mel è un uomo molto impegnato.
Richiede molto tempo e impegno\lstare davanti alle cascate ad

aspettare gli Allenatori.

entries.original:
"Did you notice?

One of the Lapras is in a different
position than the rest."
entries.translation_source: Did you notice? One of the Lapras is in a different position than the rest.
entries.translated:
Hai notato? Uno dei Lapras è in una
posizione diversa dagli altri.

entries.original: "Almost there!"
entries.translation_source: Almost there!
entries.translated: Ci siamo quasi!

entries.original:
"Haha, I’m kidding!
It’s still a lot farther to Mel!"
entries.translation_source: Haha, I’m kidding! It’s still a lot farther to Mel!
entries.translated:
Ahah, scherzavo! C{B4}è ancora molta
strada da fare per arrivare a Mel!

entries.original:
"You can ride the Lapras to make
your way back up to the top."
entries.translation_source: You can ride the Lapras to make your way back up to the top.
entries.translated:
Puoi cavalcare Lapras per tornare
in cima.

entries.original:
"Normal-type Pokémon are the safest
of all Pokémon.

Pokémon shooting fire out of their
mouths or lightning out of their\lcheeks can be very dangerous."
entries.translation_source: Normal-type Pokémon are the safest of all Pokémon. Pokémon shooting fire out of their mouths or lightning out of their cheeks can be very dangerous.
entries.translated:
I Pokémon di tipo Normale sono i
più sicuri fra tutti i Pokémon. I\lPokémon che sparano fuoco dalla

bocca o fulmini dalle guance
possono essere molto pericolosi.

entries.original:
"Mel takes a lot of pride in his
looks.

That’s why he has me, a full-time
makeup artist here."
entries.translation_source: Mel takes a lot of pride in his looks. That’s why he has me, a full-time makeup artist here.
entries.translated:
Mel va molto fiero del suo aspetto.
Per questo ha me, una truccatrice a\ltempo pieno qui.

entries.original:
"There was a Pokémon hiding under
the lily pad!

The Pokémon attacked!"
entries.translation_source: There was a Pokémon hiding under the lily pad! The Pokémon attacked!
entries.translated:
C{B4}era un Pokémon nascosto sotto la
ninfea! Il Pokémon ha attaccato!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] dove back into
the pond."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] dove back into the pond.
entries.translated:
[black]Il [buffer1] è tornato a tuffarsi
nello stagno.

entries.original:
"Many of the Pokémon in this Gym
benefit from the magnetized floor.

Meaning, you’re at a disadvantage!"
entries.translation_source: Many of the Pokémon in this Gym benefit from the magnetized floor. Meaning, you’re at a disadvantage!
entries.translated:
Molti dei Pokémon in questa
Palestra beneficiano del pavimento\lmagnetizzato. Quindi sei in

svantaggio!

entries.original:
"Don’t you love the mixed typing of
the Gym?"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you love the mixed typing of the Gym?
entries.translated:
Non ti piace il tipo misto della
Palestra?

entries.original: "It’s great!"
entries.translation_source: It’s great!
entries.translated: È fantastico!

entries.original:
"Galavan loves Electric-types, but
he couldn’t leave Steel-types out."
entries.translation_source: Galavan loves Electric-types, but he couldn’t leave Steel-types out.
entries.translated:
Galavan ama i tipi Elettro, ma non
poteva escludere i tipi Acciaio.

entries.original:
"The magnetic floor lifts all
Electric- and Steel-types right\loff the ground!"
entries.translation_source: The magnetic floor lifts all Electric- and Steel-types right off the ground!
entries.translated:
Il pavimento magnetico solleva da
terra tutti i Pokémon di tipo\lElettro e Acciaio!

entries.original:
"Just because a bulb was turned on,
that doesn’t mean it won’t have to\lbe turned off later."
entries.translation_source: Just because a bulb was turned on, that doesn’t mean it won’t have to be turned off later.
entries.translated:
Solo perché una lampadina è stata
accesa, non significa che non dovrà\lessere spenta in seguito.

entries.original:
"Those light bulbs control the flow
of electricity in the Gym.

By turning them on or off, you’re
changing where the electricity in\lthis Gym goes."
entries.translation_source: Those light bulbs control the flow of electricity in the Gym. By turning them on or off, you’re changing where the electricity in this Gym goes.
entries.translated:
Quei bulbi controllano il flusso
dell{B4}elettricità nella Palestra.\lAccendendoli o spegnendoli, stai

cambiando dove va l{B4}elettricità in
questa Palestra.

entries.original: "The floor here is magnetized."
entries.translation_source: The floor here is magnetized.
entries.translated: Il pavimento qui è magnetizzato.

entries.original: "That’s one way to overcome it."
entries.translation_source: That’s one way to overcome it.
entries.translated: Quello è un modo per superarlo.

entries.original:
"As long as the floor is magnetized,
no Electric- or Steel-type will\lbe affected by Spikes!"
entries.translation_source: As long as the floor is magnetized, no Electric- or Steel-type will be affected by Spikes!
entries.translated:
Finché il pavimento è magnetizzato,
nessun tipo Elettro o Acciaio verrà\lcolpito da Punte!

entries.original:
"If you can beat the master worker
of the Dehara Gym, you’re ready to\lface Galavan."
entries.translation_source: If you can beat the master worker of the Dehara Gym, you’re ready to face Galavan.
entries.translated:
Se riesci a battere il maestro
lavoratore della Palestra di\lDehara, sei pronto per affrontare

Galavan.

entries.original:
"I’m not paralyzed, but I seem to
be struck by you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not paralyzed, but I seem to be struck by you!
entries.translated:
Non sono paralizzato, ma sembri
avermi colpito!

entries.original:
"Not only do I get to collect
Electric-types, but I also get to\lcollect Steel-types!

I love them both equally!"
entries.translation_source: Not only do I get to collect Electric-types, but I also get to collect Steel-types! I love them both equally!
entries.translated:
Non solo posso collezionare Pokémon
di tipo Elettro, ma posso anche\lcollezionare Pokémon di tipo

Acciaio! Li adoro entrambi allo
stesso modo!

entries.original:
"It’s a bulb of some sort.

Turn it [green][buffer1][black]?"
entries.translation_source: It’s a bulb of some sort. Turn it [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3]?
entries.translated:
È un bulbo di qualche tipo. Girarlo
[green][buffer1][black]?

entries.original: "on"
entries.translation_source: on
entries.translated: attivo

entries.original: "off"
entries.translation_source: off
entries.translated: disattivo

entries.original: "[green]Bzz\. Bzz\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Bzz[game-token-2] Bzz[game-token-3]
entries.translated: [green]Bzz\. Bzz\.

entries.original: "[black]The [buffer1] rolled off."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] rolled off.
entries.translated: [black]Il [buffer1] è rotolato via.

entries.original:
"This is the Antisis Gym
Ring Challenge."
entries.translation_source: This is the Antisis Gym Ring Challenge.
entries.translated:
Questa è la Sfida dell{B4}Anello della
Palestra di Antisis.

entries.original: "Enter"
entries.translation_source: Enter
entries.translated: Entra

entries.original: "Rules"
entries.translation_source: Rules
entries.translated: Regole

entries.original: "Leave"
entries.translation_source: Leave
entries.translated: Lascia

entries.original: "Stay here."
entries.translation_source: Stay here.
entries.translated: Resta qui.

entries.original: "Your Pokémon has been healed."
entries.translation_source: Your Pokémon has been healed.
entries.translated: Il tuo Pokémon è stato curato.

entries.original:
"I’m gonna knock ya right outta the
ring before ya can even get going!"
entries.translation_source: I’m gonna knock ya right outta the ring before ya can even get going!
entries.translated:
Ti butterò fuori dal ring prima
ancora che tu possa iniziare!

entries.original:
"I have come to test your strength
in the ring.

Hiyah!"
entries.translation_source: I have come to test your strength in the ring. Hiyah!
entries.translated:
Sono venuto a mettere alla prova la
tua forza sul ring. Hiyah!

entries.original:
"Beat me, an’ it’s smooth sailin’ to
Big Mo!

It’s too bad I ain’t gonna let
that happen!"
entries.translation_source: Beat me, an’ it’s smooth sailin’ to Big Mo! It’s too bad I ain’t gonna let that happen!
entries.translated:
Batti me, e si naviga tranquilli
fino a Big Mo! Peccato che non ti\llascerò farlo!

entries.original:
"The rules are simple.

Choose one Pokémon to battle three
Trainers in a row.

Each Trainer is also only using
one Pokémon.

You can use whatever Pokémon you
want in the ring, but you can’t use\l[green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or [green]Fairy[blue]-type\lmoves in the battles.

For moves that change their types
in battles, we only care about the\ltypes those moves become.

We don’t like those types here in
the ring, and Big Mo won’t let you\luse the [green]most common of those move\lon your team[blue] if you get to him.

If some types appear equally on
your team, we’ll ban the types in\lthe order of Flying, Psychic, and\lthen Fairy.

So, say you have a Toucannon and an
Alakazam on your team, you won’t\lbe able to use Flying-type moves\lagainst Big Mo, since Flying comes\lbefore Psychic.

Got it?

Don’t get confused!"
entries.translation_source: The rules are simple. Choose one Pokémon to battle three Trainers in a row. Each Trainer is also only using one Pokémon. You can use whatever Pokémon you want in the ring, but you can’t use [color-green-1]Flying[color-blue-2]-, [color-green-3]Psychic[color-blue-4]-, or [color-green-5]Fairy[color-blue-6]-type moves in the battles. For moves that change their types in battles, we only care about the types those moves become. We don’t like those types here in the ring, and Big Mo won’t let you use the [color-green-7]most common of those move on your team[color-blue-8] if you get to him. If some types appear equally on your team, we’ll ban the types in the order of Flying, Psychic, and then Fairy. So, say you have a Toucannon and an Alakazam on your team, you won’t be able to use Flying-type moves against Big Mo, since Flying comes before Psychic. Got it? Don’t get confused!
entries.translated:
Le regole sono semplici. Scegli un
Pokémon per affrontare tre\lAllenatori di seguito. Ogni

Allenatore userà anche lui un solo
Pokémon. Puoi usare qualsiasi\lPokémon tu voglia sul ring, ma non

puoi usare mosse di tipo [green]Volante[blue],
[green]Psico[blue] o [green]Folletto[blue] durante le lotte.\lPer le mosse che cambiano tipo

durante la lotta, consideriamo solo
il tipo che diventano. A noi non\lpiacciono quei tipi qui sul ring, e

Big Mo non ti lascerà usare la
[green]mossa più comune tra quelle della\ltua squadra[blue] se arrivi da lui. Se

alcuni tipi appaiono in egual
misura nella tua squadra, bandiremo\li tipi nell{B4}ordine Volante, Psico e

poi Folletto. Quindi, metti che tu
abbia un Toucannon e un Alakazam\lnella tua squadra, non potrai usare

mosse di tipo Volante contro Big
Mo, perché Volante viene prima di\lPsico. Capito? Non confonderti!

entries.original:
"The rules are simple.

Choose one Pokémon to battle three
Trainers in a row.

Each Trainer is also only using
one Pokémon.

You can use whatever Pokémon you
want in the ring, but you can’t use\l[green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or [green]Fairy[blue]-type\lmoves in the battles.

For moves that change their types
in battles, we only care about the\ltypes those moves become.

We don’t like those types here in
the Gym, but Big Mo is a nice guy\land he’ll let you use ’em if you\lcan get to him."
entries.translation_source: The rules are simple. Choose one Pokémon to battle three Trainers in a row. Each Trainer is also only using one Pokémon. You can use whatever Pokémon you want in the ring, but you can’t use [color-green-1]Flying[color-blue-2]-, [color-green-3]Psychic[color-blue-4]-, or [color-green-5]Fairy[color-blue-6]-type moves in the battles. For moves that change their types in battles, we only care about the types those moves become. We don’t like those types here in the Gym, but Big Mo is a nice guy and he’ll let you use ’em if you can get to him.
entries.translated:
Le regole sono semplici. Scegli un
Pokémon per lottare contro tre\lAllenatori di fila. Ogni Allenatore

usa un solo Pokémon. Puoi usare
qualsiasi Pokémon tu voglia\lnell{B4}arena, ma non puoi usare mosse

di tipo [green]Volante[blue], [green]Psico[blue] o [green]Folletto[blue]
nelle lotte. Per le mosse che\lcambiano tipo durante la lotta, ci

importa solo il tipo che diventano.
Non ci piacciono quei tipi qui in\lPalestra, ma Big Mo è un bravo

ragazzo e ti permetterà di usarle
se riesci ad arrivare da lui.

entries.translation_source: The rules are simple. Choose one Pokémon to battle three Trainers in a row. Each Trainer is also only using one Pokémon. You can use whatever Pokémon you want in the ring, but you can’t use [color-green-1]Flying[color-blue-2]-, [color-green-3]Psychic[color-blue-4]-, or [color-green-5]Fairy[color-blue-6]-type moves in the battles. For moves that change their types in battles, we only care about the types those moves become.
