entries.translated:
Le regole sono semplici. Scegli un
Pokémon per affrontare tre\lAllenatori di fila. Ogni Allenatore

usa anche lui un solo Pokémon. Puoi
usare qualsiasi Pokémon tu voglia\lnell{B4}arena, ma non puoi usare mosse

di tipo [green]Volante[blue], [green]Psico[blue] o [green]Folletto[blue]
nelle battaglie. Per le mosse che\lcambiano tipo in battaglia, ci

interessa solo il tipo che
diventano. Non ci piacciono quei\ltipi qui in Palestra, ma Big Mo è

un bravo ragazzo, e ti [green]fermerà[blue] solo
dall{B4}usare mosse di tipo [green]Folletto[blue]\lse riuscirai a raggiungerlo.

entries.original:
"You think I wanna hold onto your
Pokémon for you?

Go dump your Pokémon in the PC
until you only have one left!"
entries.translation_source: You think I wanna hold onto your Pokémon for you? Go dump your Pokémon in the PC until you only have one left!
entries.translated:
Credi che abbia voglia di tenere i
tuoi Pokémon per te? Vai a\ldepositare i tuoi Pokémon nel PC

finché non te ne resta solo uno!

entries.original:
"You survived the ring.
Good job, kid.

Go through that door if you wanna
battle Big Mo."
entries.translation_source: You survived the ring. Good job, kid. Go through that door if you wanna battle Big Mo.
entries.translated:
Hai superato l{B4}anello. Bel lavoro,
ragazzino. Passa da quella porta se\lvuoi sfidare Big Mo.

entries.original:
"Not only did you survive the ring,
but you also took down Big Mo!

I don’t get impressed easy, but
you’ve done the job, kid."
entries.translation_source: Not only did you survive the ring, but you also took down Big Mo! I don’t get impressed easy, but you’ve done the job, kid.
entries.translated:
Non solo hai superato il ring, ma
hai anche abbattuto Big Mo! Non mi\limpressiono facilmente, ma hai

fatto un bel lavoro, ragazzo.

entries.original:
"This is the Antisis Gym!

Do ya think ya got what it takes to
survive the ring, and beat Big Mo?"
entries.translation_source: This is the Antisis Gym! Do ya think ya got what it takes to survive the ring, and beat Big Mo?
entries.translated:
Questa è la Palestra di Antisis!
Pensi davvero di avere quello che\lserve per sopravvivere nel ring e

battere Big Mo?

entries.original:
"Not many challengers survive the
ring like you did.

You’re a real special one, kid."
entries.translation_source: Not many challengers survive the ring like you did. You’re a real special one, kid.
entries.translated:
Pochi sfidanti sopravvivono al ring
come hai fatto tu. Sei proprio un\ltipo speciale, ragazzo.

entries.original:
"Big Mo just turned our old Ring
Challenge into some sorta fancy\lbattle facility.

He even convinced those dinguses at
the Battle Frontier to send over\lone of their poozers to referee it!

But no matter what he did, he
couldn’t convince ’em to add it\las an \qoofficial\qc battle facility.

So, since you can’t get any sorta
print by winnin’ here, if you can\lsomehow manage to get to [green]100[blue] wins,\lyou’ll get a shiny new star on your\lTrainer Card.

Now, ain’t that sweet?"
entries.translation_source: Big Mo just turned our old Ring Challenge into some sorta fancy battle facility. He even convinced those dinguses at the Battle Frontier to send over one of their poozers to referee it! But no matter what he did, he couldn’t convince ’em to add it as an [quote-open-1]official[quote-close-2] battle facility. So, since you can’t get any sorta print by winnin’ here, if you can somehow manage to get to [color-green-3]100[color-blue-4] wins, you’ll get a shiny new star on your Trainer Card. Now, ain’t that sweet?
entries.translated:
Big Mo ha appena trasformato la
nostra vecchia Sfida del Ring in\luna sorta di esclusiva struttura

per lotte. Ha persino convinto quei
babbei del Parco Lotta a mandare\luno dei loro tipi a fare da

arbitro! Ma per quanto ci abbia
provato, non è riuscito a\lconvincerli ad aggiungerla come

struttura per lotte \qoufficiale\qc.
Quindi, visto che qui non puoi\lottenere alcun tipo di stampa

vincendo, se riesci in qualche modo
a raggiungere [green]100[blue] vittorie,\lotterrai una nuova stella

luccicante sulla tua Scheda
Allenatore. Beh, non è fantastico?

entries.original:
"Do ya really think you can take
down Big Mo with no [green][buffer1][blue]-type\lmoves? Huh?"
entries.translation_source: Do ya really think you can take down Big Mo with no [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]-type moves? Huh?
entries.translated:
Pensi davvero di poter battere Big
Mo senza mosse di tipo [green][buffer1][blue]?\lEh?

entries.original:
"Do ya really think you can take
down Big Mo when your [green]speed[blue] is\lyour [green]weight[blue], and you [green]can’t use[blue]\lany [green]priority Abilities[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Do ya really think you can take down Big Mo when your [color-green-1]speed[color-blue-2] is your [color-green-3]weight[color-blue-4], and you [color-green-5]can’t use[color-blue-6] any [color-green-7]priority Abilities[color-blue-8]?
entries.translated:
Pensi davvero di poter sconfiggere
Big Mo quando la tua [green]velocità[blue] è il\ltuo [green]peso[blue], e non [green]puoi usare[blue] nessuna

[green]abilità di priorità[blue]?

entries.original:
"Do ya really think you can take
down Big Mo when your [green]speed[blue] is\lyour [green]weight[blue], and you [green]can’t use[blue] any\l[green]Fairy[blue]-type moves or [green]priority\lAbilities[blue], huh?"
entries.translation_source: Do ya really think you can take down Big Mo when your [color-green-1]speed[color-blue-2] is your [color-green-3]weight[color-blue-4], and you [color-green-5]can’t use[color-blue-6] any [color-green-7]Fairy[color-blue-8]-type moves or [color-green-9]priority Abilities[color-blue-10], huh?
entries.translated:
Davvero pensi di poter battere Big
Mo quando la tua [green]velocità[blue] è il tuo\l[green]peso[blue], e non puoi usare [green]mosse[blue] di

tipo [green]Folletto[blue] o [green]abilità con
priorità[blue], eh?

entries.original:
"You’re the new toughest chump in
Antisis City!"
entries.translation_source: You’re the new toughest chump in Antisis City!
entries.translated:
Sei il nuovo spaccone più tosto di
Città di Antisis!

entries.original:
"The constant waves have washed all
of the fish away.

Make sure you don’t travel too far
in the water.

Otherwise, you’ll be washed away
like those fish!"
entries.translation_source: The constant waves have washed all of the fish away. Make sure you don’t travel too far in the water. Otherwise, you’ll be washed away like those fish!
entries.translated:
Le onde incessanti hanno portato
via tutti i pesci. Assicurati di\lnon avventurarti troppo lontano in

acqua. Altrimenti, verrai
trascinato via come quei pesci!

entries.original:
"Staying on land keeps you safe
during the waves.

I don’t really even need my
inner tube!"
entries.translation_source: Staying on land keeps you safe during the waves. I don’t really even need my inner tube!
entries.translated:
Restare sulla terraferma ti tiene
al sicuro durante le onde. In\lrealtà non mi serve nemmeno il mio

ciambellone gonfiabile!

entries.original:
"Have you noticed?

The distance you can travel between
each platform varies."
entries.translation_source: Have you noticed? The distance you can travel between each platform varies.
entries.translated:
Hai notato? La distanza che puoi
percorrere tra ogni piattaforma\lvaria.

entries.original:
"Sometimes you can travel a lot
and other times not!"
entries.translation_source: Sometimes you can travel a lot and other times not!
entries.translated:
A volte puoi viaggiare molto, altre
volte no!

entries.original:
"Some platforms allow you to travel
farther from them than others."
entries.translation_source: Some platforms allow you to travel farther from them than others.
entries.translated:
Alcune piattaforme ti permettono di
allontanarti da esse più di altre.

entries.original:
"It may be safer, but it’s not
always the best idea to land on\lthe first spot you see.

There are only so many steps you
can take before the wave hits.

Landing farther on a platform can
increase your chances of\lsurviving the following wave."
entries.translation_source: It may be safer, but it’s not always the best idea to land on the first spot you see. There are only so many steps you can take before the wave hits. Landing farther on a platform can increase your chances of surviving the following wave.
entries.translated:
Può essere più sicuro, ma non è
sempre la scelta migliore atterrare\lnel primo punto che vedi. Hai solo

un certo numero di passi prima che
arrivi l{B4}onda. Atterrare più\llontano su una piattaforma può

aumentare le tue possibilità di
sopravvivere all{B4}onda successiva.

entries.original:
"There’s a button embedded in the
rock!

Press it?"
entries.translation_source: There’s a button embedded in the rock! Press it?
entries.translated:
C{B4}è un pulsante incastonato nella
roccia! Premilo?

entries.original:
"The door to the Gym Leader has
been unlocked."
entries.translation_source: The door to the Gym Leader has been unlocked.
entries.translated:
La porta del Capopalestra è stata
sbloccata.

entries.original:
"The buttons were not pressed in
the correct order.

The puzzle has been reset."
entries.translation_source: The buttons were not pressed in the correct order. The puzzle has been reset.
entries.translated:
I pulsanti non sono stati premuti
nell{B4}ordine corretto. L{B4}enigma è\lstato reimpostato.

entries.original:
"The button embedded in this rock
has already been pressed."
entries.translation_source: The button embedded in this rock has already been pressed.
entries.translated:
Il pulsante incastonato in questa
roccia è già stato premuto.

entries.original:
"The door to the Gym Leader has
already been unlocked."
entries.translation_source: The door to the Gym Leader has already been unlocked.
entries.translated:
La porta del Capopalestra è già
stata sbloccata.

entries.original:
"Don’t forget, if you press the
buttons in the rocks too early,\lyou won’t be able to get to\lBenjamin!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t forget, if you press the buttons in the rocks too early, you won’t be able to get to Benjamin!
entries.translated:
Non dimenticare: se premi i
pulsanti nelle rocce troppo presto,\lnon sarai in grado di arrivare da

Benjamin!

entries.original:
"Be careful of the Pokémon you
choose to use!

Sometimes, they forget every move
they know when they devolve!

When that happens, all you’ll be
able to do is Struggle!"
entries.translation_source: Be careful of the Pokémon you choose to use! Sometimes, they forget every move they know when they devolve! When that happens, all you’ll be able to do is Struggle!
entries.translated:
Fai attenzione ai Pokémon che
scegli di usare! A volte\ldimenticano tutte le mosse che

conoscono quando regrediscono!
Quando succede, l{B4}unica cosa che\lpotrai fare sarà Lotta!

entries.original:
"When I think of the correct order
of the buttons, I think back to the\lcurious case of Benjamin Butterfree\."
entries.translation_source: When I think of the correct order of the buttons, I think back to the curious case of Benjamin Butterfree[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Quando penso all{B4}ordine corretto
dei pulsanti, mi torna in mente il\lcurioso caso di Benjamin Butterfree\.

entries.original:
"The experiences on your journey
thus far\.

Can you picture them?"
entries.translation_source: The experiences on your journey thus far[game-token-1] Can you picture them?
entries.translated:
Le esperienze del tuo viaggio
finora\. Riesci a immaginarle?

entries.original:
"I see\.
You do remember them."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1] You do remember them.
entries.translated: Capisco\. Ti ricordi di loro.

entries.original:
"Use your memories.
They will guide you."
entries.translation_source: Use your memories. They will guide you.
entries.translated: Usa i tuoi ricordi. Ti guideranno.

entries.original:
"Hey there, kid!

-HACK- -COUGH-

Welcome to your first Gym
Challenge!

Let me start you off with a
small gift.

-COUGH- -WHEEZE-"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, kid! -HACK- -COUGH- Welcome to your first Gym Challenge! Let me start you off with a small gift. -COUGH- -WHEEZE-
entries.translated:
Ehi, ragazzino! -HACK- -COUGH-
Benvenuto alla tua prima Sfida in\lPalestra! Lascia che ti dia un

piccolo regalo. -COUGH- -WHEEZE-

entries.original:
"The Gym Leader, Mirskle, prefers
flowery Pokémon.

If you come prepared with a [green]Fire[blue] or
[green]Flying[blue]-type Pokémon, you should be\lable to take him out no sweat!

-COUGH- -COUGH-

Also, be aware, Mirskle likes to
fill his Gym with fog from time to\ltime, and this may have an effect\lon your battling.

It’ll allow you to dodge hits
easily, but you’ll also have a\lharder time landing them as well!

Your main strategy should be to
first remove the Fog from the\lbattlefield, and then lay it on\lyour opponent.

You know, with a move like
[green]Sandstorm[blue] or [green]Defog[blue].

Good luck out there!

-COUGH- -WHEEZE-"
entries.translation_source: The Gym Leader, Mirskle, prefers flowery Pokémon. If you come prepared with a [color-green-1]Fire[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Flying[color-blue-4]-type Pokémon, you should be able to take him out no sweat! -COUGH- -COUGH- Also, be aware, Mirskle likes to fill his Gym with fog from time to time, and this may have an effect on your battling. It’ll allow you to dodge hits easily, but you’ll also have a harder time landing them as well! Your main strategy should be to first remove the Fog from the battlefield, and then lay it on your opponent. You know, with a move like [color-green-5]Sandstorm[color-blue-6] or [color-green-7]Defog[color-blue-8]. Good luck out there! -COUGH- -WHEEZE-
entries.translated:
Il Capopalestra, Mirskle,
preferisce Pokémon fioriti. Se ti\lpresenti con un Pokémon di tipo

[green]Fuoco[blue] o [green]Volante[blue], dovresti
sconfiggerlo senza problemi!\l-TOSSE- -TOSSE- Inoltre, tieni

presente che a Mirskle piace
riempire la sua Palestra di nebbia\ldi tanto in tanto, e questo

potrebbe influenzare le tue lotte.
Ti permetterà di schivare i colpi\lfacilmente, ma avrai anche più

difficoltà a mettere a segno i
tuoi! La tua strategia principale\ldovrebbe essere quella di rimuovere

prima la Nebbia dal campo di
battaglia, e poi infliggerla al tuo\lavversario. Sai, con una mossa come

[green]Terrempesta[blue] o [green]Antinebbia[blue]. Buona
fortuna là fuori! -TOSSE- -RANTOLO-

entries.original:
"I’m impressed!

You managed to beat Mirskle even
with your eyes full of \qofog\qc!

Take this as some extra proof of
your victory here."
entries.translation_source: I’m impressed! You managed to beat Mirskle even with your eyes full of [quote-open-1]fog[quote-close-2]! Take this as some extra proof of your victory here.
entries.translated:
Sono colpito! Sei riuscito a
battere Mirskle persino con gli\locchi pieni di \qofog\qc! Prendi questo

come ulteriore prova della tua
vittoria qui.

entries.original:
"That’s a rare gemstone that can
power up a [green]grassy[blue] move in battle\lfor you!

I’m sure it’ll help you out, champ
in the making."
entries.translation_source: That’s a rare gemstone that can power up a [color-green-1]grassy[color-blue-2] move in battle for you! I’m sure it’ll help you out, champ in the making.
entries.translated:
È una gemma rara che può potenziare
una mossa [green]Erba[blue] in lotta per te!\lSono sicuro che ti sarà utile,

campione in divenire.

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s you!
Champ in the making!

I didn’t see you there!

Welcome to the Crater Town Gym!

Let’s start you off with some
Fresh Water."
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s you! Champ in the making! I didn’t see you there! Welcome to the Crater Town Gym! Let’s start you off with some Fresh Water.
entries.translated:
Ah, sei tu! Un Campione in erba!
Non ti avevo visto! Benvenuto alla\lPalestra di Crater Town! Iniziamo

con un po{B4} di Acqua Fresca.

entries.original:
"As you can or can’t see, this Gym
is centred around [green]Dark[blue]-types.

If you want to win here, a good
starting point would be bringing\l[green]Fighting[blue]-, [green]Bug[blue]- or [green]Fairy[blue]-types.

Just be aware, because of the many
Trainers that struggle in this Gym,\l[green]negative emotions[blue] will fill the air\las you battle.

These emotions will inflict damage
at the end of each turn.

Only [green]Dark[blue]-types, [green]Psychic[blue]-types,
[green]Ghost[blue]-types, and Pokémon with the\lAbilities [green]Magic Guard[blue], [green]Unaware[blue], or\l[green]Oblivious[blue] are unaffected.

If you end up struggling because of
the negative emotions, bringing a\lPokémon that isn’t affected could\lreally help you out.

Now, getting to Véga, the Leader,
is relatively simple.

Navigate the dimly lit hallways, and
don’t get spotted.

If you get spotted, you’ll either
have to battle some Trainers or be\lsent back to the beginning of\lthe hallway.

Every Trainer you defeat will
brighten up the room, so I\lrecommend battling them all first.

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: As you can or can’t see, this Gym is centred around [color-green-1]Dark[color-blue-2]-types. If you want to win here, a good starting point would be bringing [color-green-3]Fighting[color-blue-4]-, [color-green-5]Bug[color-blue-6]- or [color-green-7]Fairy[color-blue-8]-types. Just be aware, because of the many Trainers that struggle in this Gym, [color-green-9]negative emotions[color-blue-10] will fill the air as you battle. These emotions will inflict damage at the end of each turn. Only [color-green-11]Dark[color-blue-12]-types, [color-green-13]Psychic[color-blue-14]-types, [color-green-15]Ghost[color-blue-16]-types, and Pokémon with the Abilities [color-green-17]Magic Guard[color-blue-18], [color-green-19]Unaware[color-blue-20], or [color-green-21]Oblivious[color-blue-22] are unaffected. If you end up struggling because of the negative emotions, bringing a Pokémon that isn’t affected could really help you out. Now, getting to Véga, the Leader, is relatively simple. Navigate the dimly lit hallways, and don’t get spotted. If you get spotted, you’ll either have to battle some Trainers or be sent back to the beginning of the hallway. Every Trainer you defeat will brighten up the room, so I recommend battling them all first. Good luck out there!
entries.translated:
Come vedi o non vedi, questa
Palestra è incentrata sui tipi\l[green]Buio[blue]. Se vuoi vincere qui, un buon

punto di partenza sarebbe portare
tipi [green]Lotta[blue], [green]Coleottero[blue] o [green]Folletto[blue].\lSemplicemente, tieni presente che,

a causa dei molti Allenatori che
faticano in questa Palestra,\l[green]emozioni negative[blue] riempiranno

l{B4}aria mentre combatti. Queste
emozioni infliggeranno danno alla\lfine di ogni turno. Solo i tipi

[green]Buio[blue], [green]Psico[blue], [green]Spettro[blue] e i Pokémon
con le abilità [green]Magicscudo[blue],\l[green]Imprudenza[blue] o [green]Oblio[blue] non sono

influenzati. Se finisci per avere
difficoltà a causa delle emozioni\lnegative, portare un Pokémon che

non è influenzato potrebbe davvero
aiutarti. Ora, arrivare a Véga, il\lCapopalestra, è relativamente

semplice. Muoviti attraverso i
corridoi scarsamente illuminati e\lnon farti scoprire. Se vieni

scoperto, dovrai o combattere
contro alcuni Allenatori o essere\lrimandato all{B4}inizio del corridoio.

Ogni Allenatore che sconfiggi
illuminerà la stanza, quindi ti\lconsiglio di combatterli tutti

prima. Buona fortuna là fuori!

entries.original:
"Well done!

You managed to find your way
through the dark and take\ldown Véga!

Take this, as an extra reward for
your victory."
entries.translation_source: Well done! You managed to find your way through the dark and take down Véga! Take this, as an extra reward for your victory.
entries.translated:
Ben fatto! Sei riuscito a farti
strada nel buio e a sconfiggere\lVéga! Prendi questo, come

ricompensa extra per la tua
vittoria.

entries.original:
"That Gem I gave you can power up a
single [green]Dark[blue]-type move in battle.

With it, you can unleash your
dark fury!

Mwahahahaha!"

tailwind in this Gym!

speed of all Flying-type Pokémon,\lso don’t get cocky just because\lyour Pokémon might have a high\lspeed stat.

entries.translation_source: Contrary to popular belief, this Gym is not an Ice-type gym. It’s a [color-green-1]Flying[color-blue-2]-type Gym! And the best way to counter Flying-types is to clip their wings with [color-green-3]ice[color-blue-4], [color-green-5]rocks[color-blue-6], or [color-green-7]electricity[color-blue-8]! But be careful, because there’s a tailwind in this Gym! entries.original:
"Mel?
Well, he’s just a [green]normal[blue] guy!

If this were a normal Normal-type
Gym, I’d say using Fighting-types\lwould be a great way to take him\ldown.

But, it isn’t.

In this Gym, all battles are
[green]Inverse Battles[blue]!

Meaning, all type matchups will
be reversed.

So, can you guess what type would
be best suited to take down Mel?

\.

You’re right! There isn’t one!

[green]Ghost[blue]-type moves will be super
effective against his Normal-types,\lbut Normal-type moves will also\lbe super effective on Ghost-types.

Your best bet to take Mel down is to
use a Pokémon that knows Ghost-\ltype moves, but isn’t one itself.

If you need more practice getting
used to this kind of battle, you\lshould check out the [green]Inverse Battle\lHouse[blue] in town.

If you’re ready to start, head
down the slide next to me.

Your goal is to use the Lapras to
make your way back up here.

But make sure you’ve stocked up on
supplies first.

There’s no going back until you
reach Mel."
entries.translation_source: Mel? Well, he’s just a [color-green-1]normal[color-blue-2] guy! If this were a normal Normal-type Gym, I’d say using Fighting-types would be a great way to take him down. But, it isn’t. In this Gym, all battles are [color-green-3]Inverse Battles[color-blue-4]! Meaning, all type matchups will be reversed. So, can you guess what type would be best suited to take down Mel? [game-token-5] You’re right! There isn’t one! [color-green-6]Ghost[color-blue-7]-type moves will be super effective against his Normal-types, but Normal-type moves will also be super effective on Ghost-types. Your best bet to take Mel down is to use a Pokémon that knows Ghost- type moves, but isn’t one itself. If you need more practice getting used to this kind of battle, you should check out the [color-green-8]Inverse Battle House[color-blue-9] in town. If you’re ready to start, head down the slide next to me. Your goal is to use the Lapras to make your way back up here. But make sure you’ve stocked up on supplies first. There’s no going back until you reach Mel.
entries.translated:
Mel? Beh, è solo un ragazzo
[green]normale[blue]! Se fosse una normale\lpalestra di tipo Normale, direi che

usare Pokémon di tipo Lotta sarebbe
un ottimo modo per sconfiggerlo. Ma\lnon lo è. In questa palestra, tutte

le lotte sono [green]Lotte Inverse[blue]! Il che
significa che tutti i rapporti di\lefficacia tra i tipi saranno

invertiti. Quindi, puoi indovinare
quale tipo sarebbe più adatto a\lsconfiggere Mel? \\. Esatto! Non ce

n{B4}è uno! Le mosse di tipo [green]Spettro[blue]
saranno superefficaci contro i suoi\lPokémon di tipo Normale, ma anche

le mosse di tipo Normale saranno
superefficaci sui Pokémon di tipo\lSpettro. La tua migliore

possibilità per sconfiggere Mel è
usare un Pokémon che conosca mosse\ldi tipo Spettro, ma che non sia di

quel tipo. Se hai bisogno di più
pratica per abituarti a questo tipo\ldi lotta, dovresti dare un{B4}occhiata

alla [green]Casa delle Lotte Inverse[blue] in
città. Se sei pronto per iniziare,\lscendi lungo lo scivolo accanto a

Lapras per ritornare quassù. Ma\lassicurati di aver fatto scorta di

indietro finché non raggiungerai\lMel.

"Galavan likes to use both [green]Electric[blue]-
and [green]Steel[blue]-type Pokémon.

good way to wreck him, but that\lwon’t work in this Gym.

entries.translation_source: Galavan likes to use both [color-green-1]Electric[color-blue-2]- and [color-green-3]Steel[color-blue-4]-type Pokémon. entries.original:
"Galavan likes to use both [green]Electric[blue]-
and [green]Steel[blue]-type Pokémon.

I’d say Ground-type Pokémon are a
good way to wreck him, but that\lwon’t work in this Gym.

This means that any [green]Electric[blue]- and

entries.translation_source: Galavan likes to use both [color-green-1]Electric[color-blue-2]- and [color-green-3]Steel[color-blue-4]-type Pokémon. I’d say Ground-type Pokémon are a good way to wreck him, but that won’t work in this Gym. Unfortunately, the floor here is both magnetized and electrified. This means that any [color-green-5]Electric[color-blue-6]- and [color-green-7]Steel[color-blue-8]-types are lifted right off the floor! You won’t be able to hit them with Ground-type moves, so you’ll have to come up with some alternate way of doing major damage. Additionally, [color-green-9]Electric[color-blue-10]-type moves will usually be powered up. entries.translated:
A Galavan piace usare sia Pokémon

entries.original:
"For the most part, Big Mo is a
lover of big, slow, and tough\lPokémon, often [green]Fighting[blue]-type.

If you’re just an average Trainer,
and have a [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-, or\l[green]Fairy[blue]-type, you may win no prob!

But before you can face Big Mo,
you’ll need to clear the Gym’s\l[green]Ring Challenge[blue].

And in that, no [green]Flying[blue]-, [green]Psychic[blue]-,
or [green]Fairy[blue]-type moves are allowed.

That may seem difficult, but
honestly, if you’re not using a\lPokémon weak to Fighting-type\lmoves, it should be a cinch for\lyou to clear.

And be aware that depending on how
hardcore you want to fight, there\lmay be certain restrictions in the\lbattle against Big Mo as well.

The [green]boys out back[blue] will let you know
what’s up with the fight, though,\lso don’t sweat remembering.

Good luck in the ring!"
entries.translation_source: For the most part, Big Mo is a lover of big, slow, and tough Pokémon, often [color-green-1]Fighting[color-blue-2]-type. If you’re just an average Trainer, and have a [color-green-3]Flying[color-blue-4]-, [color-green-5]Psychic[color-blue-6]-, or [color-green-7]Fairy[color-blue-8]-type, you may win no prob! But before you can face Big Mo, you’ll need to clear the Gym’s [color-green-9]Ring Challenge[color-blue-10]. And in that, no [color-green-11]Flying[color-blue-12]-, [color-green-13]Psychic[color-blue-14]-, or [color-green-15]Fairy[color-blue-16]-type moves are allowed. That may seem difficult, but honestly, if you’re not using a Pokémon weak to Fighting-type moves, it should be a cinch for you to clear. And be aware that depending on how hardcore you want to fight, there may be certain restrictions in the battle against Big Mo as well. The [color-green-17]boys out back[color-blue-18] will let you know what’s up with the fight, though, so don’t sweat remembering. Good luck in the ring!
entries.translated:
Per la maggior parte, Big Mo ama i

Allenatore medio e hai un Pokémon
di tipo [green]Volante[blue], [green]Psico[blue] o [green]Folletto[blue],\lpotresti vincere senza problemi! Ma

prima di poter affrontare Big Mo,

quella, non sono permesse mosse di
tipo [green]Volante[blue], [green]Psico[blue] o [green]Folletto[blue].\lPotrebbe sembrare difficile, ma

onestamente, se non usi un Pokémon
debole alle mosse di tipo Lotta,\ldovrebbe essere un gioco da ragazzi

per te. E tieni presente che, a
seconda di quanto vuoi combattere,\lpotrebbero esserci delle

restrizioni anche nella lotta
contro Big Mo. I [green]ragazzi là fuori[blue]\lti faranno sapere come funziona la

lotta, quindi non preoccuparti di
ricordare. Buona fortuna nel ring!

entries.original:
"Just like back in Mel’s Gym, this
Gym is centred around [green]water[blue].

But unlike his Gym, the Trainers
here actually use [green]Water[blue]-types!

Bringing electrifying [green]Electric[blue]-
types or grassy [green]Grass[blue]-types will\ldo you wonders.

Just be careful.

Trainers in this Gym are masters
of adaptation.

When you fight them, all Pokémon
in battle will become the [green]same type[blue]\las their [green]first two moves[blue].

As for how to get to Tessy,
you’ll need a Pokémon that can\lSurf across the waves.

But be careful, spending too much
time in the water can get you\lwashed back to the entrance!

You’ll need to scout ahead and
find the shortest path to the\lnext platform.

And be aware that although moving
on land will advance the timer,\lyou won’t get washed away if\lyou’re not in the water.

Good luck out there!"
entries.translation_source: Just like back in Mel’s Gym, this Gym is centred around [color-green-1]water[color-blue-2]. But unlike his Gym, the Trainers here actually use [color-green-3]Water[color-blue-4]-types! Bringing electrifying [color-green-5]Electric[color-blue-6]- types or grassy [color-green-7]Grass[color-blue-8]-types will do you wonders. Just be careful. Trainers in this Gym are masters of adaptation. When you fight them, all Pokémon in battle will become the [color-green-9]same type[color-blue-10] as their [color-green-11]first two moves[color-blue-12]. As for how to get to Tessy, you’ll need a Pokémon that can Surf across the waves. But be careful, spending too much time in the water can get you washed back to the entrance! You’ll need to scout ahead and find the shortest path to the next platform. And be aware that although moving on land will advance the timer, you won’t get washed away if you’re not in the water. Good luck out there!
entries.translated:

questa Palestra è incentrata\lsull{B4}[green]acqua[blue]. Ma a differenza della

sua, qui gli Allenatori usano
veramente i Pokémon di tipo [green]Acqua[blue]!\lPortare Pokémon elettrizzanti di

tipo [green]Elettro[blue] o erbosi di tipo [green]Erba[blue]
ti sarà di grande aiuto. Ma stai\lattento: gli Allenatori di questa

Palestra sono maestri
dell{B4}adattamento. Quando li\laffronti, tutti i Pokémon in lotta

diventeranno dello [green]stesso tipo[blue]
delle loro [green]prime due mosse[blue]. Per\lraggiungere Tessy, ti servirà un

Pokémon che conosca Surf per
cavalcare le onde. Ma fai\lattenzione: passare troppo tempo in

acqua può trascinarti via fino
all{B4}ingresso! Dovrai esplorare in\lanticipo e trovare il percorso più

breve per la piattaforma
successiva. E tieni presente che,\lanche se muoversi sulla terraferma

farà avanzare il timer, non verrai
spazzato via se non sei in acqua.\lBuona fortuna!

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of the curious
case of Benjamin Butterfree?

Born a Butterfree, fainted a
Caterpie, poor Benjamin aged\lbackwards his entire life.

And in the spirit of Butterfree,
our Leader, Benjamin designed\lthis Gym.

And you guessed it, in this Gym
Trainers like to use [green]Bug[blue]-types!

Bringing some [green]Rock[blue]-, [green]Flying[blue]-, or
[green]Fire[blue]-types can really put them\lin their place.

But be careful, because in this Gym
when a Pokémon is defeated, it\lregresses to an earlier state.

Pokémon only faint when they can
regress no more.

Because of this unique battling
condition, Pokémon won’t earn any\lExp. in this Gym.

And as for how to find Benjamin,
I’ll tell you this.

In each of the rooms along the
wall, buttons are hidden in rocks.

Press these buttons in the right
order, and you’ll open up a path\lto ol’ Benjamin.

And what is the correct order?

All I can tell you to do is think
back to the curious case of\lBenjamin Butterfree\."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of the curious case of Benjamin Butterfree? Born a Butterfree, fainted a Caterpie, poor Benjamin aged backwards his entire life. And in the spirit of Butterfree, our Leader, Benjamin designed this Gym. And you guessed it, in this Gym Trainers like to use [color-green-1]Bug[color-blue-2]-types! Bringing some [color-green-3]Rock[color-blue-4]-, [color-green-5]Flying[color-blue-6]-, or [color-green-7]Fire[color-blue-8]-types can really put them in their place. But be careful, because in this Gym when a Pokémon is defeated, it regresses to an earlier state. Pokémon only faint when they can regress no more. Because of this unique battling condition, Pokémon won’t earn any Exp. in this Gym. And as for how to find Benjamin, I’ll tell you this. In each of the rooms along the wall, buttons are hidden in rocks. Press these buttons in the right order, and you’ll open up a path to ol’ Benjamin. And what is the correct order? All I can tell you to do is think back to the curious case of Benjamin Butterfree[game-token-9]
entries.translated:
Hai mai sentito parlare del curioso
caso di Benjamin Butterfree? Nato\lButterfree, svenuto Caterpie, il

povero Benjamin è ringiovanito per
tutta la vita. E nello spirito di\lButterfree, il nostro Capopalestra,

Benjamin ha progettato questa
Palestra. E hai indovinato, in\lquesta Palestra agli Allenatori

piace usare Pokémon di tipo
[green]Coleottero[blue]! Portare dei Pokémon di\ltipo [green]Roccia[blue], [green]Volante[blue] o [green]Fuoco[blue] può

davvero metterli al loro posto. Ma
fai attenzione, perché in questa\lPalestra, quando un Pokémon viene

sconfitto, regredisce a uno stadio
precedente. I Pokémon svengono solo\lquando non possono più regredire. A

causa di questa condizione di lotta
unica, i Pokémon non guadagneranno\lPunti Esp. in questa Palestra. E

per quanto riguarda come trovare
Benjamin, ti dirò questo. In ognuna\ldelle stanze lungo la parete, dei

pulsanti sono nascosti nelle rocce.
Premi questi pulsanti nell{B4}ordine\lgiusto e aprirai un percorso verso

il vecchio Benjamin. E qual è
l{B4}ordine corretto? Tutto ciò che\lposso dirti è di ripensare al

curioso caso di Benjamin Butterfree\.

Pokémon. Vorrei poter andare con\lte, ma purtroppo sono bloccato in

campione in erba!

entries.original:
"Ya ever met that Mirskle guy?

Don’t get too cozy with him - he’s
real loco in the coco!

And what he does in his spare time
ain’t fer good boys and gals like\lyou, right?

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Ya ever met that Mirskle guy? Don’t get too cozy with him - he’s real loco in the coco! And what he does in his spare time ain’t fer good boys and gals like you, right? Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Hai mai incontrato quel tipo,
Mirskle? Non diventare troppo amico\ldi lui: è proprio fuori di testa! E

quello che fa nel tempo libero non
è roba da bravi ragazzi e ragazze\lcome te, giusto? Ah ah ah!

entries.original:
"What’s the deal with that Véga
guy, anyway?

Ya ever seen him crack a smile?
’Cos I sure haven’t!

I mean, it wouldn’t kill him to
lighten up a bit, would it?

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: What’s the deal with that Véga guy, anyway? Ya ever seen him crack a smile? ’Cos I sure haven’t! I mean, it wouldn’t kill him to lighten up a bit, would it? Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Che c{B4}è di strano in quel tipo,
Véga, poi? L{B4}hai mai visto fare un\lsorriso? Perché io di sicuro no!

Voglio dire, non gli farebbe mica
male rilassarsi un po{B4}, no? Ah ah\lah!

entries.original:
"Ya been to see Alice yet?

Let me tell ya, she’s somethin’
else.

When she ain’t battlin’, she’s workin’
on somethin’ to let people fly\lwithout machines.

Now that\.\CC0818 that’s somethin’ I can
get behind!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Ya been to see Alice yet? Let me tell ya, she’s somethin’ else. When she ain’t battlin’, she’s workin’ on somethin’ to let people fly without machines. Now that[game-token-1][control-code-2] that’s somethin’ I can get behind! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Sei già andato a trovare Alice?
Lascia che te lo dica, è davvero\lunica. Quando non lotta, sta

lavorando a qualcosa per far volare
la gente senza macchine. Ora che\.\CC0818\lquesta sì che è una cosa che posso

approvare! Ah ah ah!

entries.original:
"For a Normal-type Gym Leader,
Mel is anything but.

He’s always payin’ attention to
his body and not his Pokémon!

What kind of example does that
set for young Trainers, huh?

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: For a Normal-type Gym Leader, Mel is anything but. He’s always payin’ attention to his body and not his Pokémon! What kind of example does that set for young Trainers, huh? Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Per essere un Capopalestra di tipo
Normale, Mel è tutt{B4}altro. Pensa\lsempre al suo corpo e non ai suoi

Pokémon! Che esempio dà ai giovani
Allenatori, eh? Ah ah ah!

entries.original:
"Now, ol’ Galavan - that guy’s clearly
the best Gym Leader, no doubt\.

Why? ’Cos he’s handsome, and strong,
and he’s a genius at machines!

What?\.\CC0820 c’mon, can’t a guy have
favourites or somethin’?

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Now, ol’ Galavan - that guy’s clearly the best Gym Leader, no doubt[game-token-1] Why? ’Cos he’s handsome, and strong, and he’s a genius at machines! What?[game-token-2][control-code-3] c’mon, can’t a guy have favourites or somethin’? Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Ora, quel Galavan di una volta -
quel tizio è chiaramente il miglior\lCapopalestra, senza dubbio\. Perché?

Perché è bello, forte, e un genio
delle macchine! Cosa?\.\CC0820 dai, non può\luno avere i suoi preferiti o

qualcosa del genere? Ah ah ah!

entries.original:
"Ya ever seen Big Mo?
The guy’s huge - seriously!

He’s so big, a Lickilicky thought
he was its mama!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Ya ever seen Big Mo? The guy’s huge - seriously! He’s so big, a Lickilicky thought he was its mama! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Hai mai visto Big Mo? Quel tizio è
enorme, sul serio! È così grosso\lche un Lickilicky pensava fosse sua

mamma! Ah ah ah!

entries.original:
"Ya know, that Tessy chick’s pretty
young, but don’t be fooled.

That’s a lady who ain’t afraid ta
play as dirty as Cootes Bog!

But hey, ya got everythin’ to beat
her at her own game, right?

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Ya know, that Tessy chick’s pretty young, but don’t be fooled. That’s a lady who ain’t afraid ta play as dirty as Cootes Bog! But hey, ya got everythin’ to beat her at her own game, right? Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Sai, quella tipa di Tessy è
parecchio giovane, ma non farti\lingannare. È una donna che non ha

paura di giocare sporco quanto
Cootes Bog! Ma ehi, hai tutto quel\lche serve per batterla con le sue

stesse regole, giusto? Ah ah ah!

entries.original:
"The curious case of Benjamin
Butterfree\.

Man, if I could get younger, that
would be pretty cool.

’Course, bein’ too small to reach
the shelves would be pretty\lannoyin’, no doubt!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: The curious case of Benjamin Butterfree[game-token-1] Man, if I could get younger, that would be pretty cool. ’Course, bein’ too small to reach the shelves would be pretty annoyin’, no doubt! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Il curioso caso di Benjamin
Butterfree\. Mannaggia, se potessi\ldiventare più giovane, sarebbe

davvero fantastico. Certo, essere
troppo piccolo per raggiungere gli\lscaffali sarebbe parecchio

fastidioso, senza dubbio! Ah ah ah!

entries.original:
"You’re almost there, [player]!

The final climb to the Pokémon
League is about to begin!

And knowing ya, I’m sure you’ll
get there in one piece!

I can’t say the same for the
Trainers you’ll come across on\lthe way, though\.

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: You’re almost there, [player-name-1]! The final climb to the Pokémon League is about to begin! And knowing ya, I’m sure you’ll get there in one piece! I can’t say the same for the Trainers you’ll come across on the way, though[game-token-2] Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Sei quasi arrivato, [player]!
L{B4}ultima salita verso la Lega\lPokémon sta per cominciare! E

conoscendoti, sono sicuro che ci
arriverai sano e salvo! Non posso\ldire lo stesso degli Allenatori che

incontrerai lungo la strada, però\.
Ah ah ah!

entries.original:
"[player], ya made it to the
Pokémon League!

So, ya wanna hear ol’ Galavan
gossip about the Elite 4, huh?

Man, if ya got time to chat, that’s
time better spent preppin’ for the\lfinal push, right?

Doncha worry ’bout a thing!

Ol’ Galavan’s behind ya, the whole
way, so go get ’em!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], ya made it to the Pokémon League! So, ya wanna hear ol’ Galavan gossip about the Elite 4, huh? Man, if ya got time to chat, that’s time better spent preppin’ for the final push, right? Doncha worry ’bout a thing! Ol’ Galavan’s behind ya, the whole way, so go get ’em! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
[player], sei arrivato alla Lega
Pokémon! Allora, vuoi sentire i\lpettegolezzi del vecchio Galavan

sui Superquattro, eh? Amico, se hai
tempo per chiacchierare, è tempo\lspeso meglio a prepararti per

l{B4}assalto finale, no? Non
preoccuparti per niente! Il vecchio\lGalavan è con te, fino in fondo,

quindi vai e fagliela vedere! Ah ah
ah!

Scopri i segreti dietro
le misteriose tavolette
di pietra!

entries.original:
"Hello there, stranger!

Take time to explore Icicle Cave.

It may not seem that big, but it is
larger than it appears!

Why in fact, just the other day, I
saw a Pokémon burrow its way\lthrough the wall to what must be\lan entirely new cave!"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, stranger! Take time to explore Icicle Cave. It may not seem that big, but it is larger than it appears! Why in fact, just the other day, I saw a Pokémon burrow its way through the wall to what must be an entirely new cave!
entries.translated:
Ciao, straniero! Prenditi il tempo
per esplorare Icicle Cave. Potrebbe\lnon sembrare così grande, ma è più

grande di quanto sembri! Anzi,
proprio l{B4}altro giorno ho visto un\lPokémon scavare attraverso il muro

fino a quella che dev{B4}essere una
grotta completamente nuova!

entries.original:
"Who could have predicted there
would be a hidden section of\lIcicle Cave?

If it had not been for that
Sandslash’s sloppy digging, this\lplace may have remained hidden for\lfar longer.

But now that it is accessible, I
was able to discover another one\lof the ancient relics!

The tablet that [buffer1] here\. there are
several similar around Borrius.

On each is text in an ancient
dialect, long since forgotten.

However!

After many years of studying the
language, I have created a device\lcapable of translating the text.

In fact, if you are willing to
assist me in uncovering the secrets\lof these stone walls, I will be\lwilling to share it with you."
entries.translation_source: Who could have predicted there would be a hidden section of Icicle Cave? If it had not been for that Sandslash’s sloppy digging, this place may have remained hidden for far longer. But now that it is accessible, I was able to discover another one of the ancient relics! The tablet that [buffer1-1] here[game-token-2] there are several similar around Borrius. On each is text in an ancient dialect, long since forgotten. However! After many years of studying the language, I have created a device capable of translating the text. In fact, if you are willing to assist me in uncovering the secrets of these stone walls, I will be willing to share it with you.
entries.translated:
Chi avrebbe mai potuto prevedere
che ci fosse una sezione nascosta\ldella Grotta Ghiacciata? Se non

fosse stato per gli scavi sciatti
di quel Sandslash, questo posto\lsarebbe potuto rimanere nascosto

molto più a lungo. Ma ora che è
accessibile, sono stato in grado di\lscoprire un altro dei manufatti

antichi! La tavoletta che [buffer1]
qui\. Ce ne sono diverse simili in\lgiro per Borrius. Su ciascuna c{B4}è

un testo in un dialetto antico, da
tempo dimenticato. Tuttavia! Dopo\lmolti anni di studio della lingua,

ho creato un dispositivo in grado
di tradurre il testo. In effetti,\lse sei disposto ad aiutarmi a

svelare i segreti di queste pareti
di pietra, sarò lieto di\lcondividerlo con te.

entries.original:
"Hmph\. that is rather unfortunate.

No one in the Archeology Society
has managed to learn this dialect\.\lother than myself, of course.

I doubt an inexperienced Trainer
like you could read it without my\lassistance."
entries.translation_source: Hmph[game-token-1] that is rather unfortunate. No one in the Archeology Society has managed to learn this dialect[game-token-2] other than myself, of course. I doubt an inexperienced Trainer like you could read it without my assistance.
entries.translated:
Tsk\. è piuttosto sfortunato. Nessuno
nella Società di Archeologia è\lriuscito a imparare questo dialetto\.

a parte me, ovviamente. Dubito che
un Allenatore inesperto come te\lpossa leggerlo senza il mio aiuto.

entries.original:
"Wonderful!

This is the device you will need to
read the text on these tablets."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful! This is the device you will need to read the text on these tablets.
entries.translated:
Meraviglioso! Ti servirà per
leggere il testo su queste\ltavolette.

entries.original:
"With the [green][buffer1][blue] in hand,
you will be able to translate the\lancient dialect, if you so desire.

In fact, it may be advantageous for
you to discover what is behind\lthese tablets.

Once you have solved the riddle on
each of the tablets in Borrius,\lcome see me, and I will reward you\lfor your efforts."
entries.translation_source: With the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] in hand, you will be able to translate the ancient dialect, if you so desire. In fact, it may be advantageous for you to discover what is behind these tablets. Once you have solved the riddle on each of the tablets in Borrius, come see me, and I will reward you for your efforts.
entries.translated:
Con [green][buffer1][blue] in mano, sarai in
grado di tradurre l{B4}antico\ldialetto, se lo desideri. Anzi,

potrebbe esserti utile scoprire
cosa si nasconde dietro queste\ltavolette. Una volta che avrai

risolto l{B4}enigma di ogni tavoletta
di Borrius, vieni a trovarmi, e ti\lricompenserò per i tuoi sforzi.

entries.original:
"As of now, the secrets behind [green][buffer3][blue]
tablet\\08 have yet to be uncovered.

Once you have uncovered what is
behind all of them, come see me\lfor a reward."
entries.translation_source: As of now, the secrets behind [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-blue-3] tablet[raw-escape-4] have yet to be uncovered. Once you have uncovered what is behind all of them, come see me for a reward.
entries.translated:
Adesso, i segreti dietro [green][buffer3][blue]
tavoletta\\08 non sono ancora stati\lsvelati. Una volta che avrai

scoperto cosa si nasconde dietro a
tutte, vieni a trovarmi per una\lricompensa.

entries.original:
"You have done it!

You have uncovered the secrets
behind each of the ancient stone\ltablets in Borrius!

Not even I, the greatest mind in
the Archeology Society, was able to\lsolve the mysteries.

I must be honest\. I may have
misjudged you at first.

However, I have come to learn that
there certainly is more to one than\lcan be discerned at first glance.

You have my apologies, and once
more, my thanks."
entries.translation_source: You have done it! You have uncovered the secrets behind each of the ancient stone tablets in Borrius! Not even I, the greatest mind in the Archeology Society, was able to solve the mysteries. I must be honest[game-token-1] I may have misjudged you at first. However, I have come to learn that there certainly is more to one than can be discerned at first glance. You have my apologies, and once more, my thanks.
entries.translated:
Ce l{B4}hai fatta! Hai scoperto i
segreti dietro ciascuna delle\lantiche tavolette di pietra a

Borrius! Nemmeno io, la mente più
brillante della Società di\lArcheologia, sono riuscito a

risolvere i misteri. Devo essere
onesto\. Potrei averti giudicato male\lall{B4}inizio. Tuttavia, ho imparato

che c{B4}è sicuramente di più in una
persona di quanto si possa\ldiscernere a prima vista. Hai le

mie scuse, e ancora una volta, i
miei ringraziamenti.

entries.original:
"I am sure you noticed the ancient
dens behind each of the tablets,\lyes?

Once a den has been emptied for the
day, throw in one of those [green]Wishing\lPieces[blue].

They will allow a new Pokémon to
be encountered.

And with that, I tip my hat to you,
Trainer, and farewell.

Until we meet again!"
entries.translation_source: I am sure you noticed the ancient dens behind each of the tablets, yes? Once a den has been emptied for the day, throw in one of those [color-green-1]Wishing Pieces[color-blue-2]. They will allow a new Pokémon to be encountered. And with that, I tip my hat to you, Trainer, and farewell. Until we meet again!
entries.translated:
Sono sicuro che avrai notato gli
antichi antri dietro ciascuna delle\lsteli, giusto? Quando un antro è

stato svuotato per la giornata,
gettaci dentro uno di quei [green]Pezzi\lDesiderio[blue]. Ti permetteranno di

incontrare un nuovo Pokémon. E con
questo, mi tolgo il cappello\ldavanti a te, Allenatore, e mi

congedo. Fino al nostro prossimo
incontro!

Thief\qc.

"This tablet was found on 2F after

entries.translated:
Questa tavoletta è stata trovata al
2F dopo aver saltato su alcune\lrocce vicino alla parete più alta

entries.original:
"This tablet was found on B1F close

entries.translation_source: This tablet was found on B1F close to the ladder out to Route 6, and beneath the waterfall.
entries.translated:
Questa tavoletta è stata trovata al
B1F vicino alla scala per uscire\lsul Percorso 6, e sotto la cascata.

entries.original:
"This tablet was found on 1F after
using Rock Climb in the upper west
most part of the cavern."

entries.translated:
Questa lastra è stata trovata al 1F

caverna.

entries.original:
"This tablet was found in the
section of 3F with the electric
barrier."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found in the section of 3F with the electric barrier.
entries.translated:
Questa tavoletta è stata trovata
nella sezione del 3F con la\lbarriera elettrica.

entries.original:
"This tablet was found on B3F near
the entrance to the ruins."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found on B3F near the entrance to the ruins.
entries.translated:
Questa tavoletta è stata trovata al
B3F vicino all{B4}ingresso delle\lrovine.

entries.original:
"This tablet was found in the large
room on 1F after hiding the red,
yellow, and blue crystals."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found in the large room on 1F after hiding the red, yellow, and blue crystals.
entries.translated:
Questa tavoletta è stata trovata
nella grande sala al 1F dopo aver\lnascosto i cristalli rosso, giallo

entries.original:
"This tablet was found on B1F in the
magma chamber accessed from the
west ladder on 1F."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found on B1F in the magma chamber accessed from the west ladder on 1F.
entries.translated:
Questa tavoletta è stata trovata al
B1F nella camera magmatica,\laccessibile dalla scala a ovest del

1F.

entries.original:
"This tablet was found after using
Rock Climb to access a dive spot
at the Ruins of Void."
entries.translation_source: This tablet was found after using Rock Climb to access a dive spot at the Ruins of Void.
entries.translated:
Questa tavoletta è stata trovata
dopo aver usato Scalaroccia per\lraggiungere un punto di immersione

nelle Rovine del Vuoto.

entries.original: "[green]Seyyyy!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Seyyyy!
entries.translated: [green]Seyyyy!

entries.original:
"This Chansey charges [green]$[buffer1][black] to heal
Insane Trainers."
entries.translation_source: This Chansey charges [color-green-1]$[buffer1-2][color-black-3] to heal Insane Trainers.
entries.translated:
Questo Chansey chiede [green]$[buffer1][black] per
curare gli Allenatori Folli.

entries.original:
"If you are crazy enough to attempt
Insane, then you should be crazy\lenough to buy healing items, or be\lprepared to pay the price of\l6 Full Restores, 5 Revives, and\l6 Max Elixirs every time you need\lto heal.

Don’t like this?

Play on a lower difficulty.

This game mode is not meant for
those who want to take the easy\lway out.

You have been warned."
entries.translation_source: If you are crazy enough to attempt Insane, then you should be crazy enough to buy healing items, or be prepared to pay the price of 6 Full Restores, 5 Revives, and 6 Max Elixirs every time you need to heal. Don’t like this? Play on a lower difficulty. This game mode is not meant for those who want to take the easy way out. You have been warned.
entries.translated:
Se sei abbastanza pazzo da tentare
l{B4}Insane, allora dovresti essere\labbastanza pazzo da comprare

oggetti curativi, oppure prepararti
a pagare il prezzo di 6 Cura\lTotale, 5 Revitalizzanti e 6 Max

Elisir ogni volta che hai bisogno
di curarti. Non ti piace? Gioca a\luna difficoltà più bassa. Questa

modalità di gioco non è pensata per
chi vuole scegliere la via più\lfacile. Sei stato avvertito.

entries.original: "You don’t have enough money."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough money.
entries.translated: Non hai abbastanza soldi.

entries.original: "Why"
entries.translation_source: Why
entries.translated: Perché

entries.original:
"[player]!
Fancy meeting you here!

Figured you’d be out running one of
Log’s \qoerrands\qc, or something.

\.

Oh, you are. Typical.

He’s such a cheapskate.
He can’t do anything himself."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Fancy meeting you here! Figured you’d be out running one of Log’s [quote-open-2]errands[quote-close-3], or something. [game-token-4] Oh, you are. Typical. He’s such a cheapskate. He can’t do anything himself.
entries.translated:
[player]! Che sorpresa vederti qui!
Pensavo che fossi in giro a fare\luna delle \qocommissioni\qc di Log, o

qualcosa del genere. \. Ah, infatti.
Tipico. È proprio un tirchio. Non\lsa fare niente da solo.

entries.original:
"What’s that?
Log gave you something for me?"
entries.translation_source: What’s that? Log gave you something for me?
entries.translated:
Cos{B4}è? Log ti ha dato qualcosa per
me?

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed the Pokédex
over to [rival]."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed the Pokédex over to [text-token-rival-3].
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha consegnato il Pokédex a
[rival].

entries.original:
"Oh, great\. now I’m never gonna get
Log’s voice out of my head.

But, uh\.\CC0818 thanks, I guess.

He asked you to fill this out,
didn’t he?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, great[game-token-1] now I’m never gonna get Log’s voice out of my head. But, uh[game-token-2][control-code-3] thanks, I guess. He asked you to fill this out, didn’t he?
entries.translated:
Oh, fantastico\. ora non riuscirò mai
più a togliermi dalla testa la voce\ldi Log. Però, ehm\.\CC0818 grazie, immagino.

Ti ha chiesto lui di compilare
questo, vero?

entries.original:
"Well, if that’s the case, hopefully
you caught some good Pokémon\lto fill its pages, right?

Let’s battle!

I wanna see if you’ve gotten any
better since last time!"
entries.translation_source: Well, if that’s the case, hopefully you caught some good Pokémon to fill its pages, right? Let’s battle! I wanna see if you’ve gotten any better since last time!
entries.translated:
Beh, se è così, spero che tu abbia
catturato dei buoni Pokémon per\lriempire le sue pagine, giusto?

Combattiamo! Voglio vedere se sei
migliorato dall{B4}ultima volta!

entries.original:
"Well, if that’s the case, hopefully
you caught some good Pokémon to\lfill its pages, right?

Let’s battle!

Who knows, maybe you’ll actually
beat me this time!"
entries.translation_source: Well, if that’s the case, hopefully you caught some good Pokémon to fill its pages, right? Let’s battle! Who knows, maybe you’ll actually beat me this time!
entries.translated:
Beh, se è così, spero che tu abbia
catturato dei buoni Pokémon per\lriempirne le pagine, giusto?

Battagliamo! Chissà, magari
stavolta riuscirai persino a\lbattermi!

entries.original:
"If I’d known you could catch Pokémon
like those, I’d’ve started much sooner."
entries.translation_source: If I’d known you could catch Pokémon like those, I’d’ve started much sooner.
entries.translated:
Se avessi saputo che potevi
catturare Pokémon come quelli,\lavrei iniziato molto prima.

entries.original:
"Okay, fine.

I guess I can help fill
this thing out.

If it’s gonna help me get a bit
stronger, I’ll take it.

And when I find my parents, they
won’t even recognize me for all\lmy power!

Oh, right.

I guess as thanks for getting this
to me, you can have these."
entries.translation_source: Okay, fine. I guess I can help fill this thing out. If it’s gonna help me get a bit stronger, I’ll take it. And when I find my parents, they won’t even recognize me for all my power! Oh, right. I guess as thanks for getting this to me, you can have these.
entries.translated:
Va bene, va bene. Immagino di poter
aiutare a compilare questa cosa. Se\lmi aiuterà a diventare un po{B4} più

forte, lo accetto. E quando troverò
i miei genitori, non mi\lriconosceranno nemmeno per tutto il

mio potere! Ah, giusto. Immagino
che, come ringraziamento per avermi\lportato questo, tu possa prendere

questi.

entries.original:
"Have you considered taking on the
Gym Challenge, [player]?

Just like in my home region of Hoenn,
there are 8 Gyms in Borrius.

If you can beat all of them, you’ll
be hailed as a powerful Trainer.

I started my challenge already, but
I had a tough time in Dresco Town.

The Gym Leader there kept using
[green][buffer1][blue] on my Pokémon, so\lI searched for a way to prevent\lthem from [buffer2].

Fortunately, I found those [green]Safety
Goggles[blue], so he didn’t stand a\lchance after that!

Good luck, [player].

Next time, the battle won’t go the
same way as this one!

I promise you that!"
entries.translation_source: Have you considered taking on the Gym Challenge, [player-name-1]? Just like in my home region of Hoenn, there are 8 Gyms in Borrius. If you can beat all of them, you’ll be hailed as a powerful Trainer. I started my challenge already, but I had a tough time in Dresco Town. The Gym Leader there kept using [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] on my Pokémon, so I searched for a way to prevent them from [buffer2-5]. Fortunately, I found those [color-green-6]Safety Goggles[color-blue-7], so he didn’t stand a chance after that! Good luck, [player-name-8]. Next time, the battle won’t go the same way as this one! I promise you that!
entries.translated:
Hai mai pensato di affrontare la
Sfida Palestra, [player]? Proprio\lcome nella mia regione natale,

Hoenn, ci sono 8 Palestre a
Borrius. Se riuscirai a\lsconfiggerle tutte, sarai acclamato

come un potente Allenatore. Ho già
iniziato la mia sfida, ma ho avuto\ldifficoltà a Dresco Town. Il

Capopalestra di lì continuava a
usare [green][buffer1][blue] sui miei Pokémon,\lcosì ho cercato un modo per

impedire loro di [buffer2].
Fortunatamente, ho trovato quegli\l[green]Occhiali Protettivi[blue], e dopo non ha

avuto scampo! Buona fortuna,
[player]. La prossima volta, la\llotta non andrà come questa! Te lo

prometto!

entries.original: "falling asleep"

entries.translated: che si addormenta

Sarebbe stato più saggio indossare
dei pantaloni in questa grotta.

[red]Catturerò ancora più Pokémon
carini!

Perché mi alleno in questa grotta?

muscoli.

entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Thick Fat[color-blue-2] is a Pokémon’s ability that halves the damage done by [color-green-3]Ice[color-blue-4]- and [color-green-5]Fire[color-blue-6]-type moves.

[green]Sgrasso[blue] è un{B4}abilità di un Pokémon
che dimezza i danni inflitti dalle\lmosse di tipo [green]Ghiaccio[blue] e [green]Fuoco[blue].

"Running in circles helps boost my

entries.translated:
Correre in cerchio aiuta ad
aumentare l{B4}amicizia dei miei\lPokémon!

"I trained under Alice in the
Blizzard City Gym.

entries.translated:
Mi sono allenato da Alice nella

ispirato a diventare uno Sciatore.

entries.translation_source: Don’t you know its rude to barge in on someone else’s meeting?
entries.translated:
Non sai che è maleducato irrompere

entries.translated:
Hai invaso il nostro luogo

entries.original: "So rude!"

"I’m not talking to you.
You’re too mean."

Non parlo con te. Sei troppo
cattivo.

"I’m Lily, President of the Skiers
Club.

I’m warning you, I’m not easy to
beat!"

entries.translated:
Sono Lily, presidente del Club
degli Sciatori. Ti avverto, non\lsono facile da battere!

"You’re pretty powerful, I’m
impressed!

You should make a career change and
join our club.

\.

What\. not interested?

Then at least take this!"
entries.translation_source: You’re pretty powerful, I’m impressed! You should make a career change and join our club. [game-token-1] What[game-token-2] not interested? Then at least take this!
entries.translated:
Sei piuttosto forte, sono
impressionato! Dovresti cambiare\lcarriera e unirti al nostro club. \.

Cosa\. non ti interessa? Allora
prendi almeno questo!

"We have plenty of Glalitites here

our skis!"

entries.translated:
Qui al Club degli Sciatori abbiamo
un sacco di Glalitite. Si attaccano\lsempre al fondo dei nostri sci!

entries.original:
"It was about time we found a new
training spot, anyway.

This one is quite cold."
entries.translation_source: It was about time we found a new training spot, anyway. This one is quite cold.
entries.translated:
Era ora che trovassimo un nuovo
posto per allenarci, comunque. Qui\lfa davvero freddo.

entries.original:
"Hmph.

My training was ruined, thanks
to you."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. My training was ruined, thanks to you.
entries.translated:
Tsk. L{B4}allenamento mi è stato
rovinato, per colpa tua.

entries.original:
"THE PLATE
IS THE KEY."

entries.translated: LA LASTRA È LA CHIAVE.

entries.translation_source: Translate the text?
entries.translated: Tradurre il testo?

entries.translated: Traduzione.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830

entries.original: "Icy Hole"
entries.translation_source: Icy Hole
entries.translated: Buco gelido

entries.original:
"A small cave located underneath
Bellin Town.
Many Ice-type Pokémon make
it their home."
entries.translation_source: A small cave located underneath Bellin Town. Many Ice-type Pokémon make it their home.
entries.translated:
Una piccola grotta situata sotto
Bellin Town. Molti Pokémon di tipo\lGhiaccio la chiamano casa.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!

I appear to have gotten myself in
quite the predicament, you see.

I can no longer start sliding on
my own!

Would you care to help by giving
me a jump start?"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! I appear to have gotten myself in quite the predicament, you see. I can no longer start sliding on my own! Would you care to help by giving me a jump start?
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! A quanto pare mi
sono messo in un bel pasticcio,\lcapisci. Non riesco più a iniziare

a scivolare da solo! Ti
dispiacerebbe aiutarmi dandomi una\lspinta iniziale?

entries.original:
"You appear to have gotten me out of
my predicament!

For that, you have my gratitude."
entries.translation_source: You appear to have gotten me out of my predicament! For that, you have my gratitude.
entries.translated:
Sembra che tu mi abbia tirato fuori
dai guai! Per questo, hai la mia\lgratitudine.

entries.original: "Ooh hoo hoo hoo\."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ooh hoo hoo hoo\.

entries.original:
"’Till another predicament brings us
together again, I bid you adieu."
entries.translation_source: ’Till another predicament brings us together again, I bid you adieu.
entries.translated:
Fino a quando un{B4}altra disavventura
non ci riunirà di nuovo, vi saluto.

"[black]It’s a statue of a Pokémon.
It seems to exude power\.

[player] read the engraved
writing\.

\.
\.

A body of rock.

A body of ice.

A body of steel.

When gathers the three Pokémon,
the king shall appear."

entries.translated:
[black]È una statua di un Pokémon. Sembra
emanare potere\. [player] ha letto\ll{B4}iscrizione incisa\. \. \. Un corpo di

roccia. Un corpo di ghiaccio. Un
corpo di acciaio. Quando si\lriuniranno i tre Pokémon, il re

apparirà.

entries.original:
"Use [green]Cut[blue] to get rid of that pesky
tree blocking [green]Valley Cave[blue].

Then head on up to [green]Blizzard City[blue] to
get [green]Rock Smash[blue] from my friend.

Best of luck on yer quest!"
entries.translation_source: Use [color-green-1]Cut[color-blue-2] to get rid of that pesky tree blocking [color-green-3]Valley Cave[color-blue-4]. Then head on up to [color-green-5]Blizzard City[color-blue-6] to get [color-green-7]Rock Smash[color-blue-8] from my friend. Best of luck on yer quest!
entries.translated:
Usa [green]Taglio[blue] per sbarazzarti di quel
fastidioso albero che blocca [green]Valley\lCave[blue]. Poi sali a [green]Blizzard City[blue] per

ottenere [green]Spaccaroccia[blue] dal mio
amico. Buona fortuna nella tua\limpresa!

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

Looks like ya made contact with
my friend.

Now go over to those rocks and give
’em a good smashin’!"
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! Looks like ya made contact with my friend. Now go over to those rocks and give ’em a good smashin’!
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Sembra che tu abbia
fatto conoscenza con il mio amico.\lOra vai da quelle rocce e spaccale

come si deve!

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

Looks like ya opened up a pathway
for yerself.

Now just keep heading [green]east[blue] until
you reach [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]"
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! Looks like ya opened up a pathway for yerself. Now just keep heading [color-green-1]east[color-blue-2] until you reach [color-green-3]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-4]
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Sembra che tu abbia
aperto un passaggio per conto tuo.\lOra continua semplicemente verso

[green]est[blue] finché non raggiungi [green]Thundercap
Mt.[blue]

entries.original:
"These walls are full of treasure.

I make my living by digging it out
and selling as much as I can.

I’ve hit my limit for now, though,
so why don’t you try instead of me?

It’ll cost you $[green][buffer1][blue], but you’re
free to keep what you dig up!"
entries.translation_source: These walls are full of treasure. I make my living by digging it out and selling as much as I can. I’ve hit my limit for now, though, so why don’t you try instead of me? It’ll cost you $[color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3], but you’re free to keep what you dig up!
entries.translated:
Queste pareti sono piene di tesori.
Mi guadagno da vivere scavandoli\lfuori e vendendone quanti più

posso. Per ora però ho raggiunto il
mio limite, quindi perché non provi\ltu al posto mio? Ti costerà

$[green][buffer1][blue], ma quello che trovi
potrai tenerlo!

entries.original:
"Why don’t you try mining instead
of me?

It’ll cost you $[green][buffer1][blue], but you’re
free to keep what you dig up!"
entries.translation_source: Why don’t you try mining instead of me? It’ll cost you $[color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3], but you’re free to keep what you dig up!
entries.translated:
Perché non provi a scavare tu
invece di me? Ti costerà $[green][buffer1][blue],\lma ciò che troverai potrai tenerlo!

entries.original:
"When mining with my tools, you’ll
be able to find Hard Stones, Heart\lScales, Everstones, Evolution\lStones, Shards, and Revives.

You’ll probably dig up Hard Stones
or Everstones, but on the off\lchance you don’t\. you could\lscore big!"
entries.translation_source: When mining with my tools, you’ll be able to find Hard Stones, Heart Scales, Everstones, Evolution Stones, Shards, and Revives. You’ll probably dig up Hard Stones or Everstones, but on the off chance you don’t[game-token-1] you could score big!
entries.translated:
Quando scavi con i miei strumenti,
potrai trovare Pietre Dure, Squame\lCuore, Pietrastanti, Pietre

Evolutive, Frammenti e
Revitalizzanti. Probabilmente\ltirerai fuori Pietre Dure o

Pietrastanti, ma nel caso in cui
non succeda\. potresti fare il colpo\lgrosso!

entries.original:
"Okay, just face the wall to get
started!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, just face the wall to get started!
entries.translated:
Va bene, per iniziare basta
voltarsi verso il muro!

entries.original:
"With real machinery like an ADM,
the treasure you’d be able to find\lwould be of much higher quality.

But ADM’s are expensive, and I
can’t afford something like that!

But if you ever want to give
digging another go, you know\lwhere to find me."
entries.translation_source: With real machinery like an ADM, the treasure you’d be able to find would be of much higher quality. But ADM’s are expensive, and I can’t afford something like that! But if you ever want to give digging another go, you know where to find me.
entries.translated:
Con macchinari veri come un ADM, il
tesoro che potresti trovare sarebbe\ldi qualità molto superiore. Ma gli

ADM sono costosi, e io non posso
permettermi una cosa del genere!\lPerò, se ti viene voglia di

riprovare a scavare, sai dove
trovarmi.

entries.original:
"If you ever want to give mining
another go, you know where to\lfind me."
entries.translation_source: If you ever want to give mining another go, you know where to find me.
entries.translated:
Se mai vorrai riprovare a scavare,
sai dove trovarmi.

entries.original:
"If you ever want to give mining
a go, you know where to find me."
entries.translation_source: If you ever want to give mining a go, you know where to find me.
entries.translated:
Se mai vorrai provare a scavare,
sai dove trovarmi.

entries.original:
"Looks like you don’t have enough
money to pay me.

I can’t just let you do this
for free.

I’m not a saint, you know!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like you don’t have enough money to pay me. I can’t just let you do this for free. I’m not a saint, you know!
entries.translated:
Sembra che tu non abbia abbastanza
soldi per pagarmi. Non posso\lsemplicemente lasciarti fare

gratis. Non sono mica un santo,
sai!

entries.original:
"These boulders have been placed
so strategically!

It’s almost as if someone doesn’t
want people going this way\lright now\."
entries.translation_source: These boulders have been placed so strategically! It’s almost as if someone doesn’t want people going this way right now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Questi massi sono stati sistemati
in modo così strategico! È quasi\lcome se qualcuno non volesse che la

gente passasse di qui proprio
adesso\.

entries.original:
"The boulders that were here!
They mysteriously vanished!

One moment I was standing here,
and the next thing I knew, they\lwere gone!

What could have happened to them?"
entries.translation_source: The boulders that were here! They mysteriously vanished! One moment I was standing here, and the next thing I knew, they were gone! What could have happened to them?
entries.translated:
I massi che erano qui! Sono spariti
misteriosamente! Un attimo prima\lero qui in piedi, e un attimo dopo

non c{B4}erano più! Cosa può essere
successo loro?

entries.original:
"As soon as we finished the bridge
to this new entrance, the walls\lcracked open, and the sea water\lstarted flooding in!

Because why would we get a day off?"
entries.translation_source: As soon as we finished the bridge to this new entrance, the walls cracked open, and the sea water started flooding in! Because why would we get a day off?
entries.translated:
Appena abbiamo finito il ponte
verso questo nuovo ingresso, i muri\lsi sono spaccati e l{B4}acqua del mare

ha iniziato a irrompere! Perché mai
avremmo dovuto avere un giorno\llibero?

entries.original:
"This section of the tunnel will go
to Vivill Town when it’s completed.

We’re working as fast as we can,
but I have no idea when we’ll\lget there."
entries.translation_source: This section of the tunnel will go to Vivill Town when it’s completed. We’re working as fast as we can, but I have no idea when we’ll get there.
entries.translated:
Questo tratto del tunnel porterà a
Vivill Town quando sarà completato.\lStiamo lavorando il più velocemente

possibile, ma non ho idea di quando
arriveremo fin là.

entries.original:
"The walls of the tunnel just keep
collapsing for some reason!

One of these days\. I swear\.

We’re going on strike!"
entries.translation_source: The walls of the tunnel just keep collapsing for some reason! One of these days[game-token-1] I swear[game-token-2] We’re going on strike!
entries.translated:
Le pareti del tunnel continuano a
crollare per qualche motivo! Un\lgiorno di questi\. Lo giuro\. Andremo

in sciopero!

entries.original:
"This section of the Expressway was
intentionally blocked off due to\lthe high crime rate in Antisis\lCity.

If you’re stuck here without a way
back home, I can teleport you over\lthe blockage.

Would you like that?"
entries.translation_source: This section of the Expressway was intentionally blocked off due to the high crime rate in Antisis City. If you’re stuck here without a way back home, I can teleport you over the blockage. Would you like that?
entries.translated:
Questo tratto dell{B4}Autostrada è
stato chiuso appositamente a causa\ldell{B4}alto tasso di criminalità di

Antisis City. Se sei bloccato qui
senza un modo per tornare a casa,\lposso teletrasportarti oltre il

blocco. Ti piacerebbe?

entries.original:
"Okay, here we go!

Solosis, Duosion, Alakazam!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, here we go! Solosis, Duosion, Alakazam!
entries.translated:
Ok, si parte! Solosis, Duosion,
Alakazam!

entries.original: "Stay safe in Antisis City."
entries.translation_source: Stay safe in Antisis City.
entries.translated: Stai al sicuro ad Antisis City.

entries.original:
"Workers of Borrius unite!

We must unionize to fight against
the constant collapse of the KBT\lExpressway walls!"
entries.translation_source: Workers of Borrius unite! We must unionize to fight against the constant collapse of the KBT Expressway walls!
entries.translated:
Lavoratori di Borrius, unitevi!
Dobbiamo sindacalizzarci per\lcombattere il continuo crollo delle

mura della KBT Expressway!

entries.original:
"We’re sick and tired of water
flooding the KBT Expressway!

We’re going on strike until we can
be assured it won’t happen again!"
entries.translation_source: We’re sick and tired of water flooding the KBT Expressway! We’re going on strike until we can be assured it won’t happen again!
entries.translated:
Siamo stufi marci che l{B4}acqua
allaghi la KBT Expressway!\lSciopereremo finché non potremo

essere certi che non succederà di
nuovo!

entries.original:
"No one’s getting through here until
we’re done protesting!"
entries.translation_source: No one’s getting through here until we’re done protesting!
entries.translated:
Nessuno passerà di qui finché non
avremo finito di protestare!

entries.original:
"If regular people like you aren’t
suffering because of our protest,\lthen it’s meaningless!"
entries.translation_source: If regular people like you aren’t suffering because of our protest, then it’s meaningless!
entries.translated:
Se la gente comune come te non
soffre per via della nostra\lprotesta, allora è inutile!

entries.original:
"Are you being inconvenienced?

Good.

That means our protest is working."
entries.translation_source: Are you being inconvenienced? Good. That means our protest is working.
entries.translated:
Ti stai trovando in difficoltà?
Bene. Significa che la nostra\lprotesta sta funzionando.

entries.original:
"No one is allowed to go this way
right now.

Scram, kid!"
entries.translation_source: No one is allowed to go this way right now. Scram, kid!
entries.translated:
Nessuno può passare di qui adesso.
Filatela, ragazzino!

entries.original:
"This wall looks weak!

Charge the ADM with [buffer2] [buffer1]
to knock it down?"
entries.translation_source: This wall looks weak! Charge the ADM with [buffer2-1] [buffer1-2] to knock it down?
entries.translated:
Questo muro sembra debole! Vuoi
caricare l{B4}ADM con [buffer2]\l[buffer1] per abbatterlo?

entries.original: "The ADM broke through the rubble!"
entries.translation_source: The ADM broke through the rubble!
entries.translated: L{B4}ADM ha sfondato le macerie!

entries.original:
"This wall looks weak!
Could something dig through it?"
entries.translation_source: This wall looks weak! Could something dig through it?
entries.translated:
Questo muro sembra fragile!
Qualcosa potrebbe scavare\lattraverso?

entries.original:
"This wall looks weak!

If charged with [green][buffer2] [buffer1][black], the
ADM could knock it down."
entries.translation_source: This wall looks weak! If charged with [color-green-1][buffer2-2] [buffer1-3][color-black-4], the ADM could knock it down.
entries.translated:
Questo muro sembra debole! Se
caricato con [green][buffer2] [buffer1][black],\ll{B4}ADM potrebbe abbatterlo.

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon will learn
[buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon will learn [buffer1-1]?
entries.translated: Quale Pokémon imparerà [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"This Gem Family member is
disappointed."
entries.translation_source: This Gem Family member is disappointed.
entries.translated:
Questo membro della Famiglia Gemma
è deluso.

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough
[green][buffer2]s."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough [color-green-1][buffer2-2]s.
entries.translated: Non hai abbastanza [green][buffer2]s.

entries.original:
"Score!
More Gems for our family!"
entries.translation_source: Score! More Gems for our family!
entries.translated:
Grande! Più Gemme per la nostra
famiglia!

"I’m the Gem Family brother that
loves his Ratatta!

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother that loves his Ratatta! I can teach [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] to a Pokémon for [color-green-4][buffer3-5] [buffer2-6]s[color-blue-7].
entries.translated:
Sono il fratello della Famiglia
Gemma che adora il suo Rattata!\lPosso insegnare [green][buffer1][blue] a un

Pokémon per [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].

"I’m the Gem Family brother with
powerful fists.

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother with powerful fists. I can teach [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] to a Pokémon for [color-green-4][buffer3-5] [buffer2-6]s[color-blue-7].
entries.translated:
Sono il fratello della Famiglia
Gemma con pugni possenti. Posso\linsegnare [green][buffer1][blue] a un Pokémon per

[green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].

I can teach [green][buffer1][blue] to a
Pokémon for [green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother with wings of light. I can teach [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] to a Pokémon for [color-green-4][buffer3-5] [buffer2-6]s[color-blue-7].
entries.translated:

Gemma con ali di luce. Posso\linsegnare [green][buffer1][blue] a un Pokémon per

[green][buffer3] [buffer2]s[blue].

entries.translation_source: I’m the Gem Family brother with the toxic disposition. I can teach [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] to a Pokémon for [color-green-4][buffer3-5] [buffer2-6]s[color-blue-7].
entries.translated:
Sono il fratello della Famiglia
