entries.original:
"Did you know that mud from Cootes
Bog contains minerals that are\lgreat for the skin?

If you’d like, I can massage your
Pokémon with some."
entries.translation_source: Did you know that mud from Cootes Bog contains minerals that are great for the skin? If you’d like, I can massage your Pokémon with some.
entries.translated:
Lo sapevi che il fango di Cootes
Bog contiene minerali ottimi per la\lpelle? Se vuoi, posso massaggiare i

tuoi Pokémon con un po{B4} di quello.

entries.original:
"Alright!
Let me get started."
entries.translation_source: Alright! Let me get started.
entries.translated: Va bene! Lasciami iniziare.

entries.original:
"There. All done!

The massage has made your Pokémon
more friendly to you."
entries.translation_source: There. All done! The massage has made your Pokémon more friendly to you.
entries.translated:
Ecco fatto! Il massaggio ha reso il
tuo Pokémon più amichevole con te.

entries.original:
"Sorry!

I am exhausted from the massage
earlier.

Please come back again another day!"
entries.translation_source: Sorry! I am exhausted from the massage earlier. Please come back again another day!
entries.translated:
Scusa! Sono esausto per il
massaggio di prima. Torna un altro\lgiorno!

entries.original:
"Oh, I see.

I won’t be here all day, so come
back quick if you change your mind."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I see. I won’t be here all day, so come back quick if you change your mind.
entries.translated:
Oh, capisco. Non sarò qui tutto il
giorno, quindi torna presto se\lcambi idea.

entries.original:
"Massage the Egg?
It may be a bit too early for that."
entries.translation_source: Massage the Egg? It may be a bit too early for that.
entries.translated:
Massaggiare l{B4}Uovo? Potrebbe essere
un po{B4} troppo presto per questo.

entries.original:
"I am the Day-Care Man’s sister.

It’s my job to give away Eggs
Trainers did not want to keep.

Here, take one."
entries.translation_source: I am the Day-Care Man’s sister. It’s my job to give away Eggs Trainers did not want to keep. Here, take one.
entries.translated:
Sono la sorella dell{B4}Uomo
dell{B4}Asilo Pokémon. Il mio compito\lè dare via le Uova che gli

Allenatori non volevano tenere.
Tieni, prendine una.

entries.original:
"I am the Day-Care Man’s sister.

It’s my job to give away Eggs
Trainers did not want to keep.

If you free up a space in your
party, you should come get one."
entries.translation_source: I am the Day-Care Man’s sister. It’s my job to give away Eggs Trainers did not want to keep. If you free up a space in your party, you should come get one.
entries.translated:
Sono la sorella dell{B4}Uomo
dell{B4}Asilo Pokémon. Il mio compito\lè dare via le Uova che gli

Allenatori non volevano tenere. Se
liberi uno spazio nella tua\lsquadra, dovresti venire a

prenderne una.

entries.original:
"The next time I’m here, I’ll have
more free Eggs to give out.

But if you’re desperate for more,
I can always sell you some\.

I am sure the Day-Care Man wouldn’t
mind some extra pocket cash\.

Come on by again, will you?"
entries.translation_source: The next time I’m here, I’ll have more free Eggs to give out. But if you’re desperate for more, I can always sell you some[game-token-1] I am sure the Day-Care Man wouldn’t mind some extra pocket cash[game-token-2] Come on by again, will you?
entries.translated:
La prossima volta che sarò qui,
avrò più Uova gratuite da dare. Ma\lse sei disperato per averne ancora,

posso sempre vendertene alcune\. Sono
sicuro che l{B4}uomo dell{B4}Asilo\lPokémon non avrebbe nulla in

contrario a qualche soldo extra in
tasca\. Passa pure di nuovo, va bene?

entries.original:
"I am the Day-Care Man’s sister.

I can sell you a rare Egg for
$[green]50000[red]."
entries.translation_source: I am the Day-Care Man’s sister. I can sell you a rare Egg for $[color-green-1]50000[color-red-2].
entries.translated:
Sono la sorella dell{B4}Uomo della
Pensione. Posso venderti un Uovo\lraro per $[green]50000[red].

entries.original:
"Back for even more, eh?

My, aren’t you a greedy one,
fufufufu\.

I can sell you a rare Egg for
$[green]100000[red]."
entries.translation_source: Back for even more, eh? My, aren’t you a greedy one, fufufufu[game-token-1] I can sell you a rare Egg for $[color-green-2]100000[color-red-3].
entries.translated:
Tornato per averne ancora, eh? Oh,
ma che ingordo che sei, fufufufu\.\lPosso venderti un raro Uovo per

$[green]100000[red].

entries.original: "Come on by again, will you?"
entries.translation_source: Come on by again, will you?
entries.translated: Torna pure a trovarci, d{B4}accordo?

entries.original:
"The next time I’m here, I’ll have
more free Eggs to give out.

Come on by again, will you?"
entries.translation_source: The next time I’m here, I’ll have more free Eggs to give out. Come on by again, will you?
entries.translated:
La prossima volta che sarò qui,
avrò altre Uova gratuite da\ldistribuire. Passa di nuovo, va

bene?

entries.original:
"Fufufu\. You don’t have enough
money to buy an Egg.

The next time I’m here, I’ll have
more free Eggs to give out.

Come on by again, will you?"
entries.translation_source: Fufufu[game-token-1] You don’t have enough money to buy an Egg. The next time I’m here, I’ll have more free Eggs to give out. Come on by again, will you?
entries.translated:
Fufufu\. Non hai abbastanza soldi per
comprare un Uovo. La prossima volta\lche sarò qui, avrò più Uova gratis

da distribuire. Passa di nuovo,
vuoi?

entries.original:
"Fufufu\. You don’t have enough
space in your party for an Egg."
entries.translation_source: Fufufu[game-token-1] You don’t have enough space in your party for an Egg.
entries.translated:
Fufufu\. Non hai abbastanza spazio
nel tuo gruppo per un Uovo.

entries.original:
"Isn’t the sea breeze so calming?

Take a break!
Relax!

Let the wind wash over you\.

Sometimes you’ve gotta live in the
moment, you know?"
entries.translation_source: Isn’t the sea breeze so calming? Take a break! Relax! Let the wind wash over you[game-token-1] Sometimes you’ve gotta live in the moment, you know?
entries.translated:
Non trovi che la brezza del mare
sia così rilassante? Fai una pausa!\lRilassati! Lascia che il vento ti

attraversi\. A volte bisogna vivere
il momento, sai?

entries.original: "Lost Hanky"
entries.translation_source: Lost Hanky
entries.translated: Fazzoletto perduto

entries.original:
"A patron of the Magnolia Cafe has
lost his handkerchief! Return it to
him on Friday morning."
entries.translation_source: A patron of the Magnolia Cafe has lost his handkerchief! Return it to him on Friday morning.
entries.translated:
Un cliente del Magnolia Cafe ha
perso il suo fazzoletto!\lRestituisciglielo venerdì mattina.

entries.original:
"My handkerchief is my life.
I cannot imagine life without it.

Do you feel the same about your
handkerchief?"
entries.translation_source: My handkerchief is my life. I cannot imagine life without it. Do you feel the same about your handkerchief?
entries.translated:
Il mio fazzoletto è la mia vita.
Non riesco a immaginare la vita\lsenza di lui. Provi lo stesso per

il tuo fazzoletto?

entries.original:
"My handkerchief!
You found it!

I must have dropped it when I came
to the café last.

Thank heavens you were around to
pick it up!

Please, as my thanks, I want you to
graciously accept this gift."
entries.translation_source: My handkerchief! You found it! I must have dropped it when I came to the café last. Thank heavens you were around to pick it up! Please, as my thanks, I want you to graciously accept this gift.
entries.translated:
Il mio fazzoletto! L{B4}hai trovato!
Deve essermi caduto quando sono\lvenuto al café l{B4}ultima volta.

Grazie al cielo eri nei paraggi per
raccoglierlo! Ti prego, come\lringraziamento, voglio che accetti

con grazia questo dono.

entries.original:
"[black]It looks like someone forgot their
handkerchief.

Best return it to its proper owner!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]It looks like someone forgot their handkerchief. Best return it to its proper owner!
entries.translated:
[black]Sembra che qualcuno abbia
dimenticato il proprio fazzoletto.\lMeglio restituirlo al suo legittimo

proprietario!

entries.original:
"Howdy do, I brought my Pokémon
here straight from the ranch."
entries.translation_source: Howdy do, I brought my Pokémon here straight from the ranch.
entries.translated:
Salve, ho portato qui i miei
Pokémon direttamente dal ranch.

entries.original: "You done good, my Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You done good, my Pokémon.
entries.translated: Hai fatto bene, mio Pokémon.

entries.original:
"I bring my Pokémon here from the
ranch often so they can have a\llittle fun."
entries.translation_source: I bring my Pokémon here from the ranch often so they can have a little fun.
entries.translated:
Porto spesso qui i miei Pokémon dal
ranch, così possono divertirsi un\lpo{B4}.

entries.original:
"I’m a master rancher!

What does that even mean?
Battle me and find out!"
entries.translation_source: I’m a master rancher! What does that even mean? Battle me and find out!
entries.translated:
Sono un maestro allevatore! Che
vuol dire, esattamente? Combatti\lcon me e scoprirai!

entries.original:
"It means I’m the master of my
ranch!

My word is law!"
entries.translation_source: It means I’m the master of my ranch! My word is law!
entries.translated:
Vuol dire che sono il padrone del
mio ranch! La mia parola è legge!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon are raring to go!

We come to this café as much as we
can just for the battles!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon are raring to go! We come to this café as much as we can just for the battles!
entries.translated:
I miei Pokémon non vedono l{B4}ora di
combattere! Veniamo in questo caffè\logni volta che possiamo solo per le

lotte!

entries.original:
"Next time I’m here, we should have
another go at our battle!"
entries.translation_source: Next time I’m here, we should have another go at our battle!
entries.translated:
La prossima volta che sarò qui,
dovremmo rifare la nostra\lbattaglia!

entries.original:
"Do you love the Pokémon Eevee?
I sure do!

I don’t have one, but I’m still a
huge fan all the same.

But I always wondered, why is Eevee
so popular?

It gets all this special attention.

I know it’s cute and all, but take
this Z-Crystal for instance.

Why does Eevee get one?

Oh, well\."
entries.translation_source: Do you love the Pokémon Eevee? I sure do! I don’t have one, but I’m still a huge fan all the same. But I always wondered, why is Eevee so popular? It gets all this special attention. I know it’s cute and all, but take this Z-Crystal for instance. Why does Eevee get one? Oh, well[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ti piace il Pokémon Eevee? A me sì!
Non ne ho uno, ma resto comunque un\lgrandissimo fan. Però mi sono

sempre chiesto: perché Eevee è così
popolare? Riceve tutta questa\lattenzione speciale. So che è

carino e tutto, ma prendi questo
Cristallo Z, per esempio. Perché\lEevee ne riceve uno? Oh, vabbè\.

entries.original:
"Now you have the Z-Crystal meant
for Eevee!

I can worry less now that it’s out
of my head\."
entries.translation_source: Now you have the Z-Crystal meant for Eevee! I can worry less now that it’s out of my head[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ora hai lo Z-Cristallo destinato a
Eevee! Posso preoccuparmi meno ora\lche mi è uscito dalla testa\.

entries.original:
"Heya!

I don’t believe I’ve formally
introduced myself.

My name’s Catherine!
But most people call me Cathy.

I came here from Kanto with my
friend Mahina.

Prof. Oak wanted us to complete the
Pokédex, so every day we travel\laround Borrius searching for as\lmany rare Pokémon as we can.

It’s thanks to these travels that I
was able to unlock a hidden power\lliving within my Blastoise.

If you have a Blastoise too,
this’ll help you unlock your\lBlastoise’s hidden potential, too."
entries.translation_source: Heya! I don’t believe I’ve formally introduced myself. My name’s Catherine! But most people call me Cathy. I came here from Kanto with my friend Mahina. Prof. Oak wanted us to complete the Pokédex, so every day we travel around Borrius searching for as many rare Pokémon as we can. It’s thanks to these travels that I was able to unlock a hidden power living within my Blastoise. If you have a Blastoise too, this’ll help you unlock your Blastoise’s hidden potential, too.
entries.translated:
Ehi! Non credo di essermi
presentata formalmente. Mi chiamo\lCatherine! Ma la maggior parte

delle persone mi chiama Cathy. Sono
venuta qui da Kanto con la mia\lamica Mahina. Il Prof. Oak voleva

che completassimo il Pokédex, così
ogni giorno viaggiamo per Borrius\lcercando quanti più Pokémon rari

possibile. È grazie a questi viaggi
che sono riuscita a risvegliare un\lpotere nascosto che vive nel mio

Blastoise. Se anche tu hai un
Blastoise, questo ti aiuterà a\lrisvegliare anche il potenziale

nascosto del tuo Blastoise.

entries.original:
"I like battling in Hidden Grottos
with my Blastoise, so if you ever\lfind yourself in one, let’s team\lup and fight together!

We make a powerful team.

But I prefer to only use Blastoise
when absolutely necessary."
entries.translation_source: I like battling in Hidden Grottos with my Blastoise, so if you ever find yourself in one, let’s team up and fight together! We make a powerful team. But I prefer to only use Blastoise when absolutely necessary.
entries.translated:
Mi piace combattere nelle Grotte
Nascoste con il mio Blastoise,\lquindi se mai dovessi trovarti in

una, facciamo squadra e combattiamo
insieme! Formiamo una squadra\lpotente. Però preferisco usare

Blastoise solo quando è
assolutamente necessario.

entries.original:
"Abimbola!
That’s my name!

What’s an Abimbola?
Beats me!

But my friends call me Abimbol
for short. I love it!

I think you should take this for
listening to me tell you all\labout my name!"
entries.translation_source: Abimbola! That’s my name! What’s an Abimbola? Beats me! But my friends call me Abimbol for short. I love it! I think you should take this for listening to me tell you all about my name!
entries.translated:
Abimbola! Questo è il mio nome!
Cos{B4}è un Abimbola? Boh! Ma i miei\lamici mi chiamano Abimbol per

brevità. Mi piace! Penso che
dovresti prendere questo per avermi\lascoltato parlare di tutto il mio

nome!

entries.original:
"You seem like a cool Trainer -
let’s team up sometime!

I like battling in Hidden Grottos,
so if you see I’m there, too, pick\lme to fight with!

I like to start by incapacitating
the opponent, and once that’s done,\lit’s no holds barred!

Yeah!"
entries.translation_source: You seem like a cool Trainer - let’s team up sometime! I like battling in Hidden Grottos, so if you see I’m there, too, pick me to fight with! I like to start by incapacitating the opponent, and once that’s done, it’s no holds barred! Yeah!
entries.translated:
Sembri un Allenatore in gamba -
facciamo squadra qualche volta! Mi\lpiace lottare nelle Grotte

Nascoste, quindi se vedi che ci
sono anch{B4}io, scegli me come\lcompagno di lotta! Mi piace

cominciare mettendo fuori
combattimento l{B4}avversario, e una\lvolta fatto, non ci sono più

regole! Sì!

entries.original:
"So, you have chosen to speak with I,
the great and regal Alford.

Because of your bravery, you
deserve something special."
entries.translation_source: So, you have chosen to speak with I, the great and regal Alford. Because of your bravery, you deserve something special.
entries.translated:
Dunque, hai scelto di parlare con
me, il grande e regale Alford. Per\lil tuo coraggio, meriti qualcosa di

speciale.

entries.original:
"I am a big lover of regal Pokémon.

These Pokémon I carry with me
define who I am.

If you are ever in need of
assistance, do not hesitate to\lcall on my regal Pokémon and me."
entries.translation_source: I am a big lover of regal Pokémon. These Pokémon I carry with me define who I am. If you are ever in need of assistance, do not hesitate to call on my regal Pokémon and me.
entries.translated:
Sono un grande amante dei Pokémon
regali. Questi Pokémon che porto\lcon me definiscono chi sono. Se mai

avrai bisogno di aiuto, non esitare
a chiamare me e i miei Pokémon\lregali.

entries.original:
"My friend, Cathy and I came here
together from the Kanto region.

We were given Pokémon by Prof.
Oak, and tasked with completing\la Pokédex.

During my travels, I deepened my
bond with my Venusaur, and now\lwe fight as one.

If you have a Venusaur such as
mine, you may find this helps\lstrengthen your bond with it."
entries.translation_source: My friend, Cathy and I came here together from the Kanto region. We were given Pokémon by Prof. Oak, and tasked with completing a Pokédex. During my travels, I deepened my bond with my Venusaur, and now we fight as one. If you have a Venusaur such as mine, you may find this helps strengthen your bond with it.
entries.translated:
Il mio amico, Cathy, e io siamo
arrivati qui insieme dalla regione\ldi Kanto. Ci hanno dato dei Pokémon

dal Prof. Oak e ci hanno affidato
il compito di completare il\lPokédex. Durante i miei viaggi, ho

approfondito il legame con il mio
Venusaur, e ora combattiamo come un\ltutt{B4}uno. Se hai un Venusaur come

il mio, potresti scoprire che
questo aiuta a rafforzare il tuo\llegame con lui.

entries.original:
"If you ever wish for a powerful
partner in a Hidden Grotto,\lmy Venusaur and I are sure to be\la good pick."
entries.translation_source: If you ever wish for a powerful partner in a Hidden Grotto, my Venusaur and I are sure to be a good pick.
entries.translated:
Se mai desideri un partner potente
in una Tana Nascosta, il mio\lVenusaur e io saremo sicuramente

una buona scelta.

entries.original:
"Oh, hey, [buffer3]\.

Nice of you to drop by\.

I was just drinkin’ this herbal tea,
and then you showed up.

\.

Uh, might sound odd, but\.\CC0818 could
you spot me a [green][buffer1][blue]?

I’ve got a [green][buffer2][blue] you might like
for it, if you wanna trade\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, hey, [buffer3-1][game-token-2] Nice of you to drop by[game-token-3] I was just drinkin’ this herbal tea, and then you showed up. [game-token-4] Uh, might sound odd, but[game-token-5][control-code-6] could you spot me a [color-green-7][buffer1-8][color-blue-9]? I’ve got a [color-green-10][buffer2-11][color-blue-12] you might like for it, if you wanna trade[game-token-13]
entries.translated:
Oh, ehi, [buffer3]\. Che gentile a
passare di qui\. Stavo giusto bevendo\lquesto tè alle erbe, e poi sei

spuntato tu. \. Eh, può sembrare
strano, ma\.\CC0818 potresti passarmi un\l[green][buffer1][blue]? Ho un [green][buffer2][blue] che

potrebbe piacerti in cambio, se
vuoi scambiare\.

entries.original:
"Aw, not cool, [buffer3]\.

Whelp, guess I’ll get back to
my tea\.

Calms the nerves, [buffer3]\."
entries.translation_source: Aw, not cool, [buffer3-1][game-token-2] Whelp, guess I’ll get back to my tea[game-token-3] Calms the nerves, [buffer3-4][game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Ah, non è affatto carino, [buffer3]\.
Vabbè, credo che tornerò al mio tè\.\lCalma i nervi, [buffer3]\.

"Did you know the League doesn’t pay
me for anything anymore?

I’m dead, so I don’t need food, and
I don’t get tired, so I don’t sleep,\lso I don’t need shelter, so I don’t\lneed rent money.

Gotta spend I dunno how long doing
whatever the League and this\lstupid thing wants\.

Which includes getting coffee\.

Which isn’t even for me\.

And was paid for by my host stealing
from the other customers."

che non è nemmeno per me\. Ed è stato\lpagato dal mio ospite che ruba agli

all this tea here?

Daddy said I shouldn’t bring any food
or drink I didn’t buy from the café\lhere, because it’s rude.

So I just bought all the different
tea here, and had a big tea party\lwith all my friends!

No coffee, though.

Daddy says I’m not old enough yet."

entries.translation_source: Hurry up, [player-name-1], choose a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sbrigati, [player], scegli un
Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Let’s use our new Pokémon to break
out of here!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s use our new Pokémon to break out of here!
entries.translated:
Usiamo i nostri nuovi Pokémon per
uscire di qui!

entries.original:
"Hey!
Who do you think you are?

Do you think you can get away with
keeping me locked up in here?

You’d better let me through right
now, or you’re gonna feel my wrath!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! Who do you think you are? Do you think you can get away with keeping me locked up in here? You’d better let me through right now, or you’re gonna feel my wrath!
entries.translated:
Ehi! Chi credi di essere? Pensi
davvero di cavartela tenendomi\lchiuso qui dentro? Faresti meglio a

farmi passare subito, o sentirai la
mia ira!

entries.original:
"Back off, kid.

I’m under strict orders to keep you
locked up."
entries.translation_source: Back off, kid. I’m under strict orders to keep you locked up.
entries.translated:
Indietro, ragazzino. Ho ordini
severi di tenerti rinchiuso.

entries.original:
"So scram, unless you want
to\.\CC0820 feel my wrath."
entries.translation_source: So scram, unless you want to[game-token-1][control-code-2] feel my wrath.
entries.translated:
Quindi, levati di torno, a meno che
tu non voglia\.\CC0820 sentire la mia ira.

entries.original:
"Smart choice.

Keep far away from this door,
and you won’t regret it."
entries.translation_source: Smart choice. Keep far away from this door, and you won’t regret it.
entries.translated:
Buona scelta. Stai ben lontano da
questa porta e non te ne pentirai.

entries.original:
"Huh? Who are you?

Pretty sure I was by myself
when they threw me in here.

\.

[player], huh?

And you’re saying you got sucked
in here by a magic portal?

That’s a pretty dramatic entrance."
entries.translation_source: Huh? Who are you? Pretty sure I was by myself when they threw me in here. [game-token-1] [player-name-2], huh? And you’re saying you got sucked in here by a magic portal? That’s a pretty dramatic entrance.
entries.translated:
Eh? Chi sei? Sono abbastanza sicuro
di essere stato da solo quando mi\lhanno buttato qui dentro. \.

[player], eh? E stai dicendo che
sei stato risucchiato qui da un\lportale magico? Che entrata

plateale.

entries.original:
"Hey\. Those clothes\.
Do you live in Frozen Heights?

I just moved in, but I guess I
never stopped by to say hi."
entries.translation_source: Hey[game-token-1] Those clothes[game-token-2] Do you live in Frozen Heights? I just moved in, but I guess I never stopped by to say hi.
entries.translated:
Ehi\. Quei vestiti\. Vivi a Frozen
Heights? Mi sono appena trasferito\lqui, ma suppongo di non essere mai

passato a salutarti.

entries.original:
"Say\.\CC0818 how about we buddy up
and look for a way out together?

The door back there’s a bust with
that guard in the way.

Oh yeah, I guess I should introduce
myself, partner.

My name is\."
entries.translation_source: Say[game-token-1][control-code-2] how about we buddy up and look for a way out together? The door back there’s a bust with that guard in the way. Oh yeah, I guess I should introduce myself, partner. My name is[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Sai\.\CC0818 che ne dici se facciamo squadra
e cerchiamo insieme una via\ld{B4}uscita? La porta laggiù è un

disastro con quella guardia di
mezzo. Ah già, credo che dovrei\lpresentarmi, partner. Il mio nome è\.

entries.original:
"My name’s [rival].

I’m looking for my parents, and I
thought these people would have\la lead on them.

And, well\.\CC0818 you can see they hate
it when people go snooping.

Anyway, we’d better start looking
for another exit, so let’s move."
entries.translation_source: My name’s [text-token-rival-1]. I’m looking for my parents, and I thought these people would have a lead on them. And, well[game-token-2][control-code-3] you can see they hate it when people go snooping. Anyway, we’d better start looking for another exit, so let’s move.
entries.translated:
Mi chiamo [rival]. Sto cercando i
miei genitori e pensavo che queste\lpersone avessero qualche indizio su

di loro. E, beh\.\CC0818 puoi vedere che
odiano quando la gente ficca il\lnaso. Comunque, faremo meglio a

cercare un{B4}altra uscita, quindi
muoviamoci.

entries.original:
"À.

We’d better look for another way
out of here."
entries.translation_source: À. We’d better look for another way out of here.
entries.translated: À. È meglio cercare un{B4}altra via d{B4}uscita da qui.

entries.original:
"Did you hear that, [player]?

It sounded like some Pokémon are
trapped in that cage over there!

Let’s go check it out."
entries.translation_source: Did you hear that, [player-name-1]? It sounded like some Pokémon are trapped in that cage over there! Let’s go check it out.
entries.translated:
Hai sentito, [player]? Sembrava che
alcuni Pokémon fossero intrappolati\lin quella gabbia laggiù! Andiamo a

dare un{B4}occhiata.

entries.original:
"There are many Pokémon locked
away in the cage\."
entries.translation_source: There are many Pokémon locked away in the cage[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ci sono molti Pokémon rinchiusi
nella gabbia\.

entries.original:
"The cage door is unlocked.
The Pokémon are gone."
entries.translation_source: The cage door is unlocked. The Pokémon are gone.
entries.translated:
Il cancello della gabbia è
sbloccato. I Pokémon sono andati\lvia.

entries.original:
"The lock appears fragile.
Break it?"
entries.translation_source: The lock appears fragile. Break it?
entries.translated:
La serratura sembra fragile.
Romperla?

entries.original: "The cage door swung open!"
entries.translation_source: The cage door swung open!
entries.translated:
La porta della gabbia si è
spalancata!

entries.original:
"It looks like these Pokémon are
grateful and want to join us!

If we each take one and put them in
these Poké Balls I picked up, we\lcan use them to attack the guard\land escape!

So, what are you waiting for?
Go ahead, choose a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It looks like these Pokémon are grateful and want to join us! If we each take one and put them in these Poké Balls I picked up, we can use them to attack the guard and escape! So, what are you waiting for? Go ahead, choose a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Sembra che questi Pokémon siano
grati e vogliano unirsi a noi! Se\lne prendiamo uno ciascuno e lo

mettiamo in queste Poké Ball che ho
raccolto, possiamo usarli per\lattaccare la guardia e fuggire!

Allora, che aspettate? Dai, scegli
un Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Will you take the [green][buffer2][black] Pokémon,
[green][buffer1][black]?"
entries.translation_source: Will you take the [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-black-3] Pokémon, [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-black-6]?
entries.translated:
Prenderai il Pokémon [green][buffer2][black],
[green][buffer1][black]?

entries.original:
"The [green][buffer1][black] joined [player]’s party!
It has the [green][buffer2][black] nature."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3] joined [player-name-4]’s party! It has the [color-green-5][buffer2-6][color-black-7] nature.
entries.translated:
Il [green][buffer1][black] si è unito alla squadra
di [player]! Ha la natura [green][buffer2][black].

entries.original: "[blue]I’ll take this one, then."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I’ll take this one, then.
entries.translated: [blue]Prendo io questo, allora.

entries.original: "[black]Disheartened, the [buffer1] left."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Disheartened, the [buffer1-2] left.
entries.translated:
[black]Con il morale a terra, [buffer1] se
ne andò.

entries.original:
"Now that we have our own Pokémon,
let’s head back to the exit.

We’ll force our way out of here!"
entries.translation_source: Now that we have our own Pokémon, let’s head back to the exit. We’ll force our way out of here!
entries.translated:
Ora che abbiamo i nostri Pokémon,
torniamo all{B4}uscita. Ci faremo\lstrada fuori di qui!

entries.original:
"I told you before.

I’m under strict orders to keep you
locked up."
entries.translation_source: I told you before. I’m under strict orders to keep you locked up.
entries.translated:
Te l{B4}ho detto prima. Ho ordini
rigidi di tenerti rinchiuso.

entries.original:
"Heh heh heh\.

You don’t really have a choice
anymore.

You’re gonna let us out, or get your
sorry butt handed to you."
entries.translation_source: Heh heh heh[game-token-1] You don’t really have a choice anymore. You’re gonna let us out, or get your sorry butt handed to you.
entries.translated:
Heh heh heh\. Non hai più davvero
scelta. O ci fai uscire, oppure ti\lprenderai una bella batosta.

entries.original:
"Quit fooling yourself.

There’s nothing you can do to make
me let you through."
entries.translation_source: Quit fooling yourself. There’s nothing you can do to make me let you through.
entries.translated:
Smettila di prenderti in giro. Non
c{B4}è niente che tu possa fare per\lconvincermi a lasciarti passare.

entries.original:
"[player], let’s team up and show
this guy what we can do!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], let’s team up and show this guy what we can do!
entries.translated:
[player], facciamo squadra e
mostriamogli di cosa siamo capaci!

entries.original:
"You both are really starting
to get on my nerves!

Inkay! Skorupi!

Show them why you don’t mess
with the [black]Shadows[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: You both are really starting to get on my nerves! Inkay! Skorupi! Show them why you don’t mess with the [color-black-1]Shadows[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Voi due state davvero iniziando a
darmi sui nervi! Inkay! Skorupi!\lMostrate loro perché non si scherza

con le [black]Ombre[blue]!

entries.original:
"I knew it was a bad idea to lock
them up in here\."
entries.translation_source: I knew it was a bad idea to lock them up in here[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sapevo che era una cattiva idea
rinchiuderli qui dentro\.

entries.original:
"That’s what you get for messing
with the Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: That’s what you get for messing with the Shadows!
entries.translated:
È quello che ti meriti per aver
importunato le Ombre!

entries.original:
"Not bad, [player]!
You and I make a pretty good team!

But I’ll take it from here.

Let me use these items on your
Pokémon to heal it from the fight."
entries.translation_source: Not bad, [player-name-1]! You and I make a pretty good team! But I’ll take it from here. Let me use these items on your Pokémon to heal it from the fight.
entries.translated:
Non male, [player]! Tu ed io
facciamo una bella squadra! Ma da\lqui in poi ci penso io. Lascia che

usi questi oggetti sul tuo Pokémon
per curarlo dopo la lotta.

entries.original:
"That’s a letdown.

I really thought you and I could
handle him together.

I guess I’ll deal with him myself.

Use this Potion on your Pokémon
to make it feel better."
entries.translation_source: That’s a letdown. I really thought you and I could handle him together. I guess I’ll deal with him myself. Use this Potion on your Pokémon to make it feel better.
entries.translated:
Che delusione. Pensavo davvero che
tu ed io potessimo occuparcene\linsieme. Suppongo che me la vedrò

da solo. Usa questa Pozione sul tuo
Pokémon per farlo stare meglio.

entries.original:
"No!
My Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: No! My Pokémon!
entries.translated: No! I miei Pokémon!

entries.original:
"No!
My Inkay!"
entries.translation_source: No! My Inkay!
entries.translated: No! Il mio Inkay!

entries.original:
"[buffer1]!
Move in and strike!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1]! Move in and strike!
entries.translated: [buffer1]! Avanza e colpisci!

entries.original: "[buffer1]! Use [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1]! Use [buffer2-2]!
entries.translated: [buffer1]! Usa [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Alright, alright, I give up!
I’ll let you through!

Please, have mercy on me!
Don’t hurt me anymore! Please!"
entries.translation_source: Alright, alright, I give up! I’ll let you through! Please, have mercy on me! Don’t hurt me anymore! Please!
entries.translated:
Va bene, va bene, mi arrendo! Vi
lascerò passare! Per favore, abbi\lpietà di me! Non farmi più male! Ti

prego!

entries.original: "[buffer1]! Return!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1]! Return!
entries.translated: [buffer1]! Torna!

entries.original:
"I’m getting out of here now,
[player].

I’m sure you’re capable of taking
care of yourself from here on out.

If you run into any trouble, just
use your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I’m getting out of here now, [player-name-1]. I’m sure you’re capable of taking care of yourself from here on out. If you run into any trouble, just use your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Me ne vado subito da qui, [player].
Sono sicuro che d{B4}ora in poi sarai\lin grado di cavartela da solo. Se

incontri qualche difficoltà, usa
semplicemente i tuoi Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Oh, one more thing.

As soon as you get home, we’re
going to battle.

You impressed me when we battled
together, so I want to see how I’ll\lfare against you.

Until then, don’t tire yourself
out too much."
entries.translation_source: Oh, one more thing. As soon as you get home, we’re going to battle. You impressed me when we battled together, so I want to see how I’ll fare against you. Until then, don’t tire yourself out too much.
entries.translated:
Oh, un{B4}ultima cosa. Appena torni a
casa, combatteremo. Mi hai colpito\lquando abbiamo combattuto insieme,

quindi voglio vedere come me la
caverò contro di te. Fino ad\lallora, non stancarti troppo.

entries.original:
"Oh, one more thing.

As soon as you get home, we’re
going to battle.

You have a lot to learn about
battling, and I wouldn’t mind\lshowing you a thing or two.

Until then, don’t tire yourself
out too much."
entries.translation_source: Oh, one more thing. As soon as you get home, we’re going to battle. You have a lot to learn about battling, and I wouldn’t mind showing you a thing or two. Until then, don’t tire yourself out too much.
entries.translated:
Oh, un{B4}ultima cosa. Appena torni a
casa, combatteremo. Hai ancora\lmolto da imparare sulle lotte, e

non mi dispiacerebbe mostrarti un
paio di cose. Fino ad allora, non\lstancarti troppo.

entries.original:
"Oh, one more thing.

As soon as you get home, we’re
going to battle.

You torchickened out earlier, but I
won’t let you skip out next time!

Until then, don’t tire yourself
out too much."
entries.translation_source: Oh, one more thing. As soon as you get home, we’re going to battle. You torchickened out earlier, but I won’t let you skip out next time! Until then, don’t tire yourself out too much.
entries.translated:
Ah, un{B4}ultima cosa. Appena sarai a
casa, lotteremo. Prima ti sei\ltirato indietro come un pollo, ma

la prossima volta non ti lascerò
saltare l{B4}incontro! Fino ad allora,\lnon stancarti troppo.

entries.original: "Now burn it."
entries.translation_source: Now burn it.
entries.translated: Ora brucialo.

entries.original:
"[red]As you observed, these specimens
are completely immune to extreme\lcold and extreme heat."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]As you observed, these specimens are completely immune to extreme cold and extreme heat.
entries.translated:
[red]Come hai osservato, questi
esemplari sono completamente immuni\lal freddo estremo e al caldo

estremo.

entries.original:
"What about the immunity to
electricity?"
entries.translation_source: What about the immunity to electricity?
entries.translated: E l{B4}immunità all{B4}elettricità?

entries.original:
"[red]We have yet to complete that, sir.

It is difficult to enhance the
specimens quickly when we have our\lexternal research as well."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]We have yet to complete that, sir. It is difficult to enhance the specimens quickly when we have our external research as well.
entries.translated:
[red]Non abbiamo ancora completato
quello, signore. È difficile\lpotenziare i campioni rapidamente

quando abbiamo anche la nostra
ricerca esterna.

entries.original:
"Very well.
This will do for now."
entries.translation_source: Very well. This will do for now.
entries.translated: Molto bene. Per ora andrà bene.

entries.original:
"Ah, Marlon, perfect timing.

We’re moving up our timetable.

I’m unsure as to why, but our target
seems to have relocated to our\lvicinity earlier than anticipated.

With the Shadow Warriors enhanced
and the package we need arriving\ltoday, we can begin the operation."
entries.translation_source: Ah, Marlon, perfect timing. We’re moving up our timetable. I’m unsure as to why, but our target seems to have relocated to our vicinity earlier than anticipated. With the Shadow Warriors enhanced and the package we need arriving today, we can begin the operation.
entries.translated:
Ah, Marlon, tempismo perfetto.
Stiamo anticipando la tabella di\lmarcia. Non so bene perché, ma il

nostro bersaglio sembra essersi
spostato nei nostri paraggi prima\ldel previsto. Con i Shadow Warriors

potenziati e il pacchetto di cui
abbiamo bisogno in arrivo oggi,\lpossiamo iniziare l{B4}operazione.

entries.original:
"Understood.

There’s just one more thing to
discuss before I head out.

The trespassers we locked up
in the warehouse have escaped."
entries.translation_source: Understood. There’s just one more thing to discuss before I head out. The trespassers we locked up in the warehouse have escaped.
entries.translated:
Ricevuto. C{B4}è solo un{B4}altra cosa di
cui discutere prima che me ne vada.\lGli intrusi che abbiamo rinchiuso

nel magazzino sono fuggiti.

entries.original:
"This grunt over here let them
get away."
entries.translation_source: This grunt over here let them get away.
entries.translated:
Questo scagnozzo qui li ha lasciati
scappare.

entries.original:
"How bad is it?
What did those two see?"
entries.translation_source: How bad is it? What did those two see?
entries.translated:
Quanto è grave? Cosa hanno visto
quei due?

entries.original:
"The first one, the boy with
red hair, saw nothing relevant.

The second one, however\.

If Fey finds out that [buffer2] was in
the lab, she will insist on\lrelocating in the middle of our\loperation.

You know that’s time and resources
we can’t afford\."
entries.translation_source: The first one, the boy with red hair, saw nothing relevant. The second one, however[game-token-1] If Fey finds out that [buffer2-2] was in the lab, she will insist on relocating in the middle of our operation. You know that’s time and resources we can’t afford[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Il primo, il ragazzo dai capelli
rossi, non ha visto nulla di\lrilevante. Il secondo, però\. Se Fey

scopre che [buffer2] era nel
laboratorio, insisterà per\ltrasferirsi nel bel mezzo della

nostra operazione. Sai bene che non
possiamo permetterci di perdere\ltempo e risorse\.

entries.original:
"Then make sure Fey doesn’t find
out about what happened.

Our priority right now is obtaining
the package needed for the mission.

We’ll deal with that second one
who escaped at a later time."
entries.translation_source: Then make sure Fey doesn’t find out about what happened. Our priority right now is obtaining the package needed for the mission. We’ll deal with that second one who escaped at a later time.
entries.translated:
Allora assicurati che Fey non
scopra cosa è successo. La nostra\lpriorità adesso è ottenere il pacco

necessario per la missione. Ci
occuperemo di quel secondo\lfuggitivo in un secondo momento.

entries.original:
"Understood.

I have a plan to obtain that
package, and it’ll even allow this\lfailure of a grunt here to redeem\lhimself.

Once I have it, I’ll head straight
for the target."
entries.translation_source: Understood. I have a plan to obtain that package, and it’ll even allow this failure of a grunt here to redeem himself. Once I have it, I’ll head straight for the target.
entries.translated:
Ricevuto. Ho un piano per
procurarmi quel pacco, e permetterà\lpersino a questo fallimento di

recluta qui presente di
riscattarsi. Una volta che l{B4}avrò,\landrò dritto all{B4}obiettivo.

entries.original: "Then good luck, Marlon."
entries.translation_source: Then good luck, Marlon.
entries.translated: Allora in bocca al lupo, Marlon.

entries.original:
"Close\.\CC0818 We’re getting so close\.

Soon, it won’t be long before that
power finally becomes ours\."
entries.translation_source: Close[game-token-1][control-code-2] We’re getting so close[game-token-3] Soon, it won’t be long before that power finally becomes ours[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Vicini\.\CC0818 Siamo così vicini\. Presto,
non passerà molto prima che quel\lpotere diventi finalmente nostro\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
You finally made it out!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You finally made it out!
entries.translated:
[player]! Finalmente ce l{B4}hai fatta
a uscire!

entries.original:
"Have you met old man Log yet?

He’s supposed to be an expert on
Pokémon’s stats, or whatever\.

I just filled him in on what
happened."
entries.translation_source: Have you met old man Log yet? He’s supposed to be an expert on Pokémon’s stats, or whatever[game-token-1] I just filled him in on what happened.
entries.translated:
Hai incontrato il vecchio Log?
Dovrebbe essere un esperto delle\lstatistiche dei Pokémon, o qualcosa

del genere\. Gli ho appena detto cosa
è successo.

entries.original:
"I study all aspects of Pokémon
stats and capture rates.

And my title is Professor,
not \qoold man\qc!

Anyway, that must have been quite
the ordeal you both went through.

I’m relieved to see both of you
are unharmed.

And it seems you’ve even managed to
acquire rare Pokémon!

I was planning on giving [rival]
a Pokémon of his own someday,\lbut now I don’t have to!

Ho ho ho!"
entries.translation_source: I study all aspects of Pokémon stats and capture rates. And my title is Professor, not [quote-open-1]old man[quote-close-2]! Anyway, that must have been quite the ordeal you both went through. I’m relieved to see both of you are unharmed. And it seems you’ve even managed to acquire rare Pokémon! I was planning on giving [text-token-rival-3] a Pokémon of his own someday, but now I don’t have to! Ho ho ho!
entries.translated:
Studio ogni aspetto delle
statistiche Pokémon e dei tassi di\lcattura. E il mio titolo è

Professor, non \qovecchio\qc! Comunque,
dev{B4}essere stata una bella prova\lquella che avete affrontato

insieme. Sono sollevato di vedere
che entrambi siete sani e salvi. E\la quanto pare siete riusciti anche

ad ottenere Pokémon rari! Avevo
intenzione di dare a [rival] un\lPokémon tutto suo un giorno, ma ora

non è necessario! Ho ho ho!

entries.original:
"Someday?

I’ve been here a whole week,
and I was expecting one ASAP!"
entries.translation_source: Someday? I’ve been here a whole week, and I was expecting one ASAP!
entries.translated:
Un giorno? Sono qui da un{B4}intera
settimana, e me ne aspettavo uno\lsubito!

entries.original:
"Well, of course I was always going
to give you one, [rival]!

There are plenty of errands I’m too
old to run myself, after all!

It’s just that\.\CC0818 you’re insistent
on looking for your parents.

I keep telling you, no one has
seen them in years!

Even if they are somehow still in
Borrius, finding them is much too\lbig a task for you alone.

I was hoping you’d accept that fact
before giving you a Pokémon,\lbut you refuse to listen!"
entries.translation_source: Well, of course I was always going to give you one, [text-token-rival-1]! There are plenty of errands I’m too old to run myself, after all! It’s just that[game-token-2][control-code-3] you’re insistent on looking for your parents. I keep telling you, no one has seen them in years! Even if they are somehow still in Borrius, finding them is much too big a task for you alone. I was hoping you’d accept that fact before giving you a Pokémon, but you refuse to listen!
entries.translated:
Beh, naturalmente avrei sempre
finito per dartene uno, [rival]!\lCi sono un sacco di commissioni che

sono troppo vecchio per sbrigare da
solo, dopotutto! È solo che\.\CC0818 sei\lcosì insistente nel cercare i tuoi

genitori. Continuo a dirti che
nessuno li ha visti da anni! Anche\lse fossero ancora in qualche modo a

Borrius, trovarli sarebbe un
compito troppo grande per te da\lsolo. Speravo che accettassi questo

fatto prima di darti un Pokémon, ma
ti rifiuti di ascoltare!

entries.original:
"You may be my \qolegal guardian\qc or
whatever in Borrius, but you sure\ldon’t know anything about me!

I’m strong!
Strong enough to fend for myself!

And when I see my parents, they’ll
see just how strong I really am!

Just like you’re about to!"
entries.translation_source: You may be my [quote-open-1]legal guardian[quote-close-2] or whatever in Borrius, but you sure don’t know anything about me! I’m strong! Strong enough to fend for myself! And when I see my parents, they’ll see just how strong I really am! Just like you’re about to!
entries.translated:
Potrai anche essere il mio \qotutore
legale\qc o quel che sei a Borrius,\lma di me non sai proprio niente!

Sono forte! Abbastanza forte da
cavarmela da solo! E quando rivedrò\li miei genitori, vedranno quanto

sono davvero forte! Proprio come
stai per vedere!

entries.original:
"Come on, [player]!

I said I owed you a battle before,
so lemme show you both how a real\lTrainer does it!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player-name-1]! I said I owed you a battle before, so lemme show you both how a real Trainer does it!
entries.translated:
Dai, [player]! Ti avevo detto che
ti dovevo una lotta, quindi lascia\lche vi mostri a entrambi come

combatte un vero Allenatore!

entries.original:
"Come on, [player]!

I said I’d show you the ropes,
so lemme teach you both how a\lreal Trainer does it!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player-name-1]! I said I’d show you the ropes, so lemme teach you both how a real Trainer does it!
entries.translated:
Avanti, [player]! Ho detto che ti
avrei mostrato i trucchi del\lmestiere, quindi lascia che vi

insegni a entrambi come si fa
davvero da Allenatore!

entries.original:
"That was a fine battle.

Very enthralling, if I do say so,
myself."
entries.translation_source: That was a fine battle. Very enthralling, if I do say so, myself.
entries.translated:
È stata una bella battaglia.
Davvero avvincente, se posso dirlo\lio stesso.

entries.original:
"Tch\.\CC0820 no one cares how it made
you feel, old man.

I only care about how strong it made
our Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Tch[game-token-1][control-code-2] no one cares how it made you feel, old man. I only care about how strong it made our Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Tsk\.\CC0820 a nessuno importa di come ti ha
fatto sentire, vecchio. A me\limporta solo di quanto ha reso

forti i nostri Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Well\.\CC0818 erm\.

From what I can see, your Pokémon
do have some nice stats\.

I see potential for them to become
strong Pokémon some day."
entries.translation_source: Well[game-token-1][control-code-2] erm[game-token-3] From what I can see, your Pokémon do have some nice stats[game-token-4] I see potential for them to become strong Pokémon some day.
entries.translated:
Beh\.\CC0818 ehm\. Da quello che posso vedere,
i tuoi Pokémon hanno davvero delle\lbuone statistiche\. Vedo del

potenziale perché diventino dei
Pokémon forti un giorno.

entries.original:
"Finally, the first useful thing
you’ve said all day.

And it’s gonna be the last, because
I’m outta here."
entries.translation_source: Finally, the first useful thing you’ve said all day. And it’s gonna be the last, because I’m outta here.
entries.translated:
Finalmente, la prima cosa utile che
hai detto oggi. E sarà anche\ll{B4}ultima, perché me ne vado.

entries.original:
"Well, he’s certainly a handful,
isn’t he?

And now that he’s gone, who will
run my errands for me?"
entries.translation_source: Well, he’s certainly a handful, isn’t he? And now that he’s gone, who will run my errands for me?
entries.translated:
Beh, è sicuramente un tipo tosto,
non è vero? E ora che se n{B4}è\landato, chi farà le mie

commissioni?

entries.original:
"Ah, yes, [player].

You seem rather capable\.\CC0818 you should
assist me!

Ah, what a splendid idea, your
father was well known for helping\lothers, after all.

It’s only fitting that his [buffer2]
would follow in his footsteps.

As for the task, there’s a package in
[green]Bellin Town[blue] at the [green]Poké Mart[blue].

I would go get it myself, but my
assistants and I are much too busy\lwith our own research\.

Don’t fret, the clerk knows someone
will be picking it up in my stead.

Since you have your own Pokémon
with you, it should be easy!

But, just in case, this repellent will
make the journey easier for you."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes, [player-name-1]. You seem rather capable[game-token-2][control-code-3] you should assist me! Ah, what a splendid idea, your father was well known for helping others, after all. It’s only fitting that his [buffer2-4] would follow in his footsteps. As for the task, there’s a package in [color-green-5]Bellin Town[color-blue-6] at the [color-green-7]Poké Mart[color-blue-8]. I would go get it myself, but my assistants and I are much too busy with our own research[game-token-9] Don’t fret, the clerk knows someone will be picking it up in my stead. Since you have your own Pokémon with you, it should be easy! But, just in case, this repellent will make the journey easier for you.
entries.translated:
Ah, sì, [player]. Sembri piuttosto
capace\.\CC0818 dovresti aiutarmi! Ah, che\lidea splendida, tuo padre era ben

noto per aiutare gli altri,
dopotutto. È giusto che il suo\l[buffer2] segua le sue orme. Per

quanto riguarda il compito, c{B4}è un
pacco a [green]Bellin Town[blue] al [green]Poké Market[blue].\lAndrei a prenderlo io stesso, ma i

miei assistenti ed io siamo troppo
occupati con le nostre ricerche\. Non\lpreoccuparti, l{B4}addetto sa che

qualcuno passerà a ritirarlo al
posto mio. Dato che hai i tuoi\lPokémon con te, dovrebbe essere

facile! Ma, per sicurezza, questo
repellente renderà il viaggio più\lsemplice per te.

entries.original:
"And while you’re at it, you could
assist me with another task!

A fellow Professor, Oak, asked me to
give these to two young Trainers.

It’s an encyclopedia for recording
the data of Pokémon.

Apparently, Borrius has plenty of
Pokémon his own region lacks."
entries.translation_source: And while you’re at it, you could assist me with another task! A fellow Professor, Oak, asked me to give these to two young Trainers. It’s an encyclopedia for recording the data of Pokémon. Apparently, Borrius has plenty of Pokémon his own region lacks.
entries.translated:
E già che ci sei, potresti aiutarmi
con un altro compito! Un altro\lProfessore, Oak, mi ha chiesto di

consegnare questi a due giovani
Allenatori. È un{B4}enciclopedia per\lregistrare i dati dei Pokémon. A

quanto pare, Borrius ha molti
Pokémon che mancano alla sua\lregione.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received the Pokédex
from Prof. Log!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received the Pokédex from Prof. Log!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto il Pokédex dal
Prof. Log!

entries.original:
"Personally, I’m content with just
observing species for the Pokédex.

However, if you want complete data
on Pokémon, including their base\lstats, you’ll need to catch them.

So, here are some tools for
catching wild Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Personally, I’m content with just observing species for the Pokédex. However, if you want complete data on Pokémon, including their base stats, you’ll need to catch them. So, here are some tools for catching wild Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Personalmente, mi basta osservare
le specie per il Pokédex. Però, se\lvuoi dati completi sui Pokémon,

comprese le loro statistiche base,
dovrai catturarli. Quindi, ecco\lalcuni strumenti per catturare

Pokémon selvatici.

entries.original:
"If you’re not in the mood for
catching Pokémon, use that Repel I\lgave you to keep them away.

If you need anything else from me,
I’ll be in my lab.

But before you depart, you should
head home and inform your mother.

She’s been very worried about you.

Good luck, [player].
My studies are depending on you!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re not in the mood for catching Pokémon, use that Repel I gave you to keep them away. If you need anything else from me, I’ll be in my lab. But before you depart, you should head home and inform your mother. She’s been very worried about you. Good luck, [player-name-1]. My studies are depending on you!
entries.translated:
Se non hai voglia di catturare
Pokémon, usa quel Repellente che ti\lho dato per tenerli lontani. Se ti

serve altro da me, sarò nel mio
laboratorio. Ma prima di partire,\ldovresti tornare a casa e avvisare

tua madre. È molto preoccupata per
te. Buona fortuna, [player]. I miei\lstudi dipendono da te!

entries.original: "You!"
entries.translation_source: You!
entries.translated: Tu!

entries.original: "Uh, I mean, excuse me."
entries.translation_source: Uh, I mean, excuse me.
entries.translated: Uh, cioè, mi scusi.

entries.original:
"Hi, there!
May I help you?

\.

Wait\.\CC0818 you’re telling me Prof. Log
sent you to get his package?"
entries.translation_source: Hi, there! May I help you? [game-token-1] Wait[game-token-2][control-code-3] you’re telling me Prof. Log sent you to get his package?
entries.translated:
Ciao! Posso aiutarti? \. Aspetta\.\CC0818 mi
stai dicendo che il Prof. Log ti ha\lmandato a prendere il suo pacco?

entries.original:
"Uh, oh.
I thought that guy smelled fishy\."
entries.translation_source: Uh, oh. I thought that guy smelled fishy[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Uh, oh. Pensavo che quel tizio
fosse losco\.

entries.original:
"Here’s the deal, kid.

I already gave the package to the
man who was just here.

But if you want to blame anyone for
this mix-up, blame Prof. Log.

I told him he needed to tell me
who he’d be sending, but he just\lkept saying \qosomeone will get it.\qc

There’s nothing I can do for you
at this point, but maybe if you\lchase after that man, you can\lcatch him before he gets too far!"
entries.translation_source: Here’s the deal, kid. I already gave the package to the man who was just here. But if you want to blame anyone for this mix-up, blame Prof. Log. I told him he needed to tell me who he’d be sending, but he just kept saying [quote-open-1]someone will get it.[quote-close-2] There’s nothing I can do for you at this point, but maybe if you chase after that man, you can catch him before he gets too far!
entries.translated:
Ecco il punto, ragazzo. Ho già dato
il pacco all{B4}uomo che era qui poco\lfa. Ma se vuoi incolpare qualcuno

per questo pasticcio, incolpa il
Prof. Log. Gli ho detto che doveva\ldirmi chi avrebbe mandato, ma lui

continuava a dire \qoqualcuno lo
prenderà.\qc Non c{B4}è niente che possa\lfare per te a questo punto, ma

forse se insegui quell{B4}uomo, puoi
prenderlo prima che vada troppo\llontano!

entries.original:
"Did you receive the package
from the Mart?"
entries.translation_source: Did you receive the package from the Mart?
entries.translated: Hai ricevuto il pacco dal Market?

entries.original: "Yes, I did, sir."
entries.translation_source: Yes, I did, sir.
entries.translated: Sì, signore, l{B4}ho fatto.

entries.original: "Were you discreet in doing so?"
entries.translation_source: Were you discreet in doing so?
entries.translated: Sei stato discreto nel farlo?

entries.original:
"I was, sir.

I even ran into one of the two I
let escape from the warehouse, but\lI chose to avoid a confrontation.

As far as I’m aware, I wasn’t
followed."
entries.translation_source: I was, sir. I even ran into one of the two I let escape from the warehouse, but I chose to avoid a confrontation. As far as I’m aware, I wasn’t followed.
entries.translated:
Lo ero, signore. Sono persino
incappato in uno dei due che ho\llasciato fuggire dal magazzino, ma

ho scelto di evitare uno scontro.
Per quanto ne so, non sono stato\lseguito.

entries.original:
"Good work.

I’d say you’re back on the road to
earning whatever you asked for\lwhen you joined us."
entries.translation_source: Good work. I’d say you’re back on the road to earning whatever you asked for when you joined us.
entries.translated:
Bel lavoro. Direi che sei di nuovo
sulla strada per guadagnarti\lqualunque cosa avessi chiesto

quando ti sei unito a noi.

entries.original:
"It was a mechanical leg for my
mother, sir."
entries.translation_source: It was a mechanical leg for my mother, sir.
entries.translated:
Era una gamba meccanica per mia
madre, signore.

entries.original:
"Legs, arms, another head,
whatever.

As long as this package contains all
of the goods that we need for the\loperation, the scientists will build\las many limbs as your mother wants."
entries.translation_source: Legs, arms, another head, whatever. As long as this package contains all of the goods that we need for the operation, the scientists will build as many limbs as your mother wants.
entries.translated:
Gambe, braccia, un{B4}altra testa, fa
lo stesso. Finché questo pacco\lcontiene tutta la merce che ci

serve per l{B4}operazione, gli
scienziati costruiranno tutti gli\larti che vuole tua madre.

entries.original:
"I’m heading [green]north of Frozen Heights[blue]
to capture the target.

Report back to Zeph and inform
him of my current status."
entries.translation_source: I’m heading [color-green-1]north of Frozen Heights[color-blue-2] to capture the target. Report back to Zeph and inform him of my current status.
entries.translated:
Sto andando [green]a nord di Frozen
Heights[blue] per catturare il bersaglio.\lRiferisci a Zeph e informalo del

mio stato attuale.

entries.original: "[blue]Cacnea, use Cut!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Cacnea, use Cut!
entries.translated: [blue]Cacnea, usa Taglio!

entries.original: "[green]Cac!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Cac!
entries.translated: [green]Cac!

entries.original:
"No!
You need to recover the package!"
entries.translation_source: No! You need to recover the package!
entries.translated: No! Devi recuperare il pacco!

entries.original:
"One with the wind, one with the
snow\.

A heart that is frozen in absolute
zero!

Now, become the snow that drives the
harshest blizzard!

Sankren fimbulvetr!

Descend to me, Articuno!"
entries.translation_source: One with the wind, one with the snow[game-token-1] A heart that is frozen in absolute zero! Now, become the snow that drives the harshest blizzard! Sankren fimbulvetr! Descend to me, Articuno!
entries.translated:
Uno con il vento, uno con la neve\.
Un cuore congelato nello zero\lassoluto! Ora, diventa la neve che

scatena la bufera più feroce!
Sankren fimbulvetr! Discendi da me,\lArticuno!

entries.original:
"Shadow Warriors!

Restrain it!"
entries.translation_source: Shadow Warriors! Restrain it!
entries.translated: Guerrieri dell{B4}Ombra! Trattenetelo!

entries.original:
"Now, Articuno, it’s time for you to
become ours."
entries.translation_source: Now, Articuno, it’s time for you to become ours.
entries.translated:
Ora, Articuno, è tempo che tu
diventi nostro.

entries.original:
"The operation was a success.

Time to report back to Zeph."
entries.translation_source: The operation was a success. Time to report back to Zeph.
entries.translated:
L{B4}operazione è riuscita. È ora di
riferire a Zeph.

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 I recognize you from the lab!

I’d have thought your imprisonment,
however brief, would have taught\lyou better\.

Do you just enjoy being locked up?
Or did someone\.\CC0818 send you?

\.\CC0818no. We don’t have time to deal
with you now.

But regardless, we can’t have you
pursuing us any further."
entries.translation_source: You[game-token-1][control-code-2] I recognize you from the lab! I’d have thought your imprisonment, however brief, would have taught you better[game-token-3] Do you just enjoy being locked up? Or did someone[game-token-4][control-code-5] send you? [game-token-6][control-code-7]no. We don’t have time to deal with you now. But regardless, we can’t have you pursuing us any further.
entries.translated:
Tu\.\CC0820 Ti riconosco dal laboratorio!
Avrei pensato che la tua prigionia,\lper quanto breve, ti avesse

insegnato a comportarti meglio\. Ti
piace forse stare rinchiuso? O ti\lha mandato qualcuno\.\CC0818? \.\CC0818no. Non

abbiamo tempo di occuparci di te
adesso. Ma, in ogni caso, non\lpossiamo permetterti di continuare

a seguirci.

entries.original:
"Grunts!

One of you, stall [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: Grunts! One of you, stall [buffer1-1]!
entries.translated:
Reclute! Uno di voi trattenga
[buffer1]!

entries.original:
"[red]Who do you think you are, huh?

Do you think you can just follow
us and get away with it?

Don’t expect any mercy from
the [black]Shadows[red]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Who do you think you are, huh? Do you think you can just follow us and get away with it? Don’t expect any mercy from the [color-black-2]Shadows[color-red-3]!
entries.translated:
[red]Chi credi di essere, eh? Pensi di
poterci seguire così e farla\lfranca? Non aspettarti pietà dalle

[black]Ombre[red]!

entries.original:
"[red]\.\CC0818Oh, you wanted this package.

Here, you can have it.
We’ve taken what we needed from it."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1][game-token-2][control-code-3]Oh, you wanted this package. Here, you can have it. We’ve taken what we needed from it.
entries.translated:
[red]\.\CC0818Oh, volevi questo pacco. Ecco, puoi
prenderlo. Abbiamo preso ciò che ci\lserviva.

entries.original:
"[red]You’d be smart not to follow
us again."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]You’d be smart not to follow us again.
entries.translated:
[red]Faresti bene a non seguirci di
nuovo.

entries.original:
"No!
You need to return Log’s package!"
entries.translation_source: No! You need to return Log’s package!
entries.translated:
No! Devi restituire il pacco del
Prof. Log!

entries.original:
"Alright, grunts.

For our next operation, we’ll be
heading to [green]Cinder Volcano[blue] and\lensuring Ivory obtains her target."
entries.translation_source: Alright, grunts. For our next operation, we’ll be heading to [color-green-1]Cinder Volcano[color-blue-2] and ensuring Ivory obtains her target.
entries.translated:
Va bene, reclute. Per la nostra
prossima operazione, ci dirigeremo\lverso [green]Cinder Volcano[blue] e faremo in

modo che Ivory ottenga il suo
obiettivo.

entries.original:
"I will tolerate no screw ups!

Last time we were followed, and I
can’t have that happening again.

We don’t have the luxury of dealing
with unwanted Trainers right now.

Keep a low profile at all costs,
and no matter what, do not get\lnoticed!

Do I make myself clear?"
entries.translation_source: I will tolerate no screw ups! Last time we were followed, and I can’t have that happening again. We don’t have the luxury of dealing with unwanted Trainers right now. Keep a low profile at all costs, and no matter what, do not get noticed! Do I make myself clear?
entries.translated:
Non tollererò nessun pasticcio!
L{B4}ultima volta siamo stati seguiti,\le non posso permettere che succeda

di nuovo. Non abbiamo il lusso di
occuparci di Allenatori\lindesiderati in questo momento.

Restate il più possibile in
incognito, e qualunque cosa accada,\lnon fatevi notare! Mi sono

spiegato?

entries.original: "Yes, sir!"
entries.translation_source: Yes, sir!
entries.translated: Sì, signore!

entries.original: "Move out."
entries.translation_source: Move out.
entries.translated: Spostati.

entries.original: "Arthur"
entries.translation_source: Arthur
entries.translated: Arthur

entries.original:
"Hello there, young [buffer1]!

What can I do for you?

\.

Ah, so Prof. Euler Log sent you.

What you describe sounds troubling
indeed.

Well, I believe I can shed some
light on what those scoundrels are\ltrying to achieve.

Incidentally, are you well-versed in
Borrius’ history?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, young [buffer1-1]! What can I do for you? [game-token-2] Ah, so Prof. Euler Log sent you. What you describe sounds troubling indeed. Well, I believe I can shed some light on what those scoundrels are trying to achieve. Incidentally, are you well-versed in Borrius’ history?
entries.translated:
Salve, giovane [buffer1]! Come posso
aiutarti? \. Ah, quindi ti ha mandato\lil Prof. Euler Log. Quello che

descrivi suona davvero
preoccupante. Beh, credo di poter\lfare un po{B4} di luce su ciò che quei

farabutti stanno cercando di
ottenere. A proposito, conosci bene\lla storia di Borrius?

entries.original:
"Is that so?

Then you may use my [green]television[blue]
over there.

I recorded a program from last night
that may help you fill in the gaps."
entries.translation_source: Is that so? Then you may use my [color-green-1]television[color-blue-2] over there. I recorded a program from last night that may help you fill in the gaps.
entries.translated:
È così? Allora puoi usare la mia
[green]televisione[blue] laggiù. Ho registrato\lun programma di ieri sera che

potrebbe aiutarti a riempire gli
spazi vuoti.

entries.original:
"Excellent.

Then, as you know, the dark force
of Borrius was sealed away, many,\lmany years ago.

However, it is said that if the
three legendary Pokémon used to\lseal it away are brought back\ltogether at a place called the\l[green]Ruins of Void[blue], the power can be\lreleased once again.

This must be what those thugs you
encountered are after - to engulf\lBorrius in darkness once again.

If what you say is accurate,
their next target will surely be\."
entries.translation_source: Excellent. Then, as you know, the dark force of Borrius was sealed away, many, many years ago. However, it is said that if the three legendary Pokémon used to seal it away are brought back together at a place called the [color-green-1]Ruins of Void[color-blue-2], the power can be released once again. This must be what those thugs you encountered are after - to engulf Borrius in darkness once again. If what you say is accurate, their next target will surely be[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Eccellente. Allora, come sai, la
forza oscura di Borrius è stata\lsigillata molti, molti anni fa.

Tuttavia, si dice che se i tre
Pokémon leggendari usati per\lsigillarla vengono riuniti in un

luogo chiamato le [green]Rovine del Vuoto[blue],
il potere può essere rilasciato\lancora una volta. Questo dev{B4}essere

ciò che quei teppisti che hai
incontrato stanno cercando -\lavvolgere Borrius nell{B4}oscurità

ancora una volta. Se quello che
dici è accurato, il loro prossimo\lobiettivo sarà sicuramente\.

entries.original: "Grampa Arthur!"
entries.translation_source: Grampa Arthur!
entries.translated: Nonno Arthur!

entries.original: "What’s wrong, Jax?"
entries.translation_source: What’s wrong, Jax?
entries.translated: Che succede, Jax?

entries.original:
"I just saw those guys in black
heading in the direction of\l[green]Cinder Volcano[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: I just saw those guys in black heading in the direction of [color-green-1]Cinder Volcano[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Ho appena visto quei tipi in nero
andare verso [green]Cinder Volcano[blue]!

entries.original:
"So it’s true\.

I was just telling [player] here
about their possible aims\.\lbut this confirms my suspicions.

Those thugs must be after the
legendary Pokémon, [green]Moltres[blue]."
entries.translation_source: So it’s true[game-token-1] I was just telling [player-name-2] here about their possible aims[game-token-3] but this confirms my suspicions. Those thugs must be after the legendary Pokémon, [color-green-4]Moltres[color-blue-5].
entries.translated:
Quindi è vero\. Stavo proprio dicendo
a [player] qui dei loro possibili\lobiettivi\. ma questo conferma i miei

sospetti. Quei malviventi devono
essere a caccia del Pokémon\lleggendario, [green]Moltres[blue].

entries.original:
"[player]? Gah, no, what am I
talking about?

Grampa, we have to stop those guys,
right?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]? Gah, no, what am I talking about? Grampa, we have to stop those guys, right?
entries.translated:
[player]? Ah, no, che sto dicendo?
Nonno, dobbiamo fermare quei tizi,\lgiusto?

entries.original:
"Not yet, Jax.

First things first, I need you to
fly to Frozen Heights and bring\lProf. Log here.

He needs to be informed of what
has transpired."
entries.translation_source: Not yet, Jax. First things first, I need you to fly to Frozen Heights and bring Prof. Log here. He needs to be informed of what has transpired.
entries.translated:
Non ancora, Jax. Prima le cose
importanti: voglio che tu voli a\lFrozen Heights e porti qui il Prof.

Log. Deve essere informato di ciò
che è accaduto.

entries.original: "Right away, Grampa!"
entries.translation_source: Right away, Grampa!
entries.translated: Subito, nonno!

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

So, it is as bad as I feared\.

What do you think should be done
about this, Arthur?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] So, it is as bad as I feared[game-token-2] What do you think should be done about this, Arthur?
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Quindi è tanto grave quanto
temevo\. Cosa pensi che si dovrebbe\lfare al riguardo, Arthur?

entries.original:
"Jax will fly out to intercept these
\qoShadows\qc.

So far, he’s shown himself to be a
quite capable Trainer\.

And as you know, Euler, I’ve been
training him as my successor, so I\lbelieve he’s our best hope.

He’ll confront these \qoShadows\qc and
stop them before they reach\lMoltres."
entries.translation_source: Jax will fly out to intercept these [quote-open-1]Shadows[quote-close-2]. So far, he’s shown himself to be a quite capable Trainer[game-token-3] And as you know, Euler, I’ve been training him as my successor, so I believe he’s our best hope. He’ll confront these [quote-open-4]Shadows[quote-close-5] and stop them before they reach Moltres.
entries.translated:
Jax volerà fuori per intercettare
queste \qoShadows\qc. Finora, si è\ldimostrato un Allenatore piuttosto

capace\. E come sai, Euler, l{B4}ho
addestrato come mio successore,\lquindi credo che sia la nostra

migliore speranza. Affronterà
queste \qoShadows\qc e le fermerà prima\lche raggiungano Moltres.

entries.original:
"Of course.

That seems like a very reasonable
plan, Arthur."
entries.translation_source: Of course. That seems like a very reasonable plan, Arthur.
entries.translated:
Certo. Mi sembra un piano molto
ragionevole, Arthur.

entries.original:
"Understood, Grampa.

I’m heading out.

I’ll stop them and save Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: Understood, Grampa. I’m heading out. I’ll stop them and save Moltres!
entries.translated:
Ricevuto, nonno. Esco subito. Li
fermerò e salverò Moltres!

entries.original:
"Well, [player], I think it’s time
for you to head home.

You’ve completed your errand, and
I’m sure your mother misses you.

But still, I’m surprised that you
managed to get here so easily\.

I’ll have to brag to your mother
about what a reliable errand [buffer1]\lyou’ve become!

Ho ho ho!"
entries.translation_source: Well, [player-name-1], I think it’s time for you to head home. You’ve completed your errand, and I’m sure your mother misses you. But still, I’m surprised that you managed to get here so easily[game-token-2] I’ll have to brag to your mother about what a reliable errand [buffer1-3] you’ve become! Ho ho ho!
entries.translated:
Bene, [player], penso sia ora di
tornartene a casa. Hai completato\lla tua commissione, e sono sicuro

che tua madre ti stia aspettando.
Eppure, resto sorpreso che tu sia\lriuscito ad arrivare fin qui così

facilmente\. Dovrò vantarmi con tua
madre di quanto [buffer1] affidabile\lsei diventato! O ho ho!

entries.original:
"Now, wait just a moment, Euler.

I know Jax is capable, but I believe
this young [buffer1] may be just as\luseful.

[player] has had prior experience
with these \qoShadows\qc, and Jax very\lwell might benefit from the extra\lassistance [player] could lend."
entries.translation_source: Now, wait just a moment, Euler. I know Jax is capable, but I believe this young [buffer1-1] may be just as useful. [player-name-2] has had prior experience with these [quote-open-3]Shadows[quote-close-4], and Jax very well might benefit from the extra assistance [player-name-5] could lend.
entries.translated:
Ora aspetta un momento, Euler. So
che Jax è capace, ma credo che\lquesto giovane [buffer1] possa

essere altrettanto utile. [player]
ha già avuto esperienza con queste\l\qoShadows\qc, e Jax potrebbe trarre

grande beneficio dall{B4}aiuto extra
che [player] potrebbe offrire.

entries.original:
"Assistance?

Arthur, [player] only became a
Trainer very recently\."
entries.translation_source: Assistance? Arthur, [player-name-1] only became a Trainer very recently[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Assistenza? Arthur, [player] è
diventato un Allenatore solo di\lrecente\.

entries.original:
"Is that\.\CC0818 is that Dresco Town’s
Gym Badge?

To think that you’d make this much
progress so quickly\."
entries.translation_source: Is that[game-token-1][control-code-2] is that Dresco Town’s Gym Badge? To think that you’d make this much progress so quickly[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
È quella\.\CC0818 è la Medaglia di Dresco
Town? Pensare che tu abbia fatto\lcosì tanti progressi così in fretta\.

entries.original:
"You see, Euler?

I think that Badge shows that
[player]’s more than capable of\ltaking care of [buffer1]self.

Right now, the four of us are the
only ones who know the true aim of\lthe Shadows.

Having another Trainer capable of
fighting them\.\CC0818 surely you see\lmy point."
entries.translation_source: You see, Euler? I think that Badge shows that [player-name-1]’s more than capable of taking care of [buffer1-2]self. Right now, the four of us are the only ones who know the true aim of the Shadows. Having another Trainer capable of fighting them[game-token-3][control-code-4] surely you see my point.
entries.translated:
Capisci, Euler? Credo che quella
Medaglia dimostri che [player] è\lpiù che capace di prendersi cura di

[buffer1]stesso. Al momento, noi
quattro siamo gli unici a conoscere\lil vero obiettivo degli Shadows.

Avere un altro Allenatore capace di
combatterli\.\CC0818 capisci sicuramente\lcosa intendo.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

Maybe you’re right.

If this takes a turn for the worse,
we’ll need all the help we can get."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] Maybe you’re right. If this takes a turn for the worse, we’ll need all the help we can get.
entries.translated:
Mmm\. Forse hai ragione. Se la
situazione dovesse peggiorare,\lavremo bisogno di tutto l{B4}aiuto

possibile.

entries.original:
"Alright, [player], you may follow
after Jax.

I’ll\.\CC0820 tell your mother you finished
my errand, and you’ve left home to\ltake the Gym Leader challenge.

Yes, I think that will do it."
entries.translation_source: Alright, [player-name-1], you may follow after Jax. I’ll[game-token-2][control-code-3] tell your mother you finished my errand, and you’ve left home to take the Gym Leader challenge. Yes, I think that will do it.
entries.translated:
Va bene, [player], puoi seguire
Jax. Io\.\CC0820 dirò a tua madre che hai\lfinito la mia commissione e che sei

uscito di casa per affrontare la
sfida della Capopalestra. Sì, credo\lche andrà bene così.

entries.original:
"Don’t force yourself, [player].

If you feel you are too injured to
continue, then you must fall back.

Jax will help, if it comes to that.

Good luck, youngster."
entries.translation_source: Don’t force yourself, [player-name-1]. If you feel you are too injured to continue, then you must fall back. Jax will help, if it comes to that. Good luck, youngster.
entries.translated:
Non forzarti, [player]. Se senti di
essere troppo ferito per\lcontinuare, allora devi ritirarti.

Jax ti aiuterà, se necessario.
Buona fortuna, giovane.

entries.original:
"We’re running out of time, [player].

You need to hurry to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]
and save [green]Zapdos[blue]!

If it’s captured too, we’ll all be
doomed\."
entries.translation_source: We’re running out of time, [player-name-1]. You need to hurry to [color-green-2]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-3] and save [color-green-4]Zapdos[color-blue-5]! If it’s captured too, we’ll all be doomed[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Stiamo finendo il tempo, [player].
Devi sbrigarti a [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] e\lsalvare [green]Zapdos[blue]! Se viene catturato

anche lui, saremo tutti condannati\.

entries.original:
"Jax told me the news.

A job well done saving Zapdos,
[player]!

All that remains now is retrieving
Moltres and Articuno from the\lShadows.

Jax is in [green]Dehara City[blue] waiting to
discuss the next move."
entries.translation_source: Jax told me the news. A job well done saving Zapdos, [player-name-1]! All that remains now is retrieving Moltres and Articuno from the Shadows. Jax is in [color-green-2]Dehara City[color-blue-3] waiting to discuss the next move.
entries.translated:
Jax mi ha dato la notizia. Ottimo
lavoro a salvare Zapdos, [player]!\lOra non resta che recuperare

Moltres e Articuno dalle Ombre. Jax
è a [green]Dehara City[blue] e ti aspetta per\ldiscutere la prossima mossa.

entries.original:
"So, the dark force has been
released\.

If it isn’t stopped, it could be
used to destroy the whole region!

You must find Jax and seal it away
once more!"
entries.translation_source: So, the dark force has been released[game-token-1] If it isn’t stopped, it could be used to destroy the whole region! You must find Jax and seal it away once more!
entries.translated:
Quindi, la forza oscura è stata
liberata\. Se non viene fermata,\lpotrebbe essere usata per

distruggere tutta la regione! Devi
trovare Jax e sigillarla di nuovo!

entries.original:
"You did it!

You defeated the Light of Ruin and
saved us!

You are a true Guardian of Borrius!

Your father would be proud."
entries.translation_source: You did it! You defeated the Light of Ruin and saved us! You are a true Guardian of Borrius! Your father would be proud.
entries.translated:
Ce l{B4}hai fatta! Hai sconfitto la
Luce della Rovina e ci hai salvati!\lSei un vero Guardiano di Borrius!

Tuo padre sarebbe orgoglioso.

entries.original:
"Now that everything is at peace
once more, why don’t you take on\lthe [green]Pokémon League[blue]?

I’m sure someone with your skill
could easily become the champion."
entries.translation_source: Now that everything is at peace once more, why don’t you take on the [color-green-1]Pokémon League[color-blue-2]? I’m sure someone with your skill could easily become the champion.
entries.translated:
Ora che tutto è di nuovo in pace,
perché non provi a sfidare la [green]Lega\lPokémon[blue]? Sono sicuro che qualcuno

con la tua abilità potrebbe
diventare facilmente il campione.

entries.original:
"Oh, [player]! Welcome.

Thank you for assisting Jax
in my rescue.

He\.\CC0818 well, actually, he came to see
me just before.

He told me about how the pressure
of trying to live up to my legacy\lwas messing with his head\.

All the more so after the setbacks
against the Shadows and the Light\lof Ruin.

I admit, perhaps I was asking
too much of him\.

So I told him that he should
improve himself, for his own sake,\lnot mine.

Although\. I wouldn’t mind if
he became strong enough to take\lyour place as Champion, myself.

Ho ho ho!

Oh, yes.

As thanks for rescuing me,
I’d like you to have this."
entries.translation_source: Oh, [player-name-1]! Welcome. Thank you for assisting Jax in my rescue. He[game-token-2][control-code-3] well, actually, he came to see me just before. He told me about how the pressure of trying to live up to my legacy was messing with his head[game-token-4] All the more so after the setbacks against the Shadows and the Light of Ruin.
