I admit, perhaps I was asking too much of him[game-token-5] So I told him that he should improve himself, for his own sake, not mine. Although[game-token-6] I wouldn’t mind if he became strong enough to take your place as Champion, myself. Ho ho ho! Oh, yes. As thanks for rescuing me, I’d like you to have this.
entries.translated:
Oh, [player]! Benvenuto. Grazie per
aver aiutato Jax a salvarmi. Lui\.\CC0818\lbeh, in realtà, è venuto a trovarmi

poco prima. Mi ha parlato di come
la pressione di cercare di essere\lall{B4}altezza della mia eredità gli

stesse dando alla testa\. Ancora di
più dopo i contrattempi contro gli\lShadows e la Light of Ruin. Ammetto

che forse gli stavo chiedendo
troppo\. Così gli ho detto che doveva\lmigliorarsi, per il suo bene, non

per me. Anche se\. non mi
dispiacerebbe se diventasse\labbastanza forte da prendere il tuo

posto come Campione, io stesso. Ho
ho ho! Oh, sì. Come ringraziamento\lper aver contribuito al mio

salvataggio, vorrei darti questo.

entries.original:
"Have a [green]Salamence[blue] hold that,
and it’ll be able to Mega Evolve.

Jax was training a Bagon, on the
side\.\CC0818 but he needed something to\lfly with in the meantime, so\lhe trained a Starly, as well.

Now though, he’s grown rather fond
of both of them!"
entries.translation_source: Have a [color-green-1]Salamence[color-blue-2] hold that, and it’ll be able to Mega Evolve. Jax was training a Bagon, on the side[game-token-3][control-code-4] but he needed something to fly with in the meantime, so he trained a Starly, as well. Now though, he’s grown rather fond of both of them!
entries.translated:
Fallo tenere a un [green]Salamence[blue], e
potrà Mega Evolvere. Jax stava\lallenando un Bagon, di nascosto\.\CC0818 ma

nel frattempo gli serviva qualcosa
con cui volare, quindi ha allenato\lanche uno Starly. Però ormai si è

affezionato parecchio a entrambi!

entries.original: "How go your travels, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: How go your travels, [player-name-1]?
entries.translated: Come vanno i tuoi viaggi, [player]?

entries.original:
"Get moving, [player], to Cinder
Volcano - and be quick.

I don’t think it’s anything Jax can’t
handle, but he may appreciate\lyour help."
entries.translation_source: Get moving, [player-name-1], to Cinder Volcano - and be quick. I don’t think it’s anything Jax can’t handle, but he may appreciate your help.
entries.translated:
Muoviti, [player], verso il Vulcano
Cenere - e sbrigati. Non credo sia\lqualcosa che Jax non possa gestire,

ma potrebbe apprezzare il tuo
aiuto.

entries.original:
"Looks like I’m here.

I’d better get moving, then."
entries.translation_source: Looks like I’m here. I’d better get moving, then.
entries.translated:
Sembra che sia arrivato. Allora è
meglio che mi muova.

entries.original:
"One with the wind, one with the
flames\.

The guard that keeps vigil over
the sacred torch!

Now, become the inferno that
scorches the wastelands!

Sankren bolganone!

Descend to me, Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: One with the wind, one with the flames[game-token-1] The guard that keeps vigil over the sacred torch! Now, become the inferno that scorches the wastelands! Sankren bolganone! Descend to me, Moltres!
entries.translated:
Uno col vento, uno con le fiamme\. La
guardia che veglia sulla torcia\lsacra! Ora, diventa l{B4}inferno che

arde le terre desolate! Sankren
bolganone! Scendi da me, Moltres!

entries.original: "And now for the capture!"
entries.translation_source: And now for the capture!
entries.translated: E ora per la cattura!

entries.original:
"Now, Shadow Warriors!

Restrain it!"
entries.translation_source: Now, Shadow Warriors! Restrain it!
entries.translated:
Ora, Guerrieri dell{B4}Ombra!
Immobilizzatelo!

entries.original:
"That was about as routine as it
could get.

Mission complete.

Let’s move out."
entries.translation_source: That was about as routine as it could get. Mission complete. Let’s move out.
entries.translated:
Era il massimo della routine
possibile. Missione completata.\lAndiamo.

entries.original:
"[blue]Stop right there, Shadow!

Return Moltres back to where
it belongs!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Stop right there, Shadow! Return Moltres back to where it belongs!
entries.translated:
[blue]Fermati subito, Shadow! Riporta
Moltres al suo posto!

entries.original:
"[red]Unfortunately, I see no reason
to humor your foolish request.

Step aside, if you know what’s good
for you."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Unfortunately, I see no reason to humor your foolish request. Step aside, if you know what’s good for you.
entries.translated:
[red]Purtroppo, non vedo alcun motivo
per assecondare la tua sciocca\lrichiesta. Fatti da parte, se sai

quello che ti conviene.

entries.original:
"[blue]Sorry, but you’re not going anywhere
until Moltres is free.

If you won’t come quietly, then I’ll
have to use force."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Sorry, but you’re not going anywhere until Moltres is free. If you won’t come quietly, then I’ll have to use force.
entries.translated:
[blue]Mi dispiace, ma non andrai da
nessuna parte finché Moltres non\lsarà libero. Se non verrai con le

buone, allora dovrò usare la forza.

entries.original:
"[red]Sigh\.\CC0818 I had hoped it wouldn’t
come to this\.

My party was kept light for this
mission, but fortunately, I have\lother allies besides my Pokémon\.

Shadow Warriors\.\CC0820 if you would\.[blue]"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Sigh[game-token-2][control-code-3] I had hoped it wouldn’t come to this[game-token-4] My party was kept light for this mission, but fortunately, I have other allies besides my Pokémon[game-token-5] Shadow Warriors[game-token-6][control-code-7] if you would[game-token-8][color-blue-9]
entries.translated:
[red]Sospiro\.\CC0818 Speravo non si arrivasse a
questo\. Ho tenuto la squadra ridotta\lper questa missione, ma per fortuna

ho altri alleati oltre ai miei
Pokémon\. Shadow Warriors\.\CC0820 se volete\.[blue]

entries.original: "[blue]Ivory, wait!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Ivory, wait!
entries.translated: [blue]Ivory, aspetta!

entries.original:
"[blue]You don’t need to waste time over
this lone Trainer.

I’ll hold him off.
Just focus on the mission!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You don’t need to waste time over this lone Trainer. I’ll hold him off. Just focus on the mission!
entries.translated:
[blue]Non devi perdere tempo con questo
Allenatore solitario. Lo terrò\loccupato. Concentrati solo sulla

missione!

entries.original: "[red]Let’s go, Shadow Warriors\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Let’s go, Shadow Warriors[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [red]Andiamo, Guerrieri Ombra\.

entries.original:
"[blue]No\.\CC0818 they escaped with Moltres\.

Gah! This isn’t the time to feel
sorry for myself.

I gotta chase after them\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]No[game-token-2][control-code-3] they escaped with Moltres[game-token-4] Gah! This isn’t the time to feel sorry for myself. I gotta chase after them[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
[blue]No\.\CC0818 sono scappati con Moltres\. Gah!
Non è il momento di compatirmi.\lDevo inseguirli\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh? Wait, you’re\.\CC0820 [player],
I think?

Did Grampa Arthur send you here?

\.

Ah, so you were sent as backup.

Jeez, I got embarrassed in front
of you\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Huh? Wait, you’re[game-token-2][control-code-3] [player-name-4], I think? Did Grampa Arthur send you here? [game-token-5] Ah, so you were sent as backup. Jeez, I got embarrassed in front of you[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
[blue]Eh? Aspetta, tu sei\.\CC0820 [player],
credo? Il nonno Arthur ti ha\lmandato qui? \. Ah, quindi sei stato

mandato come rinforzo. Cavolo, ho
fatto una figuraccia davanti a te\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Well\.

Now that you’re here, why don’t you
and I team up?

You were sent to help, and I gotta
admit I could do with some right now\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Well[game-token-2] Now that you’re here, why don’t you and I team up? You were sent to help, and I gotta admit I could do with some right now[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[blue]Beh\. Ora che sei qui, perché non
facciamo squadra io e te? Sei stato\lmandato ad aiutare, e devo

ammettere che adesso mi servirebbe
un po{B4} di aiuto\.

entries.original: "[black][player] decided to go with Jax!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] decided to go with Jax!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha deciso di schierarsi
con Jax!

entries.original:
"[blue]Alright!
I bet we’ll make a good team!

Your Pokémon are in better shape
than I am right now, so you lead.

I can hang back and support.

I’ll make sure to keep us both
healed up, too."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Alright! I bet we’ll make a good team! Your Pokémon are in better shape than I am right now, so you lead. I can hang back and support. I’ll make sure to keep us both healed up, too.
entries.translated:
[blue]Bene! Scommetto che faremo una
grande squadra! I tuoi Pokémon sono\lin condizioni migliori delle mie al

momento, quindi vai tu davanti. Io
starò dietro a dare supporto. Mi\lassicurerò di tenere guariti

entrambi, inoltre.

entries.original:
"[blue]In that case, Staravia.
Let’s cut them off at the exit."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]In that case, Staravia. Let’s cut them off at the exit.
entries.translated:
[blue]In quel caso, Staravia. Tagliamogli
la strada all{B4}uscita.

entries.original:
"[black]While teamed up with Jax, the
[green]first 3[black] viable Pokémon in your\lparty will be selected for battle."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]While teamed up with Jax, the [color-green-2]first 3[color-black-3] viable Pokémon in your party will be selected for battle.
entries.translated:
[black]Mentre sei in squadra con Jax, i
[green]primi 3[black] Pokémon validi della tua\lsquadra saranno selezionati per la

lotta.

entries.original:
"Let’s get to the exit as quick as
possible and stop the Shadows from\lescaping with Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s get to the exit as quick as possible and stop the Shadows from escaping with Moltres!
entries.translated:
Raggiungiamo l{B4}uscita il più in
fretta possibile e impediamo alle\lOmbre di fuggire con Moltres!

entries.original:
"[blue]Where are you going, [player]?
The exit’s the other way!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Where are you going, [player-name-2]? The exit’s the other way!
entries.translated:
[blue]Dove vai, [player]? L{B4}uscita è
dall{B4}altra parte!

entries.original:
"[blue]Looks like we’ve reached the
exit, [player].

I’ll go on ahead.
Don’t stay too far behind!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Looks like we’ve reached the exit, [player-name-2]. I’ll go on ahead. Don’t stay too far behind!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sembra che abbiamo raggiunto
l{B4}uscita, [player]. Io vado avanti.\lNon restare troppo indietro!

entries.original: "Staravia! Use Aerial Ace!"
entries.translation_source: Staravia! Use Aerial Ace!
entries.translated: Staravia! Usa Aeroassalto!

entries.original: "[green]Ravia!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Ravia!
entries.translated: [green]Ravia!

entries.original: "[green]Raptor!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Raptor!
entries.translated: [green]Raptor!

entries.original: "Duskull! Use Payback!"
entries.translation_source: Duskull! Use Payback!
entries.translated: Duskull! Usa Contrattacco!

entries.original: "Cacnea! Use Feint Attack!"
entries.translation_source: Cacnea! Use Feint Attack!
entries.translated: Cacnea! Usa Finta!

entries.original: "[green]Skull\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Skull[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Teschio\.

entries.original:
"Your shadowy reign of terror
ends here and now!

I won’t let you escape from Cinder
Volcano with Moltres in hand!"
entries.translation_source: Your shadowy reign of terror ends here and now! I won’t let you escape from Cinder Volcano with Moltres in hand!
entries.translated:
Il tuo oscuro regno del terrore
finisce qui e ora! Non ti lascerò\lfuggire da Cinder Volcano con

Moltres tra le mani!

entries.original:
"\qoShadowy reign of terror\qc?
Seriously?

We have Moltres, and we’re well
within our rights to keep it.

You may have some self-righteous
notion that what we’re doing is\l\qoevil\qc, but you’re wrong!

You simply don’t understand what’s
at stake here\."
entries.translation_source: [quote-open-1]Shadowy reign of terror[quote-close-2]? Seriously? We have Moltres, and we’re well within our rights to keep it. You may have some self-righteous notion that what we’re doing is [quote-open-3]evil[quote-close-4], but you’re wrong! You simply don’t understand what’s at stake here[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
\qoOscuro regno del terrore\qc? Sul
serio? Abbiamo Moltres, e abbiamo\ltutto il diritto di tenerlo. Potrai

anche avere qualche idea
bacchettona su quello che stiamo\lfacendo sia \qocattivo\qc, ma ti

sbagli! Semplicemente non capisci
cosa c{B4}è in gioco qui\.

entries.original:
"[red]That’s it, Marlon.
Stall him for just a little longer.

These Shadow Warriors have been out
in the light for too long\.

They’ll revert to dust if they
remain here.

I need to return to base with
them now."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]That’s it, Marlon. Stall him for just a little longer. These Shadow Warriors have been out in the light for too long[game-token-2] They’ll revert to dust if they remain here. I need to return to base with them now.
entries.translated:
[red]Bene, Marlon. Trattienilo ancora
per un po{B4}. Questi Guerrieri Ombra\lsono stati esposti alla luce troppo

a lungo\. Torneranno polvere se
restano qui. Devo tornare alla base\lcon loro adesso.

entries.original:
"Of course, Ivory.
I have this under control.

Take the Shadow Warriors and go.

I can hold off this boy until
you escape with Moltres."
entries.translation_source: Of course, Ivory. I have this under control. Take the Shadow Warriors and go. I can hold off this boy until you escape with Moltres.
entries.translated:
Certo, Ivory. Ho tutto sotto
controllo. Prendi i Guerrieri\ldell{B4}Ombra e vai. Posso tenere a

bada questo ragazzo finché non
scappi con Moltres.

entries.original:
"[blue][player]!
Help me out against him!

I don’t care what he claims is really
at stake here, we have to blast\lthrough him and chase after Moltres!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]! Help me out against him! I don’t care what he claims is really at stake here, we have to blast through him and chase after Moltres!
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Dammi una mano contro di
lui! Non mi importa cosa dica sia\ldavvero in gioco qui, dobbiamo

sfondarlo e inseguire Moltres!

entries.original:
"So, we meet again, [player].

I take it, then, you’ve decided to
make it your business to interfere?

That’s unfortunate.

But two of you trying to get
past makes no difference to me."
entries.translation_source: So, we meet again, [player-name-1]. I take it, then, you’ve decided to make it your business to interfere? That’s unfortunate. But two of you trying to get past makes no difference to me.
entries.translated:
Allora ci rivediamo, [player].
Deduzione: avete deciso di farvi\lgli affari miei e interferire?

Peccato. Ma se siete in due a
provarci, per me non fa alcuna\ldifferenza.

entries.original:
"One of you grunts, give me a hand
over here!"
entries.translation_source: One of you grunts, give me a hand over here!
entries.translated:
Uno di voi scagnozzi, date una mano
qui!

entries.original:
"[red]I’ll assist you in your battle,
Marlon, sir!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’ll assist you in your battle, Marlon, sir!
entries.translated:
[red]Ti assisterò nella tua battaglia,
signor Marlon!

entries.original:
"[black]Choose up to three Pokémon to
battle with."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Choose up to three Pokémon to battle with.
entries.translated:
[black]Scegli fino a tre Pokémon con cui
lottare.

entries.original:
"Well, I suppose that’s fine.
Our operation was a success.

Ivory is long gone by now."
entries.translation_source: Well, I suppose that’s fine. Our operation was a success. Ivory is long gone by now.
entries.translated:
Beh, suppongo che vada bene. La
nostra operazione ha avuto\lsuccesso. Ivory è già sparita da un

pezzo.

entries.original:
"You can follow me if you want, but
it won’t do you any good.

You already know I’ll never lead
you to Moltres\.

So I advise both of you to do the
smart thing, and leave us alone."
entries.translation_source: You can follow me if you want, but it won’t do you any good. You already know I’ll never lead you to Moltres[game-token-1] So I advise both of you to do the smart thing, and leave us alone.
entries.translated:
Puoi seguirmi se vuoi, ma non ti
servirà a niente. Sai già che non\lvi porterò mai da Moltres\. Quindi

consiglio a entrambi di fare la
cosa intelligente e lasciarci in\lpace.

entries.original: "Let’s move."
entries.translation_source: Let’s move.
entries.translated: Muoviamoci.

entries.original:
"Grr\.\CC0818 He’s right\.\CC0818

It’s not even worth chasing him\.

That woman was the one who
took Moltres\."
entries.translation_source: Grr[game-token-1][control-code-2] He’s right[game-token-3][control-code-4] It’s not even worth chasing him[game-token-5] That woman was the one who took Moltres[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Grr\.\CC0818 Ha ragione\.\CC0818 Non vale nemmeno la
pena inseguirlo\. È stata quella\ldonna a prendere Moltres\.

entries.original:
"Anyway, thanks, [player] - he was a
lot tougher than I thought\.

Let’s head back to Grampa’s house,
and tell him what happened."
entries.translation_source: Anyway, thanks, [player-name-1] - he was a lot tougher than I thought[game-token-2] Let’s head back to Grampa’s house, and tell him what happened.
entries.translated:
Comunque, grazie, [player] - era
molto più forte di quanto pensassi\.\lTorniamo a casa del nonno e

raccontiamogli cosa è successo.

entries.original:
"I see\.\CC0820 this isn’t good.

At this point, there’s now only one
Legendary Pokémon left - [green]Zapdos[blue].

It’s imperative that it be rescued
before the Shadows can capture it."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1][control-code-2] this isn’t good. At this point, there’s now only one Legendary Pokémon left - [color-green-3]Zapdos[color-blue-4]. It’s imperative that it be rescued before the Shadows can capture it.
entries.translated:
Capisco\.\CC0820 non è una buona notizia. A
questo punto, è rimasto solo un\lPokémon leggendario - [green]Zapdos[blue]. È

fondamentale salvarlo prima che le
Ombre possano catturarlo.

entries.original:
"Zapdos\.

It lives in [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue], right?

I’ll head on out right away."
entries.translation_source: Zapdos[game-token-1] It lives in [color-green-2]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-3], right? I’ll head on out right away.
entries.translated:
Zapdos\. Vive in [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue],
giusto? Parto subito.

entries.original:
"Actually, Jax, I have a different
task for you.

To the best of my knowledge,
the Shadows still lack the object\lused to seal the dark force.

Friends of mine that live on [green]Route 9[blue]
should know of its location.

Go to them and explain the
situation.

I’m sure they’ll be willing to help
us find it before the Shadows do."
entries.translation_source: Actually, Jax, I have a different task for you. To the best of my knowledge, the Shadows still lack the object used to seal the dark force. Friends of mine that live on [color-green-1]Route 9[color-blue-2] should know of its location. Go to them and explain the situation. I’m sure they’ll be willing to help us find it before the Shadows do.
entries.translated:
In realtà, Jax, ho un compito
diverso per te. Per quanto ne so,\lgli Shadows non hanno ancora

l{B4}oggetto usato per sigillare la
forza oscura. Alcuni miei amici che\lvivono su [green]Percorso 9[blue] dovrebbero

conoscere la sua posizione. Vai da
loro e spiega la situazione. Sono\lsicuro che saranno disposti ad

aiutarci a trovarlo prima degli
Shadows.

entries.original: "You got it, Grampa."
entries.translation_source: You got it, Grampa.
entries.translated: Certo, nonno.

entries.original:
"Good, good.

In the meantime, [player] will be
the one who will head to\l[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue] and save [green]Zapdos[blue].

[player]\.\CC0818 you’ve proven yourself
by defending Jax back at Cinder\lVolcano, and I think you’re up to\lthe task.

You can head there by taking the
highway south-east from the next\ltown over, [green]Crater Town[blue].

You may need the Badge there in
order to travel to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue],\lso make sure that obtaining the\lBadge is your utmost priority."
entries.translation_source: Good, good. In the meantime, [player-name-1] will be the one who will head to [color-green-2]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-3] and save [color-green-4]Zapdos[color-blue-5]. [player-name-6][game-token-7][control-code-8] you’ve proven yourself by defending Jax back at Cinder Volcano, and I think you’re up to the task. You can head there by taking the highway south-east from the next town over, [color-green-9]Crater Town[color-blue-10]. You may need the Badge there in order to travel to [color-green-11]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-12], so make sure that obtaining the Badge is your utmost priority.
entries.translated:
Bene, bene. Nel frattempo, [player]
sarà colui che si dirigerà al [green]Monte\lTuono[blue] per salvare [green]Zapdos[blue]. [player]\.\CC0818

hai dimostrato il tuo valore
difendendo Jax al Vulcano Cenere e\lpenso che tu sia all{B4}altezza del

compito. Puoi arrivarci prendendo
l{B4}autostrada a sud-est dalla\lprossima città, [green]Città del Cratere[blue].

Potresti aver bisogno della
Medaglia di quella città per\lviaggiare verso il [green]Monte Tuono[blue],

quindi assicurati che ottenere la
Medaglia sia la tua massima\lpriorità.

entries.original:
"I’ll head back to Frozen Heights,
[player].

I’ll explain to your mother that
I’ve seen you off, and you’re on\lyour way to the next Gym Badge.

No sense in letting her worry,
after all."
entries.translation_source: I’ll head back to Frozen Heights, [player-name-1]. I’ll explain to your mother that I’ve seen you off, and you’re on your way to the next Gym Badge. No sense in letting her worry, after all.
entries.translated:
Tornerò a Frozen Heights, [player].
Spiegherò a tua madre che ti ho\lvisto ripartire e che sei in

viaggio verso la prossima Medaglia
Palestra. Non ha senso farla\lpreoccupare, dopotutto.

entries.original:
"My Staravia’s still tired from the
battle earlier, but I should still\lbe able to give you a lift back to\l[green]Cinder Volcano[blue].

Do you want me to do that?"
entries.translation_source: My Staravia’s still tired from the battle earlier, but I should still be able to give you a lift back to [color-green-1]Cinder Volcano[color-blue-2]. Do you want me to do that?
entries.translated:
La mia Staravia è ancora stanca per
la battaglia di prima, ma dovrei\lcomunque poterti dare un passaggio

di ritorno al [green]Cinder Volcano[blue]. Vuoi
che lo faccia?

entries.original: "Let’s head out right away."
entries.translation_source: Let’s head out right away.
entries.translated: Andiamocene subito.

entries.original:
"In that case, these Repels should
help you get back through Grim\lWoods and Cinder Volcano quicker."
entries.translation_source: In that case, these Repels should help you get back through Grim Woods and Cinder Volcano quicker.
entries.translated:
Allora questi Repellenti dovrebbero
aiutarti a tornare più in fretta\lattraverso Grim Woods e Cinder

Volcano.

entries.original:
"The asset has sent word.

The target is on the move."
entries.translation_source: The asset has sent word. The target is on the move.
entries.translated:
L{B4}asset ha inviato un messaggio. Il
bersaglio è in movimento.

entries.original:
"Alright, then.

Let’s move into position."
entries.translation_source: Alright, then. Let’s move into position.
entries.translated:
Va bene allora. Mettiamoci in
posizione.

entries.original:
"Quick!

Grab [buffer1] now!"
entries.translation_source: Quick! Grab [buffer1-1] now!
entries.translated: Presto! Prendi [buffer1] ora!

entries.original:
"Ah, right on schedule.

Tell me, [buffer1], what is your name?

\.

[player], was it?

At last, we finally meet.

I am Zeph, the man lurking in the
Shadows behind this organization."
entries.translation_source: Ah, right on schedule. Tell me, [buffer1-1], what is your name? [game-token-2] [player-name-3], was it? At last, we finally meet. I am Zeph, the man lurking in the Shadows behind this organization.
entries.translated:
Ah, giusto in orario. Dimmi,
[buffer1], qual è il tuo nome? \.\l[player], giusto? Finalmente ci

incontriamo. Io sono Zeph, l{B4}uomo
che si cela nelle Ombre dietro\lquesta organizzazione.

entries.original:
"I shall get to the point - I’ve
been informed that not only have\lyou trespassed in our laboratory,\lbut you’ve tried to interfere with\ltwo of our operations as well.

That, make no mistake,
is unacceptable.

However, it does beg the question,
of who exactly you’re working for\.

\.

You work for no one?
Nonsense.

Surely you can craft a more
plausible lie than that.

You’re not even trying."
entries.translation_source: I shall get to the point - I’ve been informed that not only have you trespassed in our laboratory, but you’ve tried to interfere with two of our operations as well. That, make no mistake, is unacceptable. However, it does beg the question, of who exactly you’re working for[game-token-1] [game-token-2] You work for no one? Nonsense. Surely you can craft a more plausible lie than that. You’re not even trying.
entries.translated:
Vengo subito al punto: mi è stato
riferito che non solo siete entrato\lnel nostro laboratorio, ma avete

anche cercato di interferire con
due delle nostre operazioni.\lQuesto, senza alcun dubbio, è

inaccettabile. Tuttavia, sorge
spontanea la domanda, per chi state\llavorando\. \. Lavorate per nessuno?

Sciocchezze. Sicuramente riuscite a
inventare una bugia più plausibile\ldi quella. Nemmeno ci state

provando.

entries.original:
"Very well, if you will not talk,
then Ivory here will have to give\lyou a little\.\CC0818 incentive."
entries.translation_source: Very well, if you will not talk, then Ivory here will have to give you a little[game-token-1][control-code-2] incentive.
entries.translated:
Molto bene, se non vuoi parlare,
allora Ivory qui dovrà darti un\lpiccolo\.\CC0818 incentivo.

entries.original:
"[red]So, you’re the Trainer Marlon seems
to have a score to settle with\.

Try not to struggle so much - it’ll
only hurt all the more."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]So, you’re the Trainer Marlon seems to have a score to settle with[game-token-2] Try not to struggle so much - it’ll only hurt all the more.
entries.translated:
[red]Quindi sei tu l{B4}Allenatore con cui
Marlon sembra avere un conto in\lsospeso\. Cerca di non resistere

troppo: finirai solo per soffrire
di più.

entries.original:
"Oh, Ivory\.

How are we supposed to scare [buffer1]
straight if you cannot even defeat\l[buffer1] in a simple battle?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, Ivory[game-token-1] How are we supposed to scare [buffer1-2] straight if you cannot even defeat [buffer1-3] in a simple battle?
entries.translated:
Oh, Ivory\. Come pensiamo di
rimettere [buffer1] in riga se non\lriesci nemmeno a sconfiggere

[buffer1] in un semplice
combattimento?

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph, I’m a scientist.

My best skills lie elsewhere."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Zeph, I’m a scientist. My best skills lie elsewhere.
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph, sono uno scienziato. Le mie
migliori capacità stanno altrove.

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0818 very well.

In the absence of anyone else,
Houndoom and I will personally\lshow you the meaning of pain."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1][control-code-2] very well. In the absence of anyone else, Houndoom and I will personally show you the meaning of pain.
entries.translated:
Uff\.\CC0818 molto bene. In assenza di
chiunque altro, io e Houndoom vi\lmostreremo di persona il

significato del dolore.

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph, I’m not sure Houndoom alone
will be enough to beat [buffer1]\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Zeph, I’m not sure Houndoom alone will be enough to beat [buffer1-2][game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph, non sono sicuro che Houndoom
da solo basti a sconfiggere\l[buffer1]\.

entries.original:
"You doubt me, Ivory?

Houndoom and I are more than
capable of finishing [buffer1] off."
entries.translation_source: You doubt me, Ivory? Houndoom and I are more than capable of finishing [buffer1-1] off.
entries.translated:
Dubiti di me, Ivory? Houndoom e io
siamo più che in grado di finire\l[buffer1].

entries.original:
"Now then, [player].

I’ve been quite patient with you,
but I’m afraid you’ve forced\lmy hand.

Time to suffer for your interference!"
entries.translation_source: Now then, [player-name-1]. I’ve been quite patient with you, but I’m afraid you’ve forced my hand. Time to suffer for your interference!
entries.translated:
Ebbene, [player]. Sono stato
piuttosto paziente con te, ma temo\lche mi hai costretto a reagire. È

ora di soffrire per la tua
intromissione!

entries.original:
"I’ve got to hand it to you.
You’re stronger than I anticipated.

I do like that about you, [buffer1].

That strength is something I wished
for my son, too\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve got to hand it to you. You’re stronger than I anticipated. I do like that about you, [buffer1-1]. That strength is something I wished for my son, too[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Devo riconoscertelo. Sei più forte
di quanto avessi previsto. È anche\lquesto che mi piace di te,

[buffer1]. Quella forza è qualcosa
che avrei voluto anche per mio\lfiglio\.

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph! Marlon has just sent word.

He’s finished with his investigation
of the green-hatted boy.

You’ll want to hear this."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Zeph! Marlon has just sent word. He’s finished with his investigation of the green-hatted boy. You’ll want to hear this.
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph! Marlon ha appena mandato un
messaggio. Ha finito di indagare\lsul ragazzo col cappello verde.

Vuoi assolutamente sentire questo.

entries.original:
"Yes, what is it?

\.

I see\."
entries.translation_source: Yes, what is it? [game-token-1] I see[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Sì, cos{B4}è? \. Capisco\.

entries.original:
"I’m afraid, [player], that you’ve now
lost your leverage.

I’m told there was a boy with you
when you happened upon our last\loperation.

We have successfully identified him
as the grandson of a well-known\lhistorian named Arthur.

Was he involved in your appearance
there?

\.

Your reaction speaks volumes.
It was indeed his doing.

That old fool\.\CC0818 how long must he
interfere with us\.?"
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid, [player-name-1], that you’ve now lost your leverage. I’m told there was a boy with you when you happened upon our last operation. We have successfully identified him as the grandson of a well-known historian named Arthur. Was he involved in your appearance there? [game-token-2] Your reaction speaks volumes. It was indeed his doing. That old fool[game-token-3][control-code-4] how long must he interfere with us[game-token-5]?
entries.translated:
Temo, [player], che tu abbia ormai
perso il tuo vantaggio. Mi è stato\ldetto che c{B4}era un ragazzo con te

quando vi siete imbattuti nella
nostra ultima operazione. Siamo\lriusciti a identificarlo come il

nipote di un noto storico di nome
Arthur. Era coinvolto nella tua\lcomparsa lì? \. La tua reazione parla

da sé. È stato davvero opera sua.
Quel vecchio sciocco\.\CC0818 per quanto\lancora dovrà immischiarsi nei

nostri affari\.?

entries.original:
"[red]Sir!

A monster just appeared out of thin
air in the basement chamber!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Sir! A monster just appeared out of thin air in the basement chamber!
entries.translated:
[red]Signore! Un mostro è appena apparso
dal nulla nella camera del\lseminterrato!

entries.original:
"All grunts get down there NOW!

Stop whatever that monster is and
protect the Shadow Warriors!"
entries.translation_source: All grunts get down there NOW! Stop whatever that monster is and protect the Shadow Warriors!
entries.translated:
Tutte le reclute laggiù, ORA!
Fermate qualunque cosa sia quel\lmostro e proteggete i Guerrieri

Ombra!

entries.original:
"Ivory, we’ll heal our Pokémon and
join the containment efforts.

We cannot afford to lose even
a single Shadow Warrior right now.

If any are destroyed and Fey
finds out\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory, we’ll heal our Pokémon and join the containment efforts. We cannot afford to lose even a single Shadow Warrior right now. If any are destroyed and Fey finds out[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ivory, cureremo i nostri Pokémon e
ci uniremo agli sforzi di\lcontenimento. Non possiamo

permetterci di perdere nemmeno un
singolo Guerriero Ombra in questo\lmomento. Se ne viene distrutto

anche solo uno e Fey lo scopre\.

entries.original:
"[red]I understand, Zeph.

But what should we do about
the [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I understand, Zeph. But what should we do about the [buffer1-2]?
entries.translated:
[red]Capisco, Zeph. Ma che cosa dovremmo
fare del [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Let [buffer1] go, for now.

As long as their public appearances
remain scarce, there is no reason\lfor Fey and Arthur to ever speak\lwith one another.

There is little chance he would ever
tell her."
entries.translation_source: Let [buffer1-1] go, for now. As long as their public appearances remain scarce, there is no reason for Fey and Arthur to ever speak with one another. There is little chance he would ever tell her.
entries.translated:
Lascia andare [buffer1], per ora.
Finché le loro apparizioni\lpubbliche restano rare, non c{B4}è

motivo che Fey e Arthur si parlino
mai. È molto improbabile che lui\lglielo dica mai.

entries.original:
"[player]\.\CC0818 I suspect you have
no intention of obeying, but I will\lonly warn you once.

Keep out of our business, or you
may find things will escalate\lbeyond your control\.

So for your sake, I hope we don’t
need to meet again, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1][game-token-2][control-code-3] I suspect you have no intention of obeying, but I will only warn you once. Keep out of our business, or you may find things will escalate beyond your control[game-token-4] So for your sake, I hope we don’t need to meet again, [buffer1-5].
entries.translated:
[player]\.\CC0818 Sospetto che tu non abbia
alcuna intenzione di obbedire, ma\lti avverto una sola volta. Stai

fuori dai nostri affari, o potresti
scoprire che la situazione\ldegenererà oltre il tuo controllo\.

Per il tuo bene, spero che non ci
sia bisogno di rivederci, [buffer1].

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0830 pa\.\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo[game-token-2][control-code-3] pa[game-token-4][control-code-5]
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0830 pa\.\CC0830

entries.original:
"Hoooo weeee!

If that ain’t the darndest thing
I ever did see - a [buffer1] coming\loutta some magic portal!

Where’d ya come from, [buffer1]?

\.

What’s that?

Ya were tryin’ to get to
Thundercap Mt. when all of a\lsudden ya were kidnapped?

Hoooo weeee!
That sure sounds scary, [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: Hoooo weeee! If that ain’t the darndest thing I ever did see - a [buffer1-1] coming outta some magic portal! Where’d ya come from, [buffer1-2]? [game-token-3] What’s that? Ya were tryin’ to get to Thundercap Mt. when all of a sudden ya were kidnapped? Hoooo weeee! That sure sounds scary, [buffer1-4].
entries.translated:
Hoooo weeee! Se non è la cosa più
strana che abbia mai visto - un\l[buffer1] che esce da un portale

magico! Da dove vieni, [buffer1]? \.
Come? Stavi cercando di raggiungere\lThundercap Mt. quando

all{B4}improvviso sei stato rapito?
Hoooo weeee! Sembra davvero\lspaventoso, [buffer1].

entries.original:

we’ve completed our operation.

There’s no way you’re getting in."
entries.translation_source: Good luck with that. This barrier isn’t going down until we’ve completed our operation. There’s no way you’re getting in.
entries.translated:
Buona fortuna con quello. Questa
barriera non cadrà finché non\lavremo completato la nostra

operazione. Non entrerai mai.

entries.original:
"ARGH!

Come on, Staraptor. There has to
be another way onto the route.

Maybe there’s a secret [green]underground
passage[blue] in town\.

Let’s go look around."
entries.translation_source: ARGH! Come on, Staraptor. There has to be another way onto the route. Maybe there’s a secret [color-green-1]underground passage[color-blue-2] in town[game-token-3] Let’s go look around.
entries.translated:
ARGH! Forza, Staraptor. Deve
esserci un altro modo per arrivare\lalla route. Forse in città c{B4}è un

[green]passaggio sotterraneo[blue] segreto\.

entries.original:
"[player]!

So you found the hidden passage
too, I see.

But it looks like we’ll have a ton
of Shadows to fight through just to\lget to my grampa’s friend.

Actually, why don’t we team up?
We could move quicker that way."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! So you found the hidden passage too, I see. But it looks like we’ll have a ton of Shadows to fight through just to get to my grampa’s friend. Actually, why don’t we team up? We could move quicker that way.
entries.translated:
[player]! Quindi hai trovato anche
tu il passaggio segreto, vedo. Però\lsembra che dovremo affrontare un

sacco di Ombre per arrivare
all{B4}amico di mio nonno. In realtà,\lperché non uniamo le forze? In

questo modo potremmo muoverci più
in fretta.

entries.original:
"What?\CC0818 Are\.\CC0818 are you sure you can
make it on your own?

But I\.\CC0818 Sigh\. I understand,
[player].

If you’ve got other things to take
care of first, I’ll look for my\lgrampa’s friend on my own."
entries.translation_source: What?[control-code-1] Are[game-token-2][control-code-3] are you sure you can make it on your own? But I[game-token-4][control-code-5] Sigh[game-token-6] I understand, [player-name-7]. If you’ve got other things to take care of first, I’ll look for my grampa’s friend on my own.
entries.translated:
Cosa?\CC0818 Sei\.\CC0818 sicuro di potercela fare
da solo? Ma io\.\CC0818 Sigh\. Capisco,\l[player]. Se hai altre cose a cui

pensare prima, cercherò da solo
l{B4}amico di mio nonno.

entries.original:
"Great!

The route’s pretty big, so it looks
like a two-Trainer job.

Why don’t you take the lead?

I’ll support your Pokémon and keep
them healed.

Let’s do this thing, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Great! The route’s pretty big, so it looks like a two-Trainer job. Why don’t you take the lead? I’ll support your Pokémon and keep them healed. Let’s do this thing, [player-name-1]!
entries.translated:
Grande! Il percorso è piuttosto
grande, quindi sembra proprio un\llavoro da due Allenatori. Perché

non prendi tu il comando? Io
supporterò i tuoi Pokémon e li\lterrò in salute. Diamoci dentro,

[player]!

entries.original:
"Let’s find my grampa’s friend,
[player]!

Before the Shadows do something
unspeakable\."
entries.translation_source: Let’s find my grampa’s friend, [player-name-1]! Before the Shadows do something unspeakable[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Troviamo l{B4}amico del mio nonno,
[player]! Prima che le Ombre\lfacciano qualcosa di indicibile\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
Where are you going?

We don’t have time to leave
Route 9.

Unless, you’re saying you no longer
want to team up with me?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Where are you going? We don’t have time to leave Route 9. Unless, you’re saying you no longer want to team up with me?
entries.translated:
[player]! Dove stai andando? Non
abbiamo tempo di lasciare Percorso\l9. A meno che tu non stia dicendo

che non vuoi più fare squadra con
me?

entries.original:
"Looks like the path to the house is
on our right, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Looks like the path to the house is on our right, [player-name-1].
entries.translated:
Sembra che il sentiero per la casa
sia sulla nostra destra, [player].

entries.original:
"Let’s hurry that way before it’s
too late!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s hurry that way before it’s too late!
entries.translated:
Sbrighiamoci da quella parte prima
che sia troppo tardi!

entries.original:
"[blue]It looks like we made it.
I’ll go on ahead.

Follow me inside quickly!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]It looks like we made it. I’ll go on ahead. Follow me inside quickly!
entries.translated:
[blue]Sembra che ce l{B4}abbiamo fatta.
Andrò avanti. Seguimi dentro in\lfretta!

entries.original: "Dr. Harth"
entries.translation_source: Dr. Harth
entries.translated: Dott. Harth

entries.original:
"[blue]You think I’m gonna let you walk out
of here!?

You stole the Prison Stone\.
the very thing needed to seal\land unseal the dark force!

You couldn’t possibly want it for
anything, except evil!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]You think I’m gonna let you walk out of here!? You stole the Prison Stone[game-token-2] the very thing needed to seal and unseal the dark force! You couldn’t possibly want it for anything, except evil!
entries.translated:
[blue]Pensi davvero che ti lascerò uscire
di qui!? Hai rubato la Pietra della\lPrigione\. la cosa stessa necessaria

per sigillare e dissigillare la
forza oscura! Non potresti volerla\lper nient{B4}altro che per il male!

entries.original:
"I’m afraid, as always, you are quite
mistaken, boy.

But I’ll humor you for a moment\.

What, exactly, do you think we
have planned?

Based on what you’ve seen of us?
Please, enlighten me."
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid, as always, you are quite mistaken, boy. But I’ll humor you for a moment[game-token-1] What, exactly, do you think we have planned? Based on what you’ve seen of us? Please, enlighten me.
entries.translated:
Temo che, come sempre, tu sia
completamente in errore, ragazzo.\lMa ti assecondo per un momento\.

Cosa, esattamente, pensi che
abbiamo in mente? In base a quello\lche hai visto di noi? Dai,

illuminami.

entries.original:
"[blue]What else?

Capturing the Legendary bird
Pokémon\.\CC0818 stealing the Prison Stone\.

You intend to plunge Borrius into war
and darkness!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What else? Capturing the Legendary bird Pokémon[game-token-2][control-code-3] stealing the Prison Stone[game-token-4] You intend to plunge Borrius into war and darkness!
entries.translated:
[blue]Cos{B4}altro? Catturare il Pokémon
uccello leggendario\.\CC0818 rubare la\lPietra della Prigione\. Intendi

gettare Borrius nella guerra e
nell{B4}oscurità!

entries.original:
"[red]Interesting.

Then I ask you: why would we ever
do that?

Send our own region into chaos?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Interesting. Then I ask you: why would we ever do that? Send our own region into chaos?
entries.translated:
[red]Interessante. Allora ti chiedo:
perché dovremmo mai farlo? Gettare\lla nostra stessa regione nel caos?

entries.original:
"[blue]What?

Well\.\CC0820 rule the world?

The dark force is an incredible
power, and\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What? Well[game-token-2][control-code-3] rule the world? The dark force is an incredible power, and[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[blue]Cosa? Beh\.\CC0820 governare il mondo? La
forza oscura è un potere\lincredibile, e\.

entries.original:
"[red]I knew it. You can only think of
simple, immature motives.

You think that the \qoforce we intend
to release\qc is only for destruction.

In fact, our intent is to save.

Save something that we unjustly lost,
and would sacrifice much to regain\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I knew it. You can only think of simple, immature motives. You think that the [quote-open-2]force we intend to release[quote-close-3] is only for destruction. In fact, our intent is to save. Save something that we unjustly lost, and would sacrifice much to regain[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[red]Lo sapevo. Riesci a pensare solo a
motivazioni semplici e immature.\lPensi che la \qoforza che intendiamo

liberare\qc serva solo a distruggere.
In realtà, il nostro intento è\lsalvare. Salvare qualcosa che

abbiamo ingiustamente perso, e
saremmo disposti a sacrificare\lmolto per riaverlo\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh? What are you talking about?

I don’t get what you’re saying
at all!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Huh? What are you talking about? I don’t get what you’re saying at all!
entries.translated:
[blue]Eh? Di cosa stai parlando? Non
capisco affatto quello che dici!

entries.original:
"[red]I won’t waste any more time
explaining.

That time can be better spent making
sure you\.\CC0820 and your friend waiting\lby the door are dealt with."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I won’t waste any more time explaining. That time can be better spent making sure you[game-token-2][control-code-3] and your friend waiting by the door are dealt with.
entries.translated:
[red]Non perderò altro tempo a spiegare.
Quel tempo è meglio impiegarlo per\lassicurarmi che te\.\CC0820 e il tuo amico

che aspetta vicino alla porta
veniate sistemati.

entries.original:
"[blue][player]! You’re right on time!

The Shadows have the Prison Stone,
the object needed to release the\ldark force!

You gotta help me get that thing
back!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][player-name-2]! You’re right on time! The Shadows have the Prison Stone, the object needed to release the dark force! You gotta help me get that thing back!
entries.translated:
[blue][player]! Sei proprio in tempo! Le
Ombre hanno la Pietra della\lPrigione, l{B4}oggetto necessario per

liberare la forza oscura! Devi
aiutarmi a riprendere quella cosa!

entries.original:
"I should have known they wouldn’t
go quietly.

You, grunt, assist me."
entries.translation_source: I should have known they wouldn’t go quietly. You, grunt, assist me.
entries.translated:
Avrei dovuto sapere che non
sarebbero andati via in silenzio.\lTu, recluta, aiutami.

entries.original:
"Scientists, prepare the backup plan
in case we’re defeated."
entries.translation_source: Scientists, prepare the backup plan in case we’re defeated.
entries.translated:
Scienziati, preparate il piano di
riserva nel caso venissimo\lsconfitti.

entries.original:
"Right away.

We’ll activate the mobile creation
pods."
entries.translation_source: Right away. We’ll activate the mobile creation pods.
entries.translated:
Subito. Attiveremo le capsule
mobili di creazione.

entries.original:
"Please don’t take this personally,
but I’ll have to escort both of\lyou out\.\CC0818 the hard way."
entries.translation_source: Please don’t take this personally, but I’ll have to escort both of you out[game-token-1][control-code-2] the hard way.
entries.translated:
Ti prego, non prenderla sul
personale, ma dovrò accompagnarvi\lentrambi fuori\.\CC0818 a modo mio.

entries.original:
"[blue]How’s that!

As long as I’ve got my Pokémon,
I’m unstoppable!

No\.\CC0818 we’re unstoppable!

Now, hand over the Prison Stone!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]How’s that! As long as I’ve got my Pokémon, I’m unstoppable! No[game-token-2][control-code-3] we’re unstoppable! Now, hand over the Prison Stone!
entries.translated:
[blue]Che ne dici! Finché ho i miei
Pokémon, sono inarrestabile! No\.\CC0818\lsiamo inarrestabili! Ora,

consegnami la Pietra Prigione!

entries.original:
"Hmph\.

Funny thing to say, considering your
friend did most of the work\."
entries.translation_source: Hmph[game-token-1] Funny thing to say, considering your friend did most of the work[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Tsk\. Strano da dire, considerando
che il tuo amico ha fatto la\lmaggior parte del lavoro\.

entries.original: "[blue]W-what did you say!?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]W-what did you say!?
entries.translated: [blue]C-cosa hai detto!?

entries.original:
"No matter the numbers, we’re not
beaten yet\.\CC0818 assuming they’re ready.

And they should be functional by
now, I hope?"
entries.translation_source: No matter the numbers, we’re not beaten yet[game-token-1][control-code-2] assuming they’re ready. And they should be functional by now, I hope?
entries.translated:
A prescindere dai numeri, non siamo
ancora sconfitti\.\CC0818 ammesso che siano\lpronti. E dovrebbero essere già

funzionanti ormai, spero?

entries.original:
"Yes, ma’am.

They are not as powerful as the ones
we can synthesize in the lab\.

However, they should serve well
enough as a distraction."
entries.translation_source: Yes, ma’am. They are not as powerful as the ones we can synthesize in the lab[game-token-1] However, they should serve well enough as a distraction.
entries.translated:
Sì, signora. Non sono potenti
quanto quelli che possiamo\lsintetizzare in laboratorio\.

Tuttavia, dovrebbero bastare come
diversivo.

entries.original:
"[blue]What\.\CC0820 are those things?

Don’t tell me\.\CC0820 that’s the
old couple!?

What did you do to them!?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What[game-token-2][control-code-3] are those things? Don’t tell me[game-token-4][control-code-5] that’s the old couple!? What did you do to them!?
entries.translated:
[blue]Che\.\CC0820 cosa sono quelle cose? Non
dirmi\.\CC0820 che sono la vecchia coppia!?\lChe cosa gli avete fatto!?

entries.original:
"They’ve been optimized, into
something more fit for our purpose.

And right now, their purpose\.\CC0818 is to
hold you off, as we retreat."
entries.translation_source: They’ve been optimized, into something more fit for our purpose. And right now, their purpose[game-token-1][control-code-2] is to hold you off, as we retreat.
entries.translated:
Sono stati ottimizzati, trasformati
in qualcosa di più adatto al nostro\lscopo. E in questo momento, il loro

scopo\.\CC0818 è trattenerti, mentre ci
ritiriamo.

entries.original:
"Dangit\.\CC0818 I don’t wanna let them
get away, but we have to help\lthose poor people!

Maybe we’re not too late!

If we can beat them quickly enough,
hopefully they’ll go back to the\lway they were!"
entries.translation_source: Dangit[game-token-1][control-code-2] I don’t wanna let them get away, but we have to help those poor people! Maybe we’re not too late! If we can beat them quickly enough, hopefully they’ll go back to the way they were!
entries.translated:
Accidenti\.\CC0818 Non voglio lasciarli
scappare, ma dobbiamo aiutare\lquelle povere persone! Forse non è

troppo tardi! Se riusciamo a
batterli abbastanza in fretta,\lsperiamo che tornino come prima!

entries.original: "[red]Shadow Warriors, attack!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Shadow Warriors, attack!
entries.translated: [red]Guerrieri dell{B4}Ombra, attaccate!

entries.original:
"Ohh\.

What did I\.\CC0820 what was I doing\.?"
entries.translation_source: Ohh[game-token-1] What did I[game-token-2][control-code-3] what was I doing[game-token-4]?
entries.translated: Ohh\. Cosa stavo\.\CC0820 cosa stavo facendo\.?

entries.original:
"We did it!
They’re okay!"
entries.translation_source: We did it! They’re okay!
entries.translated: Ce l{B4}abbiamo fatta! Stanno bene!

entries.original:
"Oh! Thank you, Jax\.\CC0820 and my thanks
to you too\.\CC0820 [player], was it?

Any longer, and our will would have
been overwritten entirely."
entries.translation_source: Oh! Thank you, Jax[game-token-1][control-code-2] and my thanks to you too[game-token-3][control-code-4] [player-name-5], was it? Any longer, and our will would have been overwritten entirely.
entries.translated:
Oh! Grazie, Jax\.\CC0820 e grazie anche a te\.\CC0820
[player], giusto? Ancora un po{B4}, e\lla nostra volontà sarebbe stata

riscritta completamente.

entries.original:
"What matters is that you’re
safe now."
entries.translation_source: What matters is that you’re safe now.
entries.translated:
L{B4}importante è che ora sei al
sicuro.

entries.original:
"But dangit\.\CC0820 they got away with the
Prison Stone\."
entries.translation_source: But dangit[game-token-1][control-code-2] they got away with the Prison Stone[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ma accidenti\.\CC0820 sono fuggiti con la
Pietra della Prigione\.

entries.original:
"So they managed to escape with it\.

Jax, you must give chase!

If they break the stone and use
the bottle inside, then the results\lcould be catastrophic!"
entries.translation_source: So they managed to escape with it[game-token-1] Jax, you must give chase! If they break the stone and use the bottle inside, then the results could be catastrophic!
entries.translated:
Quindi sono riusciti a fuggire con
essa\. Jax, devi inseguirli! Se\ldovessero rompere la pietra e usare

la bottiglia al suo interno, le
conseguenze potrebbero essere\lcatastrofiche!

entries.original:
"I know\.\CC0818 do you know where they
could be headed, Dr. Harth?"
entries.translation_source: I know[game-token-1][control-code-2] do you know where they could be headed, Dr. Harth?
entries.translated:
Lo so\.\CC0818 Sai dove potrebbero essere
diretti, dottor Harth?

entries.original:
"If they intend to release the seal
on the stone, they will be heading\lfor the [green]Ruins of Void[blue].

Only there can the bottle within
be obtained."
entries.translation_source: If they intend to release the seal on the stone, they will be heading for the [color-green-1]Ruins of Void[color-blue-2]. Only there can the bottle within be obtained.
entries.translated:
Se intendono spezzare il sigillo
sulla pietra, si dirigeranno verso\lle [green]Rovine del Vuoto[blue]. Solo lì si può

ottenere la bottiglia al suo
interno.

entries.original:
"The [green]Ruins of Void[blue], he said\.

[player], I’m heading back to brief
Grampa on what’s happened.

While I’m doing that, you should
head to [green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]

As long as the Shadows don’t have
Zapdos, there’s still a chance to\lstop them!

Oh yeah\.\CC0818 since you need the HM
move [green]Strength[blue] to navigate the\lmountain path\.

You should probably head back to
[green]Fallshore City[blue], and get the Gym\lBadge there.

I think I last saw the Gym Leader,
back in [green]Tehl Town[blue], actually\.

Once you’ve done that and rescued
[green]Zapdos[blue], I’ll meet up with you in\l[green]Epidimy Town[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Ruins of Void[color-blue-2], he said[game-token-3] [player-name-4], I’m heading back to brief Grampa on what’s happened. While I’m doing that, you should head to [color-green-5]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-6] As long as the Shadows don’t have Zapdos, there’s still a chance to stop them! Oh yeah[game-token-7][control-code-8] since you need the HM move [color-green-9]Strength[color-blue-10] to navigate the mountain path[game-token-11] You should probably head back to [color-green-12]Fallshore City[color-blue-13], and get the Gym Badge there. I think I last saw the Gym Leader, back in [color-green-14]Tehl Town[color-blue-15], actually[game-token-16] Once you’ve done that and rescued [color-green-17]Zapdos[color-blue-18], I’ll meet up with you in [color-green-19]Epidimy Town[color-blue-20].
entries.translated:
Le [green]Rovine del Vuoto[blue], ha detto\.
[player], torno a fare rapporto al\lnonno su quanto accaduto. Mentre lo

faccio, dovresti dirigerti al [green]Monte
Tuono[blue]. Finché le Ombre non hanno\lZapdos, c{B4}è ancora una possibilità

di fermarle! Oh, giusto\.\CC0818 dato che ti
serve la MN [green]Forza[blue] per navigare sul\lsentiero di montagna\. Dovresti

probabilmente tornare a [green]Borgo
Foglia[blue] e ottenere la Medaglia della\lPalestra lì. Credo di aver visto

l{B4}ultimo Capopalestra a [green]Città di
Tehl[blue], in realtà\. Una volta fatto ciò\le salvato [green]Zapdos[blue], ti incontrerò a

[green]Città di Epidimy[blue].

entries.original:
"Phew\.\CC0820 nothin’ beats gettin’ away
from the city life and comin’ back\lto Mother Nature.

I mean, how else are ya gonna get
a great natural tan like mine, huh?

Good looks are things ya gotta put
in effort to keep up, after all.

Beauty is the most important virtue,
ammirite?"
entries.translation_source: Phew[game-token-1][control-code-2] nothin’ beats gettin’ away from the city life and comin’ back to Mother Nature. I mean, how else are ya gonna get a great natural tan like mine, huh? Good looks are things ya gotta put in effort to keep up, after all. Beauty is the most important virtue, ammirite?
entries.translated:
Uff\.\CC0820 non c{B4}è niente di meglio che
allontanarsi dalla vita cittadina e\ltornare da Madre Natura. Voglio

dire, altrimenti come fai a
ottenere un{B4}abbronzatura naturale\lfantastica come la mia, eh? Il

bell{B4}aspetto è una cosa per cui
bisogna impegnarsi per mantenerlo,\ldopotutto. La bellezza è la virtù

più importante, vero?

entries.original:
"Right. Ya know what’s important
in life. I like that."
entries.translation_source: Right. Ya know what’s important in life. I like that.
entries.translated:
Giusto. Sai cosa conta nella vita.
Mi piace.

entries.original:
"Partner, ya dunno what yer missin’,
then."
entries.translation_source: Partner, ya dunno what yer missin’, then.
entries.translated:
Partner, allora non sai cosa ti
perdi.

entries.original:
"This place is perfect for my
routine.

Whenever I head back to the Gym,
the mist from the waterfalls\lcomplements my well-toned bod.

Wanna feel? All natural pecs,
right here."
entries.translation_source: This place is perfect for my routine. Whenever I head back to the Gym, the mist from the waterfalls complements my well-toned bod. Wanna feel? All natural pecs, right here.
entries.translated:
Questo posto è perfetto per la mia
routine. Ogni volta che torno alla\lPalestra, la nebbia delle cascate

si abbina perfettamente al mio
fisico scolpito. Vuoi toccarlo?\lPettorali naturali al 100%, proprio

qui.

entries.original:
"Oh, sorry, name’s Mel, the
[green]Fallshore City[blue] Gym Leader.

Sorry I wasn’t in when ya came
knockin’, but, well\.\CC0818 my workout\lwaits for no one.

It’s a lotta pressure, but the gals
back at the Gym don’t seem to\lmind\.

Anyway, I’m just about done for
the day, so if ya wanna battle,\lI got time for it.

See ya soon, partner."
entries.translation_source: Oh, sorry, name’s Mel, the [color-green-1]Fallshore City[color-blue-2] Gym Leader. Sorry I wasn’t in when ya came knockin’, but, well[game-token-3][control-code-4] my workout waits for no one. It’s a lotta pressure, but the gals back at the Gym don’t seem to mind[game-token-5] Anyway, I’m just about done for the day, so if ya wanna battle, I got time for it. See ya soon, partner.
entries.translated:
Oh, scusa, mi chiamo Mel, la
[green]Capopalestra di Fallshore City[blue].\lScusa se non c{B4}ero quando sei

venuto a bussare, ma, beh\.\CC0818 il mio
allenamento non aspetta nessuno. È\ltanta pressione, ma le ragazze in

Palestra non sembrano farci caso\.
Comunque, ho quasi finito per oggi,\lquindi se vuoi combattere, ho un

po{B4} di tempo. A presto, amico.

entries.original:
"Just wanna quick word with ya,
before ya hightail it."
entries.translation_source: Just wanna quick word with ya, before ya hightail it.
entries.translated:
Voglio dirti due parole, prima che
tu te la dia a gambe.

entries.original:
"Right ’fore ya arrived, I’d been
hearin’ some hubbub about some\lrascals stoppin’ the townsfolk\lin [green]Epidimy[blue] from explorin’ ol’\l[green]Thundercap Mt.[blue]

Now, I was thinkin’ ’bout layin’ down
the law on them outlaws.

’Cos not only do I look good,
I do good, too.

And I do it while lookin’ good!

Anyway, one of ’em said they were
guardin’ the mountain to keep\lya out.

Mentioned yer name an’ everythin’.

Now, I don’t rightly know what
kinda hullabaloo yer mixed up in,\lbut I’m gonna help ya fix it.

So, take this and get yer heinie to
Epidimy faster."
entries.translation_source: Right ’fore ya arrived, I’d been hearin’ some hubbub about some rascals stoppin’ the townsfolk in [color-green-1]Epidimy[color-blue-2] from explorin’ ol’ [color-green-3]Thundercap Mt.[color-blue-4] Now, I was thinkin’ ’bout layin’ down the law on them outlaws. ’Cos not only do I look good, I do good, too. And I do it while lookin’ good! Anyway, one of ’em said they were guardin’ the mountain to keep ya out. Mentioned yer name an’ everythin’. Now, I don’t rightly know what kinda hullabaloo yer mixed up in, but I’m gonna help ya fix it. So, take this and get yer heinie to Epidimy faster.
entries.translated:
Proprio prima che arrivassi, avevo
sentito un po{B4} di trambusto su\lalcuni mascalzoni che impedivano

agli abitanti di [green]Epidimy[blue] di
esplorare il vecchio [green]Monte\lThundercap[blue]. Ora, stavo pensando di

fare giustizia su quei fuorilegge.
Perché non solo ho un bell{B4}aspetto,\lma faccio anche del bene. E lo

faccio mentre ho un bell{B4}aspetto!
Comunque, uno di loro ha detto che\lstavano sorvegliando la montagna

per tenerti fuori. Hanno menzionato
il tuo nome e tutto il resto. Ora,\lnon so bene che tipo di baraonda tu

sia coinvolto, ma ti aiuterò a
sistemarla. Quindi, prendi questo e\lporta il tuo sedere a Epidimy più

velocemente.

entries.original:
"[blue]Just like the other HM’s, if ya
got a Pokémon that can learn it,\lit can use it.

Just choose a Pokémon that can
learn it, and as long as it ain’t\lgot four HM moves learned already,\lthat nifty doodad can take ya\lanywhere ya been before.

Anyway, don’t keep me waitin’ too
long, partner.

Ya don’t wanna miss my fine an’
dandy work!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Just like the other HM’s, if ya got a Pokémon that can learn it, it can use it. Just choose a Pokémon that can learn it, and as long as it ain’t got four HM moves learned already, that nifty doodad can take ya anywhere ya been before. Anyway, don’t keep me waitin’ too long, partner. Ya don’t wanna miss my fine an’ dandy work!
entries.translated:
[blue]Proprio come le altre MN, se hai un
Pokémon che la può imparare, può\lusarla. Basta scegliere un Pokémon

che la possa imparare e, finché non
ha già imparato quattro mosse MN,\lquel simpatico aggeggio può

portarti in tutti i posti in cui
sei già stato. Comunque, non farmi\laspettare troppo, amico. Non vorrai

perderti il mio bel lavoro, no?

entries.original:
"This is your final warning, rascal.
Move or be moved."
entries.translation_source: This is your final warning, rascal. Move or be moved.
entries.translated:
Questo è il tuo ultimo
avvertimento, canaglia. Muoviti o\lti farò muovere.

entries.original:
"I refuse to abandon my post.

I must prevent [player] from entering
Thundercap Mt. at all cost."
entries.translation_source: I refuse to abandon my post. I must prevent [player-name-1] from entering Thundercap Mt. at all cost.
entries.translated:
Rifiuto di abbandonare il mio
posto. Devo impedire a [player] di\lentrare in Thundercap Mt. a ogni

costo.

entries.original: "[buffer1], hit ’em with a [buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1], hit ’em with a [buffer2-2]!
entries.translated: [buffer1], colpiscili con [buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Now, I don’t wanna hurt ya,
but I got a deep-tissue massage\llater today\.

And if I’m late ’cos yer holdin’ me
up, well, there’s gonna be trouble."
entries.translation_source: Now, I don’t wanna hurt ya, but I got a deep-tissue massage later today[game-token-1] And if I’m late ’cos yer holdin’ me up, well, there’s gonna be trouble.
entries.translated:
Ora, non voglio farti male, ma più
tardi oggi ho un massaggio dei\ltessuti profondi\. E se faccio tardi

perché mi stai trattenendo, be{B4}, ci
saranno guai.

entries.original:
"Urgh\.\CC0820 so why’d you\.\CC0820 hit me first,
then\.?"
entries.translation_source: Urgh[game-token-1][control-code-2] so why’d you[game-token-3][control-code-4] hit me first, then[game-token-5]?
entries.translated:
Ugh\.\CC0820 allora perché hai\.\CC0820 colpito prima
me, allora\.?

entries.original:
"Awright, I reckon ya got this from
here, partner.

As for me, I gotta run.

Whatever these rascals are up to,
they don’ want ya interferin’.

Go wild in there fer me, okay?"
entries.translation_source: Awright, I reckon ya got this from here, partner. As for me, I gotta run. Whatever these rascals are up to, they don’ want ya interferin’. Go wild in there fer me, okay?
entries.translated:
Beh, credo che da qui in poi te la
cavi da solo, partner. Per quanto\lmi riguarda, devo scappare.

Qualunque cosa stiano combinando
quei mascalzoni, non vogliono che\lti impicci. Fai pure il matto

laggiù anche per me, va bene?

entries.original:
"Owww\.
My head\."
entries.translation_source: Owww[game-token-1] My head[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Ahi\. La mia testa\.

entries.original: "STOP!"
entries.translation_source: STOP!
entries.translated: FERMO!

entries.original:
"I can’t let you through!

\.

That look\.\CC0818 do you seriously not
remember me?

I’m the grunt you and your friend
disgraced back at our base!

I’ve gotten stronger since then,
so it’s time for a little payback!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t let you through! [game-token-1] That look[game-token-2][control-code-3] do you seriously not remember me? I’m the grunt you and your friend disgraced back at our base! I’ve gotten stronger since then, so it’s time for a little payback!
entries.translated:
Non posso lasciarti passare! \.
Quello sguardo\.\CC0818 davvero non ti\lricordi di me? Sono la recluta che

tu e il tuo amico avete umiliato
alla nostra base! Da allora sono\ldiventato più forte, quindi è ora

di una piccola vendetta!

entries.original:
"You’ve really done it now!

This was my last chance to get back
in good standing with the higher-\lups, and you ruined it!

I’ll never forget this!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve really done it now! This was my last chance to get back in good standing with the higher- ups, and you ruined it! I’ll never forget this!
entries.translated:
Adesso hai davvero esagerato!
Questa era la mia ultima\lpossibilità di riconquistare il

favore dei superiori, e tu l{B4}hai
rovinata! Non me lo dimenticherò\lmai!

entries.original:
"[red]Uh oh!

[player]’s hot on our tails!

I’d better go warn Marlon!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Uh oh! [player-name-2]’s hot on our tails! I’d better go warn Marlon!
entries.translated:
[red]Oh no! [player] è alle nostre
calcagna! Meglio andare ad\lavvertire Marlon!

entries.original:
"I have the key to free
the Pokémon!

But you’re not getting it!"
entries.translation_source: I have the key to free the Pokémon! But you’re not getting it!
entries.translated:
Ho la chiave per liberare i
Pokémon! Ma non la avrai mai!

entries.original: "Okay, maybe you ARE getting it\."
entries.translation_source: Okay, maybe you ARE getting it[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Va bene, forse stai DAVVERO capendo\.

entries.original:
"The other grunts are gonna be
peeved\."
entries.translation_source: The other grunts are gonna be peeved[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Gli altri scagnozzi si infurieranno\.

entries.original:
"[black]There appear to be some Pokémon
sealed behind an electric barrier."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]There appear to be some Pokémon sealed behind an electric barrier.
entries.translated:
[black]Sembra che ci siano dei Pokémon
sigillati dietro una barriera\lelettrica.

entries.original:
"[black]There appear to be some Pokémon
sealed behind an electric barrier.

Disengage the barrier to free them?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]There appear to be some Pokémon sealed behind an electric barrier. Disengage the barrier to free them?
entries.translated:
[black]Sembra che ci siano alcuni Pokémon
sigillati dietro una barriera\lelettrica. Disattivare la barriera

per liberarli?

entries.original: "[black][player] disengaged the barrier!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] disengaged the barrier!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha disattivato la
barriera!

entries.original:
"[black]The freed Pokémon appear to be
headed up the mountain."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The freed Pokémon appear to be headed up the mountain.
entries.translated:
[black]I Pokémon liberati sembrano
dirigersi verso la montagna.

entries.original:
"The Pokémon you freed are
repairing the stairs!"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon you freed are repairing the stairs!
entries.translated:
I Pokémon che hai liberato stanno
riparando le scale!

entries.original:
"One with the wind, one with the
lightning\.

The all-seeing eye of the raging
thunderstorm!

Now, become the lightning that
smites all evil!

Sankren thoron!

Descend to me, Zapdos!
Shake the sky and let thunder roar!

Come forth from the stormy clouds
in which you dwell!"
entries.translation_source: One with the wind, one with the lightning[game-token-1] The all-seeing eye of the raging thunderstorm! Now, become the lightning that smites all evil! Sankren thoron! Descend to me, Zapdos! Shake the sky and let thunder roar! Come forth from the stormy clouds in which you dwell!
entries.translated:
Uno con il vento, uno con il
fulmine\. L{B4}occhio onniveggente della\lfuriosa tempesta! Ora, diventa il

fulmine che annienta tutto il male!
Sankren thoron! Discendi da me,\lZapdos! Fai tremare il cielo e

lascia ruggire il tuono! Vieni
fuori dalle nubi tempestose in cui\ldimori!

entries.original:
"Finally, the very last key appears in
front of us\.\CC0820 and now\."
entries.translation_source: Finally, the very last key appears in front of us[game-token-1][control-code-2] and now[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Finalmente, l{B4}ultima chiave appare
davanti a noi\.\CC0820 e ora\.

entries.original:
"Wha - it knocked out that Shadow
Warrior in a single blow!?

So much for its \qoelectrical
resistance\qc\."
entries.translation_source: Wha - it knocked out that Shadow Warrior in a single blow!? So much for its [quote-open-1]electrical resistance[quote-close-2][game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Che - ha messo KO quel Guerriero
Ombra con un solo colpo!? Addio\lalla sua \qoresistenza elettrica\qc\.

entries.original:
"All remaining Shadow Warriors,
restrain Zapdos!"
entries.translation_source: All remaining Shadow Warriors, restrain Zapdos!
entries.translated:
Tutti i Guerrieri Ombra rimasti,
trattenete Zapdos!

entries.original: "Tch\.\CC0818 so that’s its Discharge attack\."
entries.translation_source: Tch[game-token-1][control-code-2] so that’s its Discharge attack[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Tsk\.\CC0818 quindi questa è la sua mossa
Scarica\.

entries.original:
"Well, Zapdos, you leave me
no choice\."
entries.translation_source: Well, Zapdos, you leave me no choice[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ebbene, Zapdos, non mi lasci scelta\.

entries.original:
"Heh\.
Nice try, Zapdos.

But I don’t make the same
mistake twice."
entries.translation_source: Heh[game-token-1] Nice try, Zapdos. But I don’t make the same mistake twice.
entries.translated:
Heh\. Bel tentativo, Zapdos. Ma non
commetto lo stesso errore due\lvolte.

entries.original: "Krookodile! Use Stone Edge!"
entries.translation_source: Krookodile! Use Stone Edge!
entries.translated: Krookodile! Usa Pietrataglio!

entries.original: "[green]Dile!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Dile!
entries.translated: [green]Dile!

entries.original: "[lightgreen]A critical hit!"
entries.translation_source: [color-lightgreen-1]A critical hit!
entries.translated: [lightgreen]Colpo critico!

entries.original:
"Now, Zapdos, it’s time for you\.\CC0818
to finally be ours!"
entries.translation_source: Now, Zapdos, it’s time for you[game-token-1][control-code-2] to finally be ours!
entries.translated:
Ora, Zapdos, è il momento che tu\.\CC0818
diventi finalmente nostro!

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0818 that took a lot longer
than I expected\."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1][control-code-2] that took a lot longer than I expected[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Sospiro\.\CC0818 ci è voluto molto più tempo
del previsto\.

entries.original:
"Now, all that’s left is to rendezvous
at the [green]Ruins of Void[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Now, all that’s left is to rendezvous at the [color-green-1]Ruins of Void[color-blue-2][game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ora non resta che ricongiungerci
alle [green]Rovine del Vuoto[blue]\.

entries.original:
"You again!

What were those guards doing?

I had them all stationed to prevent
you or that green-hatted boy from\linterfering!

I even destroyed the stairs behind
me\.\CC0818 and yet\.\CC0818 you’re here.

How did you manage to pull
it off\.?

It would take a monumental amount of
stubbornness to not realize it was\lsupposed to be impossible."
entries.translation_source: You again! What were those guards doing? I had them all stationed to prevent you or that green-hatted boy from interfering! I even destroyed the stairs behind me[game-token-1][control-code-2] and yet[game-token-3][control-code-4] you’re here. How did you manage to pull it off[game-token-5]? It would take a monumental amount of stubbornness to not realize it was supposed to be impossible.
entries.translated:
Di nuovo tu! Che cosa facevano
quelle guardie? Le avevo disposte\ltutte lì per impedirti di

interferire, o a quel ragazzo col
cappello verde! Ho perfino\ldistrutto le scale dietro di me\.\CC0818

eppure\.\CC0818 sei qui. Come hai fatto a
riuscirci\.? Ci vorrebbe una\ltestardaggine monumentale per non

accorgersi che doveva essere
impossibile.

entries.original:
"But\.\CC0818 no matter how it happened,
no matter that you’re here now\.

None of it changes the fact that
I have Zapdos in my possession.

With its power in my hands, there’s
no chance you’ll be able to stop\lme from leaving.

And if you think there is, then, I
will show you first-hand\.

The power of Zapdos!
The power of a Legendary Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: But[game-token-1][control-code-2] no matter how it happened, no matter that you’re here now[game-token-3] None of it changes the fact that I have Zapdos in my possession. With its power in my hands, there’s no chance you’ll be able to stop me from leaving. And if you think there is, then, I will show you first-hand[game-token-4] The power of Zapdos! The power of a Legendary Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Ma\.\CC0818 non importa come sia successo,
non importa che tu sia qui ora\.\lNiente di tutto ciò cambia il fatto

che io abbia Zapdos in mio
possesso. Con il suo potere nelle\lmie mani, non c{B4}è possibilità che

tu possa impedirmi di andarmene. E
se pensi che ci sia, allora, te lo\lmostrerò di persona\. Il potere di

Zapdos! Il potere di un Pokémon
Leggendario!

entries.original:
"I will show you first-hand\.

The power of Zapdos!
The power of a Legendary Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I will show you first-hand[game-token-1] The power of Zapdos! The power of a Legendary Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Te lo mostrerò di persona\. La
potenza di Zapdos! La potenza di un\lPokémon leggendario!

entries.original:
"Even with a Legendary Pokémon\.
it all amounted to nothing\.!?"
entries.translation_source: Even with a Legendary Pokémon[game-token-1] it all amounted to nothing[game-token-2]!?
entries.translated:
Anche con un Pokémon leggendario\. è
stato tutto inutile\.!?

entries.original:
"So\.\CC0818 it’s over for me.

Zapdos destroyed all of my Shadow
Warriors, and the Grunts I brought\lfor the mission have all been\ldefeated\.

I concede\.

I can’t stop you from taking Zapdos
from me by force.

Fine, then, I’ll release Zapdos back
into the wild.

I give you my word that I won’t
go after it again\."
entries.translation_source: So[game-token-1][control-code-2] it’s over for me. Zapdos destroyed all of my Shadow Warriors, and the Grunts I brought for the mission have all been defeated[game-token-3] I concede[game-token-4] I can’t stop you from taking Zapdos from me by force. Fine, then, I’ll release Zapdos back into the wild. I give you my word that I won’t go after it again[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Quindi\.\CC0818 per me è finita. Zapdos ha
distrutto tutti i miei Shadow\lWarriors, e le reclute che ho

portato per la missione sono state
sconfitte\. Mi arrendo\. Non posso\limpedirti di portarmi via Zapdos

con la forza. Va bene, allora,
lascerò Zapdos tornare libero in\lnatura. Ti do la mia parola che non

gli darò più la caccia\.

entries.original:
"Please tell me you have good news
for me.

Zapdos, is it\.?

\.

Really? That’s amazing news!

I thought for sure Marlon would
escape with Zapdos, even if you\ldefeated him.

And you say he just let it go?

Guess even he knew when to fold,
huh?"
entries.translation_source: Please tell me you have good news for me. Zapdos, is it[game-token-1]? [game-token-2] Really? That’s amazing news! I thought for sure Marlon would escape with Zapdos, even if you defeated him. And you say he just let it go? Guess even he knew when to fold, huh?
entries.translated:
Ti prego, dimmi che hai buone
notizie per me. Zapdos, vero\.? \.\lDavvero? È una notizia incredibile!

Ero certo che Marlon sarebbe
scappato con Zapdos, anche se lo\lavessi sconfitto. E dici che l{B4}ha

semplicemente lasciato andare?
Immagino che anche lui abbia capito\lquando era ora di cedere, eh?

entries.original:
"Well, if Zapdos is safe, we can take
a well-earned breather for the\ltime being.

Oh yeah\.\CC0818 you’re taking on
the Gym challenge, right?

In that case, you should probably
check out [green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue].

It’s not exactly an official Gym,
but think of it like Gym 4.5!

I heard that if you can defeat
the Successor of the Mansion,\lyou’ll be able to wield an\lincredible new power!

What kind? Ha ha, that would be
spoiling the surprise!"
entries.translation_source: Well, if Zapdos is safe, we can take a well-earned breather for the time being. Oh yeah[game-token-1][control-code-2] you’re taking on the Gym challenge, right? In that case, you should probably check out [color-green-3]Tarmigan Mansion[color-blue-4]. It’s not exactly an official Gym, but think of it like Gym 4.5! I heard that if you can defeat the Successor of the Mansion, you’ll be able to wield an incredible new power! What kind? Ha ha, that would be spoiling the surprise!
entries.translated:
Bene, se Zapdos è al sicuro,
possiamo prenderci una meritata\lpausa per il momento. Ah già\.\CC0818 stai

affrontando la Sfida in Palestra,
giusto? In tal caso, dovresti\lprobabilmente dare un{B4}occhiata a

[green]Villa Tarmigan[blue]. Non è esattamente
una Palestra ufficiale, ma pensala\lcome Palestra 4.5! Ho sentito che

se riesci a sconfiggere il
Successore della Villa, potrai\lusare un incredibile nuovo potere!

Che tipo? Ah ah, questo rovinerebbe
la sorpresa!

entries.original:
"\.

\CC0600You’re really amazing, [player]\.
I mean\.\CC0818 all by yourself, you\."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] [control-code-2]You’re really amazing, [player-name-3][game-token-4] I mean[game-token-5][control-code-6] all by yourself, you[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
\.\CC0600\. \CC0600Sei davvero incredibile, [player]\.
Voglio dire\.\CC0818 tutto da solo, tu\.

entries.original:
"But, let’s not take too long of
a break.

We can’t forget the Shadows are still
out there, and they still have\lMoltres and Articuno.

Luckily, I finished talking with
Grampa, and I think I might know\lhow to get them back.

Once you’re finished with
[green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue], head [green]north[blue]\ltowards [green]Route 12[blue].

I’ll meet up with you in
[green]Dehara City[blue].

We can go over the plan to
rescue them from the Shadows\lonce you arrive.

Alright, see you then!"
