entries.translation_source: But, let’s not take too long of a break. We can’t forget the Shadows are still out there, and they still have Moltres and Articuno. Luckily, I finished talking with Grampa, and I think I might know how to get them back. Once you’re finished with [color-green-1]Tarmigan Mansion[color-blue-2], head [color-green-3]north[color-blue-4] towards [color-green-5]Route 12[color-blue-6]. I’ll meet up with you in [color-green-7]Dehara City[color-blue-8]. We can go over the plan to rescue them from the Shadows once you arrive. Alright, see you then!
entries.translated:
Ma non facciamoci prendere troppo
tempo da una pausa. Non dobbiamo\ldimenticare che le Ombre sono

ancora là fuori, e hanno ancora
Moltres e Articuno. Per fortuna, ho\lfinito di parlare con il nonno, e

credo di aver capito come
recuperarli. Una volta che hai\lfinito con [green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue],

dirigiti [green]nord[blue] verso [green]Percorso 12[blue]. Ti
raggiungerò a [green]Città di Dehara[blue].\lPotremo ripassare il piano per

salvarli dalle Ombre una volta che
arriverai. Va bene, ci vediamo\lallora!

entries.original:
"Staraptor!

Let’s go!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! Let’s go!
entries.translated: Staraptor! Vai!

entries.original:
"Caught up to you at last!

I’d beaten Successor Maxima, but I
figured a bit more training at the\lMansion couldn’t hurt.

Let me guess, you also got the
power of Mega Evolution?

\.

What am I saying?
Of course you did.

Anyone who’s beaten me that many
times wouldn’t have been slowed\ldown by that.

Of course, I’m gonna be putting
an end to your record, right here,\lright now!

Come on then!
Lemme show you my new power!"
entries.translation_source: Caught up to you at last! I’d beaten Successor Maxima, but I figured a bit more training at the Mansion couldn’t hurt. Let me guess, you also got the power of Mega Evolution? [game-token-1] What am I saying? Of course you did. Anyone who’s beaten me that many times wouldn’t have been slowed down by that. Of course, I’m gonna be putting an end to your record, right here, right now! Come on then! Lemme show you my new power!
entries.translated:
Ti ho finalmente raggiunto! Avevo
battuto Successor Maxima, ma ho\lpensato che un po{B4} di allenamento

in più alla Villa non avrebbe
guastato. Fammi indovinare, hai\lpreso anche tu il potere della

Megaevoluzione? \. Che sto dicendo?
Certo che sì. Chiunque mi abbia\lbattuto così tante volte non si

sarebbe lasciato rallentare da una
cosa del genere. Naturalmente,\lmetterò fine alla tua serie proprio

qui, proprio ora! Forza allora!
Lascia che ti mostri il mio nuovo\lpotere!

entries.original:
"How do you keep doing it, [player]?

No matter how much I train, it’s
like you’re always two steps ahead\."
entries.translation_source: How do you keep doing it, [player-name-1]? No matter how much I train, it’s like you’re always two steps ahead[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Come fai a continuare a farlo,
[player]? Per quanto mi alleni,\lsembra che tu sia sempre due passi

avanti\.

entries.original:
"Huff\.\CC0820 huff\.

Good thing I was able to catch up
to you two."
entries.translation_source: Huff[game-token-1][control-code-2] huff[game-token-3] Good thing I was able to catch up to you two.
entries.translated:
Ansim\.\CC0820 ansim\. Per fortuna sono
riuscito a raggiungervi.

entries.original:
"Old man Log?

Jeez, I’m surprised you can still run
that fast at your age."
entries.translation_source: Old man Log? Jeez, I’m surprised you can still run that fast at your age.
entries.translated:
Vecchio Log? Cavolo, mi sorprende
che alla tua età tu riesca ancora a\lcorrere così veloce.

entries.original:
"How rude, [rival]\.

I came all the way out here with
something for you, you know!

Well, I suppose it can’t be helped -
I was like that myself, in my\lyouth, truth be told.

Oh, those were the days, back
when Arthur and I were Trainers.

We were quite the fierce rivals\.

So fierce, our spars could last for
days without stopping!"
entries.translation_source: How rude, [text-token-rival-1][game-token-2] I came all the way out here with something for you, you know! Well, I suppose it can’t be helped - I was like that myself, in my youth, truth be told. Oh, those were the days, back when Arthur and I were Trainers. We were quite the fierce rivals[game-token-3] So fierce, our spars could last for days without stopping!
entries.translated:
Che scortesia, [rival]\. Sono venuto
fin qui apposta con qualcosa per\lte, sai! Beh, suppongo che non si

possa farci nulla - da giovane ero
anch{B4}io così, a dire il vero. Oh,\lbei tempi, quando Arthur e io

eravamo Allenatori. Eravamo rivali
davvero agguerriti\. Così tanto, che\lle nostre sfide potevano durare

giorni senza mai fermarci!

entries.original:
"I really don’t have time for your
trip down memory lane, old man.

Are you going to give us what you
brought along or not?"
entries.translation_source: I really don’t have time for your trip down memory lane, old man. Are you going to give us what you brought along or not?
entries.translated:
Non ho davvero tempo per il tuo
tuffo nei ricordi, vecchio. Ci\ldarai quello che hai portato con te

oppure no?

entries.original:
"[player], this is for you.

If you’re going to keep at the
Gym Challenge, you’ll need this to\lcross the sea."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], this is for you. If you’re going to keep at the Gym Challenge, you’ll need this to cross the sea.
entries.translated:
[player], questo è per te. Se
intendi continuare la Sfida delle\lPalestre, ti servirà per

attraversare il mare.

entries.original:
"And while your attitude certainly
needs an adjustment, [rival], you\lmay have one as well."
entries.translation_source: And while your attitude certainly needs an adjustment, [text-token-rival-1], you may have one as well.
entries.translated:
E mentre il tuo atteggiamento ha
sicuramente bisogno di una\lsistemata, [rival], anche tu

potresti averne bisogno.

entries.original:
"Surf, huh\.
Yeah, this’ll be useful.

I figured out the Shadows had
something to do with my parents’\ldisappearance, and I managed to\ltrack them to the Ruins of Void.

Once I get directions, I’ll Surf
there, and find out what happened\lto them once and for all!

So, thanks, I guess, Log."
entries.translation_source: Surf, huh[game-token-1] Yeah, this’ll be useful. I figured out the Shadows had something to do with my parents’ disappearance, and I managed to track them to the Ruins of Void. Once I get directions, I’ll Surf there, and find out what happened to them once and for all! So, thanks, I guess, Log.
entries.translated:
Surf, eh\. Sì, tornerà utile. Ho
capito che gli Shadows avevano\lqualcosa a che fare con la

scomparsa dei miei genitori, e sono
riuscito a rintracciarli fino alle\lRuins of Void. Una volta che avrò

le indicazioni, ci andrò usando
Surf, e scoprirò cosa è successo\lloro una volta per tutte! Quindi,

grazie, suppongo, Log.

entries.original:
"The Shadows, you say?

Ah, yes\. that reminds me what I
came here for."
entries.translation_source: The Shadows, you say? Ah, yes[game-token-1] that reminds me what I came here for.
entries.translated:
Le Ombre, dici? Ah, sì\. mi ricorda
perché sono venuto qui.

entries.original:
"[player], Arthur has filled me in on
your recent escapades.

First, let me congratulate you on
rescuing Zapdos.

But of course, I never doubted you
for a moment, [player]!

Ho ho ho!

\.

Anyway, if you’re looking to head
in the same direction as the\lShadows\.

There’s an old colleague of mine
living in Dehara City, who is a\lfastidious researcher of the\lRuins of Void.

I’ve been told that Jax went on
ahead to look for him.

If needed, he can provide you with
the Surfing directions."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], Arthur has filled me in on your recent escapades. First, let me congratulate you on rescuing Zapdos. But of course, I never doubted you for a moment, [player-name-2]! Ho ho ho! [game-token-3] Anyway, if you’re looking to head in the same direction as the Shadows[game-token-4] There’s an old colleague of mine living in Dehara City, who is a fastidious researcher of the Ruins of Void. I’ve been told that Jax went on ahead to look for him. If needed, he can provide you with the Surfing directions.
entries.translated:
[player], Arthur mi ha messo al
corrente delle tue recenti\lscorribande. Per prima cosa,

lasciami congratularmi con te per
aver salvato Zapdos. Ma ovviamente,\lnon ho mai dubitato di te nemmeno

per un momento, [player]! Ho ho ho!
\. Comunque, se stai cercando di\landare nella stessa direzione delle

Ombre\. C{B4}è un mio vecchio collega
che vive a Città di Dehara, uno\lscrupoloso ricercatore delle Rovine

del Vuoto. Mi hanno detto che Jax è
andato avanti per cercarlo. Se\lnecessario, può darti le

indicazioni per Surf.

entries.original:
"Some old guy in Dehara City knows
the way to the Ruins of Void?

Guess that takes care of where
I’ll be heading next.

Thanks, Log, for saying something
worth listening to for once."
entries.translation_source: Some old guy in Dehara City knows the way to the Ruins of Void? Guess that takes care of where I’ll be heading next. Thanks, Log, for saying something worth listening to for once.
entries.translated:
Un vecchio a Dehara City conosce la
strada per le Rovine del Vuoto?\lSuppongo che questo chiarisca dove

andrò dopo. Grazie, Log, per aver
detto qualcosa che valesse la pena\lascoltare per una volta.

entries.original:
"Catch you later, [player].

Next time, I swear I’ll close that
gap between us for sure!"
entries.translation_source: Catch you later, [player-name-1]. Next time, I swear I’ll close that gap between us for sure!
entries.translated:
Ci vediamo, [player]. La prossima
volta, giuro che colmerò davvero il\ldivario tra noi!

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0820 looks like his journey
with Pokémon hasn’t mellowed him\lout at all.

\.\CC0820Well, good luck, [player].
I’ll be praying for your success."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1][control-code-2] looks like his journey with Pokémon hasn’t mellowed him out at all. [game-token-3][control-code-4]Well, good luck, [player-name-5]. I’ll be praying for your success.
entries.translated:
Sigh\.\CC0820 sembra che il suo viaggio con
i Pokémon non l{B4}abbia affatto reso\lpiù tranquillo. \.\CC0820{BC}uona fortuna,

[player]. Pregherò per il tuo
successo.

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0820 now what am I supposed
to do\.?

I have nothing to show Zeph and
Ivory\.

The goal is no longer reachable
without Zapdos\.

Should we\.\CC0818 abandon our cause?

Truthfully, I’ve been having doubts
about the lengths we’ve gone to\.

I think it’s time I returned back
home, to my children."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1][control-code-2] now what am I supposed to do[game-token-3]? I have nothing to show Zeph and Ivory[game-token-4] The goal is no longer reachable without Zapdos[game-token-5] Should we[game-token-6][control-code-7] abandon our cause? Truthfully, I’ve been having doubts about the lengths we’ve gone to[game-token-8] I think it’s time I returned back home, to my children.
entries.translated:
Sigh\.\CC0820 ora che diavolo dovrei fare\.?
Non ho nulla da mostrare a Zeph e\lIvory\. Il nostro obiettivo non è più

raggiungibile senza Zapdos\. Dovremmo\.\CC0818
abbandonare la nostra causa? A dire\lil vero, ho avuto dei dubbi su fin

dove ci siamo spinti\. Credo sia ora
che torni a casa, dai miei figli.

entries.original:
"Incredible\.\CC0820 such a marvel of
modern technology!

To think that such a feat was even
possible\.

Oh, Marlon\.\CC0818 you had done so well,
up until that last blunder\.

But do not fret, for I can take
care of the rest from here.

In the meantime, I think you will
have all the time in the world for\lreflection\.\CC0818 and regret."
entries.translation_source: Incredible[game-token-1][control-code-2] such a marvel of modern technology! To think that such a feat was even possible[game-token-3] Oh, Marlon[game-token-4][control-code-5] you had done so well, up until that last blunder[game-token-6] But do not fret, for I can take care of the rest from here. In the meantime, I think you will have all the time in the world for reflection[game-token-7][control-code-8] and regret.
entries.translated:
Incredibile\.\CC0820 una meraviglia della
tecnologia moderna! Pensare che\lun{B4}impresa simile fosse persino

possibile\. Oh, Marlon\.\CC0818 avevi fatto
così bene, fino a quell{B4}ultimo\lerrore\. Ma non preoccuparti, perché

da qui in poi posso occuparmi io
del resto. Nel frattempo, credo che\lavrai tutto il tempo del mondo per

la riflessione\.\CC0818 e il rimpianto.

entries.original:
"What\.\CC0820 exactly is this, Hoopa?

I ask you to summon another Zapdos,
to make up for Marlon’s failure,\land you bring me this?

Pathetic!
This does not even resemble Zapdos!"
entries.translation_source: What[game-token-1][control-code-2] exactly is this, Hoopa? I ask you to summon another Zapdos, to make up for Marlon’s failure, and you bring me this? Pathetic! This does not even resemble Zapdos!
entries.translated:
Che\.\CC0820 cos{B4}è esattamente questa roba,
Hoopa? Ti chiedo di evocare un\laltro Zapdos, per compensare il

fallimento di Marlon, e tu mi porti
questo? Patetico! Questo non\lassomiglia nemmeno a Zapdos!

entries.original:
"Such a useless creature\.\CC0818 it does
nothing but cower inside that\lold bag!"
entries.translation_source: Such a useless creature[game-token-1][control-code-2] it does nothing but cower inside that old bag!
entries.translated:
Una creatura così inutile\.\CC0818 non fa
altro che rannicchiarsi dentro\lquella vecchia borsa!

entries.original:
"Hoopa, I know it is difficult for
you, but get it right this time.

Summon forth a Zapdos.

I do not care where you must summon
it from.

Even if you have to expend every
last ounce of energy to summon one\lfrom another region\.

Just bring me a Zapdos.

UNDERSTOOD?"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, I know it is difficult for you, but get it right this time. Summon forth a Zapdos. I do not care where you must summon it from. Even if you have to expend every last ounce of energy to summon one from another region[game-token-1] Just bring me a Zapdos. UNDERSTOOD?
entries.translated:
Hoopa, so che per te è difficile,
ma questa volta fa{B4} bene. Evoca uno\lZapdos. Non mi importa da dove tu

debba evocarlo. Anche se dovrai
spendere fino all{B4}ultima goccia di\lenergia per evocarlo da un{B4}altra

regione\. Portami semplicemente uno
Zapdos. CHIARO?

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.

entries.original:
"That is more like it!
Much better, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: That is more like it! Much better, Hoopa.
entries.translated:
Ecco, così va meglio! Molto meglio,
Hoopa.

entries.original: "[black]CHZKKK.\CC0815.\CC0815.\CC0815"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]CHZKKK.[control-code-2].[control-code-3].[control-code-4]
entries.translated: [black]CHZKKK.\CC0815.\CC0815.\CC0815

entries.original:
"Hello, have we connected?

\.\CC0820It is I, the grunt you met
with earlier.

I have just secured the final
necessary Pokémon.

I will be moving on to the Ruins of
Void, momentarily.

\.\CC0820Yes, of course.
So then, just as promised\.

I will be assuming command of
the branch?

\.\CC0820Certainly - as long as Hoopa is
relatively unharmed, you may\ldiscover whatever you like.

\.\CC0820Not to worry - the disposal of the
Shadow Warriors will be a quick and\lclean one.

There will be no trace\.

\.\CC0820Understood. We will speak later
when I report my progress."
entries.translation_source: Hello, have we connected? [game-token-1][control-code-2]It is I, the grunt you met with earlier. I have just secured the final necessary Pokémon. I will be moving on to the Ruins of Void, momentarily. [game-token-3][control-code-4]Yes, of course. So then, just as promised[game-token-5] I will be assuming command of the branch? [game-token-6][control-code-7]Certainly - as long as Hoopa is relatively unharmed, you may discover whatever you like. [game-token-8][control-code-9]Not to worry - the disposal of the Shadow Warriors will be a quick and clean one. There will be no trace[game-token-10] [game-token-11][control-code-12]Understood. We will speak later when I report my progress.
entries.translated:
Pronto, siamo collegati? \.\CC0820Sono io,
la recluta che hai incontrato\lprima. Ho appena procurato l{B4}ultimo

Pokémon necessario. Tra poco andrò
alle Rovine del Vuoto. \.\CC0820Sì, certo.\lQuindi, come promesso\. sarò io ad

assumere il comando della sede?
\.\CC0820Certamente - purché Hoopa sia\lrelativamente illeso, potrai

scoprire tutto ciò che vuoi. \.\CC0820Non
preoccuparti - l{B4}eliminazione dei\lGuerrieri dell{B4}Ombra sarà rapida e

pulita. Non resterà alcuna traccia\.
\.\CC0820Capito. Ci sentiremo più tardi\lquando ti riferirò i miei

progressi.

entries.original:
"Now then\.\CC0818 we have no more time to
waste.

With Zapdos in my hands, Zeph
finally has the last piece needed\lto perform the unbinding.

Now\.\CC0818 open up a portal to the Ruins
of Void, Hoopa.

You surely still have energy left to
do that, even after summoning such\la powerful Pokémon\.

Of course, once you have regained
all your power, exhaustion will no\llonger be an issue\.

Recover your strength, and then
transport yourself over too.

You will find me by my Cube’s
signal.

And as a reminder\.\CC0820 remain
inconspicuous.

Zeph still has a loyal following
who may prove\.\CC0818 problematic.

He must not know.
It would ruin everything.

I am placing my faith in you this
one last time, Hoopa, so do not\lerr!"
entries.translation_source: Now then[game-token-1][control-code-2] we have no more time to waste. With Zapdos in my hands, Zeph finally has the last piece needed to perform the unbinding. Now[game-token-3][control-code-4] open up a portal to the Ruins of Void, Hoopa. You surely still have energy left to do that, even after summoning such a powerful Pokémon[game-token-5] Of course, once you have regained all your power, exhaustion will no longer be an issue[game-token-6] Recover your strength, and then transport yourself over too. You will find me by my Cube’s signal. And as a reminder[game-token-7][control-code-8] remain inconspicuous. Zeph still has a loyal following who may prove[game-token-9][control-code-10] problematic. He must not know. It would ruin everything. I am placing my faith in you this one last time, Hoopa, so do not err!
entries.translated:
Allora\.\CC0818 non abbiamo più tempo da
perdere. Con Zapdos nelle mie mani,\lZeph ha finalmente l{B4}ultimo pezzo

necessario per compiere lo
scioglimento. Ora\.\CC0818 apri un portale\lper le Rovine del Vuoto, Hoopa.

Sicuramente hai ancora energia per
farlo, anche dopo aver evocato un\lPokémon così potente\. Naturalmente,

una volta che avrai recuperato
tutto il tuo potere, la stanchezza\lnon sarà più un problema\. Recupera

le forze, e poi trasportati anche
tu. Mi troverai grazie al segnale\ldel mio Cubo. E come promemoria\.\CC0820 non

farti notare. Zeph ha ancora un
seguito fedele che potrebbe\lrivelarsi\.\CC0818 problematico. Non deve

saperlo. Rovinerebbe tutto. Ripongo
la mia fiducia in te per\lquest{B4}ultima volta, Hoopa, quindi

non sbagliare!

entries.original:
"[player]! You made it!

Sorry I didn’t see you - I was
killing time on these machines\.

This [green]Cloud Burst[blue] game’s really
addictive, and I guess I just\ltuned out.

In the process, though, I actually
earned enough Coins to buy not\lone, but two [green]Ability Capsules[blue]!

Have you heard of them?

If a Pokémon has two possible
Abilities, the Capsules change one\linto the other."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You made it! Sorry I didn’t see you - I was killing time on these machines[game-token-2] This [color-green-3]Cloud Burst[color-blue-4] game’s really addictive, and I guess I just tuned out. In the process, though, I actually earned enough Coins to buy not one, but two [color-green-5]Ability Capsules[color-blue-6]! Have you heard of them? If a Pokémon has two possible Abilities, the Capsules change one into the other.
entries.translated:
[player]! Ce l{B4}hai fatta! Scusa se
non ti ho visto - stavo ammazzando\lil tempo su queste macchine\\. Questo

[green]Cloud Burst[blue] gioco è davvero
coinvolgente, e credo di essermi\ldistratto. Nel frattempo, però, ho

guadagnato abbastanza gettoni per
comprare non una, ma due [green]Capsule\lAbilità[blue]! Ne hai sentito parlare? Se

un Pokémon ha due possibili
Abilità, le Capsule cambiano l{B4}una\lnell{B4}altra.

entries.original:
"But, Cloud Burst can wait.

Let’s take this somewhere outside,
where it’s a bit less noisy."
entries.translation_source: But, Cloud Burst can wait. Let’s take this somewhere outside, where it’s a bit less noisy.
entries.translated:
Ma Cloud Burst può aspettare.
Andiamo fuori, da qualche parte\ldove ci sia un po{B4} meno rumore.

entries.original:
"Alright, I guess this’ll do.

Okay, listen up.

While I was waiting for you, I saw
a bunch of Shadow Grunts heading\lwest, towards the Ruins of Void.

According to Grampa, the only
reason for them to go there\.\CC0818 is if\lthey’ve gotten everything they\lneeded to perform the unbinding.

You know, the ritual needed to
release the dark force.

But, it shouldn’t be possible
without Zapdos\.

That’s why Grampa thinks they’re
going to try the unbinding anyway,\land hope the incomplete ritual is\lenough for their purposes.

This is our chance to head over
there too, and steal back Articuno\land Moltres!

It’s perfect.

They’ll be the only ones at the
ruins, so we won’t have to worry\labout them turning innocent people\linto those monsters!"
entries.translation_source: Alright, I guess this’ll do. Okay, listen up. While I was waiting for you, I saw a bunch of Shadow Grunts heading west, towards the Ruins of Void. According to Grampa, the only reason for them to go there[game-token-1][control-code-2] is if they’ve gotten everything they needed to perform the unbinding. You know, the ritual needed to release the dark force. But, it shouldn’t be possible without Zapdos[game-token-3] That’s why Grampa thinks they’re going to try the unbinding anyway, and hope the incomplete ritual is enough for their purposes. This is our chance to head over there too, and steal back Articuno and Moltres! It’s perfect. They’ll be the only ones at the ruins, so we won’t have to worry about them turning innocent people into those monsters!
entries.translated:
Va bene, suppongo che andrà bene.
Allora, ascolta. Mentre ti\laspettavo, ho visto un gruppo di

Reclute Ombra dirigersi verso
ovest, verso le Rovine del Vuoto.\lSecondo il Nonno, l{B4}unico motivo

per cui vadano lì\.\CC0818 è se hanno
ottenuto tutto ciò di cui hanno\lbisogno per eseguire lo

scioglimento. Sai, il rituale
necessario per liberare la forza\loscura. Ma non dovrebbe essere

possibile senza Zapdos\. Ecco perché
il Nonno pensa che tenteranno\lcomunque lo scioglimento, sperando

che il rituale incompleto basti ai
loro scopi. Questa è la nostra\loccasione per andare anche noi là e

riprendere Articuno e Moltres! È
perfetto. Saranno gli unici alle\lrovine, quindi non dovremo

preoccuparci che trasformino
persone innocenti in quei mostri!

entries.original:
"But before we do that, first
things first, you ought to get\lDehara City’s Gym Badge.

You’ll need it in order to Surf to
the Ruins of Void with me, after\lall, since there’s no way to get\lthere on foot.

Alright - I’ll head home to prepare
my Pokémon.

In the meantime, you go get that
Badge."
entries.translation_source: But before we do that, first things first, you ought to get Dehara City’s Gym Badge. You’ll need it in order to Surf to the Ruins of Void with me, after all, since there’s no way to get there on foot. Alright - I’ll head home to prepare my Pokémon. In the meantime, you go get that Badge.
entries.translated:
Ma prima di fare quello, prima le
cose importanti, devi ottenere la\lMedaglia della Palestra di Dehara

City. Ne avrai bisogno per usare
Surf con me fino alle Rovine del\lVuoto, dopotutto, visto che non c{B4}è

modo di arrivarci a piedi. Va bene
- io torno a casa a preparare i\lmiei Pokémon. Nel frattempo, tu vai

a prendere quella Medaglia.

entries.original:
"What the-?

[player], look out!"
entries.translation_source: What the-? [player-name-1], look out!
entries.translated: Che di-? [player], fai attenzione!

entries.original:
"Are you alright?
What happened?

All of a sudden a strange ring
appeared, and we got sucked here\.

I was afraid of losing you, so I
tried jumping in after you\."
entries.translation_source: Are you alright? What happened? All of a sudden a strange ring appeared, and we got sucked here[game-token-1] I was afraid of losing you, so I tried jumping in after you[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Stai bene? Che è successo?
All{B4}improvviso è apparso uno strano\lanello e siamo stati risucchiati

qui\. Avevo paura di perderti, così
ho cercato di buttarmi dentro dopo\ldi te\.

entries.original:
"Where are we, anyway?

Wait\.\CC0820 is this\.\CC0820 the Ruins of Void?"
entries.translation_source: Where are we, anyway? Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] is this[game-token-3][control-code-4] the Ruins of Void?
entries.translated:
Dove siamo, comunque? Aspetta\.\CC0820 sono\.\CC0820
le Rovine del Vuoto?

entries.original:
"It has to be.

Look, those are Shadow Grunts at the
top of the stairs!"
entries.translation_source: It has to be. Look, those are Shadow Grunts at the top of the stairs!
entries.translated:
Deve esserlo. Guarda, sono delle
reclute Ombra in cima alle scale!

entries.original:
"Understood?

This is where you must make your
stand.

For the sake of the unbinding, those
two must not be allowed up here.

Demonstrate to them\.\CC0818 the power
of the Light of Ruin!"
entries.translation_source: Understood? This is where you must make your stand. For the sake of the unbinding, those two must not be allowed up here. Demonstrate to them[game-token-1][control-code-2] the power of the Light of Ruin!
entries.translated:
Capito? È qui che devi resistere.
Per il bene dello scioglimento,\lquei due non devono essere lasciati

salire fin quassù. Mostra loro\.\CC0818 il
potere della Luce della Rovina!

entries.original:
"I can’t hear them from here,
but whatever they’re saying,\lit can’t be good!

Staraptor!

Take out those Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t hear them from here, but whatever they’re saying, it can’t be good! Staraptor! Take out those Shadows!
entries.translated:
Non riesco a sentirli da qui, ma
qualunque cosa stiano dicendo non\lpuò essere una buona cosa!

Staraptor! Elimina quelle Ombre!

entries.original:
"Staraptor!

STARAPTOR!

NOOOOOO!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! STARAPTOR! NOOOOOO!
entries.translated: Staraptor! STARAPTOR! NOOOOOO!

entries.original:
"That blast\.\CC0820 it destroyed the
staircase!

And Staraptor was\.\CC0820 Staraptor was-!

\. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \.

Sniff\.

Guh\.\CC0820 sorry\.\CC0820 I’m finding it hard\.\CC0820 to
stay focused\."
entries.translation_source: That blast[game-token-1][control-code-2] it destroyed the staircase! And Staraptor was[game-token-3][control-code-4] Staraptor was-! [game-token-5] [game-token-6] [game-token-7] [game-token-8] [game-token-9] [game-token-10] [game-token-11] [game-token-12] [game-token-13] [game-token-14] Sniff[game-token-15] Guh[game-token-16][control-code-17] sorry[game-token-18][control-code-19] I’m finding it hard[game-token-20][control-code-21] to stay focused[game-token-22]
entries.translated:
Quell{B4}esplosione\.\CC0820 ha distrutto la
scala! E Staraptor era\.\CC0820 Staraptor\lera-! \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. \. Sniff\. Guh\.\CC0820 scusa\.\CC0820

faccio fatica\.\CC0820 a restare concentrato\.

entries.original:
"Wait\.\CC0818 I think that blast just
uncovered an entrance into\lthe Ruins."
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] I think that blast just uncovered an entrance into the Ruins.
entries.translated:
Aspetta\.\CC0818 Credo che quell{B4}esplosione
abbia appena scoperto un ingresso\lnelle Rovine.

entries.original:
"You should go in there and find a
way to the top.

I\.\CC0820 I only brought Staraptor with
me, so I can’t go with you.

I’ll\.\CC0818 stay here and heal up your
Pokémon, if you want."
entries.translation_source: You should go in there and find a way to the top. I[game-token-1][control-code-2] I only brought Staraptor with me, so I can’t go with you. I’ll[game-token-3][control-code-4] stay here and heal up your Pokémon, if you want.
entries.translated:
Dovresti entrare lì dentro e
trovare un modo per arrivare in\lcima. Io\.\CC0820 Ho portato con me solo

Staraptor, quindi non posso venire
con te. Resterò\.\CC0818 qui a curare i tuoi\lPokémon, se vuoi.

entries.original:
"And please\.\CC0818 find Staraptor for me.

That blast must’ve hurt it really
badly.

When you find it, shout down to me."
entries.translation_source: And please[game-token-1][control-code-2] find Staraptor for me. That blast must’ve hurt it really badly. When you find it, shout down to me.
entries.translated:
E per favore\.\CC0818 trova Staraptor per
me. Quell{B4}esplosione deve averlo\lferito davvero male. Quando lo

trovi, gridami da lassù.

entries.original: "Ethereal Voice"
entries.translation_source: Ethereal Voice
entries.translated: Voce Eterea

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO SEEK PASSAGE TO THE HEART
OF THE TEMPLE OF VOID\.

PROVE YOUR WORTH, AGAINST THE
GUARDIAN OF THIS SACRED GROUND!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]YOU WHO SEEK PASSAGE TO THE HEART OF THE TEMPLE OF VOID[game-token-2] PROVE YOUR WORTH, AGAINST THE GUARDIAN OF THIS SACRED GROUND!
entries.translated:
[blue]TU CHE CERCHI PASSAGGIO VERSO IL
CUORE DEL TEMPIO DEL VUOTO\. DIMOSTRA\lIL TUO VALORE, CONTRO IL GUARDIANO

DI QUESTO TERRENO SACRO!

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO NOW POSSESS THE RIGHT OF
PASSAGE\.

YOUR NEXT TRIAL AWAITS, FURTHER
WITHIN THESE HALLS\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]YOU WHO NOW POSSESS THE RIGHT OF PASSAGE[game-token-2] YOUR NEXT TRIAL AWAITS, FURTHER WITHIN THESE HALLS[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[blue]TU CHE ORA POSSEDI IL DIRITTO DI
PASSAGGIO\. LA TUA PROSSIMA PROVA TI\lATTENDE, PIÙ AVANTI IN QUESTE SALE\.

entries.original: "Uh oh."
entries.translation_source: Uh oh.
entries.translated: Oh no.

entries.original:
"Sir, [player] is attempting to
make [buffer1] way up here by coming\lthrough the ruins!"
entries.translation_source: Sir, [player-name-1] is attempting to make [buffer1-2] way up here by coming through the ruins!
entries.translated:
Signore, [player] sta cercando di
farsi strada fino a [buffer1] qui su\lpassando attraverso le rovine!

entries.original:
"No matter.

By the time [player] ascends, Zeph
will be ready for the unbinding.

However, should the need arise, I
will require you to stall [player]\lfor as long as possible."
entries.translation_source: No matter. By the time [player-name-1] ascends, Zeph will be ready for the unbinding. However, should the need arise, I will require you to stall [player-name-2] for as long as possible.
entries.translated:
Non importa. Quando [player]
salirà, Zeph sarà pronto per la\lliberazione. Tuttavia, se fosse

necessario, ti chiederò di
trattenere [player] il più a lungo\lpossibile.

entries.original:
"If I did not need you, Hoopa,
I would throw your Poké Ball\lright back into the ocean for all\lof the trouble you have caused!"
entries.translation_source: If I did not need you, Hoopa, I would throw your Poké Ball right back into the ocean for all of the trouble you have caused!
entries.translated:
Se non avessi bisogno di te, Hoopa,
ti rispedirei subito la tua Poké\lBall nell{B4}oceano per tutti i guai

che hai causato!

entries.original:
"I’ve got a bad feeling
about that Claydol\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve got a bad feeling about that Claydol[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ho una brutta sensazione riguardo a
quel Claydol\.

entries.original: "What the\.?"
entries.translation_source: What the[game-token-1]?
entries.translated: Ma che\.?

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO SEEK TO VIOLATE THESE
SACRED GROUNDS\.

DEMONSTRATE YOUR WORTH, OR BE
SMOTE BY MY JUDGMENT!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]YOU WHO SEEK TO VIOLATE THESE SACRED GROUNDS[game-token-2] DEMONSTRATE YOUR WORTH, OR BE SMOTE BY MY JUDGMENT!
entries.translated:
[blue]TU CHE CERCHI DI VIOLARE QUESTO
LUOGO SACRO\. DIMOSTRA IL TUO VALORE,\lO SARAI ABBATTUTO DAL MIO GIUDIZIO!

entries.original:
"Huh? This Pokémon wants to fight?

We handle Shadow Warriors on
the daily!

One normal Pokémon’s nothing to us!
Let’s take it down!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? This Pokémon wants to fight? We handle Shadow Warriors on the daily! One normal Pokémon’s nothing to us! Let’s take it down!
entries.translated:
Eh? Questo Pokémon vuole
combattere? Noi abbiamo a che fare\lcon gli Shadow Warriors tutti i

giorni! Un Pokémon normale non è
niente per noi! Abbattiamolo!

entries.original: "Groan\."
entries.translation_source: Groan[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ugh\.

entries.original:
"YOU WHO LACK THE RIGHT\.

BEGONE FROM THIS PLACE, LEST YE BE
CAST INTO THE VOID!"
entries.translation_source: YOU WHO LACK THE RIGHT[game-token-1] BEGONE FROM THIS PLACE, LEST YE BE CAST INTO THE VOID!
entries.translated:
VOI CHE NON AVETE IL DIRITTO\.
ANDATEVENE DA QUESTO LUOGO, O\lSARETE SCAGLIATI NEL VUOTO!

entries.original: "It’s Jax’s Staraptor."
entries.translation_source: It’s Jax’s Staraptor.
entries.translated: È lo Staraptor di Jax.

entries.original:
"Thank goodness\.\CC0818 it looks like
Staraptor will make a full recovery."
entries.translation_source: Thank goodness[game-token-1][control-code-2] it looks like Staraptor will make a full recovery.
entries.translated:
Meno male\.\CC0818 sembra che Staraptor si
riprenderà completamente.

entries.original:
"Thanks for finding Staraptor for
me\.

\.

I’m sorry\.\CC0820 I had to rely on you
yet again\.

Mmm? Ah, never mind me.

Anyway, great job on getting this
far up.

It looks like we’re nearly at the
top - just a little more and we’ll\lreach the Shadows.

Sorry I can’t be\.\CC0818 more useful\.

But, uh\.\CC0818 if you need healing,
I’ll be waiting right outside."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for finding Staraptor for me[game-token-1] [game-token-2] I’m sorry[game-token-3][control-code-4] I had to rely on you yet again[game-token-5] Mmm? Ah, never mind me. Anyway, great job on getting this far up. It looks like we’re nearly at the top - just a little more and we’ll reach the Shadows. Sorry I can’t be[game-token-6][control-code-7] more useful[game-token-8] But, uh[game-token-9][control-code-10] if you need healing, I’ll be waiting right outside.
entries.translated:
Grazie per aver ritrovato Staraptor
per me\. \. Mi dispiace\.\CC0820 dover contare\lancora una volta su di te\. Mmm? Ah,

non farci caso. Comunque, ottimo
lavoro ad arrivare fin qui. Sembra\lche siamo quasi in cima: ancora un

altro po{B4} e raggiungeremo le Ombre.
Scusa se non posso esserti\.\CC0818 più\lutile\. Ma, eh\.\CC0818 se hai bisogno di

cure, ti aspetterò proprio qui
fuori.

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO WOULD ENTER THE HEART OF
THE TEMPLE OF VOID\.

AGAINST THE THREE, DEMONSTRATE
YOUR STRENGTH OF BODY AND SOUL."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]YOU WHO WOULD ENTER THE HEART OF THE TEMPLE OF VOID[game-token-2] AGAINST THE THREE, DEMONSTRATE YOUR STRENGTH OF BODY AND SOUL.
entries.translated:
[blue]TU CHE VORRESTI ENTRARE NEL CUORE
DEL TEMPIO DEL VUOTO\. CONTRO I TRE,\lDIMOSTRA LA TUA FORZA DI CORPO E

ANIMA.

entries.original:
"You gaze into the portal\.

\.

Pokémon are attempting to cross
through from the other side!

Are you ready to face them?

Be aware, once the battles begin,
there will be no chance to recover."
entries.translation_source: You gaze into the portal[game-token-1] [game-token-2] Pokémon are attempting to cross through from the other side! Are you ready to face them? Be aware, once the battles begin, there will be no chance to recover.
entries.translated:
Fissi il portale\. \. Dei Pokémon
stanno cercando di attraversarlo\ldall{B4}altro lato! Sei pronto ad

affrontarli? Tieni presente che,
una volta iniziate le lotte, non ci\lsarà alcuna possibilità di

recuperare.

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] ran back into
the portal."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] ran back into the portal.
entries.translated:
Il [buffer1] è rientrato nel
portale.

entries.original:
"Another Pokémon is making its way
through the portal!"
entries.translation_source: Another Pokémon is making its way through the portal!
entries.translated:
Un altro Pokémon si sta facendo
strada attraverso il portale!

entries.original:
"[blue]YOU WHO NOW POSSESS THE RIGHT OF
PASSAGE\.

WITH FORTIFIED BODY, AND RIGHTEOUS
SOUL, STEP FORTH!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]YOU WHO NOW POSSESS THE RIGHT OF PASSAGE[game-token-2] WITH FORTIFIED BODY, AND RIGHTEOUS SOUL, STEP FORTH!
entries.translated:
[blue]TU CHE ORA POSSEGGI IL DIRITTO DI
PASSAGGIO\. CON CORPO FORTIFICATO E\lANIMA RETTA, AVANZA!

entries.original:
"That Claydol may have knocked us
down before, but we’re still not\lgoing to let you through without\la fight!

We can’t let the unbinding be
disrupted!"
entries.translation_source: That Claydol may have knocked us down before, but we’re still not going to let you through without a fight! We can’t let the unbinding be disrupted!
entries.translated:
Quel Claydol può averci abbattuti
prima, ma non ti lasceremo passare\lsenza combattere! Non possiamo

permettere che la liberazione venga
interrotta!

entries.original:
"We’re not done yet!

It’s my turn to take you down!"
entries.translation_source: We’re not done yet! It’s my turn to take you down!
entries.translated:
Non abbiamo ancora finito! Adesso
tocca a me mandarti KO!

entries.original: "Wait!"
entries.translation_source: Wait!
entries.translated: Aspetta!

entries.original:
"[player] has more important things
to do than deal with you.

If you want to take someone on,
why don’t you try me on for size!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] has more important things to do than deal with you. If you want to take someone on, why don’t you try me on for size!
entries.translated:
[player] ha cose più importanti da
fare che occuparsi di te. Se vuoi\laffrontare qualcuno, perché non

provi con me!

entries.original:
"[player]!

I don’t know how it’s possible,
but from the way these guys have\lbeen talking, the Shadows must\lhave captured Zapdos!

I’ll take care of these goons.

In the meantime, you gotta stop the
Shadows from carrying out their\l\qounbinding\qc!

Hurry! There’s no time left!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! I don’t know how it’s possible, but from the way these guys have been talking, the Shadows must have captured Zapdos! I’ll take care of these goons. In the meantime, you gotta stop the Shadows from carrying out their [quote-open-2]unbinding[quote-close-3]! Hurry! There’s no time left!
entries.translated:
[player]! Non so come sia
possibile, ma da come parlavano\lquesti tipi, gli Shadows devono

aver catturato Zapdos! Mi occuperò
di questi delinquenti. Nel\lfrattempo, devi impedire agli

Shadows di portare a termine il
loro \qoscioglimento\qc! Sbrigati! Non\lc{B4}è più tempo!

entries.original:
"[red]Gotcha! You seriously never learn,
do you, kid?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Gotcha! You seriously never learn, do you, kid?
entries.translated:
[red]Preso! Non impari mai, vero,
ragazzino?

entries.original:
"Get moving.
You’re going to want to see this\."
entries.translation_source: Get moving. You’re going to want to see this[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Muoviti. Vorrai vedere questo\.

entries.original:
"[red]All preparations have been
completed, Zeph.

You can proceed with the unbinding
when ready."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]All preparations have been completed, Zeph. You can proceed with the unbinding when ready.
entries.translated:
[red]Tutti i preparativi sono stati
completati, Zeph. Puoi procedere\lcon lo scioglimento quando sei

pronto.

entries.original:
"Thank you, Ivory.

Just\.\CC0818 one last thing, before we get
started.

Marlon\.\CC0818 where is he, exactly?"
entries.translation_source: Thank you, Ivory. Just[game-token-1][control-code-2] one last thing, before we get started. Marlon[game-token-3][control-code-4] where is he, exactly?
entries.translated:
Grazie, Ivory. Solo\.\CC0818 un{B4}ultima cosa,
prima di cominciare. Marlon\.\CC0818 dov{B4}è\lesattamente?

entries.original:
"[red]I’m sorry, Zeph, we still don’t know
where he is.

According to the Grunt who delivered
Zapdos to us, Marlon’s off dealing\lwith some unofficial business.

The Grunt said he wouldn’t clarify
any further, and I haven’t heard\lfrom him either."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’m sorry, Zeph, we still don’t know where he is. According to the Grunt who delivered Zapdos to us, Marlon’s off dealing with some unofficial business. The Grunt said he wouldn’t clarify any further, and I haven’t heard from him either.
entries.translated:
[red]Mi dispiace, Zeph, ancora non
sappiamo dov{B4}è. Secondo il Recluta\lche ci ha consegnato Zapdos, Marlon

è fuori a sbrigare degli affari non
ufficiali. La Recluta ha detto che\lnon avrebbe chiarito oltre, e

anch{B4}io non ho avuto sue notizie.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.\CC0820 he HAS been rather on edge,
lately\.

I hope he hasn’t gotten cold feet,
now of all times.

I would hate for him to miss
everything we have worked so\lhard for\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1][control-code-2] he HAS been rather on edge, lately[game-token-3] I hope he hasn’t gotten cold feet, now of all times. I would hate for him to miss everything we have worked so hard for[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Mh\.\CC0820 ultimamente è stato piuttosto
teso\. Spero non abbia avuto un\lripensamento, proprio adesso. Mi

dispiacerebbe se si perdesse tutto
ciò per cui abbiamo lavorato così\lduramente\.

entries.original:
"But either way, with or without him,
the unbinding must proceed."
entries.translation_source: But either way, with or without him, the unbinding must proceed.
entries.translated:
Ma in ogni caso, con o senza di
lui, lo scioglimento deve\lprocedere.

entries.original:
"Finally\.\CC0818 the time has come to make
our dream a reality.

Once the dark force is unbound,
I shall use its power to undo the\ltragedies of all those years ago\.

And then, at long last\.\CC0820 his smile will
finally return to me\."
entries.translation_source: Finally[game-token-1][control-code-2] the time has come to make our dream a reality. Once the dark force is unbound, I shall use its power to undo the tragedies of all those years ago[game-token-3] And then, at long last[game-token-4][control-code-5] his smile will finally return to me[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Finalmente\.\CC0818 è giunto il momento di
trasformare il nostro sogno in\lrealtà. Una volta che la forza

oscura sarà liberata, userò il suo
potere per annullare le tragedie di\ltutti quegli anni fa\. E poi,

finalmente, dopo tanto tempo\.\CC0820 il suo
sorriso tornerà finalmente da me\.

entries.original:
"The keeper of storms, Zapdos!
Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: The keeper of storms, Zapdos! Come forth!
entries.translated:
Custode delle tempeste, Zapdos!
Vieni fuori!

entries.original:
"The sacred flame, Moltres!
Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: The sacred flame, Moltres! Come forth!
entries.translated:
La fiamma sacra, Moltres! Fatti
avanti!

entries.original:
"The disciple of ice, Articuno!
Come forth!"
entries.translation_source: The disciple of ice, Articuno! Come forth!
entries.translated:
Il discepolo del ghiaccio,
Articuno! Avanti!

entries.original:
"With these three legendary bird
Pokémon assembled here alongside\lthe Prison Stone, the seal can\lbe broken."
entries.translation_source: With these three legendary bird Pokémon assembled here alongside the Prison Stone, the seal can be broken.
entries.translated:
Con questi tre Pokémon uccello
leggendari riuniti qui insieme alla\lPietra della Prigione, il sigillo

può essere spezzato.

entries.original:
"One with the shadows, one with
the night\.

A dark hole traced by a ring
of fury!

With keys of ice, fire and lightning,
let the sealed force no longer\lbe caged!"
entries.translation_source: One with the shadows, one with the night[game-token-1] A dark hole traced by a ring of fury! With keys of ice, fire and lightning, let the sealed force no longer be caged!
entries.translated:
Uno con le ombre, uno con la notte\.
Un buco oscuro tracciato da un\lanello di furia! Con chiavi di

ghiaccio, fuoco e fulmine, fa{B4} che
la forza sigillata non sia più in\lgabbia!

entries.original:
"At last, the bottle\.

With this, the dark force is mine
to command\."
entries.translation_source: At last, the bottle[game-token-1] With this, the dark force is mine to command[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Finalmente, la bottiglia\. Con
questa, la forza oscura è mia da\lcomandare\.

entries.original:
"What\.? Nothing is happening?

Why!? The bottle is open\.!"
entries.translation_source: What[game-token-1]? Nothing is happening? Why!? The bottle is open[game-token-2]!
entries.translated:
Cosa\.? Non sta succedendo nulla?
Perché!? La bottiglia è aperta\.!

entries.original: "Heh heh heh\."
entries.translation_source: Heh heh heh[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Eheh eheh eheh\.

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 who do you think you are!?

Have you tampered with the
unbinding?

Answer me!"
entries.translation_source: You[game-token-1][control-code-2] who do you think you are!? Have you tampered with the unbinding? Answer me!
entries.translated:
Tu\. \CC0820 chi credi di essere!? Hai
manomesso lo scioglimento?\lRispondimi!

entries.original:
"Who, me?

The name is Aklove.

I am just a lowly Grunt among the
Shadows, nothing more."
entries.translation_source: Who, me? The name is Aklove. I am just a lowly Grunt among the Shadows, nothing more.
entries.translated:
Chi, io? Mi chiamo Aklove. Sono
solo un umile Recluta tra le Ombre,\lniente di più.

entries.original:
"Answer my question, grunt!

What have you done!?"
entries.translation_source: Answer my question, grunt! What have you done!?
entries.translated:
Rispondi alla mia domanda, recluta!
Che cosa hai fatto!?

entries.original:
"What have I done\.?

Nothing.

The ritual itself went completely
uninterrupted.

In fact, I commend you on an
almost flawless execution.

However, there was one key
component you were missing."
entries.translation_source: What have I done[game-token-1]? Nothing. The ritual itself went completely uninterrupted. In fact, I commend you on an almost flawless execution. However, there was one key component you were missing.
entries.translated:
Cosa ho fatto\.? Niente. Il rituale
in sé è andato completamente senza\linterruzioni. Anzi, ti faccio i

complimenti per un{B4}esecuzione quasi
impeccabile. Tuttavia, c{B4}era un\lcomponente chiave che ti mancava.

entries.original:
"Missing\.?

And what, exactly, would that be?"
entries.translation_source: Missing[game-token-1]? And what, exactly, would that be?
entries.translated:
Mancante\.? E cosa, esattamente,
sarebbe?

entries.original:
"In order to release the dark force
from the Prison Bottle, naturally,\lthere needs to be somewhere for\lthat power to go.

To be exact, you need the Pokémon
that used to HOUSE the dark force\l- something, I notice, you are\lsorely lacking.

Of course, you would have known
that, had I not deleted that little\ldetail from your files.

Honestly, I hoped to manipulate you
by infiltrating your organization,\lbut I am almost disappointed - it\lwas laughably easy!

And now, you have played right into
my hands and released the Prison\lBottle for me!

All that is left is for you to
step aside.

I shall finish the unbinding myself!"
entries.translation_source: In order to release the dark force from the Prison Bottle, naturally, there needs to be somewhere for that power to go. To be exact, you need the Pokémon that used to HOUSE the dark force - something, I notice, you are sorely lacking. Of course, you would have known that, had I not deleted that little detail from your files. Honestly, I hoped to manipulate you by infiltrating your organization, but I am almost disappointed - it was laughably easy! And now, you have played right into my hands and released the Prison Bottle for me! All that is left is for you to step aside. I shall finish the unbinding myself!
entries.translated:
Per rilasciare la forza oscura
dalla Prison Bottle, naturalmente,\ldeve esserci un posto dove quel

potere possa andare. Per essere
precisi, hai bisogno del Pokémon\lche un tempo OSPITAVA la forza

oscura - qualcosa, noto, di cui sei
terribilmente sprovvisto. Certo,\ll{B4}avresti saputo, se non avessi

cancellato quel piccolo dettaglio
dai tuoi file. Onestamente, speravo\ldi manipolarti infiltrandomi nella

tua organizzazione, ma sono quasi
deluso - è stato ridicolmente\lfacile! E ora, hai fatto proprio il

mio gioco e hai rilasciato la
Prison Bottle per me! Non resta che\lfarti da parte. Finirò la

liberazione io stesso!

entries.original:
"Wha-?
How dare you make a fool of me!

You will pay for this insult!"
entries.translation_source: Wha-? How dare you make a fool of me! You will pay for this insult!
entries.translated:
Cosa-? Come osi farmi fare la
figura del pazzo! La pagherai per\lquesto insulto!

entries.original:
"Houndoom!

Teach this fool a lesson!"
entries.translation_source: Houndoom! Teach this fool a lesson!
entries.translated:
Houndoom! Dai una lezione a questo
sciocco!

entries.original:
"Hoopa!
Remove the threat!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! Remove the threat!
entries.translated: Hoopa! Elimina la minaccia!

entries.original:
"Impossible\.\CC0820 Houndoom was\.

That portal\.\CC0818 so it was you who
brought [player] into our base!"
entries.translation_source: Impossible[game-token-1][control-code-2] Houndoom was[game-token-3] That portal[game-token-4][control-code-5] so it was you who brought [player-name-6] into our base!
entries.translated:
Impossibile\.\CC0820 Houndoom era\. Quel
portale\.\CC0818 quindi sei stato tu a\lportare [player] nella nostra base!

entries.original:
"Actually, that was Hoopa acting of
its own accord.

It knew we were about to begin
the process of releasing its power,\lso in a futile act of desperation,\lit summoned [player] to rescue it\lfrom me.

For you see\.\CC0818 for reasons I cannot
fathom, it is [player], not I, that\lHoopa prefers as its Trainer.

And so, naturally, I want to see
[player] eliminated.

Once [buffer2] is gone, Hoopa will have
to accept ME as its true Trainer\.

Only then will I finally be able to
use its true power, capable of\lmoving entire landmasses\."
entries.translation_source: Actually, that was Hoopa acting of its own accord. It knew we were about to begin the process of releasing its power, so in a futile act of desperation, it summoned [player-name-1] to rescue it from me. For you see[game-token-2][control-code-3] for reasons I cannot fathom, it is [player-name-4], not I, that Hoopa prefers as its Trainer. And so, naturally, I want to see [player-name-5] eliminated. Once [buffer2-6] is gone, Hoopa will have to accept ME as its true Trainer[game-token-7] Only then will I finally be able to use its true power, capable of moving entire landmasses[game-token-8]
entries.translated:
In realtà, è stato Hoopa ad agire
di propria iniziativa. Sapeva che\lstavamo per iniziare il processo di

rilascio del suo potere, quindi in
un futile atto di disperazione, ha\levocato [player] per salvarlo da

me. Vedete\.\CC0818 per ragioni che non
riesco a comprendere, è [player],\lnon io, che Hoopa preferisce come

suo Allenatore. E così,
naturalmente, voglio vedere\l[player] eliminato. Una volta che

[buffer2] se ne sarà andato, Hoopa
dovrà accettare ME come suo vero\lAllenatore\. Solo allora potrò

finalmente usare il suo vero
potere, capace di spostare intere\lmasse continentali\.

entries.original:
"I\.\CC0820 concede\.

I cannot hope to fight a Pokémon
like that\."
entries.translation_source: I[game-token-1][control-code-2] concede[game-token-3] I cannot hope to fight a Pokémon like that[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Io\.\CC0820 mi arrendo\. Non posso sperare di
combattere contro un Pokémon così\.

entries.original:
"That is a wise decision.

Now, stand aside!"
entries.translation_source: That is a wise decision. Now, stand aside!
entries.translated:
È una decisione saggia. Ora,
mettiti da parte!

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, Ivory\.

I couldn’t\.\CC0818 finish what we started\.

But this is not the end\.\CC0818 we will find
another way to bring them back\."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, Ivory[game-token-1] I couldn’t[game-token-2][control-code-3] finish what we started[game-token-4] But this is not the end[game-token-5][control-code-6] we will find another way to bring them back[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace, Ivory\. Non sono
riuscito\.\CC0818 a finire ciò che avevamo\liniziato\. Ma non è la fine\.\CC0818 troveremo

un altro modo per riportarli
indietro\.

entries.original: "And now, let the main event begin."
entries.translation_source: And now, let the main event begin.
entries.translated:
E ora, che abbia inizio l{B4}evento
principale.

entries.original:
"Hoopa! The time has come!

Your true power is about to be
released from the Prison Bottle!

And as your Trainer, I am fully
capable of controlling it!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! The time has come! Your true power is about to be released from the Prison Bottle! And as your Trainer, I am fully capable of controlling it!
entries.translated:
Hoopa! È arrivato il momento! Il
tuo vero potere sta per essere\lliberato dalla Bottiglia della

Prigione! E, come tuo Allenatore,
sono perfettamente in grado di\lcontrollarlo!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0810 pa\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo[game-token-2][control-code-3] pa[game-token-4]
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0810 pa\.

entries.original:
"At last\. I have waited so long for
this moment\.

Hoopa!

The seal on your power has finally
been broken!"
entries.translation_source: At last[game-token-1] I have waited so long for this moment[game-token-2] Hoopa! The seal on your power has finally been broken!
entries.translated:
Finalmente\. Ho aspettato così a
lungo questo momento\. Hoopa! Il\lsigillo del tuo potere è stato

finalmente spezzato!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo hoo hoo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo hoo hoo!
entries.translated: [green]Hoo hoo hoo!

entries.original:
"Aklove! Tell me!

What reason could you have for
doing any of this?

If we share a common goal, perhaps
we can work together!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove! Tell me! What reason could you have for doing any of this? If we share a common goal, perhaps we can work together!
entries.translated:
Aklove! Dimmi! Che motivo potresti
avere per fare tutto questo? Se\lcondividiamo un obiettivo comune,

forse possiamo lavorare insieme!

entries.original:
"Fool\.\CC0818 our goals are inevitably at
odds.

I am a descendant of the so-called
\qoforeign king\qc from the great war.

My goal is simply to finish what he
started - and win the war.

With Hoopa’s power now unbound, I
will bring the weapon he created,\land use it to rain fire and\ldestruction across Borrius!

Then, finally, his suffering can
be at its end\.

Now, tell me, Zeph.
What were your goals?"
entries.translation_source: Fool[game-token-1][control-code-2] our goals are inevitably at odds. I am a descendant of the so-called [quote-open-3]foreign king[quote-close-4] from the great war. My goal is simply to finish what he started - and win the war. With Hoopa’s power now unbound, I will bring the weapon he created, and use it to rain fire and destruction across Borrius! Then, finally, his suffering can be at its end[game-token-5] Now, tell me, Zeph. What were your goals?
entries.translated:
Stolto\.\CC0818 i nostri obiettivi sono
inevitabilmente in conflitto. Sono\lun discendente del cosiddetto \qore

straniero\qc della grande guerra. Il
mio obiettivo è semplicemente\lfinire ciò che lui ha iniziato e

vincere la guerra. Con il potere di
Hoopa ora scatenato, porterò l{B4}arma\lche ha creato e la userò per far

piovere fuoco e distruzione su
Borrius! Poi, finalmente, la sua\lsofferenza può giungere al termine\.

Ora, dimmi, Zeph. Quali erano i
tuoi obiettivi?

entries.original:
"My goals?

There was only one\.\CC0820 one I always
kept at the forefront of my mind\.

It was\.\CC0820 to see him again\.

My little boy\."
entries.translation_source: My goals? There was only one[game-token-1][control-code-2] one I always kept at the forefront of my mind[game-token-3] It was[game-token-4][control-code-5] to see him again[game-token-6] My little boy[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
I miei obiettivi? Ce n{B4}era solo uno\.\CC0820
uno che ho sempre tenuto in cima ai\lmiei pensieri\. Era\.\CC0820 rivederlo\. Il mio

piccolo ragazzo\.

entries.original:
"Ah\.\CC0818 what a waste\.\CC0818 such great
power, for such a meagre wish\.

You lack ambition, Zeph!"
entries.translation_source: Ah[game-token-1][control-code-2] what a waste[game-token-3][control-code-4] such great power, for such a meagre wish[game-token-5] You lack ambition, Zeph!
entries.translated:
Ah\.\CC0818 che spreco\.\CC0818 un potere così
grande, per un desiderio così\lmisero\. Ti manca ambizione, Zeph!

entries.original:
"Enough of this!
Remove yourself from my presence.

The Shadows are finished.

It is time for Borrius to see
the light\.\CC0818 the Light of Ruin!

Ah, but first\.

I see that our guest of honour has
deigned to join us.

Grunts, bring [buffer1] to me."
entries.translation_source: Enough of this! Remove yourself from my presence. The Shadows are finished. It is time for Borrius to see the light[game-token-1][control-code-2] the Light of Ruin! Ah, but first[game-token-3] I see that our guest of honour has deigned to join us. Grunts, bring [buffer1-4] to me.
entries.translated:
Basta così! Togliti dalla mia
presenza. Le Ombre sono finite. È\ltempo che Borrius veda la luce\.\CC0818 la

Luce della Rovina! Ah, ma prima\.
Vedo che il nostro ospite d{B4}onore\lsi è degnato di unirsi a noi.

Reclute, portatemi [buffer1].

entries.original: "My grunts\."
entries.translation_source: My grunts[game-token-1]
entries.translated: I miei scagnozzi\.

entries.original:
"Is this truly so surprising, Zeph?

You and I both know that you are
not the ultimate authority here.

I have gone above you\.

I have spoken with Fey.

And she has agreed that as long as I
provide her with a small sample of\lHoopa’s power to study, I will be\lgranted control of her Shadow\lbranch to do with as I please."
entries.translation_source: Is this truly so surprising, Zeph? You and I both know that you are not the ultimate authority here. I have gone above you[game-token-1] I have spoken with Fey. And she has agreed that as long as I provide her with a small sample of Hoopa’s power to study, I will be granted control of her Shadow branch to do with as I please.
entries.translated:
È davvero così sorprendente, Zeph?
Tu ed io sappiamo entrambi che non\lsei l{B4}autorità suprema qui. Sono

salito sopra di te\. Ho parlato con
Fey. E lei ha accettato che, finché\lle fornisco un piccolo campione del

potere di Hoopa da studiare, mi
verrà concesso il controllo del suo\lramo Ombra, da usare come meglio

credo.

entries.original:
"But this is\.

THIS IS MY ORGANIZATION!

I founded the company, and this
branch was only allowed to exist\lbecause I approved it!

I may have retired and handed over
the reins, but that does not mean\lI can simply be\.\CC0818 replaced!

She and I had a deal!"
entries.translation_source: But this is[game-token-1] THIS IS MY ORGANIZATION! I founded the company, and this branch was only allowed to exist because I approved it! I may have retired and handed over the reins, but that does not mean I can simply be[game-token-2][control-code-3] replaced! She and I had a deal!
entries.translated:
Ma questo è\. QUESTA È LA MIA
ORGANIZZAZIONE! Ho fondato la\lsocietà, e questa filiale ha potuto

esistere solo perché l{B4}ho approvata
io! Potrei anche essermi ritirato e\laver ceduto le redini, ma questo

non significa che io possa
semplicemente essere\.\CC0818 sostituito!\lLei e io avevamo un accordo!

entries.original:
"A deal which, need I remind you,
you transgressed, Zeph.

And no one is irreplaceable in an
organization - not even you.

But enough of this.

Nothing you can say will change
the outcome of these events.

And now\."
entries.translation_source: A deal which, need I remind you, you transgressed, Zeph. And no one is irreplaceable in an organization - not even you. But enough of this. Nothing you can say will change the outcome of these events. And now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Un affare che, permettimi di
ricordartelo, hai infranto, Zeph. E\lnessuno è insostituibile in

un{B4}organizzazione, nemmeno tu. Ma
basta con questa storia. Nulla di\lciò che puoi dire cambierà l{B4}esito

di questi eventi. E ora\.

entries.original:
"[player]\.

I can finally have the satisfaction
of eliminating you once and\lfor all.

You have been a repeated nuisance
to the Shadows\.

And I cannot have you becoming
a nuisance to me as well."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1][game-token-2] I can finally have the satisfaction of eliminating you once and for all. You have been a repeated nuisance to the Shadows[game-token-3] And I cannot have you becoming a nuisance to me as well.
entries.translated:
[player]\. Posso finalmente avere la
soddisfazione di eliminarti una\lvolta per tutte. Sei stato una

seccatura ricorrente per gli
Shadows\. E non posso permettermi che\ltu lo diventi anche per me.

entries.original:
"Hoopa!

Summon a Pokémon to crush this fool!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! Summon a Pokémon to crush this fool!
entries.translated:
Hoopa! Evoca un Pokémon per
schiacciare questo idiota!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] flew back into
the portal."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] flew back into the portal.
entries.translated:
[black]Il [buffer1] è volato di nuovo nel
portale.

entries.original:
"What\.?
You actually defeated it?"
entries.translation_source: What[game-token-1]? You actually defeated it?
entries.translated: Cosa\.? L{B4}hai davvero sconfitto?

entries.original: "Summon another, Hoopa!"
entries.translation_source: Summon another, Hoopa!
entries.translated: Evocane un altro, Hoopa!

entries.original:
"Is that truly your best, Hoopa?

Perhaps I should have simply done it
myself\."
entries.translation_source: Is that truly your best, Hoopa? Perhaps I should have simply done it myself[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
È davvero il massimo che sai fare,
Hoopa? Forse avrei dovuto\lsemplicemente farlo io\.

entries.original:
"[player]! You have been an eyesore
for too long!

However, no matter how strong you
may be, I still have my trump card."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You have been an eyesore for too long! However, no matter how strong you may be, I still have my trump card.
entries.translated:
[player]! Sei stato un fastidio per
troppo tempo! Però, per quanto tu\lpossa essere forte, ho ancora il

mio asso nella manica.

entries.original:
"When I was granted control of these
grunts, it came with a request.

My beneficiary seems to have taken
an interest in you, [player].

Which is why\.

\.I have been instructed to seal you
inside this very Cube!"
entries.translation_source: When I was granted control of these grunts, it came with a request. My beneficiary seems to have taken an interest in you, [player-name-1]. Which is why[game-token-2] [game-token-3]I have been instructed to seal you inside this very Cube!
entries.translated:
Quando mi è stato affidato il
comando di queste reclute, venne\lcon una richiesta. Il mio

benefattore sembra essersi
interessato a te, [player]. È per\lquesto che\. \.mi è stato ordinato di

sigillarti dentro proprio questo
Cubo!

entries.original:
"No\. you can’t be serious\.

The Cube would never accept live
organic matter!

I would know\.\CC0818 I built in the security
measures, myself!"
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1] you can’t be serious[game-token-2] The Cube would never accept live organic matter! I would know[game-token-3][control-code-4] I built in the security measures, myself!
entries.translated:
No\. non puoi fare sul serio\. Il Cubo
non accetterebbe mai materia\lorganica viva! Lo saprei\.\CC0818 Ho

costruito io stesso le misure di
sicurezza!

entries.original:
"Heh\. you really have not kept
yourself up to speed since you\lretired, have you?

Fey has done marvelous work on this
special Cube of hers.

So watch carefully, Zeph - watch
just how far your invention has come!"
entries.translation_source: Heh[game-token-1] you really have not kept yourself up to speed since you retired, have you? Fey has done marvelous work on this special Cube of hers. So watch carefully, Zeph - watch just how far your invention has come!
entries.translated:
Eh\. non ti sei proprio tenuto al
passo da quando sei andato in\lpensione, vero? Fey ha fatto un

lavoro meraviglioso su questo suo
Cubo speciale. Quindi osserva bene,\lZeph - guarda fin dove è arrivata

la tua invenzione!

entries.original:
"Aklove, don’t proceed with this!

What you’re attempting\.\CC0818 could very
well end [player]’s life!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove, don’t proceed with this! What you’re attempting[game-token-1][control-code-2] could very well end [player-name-3]’s life!
entries.translated:
Aklove, non andare avanti con
questo! Quello che stai tentando\.\CC0818\lpotrebbe benissimo costare la vita

a [player]!

entries.original:
"If that truly is the case, whether
[buffer2] goes now or when the weapon is\lfired, makes no difference to me."
entries.translation_source: If that truly is the case, whether [buffer2-1] goes now or when the weapon is fired, makes no difference to me.
entries.translated:
Se davvero è così, per me non fa
alcuna differenza se [buffer2] se ne\lva adesso o quando l{B4}arma viene

sparata.

entries.original:
"And before you think you can escape
this, [player]\.

Be aware\.\CC0820 I know where your
mother lives.

I cannot guarantee her safety should
you attack me or flee\."
entries.translation_source: And before you think you can escape this, [player-name-1][game-token-2] Be aware[game-token-3][control-code-4] I know where your mother lives. I cannot guarantee her safety should you attack me or flee[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
E prima che tu pensi di poter
scappare da tutto questo, [player]\.\lSappi bene\.\CC0820 che so dove vive tua

madre. Non posso garantire la sua
incolumità se mi attaccherai o se\lfuggirai\.

entries.original:
"Good, so you will be cooperative.

Then this is goodbye, [player].
May we never meet again."
entries.translation_source: Good, so you will be cooperative. Then this is goodbye, [player-name-1]. May we never meet again.
entries.translated:
Bene, quindi sarai collaborativo.
Allora questo è un addio, [player].\lChe non ci si incontri mai più.

entries.original:
"PAYLOAD RECEIVED.

PROCESSING.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: PAYLOAD RECEIVED. PROCESSING.[control-code-1].[control-code-2].[control-code-3]
entries.translated: CARICO RICEVUTO. ELABORAZIONE.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830

entries.original:
"PROCESSING COMPLETE.

SENTIENT MATTER DETECTED.

COPYING.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830"
entries.translation_source: PROCESSING COMPLETE. SENTIENT MATTER DETECTED. COPYING.[control-code-1].[control-code-2].[control-code-3]
entries.translated:
ELABORAZIONE COMPLETATA. MATERIA
SENZIENTE RILEVATA. COPIANDO.\CC0830.\CC0830.\CC0830

entries.original:
"ENTRY H005 HAS BEEN COPIED
SUCCESSFULLY.

THE DATA HAS BEEN UPLOADED TO
THE MAINFRAME."
entries.translation_source: ENTRY H005 HAS BEEN COPIED SUCCESSFULLY. THE DATA HAS BEEN UPLOADED TO THE MAINFRAME.
entries.translated:
LA VOCE H005 È STATA COPIATA CON
SUCCESSO. I DATI SONO STATI\lCARICATI NEL MAINFRAME.

entries.original:
"I can’t believe my eyes\.

You\.\CC0818 you’re\.\CC0818 you’re my [buffer3]\.

[player]\.

No matter how old you get, I’ll
always recognize you!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t believe my eyes[game-token-1] You[game-token-2][control-code-3] you’re[game-token-4][control-code-5] you’re my [buffer3-6][game-token-7] [player-name-8][game-token-9] No matter how old you get, I’ll always recognize you!
entries.translated:
Non posso credere ai miei occhi\. Tu\.\CC0818
sei\.\CC0818 sei il mio [buffer3]\. [player]\.\lNon importa quanti anni tu abbia,

ti riconoscerò sempre!

entries.original: "Oh, they got to you too, huh?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, they got to you too, huh?
entries.translated: Oh, hanno preso anche te, eh?

entries.original:
"Marlon, how do you know my
[buffer3]?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, how do you know my [buffer3-1]?
entries.translated:
Marlon, come conosci il mio
[buffer3]?

entries.original:
"We’ve run into each other a few
times now.

Your [buffer3] seems to have the
same sense of justice as you\.

Always running in blindly when
[buffer2]’s not wanted\."
entries.translation_source: We’ve run into each other a few times now. Your [buffer3-1] seems to have the same sense of justice as you[game-token-2] Always running in blindly when [buffer2-3]’s not wanted[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Ci siamo già imbattuti l{B4}uno
nell{B4}altro un paio di volte ormai.\lIl tuo [buffer3] sembra avere il tuo

stesso senso della giustizia\. Si
butta sempre a capofitto quando\l[buffer2] non serve\.

entries.original:
"Then, I guess you turned out just
as I hoped you would, [player].

I’m so proud, I’m at a loss
for words\."
entries.translation_source: Then, I guess you turned out just as I hoped you would, [player-name-1]. I’m so proud, I’m at a loss for words[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Allora, immagino che tu sia
diventato proprio come speravo,\l[player]. Sono così orgoglioso che

resto senza parole\.

entries.original: "Whoa, watch out!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa, watch out!
entries.translated: Ehi, attenzione!

entries.original:
"You need to be mindful of your
surroundings in here, [player].

Items from many different Trainers
are constantly arriving, so you\lcan never know when one is going\lto come flying out of nowhere!"
entries.translation_source: You need to be mindful of your surroundings in here, [player-name-1]. Items from many different Trainers are constantly arriving, so you can never know when one is going to come flying out of nowhere!
entries.translated:
Devi stare attento a ciò che ti
circonda qui dentro, [player]. Gli\loggetti di molti Allenatori diversi

arrivano di continuo, quindi non
puoi mai sapere quando uno verrà\lscagliato fuori dal nulla!

entries.original:
"But for now, I think we’re in
the clear.

These platforms are usually safe
for us to stand on.

Not that they’re meant for us,
of course.

As I’m sure you guessed, this place
wasn’t designed for human life.

Sending people here is something
that shouldn’t even be possible\."
entries.translation_source: But for now, I think we’re in the clear. These platforms are usually safe for us to stand on. Not that they’re meant for us, of course. As I’m sure you guessed, this place wasn’t designed for human life. Sending people here is something that shouldn’t even be possible[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ma per ora, credo che siamo fuori
pericolo. Di solito queste\lpiattaforme sono sicure su cui

stare. Non che siano pensate per
noi, ovviamente. Come avrai\lsicuramente capito, questo posto

non è stato progettato per la vita
umana. Mandare persone qui è\lqualcosa che non dovrebbe nemmeno

essere possibile\.

entries.original:
"Oh, I forgot to ask.
How did you wind up in here, too?

And did Hoopa ever make contact
with you?

Marlon tells me it’s been 16 years
since I was trapped in here, so you\lmust have seen Hoopa by now.

\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I forgot to ask. How did you wind up in here, too? And did Hoopa ever make contact with you? Marlon tells me it’s been 16 years since I was trapped in here, so you must have seen Hoopa by now. [game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh, mi ero dimenticato di
chiedertelo. Come sei finito anche\ltu qui dentro? E Hoopa ti ha mai

contattato? Marlon mi dice che sono
passati 16 anni da quando sono\lrimasto intrappolato qui dentro,

quindi a questo punto devi aver
visto Hoopa. \.

entries.original:
"Oh\.\CC0818 poor Hoopa\.

I never intended for that to
happen to it\.

I was trying to protect it when I
threw it in the ocean, but it seems\lit ended up in danger anyway\.

\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1][control-code-2] poor Hoopa[game-token-3] I never intended for that to happen to it[game-token-4] I was trying to protect it when I threw it in the ocean, but it seems it ended up in danger anyway[game-token-5] [game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Oh\.\CC0818 povero Hoopa\. Non avevo alcuna
intenzione che gli accadesse una\lcosa del genere\. Stavo cercando di

proteggerlo quando l{B4}ho gettato
nell{B4}oceano, ma sembra che sia\lfinito in pericolo lo stesso\. \.

entries.original:
"Marlon, from what I understand,
the Shadow Warrior project is\lstill ongoing\.?

16 years\.\CC0818 and you continued to
inflict such cruelty, on both\lpeople and Pokémon!?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, from what I understand, the Shadow Warrior project is still ongoing[game-token-1]? 16 years[game-token-2][control-code-3] and you continued to inflict such cruelty, on both people and Pokémon!?
entries.translated:
Marlon, da quello che so, il
progetto Shadow Warrior è ancora in\lcorso\.? 16 anni\.\CC0818 e hai continuato a

infliggere una crudeltà simile, sia
alle persone sia ai Pokémon!?

entries.original:
"We were desperate, Aros!

And there was no denying the
improvements with each experiment.

We were getting so, so close\."
entries.translation_source: We were desperate, Aros! And there was no denying the improvements with each experiment. We were getting so, so close[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Eravamo disperati, Aros! E non si
potevano negare i miglioramenti a\logni esperimento. Eravamo così,

così vicini\.

entries.original:
"I know your intentions were good,
Marlon.

But even the worst of men had good
intentions at one point.

And unfortunately, the harm you
inflicted outweighs the good you\lthought you would bring about with\lyour actions!

Why can’t you see that?"
entries.translation_source: I know your intentions were good, Marlon. But even the worst of men had good intentions at one point. And unfortunately, the harm you inflicted outweighs the good you thought you would bring about with your actions! Why can’t you see that?
entries.translated:
So che le tue intenzioni erano
buone, Marlon. Ma perfino gli\luomini peggiori avevano buone

intenzioni, a un certo punto. E
purtroppo, il danno che hai causato\lsupera il bene che pensavi di

portare con le tue azioni! Perché
non riesci a vederlo?

entries.original:
"Of course I’m aware of the harm
we caused!

Were it up to me, our research
would have been restricted to\lPokémon that wouldn’t have been\lhurt by the process.

But Fey\.\CC0818 she insisted we branch out,
use different species of Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: Of course I’m aware of the harm we caused! Were it up to me, our research would have been restricted to Pokémon that wouldn’t have been hurt by the process. But Fey[game-token-1][control-code-2] she insisted we branch out, use different species of Pokémon[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Naturalmente sono consapevole del
danno che abbiamo causato! Se fosse\ldipeso da me, la nostra ricerca si

sarebbe limitata ai Pokémon che non
sarebbero stati feriti dal\lprocesso. Ma Fey\.\CC0818 insistette perché

ampliassimo il campo, usando specie
diverse di Pokémon\.

entries.original:
"That witch!

She’s the reason I’m even in here
at all!

I knew, from the moment she saw
Hoopa, that she had a growing\lobsession with it.

That’s why I cast Hoopa’s Poké Ball
out to sea\.\CC0818 trying to put it\lout of her reach.

When I met with her on the bridge
that day, she asked about Hoopa.

I tried to play it cool, saying I no
longer had it\.

But when she heard that, she took a
Cube from her pocket, and\.\CC0818 well\.

\.

Wait\.\CC0818 was it because I opposed the
Shadow Warrior Project?

After I discovered its existence,
I secretly began sabotaging your\lwork night after night\.

But no, that can’t be\.\CC0818 I
shouldn’t even be alive were that\lthe case\."
entries.translation_source: That witch! She’s the reason I’m even in here at all! I knew, from the moment she saw Hoopa, that she had a growing obsession with it. That’s why I cast Hoopa’s Poké Ball out to sea[game-token-1][control-code-2] trying to put it out of her reach. When I met with her on the bridge that day, she asked about Hoopa. I tried to play it cool, saying I no longer had it[game-token-3] But when she heard that, she took a Cube from her pocket, and[game-token-4][control-code-5] well[game-token-6] [game-token-7] Wait[game-token-8][control-code-9] was it because I opposed the Shadow Warrior Project? After I discovered its existence, I secretly began sabotaging your work night after night[game-token-10] But no, that can’t be[game-token-11][control-code-12] I shouldn’t even be alive were that the case[game-token-13]
entries.translated:
Quella strega! È lei il motivo per
cui sono qui dentro! Sapevo, dal\lmomento in cui ha visto Hoopa, che

aveva una crescente ossessione per
lui. Ecco perché ho gettato la Poké\lBall di Hoopa in mare\.\CC0818 cercando di

tenerlo fuori dalla sua portata.
Quando l{B4}ho incontrata sul ponte\lquel giorno, ha chiesto di Hoopa.

Ho cercato di fare il vago, dicendo
che non lo avevo più\. Ma quando l{B4}ha\lsentito, ha preso un Cubo dalla

tasca e\.\CC0818 beh\. \. Aspetta\.\CC0818 è stato perché
mi sono opposto al Progetto\lGuerriero Ombra? Dopo aver scoperto

la sua esistenza, ho iniziato
segretamente a sabotare il tuo\llavoro notte dopo notte\. Ma no, non

può essere\.\CC0818 non dovrei nemmeno
essere vivo se fosse così\.

entries.original:
"Whatever her reasoning was, Aros,
she certainly didn’t tell us\lanything.

We weren’t even aware you were
alive at all."
entries.translation_source: Whatever her reasoning was, Aros, she certainly didn’t tell us anything. We weren’t even aware you were alive at all.
entries.translated:
Qualunque fosse il suo
ragionamento, Aros, certamente non\lci ha detto niente. Non sapevamo

nemmeno che fossi ancora vivo.

entries.original:
"If you can call this living.

We’re nothing but data right now,
so are we really alive?

How do we know we aren’t copies of
our real selves, and our physical\lbodies are gone forever\.?"
entries.translation_source: If you can call this living. We’re nothing but data right now, so are we really alive? How do we know we aren’t copies of our real selves, and our physical bodies are gone forever[game-token-1]?
entries.translated:
Se si può chiamare questa vita. Al
momento non siamo altro che dati,\lquindi siamo davvero vivi? Come

facciamo a sapere che non siamo
copie dei nostri veri io, e che i\lnostri corpi fisici sono scomparsi

per sempre\.?

entries.original: "What’s going on?"
entries.translation_source: What’s going on?
entries.translated: Che sta succedendo?

entries.original:
"Oh, that happens every so often.

It means the Cube is about to
begin the sorting process.

Soon, we’ll be whisked away to
