some other Cube sector.

You’ll get used to it eventually."
entries.translation_source: Oh, that happens every so often. It means the Cube is about to begin the sorting process. Soon, we’ll be whisked away to some other Cube sector. You’ll get used to it eventually.
entries.translated:
Oh, succede ogni tanto. Significa
che il Cubo sta per iniziare il\lprocesso di smistamento. Presto

verremo trasportati in qualche
altro settore del Cubo. Prima o poi\lti ci abituerai.

entries.original:
"Eventually\.?

Don’t tell me we’re trapped here!

Is there really no way out!?"
entries.translation_source: Eventually[game-token-1]? Don’t tell me we’re trapped here! Is there really no way out!?
entries.translated:
Alla fine\.? Non dirmi che siamo
intrappolati qui! Non c{B4}è davvero\lnessuna via d{B4}uscita!?

entries.original:
"If there was, I’d have freed
myself ages ago, Marlon.

I’ve tried everything, so unless
you’ve thought of something I\lhaven’t, better get used to your\lnew digital life.

Sigh\.

It’s not all bad, though.

At least we don’t need to eat
or sleep!"
entries.translation_source: If there was, I’d have freed myself ages ago, Marlon. I’ve tried everything, so unless you’ve thought of something I haven’t, better get used to your new digital life. Sigh[game-token-1] It’s not all bad, though. At least we don’t need to eat or sleep!
entries.translated:
Se ci fosse, mi sarei già liberato
da un pezzo, Marlon. Ho provato di\ltutto, quindi a meno che tu non

abbia pensato a qualcosa che a me è
sfuggito, è meglio che ti abitui\lalla tua nuova vita digitale. Sigh\.

Non è tutto così male, però. Almeno
non dobbiamo mangiare né dormire!

entries.original:
"I really wish I could’ve gotten to
know you better, [player].

Maybe if we get lucky, we’ll wind
up together again someday\."
entries.translation_source: I really wish I could’ve gotten to know you better, [player-name-1]. Maybe if we get lucky, we’ll wind up together again someday[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Vorrei davvero aver avuto modo di
conoscerti meglio, [player]. Forse,\lse siamo fortunati, finiremo di

nuovo insieme un giorno\.

entries.original:
"It can’t be\.
Is that\.\CC0818 a Cube V3?

\.

It is!"
entries.translation_source: It can’t be[game-token-1] Is that[game-token-2][control-code-3] a Cube V3? [game-token-4] It is!
entries.translated:
Non può essere\. È quello\.\CC0818 un Cube V3?
\. Lo è!

entries.original: "Marlon, do you have one, too?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, do you have one, too?
entries.translated: Marlon, ne hai uno anche tu?

entries.original:
"I do, yes.

But what does that have to
do with\.?"
entries.translation_source: I do, yes. But what does that have to do with[game-token-1]?
entries.translated: Sì, è così. Ma che c{B4}entra con\.?

entries.original:
"I think I know how to free you,
but only if I’m right about this\lplace being the third version\lcreated of Cube Space.

I’m pretty sure I am, though -
when I was first sent here,\lthe place was devoid of items.

The Cube V3 had only just been
revealed to the public, but no one\lhad access to it yet.

It didn’t take long to figure out
I’d been trapped in a more\ladvanced Cube Space.

I came up with a plan to free
myself, but my own Cube’s an\loutdated V2.

But as for you two\.\CC0818
I think this can work!"
entries.translation_source: I think I know how to free you, but only if I’m right about this place being the third version created of Cube Space. I’m pretty sure I am, though - when I was first sent here, the place was devoid of items. The Cube V3 had only just been revealed to the public, but no one had access to it yet. It didn’t take long to figure out I’d been trapped in a more advanced Cube Space. I came up with a plan to free myself, but my own Cube’s an outdated V2. But as for you two[game-token-1][control-code-2] I think this can work!
entries.translated:
Credo di sapere come liberarti, ma
solo se ho ragione sul fatto che\lquesto posto sia la terza versione

creata di Cube Space. Anche se sono
abbastanza sicuro di sì: quando\lsono stato mandato qui per la prima

volta, il posto era privo di
oggetti. La Cube V3 era stata\lappena svelata al pubblico, ma

nessuno vi aveva ancora accesso.
Non ci volle molto per capire che\lero rimasto intrappolato in una

Cube Space più avanzata. Ho ideato
un piano per liberarmi, ma la mia\lCube è una vecchia V2. Ma per voi

due\.\CC0818 credo che possa funzionare!

entries.original:
"What do we need to do, Aros?
Hurry, we can’t have much time left!"
entries.translation_source: What do we need to do, Aros? Hurry, we can’t have much time left!
entries.translated:
Cosa dobbiamo fare, Aros? Sbrigati,
non ci resta molto tempo!

entries.original:
"Hand me your Cubes.

I’ll make the necessary modifications
for your escape.

If I’m correct, opening your Cubes
in here will cause a chain reaction,\lone that’ll forcibly eject you from\lCube Space."
entries.translation_source: Hand me your Cubes. I’ll make the necessary modifications for your escape. If I’m correct, opening your Cubes in here will cause a chain reaction, one that’ll forcibly eject you from Cube Space.
entries.translated:
Dammi i tuoi Cubi. Apporterò le
modifiche necessarie per la tua\lfuga. Se ho ragione, aprire i tuoi

Cubi qui dentro causerà una
reazione a catena, una che ti\lespellerà con la forza dallo Spazio

Cubico.

entries.original:
"Are you sure about this, Aros?
Will this actually break us out?"
entries.translation_source: Are you sure about this, Aros? Will this actually break us out?
entries.translated:
Sei sicuro di questo, Aros? Ci farà
davvero evadere?

entries.original:
"Either that, or your digital selves
will be destroyed forever.

No biggie.

Don’t worry - I rate your survival
odds as being higher than not."
entries.translation_source: Either that, or your digital selves will be destroyed forever. No biggie. Don’t worry - I rate your survival odds as being higher than not.
entries.translated:
O altrimenti i vostri sé digitali
verranno distrutti per sempre. Roba\lda niente. Non preoccuparti - stimo

le tue probabilità di sopravvivenza
più alte che basse.

entries.original: "Oh, THAT’S comforting\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, THAT’S comforting[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Oh, che rassicurante\.

entries.original:
"\.

If this works\.\CC0818 promise me something,
Marlon.

You’ll lay to rest the Pokémon that
you’ve turned into Shadow Warriors.

And you’ll end the Shadow Warrior
Project once and for all."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] If this works[game-token-2][control-code-3] promise me something, Marlon. You’ll lay to rest the Pokémon that you’ve turned into Shadow Warriors. And you’ll end the Shadow Warrior Project once and for all.
entries.translated:
\. Se questo funziona\.\CC0818 promettimi una
cosa, Marlon. Darai il meritato\lriposo ai Pokémon che hai

trasformato in Guerrieri Ombra. E
porrai fine una volta per tutte al\lProgetto Guerriero Ombra.

entries.original:
"\.\CC0840Alright.

You have my word.

I doubt we’ll be making any more
as it is\.

The fact I’m trapped here clearly
shows the Science Society has\lterminated our partnership.

But, what about you?
Are you not coming with us?"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1][control-code-2]Alright. You have my word. I doubt we’ll be making any more as it is[game-token-3] The fact I’m trapped here clearly shows the Science Society has terminated our partnership. But, what about you? Are you not coming with us?
entries.translated:
\.\CC0840Va bene. Hai la mia parola. Dubito
che ne faremo altre, ormai\. Il fatto\lche io sia bloccato qui dimostra

chiaramente che la Società
Scientifica ha interrotto la nostra\lcollaborazione. Ma tu? Non vieni

con noi?

entries.original:
"I can’t\.

At least not without a Cube V3 of
my own.

In order for me to escape, someone
on the outside has to let me out."
entries.translation_source: I can’t[game-token-1] At least not without a Cube V3 of my own. In order for me to escape, someone on the outside has to let me out.
entries.translated:
Non posso\. Almeno non senza un mio
Cube V3. Per riuscire a scappare,\lqualcuno fuori deve farmi uscire.

entries.original:
"And [player]\.
I wish we had more time to talk.

If only we were meeting under
better circumstances\."
entries.translation_source: And [player-name-1][game-token-2] I wish we had more time to talk. If only we were meeting under better circumstances[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
E [player]\. Vorrei che avessimo più
tempo per parlare. Se solo ci\lincontrassimo in circostanze

migliori\.

entries.original:
"I’ll keep this brief - help Marlon
end the Shadow Warrior Project.

From what I remember, they’re highly
sensitive to light, so exposing them\lshould lay their souls to rest.

And above all else, save Hoopa.

The longer its power remains unbound,
the more it loses its sense of self.

Confine its power, and you can return
it to how it used to be."
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep this brief - help Marlon end the Shadow Warrior Project. From what I remember, they’re highly sensitive to light, so exposing them should lay their souls to rest. And above all else, save Hoopa. The longer its power remains unbound, the more it loses its sense of self. Confine its power, and you can return it to how it used to be.
entries.translated:
La faccio breve: aiuta Marlon a
porre fine allo Shadow Warrior\lProject. Per quanto ricordo, sono

estremamente sensibili alla luce,
quindi esporli dovrebbe finalmente\lplacare le loro anime. E

soprattutto, salva Hoopa. Più a
lungo il suo potere resta libero,\lpiù perde il senso di sé.

Imprigiona il suo potere, e potrai
riportarlo a com{B4}era prima.

entries.original:
"Alright, I’m done.

I’ve set your coordinates to
Cinder Volcano.

If you make it out, it shouldn’t
take long for you to reach the\lShadow Warriors.

And as thanks in advance, I took the
liberty of giving back what you\llost because of them, Marlon\."
entries.translation_source: Alright, I’m done. I’ve set your coordinates to Cinder Volcano. If you make it out, it shouldn’t take long for you to reach the Shadow Warriors. And as thanks in advance, I took the liberty of giving back what you lost because of them, Marlon[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Bene, ho finito. Ho impostato le
tue coordinate su Cinder Volcano.\lSe riesci a uscirne, non dovrebbe

volerci molto per raggiungere i
Shadow Warriors. E come\lringraziamento anticipato, mi sono

preso la libertà di restituirti
quello che hai perso a causa loro,\lMarlon\.

entries.original: "No\. that shouldn’t be possible\."
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1] that shouldn’t be possible[game-token-2]
entries.translated: No\. non dovrebbe essere possibile\.

entries.original:
"Never mind!

You’re running out of time!
You have to go, now!"
entries.translation_source: Never mind! You’re running out of time! You have to go, now!
entries.translated:
Lascia perdere! Stai finendo il
tempo! Devi andare, adesso!

entries.original:
"Aros\.\CC0818 I promise I’ll end this\.

And when I do, I swear I’ll return
for you.

I swear!"
entries.translation_source: Aros[game-token-1][control-code-2] I promise I’ll end this[game-token-3] And when I do, I swear I’ll return for you. I swear!
entries.translated:
Aros\.\CC0818 ti prometto che finirò tutto
questo\. E quando lo farò, giuro che\ltornerò da te. Lo giuro!

entries.original:
"Goodbye, Marlon, [player]\.

Don’t forget what you promised me!"
entries.translation_source: Goodbye, Marlon, [player-name-1][game-token-2] Don’t forget what you promised me!
entries.translated:
Addio, Marlon, [player]\. Non
dimenticare ciò che mi hai\lpromesso!

entries.original:
"I don’t know who you are, but
you’re not getting past me, too!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t know who you are, but you’re not getting past me, too!
entries.translated:
Non so chi tu sia, ma non passerai
nemmeno tu da me!

entries.original:
"\.[player]?

But\.\CC0818 but\.\CC0818 but you’re supposed to
be out of the picture!

How is this possible?

I need to warn the others!"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1][player-name-2]? But[game-token-3][control-code-4] but[game-token-5][control-code-6] but you’re supposed to be out of the picture! How is this possible? I need to warn the others!
entries.translated:
\.[player]? Ma\.\CC0818 ma\.\CC0818 ma dovresti essere
fuori dai giochi! Com{B4}è possibile?\lDevo avvertire gli altri!

entries.original: "[red]Ughhhhh\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Ughhhhh[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [red]Ughhhhh\.

entries.original: "[red]Oh no no no no!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Oh no no no no!
entries.translated: [red]Oh no no no no!

entries.original: "[red]Véga, sir!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Véga, sir!
entries.translated: [red]Véga, signore!

entries.original:
"Véga!

What’s the meaning of this?"
entries.translation_source: Véga! What’s the meaning of this?
entries.translated: Véga! Che significa tutto questo?

entries.original:
"Marlon?

I was informed that you’d been
disposed of\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon? I was informed that you’d been disposed of[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Marlon? Mi è stato riferito che eri
stato eliminato\.

entries.original:
"I don’t care what you were told!

The rest of the Shadow Warriors\.\CC0818
what have you done with them!?"
entries.translation_source: I don’t care what you were told! The rest of the Shadow Warriors[game-token-1][control-code-2] what have you done with them!?
entries.translated:
Non m{B4}importa di quello che ti
hanno detto! Il resto dei Guerrieri\lOmbra\.\CC0818 che ne hai fatto!?

entries.original:
"The Shadow Warriors?

Fey deemed this place unsafe for
them after the previous incident.

Most of them have already been
moved somewhere more secure."
entries.translation_source: The Shadow Warriors? Fey deemed this place unsafe for them after the previous incident. Most of them have already been moved somewhere more secure.
entries.translated:
I Guerrieri Ombra? Fey ha ritenuto
questo posto non sicuro per loro\ldopo il precedente incidente. La

maggior parte di loro è già stata
trasferita in un luogo più sicuro.

entries.original: "[red]Um\.\CC0818 sir\.?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Um[game-token-2][control-code-3] sir[game-token-4]?
entries.translated: [red]Ehm\.\CC0818 signore\.

entries.original:
"Tell me where they are, Véga!

Or so help me, I’ll turn you into
one of them myself!"
entries.translation_source: Tell me where they are, Véga! Or so help me, I’ll turn you into one of them myself!
entries.translated:
Dimmi dove sono, Véga! O per Dio,
ti trasformerò io stesso in uno di\lloro!

entries.original:
"Please. Do you really believe you
can still order me about?

I am Agent Véga of the
Science Society.

My loyalties are with Fey\.\CC0818
and you lost your authority over\lme when you broke your contract\lwith her.

Openly bringing Shadow Warriors out
into the public?

Trying to release a dark force known
for its destructive nature, without\lfirst trying to understand it?

The Rangers are already determined
to find something to catch us on,\lso we should consider ourselves\lfortunate that no one else\ldiscovered that we were creating\lliving weapons.

You must have had some idea of the
potential consequences, were Fey\lto ever find out, yes?

Especially now, when she is close to
achieving perfection\."
entries.translation_source: Please. Do you really believe you can still order me about? I am Agent Véga of the Science Society. My loyalties are with Fey[game-token-1][control-code-2] and you lost your authority over me when you broke your contract with her. Openly bringing Shadow Warriors out into the public? Trying to release a dark force known for its destructive nature, without first trying to understand it? The Rangers are already determined to find something to catch us on, so we should consider ourselves fortunate that no one else discovered that we were creating living weapons. You must have had some idea of the potential consequences, were Fey to ever find out, yes? Especially now, when she is close to achieving perfection[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Per favore. Credi davvero di
potermi ancora dare ordini? Sono\ll{B4}Agente Véga della Società

Scientifica. Le mie lealtà sono con
Fey\.\CC0818 e hai perso la tua autorità su\ldi me quando hai rotto il tuo

contratto con lei. Portare
apertamente i Guerrieri Ombra in\lpubblico? Tentare di rilasciare una

forza oscura conosciuta per la sua
natura distruttiva, senza prima\lcercare di capirla? I Ranger sono

già determinati a trovare qualcosa
per incastrarci, quindi dovremmo\lconsiderarci fortunati che nessun

altro abbia scoperto che stavamo
creando armi viventi. Dovevi avere\lqualche idea delle potenziali

conseguenze, se Fey mai lo
scoprisse, sì? Soprattutto ora, che\lè vicina a raggiungere la

perfezione\.

entries.original: "[red]Sir\.\CC0818 um\.\CC0818 excuse me, sir\.?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Sir[game-token-2][control-code-3] um[game-token-4][control-code-5] excuse me, sir[game-token-6]?
entries.translated: [red]Signore\.\CC0818 ehm\.\CC0818 mi scusi, signore\.?

entries.original:
"We knew\.\CC0818 we knew she would
never approve.

But even then, we still had to try.

All we had to show was failure
after failure\.

Tell me, what would you have done,
Véga?"
entries.translation_source: We knew[game-token-1][control-code-2] we knew she would never approve. But even then, we still had to try. All we had to show was failure after failure[game-token-3] Tell me, what would you have done, Véga?
entries.translated:
Lo sapevamo\.\CC0818 lo sapevamo che non
l{B4}avrebbe mai approvato. Ma anche\lallora dovevamo comunque provarci.

Tutto ciò che avevamo da mostrare
era fallimento dopo fallimento\.\lDimmi, cosa avresti fatto tu, Véga?

entries.original:
"I would have continued waiting
patiently.

The last experiment alone should
have made it clear that practical\lapplication was well within reach.

Fey certainly has not given up\.

But then, that is how YOU should
have acted, according to YOUR\lwishes\."
entries.translation_source: I would have continued waiting patiently. The last experiment alone should have made it clear that practical application was well within reach. Fey certainly has not given up[game-token-1] But then, that is how YOU should have acted, according to YOUR wishes[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Avrei continuato ad aspettare
pazientemente. Il solo ultimo\lesperimento avrebbe dovuto chiarire

che l{B4}applicazione pratica era a
portata di mano. Fey di certo non\lsi è arresa\. Ma, in fondo, è così

che avresti dovuto comportarti,
secondo i TUOI desideri\.

entries.original:
"What are you implying?

What do you know about what Fey
truly wants?"
entries.translation_source: What are you implying? What do you know about what Fey truly wants?
entries.translated:
Che cosa vuoi insinuare? Cosa sai
di ciò che Fey desidera davvero?

entries.original:
"Who knows\.

She won’t even tell me, and I’m her
right-hand man.

She’s always been the type to keep
her cards close to her chest\."
entries.translation_source: Who knows[game-token-1] She won’t even tell me, and I’m her right-hand man. She’s always been the type to keep her cards close to her chest[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Chi lo sa\. Non me lo dice nemmeno, e
sono il suo braccio destro. Ha\lsempre avuto l{B4}abitudine di tenersi

le carte coperte\.

entries.original:
"Just to clear up any
misunderstandings\.

\.The Shadow Warriors, what do you
plan to do with them now?"
entries.translation_source: Just to clear up any misunderstandings[game-token-1] [game-token-2]The Shadow Warriors, what do you plan to do with them now?
entries.translated:
Solo per chiarire eventuali
malintesi\. \.The Shadow Warriors, cosa\lavete intenzione di fare con loro

adesso?

entries.original: "[red]Please don’t ignore me, sir\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Please don’t ignore me, sir[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [red]La prego di non ignorarmi, signore\.

entries.original:
"Destroy them - the whole wretched
lot of them.

I’ve had time to reflect on what
we did to all those poor Pokémon\.

It was wrong - all of it!

None of them deserved to be
experimented on\.\CC0818 especially not in\lthat way!

I can’t change what we did, but I
can certainly end their pain now."
entries.translation_source: Destroy them - the whole wretched lot of them. I’ve had time to reflect on what we did to all those poor Pokémon[game-token-1] It was wrong - all of it! None of them deserved to be experimented on[game-token-2][control-code-3] especially not in that way! I can’t change what we did, but I can certainly end their pain now.
entries.translated:
Distruggili - tutti quanti, fino
all{B4}ultimo miserabile. Ho avuto\ltempo di riflettere su ciò che

abbiamo fatto a tutti quei poveri
Pokémon\. Era sbagliato - tutto\lquanto! Nessuno di loro meritava di

essere usato come cavia\.\CC0818 soprattutto
non in quel modo! Non posso\lcambiare quello che abbiamo fatto,

ma posso certamente porre fine al
loro dolore adesso.

entries.original:
"And I cannot let you do that.

Aklove still has need of them,
and as per our contract, Fey is\lproviding him with both Grunts and\lShadow Warriors - all for his new\lorganization, the Light of Ruin.

But if you refuse to stand aside and
let us leave\."
entries.translation_source: And I cannot let you do that. Aklove still has need of them, and as per our contract, Fey is providing him with both Grunts and Shadow Warriors - all for his new organization, the Light of Ruin. But if you refuse to stand aside and let us leave[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
E non posso permetterti di farlo.
Aklove ha ancora bisogno di loro, e\lin base al nostro contratto, Fey

gli sta fornendo sia le Reclute sia
i Guerrieri Ombra - tutto per la\lsua nuova organizzazione, la Luce

della Rovina. Ma se rifiuti di
farti da parte e lasciarci andare\.

entries.original:
"One of you!

Help me get rid of him!"
entries.translation_source: One of you! Help me get rid of him!
entries.translated:
Uno di voi! Aiutatemi a sbarazzarmi
di lui!

entries.original: "I hope it was worth it, Marlon\."
entries.translation_source: I hope it was worth it, Marlon[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Spero che ne sia valsa la pena,
Marlon\.

entries.original: "[red]SIIIIIIIR!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]SIIIIIIIR!
entries.translated: [red]SIIIIIIIGNOREE!

entries.original:
"[red]It’s [player], sir!

[buffer3]’s here too!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]It’s [player-name-2], sir! [buffer3-3]’s here too!
entries.translated:
[red]È [player], signore! Anche [buffer3]
è qui!

entries.original:
"Sigh\.\CC0820 so much for the most secure
item storage in the world\."
entries.translation_source: Sigh[game-token-1][control-code-2] so much for the most secure item storage in the world[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Uff\.\CC0820 addio al deposito oggetti più
sicuro del mondo\.

entries.original:
"You had one job\.\CC0818 keep out any
and all intruders!

But since you have so obviously
failed at that task, I suppose\lthat old adage must be true.

If you want anything done properly,
you must do it yourself."
entries.translation_source: You had one job[game-token-1][control-code-2] keep out any and all intruders! But since you have so obviously failed at that task, I suppose that old adage must be true. If you want anything done properly, you must do it yourself.
entries.translated:
Avevi un solo compito\.\CC0818 tenere fuori
ogni singolo intruso! Ma visto che\lhai così palesemente fallito in

quel compito, suppongo che il
vecchio detto debba essere vero. Se\lvuoi che qualcosa sia fatto bene,

devi farlo da te.

entries.original:
"[player]! So you survived the trip
back, too.

Quickly - we need to deal with Véga
and his cronies!

Your Pokémon can still fight, can’t
they? Great!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! So you survived the trip back, too. Quickly - we need to deal with Véga and his cronies! Your Pokémon can still fight, can’t they? Great!
entries.translated:
[player]! Quindi sei sopravvissuto
anche al viaggio di ritorno.\lPresto: dobbiamo occuparci di Véga

e dei suoi scagnozzi! I tuoi
Pokémon possono ancora combattere,\lvero? Bene!

entries.original:
"There’s no time to back out of
this fight, [player]!

We need to work together to deal
with Véga and his cronies!"
entries.translation_source: There’s no time to back out of this fight, [player-name-1]! We need to work together to deal with Véga and his cronies!
entries.translated:
Non c{B4}è tempo per tirarsi indietro
da questa lotta, [player]! Dobbiamo\lcollaborare per occuparci di Véga e

dei suoi scagnozzi!

entries.original:
"[player]\.\CC0818 it is truly unfortunate that
you had to find out this way.

But I will not hesitate.

You are no longer a mere opponent\.\CC0818
you are an enemy!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1][game-token-2][control-code-3] it is truly unfortunate that you had to find out this way. But I will not hesitate. You are no longer a mere opponent[game-token-4][control-code-5] you are an enemy!
entries.translated:
[player]\.\CC0818 è davvero un peccato che
tu l{B4}abbia scoperto in questo modo.\lMa non esiterò. Non sei più un

semplice avversario\.\CC0818 sei un nemico!

entries.original: "This useless grunt let me down\."
entries.translation_source: This useless grunt let me down[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Questa recluta inutile mi ha deluso\.

entries.original:
"I doubt this would have gone much
better even with a useless grunt\."
entries.translation_source: I doubt this would have gone much better even with a useless grunt[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Dubito che sarebbe andata molto
meglio anche con una recluta\linutile\.

entries.original:
"All Grunts, retreat back to your
new base!

We’ve mostly finished what we
came for - there is no need to\lremain here!"
entries.translation_source: All Grunts, retreat back to your new base! We’ve mostly finished what we came for - there is no need to remain here!
entries.translated:
Tutte le reclute, ritiratevi alla
vostra nuova base! Abbiamo\lpraticamente finito ciò per cui

siamo venuti - non c{B4}è bisogno di
restare qui!

entries.original:
"No you don’t!

You’re not getting away that easily!"
entries.translation_source: No you don’t! You’re not getting away that easily!
entries.translated:
No, invece! Non te la caverai così
facilmente!

entries.original: "You can’t restrain me!"
entries.translation_source: You can’t restrain me!
entries.translated: Non puoi trattenermi!

entries.original:
"There’s nowhere for you to run,
Véga!

Now, tell me where you’re keeping
the Shadow Warriors!"
entries.translation_source: There’s nowhere for you to run, Véga! Now, tell me where you’re keeping the Shadow Warriors!
entries.translated:
Non c{B4}è nessun posto in cui tu
possa fuggire, Véga! Ora dimmi dove\lstai tenendo i Guerrieri Ombra!

entries.original:
"You think you have me cornered,
do you, Marlon?

Quite the opposite - it is you
who will soon be pinned down."
entries.translation_source: You think you have me cornered, do you, Marlon? Quite the opposite - it is you who will soon be pinned down.
entries.translated:
Credi di avermi messo alle strette,
vero, Marlon? È proprio il\lcontrario: sarai tu a essere presto

immobilizzato.

entries.original: "What’s that supposed to mean, Véga?"
entries.translation_source: What’s that supposed to mean, Véga?
entries.translated: Che dovrebbe significare, Véga?

entries.original:
"I’m sure you’re aware of the
incident that took place here, yes?"
entries.translation_source: I’m sure you’re aware of the incident that took place here, yes?
entries.translated:
Sono sicuro che sei a conoscenza
dell{B4}incidente avvenuto qui, sì?

entries.original: "Of course\.\CC0818 what’s your point?"
entries.translation_source: Of course[game-token-1][control-code-2] what’s your point?
entries.translated: Certo\.\CC0818 qual è il tuo punto?

entries.original:
"The monster that appeared from
the lava\.\CC0818 those fools unfortunate\lenough to be present fought tooth\land nail to subdue it.

It only sleeps now, having been
overwhelmed by sheer numbers.

But supposing one had the means to
reawaken and control it\."
entries.translation_source: The monster that appeared from the lava[game-token-1][control-code-2] those fools unfortunate enough to be present fought tooth and nail to subdue it. It only sleeps now, having been overwhelmed by sheer numbers. But supposing one had the means to reawaken and control it[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Il mostro apparso dalla lava\.\CC0818 quegli
sciocchi sfortunati abbastanza da\lessere presenti hanno combattuto

con tutte le forze per
sottometterlo. Ora dorme soltanto,\ldopo essere stato sopraffatto dalla

superiorità numerica. Ma supponendo
che qualcuno avesse i mezzi per\lrisvegliarlo e controllarlo\.

entries.original: "No\.\CC0820 surely you’re not planning\.!?"
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1][control-code-2] surely you’re not planning[game-token-3]!?
entries.translated: No\.\CC0820 di certo non stai pianificando\.!?

entries.original:
"Oh yes, Marlon.

Fey had Aklove pass me a certain
artifact, capable of controlling\lthe monster that slumbers beneath\lthe magma.

And now\."
entries.translation_source: Oh yes, Marlon. Fey had Aklove pass me a certain artifact, capable of controlling the monster that slumbers beneath the magma. And now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh sì, Marlon. Fey ha fatto
consegnare ad Aklove un certo\lartefatto, capace di controllare il

mostro che dorme sotto il magma. E
ora\.

entries.original:
"Groudon!
Respond to my Red Orb!

Awaken, and revert to your
primordial state!"
entries.translation_source: Groudon! Respond to my Red Orb! Awaken, and revert to your primordial state!
entries.translated:
Groudon! Rispondi alla mia Sfera
Rossa! Risvegliati e ritorna alla\ltua forma primordiale!

entries.original:
"What now, Marlon?

You cannot keep holding me here -
the cave will soon collapse, and\lwe will both be trapped.

You cannot hope to find the Shadow
Warriors whilst buried under rubble."
entries.translation_source: What now, Marlon? You cannot keep holding me here - the cave will soon collapse, and we will both be trapped. You cannot hope to find the Shadow Warriors whilst buried under rubble.
entries.translated:
E adesso, Marlon? Non puoi
continuare a tenermi qui - la\lgrotta crollerà presto, e resteremo

entrambi intrappolati. Non puoi
sperare di trovare i Guerrieri\ldell{B4}Ombra mentre sei sepolto sotto

le macerie.

entries.original:
"It’s simple.

If that happens, I’ll use Krookodile
to dig my way out.

Even if you must remain trapped,
Véga, I know Fey.

There are only so many places in
Borrius she’d consider secure\lenough to store the Shadow\lWarriors.

Once I rejoin Zeph in Frozen
Heights, we’ll scour every possible\llocation until we find them!"
entries.translation_source: It’s simple. If that happens, I’ll use Krookodile to dig my way out. Even if you must remain trapped, Véga, I know Fey. There are only so many places in Borrius she’d consider secure enough to store the Shadow Warriors. Once I rejoin Zeph in Frozen Heights, we’ll scour every possible location until we find them!
entries.translated:
È semplice. Se dovesse succedere,
userò Krookodile per scavarmi una\lvia d{B4}uscita. Anche se tu dovessi

rimanere intrappolato, Véga,
conosco Fey. Ci sono solo pochi\lposti a Borrius che lei

considererebbe abbastanza sicuri
per nascondere i Shadow Warriors.\lUna volta che mi riunirò a Zeph a

Frozen Heights, setacceremo ogni
possibile luogo finché non li\ltroveremo!

entries.original:
"I thought you’d continue to be
stubborn, Marlon."
entries.translation_source: I thought you’d continue to be stubborn, Marlon.
entries.translated:
Pensavo che avresti continuato a
fare il testardo, Marlon.

entries.original:
"Groudon!

The earth trembles with your
every step!

Now, subdue them!"
entries.translation_source: Groudon! The earth trembles with your every step! Now, subdue them!
entries.translated:
Groudon! La terra trema a ogni tuo
passo! Ora, sottomettili!

entries.original:
"Can’t keep your footing, Marlon?

Then, I shall take that as my cue
to leave."
entries.translation_source: Can’t keep your footing, Marlon? Then, I shall take that as my cue to leave.
entries.translated:
Non riesci a tenerti in piedi,
Marlon? Allora lo prenderò come il\lsegnale per andarmene.

entries.original: "Curses\.\CC0818 he escaped\."
entries.translation_source: Curses[game-token-1][control-code-2] he escaped[game-token-3]
entries.translated: Maledizione\.\CC0818 è scappato\.

entries.original:
"[player]!

You have to stop Groudon’s
rampage!

If not, the cave will collapse and
we’ll both be trapped here!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You have to stop Groudon’s rampage! If not, the cave will collapse and we’ll both be trapped here!
entries.translated:
[player]! Devi fermare la furia di
Groudon! Altrimenti la caverna\lcrollerà e resteremo entrambi

intrappolati qui!

entries.original:
"Ngh\.\CC0818 [player], are you alright?

\.\CC0818No! We’ve been separated!"
entries.translation_source: Ngh[game-token-1][control-code-2] [player-name-3], are you alright? [game-token-4][control-code-5]No! We’ve been separated!
entries.translated:
Ugh\.\CC0818 [player], stai bene? \.\CC0818No! Ci
siamo separati!

entries.original:
"Wait, these Poké Balls on my side\.\CC0818
aren’t they [player]’s Pokémon?

They must have been dropped when
Groudon used that attack\.

What now\.\CC0818 my own Pokémon are too
badly hurt to take that thing on\.!"
entries.translation_source: Wait, these Poké Balls on my side[game-token-1][control-code-2] aren’t they [player-name-3]’s Pokémon? They must have been dropped when Groudon used that attack[game-token-4] What now[game-token-5][control-code-6] my own Pokémon are too badly hurt to take that thing on[game-token-7]!
entries.translated:
Aspetta, queste Poké Ball dalla mia
parte\.\CC0818 non sono i Pokémon di\l[player]? Devono essere cadute

quando Groudon ha usato
quell{B4}attacco\. E adesso\.\CC0818 i miei\lPokémon sono troppo malridotti per

affrontare quella cosa\.!

entries.original:
"Wait\.\CC0818 [player]!

Let me use your Poké Balls!
I’ll command your Pokémon!

Just direct me on whether you want
to fight or switch!"
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] [player-name-3]! Let me use your Poké Balls! I’ll command your Pokémon! Just direct me on whether you want to fight or switch!
entries.translated:
Aspetta\.\CC0818 [player]! Lasciami usare le
tue Poké Ball! Comanderò io i tuoi\lPokémon! Dimmi solo se vuoi lottare

o cambiare!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] sank into the lava and
fell into a deep slumber once more."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] sank into the lava and fell into a deep slumber once more.
entries.translated:
[black]Il [buffer1] è sprofondato nella
lava ed è caduto di nuovo in un\lsonno profondo.

entries.original: "Phew\.\CC0818 we survived\.\CC0818 somehow\."
entries.translation_source: Phew[game-token-1][control-code-2] we survived[game-token-3][control-code-4] somehow[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Uff\.\CC0818 ce l{B4}abbiamo fatta\.\CC0818 in qualche
modo\.

entries.original:
"Krookodile! Destroy the rocks!
Use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: Krookodile! Destroy the rocks! Use Rock Smash!
entries.translated:
Krookodile! Distruggi le rocce! Usa
Spaccaroccia!

entries.original:
"Thank you for your help,
[player].

I honestly don’t know what I would
have done without you.

Here - I suppose you’ll want your
Pokémon back."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for your help, [player-name-1]. I honestly don’t know what I would have done without you. Here - I suppose you’ll want your Pokémon back.
entries.translated:
Grazie per il tuo aiuto, [player].
Onestamente, non so cosa avrei\lfatto senza di te. Ecco - suppongo

che vorrai riavere indietro i tuoi
Pokémon.

entries.original:
"How about you\.\CC0818 no, on second
thought, that’s not a good idea\."
entries.translation_source: How about you[game-token-1][control-code-2] no, on second thought, that’s not a good idea[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Che ne dici di\.\CC0818 no, a pensarci bene,
non è una buona idea\.

entries.original:
"Look, I’m grateful for your help.

Truly, I am.

However, this next task\.\CC0818 is
something I need to handle alone.

Right now, I need to secure Zeph’s
aid in finding the Light of Ruin’s\lnew base.

If you followed me to our base in
[green]Frozen Heights[blue], Zeph would never\lagree to help.

So please, [player], for both our
sakes - stay away from our base."
entries.translation_source: Look, I’m grateful for your help. Truly, I am. However, this next task[game-token-1][control-code-2] is something I need to handle alone. Right now, I need to secure Zeph’s aid in finding the Light of Ruin’s new base. If you followed me to our base in [color-green-3]Frozen Heights[color-blue-4], Zeph would never agree to help. So please, [player-name-5], for both our sakes - stay away from our base.
entries.translated:
Guarda, sono grato per il tuo
aiuto. Davvero, lo sono. Tuttavia,\lquesto prossimo compito\.\CC0818 è qualcosa

che devo affrontare da solo. Per
ora, devo assicurarmi l{B4}aiuto di\lZeph per trovare la nuova base

della Light of Ruin. Se mi seguissi
alla nostra base a [green]Frozen Heights[blue],\lZeph non accetterebbe mai di

aiutare. Quindi, per favore,
[player], per il bene di entrambi,\lstai alla larga dalla nostra base.

entries.original:
"It looks like someone left their
uniform on the floor.

Put it on?"
entries.translation_source: It looks like someone left their uniform on the floor. Put it on?
entries.translated:
Sembra che qualcuno abbia lasciato
la sua uniforme per terra.\lIndossarla?

entries.original: "You put on the clothes."
entries.translation_source: You put on the clothes.
entries.translated: Hai indossato i vestiti.

entries.original:
"Your clothes are on the ground.
Put them on?"
entries.translation_source: Your clothes are on the ground. Put them on?
entries.translated:
I tuoi vestiti sono a terra. Vuoi
indossarli?

entries.original:
"Marlon’s Uniform is now available
in the Costume Box!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon’s Uniform is now available in the Costume Box!
entries.translated:
La divisa di Marlon è ora
disponibile nella Scatola Costumi!

entries.original: "Aros"
entries.translation_source: Aros
entries.translated: Aros

entries.original:
"\.and so Fey ordered the grunts
to join Aklove’s \qoLight of Ruin\qc.

You understand now, Marlon?

Frankly, the fact any grunts and
scientists were allowed to remain\lis a miracle\."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]and so Fey ordered the grunts to join Aklove’s [quote-open-2]Light of Ruin[quote-close-3]. You understand now, Marlon? Frankly, the fact any grunts and scientists were allowed to remain is a miracle[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
\.e così Fey ordinò agli scagnozzi di
unirsi alla \qoLuce di Rovina\qc di\lAklove. Capisci ora, Marlon?

Francamente, il fatto che a
scagnozzi e scienziati sia stato\lpermesso di restare è un miracolo\.

entries.original:
"I see\.\CC0818 I had no idea things had
gotten this bad\.

But I think I know how to make up
the difference.

And I know this may not sound like
the most agreeable idea, but\."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1][control-code-2] I had no idea things had gotten this bad[game-token-3] But I think I know how to make up the difference. And I know this may not sound like the most agreeable idea, but[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Vedo\.\CC0818 Non avevo idea che la
situazione fosse così grave\. Ma\lcredo di sapere come colmare la

differenza. E so che forse non
sembra l{B4}idea più gradevole, ma\.

entries.original:
"What the\.

That’s my uniform!

[player]\.\CC0818 is that you?"
entries.translation_source: What the[game-token-1] That’s my uniform! [player-name-2][game-token-3][control-code-4] is that you?
entries.translated:
Ma che\. Quella è la mia uniforme!
[player]\.\CC0818 sei tu?

entries.original:
"What!?
You\.\CC0820 you’re\.

No! It cannot possibly be you!

You’re\.\CC0818 you must be some
sort of spy!

Aklove\.\CC0818 how long must you
torment me\.?"
entries.translation_source: What!? You[game-token-1][control-code-2] you’re[game-token-3] No! It cannot possibly be you! You’re[game-token-4][control-code-5] you must be some sort of spy! Aklove[game-token-6][control-code-7] how long must you torment me[game-token-8]?
entries.translated:
Cosa!? Tu\.\CC0820 tu sei\. No! Non puoi
assolutamente essere tu! Sei\.\CC0818 devi\lessere una specie di spia! Aklove\.\CC0818

per quanto tempo intendi
tormentarmi\.?

entries.original:
"You thought you could fool me
again, faker? Like he did?

Even though I see that you wear
[player]’s face under the mask\.

You are still a far cry from the
real deal!

Once I’ve sent you running back to
Aklove, deliver a message to him\lfor me!

Tell him\.\CC0820 that you’ll all suffer for
your irredeemable sins!"
entries.translation_source: You thought you could fool me again, faker? Like he did? Even though I see that you wear [player-name-1]’s face under the mask[game-token-2] You are still a far cry from the real deal! Once I’ve sent you running back to Aklove, deliver a message to him for me! Tell him[game-token-3][control-code-4] that you’ll all suffer for your irredeemable sins!
entries.translated:
Pensavi di potermi ingannare di
nuovo, impostore? Come ha fatto\llui? Anche se vedo che sotto la

maschera indossi il volto di
[player]\. Sei ancora lontanissimo\ldall{B4}essere quello vero! Una volta

che ti avrò rimandato di corsa da
Aklove, portagli un messaggio da\lparte mia! Digli\.\CC0820 che soffrirete

tutti per i vostri peccati
imperdonabili!

entries.original:
"This battle style\.\CC0818 this aura\.\CC0818
it cannot be\.\CC0818 are you really\l[player]\.!?

No, this can’t be true!"
entries.translation_source: This battle style[game-token-1][control-code-2] this aura[game-token-3][control-code-4] it cannot be[game-token-5][control-code-6] are you really [player-name-7][game-token-8]!? No, this can’t be true!
entries.translated:
Questo stile di lotta\.\CC0818 questa aura\.\CC0818
non può essere\.\CC0818 sei davvero\l[player]\.!? No, non può essere vero!

entries.original:
"Zeph!
Enough!

We don’t have time for infighting
right now!

[player] isn’t the enemy - the
Light of Ruin is!

And you can either accept that fact,
or else I’ll be assuming command\lof what remains of the Shadows."
entries.translation_source: Zeph! Enough! We don’t have time for infighting right now! [player-name-1] isn’t the enemy - the Light of Ruin is! And you can either accept that fact, or else I’ll be assuming command of what remains of the Shadows.
entries.translated:
Zeph! Basta! Non abbiamo tempo per
litigare tra noi adesso! [player]\lnon è il nemico - la Luce della

Rovina è! E o accetti questo fatto,
oppure assumerò il comando di ciò\lche resta delle Ombre.

entries.original:
"Thank you.
Now then\.

What have you been planning, Zeph?

From what I gathered, we’ll be
staging an attack on the Light of\lRuin’s new base?"
entries.translation_source: Thank you. Now then[game-token-1] What have you been planning, Zeph? From what I gathered, we’ll be staging an attack on the Light of Ruin’s new base?
entries.translated:
Grazie. E allora\. Cosa hai
pianificato, Zeph? Da quanto ho\lcapito, stiamo per sferrare un

attacco alla nuova base della Light
of Ruin?

entries.original:
"That’s right\.

I’m having our remaining scientists
locate their base.

Once they’ve managed to find it,
we’ll take the Light of Ruin by\lsurprise and destroy it.

With their main force left reeling,
we’ll steal back the Prison Bottle\land what remaining Shadow Warriors\lthey have left.

However, I’m still unsure as to how
long it will take to locate them\.

And unfortunately, we’re pressed for
time.

Right now, Aklove is with Fey as
she studies Hoopa.

When she finishes, Aklove intends to
turn its power on Borrius\.

If we can take out his base while
he’s gone, we can catch him off\lguard when he returns, and seal\lHoopa’s power away once again.

Without it, Aklove’s power will be
greatly diminished."
entries.translation_source: That’s right[game-token-1] I’m having our remaining scientists locate their base. Once they’ve managed to find it, we’ll take the Light of Ruin by surprise and destroy it. With their main force left reeling, we’ll steal back the Prison Bottle and what remaining Shadow Warriors they have left. However, I’m still unsure as to how long it will take to locate them[game-token-2] And unfortunately, we’re pressed for time. Right now, Aklove is with Fey as she studies Hoopa. When she finishes, Aklove intends to turn its power on Borrius[game-token-3] If we can take out his base while he’s gone, we can catch him off guard when he returns, and seal Hoopa’s power away once again. Without it, Aklove’s power will be greatly diminished.
entries.translated:
Giusto\. Sto facendo in modo che i
nostri scienziati rimasti\llocalizzino la loro base. Una volta

che saranno riusciti a trovarla,
coglieremo di sorpresa la Luce\lRovina e la distruggeremo. Con le

loro forze principali in
difficoltà, riprenderemo la\lBottiglia Prigione e gli ultimi

Guerrieri Ombra che sono rimasti.
Tuttavia, non sono ancora sicuro di\lquanto tempo ci vorrà per

localizzarli\. E purtroppo siamo a
corto di tempo. In questo momento,\lAklove è con Fey mentre lei studia

Hoopa. Quando avrà finito, Aklove
intende rivolgere il suo potere su\lBorrius\. Se riusciamo a distruggere

la sua base mentre lui è via,
possiamo coglierlo di sorpresa\lquando tornerà, e sigillare di

nuovo il potere di Hoopa. Senza di
esso, il potere di Aklove sarà\lnotevolmente ridotto.

entries.original:
"Roger that, Zeph.

And I take it you’re certain Fey
won’t retaliate against us if we\ltake action?"
entries.translation_source: Roger that, Zeph. And I take it you’re certain Fey won’t retaliate against us if we take action?
entries.translated:
Ricevuto, Zeph. E immagino che tu
sia sicuro che Fey non si\lvendicherà contro di noi se agiamo?

entries.original:
"I’m certain, Marlon.

From talking with some of our
scientists, Fey could not care\lless about Aklove’s goals.

All she wants is to study that
Pokémon’s power.

She’ll give him her support, of
course, but for the most part,\lit is up to Aklove as to whether\lor not he succeeds.

Of course, we shouldn’t make light of
how dangerous he is alone\."
entries.translation_source: I’m certain, Marlon. From talking with some of our scientists, Fey could not care less about Aklove’s goals. All she wants is to study that Pokémon’s power. She’ll give him her support, of course, but for the most part, it is up to Aklove as to whether or not he succeeds. Of course, we shouldn’t make light of how dangerous he is alone[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ne sono certo, Marlon. Parlando con
alcuni dei nostri scienziati, a Fey\lnon importa affatto degli obiettivi

di Aklove. Tutto ciò che vuole è
studiare il potere di quel Pokémon.\lNaturalmente, gli darà il suo

sostegno, ma per la maggior parte
spetta ad Aklove decidere se abbia\lsuccesso oppure no. Ovviamente, non

dovremmo sottovalutare quanto sia
pericoloso da solo\.

entries.original:
"Then it seems to me that in order
for our plan to go off without a\lhitch, we’ll need all the manpower\lwe can muster.

So, I suggest we bring [player]
along, as well."
entries.translation_source: Then it seems to me that in order for our plan to go off without a hitch, we’ll need all the manpower we can muster. So, I suggest we bring [player-name-1] along, as well.
entries.translated:
Allora mi sembra che, per far sì
che il nostro piano riesca senza\lintoppi, avremo bisogno di tutta la

manodopera che riusciamo a
radunare. Quindi suggerisco di\lportare con noi anche [player].

entries.original:
"Marlon, I don’t understand\.

Why would you put so much faith
in [buffer1]?

[player] has only tried to interfere
with us before.

What makes you think [buffer2] would even
be willing to help us?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, I don’t understand[game-token-1] Why would you put so much faith in [buffer1-2]? [player-name-3] has only tried to interfere with us before. What makes you think [buffer2-4] would even be willing to help us?
entries.translated:
Marlon, non capisco\. Perché riponi
così tanta fiducia in [buffer1]?\l[player] ha solo cercato di

ostacolarci finora. Cosa ti fa
pensare che [buffer2] sarebbe\lpersino disposto ad aiutarci?

entries.original:
"We were imprisoned together in the
Cube Space, Zeph.

And while we were there, we made a
promise to someone.

We promised we would destroy the
remaining Shadow Warriors and set\ltheir souls free.

And [player] knows that as long as
the Light of Ruin is holding onto\lthe Shadow Warriors, their souls\lwill remain trapped."
entries.translation_source: We were imprisoned together in the Cube Space, Zeph. And while we were there, we made a promise to someone. We promised we would destroy the remaining Shadow Warriors and set their souls free. And [player-name-1] knows that as long as the Light of Ruin is holding onto the Shadow Warriors, their souls will remain trapped.
entries.translated:
Eravamo imprigionati insieme nello
Spazio Cubo, Zeph. E mentre eravamo\llì, abbiamo fatto una promessa a

qualcuno. Abbiamo promesso che
avremmo distrutto i Guerrieri Ombra\lrimasti e liberato le loro anime. E

[player] sa che, finché la Luce
della Rovina continuerà a tenere\lprigionieri i Guerrieri Ombra, le

loro anime resteranno intrappolate.

entries.original:
"Are you saying that not only did
both of you survive a trip inside\lthe Cube, but someone else was\lthere, too?

Someone who knew about the existence
of the Shadow Warriors?"
entries.translation_source: Are you saying that not only did both of you survive a trip inside the Cube, but someone else was there, too? Someone who knew about the existence of the Shadow Warriors?
entries.translated:
Stai dicendo che non solo siete
sopravvissuti entrambi a un viaggio\ldentro il Cubo, ma che c{B4}era anche

qualcun altro? Qualcuno che sapeva
dell{B4}esistenza degli Shadow\lWarriors?

entries.original:
"It was Aros, Zeph.

Fey imprisoned him in there sixteen
years ago.

And not only that, it turns out Aros
is [player]’s father, too."
entries.translation_source: It was Aros, Zeph. Fey imprisoned him in there sixteen years ago. And not only that, it turns out Aros is [player-name-1]’s father, too.
entries.translated:
È stato Aros, Zeph. Fey lo ha
imprigionato là dentro sedici anni\lfa. E non solo, a quanto pare Aros

è anche il padre di [player].

entries.original:
"Aros!? I see\.\CC0818 so that’s what became
of him\.

Well, I’m not surprised then.

He was always quick to identify bugs
in any system.

If anyone could figure out a way
out, no matter how flawed, it\lwould surely be him\."
entries.translation_source: Aros!? I see[game-token-1][control-code-2] so that’s what became of him[game-token-3] Well, I’m not surprised then. He was always quick to identify bugs in any system. If anyone could figure out a way out, no matter how flawed, it would surely be him[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Aros!? Capisco\.\CC0818 quindi è questo che
ne è stato di lui\. Beh, allora non\lsono sorpreso. Era sempre rapido a

individuare i bug in qualsiasi
sistema. Se qualcuno potesse\ltrovare una via d{B4}uscita, per

quanto difettosa, sarebbe
sicuramente lui\.

entries.original:
"So, [player]\. would you be willing
to lend us your aid?

We intend to gather what resources
we can, and go for the Light of\lRuin directly.

\.

Yes, I’m aware - you and the
Shadows\.\CC0818 we haven’t always seen\leye-to-eye, have we?

Then, if I trusted you with our
most important secrets, would that\lbe enough?

In that case, let me explain what
our true purpose was\.

The true purpose of the Shadows\."
entries.translation_source: So, [player-name-1][game-token-2] would you be willing to lend us your aid? We intend to gather what resources we can, and go for the Light of Ruin directly. [game-token-3] Yes, I’m aware - you and the Shadows[game-token-4][control-code-5] we haven’t always seen eye-to-eye, have we? Then, if I trusted you with our most important secrets, would that be enough? In that case, let me explain what our true purpose was[game-token-6] The true purpose of the Shadows[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Quindi, [player]\. saresti disposto a
prestarci il tuo aiuto? Intendiamo\lraccogliere quante più risorse

possiamo e puntare direttamente
alla Luce della Rovina\. Sì, ne sono\lconsapevole - tu e le Ombre\.\CC0818 non

sempre siamo andati d{B4}accordo,
vero? Allora, se ti affidassi i\lnostri segreti più importanti,

sarebbe sufficiente? In tal caso,
lasciami spiegare quale fosse il\lnostro vero scopo\. Il vero scopo

delle Ombre\.

entries.original:
"It all began, seventeen years ago\.

Zeph’s son had just passed away.

As his old friends, we came to visit
him from our home region of Hoenn\."
entries.translation_source: It all began, seventeen years ago[game-token-1] Zeph’s son had just passed away. As his old friends, we came to visit him from our home region of Hoenn[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Tutto ebbe inizio diciassette anni
fa\. Il figlio di Zeph era appena\lmorto. Come suoi vecchi amici,

siamo venuti a trovarlo dalla
nostra regione natale, Hoenn\.

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph\.\CC0818 how are you holding up?

I’m so sorry\.\CC0818 Marlon and I just
heard\.\CC0820 about your son\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Zeph[game-token-2][control-code-3] how are you holding up? I’m so sorry[game-token-4][control-code-5] Marlon and I just heard[game-token-6][control-code-7] about your son[game-token-8]
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph\.\CC0818 come te la cavi? Mi dispiace
tanto\.\CC0818 Marlon e io abbiamo appena\lsentito\.\CC0820 di tuo figlio\.

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0818 Marlon\.\CC0818 thank you for
your condolences.

It’s good to see you again after all
these years\."
entries.translation_source: Ivory[game-token-1][control-code-2] Marlon[game-token-3][control-code-4] thank you for your condolences. It’s good to see you again after all these years[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0818 Marlon\.\CC0818 grazie per le vostre
condoglianze. È bello rivedervi\ldopo tutti questi anni\.

entries.original:
"I take it you travelled by boat to
get here?

How was the journey?"
entries.translation_source: I take it you travelled by boat to get here? How was the journey?
entries.translated:
Immagino che tu sia arrivato in
barca per venire qui? Com{B4}è andato\lil viaggio?

entries.original:
"[red]Very pleasant.

It took a few days to arrive here,
but the journey was lovely."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Very pleasant. It took a few days to arrive here, but the journey was lovely.
entries.translated:
[red]Molto piacevole. Ci sono voluti
alcuni giorni per arrivare fin qui,\lma il viaggio è stato splendido.

entries.original:
"If I remember correctly, you
have a son, too\. right?"
entries.translation_source: If I remember correctly, you have a son, too[game-token-1] right?
entries.translated:
Se ricordo bene, hai anche un
figlio\. giusto?

entries.original:
"We did\.

Unfortunately, he\.\CC0820 he succumbed to
illness much too young."
entries.translation_source: We did[game-token-1] Unfortunately, he[game-token-2][control-code-3] he succumbed to illness much too young.
entries.translated:
Lo abbiamo fatto\. Purtroppo, lui\.\CC0820 è
morto di malattia troppo giovane.

entries.original:
"You are knowledgable scientists\.\CC0818
have you ever thought about trying\lto bring him back?"
entries.translation_source: You are knowledgable scientists[game-token-1][control-code-2] have you ever thought about trying to bring him back?
entries.translated:
Siete scienziati competenti\.\CC0818 avete
mai pensato di provare a riportarlo\lindietro?

entries.original:
"Of course\.

As scientists, we thought that if
anyone could find a way, it would\lbe us.

Sadly, there are no known methods
to truly revive the dead.

We had no choice but to try and
move on.

Then, a year ago, Ivory gave birth
to twins\.

It was one of the happiest moments
of our lives.

Of course we miss our first child,
but our new ones have done much\lto fill the voids in our hearts\."
entries.translation_source: Of course[game-token-1] As scientists, we thought that if anyone could find a way, it would be us. Sadly, there are no known methods to truly revive the dead. We had no choice but to try and move on. Then, a year ago, Ivory gave birth to twins[game-token-2] It was one of the happiest moments of our lives. Of course we miss our first child, but our new ones have done much to fill the voids in our hearts[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Certo\. Come scienziati, pensavamo
che se qualcuno potesse trovare un\lmodo, saremmo stati noi. Purtroppo,

non ci sono metodi noti per
riportare veramente in vita i\lmorti. Non abbiamo avuto altra

scelta che cercare di andare
avanti. Poi, un anno fa, Ivory ha\ldato alla luce due gemelli\. È stato

uno dei momenti più felici della
nostra vita. Certo che ci manca il\lnostro primo figlio, ma i nuovi

hanno fatto molto per colmare i
vuoti nei nostri cuori\.

entries.original:
"Is that so\.

Where are they now, if I may ask?"
entries.translation_source: Is that so[game-token-1] Where are they now, if I may ask?
entries.translated:
Ah sì\. Dove sono adesso, se posso
chiedere?

entries.original:
"[red]Euler Log, a friend of ours, agreed
to babysit for the time being.

They’re with him now, back in
Frozen Heights."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Euler Log, a friend of ours, agreed to babysit for the time being. They’re with him now, back in Frozen Heights.
entries.translated:
[red]Euler Log, un nostro amico, ha
accettato di fare da babysitter per\lil momento. Sono con lui adesso, di

ritorno a Frozen Heights.

entries.original:
"Frozen Heights\.\CC0820 a friend of mine
lives there as well.

He’s my old partner\.\CC0818 the one who
helped me found my own company\.

But around here, he’s simply known
as the \qoGuardian of Borrius\qc.

He’s even managed to befriend a
so-called \qomythical\qc Pokémon!

I think his wife recently gave
birth to their own child, actually\.

However, I don’t quite remember the
child’s name\."
entries.translation_source: Frozen Heights[game-token-1][control-code-2] a friend of mine lives there as well. He’s my old partner[game-token-3][control-code-4] the one who helped me found my own company[game-token-5] But around here, he’s simply known as the [quote-open-6]Guardian of Borrius[quote-close-7]. He’s even managed to befriend a so-called [quote-open-8]mythical[quote-close-9] Pokémon! I think his wife recently gave birth to their own child, actually[game-token-10] However, I don’t quite remember the child’s name[game-token-11]
entries.translated:
Frozen Heights\.\CC0820 un mio amico vive
anche lì. È il mio vecchio partner\.\CC0818\lquello che mi ha aiutato a fondare

la mia azienda\. Ma qui in zona, è
semplicemente conosciuto come il\l\qoGuardiano di Borrius\qc. È persino

riuscito a fare amicizia con un
cosiddetto Pokémon \qomitico\qc! Credo\lche sua moglie abbia partorito di

recente anche il loro bambino, in
realtà\. Tuttavia, non ricordo bene\lil nome del bambino\.

entries.original:
"What about your new twins?
What are their names?"
entries.translation_source: What about your new twins? What are their names?
entries.translated:
E i tuoi nuovi gemelli? Come si
chiamano?

entries.original:
"[red]Their names are [rival]
and Melony.

They’re the most beautiful children
in the world."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Their names are [text-token-rival-2] and Melony. They’re the most beautiful children in the world.
entries.translated:
[red]Si chiamano [rival] e Melony. Sono
i bambini più belli del mondo.

entries.original:
"Yes, that’s right\.\CC0818 Ivory and I are
[rival] and Melony’s parents.

[rival]\.\CC0818 ever since he arrived,
he’s been looking for us, hasn’t he?

I always regretted leaving them
both, but after spending so much\ltime away, I had really hoped they\lcould meet their old brother\.

Ah\.\CC0820 how stupid I was\."
entries.translation_source: Yes, that’s right[game-token-1][control-code-2] Ivory and I are [text-token-rival-3] and Melony’s parents. [text-token-rival-4][game-token-5][control-code-6] ever since he arrived, he’s been looking for us, hasn’t he? I always regretted leaving them both, but after spending so much time away, I had really hoped they could meet their old brother[game-token-7] Ah[game-token-8][control-code-9] how stupid I was[game-token-10]
entries.translated:
Sì, esatto\.\CC0818 Ivory e io siamo i
genitori di [rival] e Melony.\l[rival]\.\CC0818 da quando è arrivato, ci

sta cercando, vero? Ho sempre
rimpianto di aver lasciato\lentrambi, ma dopo aver trascorso

così tanto tempo lontano, speravo
davvero che potessero incontrare il\lloro fratello maggiore\. Ah\.\CC0820 che

sciocco sono stato\.

entries.original:
"Perhaps I should take it from
here\.

When I learned that we had both
experienced the pain of losing our\lown children, I made an offer.

Our combined scientific knowledge\.\CC0818
united together under one common\lgoal\.

I felt with that resolve, we could
achieve the impossible."
entries.translation_source: Perhaps I should take it from here[game-token-1] When I learned that we had both experienced the pain of losing our own children, I made an offer. Our combined scientific knowledge[game-token-2][control-code-3] united together under one common goal[game-token-4] I felt with that resolve, we could achieve the impossible.
entries.translated:
Forse dovrei occuparmene io\. Quando
ho saputo che avevamo entrambi\lprovato il dolore di perdere i

nostri figli, ho fatto una
proposta. Le nostre conoscenze\lscientifiche unite\.\CC0818 sotto un unico

obiettivo comune\. Sentivo che, con
quella determinazione, avremmo\lpotuto ottenere l{B4}impossibile.

entries.original:
"Of course, Marlon and Ivory were
most skeptical, but after many\lattempts, I convinced them."
entries.translation_source: Of course, Marlon and Ivory were most skeptical, but after many attempts, I convinced them.
entries.translated:
Naturalmente, Marlon e Ivory erano
i più scettici, ma dopo molti\ltentativi li ho convinti.

entries.original:
"They agreed to return their children
to their home in Hoenn and then\lmove to Borrius without them.

With no distractions, I was certain
we would succeed."
entries.translation_source: They agreed to return their children to their home in Hoenn and then move to Borrius without them. With no distractions, I was certain we would succeed.
entries.translated:
Hanno accettato di riportare i loro
figli a casa loro, a Hoenn, e poi\ltrasferirsi a Borrius senza di

loro. Senza distrazioni, ero certo
che avremmo avuto successo.

entries.original:
"However, as we soon discovered, the
three of us could only do so much\lon our own.

And so, we partnered with an
independent organization, known as\l\qoThe Science Society\qc."
entries.translation_source: However, as we soon discovered, the three of us could only do so much on our own. And so, we partnered with an independent organization, known as [quote-open-1]The Science Society[quote-close-2].
entries.translated:
Tuttavia, come scoprimmo presto,
noi tre potevamo fare solo fino a\lun certo punto da soli. E così, ci

unimmo a un{B4}organizzazione
indipendente, nota come \qoSocietà\ldella Scienza\qc.

entries.original:
"Together with their help, our
research suddenly gained speed.

However, this research required my
undivided attention.

And so, realizing that I simply could
not oversee so many projects at\lonce, I stepped down from my\lposition as CEO of Cube Corp."
entries.translation_source: Together with their help, our research suddenly gained speed. However, this research required my undivided attention. And so, realizing that I simply could not oversee so many projects at once, I stepped down from my position as CEO of Cube Corp.
entries.translated:
Con il loro aiuto, la nostra
ricerca ha improvvisamente\laccelerato. Tuttavia, questa

ricerca richiedeva la mia
attenzione totale. E così,\lrendendomi conto che semplicemente

non potevo supervisionare così
tanti progetti contemporaneamente,\lmi sono dimesso dalla mia posizione

di amministratore delegato di Cube
Corp.

entries.original:
"In my place, I left it to a young
woman\.\CC0818 Fey, the leader of the\lScience Society."
entries.translation_source: In my place, I left it to a young woman[game-token-1][control-code-2] Fey, the leader of the Science Society.
entries.translated:
Al mio posto l{B4}ho lasciato a una
giovane donna\. \CC0818 Fey, la leader della\lScience Society.

entries.original:
"Yes\.\CC0818 Zeph is the inventor of the
Super Cube.

The first Cube, meant for simple
storage, was a collaborative effort\lbetween him, your father and Fey.

It’s what allowed Cube Corp. to
take off, and become the major\linfluence in Borrius it is today."
entries.translation_source: Yes[game-token-1][control-code-2] Zeph is the inventor of the Super Cube. The first Cube, meant for simple storage, was a collaborative effort between him, your father and Fey. It’s what allowed Cube Corp. to take off, and become the major influence in Borrius it is today.
entries.translated:
Sì\.\CC0818 Zeph è l{B4}inventore della Super
Cube. Il primo Cube, pensato per il\lsemplice immagazzinamento, fu il

frutto di una collaborazione tra
lui, tuo padre e Fey. È ciò che ha\lpermesso a Cube Corp. di decollare

e diventare l{B4}influenza principale
in Borrius che è oggi.

entries.original:
"And this is how she repays me,
after all this\.!

She practically stole Cube Corp.,
the company I founded with my\lown two hands\.

And she allows Aklove to steal my
Shadows from me, too\.!"
entries.translation_source: And this is how she repays me, after all this[game-token-1]! She practically stole Cube Corp., the company I founded with my own two hands[game-token-2] And she allows Aklove to steal my Shadows from me, too[game-token-3]!
entries.translated:
E così mi ripaga, dopo tutto
questo\.! Mi ha praticamente rubato\lCube Corp., la compagnia che ho

fondato con le mie stesse mani\. E
permette anche ad Aklove di rubarmi\lgli Shadows\.!

entries.original:
"Phoo\.

I shouldn’t dwell on that now.

Anyway\.\CC0820 Fey was the one who gave
us the template for the project,\las you have likely guessed."
entries.translation_source: Phoo[game-token-1] I shouldn’t dwell on that now. Anyway[game-token-2][control-code-3] Fey was the one who gave us the template for the project, as you have likely guessed.
entries.translated:
Phoo\. Non dovrei pensarci adesso.
Comunque\.\CC0820 Fey è stata quella che ci\lha dato il modello per il progetto,

come avrai probabilmente intuito.

entries.original:
"Thus, before I stepped down as CEO,
I established a new branch at Cube\lCorp. entirely dedicated to the\lrevival efforts.

I called it the Shadow branch.
Or as you know it, the \qoShadows\qc.

To avoid tarnishing Cube Corp’s
reputation, I had to ensure our\lexperiments had no ties to the\lcompany whatsoever.

And with that out of the way, we
were able to experiment worry-free."
entries.translation_source: Thus, before I stepped down as CEO, I established a new branch at Cube Corp. entirely dedicated to the revival efforts. I called it the Shadow branch. Or as you know it, the [quote-open-1]Shadows[quote-close-2]. To avoid tarnishing Cube Corp’s reputation, I had to ensure our experiments had no ties to the company whatsoever. And with that out of the way, we were able to experiment worry-free.
entries.translated:
Pertanto, prima di dimettermi da
CEO, ho istituito un nuovo ramo\lpresso Cube Corp. interamente

dedicato agli sforzi di
rivitalizzazione. L{B4}ho chiamato il\lramo Ombra. O come lo conosci, il

\qoOmbre\qc. Per evitare di macchiare
la reputazione di Cube Corp.,\ldovevo assicurarmi che i nostri

esperimenti non avessero alcun
legame con la società. E con ciò\lrisolto, siamo stati in grado di

sperimentare senza preoccupazioni.

entries.original: "Ivory, status report. "
entries.translation_source: Ivory, status report.
entries.translated: Ivory, rapporto sulla situazione.

entries.original:
"[red]We’re ready to begin the first trial,
Zeph.[blue]"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]We’re ready to begin the first trial, Zeph.[color-blue-2]
entries.translated:
[red]Siamo pronti a iniziare la prima
prova, Zeph.[blue]

entries.original:
"Then let’s begin, shall we?

Everyone, take your positions."
entries.translation_source: Then let’s begin, shall we? Everyone, take your positions.
entries.translated:
Allora cominciamo, va bene? Tutti,
prendete posizione.

entries.original:
"Zeph, are you certain that this
will work?"
entries.translation_source: Zeph, are you certain that this will work?
entries.translated: Zeph, sei sicuro che funzionerà?

entries.original:
"Of course nothing is certain,
Marlon.

It is merely the first of many
prototypes.

I don’t expect perfect results on
the first try.

However, we can worry about the
finer points later.

For now\.\CC0818 let’s find out if this is
merely a hypothesis, or not."
entries.translation_source: Of course nothing is certain, Marlon. It is merely the first of many prototypes. I don’t expect perfect results on the first try. However, we can worry about the finer points later. For now[game-token-1][control-code-2] let’s find out if this is merely a hypothesis, or not.
entries.translated:
Naturalmente, nulla è certo,
Marlon. È soltanto il primo di\lmolti prototipi. Non mi aspetto

risultati perfetti al primo
tentativo. Tuttavia, possiamo\loccuparci dei dettagli più avanti.

Per ora\.\CC0818 scopriamo se si tratta
soltanto di un{B4}ipotesi, o no.

entries.original:
"To start with, I just place this
Pokémon here\."
entries.translation_source: To start with, I just place this Pokémon here[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Per cominciare, posiziono
semplicemente questo Pokémon qui\.

entries.original:
"Then, place the sample remains
next to it\."
entries.translation_source: Then, place the sample remains next to it[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Allora, posiziona i resti del
campione accanto ad esso\.

entries.original:
"And finally, turn on the molecular
fusion device!"
entries.translation_source: And finally, turn on the molecular fusion device!
entries.translated:
E infine, attivate il dispositivo
di fusione molecolare!

entries.original:
"Now, once this cloak is on to shield
it from the light, it should become\lmobile\."
entries.translation_source: Now, once this cloak is on to shield it from the light, it should become mobile[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ora, una volta indossato questo
mantello per proteggerlo dalla\lluce, dovrebbe diventare mobile\.

entries.original:
"It\.\CC0820 worked!

Now, let’s see if it can actually
move its body\."
entries.translation_source: It[game-token-1][control-code-2] worked! Now, let’s see if it can actually move its body[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ha\.\CC0820 funzionato! Ora vediamo se
riesce davvero a muovere il corpo\.

entries.original: "Whoa!"
entries.translation_source: Whoa!
entries.translated: Accidenti!

entries.original:
"Quick, Marlon!

Hand me that control gauntlet!"
entries.translation_source: Quick, Marlon! Hand me that control gauntlet!
entries.translated:
Presto, Marlon! Passami quel guanto
di controllo!

entries.original:
"Stay, creature!

You must obey!"
entries.translation_source: Stay, creature! You must obey!
entries.translated: Fermo, creatura! Devi obbedire!

entries.original: "Hmm\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Mmh\.

entries.original:
"I’ll admit this is not what I was
originally hoping for.

However, this certainly is a step in
the right direction.

Given time, we should\.\CC0820 we should be
able to bring them back\."
entries.translation_source: I’ll admit this is not what I was originally hoping for. However, this certainly is a step in the right direction. Given time, we should[game-token-1][control-code-2] we should be able to bring them back[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Devo ammettere che non era quello
che speravo inizialmente. Tuttavia,\lè sicuramente un passo nella giusta

direzione. Col tempo, dovremmo\.\CC0820
dovremmo riuscire a riportarli\lindietro\.

entries.original:
"All things considered, though, the
first test went rather smoothly."
entries.translation_source: All things considered, though, the first test went rather smoothly.
entries.translated:
Comunque, tutto considerato, il
primo test è andato piuttosto\lliscio.

entries.original:
"Fey said we had to continue the
research, not to let this setback\ltrip us up.

Her words\.\CC0818 spurred on by her,
we continued to work on the\lShadow Warriors.

However, even with the control
gauntlet, some proved difficult\lto control.

One lashed out at my face, leaving
this scar you see today.

Another lashed out at Marlon,
severing his arm.

And yet, despite our injuries, we
pressed on\."
entries.translation_source: Fey said we had to continue the research, not to let this setback trip us up. Her words[game-token-1][control-code-2] spurred on by her, we continued to work on the Shadow Warriors. However, even with the control gauntlet, some proved difficult to control. One lashed out at my face, leaving this scar you see today. Another lashed out at Marlon, severing his arm. And yet, despite our injuries, we pressed on[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Fey ha detto che dovevamo
continuare la ricerca, per non\llasciare che questo contrattempo ci

ostacolasse. Le sue parole\.\CC0818 spronati
da lei, continuammo a lavorare sui\lGuerrieri Ombra. Tuttavia, persino

con il guanto di controllo, alcuni
si rivelarono difficili da\lcontrollare. Uno mi assalì il

volto, lasciandomi questa cicatrice
che vedi oggi. Un altro assalì\lMarlon, recidendogli il braccio.

Eppure, nonostante le ferite,
continuammo\.

entries.original:
"Over the course of several years,
the Science Society helped us\lcapture more Pokémon, and combine\lthem with more test subjects.

Some were living - as per Fey’s
request - and others were not."
entries.translation_source: Over the course of several years, the Science Society helped us capture more Pokémon, and combine them with more test subjects. Some were living - as per Fey’s request - and others were not.
entries.translated:
Nel corso di diversi anni, la
Società Scientifica ci ha aiutato a\lcatturare più Pokémon e a

combinarli con altri soggetti di
prova. Alcuni erano vivi - su\lrichiesta di Fey - e altri no.

entries.original:
"That is not to say we turned anyone
against their will, of course.

All grunts that became Shadow
Warriors did so willingly for the\lchance to gain great power\.

But Fey\.\CC0818 she was like a demoness,
driving us to crueller and crueller\lextremes, in order to revive our\lchildren.

Of course, I suspect she had
absolutely no interest in them\lat all.

It was always the Shadow Warriors
she was invested in."
entries.translation_source: That is not to say we turned anyone against their will, of course. All grunts that became Shadow Warriors did so willingly for the chance to gain great power[game-token-1] But Fey[game-token-2][control-code-3] she was like a demoness, driving us to crueller and crueller extremes, in order to revive our children. Of course, I suspect she had absolutely no interest in them at all. It was always the Shadow Warriors she was invested in.
entries.translated:
Ciò non significa che abbiamo
costretto nessuno contro la sua\lvolontà, ovviamente. Tutti gli

sgherri che sono diventati
Guerrieri Ombra lo hanno fatto\lvolontariamente per la possibilità

di ottenere un grande potere\. Ma Fey\.\CC0818
era come una demonessa, spingendoci\lverso estremi sempre più crudeli,

al fine di rianimare i nostri
figli. Ovviamente, sospetto che lei\lnon avesse alcun interesse per

loro. Erano sempre i Guerrieri
Ombra a cui era interessata.

entries.original:
"Eventually, we concluded we would
not be able to bring back our\lchildren using the Shadow Warriors.

Despite coming close with our last
trial, the cost to our children\lwould have been too great had\lwe continued in that same direction.

And so, we were forced to try a
new approach.

One that was extreme, yet plausible,
if recent events are anything to\lgo by\."
entries.translation_source: Eventually, we concluded we would not be able to bring back our children using the Shadow Warriors. Despite coming close with our last trial, the cost to our children would have been too great had we continued in that same direction. And so, we were forced to try a new approach. One that was extreme, yet plausible, if recent events are anything to go by[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Alla fine, abbiamo concluso che non
saremmo riusciti a riportare\lindietro i nostri figli usando i

Shadow Warriors. Nonostante ci
siamo avvicinati con la nostra\lultima prova, il costo per i nostri

figli sarebbe stato troppo grande
se avessimo continuato nella stessa\ldirezione. E così, siamo stati

costretti a provare un nuovo
approccio. Uno estremo, ma\lplausibile, se i recenti eventi

sono indicativi\.

entries.original:
"The plan was to bring the Ultimate
Weapon - the one mentioned in the\lold legends - here to Borrius.

But while that weapon may be
capable of mass destruction, it\lwas also the same device used to\lrestore the foreign king’s Pokémon.

And if the weapon could bring a
Pokémon back to life\.

\.it stands to reason it could
bring our children back as well\.

But how much of it was our idea\.?

And how much of it was Aklove’s
machinations\.?"
entries.translation_source: The plan was to bring the Ultimate Weapon - the one mentioned in the old legends - here to Borrius. But while that weapon may be capable of mass destruction, it was also the same device used to restore the foreign king’s Pokémon. And if the weapon could bring a Pokémon back to life[game-token-1] [game-token-2]it stands to reason it could bring our children back as well[game-token-3] But how much of it was our idea[game-token-4]? And how much of it was Aklove’s machinations[game-token-5]?
entries.translated:
Il piano era portare qui a Borrius
l{B4}Arma Suprema - quella menzionata\lnelle antiche leggende -. Ma

sebbene quell{B4}arma possa essere
capace di distruzione di massa, era\lanche lo stesso dispositivo usato

per restituire i Pokémon del re
straniero. E se l{B4}arma poteva\lriportare in vita un Pokémon\. \.è

logico pensare che possa riportare
in vita anche i nostri figli\. Ma\lquanto di tutto questo era una

nostra idea\.? E quanto invece erano
le macchinazioni di Aklove\.?"},{

entries.original:
"Yes\.\CC0818 under Zeph’s instructions, we
began researching the dark force\lof Borrius.

At the time, we hoped to use its
power to bring us the Ultimate\lWeapon.

Of course, we had no idea the dark
force was, in fact, Aros’s old\lpartner, Hoopa.

And from there\.\CC0818 you know the rest.

\. \. \. \.

Phew\.\CC0820 well, that was an explanation
and a half.

Take it all in, [player].

\.

Okay, now that you know what’s
really been going on, you should\lhave no hesitation about working\lwith us."
entries.translation_source: Yes[game-token-1][control-code-2] under Zeph’s instructions, we began researching the dark force of Borrius. At the time, we hoped to use its power to bring us the Ultimate Weapon. Of course, we had no idea the dark force was, in fact, Aros’s old partner, Hoopa. And from there[game-token-3][control-code-4] you know the rest.
