[game-token-5] [game-token-6] [game-token-7] [game-token-8] Phew[game-token-9][control-code-10] well, that was an explanation and a half. Take it all in, [player-name-11]. [game-token-12] Okay, now that you know what’s really been going on, you should have no hesitation about working with us.
entries.translated:
Sì\.\CC0818 su ordine di Zeph, abbiamo
iniziato a studiare la forza oscura\ldi Borrius. All{B4}epoca speravamo di

usarne il potere per ottenere
l{B4}Arma Suprema. Ovviamente, non\lavevamo idea che la forza oscura

fosse, in realtà, il vecchio
partner di Aros, Hoopa. E da lì\.\CC0818\lconosci il resto. \. \. \. \. Uff\.\CC0820 beh,

questa sì che è stata una
spiegazione lunga e dettagliata.\lAssorbi tutto, [player]. \. Okay, ora

che sai cosa sta succedendo
davvero, non dovresti avere\lesitazioni a collaborare con noi.

entries.original:
"I should apologize, [player]\.

I believed you to be some sort of
spy, sent by Aklove.

If I’d known you were the real deal
all along, I would have reacted\lless\.\CC0818 violently."
entries.translation_source: I should apologize, [player-name-1][game-token-2] I believed you to be some sort of spy, sent by Aklove. If I’d known you were the real deal all along, I would have reacted less[game-token-3][control-code-4] violently.
entries.translated:
Dovrei scusarmi, [player]\. Credevo
che fossi una specie di spia,\linviata da Aklove. Se avessi saputo

che eri il vero affare fin
dall{B4}inizio, avrei reagito meno\.\CC0818\lviolentemente.

entries.original:
"Sir!

We’ve detected remnants of Hoopa’s
portal energy in Vivill Town!

It’s quite likely the Light of Ruin’s
base!"
entries.translation_source: Sir! We’ve detected remnants of Hoopa’s portal energy in Vivill Town! It’s quite likely the Light of Ruin’s base!
entries.translated:
Signore! Abbiamo rilevato tracce
dell{B4}energia dei portali di Hoopa a\lVivill Town! È molto probabile che

sia la base della Light of Ruin!

entries.original:
"Vivill Town\.

So\.\CC0820 the old base used by the
Science Society, now serves as the\lLight of Ruin’s\.

I should have known\."
entries.translation_source: Vivill Town[game-token-1] So[game-token-2][control-code-3] the old base used by the Science Society, now serves as the Light of Ruin’s[game-token-4] I should have known[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Vivill Town\. Quindi\.\CC0820 la vecchia base
usata dalla Science Society ora\lserve alla Light of Ruin\. Avrei

dovuto capirlo\.

entries.original:
"Marlon\.\CC0818 we cannot remain here
any longer.

Now that Aklove is distracted,
we must strike quickly!

It’s time to rally our fighting
force and depart for Vivill Town.

Prepare the Shadow!
We move out at once!"
entries.translation_source: Marlon[game-token-1][control-code-2] we cannot remain here any longer. Now that Aklove is distracted, we must strike quickly! It’s time to rally our fighting force and depart for Vivill Town. Prepare the Shadow! We move out at once!
entries.translated:
Marlon\.\CC0818 non possiamo restare qui
ancora a lungo. Ora che Aklove è\ldistratto, dobbiamo colpire in

fretta! È il momento di radunare la
nostra forza combattente e partire\lper Vivill Town. Preparate l{B4}Ombra!

Muoviamoci subito!

entries.original:
"Of course, Zeph.

I doubt we have much time until
Aklove returns."
entries.translation_source: Of course, Zeph. I doubt we have much time until Aklove returns.
entries.translated:
Certo, Zeph. Dubito che abbiamo
ancora molto tempo prima che Aklove\lritorni.

entries.original:
"And [player]\.\CC0818 please, don’t tell
[rival] about Ivory and me.

At least\.\CC0818 not until the time is
truly right.

That we neglected our children
in favour of another\.\CC0818 the thought\lwould sicken him."
entries.translation_source: And [player-name-1][game-token-2][control-code-3] please, don’t tell [text-token-rival-4] about Ivory and me. At least[game-token-5][control-code-6] not until the time is truly right. That we neglected our children in favour of another[game-token-7][control-code-8] the thought would sicken him.
entries.translated:
E [player]\.\CC0818 per favore, non dire a
[rival] nulla di Ivory e me.\lAlmeno\.\CC0818 non finché non sarà davvero

il momento giusto. Che abbiamo
trascurato i nostri figli a favore\ldi un altro\.\CC0818 l{B4}idea lo nauseerebbe.

entries.original:
"Oh, before I forget, keep the
outfit.

I think it looks rather good on
you.

Who knows\.\CC0818 it may come in handy
someday."
entries.translation_source: Oh, before I forget, keep the outfit. I think it looks rather good on you. Who knows[game-token-1][control-code-2] it may come in handy someday.
entries.translated:
Oh, prima che me ne dimentichi,
tieni l{B4}outfit. Credo ti stia\lproprio bene. Chissà\.\CC0818 potrebbe

tornarti utile un giorno.

entries.original:
"Have you the means to cross water -
the HM for Surf?

If you cannot use it, then you
should first obtain [green]Dehara City[blue]’s\lGym Badge, before you regroup\lwith us.

We must reach [green]Vivill Town[blue] as soon
as possible, so please hurry.

It’s [green]northeast[blue] of [green]Dehara City[blue],
when you are ready."
entries.translation_source: Have you the means to cross water - the HM for Surf? If you cannot use it, then you should first obtain [color-green-1]Dehara City[color-blue-2]’s Gym Badge, before you regroup with us. We must reach [color-green-3]Vivill Town[color-blue-4] as soon as possible, so please hurry. It’s [color-green-5]northeast[color-blue-6] of [color-green-7]Dehara City[color-blue-8], when you are ready.
entries.translated:
Hai i mezzi per attraversare
l{B4}acqua, cioè la MN di Surf? Se non\lpuoi usarla, allora dovresti prima

ottenere la Medaglia della Palestra
di [green]Dehara City[blue], prima di\lricongiungerti a noi. Dobbiamo

raggiungere [green]Vivill Town[blue] il prima
possibile, quindi sbrigati. È a\l[green]nordest[blue] di [green]Dehara City[blue], quando sei

pronto.

entries.original: "daughter"
entries.translation_source: daughter
entries.translated: figlia

entries.original:
"You’re seriously only leaving
Dehara now?

Man, you sure are slow!

Well, while you were loitering
around, I figured out how to get\lto the Ruins of Void.

Of course, by the time I got there,
it was too late to do anything\."
entries.translation_source: You’re seriously only leaving Dehara now? Man, you sure are slow! Well, while you were loitering around, I figured out how to get to the Ruins of Void. Of course, by the time I got there, it was too late to do anything[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Stai davvero uscendo da Dehara solo
adesso? Amico, sei davvero lento!\lBeh, mentre bighellonavi in giro,

ho capito come arrivare alle Rovine
del Vuoto. Naturalmente, quando ci\lsono arrivato, era troppo tardi per

fare qualsiasi cosa\.

entries.original:
"[player]!
Just the [buffer1] I was looking for!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Just the [buffer1-2] I was looking for!
entries.translated:
[player]! Proprio il [buffer1] che
stavo cercando!

entries.original:
"Wait\.\CC0818 who the heck are you
supposed to be?"
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] who the heck are you supposed to be?
entries.translated: Aspetta\.\CC0818 e tu chi diavolo saresti?

entries.original:
"[player], have you seen Jax?

Last I heard, he was planning to
travel to the Ruins of Void."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], have you seen Jax? Last I heard, he was planning to travel to the Ruins of Void.
entries.translated:
[player], hai visto Jax? L{B4}ultima
volta che ho sentito, stava\lprogettando di andare alle Rovine

del Vuoto.

entries.original:
"Whatever the Shadows were planning,
they’d already done it by the time\lI got there.

I saw signs of a battle, but nobody
was around\.\CC0818 and that includes\lanyone named Jax."
entries.translation_source: Whatever the Shadows were planning, they’d already done it by the time I got there. I saw signs of a battle, but nobody was around[game-token-1][control-code-2] and that includes anyone named Jax.
entries.translated:
Qualunque cosa stessero progettando
le Ombre, l{B4}avevano già fatta\lquando sono arrivato. Ho visto i

segni di una lotta, ma non c{B4}era
nessuno\.\CC0818 e questo include chiunque\lsi chiami Jax.

entries.original:
"[player], you were the last one to
see him!

What happened in there?

\.

Aklove?
I’ve never heard of him before\.

And it’s just as I feared - the dark
force has been released at last\.

\.

What!? Aros has been trapped
inside a Cube, you say?

Utter madness!

\.

Oh no\.

If I know Zeph, there’s only one
thing he could have possibly done\lwith Jax\.

\.

Oh?
You say Jax wasn’t with Zeph?

That gives me hope\.\CC0818 he must still
be out there\.

I’m surprised Zeph agreed to work
with you, but you know the saying\.

\qoThe enemy of my enemy is my
friend.\qc"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], you were the last one to see him! What happened in there? [game-token-2] Aklove? I’ve never heard of him before[game-token-3] And it’s just as I feared - the dark force has been released at last[game-token-4] [game-token-5] What!? Aros has been trapped inside a Cube, you say? Utter madness! [game-token-6] Oh no[game-token-7] If I know Zeph, there’s only one thing he could have possibly done with Jax[game-token-8] [game-token-9] Oh? You say Jax wasn’t with Zeph? That gives me hope[game-token-10][control-code-11] he must still be out there[game-token-12] I’m surprised Zeph agreed to work with you, but you know the saying[game-token-13] [quote-open-14]The enemy of my enemy is my friend.[quote-close-15]
entries.translated:
[player], sei stato l{B4}ultimo a
vederlo! Cosa è successo là dentro?\l\. Aklove? Non ne ho mai sentito

parlare prima\. Ed è proprio come
temevo - la forza oscura è stata\lfinalmente liberata\. \. Cosa!? Aros è

stato intrappolato dentro un Cubo,
dici? Follia pura! \. Oh no\. Se\lconosco Zeph, c{B4}è solo una cosa che

potrebbe aver fatto con Jax\. \. Oh?
Dici che Jax non era con Zeph?\lQuesto mi dà speranza\.\CC0818 deve essere

ancora là fuori\. Mi sorprende che
Zeph abbia accettato di lavorare\lcon te, ma conosci il detto\. \qoIl

nemico del mio nemico è mio amico.\qc

entries.original:
"[player]\.\CC0818 I don’t like the sound of
what you told me.

If this Aklove, the one who controls
Hoopa, is working with Fey, then\lthey pose an even larger threat\lthan I suspected.

And if the Light of Ruin is another
branch like the Shadows, then that\lmeans only one thing\.

A recruitment drive\.\CC0818 to find more
people to turn into those\labominations!

How Hoopa fits into things, however,
I have no idea\."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1][game-token-2][control-code-3] I don’t like the sound of what you told me. If this Aklove, the one who controls Hoopa, is working with Fey, then they pose an even larger threat than I suspected. And if the Light of Ruin is another branch like the Shadows, then that means only one thing[game-token-4] A recruitment drive[game-token-5][control-code-6] to find more people to turn into those abominations! How Hoopa fits into things, however, I have no idea[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
[player]\.\CC0818 Non mi piace ciò che mi
hai detto. Se questo Aklove, colui\lche controlla Hoopa, sta lavorando

con Fey, allora rappresentano una
minaccia ancora più grande di\lquanto sospettassi. E se la Luce

della Rovina è un altro ramo come
le Ombre, allora significa solo una\lcosa\. una campagna di reclutamento\.\CC0818

per trovare più persone da
trasformare in quelle abominazioni!\lCome Hoopa si inserisce in tutto

ciò, tuttavia, non ne ho idea\.

entries.original:
"If they have taken Jax\.\CC0818 no,
I’ll try to stay optimistic.

Jax is a resourceful boy\.

But lately, he seems to be
contacting me less and less\.\land with less pep, every time.

[player], head over to Vivill Town.

Stop the Light of Ruin, and try to
find Jax.

Whether he’s there of his own free
will or not, I suspect he will be\lwith them."
entries.translation_source: If they have taken Jax[game-token-1][control-code-2] no, I’ll try to stay optimistic. Jax is a resourceful boy[game-token-3] But lately, he seems to be contacting me less and less[game-token-4] and with less pep, every time. [player-name-5], head over to Vivill Town. Se hanno preso Jax\.\CC0818 no, cercherò di
essere ottimista. Jax è un ragazzo\lintraprendente\. Ma ultimamente,

sembra che mi contatti sempre meno\.
e con meno entusiasmo, ogni volta.\l[player], dirigiti a Vivill Town.

Ferma la Luce Rovinosa, e cerca di
trovare Jax. Che sia lì di sua\lspontanea volontà o no, sospetto

che sarà con loro.

"Okay, that’s it!
I’ve had it!

I kept my yap shut all this time,
but I’m not just gonna be ignored\lanymore!

Listen, old man\.\CC0818 I have no idea
who you are, or what’s happening\.

But if whatever is going on has to
do with the Shadows, then I want in!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, that’s it! I’ve had it! I kept my yap shut all this time, but I’m not just gonna be ignored anymore! Listen, old man[game-token-1][control-code-2] I have no idea who you are, or what’s happening[game-token-3] But if whatever is going on has to do with the Shadows, then I want in!
entries.translated:
Basta, adesso! Ne ho abbastanza!
Sono rimasto zitto finora, ma non\lmi farò più ignorare! Ascolta,

vecchio\.\CC0818 Non ho idea di chi tu sia,
o di cosa stia succedendo\. Ma se\lquello che sta accadendo ha a che

fare con gli Shadows, allora voglio
partecipare!

entries.original:
"Oh! My apologies!
I didn’t mean to be rude.

Who might you be?"

entries.translated:
Oh! Le mie scuse! Non volevo essere
scortese. Chi potresti essere?

entries.original:
"I’m mad as all else!

I don’t care about this Light of
Ruin or whatever\.

I came this close to finding the
Shadows and finding my parents,\land they got away from me again!

So if I hear they’re heading to
Vivill Town, then that’s where\lI’m going!"
entries.translation_source: I’m mad as all else! I don’t care about this Light of Ruin or whatever[game-token-1] I came this close to finding the Shadows and finding my parents, and they got away from me again! So if I hear they’re heading to Vivill Town, then that’s where I’m going!
entries.translated:
Sono furibondo! Non mi importa di
questa Luce della Rovina o quel che\lè\. Ero a un passo dal trovare gli

Shadows e ritrovare i miei
genitori, e mi sono scappati di\lnuovo! Quindi, se sento che si

stanno dirigendo a Vivill Town,
allora andrò lì!

entries.original:
"Please, I urge you to wait!

As of now, the Shadows are our
pawns to fix a greater problem!

At least hold off on your act of
vengeance until this ordeal is\lover, understood?"
entries.translation_source: Please, I urge you to wait! As of now, the Shadows are our pawns to fix a greater problem! At least hold off on your act of vengeance until this ordeal is over, understood?
entries.translated:
Per favore, ti imploro di
aspettare! Per ora, le Ombre sono\lle nostre pedine per risolvere un

problema più grande! Almeno
trattieni la tua vendetta finché\lquesta faccenda non sarà finita,

capito?

entries.original:
"They’re YOUR pawns, old man.
They’re MY only lead to my parents.

I’m not stupid.
I know what’s at stake.

But the second this is all over,
I won’t hesitate to shake ’em down\lfor what I want to know."
entries.translation_source: They’re YOUR pawns, old man. They’re MY only lead to my parents. I’m not stupid. I know what’s at stake. But the second this is all over, I won’t hesitate to shake ’em down for what I want to know.

Sono le TUE pedine, vecchio. Sono
il MIO unico indizio per trovare i\lmiei genitori. Non sono stupido. So

cosa c{B4}è in gioco. Ma non appena
sarà tutto finito, non esiterò a\lmetterli alle strette per ottenere

ciò che voglio sapere.

"[player], since this is officially
your \qomission\qc, I’ll be waiting for\lyou in [green]Vivill Town[blue].

play nice with the Shadows until\lwe’re done.

entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], since this is officially your [quote-open-2]mission[quote-close-3], I’ll be waiting for you in [color-green-4]Vivill Town[color-blue-5]. And for your sake, I’ll even play nice with the Shadows until we’re done. Don’t be late, [player-name-6].

[player], dato che questa è
ufficialmente la tua \qomissione\qc, ti\laspetterò a [green]Vivill Town[blue]. E per il

tuo bene, mi comporterò bene con le
Shadows finché non avremo finito.\lNon fare tardi, [player].

"That boy\.\CC0818 he’s got quite the mouth
to him\.

Vivill Town, [player].

as you’ve returned."
entries.translation_source: That boy[game-token-1][control-code-2] he’s got quite the mouth to him[game-token-3] Well, I wish you luck in Vivill Town, [player-name-4]. Let me know how it went, as soon as you’ve returned.
entries.translated:
Quel ragazzo\.\CC0818 ha proprio la
parlantina\. Beh, ti auguro buona\lfortuna a Vivill Town, [player].

Fammi sapere com{B4}è andata, appena
sarai tornato.

entries.original:
"Sheesh, about time you got here,
[player]."
entries.translation_source: Sheesh, about time you got here, [player-name-1].
entries.translated:
Accidenti, era ora che arrivassi
qui, [player].

entries.original:
"Sorry\.\CC0818 I’m just a little on edge.

I’m getting close\.\CC0818 so close to
finding out what happened to\lmy parents\.

I guess it’s making me lose my cool
somehow."
entries.translation_source: Sorry[game-token-1][control-code-2] I’m just a little on edge. I’m getting close[game-token-3][control-code-4] so close to finding out what happened to my parents[game-token-5] I guess it’s making me lose my cool somehow.

Spiacente\.\CC0818 sono solo un po{B4} teso. Mi
sto avvicinando\.\CC0818 così vicino a\lscoprire cosa è successo ai miei

genitori\. Penso che in qualche modo
mi stia facendo perdere la calma.

"While you were making your way
over, I tried scouting the area to\llook for the Shadows, but\. so far\lI’ve seen no sign of them."
entries.translation_source: While you were making your way over, I tried scouting the area to look for the Shadows, but[game-token-1] so far I’ve seen no sign of them.
entries.translated:
Mentre ti stavi avvicinando, ho
cercato di esplorare la zona per\ltrovare le Ombre, ma\. finora non ho

visto alcun segno di loro.

entries.original:
"It’s weird\.\CC0818 it’s like the entire town
is deserted.

The only person I saw was this guy
with a weird symbol on his outfit,\lhanging around the warehouse,\lnorth of town.

Is that the base of these
\qoLight of Ruin\qc guys?"
entries.translation_source: It’s weird[game-token-1][control-code-2] it’s like the entire town is deserted. The only person I saw was this guy with a weird symbol on his outfit, hanging around the warehouse, north of town. Is that the base of these [quote-open-3]Light of Ruin[quote-close-4] guys?
entries.translated:
È strano\.\CC0818 è come se l{B4}intera città
fosse deserta. L{B4}unica persona che\lho visto è stato quel tizio con un

simbolo strano sul vestito, che
girava nei paraggi del magazzino, a\lnord della città. È quella la base

di quei tipi della \qoLight of Ruin\qc?

entries.original:
"Well, only one way to find out.
I’m going on ahead.

If that is their base, then the
Shadows aren’t going to be far\lbehind."
entries.translation_source: Well, only one way to find out. I’m going on ahead. If that is their base, then the Shadows aren’t going to be far behind.
entries.translated:
Beh, c{B4}è solo un modo per
scoprirlo. Vado avanti io. Se\lquella è la loro base, allora le

Ombre non saranno lontane.

"You’re one of those Light of Ruin

What’re you doing in this miserable
place, anyway?"
entries.translation_source: You’re one of those Light of Ruin thugs, aren’t you? What’re you doing in this miserable place, anyway?
entries.translated:
Sei uno di quei scagnozzi di Light
of Ruin, vero? Cosa ci fai,\lcomunque, in questo posto misero?

entries.original:
"What I’m doing here isn’t any of
your business, kid.

You’ll leave if you know what’s
good for you."
entries.translation_source: What I’m doing here isn’t any of your business, kid. You’ll leave if you know what’s good for you.
entries.translated:
Quello che sto facendo qui non sono
affari tuoi, ragazzino. Faresti\lmeglio ad andartene se ci tieni.

"I think we’ve got the right place,
[player]!

entries.translation_source: I think we’ve got the right place, [player-name-1]! He absolutely screams [quote-open-2]suspicious[quote-close-3].
entries.translated:
Credo che abbiamo trovato il posto
giusto, [player]! Urla proprio\l\qosospetto\qc.

"You’re not fooling anyone, pal.

We know this is your headquarters,
and we’re gonna be busting in\lwhether you like it or not!"
entries.translation_source: You’re not fooling anyone, pal. We know this is your headquarters, and we’re gonna be busting in whether you like it or not!
entries.translated:
Non stai ingannando nessuno, amico.
Sappiamo che questa è la tua sede,\le sfonderemo comunque, che ti

piaccia o no!

"CHZKKK\.

\.\CC0820Ma’am\.\CC0818 it looks like they came
after all.

with them."
entries.translation_source: CHZKKK[game-token-1] [game-token-2][control-code-3]Ma’am[game-token-4][control-code-5] it looks like they came after all. But, I thought you said they would have a small army with them[game-token-6] No, it’s just two Trainers[game-token-7] Understood. No need for backup - I can deal with them.

CHZKKK\. \.\CC0820Signora\.\CC0818 sembra che siano

Allenatori\. Ricevuto. Non c{B4}è\lbisogno di rinforzi - posso

occuparmene io.

"You made a huge mistake,
coming here alone."

entries.translated:
Hai fatto un grosso errore venendo
qui da solo.

"You think we’re alone?
Keep dreaming.

When our backup arrives,
you’ll eat those words!"
entries.translation_source: You think we’re alone? Keep dreaming. When our backup arrives, you’ll eat those words!
entries.translated:
Pensi che siamo soli? Continua a
sognare. Quando arriveranno i\lnostri rinforzi, ti rimangerai

quelle parole!

"Ha ha\.\CC0818 well, thank you for

\.\CC0818not that any of it matters.

mat for you behind these doors?

our entire Light of Ruin branch!

idea what you’ve stepped into!"
entries.translation_source: Ha ha[game-token-1][control-code-2] well, thank you for confirming our suspicions[game-token-3] [game-token-4][control-code-5]not that any of it matters. You arrogant little fools have no idea what you’ve stepped into!

"Sorry, but nothing is gonna stop me

Scusa, ma niente mi impedirà di
ottenere ciò che voglio. Né tu né\ll{B4}intero tuo ramo!

"\.\CC0818What?

C’mon, he was being obnoxious.

\.\CC0818{BD}osa? Dai, era insopportabile. Se
l{B4}è proprio cercata.

"Quick, let’s head inside while he’s
still unconcious."

Presto, entriamo mentre è ancora
incosciente.

"Man, those Shadow guys sure know

Accidenti, quelli della Shadow

Non abbiamo molto tempo, [player].
Quel grunt che ho steso potrebbe\lsvegliarsi da un momento all{B4}altro,

Quella porta là davanti sembra

"What the\.\CC0820

Che di\.\CC0820 Come ha fatto un Guerriero
Ombra ad arrivare qui?

"We aren’t equipped to deal with

Non siamo più attrezzati per

C-cosa? Questa non è affatto una

"Hey, [player]!

Ehi, [player]! È uno dei tuoi amici

"Geez\. that was close\.

\.

Accidenti\. è stato vicino\. Ma che

"But hey, at least it did us

Ma dai, almeno ci ha fatto un

Va bene - dovrò avvertire tutti gli

"Why you\.

Ma tu\. Tornerò! Quando arriveranno i

"If that’s all the Light of Ruin

Se è tutto quello che ha la Light

"Come back here once you’ve learned

entries.original: "Please enter the other [green]5[blue] letters."
entries.translation_source: Please enter the other [color-green-1]5[color-blue-2] letters.
entries.translated: Inserisci le altre [green]5[blue] lettere.

entries.original: "aklov"
entries.translation_source: aklov
entries.translated: aklov

entries.original:
"That doesn’t look like the correct
password\."
entries.translation_source: That doesn’t look like the correct password[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non sembra la password corretta\.

entries.original: "And the last letter is E\."
entries.translation_source: And the last letter is E[game-token-1]
entries.translated: E l{B4}ultima lettera è E\.

entries.original: "The door is open for you, Zeph."
entries.translation_source: The door is open for you, Zeph.
entries.translated: La porta è aperta per te, Zeph.

entries.original:
"Good work, scientist.

I should have known that arrogant
fool would make the password his\lown name\."
entries.translation_source: Good work, scientist. I should have known that arrogant fool would make the password his own name[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ottimo lavoro, scienziato. Avrei
dovuto immaginare che quello\lspaccone avrebbe reso la password

il suo stesso nome\.

entries.original:
"Marlon, has that boy returned with
the bottle yet?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon, has that boy returned with the bottle yet?
entries.translated:
Marlon, quel ragazzo è tornato con
la bottiglia?

entries.original:
"No, he hasn’t.
He must still be searching for it."
entries.translation_source: No, he hasn’t. He must still be searching for it.
entries.translated:
No, non l{B4}ha ancora fatto. Deve
essere ancora in cerca di quello.

entries.original:
"We’ll have to proceed without
him, then.

Aklove still appears to be with
Fey, so with luck, we won’t need\lthe bottle."
entries.translation_source: We’ll have to proceed without him, then. Aklove still appears to be with Fey, so with luck, we won’t need the bottle.
entries.translated:
Allora dovremo procedere senza di
lui. Aklove sembra ancora essere\lcon Fey, quindi con un po{B4} di

fortuna non avremo bisogno della
bottiglia.

entries.original:
"Ivory!

So my suspicions were correct -
you HAVE betrayed us."
entries.translation_source: Ivory! So my suspicions were correct - you HAVE betrayed us.
entries.translated:
Ivory! Quindi i miei sospetti erano
fondati - ci hai DAVVERO traditi.

entries.original:
"[red]I betrayed you?
That’s simply untrue, Zeph.

My position\.\CC0818 my goals\.\CC0818 they haven’t
changed one bit.

It was you, who betrayed us\.\CC0818
when you refused to accept\lAklove as your replacement."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I betrayed you? That’s simply untrue, Zeph. My position[game-token-2][control-code-3] my goals[game-token-4][control-code-5] they haven’t changed one bit. It was you, who betrayed us[game-token-6][control-code-7] when you refused to accept Aklove as your replacement.
entries.translated:
[red]Ti ho tradito? Non è affatto vero,
Zeph. La mia posizione\.\CC0818 i miei\lobiettivi\.\CC0818 non sono cambiati per

niente. Sei stato tu a tradirci\.\CC0818
quando hai rifiutato di accettare\lAklove come tuo sostituto.

entries.original:
"[red]After Aklove took over the
leadership at the Ruins of Void, he\lgave me an offer I couldn’t refuse.

If I assist in his grand plan, then
he’ll grant me the power to finish\lwhat we started.

So don’t you see, Zeph?
This was the best course of action\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]After Aklove took over the leadership at the Ruins of Void, he gave me an offer I couldn’t refuse. If I assist in his grand plan, then he’ll grant me the power to finish what we started. So don’t you see, Zeph? This was the best course of action[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[red]Dopo che Aklove ha preso il comando
alle Rovine del Vuoto, mi ha fatto\lun{B4}offerta che non potevo

rifiutare. Se lo aiuto nel suo
grande piano, mi concederà il\lpotere di finire ciò che abbiamo

iniziato. Quindi non lo capisci,
Zeph? Questa era la scelta migliore\.

entries.original:
"Grand plan?
You fool, Ivory!

He made it no secret to us that he
intends to destroy Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Grand plan? You fool, Ivory! He made it no secret to us that he intends to destroy Borrius!
entries.translated:
Grande piano? Sciocco, Ivory! Non
ci ha nascosto che intende\ldistruggere Borrius!

entries.original: "[red]Grunts\.\CC0820 leave us, for now."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Grunts[game-token-2][control-code-3] leave us, for now.
entries.translated: [red]Reclute\.\CC0820 lasciateci, per ora.

entries.original:
"[red]Perhaps that’s his aim\.\CC0818 but his
aim aligns with ours.

Like us, he intends to use Hoopa’s
power to bring the Ultimate Weapon\lto Borrius.

And then, using the Shadow Warriors
as fuel\.\CC0818 he’ll engage it."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Perhaps that’s his aim[game-token-2][control-code-3] but his aim aligns with ours. Like us, he intends to use Hoopa’s power to bring the Ultimate Weapon to Borrius. And then, using the Shadow Warriors as fuel[game-token-4][control-code-5] he’ll engage it.
entries.translated:
[red]Forse è quello il suo obiettivo\.\CC0818 ma
il suo obiettivo coincide con il\lnostro. Come noi, intende usare il

potere di Hoopa per portare l{B4}Arma
Suprema a Borrius. E poi, usando\lgli Shadow Warriors come

combustibile\.\CC0818 lo userà.

entries.original:
"[red]When the dust settles, I’ll be
granted use of the weapon to\lrestore my son\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]When the dust settles, I’ll be granted use of the weapon to restore my son[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[red]Quando la polvere si sarà posata,
mi sarà concesso l{B4}uso dell{B4}arma\lper riavere mio figlio\.

entries.original:
"What\.\CC0818 how can you do this?

What’s the point in helping him, when
it leaves us without a home to\lreturn to!?

It’ll destroy everything!

And that includes the children we
still have living here!"
entries.translation_source: What[game-token-1][control-code-2] how can you do this? What’s the point in helping him, when it leaves us without a home to return to!? It’ll destroy everything! And that includes the children we still have living here!
entries.translated:
Cosa\.\CC0818 come puoi fare questo? Qual è
il senso di aiutarlo, se ci lascia\lsenza una casa in cui tornare!?

Distruggerà tutto! E questo include
i bambini che vivono ancora qui!

entries.original:
"[red]Marlon\.\CC0818 of course I’ve prepared
for that inevitable outcome.

Aklove has agreed to safeguard our
children until this whole ordeal\lhas passed.

At the end of it all, yes, Borrius
may be gone\.

But, our entire family will be
reunited once again\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Marlon[game-token-2][control-code-3] of course I’ve prepared for that inevitable outcome. Aklove has agreed to safeguard our children until this whole ordeal has passed. At the end of it all, yes, Borrius may be gone[game-token-4] But, our entire family will be reunited once again[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
[red]Marlon\.\CC0818 Certo, mi sono preparato per
quell{B4}inevitabile esito. Aklove ha\laccettato di proteggere i nostri

figli finché tutto questo non sarà
finito. Alla fine di tutto, sì,\lBorrius potrebbe anche scomparire\.

Ma tutta la nostra famiglia si
riunirà di nuovo\.

entries.original:
"Listen to yourself, Ivory!

You’re claiming our entire plan\.\CC0818 is
worth sacrificing an entire region!

It was always one thing to use the
lives of willing grunts to create\lthe Shadow Warriors\.

But these are countless innocent
lives you’d be wiping out!"
entries.translation_source: Listen to yourself, Ivory! You’re claiming our entire plan[game-token-1][control-code-2] is worth sacrificing an entire region! It was always one thing to use the lives of willing grunts to create the Shadow Warriors[game-token-3] But these are countless innocent lives you’d be wiping out!
entries.translated:
Ascoltati, Ivory! Stai sostenendo
che il nostro intero piano\.\CC0818 valga il\lsacrificio di un{B4}intera regione!

Era già una cosa usare le vite di
reclute consenzienti per creare gli\lShadow Warriors\. Ma qui stai per

cancellare un numero incalcolabile
di vite innocenti!

entries.original:
"I agree with Marlon, Ivory.

I’ve crossed many lines, but this is
one I refuse to overstep\.

And I cannot allow you to do
the same.

Borrius is my home\.\CC0818 no, our home!

And that includes my own son\.\CC0818
he still needs a home to return to!

Shadow Warrior!
Seize her!

I’m sorry, but this is necessary,
Ivory\."
entries.translation_source: I agree with Marlon, Ivory. I’ve crossed many lines, but this is one I refuse to overstep[game-token-1] And I cannot allow you to do the same. Borrius is my home[game-token-2][control-code-3] no, our home! And that includes my own son[game-token-4][control-code-5] he still needs a home to return to! Shadow Warrior! Seize her! I’m sorry, but this is necessary, Ivory[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Sono d{B4}accordo con Marlon, Ivory.
Ho oltrepassato molti limiti, ma\lquesto è uno che mi rifiuto di

superare\. E non posso permettere che
tu faccia lo stesso. Borrius è casa\lmia\.\CC0818 no, casa nostra! E questo

include mio figlio\.\CC0818 ha ancora
bisogno di una casa a cui tornare!\lGuerriero Ombra! Prendila! Mi

dispiace, ma è necessario, Ivory\.

entries.original:
"[red]What now, Marlon?

Are you really going to let Zeph
do this?

Will you truly allow him to sacrifice
everything we’ve worked so hard\lfor, all these years\.?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]What now, Marlon? Are you really going to let Zeph do this? Will you truly allow him to sacrifice everything we’ve worked so hard for, all these years[game-token-2]?
entries.translated:
[red]E adesso, Marlon? Lascerai davvero
che Zeph faccia questo? Permetterai\ldavvero che sacrifichi tutto ciò

per cui abbiamo lavorato così
duramente, per tutti questi anni\.

entries.original:
"Without a doubt in my mind, Ivory.

I have no hesitation, anymore.

You can ask a thousand times,
and I wouldn’t change my answer."
entries.translation_source: Without a doubt in my mind, Ivory. I have no hesitation, anymore. You can ask a thousand times, and I wouldn’t change my answer.
entries.translated:
Senza alcun dubbio nella mia mente,
Ivory. Non ho più alcuna\lesitazione. Puoi chiedermelo mille

volte, e non cambierei la mia
risposta.

entries.original:
"[red]Suit yourself.

Even if you lock me up, it will only
delay the inevitable.

Aklove will find the Ultimate
Weapon, and when he does\.

At last, he will keep his promise
to me\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Suit yourself. Even if you lock me up, it will only delay the inevitable. Aklove will find the Ultimate Weapon, and when he does[game-token-2] At last, he will keep his promise to me[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[red]Fa{B4} come ti pare. Anche se mi
rinchiudi, ritarderà solo\ll{B4}inevitabile. Aklove troverà

l{B4}Arma Suprema e, quando lo farà\.
Alla fine, manterrà la sua promessa\lcon me\.

entries.original:
"Oh, we have no intention of holding
you for long.

We just need you out of the way
so we can disrupt your plans.

Once we discover where you’re
keeping the rest of the Shadow\lWarriors, Aklove’s big scheme will\lbe over.

You said it yourself, Ivory.

Without them, you have nothing to
power the weapon."
entries.translation_source: Oh, we have no intention of holding you for long. We just need you out of the way so we can disrupt your plans. Once we discover where you’re keeping the rest of the Shadow Warriors, Aklove’s big scheme will be over. You said it yourself, Ivory. Without them, you have nothing to power the weapon.
entries.translated:
Oh, non abbiamo alcuna intenzione
di trattenerti a lungo. Dobbiamo\lsolo toglierti di mezzo, così

possiamo mandare all{B4}aria i vostri
piani. Quando scopriremo dove tieni\lnascosti gli altri Shadow Warriors,

il grande piano di Aklove sarà
finito. L{B4}hai detto tu stesso,\lIvory. Senza di loro, non hai nulla

con cui alimentare l{B4}arma.

entries.original: "[red]Right on cue\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Right on cue[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [red]Proprio al momento giusto\.

entries.original:
"No, no, no!
It’s too soon for him to return!"
entries.translation_source: No, no, no! It’s too soon for him to return!
entries.translated:
No, no, no! È troppo presto perché
torni!

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0818 why have I stopped receiving
the pertinent information needed to\llocate the Ultimate Weapon?"
entries.translation_source: Ivory[game-token-1][control-code-2] why have I stopped receiving the pertinent information needed to locate the Ultimate Weapon?
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0818 perché ho smesso di ricevere
le informazioni pertinenti\lnecessarie a localizzare l{B4}Arma

Suprema?

entries.original:
"[red]I apologize, Aklove.

The Shadows have proven more
troublesome than we anticipated.

Unfortunately, the Pokémon you
summoned to patrol the waters\lfailed to repel them.

The Shadows were able to bombard
the cliffside, shattering the wall\land flooding the Research Lab."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I apologize, Aklove. The Shadows have proven more troublesome than we anticipated. Unfortunately, the Pokémon you summoned to patrol the waters failed to repel them. The Shadows were able to bombard the cliffside, shattering the wall and flooding the Research Lab.
entries.translated:
[red]Mi scuso, Aklove. The Shadows si
sono rivelate più ostiche di quanto\lavessimo previsto. Purtroppo, i

Pokémon che hai evocato per
pattugliare le acque non sono\lriusciti a respingerle. The Shadows

sono riuscite a bombardare la
scogliera, frantumando il muro e\lallagando il Laboratorio di

Ricerca.

entries.original:
"WHAT!?

My data on the Ultimate Weapon has
been destroyed!?"
entries.translation_source: WHAT!? My data on the Ultimate Weapon has been destroyed!?
entries.translated:
COSA!? I miei dati sull{B4}Arma
suprema sono stati distrutti!?

entries.original:
"[red]Most of it is too corrupted to be
recovered.

But we did learn something vital
before the attack.

The Ultimate Weapon is no longer in
your home region\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Most of it is too corrupted to be recovered. But we did learn something vital before the attack. The Ultimate Weapon is no longer in your home region[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[red]La maggior parte è troppo corrotta
per poter essere recuperata. Ma\labbiamo scoperto qualcosa di vitale

prima dell{B4}attacco. L{B4}Arma Suprema
non si trova più nella tua regione\lnatale\.

entries.original:
"Interesting\.\CC0818 we will discuss this
further, once I have dealt with\lthe intruders."
entries.translation_source: Interesting[game-token-1][control-code-2] we will discuss this further, once I have dealt with the intruders.
entries.translated:
Interessante\. \CC0818 ne discuteremo più a
fondo, una volta che mi sarò\loccupato degli intrusi.

entries.original:
"Zeph\.\CC0818 did you really think you would
be able to stop me?

What you have accomplished is no
more than an inconvenience.

No one will stop me, Zeph!
Not even you!

I WILL find the weapon!"
entries.translation_source: Zeph[game-token-1][control-code-2] did you really think you would be able to stop me? What you have accomplished is no more than an inconvenience. No one will stop me, Zeph! Not even you! I WILL find the weapon!
entries.translated:
Zeph\.\CC0818 hai davvero pensato di
riuscire a fermarmi? Quello che hai\lottenuto non è altro che un

fastidio. Nessuno mi fermerà, Zeph!
Nemmeno tu! TROVERÒ IO l{B4}arma!

entries.original:
"Alright, I held up my end of
the deal, you goon.

I’m pretty sure I found what you’re
looking for\.

But you’re not getting it just yet.

Tell me what I want to know,
and I’ll hand it over. Got it?"
entries.translation_source: Alright, I held up my end of the deal, you goon. I’m pretty sure I found what you’re looking for[game-token-1] But you’re not getting it just yet. Tell me what I want to know, and I’ll hand it over. Got it?
entries.translated:
Va bene, ho mantenuto la mia parte
dell{B4}accordo, idiota. Sono quasi\lcerto di aver trovato quello che

stai cercando\. Ma non l{B4}avrai
ancora. Dimmi quello che voglio\lsapere e te lo darò. Capito?

entries.original:
"I have no time for your games,
boy!

Give it to me!"
entries.translation_source: I have no time for your games, boy! Give it to me!
entries.translated:
Non ho tempo per i tuoi giochi,
ragazzo! Daglielo a me!

entries.original:
"No way, old man.

Tell me what you did to my parents,
and it’s all yours."
entries.translation_source: No way, old man. Tell me what you did to my parents, and it’s all yours.
entries.translated:
Neanche per sogno, vecchio. Dimmi
cosa hai fatto ai miei genitori, e\lsarà tutto tuo.

entries.original: "Now’s really not the time for\."
entries.translation_source: Now’s really not the time for[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non è proprio il momento per\.

entries.original: "ENOUGH! Do you mind?"
entries.translation_source: ENOUGH! Do you mind?
entries.translated: BASTA! Ti dispiace?

entries.original:
"Oh, you must be the big-wig
everyone’s talking about.

Aklove, I’m guessing.

Shut your trap, pal.
I’m not here for you."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you must be the big-wig everyone’s talking about. Aklove, I’m guessing. Shut your trap, pal. I’m not here for you.
entries.translated:
Oh, devi essere il pezzo grosso di
cui tutti parlano. Aklove,\lsuppongo. Tieni a freno la lingua,

amico. Non sono qui per te.

entries.original: "How dare you\."
entries.translation_source: How dare you[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Come osi\.

entries.original:
"HOW DARE YOU!

I am a patient man, but I have no
tolerance for your disrespect,\lyou little brat!"
entries.translation_source: HOW DARE YOU! I am a patient man, but I have no tolerance for your disrespect, you little brat!
entries.translated:
COME OSI! Sono un uomo paziente, ma
non tollero la tua mancanza di\lrispetto, marmocchio!

entries.original:
"Hoopa!
Send him to\."
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! Send him to[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Hoopa! Mandalo lì\.

entries.original: "[red]Aklove, wait!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Aklove, wait!
entries.translated: [red]Aklove, aspetta!

entries.original:
"[red]Our deal\.\CC0820 don’t forget what you
promised me!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Our deal[game-token-2][control-code-3] don’t forget what you promised me!
entries.translated:
[red]Il nostro accordo\.\CC0820 non dimenticare
quello che mi hai promesso!

entries.original:
"Our deal\.?

Ha\.\CC0820 ha ha ha ha\.\CC0818 you mean to
tell me THIS is your son?"
entries.translation_source: Our deal[game-token-1]? Ha[game-token-2][control-code-3] ha ha ha ha[game-token-4][control-code-5] you mean to tell me THIS is your son?
entries.translated:
Il nostro accordo\.? Ah\.\CC0820 ah ah ah ah\.\CC0818
vuoi dirmi che QUESTO è tuo figlio?

entries.original:
"Your son\.?

No\.\CC0820 no, it can’t be\.\CC0818 it has to be
a lie\.!

My parents\.\CC0820 they’d never do such
horrible things\.

They can’t be members of
the Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: Your son[game-token-1]? No[game-token-2][control-code-3] no, it can’t be[game-token-4][control-code-5] it has to be a lie[game-token-6]! My parents[game-token-7][control-code-8] they’d never do such horrible things[game-token-9] They can’t be members of the Shadows!
entries.translated:
Tuo figlio\.? No\.\CC0820 no, non può essere\.\CC0818
dev{B4}essere una bugia\.! I miei\lgenitori\.\CC0820 non farebbero mai cose

così orribili\. Non possono essere
membri delle Ombre!

entries.original: "Oh, this is just rich, Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, this is just rich, Ivory!
entries.translated: Oh, questa sì che è bella, Ivory!

entries.original:
"It is exactly as you heard, boy!

Your own parents are villains!"
entries.translation_source: It is exactly as you heard, boy! Your own parents are villains!
entries.translated:
È esattamente come hai sentito,
ragazzo! I tuoi stessi genitori\lsono dei criminali!

entries.original: "Aklove, that’s enough!"
entries.translation_source: Aklove, that’s enough!
entries.translated: Aklove, basta così!

entries.original:
"[rival], we wanted to come home\.

We really did\."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1], we wanted to come home[game-token-2] We really did[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[rival], volevamo tornare a casa\.
Davvero\.

entries.original:
"\qoJust one more day.\qc

That’s the lie we told ourselves,
over and over.

But after my injury\.\CC0818 I knew the only
way to justify it, was to come\lhome with your brother.

We had to keep going\.\CC0818 so our family
could be whole again\."
entries.translation_source: [quote-open-1]Just one more day.[quote-close-2] That’s the lie we told ourselves, over and over. But after my injury[game-token-3][control-code-4] I knew the only way to justify it, was to come home with your brother. We had to keep going[game-token-5][control-code-6] so our family could be whole again[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
\qoSolo un altro giorno.\qc Questa era
la bugia che ci raccontavamo,\lancora e ancora. Ma dopo il mio

infortunio\.\CC0818 sapevo che l{B4}unico modo
per giustificarlo era tornare a\lcasa con tuo fratello. Dovevamo

andare avanti\.\CC0818 così la nostra
famiglia avrebbe potuto essere di\lnuovo completa\.

entries.original:
"What kind of stupid logic is that!?
My brother is dead and gone!

What about me?
What about Melony?

Did the lives we had to live matter
to you?

And even all those times I was so
close by\.

You never even reached out to
to say you were okay!"
entries.translation_source: What kind of stupid logic is that!? My brother is dead and gone! What about me? What about Melony? Did the lives we had to live matter to you? And even all those times I was so close by[game-token-1] You never even reached out to to say you were okay!
entries.translated:
Che razza di logica idiota è
quella!? Mio fratello è morto e\lsepolto! E io? E Melony? Le vite

che abbiamo dovuto vivere contavano
qualcosa per te? E persino tutte\lquelle volte che ero così vicino a

te\. Non hai mai nemmeno fatto un
passo avanti per dire che stavi\lbene!

entries.original:
"ENOUGH!

Your incessant blathering is
beginning to irk me."
entries.translation_source: ENOUGH! Your incessant blathering is beginning to irk me.
entries.translated:
BASTA! Il tuo continuo blaterare
comincia a irritarmi.

entries.original:
"Hoopa, you know what to do
with the boy."
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, you know what to do with the boy.
entries.translated:
Hoopa, sai cosa fare con il
ragazzo.

entries.original: "Him as well, Hoopa."
entries.translation_source: Him as well, Hoopa.
entries.translated: Anche lui, Hoopa.

entries.original:
"As per your request, Ivory, they
have been sent to a safe location.

They will be out of harm’s way
during the coming ordeal."
entries.translation_source: As per your request, Ivory, they have been sent to a safe location. They will be out of harm’s way during the coming ordeal.
entries.translated:
Come richiesto, Ivory, sono stati
inviati in un luogo sicuro. Saranno\lal riparo durante il calvario che

verrà.

entries.original:
"And where do you think you are
going, Zeph?"
entries.translation_source: And where do you think you are going, Zeph?
entries.translated: E dove credi di andare, Zeph?

entries.original:
"I know when to cut my losses.

With Marlon and that boy gone,
we’re outmatched."
entries.translation_source: I know when to cut my losses. With Marlon and that boy gone, we’re outmatched.
entries.translated:
So quando tagliare le perdite. Con
Marlon e quel ragazzo andati, non\lsiamo alla loro altezza.

entries.original:
"Hoopa, he wants to be rid of us,
so we ought to return in kind.

Send him to join that Houndoom
of his!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, he wants to be rid of us, so we ought to return in kind. Send him to join that Houndoom of his!
entries.translated:
Hoopa, lui vuole liberarsi di noi,
quindi dovremmo ricambiare. Mandalo\la raggiungere il suo Houndoom!

entries.original:
"As for you, [player]\.

You have been a constant source of
trouble\.\CC0818 a real thorn in my side.

Hoopa’s Trainer\.\CC0818 and the one who
wishes to seize the title\.

I will crush you here, and in doing
so\.

I will prove Hoopa’s power belongs
only to me!"
entries.translation_source: As for you, [player-name-1][game-token-2] You have been a constant source of trouble[game-token-3][control-code-4] a real thorn in my side. Hoopa’s Trainer[game-token-5][control-code-6] and the one who wishes to seize the title[game-token-7] I will crush you here, and in doing so[game-token-8] I will prove Hoopa’s power belongs only to me!
entries.translated:
E tu, [player]\. Sei stato una
costante fonte di guai\.\CC0818 una vera\lspina nel fianco. L{B4}Allenatore di

Hoopa\.\CC0818 e colui che desidera
conquistare il titolo\. Ti schiaccerò\lqui, e così facendo\. dimostrerò che

il potere di Hoopa appartiene solo
a me!

entries.original:
"Hoopa, you useless creature!

The only thing you are fit for
is scientific research!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, you useless creature! The only thing you are fit for is scientific research!
entries.translated:
Hoopa, creatura inutile! L{B4}unica
cosa per cui sei adatto è la\lricerca scientifica!

entries.original:
"[player]!

Your escape from the Cube was my
oversight!

I should have been more thorough
and followed my directions to the\lletter\."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Your escape from the Cube was my oversight! I should have been more thorough and followed my directions to the letter[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[player]! La tua fuga dal Cubo è
stata una mia svista! Avrei dovuto\lessere più scrupoloso e seguire le

mie istruzioni alla lettera\.

entries.original:
"But I guess it does not matter.
What is done is done.

And unfortunately, I am out of
Pokémon.

So, let us cut a deal.

I have something you may be
greatly invested in\.

Yes\.\CC0818 I am, of course, talking about
your friend - the boy with the\lgreen hat.

I expect you are wondering what
happened to him, are you not?"
entries.translation_source: But I guess it does not matter. What is done is done. And unfortunately, I am out of Pokémon. So, let us cut a deal. I have something you may be greatly invested in[game-token-1] Yes[game-token-2][control-code-3] I am, of course, talking about your friend - the boy with the green hat. I expect you are wondering what happened to him, are you not?
entries.translated:
Ma immagino che non importi. Quel
che è fatto è fatto. E purtroppo,\lho finito i Pokémon. Quindi,

facciamo un accordo. Ho qualcosa a
cui potresti essere molto\linteressato\.. Sì\..\CC0818 Sto ovviamente

parlando del tuo amico - il ragazzo
con il cappello verde. Immagino tu\lti stia chiedendo che fine abbia

fatto, non è vero?

entries.original:
"Oh yes\.\CC0818 I know exactly where
he is.

Would you like to meet him?"
entries.translation_source: Oh yes[game-token-1][control-code-2] I know exactly where he is. Would you like to meet him?
entries.translated:
Oh sì\.\CC0818 So esattamente dov{B4}è. Vuoi
incontrarlo?

entries.original: "Then, in that case\."
entries.translation_source: Then, in that case[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Allora, in tal caso\.

entries.original: "Hoopa, take this for your wounds."
entries.translation_source: Hoopa, take this for your wounds.
entries.translated:
Hoopa, prendi questo per le tue
ferite.

entries.original: "Now, send [player] to join [buffer1] friend!"
entries.translation_source: Now, send [player-name-1] to join [buffer1-2] friend!
entries.translated:
Ora, manda [player] a raggiungere
l{B4}amico di [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"[player]! Is that really you?

I didn’t think I’d see a friendly
face in here.

I don’t know how long I’ve been
here, but it feels like forever\."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Is that really you? I didn’t think I’d see a friendly face in here. I don’t know how long I’ve been here, but it feels like forever[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[player]! Sei davvero tu? Non
pensavo di vedere un volto amico\lqui dentro. Non so da quanto tempo

sono qui, ma mi sembra un{B4}eternità\.

entries.original:
"Huh? How did I get here?

I\.\CC0820 well, it’s\.

When you didn’t come back out of
the ruins, I ran inside to find you.

Next thing I knew, a portal opened
up under me, and I wound up here.

I can’t believe I could have been
so stupid\.

So stupid\.\CC0818 what’s Grampa been
training me for, if I mess up so\leasily when it matters most\.?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? How did I get here? I[game-token-1][control-code-2] well, it’s[game-token-3] When you didn’t come back out of the ruins, I ran inside to find you. Next thing I knew, a portal opened up under me, and I wound up here. I can’t believe I could have been so stupid[game-token-4] So stupid[game-token-5][control-code-6] what’s Grampa been training me for, if I mess up so easily when it matters most[game-token-7]?
entries.translated:
Eh? Come sono arrivato qui? Io\.\CC0820 beh,
è\. Quando non sei tornato fuori\ldalle rovine, sono corso dentro a

cercarti. Poi, all{B4}improvviso, si è
aperto un portale sotto di me e mi\lsono ritrovato qui. Non riesco a

credere di essere stato così
stupido\. Così stupido\.\CC0818 a che cosa mi\lha allenato il nonno, se poi

sbaglio così facilmente proprio
quando conta di più\.

entries.original:
"Hey\.\CC0818 tell me we won against
the Shadows, at least.

Did we save Articuno and Moltres?"
entries.translation_source: Hey[game-token-1][control-code-2] tell me we won against the Shadows, at least. Did we save Articuno and Moltres?
entries.translated:
Ehi\.\CC0818 dimmi almeno che abbiamo vinto
contro gli Shadows. Abbiamo salvato\lArticuno e Moltres?

entries.original:
"Ahh, who am I kidding?

If you’re stuck in here with me,
things obviously went south."
entries.translation_source: Ahh, who am I kidding? If you’re stuck in here with me, things obviously went south.
entries.translated:
Ahh, chi voglio prendere in giro?
Se sei bloccato qui con me,\lovviamente le cose sono andate

male.

entries.original:
"You know what?

You can fill me in on the details
once we find a way out.

For now, let’s just focus on getting
back home.

This place is really confusing, but
I’ve managed to figure out some of\lthe rules here."
entries.translation_source: You know what? You can fill me in on the details once we find a way out. For now, let’s just focus on getting back home. This place is really confusing, but I’ve managed to figure out some of the rules here.
entries.translated:
Sai cosa? Puoi aggiornarmi sui
dettagli quando troveremo una via\ld{B4}uscita. Per ora concentriamoci

solo sul tornare a casa. Questo
posto è davvero confusionario, ma\lsono riuscito a capire alcune delle

regole qui.

entries.original:
"These rock slabs\.

I’ve noticed they move when you
step on a certain spot."
entries.translation_source: These rock slabs[game-token-1] I’ve noticed they move when you step on a certain spot.
entries.translated:
Queste lastre di roccia\. Ho notato
che si muovono quando pesti un\lpunto preciso.

entries.original: "Quick, follow me."
entries.translation_source: Quick, follow me.
entries.translated: Svelto, seguimi.

entries.original:
"The laws of our world clearly don’t
apply here, so stay sharp.

What you see might not always
be real\."
entries.translation_source: The laws of our world clearly don’t apply here, so stay sharp. What you see might not always be real[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Le leggi del nostro mondo qui non
valgono chiaramente, quindi stai\lall{B4}erta. Ciò che vedi potrebbe non

essere sempre reale\.

entries.original: "Now, do we go this way\.?"
entries.translation_source: Now, do we go this way[game-token-1]?
entries.translated: Ora andiamo da questa parte\.?

entries.original: "No, I think it was that way\."
entries.translation_source: No, I think it was that way[game-token-1]
entries.translated: No, penso fosse da quella parte\.

entries.original:
"Gah! Let’s just split up.

We’ll have better luck finding
the exit apart."
entries.translation_source: Gah! Let’s just split up. We’ll have better luck finding the exit apart.
entries.translated:
Argh! Dividiamoci e basta. Avremo
più fortuna a trovare l{B4}uscita\lseparati.

entries.original:
"Let’s split up.

We’ll have better luck finding
the exit apart."
entries.translation_source: Let’s split up. We’ll have better luck finding the exit apart.
entries.translated:
Dividiamoci. Avremo più fortuna a
trovare l{B4}uscita separati.

entries.original:
"I’ve never been here before,
so this must be the right way!

Let’s continue on, [player]."
entries.translation_source: I’ve never been here before, so this must be the right way! Let’s continue on, [player-name-1].
entries.translated:
Non sono mai stato qui prima,
quindi questa deve essere la strada\lgiusta! Andiamo avanti, [player].

entries.original:
"This has to be it\.

I can feel it!"
entries.translation_source: This has to be it[game-token-1] I can feel it!
entries.translated: Deve essere questo\. Lo sento!

entries.original:
"Hmm\.
Something feels off.

This platform seems different than
the other ones.

It didn’t move when I stepped on
the centre spot.

Could we have missed something?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] Something feels off. This platform seems different than the other ones. It didn’t move when I stepped on the centre spot. Could we have missed something?
entries.translated:
Hmm\. C{B4}è qualcosa che non va. Questa
piattaforma sembra diversa dalle\laltre. Non si è mossa quando ho

messo il piede sul punto centrale.
Possibile che ci sia sfuggito\lqualcosa?

entries.original:
"I passed by plenty of boulders on
my way down here.

When I pushed one, another moved at
the same time!

But I noticed that not every
boulder I pushed moved another\.

Could those be the key to moving
this rock slab?"
entries.translation_source: I passed by plenty of boulders on my way down here. When I pushed one, another moved at the same time! But I noticed that not every boulder I pushed moved another[game-token-1] Could those be the key to moving this rock slab?
entries.translated:
Ho passato parecchie rocce mentre
scendevo qui. Quando ne spingevo\luna, un{B4}altra si muoveva allo

stesso tempo! Ma ho notato che non
tutte le rocce che spingevo\lfacevano muovere un{B4}altra\.?

Potrebbero essere la chiave per
spostare questa lastra di roccia?

entries.original:
"This looks like\.\CC0818 the very bottom of
this world.

Well, if you can even call it that\.

But what now?
This place looks like a dead end."
entries.translation_source: This looks like[game-token-1][control-code-2] the very bottom of this world. Well, if you can even call it that[game-token-3] But what now? This place looks like a dead end.
entries.translated:
Sembra\.\CC0818 il punto più profondo di
questo mondo. Beh, se si può ancora\lchiamare così\. Ma adesso? Questo

posto sembra un vicolo cieco.

entries.original:
"Wait\.\CC0820 I’m starting to remember now\.

Grampa Arthur told me stories about
a place like this\.

About a world where the laws of
nature have no bounds\.

About a world opposite ours\.

And if what Grampa told me is true,
then there’s only one thing that’s\lliving here\."
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] I’m starting to remember now[game-token-3] Grampa Arthur told me stories about a place like this[game-token-4] About a world where the laws of nature have no bounds[game-token-5] About a world opposite ours[game-token-6] And if what Grampa told me is true, then there’s only one thing that’s living here[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Aspetta\.\CC0820 Sto cominciando a ricordare
adesso\. Nonno Arthur mi raccontava\lstorie di un posto come questo\. Di

un mondo in cui le leggi della
natura non hanno limiti\. Di un mondo\lopposto al nostro\. E se quello che

mi ha detto Nonno è vero, allora
c{B4}è solo una cosa che vive qui\.

entries.original:
"That cry!
Did you hear that?

That must have been the Pokémon
Grampa Arthur was talking about!

If anything knows the way out of
here, it’d be that Pokémon!

Let’s go take a closer look!"
entries.translation_source: That cry! Did you hear that? That must have been the Pokémon Grampa Arthur was talking about! If anything knows the way out of here, it’d be that Pokémon! Let’s go take a closer look!
entries.translated:
Quel verso! L{B4}hai sentito? Doveva
essere il Pokémon di cui parlava il\lnonno Arthur! Se qualcosa sa la

strada per uscire di qui, è proprio
quel Pokémon! Andiamo a dare\lun{B4}occhiata da vicino!

entries.original:
"[player], this is our chance!

I think that Pokémon is up ahead!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], this is our chance! I think that Pokémon is up ahead!
entries.translated:
[player], questa è la nostra
occasione! Credo che quel Pokémon\lsia più avanti!

entries.original:
"No\.\CC0820 this is a mistake.

What am I thinking?"
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1][control-code-2] this is a mistake. What am I thinking?
entries.translated:
No\.\CC0820 questo è un errore. A cosa sto
pensando?

entries.original:
"If that Pokémon attacks us,
I’ll just get in the way.

But I still have items with me, so
let me heal your Pokémon first."
entries.translation_source: If that Pokémon attacks us, I’ll just get in the way. But I still have items with me, so let me heal your Pokémon first.
entries.translated:
Se quel Pokémon ci attacca, mi
metterò solo in mezzo. Ma ho ancora\ldegli strumenti con me, quindi

lascia che curi prima i tuoi
Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Be careful, [player].

There’s no telling what that
Pokémon’s capable of."
entries.translation_source: Be careful, [player-name-1]. There’s no telling what that Pokémon’s capable of.
entries.translated:
Fai attenzione, [player]. Non si sa
di cosa sia capace quel Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Are you alright, [player]?

That Pokémon did a real number
on you\.

Here, let me heal your Pokémon
for you."
entries.translation_source: Are you alright, [player-name-1]? That Pokémon did a real number on you[game-token-2] Here, let me heal your Pokémon for you.
entries.translated:
Stai bene, [player]? Quel Pokémon
ti ha ridotto proprio male\. Dai,\llascia che curi i tuoi Pokémon.

entries.original:
"That power, that presence\.\CC0820 that was
definitely the ruler of this world!

There’s no doubt about it!
Look ahead!"
entries.translation_source: That power, that presence[game-token-1][control-code-2] that was definitely the ruler of this world! There’s no doubt about it! Look ahead!
entries.translated:
Quel potere, quella presenza\.\CC0820 era
sicuramente il sovrano di questo\lmondo! Non c{B4}è dubbio! Guarda

avanti!

entries.original:
"Look at that\.\CC0818 it must have decided
to set us free.

That battle must have made a real
impression, somehow.

Now, I don’t know about you, but
I’ve definitely spent way too long\linside here.

I’m taking my chances on that
portal.

Let’s go home, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Look at that[game-token-1][control-code-2] it must have decided to set us free. That battle must have made a real impression, somehow. Now, I don’t know about you, but I’ve definitely spent way too long inside here. I’m taking my chances on that portal. Let’s go home, [player-name-3]!
entries.translated:
Guarda un po{B4}\.\CC0818 Deve aver deciso di
lasciarci liberi. Quella battaglia\ldeve avergli fatto una bella

impressione, in qualche modo. Ora,
non so tu, ma io ho decisamente\lpassato troppo tempo qui dentro. Mi

gioco il tutto per tutto su quel
portale. Andiamo a casa, [player]!

entries.original: "Wait\.\CC0820 isn’t this\.?"
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1][control-code-2] isn’t this[game-token-3]?
entries.translated: Aspetta\.\CC0820 non è forse questo\.?

entries.original:
"It’s Rift Cave\.\CC0818 then that means\.!

We must be back in our world!

But, why\.?

\.

Ah, right. Rift Cave is also said to
disobey the laws of reality."
entries.translation_source: It’s Rift Cave[game-token-1][control-code-2] then that means[game-token-3]! We must be back in our world! But, why[game-token-4]? [game-token-5] Ah, right. Rift Cave is also said to disobey the laws of reality.
entries.translated:
È la Rift Cave\.\CC0818 allora significa\.!
Dobbiamo essere tornati nel nostro\lmondo! Ma, perché\.? \. Ah, già. Si

dice anche che Rift Cave sfidi le
leggi della realtà.

entries.original:
"Anyway, now that we made it,
let’s get back to it.

[player]\.\CC0818 what happened back at the
Ruins of Void?

\.

Aklove\.

Then that means we don’t have
a second to spare!"
entries.translation_source: Anyway, now that we made it, let’s get back to it. [player-name-1][game-token-2][control-code-3] what happened back at the Ruins of Void? [game-token-4] Aklove[game-token-5] Then that means we don’t have a second to spare!
entries.translated:
Comunque, ora che ci siamo
riusciti, torniamo al sodo.\l[player]\.\CC0818 cosa è successo alle

Rovine del Vuoto? \. Aklove\. Allora
vuol dire che non abbiamo un\lsecondo da perdere!

entries.original: "No\. not this time\."
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1] not this time[game-token-2]
entries.translated: No\. non questa volta\.

entries.original:
"[player], being trapped in there
taught me a lot of things\.

But most importantly, it’s taught me
I’m nothing without my Pokémon.

I never want to find myself being
so useless to anyone again.

Meet me in Vivill Town.

I promise both my Pokémon and I
will be ready this time."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], being trapped in there taught me a lot of things[game-token-2] But most importantly, it’s taught me I’m nothing without my Pokémon. I never want to find myself being so useless to anyone again. Meet me in Vivill Town. I promise both my Pokémon and I will be ready this time.
entries.translated:
[player], restare rinchiuso lì
dentro mi ha insegnato molte cose\.\lMa soprattutto, mi ha insegnato che

senza i miei Pokémon non sono
niente. Non voglio più ritrovarmi a\lessere così inutile per nessuno.

Incontrami a Vivill Town. Prometto
che, questa volta, io e i miei\lPokémon saremo pronti.

entries.original:
"[player]! You made it!

I picked up my grandfather on the
way here.

He said he wanted to speak to both
of us."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You made it! I picked up my grandfather on the way here. He said he wanted to speak to both of us.
entries.translated:
[player]! Ce l{B4}hai fatta! Ho preso
mio nonno lungo la strada per\lvenire qui. Ha detto che voleva

parlare con entrambi noi.

entries.original:
"Yes, [player], I’m relieved to
see both you and Jax are safe.

You two had me very worried!

While it may not have seemed very
long to you, much time has passed\lhere while you both were in the\lDistortion World."
entries.translation_source: Yes, [player-name-1], I’m relieved to see both you and Jax are safe. You two had me very worried! While it may not have seemed very long to you, much time has passed here while you both were in the Distortion World.
entries.translated:
Sì, [player], sono sollevato di
vedere che sia tu che Jax state\lbene. Mi avete fatto preoccupare

molto! Anche se a te potrebbe non
essere sembrato così tanto, qui è\lpassato moltissimo tempo mentre voi

due eravate nel Mondo Distorto.

entries.original:
"That explains why I hadn’t been
there that long before [player]\lshowed up."
entries.translation_source: That explains why I hadn’t been there that long before [player-name-1] showed up.
entries.translated:
Questo spiega perché non ero lì da
molto prima che arrivasse [player].

entries.original:
"And as I’m sure you’ve already
guessed, the Light of Ruin is\llong gone.

I witnessed them leave myself,
in fact.

I was keeping a close eye on your
status from Route 2, when I saw.

Hoopa appeared in front of this
warehouse with who I presume to\lbe the Light of Ruin’s leader.

When you didn’t emerge as well,
I feared the worst.

However, I was not given much time
to sail over and see for myself\lbefore their leader and all of his\lunderlings vanished!

Gone!

In the blink of an eye!

With Hoopa already under their
control, I’m at a loss for what\lthis Aklove character could\lbe planning next\."
entries.translation_source: And as I’m sure you’ve already guessed, the Light of Ruin is long gone. I witnessed them leave myself, in fact. I was keeping a close eye on your status from Route 2, when I saw. Hoopa appeared in front of this warehouse with who I presume to be the Light of Ruin’s leader. When you didn’t emerge as well, I feared the worst. However, I was not given much time to sail over and see for myself before their leader and all of his underlings vanished! Gone! In the blink of an eye! With Hoopa already under their control, I’m at a loss for what this Aklove character could be planning next[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
E come sono sicuro tu abbia già
intuito, la Luce della Rovina è\lsparita da tempo. Io stesso li ho

visti andarsene, in effetti. Stavo
tenendo d{B4}occhio la tua situazione\ldalla Rotovia 2, quando ho visto.

Hoopa è apparso davanti a questo
magazzino con colui che presumo sia\lil leader della Luce della Rovina.

Quando anche tu non sei emerso, ho
temuto il peggio. Tuttavia, non ho\lavuto molto tempo per navigare e

vedere con i miei occhi prima che
il loro leader e tutti i suoi\lsottoposti scomparissero! Spariti!

In un batter d{B4}occhio! Con Hoopa
già sotto il loro controllo, non so\lcosa questo tizio Aklove possa

pianificare dopo\.

entries.original:
"[player]!

I’ve been looking everywhere
for you!

Aklove\.\CC0818 he’s\."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! I’ve been looking everywhere for you! Aklove[game-token-2][control-code-3] he’s[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[player]! Ti stavo cercando
ovunque! Aklove\.\CC0818 lui è\.

entries.original:
"Young man, what do you know of
the Light of Ruin’s whereabouts?"
entries.translation_source: Young man, what do you know of the Light of Ruin’s whereabouts?
entries.translated:
Giovanotto, cosa sai di dove si
trovi la Light of Ruin?

entries.original:
"More than you all, apparently.

When we confronted them, I was sent
to a holding cell in some building\lalong with\.

Along with my dad\.\CC0820 Marlon."
entries.translation_source: More than you all, apparently. When we confronted them, I was sent to a holding cell in some building along with[game-token-1] Along with my dad[game-token-2][control-code-3] Marlon.
entries.translated:
Più di voi tutti, a quanto pare.
Quando li abbiamo affrontati, sono\lstato rinchiuso in una cella di

contenimento in un edificio insieme
a\. Insieme a mio padre\.\CC0820 Marlon.

entries.original: "Marlon is your father!?"
entries.translation_source: Marlon is your father!?
entries.translated: Marlon è tuo padre!?

entries.original:
"I don’t know what concern it is to
you, old man, but yeah.

We were locked up for a pretty
long time.

I wouldn’t say anything to him,
though.

I couldn’t.

But when they started moving us
somewhere, I took the opportunity\lto escape.

My dad wasn’t so lucky.

He got shuffled into this big
mountain covered in crystals."
entries.translation_source: I don’t know what concern it is to you, old man, but yeah. We were locked up for a pretty long time. I wouldn’t say anything to him, though. I couldn’t. But when they started moving us somewhere, I took the opportunity to escape. My dad wasn’t so lucky. He got shuffled into this big mountain covered in crystals.
entries.translated:
Non so che cosa ti riguardi,
vecchio, ma sì. Siamo stati\lrinchiusi per parecchio tempo. Non

gli avrei detto nulla, però. Non
potevo. Ma quando hanno iniziato a\lspostarci da qualche parte, ho

colto l{B4}occasione per scappare. Mio
padre non è stato così fortunato.\lL{B4}hanno portato in questa grande

montagna coperta di cristalli.

entries.original:
"Crystal Peak\.

Could that be what they’re after?

No\.\CC0818 no\.\CC0818 there’s little
possibility they know it’s there\."
entries.translation_source: Crystal Peak[game-token-1] Could that be what they’re after? No[game-token-2][control-code-3] no[game-token-4][control-code-5] there’s little possibility they know it’s there[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Crystal Peak\. Potrebbe essere questo
ciò che stanno cercando? No\.\CC0818 no\.\CC0818 c{B4}è\lpoca possibilità che sappiano che

si trova lì\.

entries.original:
"What?

What’s at Crystal Peak?"
entries.translation_source: What? What’s at Crystal Peak?
entries.translated: Che? Cosa c{B4}è a Crystal Peak?

entries.original:
"We have little time, Jax.

I’ll arrange passage for us to East
Borrius from Seaport City."
entries.translation_source: We have little time, Jax. I’ll arrange passage for us to East Borrius from Seaport City.
entries.translated:
Abbiamo poco tempo, Jax.
Organizzerò per noi il passaggio a\lEst Borrius da Seaport City.

entries.original:
"I don’t need passage!

Tell me what’s at Crystal Peak!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t need passage! Tell me what’s at Crystal Peak!
entries.translated:
Non mi serve il passaggio! Dimmi
che cosa c{B4}è al Picco di Cristallo!

entries.original:
"I could be wrong, of course, but
if Aklove’s goal is to cause mass\ldestruction, then he’ll be going\lafter something hidden atop the\lmountain."
entries.translation_source: I could be wrong, of course, but if Aklove’s goal is to cause mass destruction, then he’ll be going after something hidden atop the mountain.
entries.translated:
Potrei sbagliarmi, naturalmente, ma
se l{B4}obiettivo di Aklove è causare\ldistruzione di massa, allora andrà

a cercare qualcosa nascosto in cima
alla montagna.

entries.original:
"What, like the weapon they keep
blabbing on about?"
entries.translation_source: What, like the weapon they keep blabbing on about?
entries.translated:
Tipo l{B4}arma di cui non fanno che
blaterare?

entries.original: "So I’m correct, after all\."
entries.translation_source: So I’m correct, after all[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Quindi avevo ragione, alla fine\.

entries.original:
"I have kept this information secret
for many years\.

But I see no choice other than
to reveal it now.

The weapon Aklove has been
searching for\.

The weapon I presume Aklove hoped
Hoopa would bring him\.

It was already brought to Borrius
3000 years ago."
entries.translation_source: I have kept this information secret for many years[game-token-1] But I see no choice other than to reveal it now. The weapon Aklove has been searching for[game-token-2] The weapon I presume Aklove hoped Hoopa would bring him[game-token-3] It was already brought to Borrius 3000 years ago.
entries.translated:
Ho tenuto segreta questa
informazione per molti anni\. Ma non\lvedo altra scelta se non rivelarla

adesso. L{B4}arma che Aklove stava
cercando\. L{B4}arma che presumo Aklove\lsperasse che Hoopa gli portasse\. Era

già stata portata a Borrius 3000
anni fa.

entries.original:
"Young man, what do you plan to
do now?"
entries.translation_source: Young man, what do you plan to do now?
entries.translated:
Giovanotto, cosa hai intenzione di
fare adesso?

entries.original:
"Well\.\CC0818 I haven’t really thought
about it.

I finally found what I was looking
for, and it was the last thing I\lcould’ve wanted\.

All I can say is if Aklove plans
to destroy Borrius with some\lweapon, he’s gotta go through\lme, first.

I haven’t decided if I want to be
with my parents, but if I do, I’d\lwant to be with them here.

I’ve really started to take a
liking to Borrius, you know?

And no one, and I mean NO ONE, will
ever take my parents from me again."
entries.translation_source: Well[game-token-1][control-code-2] I haven’t really thought about it. I finally found what I was looking for, and it was the last thing I could’ve wanted[game-token-3] All I can say is if Aklove plans to destroy Borrius with some weapon, he’s gotta go through me, first. I haven’t decided if I want to be with my parents, but if I do, I’d want to be with them here. I’ve really started to take a liking to Borrius, you know? And no one, and I mean NO ONE, will ever take my parents from me again.
entries.translated:
Beh\.\CC0818 Non ci ho pensato molto. Ho
finalmente trovato quello che stavo\lcercando, ed era l{B4}ultima cosa che

avrei voluto\. Tutto ciò che posso
dire è che se Aklove ha intenzione\ldi distruggere Borrius con qualche

arma, dovrà passare attraverso di
me, prima. Non ho deciso se voglio\lstare con i miei genitori, ma se lo

faccio, vorrei stare con loro qui.
Ho davvero iniziato ad apprezzare\lBorrius, sai? E nessuno, e intendo

NESSUNO, mi porterà mai più via i
miei genitori.

entries.original: "Toucannon! Let’s get a move on!"
entries.translation_source: Toucannon! Let’s get a move on!
entries.translated: Toucannon! Muoviamoci!

entries.original: "Wait!"
entries.translation_source: Wait!
entries.translated: Aspetta!

entries.original:
"There’s no point in rushing in
there without a plan.

We need everyone ready.

We’re going to hit them with
everything we’ve got."
entries.translation_source: There’s no point in rushing in there without a plan. We need everyone ready. We’re going to hit them with everything we’ve got.
entries.translated:
Non ha senso precipitarsi lì dentro
senza un piano. Dobbiamo essere\ltutti pronti. Li colpiremo con

tutto quello che abbiamo.

entries.original: "Yeah, yeah, I got that."
entries.translation_source: Yeah, yeah, I got that.
entries.translated: Sì, sì, ho capito.

entries.original:
"So [player], get to [green]Seaport City[blue]
ASAP!

If you can’t fly yet, the quickest
way there would be to earn the\l[green]Antisis City[blue] Gym Badge, and then\lhead east along [green]Route 17[blue].

While you’re making your way over,
Grampa Arthur and I will see what\lwe can come up with."
entries.translation_source: So [player-name-1], get to [color-green-2]Seaport City[color-blue-3] ASAP! If you can’t fly yet, the quickest way there would be to earn the [color-green-4]Antisis City[color-blue-5] Gym Badge, and then head east along [color-green-6]Route 17[color-blue-7]. While you’re making your way over, Grampa Arthur and I will see what we can come up with.
entries.translated:
Allora [player], vai subito a
[green]Seaport City[blue]! Se ancora non puoi\lvolare, il modo più veloce per

arrivarci sarebbe ottenere la
Medaglia della Palestra di [green]Antisis\lCity[blue], e poi dirigerti a est lungo

la [green]Route 17[blue]. Mentre ti metti in
viaggio, il nonno Arthur ed io\lvedremo cosa riusciamo a

inventarci.

entries.original: "Alright, Grampa Arthur, you ready?"
entries.translation_source: Alright, Grampa Arthur, you ready?
entries.translated: Allora, nonno Arthur, sei pronto?

entries.original:
"As ready as I’ll ever be!

This sure brings me back!"
entries.translation_source: As ready as I’ll ever be! This sure brings me back!
entries.translated:
Pronto come non mai! Questo mi
riporta davvero indietro!

entries.original: "Staraptor! Take us to [green]Seaport City[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! Take us to [color-green-1]Seaport City[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated: Staraptor! Portaci a [green]Seaport City[blue]!

entries.original: "Clerk"
entries.translation_source: Clerk
entries.translated: Impiegato

entries.original:
"What do you mean, the ship’s not
running?

We need to get to Polder Town
ASAP!

The fate of Borrius depends on it!"
entries.translation_source: What do you mean, the ship’s not running? We need to get to Polder Town ASAP! The fate of Borrius depends on it!
entries.translated:
Che vuoi dire, la nave non è in
servizio? Dobbiamo arrivare a\lPolder Town il prima possibile! Il

destino di Borrius dipende da
questo!

entries.original:
"Look, mate.

I told you already, I’m sorry, but
it can’t be helped.

The ship’s having engine troubles,
and there’s not a thing I can do.

But a friend of mine who owes me
a favor can take you to Polder\lTown, if it’s that urgent.

He can be found on the docks north
of here.

Show him one of these S.S. Tickets,
tell him I sent you, and he should\ltake you there."
