entries.translation_source: Look, mate. I told you already, I’m sorry, but it can’t be helped. The ship’s having engine troubles, and there’s not a thing I can do. But a friend of mine who owes me a favor can take you to Polder Town, if it’s that urgent. He can be found on the docks north of here. Show him one of these S.S. Tickets, tell him I sent you, and he should take you there.
entries.translated:
Senti, amico. Te l{B4}ho già detto, mi
dispiace, ma non si può fare. La\lnave ha dei problemi al motore, e

non posso farci niente. Ma un mio
amico che mi deve un favore può\lportarti a Polder Town, se è così

urgente. Lo puoi trovare ai moli a
nord di qui. Mostragli uno di\lquesti Biglietti S.S., digli che ti

mando io, e dovrebbe portarti lì.

entries.original:
"If that’ll get us there quickly,
let’s do that."
entries.translation_source: If that’ll get us there quickly, let’s do that.
entries.translated:
Se ci porterà lì in fretta,
facciamolo.

entries.original:
"You got that, [player]?

Meet us at the boat on the docks
[green]north[blue] of here.

We’ll go on ahead and board without
you, so there’s no delay.

Oh, right - take this ticket so you
can get on the boat, too."
entries.translation_source: You got that, [player-name-1]? Meet us at the boat on the docks [color-green-2]north[color-blue-3] of here. We’ll go on ahead and board without you, so there’s no delay. Oh, right - take this ticket so you can get on the boat, too.
entries.translated:
Hai capito, [player]? Incontrateci
alla barca sui moli a [green]nord[blue] di qui.\lNoi andremo avanti e saliremo a

bordo senza di te, così non ci
saranno ritardi. Ah, già - prendi\lquesto biglietto così potrai salire

anche tu sulla barca.

entries.original: "We’ve made it\.\CC0818 it’s East Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: We’ve made it[game-token-1][control-code-2] it’s East Borrius!
entries.translated:
Ce l{B4}abbiamo fatta\.\CC0818 è il Borrius
orientale!

entries.original: "Huh? Up there\.\CC0818 above Crystal Peak\.!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? Up there[game-token-1][control-code-2] above Crystal Peak[game-token-3]!
entries.translated: Eh? Lassù\.\CC0818 sopra Crystal Peak\.!

entries.original:
"Grampa Arthur, we need to head for
Crystal Peak.

That’s no ordinary storm brewing
above the mountain.

They must be getting the Ultimate
Weapon ready to destroy Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Grampa Arthur, we need to head for Crystal Peak. That’s no ordinary storm brewing above the mountain. They must be getting the Ultimate Weapon ready to destroy Borrius!
entries.translated:
Nonno Arthur, dobbiamo andare a
Crystal Peak. Quella sopra la\lmontagna non è una tempesta

qualunque. Devono star preparando
l{B4}Arma Suprema per distruggere\lBorrius!

entries.original:
"I concur, Jax.

Let’s make haste towards the
mountain.

We have to put an end to the Light
of Ruin’s schemes and save Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: I concur, Jax. Let’s make haste towards the mountain. We have to put an end to the Light of Ruin’s schemes and save Borrius!
entries.translated:
Concordo, Jax. Sbrighiamoci verso
la montagna. Dobbiamo porre fine ai\lpiani della Light of Ruin e salvare

Borrius!

entries.original:
"Grampa and I will go on ahead to
the top of Crystal Peak, [player].

We can’t run in blind on this one,
so we’ll come up with a plan to\lstop their big scheme.

Follow us up as fast as you can,
okay?

In order to reach the top of
Crystal Peak, you’ll need the\lability to climb waterfalls\.

\.

Yeah\.\CC0818 that look on your face says
you know\.\CC0818 it’s the story of your\lentire Gym Challenge\.

That’s right\.\CC0818 you need [green]Polder Town[blue]’s
Gym Badge, and the HM for it.

But anyway, once you’ve done that,
make a beeline for [green]Crystal Peak[blue].

Got it?
See you there, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Grampa and I will go on ahead to the top of Crystal Peak, [player-name-1]. We can’t run in blind on this one, so we’ll come up with a plan to stop their big scheme. Follow us up as fast as you can, okay? In order to reach the top of Crystal Peak, you’ll need the ability to climb waterfalls[game-token-2] [game-token-3] Yeah[game-token-4][control-code-5] that look on your face says you know[game-token-6][control-code-7] it’s the story of your entire Gym Challenge[game-token-8] That’s right[game-token-9][control-code-10] you need [color-green-11]Polder Town[color-blue-12]’s Gym Badge, and the HM for it. But anyway, once you’ve done that, make a beeline for [color-green-13]Crystal Peak[color-blue-14]. Got it? See you there, [player-name-15].
entries.translated:
Il nonno ed io andremo avanti verso
la cima del Picco Cristallo,\l[player]. Non possiamo lanciarci

alla cieca in questa missione,
quindi elaboreremo un piano per\lfermare il loro grande progetto.

Seguici il più velocemente
possibile, d{B4}accordo? Per\lraggiungere la cima del Picco

Cristallo, avrai bisogno
dell{B4}abilità di scalare le cascate\. \.\lSì\.\CC0818 quell{B4}espressione sul tuo volto

dice che sai\.\CC0818 è la storia della tua
intera Sfida delle Palestre\. Esatto\.\CC0818\lti serve la Medaglia della Palestra

di [green]Polder Town[blue] e la MN per usarla.
Ma comunque, una volta fatto,\ldirigiti dritto verso [green]Picco

Cristallo[blue]. Capito? Ci vediamo lì,
[player].

entries.original:
"[player]!
What took you so long?

That Jax guy and his grandpa ran
into me on my way up.

They told me to wait here for you,
saying it shouldn’t take too long\lfor you to join the fight.

Well, I figured I’d have an easier
time getting up the mountain with\lyou, anyway, so here I am.

The place is crawling with Light of
Ruin goons after all, so it’s not so\leasy to climb solo right now.

But before we go\.\CC0818 battle me.

Just a quick check to make sure
you’re ready.

I’ll know if you’re strong enough
to be my climbing buddy!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! What took you so long? That Jax guy and his grandpa ran into me on my way up. They told me to wait here for you, saying it shouldn’t take too long for you to join the fight. Well, I figured I’d have an easier time getting up the mountain with you, anyway, so here I am. The place is crawling with Light of Ruin goons after all, so it’s not so easy to climb solo right now. But before we go[game-token-2][control-code-3] battle me. Just a quick check to make sure you’re ready. I’ll know if you’re strong enough to be my climbing buddy!
entries.translated:
[player]! Perché ci hai messo così
tanto? Quel Jax e suo nonno mi sono\lvenuti incontro mentre salivo. Mi

hanno detto di aspettarti qui,
dicendo che non ci avresti messo\lmolto a unirti alla lotta. Beh, ho

pensato che sarebbe stato più
facile scalare la montagna con te,\lcomunque, quindi eccomi qui. Il

posto brulica di sgherri della Luce
della Rovina, dopotutto, quindi non\lè così facile scalare da soli al

momento. Ma prima di andare\.\CC0818 lotta
con me. Solo un rapido controllo\lper assicurarmi che tu sia pronto.

Saprò se sei abbastanza forte da
essere il mio compagno di scalata!

entries.original:
"Man\. what was I even worried about?
Of course you’re ready!"
entries.translation_source: Man[game-token-1] what was I even worried about? Of course you’re ready!
entries.translated:
Accidenti\. ma di cosa mi
preoccupavo? Certo che sei pronto!

entries.original:
"You might be ready to climb the
mountain, but I guess I’m not.

Let me grab some different Pokémon
from the PC real quick."
entries.translation_source: You might be ready to climb the mountain, but I guess I’m not. Let me grab some different Pokémon from the PC real quick.
entries.translated:
Potresti essere pronto a scalare la
montagna, ma immagino che io non lo\lsia. Lasciami prendere in fretta

dei Pokémon diversi dal PC.

entries.original: "Alright, I’m back."
entries.translation_source: Alright, I’m back.
entries.translated: Va bene, sono tornato.

entries.original:
"Let’s make our way to the top as
quick as possible.

I’ll keep your Pokémon healed up
on the way."
entries.translation_source: Let’s make our way to the top as quick as possible. I’ll keep your Pokémon healed up on the way.
entries.translated:
Cerchiamo di arrivare in cima il
più velocemente possibile. Durante\lla salita, ti curerò sempre i

Pokémon.

entries.original:
"You ready to keep going up the
mountain, [player]?"
entries.translation_source: You ready to keep going up the mountain, [player-name-1]?
entries.translated:
Sei pronto a continuare a salire la
montagna, [player]?

entries.original:
"[black][player] decided to go with
[rival]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] decided to go with [text-token-rival-3]!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha deciso di andare con
[rival]!

entries.original:
"[black]While teamed up with [rival], the
[green]first 3[black] viable Pokémon in your\lparty will be selected for battle.

[rival] is also capable of using
Surf and Rock Climb."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]While teamed up with [text-token-rival-2], the [color-green-3]first 3[color-black-4] viable Pokémon in your party will be selected for battle. [text-token-rival-5] is also capable of using Surf and Rock Climb.
entries.translated:
[black]Quando fai squadra con [rival], i
[green]primi 3[black] Pokémon utilizzabili del\ltuo team verranno selezionati per

la lotta. [rival] è anche in grado
di usare Surf e Scalata Rocce.

entries.original:
"Hurry up, [player].
There’s no time to waste!"
entries.translation_source: Hurry up, [player-name-1]. There’s no time to waste!
entries.translated:
Sbrigati, [player]. Non c{B4}è tempo
da perdere!

entries.original:
"Let’s make our way to the top as
quick as possible.

Those Light of Ruin guys don’t
stand a chance against both of us!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s make our way to the top as quick as possible. Those Light of Ruin guys don’t stand a chance against both of us!
entries.translated:
Andiamo in cima il più in fretta
possibile. Quei tipi della Light of\lRuin non hanno scampo contro noi

due!

entries.original:
"Man\.\CC0818 Ivory is REALLY starting to
get on my nerves\.

I couldn’t wait to meet my parents
just a short while ago, but it’s\llike she doesn’t even care about\lme or my sister one bit!

What’s her problem?"
entries.translation_source: Man[game-token-1][control-code-2] Ivory is REALLY starting to get on my nerves[game-token-3] I couldn’t wait to meet my parents just a short while ago, but it’s like she doesn’t even care about me or my sister one bit! What’s her problem?
entries.translated:
Accidenti\.\CC0818 Ivory mi sta DAVVERO
cominciando a dare sui nervi\. Poco\lfa non vedevo l{B4}ora di incontrare i

miei genitori, ma è come se non le
importasse minimamente di me o di\lmia sorella! Qual è il suo

problema?

entries.original:
"We’ve almost made it to the top,
[player]!

We just need to figure out a way to
get past those goons without being\lspotted by them.

If only we could somehow push
something in front of them to block\ltheir view\."
entries.translation_source: We’ve almost made it to the top, [player-name-1]! We just need to figure out a way to get past those goons without being spotted by them. If only we could somehow push something in front of them to block their view[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Siamo quasi arrivati in cima,
[player]! Dobbiamo solo capire come\lpassare oltre quei teppisti senza

farci vedere da loro. Se solo
riuscissimo in qualche modo a\lspingere qualcosa davanti a loro

per bloccarne la vista\.

entries.original:
"This seems like the top of the
mountain, [player]!

Just a little more and we can stop
Aklove!"
entries.translation_source: This seems like the top of the mountain, [player-name-1]! Just a little more and we can stop Aklove!
entries.translated:
Sembra la cima della montagna,
[player]! Ancora un po{B4} e possiamo\lfermare Aklove!

entries.original:
"Where are you going, [player]?

Do you need to head back to town to
get supplies or something?"
entries.translation_source: Where are you going, [player-name-1]? Do you need to head back to town to get supplies or something?
entries.translated:
Dove stai andando, [player]? Devi
tornare in città a prendere\lprovviste o qualcosa del genere?

entries.original:
"Hurry back, [player].
There’s no time to waste!"
entries.translation_source: Hurry back, [player-name-1]. There’s no time to waste!
entries.translated:
Torna in fretta, [player]. Non c{B4}è
tempo da perdere!

entries.original:
"Wha-? These Pokémon\.

That Aklove guy must have had Hoopa
set this trap to slow us down!

But we can’t stop moving now!

C’mon, [player]! Let’s blast through
these things and get to the summit!"
entries.translation_source: Wha-? These Pokémon[game-token-1] That Aklove guy must have had Hoopa set this trap to slow us down! But we can’t stop moving now! C’mon, [player-name-2]! Let’s blast through these things and get to the summit!
entries.translated:
C-? Questi Pokémon\. Quel tizio,
Aklove, deve aver fatto in modo che\lHoopa preparasse questa trappola

per rallentarci! Ma non possiamo
fermarci ora! Avanti, [player]!\lSfondiamo queste cose e arriviamo

in cima!

entries.original:
"How’s that!
As if that was ever gonna stop us!"
entries.translation_source: How’s that! As if that was ever gonna stop us!
entries.translated:
Che te ne pare! Come se ci avesse
mai fermati!

entries.original:
"You! You’re still here!?

Why? Why would you ever do any
of this!?

There’s no point helping out that
Aklove goon!"
entries.translation_source: You! You’re still here!? Why? Why would you ever do any of this!? There’s no point helping out that Aklove goon!
entries.translated:
Tu! Sei ancora qui!? Perché? Perché
faresti mai tutto questo!? Non ha\lsenso aiutare quello scagnozzo di

Aklove!

entries.original:
"[red]I’m sorry, [rival]\.

I\.\CC0820 I can’t go back on our
deal now.

When the dust finally clears, you’ll
see that it was worth it\.

In the meantime, I\.\CC0820 I’m just
glad to know that you returned.

Stay here, where you’ll be safe from
the fallout."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’m sorry, [text-token-rival-2][game-token-3] I[game-token-4][control-code-5] I can’t go back on our deal now. When the dust finally clears, you’ll see that it was worth it[game-token-6] In the meantime, I[game-token-7][control-code-8] I’m just glad to know that you returned. Stay here, where you’ll be safe from the fallout.
entries.translated:
[red]Mi dispiace, [rival]\. I\.\CC0820 non posso
tornare indietro sulla nostra\lintesa adesso. Quando la polvere si

sarà finalmente posata, capirai che
ne è valsa la pena\. Nel frattempo,\lio\.\CC0820 sono solo contento di sapere che

sei tornato. Resta qui, dove sarai
al sicuro dalle conseguenze.

entries.original:
"I didn’t come back because I wanted
to be safe!

I came back to stop the destruction
you’re planning!

This whole time, I wanted you and
dad to come back, so we could be\la family again.

And now, as soon as I find you,
you think you can get away with\lsomething like this!?

No way!

You’ve already destroyed one home
when you left us.

I won’t let you destroy another!"
entries.translation_source: I didn’t come back because I wanted to be safe! I came back to stop the destruction you’re planning! This whole time, I wanted you and dad to come back, so we could be a family again. And now, as soon as I find you, you think you can get away with something like this!? No way! You’ve already destroyed one home when you left us. I won’t let you destroy another!
entries.translated:
Non sono tornato perché volevo
mettermi al sicuro! Sono tornato\lper fermare la distruzione che stai

progettando! Per tutto questo
tempo, ho voluto che tu e papà\ltornaste, così saremmo potuti

essere di nuovo una famiglia. E
adesso, non appena ti trovo, credi\ldi potertela cavare con una cosa

del genere!? Niente affatto! Hai
già distrutto una casa quando ci\lhai lasciati. Non ti lascerò

distruggerne un{B4}altra!

entries.original:
"[red]If it were up to me, we wouldn’t
be destroying anything, [rival].

But this is the only way\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]If it were up to me, we wouldn’t be destroying anything, [text-token-rival-2]. But this is the only way[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[red]Se dipendesse da me, non staremmo
distruggendo nulla, [rival]. Ma è\ll{B4}unico modo\.

entries.original:
"[red]Alakazam!
Immobilize him!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Alakazam! Immobilize him!
entries.translated: [red]Alakazam! Immobilizzalo!

entries.original:
"[red]I’m sorry, [rival]\.\CC0818 but this is for
your own good.

Stay here and out of harm’s way,
until we’re finished at the summit."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’m sorry, [text-token-rival-2][game-token-3][control-code-4] but this is for your own good. Stay here and out of harm’s way, until we’re finished at the summit.
entries.translated:
[red]Mi dispiace, [rival]\.\CC0818 ma è per il
tuo bene. Rimani qui e lontano dai\lpericoli, finché non avremo finito

in vetta.

entries.original:
"[red]What about you, [player]?

I suppose it’s too much to hope
you’ll turn back?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]What about you, [player-name-2]? I suppose it’s too much to hope you’ll turn back?
entries.translated:
[red]E tu, [player]? Suppongo sia troppo
sperare che tu faccia dietrofront?

entries.original:
"Ngh\.\CC0818 [player]\.\CC0818 take\.\CC0818 my Pokémon\.

I can’t fight\.\CC0818 but\.\CC0818 they’ll back
you up\."
entries.translation_source: Ngh[game-token-1][control-code-2] [player-name-3][game-token-4][control-code-5] take[game-token-6][control-code-7] my Pokémon[game-token-8] I can’t fight[game-token-9][control-code-10] but[game-token-11][control-code-12] they’ll back you up[game-token-13]
entries.translated:
Ngh\.\CC0818 [player]\.\CC0818 prendi\.\CC0818 i miei Pokémon\.
Non posso combattere\.\CC0818 ma\.\CC0818 ti daranno\lman forte\.

entries.original:
"[black][rival] is lending you his
Toucannon, Vaporeon, and Mamoswine\lfor your fight with Ivory!

When the battle starts, they will
automatically join your team."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][text-token-rival-2] is lending you his Toucannon, Vaporeon, and Mamoswine for your fight with Ivory! When the battle starts, they will automatically join your team.
entries.translated:
[black][rival] ti presta il suo
Toucannon, Vaporeon e Mamoswine per\lla tua lotta con Ivory! Quando la

battaglia inizierà, si uniranno
automaticamente alla tua squadra.

entries.original:
"[red]So, I suppose you’ll follow this
path no matter what\.

Very well, then\. I only need to
hold you off just long enough\.

Until Aklove is finished, you shall
not pass!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]So, I suppose you’ll follow this path no matter what[game-token-2] Very well, then[game-token-3] I only need to hold you off just long enough[game-token-4] Until Aklove is finished, you shall not pass!
entries.translated:
[red]Dunque, immagino che seguirai
questa strada a qualunque costo\.\lMolto bene, allora\. Mi basta

trattenerti quel tanto che basta\.
Finché Aklove non avrà finito, non\lpasserai!

entries.original:
"[red]As I thought\.\CC0818 this was all I could
do to stall you.

However, the preparations must be
almost complete by now.

All I can do is hope the remaining
Grunts above us can hold you off\lfor just long enough.

Farewell\.\CC0818 [player], [rival]."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]As I thought[game-token-2][control-code-3] this was all I could do to stall you. However, the preparations must be almost complete by now. All I can do is hope the remaining Grunts above us can hold you off for just long enough. Farewell[game-token-4][control-code-5] [player-name-6], [text-token-rival-7].
entries.translated:
[red]Come immaginavo\.\CC0818 Era tutto ciò che
potevo fare per rallentarti.\lTuttavia, i preparativi devono

essere quasi completi ormai. Posso
solo sperare che le reclute rimaste\lsopra di noi riescano a trattenerti

abbastanza a lungo. Addio\.\CC0818 [player],
[rival].

entries.original:
"Alright, I’m good.

Let’s keep going, and finish this
once and for all!"
entries.translation_source: Alright, I’m good. Let’s keep going, and finish this once and for all!
entries.translated:
Va bene, sto bene. Andiamo avanti e
finiamola una volta per tutte!

entries.original:
"Come on, Krookodile\.

Just pick up that boulder and move
it to the side."
entries.translation_source: Come on, Krookodile[game-token-1] Just pick up that boulder and move it to the side.
entries.translated:
Dai, Krookodile\. Solleva quel masso
e spostalo di lato.

entries.original:
"No, Krookodile!
You can’t push it!

There’s a rock in the way!

Argh\.\CC0818 if only one of my Pokémon
knew Dig\."
entries.translation_source: No, Krookodile! You can’t push it! There’s a rock in the way! Argh[game-token-1][control-code-2] if only one of my Pokémon knew Dig[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
No, Krookodile! Non puoi spingerlo!
C{B4}è una roccia di mezzo! Argh\.\CC0818 se\lsolo uno dei miei Pokémon

conoscesse Scavo\.

entries.original: "Hey! I told you I’d come back!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! I told you I’d come back!
entries.translated:
Ehi! Ti avevo detto che sarei
tornato!

entries.original:
"[buffer1]! Use [buffer2]!
Help him out of there!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1]! Use [buffer2-2]! Help him out of there!
entries.translated:
[buffer1]! Usa [buffer2]! Tiralo
fuori di lì!

entries.original:
"It’s good to see you again, [rival].

Have you given any thought on what
I told you, at all?"
entries.translation_source: It’s good to see you again, [text-token-rival-1]. Have you given any thought on what I told you, at all?
entries.translated:
È bello rivederti, [rival]. Hai
pensato almeno un po{B4} a quello che\lti ho detto?

entries.original:
"Yeah, and I believe you.

But that doesn’t mean I’ve forgiven
you for leaving us behind in Hoenn."
entries.translation_source: Yeah, and I believe you. But that doesn’t mean I’ve forgiven you for leaving us behind in Hoenn.
entries.translated:
Sì, e ti credo. Ma questo non vuol
dire che ti abbia perdonato per\laverci lasciato indietro a Hoenn.

entries.original:
"I can’t apologize enough for that,
[rival]\.

And I don’t expect you to ever
forgive us for what we did\."
entries.translation_source: I can’t apologize enough for that, [text-token-rival-1][game-token-2] And I don’t expect you to ever forgive us for what we did[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Non potrò mai scusarmi abbastanza
per quello, [rival]\. E non mi\laspetto certo che tu ci perdoni mai

per ciò che abbiamo fatto\.

entries.original:
"Still\.\CC0820 I’m willing to give it
another shot.

At least you’re not trying to blow
everything up, like Ivory."
entries.translation_source: Still[game-token-1][control-code-2] I’m willing to give it another shot. At least you’re not trying to blow everything up, like Ivory.
entries.translated:
Comunque\.\CC0820 Sono disposto a
riprovarci. Almeno non stai\lcercando di far saltare tutto in

aria, come Ivory.

entries.original:
"Ha ha\.\CC0818 appreciated, [rival],
despite the low-hanging fruit.

I swear I will do everything I can
to atone, for as long as I live.

And speaking of your mother, she
informed me that Aklove is almost\lready to fire the Ultimate Weapon.

Thankfully, we’re not too far from
the summit.

However, getting to the top is a bit
less simple\."
entries.translation_source: Ha ha[game-token-1][control-code-2] appreciated, [text-token-rival-3], despite the low-hanging fruit. I swear I will do everything I can to atone, for as long as I live. And speaking of your mother, she informed me that Aklove is almost ready to fire the Ultimate Weapon. Thankfully, we’re not too far from the summit. However, getting to the top is a bit less simple[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Ah ah\.\CC0818 apprezzo, [rival],
nonostante la battuta facile. Giuro\lche farò tutto ciò che posso per

espiare, finché vivrò. E, a
proposito di tua madre, mi ha\linformato che Aklove è quasi pronto

a sparare l{B4}Arma Suprema. Per
fortuna, non siamo troppo lontani\ldalla cima. Tuttavia, arrivare in

vetta è un po{B4} meno semplice\.

entries.original:
"Why? There can’t be any more than a
couple of goons left."
entries.translation_source: Why? There can’t be any more than a couple of goons left.
entries.translated:
Perché? Non possono esserci più di
un paio di scagnozzi rimasti.

entries.original:
"Those grunts are exactly the
problem\.

I’m not sure how, but whenever
they locked eyes with me\.

\.my body froze up, and they just
threw me back in the cell.

Unless you can sneak past them
somehow\."
entries.translation_source: Those grunts are exactly the problem[game-token-1] I’m not sure how, but whenever they locked eyes with me[game-token-2] [game-token-3]my body froze up, and they just threw me back in the cell. Unless you can sneak past them somehow[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Quegli scagnozzi sono proprio il
problema\. Non so come, ma ogni volta\lche mi fissavano\. \.il mio corpo si

paralizzava, e mi ributtavano in
cella. A meno che tu non riesca a\lsgattaiolare oltre di loro in

qualche modo\.

entries.original:
"And we’ll find that \qosomehow\qc.

[player] and I got this far up on
our own, didn’t we?

Even if we can’t just fight our way
past, we’ll find an answer!"
entries.translation_source: And we’ll find that [quote-open-1]somehow[quote-close-2]. [player-name-3] and I got this far up on our own, didn’t we? Even if we can’t just fight our way past, we’ll find an answer!
entries.translated:
E troveremo un modo \qoin qualche
modo\qc. [player] e io siamo arrivati\lfin qui con le nostre forze, no?

Anche se non possiamo semplicemente
farci strada combattendo, troveremo\luna soluzione!

entries.original:
"Just be careful, [rival].

I’ll wait here with Melony until
you figure out a way past.

Oh, and give the item we asked
you to find in the warehouse to\l[player], will you?

It should help you deal with Aklove
if he tries anything at the summit."
entries.translation_source: Just be careful, [text-token-rival-1]. I’ll wait here with Melony until you figure out a way past. Oh, and give the item we asked you to find in the warehouse to [player-name-2], will you? It should help you deal with Aklove if he tries anything at the summit.
entries.translated:
Stai attento, [rival]. Ti
aspetterò qui con Melony finché non\ltroverai un modo per passare. Ah, e

l{B4}oggetto che ti abbiamo chiesto di
trovare nel magazzino, lo dai a\l[player], va bene? Dovrebbe

aiutarti a gestire Aklove se prova
a fare qualcosa alla vetta.

entries.original:
"Here, [player].
You’ll need this."
entries.translation_source: Here, [player-name-1]. You’ll need this.
entries.translated: Qui, [player]. Ne avrai bisogno.

entries.original:
"Apparently, that’s the only thing
that can seal the dark force away\lagain, so don’t drop it.

Let’s go, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Apparently, that’s the only thing that can seal the dark force away again, so don’t drop it. Let’s go, [player-name-1]!
entries.translated:
A quanto pare, è l{B4}unica cosa che
può sigillare di nuovo la forza\loscura, quindi non lasciarla

cadere. Andiamo, [player]!

entries.original:
"If you can find something to
obscure that grunt’s vision,\lthere’s a chance he won’t notice\lif you try to sneak past."
entries.translation_source: If you can find something to obscure that grunt’s vision, there’s a chance he won’t notice if you try to sneak past.
entries.translated:
Se riesci a trovare qualcosa per
oscurare la visuale di quella\lrecluta, c{B4}è la possibilità che non

si accorga di te se provi a
sgattaiolare oltre.

entries.original:
"This weird guy keeps trying to
convince me he’s my dad.

[rival] wasn’t happy about it,
but he still bought it.

I’m not falling for it, though!

Why would my dad just appear out
of the blue after 16 years?"
entries.translation_source: This weird guy keeps trying to convince me he’s my dad. [text-token-rival-1] wasn’t happy about it, but he still bought it. I’m not falling for it, though! Why would my dad just appear out of the blue after 16 years?
entries.translated:
Questo tipo strano continua a
cercare di convincermi che è mio\lpadre. [rival] non ne era

contento, ma ci è comunque cascato.
Io, però, non ci casco! Perché mio\lpadre dovrebbe comparire dal nulla

dopo 16 anni?

entries.original:
"That weird guy ran to the summit
to join the fight.

I really hope we make it out of
this in one piece\."
entries.translation_source: That weird guy ran to the summit to join the fight. I really hope we make it out of this in one piece[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Quel tipo strambo è corso in cima
per unirsi alla battaglia. Spero\ldavvero che ne usciremo tutti in un

pezzo\.

entries.original:
"\CC0600Psst\CC0601\.\CC0600

You two! Get over here!"
entries.translation_source: [control-code-1]Psst[control-code-2][game-token-3][control-code-4] You two! Get over here!
entries.translated: \CC0600Psst\CC0601\.\CC0600 Voi due! Venite qui!

entries.original:
"\CC0600There’s no sense rushing in and
getting captured!

Don’t worry, Grampa and I thought
of a plan.

Now listen up\CC0601\."
entries.translation_source: [control-code-1]There’s no sense rushing in and getting captured! Don’t worry, Grampa and I thought of a plan. Now listen up[control-code-2][game-token-3]
entries.translated:
\CC0600Non ha senso precipitarsi e farsi
catturare! Non preoccuparti, io e\lil nonno abbiamo pensato a un

piano. Ora ascolta\CC0601\.

entries.original:
"[red]All preparations have been
completed, Aklove.

The Shadow Warriors have been
successfully integrated into\lthe weapon.

Along with power absorbed from the
mountain, it’s now fully charged.

You may proceed with the activation
when ready."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]All preparations have been completed, Aklove. The Shadow Warriors have been successfully integrated into the weapon. Along with power absorbed from the mountain, it’s now fully charged. You may proceed with the activation when ready.
entries.translated:
[red]Tutti i preparativi sono stati
completati, Aklove. I Guerrieri\lOmbra sono stati integrati con

successo nell{B4}arma. Insieme
all{B4}energia assorbita dalla\lmontagna, ora è completamente

carica. Puoi procedere con
l{B4}attivazione quando sei pronto.

entries.original: "The Ultimate Weapon\."
entries.translation_source: The Ultimate Weapon[game-token-1]
entries.translated: L{B4}Arma Suprema\.

entries.original:
"I still cannot believe it was hidden
in plain sight, all this time.

The crystal atop the mountain\.\CC0818
the Borrian insurgents must have\lbrought it here 3000 years ago\lusing Hoopa’s power.

The history books never mentioned
that little detail\.

To think that I wasted countless
hours searching for it!

But no matter - I have my chance to
activate it now."
entries.translation_source: I still cannot believe it was hidden in plain sight, all this time. The crystal atop the mountain[game-token-1][control-code-2] the Borrian insurgents must have brought it here 3000 years ago using Hoopa’s power. The history books never mentioned that little detail[game-token-3] To think that I wasted countless hours searching for it! But no matter - I have my chance to activate it now.
entries.translated:
Non posso ancora credere che fosse
nascosto in piena vista, per tutto\lquesto tempo. Il cristallo sulla

cima della montagna\.\CC0818 gli insorti
Borrian devono averlo portato qui\l3000 anni fa usando il potere di

Hoopa. I libri di storia non hanno
mai menzionato quel piccolo\ldettaglio\. Pensare che ho sprecato

ore e ore a cercarlo! Ma non
importa - ora ho la possibilità di\lattivarlo.

entries.original:
"All systems have been engaged.

And with the push of this button\."
entries.translation_source: All systems have been engaged. And with the push of this button[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tutti i sistemi sono stati
attivati. E con la pressione di\lquesto pulsante\.

entries.original: "Gastrodon, now! Use Earth Power!"
entries.translation_source: Gastrodon, now! Use Earth Power!
entries.translated: Gastrodon, adesso! Usa Geoforza!

entries.original:
"What!? You\.\CC0820 how can this be
possible!

It cannot be that\.\CC0818 Hoopa!"
entries.translation_source: What!? You[game-token-1][control-code-2] how can this be possible! It cannot be that[game-token-3][control-code-4] Hoopa!
entries.translated:
Che!? Tu\.\CC0820 come può essere possibile!
Non può essere che\.\CC0818 Hoopa!

entries.original:
"Yup. Guess the world you sent me
to wasn’t as deadly as you hoped!"
entries.translation_source: Yup. Guess the world you sent me to wasn’t as deadly as you hoped!
entries.translated:
Già. Immagino che il mondo in cui
mi hai mandato non fosse mortale\lcome speravi!

entries.original:
"Hoopa! You useless Pokémon!

You could not even be rid of him
properly!?"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! You useless Pokémon! You could not even be rid of him properly!?
entries.translated:
Hoopa! Pokémon inutile! Non sei
riuscito nemmeno a liberartene come\lsi deve!?

entries.original:
"Hold on\.

If you were not present for the
attack on our base, then it is\lclear you could not have escaped\lon your own\.

Then, there is nothing to stop me
from sending you right back!"
entries.translation_source: Hold on[game-token-1] If you were not present for the attack on our base, then it is clear you could not have escaped on your own[game-token-2] Then, there is nothing to stop me from sending you right back!
entries.translated:
Aspetta\. Se non eri presente durante
l{B4}attacco alla nostra base, allora\lè chiaro che non potevi essere

fuggito da solo\. Quindi, non c{B4}è
nulla che mi impedisca di\lrispedirti indietro!

entries.original: "Hoopa! Get rid of him!"
entries.translation_source: Hoopa! Get rid of him!
entries.translated: Hoopa! Sbarazzati di lui!

entries.original:
"Gastrodon! Keep me locked down with
your Sticky Hold!"
entries.translation_source: Gastrodon! Keep me locked down with your Sticky Hold!
entries.translated:
Gastrodon! Tienimi bloccato con la
tua abilità Antifurto!

entries.original:
"Tch\.\CC0818 have it your way.

I only need you incapacitated for
long enough.

Hoopa! Prepare to\."
entries.translation_source: Tch[game-token-1][control-code-2] have it your way. I only need you incapacitated for long enough. Hoopa! Prepare to[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Tsk\.\CC0818 fai come ti pare. Ho solo
bisogno che tu sia incapacitato\labbastanza a lungo. Hoopa!

Preparati a\.

entries.original: "[player]! Now’s your chance!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Now’s your chance!
entries.translated: [player]! Ora è la tua occasione!

entries.original:
"Gah\.\CC0820 I should have known.

So it was you who aided the escape\.!"
entries.translation_source: Gah[game-token-1][control-code-2] I should have known. So it was you who aided the escape[game-token-3]!
entries.translated:
Gah\.\CC0820 Avrei dovuto capirlo. Quindi
sei stato tu ad aver agevolato la\lfuga\.!

entries.original:
"Fine! Hoopa! You handle [player]!
I will deal with this other pest."
entries.translation_source: Fine! Hoopa! You handle [player-name-1]! I will deal with this other pest.
entries.translated:
Va bene! Hoopa! Occupati di
[player]! Io mi sbarazzo di questo\laltro fastidio.

entries.original:
"As for you, Ivory, activate the
weapon in my stead!"
entries.translation_source: As for you, Ivory, activate the weapon in my stead!
entries.translated:
Quanto a te, Ivory, attiva l{B4}arma
al posto mio!

entries.original:
"I don’t think so!
You’re not going anywhere, Ivory!"
entries.translation_source: I don’t think so! You’re not going anywhere, Ivory!
entries.translated:
Non credo proprio! Non vai da
nessuna parte, Ivory!

entries.original:
"You may have gotten the better of
me before, but this time, I’m taking\lyou down a peg!

I’m gonna stop you and save us all!"
entries.translation_source: You may have gotten the better of me before, but this time, I’m taking you down a peg! I’m gonna stop you and save us all!
entries.translated:
Potresti avermi battuto la volta
scorsa, ma stavolta ti darò una\llezione! Ti fermerò e salverò tutti

noi!

entries.original:
"Arrrrgh!

Why do all these annoyances keep
popping up out of the woodwork!?

\.

Fine, ’tis only a matter of time
now before you are all defeated.

I am a patient man\.

I have waited a year for this day,
so what is a few more moments?"
entries.translation_source: Arrrrgh! Why do all these annoyances keep popping up out of the woodwork!? [game-token-1] Fine, ’tis only a matter of time now before you are all defeated. I am a patient man[game-token-2] I have waited a year for this day, so what is a few more moments?
entries.translated:
Arrrrgh! Perché tutti questi
fastidi continuano a spuntare come\lfunghi!? \. Va bene, ormai è solo

questione di tempo prima che
veniate tutti sconfitti. Sono un\luomo paziente\. Ho aspettato un anno

per questo giorno, quindi che sono
mai ancora pochi istanti?

entries.original:
"Hold the line, Hoopa and Ivory!

Do not allow them near the weapon!

Once I’m done dealing with this
\qohero\qc, I’ll fire the Weapon\land be done with it."
entries.translation_source: Hold the line, Hoopa and Ivory! Do not allow them near the weapon! Once I’m done dealing with this [quote-open-1]hero[quote-close-2], I’ll fire the Weapon and be done with it.
entries.translated:
Tenete la posizione, Hoopa e Ivory!
Non lasciateli avvicinare all{B4}Arma!\lQuando avrò finito di occuparmi di

questo \qoeroe\qc, sparerò con l{B4}Arma e
la finiremo qui.

entries.original:
"[red]I’m sorry\.\CC0820 Marlon\.\CC0830 [rival]\.\CC0830
This is the only way\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’m sorry[game-token-2][control-code-3] Marlon[game-token-4][control-code-5] [text-token-rival-6][game-token-7][control-code-8] This is the only way[game-token-9]
entries.translated:
[red]Mi dispiace\.\CC0820 Marlon\.\CC0830 [rival]\.\CC0830 È
l{B4}unico modo\.

entries.original:
"[player]! Take down Hoopa, and turn
off that weapon!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! Take down Hoopa, and turn off that weapon!
entries.translated:
[player]! Sconfiggi Hoopa e spegni
quell{B4}arma!

entries.original: "[black]Rayquaza flew away!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Rayquaza flew away!
entries.translated: [black]Rayquaza è volato via!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0820 Hooooo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo[game-token-2][control-code-3] Hooooo!
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0820 Hooooo!

entries.original:
"[black]Hoopa summoned a mysterious power
and increased its size!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Hoopa summoned a mysterious power and increased its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Hoopa ha evocato un potere
misterioso e ha aumentato le sue\ldimensioni!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.

entries.original:
"Quick, [player]!
Seal its power while it’s weakened!"
entries.translation_source: Quick, [player-name-1]! Seal its power while it’s weakened!
entries.translated:
Svelto, [player]! Sigilla il suo
potere mentre è indebolito!

entries.original: "[green]Hoo\.\CC0820 pa?"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hoo[game-token-2][control-code-3] pa?
entries.translated: [green]Hoo\.\CC0820 pa?

entries.original:
"You\.! You truly are the most
useless, pathetic Pokémon!

Too many times now have you failed
at the simplest tasks!"
entries.translation_source: You[game-token-1]! You truly are the most useless, pathetic Pokémon! Too many times now have you failed at the simplest tasks!
entries.translated:
Tu\.! Sei davvero il Pokémon più
inutile e patetico! Troppe volte\lormai hai fallito nei compiti più

semplici!

entries.original:
"Begone, Hoopa!
Leave my sight!

With your power sealed, I will just
have to\."
entries.translation_source: Begone, Hoopa! Leave my sight! With your power sealed, I will just have to[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Vattene, Hoopa! Sparisci dalla mia
vista! Con il tuo potere sigillato,\ldovrò semplicemente\.

entries.original:
"Gotcha!

Not so tough without that Pokémon,
are you?"
entries.translation_source: Gotcha! Not so tough without that Pokémon, are you?
entries.translated:
Ti ho preso! Non sei così forte
senza quel Pokémon, eh?

entries.original: "Unhand me, you uncouth brute!"
entries.translation_source: Unhand me, you uncouth brute!
entries.translated: Lasciami, bruto villano!

entries.original: "Not on your life, Aklove!"
entries.translation_source: Not on your life, Aklove!
entries.translated: Neanche per sogno, Aklove!

entries.original:
"[player]!
I got him! Now’s your chance!

Turn off the Ultimate Weapon!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! I got him! Now’s your chance! Turn off the Ultimate Weapon!
entries.translated:
[player]! L{B4}ho preso! È la tua
occasione! Disattiva l{B4}Arma\lSuprema!

entries.original:
"Out of my way!

The weapon must be activated,
no matter the cost!

But if you will not stand aside
and allow me to pass, then with\lor without Hoopa, I will bring you\lto your knees!"
entries.translation_source: Out of my way! The weapon must be activated, no matter the cost! But if you will not stand aside and allow me to pass, then with or without Hoopa, I will bring you to your knees!
entries.translated:
Fatti da parte! L{B4}arma deve essere
attivata, a qualunque costo! Ma se\lnon ti sposti e non mi lasci

passare, allora con o senza Hoopa
ti metterò in ginocchio!

entries.original: "You take it from here, okay?"
entries.translation_source: You take it from here, okay?
entries.translated: Da qui in poi ci pensi tu, ok?

entries.original:
"[player]! You didn’t think I’d let you
handle this alone, right?

We fought our way up here together,
so let’s take him down together!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You didn’t think I’d let you handle this alone, right? We fought our way up here together, so let’s take him down together!
entries.translated:
[player]! Non pensavi davvero che
ti avrei lasciato affrontare tutto\lda solo, vero? Ci siamo fatti

strada fin quassù insieme, quindi
abbattiamolo insieme!

entries.original:
"No\.\CC0818 No\.\CC0818 No!

This cannot be happening!

THIS CANNOT BE HAPPENING!"
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1][control-code-2] No[game-token-3][control-code-4] No! This cannot be happening! THIS CANNOT BE HAPPENING!
entries.translated:
No\.\CC0818 No\.\CC0818 No! Non può stare succedendo!
QUESTO NON PUÒ STARE SUCCEDENDO!

entries.original:
"It’s over, Aklove.
Time to turn yourself in."
entries.translation_source: It’s over, Aklove. Time to turn yourself in.
entries.translated:
È finita, Aklove. È ora di
costituirti.

entries.original:
"I REFUSE!

NO! THIS IS NOT OVER!"
entries.translation_source: I REFUSE! NO! THIS IS NOT OVER!
entries.translated: MI RIFIUTO! NO! NON È FINITA QUI!

entries.original:
"What!? The Weapon\.\CC0818 it started up
somehow!"
entries.translation_source: What!? The Weapon[game-token-1][control-code-2] it started up somehow!
entries.translated:
Cosa!? L{B4}Arma\.\CC0818 si è avviata in
qualche modo!

entries.original: "It’s not possible\."
entries.translation_source: It’s not possible[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non è possibile\.

entries.original:
"Dresco Town\.\CC0820 my home\.\CC0820
No!"
entries.translation_source: Dresco Town[game-token-1][control-code-2] my home[game-token-3][control-code-4] No!
entries.translated: Dresco Town\.\CC0820 casa mia\.\CC0820 No!

entries.original:
"Ha ha\.\CC0820 hahahahaha\.

Despite your interference, it appears
I have triumphed!

The 3000-year-old war\.\CC0818 has reached
its proper conclusion.

No longer will the great king have
to suffer for all eternity.

When he learns I have accomplished
what he failed to do, his Pokémon\lwill finally return to him\."
entries.translation_source: Ha ha[game-token-1][control-code-2] hahahahaha[game-token-3] Despite your interference, it appears I have triumphed! The 3000-year-old war[game-token-4][control-code-5] has reached its proper conclusion. No longer will the great king have to suffer for all eternity. When he learns I have accomplished what he failed to do, his Pokémon will finally return to him[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Ah ah\.\CC0820 ahahahahaha\. Nonostante il tuo
intervento, pare che abbia\ltrionfato! La guerra di 3000 anni\.\CC0818

ha raggiunto la sua giusta
conclusione. Il grande re non dovrà\lpiù soffrire per l{B4}eternità. Quando

scoprirà che ho compiuto ciò che
lui non riuscì a fare, i suoi\lPokémon torneranno finalmente da

lui\.

entries.original:
"No\.\CC0820 it cannot be\.

The colour of the cannon\.
it is all wrong!"
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1][control-code-2] it cannot be[game-token-3] The colour of the cannon[game-token-4] it is all wrong!
entries.translated:
No\.\CC0820 non può essere\. Il colore del
cannone\. è tutto sbagliato!

entries.original:
"Wha\.

How are you here!?"
entries.translation_source: Wha[game-token-1] How are you here!?
entries.translated: Cosa\.? Come fai a essere qui!?

entries.original:
"It’s simple, really.

That Hoopa of yours had sent
Houndoom to an empty cavern in\lCinder Volcano - a place that was\lof no danger to it at all.

You then sent me there as well.
Together, we managed to escape.

Once I was out, I made contact with
Fey and she had Agent Véga direct\lme here.

It seems she never fully intended
to allow you to rain destruction\."
entries.translation_source: It’s simple, really. That Hoopa of yours had sent Houndoom to an empty cavern in Cinder Volcano - a place that was of no danger to it at all. You then sent me there as well. Together, we managed to escape. Once I was out, I made contact with Fey and she had Agent Véga direct me here. It seems she never fully intended to allow you to rain destruction[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
È semplice, davvero. Quel tuo Hoopa
ha mandato Houndoom in una caverna\lvuota nel Cinder Volcano - un posto

che non rappresentava alcun
pericolo per lui. Poi mi hai\lmandato lì anche tu. Insieme, siamo

riusciti a fuggire. Una volta
fuori, ho contattato Fey e lei ha\lfatto sì che l{B4}Agente Véga mi

indirizzasse qui. Sembra che non
abbia mai veramente inteso\lpermetterti di scatenare

distruzione\.

entries.original:
"That deceitful wench!

I should have known she could
not be trusted\."
entries.translation_source: That deceitful wench! I should have known she could not be trusted[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Quella perfida sgualdrina! Avrei
dovuto capire che non ci si poteva\lfidare di lei\.

entries.original:
"Argh, forget her!

Just tell me, what have you done!?"
entries.translation_source: Argh, forget her! Just tell me, what have you done!?
entries.translated:
Argh, scordatela! Dimmi solo, che
cosa hai fatto!?

entries.original:
"I modified the weapon’s settings
before firing it, boy.

I restored it to its original
purpose.

To give life, not take it."
entries.translation_source: I modified the weapon’s settings before firing it, boy. I restored it to its original purpose. To give life, not take it.
entries.translated:
Ho modificato le impostazioni
dell{B4}arma prima di sparare,\lragazzo. L{B4}ho riportata al suo

scopo originario. Dare vita, non
toglierla.

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 you utter, utter fool!

We only extracted enough power from
the Shadow Warriors for a single\lblast before they all fell apart!"
entries.translation_source: You[game-token-1][control-code-2] you utter, utter fool! We only extracted enough power from the Shadow Warriors for a single blast before they all fell apart!
entries.translated:
Tu\.\CC0820, idiota totale, idiota totale!
Abbiamo estratto abbastanza energia\ldagli Shadow Warriors per una sola

esplosione prima che andassero
tutti in pezzi!

entries.original:
"[red]But\.\CC0820 you promised you would use
the weapon to restore my lost son!

Were you planning to betray me,
this entire time?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]But[game-token-2][control-code-3] you promised you would use the weapon to restore my lost son! Were you planning to betray me, this entire time?
entries.translated:
[red]Ma\.\CC0820 avevi promesso che avresti usato
l{B4}arma per riportare da me mio\lfiglio perduto! Avevi intenzione di

tradirmi per tutto questo tempo?

entries.original:
"Of course I was!

I had no intention of ever
helping you!

If all had gone according to plan,
I would have just left you as the\lscapegoat, and flown off!

Like so!"
entries.translation_source: Of course I was! I had no intention of ever helping you! If all had gone according to plan, I would have just left you as the scapegoat, and flown off! Like so!
entries.translated:
Certo che sì! Non avevo alcuna
intenzione di aiutarti! Se tutto\lfosse andato secondo i piani, ti

avrei semplicemente lasciato come
capro espiatorio e me ne sarei\lvolato via! Proprio così!

entries.original:
"Staraptor! After him!
Let’s go!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! After him! Let’s go!
entries.translated: Staraptor! Dietro di lui! Andiamo!

entries.original:
"[red]Zeph\.\CC0820 my son’s remains\.\CC0820 I had
them with me\.

Why didn’t you\.\CC0820 why didn’t you
come for them!?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Zeph[game-token-2][control-code-3] my son’s remains[game-token-4][control-code-5] I had them with me[game-token-6] Why didn’t you[game-token-7][control-code-8] why didn’t you come for them!?
entries.translated:
[red]Zeph\.\CC0820 i resti di mio figlio\.\CC0820 li avevo
con me\. Perché non sei venuto\.\CC0820 perché\lnon sei venuto a prenderli!?

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0820 I’m sorry\.\CC0820 truly\.\CC0820 I\.\CC0820
I wish I could have\.

But there was only a sliver of time
available for me to slip in after\l[player] sealed Hoopa’s power.

And at that point\.\CC0818 I couldn’t take
the chance I’d be noticed!

I’m so sorry, Ivory."
entries.translation_source: Ivory[game-token-1][control-code-2] I’m sorry[game-token-3][control-code-4] truly[game-token-5][control-code-6] I[game-token-7][control-code-8] I wish I could have[game-token-9] But there was only a sliver of time available for me to slip in after [player-name-10] sealed Hoopa’s power. And at that point[game-token-11][control-code-12] I couldn’t take the chance I’d be noticed! I’m so sorry, Ivory.
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0820 Mi dispiace\.\CC0820 davvero\.\CC0820 Io\.\CC0820 Vorrei
aver potuto\. Ma avevo solo un\lpiccolo intervallo di tempo per

infilarmi qui dopo che [player] ha
sigillato il potere di Hoopa. E a\lquel punto\.\CC0818 non potevo rischiare di

essere notato! Mi dispiace
tantissimo, Ivory.

entries.original:
"[red]Marlon\.\CC0820 [rival]\.\CC0820 all I ever wanted
was\.\CC0820 was\.

It was all for him\.\CC0820 always for him\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Marlon[game-token-2][control-code-3] [text-token-rival-4][game-token-5][control-code-6] all I ever wanted was[game-token-7][control-code-8] was[game-token-9] It was all for him[game-token-10][control-code-11] always for him[game-token-12]
entries.translated:
[red]Marlon\.\CC0820 [rival]\.\CC0820 tutto ciò che ho
sempre voluto era\.\CC0820 era\. Era tutto per\llui\.\CC0820 sempre per lui\.

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0820 you still don’t get it.

Yes, we lost one child, but we
gained two more.

After I met [rival]\.\CC0820 I’ve come to
understand what we’ve lost by\labandoning them all those years\lago.

But it’s not too late for us!

We can start again\.\CC0820 build a new
relationship with them!

We can never truly make up for all
the years we lost, but we can at\lleast start somewhere."
entries.translation_source: Ivory[game-token-1][control-code-2] you still don’t get it. Yes, we lost one child, but we gained two more. After I met [text-token-rival-3][game-token-4][control-code-5] I’ve come to understand what we’ve lost by abandoning them all those years ago. But it’s not too late for us! We can start again[game-token-6][control-code-7] build a new relationship with them! We can never truly make up for all the years we lost, but we can at least start somewhere.
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0820 ancora non capisci. Sì,
abbiamo perso un figlio, ma ne\labbiamo guadagnati altri due. Dopo

aver incontrato [rival]\.\CC0820 ho capito
cosa abbiamo perso abbandonandoli\ltutti quegli anni fa. Ma non è

troppo tardi per noi! Possiamo
ricominciare\.\CC0820 costruire un nuovo\lrapporto con loro! Non potremo mai

recuperare davvero tutti gli anni
perduti, ma almeno possiamo\liniziare da qualche parte.

entries.original:
"[red]I\.\CC0820 I need time to think - alone.

Don’t come looking for me."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I[game-token-2][control-code-3] I need time to think - alone. Don’t come looking for me.
entries.translated:
[red]I\.\CC0820 Ho bisogno di tempo per pensare -
da sola. Non venire a cercarmi.

entries.original: "Is\.\CC0818 is it over?"
entries.translation_source: Is[game-token-1][control-code-2] is it over?
entries.translated: È\.\CC0818 è finita?

entries.original:
"Zeph, Marlon, you’re under arrest.

I should not need to spell out
your crimes.

You are both fully aware of what
you’ve done."
entries.translation_source: Zeph, Marlon, you’re under arrest. I should not need to spell out your crimes. You are both fully aware of what you’ve done.
entries.translated:
Zeph, Marlon, siete in arresto. Non
dovrei nemmeno dover spiegare i\lvostri crimini. Siete entrambi

pienamente consapevoli di ciò che
avete fatto.

entries.original:
"Please, Arthur.

Take me in, but let Marlon be.

He’s suffered enough through
all this\."
entries.translation_source: Please, Arthur. Take me in, but let Marlon be. He’s suffered enough through all this[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ti prego, Arthur. Porta me via, ma
lascia stare Marlon. Ha sofferto\labbastanza per tutto questo\.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You were key in draining the power
supply of the Ultimate Weapon\.

I suppose we can work something
out.

Marlon is free to go for now.

As for you, please come with us.
We have a lot to discuss."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] You were key in draining the power supply of the Ultimate Weapon[game-token-2] I suppose we can work something out. Marlon is free to go for now. As for you, please come with us. We have a lot to discuss.
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Sei stato fondamentale
nell{B4}esaurire la fonte di energia\ldell{B4}Arma Suprema\. Suppongo che

possiamo trovare una soluzione.
Marlon è libero di andare, per ora.\lPer quanto riguarda te, vieni con

noi, per favore. Abbiamo molto di
cui parlare.

entries.original:
"Marlon, please, watch over my son
while I’m gone."
entries.translation_source: Marlon, please, watch over my son while I’m gone.
entries.translated:
Marlon, per favore, prenditi cura
di mio figlio mentre sono via.

entries.original:
"Of course, Zeph.

I’ll take him back to my home until
you’re released."
entries.translation_source: Of course, Zeph. I’ll take him back to my home until you’re released.
entries.translated:
Certo, Zeph. Lo porterò a casa mia
finché non sarai liberato.

entries.original:
"Then, I guess this is it,
[player]?

No\.\CC0818 there’s one more thing I
need to do."
entries.translation_source: Then, I guess this is it, [player-name-1]? No[game-token-2][control-code-3] there’s one more thing I need to do.
entries.translated:
Allora, immagino che sia questo,
[player]? No\.\CC0818 c{B4}è un{B4}ultima cosa che\ldevo fare.

entries.original:
"Listen up, old man!

I didn’t spend the last who knows
how many days searching for you\lonly to be happy when I found you!

I’m gonna show you what you’ve been
missing out on all these years!

I’m gonna show you how strong
I’ve become!"
entries.translation_source: Listen up, old man! I didn’t spend the last who knows how many days searching for you only to be happy when I found you! I’m gonna show you what you’ve been missing out on all these years! I’m gonna show you how strong I’ve become!
entries.translated:
Ascolta, vecchio! Non ho passato
gli ultimi chissà quanti giorni a\lcercarti solo per essere felice

quando ti ho trovato! Ti farò
vedere cosa ti sei perso per tutti\lquesti anni! Ti farò vedere quanto

sono diventato forte!

entries.original:
"[rival], I already know you’re
strong\."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1], I already know you’re strong[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [rival], so già che sei forte\.

entries.original:
"No, no, no.
You don’t understand, old man.

Seeing me fight is one thing, but
you haven’t really experienced it."
entries.translation_source: No, no, no. You don’t understand, old man. Seeing me fight is one thing, but you haven’t really experienced it.
entries.translated:
No, no, no. Non capisci, vecchio.
Vedermi combattere è una cosa, ma\lnon l{B4}hai davvero sperimentato.

entries.original:
"[player]!

For one last time, I want you to
fight by my side!

You’re gonna help me prove to him
how strong I am!

Beating him down alone isn’t enough,
I need to show him that I’m just\las strong, if not stronger than\lsomeone who could take down Hoopa!

And then he’ll really know how far
I’ve come!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! For one last time, I want you to fight by my side! You’re gonna help me prove to him how strong I am! Beating him down alone isn’t enough, I need to show him that I’m just as strong, if not stronger than someone who could take down Hoopa! And then he’ll really know how far I’ve come!
entries.translated:
[player]! Per l{B4}ultima volta,
voglio che combatti al mio fianco!\lMi aiuterai a dimostrargli quanto

sono forte! Metterlo al tappeto da
solo non basta, devo mostrargli che\lsono forte quanto, se non più, di

qualcuno capace di sconfiggere
Hoopa! E allora capirà davvero\lquanta strada ho fatto!

entries.original:
"Let’s do this, old man!

I’ve been saving this one,
just for you!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s do this, old man! I’ve been saving this one, just for you!
entries.translated:
Facciamola finita, vecchio! Questo
l{B4}ho tenuto da parte apposta per\lte!

entries.original:
"Is that right\.\CC0820 but I still have
my pride as a Trainer, [rival].

I’m afraid I won’t just let you win
that easily!"
entries.translation_source: Is that right[game-token-1][control-code-2] but I still have my pride as a Trainer, [text-token-rival-3]. I’m afraid I won’t just let you win that easily!
entries.translated:
Davvero\.\CC0820 ma ho ancora il mio
orgoglio di Allenatore, [rival].\lTemo che non ti lascerò vincere

così facilmente!

entries.original:
"You know, [rival], I already knew
how far you’d come.

But your strength in battle isn’t how
I know that.

Your prideful, yet good heart was
what helped save us all from\ldisaster.

That’s what truly makes you a
strong Trainer.

I couldn’t be more proud of you."
entries.translation_source: You know, [text-token-rival-1], I already knew how far you’d come. But your strength in battle isn’t how I know that. Your prideful, yet good heart was what helped save us all from disaster. That’s what truly makes you a strong Trainer. I couldn’t be more proud of you.
entries.translated:
Sai, [rival], sapevo già quanto
fossi arrivato lontano. Ma la tua\lforza in battaglia non è il modo in

cui lo sapevo. Il tuo cuore
orgoglioso ma buono è stato ciò che\lci ha aiutati a salvarci tutti dal

disastro. È questo che ti rende
davvero un forte Allenatore. Non\lpotrei essere più fiero di te.

entries.original:
"Old man\.\CC0820 no\.\CC0820 Dad\.

Took you long enough\.\CC0818 to finally
say that\."
entries.translation_source: Old man[game-token-1][control-code-2] no[game-token-3][control-code-4] Dad[game-token-5] Took you long enough[game-token-6][control-code-7] to finally say that[game-token-8]
entries.translated:
Vecchio\.\CC0820 no\.\CC0820 Papà\. Ci hai messo
abbastanza\.\CC0818 a dirlo finalmente\.

entries.original:
"[rival], let’s get Melony and go
home to Frozen Heights.

I want to get to know you both."
entries.translation_source: [text-token-rival-1], let’s get Melony and go home to Frozen Heights. I want to get to know you both.
entries.translated:
[rival], andiamo a prendere Melony
e torniamo a Frozen Heights. Voglio\lconoscervi entrambi.

entries.original: "What about\.\CC0820 you know\.\CC0820 her?"
entries.translation_source: What about[game-token-1][control-code-2] you know[game-token-3][control-code-4] her?
entries.translated: E se\.\CC0820 conoscessi\.\CC0820 lei?

entries.original:
"Ivory\.\CC0820 needs time to herself.

She sacrificed so much, for nothing,
in the end.

I think she needs to process that.

When she’s ready, we can always
find her."
entries.translation_source: Ivory[game-token-1][control-code-2] needs time to herself. She sacrificed so much, for nothing, in the end. I think she needs to process that. When she’s ready, we can always find her.
entries.translated:
Ivory\.\CC0820 ha bisogno di un po{B4} di tempo
per sé. Ha sacrificato così tanto,\lper niente, alla fine. Credo che

debba elaborarlo. Quando sarà
pronta, potremo sempre trovarla.

entries.original:
"Hey, [player]\.\CC0818
I want you to have this.

I picked it up, back when we were
first trapped in the Shadows’ base."
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player-name-1][game-token-2][control-code-3] I want you to have this. I picked it up, back when we were first trapped in the Shadows’ base.
entries.translated:
Ehi, [player]\.\CC0818 Voglio che tu abbia
questo. L{B4}ho preso quando siamo\lrimasti intrappolati per la prima

volta nella base delle Ombre.

entries.original:
"[player], it’s no secret that you got
as strong as I did\.\CC0818 no, maybe even\lstronger.

Man, you’ve sure come a long way
since we teamed up together back\lin the Shadows’ base.

Whether it was fate or Hoopa that
brought us together\.

I’m glad we got to be friends.

If you’re not busy with anything
else, why don’t you finish off the\lrest of the Gym Challenge?

The Champion’s seat in Borrius is
currently vacant\.

And I can’t think of anyone better
to have the title than you.

The final Gym is east of Magnolia
Town, in [green]Redwood Village[blue].

Good luck, [player].

I’ll come and congratulate you
once you become the Champ!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], it’s no secret that you got as strong as I did[game-token-2][control-code-3] no, maybe even stronger. Man, you’ve sure come a long way since we teamed up together back in the Shadows’ base. Whether it was fate or Hoopa that brought us together[game-token-4] I’m glad we got to be friends. If you’re not busy with anything else, why don’t you finish off the rest of the Gym Challenge? Ho sentito che ci sono dei maniaci

avuto più fortuna nel trovare quel\lfuggitivo\. Buona fortuna, [player]!

entries.original: "Hold it!"

entries.translated: Fermo lì!

entries.original:
"Finally, I managed to catch up
with you, [player]!

I was feeling down after Aklove
got away from me, but catching up\lto you perked me right up again!

\.

Huh? Why am I here?

Well, funny story\.\CC0818 actually, it

But ever since he retired, the
Champion’s title has been open\lfor the taking!

This whole time, Grampa Arthur

you run these errands too\.

bit of a rivalry, ha ha!

But now that a worthy challenger
has appeared, someone I respect,\lthis is going to be a fun battle!"
entries.translation_source: Finally, I managed to catch up with you, [player-name-1]! I was feeling down after Aklove got away from me, but catching up to you perked me right up again! [game-token-2] Huh? Why am I here? Well, funny story[game-token-3][control-code-4] actually, it was Grampa Arthur who used to be the Champion of Borrius. entries.translated:
Finalmente, sono riuscito a
raggiungerti, [player]! Ero giù di\lmorale dopo che Aklove mi è

sfuggito, ma raggiungerti mi ha
tirato su di nuovo! \. Eh? Perché\lsono qui? Beh, una storia

divertente\.\CC0818 in realtà, era il Nonno
Arthur che era il Campione di\lBorrius. Ma da quando si è

ritirato, il titolo di Campione è

- facendomi combattere contro le\lminacce alla regione. Sono sicuro

ti ha fatto fare queste commissioni\lanche\. Lui e il Nonno hanno sempre

avuto un po{B4} di rivalità, ha ha! Ma
ora che un degno sfidante è\lapparso, qualcuno che rispetto,

questa sarà una bella lotta!

entries.original:
"Now, it’s just you and me.

You ready?
Let’s go!"
entries.translation_source: Now, it’s just you and me. You ready? Let’s go!
entries.translated:
Ora siamo solo io e te. Sei pronto?
Andiamo!

entries.original:
"Come to think of it, we always
battled side-by-side, right?

So, I think that the best way to
battle for the Champion’s Seat is\lwith two Pokémon side-by-side!

That’s right! We’re making this a
Double Battle!

Are you ready? I put my best team
together just for this!

Here I come, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Come to think of it, we always battled side-by-side, right? So, I think that the best way to battle for the Champion’s Seat is with two Pokémon side-by-side! That’s right! We’re making this a Double Battle! Are you ready? I put my best team together just for this! Here I come, [player-name-1]!
entries.translated:
Ripensandoci, abbiamo sempre
combattuto fianco a fianco, giusto?\lQuindi, credo che il modo migliore

per lottare per il Trono del
Campione sia con due Pokémon fianco\la fianco! Esatto! La faremo

diventare una Lotta in Doppio! Sei

entries.original:
"\.

\.so\.\CC0818 that’s that.

\.

I see. I guess that makes sense,
after all.

I always knew you were the stronger
Trainer out of the both of us, even\lafter I got a head-start over you\."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] [game-token-2]so[game-token-3][control-code-4] that’s that. [game-token-5] I see. I guess that makes sense, after all. I always knew you were the stronger Trainer out of the both of us, even after I got a head-start over you[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
\.\.\. \.quindi\.\CC0818 ecco tutto. \. Capisco.
Immagino abbia senso, in fondo. Ho\lsempre saputo che eri tu

l{B4}Allenatore più forte tra noi due,
anche dopo aver preso un vantaggio\liniziale su di te\.

entries.original:
"You know, before we began our
fight, I kept thinking\.

\.about all the times I rushed in,
and then you helped bail me out.

Even at Crystal Peak, when I
thought I prepared my Pokémon\lwell enough, we wouldn’t have\lwon without you.

And even though we won, I got
complacent and Aklove got away.

That’s when I realized\.

Even if my Pokémon grow stronger,
what use is it if I don’t grow\lstronger with them?

I guess that’s the difference that
ended up deciding the winner.

So, I’m going to get stronger.

Not just my Pokémon.

Me.

And when I do, let’s do this again!

I’ll take your crown with my own
two hands!

But for now, let’s get you
officially recognized as Borrius’\lnew Champion!

Come on!
The register’s just up ahead.

Follow me!"

entries.translated:
Sai, prima di iniziare il nostro
scontro, continuavo a pensare\. \.a\ltutte le volte in cui mi sono

precipitato e tu mi hai aiutato a
tirarmi fuori dai guai. Anche al\lPicco Cristallo, quando pensavo di

aver preparato bene i miei Pokémon,
non avremmo vinto senza di te. E\lanche se abbiamo vinto, sono

diventato compiacente e Aklove è
scappato. È stato allora che ho\lcapito\. Anche se i miei Pokémon

diventano più forti, a cosa serve
se non divento più forte con loro?\lImmagino sia questa la differenza

che ha deciso il vincitore. Quindi,
diventerò più forte. Non solo i\lmiei Pokémon. Io. E quando lo farò,

rifacciamolo! Prenderò la tua
corona con le mie mani! Ma per ora,\lfacciamo in modo che tu venga

ufficialmente riconosciuto come
nuovo Campione di Borrius! Vieni!\lIl registro è proprio qui davanti.

Seguimi!

Questa stanza è la Hall of Fame\\. È

Congratulazioni per aver completato

Lotta sono state sbloccate!

Inoltre, è stato aggiunto un nuovo
outfit al Box Costumi!

Congratulations!

\.

[player]! Congratulazioni! Ti avevo
detto che sarei passato dopo che\lfossi diventato il Campione, no?

"Yes, congratulations, [player]!

I was hoping I’d get the chance to
see you in person when you\lreturned home.

Are you surprised to see me back
in the old black and red?

That outfit I let you keep wasn’t
my only one, you know!

But even after all that happened,
I felt I needed to wear it again.

Ivory’s still missing, so I hope
that it will be easier to find her\lif I look just like her.

If you happen to hear anything,
[player], don’t hesitate to let\lme know.

And of course, don’t think I’ve
forgotten about your father.

I’ve been looking into freeing him
from the Cube, but so far, I\lhaven’t had much luck.

When I find something useful, I’ll
be sure to have a Mission for you."
entries.translation_source: Yes, congratulations, [player-name-1]! I was hoping I’d get the chance to see you in person when you returned home. Are you surprised to see me back in the old black and red? That outfit I let you keep wasn’t my only one, you know! But even after all that happened, I felt I needed to wear it again. Ivory’s still missing, so I hope that it will be easier to find her if I look just like her. If you happen to hear anything, [player-name-2], don’t hesitate to let me know. entries.translated:
Sì, congratulazioni, [player]!
Speravo di avere la possibilità di\lvederti di persona quando sei

tornato a casa. Sei sorpreso di
vedermi di nuovo con il vecchio\labito nero e rosso? Quell{B4}abito che

ti ho lasciato non era il mio
unico, sai! Ma anche dopo tutto\lquello che è successo, ho sentito

il bisogno di indossarlo di nuovo.
Ivory è ancora scomparsa, quindi\lspero che sarà più facile trovarla

se assomiglio proprio a lei. Se
dovessi sentire qualcosa, [player],\lnon esitare a farmelo sapere. E

naturalmente, non pensare che mi
sia dimenticato di tuo padre. Ho\lcercato di liberarlo dal Cubo, ma

finora non ho avuto molta fortuna.
Quando troverò qualcosa di utile,\lmi assicurerò di avere una Missione

per te.

entries.original:
"[player], my [buffer1], a hearty
congratulations to you!

I heard the news!

To think, after all this time, I
have finally bested old Arthur!

Ho ho ho!

Erm\. excuse me.

Now, my [buffer1], the reason for
my visit.

I have yet another errand for
you to run!

You thought you were done with
those, didn’t you?

Ho ho ho!

Erm\. anyway, following your
defeat of Hoopa atop Crystal Peak,\lmysterious portals have begun\lappearing around Borrius.

When approached, powerful Pokémon
are said to leap forth.

As the Guardian of Borrius in both
name and standing, it is your\lresponsibility to take care of\lthese Pokémon.

I assume that in most cases, if you
capture the Pokémon, the portals\lwill disappear permanently.

Although, it is doubtful that they
will all stay gone forever\.

In any case!

Capture the Pokémon found in these
mysterious portals.

Some portals may only appear if you
bring specific Pokémon, but the\lPokémon in those portals must be\lcaptured regardless.

And if a portal refuses to disappear
permanently after catching the\lPokémon, simply registering it in\lyour Pokédex will be enough."

[player], il mio [buffer1],
vivissime congratulazioni! Ho\lsentito la notizia! Pensare che,

Dunque, sei venuto\. Ah ah ah ah\. non

"He’s insane\.\CC0818 he really thinks
he can try again\.

Perché\. perché non hai potuto

My dreams\.\CC0818 my possessions\.\CC0818
my\.\CC0818 victory\."

Perché\.\CC0818 perché devi rubarmi tutto\. I
miei sogni\.\CC0818 i miei averi\.\CC0818 la mia\.\CC0818\lvittoria\.

"It’s over, Aklove.

of Borrius\.

What was the point of any of it!?

of life\.\CC0818 what would it have\lachieved!?"

È finita, Aklove. I tuoi piani
distruttivi finiscono qui. Dimmi\lsoltanto\.\CC0818 la distruzione di Borrius\.

A cosa serviva!? Qual era il senso
di tutto questo!? Tutta quella\ldistruzione, tutta quella perdita

di vite\.\CC0818 cosa avresti ottenuto!?

"Fine\.\CC0820 I will tell you\.

My ancestor, the one the legends
refer to as \qothe foreign king\qc\lfrom the Great War\.

Even now, 3000 years later, he still
walks the earth to this day.

Once I finished what he started\.\CC0818
once I had brought that war to its\lproper conclusion\.

Then he could rest in peace.

The subjugation of Borrius\.\CC0818 would
have finally seen his last wish\lfulfilled.

But now\.\CC0818 it is no longer possible\."
entries.translation_source: Fine[game-token-1][control-code-2] I will tell you[game-token-3] My ancestor, the one the legends refer to as [quote-open-4]the foreign king[quote-close-5] from the Great War[game-token-6] Even now, 3000 years later, he still walks the earth to this day. The subjugation of Borrius[game-token-10][control-code-11] would have finally seen his last wish fulfilled. But now[game-token-12][control-code-13] it is no longer possible[game-token-14]
entries.translated:
Bene\.\CC0820 Te lo dirò\. Il mio antenato,
colui che le leggende chiamano \qo il\lre straniero \qc della Grande Guerra\.

Ancora oggi, 3000 anni dopo,
cammina ancora sulla terra. Una\lvolta terminato ciò che lui aveva

iniziato\.\CC0818 una volta portata quella
guerra alla sua giusta conclusione\.\lAllora avrebbe potuto riposare in

pace. La sottomissione di Borrius\.\CC0818
avrebbe finalmente visto il suo\lultimo desiderio esaudito. Ma ora\.\CC0818

non è più possibile\.

entries.translation_source: That’s so pathetic.

"Let’s say you’re right.

Let’s say the legend’s true and the
king’s still alive.

But 3000 years\.

Do you really think not a second
of that was spent on reflection?

On regret?

Isn’t it possible he no longer
wants war?

How would you know?

You just projected your desires
onto a myth and nearly destroyed\lour region because of it!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s say you’re right. Let’s say the legend’s true and the king’s still alive. But 3000 years[game-token-1] Do you really think not a second of that was spent on reflection? On regret? Isn’t it possible he no longer wants war? How would you know? You just projected your desires onto a myth and nearly destroyed our region because of it!

Ammettiamo che tu abbia ragione.
Ammettiamo che la leggenda sia vera\le che il re sia ancora vivo. Ma

3000 anni\. Davvero pensi che nemmeno
un secondo di tutto quel tempo sia\lstato dedicato alla riflessione? Al

rimpianto? Non è possibile che non
voglia più la guerra? Come potresti\lsaperlo? Hai semplicemente

proiettato i tuoi desideri su un
mito e per questo hai quasi\ldistrutto la nostra regione!

[player]’s mother\.\CC0818 Jax’s grandfather\.\CC0818

entries.original:
"Let me explain how the Pokémon
Wireless Club works.

On this, the top floor, there are
two rooms.

First, the room on the left.
It’s the Union Room.

You may link up with Trainers
around you who have also\lentered the Union Room using\lthe Wireless Adapter.

With them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.

Second, the room on the right is
the Direct Corner.

You may battle Pokémon with your
friends in this room, but trading is\lno longer available.

Please use Unbound Cloud if you
wish to trade Pokémon.

Sometimes, you may not be able to
find your friends in the Union Room\lor the Direct Corner.

In that case, please move closer
to your friends.

If the Wireless Adapter isn’t
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.

If that is the case, you must go
to the Direct Corner.

I hope you enjoy the Wireless
Communication System."
entries.translation_source: Let me explain how the Pokémon Wireless Club works. On this, the top floor, there are two rooms. First, the room on the left. It’s the Union Room. You may link up with Trainers around you who have also entered the Union Room using the Wireless Adapter. With them, you may do things like chat, battle, and trade. Second, the room on the right is the Direct Corner. You may battle Pokémon with your friends in this room, but trading is no longer available. Please use Unbound Cloud if you wish to trade Pokémon. Sometimes, you may not be able to find your friends in the Union Room or the Direct Corner. In that case, please move closer to your friends. If the Wireless Adapter isn’t connected, you may still link up using a GBA Game Link cable. If that is the case, you must go to the Direct Corner. I hope you enjoy the Wireless Communication System.
entries.translated:

sinistra. È la Sala Unione. Puoi\lconnetterti con gli Allenatori

loro nella Sala Unione usando\ll{B4}Adattatore Wireless. Con loro

entries.original:
"Each member of the Elite Four likes
to set up certain conditions on the\lfield before battle.

First, there’s [green]Moleman[blue].

He likes to set up a vicious
Sandstorm, a kind of Sandstorm\lthat does more damage than a\lregular Sandstorm.

This kind of Sandstorm also boosts
Ground-type Pokémon’s Sp. Def,\land won’t go away if you try to\lget rid of it.

Next, there’s [green]Elias[blue].

When you fight him, all Ghost-type
Pokémon will take half damage\land be immune to entry hazards\lwhen they’re at full health.

Safeguard and Substitute will also
fail unless used by a Ghost-type.

Third, comes [green]Arabella[blue].

Her room is filled with a
Misty Terrain.

And not only that, but any Fairy-
types sent out will have their\llowest defensive stat boosted.

Lastly, comes [green]Penny[blue].

There’s a rainbow in her room that
raises the chance of secondary move\leffects used by Dragon-types.

Make sure you’re prepared for these
conditions before you fight them!"
entries.translation_source: Each member of the Elite Four likes to set up certain conditions on the field before battle. First, there’s [color-green-1]Moleman[color-blue-2]. He likes to set up a vicious Sandstorm, a kind of Sandstorm that does more damage than a regular Sandstorm. This kind of Sandstorm also boosts Ground-type Pokémon’s Sp. Def, and won’t go away if you try to get rid of it. Next, there’s [color-green-3]Elias[color-blue-4]. When you fight him, all Ghost-type Pokémon will take half damage and be immune to entry hazards when they’re at full health. Safeguard and Substitute will also fail unless used by a Ghost-type. Third, comes [color-green-5]Arabella[color-blue-6]. Her room is filled with a Misty Terrain. And not only that, but any Fairy- types sent out will have their lowest defensive stat boosted. Lastly, comes [color-green-7]Penny[color-blue-8]. There’s a rainbow in her room that raises the chance of secondary move effects used by Dragon-types. Make sure you’re prepared for these conditions before you fight them!
entries.translated:
Ogni membro dell{B4}Elite 4 ama
impostare certe condizioni sul\lcampo prima della battaglia. Prima,

c{B4}è [green]Moleman[blue]. A lui piace creare una
violenta Tempesta di Sabbia, una\lspecie di Tempesta di Sabbia che

infligge più danni di una normale
Tempesta di Sabbia. Questo tipo di\lTempesta di Sabbia aumenta anche la

Dif. Sp. dei Pokémon di tipo Terra
e non scompare se provi a\lrimuoverla. Poi, c{B4}è [green]Elias[blue]. Quando

lo combatti, tutti i Pokémon di
tipo Spettro subiranno la metà dei\ldanni e saranno immuni alle insidie

d{B4}ingresso quando sono alla massima
salute. Salvaguardia e Sostituto\lfalliranno a meno che non vengano

usati da un tipo Spettro. Terza,
viene [green]Arabella[blue]. La sua stanza è\lpiena di un Campo Nebbioso. E non

solo, ma qualsiasi tipo Folletto
mandato in campo avrà la sua\lstatistica difensiva più bassa

potenziata. Infine, viene [green]Penny[blue].
C{B4}è un arcobaleno nella sua stanza\lche aumenta la probabilità degli

effetti secondari delle mosse usate
dai tipi Drago. Assicurati di\lessere preparato per queste

condizioni prima di combatterli!
