mercato di [green][buffer1][red].

entries.original:
"The Elite Four are among the
strongest Trainers in Borrius.

Before fighting them, you should
know what you’re up against.

Moleman uses [green]Ground[red]-types,
Elias uses [green]Ghost[red]-types,\lArabella uses [green]Fairy[red]-types,\land Penny uses [green]Dragon[red]-types.

They don’t have many shared
weaknesses, so prepare properly\lby bringing Pokémon that know a\lgood variety of moves."
entries.translation_source: The Elite Four are among the strongest Trainers in Borrius. Before fighting them, you should know what you’re up against. Moleman uses [color-green-1]Ground[color-red-2]-types, Elias uses [color-green-3]Ghost[color-red-4]-types, Arabella uses [color-green-5]Fairy[color-red-6]-types, and Penny uses [color-green-7]Dragon[color-red-8]-types. They don’t have many shared weaknesses, so prepare properly by bringing Pokémon that know a good variety of moves.
entries.translated:
I Superquattro sono tra gli
Allenatori più forti di Borrius.\lPrima di affrontarli, devi sapere

con chi hai a che fare. Moleman usa
Pokémon di tipo [green]Terra[red], Elias usa\lPokémon di tipo [green]Spettro[red], Arabella

usa Pokémon di tipo [green]Folletto[red] e
Penny usa Pokémon di tipo [green]Drago[red].\lNon hanno molte debolezze in

comune, quindi preparati bene
portando Pokémon che conoscono una\lbuona varietà di mosse.

entries.original:
"Trainer!

Once you pass through the doorway
behind me, your Pokémon League\lchallenge will begin.

And once begun, there is no turning
back until you have cleared the\lchallenge.

Have you healed your Pokémon?

Have you purchased essential items?

If so, you may begin your challenge
whenever it most suits you.

Demonstrate the power that brought
you here and go for glory!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer! Once you pass through the doorway behind me, your Pokémon League challenge will begin. And once begun, there is no turning back until you have cleared the challenge. Have you healed your Pokémon? Have you purchased essential items? If so, you may begin your challenge whenever it most suits you. Demonstrate the power that brought you here and go for glory!
entries.translated:
Allenatore! Una volta che avrai
varcato la porta dietro di me, la\ltua sfida alla Lega Pokémon avrà

inizio. E una volta iniziata, non
si torna indietro finché non avrai\lcompletato la sfida. Hai curato i

tuoi Pokémon? Hai acquistato gli
oggetti essenziali? Se sì, puoi\liniziare la tua sfida quando ti è

più comodo. Dimostra la forza che
ti ha portato fin qui e punta alla\lgloria!

entries.original:
"You will be facing the Elite Four
of the Pokémon League.

You may challenge them in any
order, but if you lose to any of\lthem, you will have to start your\lchallenge anew."
entries.translation_source: You will be facing the Elite Four of the Pokémon League. You may challenge them in any order, but if you lose to any of them, you will have to start your challenge anew.
entries.translated:
Ti troverai ad affrontare i
Superquattro della Lega Pokémon.\lPuoi sfidarli in qualunque ordine,

ma se perdi contro uno di loro,
dovrai ricominciare la sfida da\lcapo.

entries.original: "You Are My Only"
entries.translation_source: You Are My Only
entries.translated: Tu sei il mio unico

entries.original:
"Bonds are powerful! Can you clear
the Pokémon League with only one
Pokémon, and prove your bond?"
entries.translation_source: Bonds are powerful! Can you clear the Pokémon League with only one Pokémon, and prove your bond?
entries.translated:
I legami sono potenti! Riesci a
superare la Lega Pokémon con un\lsolo Pokémon e a dimostrare il tuo

legame?

entries.original:
"My only friend is my Pokémon.

I don’t need any more friends
than him.

The bond between a Trainer and
their best friend is unbreakable,\ldon’t you think?

A Trainer and their best friend
can beat any challenge!

Even the Pokémon League!

Do you think you can beat it with
only one Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: My only friend is my Pokémon. I don’t need any more friends than him. The bond between a Trainer and their best friend is unbreakable, don’t you think? A Trainer and their best friend can beat any challenge! Even the Pokémon League! Do you think you can beat it with only one Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Il mio unico amico è il mio
Pokémon. Non mi servono altri amici\loltre a lui. Il legame tra un

Allenatore e il suo migliore amico
è indissolubile, non credi? Un\lAllenatore e il suo migliore amico

possono superare qualsiasi sfida!
Persino la Lega Pokémon! Pensi di\lpoterla battere con un solo

Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Good luck, and never forget the
bond between you and your Pokémon\lfills you with strength!"
entries.translation_source: Good luck, and never forget the bond between you and your Pokémon fills you with strength!
entries.translated:
Buona fortuna, e non dimenticare
mai che il legame tra te e il tuo\lPokémon ti riempie di forza!

entries.original:
"I guess you’re one of those people
that needs more than one friend."
entries.translation_source: I guess you’re one of those people that needs more than one friend.
entries.translated:
Suppongo che tu sia uno di quelli
che ha bisogno di più di un amico.

entries.original:
"You can do it!

All you need to do is beat the
Pokémon League with just one\lPokémon!"
entries.translation_source: You can do it! All you need to do is beat the Pokémon League with just one Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Ce la puoi fare! Devi solo battere
la Lega Pokémon con un solo\lPokémon!

entries.original:
"You did it!

I definitely never doubted you!

You’ve proven the bond with your
Pokémon is most important to you.

Well, take this, in case you want
an even stronger friend."
entries.translation_source: You did it! I definitely never doubted you! You’ve proven the bond with your Pokémon is most important to you. Well, take this, in case you want an even stronger friend.
entries.translated:
Hai fatto centro! Di sicuro non ho
mai dubitato di te! Hai dimostrato\lche il legame con il tuo Pokémon è

la cosa più importante per te.
Bene, prendi questo, nel caso tu\lvoglia un amico ancora più forte.

entries.original:
"Never underestimate the power of
friendship!

It is definitely the most important
stat!"
entries.translation_source: Never underestimate the power of friendship! It is definitely the most important stat!
entries.translated:
Non sottovalutare mai il potere
dell{B4}amicizia! È decisamente la\lstatistica più importante!

entries.original: "Moleman"
entries.translation_source: Moleman
entries.translated: Moleman

entries.original:
"Who dares enter the domain of the
Mole-Man?

Surface-dweller!

For years, my fellow mole-people
and I have lived below ground with\lonly Ground-type Pokémon and the\lEarth itself.

In that world without sunlight, we
tempered our spirits and grew\lstrong!

And yet, you try to establish
dominance over us, as your\lancestors did so many years ago!?

Very well! Learn of the wrath of
the mole-people and the very Earth!"
entries.translation_source: Who dares enter the domain of the Mole-Man? Surface-dweller! For years, my fellow mole-people and I have lived below ground with only Ground-type Pokémon and the Earth itself. In that world without sunlight, we tempered our spirits and grew strong! And yet, you try to establish dominance over us, as your ancestors did so many years ago!? Very well! Learn of the wrath of the mole-people and the very Earth!
entries.translated:
Chi osa entrare nel dominio
dell{B4}Uomo-Talpa? Abitante di\lsuperficie! Per anni, io e i miei

compagni del popolo-talpa abbiamo
vissuto sottoterra con solo Pokémon\ldi tipo Terra e la Terra stessa. In

quel mondo senza luce solare,
abbiamo temprato i nostri spiriti e\lsiamo diventati forti! Eppure,

cerchi di stabilire il dominio su
di noi, come fecero i tuoi antenati\ltanti anni fa!? Molto bene! Impara

l{B4}ira del popolo-talpa e della
Terra stessa!

entries.original:
"I, the living embodiment of the
ground\. defeated by a surface-\ldweller?

But I, the Mole-man, will have my
revenge someday!

This I swear, on behalf of all
mole-people!"
entries.translation_source: I, the living embodiment of the ground[game-token-1] defeated by a surface- dweller? But I, the Mole-man, will have my revenge someday! This I swear, on behalf of all mole-people!
entries.translated:
Io, l{B4}incarnazione vivente della
terra\. sconfitto da un abitante\ldella superficie? Ma io,

l{B4}Uomo-Talpa, mi vendicherò un
giorno! Lo giuro, in nome di tutta\lla gente-talpa!

entries.original:
"I cannot leave the clutches of this
so-called \qoElite Four\qc for now.

But when the time is right\. hmph.

Very well.

Test your mettle against the rest
of them.

Until we meet again\."
entries.translation_source: I cannot leave the clutches of this so-called [quote-open-1]Elite Four[quote-close-2] for now. But when the time is right[game-token-3] hmph. Very well. Test your mettle against the rest of them. Until we meet again[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Non posso ancora sfuggire alle
grinfie di questo cosiddetto\l\qoSuperquattro\qc. Ma quando sarà il

momento\. hmph. Molto bene. Metti
alla prova la tua tempra contro il\lresto di loro. Fino al nostro

prossimo incontro\.

entries.original:
"So, you have bested the greatest
of man and mole-man.

It is time for you to take the
throne of Champion.

Enter through the door in the
centre of the room outside.

Until the day we mole-people take
it for our own\."
entries.translation_source: So, you have bested the greatest of man and mole-man. It is time for you to take the throne of Champion. Enter through the door in the centre of the room outside. Until the day we mole-people take it for our own[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Allora, hai sconfitto il più grande
degli uomini e degli uomini-talpa.\lÈ il momento per te di salire sul

trono del Campione. Entra dalla
porta al centro della stanza fuori.\lFino al giorno in cui noi

uomini-talpa lo faremo nostro\.

entries.original:
"Surface-dweller!
You dare show yourself again?

I warn you, the mole-people do not
suffer an insult twice!

I have toiled underground,
reaffirming my connection\lto the Earth itself\.

All in preparation for this day!

And now, I shall exact my
vengeance on all surface-dwellers\.

Starting with you!"
entries.translation_source: Surface-dweller! You dare show yourself again? I warn you, the mole-people do not suffer an insult twice! I have toiled underground, reaffirming my connection to the Earth itself[game-token-1] All in preparation for this day! And now, I shall exact my vengeance on all surface-dwellers[game-token-2] Starting with you!
entries.translated:
Abitante della superficie! Osi
farti vedere di nuovo? Ti avverto,\lil popolo-talpa non tollera un

insulto due volte! Ho faticato
sottoterra, riaffermando il mio\llegame con la Terra stessa\. Tutto in

preparazione di questo giorno! E
ora, mi prenderò la mia vendetta\lcontro tutti gli abitanti della

superficie\. A cominciare da te!

entries.original:
"Gah\. so my revenge must be
postponed for another day\.

Leave. And do not return, for I
shall surely triumph next time!"
entries.translation_source: Gah[game-token-1] so my revenge must be postponed for another day[game-token-2] Leave. And do not return, for I shall surely triumph next time!
entries.translated:
Accidenti\. dunque la mia vendetta
dovrà essere rimandata a un altro\lgiorno\. Vattene. E non tornare,

perché la prossima volta trionferò
di sicuro!

entries.original:
"So, you have bested the greatest
of man and mole-man.

It is time for you to defend your
title of Champion.

Until the day we mole-people take
it for our own\."
entries.translation_source: So, you have bested the greatest of man and mole-man. It is time for you to defend your title of Champion. Until the day we mole-people take it for our own[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Così, hai sconfitto il più grande
tra gli uomini e gli uomini-talpa.\lÈ tempo che tu difenda il tuo

titolo di Campione. Fino al giorno
in cui noi talpiani ce ne\limpadroniremo per nostro conto\.

entries.original: "Elias"
entries.translation_source: Elias
entries.translated: Elias

entries.original:
"Howdy. I’m Elias.

Or rather, I’m the corpse formerly
known as Elias.

Guess being dead doesn’t get me
out of my duties as a member of\lthe Elite Four, huh?

Lousy economy\.

Yup. Served as a member for years
while I was alive.

Then those jerks dug up my body
after I croaked, and shoved a\lGhost Pokémon along with my spirit\lright back inside.

Oh, don’t get me wrong.

Still got my wits, and my Pokémon
haven’t gotten any less strong.

In fact, I think they might have
only gotten stronger, if anything\.

Sigh, I suppose we should battle
before this stupid flesh prison\lfalls apart."
entries.translation_source: Howdy. I’m Elias. Or rather, I’m the corpse formerly known as Elias. Guess being dead doesn’t get me out of my duties as a member of the Elite Four, huh? Lousy economy[game-token-1] Yup. Served as a member for years while I was alive. Then those jerks dug up my body after I croaked, and shoved a Ghost Pokémon along with my spirit right back inside. Oh, don’t get me wrong. Still got my wits, and my Pokémon haven’t gotten any less strong. In fact, I think they might have only gotten stronger, if anything[game-token-2] Sigh, I suppose we should battle before this stupid flesh prison falls apart.
entries.translated:
Ehilà. Sono Elias. O meglio, sono
il cadavere un tempo noto come\lElias. Immagino che essere morto

non mi esoneri dai miei doveri di
membro dei Superquattro, eh?\lEconomia schifosa\. Eh già. Ho

servito come membro per anni quando
ero vivo. Poi quei cretini hanno\ldissotterrato il mio corpo dopo che

ho crepato, e hanno infilato un
Pokémon Spettro insieme al mio\lspirito di nuovo dentro. Oh, non

fraintendermi. Ho ancora le mie
facoltà mentali, e i miei Pokémon\lnon sono diventati meno forti.

Anzi, penso che siano diventati
solo più forti, semmai\. Sospiro,\lsuppongo che dovremmo combattere

prima che questa stupida prigione
di carne vada in pezzi.

entries.original:
"Well, can’t blame a loss on the
lousy job market, so I guess we’re\ldone here.

Go face the rest of the Elite Four.

And kid\. try not to let yourself
be dug up and experimented on\lafter you pass, okay?

Take it from me.
It’s really inconvenient."
entries.translation_source: Well, can’t blame a loss on the lousy job market, so I guess we’re done here. Go face the rest of the Elite Four. And kid[game-token-1] try not to let yourself be dug up and experimented on after you pass, okay? Take it from me. It’s really inconvenient.
entries.translated:
Beh, non posso dare la colpa di una
sconfitta al pessimo mercato del\llavoro, quindi immagino che qui

abbiamo finito. Vai ad affrontare
il resto dei Superquattro. E\lragazzino\. cerca di non farti

dissotterrare e usare come cavia
dopo che sarai passato, va bene?\lFidati di me. È davvero scomodo.

entries.original:
"Huh, would you look at that?

That’s all four of us down
for the count.

Take your rightful throne as
Champion.

It’s the centre door outside.
You can’t miss it."
entries.translation_source: Huh, would you look at that? That’s all four of us down for the count. Take your rightful throne as Champion. It’s the centre door outside. You can’t miss it.
entries.translated:
Eh, guarda un po{B4}? Siamo tutti e
quattro a terra. Prenditi il tuo\llegittimo trono da Campione. È la

porta centrale all{B4}esterno. Non
puoi sbagliarti.

entries.original:
"Hey.
Surprised to see me again?

Don’t be.
I sorta knew this would happen.

They keep telling me that they’ll
find my replacement eventually,\lbut that day never comes\.

But you didn’t come here to listen
to dead air. Or a dead man.

Sigh\. Let’s just get this battle
over with."
entries.translation_source: Hey. Surprised to see me again? Don’t be. I sorta knew this would happen. They keep telling me that they’ll find my replacement eventually, but that day never comes[game-token-1] But you didn’t come here to listen to dead air. Or a dead man. Sigh[game-token-2] Let’s just get this battle over with.

Ehi. Sorpreso di rivedermi? Non
esserlo. In un certo senso sapevo\lche sarebbe successo. Continuano a

dirmi che prima o poi troveranno il
mio sostituto, ma quel giorno non\larriva mai\. Però non sei venuto qui

ad ascoltare il silenzio. O un uomo
morto. Sigh\. Mettiamo fine a questo\lscontro.

\.I mean, whether it’s life or

si tratti di vita o di morte, non\lricevo comunque alcun rispetto.

"Hi there, friend!

Oh no, I’m not a lost kid!

I’m the Fairy Princess Arabella!
I’m one of the Elite Four!

Daddy used to be a member, but
then he got fired.

So, I volunteered, and now I’m in
the Elite Four!

It’s great! I get given lots of
money to battle Trainers!

\.even if I have to share some
with Daddy.

And I get to invite people to my
tea parties when I win!

Okay, friend!

Let’s battle! I’m gonna show you
how a fairy princess does it!"

So, I volunteered, and now I’m in the Elite Four! It’s great! I get given lots of money to battle Trainers! [game-token-1]even if I have to share some with Daddy. Ciao, amico! Oh no, non sono una
bambina smarrita! Sono la\lPrincipessa Folletto Arabella! Sono

una dei Superquattro! Papà era un
membro, ma poi è stato licenziato.\lCosì mi sono offerta volontaria e

ora sono nei Superquattro! È
fantastico! Mi danno un sacco di\lsoldi per combattere contro gli

Allenatori! \.anche se devo
condividerne un po{B4} con Papà. E\lquando vinco, posso invitare le

persone alle mie feste del tè!
Okay, amico! Combattiamo! Ti\lmostrerò come fa una principessa

folletto!

entries.original:
"When you’re done with the rest of
the Elite Four, will you still join\lone of my tea parties?

It’s going to be so much fun!

If not\. can I ask: do you know
what \qodeadbeat\qc means?

That’s what people call Daddy now."

entries.translated:
Quando avrai finito con il resto
dei Superquattro, verrai ancora a\luno dei miei tè? Sarà così

divertente! Altrimenti\. posso
chiederti: sai cosa significa\l\qofannullone\qc? È così che la gente

chiama papà adesso.

entries.original:
"Wow. You beat all of us!
You’re really super strong!

There’s a big door in the centre
of the hall outside.

That’s where the Champion room is!
You should go and see it!"
entries.translation_source: Wow. You beat all of us! You’re really super strong! There’s a big door in the centre of the hall outside. That’s where the Champion room is! You should go and see it!
entries.translated:
Wow. Ci hai battuti tutti! Sei
davvero fortissimo! C{B4}è una grande\lporta al centro della hall fuori.

Lì si trova la stanza del Campione!
Dovresti andarci a dare\lun{B4}occhiata!

entries.original:
"Hi there, [player]!
Did you miss me?

I just finished a tea party with

Sorry, you’ll have to wait for the

Yay! I wanna show you how much

Arabella the fairy princess!

You’re here for a battle instead, aren’t you[game-token-3]? Yay! I wanna show you how much stronger I got! Really! Okay! For my fairy friends, and for Daddy[game-token-4] Arabella the fairy princess! Ciao, [player]! Ti sono mancata? Ho
appena finito una festa del tè con\lle mie amiche proprio adesso.

Scusa, dovrai aspettare il prossimo\.
Oh! Sei qui per una lotta invece,\lvero\.? Evviva! Voglio mostrarti

quanto sono diventata più forte!
Davvero! Va bene! Per le mie amiche\lfatate, e per papà\. Arabella, la

principessa delle fate!
Trasformazione!

entries.original:
"Thanks for battling me again!

Daddy hardly battles anymore since
he quit.

But it’s okay!

I’ll keep working at the Elite Four
until Daddy gets a new job!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks for battling me again! Daddy hardly battles anymore since he quit. But it’s okay! I’ll keep working at the Elite Four until Daddy gets a new job!
entries.translated:
Grazie per aver lottato di nuovo
con me! Papà non lotta quasi più da\lquando ha smesso. Ma va bene!

Continuerò a lavorare con i
Superquattro finché papà non\ltroverà un nuovo lavoro!

entries.original:
"Wow. You beat all of us!
You’re really super strong!

You should go defend your title of
Champion now!"
entries.translation_source: Wow. You beat all of us! You’re really super strong! You should go defend your title of Champion now!
entries.translated:
Wow. Ci hai battuti tutti! Sei
davvero fortissimo! Dovresti andare\la difendere il tuo titolo di

Campione adesso!

entries.translation_source: Penny
entries.translated: Penny

entries.original:
"Hi, I’m Penny!

\.what?
This thing I’m wearing?

These aren’t clothes, they’re my
patented Goodra bottoms!

I’ve always been a huge fan of
Dragon-type Pokémon, so I love\llooking just like them!

There isn’t anything I don’t know
about them, and there isn’t a\lsingle piece of Dragon merchandise\lI haven’t bought!

Dragons are the best!

With their tails and their wings
and their FIRE BREATHING!

A filthy casual like you doesn’t
stand a chance against me!

I’ll prove it to you right now!

GRAWR!"

I’ve always been a huge fan of Dragon-type Pokémon, so I love looking just like them! There isn’t anything I don’t know about them, and there isn’t a single piece of Dragon merchandise I haven’t bought! Dragons are the best! With their tails and their wings and their FIRE BREATHING! A filthy casual like you doesn’t stand a chance against me! I’ll prove it to you right now! GRAWR!
entries.translated:
Ciao, sono Penny! \.cosa? Questa cosa
che indosso? Non sono vestiti, sono\li miei patentati pantaloncini di

Goodra! Sono sempre stata una
grandissima fan dei Pokémon di tipo\lDrago, quindi adoro sembrare

proprio come loro! Non c{B4}è niente
che non sappia su di loro, e non\lc{B4}è un solo pezzo di merchandising

FIATO DI FUOCO! Una casual di poco
conto come te non ha alcuna\lpossibilità contro di me! Te lo

dimostrerò adesso stesso! GRAWR!

"What!? But I had the best Pokémon
type in the world ever!

\.Aw, fine.
I guess that was pretty impressive.

Looks like my dragons and I still
need to get stronger."
entries.translation_source: What!? But I had the best Pokémon type in the world ever! [game-token-1]Aw, fine. I guess that was pretty impressive. Looks like my dragons and I still need to get stronger.

Cosa!? Ma avevo il miglior tipo
Pokémon del mondo di sempre! \.Uff,\lva bene. Immagino che sia stato

piuttosto impressionante. Sembra
che io e i miei draghi dobbiamo\lancora diventare più forti.

Non hai ancora finito, vero? Vai a

entries.original:
"Wowee!
Even I lost!

And now you get to be
Borrius’ Champion!

It’s time for you to take the
centre door right outside.

As for me, I’m heading off to
Dragon-con.

You want me to pick you up anything
while I’m there?

No? Ah, suit yourself.
More merch for me!"
entries.translation_source: Wowee! Even I lost! And now you get to be Borrius’ Champion! It’s time for you to take the centre door right outside. As for me, I’m heading off to Dragon-con. You want me to pick you up anything while I’m there? No? Ah, suit yourself. More merch for me!

Wowee! Persino io ho perso! E
adesso tocca a te diventare il\lCampione di Borrius! È ora che tu

prenda la porta centrale proprio

qualcosa mentre sono lì? No? Ah,
come vuoi. Più merchandising per\lme!

And now, thanks to my harsh
training, non-stop studying of\lDragon’s Monthly, and a king’s\lransom of Dragon memorabilia\.

I’m the greatest expert on all
things Dragon you ever saw!

Dukes up! My Dragons and I are
itching to throw down!

GRAWR!"

a un patrimonio di memorabilia dei
Dragon\. Sono il più grande esperto\ldi tutto ciò che riguarda i Dragon

che tu abbia mai visto! Su, le
mani! Io e i miei Draghi non\lvediamo l{B4}ora di menare le mani!

GRAWR!

until I beat you myself!"

"[player]!

[player]! Non posso lasciarti

entries.original:
"Wait one moment, [player]!

Are you surprised to see me out
here?

Well, I thought I heard a familiar
cry calling out to me\.

That was the moment when I
encountered Zapdos.

No, not the one from Thundercap Mt.\.\CC0818
the one Aklove used for the\lunbinding at the Ruins of Void.

I still don’t know why it came to me,
why it chose me as its Trainer\.

But I knew it was a sign - that I
had to find you and battle you\lonce again!

To be honest, defeating you is
[rival]’s goal, first and foremost\.

But I’m his father - I can’t sit
around and let my own skills\lstagnate, can I?

So, no matter how long a shot
this is, I’d like to try my hand\lat defeating you!"

Aspetta un momento, [player]! Sei
sorpreso di vedermi qui fuori? Beh,\lpensavo di aver sentito un verso

Tuono\.\CC0818 quello che Aklove ha usato

venuto da me, perché abbia scelto
me come suo Allenatore\. Ma sapevo\lche era un segno: che dovevo

di te! Ad essere onesti,\lsconfiggerti è l{B4}obiettivo di

[rival], innanzitutto\. Ma sono suo
padre: non posso starmene seduto a\llasciare che le mie abilità

ristagnino, no? Quindi, per quanto
sia improbabile, vorrei provare a\lsconfiggerti!

I’m afraid that [rival] and I have

title of Champion - myself, or\l[rival]?

"There you are, [player].

I\.\CC0818 well, when I heard that you had

Marlon, or even [rival]?

Let me test myself against the true
strength of Borrius’s Champion!"
entries.translation_source: I’m afraid I cannot let you pass through those doors so easily. You see, my son was pestering me to find you and record a victory. And as his father, I ought to do my very best for him! Ah, but of course, I don’t expect you to just hand me a victory out of pity. Let me test myself against the true strength of Borrius’s Champion!
entries.translated:
Temo di non poterti lasciar passare
attraverso quelle porte così\lfacilmente. Vedi, mio figlio

continuava a tormentarmi perché ti
trovassi e registrassi una\lvittoria. E, come suo padre, dovrei

fare del mio meglio per lui! Ah, ma
certo, non mi aspetto che tu mi\lregali una vittoria per pietà.

Lascia che metta alla prova me
stesso contro la vera forza del\lCampione di Borrius!

entries.original:
"[player]!
So you finally came back, huh?

Ever since I lost to you, I’ve been
thinking long and hard about what\lI’ve been lacking\.

And especially about my Grampa
Arthur’s legacy\.

But right now, this isn’t about
Grampa. Or even about me.

This is about knowing there’s a strong
Trainer in front of me, ripe to be\lchallenged!

And that’s what gets my heart
racing, no matter when or where!

It’s on, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! So you finally came back, huh? Ever since I lost to you, I’ve been thinking long and hard about what I’ve been lacking[game-token-2] And especially about my Grampa Arthur’s legacy[game-token-3] But right now, this isn’t about Grampa. Or even about me. This is about knowing there’s a strong Trainer in front of me, ripe to be challenged! And that’s what gets my heart racing, no matter when or where! It’s on, [player-name-4]!
entries.translated:
[player]! Allora sei finalmente
tornato, eh? Da quando ho perso\lcontro di te, ho pensato a lungo su

cosa mi sia mancato\. E in
particolare sull{B4}eredità del mio\lGrampa Arthur\. Ma in questo momento,

non si tratta di Grampa. Neanche di
me. Si tratta di sapere che di\lfronte a me c{B4}è un Allenatore

forte, pronto per essere sfidato! E
questo è ciò che fa battere il mio\lcuore, non importa quando e dove!

Ci siamo, [player]!

entries.original:
"Back again, [player]?
Well, so am I.

No matter how often I lose,
I can’t help it!

Every battle, I get to measure just
how much of a gap I have to close\lto catch up to you!

So, let’s see the level of strength I
have to surpass, [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Back again, [player-name-1]? Well, so am I. No matter how often I lose, I can’t help it! Every battle, I get to measure just how much of a gap I have to close to catch up to you! So, let’s see the level of strength I have to surpass, [player-name-2]!
entries.translated:
Di nuovo qui, [player]? Beh, anche
io. Non importa quante volte perda,\lnon ci posso fare niente! In ogni

battaglia, posso misurare quanto mi
manca per colmare il divario e\lraggiungerti! Allora, vediamo il

livello di forza che devo superare,
[player]!

entries.original:
"Hi, [player]!

Remember me? It’s Milo!
From Thundercap Mt.!

I came all this way just to see
you again!

Say, let’s have a battle!

I bet it’ll be super fun with a
strong Trainer like you!"
entries.translation_source: Hi, [player-name-1]! Remember me? It’s Milo! From Thundercap Mt.! I came all this way just to see you again! Say, let’s have a battle! I bet it’ll be super fun with a strong Trainer like you!
entries.translated:
Ciao, [player]! Ti ricordi di me?
Sono Milo! Dal Monte Thundercap! Ho\lfatto tutta questa strada solo per

rivederti! Sai, facciamo una lotta!
Scommetto che sarà super divertente\lcon un Allenatore forte come te!

entries.original:
"You’re still super strong,
[player]!

That was so much fun!
I’m glad I came all this way!"
entries.translation_source: You’re still super strong, [player-name-1]! That was so much fun! I’m glad I came all this way!
entries.translated:
Sei ancora super forte, [player]! È
stato davvero divertentissimo! Sono\lfelice di essere arrivato fin qui!

entries.original:
"Hey, Champion!

I made it through the Elite Four
just so I could battle with you!

Me and my shorts won’t lose this
fight!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Champion! I made it through the Elite Four just so I could battle with you! Me and my shorts won’t lose this fight!
entries.translated:
Ehi, Campione! Ho superato i
Superquattro solo per potermi\lsfidare con te! Io e i miei

pantaloncini non perderemo questa
lotta!

entries.original: "Shadow"
entries.translation_source: Shadow
entries.translated: Ombra

entries.original: "Nostalgic"
entries.translation_source: Nostalgic
entries.translated: Nostalgico

entries.original: "Machine"
entries.translation_source: Machine
entries.translated: Macchina

entries.original: "Polder Town"
entries.translation_source: Polder Town
entries.translated: Polder Town

entries.original: "Polder Town D"
entries.translation_source: Polder Town D
entries.translated: Polder Town D

entries.original: "Polder Town N"
entries.translation_source: Polder Town N
entries.translated: Polder Town N

entries.original:
"Welcome to East Borrius!

Polder Town is a far cry from
any place in West Borrius, don’t\lyou think?

Like, I doubt West Borrians would
willingly live in a swamp."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to East Borrius! Polder Town is a far cry from any place in West Borrius, don’t you think? Like, I doubt West Borrians would willingly live in a swamp.
entries.translated:
Benvenuto nell{B4}Est di Borrius!
Polder Town è ben lontana da\lqualsiasi posto del West di

Borrius, non credi? Tipo, dubito
che gli abitanti del West di\lBorrius vivrebbero volentieri in

una palude.

entries.original:
"You might think the muddy ground
makes it hard to live here, but\lguess again!

The mud is actually very good for
the skin."
entries.translation_source: You might think the muddy ground makes it hard to live here, but guess again! The mud is actually very good for the skin.
entries.translated:
Potresti pensare che il terreno
fangoso renda difficile vivere qui,\lma ti sbagli di grosso! Il fango fa

benissimo alla pelle.

entries.original:
"Tessy’s Pokémon may not all look
like [green]Water[red]-type Pokémon, but I\lguarantee you, most will be when\lyou fight them!"
entries.translation_source: Tessy’s Pokémon may not all look like [color-green-1]Water[color-red-2]-type Pokémon, but I guarantee you, most will be when you fight them!
entries.translated:
I Pokémon di Tessy potrebbero non
sembrare tutti Pokémon di tipo\l[green]Acqua[red], ma vi garantisco che la

maggior parte lo sarà quando li
affronterete!

entries.original:
"Tessy’s so smart!

She figured out a way to make her
Pokémon the same type as their\lmoves!

I bet she learned how at the
[green]Battle Circus[red]."
entries.translation_source: Tessy’s so smart! She figured out a way to make her Pokémon the same type as their moves! I bet she learned how at the [color-green-1]Battle Circus[color-red-2].
entries.translated:
Tessy è così intelligente! Ha
trovato un modo per rendere i suoi\lPokémon dello stesso tipo delle

loro mosse! Scommetto che ha
imparato come fare al [green]Battle\lCircus[red].

entries.original:
"Today, we’re dancing for a reason.

When we fulfill our purpose, we’ll
disappear for a reason."
entries.translation_source: Today, we’re dancing for a reason. When we fulfill our purpose, we’ll disappear for a reason.
entries.translated:
Oggi balliamo per un motivo. Quando
porteremo a termine il nostro\lscopo, scompariremo per un motivo.

entries.original:
"We dance to worship our goddess!
The one and only Meloetta!

Who needs Arceus?"
entries.translation_source: We dance to worship our goddess! The one and only Meloetta! Who needs Arceus?
entries.translated:
Danziamo per adorare la nostra dea!
L{B4}unica e sola Meloetta! Chi ha\lbisogno di Arceus?

entries.original:
"Legend has it that Meloetta will
appear if you dance hard enough.

We dance for the chance to one day
witness a true dancer."
entries.translation_source: Legend has it that Meloetta will appear if you dance hard enough. We dance for the chance to one day witness a true dancer.
entries.translated:
La leggenda vuole che Meloetta
appaia se danzi abbastanza forte.\lNoi danziamo per avere un giorno la

possibilità di vedere un vero
danzatore.

entries.original:
"The night I see Meloetta is the
night I resume my normal life.

But until then\.
I dance!"
entries.translation_source: The night I see Meloetta is the night I resume my normal life. But until then[game-token-1] I dance!
entries.translated:
La notte in cui vedrò Meloetta sarà
la notte in cui riprenderò la mia\lvita normale. Ma fino ad allora\.

Danzo!

entries.original:
"Meloetta!
We love you!"
entries.translation_source: Meloetta! We love you!
entries.translated: Meloetta! Ti adoriamo!

entries.original:
"[black]Meloetta is challenging you to a
dance off for the right to battle!

Do you accept the challenge?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Meloetta is challenging you to a dance off for the right to battle! Do you accept the challenge?
entries.translated:
[black]Meloetta ti sfida a una gara di
ballo per il diritto di combattere!\lAccetti la sfida?

entries.original:
"[black]During the course of the dance off,
keys will appear on the screen.

To win, press all corresponding
keys before they disappear."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]During the course of the dance off, keys will appear on the screen. To win, press all corresponding keys before they disappear.
entries.translated:
[black]Durante il corso della sfida di
ballo, i tasti appariranno sullo\lschermo. Per vincere, premi tutti i

tasti corrispondenti prima che
scompaiano.

entries.original:
"[black]Meloetta is pleased with your
performance.

It acknowledges your right to
battle it!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Meloetta is pleased with your performance. It acknowledges your right to battle it!
entries.translated:
[black]Meloetta è soddisfatta della tua
prestazione. Riconosce il tuo\ldiritto a sfidarla!

entries.original:
"[black]Meloetta is displeased you could
not defeat it in a dance off."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Meloetta is displeased you could not defeat it in a dance off.
entries.translated:
[black]Meloetta è scontenta che non sei
riuscito a batterla in una sfida di\lballo.

entries.original: "Lalalala!"
entries.translation_source: Lalalala!
entries.translated: Lalalala!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] took off in the
moonlight."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] took off in the moonlight.
entries.translated:
Il [buffer1] è decollato al chiaro
di luna.

entries.original:
"Will you come see Polder Town’s
famous Croagunk show?"
entries.translation_source: Will you come see Polder Town’s famous Croagunk show?
entries.translated:
Verrai a vedere il famoso
spettacolo di Croagunk di Polder\lTown?

entries.original:
"Okay!
I’m going to get all fired up!"
entries.translation_source: Okay! I’m going to get all fired up!
entries.translated: Okay! Mi darò la carica!

entries.original:
"Ready all Croagunk!
Everyone, gather up!"
entries.translation_source: Ready all Croagunk! Everyone, gather up!
entries.translated:
Tutti i Croagunk pronti! Tutti,
radunatevi!

entries.original:
"The Croagunk that I will have you
follow today is\."
entries.translation_source: The Croagunk that I will have you follow today is[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Il Croagunk che ti farò seguire
oggi è\.

entries.original:
"This--the Croagunk with the
[buffer2]!

It’s holding a [buffer1]!
Ready, set, go!"
entries.translation_source: This--the Croagunk with the [buffer2-1]! It’s holding a [buffer1-2]! Ready, set, go!
entries.translated:
Questo--il Croagunk con il
[buffer2]! Sta tenendo un [buffer1]!\lPronti, partenza, via!

entries.original:
"Okay! Find the Croagunk that
I asked you to follow!"
entries.translation_source: Okay! Find the Croagunk that I asked you to follow!
entries.translated:
Va bene! Trova il Croagunk che ti
ho chiesto di seguire!

entries.original:
"[red]That Croagunk is holding a
[buffer1], right?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]That Croagunk is holding a [buffer1-2], right?
entries.translated:
[red]Quel Croagunk tiene un [buffer1],
vero?

entries.original:
"[red]You are\.
\.\ltotally correct!

Receive the prize, a [buffer1],
from that Croagunk!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]You are[game-token-2] [game-token-3] totally correct! Receive the prize, a [buffer1-4], from that Croagunk!
entries.translated:
[red]Hai\. \. perfettamente ragione! Ricevi
il premio, un [buffer1], da quel\lCroagunk!

entries.original:
"[red]You are\.
\.\linconceivably incorrect!

I’m sorry\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]You are[game-token-2] [game-token-3] inconceivably incorrect! I’m sorry[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[red]Hai\. \. incredibilmente torto! Mi
dispiace\.

entries.original:
"[red]That marks the grand finale of our
Croagunk show!

Thank you, one and all!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]That marks the grand finale of our Croagunk show! Thank you, one and all!
entries.translated:
[red]Questo segna il gran finale del
nostro spettacolo di Croagunk!\lGrazie a tutti!

entries.original:
"That’s too bad\.
I guarantee it’s great, though."
entries.translation_source: That’s too bad[game-token-1] I guarantee it’s great, though.
entries.translated:
Che peccato\. Però ti garantisco che
è ottimo.

entries.original:
"You want to see the Croagunk
again?

There are a lot of preparations
and such to make, so come back\ltomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: You want to see the Croagunk again? There are a lot of preparations and such to make, so come back tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Vuoi rivedere Croagunk? Ci sono un
sacco di preparativi e cose da\lfare, quindi torna domani!

entries.original: "[green]Croak\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Croak[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Cra\.

entries.original:
"Operating a ship every day can wear
you out! It’s not running today.

It leaves for Seaport City on
[green]Sundays[blue] and [green]Wednesdays[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Operating a ship every day can wear you out! It’s not running today. It leaves for Seaport City on [color-green-1]Sundays[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Wednesdays[color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Gestire una nave ogni giorno può
sfiancarti! Oggi non è in servizio.\lParte per Seaport City di [green]domenica[blue]

e [green]mercoledì[blue]!

entries.original:
"When it’s working, the S.S. Marine
sets sail to West Borrius on\lSundays and Wednesdays."
entries.translation_source: When it’s working, the S.S. Marine sets sail to West Borrius on Sundays and Wednesdays.
entries.translated:
Quando funziona, la S.S. Marine
salpa verso il Borrius occidentale\lla domenica e il mercoledì.

entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine sets sail to West
Borrius every [green]Sunday[blue] and [green]Wednesday[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine sets sail to West Borrius every [color-green-1]Sunday[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Wednesday[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
La S.S. Marine salpa per West
Borrius ogni [green]domenica[blue] e [green]mercoledì[blue].

entries.original: "Average Angler"
entries.translation_source: Average Angler
entries.translated: Pescatore medio

entries.original: "Great Piscator"
entries.translation_source: Great Piscator
entries.translated: Grande Pescatore

entries.original: "Fisher Master"
entries.translation_source: Fisher Master
entries.translated: Maestro Pescatore

entries.original:
"It’s time to whip out your Rod and
get fishing! Hook [buffer1] Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It’s time to whip out your Rod and get fishing! Hook [buffer1-1] Pokémon.
entries.translated:
È ora di tirare fuori la tua Canna
da pesca e andare a pescare! Tira\lsu [buffer1] Pokémon.

entries.original:
"It’s time to whip out the bait and
lure in some fish! Hook [buffer1] Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It’s time to whip out the bait and lure in some fish! Hook [buffer1-1] Pokémon.
entries.translated:
È ora di tirare fuori l{B4}esca e
attirare qualche pesce! Aggancia\l[buffer1] Pokémon.

entries.original:
"It’s time to plant yourself firm
and look onward. Hook [buffer1] Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: It’s time to plant yourself firm and look onward. Hook [buffer1-1] Pokémon.
entries.translated:
È ora di mettere radici salde e
guardare avanti. Cattura [buffer1]\lPokémon.

entries.original:
"Hey, Trainer!

Remember me?
I certainly remember you.

I’m the guy you met in Gurun Town!

My hope was to strike it big here
in East Borrius, but the only gig\lI could find involves fishing\.

Anyway, I was hired as a sporting
goods promoter by Cube Corp.

They wanted me to encourage
Trainers to fish more, and\lthereby promote their signature\lfishing rod band.

So, here’s my encouragement
to you!

If you fish for at least [green][buffer1][blue]
Pokémon using fishing rods you\lobtain yourself, you’ll be eligible\lfor a reward!

How does that sound?
Great, right?

Come back to me if you’ve fished at
least [green][buffer1][blue] times!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Trainer! Remember me? I certainly remember you. I’m the guy you met in Gurun Town! My hope was to strike it big here in East Borrius, but the only gig I could find involves fishing[game-token-1] Anyway, I was hired as a sporting goods promoter by Cube Corp. They wanted me to encourage Trainers to fish more, and thereby promote their signature fishing rod band. So, here’s my encouragement to you! If you fish for at least [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] Pokémon using fishing rods you obtain yourself, you’ll be eligible for a reward! How does that sound? Great, right? Come back to me if you’ve fished at least [color-green-5][buffer1-6][color-blue-7] times!
entries.translated:
Ehi, Allenatore! Ti ricordi di me?
Io di certo mi ricordo di te. Sono\lil tipo che hai incontrato a Gurun

Town! Speravo di fare fortuna qui a
East Borrius, ma l{B4}unico lavoro che\lho trovato riguarda la pesca\.

Comunque, sono stato assunto da
Cube Corp come promoter di articoli\lsportivi. Volevano che

incoraggiassi gli Allenatori a
pescare di più, e così promuovere\lla loro fascia per canne da pesca

originale. Quindi, ecco il mio
incoraggiamento per te! Se peschi\lalmeno [green][buffer1][blue] Pokémon usando

canne da pesca che ottieni tu
stesso, sarai idoneo per una\lricompensa! Che te ne pare? Ottimo,

vero? Torna da me se hai pescato
almeno [green][buffer1][blue] volte!

entries.original:
"After your great showing, I now
have another task for you.

Promote Cube Corp.’s rods even
further by fishing for Pokémon\lat least [green][buffer1][blue] times."
entries.translation_source: After your great showing, I now have another task for you. Promote Cube Corp.’s rods even further by fishing for Pokémon at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] times.
entries.translated:
Dopo la tua grande prova, ora ho un
altro incarico per te. Promuovi\lancora di più le canne di Cube

Corp. pescando Pokémon almeno
[green][buffer1][blue] volte.

entries.original:
"After your great showing, I now
have one last task for you.

Promote Cube Corp.’s rods even
further by fishing for Pokémon\lat least 50 more times, for a\lgrand total of [green][buffer1][blue] times!

This should be easy for a great
piscator such as yourself."
entries.translation_source: After your great showing, I now have one last task for you. Promote Cube Corp.’s rods even further by fishing for Pokémon at least 50 more times, for a grand total of [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] times! This should be easy for a great piscator such as yourself.
entries.translated:
Dopo la tua grande prova, ho ora un
ultimo compito per te. Promuovi\lancora di più le canne di Cube

Corp. pescando Pokémon almeno altre
50 volte, per un totale di [green][buffer1][blue]\lvolte! Per un grande pescatore come

te, dovrebbe essere facile.

entries.original:
"Great job, Trainer!

I’ve received word from Cube Corp.
that you’ve promoted their brand\la total of [green][buffer2][blue] times!

Here’s your reward!"
entries.translation_source: Great job, Trainer! I’ve received word from Cube Corp. that you’ve promoted their brand a total of [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] times! Here’s your reward!
entries.translated:
Ottimo lavoro, Allenatore! Ho
ricevuto notizia da Cube Corp. che\lhai promosso il loro marchio un

totale di [green][buffer2][blue] volte! Ecco la
tua ricompensa!

entries.original:
"Thanks to your fishing efforts,
I’ve been promoted!

I’m now the assistant to the
regional manager of Cube Corp.’s\lfishing branch!

Some day soon, I’ll be running
that joint!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks to your fishing efforts, I’ve been promoted! I’m now the assistant to the regional manager of Cube Corp.’s fishing branch! Some day soon, I’ll be running that joint!
entries.translated:
Grazie ai tuoi sforzi nella pesca,
sono stato promosso! Ora sono\ll{B4}assistente del responsabile

regionale della filiale pesca di
Cube Corp.! Un giorno, non troppo\llontano, sarò io a mandare avanti

quel posto!

entries.original:
"My sources at Cube Corp. tell me
that you’ve only fished for [green][buffer2][blue]\lPokémon so far.

You need to fish for at least [green][buffer1][blue]
if you want the reward."
entries.translation_source: My sources at Cube Corp. tell me that you’ve only fished for [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] Pokémon so far. You need to fish for at least [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] if you want the reward.
entries.translated:
Le mie fonti alla Cube Corp. mi
dicono che finora hai pescato solo\lPokémon [green][buffer2][blue]. Devi pescare

almeno [green][buffer1][blue] se vuoi la
ricompensa.

entries.original:
"Or at least, I’d like to give you
one, but you have no space in your\lparty for it."
entries.translation_source: Or at least, I’d like to give you one, but you have no space in your party for it.
entries.translated:
O almeno, vorrei dartene uno, ma
non hai spazio nella tua squadra\lper lui.

entries.original:
"A terrific Trainer!

Let me share a training tip with
you.

During a battle with a Trainer,
even if your Pokémon’s items are\ltaken away, don’t worry.

They will be returned to you
safely after the battle.

\.But disposable items seem
to disappear."
entries.translation_source: A terrific Trainer! Let me share a training tip with you. During a battle with a Trainer, even if your Pokémon’s items are taken away, don’t worry. They will be returned to you safely after the battle. [game-token-1]But disposable items seem to disappear.
entries.translated:
Un Allenatore eccezionale! Lascia
che ti dia un consiglio di\lallenamento. Durante una lotta con

un Allenatore, anche se gli
strumenti dei tuoi Pokémon vengono\ltolti, non preoccuparti. Ti

verranno restituiti sani e salvi
dopo la lotta. \.Ma gli strumenti usa\le getta sembrano sparire.

entries.original:
"I caught my precious partner in
the [green]Safari Zone[blue].

It’s just to the [green]east[blue] of town."
entries.translation_source: I caught my precious partner in the [color-green-1]Safari Zone[color-blue-2]. It’s just to the [color-green-3]east[color-blue-4] of town.
entries.translated:
Ho catturato il mio prezioso
partner nella [green]Safari Zone[blue]. È appena\la [green]est[blue] della città.

entries.original:
"We can live unchanged,
because we keep changing.

I mean, Pokémon also evolve,
but their Natures stay the same.

At least they’re supposed to\."
entries.translation_source: We can live unchanged, because we keep changing. I mean, Pokémon also evolve, but their Natures stay the same. At least they’re supposed to[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Possiamo vivere senza cambiare,
perché continuiamo a cambiare.\lVoglio dire, anche i Pokémon si

evolvono, ma le loro Nature restano
le stesse. Almeno dovrebbero\.

entries.original:
"Only the lowest kind of employee
will tell you to not buy a\lparticular item.

Such as that woman stocking the
shelves, for instance.

She has no business sense.

I, on the other hand, will tell
you this.

Buy as many [green]Max Repels[blue] as you can!

They have the best value out of
all repellants!"
entries.translation_source: Only the lowest kind of employee will tell you to not buy a particular item. Such as that woman stocking the shelves, for instance. She has no business sense. I, on the other hand, will tell you this. Buy as many [color-green-1]Max Repels[color-blue-2] as you can! They have the best value out of all repellants!
entries.translated:
Solo il tipo più basso di
dipendente ti dirà di non comprare\lun certo oggetto. Come quella donna

che rifornisce gli scaffali, per
esempio. Non ha alcun senso degli\laffari. Io, invece, ti dirò questo:

compra quanti più [green]Super Repellenti[blue]
puoi! Hanno il miglior rapporto\lqualità-prezzo tra tutti i

repellenti!

entries.original:
"Let me give you a Trainer’s tip:
don’t buy Ultra Balls.

They’re not worth your money.

Instead, try to buy specialty
Poké Balls such as the [green]Quick Ball[red]\lor [green]Net Ball[red].

They’re cheaper and they tend to
have a better chance at a capture.

Unfortunately none are available
here, but many other Marts in\lBorrius sell such Poké Balls."
entries.translation_source: Let me give you a Trainer’s tip: don’t buy Ultra Balls. They’re not worth your money. Instead, try to buy specialty Poké Balls such as the [color-green-1]Quick Ball[color-red-2] or [color-green-3]Net Ball[color-red-4]. They’re cheaper and they tend to have a better chance at a capture. Unfortunately none are available here, but many other Marts in Borrius sell such Poké Balls.
entries.translated:
Lascia che ti dia un consiglio da
Allenatore: non comprare Ultra\lBall. Non valgono i tuoi soldi.

Piuttosto, prova a comprare Poké
Ball speciali come la [green]Rapid Ball[red] o\lla [green]Rete Ball[red]. Costano meno e

tendono ad avere maggiori
probabilità di cattura. Purtroppo\lqui non ne sono disponibili, ma

molti altri Poké Market di Borrius
vendono queste Poké Ball.

entries.original:
"Wow! Great job!
You’ve got great technical points!

I didn’t know all these moves were
TMs!

Thanks to you, I realized
the true depth of TMs.

You are a TM Master!

Thank you!
I was thrilled to see them!

As a reward, please accept this
as a gift!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Great job! You’ve got great technical points! I didn’t know all these moves were TMs! Thanks to you, I realized the true depth of TMs. You are a TM Master! Thank you! I was thrilled to see them! As a reward, please accept this as a gift!

intuito tecnico! Non sapevo che\ltutte queste mosse fossero delle

MT! Grazie a te, ho capito la vera
profondità delle MT. Sei un Maestro\ldelle MT! Grazie! Ero entusiasta di

vederle! Come ricompensa, ti prego
di accettare questo regalo!

entries.original:
"This hole you see here is what’s
known as a Raid Den.

Powerful Pokémon inhabit these
dens, and once a day, you can fight\lfor a chance to capture one in\leach den found around Borrius!

These Pokémon are scary strong, so
it’s a good idea to pick the right\lpartner to fight alongside you.

When you start the battle, you’ll
notice that the Pokémon you’re\lfighting looks very big.

This is because of the phenomenon
known as [green]Dynamax[red].

It will stay this way throughout
the battle and can only be caught\lonce it is defeated and returned to\lnormal size."
entries.translation_source: This hole you see here is what’s known as a Raid Den. Powerful Pokémon inhabit these dens, and once a day, you can fight for a chance to capture one in each den found around Borrius! These Pokémon are scary strong, so it’s a good idea to pick the right partner to fight alongside you. When you start the battle, you’ll notice that the Pokémon you’re fighting looks very big. This is because of the phenomenon known as [color-green-1]Dynamax[color-red-2]. It will stay this way throughout the battle and can only be caught once it is defeated and returned to normal size.
entries.translated:
Questo buco che vedi qui è ciò che
è conosciuto come una Tana del\lRaid. Potenti Pokémon abitano in

queste tane e, una volta al giorno,
puoi lottare per avere la\lpossibilità di catturarne uno in

ogni tana presente a Borrius!
Questi Pokémon sono spaventosamente\lforti, quindi è una buona idea

scegliere il partner giusto per
combattere al tuo fianco. Quando\linizi la lotta, noterai che il

Pokémon che stai affrontando sembra
molto grande. Questo è dovuto al\lfenomeno conosciuto come [green]Dynamax[red].

Rimarrà così per tutta la lotta e
potrà essere catturato solo dopo\lessere stato sconfitto e tornato

alle dimensioni normali.

entries.original:
"Dynamax is a unique phenomenon
that can only be used in special\lareas, like this one.

If you have mastered the power of
Mega Evolution, you’ll be able to\lDynamax your Pokémon as well.

Almost any Pokémon can Dynamax,
but if a Pokémon holds a Mega\lStone or Z-Crystal, it won’t be\lable to.

To Dynamax a Pokémon, press \btn04
when you see the red Dynamax\lsymbol appear.

If you choose to Dynamax your
Pokémon, the effect will last\lfor three turns.

During this time period, each of
your Pokémon’s moves will be\lpowered up into special variants\lknown as [green]Max Moves[red].

These Max Moves are much more
powerful than regular attacks,\lso make sure you use them to full\leffect while Dynamaxed!"
entries.translation_source: Dynamax is a unique phenomenon that can only be used in special areas, like this one. If you have mastered the power of Mega Evolution, you’ll be able to Dynamax your Pokémon as well. Almost any Pokémon can Dynamax, but if a Pokémon holds a Mega Stone or Z-Crystal, it won’t be able to. To Dynamax a Pokémon, press [button-icon-1] when you see the red Dynamax symbol appear. If you choose to Dynamax your Pokémon, the effect will last for three turns. During this time period, each of your Pokémon’s moves will be powered up into special variants known as [color-green-2]Max Moves[color-red-3]. These Max Moves are much more powerful than regular attacks, so make sure you use them to full effect while Dynamaxed!
entries.translated:
Il Dynamax è un fenomeno unico che
può essere usato solo in aree\lspeciali, come questa. Se hai

imparato a padroneggiare il potere
della Megaevoluzione, potrai anche\ldynamaxizzare i tuoi Pokémon. Quasi

tutti i Pokémon possono
dynamaxizzare, ma se un Pokémon\ltiene un Megalite o un Cristallo Z,

non potrà farlo. Per dynamaxizzare
un Pokémon, premi \btn04 quando vedi\lcomparire il simbolo rosso di

Dynamax. Se scegli di dynamaxizzare
il tuo Pokémon, l{B4}effetto durerà\lper tre turni. Durante questo

periodo, ogni mossa del tuo Pokémon
si potenzierà in varianti speciali\lnote come [green]Mosse Max[red]. Queste Mosse

Max sono molto più potenti degli

entries.original:
"Sometimes when the Pokémon you’re
fighting is desperate, it’ll throw\lup shields to defend itself.

These shields will severely reduce
the damage you can inflict until\lthey’re destroyed.

Any attack will destroy at least
one shield, but if you use a move\llike [green]Brick Break[red], you can destroy\ltwo shields at a time!"
entries.translation_source: Sometimes when the Pokémon you’re fighting is desperate, it’ll throw up shields to defend itself. These shields will severely reduce the damage you can inflict until they’re destroyed. Any attack will destroy at least one shield, but if you use a move like [color-green-1]Brick Break[color-red-2], you can destroy two shields at a time!

A volte, quando il Pokémon che stai

scudi ridurranno notevolmente il

attacco distruggerà almeno uno
scudo, ma se usi una mossa come\l[green]Breccia[red], puoi distruggere due scudi

alla volta!

entries.original: "[black]The suspicious cell ran off!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The suspicious cell ran off!
entries.translated: [black]La cellula sospetta è scappata!

entries.original: "[black]The suspicious tree ran off!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The suspicious tree ran off!
entries.translated: [black]L{B4}albero sospetto è scappato!

entries.original: "Numbskull"
entries.translation_source: Numbskull
entries.translated: Scemo

entries.original:
"Are you dense? Smash Pokémon heads
against trees [buffer1] times!"
entries.translation_source: Are you dense? Smash Pokémon heads against trees [buffer1-1] times!
entries.translated:
Sei tonto? Sbatti le teste dei
Pokémon contro gli alberi [buffer1]\lvolte!

entries.original:
"I hit me head on dem trees too
many times\.

Now, I speak ungood.

I hate da trees now that made me
dumb.

Me mad!

Me want revenge!

You do it for me?

Use [green]Headbutt[blue] to teach trees to be
good [green][buffer1][blue] times!"
entries.translation_source: I hit me head on dem trees too many times[game-token-1] Now, I speak ungood. I hate da trees now that made me dumb. Me mad! Me want revenge! You do it for me? Use [color-green-2]Headbutt[color-blue-3] to teach trees to be good [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] times!
entries.translated:
Mi sono battuto la testa su troppi
alberi\. Ora parlo male. Odio gli\lalberi che mi hanno reso stupido.

Sono arrabbiato! Voglio vendetta!
Lo fai per me? Usa [green]Colpokarate[blue] per\linsegnare agli alberi a essere

buoni [green][buffer1][blue] volte!

entries.original:
"Good, attack trees with Headbutt,
and dem who defend trees."
entries.translation_source: Good, attack trees with Headbutt, and dem who defend trees.
entries.translated:
Bene, attacca gli alberi con
Bottintesta, e quelli che difendono\lgli alberi.

entries.original: "Okee, me will hurt trees meself!"
entries.translation_source: Okee, me will hurt trees meself!
entries.translated:
Okee, io farò male agli alberi da
solo!

entries.original:
"More head bangin’!
[green][buffer3][blue] more time\\08!"
entries.translation_source: More head bangin’! [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-blue-3] more time[raw-escape-4]!
entries.translated:
Ancora più headbanging! [green][buffer3][blue]
più tempo\\08!

entries.original:
"Good, now me can go back to bein’
the best Pokémon Neurosurgeon\lin world.

Take dis to help you for you
help me."
entries.translation_source: Good, now me can go back to bein’ the best Pokémon Neurosurgeon in world. Take dis to help you for you help me.
entries.translated:
Bene, ora io poter tornare a essere
il miglior neurochirurgo Pokémon\ldel mondo. Prendi questo per

aiutarti, visto che hai aiutato me.

entries.original:
"Me be better soon.
Me brain not very broke."
entries.translation_source: Me be better soon. Me brain not very broke.
entries.translated:
Me star meglio presto. Me cervello
non troppo rotto.

entries.original:
"Oh, perfect timing, Trainer!

I have just been filming my
latest movie in this forest.

The title of the movie is:
\qoKangaskhan v Kangaskhan:\lDawn of the Kangaskhan\qc

Unfortunately, the actor portraying
the main antagonist has fallen ill.

Would you be willing to take
his place?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, perfect timing, Trainer! I have just been filming my latest movie in this forest. The title of the movie is: [quote-open-1]Kangaskhan v Kangaskhan: Dawn of the Kangaskhan[quote-close-2] Unfortunately, the actor portraying the main antagonist has fallen ill. Would you be willing to take his place?
entries.translated:
Oh, tempismo perfetto, Allenatore!
Ho appena finito di girare il mio\lultimo film in questa foresta. Il

titolo del film è: \qoKangaskhan
contro Kangaskhan: L{B4}alba del\lKangaskhan\qc Purtroppo l{B4}attore che

interpreta il principale
antagonista si è ammalato. Saresti\ldisposto a prenderne il posto?

entries.original:
"A shame\.
Truly, a shame\."
entries.translation_source: A shame[game-token-1] Truly, a shame[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Che peccato\. Davvero, che peccato\.

entries.original:
"Wonderful!

Once you have defeated all of the
Trainers in this forest, please\lbring [green]4[red] strong [green]Kangaskhan[red] for an\limportant fight scene in the movie.

It will be filmed in the likeness
of a [green]Double Battle[red].

They should ideally be levelled
[green]\Lv 70[red] or higher."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful! Once you have defeated all of the Trainers in this forest, please bring [color-green-1]4[color-red-2] strong [color-green-3]Kangaskhan[color-red-4] for an important fight scene in the movie. It will be filmed in the likeness of a [color-green-5]Double Battle[color-red-6]. They should ideally be levelled [color-green-7][game-token-8] 70[color-red-9] or higher.
entries.translated:
Fantastico! Una volta sconfitti
tutti gli Allenatori in questa\lforesta, porta per favore [green]4[red]

possenti [green]Kangaskhan[red] per una scena
di combattimento importante nel\lfilm. Sarà girata in forma di

[green]Doppia Lotta[red]. Idealmente dovrebbero
essere di livello [green]\Lv 70[red] o superiore.

entries.original:
"Wonderful!

Please make sure your party
consists of only [green]4 Kangaskhan[red]\lbefore we can begin filming the\l[green]Double Battle[red].

They should ideally be levelled
[green]\Lv 70[red] or higher."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful! Please make sure your party consists of only [color-green-1]4 Kangaskhan[color-red-2] before we can begin filming the [color-green-3]Double Battle[color-red-4]. They should ideally be levelled [color-green-5][game-token-6] 70[color-red-7] or higher.
entries.translated:
Fantastico! Assicurati che la tua
squadra sia composta solo da [green]4\lKangaskhan[red] prima che possiamo

iniziare a filmare la [green]Lotta in
Doppio[red]. Dovrebbero idealmente\lessere di livello [green]\Lv 70[red] o superiore.

entries.original:
"Wonderful!

Lights, camera, action!"
entries.translation_source: Wonderful! Lights, camera, action!
entries.translated: Meraviglioso! Luci, camera, azione!

entries.original:
"Wonderful work out there today.

For your performance, you have
earned one of these."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful work out there today. For your performance, you have earned one of these.
entries.translated:
Ottimo lavoro là fuori oggi. Per la
tua prestazione, hai guadagnato uno\ldi questi.

entries.original:
"Farewell, Trainer!

I look forward to seeing you at the
red carpet premiere!"
entries.translation_source: Farewell, Trainer! I look forward to seeing you at the red carpet premiere!
entries.translated:
Addio, Allenatore! Non vedo l{B4}ora
di vederti alla première sul\ltappeto rosso!

entries.original:
"[black]Huh?

The Cube received a notification!

It says that the movie received a
critic score of less than 30% on\lRotten Tamato Berries\.

Oh, well, didn’t hurt to help!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Huh? The Cube received a notification! It says that the movie received a critic score of less than 30% on Rotten Tamato Berries[game-token-2] Oh, well, didn’t hurt to help!
entries.translated:
[black]Eh? Il Cube ha ricevuto una
notifica! Dice che il film ha\lricevuto un punteggio della critica

inferiore al 30% su Rotten Tamato
Berries\. Beh, tutto sommato, non è\lstato male dare una mano!

entries.original: "[green]Krawwr!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Krawwr!
entries.translated: [green]Krawwr!

entries.original:
"Hey, Trainer!

You look almost as strong as you
are lost!

Beat me and I’ll tell you a secret!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Trainer! You look almost as strong as you are lost! Beat me and I’ll tell you a secret!
entries.translated:
Ehi, Allenatore! Sembri quasi forte
quanto sei perso! Battimi e ti dirò\lun segreto!

entries.original: "Wow! Okay! Okay!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Okay! Okay!
entries.translated: Wow! Va bene! Va bene!

entries.original:
"So I heard the woman over there
talking\.

Sometimes if you go backwards,
you go forwards!"
entries.translation_source: So I heard the woman over there talking[game-token-1] Sometimes if you go backwards, you go forwards!
entries.translated:
Ho sentito quella donna laggiù
parlare\. A volte, se vai indietro,\lvai avanti!

entries.original:
"I noticed a peculiar Pokémon
earlier.

When I approached it, it changed its
appearance to match mine!

No\.\CC0818 it wasn’t a Ditto.

I could tell that much at least."
entries.translation_source: I noticed a peculiar Pokémon earlier. When I approached it, it changed its appearance to match mine! No[game-token-1][control-code-2] it wasn’t a Ditto. I could tell that much at least.
entries.translated:
Ho notato uno strano Pokémon poco
fa. Quando mi sono avvicinato, ha\lcambiato il suo aspetto per

assomigliare al mio! No\.\CC0818 non era un
Ditto. Almeno questo l{B4}ho capito.

entries.original:
"This is Redwood Forest?

It’s so spooky in here, I figured
it must be Grim Woods!"
entries.translation_source: This is Redwood Forest? It’s so spooky in here, I figured it must be Grim Woods!
entries.translated:
Questa è Redwood Forest? È così
inquietante qui dentro che pensavo\ldovesse essere Grim Woods!

entries.original:
"If you have an [green]open space in your
party[blue] in addition to a spare [green]Poké\lBall[blue] when you evolve one of the\lNincada that swarm here, you’ll\lfind a new Pokémon on your team\lafter the evolution!

But the process requires a spare
[green]Poké Ball[blue] in your Cube, got that?

NOT a Great Ball or an Ultra Ball,
just a [green]Poké Ball[blue]."
entries.translation_source: If you have an [color-green-1]open space in your party[color-blue-2] in addition to a spare [color-green-3]Poké Ball[color-blue-4] when you evolve one of the Nincada that swarm here, you’ll find a new Pokémon on your team after the evolution! But the process requires a spare [color-green-5]Poké Ball[color-blue-6] in your Cube, got that? NOT a Great Ball or an Ultra Ball, just a [color-green-7]Poké Ball[color-blue-8].
entries.translated:
Se hai uno [green]spazio libero nella tua
squadra[blue] oltre a una [green]Poké Ball[blue] di\lriserva quando fai evolvere uno dei

Nincada che sciamano qui, troverai
un nuovo Pokémon nella tua squadra\ldopo l{B4}evoluzione! Ma il processo

richiede una [green]Poké Ball[blue] di riserva
nel tuo Zaino, capito? NON una\lGreat Ball o una Ultra Ball, solo

una [green]Poké Ball[blue].

entries.original:
"[red]My ESP tells me that you’re close to
finding what you seek\.

But first, let’s battle!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]My ESP tells me that you’re close to finding what you seek[game-token-2] But first, let’s battle!
entries.translated:
[red]Il mio ESP mi dice che sei vicino a
trovare ciò che cerchi\. Ma prima,\lcombatti!

entries.original:
"Nothing could have prepared me
for that."
entries.translation_source: Nothing could have prepared me for that.
entries.translated:
Niente avrebbe potuto prepararmi a
questo.

entries.original:
"[red]I can sense you’re looking for the
exit.

It’s just up ahead."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I can sense you’re looking for the exit. It’s just up ahead.
entries.translated:
[red]Sento che stai cercando l{B4}uscita. È
proprio qui davanti.

entries.original: "Redwood Village"
entries.translation_source: Redwood Village
entries.translated: Villaggio di Redwood

entries.original: "Redwood Village D"
entries.translation_source: Redwood Village D
entries.translated: Villaggio di Redwood D

entries.original: "Redwood Village N"
entries.translation_source: Redwood Village N
entries.translated: Villaggio di Redwood N

entries.original: "Be gone, wandering spirits!"
entries.translation_source: Be gone, wandering spirits!
entries.translated: Sparite, spiriti erranti!

entries.original:
"The wandering spirits have been
cleansed from my soul\."
entries.translation_source: The wandering spirits have been cleansed from my soul[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Gli spiriti erranti sono stati
purificati dalla mia anima\.

entries.original:
"Did you know that the trees in this
village actually produce red wood?

Bet you didn’t!

You must’ve thought that these
trees look like every other plain\lold forest tree.

Well, I’ll have you know that
although they may look like\lordinary forest trees, they’re\lactually very special!

Their red wood attracts many
different species of Pokémon.

Don’t believe me?

Have a Pokémon use the move
[green]Headbutt[red] on one, and see for\lyourself!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that the trees in this village actually produce red wood? Bet you didn’t! You must’ve thought that these trees look like every other plain old forest tree. Well, I’ll have you know that although they may look like ordinary forest trees, they’re actually very special! Their red wood attracts many different species of Pokémon. Don’t believe me? Have a Pokémon use the move [color-green-1]Headbutt[color-red-2] on one, and see for yourself!
entries.translated:
Lo sapevi che gli alberi di questo
villaggio producono legno rosso?\lScommetto che non lo sapevi! Avrai

pensato che questi alberi sembrano
come tutti gli altri alberi della\lforesta. Beh, ti faccio sapere che

anche se possono sembrare alberi
normali, sono in realtà molto\lspeciali! Il loro legno rosso

attira molte diverse specie di
Pokémon. Non mi credi? Fai usare a\lun Pokémon la mossa [green]Bottintesta[red] su

uno, e vedi di persona!

entries.original:
"Out of all the Borrius Gyms,
Benjamin’s is always meant to be\lchallenged last.

Why?

Well, if you hadn’t explored the
rest of Borrius first, you wouldn’t\lbe able to solve his puzzle\."
entries.translation_source: Out of all the Borrius Gyms, Benjamin’s is always meant to be challenged last. Why? Well, if you hadn’t explored the rest of Borrius first, you wouldn’t be able to solve his puzzle[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tra tutte le Palestre di Borrius,
quella di Benjamin è sempre pensata\lper essere affrontata per ultima.

Perché? Beh, se non avessi
esplorato prima il resto di\lBorrius, non saresti in grado di

risolvere il suo enigma\.

entries.original:
"Now do you see?

Benjamin’s puzzle is based on the
caves you should have travelled\lthrough last!"
entries.translation_source: Now do you see? Benjamin’s puzzle is based on the caves you should have travelled through last!
entries.translated:
Adesso capisci? L{B4}enigma di
Benjamin si basa sulle grotte che\lavresti dovuto attraversare per

ultime!

entries.original:
"Benjamin is our Gym Leader!

I want to be just like Benjamin
when I grow up!

And again when I grow down,
just like he does!"
entries.translation_source: Benjamin is our Gym Leader! I want to be just like Benjamin when I grow up! And again when I grow down, just like he does!
entries.translated:
Benjamin è il nostro Capopalestra!
Voglio essere proprio come Benjamin\lquando sarò grande! E di nuovo

quando sarò piccolo, proprio come
lui!

entries.original:
"Our little town is protected by the
Forest Guardian.

However, the Forest Guardian has
not been seen in many years.

It is said that if you bring an old
friend of the Forest Guardian, it\lwill reveal itself once more."
entries.translation_source: Our little town is protected by the Forest Guardian. However, the Forest Guardian has not been seen in many years. It is said that if you bring an old friend of the Forest Guardian, it will reveal itself once more.
entries.translated:
La nostra piccola città è protetta
dal Guardiano della Foresta.\lTuttavia, il Guardiano della

Foresta non si vede da molti anni.
Si dice che, se gli porti un\lvecchio amico del Guardiano della

Foresta, si mostrerà di nuovo.

entries.original:
"Astounding\.

The Forest Guardian has revealed
itself unto you.

It must have sensed an old friend
among the members of your party.

And not only that, it appears to
be challenging you to a battle.

You have my blessing to battle it
and capture it, if you so please."
entries.translation_source: Astounding[game-token-1] The Forest Guardian has revealed itself unto you. It must have sensed an old friend among the members of your party. And not only that, it appears to be challenging you to a battle. You have my blessing to battle it and capture it, if you so please.
entries.translated:
Stupefacente\. Il Guardiano della
Foresta si è rivelato a te. Deve\laver sentito la presenza di un

vecchio amico tra i membri del tuo
gruppo. E non solo: sembra che ti\lstia sfidando a una lotta. Hai la

mia benedizione per combatterlo e
catturarlo, se lo desideri.

entries.original:
"Congratulations on your capture of
the Forest Guardian.

Please watch over it and protect
it, as it protected and watched\lover us."
entries.translation_source: Congratulations on your capture of the Forest Guardian. Please watch over it and protect it, as it protected and watched over us.
entries.translated:
Congratulazioni per aver catturato
il Guardiano della Foresta. Ti\lprego di vegliare su di lui e

proteggerlo, proprio come lui ha
protetto e vegliato su di noi.

entries.original: "[green]Biiiiiiiiiiii!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Biiiiiiiiiiii!
entries.translated: [green]Biiiiiiiiiiii!

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] wants to fight you again!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] wants to fight you again!
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] vuole sfidarti di nuovo!

entries.original: "Splishy Splash"
entries.translation_source: Splishy Splash
entries.translated: Splash e schizzi

entries.original:
"They’re the most useless Pokémon!
Magikarp! Can you place 30 of them
in your current Box?"
entries.translation_source: They’re the most useless Pokémon! Magikarp! Can you place 30 of them in your current Box?
entries.translated:
Sono i Pokémon più inutili!
Magikarp! Puoi metterne 30 nella\ltua Casella attuale?

entries.original:
"Hey there, Pokémon Trainer.

I’m a member of the Hip Waders,
just like you!

And boy, do I have an assignment
for you.

You know the Pokémon [green]Magikarp[blue]?

\.

What am I even asking you, of
course you do!

Who doesn’t know of the famed
Pokémon?

I want you to place [green][buffer1][blue] of ’em in
a [green]single Box[blue].

When you’ve done that, I’ll take
’em off your hands for you, and\lgive you something even better in\lexchange.

As an esteemed member of the Hip
Waders, this should be a piece of\lcake for you!"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, Pokémon Trainer. I’m a member of the Hip Waders, just like you! And boy, do I have an assignment for you. You know the Pokémon [color-green-1]Magikarp[color-blue-2]? [game-token-3] What am I even asking you, of course you do! Who doesn’t know of the famed Pokémon? I want you to place [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] of ’em in a [color-green-7]single Box[color-blue-8]. When you’ve done that, I’ll take ’em off your hands for you, and give you something even better in exchange. As an esteemed member of the Hip Waders, this should be a piece of cake for you!
entries.translated:
Ehi, Allenatore Pokémon. Sono un
membro degli Hip Waders, proprio\lcome te! E ho un compito per te.

Conosci il Pokémon [green]Magikarp[blue]? \. Cosa
sto chiedendo, certo che lo\lconosci! Chi non conosce il famoso

Pokémon? Voglio che tu metta
[green][buffer1][blue] di loro in un [green]unico Box[blue].\lQuando lo farai, li prenderò dalle

tue mani e ti darò qualcosa di
ancora meglio in cambio. Essendo un\lmembro stimato degli Hip Waders,

per te dovrebbe essere un gioco da
ragazzi!

entries.original:
"Boy oh boy, Pokémon Trainer!

I can’t believe you actually
did it!

You actually got [buffer1] Magikarp in
one Box!

I mean, a task like that takes
serious dedication.

But after all, you are a member of
the Hip Waders.

So let me take them off your hands
for you.

And for an esteemed member such as
yourself, I want you to have this."
entries.translation_source: Boy oh boy, Pokémon Trainer! I can’t believe you actually did it! You actually got [buffer1-1] Magikarp in one Box! I mean, a task like that takes serious dedication. But after all, you are a member of the Hip Waders. So let me take them off your hands for you. And for an esteemed member such as yourself, I want you to have this.
entries.translated:
Accidenti, Allenatore Pokémon! Non
riesco a credere che tu l{B4}abbia\ldavvero fatto! Hai davvero preso

[buffer1] Magikarp in una sola Box!
Voglio dire, una cosa del genere\lrichiede una dedizione seria. Ma in

fondo, sei un membro dei Hip
Waders. Quindi lascia che te li\ltolga dalle mani. E per un membro

stimato come te, voglio che tu
abbia questo.

entries.original:
"Hey there, Pokémon Trainer.

I’m a member of the Hip Waders!

If you want to join our club, talk
to the club’s president back in\lSeaport City.

You know, that port city in
West Borrius?"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, Pokémon Trainer. I’m a member of the Hip Waders! If you want to join our club, talk to the club’s president back in Seaport City. You know, that port city in West Borrius?
entries.translated:
Ehi, Allenatore Pokémon. Sono un
membro degli Hip Waders! Se vuoi\lunirti al nostro club, parla con il

presidente del club a Seaport City.
Sai, quella città portuale nel\lBorrius occidentale?

entries.original:
"Hey there, Pokémon Trainer.

As of this moment, your current
Box, \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc has [green][buffer3][blue] Magikarp\lin it.

Your goal is to get [green][buffer2][blue] of those
suckers in there.

Come back when you’ve done that."
entries.translation_source: Hey there, Pokémon Trainer. As of this moment, your current Box, [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4][quote-close-5] has [color-green-6][buffer3-7][color-blue-8] Magikarp in it. Your goal is to get [color-green-9][buffer2-10][color-blue-11] of those suckers in there. Come back when you’ve done that.
entries.translated:
Ehi, Allenatore di Pokémon. Da
questo momento, il tuo Box attuale,\l\qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc contiene [green][buffer3][blue]

Magikarp. Il tuo obiettivo è
mettere lì dentro [green][buffer2][blue] di quei\lbirbanti. Torna quando l{B4}avrai

fatto.

entries.original:
"Actually, make space in your party
first for it, Pokémon Trainer."
entries.translation_source: Actually, make space in your party first for it, Pokémon Trainer.
entries.translated:
In realtà, fai prima spazio nella
tua squadra per lui, Allenatore\lPokémon.

entries.original:
"Did you know?

Magikarp aren’t really the weakest
of Pokémon!

That esteemed title goes to
Wishiwashi’s solo form!

A fish that’s also useless until
it gets bigger!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know? Magikarp aren’t really the weakest of Pokémon! That esteemed title goes to Wishiwashi’s solo form! A fish that’s also useless until it gets bigger!
entries.translated:
Lo sapevi? Magikarp non è davvero
il Pokémon più debole! Quel titolo\lprestigioso va alla forma singola

di Wishiwashi! Un pesce che è
inutile anche lui finché non\lcresce!

entries.original:
"Oh, dear me.

My daughter left me with her infant
