son, but I am much too busy today\lto look after him properly.

Would you care to tend to him
while I complete my work?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear me. My daughter left me with her infant son, but I am much too busy today to look after him properly. Would you care to tend to him while I complete my work?
entries.translated:
Oh, cielo. Mia figlia mi ha
lasciato suo figlio neonato, ma\loggi sono troppo occupata per

badare a lui come si deve. Ti
andrebbe di occupartene mentre\lfinisco il mio lavoro?

entries.original:
"Splendid.

Please walk around with him until I
finish my work today."
entries.translation_source: Splendid. Please walk around with him until I finish my work today.
entries.translated:
Splendido. Per favore, fai una
passeggiata con lui finché non avrò\lfinito il mio lavoro oggi.

entries.original:
"Ah, so you’ve returned with my
grandson.

I have finished my work for today,
so I am able to take care of him\lfor the remainder of the day.

Here is the payment for your
services."
entries.translation_source: Ah, so you’ve returned with my grandson. I have finished my work for today, so I am able to take care of him for the remainder of the day. Here is the payment for your services.
entries.translated:
Ah, quindi sei tornato con mio
nipote. Ho finito il mio lavoro per\loggi, quindi posso occuparmene per

il resto della giornata. Ecco il
pagamento per i tuoi servizi.

entries.original:
"[black][player] received $[buffer1] from
the woman!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] received $[buffer1-3] from the woman!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha ricevuto $[buffer1]
dalla donna!

entries.original:
"Oh, dear me.

I have no choice but to continue to
neglect him today."
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear me. I have no choice but to continue to neglect him today.
entries.translated:
Oh, cielo. Non ho altra scelta che
continuare a trascurarlo oggi.

entries.original:
"Please walk around with my grandson
until I finish my work today."
entries.translation_source: Please walk around with my grandson until I finish my work today.
entries.translated:
Per favore, fai una passeggiata con
mio nipote finché non avrò finito\lil mio lavoro oggi.

entries.original:
"My daughter leaves her son with me
every day, so your services will be\lrequired again, tomorrow."
entries.translation_source: My daughter leaves her son with me every day, so your services will be required again, tomorrow.
entries.translated:
Mia figlia lascia suo figlio da me
ogni giorno, quindi avrai di nuovo\lbisogno dei tuoi servizi domani.

entries.original:
"My daughter leaves her son with me
every day while she goes to work.

I’m unable to give him my full
attention, so each day I try to\lhire a part-time babysitter.

Come back between [green]7 AM[red] and [green]7 PM[red],
and I will pay you to babysit."
entries.translation_source: My daughter leaves her son with me every day while she goes to work. I’m unable to give him my full attention, so each day I try to hire a part-time babysitter. Come back between [color-green-1]7 AM[color-red-2] and [color-green-3]7 PM[color-red-4], and I will pay you to babysit.
entries.translated:
Mia figlia mi lascia suo figlio
ogni giorno mentre va a lavorare.\lNon riesco a dedicargli tutta la

mia attenzione, quindi ogni giorno
cerco di assumere una babysitter\lpart-time. Torna tra le [green]7 AM[red] e le [green]7

PM[red], e ti pagherò per fare da
babysitter.

entries.original: "[black]The baby is sleeping peacefully."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The baby is sleeping peacefully.
entries.translated: [black]Il bebè dorme pacificamente.

entries.original:
"[black]The baby started following behind
you!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The baby started following behind you!
entries.translated: [black]Il piccolo ha iniziato a seguirti!

entries.original:
"[black]Take the baby for a walk around
town until his grandmother has\lfinished her work."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Take the baby for a walk around town until his grandmother has finished her work.
entries.translated:
[black]Porta il bambino a fare una
passeggiata per la città finché sua\lnonna non avrà finito il lavoro.

entries.original:
"[black]The baby is bouncing around happily
in his stroller."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The baby is bouncing around happily in his stroller.
entries.translated:
[black]Il bambino dondola felice nel suo
passeggino.

entries.original:
"[black]Oh? There’s something in the
baby’s mouth.

Oh, no!
It’s a choking hazard!

Quick, get it out!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Oh? There’s something in the baby’s mouth. Oh, no! It’s a choking hazard! Quick, get it out!
entries.translated:
[black]Oh? C{B4}è qualcosa nella bocca del
bambino. Oh, no! È un rischio di\lsoffocamento! Presto, tiralo fuori!

entries.original:
"[black]The baby is looking at you
disapprovingly.

It doesn’t seem to want to go
this way."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The baby is looking at you disapprovingly. It doesn’t seem to want to go this way.
entries.translated:
[black]Il bambino ti guarda con
disapprovazione. Non sembra voler\landare da questa parte.

entries.original:
"Hi, Trainer!

I’m training to open up my very
own Pokémon nursery.

I still have a ways to go, but I
can still offer you something good!

If you pay me $[green][buffer1][red], I can
significantly speed up the hatching\ltime of all the Eggs in your party!

What do you say?

Sounds like a pretty good deal,
am I right?"
entries.translation_source: Hi, Trainer! I’m training to open up my very own Pokémon nursery. I still have a ways to go, but I can still offer you something good! If you pay me $[color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3], I can significantly speed up the hatching time of all the Eggs in your party! What do you say? Sounds like a pretty good deal, am I right?
entries.translated:
Ciao, Allenatore! Mi sto allenando
per aprire un mio asilo Pokémon. Ho\lancora molta strada da fare, ma

posso comunque offrirti qualcosa di
buono! Se mi paghi $[green][buffer1][red], posso\laccelerare notevolmente il tempo di

schiusa di tutte le Uova nella tua
squadra! Che ne dici? Sembra un\lbell{B4}affare, no?

entries.original:
"Sweet!

Please pass me all the Eggs in
your party."
entries.translation_source: Sweet! Please pass me all the Eggs in your party.
entries.translated:
Fantastico! Passami tutte le Uova
della tua squadra.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over all Eggs
on hand."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over all Eggs on hand.
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha consegnato tutte le
Uova in suo possesso.

entries.original:
"All done!
Here are your Eggs.

I hope to see you again tomorrow!"
entries.translation_source: All done! Here are your Eggs. I hope to see you again tomorrow!
entries.translated:
Fatto! Ecco le tue Uova. Spero di
rivederti domani!

entries.original:
"It’s okay!

You’d prefer to wait until you have
more Eggs, am I right?"
entries.translation_source: It’s okay! You’d prefer to wait until you have more Eggs, am I right?
entries.translated:
Va bene! Preferiresti aspettare di
avere più Uova, giusto?

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

You didn’t realize how much this
cost before you spoke to me, am\lI right?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] You didn’t realize how much this cost before you spoke to me, am I right?
entries.translated:
Mmm\. Non ti eri reso conto di quanto
costasse prima di parlarmi, ho\lragione?

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

Why would you want to spend money
when you have no Eggs?"
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] Why would you want to spend money when you have no Eggs?
entries.translated:
Hmm\. Perché vorresti spendere soldi
quando non hai Uova?

entries.original:
"You’re going to be here again
tomorrow, am I right?

I’m looking forward to working with
your Eggs again!"
entries.translation_source: You’re going to be here again tomorrow, am I right? I’m looking forward to working with your Eggs again!
entries.translated:
Verrai di nuovo qui domani, giusto?
Non vedo l{B4}ora di lavorare di nuovo\lcon le tue Uova!

entries.original:
"Ever come across an Egg you just
didn’t want?

Then have no fear!

I buy Eggs like those at $[green][buffer1][blue]
a pop.

Do you have any Eggs you want to
sell to me?"
entries.translation_source: Ever come across an Egg you just didn’t want? Then have no fear! I buy Eggs like those at $[color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] a pop. Do you have any Eggs you want to sell to me?
entries.translated:
Ti è mai capitato un Uovo che non
volevi? Niente paura! Compro Uova\lcome quelle a $[green][buffer1][blue] l{B4}una. Hai

Uova da vendermi?

entries.original:
"Do you have any Eggs you want to
sell to me?"
entries.translation_source: Do you have any Eggs you want to sell to me?
entries.translated: Hai qualche Uovo che vuoi vendermi?

entries.original:
"Which Egg do you want to sell
to me?"
entries.translation_source: Which Egg do you want to sell to me?
entries.translated: Quale Uovo vuoi vendermi?

entries.original:
"Are you sure you want to sell me
this Egg?"
entries.translation_source: Are you sure you want to sell me this Egg?
entries.translated:
Sei sicuro di voler vendermi questo
Uovo?

entries.original:
"Are you sure you want to sell me
all of the Eggs in your party?"
entries.translation_source: Are you sure you want to sell me all of the Eggs in your party?
entries.translated:
Sei sicuro di voler vendere tutte
le Uova nel tuo gruppo?

entries.original:
"Are you sure you want to sell me
all of the Eggs in Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc?"
entries.translation_source: Are you sure you want to sell me all of the Eggs in Box [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4][quote-close-5]?
entries.translated:
Sei sicuro di voler vendermi tutte
le Uova nella Casella \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc?

entries.original: "[black][player] sold the Egg for $[buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] sold the Egg for $[buffer1-3]!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha venduto l{B4}Uovo per
$[buffer1]!

entries.original:
"[black][player] sold [buffer1] Egg[buffer3] in the party
for $[buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] sold [buffer1-3] Egg[buffer3-4] in the party for $[buffer2-5]!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha venduto [buffer1]
Uovo[buffer3] nella squadra per\l$[buffer2]!

entries.original:
"[black][player] sold [buffer1] Egg[buffer3] in the Box
for $[buffer2]!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] sold [buffer1-3] Egg[buffer3-4] in the Box for $[buffer2-5]!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha venduto [buffer1]
Uovo[buffer3] nel Box per $[buffer2]!

entries.original:
"Pleasure doing business with you!

Come see me again if you have more
Eggs to sell."
entries.translation_source: Pleasure doing business with you! Come see me again if you have more Eggs to sell.
entries.translated:
È stato un piacere fare affari con
te! Torna a trovarmi se hai altre\lUova da vendere.

entries.original:
"Keep me in mind if you ever come
across an Egg you don’t want."
entries.translation_source: Keep me in mind if you ever come across an Egg you don’t want.
entries.translated:
Pensami se ti capita mai un Uovo
che non vuoi.

entries.original:
"You don’t have any Eggs in
your party\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have any Eggs in your party[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non hai Uova nel gruppo\.

entries.original:
"You don’t have any Eggs in
Box \qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have any Eggs in Box [quote-open-1][color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4][quote-close-5][game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Non hai nessun Uovo nel Box
\qo[green][buffer1][blue]\qc\.

entries.original:
"I can’t buy that Pokémon from you.
It’s not in an Egg!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t buy that Pokémon from you. It’s not in an Egg!
entries.translated:
Non posso comprare quel Pokémon da
te. Non è dentro un Uovo!

entries.original:
"Despite our town being known for
its export of Charcoal, I have yet\lto actually see a Pokémon hold\lthe item.

Can you help me by showing me a
Pokémon [green]holding[red] a [green]Charcoal[red]?"
entries.translation_source: Despite our town being known for its export of Charcoal, I have yet to actually see a Pokémon hold the item. Can you help me by showing me a Pokémon [color-green-1]holding[color-red-2] a [color-green-3]Charcoal[color-red-4]?
entries.translated:
Nonostante la nostra città sia nota
per l{B4}esportazione di Carbone, non\lho ancora visto un Pokémon tenerlo

davvero. Puoi aiutarmi mostrandomi
un Pokémon [green]che tiene[red] un [green]Carbone[red]?

entries.original:
"Huh, so that’s why I haven’t seen
it around here.

Charcoal is made out of black wood,
not red wood!

Okay, thank you!
You’ve made my day!

Now, let me show you something!"
entries.translation_source: Huh, so that’s why I haven’t seen it around here. Charcoal is made out of black wood, not red wood! Okay, thank you! You’ve made my day! Now, let me show you something!
entries.translated:
Ah, quindi è per questo che non
l{B4}ho visto in giro da queste parti.\lLa Carbonella è fatta di legno

nero, non di legno rosso! Va bene,
grazie! Mi hai reso la giornata!\lOra, lasciami mostrarti una cosa!

entries.original:
"Huh?

That’s an Egg."
entries.translation_source: Huh? That’s an Egg.
entries.translated: Eh? È un Uovo.

entries.original:
"Huh?

That Pokémon’s not holding
a Charcoal."
entries.translation_source: Huh? That Pokémon’s not holding a Charcoal.
entries.translated:
Eh? Quel Pokémon non tiene una
Carbonella.

entries.original:
"Have a Pokémon hold the [green]Luck
Incense[red] like Charcoal, and it’ll\l[green]double[red] the amount of [green]prize money[red]\lreceived from battles!"
entries.translation_source: Have a Pokémon hold the [color-green-1]Luck Incense[color-red-2] like Charcoal, and it’ll [color-green-3]double[color-red-4] the amount of [color-green-5]prize money[color-red-6] received from battles!
entries.translated:
Fai tenere a un Pokémon l{B4}[green]Incenso
Fortunato[red], come il Carbone, e\l[green]raddoppierà[red] la quantità di [green]soldi

premio[red] ottenuti dalle lotte!

entries.original: "So you don’t know either\."
entries.translation_source: So you don’t know either[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Quindi neanche tu lo sai\.

entries.original:
"Benjamin is a master of [green]Bug[blue]-type
Pokémon!

And he’s a huge fan of battling
backwards, too!

Even his Gym puzzle is inspired by
his [green]backwards[blue] way of thinking.

What does this all mean?
You’ll see in due time\."
entries.translation_source: Benjamin is a master of [color-green-1]Bug[color-blue-2]-type Pokémon! And he’s a huge fan of battling backwards, too! Even his Gym puzzle is inspired by his [color-green-3]backwards[color-blue-4] way of thinking. What does this all mean? You’ll see in due time[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Benjamin è un maestro dei Pokémon
di tipo [green]Coleottero[blue]! Ed è anche un\lgrande fan delle lotte al

contrario! Perfino il puzzle della
sua Palestra è ispirato al suo modo\ldi pensare [green]all{B4}indietro[blue]. Cosa

significa tutto questo? Lo
scoprirai a tempo debito\.

entries.original:
"Benjamin’s backwards way of
thinking has nothing on your way,\lit seems!"
entries.translation_source: Benjamin’s backwards way of thinking has nothing on your way, it seems!
entries.translated:
Il modo di pensare alla rovescia di
Benjamin non regge affatto al\lconfronto con il tuo, a quanto

pare!

entries.original:
"I’ll trade you my super special
[green][buffer2][blue] if you can catch me a\l[green][buffer1][blue]!

I’ve been trying really hard to
find one, but it’s so difficult!

Do you have one to trade me?"
entries.translation_source: I’ll trade you my super special [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] if you can catch me a [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6]! I’ve been trying really hard to find one, but it’s so difficult! Do you have one to trade me?
entries.translated:
Ti baratto il mio super speciale
[green][buffer2][blue] se riesci a catturarmi un\l[green][buffer1][blue]! Sto cercando davvero

tanto di trovarne uno, ma è così
difficile! Ne hai uno da\lscambiarmi?

entries.original:
"But it’s been so hard for me to
find one\."
entries.translation_source: But it’s been so hard for me to find one[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ma per me è stato così difficile
trovarne uno\.

entries.original:
"Does that look a [buffer1] to you?
I asked for a [buffer1], not that."
entries.translation_source: Does that look a [buffer1-1] to you? I asked for a [buffer1-2], not that.
entries.translated:
Ti sembra un [buffer1]? Ho chiesto
un [buffer1], non quello.

entries.original:
"Alright!
I scored myself a great Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Alright! I scored myself a great Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Bene! Mi sono preso un gran
Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Have you been playing with my old
[buffer2]?

I’ve been playing with the
[buffer1] you gave me.

I even evolved it!"
entries.translation_source: Have you been playing with my old [buffer2-1]? I’ve been playing with the [buffer1-2] you gave me. I even evolved it!
entries.translated:
Hai giocato con il mio vecchio
[buffer2]? Io ho giocato con il\l[buffer1] che mi hai dato. L{B4}ho

persino fatto evolvere!

entries.original:
"Use [green]Soak[blue] on a Pokémon you’re
fighting!

Then, throw a [green]Net Ball[blue] at it for
super easy catch!"
entries.translation_source: Use [color-green-1]Soak[color-blue-2] on a Pokémon you’re fighting! Then, throw a [color-green-3]Net Ball[color-blue-4] at it for super easy catch!
entries.translated:
Usa [green]Ammollo[blue] su un Pokémon che stai
combattendo! Poi lanciagli una [green]Rete\lBall[blue] per una cattura super facile!

entries.original:
"BEGIN FROM
THE CENTRE.
CREATE WHAT
YOU SEEK."
entries.translation_source: BEGIN FROM THE CENTRE. CREATE WHAT YOU SEEK.
entries.translated:
INIZIA DAL CENTRO. CREA CIÒ CHE
CERCHI.

entries.original: "There is a big hole in the wall."
entries.translation_source: There is a big hole in the wall.
entries.translated: C{B4}è un grande buco nel muro.

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon statue that exudes the
power of rock started moving!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Pokémon statue that exudes the power of rock started moving!
entries.translated:
[black]La statua Pokémon che emana il
potere della roccia ha iniziato a\lmuoversi!

entries.original: "[green]Zaza zari za\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Zaza zari za[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Zaza zari za\.

entries.original:
"CRACK THE
ICE. LEAVE
PURE WHAT
YOU SEEK."
entries.translation_source: CRACK THE ICE. LEAVE PURE WHAT YOU SEEK.
entries.translated:
SPACCA IL GHIACCIO. LASCIA PURO CIÒ
CHE CERCHI.

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon statue that exudes the
power of ice started moving!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Pokémon statue that exudes the power of ice started moving!
entries.translated:
[black]La statua del Pokémon che emana il
potere del ghiaccio ha iniziato a\lmuoversi!

entries.original: "[green]Jakiih!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Jakiih!
entries.translated: [green]Jakiih!

entries.original:
"NATURE MOLDS
TO OUR WILL.
TURN THE
CRYSTALS TO
WHAT YOU SEEK."
entries.translation_source: NATURE MOLDS TO OUR WILL. TURN THE CRYSTALS TO WHAT YOU SEEK.
entries.translated:
LA NATURA SI PIEGA AL NOSTRO
VOLERE. TRASFORMA I CRISTALLI IN\lCIÒ CHE CERCHI.

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon statue that exudes the
power of steel started moving!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Pokémon statue that exudes the power of steel started moving!
entries.translated:
[black]La statua Pokémon che emana il
potere dell{B4}acciaio ha iniziato a\lmuoversi!

entries.original: "[green]Ji-ji-ze-ji-zoh\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Ji-ji-ze-ji-zoh[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Ji-ji-ze-ji-zoh\.

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] disappeared."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] disappeared.
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] è scomparso.

entries.original: "Rift Cave"
entries.translation_source: Rift Cave
entries.translated: Grotta del Rift

entries.original:
"A mysterious cave said to have a
connection to the great beyond.
Those who wander about inside may
never find their way out."
entries.translation_source: A mysterious cave said to have a connection to the great beyond. Those who wander about inside may never find their way out.
entries.translated:
Una misteriosa grotta di cui si
dice sia collegata all{B4}aldilà. Chi\lsi aggira al suo interno potrebbe

non ritrovare mai la via d{B4}uscita.

entries.original: "Route 1"
entries.translation_source: Route 1
entries.translated: Percorso 1

entries.original:
"[black]A large pile of snow is blocking
the road.

Better go another way for now."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]A large pile of snow is blocking the road. Better go another way for now.
entries.translated:
[black]Un grosso cumulo di neve blocca la
strada. Meglio andare da un{B4}altra\lparte per ora.

entries.original:
"Sorry, fella.

An avalanche caused some snow piles
to gather up on the road.

If you wanna go to Bellin, you’ll
have to take the ol’ mountain road\lfor now.

Here, come with me and I’ll show you
the way."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, fella. An avalanche caused some snow piles to gather up on the road. If you wanna go to Bellin, you’ll have to take the ol’ mountain road for now. Here, come with me and I’ll show you the way.
entries.translated:
Mi spiace, amico. Una valanga ha
fatto accumulare della neve sulla\lstrada. Se vuoi andare a Bellin,

per ora dovrai prendere la vecchia
strada di montagna. Dai, vieni con\lme e ti mostro la strada.

entries.original:
"Some scary lookin’ fella came along
and melted the snow piles blockin’\lthe road.

I sure was happy and all, but
somethin’ seemed up with him.

If you care, I watched him head
[green]north of Frozen Heights[blue].

Wonder what he’s doin’ up there?"
entries.translation_source: Some scary lookin’ fella came along and melted the snow piles blockin’ the road. I sure was happy and all, but somethin’ seemed up with him. If you care, I watched him head [color-green-1]north of Frozen Heights[color-blue-2]. Wonder what he’s doin’ up there?
entries.translated:
Un tipo dall{B4}aria inquietante è
arrivato e ha sciolto i cumuli di\lneve che bloccavano la strada. Ero

contento e tutto, ma c{B4}era qualcosa
che non andava in lui. Se ti\linteressa, l{B4}ho visto andare [green]a nord

di Frozen Heights[blue]. Chissà che ci fa
lassù?

entries.original:
"Ah, you must be [player].

Prof. Log phoned ahead and told me
to guide you if you got lost.

Bellin Town is just over that way."
entries.translation_source: Ah, you must be [player-name-1]. Prof. Log phoned ahead and told me to guide you if you got lost. Bellin Town is just over that way.
entries.translated:
Ah, devi essere [player]. Il Prof.
Log mi ha telefonato in anticipo e\lmi ha detto di guidarti se ti fossi

perso. Bellin Town è proprio da
quella parte.

entries.original:
"If you’d like me to show you how to
capture a Pokémon, prove you’re\lcapable by delivering [green]Prof. Log’s\lpackage[blue] to him."
entries.translation_source: If you’d like me to show you how to capture a Pokémon, prove you’re capable by delivering [color-green-1]Prof. Log’s package[color-blue-2] to him.
entries.translated:
Se vuoi che ti mostri come
catturare un Pokémon, dimostra di\lesserne capace consegnando [green]il pacco

del Prof. Log[blue] a lui.

entries.original:
"Ah, from the Badge on your Trainer
Card, I see that you’ve become a\lrather skilled Trainer.

You’ve far surpassed the role of
Prof. Log’s errand [buffer1].

However, in my book, you’re never
too experienced to watch an expert\lcatch Pokémon!

So, what do you say?

I could show you a thing or two
about capturing Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Ah, from the Badge on your Trainer Card, I see that you’ve become a rather skilled Trainer. You’ve far surpassed the role of Prof. Log’s errand [buffer1-1]. However, in my book, you’re never too experienced to watch an expert catch Pokémon! So, what do you say? I could show you a thing or two about capturing Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ah, dal distintivo sulla tua Carta
Allenatore vedo che sei diventato\lun Allenatore piuttosto abile. Hai

superato di gran lunga il ruolo di
[buffer1] fattorino di Prof. Log.\lTuttavia, per me non si è mai

troppo esperti per osservare un
esperto catturare Pokémon! Allora,\lche ne dici? Potrei insegnarti un

paio di cose su come catturare
Pokémon.

entries.original:
"I heard from Prof. Log that you did
well delivering his package to him.

And I even heard from him that he’s
sending you on more errands as a\lfully fledged Pokémon Trainer!

You know, I used to be something of
a Trainer myself, back in my day.

I could show you a thing or two
about capturing Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I heard from Prof. Log that you did well delivering his package to him. And I even heard from him that he’s sending you on more errands as a fully fledged Pokémon Trainer! You know, I used to be something of a Trainer myself, back in my day. I could show you a thing or two about capturing Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ho sentito dal Prof. Log che hai
fatto un ottimo lavoro nel\lconsegnargli il pacco. E ho persino

sentito da lui che ti sta mandando
a fare altre commissioni come\lAllenatore Pokémon a tutti gli

effetti! Sai, anch{B4}io una volta ero
qualcosa di simile a un Allenatore,\lai miei tempi. Potrei insegnarti un

paio di cose su come catturare i
Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Alrighty!
Here we go!"
entries.translation_source: Alrighty! Here we go!
entries.translated: Va bene! Si parte!

entries.original:
"Phew\.

That one was too close for
comfort\."
entries.translation_source: Phew[game-token-1] That one was too close for comfort[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Phew\. Quello è stato troppo vicino
per star tranquilli\.

entries.original:
"As you witnessed, I successfully
captured that Pokémon by throwing\la [green]Poké Ball[blue].

However, this won’t always work.

Many times, Pokémon must be
weakened before you’ll be able\lto capture them."
entries.translation_source: As you witnessed, I successfully captured that Pokémon by throwing a [color-green-1]Poké Ball[color-blue-2]. However, this won’t always work. Many times, Pokémon must be weakened before you’ll be able to capture them.
entries.translated:
Come hai visto, ho catturato con
successo quel Pokémon lanciando una\l[green]Poké Ball[blue]. Tuttavia, non sempre

funziona. Molte volte, i Pokémon
devono essere indeboliti prima che\ltu possa catturarli.

entries.original:
"And as my thanks for allowing me to
stretch my legs today, please take\lthis Poké Ball I acquired back in\lmy younger days."
entries.translation_source: And as my thanks for allowing me to stretch my legs today, please take this Poké Ball I acquired back in my younger days.
entries.translated:
E come ringraziamento per avermi
permesso di sgranchirmi le gambe\loggi, prendi questa Poké Ball che

avevo ottenuto quand{B4}ero più
giovane.

entries.original:
"If you would ever like to see my
skills again, please, stop by."
entries.translation_source: If you would ever like to see my skills again, please, stop by.
entries.translated:
Se mai volessi rivedere le mie
abilità, passa pure a trovarmi.

entries.original:
"If you ever would like to see me in
action, please, stop by."
entries.translation_source: If you ever would like to see me in action, please, stop by.
entries.translated:
Se un giorno vorrai vedermi
all{B4}opera, passa pure a trovarmi.

entries.original: "boy"
entries.translation_source: boy
entries.translated: ragazzo

entries.original: "Route 10"
entries.translation_source: Route 10
entries.translated: Percorso 10

entries.original:
"Huah, fellow Trainer!

I am training my body and soul by
staring at this tree intently!

Take this so you can train too!"
entries.translation_source: Huah, fellow Trainer! I am training my body and soul by staring at this tree intently! Take this so you can train too!
entries.translated:
Huah, collega Allenatore! Sto
allenando il mio corpo e la mia\lanima fissando intensamente questo

albero! Prendi questo così potrai
allenarti anche tu!

entries.original:
"Huah, fellow Trainer!

I can [green]upgrade[blue] the [green]Macho Brace[blue] to
make training more efficient!

Right now it is only a measly \Lv [buffer3],
but I can upgrade it to [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue] in\lexchange for [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Huah, fellow Trainer! I can [color-green-1]upgrade[color-blue-2] the [color-green-3]Macho Brace[color-blue-4] to make training more efficient! Right now it is only a measly [game-token-5] [buffer3-6], but I can upgrade it to [color-green-7][game-token-8] [buffer2-9][color-blue-10] in exchange for [color-green-11][buffer2-12] [buffer1-13]s[color-blue-14]!
entries.translated:
Huah, collega Allenatore! Posso
[green]potenziare[blue] la [green]Macho Brace[blue] per\lrendere l{B4}allenamento più

efficiente! Al momento è solo un
misero \Lv [buffer3], ma posso\lpotenziarla a [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue] in cambio

di [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]!

entries.original:
"Fine, settle for an inferior
product!"
entries.translation_source: Fine, settle for an inferior product!
entries.translated:
Va bene, accontentati di un
prodotto inferiore!

entries.original:
"You do not have enough [buffer1]s
for me to upgrade your Macho Brace!"
entries.translation_source: You do not have enough [buffer1-1]s for me to upgrade your Macho Brace!
entries.translated:
Non hai abbastanza [buffer1] per
farmi potenziare la tua Fascia\lMacho!

entries.original:
"[black]The Macho Brace level has been
increased to \Lv [buffer2]!

Pokémon will now gain [green][buffer2]*[black] the
amount of Effort Values when held."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Macho Brace level has been increased to [game-token-2] [buffer2-3]! Pokémon will now gain [color-green-4][buffer2-5]*[color-black-6] the amount of Effort Values when held.
entries.translated:
[black]Il livello di Macho Brace è stato
aumentato a \Lv [buffer2]! I Pokémon\lora otterranno [green][buffer2]*[black] la

quantità di Punti Base quando è
tenuto.

entries.original:
"Your Macho Brace is as powerful
as it can get!

In its current state, you will
receive [green][buffer1]*[blue] the amount of effort\lvalues when training with it!"
entries.translation_source: Your Macho Brace is as powerful as it can get! In its current state, you will receive [color-green-1][buffer1-2]*[color-blue-3] the amount of effort values when training with it!
entries.translated:
La tua Bretella Macho è potente
quanto può esserlo! Nelle sue\lcondizioni attuali, riceverai

[green][buffer1]*[blue] il numero di Punti Effort
quando ti alleni con essa!

entries.original:
"The sea\.

Full of fury one moment, calm as a
Pokémon’s nature the next\."
entries.translation_source: The sea[game-token-1] Full of fury one moment, calm as a Pokémon’s nature the next[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Il mare\. Furioso un istante, calmo
come la natura di un Pokémon quello\ldopo\.

entries.original:
"Battle me.

Show me you too, can be as furious
as the sea."
entries.translation_source: Battle me. Show me you too, can be as furious as the sea.
entries.translated:
Sfidami. Dimostrami che anche tu
puoi essere furioso come il mare.

entries.original:
"You have done well.
Take this item."
entries.translation_source: You have done well. Take this item.
entries.translated:
Hai fatto un buon lavoro. Prendi
questo oggetto.

entries.original:
"That [green]Medichamite[blue] is for Mega
Evolving the Pokémon, [green]Medicham[blue].

With the right Trainer, it too can
battle as furiously as the sea."
entries.translation_source: That [color-green-1]Medichamite[color-blue-2] is for Mega Evolving the Pokémon, [color-green-3]Medicham[color-blue-4]. With the right Trainer, it too can battle as furiously as the sea.
entries.translated:
Quel [green]Medichamite[blue] serve a far
MegaEvolvere il Pokémon, [green]Medicham[blue].\lCon il giusto Allenatore, anche lui

può combattere con la stessa furia
del mare.

entries.original:
"If you can defeat all the Trainers
here and on the Auburn Waterway,\lI’d like to see your fury, too."
entries.translation_source: If you can defeat all the Trainers here and on the Auburn Waterway, I’d like to see your fury, too.
entries.translated:
Se riesci a sconfiggere tutti gli
Allenatori qui e sulla Via\lAcquatica di Auburn, vorrei vedere

anche la tua furia.

entries.original:
"Stop right there!

I want to paint this
perfect moment."
entries.translation_source: Stop right there! I want to paint this perfect moment.
entries.translated:
Fermo lì! Voglio dipingere questo
momento perfetto.

entries.original:
"A young kid, dashing through
the rain\."
entries.translation_source: A young kid, dashing through the rain[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Un ragazzino che corre sotto la
pioggia\.

entries.original:
"I don’t think it’s such a good
idea to paint in the rain.

Everything I paint gets
washed away\."
entries.translation_source: I don’t think it’s such a good idea to paint in the rain. Everything I paint gets washed away[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Non credo sia una buona idea
dipingere sotto la pioggia. Tutto\lciò che dipingo viene lavato via\.

entries.original:
"Only the uncool kids actually go
to school\."
entries.translation_source: Only the uncool kids actually go to school[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Solo i tipi poco cool vanno davvero
a scuola\.

entries.original:
"That cave over there, what do you
suppose is in it?"
entries.translation_source: That cave over there, what do you suppose is in it?
entries.translated:
Quella grotta laggiù, secondo te
cosa ci sarà dentro?

entries.original:
"I bet scary strong Pokémon live
there!"
entries.translation_source: I bet scary strong Pokémon live there!
entries.translated:
Scommetto che lì vivono Pokémon
fortissimi e spaventosi!

entries.original:
"Word around these parts is that the
cave is called the [green]Cave of Being[blue].

People say it bears a resemblance
to the lake caves of Sinnoh."
entries.translation_source: Word around these parts is that the cave is called the [color-green-1]Cave of Being[color-blue-2]. People say it bears a resemblance to the lake caves of Sinnoh.
entries.translated:
Si dice in giro che la grotta si
chiami [green]Grotta dell{B4}Essere[blue]. Dicono\lche somigli alle grotte dei laghi

di Sinnoh.

entries.original:
"In other places like Fallshore
City, it only rains sometimes.

So why is it always raining on
Route 10?"
entries.translation_source: In other places like Fallshore City, it only rains sometimes. So why is it always raining on Route 10?
entries.translated:
In altri posti come Fallshore City,
piove solo a volte. Allora perché\lpiove sempre sulla Route 10?

entries.original: "Route 11"
entries.translation_source: Route 11
entries.translated: Percorso 11

entries.original: "Cliff Cave"
entries.translation_source: Cliff Cave
entries.translated: Grotta della Rupe

entries.original:
"Beyond the boundary of rocks lies
a vast ocean.

It’s somewhere in this ocean
wherein lies the peaceful\lAlola region.

The people there have a tradition
that each of their islands is\lprotected by a guardian deity.

Do you ever wonder what it would
be like if each of the islands that\lmake up Borrius had, too?

That thought may not cross your
mind, but it certainly does mine."
entries.translation_source: Beyond the boundary of rocks lies a vast ocean. It’s somewhere in this ocean wherein lies the peaceful Alola region. The people there have a tradition that each of their islands is protected by a guardian deity. Do you ever wonder what it would be like if each of the islands that make up Borrius had, too? That thought may not cross your mind, but it certainly does mine.
entries.translated:
Oltre il confine delle rocce si
estende un vasto oceano. È da\lqualche parte in questo oceano che

si trova la pacifica regione di
Alola. La gente di lì ha la\ltradizione che ogni loro isola è

protetta da una divinità
protettrice. Ti sei mai chiesto\lcome sarebbe se anche ciascuna

delle isole che compongono Borrius
avesse una divinità protettrice?\lForse questo pensiero non ti

sfiora, ma di certo sfiora me.

entries.original:
"That Pokémon in your party\.

It certainly bears resemblance to
the guardian deities of Alola\."
entries.translation_source: That Pokémon in your party[game-token-1] It certainly bears resemblance to the guardian deities of Alola[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Quel Pokémon nella tua squadra\.
Assomiglia davvero alle divinità\lcustodi di Alola\.

entries.original:
"Reports from the Alola region
indicate their guardian deities\lare still present, which must mean\lyours is not of this world.

Regardless, this item rightfully
belongs with it, not with me."
entries.translation_source: Reports from the Alola region indicate their guardian deities are still present, which must mean yours is not of this world. Regardless, this item rightfully belongs with it, not with me.
entries.translated:
Le segnalazioni dalla regione di
Alola indicano che le loro divinità\lprotettrici sono ancora presenti,

il che deve significare che la tua
non è di questo mondo. In ogni\lcaso, questo oggetto appartiene

giustamente a lei, non a me.

entries.original:
"The [green]Tapunium Z[red] can power up any
of the Alolan guardian deities\l[green]Nature’s Madness[red], into a more\lpowerful, one-time use Z-Move."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Tapunium Z[color-red-2] can power up any of the Alolan guardian deities [color-green-3]Nature’s Madness[color-red-4], into a more powerful, one-time use Z-Move.
entries.translated:
[green]Tapunium Z[red] può potenziare una
qualsiasi delle divinità guardiane\ldi Alola, [green]Ira della Natura[red], in una

mossa Z più potente, utilizzabile
una sola volta.

entries.original:
"Upon this rocky face I see, yet
another Trainer, yearning to be.

The very best, I say, the very
best.

Then, I shall put this Trainer to
the test!"
entries.translation_source: Upon this rocky face I see, yet another Trainer, yearning to be. The very best, I say, the very best. Then, I shall put this Trainer to the test!
entries.translated:
Su questa parete rocciosa vedo, un
altro Allenatore, bramoso di\lessere. Il migliore, dico, il

migliore in assoluto. Allora,
metterò alla prova questo\lAllenatore!

entries.original:
"A glorious defeat for me, a
glorious defeat you see."
entries.translation_source: A glorious defeat for me, a glorious defeat you see.
entries.translated:
Per me è una gloriosa sconfitta,
una gloriosa sconfitta, vedi.

entries.original:
"And as this Trainer did pass the
test, I said to them, they are\lthe very best."
entries.translation_source: And as this Trainer did pass the test, I said to them, they are the very best.
entries.translated:
E poiché questo Allenatore ha
superato la prova, ho detto loro\lche sono il migliore in assoluto.

entries.original:
"An [green]Alakazite[blue] is full of might.

For [green]Alakazam[blue], it will shine
bright."
entries.translation_source: An [color-green-1]Alakazite[color-blue-2] is full of might. For [color-green-3]Alakazam[color-blue-4], it will shine bright.
entries.translated:
Una [green]Alakazite[blue] è piena di potenza.
Per [green]Alakazam[blue], risplenderà\lintensamente.

entries.original:
"Upon this rocky face I see, yet
another Trainer, yearning to be.

The very best, I say, the very
best.

But only one who has defeated all
of the Trainers on Route 11, can\lbe put to the test."
entries.translation_source: Upon this rocky face I see, yet another Trainer, yearning to be. The very best, I say, the very best. But only one who has defeated all of the Trainers on Route 11, can be put to the test.
entries.translated:
Su questo volto roccioso vedo un
altro Allenatore che anela a\ldiventare il migliore, dico, il

migliore in assoluto. Ma solo chi
ha sconfitto tutti gli Allenatori\lsulla Percorso 11, può essere messo

alla prova.

entries.original:
"We battle as one!
Us and nature!"
entries.translation_source: We battle as one! Us and nature!
entries.translated:
Combattiamo come uno solo! Noi e la
natura!

entries.original:
"Mother nature, where have we
gone wrong?"
entries.translation_source: Mother nature, where have we gone wrong?
entries.translated:
Madre natura, dove abbiamo
sbagliato?

entries.original:
"I work to protect the environment.
In turn, nature protects me!"
entries.translation_source: I work to protect the environment. In turn, nature protects me!
entries.translated:
Lavoro per proteggere l{B4}ambiente.
In cambio, la natura protegge me!

entries.original:
"We battle as one!
Us and nature!

But only against Trainers that can
take us both at once!"
entries.translation_source: We battle as one! Us and nature! But only against Trainers that can take us both at once!
entries.translated:
Combattiamo come un tutt{B4}uno! Noi e
la natura! Ma solo contro\lAllenatori che possano affrontarci

entrambi insieme!

entries.original:
"Together we’re strong!
Together with nature!"
entries.translation_source: Together we’re strong! Together with nature!
entries.translated:
Insieme siamo forti! Insieme alla
natura!

entries.original: "But together\. we’re strong\.?"
entries.translation_source: But together[game-token-1] we’re strong[game-token-2]?
entries.translated: Ma insieme\. siamo forti\.?

entries.original:
"The mountain here has a whole
network of caves running\lthrough it.

Together, we protect the Pokémon
of the cliff’s caves."
entries.translation_source: The mountain here has a whole network of caves running through it. Together, we protect the Pokémon of the cliff’s caves.
entries.translated:
Questa montagna è attraversata da
una fitta rete di grotte. Insieme\lproteggiamo i Pokémon delle grotte

della rupe.

entries.original:
"Together we’re strong!
Together with nature!

But only against Trainers that can
take us both at once!"
entries.translation_source: Together we’re strong! Together with nature! But only against Trainers that can take us both at once!
entries.translated:
Insieme siamo forti! Insieme alla
natura! Ma solo contro Allenatori\lche riescono a prenderci entrambi

in una volta!

entries.original:
"Pokémon from the sea have infested
this body of water!"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon from the sea have infested this body of water!
entries.translated:
I Pokémon del mare hanno infestato
questo specchio d{B4}acqua!

entries.original: "How did they get up here?"
entries.translation_source: How did they get up here?
entries.translated:
Come hanno fatto a salire fin
quassù?

entries.original:
"Tentacool don’t belong in ponds,
they belong in the sea!"
entries.translation_source: Tentacool don’t belong in ponds, they belong in the sea!
entries.translated:
I Tentacool non appartengono agli
stagni, appartengono al mare!

entries.original:
"With a better rod, I could catch
better Pokémon\."
entries.translation_source: With a better rod, I could catch better Pokémon[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Con una canna migliore, potrei
pescare Pokémon migliori\.

entries.original:
"I love fishing, don’t get me wrong.

But it’d be best if I also had more
work."
entries.translation_source: I love fishing, don’t get me wrong. But it’d be best if I also had more work.
entries.translated:
Mi piace pescare, non
fraintendermi. Ma sarebbe meglio se\lavessi anche più lavoro da fare.

entries.original: "It’s not easy\."
entries.translation_source: It’s not easy[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non è facile\.

entries.original:
"It’s all right.
Losing doesn’t bug me anymore."
entries.translation_source: It’s all right. Losing doesn’t bug me anymore.
entries.translated:
Va bene così. Perdere non mi
infastidisce più.

entries.original:
"I guess you get to be good at
what you like.

Well, you beat me at Pokémon,
but you can’t top me at fishing."
entries.translation_source: I guess you get to be good at what you like. Well, you beat me at Pokémon, but you can’t top me at fishing.
entries.translated:
Immagino che si diventa bravi in
ciò che si ama. Beh, mi hai battuto\la Pokémon, ma a pescare non mi

superi.

entries.original: "It’s kind of chilly out here."
entries.translation_source: It’s kind of chilly out here.
entries.translated: Qui fuori fa un po{B4} freddo.

entries.original: "That warmed me right up!"
entries.translation_source: That warmed me right up!
entries.translated: Mi ha riscaldato proprio per bene!

entries.original: "It’s always important to stay warm."
entries.translation_source: It’s always important to stay warm.
entries.translated: È sempre importante stare al caldo.

entries.original:
"This place reminds me of the Cliff
Caves from the Johto region.

Huh? I could’ve thought of something
different?

Like what? Cliff Caves Remastered?
Original Recipe Cliff Caves?"
entries.translation_source: This place reminds me of the Cliff Caves from the Johto region. Huh? I could’ve thought of something different? Like what? Cliff Caves Remastered? Original Recipe Cliff Caves?
entries.translated:
Questo posto mi ricorda le Cliff
Caves della regione di Johto. Eh?\lAvrei potuto pensare a qualcosa di

diverso? Tipo cosa? Cliff Caves
Remastered? Cliff Caves Ricetta\lOriginale?

entries.original: "I believe I can fly!"
entries.translation_source: I believe I can fly!
entries.translated: Credo di poter volare!

entries.original: "I believe I can touch the sky!"
entries.translation_source: I believe I can touch the sky!
entries.translated: Credo di poter toccare il cielo!

entries.original:
"I like to pretend I can fly like
my birds.

Being grounded sucks."
entries.translation_source: I like to pretend I can fly like my birds. Being grounded sucks.
entries.translated:
Mi piace fingere di poter volare
come i miei uccelli. Essere con i\lpiedi per terra fa schifo.

entries.original:
"Talonflame has a Hidden Ability
called [green]Gale Wings[blue].

It can use its Flying-type moves
faster!"
entries.translation_source: Talonflame has a Hidden Ability called [color-green-1]Gale Wings[color-blue-2]. It can use its Flying-type moves faster!
entries.translated:
Talonflame ha un{B4}abilità nascosta
chiamata [green]Gale Wings[blue]. Può usare più\lvelocemente le mosse di tipo

Volante!

entries.original: "Route 12"
entries.translation_source: Route 12
entries.translated: Percorso 12

entries.original:
"Did you know that your [buffer1]
is able to power moves up\linto [green]Z-Moves[blue]?

Those are super powerful moves that
can only be used once per battle!

Just equip your Pokémon with a
[green]Z-Crystal[blue] matching one of its\lmove Types, and press \btn04 when\lselecting the move to unleash a\ldevastating attack!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that your [buffer1-1] is able to power moves up into [color-green-2]Z-Moves[color-blue-3]? Those are super powerful moves that can only be used once per battle! Just equip your Pokémon with a [color-green-4]Z-Crystal[color-blue-5] matching one of its move Types, and press [button-icon-6] when selecting the move to unleash a devastating attack!
entries.translated:
Sapevi che il tuo [buffer1] è in
grado di potenziare le mosse in\l[green]Mosse Z[blue]? Sono mosse super potenti

che possono essere usate solo una
volta per lotta! Basta equipaggiare\lil tuo Pokémon con una [green]Cristallo Z[blue]

corrispondente al Tipo di una delle
sue mosse, e premere \btn04 quando\lselezioni la mossa per scatenare un

attacco devastante!

entries.original:
"There’s a Pokémon in the bag!
Take it?"
entries.translation_source: There’s a Pokémon in the bag! Take it?
entries.translated:
C{B4}è un Pokémon nella borsa! Lo
prendi?

entries.original:
"[player] found a [buffer1]!
It has a [green][buffer2][black] nature."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] found a [buffer1-2]! It has a [color-green-3][buffer2-4][color-black-5] nature.
entries.translated:
[player] ha trovato un [buffer1]! Ha
una natura [green][buffer2][black].

entries.original:
"You don’t have enough space for
this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You don’t have enough space for this Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Non hai abbastanza spazio per
questo Pokémon.

entries.original:
"There’s a Pokémon in the bag!

But it doesn’t seem like it wants
to come out right now\."
entries.translation_source: There’s a Pokémon in the bag! But it doesn’t seem like it wants to come out right now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
C{B4}è un Pokémon nella borsa! Però
non sembra voglia uscire proprio\ladesso\.

entries.original: "Check ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Check ’em!
entries.translated: Controllali!

entries.original:
"Did you enjoy checking out my
Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Did you enjoy checking out my Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Ti è piaciuto dare un{B4}occhiata ai
miei Pokémon?

entries.original: "I love showing off my Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I love showing off my Pokémon!
entries.translated: Adoro sfoggiare i miei Pokémon!

entries.original:
"This mountain pass has a very
unique layout.

You’re not going to find any other
route in Borrius with stairs built\linto the side of a mountain like\lthis one!"
entries.translation_source: This mountain pass has a very unique layout. You’re not going to find any other route in Borrius with stairs built into the side of a mountain like this one!
entries.translated:
Questo passo di montagna ha una
disposizione davvero unica. Non\ltroverai un altro percorso a

Borrius con scale costruite nel
fianco di una montagna come questo!

entries.original: "Do you know where you’re going?"
entries.translation_source: Do you know where you’re going?
entries.translated: Sai dove stai andando?

entries.original: "You must know."
entries.translation_source: You must know.
entries.translated: Devi saperlo.

entries.original:
"To go between Tarmigan Town and
Dehara City, you must first go\ldown the mountain."
entries.translation_source: To go between Tarmigan Town and Dehara City, you must first go down the mountain.
entries.translated:
Per andare tra Tarmigan Town e
Dehara City, devi prima scendere\ldalla montagna.

entries.original:
"A beautiful Trainer can’t lose
her way!

It’s simply not possible!"
entries.translation_source: A beautiful Trainer can’t lose her way! It’s simply not possible!
entries.translated:
Una bella Allenatrice non può
perdersi la strada! È semplicemente\limpossibile!

entries.original:
"My psychic powers foretell my
victory!"
entries.translation_source: My psychic powers foretell my victory!
entries.translated:
I miei poteri psichici prevedono la
mia vittoria!

entries.original: "I\. I was wrong?"
entries.translation_source: I[game-token-1] I was wrong?
entries.translated: Io\. mi sbagliavo?

entries.original:
"I must hone my psychic senses
further.

Next time, I will not be wrong."
entries.translation_source: I must hone my psychic senses further. Next time, I will not be wrong.
entries.translated:
Devo affinare ulteriormente i miei
sensi psichici. La prossima volta\lnon sbaglierò.

entries.original:
"The warmer the weather, the
stronger I get!"
entries.translation_source: The warmer the weather, the stronger I get!
entries.translated:
Più il clima è caldo, più divento
forte!

entries.original:
"The ocean off the coast is really
deep!"
entries.translation_source: The ocean off the coast is really deep!
entries.translated:
Il mare al largo della costa è
davvero profondo!

entries.original: "I’ll keep fishing."
entries.translation_source: I’ll keep fishing.
entries.translated: Continuerò a pescare.

entries.original:
"I think some Pokémon can take
you underwater."
entries.translation_source: I think some Pokémon can take you underwater.
entries.translated:
Penso che alcuni Pokémon possano
portarti sott{B4}acqua.

entries.original:
"You can’t see from on land, but
the water here is very deep!"
entries.translation_source: You can’t see from on land, but the water here is very deep!
entries.translated:
Da terra non si vede, ma l{B4}acqua
qui è molto profonda!

entries.original: "Route 13"
entries.translation_source: Route 13
entries.translated: Percorso 13

entries.original:
"[buffer1] soared upwards out
of sight."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] soared upwards out of sight.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] è salito in alto fuori
dalla vista.

entries.original:
"With my fists, I am trying to
smash this rock that continuously\lreappears under my umbrella.

Aiyah!

But it is not working\."
entries.translation_source: With my fists, I am trying to smash this rock that continuously reappears under my umbrella. Aiyah! But it is not working[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Con i miei pugni sto cercando di
spaccare questa roccia che continua\la riapparire sotto il mio ombrello.

Aiyah! Ma non funziona\.

entries.original:
"Aiyah! 
You smashed it!"
entries.translation_source: Aiyah! You smashed it!
entries.translated: Aiyah! L{B4}hai distrutto!

entries.original:
"They call me the Ocean Master.

Why?

Because I am the master of the
ocean.

I command the Pokémon of the sea,
and none can defeat me.

Allow me to show you."
entries.translation_source: They call me the Ocean Master. Why? Because I am the master of the ocean. I command the Pokémon of the sea, and none can defeat me. Allow me to show you.
entries.translated:
Mi chiamano il Maestro degli
Oceani. Perché? Perché sono il\lpadrone dell{B4}oceano. Domino i

Pokémon del mare, e nessuno può
sconfiggermi. Permettimi di\lmostrarti.

entries.original:
"You are now the Ocean Master.
Congratulations."
entries.translation_source: You are now the Ocean Master. Congratulations.
entries.translated:
Ora sei il Maestro degli Oceani.
Congratulazioni.

entries.original:
"In truth, I was called the Ocean
Master because of my name.

It was a cruel joke my classmates
played on me.

I vowed revenge, so I became an
Ace Trainer.

That is all in the past now, so I
would like you to have this."
entries.translation_source: In truth, I was called the Ocean Master because of my name. It was a cruel joke my classmates played on me. I vowed revenge, so I became an Ace Trainer. That is all in the past now, so I would like you to have this.
entries.translated:
A dire il vero, mi chiamavano il
Maestro dell{B4}Oceano a causa del mio\lnome. Era una crudeltà che i miei

compagni di classe mi facevano.
Giurai vendetta, così diventai un\lAllenatore Esperto. Tutto questo

ora appartiene al passato, quindi
vorrei che tu avessi questo.

entries.original:
"Only the Ocean Master can tame a
Mega Gyarados.

As you are one, allow your [green]Gyarados[blue]
to hold the [green]Gyaradosite[blue].

It will make for an explosive
battle."
entries.translation_source: Only the Ocean Master can tame a Mega Gyarados. As you are one, allow your [color-green-1]Gyarados[color-blue-2] to hold the [color-green-3]Gyaradosite[color-blue-4]. It will make for an explosive battle.
entries.translated:
Solo il Maestro dell{B4}Oceano può
domare un Mega Gyarados. Dato che\llo sei, fai tenere al tuo [green]Gyarados[blue]

la [green]Gyaradosite[blue]. Ne verrà fuori una
lotta esplosiva.

entries.original:
"They call me the Ocean Master.

Why?

Because I am the master of the
ocean.

I command the Pokémon of the sea,
and none can defeat me.

Especially not someone who has not
even defeated all of the Trainers\lon Route 13 and Route 14."
entries.translation_source: They call me the Ocean Master. Why? Because I am the master of the ocean. I command the Pokémon of the sea, and none can defeat me. Especially not someone who has not even defeated all of the Trainers on Route 13 and Route 14.
entries.translated:
Mi chiamano il Maestro dell{B4}Oceano.
Perché? Perché sono il maestro\ldell{B4}oceano. Comando i Pokémon del

mare e nessuno può sconfiggermi.
Soprattutto non qualcuno che non ha\lneanche sconfitto tutti gli

Allenatori sul Percorso 13 e sul
Percorso 14.

entries.original:
"Wahahah! This dude’s going to catch
himself a big one!"
entries.translation_source: Wahahah! This dude’s going to catch himself a big one!
entries.translated:
Wahahah! Questo tizio ne pescherà
uno bello grosso!

entries.original: "This dude just lost one\."
entries.translation_source: This dude just lost one[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Questo tipo ha appena perso\.

entries.original:
"This dude thinks you’re a big one.
No, you’re a big-one-to-be!"
entries.translation_source: This dude thinks you’re a big one. No, you’re a big-one-to-be!
entries.translated:
Quel tizio pensa che tu sia già
enorme. No, sei destinato a\ldiventare enorme!

entries.original:
"Oh, no! I’ve got this feeling I’ll
hook a big one!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! I’ve got this feeling I’ll hook a big one!
entries.translated:
Oh, no! Ho la sensazione che
abboccherò a un bel pesce!

entries.original:
"I look at the sea to forget all
the bad things that happened."
entries.translation_source: I look at the sea to forget all the bad things that happened.
entries.translated:
Guardo il mare per dimenticare
tutte le cose brutte che sono\lsuccesse.

entries.original:
"Ooh!
Traumatic!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh! Traumatic!
entries.translated: Oh! Traumatico!

entries.original:
"I’m looking at the sea to forget
the bad thing that happened!"
entries.translation_source: I’m looking at the sea to forget the bad thing that happened!
entries.translated:
Sto guardando il mare per
dimenticare la brutta cosa che è\lsuccessa!

entries.original:
"You can only Dive where the sea
is dark."
entries.translation_source: You can only Dive where the sea is dark.
entries.translated:
Puoi usare Sub solo dove il mare è
scuro.

entries.original: "What’s beyond the horizon?"
entries.translation_source: What’s beyond the horizon?
entries.translated: Cosa c{B4}è oltre l{B4}orizzonte?

entries.original: "Glub!"
entries.translation_source: Glub!
entries.translated: Glu!

entries.original:
"I see the Ruins of Void over
yonder!"
entries.translation_source: I see the Ruins of Void over yonder!
entries.translated: Vedo laggiù le Rovine del Vuoto!

entries.original:
"I can beat even marine Pokémon
at swimming."
entries.translation_source: I can beat even marine Pokémon at swimming.
entries.translated:
So nuotare meglio persino dei
Pokémon marini.

entries.original:
"Swimming’s great!
Sunburns aren’t!"
entries.translation_source: Swimming’s great! Sunburns aren’t!
entries.translated:
Nuotare è fantastico! Le scottature
no!

entries.original: "Shocker!"
entries.translation_source: Shocker!
entries.translated: Scossa!

entries.original:
"My friend wanted to swim to
the Ruins of Void."
entries.translation_source: My friend wanted to swim to the Ruins of Void.
entries.translated:
Il mio amico voleva nuotare fino
alle Rovine del Vuoto.

entries.original:
"If I were to ride a Pokémon on
the sea, I’d like a Lapras.

Lapras is so big, I bet it
would keep me dry on water."
entries.translation_source: If I were to ride a Pokémon on the sea, I’d like a Lapras. Lapras is so big, I bet it would keep me dry on water.
entries.translated:
Se dovessi cavalcare un Pokémon sul
mare, vorrei un Lapras. Lapras è\lcosì grande che, scommetto, mi

terrebbe all{B4}asciutto sull{B4}acqua.

entries.original:
"Oh, I just love your ride!
Can I have it if I win?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I just love your ride! Can I have it if I win?
entries.translated:
Oh, adoro proprio il tuo mezzo!
Posso averlo se vinco?

entries.original: "Oh! I lost!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! I lost!
entries.translated: Oh! Ho perso!

entries.original:
"It’s still a long way to
the Ruins of Void.

I want to go back to Dresco Town."
entries.translation_source: It’s still a long way to the Ruins of Void. I want to go back to Dresco Town.
entries.translated:
Le Rovine del Vuoto sono ancora
molto lontane. Voglio tornare a\lDresco Town.

entries.original:
"Please don’t splash my face!
You’ll ruin the makeup."
entries.translation_source: Please don’t splash my face! You’ll ruin the makeup.
entries.translated:
Per favore, non schizzarmi in
faccia! Mi rovineresti il trucco.

entries.original:
"Kurukkoo!
How do you like my birdcall?"
entries.translation_source: Kurukkoo! How do you like my birdcall?
entries.translated:
Kurukkoo! Ti piace il mio verso da
uccello?

entries.original: "I had to bug you!"
entries.translation_source: I had to bug you!
entries.translated: Dovevo disturbarti!

entries.original:
"I collect sea Pokémon on weekends
because the sea is so close."
entries.translation_source: I collect sea Pokémon on weekends because the sea is so close.
entries.translated:
Colleziono Pokémon marini nei
weekend perché il mare è così\lvicino.

entries.original:
"You need sun to sunbathe!

I very well couldn’t do it on
Route 10!"
entries.translation_source: You need sun to sunbathe! I very well couldn’t do it on Route 10!
entries.translated:
Serve il sole per prendere il sole!
Non avrei proprio potuto farlo sul\lPercorso 10!

entries.original:
"From out of the sand I leap! Hiyah!
I challenge thee!"
entries.translation_source: From out of the sand I leap! Hiyah! I challenge thee!
entries.translated:
Balzo fuori dalla sabbia! Hiyah! Ti
sfido!

entries.original: "With honour I admit defeat!"
entries.translation_source: With honour I admit defeat!
entries.translated: Con onore ammetto la sconfitta!

entries.original:
"I must refine the art of concealment.
I bid thee farewell."
entries.translation_source: I must refine the art of concealment. I bid thee farewell.
entries.translated:
Devo affinare l{B4}arte del celamento.
Ti saluto.

entries.original:
"This year, I’m going to finally
learn how to swim!"
entries.translation_source: This year, I’m going to finally learn how to swim!
entries.translated:
Quest{B4}anno imparerò finalmente a
nuotare!

entries.original:
"Yay, yay!
Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Yay, yay! Pokémon!
entries.translated: Sì, sì! Pokémon!

entries.original: "What happens now?"
entries.translation_source: What happens now?
entries.translated: E adesso cosa succede?

entries.original:
"Did I just win?
Or did I lose?"
entries.translation_source: Did I just win? Or did I lose?
entries.translated: Ho vinto? O ho perso?

entries.original: "Route 14"
entries.translation_source: Route 14
entries.translated: Percorso 14

entries.original:
"M-my legs! They cramped up!
Glub, glub\."
entries.translation_source: M-my legs! They cramped up! Glub, glub[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
L-le mie gambe! Mi sono venuti i
crampi! Glo, glo\.

entries.original:
"The water is deep here.
There are many people swimming."
entries.translation_source: The water is deep here. There are many people swimming.
entries.translated:
L{B4}acqua qui è profonda. Ci sono
molte persone che nuotano.

entries.original: "Splash!"
entries.translation_source: Splash!
entries.translated: Splash!

entries.original:
"I wish I could ride my Pokémon.
I bet you’re not tired."
entries.translation_source: I wish I could ride my Pokémon. I bet you’re not tired.
entries.translated:
Vorrei poter cavalcare il mio
Pokémon. Scommetto che tu non sei\lstanco.

entries.original: "Riding a Pokémon sure looks fun!"
entries.translation_source: Riding a Pokémon sure looks fun!
entries.translated:
Andare in groppa a un Pokémon
sembra proprio divertente!

entries.original: "Check out my buff physique!"
entries.translation_source: Check out my buff physique!
entries.translated: Guarda il mio fisico da mozzafiato!

entries.original: "Wimpy!"
entries.translation_source: Wimpy!
entries.translated: Pappamolla!

entries.original:
"I should’ve been buffing up my
Pokémon, not me!"
entries.translation_source: I should’ve been buffing up my Pokémon, not me!
entries.translated:
Avrei dovuto potenziare i miei
Pokémon, non me!

entries.original:
"I’m beat! But, I still have the
bike race and marathon left!"
entries.translation_source: I’m beat! But, I still have the bike race and marathon left!
entries.translated:
Sono sfinito! Però mi restano
ancora la gara in bici e la\lmaratona!

entries.original: "My boyfriend gave me big pearls."
entries.translation_source: My boyfriend gave me big pearls.
entries.translated:
Il mio ragazzo mi ha regalato perle
grandi.

entries.original:
"Oh, no!
My pearls were in them!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! My pearls were in them!
entries.translated:
Oh, no! Le mie perle erano lì
dentro!

entries.original:
"Will my pearls grow bigger inside
Cloyster?"
entries.translation_source: Will my pearls grow bigger inside Cloyster?
entries.translated:
Le mie perle cresceranno dentro
Cloyster?

entries.original:
"When I can’t be with my boyfriend,
I spend time with the Pokémon he\lgave me."
entries.translation_source: When I can’t be with my boyfriend, I spend time with the Pokémon he gave me.
entries.translated:
Quando non posso stare con il mio
ragazzo, passo il tempo con il\lPokémon che mi ha regalato.

entries.original:
"If only there was someone to have a
picnic with\."
entries.translation_source: If only there was someone to have a picnic with[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Se solo ci fosse qualcuno con cui
fare un picnic\.

entries.original:
"Wow!
Your Badges are too cool!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Your Badges are too cool!
entries.translated:
Wow! Le tue Medaglie sono davvero
forti!

entries.original: "Not enough!"
entries.translation_source: Not enough!
entries.translated: Non basta!

entries.original:
"You got those Badges from Gym
Leaders. I know!"
entries.translation_source: You got those Badges from Gym Leaders. I know!
entries.translated:
Hai ottenuto quelle Medaglie dai
Capipalestra. Lo so!

entries.original: "What are you looking at?"
entries.translation_source: What are you looking at?
entries.translated: Che cosa stai guardando?

entries.original: "I’m just relaxing here."
entries.translation_source: I’m just relaxing here.
entries.translated: Sto solo rilassandomi qui.

entries.original: "Even rough housers need a break."
entries.translation_source: Even rough housers need a break.
entries.translated:
Anche i tipi rissosi hanno bisogno
di una pausa.

entries.original:
"Well, well, I’ve lost. I can’t call
myself an Expert now, can I?"
entries.translation_source: Well, well, I’ve lost. I can’t call myself an Expert now, can I?
entries.translated:
Ebbene, ebbene, ho perso. Non posso
più definirmi un Esperto, vero?

entries.original:
"Whoops! Don’t tell me I snagged
a Surfing Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Whoops! Don’t tell me I snagged a Surfing Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Ops! Non dirmi che ho abboccato a
un Pokémon che fa Surf?

entries.original: "I can’t keep up!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t keep up!
entries.translated: Non riesco a tenere il passo!

entries.original:
"It’d be a handful if I hooked
your tough Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: It’d be a handful if I hooked your tough Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Sarebbe un bel problema se
agganciassi il tuo Pokémon tosto!

entries.original:
"Perhaps that reek is your sweaty
Pokémon’s body odor\."
entries.translation_source: Perhaps that reek is your sweaty Pokémon’s body odor[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Forse quella puzza è l{B4}odore
corporeo del tuo Pokémon sudato\.

entries.original:
"We’re standing on top of the
KBT Expressway!"
entries.translation_source: We’re standing on top of the KBT Expressway!
entries.translated: Siamo sopra la KBT Expressway!

entries.original:
"Can you feel the people moving
below us?"
entries.translation_source: Can you feel the people moving below us?
entries.translated:
Riesci a sentire la gente muoversi
sotto di noi?

entries.original:
"This section of the KBT Expressway
runs from Crater Town to Tehl Town."
entries.translation_source: This section of the KBT Expressway runs from Crater Town to Tehl Town.
entries.translated:
Questo tratto della KBT Expressway
va da Crater Town a Tehl Town.

entries.original:
"If 100 people as big as me stood
here, do you think the ground\lcould support the weight?"
entries.translation_source: If 100 people as big as me stood here, do you think the ground could support the weight?
entries.translated:
Se 100 persone grandi come me
stessero qui, pensi che il terreno\lreggerebbe il peso?

entries.original: "Route 15"
entries.translation_source: Route 15
entries.translated: Percorso 15

entries.original:
"Are you crazy!?

Don’t you know it’s dangerous to
swim in a thunderstorm?

\.\CC0820Us?

We’re part Ground-type!
We can’t be shocked!"
entries.translation_source: Are you crazy!? Don’t you know it’s dangerous to swim in a thunderstorm? [game-token-1][control-code-2]Us? We’re part Ground-type! We can’t be shocked!
entries.translated:
Sei fuori di testa!? Non sai che è
pericoloso nuotare durante un\ltemporale? \.\CC0820Noi? Siamo di tipo

Terra! Non possiamo essere
folgorati!

entries.original:
"Oh, dear\.

You’d best be careful swimming in
this weather!

This is no natural thunderstorm,
you see.

Something ominous is causing
the downpour."
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear[game-token-1] You’d best be careful swimming in this weather! This is no natural thunderstorm, you see. Something ominous is causing the downpour.
entries.translated:
Accidenti\. Faresti bene a fare
attenzione a nuotare con questo\ltempo! Non si tratta di un normale

temporale, vedi. Qualcosa di
sinistro sta causando il diluvio.

entries.original:
"The strange thunderstorm from
before is over now!

Why did it suddenly end?"
entries.translation_source: The strange thunderstorm from before is over now! Why did it suddenly end?
entries.translated:
Il temporale strano di prima è
finito adesso! Perché si è\linterrotto all{B4}improvviso?

entries.original: "It ended as suddenly as our battle!"
entries.translation_source: It ended as suddenly as our battle!
entries.translated:
È finita all{B4}improvviso come la
nostra lotta!

entries.original:
"What could have caused a
thunderstorm that powerful?

I know of the Ability [green]Drizzle[red], but
that was something else.

The rain was almost\.\CC0820 primordial\."
entries.translation_source: What could have caused a thunderstorm that powerful? I know of the Ability [color-green-1]Drizzle[color-red-2], but that was something else. The rain was almost[game-token-3][control-code-4] primordial[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Cosa può aver causato un temporale
così potente? Conosco l{B4}abilità\l[green]Piovischio[red], ma quella era un{B4}altra

cosa. La pioggia era quasi\.\CC0820
primordiale\.

entries.original:
"Thunderstorms don’t actually have
an effect on fishing.

But [green]Sweet Scent[blue]\.

That can’t be used if the weather
isn’t clear."
entries.translation_source: Thunderstorms don’t actually have an effect on fishing. But [color-green-1]Sweet Scent[color-blue-2][game-token-3] That can’t be used if the weather isn’t clear.
entries.translated:
I temporali in realtà non hanno
effetto sulla pesca. Ma [green]Profumino[blue]\.\lQuella non si può usare se il tempo

non è sereno.

entries.original: "Route 16"
entries.translation_source: Route 16
entries.translated: Percorso 16

entries.original: "Route 16 - 17"
entries.translation_source: Route 16 - 17
entries.translated: Percorso 16 - 17

entries.original: "[black]Something unseeable is in the way."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Something unseeable is in the way.
entries.translated:
[black]C{B4}è qualcosa di invisibile che
impedisce il passaggio.

entries.original:
"Move, kid!

You’re blockin’ the road!"
entries.translation_source: Move, kid! You’re blockin’ the road!
entries.translated:
Spostati, ragazzino! Stai bloccando
la strada!

entries.original:
"Huh?

There’s somethin’ in the way?

It better not be that pesky
Pokémon, again\."
entries.translation_source: Huh? There’s somethin’ in the way? It better not be that pesky Pokémon, again[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Eh? C{B4}è qualcosa che ostruisce il
passaggio? Spero proprio che non\lsia di nuovo quel fastidioso

Pokémon\.

entries.original:
"Take this.

If my hunch is right, it’ll get rid
of whatever’s blockin’ the road."
entries.translation_source: Take this. If my hunch is right, it’ll get rid of whatever’s blockin’ the road.
entries.translated:
Prendi questo. Se il mio intuito è
giusto, farà sparire qualunque cosa\lstia bloccando la strada.

entries.original:
"If my hunch is right, that item
should show you exactly what’s\lblockin’ the road."
entries.translation_source: If my hunch is right, that item should show you exactly what’s blockin’ the road.
entries.translated:
Se il mio intuito è giusto,
quell{B4}oggetto dovrebbe mostrarti\lesattamente cosa blocca la strada.

entries.original:
"[black]Something unseeable is in the way.

Use the Devon Scope?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Something unseeable is in the way. Use the Devon Scope?
entries.translated:
[black]Qualcosa d{B4}invisibile ostruisce il
passaggio. Usare il Devon Scope?

entries.original: "[black][player] used the Devon Scope."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] used the Devon Scope.
entries.translated: [black][player] ha usato il Visore Devon.

entries.original:
"[black]An invisible Pokémon became
completely visible!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]An invisible Pokémon became completely visible!
entries.translated:
[black]Un Pokémon invisibile è diventato
completamente visibile!

entries.original: "[black]The startled Pokémon took off!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The startled Pokémon took off!
entries.translated: [black]Il Pokémon spaventato è scappato!

entries.original:
"Hmph.

Seems like you’re a more
intimidatin’ Trainer than you let on\.

Say\. you should take on the Antisis
Gym with your Pokémon.

I hear the Gym Leader there has
been pretty bored lately."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. Seems like you’re a more intimidatin’ Trainer than you let on[game-token-1] Say[game-token-2] you should take on the Antisis Gym with your Pokémon. I hear the Gym Leader there has been pretty bored lately.
entries.translated:
Hmph. Sembra che tu sia un
Allenatore più intimidatorio di\lquanto lasci intendere\. Sai\. dovresti

affrontare la Palestra di Antisis
con i tuoi Pokémon. Ho sentito dire\lche il Capopalestra lì si annoia

parecchio ultimamente.

entries.original: "[black]The startled Pokémon attacked!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The startled Pokémon attacked!
entries.translated: [black]Il Pokémon spaventato ha attaccato!

entries.original: "[black][buffer1] took off!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2] took off!
entries.translated: [black][buffer1] è decollato!

entries.original:
"Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun,
please shine down on me\."
entries.translation_source: Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun, please shine down on me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh signor Sole, Sole, signor Sole
d{B4}Oro, per favore splendi su di me\.

entries.original:
"Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun,
has shone down on me\."
entries.translation_source: Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun, has shone down on me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh Signor Sole, Sole, Signor Sole
d{B4}Oro, ha brillato su di me\.

entries.original:
"Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun,
it’s now time to leave\."
entries.translation_source: Oh Mr. Sun, Sun, Mr. Golden Sun, it’s now time to leave[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh Signor Sole, Sole, Signor Sole
Dorato, è ora di andare via\.

entries.original:
"I get my kicks by harassing people
with my stinking Pokémon.

They’re great for startling people.
And, they bite, too."
entries.translation_source: I get my kicks by harassing people with my stinking Pokémon. They’re great for startling people. And, they bite, too.
entries.translated:
Mi diverto a tormentare la gente
con i miei Pokémon puzzolenti. Sono\lottimi per spaventare le persone. E

mordono anche.

entries.original:
"Leaving so soon?

There’s an exit toll to pay!"
entries.translation_source: Leaving so soon? There’s an exit toll to pay!
entries.translated:
Vai già via? C{B4}è un pedaggio da
pagare per uscire!

entries.original: "You took my money!"
entries.translation_source: You took my money!
entries.translated: Hai preso i miei soldi!

entries.original:
"Forget it!
I don’t need your money!"
entries.translation_source: Forget it! I don’t need your money!
entries.translated:
Lascia stare! Non ho bisogno dei
tuoi soldi!

entries.original:
"If you don’t know how, I’m willing
to show you how to swim."
entries.translation_source: If you don’t know how, I’m willing to show you how to swim.
entries.translated:
Se non sai come si fa, sono
disposto a insegnarti a nuotare.

entries.original:
"My favourite kind of guy is someone
that looks good out in the sea!"
entries.translation_source: My favourite kind of guy is someone that looks good out in the sea!
entries.translated:
Il mio tipo di ragazzo preferito è
uno che sta bene in mare aperto!

entries.original: "The tide is going out\."
entries.translation_source: The tide is going out[game-token-1]
entries.translated: La marea sta ritirandosi\.

entries.original:
"Don’t get me wrong, it’s not as if
I don’t like mountain men.

But, you know, my favourite kind of
guy looks great with Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t get me wrong, it’s not as if I don’t like mountain men. But, you know, my favourite kind of guy looks great with Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Non fraintendermi, non è che non mi
piacciano gli uomini di montagna.\lPerò, sai, il mio tipo ideale di

ragazzo sta benissimo con i
Pokémon!

entries.original:
"The bad men in Antisis City like to
harass people who get too close\lthe city."
entries.translation_source: The bad men in Antisis City like to harass people who get too close the city.
entries.translated:
I tipi loschi di Antisis City amano
molestare chi si avvicina troppo\lalla città.

entries.original:
"My dream’s a big one!

I want to battle every kind of
Pokémon from around the world!"
entries.translation_source: My dream’s a big one! I want to battle every kind of Pokémon from around the world!
entries.translated:
Il mio sogno è grande! Voglio
sfidare ogni tipo di Pokémon da\ltutto il mondo!

entries.original:
"I lost, but I am one step closer to
realizing my dream!"
entries.translation_source: I lost, but I am one step closer to realizing my dream!
entries.translated:
Ho perso, ma sono un passo più
vicino a realizzare il mio sogno!

entries.original:
"Listen, you! Whatever happens,
never lose sight of your dream!"
entries.translation_source: Listen, you! Whatever happens, never lose sight of your dream!
entries.translated:
Ascolta, tu! Qualunque cosa accada,
non perdere mai di vista il tuo\lsogno!

entries.original:
"Oh right\.
I was fishing, wasn’t I?"
entries.translation_source: Oh right[game-token-1] I was fishing, wasn’t I?
entries.translated: Ah già\. Stavo pescando, vero?

entries.original:
"I’d sensed the presence of a
Trainer for a while.

It was you!"
entries.translation_source: I’d sensed the presence of a Trainer for a while. It was you!
entries.translated:
Avevo percepito la presenza di un
Allenatore da un po{B4}. Eri tu!

entries.original:
"Defeating you will be no easy
matter."
entries.translation_source: Defeating you will be no easy matter.
entries.translated:
Sconfiggerti non sarà affatto
facile.

entries.original:
"Is it possible to become more
powerful by understanding Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Is it possible to become more powerful by understanding Pokémon?
entries.translated:
È possibile diventare più forti
comprendendo i Pokémon?

entries.original:
"My body isn’t naturally this good
looking!

My Pokémon and I exercise every
