day to keep our bodies fit."
entries.translation_source: My body isn’t naturally this good looking! My Pokémon and I exercise every day to keep our bodies fit.
entries.translated:
Il mio corpo non è naturalmente
così attraente! Io e i miei Pokémon\lci alleniamo ogni giorno per

mantenerci in forma.

entries.original: "Look at these magnificent wings!"
entries.translation_source: Look at these magnificent wings!
entries.translated: Guarda queste ali magnifiche!

entries.original: "I’m going to peck you for that!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to peck you for that!
entries.translated: Ti becco per questo!

entries.original:
"Did you know that one of my bird
Pokémon can mimic speech?"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that one of my bird Pokémon can mimic speech?
entries.translated:
Lo sapevi che uno dei miei Pokémon
uccello sa imitare la voce?

entries.original:
"I came here in hopes of bringing
new life into the area."
entries.translation_source: I came here in hopes of bringing new life into the area.
entries.translated:
Sono venuto qui sperando di portare
nuova vita in questa zona.

entries.original: "Route 17"
entries.translation_source: Route 17
entries.translated: Percorso 17

entries.original:
"Oh, geez\.
Another Trainer\.

Well, here you go."
entries.translation_source: Oh, geez[game-token-1] Another Trainer[game-token-2] Well, here you go.
entries.translated:
Oh, cavolo\. Un altro Allenatore\. Ecco
a te.

entries.original:
"I’ve been instructed by my
superiors to hand out that HM to\lany Trainers coming this way.

Until the bridge is fixed, you’ll
need to use that HM for [green]Rock Climb[blue]\lif you want to go to [green]Seaport City[blue].

Just face that rock wall over
there to use it."
entries.translation_source: I’ve been instructed by my superiors to hand out that HM to any Trainers coming this way. Until the bridge is fixed, you’ll need to use that HM for [color-green-1]Rock Climb[color-blue-2] if you want to go to [color-green-3]Seaport City[color-blue-4]. Just face that rock wall over there to use it.
entries.translated:
Ho ricevuto l{B4}ordine dai miei
superiori di consegnare quella MN a\ltutti gli Allenatori che passano di

qui. Finché il ponte non sarà
riparato, dovrai usare quella MN\lper [green]Rock Climb[blue] se vuoi andare a

[green]Seaport City[blue]. Ti basta metterti di
fronte a quella parete rocciosa\llaggiù per usarla.

entries.original:
"Sorry, kid!

A fight between some Zangoose and
Seviper took out the bridge.

It’ll take some time before we get
it fixed.

You should talk to our boss about
finding an alternative way to\lSeaport City in the meantime."
entries.translation_source: Sorry, kid! A fight between some Zangoose and Seviper took out the bridge. It’ll take some time before we get it fixed. You should talk to our boss about finding an alternative way to Seaport City in the meantime.
entries.translated:
Scusa, ragazzino! Una lotta tra
alcuni Zangoose e Seviper ha\ldistrutto il ponte. Ci vorrà un po{B4}

prima che lo ripariamo. Dovresti
parlare con il nostro capo per\ltrovare un percorso alternativo per

Seaport City nel frattempo.

entries.original: "It’s a seashell."
entries.translation_source: It’s a seashell.
entries.translated: È una conchiglia.

entries.original: "[green]Derrrr!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Derrrr!
entries.translated: [green]Derrrr!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] receded into the
sand."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] receded into the sand.
entries.translated:
Il [buffer1] si è ritirato nella
sabbia.

entries.original:
"He ho!
You thaved me!

I wath looking for Berrieth on behalf
of Tropiuth Berrieth Inc., when all\lof a thudden theth boulderth fell\ldown around me!

But you rethcued me, tho now I can
go home for the day!

Becauth of your heroic efforth, I
want you to take thome Berrieth!"
entries.translation_source: He ho! You thaved me! I wath looking for Berrieth on behalf of Tropiuth Berrieth Inc., when all of a thudden theth boulderth fell down around me! But you rethcued me, tho now I can go home for the day! Becauth of your heroic efforth, I want you to take thome Berrieth!
entries.translated:
Ehi ho! Mi hai thalvato! Stavo
cercando Berrieth per conto della\lTropiuth Berrieth Inc., quando

all{B4}improvvito quegli thassi sono
caduti tutt{B4}intorno a me! Ma tu mi\lhai thalvato, quindi ora posso

tornare a casa per oggi! Grazie ai
tuoi eroici efforth, voglio che tu\lprenda delle Berrieth!

entries.original:
"He ho!

I’ll be back tomorrow to look for
more Berrieth!"
entries.translation_source: He ho! I’ll be back tomorrow to look for more Berrieth!
entries.translated:
He ho! Tornerò domani a cercare
altri Berrieth!

entries.original:
"I am an eloquent Bird Keeper.

I only partake in the finest of
aerial battles.

As such, I refuse to partake in
battles where Pokémon on the\lground are utilized.

Hearing that, would you care for a
[green]Sky Battle[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: I am an eloquent Bird Keeper. I only partake in the finest of aerial battles. As such, I refuse to partake in battles where Pokémon on the ground are utilized. Hearing that, would you care for a [color-green-1]Sky Battle[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Sono un elegante Collezione di
Uccelli. Prendo parte solo alle\lbattaglie aeree più raffinate.

Perciò mi rifiuto di partecipare a
battaglie in cui vengono usati\lPokémon a terra. Sentendo questo,

ti andrebbe una [green]Sfida Aerea[blue]?

entries.original:
"Unfortunately for you, I also require
the defeat of all Trainers on this\lroute before I will battle you.

Please return once you have done so,
and then we can begin our eloquent\laerial battle!"
entries.translation_source: Unfortunately for you, I also require the defeat of all Trainers on this route before I will battle you. Please return once you have done so, and then we can begin our eloquent aerial battle!
entries.translated:
Sfortunatamente per te, prima di
poterti sfidare devo anche\lsconfiggere tutti gli Allenatori su

questa rotta. Per favore torna
quando avrai finito, e allora\lpotremo iniziare la nostra

eloquente battaglia aerea!

entries.original:
"Today appears to be my lucky day.
Let us battle!"
entries.translation_source: Today appears to be my lucky day. Let us battle!
entries.translated:
Oggi sembra proprio il mio giorno
fortunato. Combattiamo!

entries.original:
"A shame.
That is indeed unfortunate."
entries.translation_source: A shame. That is indeed unfortunate.
entries.translated: Che peccato. È davvero sfortunato.

entries.original:
"You have no Pokémon I would be
willing to fight.

Only [green]Flying[blue]-type Pokémon or
Pokémon with the [green]Levitate[blue] ability\lmay battle with my Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You have no Pokémon I would be willing to fight. Only [color-green-1]Flying[color-blue-2]-type Pokémon or Pokémon with the [color-green-3]Levitate[color-blue-4] ability may battle with my Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Non hai Pokémon con cui sarei
disposto a combattere. Solo Pokémon\ldi tipo [green]Volante[blue] o Pokémon con

l{B4}abilità [green]Levitazione[blue] possono
combattere con i miei Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Our aerial battle brought such joy
to my heart.

Please, take this Mega Stone for the
Pokémon [green]Pidgeot[blue] as a show of my\lgratitude!"
entries.translation_source: Our aerial battle brought such joy to my heart. Please, take this Mega Stone for the Pokémon [color-green-1]Pidgeot[color-blue-2] as a show of my gratitude!
entries.translated:
Il nostro duello aereo ha portato
tanta gioia al mio cuore. Per\lfavore, prendi questa Megapietra

per il Pokémon [green]Pidgeot[blue] come segno
della mia gratitudine!

entries.original:
"Our aerial battle brought such joy
to my heart.

Please, take these Wings as a show
of my gratitude!"
entries.translation_source: Our aerial battle brought such joy to my heart. Please, take these Wings as a show of my gratitude!
entries.translated:
Il nostro combattimento aereo ha
riempito di gioia il mio cuore. Ti\lprego, prendi queste Ali come segno

della mia gratitudine!

entries.original:
"A shame.
You don’t have space for any wings."
entries.translation_source: A shame. You don’t have space for any wings.
entries.translated:
Che peccato. Non hai spazio per
altre Ali.

entries.original:
"Our aerial battle filled me with
so much joy!

Let us do it again tomorrow."
entries.translation_source: Our aerial battle filled me with so much joy! Let us do it again tomorrow.
entries.translated:
La nostra lotta aerea mi ha
riempito di gioia! Facciamolo di\lnuovo domani.

entries.original:
"I try not to leave the area so my
fishing chain will grow as long as\lpossible."
entries.translation_source: I try not to leave the area so my fishing chain will grow as long as possible.
entries.translated:
Cerco di non allontanarmi dall{B4}area
così la mia catena di pesca\lcrescerà il più a lungo possibile.

entries.original:
"Most of my friends came to Seaport
City from far away regions."
entries.translation_source: Most of my friends came to Seaport City from far away regions.
entries.translated:
La maggior parte dei miei amici è
venuta a Seaport City da regioni\llontane.

entries.original:
"But then most of my friends went
back to where they came from\."
entries.translation_source: But then most of my friends went back to where they came from[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ma poi la maggior parte dei miei
amici è tornata nel posto da cui\lproveniva\.

entries.original:
"Actually, that guy over there is my
only friend now\."
entries.translation_source: Actually, that guy over there is my only friend now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
A dire il vero, quel tipo laggiù è
il mio unico amico ormai\.

entries.original:
"I should go back home.

There was much more variety in
watery areas where I came from."
entries.translation_source: I should go back home. There was much more variety in watery areas where I came from.
entries.translated:
Dovrei tornare a casa. Da dove
vengo io, le zone d{B4}acqua erano\lmolto più varie.

entries.original:
"Notice the cliffs here\.

This is the only place in Borrius
where they’re this vertical!"
entries.translation_source: Notice the cliffs here[game-token-1] This is the only place in Borrius where they’re this vertical!
entries.translated:
Guarda queste scogliere qui\. questo
è l{B4}unico posto a Borrius in cui\lsono così ripide!

entries.original: "All the more fun to climb!"
entries.translation_source: All the more fun to climb!
entries.translated: Ancora più divertente da scalare!

entries.original:
"When I climb down the bluffs, I
find very interesting things hidden\lin the seashells on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: When I climb down the bluffs, I find very interesting things hidden in the seashells on the beach!
entries.translated:
Quando scendo dalle scogliere,
trovo cose molto interessanti\lnascoste nelle conchiglie sulla

spiaggia!

entries.original:
"Finding rare Pokémon is much
easier if you have a DexNav.

As long as you’ve seen the
Pokémon, it’s very easy to\lencounter it again!"
entries.translation_source: Finding rare Pokémon is much easier if you have a DexNav. As long as you’ve seen the Pokémon, it’s very easy to encounter it again!
entries.translated:
Trovare Pokémon rari è molto più
facile se hai un DexNav. Finché hai\lgià visto il Pokémon, è facilissimo

incontrarlo di nuovo!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon and I have been
running across Borrius.

We can take a kid Trainer like you!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon and I have been running across Borrius. We can take a kid Trainer like you!
entries.translated:
I miei Pokémon e io abbiamo girato
in lungo e in largo Borrius.\lPossiamo battere un giovane

Allenatore come te!

entries.original:
"I guess we need to run less and
train more\."
entries.translation_source: I guess we need to run less and train more[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Immagino che dobbiamo correre meno
e allenarci di più\..

entries.original:
"Huff\. Puff\.

Jogging and battling make a tiring
combo!"
entries.translation_source: Huff[game-token-1] Puff[game-token-2] Jogging and battling make a tiring combo!
entries.translated:
Uff\. Uff\. Fare jogging e lottare è un
mix stancante!

entries.original:
"I trained my Zangoose and Seviper
to play together nicely!"
entries.translation_source: I trained my Zangoose and Seviper to play together nicely!
entries.translated:
Ho allenato il mio Zangoose e il
mio Seviper a giocare insieme senza\llitigare!

entries.original:
"Huh?
What’s that?

You say there are no Bug Pokémon
around here?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? What’s that? You say there are no Bug Pokémon around here?
entries.translated:
Eh? Cos{B4}è quello? Dici che qui non
ci sono Pokémon Coleottero?

entries.original:
"Huh?
What’s that?

Then where’d I get my Bug Pokémon
from?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? What’s that? Then where’d I get my Bug Pokémon from?
entries.translated:
Eh? Cos{B4}è quello? Allora da dove
avrei preso i miei Pokémon\lColeottero?

entries.original:
"I know there are bug Pokémon
around here!

There was one day I saw a huge
[green]swarm[blue] of them flying around!"
entries.translation_source: I know there are bug Pokémon around here! There was one day I saw a huge [color-green-1]swarm[color-blue-2] of them flying around!
entries.translated:
So che qui in giro ci sono Pokémon
Coleottero! Un giorno ne vidi\lvolare in giro un enorme [green]sciame[blue]!

entries.original:
"One day, my babies will use a
powerful Return and beat you up\lfor what you did to them!"
entries.translation_source: One day, my babies will use a powerful Return and beat you up for what you did to them!
entries.translated:
Un giorno, i miei piccoli useranno
un potente Ritorno e ti faranno\lpagare per quello che hai fatto

loro!

entries.original: "Route 18"
entries.translation_source: Route 18
entries.translated: Percorso 18

entries.original:
"Let’s have a race!

Let’s see who can get to the
Pokémon League first!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s have a race! Let’s see who can get to the Pokémon League first!
entries.translated:
Facciamo una gara! Vediamo chi
arriva per primo alla Lega Pokémon!

entries.original:
"I’ve been swimming since I was a
wee tot, but nothing could have\lprepared me for this moment."
entries.translation_source: I’ve been swimming since I was a wee tot, but nothing could have prepared me for this moment.
entries.translated:
Nuoto da quando ero un marmocchio,
ma niente avrebbe potuto prepararmi\la questo momento.

entries.original: "It was the moment I met you!"
entries.translation_source: It was the moment I met you!
entries.translated:
È stato il momento in cui ti ho
incontrato!

entries.original:
"Despite swimming since I was a wee
tot, I had never seen a Trainer\lriding on the back of a Pokémon\lbefore I battled you.

Which Pokémon is that you’re
Surfing on, anyway?

Is that a Wailmer?
It sure looks like one!"
entries.translation_source: Despite swimming since I was a wee tot, I had never seen a Trainer riding on the back of a Pokémon before I battled you. Which Pokémon is that you’re Surfing on, anyway? Is that a Wailmer? It sure looks like one!
entries.translated:
Nonostante nuoti da quando ero in
fasce, non avevo mai visto un\lAllenatore cavalcare sulla schiena

di un Pokémon prima di affrontarti.
Su quale Pokémon stai usando Surf,\lcomunque? È un Wailmer? Sembra

proprio di sì!

entries.original:
"I keep my Poké Balls in the
pockets of my swim trunks.

\.

What?
Expecting a different answer?"
entries.translation_source: I keep my Poké Balls in the pockets of my swim trunks. [game-token-1] What? Expecting a different answer?
entries.translated:
Conservo le mie Poké Ball nelle
tasche dei miei pantaloncini da\lbagno. \. Cosa? Ti aspettavi una

risposta diversa?

entries.original:
"Only the best swimmers can swim all
the way to the Pokémon League!"
entries.translation_source: Only the best swimmers can swim all the way to the Pokémon League!
entries.translated:
Solo i migliori nuotatori possono
nuotare fino alla Lega Pokémon!

entries.original: "You’re cheating!"
entries.translation_source: You’re cheating!
entries.translated: Stai barando!

entries.original:
"It defeats the purpose of swimming
across a long watery stretch if\lyour Pokémon does it for you!"
entries.translation_source: It defeats the purpose of swimming across a long watery stretch if your Pokémon does it for you!
entries.translated:
Non ha senso attraversare a nuoto
un lungo tratto d{B4}acqua se poi il\ltuo Pokémon lo fa per te!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon doesn’t know Sand-
Attack, but I can always help\lout using my psychic abilities!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon doesn’t know Sand- Attack, but I can always help out using my psychic abilities!
entries.translated:
Il mio Pokémon non conosce
Sand-Attack, ma posso sempre dare\luna mano usando le mie abilità

psichiche!

entries.original:
"You see that man on the other
beach?

He’s my rival!"
entries.translation_source: You see that man on the other beach? He’s my rival!
entries.translated:
Vedi quell{B4}uomo sull{B4}altra
spiaggia? È il mio rivale!

entries.original:
"We once fought together as the duo
named \qoThe Brain and the Brawn\qc."
entries.translation_source: We once fought together as the duo named [quote-open-1]The Brain and the Brawn[quote-close-2].
entries.translated:
Un tempo combattevamo insieme come
il duo chiamato \qoThe Brain and the\lBrawn\qc.

entries.original:
"Maybe someday I, the brawn, will
reunite with my old friend, the\lbrain."
entries.translation_source: Maybe someday I, the brawn, will reunite with my old friend, the brain.
entries.translated:
Forse un giorno io, i muscoli, mi
riunirò con il mio vecchio amico,\lil cervello.

entries.original:
"I trained with Tessy!

She taught me how to
climb Waterfalls!"
entries.translation_source: I trained with Tessy! She taught me how to climb Waterfalls!
entries.translated:
Mi sono allenato con Tessy! Mi ha
insegnato a usare Cascata!

entries.original: "Those were the days\."
entries.translation_source: Those were the days[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Erano i bei tempi\.

entries.original:
"Tessy’s the Water-type Gym Leader
in East Borrius.

If you defeat her, your Pokémon
gain the skill to scale waterfalls."
entries.translation_source: Tessy’s the Water-type Gym Leader in East Borrius. If you defeat her, your Pokémon gain the skill to scale waterfalls.
entries.translated:
Tessy è la Capopalestra di tipo
Acqua di East Borrius. Se la\lsconfiggi, i tuoi Pokémon

acquisiranno l{B4}abilità di risalire
le cascate.

entries.original:
"Tessy’s the Water-type Gym Leader
in East Borrius.

If you defeat her, your Pokémon
gain the skill to scale waterfalls.

But you already knew that,
didn’t you?"
entries.translation_source: Tessy’s the Water-type Gym Leader in East Borrius. If you defeat her, your Pokémon gain the skill to scale waterfalls. But you already knew that, didn’t you?
entries.translated:
Tessy è la Capopalestra di tipo
Acqua di East Borrius. Se la\lsconfiggi, i tuoi Pokémon imparano

già, vero?

here is the best spot for fishing\lin all of Borrius!"

Può non sembrare, ma questo posto
qui è il migliore per pescare in\ltutto Borrius!

of Cinder Volcano all day\."

Entrambi i miei amici mi danno del

dal Vulcano Cinder\.

Sembra che mi servirà più della mia
fidata Canna per diventare il\lCampione di Borrius\.

entries.original:
"Ptui!

Ugh, I hate sand, it’s coarse,
rough, and irritating.

And it gets everywhere!"

entries.translated:
Ptt! Ugh, odio la sabbia, è ruvida,
grezza e irritante. E si infila\ldappertutto!

Nascondendomi nella sabbia tutto il

Superquattro!

Diretto alla Via Vittoria, eh?

Solo io dovrei essere autorizzato a

La Via Vittoria non è per i deboli

puzzle di ghiaccio\.

Come un vero membro della famiglia

\.

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

Beh, t{B4}assicuro che sbagli di
grosso! Ho appena preso questi\lsoldi proprio da quest{B4}albero qui!

"[black][player] received $[buffer1] from

[black][player] ha ricevuto $[buffer1]

Quest{B4}albero produce soldi solo una

entries.original:
"Oh\.
Ya already knew\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] Ya already knew[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Lo sapevi già\.

"Only those who have acquired all
eight of Borrius’ Gym Badges may\lpass through this point."

entries.translated:
Solo coloro che hanno ottenuto
tutte e otto le Medaglie Palestra\ldi Borrius possono passare da

questo punto.

entries.original:
"\.

You may pass."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] You may pass.
entries.translated: \. Puoi passare.

"Past this point lies the entrance
to Victory Road.

It is the final hurdle Trainers
must overcome if they wish to\lchallenge the Elite Four for a\lchance to become Borrius’ Champion."
entries.translation_source: Past this point lies the entrance to Victory Road. It is the final hurdle Trainers must overcome if they wish to challenge the Elite Four for a chance to become Borrius’ Champion.

Oltre questo punto si trova
l{B4}ingresso della Via Vittoria. È\ll{B4}ultimo ostacolo che gli

Allenatori devono superare se
vogliono sfidare i Superquattro per\lavere la possibilità di diventare

il Campione di Borrius.

entries.original: "Hero of the Hall"
entries.translation_source: Hero of the Hall
entries.translated: Eroe dell{B4}Albo

entries.original:
"Become a grand Champion! Enter the
Hall of Fame with monotype teams."
entries.translation_source: Become a grand Champion! Enter the Hall of Fame with monotype teams.
entries.translated:
Diventa un grande Campione! Entra
nella Hall of Fame con squadre\lmonotipo.

entries.original:
"Do you know about the
Hall of Fame?

It’s the place where you go if you
defeat the Pokémon League!

At one point, the old Champion,
Artie had been there so many times,\lhe decided to set a goal of going\lthere with every team consisting\lof a common type.

Sadly, he never did reach his goal,
and only ever entered with monotype\lteams for 17 out of the 18 types.

Maybe you want to take up the
challenge instead?"
entries.translation_source: Do you know about the Hall of Fame? It’s the place where you go if you defeat the Pokémon League! At one point, the old Champion, Artie had been there so many times, he decided to set a goal of going there with every team consisting of a common type. Sadly, he never did reach his goal, and only ever entered with monotype teams for 17 out of the 18 types. Maybe you want to take up the challenge instead?
entries.translated:
Conosci la Hall of Fame? È il posto
in cui vai se sconfiggi la Lega\lPokémon! A un certo punto, il

vecchio Campione, Artie c{B4}era stato
così tante volte che decise di\lporsi l{B4}obiettivo di andarci con

ogni squadra composta da un tipo
comune. Purtroppo, non raggiunse\lmai il suo obiettivo, ed entrò solo

con squadre monotipo per 17 dei 18
tipi. Forse vuoi raccogliere tu la\lsfida?

entries.original:
"You’re taking up the challenge?
Sweet!

Bring on those victories!

There are [green]18[blue] types in total, and
you’ll need to enter the Hall of\lFame with teams for each one.

Oh, and keep this in mind: if you
Mega Evolve a Pokémon, both the\lbase species and Mega species will\lcount towards the team type.

So, let’s say you want to use a
Mega Gyarados.

In addition to a Water-type team,
you could use it on both Flying-\land Dark-type teams!"
entries.translation_source: You’re taking up the challenge? Sweet! Bring on those victories! There are [color-green-1]18[color-blue-2] types in total, and you’ll need to enter the Hall of Fame with teams for each one. Oh, and keep this in mind: if you Mega Evolve a Pokémon, both the base species and Mega species will count towards the team type. So, let’s say you want to use a Mega Gyarados. In addition to a Water-type team, you could use it on both Flying- and Dark-type teams!
entries.translated:
Accetti la sfida? Figo! Porta a
casa quelle vittorie! Ci sono [green]18[blue]\ltipi in totale, e dovrai entrare

nella Hall of Fame con squadre per
ognuno. Oh, e tieni a mente questo:\lse fai megaevolvere un Pokémon, sia

la specie base che la specie Mega
conteranno per il tipo della\lsquadra. Quindi, diciamo che vuoi

usare un Mega Gyarados. Oltre a una
squadra di tipo Acqua, potresti\lusarlo sia in squadre di tipo

Volante che Buio!

entries.original:
"Then I guess Artie will always
reign as the ultimate Champion!"
entries.translation_source: Then I guess Artie will always reign as the ultimate Champion!
entries.translated:
Allora immagino che Artie regnerà
per sempre come Campione supremo!

"It looks like the number of your
monotype Hall of Fame entries is\lonly [green][buffer2][blue].

You still need to get in there with
[green][buffer3][blue] more type\\08 to pass Artie’s\lrecord, so get battling!

Oh, and keep this in mind: if you
Mega Evolve a Pokémon, both the\lbase species and Mega species will\lcount towards the team type.

So, let’s say you want to use a
Mega Gyarados.

In addition to a Water-type team,
you could use it on both Flying-\land Dark-type teams!"
entries.translation_source: It looks like the number of your monotype Hall of Fame entries is only [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3]. You still need to get in there with [color-green-4][buffer3-5][color-blue-6] more type[raw-escape-7] to pass Artie’s record, so get battling! Oh, and keep this in mind: if you Mega Evolve a Pokémon, both the base species and Mega species will count towards the team type. So, let’s say you want to use a Mega Gyarados. In addition to a Water-type team, you could use it on both Flying- and Dark-type teams!
entries.translated:
Sembra che il numero delle tue
iscrizioni alla Hall of Fame\lmonotipo sia solo [green][buffer2][blue]. Devi

ancora entrarci con [green][buffer3][blue] altro
tipo\\\\08 per battere il record di\lArtie, quindi mettiti a lottare!

Oh, e tieni a mente: se dai a un
Pokémon una Megaevoluzione, sia la\lspecie base che la specie Mega

verranno considerate per il tipo
della squadra. Quindi, diciamo che\lvuoi usare un Mega Gyarados. Oltre

a una squadra di tipo Acqua,
potresti usarlo sia su squadre di\ltipo Volante che di tipo Buio!

Take this humble offering, oh
mighty Champion."

\.Cosa!? Hai superato il record di

Campione.

entries.original:
"What’s that?

A Youngster just isn’t the kind

I’ll take that bet!

You’ll be seeing me in the
Champion’s room someday!

I guarantee it!"

entries.translated:
Come, scusa? Un Ragazzino non è il
tipo che sfiderebbe la Lega\lPokémon? Accetto la scommessa! Un

giorno mi vedrai nella stanza del
Campione! Te lo garantisco!

entries.original: "Route 2"
entries.translation_source: Route 2
entries.translated: Percorso 2

entries.original:
"You came down from the mountain?
You must be exhausted.

Let me take care of your Pokémon
for you."
entries.translation_source: You came down from the mountain? You must be exhausted. Let me take care of your Pokémon for you.
entries.translated:
Sei sceso dalla montagna? Devi
essere esausto. Lascia che mi\lprenda cura dei tuoi Pokémon.

entries.original:
"If you’re in a hurry, the Psychic
over there can teleport you to\lDresco Town - the next town over.

Even if you decide to take him up
on his offer, it’s never a bad idea\lto be fully healed!"
entries.translation_source: If you’re in a hurry, the Psychic over there can teleport you to Dresco Town - the next town over. Even if you decide to take him up on his offer, it’s never a bad idea to be fully healed!
entries.translated:
Se hai fretta, il Sensitivo laggiù
può teletrasportarti a Dresco Town\l- la città successiva. Anche se

decidi di accettare la sua offerta,
non fa mai male essere\lcompletamente guariti!

entries.original: "[green]Cleeeeewoo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Cleeeeewoo!
entries.translated: [green]Cleeeeewoo!

entries.original:
"Hey, kid!
Listen up.

The road up ahead is fraught with
Trainers wanting to battle.

Some people have even dubbed it
\qoChallenge Road\qc.

But hey, I understand if you don’t
want to battle them.

So, using my amazing psychic
powers, I can teleport you to the\lother side for free!

What do you say, are you in?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, kid! Listen up. The road up ahead is fraught with Trainers wanting to battle. Some people have even dubbed it [quote-open-1]Challenge Road[quote-close-2]. But hey, I understand if you don’t want to battle them. So, using my amazing psychic powers, I can teleport you to the other side for free! What do you say, are you in?
entries.translated:
Ehi, ragazzino! Ascolta. La strada
più avanti è piena di Allenatori\lche vogliono combattere. Alcuni

l{B4}hanno persino soprannominata
\qoChallenge Road\qc. Ma ehi, capisco\lse non vuoi affrontarli. Quindi,

usando i miei incredibili poteri
psichici, posso teletrasportarti\ldall{B4}altra parte gratis! Che ne

dici, ci stai?

entries.original:
"What do you say, should I teleport
you to Dresco Town?"
entries.translation_source: What do you say, should I teleport you to Dresco Town?
entries.translated:
Che ne dici, vuoi che ti
teletrasporti a Dresco Town?

entries.original:
"Here we go!

Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!"
entries.translation_source: Here we go! Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!
entries.translated: Eccoci! Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!

entries.original:
"If you change your mind let
me know."
entries.translation_source: If you change your mind let me know.
entries.translated: Se cambi idea, fammelo sapere.

entries.original:
"Listen, pal, you’re on Challenge
Road to train, yeah?"
entries.translation_source: Listen, pal, you’re on Challenge Road to train, yeah?
entries.translated:
Senti, amico, sei sulla Challenge
Road per allenarti, giusto?

entries.original: "Oh, my bad, just ignore me then."
entries.translation_source: Oh, my bad, just ignore me then.
entries.translated: Oh, scusa, allora ignorami pure.

entries.original:
"I thought so!

I can tell you’re a Trainer burning
with fiery passion.

Well, I have this Pokémon here.

It’d be perfect for a Trainer
like you.

Why don’t you defeat all of the
Trainers on Challenge Road and\lthen come back here?

I’ll give it to you then, so make
sure you have space in your party!"
entries.translation_source: I thought so! I can tell you’re a Trainer burning with fiery passion. Well, I have this Pokémon here. It’d be perfect for a Trainer like you. Why don’t you defeat all of the Trainers on Challenge Road and then come back here? I’ll give it to you then, so make sure you have space in your party!
entries.translated:
Lo immaginavo! Si vede che sei un
Allenatore che arde di ardente\lpassione. Ebbene, qui ho questo

Pokémon. Sarebbe perfetto per un
Allenatore come te. Perché non\lsconfiggi tutti gli Allenatori

sulla Challenge Road e poi torni
qui? Te lo darò allora, quindi\lassicurati di avere spazio in

squadra!

entries.original:
"I thought so!

I can tell you’re a Trainer burning
with fiery passion.

Well, since you’ve defeated all of
the Trainers on this road, I’d say\lyou earned this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I thought so! I can tell you’re a Trainer burning with fiery passion. Well, since you’ve defeated all of the Trainers on this road, I’d say you earned this Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Lo immaginavo! Vedo che sei un
Allenatore che brucia di passione.\lBeh, dato che hai sconfitto tutti

gli Allenatori su questa strada,
direi che ti sei guadagnato questo\lPokémon.

entries.original:
"But make space in your party for it
first, yeah?"
entries.translation_source: But make space in your party for it first, yeah?
entries.translated:
Ma fai spazio nel tuo team per lui
prima, sì?

entries.original:
"Take care of that [buffer1],
yeah?

If you treat it well, it’ll keep
that fiery passion of yours alive\lfor sure!"
entries.translation_source: Take care of that [buffer1-1], yeah? If you treat it well, it’ll keep that fiery passion of yours alive for sure!
entries.translated:
Abbi cura di quel [buffer1],
d{B4}accordo? Se lo tratti bene, terrà\lviva di sicuro quella tua passione

ardente!

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s the Trainer burning with
fiery passion!

I bet the [buffer1] I gave you
before is doing great, yeah?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s the Trainer burning with fiery passion! I bet the [buffer1-1] I gave you before is doing great, yeah?
entries.translated:
Oh, è l{B4}Allenatore che arde di
ardente passione! Scommetto che il\l[buffer1] che ti ho dato prima

funziona alla grande, eh?

entries.original:
"[black]A mysterious ring is floating in
the air.

Something is visible deep in the
hole\.

Would you like to put your hand
deep in the hole?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]A mysterious ring is floating in the air. Something is visible deep in the hole[game-token-2] Would you like to put your hand deep in the hole?
entries.translated:
[black]Un misterioso anello fluttua
nell{B4}aria. Qualcosa è visibile in\lprofondità nel foro\. Vuoi infilare

la mano in profondità nel foro?

entries.original: "[black]The mysterious ring disappeared."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The mysterious ring disappeared.
entries.translated: [black]L{B4}anello misterioso è scomparso.

entries.original:
"Challenge Road is a place where
many Trainers come to practice."
entries.translation_source: Challenge Road is a place where many Trainers come to practice.
entries.translated:
Challenge Road è un luogo in cui
molti Allenatori vengono ad\lallenarsi.

entries.original:
"You’re taking up the challenge, eh?
I hope you healed up!"
entries.translation_source: You’re taking up the challenge, eh? I hope you healed up!
entries.translated:
Accetti la sfida, eh? Spero che ti
sia curato bene!

entries.original: "You’re decent."
entries.translation_source: You’re decent.
entries.translated: Non sei male.

entries.original:
"All Pokémon have weaknesses.
Even the strongest ones.

That’s why it’s best to raise
Pokémon of different types."
entries.translation_source: All Pokémon have weaknesses. Even the strongest ones. That’s why it’s best to raise Pokémon of different types.
entries.translated:
Tutti i Pokémon hanno debolezze.
Anche i più forti. Per questo è\lmeglio allevare Pokémon di tipi

diversi.

entries.original:
"Them [green]Yellow Poké Balls[blue] hold
items called Technical Machines.

These [green]TM[blue]s can be used to teach
your Pokémon moves as many times\las you want!"
entries.translation_source: Them [color-green-1]Yellow Poké Balls[color-blue-2] hold items called Technical Machines. These [color-green-3]TM[color-blue-4]s can be used to teach your Pokémon moves as many times as you want!
entries.translated:
Quelle [green]Poké Ball gialle[blue] contengono
oggetti chiamati Macchine Tecniche.\lQueste [green]MT[blue] possono essere usate per

insegnare mosse ai tuoi Pokémon
tutte le volte che vuoi!

entries.original:
"Did you know that moves can have
different categories?"
entries.translation_source: Did you know that moves can have different categories?
entries.translated:
Lo sapevi che le mosse possono
avere categorie diverse?

entries.original:
"These categories help determine
how your Pokémon uses its moves."
entries.translation_source: These categories help determine how your Pokémon uses its moves.
entries.translated:
Queste categorie aiutano a
determinare come il tuo Pokémon usa\lle sue mosse.

entries.original:
"A Pokémon’s moves can be physical
moves or special moves.

A high Attack stat makes physical
moves deal more damage, and a high\lSp. Atk stat makes special moves\ldeal more damage!"
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon’s moves can be physical moves or special moves. A high Attack stat makes physical moves deal more damage, and a high Sp. Atk stat makes special moves deal more damage!
entries.translated:
Le mosse di un Pokémon possono
essere mosse fisiche o mosse\lspeciali. Un alto valore di Attacco

fa infliggere più danni alle mosse
fisiche, e un alto valore di Att.\lSp. fa infliggere più danni alle

mosse speciali!

entries.original:
"Have you prepared your first two
Pokémon for this battle?"
entries.translation_source: Have you prepared your first two Pokémon for this battle?
entries.translated:
Hai preparato i tuoi primi due
Pokémon per questa lotta?

entries.original:
"Drat!
Kelsey took up my second slot!"
entries.translation_source: Drat! Kelsey took up my second slot!
entries.translated:
Dannazione! Kelsey ha preso il mio
secondo posto!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon you send out in a
Double Battle will be the Pokémon\lin the top row of your Party List.

If one of those two Pokémon has
fainted, the second Pokémon to\lbe sent out will come from the\lsecond row and so on!"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon you send out in a Double Battle will be the Pokémon in the top row of your Party List. If one of those two Pokémon has fainted, the second Pokémon to be sent out will come from the second row and so on!
entries.translated:
I Pokémon che mandi in campo in una
Lotta in doppio saranno i Pokémon\lnella riga superiore della tua

squadra. Se uno di quei due Pokémon
è svenuto, il secondo Pokémon a\lessere mandato in campo verrà dalla

seconda riga e così via!

entries.original:
"We’re a team!
We camp and battle together!

But we can’t battle you when you
only have one Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: We’re a team! We camp and battle together! But we can’t battle you when you only have one Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Siamo una squadra! Facciamo
campeggio e lottiamo insieme! Ma\lnon possiamo sfidarti quando hai

solo un Pokémon!

entries.original:
"We’re a team!
We battle and picnic together!"
entries.translation_source: We’re a team! We battle and picnic together!
entries.translated:
Siamo una squadra! Combattiamo e
facciamo picnic insieme!

entries.original:
"As long as I lose with Chad, the
outcome doesn’t matter to me!"
entries.translation_source: As long as I lose with Chad, the outcome doesn’t matter to me!
entries.translated:
Finché perdo con Chad, il risultato
non mi importa!

entries.original:
"A Pokémon that’s [green]Paralyzed[red] is
slower and might not be able to\lattack."
entries.translation_source: A Pokémon that’s [color-green-1]Paralyzed[color-red-2] is slower and might not be able to attack.
entries.translated:
Un Pokémon [green]paralizzato[red] è più lento
e potrebbe non riuscire ad\lattaccare.

entries.original:
"We’re a team!
We battle and picnic together!

But we can’t battle you when you
only have one Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: We’re a team! We battle and picnic together! But we can’t battle you when you only have one Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Siamo una squadra! Combattiamo e
facciamo picnic insieme! Ma non\lpossiamo combattere contro di te

quando hai solo un Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Pokémon with the Ability [green]Keen Eye[red]
can’t have their accuracy lowered.

They also ignore all changes to an
opponent’s evasiveness."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon with the Ability [color-green-1]Keen Eye[color-red-2] can’t have their accuracy lowered. They also ignore all changes to an opponent’s evasiveness.
entries.translated:
I Pokémon con l{B4}abilità
[green]Sguardofermo[red] non possono avere la\lprecisione ridotta. Ignorano anche

tutti i cambiamenti all{B4}elusione
dell{B4}avversario.

entries.original:
"How did this old Hiker get onto
this little piece of land?"
entries.translation_source: How did this old Hiker get onto this little piece of land?
entries.translated:
Come ha fatto questo vecchio
Escursionista a finire su questo\lpiccolo pezzo di terra?

entries.original: "I swam, of course!"
entries.translation_source: I swam, of course!
entries.translated: Ho nuotato, naturalmente!

entries.original:
"In some other regions, you can
buy a Bicycle that lets you hop up\lledges or move across water.

Unfortunately, the best you can
hope for with Borrius Bikes is to\lspeed your way up slippery slopes."
entries.translation_source: In some other regions, you can buy a Bicycle that lets you hop up ledges or move across water. Unfortunately, the best you can hope for with Borrius Bikes is to speed your way up slippery slopes.
entries.translated:
In alcune altre regioni, puoi
comprare una Bicicletta che ti\lpermette di saltare sopra i bordi

rialzati o di muoverti sull{B4}acqua.
Purtroppo, il massimo che puoi\lsperare con le Borrius Bikes è di

sfrecciare su per i pendii
scivolosi.

entries.original:
"We are the Crush Kin of Route 2!

We want to fight only the strongest
of Trainers!

If you defeat all of the Trainers
on Route 2 and Route 15, we will\lrecognize your strength, and then\lbattle you!"
entries.translation_source: We are the Crush Kin of Route 2! We want to fight only the strongest of Trainers! If you defeat all of the Trainers on Route 2 and Route 15, we will recognize your strength, and then battle you!
entries.translated:
Siamo i Crush Kin del Percorso 2!
Vogliamo combattere solo contro gli\lAllenatori più forti! Se sconfiggi

tutti gli Allenatori del Percorso 2
e del Percorso 15, riconosceremo la\ltua forza e poi combatteremo contro

di te!

entries.original:
"We are the Crush Kin of Route 2!

We want to fight only the strongest
of Trainers!

Show us what you’re made of!"
entries.translation_source: We are the Crush Kin of Route 2! We want to fight only the strongest of Trainers! Show us what you’re made of!
entries.translated:
Siamo i Crush Kin del Percorso 2!
Vogliamo combattere solo contro gli\lAllenatori più forti! Fatti valere!

entries.original: "You have proven your strength!"
entries.translation_source: You have proven your strength!
entries.translated: Hai dimostrato la tua forza!

entries.original:
"The strongest of Trainers deserve
items like this!"
entries.translation_source: The strongest of Trainers deserve items like this!
entries.translated:
I più forti tra gli Allenatori
meritano oggetti come questo!

entries.original:
"That Mega Stone is for [green]Lopunny[blue]!

When it Mega Evolves, it embraces
its true nature and becomes part\lFighting-type!"
entries.translation_source: That Mega Stone is for [color-green-1]Lopunny[color-blue-2]! When it Mega Evolves, it embraces its true nature and becomes part Fighting-type!
entries.translated:
Quella Mega Pietra è per [green]Lopunny[blue]!
Quando MegaEvolve, abbraccia la sua\lvera natura e diventa di tipo

Lotta!

entries.original:
"We are the Crush Kin of Route 2!

We want to fight only the strongest
of Trainers!

And the strongest of Trainers have
at least two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: We are the Crush Kin of Route 2! We want to fight only the strongest of Trainers! And the strongest of Trainers have at least two Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Siamo i Crush Kin del Percorso 2!
Vogliamo combattere solo contro gli\lAllenatori più forti! E gli

Allenatori più forti hanno almeno
due Pokémon!

entries.original:
"We’re the Crush Kin that dominates
Route 2!

We only fight the best of Trainers!

If you can beat all of the Trainers
on Route 2 and Route 15, we’ll\lchallenge you!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Crush Kin that dominates Route 2! We only fight the best of Trainers! If you can beat all of the Trainers on Route 2 and Route 15, we’ll challenge you!
entries.translated:
Siamo il Crush Kin che domina il
Percorso 2! Lottiamo solo contro i\lmigliori Allenatori! Se riesci a

battere tutti gli Allenatori del
Percorso 2 e del Percorso 15, ti\lsfideremo!

entries.original:
"We’re the Crush Kin that dominates
Route 2!

We only fight the best of Trainers!

Show us what you’re made of!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Crush Kin that dominates Route 2! We only fight the best of Trainers! Show us what you’re made of!
entries.translated:
Siamo i Crush Kin che dominano il
Percorso 2! Combattiamo solo contro\li migliori Allenatori! Mostraci di

che pasta sei fatto!

entries.original: "You’ve shown that you’re the best!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve shown that you’re the best!
entries.translated:
Hai dimostrato di essere il
migliore!

entries.original:
"The best of Trainers deserve
items like this!"
entries.translation_source: The best of Trainers deserve items like this!
entries.translated:
I migliori Allenatori meritano
oggetti come questo!

entries.original:
"Give that Mega Stone to [green]Lopunny[red]!

If you Mega Evolve it, it’ll
embrace its true nature and\lFighting-type power!"
entries.translation_source: Give that Mega Stone to [color-green-1]Lopunny[color-red-2]! If you Mega Evolve it, it’ll embrace its true nature and Fighting-type power!
entries.translated:
Dai quella Mega Pietra a [green]Lopunny[red]!
Se lo fai Mega Evolvere, abbraccerà\lla sua vera natura e la potenza di

tipo Lotta!

entries.original:
"We’re the Crush Kin that dominates
Route 2!

We only fight the best of Trainers!

And the best of Trainers have
at least two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Crush Kin that dominates Route 2! We only fight the best of Trainers! And the best of Trainers have at least two Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Siamo i Crush Kin che dominano il
Percorso 2! Combattiamo solo contro\li migliori Allenatori! E i migliori

Allenatori hanno almeno due
Pokémon!

entries.original: "Route 3"
entries.translation_source: Route 3
entries.translated: Percorso 3

entries.original:
"[black]The sand castle came alive
and attacked!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The sand castle came alive and attacked!
entries.translated:
[black]Il castello di sabbia si è animato
e ha attaccato!

entries.original:
"[black]The [buffer1] receded into
the sand."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The [buffer1-2] receded into the sand.
entries.translated:
[black]Il [buffer1] si è ritirato nella
sabbia.

entries.original:
"Do you prefer to avoid Trainers by
cutting through the tall grass?

The fact that you battled me means
you don’t!"
entries.translation_source: Do you prefer to avoid Trainers by cutting through the tall grass? The fact that you battled me means you don’t!
entries.translated:
Preferisci evitare gli Allenatori
tagliando per l{B4}erba alta? Il fatto\lche tu abbia combattuto contro di

me significa di no!

entries.original:
"It’s time for a grassy battle on a
grassy island!"
entries.translation_source: It’s time for a grassy battle on a grassy island!
entries.translated:
È tempo di una lotta di tipo Erba
su un{B4}isola erbosa!

entries.original: "A grassy defeat!"
entries.translation_source: A grassy defeat!
entries.translated: Una sconfitta erbosa!

entries.original:
"Please don’t Cut the grass on
this island.

If you do, it won’t be a grassy
island anymore!"
entries.translation_source: Please don’t Cut the grass on this island. If you do, it won’t be a grassy island anymore!
entries.translated:
Per favore, non usare Taglio
sull{B4}erba di quest{B4}isola. Se lo\lfai, non sarà più un{B4}isola erbosa!

entries.original:
"I wish I could live just by
inhaling the fresh air.

It smells good, so it must be
tasty, too, right?"
entries.translation_source: I wish I could live just by inhaling the fresh air. It smells good, so it must be tasty, too, right?
entries.translated:
Vorrei poter vivere solo respirando
l{B4}aria fresca. Ha un buon odore,\lquindi dev{B4}essere anche gustosa,

no?

entries.original: "I love running around on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: I love running around on the beach!
entries.translated:
Adoro correre in giro per la
spiaggia!

entries.original: "Oh no, you beat me!"
entries.translation_source: Oh no, you beat me!
entries.translated: Oh no, mi hai battuto!

entries.original:
"No matter how many times I lose,
nothing will stop me from running\laround on the beach!"
entries.translation_source: No matter how many times I lose, nothing will stop me from running around on the beach!
entries.translated:
Non importa quante volte perda,
niente mi impedirà di correre in\lgiro per la spiaggia!

entries.original:
"Fishing by the coast whilst
reminiscing about my past is\lalways pleasurable."
entries.translation_source: Fishing by the coast whilst reminiscing about my past is always pleasurable.
entries.translated:
Pescare lungo la costa mentre
ripenso al mio passato è sempre\lpiacevole.

entries.original:
"Did I become a fisherman because I
am patient, or did fishing make\lme patient?

That is the question."
entries.translation_source: Did I become a fisherman because I am patient, or did fishing make me patient? That is the question.
entries.translated:
Sono diventato pescatore perché
sono paziente, o pescare mi ha reso\lpaziente? Questo è il dilemma.

entries.original:
"Battling with you was a true test
of patience!"
entries.translation_source: Battling with you was a true test of patience!
entries.translated:
Lottare con te è stata una vera
prova di pazienza!

entries.original: "Patience is a virtue not many have."
entries.translation_source: Patience is a virtue not many have.
entries.translated:
La pazienza è una virtù che in
pochi hanno.

entries.original:
"If you hook the same Pokémon many
times in a row, odds are you’ll\lencounter one that looks different\lthan other Pokémon of its species."
entries.translation_source: If you hook the same Pokémon many times in a row, odds are you’ll encounter one that looks different than other Pokémon of its species.
entries.translated:
Se agganci lo stesso Pokémon molte
volte di fila, è probabile che ne\lincontri uno dall{B4}aspetto diverso

dagli altri Pokémon della sua
specie.

entries.original:
"Your lead Pokémon is a key
ingredient in fishing."
entries.translation_source: Your lead Pokémon is a key ingredient in fishing.
entries.translated:
Il tuo Pokémon in testa è un
ingrediente fondamentale per la\lpesca.

entries.original:
"My lead was great for fishing, but
not so much for battling!"
entries.translation_source: My lead was great for fishing, but not so much for battling!
entries.translated:
Il mio Pokémon guida era fantastico
per pescare, ma non così tanto per\lcombattere!

entries.original:
"If your lead Pokémon has the
ability [green]Suction Cups[blue] or [green]Sticky\lHold[blue], it’ll be much easier for you\lto land a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: If your lead Pokémon has the ability [color-green-1]Suction Cups[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Sticky Hold[color-blue-4], it’ll be much easier for you to land a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Se il Pokémon in testa ha l{B4}abilità
[green]Ventose[blue] o [green]Antifurto[blue], ti sarà molto\lpiù facile catturare un Pokémon.

entries.original: "Route 4"
entries.translation_source: Route 4
entries.translated: Percorso 4

entries.original: "Route 4 - 5"
entries.translation_source: Route 4 - 5
entries.translated: Percorso 4 - 5

entries.original:
"Go away, bozo.
Can’t you see we’re thinkin’ here?"
entries.translation_source: Go away, bozo. Can’t you see we’re thinkin’ here?
entries.translated:
Vattene, idiota. Non vedi che
stiamo ragionando qui?

entries.original:
"Go away, bozo.
Can’t you see we’re plottin’ here?"
entries.translation_source: Go away, bozo. Can’t you see we’re plottin’ here?
entries.translated:
Vattene, idiota. Non vedi che
stiamo complottando qui?

entries.original: "Here, take some Potions."
entries.translation_source: Here, take some Potions.
entries.translated: Tieni, prendi delle Pozioni.

entries.original:
"Cinder Volcano is dangerous, and
temperatures are extreme.

If you don’t have your Pokémon to
protect you, you could faint."
entries.translation_source: Cinder Volcano is dangerous, and temperatures are extreme. If you don’t have your Pokémon to protect you, you could faint.
entries.translated:
Il Vulcano Cinder è pericoloso e le
temperature sono estreme. Se non\lhai i tuoi Pokémon a proteggerti,

potresti svenire.

entries.original:
"Hi there, Trainer!

If you can beat me, I’ll heal your
Pokémon for free!"
entries.translation_source: Hi there, Trainer! If you can beat me, I’ll heal your Pokémon for free!
entries.translated:
Ciao, Allenatore! Se riesci a
battermi, curerò i tuoi Pokémon\lgratis!

entries.original: "Healing time!"
entries.translation_source: Healing time!
entries.translated: È ora di curarsi!

entries.original: "Time to heal up!"
entries.translation_source: Time to heal up!
entries.translated: È ora di curarsi!

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe out there!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe out there!
entries.translated:
Tutto pronto! Stai al sicuro là
fuori!

entries.original:
"That ledge will take you right back
to Dresco Town!

I’d think carefully about using it,
though.

Once you hop it, the only way back
here is through Grim Woods!"
entries.translation_source: That ledge will take you right back to Dresco Town! I’d think carefully about using it, though. Once you hop it, the only way back here is through Grim Woods!
entries.translated:
Quella sporgenza ti riporterà
dritto a Dresco Town! Però, ci\lpenserei bene prima di usarla. Una

volta saltata, l{B4}unico modo per
tornare qui è attraverso Grim\lWoods!

entries.original:
"\.

Go away."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1] Go away.
entries.translated: \. Vattene via.

entries.original: "[black]Ride on Lapras?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Ride on Lapras?
entries.translated: [black]Salire su Lapras?

entries.original: "[green]Prassss!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Prassss!
entries.translated: [green]Prassss!

entries.original:
"Does battling this high up make
you feel\. elated?"
entries.translation_source: Does battling this high up make you feel[game-token-1] elated?
entries.translated:
Combattere così in alto ti fa
sentire\. euforico?

entries.original:
"Maybe I’ve been spending too much
time in the Dresco Town Gym."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I’ve been spending too much time in the Dresco Town Gym.
entries.translated:
Forse ho passato troppo tempo nella
Palestra di Dresco Town.

entries.original:
"Mirskle has had a huge impact on
the way I live my life.

Most people say he’s a bad
influence on children, but I\lcouldn’t be happier!"
entries.translation_source: Mirskle has had a huge impact on the way I live my life. Most people say he’s a bad influence on children, but I couldn’t be happier!
entries.translated:
Mirskle ha avuto un enorme impatto
sul mio stile di vita. La maggior\lparte delle persone dice che sia

una cattiva influenza per i
bambini, ma io non potrei essere\lpiù felice!

entries.original:
"I’ll catch something good
eventually.

You just go have fun."
entries.translation_source: I’ll catch something good eventually. You just go have fun.
entries.translated:
Alla fine prenderò qualcosa di
buono. Tu divertiti pure.

entries.original:
"You see that guy up there?
He’s been fishing there for days."
entries.translation_source: You see that guy up there? He’s been fishing there for days.
entries.translated:
Vedi quel tipo lassù? È lì a
pescare da giorni.

entries.original:
"It looks like I lost.
I should catch a better haul."
entries.translation_source: It looks like I lost. I should catch a better haul.
entries.translated:
Sembra che abbia perso. Dovrei fare
una cattura migliore.

entries.original:
"To be honest, I’ve been here for
days, too."
entries.translation_source: To be honest, I’ve been here for days, too.
entries.translated:
A dirla tutta, anch{B4}io sono qui da
giorni.

entries.original: "Route 5"
entries.translation_source: Route 5
entries.translated: Percorso 5

entries.original:
"Whew\. I better take a rest\.

Groan\.

That volcano takes a lot out
of you!

Let me heal your Pokémon so you
don’t get tired like me."
entries.translation_source: Whew[game-token-1] I better take a rest[game-token-2] Groan[game-token-3] That volcano takes a lot out of you! Let me heal your Pokémon so you don’t get tired like me.
entries.translated:
Uff\. Meglio che mi riposi\. Ugh\. Quel
vulcano ti sfianca parecchio!\lLascia che curi i tuoi Pokémon così

non ti stanchi come me.

entries.original: "Take care of yourself."
entries.translation_source: Take care of yourself.
entries.translated: Abbi cura di te.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello there, Borrius Trainer.

I moved here recently with my three
Pokémon from the Unova region.

I’ve been raising them on my own up
until this point, but lately,\lthey’ve been craving adventure.

I don’t really want to leave my
home, so I’ve been searching for\lsomeone to take them off my hands.

How would you like to take care of
one for me?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello there, Borrius Trainer. I moved here recently with my three Pokémon from the Unova region. I’ve been raising them on my own up until this point, but lately, they’ve been craving adventure. I don’t really want to leave my home, so I’ve been searching for someone to take them off my hands. How would you like to take care of one for me?
entries.translated:
Oh, salve, Allenatore di Borrius.
Mi sono trasferito qui di recente\lcon i miei tre Pokémon provenienti

dalla regione di Unima. Fino a
questo momento li ho cresciuti da\lsolo, ma ultimamente hanno voglia

di avventura. In realtà non me la
sento di lasciare casa mia, quindi\lsto cercando qualcuno a cui

affidarli. Ti andrebbe di
prendertene cura per me?

entries.original:
"Oh, hello there, Borrius Trainer.

Which adventurous Pokémon will
you take now?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello there, Borrius Trainer. Which adventurous Pokémon will you take now?
entries.translated:
Oh, salve, Allenatore di Borrius.
Quale Pokémon avventuroso prenderai\ladesso?

entries.original: "You’d like [buffer1][red]?"
entries.translation_source: You’d like [buffer1-1][color-red-2]?
entries.translated: Vorresti [buffer1][red]?

entries.original: "Which one will you take?"
entries.translation_source: Which one will you take?
entries.translated: Quale prenderai?

entries.original:
"Oh, okay then.

I guess I’ll have to keep searching
for a Trainer."
entries.translation_source: Oh, okay then. I guess I’ll have to keep searching for a Trainer.
entries.translated:
Oh, va bene allora. Suppongo che
dovrò continuare a cercare un\lAllenatore.

entries.original:
"I have adventurous Pokémon to give
away, but you can’t do anything\lwith a full party of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: I have adventurous Pokémon to give away, but you can’t do anything with a full party of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ho dei Pokémon avventurosi da
regalare, ma non puoi fare nulla\lcon una squadra piena di Pokémon.

entries.original:
"When you have at least [green][buffer1] Badges[red],
come back so I can give you more!"
entries.translation_source: When you have at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2] Badges[color-red-3], come back so I can give you more!
entries.translated:
Quando avrai almeno [green][buffer1]
Medaglie[red], torna così potrò darti\lancora altro!

entries.original:
"Hello again!

How are my old friends doing?"
entries.translation_source: Hello again! How are my old friends doing?
entries.translated:
Ciao di nuovo! Come stanno i miei
vecchi amici?

entries.original: "[green]Snivy"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Snivy
entries.translated: [green]Snivy

entries.original: "[lightgreen]Tepig"
entries.translation_source: [color-lightgreen-1]Tepig
entries.translated: [lightgreen]Tepig

entries.original: "[blue]Oshawott"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Oshawott
entries.translated: [blue]Oshawott

entries.original: "Leg Day"
entries.translation_source: Leg Day
entries.translated: Giornata gambe

entries.original:
"It’s leg day! Walk [buffer1] steps to
work out those calves."
entries.translation_source: It’s leg day! Walk [buffer1-1] steps to work out those calves.
entries.translated:
È il giorno delle gambe! Cammina
per [buffer1] passi per allenare\lquei polpacci.

entries.original:
"Today is leg day.

It’s the most important day of
the week.

Some people skip leg day, but those
people are wrong.

Walking is the best way to work
out your legs.

If you walk enough, I will give you
a reward in celebration of leg day."
entries.translation_source: Today is leg day. It’s the most important day of the week. Some people skip leg day, but those people are wrong. Walking is the best way to work out your legs. If you walk enough, I will give you a reward in celebration of leg day.
entries.translated:
Oggi è il giorno delle gambe. È il
giorno più importante della\lsettimana. Alcune persone saltano

il giorno delle gambe, ma si
sbagliano. Camminare è il modo\lmigliore per allenare le gambe. Se

cammini abbastanza, ti darò una
ricompensa per celebrare il giorno\ldelle gambe.

entries.original:
"Awesome!

Now walk at least [green][buffer1][blue] steps to
really work those calves."
entries.translation_source: Awesome! Now walk at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] steps to really work those calves.
entries.translated:
Fantastico! Adesso cammina almeno
[green][buffer1][blue] passi per far lavorare\ldavvero quei polpacci.

entries.original:
"Okay, then go back to the gym and
lift some dumbbells, flabby calves!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, then go back to the gym and lift some dumbbells, flabby calves!
entries.translated:
Va bene, allora torna in palestra e
solleva qualche manubrio, polpacci\lflaccidi!

entries.original:
"You still have [green][buffer3][blue] step\\08 to go
before reaching [green][buffer1][blue].

Come on now, feel the burn!"
entries.translation_source: You still have [color-green-1][buffer3-2][color-blue-3] step[raw-escape-4] to go before reaching [color-green-5][buffer1-6][color-blue-7]. Come on now, feel the burn!
entries.translated:
Ti restano ancora [green][buffer3][blue] passi\\08
prima di raggiungere [green][buffer1][blue]. Su,\lsenti il bruciore!

entries.original:
"Whoa, I’m sure your legs are tired
after that workout.

Here, take this small snack to heal
your muscles."
entries.translation_source: Whoa, I’m sure your legs are tired after that workout. Here, take this small snack to heal your muscles.
entries.translated:
Accidenti, sono sicuro che le tue
gambe siano stanche dopo\lquell{B4}allenamento. Tieni, prendi

questo piccolo spuntino per far
riprendere i muscoli.

entries.original:
"Leg day should really be a
national holiday."
entries.translation_source: Leg day should really be a national holiday.
entries.translated:
Il leg day dovrebbe davvero essere
una festa nazionale.

entries.original:
"Are we in a forest or on a route?
I can’t tell!"
entries.translation_source: Are we in a forest or on a route? I can’t tell!
entries.translated:
Siamo in una foresta o su una
route? Non riesco a capirlo!

entries.original: "You tricked me!"
entries.translation_source: You tricked me!
entries.translated: Mi hai fregato!

entries.original:
"There are too many trees for this
to be a route.

We must be in a forest!

It’s times like these I wish I had
a Town Map\."
entries.translation_source: There are too many trees for this to be a route. We must be in a forest! It’s times like these I wish I had a Town Map[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ci sono troppi alberi perché questo
sia un percorso. Dobbiamo essere in\luna foresta! Sono momenti come

questo che mi fanno desiderare di
avere una Town Map\.

entries.original:
"Why does that guy keep looking
at me like that?"
entries.translation_source: Why does that guy keep looking at me like that?
entries.translated:
Perché quel tizio continua a
guardarmi in quel modo?

entries.original:
"I just picked up my Pokémon from
the Day Care.

They’re raring to go!"
entries.translation_source: I just picked up my Pokémon from the Day Care. They’re raring to go!
entries.translated:
Ho appena ritirato i miei Pokémon
dall{B4}Asilo Pokémon. Non vedono\ll{B4}ora di partire!

entries.original:
"Raring to go\.
More like medium rare!"
entries.translation_source: Raring to go[game-token-1] More like medium rare!
entries.translated:
Pronti a partire\. Più da media
cottura!

entries.original:
"Pokémon left in the Day Care get
stronger as you travel."
entries.translation_source: Pokémon left in the Day Care get stronger as you travel.
entries.translated:
I Pokémon lasciati all{B4}Asilo
Pokémon diventano più forti mentre\lviaggi.

entries.original:
"Keep an eye out for dark patches
between trees.

Those indicate that there is a
hidden pathway there."
entries.translation_source: Keep an eye out for dark patches between trees. Those indicate that there is a hidden pathway there.
entries.translated:
Stai attento alle zone scure tra
gli alberi. Indicano che lì c{B4}è un\lsentiero nascosto.

entries.original:
"Sometimes my shorts cause chafing
while I run, but for the most part,\lthey’re delightfully comfy and\leasy to wear!"
entries.translation_source: Sometimes my shorts cause chafing while I run, but for the most part, they’re delightfully comfy and easy to wear!
entries.translated:
A volte i miei shorts mi sfregano
mentre corro, ma per la maggior\lparte sono deliziosamente comodi e

facili da indossare!

entries.original:
"Ow!
My legs are chafing!"
entries.translation_source: Ow! My legs are chafing!
entries.translated:
Ahia! Mi si stanno sfregando le
gambe!

entries.original:
"Do you know about [green]Terrains[blue]?

For the most part, they’re special
battlefield effects that boost the\lpower of certain moves used by\lPokémon on the ground."
entries.translation_source: Do you know about [color-green-1]Terrains[color-blue-2]? For the most part, they’re special battlefield effects that boost the power of certain moves used by Pokémon on the ground.
entries.translated:
Conosci i [green]Terreni[blue]? Per la maggior
parte, sono effetti speciali del\lcampo di battaglia che aumentano la

potenza di alcune mosse usate dai
Pokémon a terra.

entries.original:
"Whenever I hear a Trainer run by,
I immediately look and catch them!

It’s those silent Trainers who walk
by that give me difficulty\."
entries.translation_source: Whenever I hear a Trainer run by, I immediately look and catch them! It’s those silent Trainers who walk by that give me difficulty[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ogni volta che sento passare un
Allenatore di corsa, mi volto\lsubito e lo acchiappo! Sono quegli

Allenatori silenziosi che passano a
piedi a darmi problemi\.

entries.original:
"Is your nature a match for mine?

Let’s synchronize in a beautiful
battle to find out!"
entries.translation_source: Is your nature a match for mine? Let’s synchronize in a beautiful battle to find out!
entries.translated:
La tua natura è in sintonia con la
mia? Sincronizziamoci in una\lbellissima lotta per scoprirlo!

entries.original:
"Even though Kirlia had Synchronize,
turns out you’re not my type\."
entries.translation_source: Even though Kirlia had Synchronize, turns out you’re not my type[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Anche se Kirlia aveva Sincronismo,
a quanto pare non sei il mio tipo\.

entries.original:
"When a Pokémon with [green]Synchronize[red]
leads the party, all Pokémon you\lfind will have the same [green]nature[red] as it!"
entries.translation_source: When a Pokémon with [color-green-1]Synchronize[color-red-2] leads the party, all Pokémon you find will have the same [color-green-3]nature[color-red-4] as it!
entries.translated:
Quando un Pokémon con [green]Sincronismo[red]
guida la squadra, tutti i Pokémon\lche incontri avranno la stessa

[green]natura[red]!

entries.original:
"There is no room in my heart for
anything but my bugs.

Say, do you also notice a bug
hiding in that girl’s hair?"
entries.translation_source: There is no room in my heart for anything but my bugs. Say, do you also notice a bug hiding in that girl’s hair?
entries.translated:
Non c{B4}è spazio nel mio cuore per
altro che per i miei insetti.\lDimmi, noti anche tu un insetto

nascosto tra i capelli di quella
ragazza?

entries.original: "Route 6"
entries.translation_source: Route 6
entries.translated: Percorso 6

entries.original: "Route 6 - 7"
entries.translation_source: Route 6 - 7
entries.translated: Percorso 6 - 7

entries.original:
"Two bridges\.

If you beat me, I’ll tell you which
one gets you to the next route!"
entries.translation_source: Two bridges[game-token-1] If you beat me, I’ll tell you which one gets you to the next route!
entries.translated:
Due ponti\. Se mi batti, ti dirò
quale ti porta al prossimo\lPercorso!

entries.original: "I guess I have to tell you now."
entries.translation_source: I guess I have to tell you now.
entries.translated: Immagino di dovertelo dire adesso.

entries.original:
"The fact that you battled me means
you’re going the right way."
entries.translation_source: The fact that you battled me means you’re going the right way.
entries.translated:
Il fatto che tu abbia combattuto
contro di me significa che stai\landando nella direzione giusta.

entries.original:
"Unless you can Surf, going this
way just leads to a dead end."
entries.translation_source: Unless you can Surf, going this way just leads to a dead end.
entries.translated:
A meno che tu non sappia Surf,
andare da questa parte porta solo a\lun vicolo cieco.

entries.original:
"This is the only Route where a
Pokémon that appears at night\lwill also appear in the early\lmorning!"
entries.translation_source: This is the only Route where a Pokémon that appears at night will also appear in the early morning!
entries.translated:
Questa è l{B4}unica Via in cui un
Pokémon che appare di notte appare\lanche al mattino presto!

entries.original:
"If you wake up really early,
you’ll hear Kricketot cries!"
entries.translation_source: If you wake up really early, you’ll hear Kricketot cries!
entries.translated:
Se ti svegli davvero presto,
sentirai i versi di Kricketot!

entries.original:
"Kricketot must stay awake longer
than other nocturnal Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Kricketot must stay awake longer than other nocturnal Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Kricketot deve restare sveglio più
a lungo degli altri Pokémon\lnotturni.

entries.original:
"Like bird Pokémon, bug Pokémon
generally change when the sun sets."
entries.translation_source: Like bird Pokémon, bug Pokémon generally change when the sun sets.
entries.translated:
Come i Pokémon uccello, i Pokémon
Coleottero di solito cambiano al\lcalare del sole.

entries.original:
"When Smeargle swarm, they swarm
on this very route!"
entries.translation_source: When Smeargle swarm, they swarm on this very route!
entries.translated:
Quando gli Smeargle si radunano in
sciame, lo fanno proprio su questo\lpercorso!

entries.original:
"I may have caught Smeargle here,
but I taught it moves elsewhere!"
entries.translation_source: I may have caught Smeargle here, but I taught it moves elsewhere!
entries.translated:
Forse ho catturato Smeargle qui, ma
gli ho insegnato mosse altrove!

entries.original:
"My Smeargle learned its moves from
the Pokémon atop Frost Mountain.

Except for Spore.

That it learned from a Shroomish
on Route 9."
entries.translation_source: My Smeargle learned its moves from the Pokémon atop Frost Mountain. Except for Spore. That it learned from a Shroomish on Route 9.
entries.translated:
Il mio Smeargle ha imparato le sue
mosse dai Pokémon in cima al Monte\lGelo. A parte Spora, che l{B4}ha

imparata da uno Shroomish sul
Percorso 9.

entries.original:
"Before letting your Pokémon hold a
[green]Figy Berry[blue], make sure it doesn’t\lhave a conflicting [green]Nature[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Before letting your Pokémon hold a [color-green-1]Figy Berry[color-blue-2], make sure it doesn’t have a conflicting [color-green-3]Nature[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Prima di far tenere al tuo Pokémon
una [green]Figy Berry[blue], assicurati che non\labbia una [green]Natura[blue] incompatibile.

entries.original:
"We’re the Sun Trio!

Beat us three to win a fantastic
prize!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Sun Trio! Beat us three to win a fantastic prize!
entries.translated:
Siamo il Trio del Sole! Sconfiggici
tutti e tre per vincere un premio\lfantastico!

entries.original: "One down, two to go!"
entries.translation_source: One down, two to go!
entries.translated: Uno fatto, ne mancano due!

entries.original:
"I’m the newest member of the
Sun Trio.

That’s why they have me stand
at the back."
entries.translation_source: I’m the newest member of the Sun Trio. That’s why they have me stand at the back.
entries.translated:
Sono l{B4}ultimo arrivato del Trio del
Sole. Per questo mi fanno stare in\lfondo.

entries.original:
"If the sun ever were to stop
shining, we’d all freeze solid!

But if it were to ever get any
hotter, we’d roast!

It’s amazing that the ball of fire
in the sky keeping us alive could\lalso end all life in an instant."
entries.translation_source: If the sun ever were to stop shining, we’d all freeze solid! But if it were to ever get any hotter, we’d roast! It’s amazing that the ball of fire in the sky keeping us alive could also end all life in an instant.
entries.translated:
Se il sole smettesse mai di
splendere, congeleremmo tutti\lall{B4}istante! Ma se diventasse

ancora più caldo, arrostiremmo! È
incredibile che quella palla di\lfuoco nel cielo che ci tiene in

vita possa anche porre fine a ogni
vita in un istante.

entries.original:
"Beating those two members of the
Sun Trio is no easy feat!

\.Actually, I’m just kidding,
they’re both weak.

I’m weak too, and that’s what
makes us the Sun Trio!

But even though I’m weak, I’m not
just going to hand over the prize!

You also have to beat me, no matter
how weak I may be!

The third member of the Sun Trio\.
Coming at you!"
entries.translation_source: Beating those two members of the Sun Trio is no easy feat! [game-token-1]Actually, I’m just kidding, they’re both weak. I’m weak too, and that’s what makes us the Sun Trio! But even though I’m weak, I’m not just going to hand over the prize! You also have to beat me, no matter how weak I may be! The third member of the Sun Trio[game-token-2] Coming at you!
entries.translated:
Battere quei due membri del Trio
del Sole non è un{B4}impresa da poco!\l\.In realtà sto solo scherzando, sono

entrambi deboli. Anch{B4}io sono
debole, ed è questo che ci rende il\lTrio del Sole! Ma anche se sono

debole, non consegnerò
semplicemente il premio! Devi\lbattere anche me, per quanto debole

possa essere! Il terzo membro del
Trio del Sole\. In arrivo!

entries.original:
"Even though I knew I’d lose going
into it, that’s what made it fun!"
entries.translation_source: Even though I knew I’d lose going into it, that’s what made it fun!
entries.translated:
Anche se sapevo che avrei perso fin
dall{B4}inizio, è proprio questo che\ll{B4}ha reso divertente!

entries.original: "And for your prize, it’s a\."
entries.translation_source: And for your prize, it’s a[game-token-1]
entries.translated: E come premio, c{B4}è un\.

entries.original:
"We love the sun!

Day or night, our source of light
is always because of the sun!"
entries.translation_source: We love the sun! Day or night, our source of light is always because of the sun!
entries.translated:
Amiamo il sole! Di giorno o di
notte, la nostra fonte di luce è\lsempre il sole!

entries.original:
"Arright, boys!

I know times have been tough ever
since those Ferrothorns kicked us\lout of Antisis.

But soon we’re gonna head on over
to Route 10 and start fresh!

We’re gonna make it our new base,
and any Trainers wantin’ to pass\lthrough are gonna have to pay a\lpretty toll!

Hahaha!"
entries.translation_source: Arright, boys! I know times have been tough ever since those Ferrothorns kicked us out of Antisis. But soon we’re gonna head on over to Route 10 and start fresh! We’re gonna make it our new base, and any Trainers wantin’ to pass through are gonna have to pay a pretty toll! Hahaha!
entries.translated:
Va bene, ragazzi! So che i tempi
sono duri da quando quei\lFerrothorns ci hanno cacciati da

Antisis. Ma presto andremo su
Percorso 10 e ripartiremo da zero!\lLa trasformeremo nella nostra nuova

base, e ogni Allenatore che vorrà
passarci dovrà pagare un bel\lpedaggio! Hahaha!

entries.original: "Yeah, yeah!"
entries.translation_source: Yeah, yeah!
entries.translated: Sì, sì!

entries.original:
"We’re gonna rough ’em up and steal
their cash!"
entries.translation_source: We’re gonna rough ’em up and steal their cash!
entries.translated:
Li malmeniamo e gli freghiamo i
soldi!

entries.original:
"They’re all gonna cry for
their mommies!"
entries.translation_source: They’re all gonna cry for their mommies!
entries.translated:
Piangeranno tutti per le loro
mamme!

entries.original:
"Whad’ya want, bozo?

Can’t you see we’re discussin’
important things here?

Scram!"
entries.translation_source: Whad’ya want, bozo? Can’t you see we’re discussin’ important things here? Scram!
entries.translated:
Che vuoi, idiota? Non vedi che
stiamo discutendo di cose\limportanti qui? Sparisci!

entries.original: "Route Gate"
entries.translation_source: Route Gate
entries.translated: Varco del Percorso

entries.original:
"Heading south takes you towards
the Auburn Waterway, a route that\lconnects Route 6 to Route 10.

You’ll need [green]Surf[red] if you want to
get there, though."
entries.translation_source: Heading south takes you towards the Auburn Waterway, a route that connects Route 6 to Route 10. You’ll need [color-green-1]Surf[color-red-2] if you want to get there, though.
entries.translated:
Andando verso sud raggiungerai
Auburn Waterway, un percorso che\lcollega Percorso 6 a Percorso 10.

Però, per arrivarci ti servirà
[green]Surf[red].

entries.original: "Route 7"
entries.translation_source: Route 7
entries.translated: Percorso 7

entries.original:
"Have you noticed that the Rattata
around here look different than the\lRattata found on Route 2?"
entries.translation_source: Have you noticed that the Rattata around here look different than the Rattata found on Route 2?
entries.translated:
Hai notato che i Rattata qui
intorno sono diversi dai Rattata\lche si trovano sul Percorso 2?

entries.original:
"They’re so strange\.
I wonder why they look different?"
entries.translation_source: They’re so strange[game-token-1] I wonder why they look different?
entries.translated:
Sono così strani\. mi chiedo perché
sembrino diversi?

entries.original:
"The strange Rattata only come out
at night, so I don’t blame you if\lyou haven’t noticed them."
entries.translation_source: The strange Rattata only come out at night, so I don’t blame you if you haven’t noticed them.
entries.translated:
Le strane Rattata escono solo di
notte, quindi non ti biasimo se non\lte ne sei accorto.

entries.original:
"When you cross the bridges, keep
an eye out on your right.

There’s a split path there that’ll
either take you back to Route 6 or\lto a house where a nice couple\lwill heal your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: When you cross the bridges, keep an eye out on your right. There’s a split path there that’ll either take you back to Route 6 or to a house where a nice couple will heal your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ooh! Un altro Allenatore ha
scoperto una di queste aree\lnascoste! Io sono Ginger, tra

l{B4}altro. Sono un{B4}Allenatrice,
proprio come te! È la prima volta\lche vieni qui? Posso spiegarti

queste aree, se è così!

entries.original:
"Have you ever tried using a move
in a Double Battle that hits more\lthan one Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Have you ever tried using a move in a Double Battle that hits more than one Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Hai mai provato a usare una mossa
in una Lotta in Doppio che colpisce\lpiù di un Pokémon?

entries.original: "I can tell you have!"
entries.translation_source: I can tell you have!
entries.translated: Si vede che sì!

entries.original:
"When a Pokémon’s move can hit
more than one target in a Double\lBattle, it does less damage.

That’s something to keep in mind
when you’re fighting two on two!"
entries.translation_source: When a Pokémon’s move can hit more than one target in a Double Battle, it does less damage. That’s something to keep in mind when you’re fighting two on two!
entries.translated:
Quando la mossa di un Pokémon può
colpire più di un bersaglio in una\lLotta in Doppio, infligge meno
