danni. Tienilo a mente quando
combatti due contro due!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon has the ability [green]Static[red].

Pokémon that hit it with direct
contact might get Paralyzed."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon has the ability [color-green-1]Static[color-red-2]. Pokémon that hit it with direct contact might get Paralyzed.
entries.translated:
Il mio Pokémon ha l{B4}abilità
[green]Statico[red]. I Pokémon che lo\lcolpiscono con contatto diretto

potrebbero restare Paralizzati.

entries.original:
"[red]My Psychic power involves reading
your mind to mimic your strategy!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]My Psychic power involves reading your mind to mimic your strategy!
entries.translated:
[red]Il mio potere Psico consiste nel
leggere la tua mente per imitare la\ltua strategia!

entries.original:
"I am not very good at it yet,
however."
entries.translation_source: I am not very good at it yet, however.
entries.translated: Però non sono ancora molto bravo.

entries.original:
"[red]I often imagine there is a Trainer
somewhere who could imitate anyone\lwell enough to best them, even with\ltheir own Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I often imagine there is a Trainer somewhere who could imitate anyone well enough to best them, even with their own Pokémon!
entries.translated:
[red]Mi immagino spesso che da qualche
parte ci sia un Allenatore capace\ldi imitare chiunque abbastanza bene

da batterlo, persino usando i suoi
stessi Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Hoo hoo\. sure is humid\. like
a sauna\."
entries.translation_source: Hoo hoo[game-token-1] sure is humid[game-token-2] like a sauna[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Hoo hoo\. che umidità\. sembra una
sauna\.

entries.original:
"Hey, kiddo, c’mere for a sec.

You’re slowly falling into a
deep sleep\.

You’re drifting off\.

\.

Drat! It’s not working!

I’ll have to take you out the
old fashioned way!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, kiddo, c’mere for a sec. You’re slowly falling into a deep sleep[game-token-1] You’re drifting off[game-token-2] [game-token-3] Drat! It’s not working! I’ll have to take you out the old fashioned way!
entries.translated:
Ehi, ragazzino, vieni qui un
attimo. Stai lentamente cadendo in\lun sonno profondo\. Stai scivolando

via\. \. Dannazione! Non sta
funzionando! Dovrò metterti KO alla\lvecchia maniera!

entries.original:
"I couldn’t best your mind or your
Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I couldn’t best your mind or your Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Non sono riuscito a battere né la
tua mente né i tuoi Pokémon!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon likes to hypnotize
children and eat their dreams.

I hide behind this tree because
kids are easier to catch off guard\lwhen they’re startled.

And once off guard, it’s easier to
lull them into a deep sleep\."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon likes to hypnotize children and eat their dreams. I hide behind this tree because kids are easier to catch off guard when they’re startled. And once off guard, it’s easier to lull them into a deep sleep[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Il mio Pokémon ama ipnotizzare i
bambini e mangiarsi i loro sogni.\lMi nascondo dietro questo albero

perché i bambini sono più facili da
cogliere di sorpresa quando si\lspaventano. E una volta colti di

sorpresa, è più facile cullarli in
un sonno profondo\.

entries.original:
"If I had a Pokémon with [green]Flame Body[blue]
or [green]Magma Armor[blue] in my party, my\lEggs would hatch much faster!"
entries.translation_source: If I had a Pokémon with [color-green-1]Flame Body[color-blue-2] or [color-green-3]Magma Armor[color-blue-4] in my party, my Eggs would hatch much faster!
entries.translated:
Se avessi in squadra un Pokémon con
[green]Corpodifuoco[blue] o [green]Magmascudo[blue], le mie\lUova si schiuderebbero molto più in

fretta!

entries.original:
"All birds can fly!
Even the flightless ones!"
entries.translation_source: All birds can fly! Even the flightless ones!
entries.translated:
Tutti gli uccelli sanno volare!
Anche quelli che non volano!

entries.original:
"See? If they couldn’t fly, then they
wouldn’t have crashed down so hard!"
entries.translation_source: See? If they couldn’t fly, then they wouldn’t have crashed down so hard!
entries.translated:
Visto? Se non avessero potuto
volare, non sarebbero caduti così\lviolentemente!

entries.original:
"Doduo and Dodrio are supposed to be
flightless birds.

Yet those flightless birds can
still learn Fly!

How in the world is that even
possible?"
entries.translation_source: Doduo and Dodrio are supposed to be flightless birds. Yet those flightless birds can still learn Fly! How in the world is that even possible?
entries.translated:
Doduo e Dodrio dovrebbero essere
uccelli incapaci di volare. Eppure\lquesti uccelli incapaci di volare

possono comunque imparare Volo!
Come diavolo è possibile?

entries.original:
"I’m the Fishing Dude!

I simply looove fishing!
I can’t bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?"
entries.translation_source: I’m the Fishing Dude! I simply looove fishing! I can’t bear to go without. Tell me, do you like to fish?
entries.translated:
Sono il Tipo della Pesca! Adoro
pescare alla follia! Non riesco\lproprio a farne a meno. Dimmi, ti

piace pescare?

entries.original:
"Grand! I like your style.
I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!"
entries.translation_source: Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends. Take this and fish, young friend!
entries.translated:
Grandioso! Mi piace il tuo stile.
Penso che potremmo essere amici.\lPrendi questo e vai a pescare,

giovane amico!

entries.original:
"Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.

From the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend."
entries.translation_source: Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry. From the seas to rivers, go out and land the big one, my friend.
entries.translated:
La pesca è uno stile di vita! È
come la poesia più raffinata. Dai\lmari ai fiumi, vai là fuori e

prendi il grosso, amico mio.

entries.original:
"Oh\.
That’s so disappointing\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] That’s so disappointing[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Che delusione\.

entries.original:
"Hello there, [player]!

How are the fish biting?"
entries.translation_source: Hello there, [player-name-1]! How are the fish biting?
entries.translated:
Ciao, [player]! Come abboccano i
pesci?

entries.original:
"Hi there, young traveller.
Your Pokémon look tired.

Let me heal them for you."
entries.translation_source: Hi there, young traveller. Your Pokémon look tired. Let me heal them for you.
entries.translated:
Ciao, giovane viaggiatore. I tuoi
Pokémon sembrano stanchi. Lascia\lche li curi per te.

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe out there!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe out there!
entries.translated:
Tutto pronto! Stai al sicuro là
fuori!

entries.original:
"This area is sealed off to anyone
who isn’t a member of the Shadows.

Since you’re not one of us,
scram, kid!"
entries.translation_source: This area is sealed off to anyone who isn’t a member of the Shadows. Since you’re not one of us, scram, kid!
entries.translated:
Quest{B4}area è interdetta a chiunque
non sia un membro degli Shadows.\lDato che non sei dei nostri,

sparisci, ragazzino!

entries.original:
"What the\.

How’d you get onto Route 9?

However it was, you’re still not
getting through here."
entries.translation_source: What the[game-token-1] How’d you get onto Route 9? However it was, you’re still not getting through here.
entries.translated:
Ma che\. Come hai fatto a finire sul
Percorso 9? Comunque sia, non\lpasserai da qui.

entries.original: "Route 8"
entries.translation_source: Route 8
entries.translated: Percorso 8

entries.original:
"All set!
Stay safe in the blizzard!"
entries.translation_source: All set! Stay safe in the blizzard!
entries.translated:
È tutto pronto! Stai al sicuro
nella bufera di neve!

entries.original: "No Fall Damage"
entries.translation_source: No Fall Damage
entries.translated: Nessun danno da caduta

entries.original:
"Practice the secret martial art of
jumping safely [buffer1] times."
entries.translation_source: Practice the secret martial art of jumping safely [buffer1-1] times.
entries.translated:
Pratica la segreta arte marziale
del salto sicuro [buffer1] volte.

entries.original:
"Ah, Trainer, did you know that
there is a secret martial art to\lavoid fall damage from moderate\lheights?

You just go to the edge of a ledge
or rock, jump, and land peacefully.

But this technique requires much
practice.

Are you ready to practice with
[green][buffer1][blue] jumps?"
entries.translation_source: Ah, Trainer, did you know that there is a secret martial art to avoid fall damage from moderate heights? You just go to the edge of a ledge or rock, jump, and land peacefully. But this technique requires much practice. Are you ready to practice with [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] jumps?
entries.translated:
Ah, Allenatore, sapevi che esiste
una segreta arte marziale per\levitare i danni da caduta da

altezze moderate? Basta andare sul
bordo di una sporgenza o di una\lroccia, saltare e atterrare

serenamente. Ma questa tecnica
richiede molta pratica. Sei pronto\la fare pratica con [green][buffer1][blue] salti?

entries.original:
"Before you start, you should do
some stretches.

And don’t be disappointed if you
take some fall damage on your\lfirst few tries.

It happens to the best jumpers."
entries.translation_source: Before you start, you should do some stretches. And don’t be disappointed if you take some fall damage on your first few tries. It happens to the best jumpers.
entries.translated:
Prima di iniziare, dovresti fare un
po{B4} di stretching. E non\lscoraggiarti se prendi qualche

danno da caduta alle prime prove.
Succede anche ai migliori\lsaltatori.

entries.original:
"I hope one day you will want to
master this super secret skill."
entries.translation_source: I hope one day you will want to master this super secret skill.
entries.translated:
Spero che un giorno vorrai
padroneggiare questa super segreta\labilità.

entries.original:
"You have only done [green][buffer2][blue] jump\\07 with
no fall damage.

You still need at least [green][buffer3][blue] more
to become a master."
entries.translation_source: You have only done [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] jump[raw-escape-4] with no fall damage. You still need at least [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-blue-7] more to become a master.
entries.translated:
Hai fatto solo [green][buffer2][blue] salti\\07
senza subire danni da caduta. Te ne\lservono ancora almeno [green][buffer3][blue] per

diventare un maestro.

entries.original:
"Wow, you are now a master of
jumping off moderate heights\lwithout fall damage!

You’d be surprised how many
Trainers get slightly injured on\lthose things.

Anyway, here is some Protein for a
post-workout snack."
entries.translation_source: Wow, you are now a master of jumping off moderate heights without fall damage! You’d be surprised how many Trainers get slightly injured on those things. Anyway, here is some Protein for a post-workout snack.
entries.translated:
Wow, ora sei un maestro nel saltare
da altezze moderate senza danni da\lcaduta! Ti stupirebbe sapere quanti

Allenatori si fanno un po{B4} male su
quelle cose. Comunque, ecco un po{B4}\ldi Proteina come spuntino

post-allenamento.

entries.original:
"Jumping from moderate heights is
a skill.

Don’t let anyone tell you
otherwise."
entries.translation_source: Jumping from moderate heights is a skill. Don’t let anyone tell you otherwise.
entries.translated:
Saltare da altezze moderate è
un{B4}abilità. Non lasciare che\lnessuno ti dica il contrario.

entries.original:
"If you’re going to get stronger,
I’ll get stronger too."
entries.translation_source: If you’re going to get stronger, I’ll get stronger too.
entries.translated:
Se hai intenzione di diventare più
forte, diventerò più forte anch{B4}io.

entries.original:
"You’d best not send out any weak
Pokémon!

Your opponents are my partners
in life!"
entries.translation_source: You’d best not send out any weak Pokémon! Your opponents are my partners in life!
entries.translated:
Faresti meglio a non mandare in
campo Pokémon deboli! I tuoi\lavversari sono i miei compagni di

vita!

entries.original:
"Thank you my friends\. for all
your hard work."
entries.translation_source: Thank you my friends[game-token-1] for all your hard work.
entries.translated:
Grazie, miei amici\. per tutto il
vostro duro lavoro.

entries.original:
"No matter what, my Pokémon will
stick with me until the end!"
entries.translation_source: No matter what, my Pokémon will stick with me until the end!
entries.translated:
Qualunque cosa accada, i miei
Pokémon resteranno con me fino alla\lfine!

entries.original:
"Even when I lose, I still get some
enjoyment out of it."
entries.translation_source: Even when I lose, I still get some enjoyment out of it.
entries.translated:
Anche quando perdo, riesco comunque
a divertirmi un po{B4}.

entries.original:
"I got used to this snowiness.
I sing while I climb now."
entries.translation_source: I got used to this snowiness. I sing while I climb now.
entries.translated:
Mi sono abituato a questa neve. Ora
canto mentre salgo.

entries.original:
"It’s still not easy to battle on
this snowy ground\."
entries.translation_source: It’s still not easy to battle on this snowy ground[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Anche su questo terreno innevato
non è facile combattere\.

entries.original:
"If I had a Bike, it would be much
easier to climb.

But where can you even get a Bike
around here?"
entries.translation_source: If I had a Bike, it would be much easier to climb. But where can you even get a Bike around here?
entries.translated:
Se avessi una Bici, sarebbe molto
più facile salire. Ma dove puoi\ltrovare una Bici da queste parti?

entries.original:
"If you run and run, you’ll become
one with the wind."
entries.translation_source: If you run and run, you’ll become one with the wind.
entries.translated:
Se corri e corri, diventerai
tutt{B4}uno con il vento.

entries.original:
"[red]Picnics are fun wherever you go,
just like Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Picnics are fun wherever you go, just like Pokémon!
entries.translated:
[red]I picnic sono divertenti ovunque tu
vada, proprio come i Pokémon!

entries.original:
"I lost because the ground is
too snowy!"
entries.translation_source: I lost because the ground is too snowy!
entries.translated:
Ho perso perché il terreno è troppo
innevato!

entries.original:
"[red]I’ll forget about losing and just
enjoy this snowy hike."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’ll forget about losing and just enjoy this snowy hike.
entries.translated:
[red]Mi dimenticherò della sconfitta e
mi godrò questa escursione sulla\lneve.

entries.original:
"No one knows the mountains better
than me, I tells ya."
entries.translation_source: No one knows the mountains better than me, I tells ya.
entries.translated:
Nessuno conosce le montagne meglio
di me, te lo dico io.

entries.original:
"How many thousands of years have I
been out here\.

If only I could lose, my journey
would end\."
entries.translation_source: How many thousands of years have I been out here[game-token-1] If only I could lose, my journey would end[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Quante migliaia di anni sono
rimasto qui fuori\. Se solo potessi\lperdere, il mio viaggio finirebbe\.

entries.original:
"Thank you\.

Thank you\.

Now my journey can come to an end\."
entries.translation_source: Thank you[game-token-1] Thank you[game-token-2] Now my journey can come to an end[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Grazie\. Grazie\. Ora il mio viaggio
può giungere al termine\.

entries.original:
"You have set me free\.

I am truly grateful from the bottom
of my heart\."
entries.translation_source: You have set me free[game-token-1] I am truly grateful from the bottom of my heart[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Mi hai liberato\. Sono davvero grato
dal profondo del cuore\.

entries.original: "Route 9"
entries.translation_source: Route 9
entries.translated: Percorso 9

entries.original: "Route 9 - 10"
entries.translation_source: Route 9 - 10
entries.translated: Percorso 9 - 10

entries.original:
"I love my daughter very much.

I can’t stand not seeing her for
even a single day.

I would even commit terrible crimes
for my daughter’s sake!

That’s how much I love her."
entries.translation_source: I love my daughter very much. I can’t stand not seeing her for even a single day. I would even commit terrible crimes for my daughter’s sake! That’s how much I love her.
entries.translated:
Amo moltissimo mia figlia. Non
sopporto di non vederla nemmeno per\lun solo giorno. Arriverei persino a

commettere crimini orribili per il
bene di mia figlia! È quanto la\lamo.

entries.original:
"Borrius is doomed\.

But now that nothing is anchoring
us down, we’re catching the next\lboat to Hoenn!"
entries.translation_source: Borrius is doomed[game-token-1] But now that nothing is anchoring us down, we’re catching the next boat to Hoenn!
entries.translated:
Borrius è condannata\. Ma ora che
niente ci tiene più ancorati,\lprenderemo la prossima nave per

Hoenn!

entries.original:
"You know, it might have been
just me\.

But I could swear Jax seemed a
little put-off by something.

And I don’t think it was just because
those thugs got away with the\lPrison Stone, either\."
entries.translation_source: You know, it might have been just me[game-token-1] But I could swear Jax seemed a little put-off by something. And I don’t think it was just because those thugs got away with the Prison Stone, either[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Sai, forse ero solo io\. Ma giurerei
che Jax sembrasse un po{B4}\lcontrariato da qualcosa. E non

credo fosse solo perché quei
teppisti sono scappati con la\lPietra della Prigione, nemmeno\.

entries.original:
"[red]Those thugs just waltzed on in
here and ransacked our home!

They pinned us to the wall, and
we were forced to watch helplessly\lwhile they scoured our home for\lthe Prison Stone."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Those thugs just waltzed on in here and ransacked our home! They pinned us to the wall, and we were forced to watch helplessly while they scoured our home for the Prison Stone.
entries.translated:
[red]Quei teppisti sono entrati qui come
se niente fosse e hanno messo a\lsoqquadro la nostra casa! Ci hanno

bloccati al muro, e siamo stati
costretti a guardare impotenti\lmentre frugavano in casa nostra in

cerca della Prison Stone.

entries.original:
"Mystical chants, kwaah!

You want Pokémon learn [green]Hex[red], skree?
[green]1 Blue Shard[red] and [green]1 Red Shard[red] it be."
entries.translation_source: Mystical chants, kwaah! You want Pokémon learn [color-green-1]Hex[color-red-2], skree? [color-green-3]1 Blue Shard[color-red-4] and [color-green-5]1 Red Shard[color-red-6] it be.
entries.translated:
Canti mistici, kwaah! Vuoi far
imparare ai Pokémon [green]Hex[red], skree? Ci\lvogliono [green]1 Frammento Blu[red] e [green]1

Frammento Rosso[red].

entries.original: "Which Pokémon it be?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon it be?
entries.translated: Quale Pokémon è?

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over 1 Blue Shard
and 1 Red Shard."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over 1 Blue Shard and 1 Red Shard.
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha consegnato 1 Frammento
Blu e 1 Frammento Rosso.

entries.original: "Hwa!"
entries.translation_source: Hwa!
entries.translated: Hwa!

entries.original:
"Huhu\. Graa\.
Not enough [buffer1]s\."
entries.translation_source: Huhu[game-token-1] Graa[game-token-2] Not enough [buffer1-3]s[game-token-4]
entries.translated: Uhu\. Grrr\. Non abbastanza [buffer1]\.

entries.original:
"Did you know humans have internal
clocks that tell them how many\ltimes they’ve been rained on?

Here, yours says\.

[buffer1]!

You’ve been rained on
[buffer1] times!

I personally have been rained on
16777215 times!

No one’ll ever be rained on more
than me!

NO ONE!"
entries.translation_source: Did you know humans have internal clocks that tell them how many times they’ve been rained on? Here, yours says[game-token-1] [buffer1-2]! You’ve been rained on [buffer1-3] times! I personally have been rained on 16777215 times! No one’ll ever be rained on more than me! NO ONE!
entries.translated:
Sapevi che gli esseri umani hanno
orologi interni che dicono loro\lquante volte sono stati bagnati

dalla pioggia? Qui, il tuo dice\.
[buffer1]! Sei stato bagnato dalla\lpioggia [buffer1] volte! Io

personalmente sono stato bagnato
dalla pioggia 16777215 volte!\lNessuno sarà mai bagnato dalla

pioggia più di me! NESSUNO!

entries.original:
"Me?
No, I’m not a Trainer.

I just find fishing in the rain
a relaxing sport.

Say\.

Now that I’ve been staring at it
for a while, how do you suppose\lI could get to that island in the\lmiddle of the lake?

What, you don’t see it?

It’s right there, just look out
onto the lake!

You still don’t see it?

Sorry, I’m a Fisherman, not an
eye doctor.

You’re on your own here, pal."
entries.translation_source: Me? No, I’m not a Trainer. I just find fishing in the rain a relaxing sport. Say[game-token-1] Now that I’ve been staring at it for a while, how do you suppose I could get to that island in the middle of the lake? What, you don’t see it? It’s right there, just look out onto the lake! You still don’t see it? Sorry, I’m a Fisherman, not an eye doctor. You’re on your own here, pal.
entries.translated:
Io? No, non sono un Allenatore.
Trovo solo che pescare sotto la\lpioggia sia uno sport rilassante.

Senti\. Ora che lo sto fissando da un
po{B4}, come pensi che potrei\lraggiungere quell{B4}isola in mezzo al

lago? Come, non la vedi? È proprio
lì, basta guardare verso il lago!\lAncora non la vedi? Scusa, sono un

Pescatore, non un oculista. Qui sei
tutto solo, amico.

entries.original:
"Me?

No, I’m not a Trainer.

I just find fishing in the rain
a relaxing sport.

Say\.

Now that I’ve been staring at it
for a while, how do you suppose\lI could get to that island in the\lmiddle of the lake?

What do you mean you don’t
see it?

I saw you pick up the yellow Poké
Ball that was resting on it!

Are you trying to tell me you won’t
share your secret with me?

In that case, leave me to fish!"
entries.translation_source: Me? No, I’m not a Trainer. I just find fishing in the rain a relaxing sport. Say[game-token-1] Now that I’ve been staring at it for a while, how do you suppose I could get to that island in the middle of the lake? What do you mean you don’t see it? I saw you pick up the yellow Poké Ball that was resting on it! Are you trying to tell me you won’t share your secret with me? In that case, leave me to fish!
entries.translated:
Io? No, non sono un Allenatore.
Trovo semplicemente che pescare\lsotto la pioggia sia uno sport

rilassante. Ehi\. Ora che lo guardo
da un po{B4}, come pensi che potrei\lraggiungere quell{B4}isola in mezzo al

lago? Cosa intendi, non la vedi? Ti
ho visto raccogliere la Poké Ball\lgialla che era su di essa! Stai

cercando di dirmi che non
condividerai il tuo segreto con me?\lIn tal caso, lasciami pescare!

entries.original:
"Now that those strange people are
gone, we can finally camp again!"
entries.translation_source: Now that those strange people are gone, we can finally camp again!
entries.translated:
Ora che quelle persone strane se ne
sono andate, possiamo finalmente\laccamparci di nuovo!

entries.original:
"I’m so happy!
I don’t even care if I lose!"
entries.translation_source: I’m so happy! I don’t even care if I lose!
entries.translated:
Sono così felice! Non mi importa
nemmeno se perdo!

entries.original:
"Ahh\.
Camping out in the leaves is great!"
entries.translation_source: Ahh[game-token-1] Camping out in the leaves is great!
entries.translated:
Ahh\. Campeggiare tra le foglie è
fantastico!

entries.original:
"Who needs seasons when you have
areas like Route 9 that are\lperpetually stuck in one!"
entries.translation_source: Who needs seasons when you have areas like Route 9 that are perpetually stuck in one!
entries.translated:
A cosa servono le stagioni quando
hai aree come Percorso 9, che\lrestano perennemente bloccate in

una sola?

entries.original:
"When those weird people showed up,
I wasn’t able to run anymore."
entries.translation_source: When those weird people showed up, I wasn’t able to run anymore.
entries.translated:
Quando sono arrivati quei tipi
strani, non sono più riuscito a\lcorrere.

entries.original: "Looks like I couldn’t outrun you!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like I couldn’t outrun you!
entries.translated:
Sembra che non sia riuscito a
seminarti!

entries.original:
"It’s so freeing being able to run
again!  "
entries.translation_source: It’s so freeing being able to run again!
entries.translated:
È così liberatorio poter correre di
nuovo!

entries.original:
"My grandparents used to live in
Antisis City, so I know a thing\lor two about thugs.

But the thugs that were on this
route\.

Not even my grandparents had ever
seen anyone like them before!

I wonder who they were?"
entries.translation_source: My grandparents used to live in Antisis City, so I know a thing or two about thugs. But the thugs that were on this route[game-token-1] Not even my grandparents had ever seen anyone like them before! I wonder who they were?
entries.translated:
I miei nonni vivevano ad Antisis
City, quindi ne so un paio di cose\lsui teppisti. Ma i teppisti che

c{B4}erano su questa rotta\. Nemmeno i
miei nonni avevano mai visto\lnessuno come loro prima d{B4}ora!

Chissà chi erano?

entries.original:
"I’m singin’ in the rain\.

Just singin’ in the rain\."
entries.translation_source: I’m singin’ in the rain[game-token-1] Just singin’ in the rain[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Sto cantando sotto la pioggia\. Sto
solo cantando sotto la pioggia\.

entries.original:
"I’m dancing in the rain\.
And I’m happy again!"
entries.translation_source: I’m dancing in the rain[game-token-1] And I’m happy again!
entries.translated:
Sto ballando sotto la pioggia\. E
sono di nuovo felice!

entries.original:
"Life’s not all about waiting for
the storm to pass.

It’s about learning to dance in
the rain."
entries.translation_source: Life’s not all about waiting for the storm to pass. It’s about learning to dance in the rain.
entries.translated:
La vita non consiste tutta
nell{B4}attendere che passi la\ltempesta. Si tratta di imparare a

ballare sotto la pioggia.

entries.original:
"In other regions, [green]Karrablast[blue] and
[green]Shelmet[blue] evolve when they’re traded\lwith each other.

But in Borrius, you just have to
use a [green]Link Stone[blue] on them!

The other one doesn’t even need
to be in the party!"
entries.translation_source: In other regions, [color-green-1]Karrablast[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Shelmet[color-blue-4] evolve when they’re traded with each other. But in Borrius, you just have to use a [color-green-5]Link Stone[color-blue-6] on them! The other one doesn’t even need to be in the party!
entries.translated:
In altre regioni, [green]Karrablast[blue] e
[green]Shelmet[blue] si evolvono quando vengono\lscambiati l{B4}uno con l{B4}altro. Ma a

Borrius, devi solo usare una [green]Pietra
Collegamento[blue] su di loro! L{B4}altro\lnon deve nemmeno essere in squadra!

entries.original:
"When is the best time to train
a bird?

When it rains, of course!"
entries.translation_source: When is the best time to train a bird? When it rains, of course!
entries.translated:
Qual è il momento migliore per
allenare un uccello? Quando piove,\lnaturalmente!

entries.original: "That’s why I’m training right now!"
entries.translation_source: That’s why I’m training right now!
entries.translated:
È per questo che mi sto allenando
proprio adesso!

entries.original:
"I only train my birds when
it rains.

And if they get zapped by lightning
while they’re flying\. that only\lmakes them stronger!"
entries.translation_source: I only train my birds when it rains. And if they get zapped by lightning while they’re flying[game-token-1] that only makes them stronger!
entries.translated:
Alleno i miei uccelli solo quando
piove. E se vengono fulminati\lmentre volano\. questo li rende solo

più forti!

entries.original:
"No\. it couldn’t be\.
But it’s the only explanation!

Did you suddenly gain the ability to
walk through walls?"
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1] it couldn’t be[game-token-2] But it’s the only explanation! Did you suddenly gain the ability to walk through walls?
entries.translated:
No\. Non può essere\. Ma è l{B4}unica
spiegazione! Hai forse acquisito\lall{B4}improvviso la capacità di

attraversare i muri?

entries.original:
"Well, sure, it’s a bit of a grind
dealing with those monsters all the\ltime, but hey, at least it’s better\lthan retail."
entries.translation_source: Well, sure, it’s a bit of a grind dealing with those monsters all the time, but hey, at least it’s better than retail.
entries.translated:
Certo, insomma, è un po{B4} una
faticaccia avere a che fare con\lquei mostri tutto il tempo, ma ehi,

almeno è meglio del commercio al
dettaglio.

entries.original:
"I heard a guy with a green hat was
wandering around the route.

But who’d have guessed there’d be
two of you brats?"
entries.translation_source: I heard a guy with a green hat was wandering around the route. But who’d have guessed there’d be two of you brats?
entries.translated:
Ho sentito che un tipo con un
cappello verde stava girovagando\lper il percorso. Ma chi avrebbe mai

immaginato che ci sarebbero stati
due marmocchi come voi?

entries.original:
"Gah! Didn’t your mother teach you
any manners, kid!?"
entries.translation_source: Gah! Didn’t your mother teach you any manners, kid!?
entries.translated:
Accidenti! Tua madre non ti ha
insegnato le buone maniere,\lragazzino!?

entries.original:
"Geez\.

Brats like you make me wonder why
anyone would even have ’em, least\lof all Zeph\."
entries.translation_source: Geez[game-token-1] Brats like you make me wonder why anyone would even have ’em, least of all Zeph[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Accidenti\. Marmocchi come te mi
fanno venire da chiedermi perché\lqualcuno dovrebbe averne,

figuriamoci Zeph\.

entries.original:
"Hey, I just follow orders.
They don’t tell me anything."
entries.translation_source: Hey, I just follow orders. They don’t tell me anything.
entries.translated:
Ehi, io eseguo solo gli ordini. Non
mi dicono niente.

entries.original:
"Gah\. That was painful\.

But I guess I’ll think of it as giving
Lady Ivory a chance to beat you\ldown herself!

Ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Gah[game-token-1] That was painful[game-token-2] But I guess I’ll think of it as giving Lady Ivory a chance to beat you down herself! Ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Accidenti\. È stato doloroso\. Però
immagino che la considererò come\lun{B4}occasione per Lady Ivory di

metterti al tappeto lei stessa! Ah
ah ah!

entries.original:
"I mean, it’s called \qothe dark
force\qc, so\.

Not exactly gonna use it for anything
other than to ruin someone’s day,\ldon’t you think?"
entries.translation_source: I mean, it’s called [quote-open-1]the dark force[quote-close-2], so[game-token-3] Not exactly gonna use it for anything other than to ruin someone’s day, don’t you think?
entries.translated:
Voglio dire, si chiama \qoil potere
oscuro\qc, quindi\. Non è che lo userai\lper altro se non per rovinare la

giornata a qualcuno, non credi?

entries.original:
"Prepare to face the wrath of
the Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: Prepare to face the wrath of the Shadows!
entries.translated:
Preparati ad affrontare l{B4}ira delle
Ombre!

entries.original:
"C’mon\. what kind of wrath was that,
anyway?"
entries.translation_source: C’mon[game-token-1] what kind of wrath was that, anyway?
entries.translated:
Andiamo\. che razza di furia era
quella, poi?

entries.original:
"Ha! Not like you’ll ever beat all of
us, anyway!

We’ve got all the pull we need to
get back up, again and again!"
entries.translation_source: Ha! Not like you’ll ever beat all of us, anyway! We’ve got all the pull we need to get back up, again and again!
entries.translated:
Ha! Tanto non riuscirai mai a
batterci tutti! Abbiamo tutta la\lgrinta di cui abbiamo bisogno per

rialzarci, ancora e ancora!

entries.original:
"Whatever. Don’t mind me.

I’ll just watch for anyone else out
here, in this miserable damp\lplace\. not that you’d care what\lsomeone from the Shadows thinks\."
entries.translation_source: Whatever. Don’t mind me. I’ll just watch for anyone else out here, in this miserable damp place[game-token-1] not that you’d care what someone from the Shadows thinks[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Fa{B4} come vuoi. Non badare a me.
Terrò d{B4}occhio chiunque altro sia\lqui fuori, in questo posto umido e

miserabile\. non che ti importi di
quello che pensa qualcuno delle\lOmbre\.

entries.original:
"You’re in for a real shocker, kid.

I’ve just called back all grunts
standing guard at the barrier, so\lnow we’re all over this route!"
entries.translation_source: You’re in for a real shocker, kid. I’ve just called back all grunts standing guard at the barrier, so now we’re all over this route!
entries.translated:
Ti aspetta una bella scossa,
ragazzino. Ho appena richiamato\ltutte le reclute di guardia al

varco, quindi ora siamo dappertutto
su questa strada!

entries.original:
"Well, even if you find your way
somehow, you’ll have to deal with\lLady Ivory.

So I’d do the smart thing, and turn
around and go home."
entries.translation_source: Well, even if you find your way somehow, you’ll have to deal with Lady Ivory. So I’d do the smart thing, and turn around and go home.
entries.translated:
Beh, anche se in qualche modo
trovassi la strada, dovresti\lcomunque vedertela con Lady Ivory.

Quindi io farei la cosa
intelligente e tornerei a casa.

entries.original:
"Erk\. This is getting way too close!

Fine! I guess I’ll just let Ivory
deal with you kids herself!\lY-yeah, that’s it!"
entries.translation_source: Erk[game-token-1] This is getting way too close! Fine! I guess I’ll just let Ivory deal with you kids herself! Y-yeah, that’s it!
entries.translated:
Erk\. Si sta avvicinando troppo! Va
bene! Immagino che lascerò che\lIvory se la veda con voi ragazzi da

sola! S-sì, ecco!

Antiche rovine dove si dice che il
potere della forza oscura sia stato\lsigillato millenni fa.

"Okay, you’re all set, [player].

Okay, sei a posto, [player]. Sarò
qui se avrai bisogno di far curare\ldi nuovo i tuoi Pokémon.

"[player]!

I’m trying to battle these grunts,

entries.translated:
[player]! Sto cercando di
combattere queste reclute, ma posso\lcurarti in fretta!

entries.original: "Ughhhhh\."

entries.translated: Ughhhhh\.

"Once we take care of you, we’re
going to finish [player]!"
entries.translation_source: Once we take care of you, we’re going to finish [player-name-1]!
entries.translated:
Una volta sistemato te, finiremo
[player]!

Flip it?"

"This ancient switch has already
been flipped."

Questo antico interruttore è già
stato azionato.

entries.translated: [black]Tornare a [green]Dehara City[black]?

entries.translated: [green]Clopppps!

SCAMBIA QUI SOTTO, POI EVITARE IL

[black][buffer1] è passato attraverso il
portale!

Un parco divertimenti fuori Polder
Town dove si possono osservare\lmolti Pokémon rari allo stato

"

Hai catturato finora [buffer2]

\btn0CSposta \btn01Indietro \btn04Altro \btn00Lancia
[buffer1]

Skip"

Scambiare [buffer1] delle tue

Non hai abbastanza Safari Ball per
saltare questo Pokémon!

entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Safari Zone! For just $500, you can play the Safari Game. Would you like to play?
entries.translated:
Benvenuto nella Zona Safari! Con

"Okay.

entries.translated: Va bene. Torna ancora!

"We only use a special kind of

Qui usiamo solo un tipo speciale di

[black][player] ha ricevuto [buffer1]
Safari Ball dall{B4}addetto.

entries.translated:
Sono disponibili diverse modalità
di difficoltà nella Zona Safari.\lQuale vuoi provare?

run out of Safari Balls.

You can also leave whenever you’d
like by pressing \btn01.

If at any point you’d like to run
only from the current Pokémon,\lit’ll cost you some Safari Balls.

Well, I’ll wish you the best
of luck!"
entries.translation_source: We’ll call you on the PA when you run out of Safari Balls. You can also leave whenever you’d like by pressing [button-icon-1]. If at any point you’d like to run only from the current Pokémon, it’ll cost you some Safari Balls. Well, I’ll wish you the best of luck!
entries.translated:
Ti chiameremo tramite la PA quando
finirai le Safari Ball. Puoi anche\luscire quando vuoi premendo \btn01. Se

in qualsiasi momento vuoi scappare
solo dal Pokémon attuale, ti\lcosterà qualche Safari Ball. Beh,

ti auguro buona fortuna!

Come again!"

Hai preso la tua parte? Ripassa
pure!

Al momento non hai alcun punteggio

Mi dispiace! Non hai salvato prima
