di nuovo!

entries.original: "What would you like to know about?"
entries.translation_source: What would you like to know about?
entries.translated: Di cosa vorresti sapere?

entries.original:
"The Safari Game is an opportunity
for you to capture as many Pokémon\las you can.

To start off, you’re given special
Safari Balls.

While playing, the Pokémon you are
attempting to capture will appear\lin front of you.

Try your best to aim and hit it
with a Safari Ball.

If you manage to land a hit, and
the Pokémon stays in the Safari\lBall, it’s yours to keep!

Once you run out of Safari Balls or
choose to quit, the game is over."
entries.translation_source: The Safari Game is an opportunity for you to capture as many Pokémon as you can. To start off, you’re given special Safari Balls. While playing, the Pokémon you are attempting to capture will appear in front of you. Try your best to aim and hit it with a Safari Ball. If you manage to land a hit, and the Pokémon stays in the Safari Ball, it’s yours to keep! Once you run out of Safari Balls or choose to quit, the game is over.
entries.translated:
Il Safari Game è un{B4}opportunità per
catturare quanti più Pokémon\lpossibile. Per iniziare, riceverai

delle speciali Safari Ball. Mentre
giochi, il Pokémon che stai\lcercando di catturare apparirà

davanti a te. Cerca di mirare e
colpirlo con una Safari Ball. Se\lriesci a colpirlo e il Pokémon

rimane nella Safari Ball, sarà tuo!
Una volta che finisci le Safari\lBall o scegli di smettere, il gioco

è finito.

entries.original:
"There are different difficulty modes
for the Safari Game.

The higher the difficulty mode, the
faster the Pokémon you are trying\lto capture will move around.

The higher difficulty modes are
still beneficial, however.

They offer the chance for you to
encounter much rarer Pokémon than\lthose that can be found in the\llower difficulty modes."
entries.translation_source: There are different difficulty modes for the Safari Game. The higher the difficulty mode, the faster the Pokémon you are trying to capture will move around. The higher difficulty modes are still beneficial, however. They offer the chance for you to encounter much rarer Pokémon than those that can be found in the lower difficulty modes.
entries.translated:
Ci sono diverse modalità di
difficoltà per il Safari Game. Più\lalta è la modalità di difficoltà,

più velocemente si muoverà il
Pokémon che stai cercando di\lcatturare. Tuttavia, le modalità di

difficoltà più alte hanno comunque
dei vantaggi. Offrono la\lpossibilità di incontrare Pokémon

molto più rari di quelli che si
possono trovare nelle modalità di\ldifficoltà più basse.

entries.original:
"In the Safari Game, Berries can be
used to aid you in your capture.

Different Berries have different
effects, and at most three Berries\lcan be fed to a Pokémon a time.

If a Pokémon has already eaten
three Berries, any new Berries will\lreplace the effects of the oldest\lused Berry.

Which Berry would you like to know
about?"
entries.translation_source: In the Safari Game, Berries can be used to aid you in your capture. Different Berries have different effects, and at most three Berries can be fed to a Pokémon a time. If a Pokémon has already eaten three Berries, any new Berries will replace the effects of the oldest used Berry. Which Berry would you like to know about?
entries.translated:
Nel Safari Game, i Frutti possono
essere usati per aiutarti nella\lcattura. Frutti diversi hanno

effetti diversi, e al massimo si
possono dare tre Frutti a un\lPokémon alla volta. Se un Pokémon

ha già mangiato tre Frutti, ogni
nuovo Frutto sostituirà gli effetti\ldel Frutto usato per primo. Di

quale Frutto vorresti saperne di
più?

entries.original:
"Which Berry would you like to know
about?"
entries.translation_source: Which Berry would you like to know about?
entries.translated:
Su quale Bacca vorresti
informazioni?

entries.original:
"If a [green]Razz Berry[blue] is fed to a wild
Pokémon, it becomes slightly\leasier to capture.

Multiple Razz Berries can be fed
to the same Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: If a [color-green-1]Razz Berry[color-blue-2] is fed to a wild Pokémon, it becomes slightly easier to capture. Multiple Razz Berries can be fed to the same Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Se un [green]Razz Berry[blue] viene dato a un
Pokémon selvatico, sarà più facile\lda catturare. Si possono dare più

Razz Berry allo stesso Pokémon.

entries.original:
"If a [green]Nanab Berry[blue] is fed to a wild
Pokémon, it will move around less.

Multiple Nanab Berries can be fed
to the same Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: If a [color-green-1]Nanab Berry[color-blue-2] is fed to a wild Pokémon, it will move around less. Multiple Nanab Berries can be fed to the same Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Se un [green]Baccananas[blue] viene dato a un
Pokémon selvatico, si muoverà di\lmeno. Si possono dare più

Baccananas allo stesso Pokémon.

entries.original:
"If a [green]Bluk Berry[blue] is fed to a wild
Pokémon, it will move farther\ldistances when it moves, but it\lwill become easier to capture.

Multiple Bluk Berries can be fed
to the same Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: If a [color-green-1]Bluk Berry[color-blue-2] is fed to a wild Pokémon, it will move farther distances when it moves, but it will become easier to capture. Multiple Bluk Berries can be fed to the same Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Se una [green]Bluk Berry[blue] viene data a un
Pokémon selvatico, si sposterà per\ldistanze maggiori quando si muove,

ma sarà più facile da catturare. Si
possono dare più Bluk Berry allo\lstesso Pokémon.

entries.original:
"If a [green]Wepear Berry[blue] is fed to a wild
Pokémon, it will be confined to a\lsmaller movement area.

Only a single Weaper Berry can be
fed to a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: If a [color-green-1]Wepear Berry[color-blue-2] is fed to a wild Pokémon, it will be confined to a smaller movement area. Only a single Weaper Berry can be fed to a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Se un [green]Wepear Berry[blue] viene dato a un
Pokémon selvatico, verrà confinato\lin un{B4}area di movimento più

piccola. Si può dare soltanto una
Wepear Berry a un Pokémon.

entries.original:
"If a [green]Pinap Berry[blue] is fed to a wild
Pokémon, it will be more likely to\lhold an item when captured.

Only a single Pinap Berry can be
fed to a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: If a [color-green-1]Pinap Berry[color-blue-2] is fed to a wild Pokémon, it will be more likely to hold an item when captured. Only a single Pinap Berry can be fed to a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Se una [green]Pinap Berry[blue] viene data a un
Pokémon selvatico, avrà più\lprobabilità di tenere uno strumento

quando viene catturato. A un
Pokémon si può dare solo una Pinap\lBerry.

entries.original: "Berries"
entries.translation_source: Berries
entries.translated: Bacche

entries.original: "Difficulty Modes"
entries.translation_source: Difficulty Modes
entries.translated: Modalità di difficoltà

entries.original: "Razz Berry"
entries.translation_source: Razz Berry
entries.translated: Bacca Razz

entries.original: "Nanab Berry"
entries.translation_source: Nanab Berry
entries.translated: Bacca Nanab

entries.original: "Bluk Berry"
entries.translation_source: Bluk Berry
entries.translated: Bacca Bluk

entries.original: "Wepear Berry"
entries.translation_source: Wepear Berry
entries.translated: Baccapera

entries.original: "Pinap Berry"
entries.translation_source: Pinap Berry
entries.translated: Bacca Pinia

entries.original:
"The higher your catching streak is
in the Safari Game, the higher the\lchance you’ll catch something with\lgood stats!

I even heard a Shiny Pokémon will
appear every [green]30th[red] encounter\."
entries.translation_source: The higher your catching streak is in the Safari Game, the higher the chance you’ll catch something with good stats! I even heard a Shiny Pokémon will appear every [color-green-1]30th[color-red-2] encounter[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Più lunga è la tua serie di catture
nel Gioco Safari, maggiori sono le\lprobabilità che tu catturi qualcosa

con buone statistiche! Ho persino
sentito dire che un Pokémon\lcromatico apparirà a ogni [green]30°[red]

incontro\.

entries.original: "Seaport City"
entries.translation_source: Seaport City
entries.translated: Città Porto

entries.original: "Seaport City D"
entries.translation_source: Seaport City D
entries.translated: Città di Seaport D

entries.original: "Seaport City N"
entries.translation_source: Seaport City N
entries.translated: Città di Seaport N

entries.original: "Davy’s Shipyard"
entries.translation_source: Davy’s Shipyard
entries.translated: Cantiere navale di Davy

entries.original: "Seaport Warehouse"
entries.translation_source: Seaport Warehouse
entries.translated: Magazzino di Seaport

entries.original:
"I remember many years ago when
Seaport City was just beginning\lto blossom!

It was back then when the legend,
Aros, arrived and helped construct\lthe Battle Frontier."
entries.translation_source: I remember many years ago when Seaport City was just beginning to blossom! It was back then when the legend, Aros, arrived and helped construct the Battle Frontier.
entries.translated:
Ricordo molti anni fa, quando
Seaport City stava appena iniziando\la fiorire! Fu allora che la

leggenda, Aros, arrivò e aiutò a
costruire la Frontiera Lotta.

entries.original:
"Some of my former colleagues can
occasionally be found performing\lunethical experiments in the\lwarehouses around here.

Where did I used to work?

Cube Corp., of course."
entries.translation_source: Some of my former colleagues can occasionally be found performing unethical experiments in the warehouses around here. Where did I used to work? Cube Corp., of course.
entries.translated:
Alcuni dei miei ex colleghi possono
occasionalmente essere trovati a\lcondurre esperimenti non etici nei

magazzini qui intorno. Dove
lavoravo una volta? Alla Cube\lCorp., naturalmente.

entries.original:
"I thought I noticed one of my
former colleagues heading towards\lthe warehouse on the docks.

I can only imagine what sort of
unethical experiments she’s\lconducting there\.

I only hope that someone with some
authority finds which crate the\lpasscode is hidden under\."
entries.translation_source: I thought I noticed one of my former colleagues heading towards the warehouse on the docks. I can only imagine what sort of unethical experiments she’s conducting there[game-token-1] I only hope that someone with some authority finds which crate the passcode is hidden under[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Mi è sembrato di vedere uno dei
miei ex colleghi dirigersi verso il\lmagazzino ai moli. Posso solo

immaginare che tipo di esperimenti
non etici stia conducendo lì\. Spero\lsolo che qualcuno con un po{B4} di

autorità scopra sotto quale cassa è
nascosto il codice d{B4}accesso\.

entries.original:
"How’s it goin’, fella?

I came all the way here from
[green]Magnolia Town[red] in East Borrius to\lcheck out this here [green]Battle\lFrontier[red]!

I heard you can spend hours just
battlin’ nonstop!"
entries.translation_source: How’s it goin’, fella? I came all the way here from [color-green-1]Magnolia Town[color-red-2] in East Borrius to check out this here [color-green-3]Battle Frontier[color-red-4]! I heard you can spend hours just battlin’ nonstop!
entries.translated:
Come va, amico? Sono venuto fin qui
da [green]Magnolia Town[red], nell{B4}Est di\lBorrius, per dare un{B4}occhiata a

questo [green]Battle Frontier[red]! Ho sentito
che si possono passare ore a\lcombattere senza sosta!

entries.original:
"Seaport City is home to the one and
only [green]Breeder’s School[red].

If you like breeding Pokémon, you
should head there and study up!"
entries.translation_source: Seaport City is home to the one and only [color-green-1]Breeder’s School[color-red-2]. If you like breeding Pokémon, you should head there and study up!
entries.translated:
Seaport City ospita l{B4}unica e sola
[green]Scuola di Allevamento[red]. Se ti piace\lallevare Pokémon, dovresti andarci

e studiare un po{B4}!

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, but only members are
allowed into the Battleground."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, but only members are allowed into the Battleground.
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace, ma solo i membri
possono entrare nel Campo di\lBattaglia.

entries.original:
"Am I from Antisis City?
No way, José!

Don’t clump me in with those chumps
from down there.

I used ta work at the port there,
but times were tough so I came\lhere for a better life.

And whaddya know, the air’s cleaner
up here, and everyone’s friendly!

But I still see my fair share of
shady stuff going down here\.

Better watch your back if you know
what’s good for you\."
entries.translation_source: Am I from Antisis City? No way, José! Don’t clump me in with those chumps from down there. I used ta work at the port there, but times were tough so I came here for a better life. And whaddya know, the air’s cleaner up here, and everyone’s friendly! But I still see my fair share of shady stuff going down here[game-token-1] Better watch your back if you know what’s good for you[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Vengo da Antisis City? Macché,
José! Non mettermi nello stesso\lcalderone di quegli incapaci

laggiù. Lavoravo al porto laggiù,
ma i tempi erano duri così sono\lvenuto qui per una vita migliore. E

indovina un po{B4}, quassù l{B4}aria è
più pulita e tutti sono cordiali!\lMa vedo ancora la mia bella dose di

roba losca succedere qui\. Faresti
meglio a guardarti le spalle se\ltieni al tuo bene\.

entries.original:
"We make all kinds of ships here at
Captain Davy’s Shipyard.

Need a high speed boat?
Come to us.

Need an advanced underground
digging mechanism? Come to us, too.

We make it all.

Heck, I even hear the captain has
started working on a top secret\lspace ship\."
entries.translation_source: We make all kinds of ships here at Captain Davy’s Shipyard. Need a high speed boat? Come to us. Need an advanced underground digging mechanism? Come to us, too. We make it all. Heck, I even hear the captain has started working on a top secret space ship[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Costruiamo ogni tipo di nave qui al
Cantiere Navale di Capitano Davy.\lTi serve un motoscafo ad alta

velocità? Vieni da noi. Ti serve un
avanzato meccanismo di scavo\lsotterraneo? Vieni da noi, anche

per quello. Facciamo tutto.
Accidenti, ho persino sentito che\lil capitano ha iniziato a lavorare

su un{B4}astronave top secret\.

entries.original:
"Ever since Antisis City closed its
port to passengers, this port has\lbeen booming!

Not only do we sail passengers to
various locations in East Borrius,\lbut we also transport cargo to\ldifferent places around Borrius.

It’s a great gig!"
entries.translation_source: Ever since Antisis City closed its port to passengers, this port has been booming! Not only do we sail passengers to various locations in East Borrius, but we also transport cargo to different places around Borrius. It’s a great gig!
entries.translated:
Da quando Antisis City ha chiuso il
suo porto ai passeggeri, questo\lporto è in pieno boom! Non solo

trasportiamo passeggeri verso varie
località nella parte orientale di\lBorrius, ma trasportiamo anche

merci in diversi luoghi di Borrius.
È un ottimo lavoro!

entries.original:
"Someone should really put up an
official sign for the KBT\lExpressway here.

The only thing written about it is
scrawled on those steel beams."
entries.translation_source: Someone should really put up an official sign for the KBT Expressway here. The only thing written about it is scrawled on those steel beams.
entries.translated:
Qui ci vorrebbe davvero un cartello
ufficiale per la KBT Expressway.\lL{B4}unica cosa scritta a riguardo è

scarabocchiata su quelle travi
d{B4}acciaio.

entries.original:
"Hi, dear.
Would you like some exotic berries?"
entries.translation_source: Hi, dear. Would you like some exotic berries?
entries.translated:
Ciao, caro. Vuoi delle bacche
esotiche?

entries.original:
"I’m sorry!

I won’t bring my Shedinja again!

I promise!

Just please, let me back in!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry! I won’t bring my Shedinja again! I promise! Just please, let me back in!
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace! Non porterò più il mio
Shedinja! Lo prometto! Ti prego,\llasciami rientrare!

entries.original:
"What are exotic berries useful
for?

Only one thing comes to mind:
[green]Natural Gift[red]!

Take it, and you’ll see!"
entries.translation_source: What are exotic berries useful for? Only one thing comes to mind: [color-green-1]Natural Gift[color-red-2]! Take it, and you’ll see!
entries.translated:
A cosa servono le bacche esotiche?
Mi viene in mente solo una cosa:\l[green]Dono Naturale[red]! Prendilo e vedrai!

entries.original:
"Do you have any Berries you’d like
to know the [green]Natural Gift[red] of?"
entries.translation_source: Do you have any Berries you’d like to know the [color-green-1]Natural Gift[color-red-2] of?
entries.translated:
Hai delle Bacche di cui vorresti
conoscere il [green]Natural Gift[red]?

entries.original:
"Which Berry should I tell you
about?"
entries.translation_source: Which Berry should I tell you about?
entries.translated: Di quale Bacca vuoi che ti parli?

entries.original:
"That’s not a Berry!

Natural Gift can only be used with
Berries!"
entries.translation_source: That’s not a Berry! Natural Gift can only be used with Berries!
entries.translated:
Quella non è una Bacca! Dono Natura
può essere usata solo con le\lBacche!

entries.original:
"If [green]Natural Gift[red] were to consume the
[green][buffer1][red], the move’s type\lwould be [green][buffer2][red], and it would have\la base power of [green][buffer3][red]!"
entries.translation_source: If [color-green-1]Natural Gift[color-red-2] were to consume the [color-green-3][buffer1-4][color-red-5], the move’s type would be [color-green-6][buffer2-7][color-red-8], and it would have a base power of [color-green-9][buffer3-10][color-red-11]!
entries.translated:
Se [green]Dono Naturale[red] dovesse consumare
[green][buffer1][red], il tipo della mossa\lsarebbe [green][buffer2][red] e avrebbe una

potenza base di [green][buffer3][red]!

entries.original:
"Exotic berries like the [green]Durin
Berry[red] turn [green]Natural Gift[red] into a\lsomewhat powerful one-use attack!"
entries.translation_source: Exotic berries like the [color-green-1]Durin Berry[color-red-2] turn [color-green-3]Natural Gift[color-red-4] into a somewhat powerful one-use attack!
entries.translated:
Le bacche esotiche come la
[green]Baccadurin[red] trasformano [green]Dono\lNaturale[red] in un attacco monouso

piuttosto potente!

entries.original:
"After many, many, many years of
fishing, my time has come to\lretire from being the greatest\lFishing Guru in existence.

But I cannot leave without passing
on my legacy.

Will you inherit this [green]Super Rod[blue]
from me?

It is my last wish\."
entries.translation_source: After many, many, many years of fishing, my time has come to retire from being the greatest Fishing Guru in existence. But I cannot leave without passing on my legacy. Will you inherit this [color-green-1]Super Rod[color-blue-2] from me? It is my last wish[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Dopo molti, molti, molti anni di
pesca, è giunto il momento per me\ldi ritirarmi dall{B4}essere il più

grande Guru della Pesca mai
esistito. Ma non posso andarmene\lsenza trasmettere la mia eredità.

Vuoi ereditare da me questo [green]Super
Amo[blue]? È il mio ultimo desiderio\.

entries.original: "Take it, then."
entries.translation_source: Take it, then.
entries.translated: Prendilo, allora.

entries.original:
"Thank you\. truly\.

My legacy will live on within you."
entries.translation_source: Thank you[game-token-1] truly[game-token-2] My legacy will live on within you.
entries.translated:
Grazie\. davvero\. La mia eredità
continuerà a vivere in te.

entries.original:
"You are not the one I was waiting
for, then\."
entries.translation_source: You are not the one I was waiting for, then[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Allora non sei tu quello che stavo
aspettando\.

entries.original:
"Ahoy, there!

If you want to set sail to [green]Polder
Town[blue], you’ll need an [green]S.S. Ticket[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Ahoy, there! If you want to set sail to [color-green-1]Polder Town[color-blue-2], you’ll need an [color-green-3]S.S. Ticket[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Ahoy, marinaio! Se vuoi salpare
verso [green]Polder Town[blue], ti servirà un\l[green]Biglietto S.S.[blue].

entries.original:
"Ahoy, there!

If you want to set sail, both you
and the person with you will need\lan [green]S.S. Ticket[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Ahoy, there! If you want to set sail, both you and the person with you will need an [color-green-1]S.S. Ticket[color-blue-2].
entries.translated:
Salve! Se vuoi salpare, sia tu sia
la persona che ti accompagna avrete\lbisogno di un [green]S.S. Ticket[blue].

entries.original:
"Ahoy, there!
Where do you want to sail?"
entries.translation_source: Ahoy, there! Where do you want to sail?
entries.translated: Ehi, voi là! Dove vuoi salpare?

entries.original:
"All right!
All aboard Seagallop Hi-Speed [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: All right! All aboard Seagallop Hi-Speed [buffer1-1]!
entries.translated:
Bene! Tutti a bordo del Seagallop
Hi-Speed [buffer1]!

entries.original:
"Ahoy, there!
You must be [player].

Your friends have already boarded
the boat to Polder Town.

You’re the last passenger, so we’ll
set sail right way."
entries.translation_source: Ahoy, there! You must be [player-name-1]. Your friends have already boarded the boat to Polder Town. You’re the last passenger, so we’ll set sail right way.
entries.translated:
Ehilà! Devi essere [player]. I tuoi
amici sono già saliti sulla barca\lper Polder Town. Sei l{B4}ultimo

passeggero, quindi salperemo
subito.

entries.original: "Shark Bait"
entries.translation_source: Shark Bait
entries.translated: Esca per squali

entries.original:
"The Sharpedo on the ocean floor of
Route 17 have become agitated!
Calm down [buffer1] of them."
entries.translation_source: The Sharpedo on the ocean floor of Route 17 have become agitated! Calm down [buffer1-1] of them.
entries.translated:
Gli Sharpedo sul fondale oceanico
del Percorso 17 si sono agitati!\lCalma [buffer1] di loro.

entries.original:
"Champion, it’s good to see you
again!

Do you not remember me?

You helped me out with the Terror
Granbull way back on Route 10!

If only our meeting now could be
under better circumstances.

You see, the local police force
is in desperate need of your\lassistance once again.

Something has caused the Sharpedo
living on the ocean floor of [green]Route\l17[blue] to become highly agitated.

I was informed you recently bought
a diving machine, so, if you would\llend it, we would like your help\lwith calming down the [green]Sharpedo[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Champion, it’s good to see you again! Do you not remember me? You helped me out with the Terror Granbull way back on Route 10! If only our meeting now could be under better circumstances. You see, the local police force is in desperate need of your assistance once again. Something has caused the Sharpedo living on the ocean floor of [color-green-1]Route 17[color-blue-2] to become highly agitated. I was informed you recently bought a diving machine, so, if you would lend it, we would like your help with calming down the [color-green-3]Sharpedo[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Campione, è bello rivederti! Non ti
ricordi di me? Mi hai aiutato con\lil Terror Granbull tanto tempo fa

sul Percorso 10! Se solo il nostro
incontro potesse avvenire in\lcircostanze migliori. Vedi, la

polizia locale ha disperatamente
bisogno del tuo aiuto ancora una\lvolta. Qualcosa ha fatto sì che gli

Sharpedo che vivono sul fondo
dell{B4}oceano del [green]Percorso 17[blue]\ldiventassero molto agitati. Sono

stato informato che hai comprato di
recente una macchina subacquea,\lquindi, se la prestassi, vorremmo

il tuo aiuto per calmare gli
[green]Sharpedo[blue].

entries.original:
"Our forces cannot do this without
you, Champion.

If you decide later on to lend a
hand, it will be much appreciated."
entries.translation_source: Our forces cannot do this without you, Champion. If you decide later on to lend a hand, it will be much appreciated.
entries.translated:
Le nostre forze non possono farcela
senza di te, Campione. Se deciderai\lpiù tardi di darci una mano, te ne

saremo molto grati.

entries.original:
"I knew we could count on you once
again, Champion!"
entries.translation_source: I knew we could count on you once again, Champion!
entries.translated:
Sapevo che potevamo contare di
nuovo su di te, Campione!

entries.original:
"The [green]Sharpedo[blue] are swimming around
[green]underwater[blue] on [green]Route 17[blue].

The boys back at HQ have informed
me there are about [green][buffer1][blue] of them that\lhave been agitated.

Oh, and I should warn you, any
Sharpedo calmed down will likely\lbecome agitated once more if you\lresurface.

Make sure you do not emerge from
the water until you have taken\lcare of them all.

If you’re smart, which I know you
are, you’ll stock up on healing\litems before heading down there."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Sharpedo[color-blue-2] are swimming around [color-green-3]underwater[color-blue-4] on [color-green-5]Route 17[color-blue-6]. The boys back at HQ have informed me there are about [color-green-7][buffer1-8][color-blue-9] of them that have been agitated. Oh, and I should warn you, any Sharpedo calmed down will likely become agitated once more if you resurface. Make sure you do not emerge from the water until you have taken care of them all. If you’re smart, which I know you are, you’ll stock up on healing items before heading down there.
entries.translated:
Gli [green]Sharpedo[blue] nuotano [green]sott{B4}acqua[blue] sul
[green]Percorso 17[blue]. I ragazzi al quartier\lgenerale mi hanno informato che ce

ne sono circa [green][buffer1][blue] che si sono
agitati. Ah, e devo avvertirti,\lqualsiasi Sharpedo calmato

probabilmente si agiterà di nuovo
se riemergi in superficie.\lAssicurati di non emergere

dall{B4}acqua finché non li avrai
sistemati tutti. Se sei\lintelligente, e so che lo sei,

farai scorta di strumenti curativi
prima di scendere laggiù.

entries.original:
"There’s no doubt in my mind
that you’re the Champion!

Please, accept this payment for
your services to the police force."
entries.translation_source: There’s no doubt in my mind that you’re the Champion! Please, accept this payment for your services to the police force.
entries.translated:
Non ho dubbi che tu sia il
Campione! Ti prego, accetta questo\lcompenso per il tuo servizio alla

polizia.

entries.original:
"\qoAsk not what your region can do
for you, but what you can do for\lyour region.\qc

I have never met anyone who
embodied those words more,\lChampion.

Until we meet again, farewell."
entries.translation_source: [quote-open-1]Ask not what your region can do for you, but what you can do for your region.[quote-close-2] I have never met anyone who embodied those words more, Champion. Until we meet again, farewell.
entries.translated:
\qoNon chiedere cosa può fare la tua
regione per te, ma cosa puoi fare\ltu per la tua regione.\qc Non ho mai

incontrato nessuno che incarnasse
quelle parole meglio di te,\lCampione. Fino al nostro prossimo

incontro, addio.

entries.original:
"Hey there, Pokémon Trainer!

I’m a member of the Hip Waders!

Just as the name suggests, we’re a
fishing club!

Why don’t you join up and enjoy
some fishing?"
entries.translation_source: Hey there, Pokémon Trainer! I’m a member of the Hip Waders! Just as the name suggests, we’re a fishing club! Why don’t you join up and enjoy some fishing?
entries.translated:
Ehi, allenatore Pokémon! Sono un
membro degli Hip Waders! Come\lsuggerisce il nome, siamo un club

di pesca! Perché non ti unisci a
noi e ti godi un po{B4} di pesca?

entries.original:
"That’s the way the tide turns, huh?

But, I won’t give up. If you change
your mind, come see me again!"
entries.translation_source: That’s the way the tide turns, huh? But, I won’t give up. If you change your mind, come see me again!
entries.translated:
Così gira la marea, eh? Ma non mi
arrenderò. Se cambi idea, torna a\ltrovarmi!

entries.original:
"Awesome! Now you are the third
member of the Hip Waders!

Here we go!

I’ll announce the Official Hip
Waders Catch of the Day!

The Pokémon we’re fishing for
today is [green][buffer1][blue]!

If you catch one, please show it
to me!"
entries.translation_source: Awesome! Now you are the third member of the Hip Waders! Here we go! I’ll announce the Official Hip Waders Catch of the Day! The Pokémon we’re fishing for today is [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]! If you catch one, please show it to me!
entries.translated:
Fantastico! Ora sei il terzo membro
degli Hip Waders! Eccoci qui!\lAnnuncerò la Cattura Ufficiale del

Giorno degli Hip Waders! Il Pokémon
che stiamo cercando di pescare oggi\lè [green][buffer1][blue]! Se ne catturi uno, per

favore fammelo vedere!

entries.original:
"The Official Hip Waders Catch of
the Day is [green][buffer1][blue]!

Have you caught one already?"
entries.translation_source: The Official Hip Waders Catch of the Day is [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]! Have you caught one already?
entries.translated:
La Cattura del Giorno ufficiale di
Hip Waders è [green][buffer1][blue]! Ne hai già\lpreso uno?

entries.original:
"The Official Hip Waders Catch of
the Day is [green][buffer1][blue]!

I’m counting on you, Member No. 3!"
entries.translation_source: The Official Hip Waders Catch of the Day is [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]! I’m counting on you, Member No. 3!
entries.translated:
La cattura del giorno ufficiale
degli Hip Waders è [green][buffer1][blue]! Conto\lsu di te, membro n. 3!

entries.original:
"Oh! This is an Egg!

I can’t tell if it’s the Offical
Hip Waders Catch of the Day! Sorry!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! This is an Egg! I can’t tell if it’s the Offical Hip Waders Catch of the Day! Sorry!
entries.translated:
Oh! Questo è un Uovo! Non riesco a
dire se sia l{B4}Offical Hip Waders\lCatch of the Day! Scusa!

entries.original:
"Oh! This is a great [buffer1]!

But it’s not the Official Hip
Waders Catch of the Day. Sorry!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! This is a great [buffer1-1]! But it’s not the Official Hip Waders Catch of the Day. Sorry!
entries.translated:
Oh! Questo è un ottimo [buffer1]! Ma
non è la Cattura del giorno\lufficiale di Hip Waders. Scusa!

entries.original:
"Oh! This is a great [buffer1]!

That’s why you’re the third member
of the Hip Waders!

Cool! Take these with you!"
entries.translation_source: Oh! This is a great [buffer1-1]! That’s why you’re the third member of the Hip Waders! Cool! Take these with you!
entries.translated:
Oh! Questo è un grande [buffer1]!
Ecco perché sei il terzo membro\ldegli Hip Waders! Fantastico!

Prendi questi con te!

entries.original:
"The appeal of fishing\.

That’s something you have to
discover through experience, rather\lthan listening to me explaining\labout it!

Right, Member No. 3?"
entries.translation_source: The appeal of fishing[game-token-1] That’s something you have to discover through experience, rather than listening to me explaining about it! Right, Member No. 3?
entries.translated:
Il fascino della pesca\. È qualcosa
che devi scoprire con l{B4}esperienza,\linvece di ascoltare me che te ne

parlo! Giusto, Membro n. 3?

entries.original: "Will you show me a tiny Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Will you show me a tiny Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Mi mostreresti un Pokémon
minuscolo?

entries.original:
"Hm\.

You don’t have the teensiest bit of
an urge to show me a tiny Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Hm[game-token-1] You don’t have the teensiest bit of an urge to show me a tiny Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Hm\. Non hai nemmeno un pochino
voglia di mostrarmi un Pokémon\lminuscolo.

entries.original:
"Hm\.
That Pokémon isn’t small enough.

I’d sure like to see a Pokémon
that’s 20 centimetres high or\lsmaller\."
entries.translation_source: Hm[game-token-1] That Pokémon isn’t small enough. I’d sure like to see a Pokémon that’s 20 centimetres high or smaller[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Hm\. Quel Pokémon non è abbastanza
piccolo. Mi piacerebbe proprio\lvedere un Pokémon alto 20

centimetri o meno\.

entries.original:
"Hm\.

I can’t see how small the Pokémon
is while it’s in an Egg."
entries.translation_source: Hm[game-token-1] I can’t see how small the Pokémon is while it’s in an Egg.
entries.translated:
Hm\. Non riesco a vedere quanto è
piccolo il Pokémon quando è in un\lUovo.

entries.original:
"Wow! Amazing!
[buffer1] is so tiny!

I wonder what it would feel like to
become [buffer1]\.

I bet I’d get a way different
outlook on life\.

Just imagining it gets me excited!
Tiny things are super interesting!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Amazing! [buffer1-1] is so tiny! I wonder what it would feel like to become [buffer1-2][game-token-3] I bet I’d get a way different outlook on life[game-token-4] Just imagining it gets me excited! Tiny things are super interesting!
entries.translated:
Wow! Incredibile! [buffer1] è così
piccolo! Mi chiedo che effetto\lfarebbe diventare [buffer1]\.

Scommetto che avrei una prospettiva
sulla vita totalmente diversa\. Solo\limmaginarlo mi elettrizza! Le cose

piccole sono super interessanti!

entries.original:
"Thanks for showing me a tiny
Pokémon!

It was super interesting!

I’d sure like it if you’d show me
one again tomorrow\."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for showing me a tiny Pokémon! It was super interesting! I’d sure like it if you’d show me one again tomorrow[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Grazie per avermi mostrato un
Pokémon piccolo! È stato super\linteressante! Mi piacerebbe molto

se me ne mostrassi un altro domani\.

entries.original:
"Have you come to show me a big
Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Have you come to show me a big Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Sei venuto a mostrarmi un Pokémon
grande?

entries.original:
"What!?
I wanna see a big Pokémon!

I wanna see a Pokémon bigger than
7 metres!"
entries.translation_source: What!? I wanna see a big Pokémon! I wanna see a Pokémon bigger than 7 metres!
entries.translated:
Cosa!? Voglio vedere un Pokémon
grande! Voglio vedere un Pokémon\lpiù grande di 7 metri!

entries.original:
"What!?
That’s not a big Pokémon!

I wanna see a Pokémon bigger than
7 metres!"
entries.translation_source: What!? That’s not a big Pokémon! I wanna see a Pokémon bigger than 7 metres!
entries.translated:
Cosa!? Quello non è un Pokémon
grande! Voglio vedere un Pokémon\lpiù grande di 7 metri!

entries.original:
"What!?

I can’t see how tall it is when
it’s in an Egg!"
entries.translation_source: What!? I can’t see how tall it is when it’s in an Egg!
entries.translated:
Cosa!? Non posso vedere quanto è
alto quando è in un Uovo!

entries.original:
"Wow! Amazing!
[buffer1] is sooooo big!

Riding on top of [buffer1]
would be so much fun!

When you look from high places, you
can see rooftops and faraway\lmountains and other things you\lusually can’t see.

That’s why I like big things so
much!"
entries.translation_source: Wow! Amazing! [buffer1-1] is sooooo big! Riding on top of [buffer1-2] would be so much fun! When you look from high places, you can see rooftops and faraway mountains and other things you usually can’t see. That’s why I like big things so much!
entries.translated:
Wow! Fantastico! [buffer1] è
cosìooooo grande! Cavalcare sopra\l[buffer1] sarebbe così divertente!

Quando guardi da posti alti, puoi
vedere i tetti, le montagne lontane\le altre cose che di solito non

riesci a vedere. Ecco perché mi
piacciono così tanto le cose\lgrandi!

entries.original:
"Big thanks for showing me a big
Pokémon!

I’d be even more happy if you’d
show me one tomorrow, too!"
entries.translation_source: Big thanks for showing me a big Pokémon! I’d be even more happy if you’d show me one tomorrow, too!
entries.translated:
Grazie mille per avermi mostrato un
Pokémon grande! Sarebbe ancora\lmeglio se domani me ne mostrassi un

altro!

entries.original: "Pangs of Hunger"
entries.translation_source: Pangs of Hunger
entries.translated: Morsi della fame

entries.original:
"A sad woman hasn’t been hungry
lately. Bring her different
Pokémon to cheer her up!"
entries.translation_source: A sad woman hasn’t been hungry lately. Bring her different Pokémon to cheer her up!
entries.translated:
Una donna triste non ha avuto molta
fame ultimamente. Portale dei\ldiversi Pokémon per tirarle su il

morale!

entries.original:
"A woman hasn’t been hungry lately.
Bring her a Pokémon resembling a
sea cucumber to cheer her up!"
entries.translation_source: A woman hasn’t been hungry lately. Bring her a Pokémon resembling a sea cucumber to cheer her up!
entries.translated:
Una donna non ha molta fame
ultimamente. Portale un Pokémon che\lassomiglia a un cetriolo di mare

per tirarla su di morale!

entries.original:
"A woman hasn’t been hungry lately.
Bring her a Pokémon with a big
nose and moustache to cheer her up!"
entries.translation_source: A woman hasn’t been hungry lately. Bring her a Pokémon with a big nose and moustache to cheer her up!
entries.translated:
Una donna non ha più avuto fame
ultimamente. Portale un Pokémon con\lun grande naso e i baffi per

tirarla su di morale!

entries.original:
"I haven’t been up to eating much
lately\.

Maybe what I need is to hear a cry
that sounds like mastication.

That might get my hunger up.

Do you know about this?

A Pokémon resembling a [green]sea
cucumber[red] has a cry that sounds\llike it’s gobbling something up!

I’d sure like to hear it sometime."
entries.translation_source: I haven’t been up to eating much lately[game-token-1] Maybe what I need is to hear a cry that sounds like mastication. That might get my hunger up. Do you know about this? A Pokémon resembling a [color-green-2]sea cucumber[color-red-3] has a cry that sounds like it’s gobbling something up! I’d sure like to hear it sometime.
entries.translated:
Non ho avuto molta voglia di
mangiare ultimamente\. Forse quello\lche mi serve è sentire un verso che

suoni come una masticazione.
Potrebbe farmi venire fame. Ne sai\lqualcosa? Un Pokémon che assomiglia

a un [green]cetriolo di mare[red] ha un verso
che sembra quello di qualcosa che\lingoia a gran bocconi! Mi

piacerebbe proprio sentirlo, prima
o poi.

entries.original:
"The cry of the Pyukumuku with
you\.

Gobble gobble gobble!
It sounds just like its eating!"
entries.translation_source: The cry of the Pyukumuku with you[game-token-1] Gobble gobble gobble! It sounds just like its eating!
entries.translated:
Il verso del Pyukumuku con te\.
Gobble gobble gobble! Sembra\lproprio che stia mangiando!

entries.original:
"If I could hear just one more cry,
my heart would flutter and my\lmouth would chomp on so much food!

I hear there’s a Pokémon with a
really [green]big nose and moustache[red] that\lhas a cry that sounds just like a\lman sneezing.

If I knew what it sounded like, I
could forget my nose and focus\lsolely on my mouth!"
entries.translation_source: If I could hear just one more cry, my heart would flutter and my mouth would chomp on so much food! I hear there’s a Pokémon with a really [color-green-1]big nose and moustache[color-red-2] that has a cry that sounds just like a man sneezing. If I knew what it sounded like, I could forget my nose and focus solely on my mouth!
entries.translated:
Se potessi sentire ancora un verso,
il mio cuore sussulterebbe e la mia\lbocca si riempirebbe di cibo da

masticare! Ho sentito che c{B4}è un
Pokémon con un [green]naso grande e i\lbaffi[red] che ha un verso che suona

proprio come uno starnuto di un
uomo. Se sapessi com{B4}è, potrei\ldimenticarmi del naso e

concentrarmi solo sulla bocca!

entries.original:
"The cry of the Probopass with
you\.

It sounds just like it’s sneezing!

It makes me giggle from the bottom
up!"
entries.translation_source: The cry of the Probopass with you[game-token-1] It sounds just like it’s sneezing! It makes me giggle from the bottom up!
entries.translated:
Il verso del Probopass con te\.
Sembra proprio che stia\lstarnutendo! Mi fa ridere di cuore!

entries.original:
"Thanks to you and your Pokémon, my
stomach is rumbling!

I feel like I could eat a truck!

This is a token of my appreciation
for getting me to eat again.

Thanks!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks to you and your Pokémon, my stomach is rumbling! I feel like I could eat a truck! This is a token of my appreciation for getting me to eat again. Thanks!
entries.translated:
Grazie a te e ai tuoi Pokémon, il
mio stomaco brontola! Mi sento come\lse potessi mangiare un camion!

Questo è un segno della mia
gratitudine per avermi fatto\ltornare a mangiare. Grazie!

entries.original:
"Oh\.
I’m so full\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] I’m so full[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Oh\. Sono così sazio\.

entries.original:
"My work always keeps me very busy,
so I’m thrilled if I can go home at\lnight.

I’m sorry to leave my wife lonely,
but that’s the life of a powerful\lexecutive.

Oh, this is a souvenir from a
business trip.

She does not seem to need it,
so I will give it to you."
entries.translation_source: My work always keeps me very busy, so I’m thrilled if I can go home at night. I’m sorry to leave my wife lonely, but that’s the life of a powerful executive. Oh, this is a souvenir from a business trip. She does not seem to need it, so I will give it to you.
entries.translated:
Il mio lavoro mi tiene sempre molto
occupato, quindi sono felicissimo\lse riesco a tornare a casa la sera.

Mi dispiace lasciare mia moglie da
sola, ma questa è la vita di un\ldirigente di alto livello. Oh,

questo è un souvenir di un viaggio
di lavoro. Non sembra averne\lbisogno, quindi lo darò a te.

entries.original:
"Tomorrow it’s work as always!

I’m a super businessman, aren’t I?"
entries.translation_source: Tomorrow it’s work as always! I’m a super businessman, aren’t I?
entries.translated:
Domani si lavora come sempre! Sono
un super uomo d{B4}affari, no?

entries.original:
"My husband is a very well known
businessman from Cube Corp.

We recently moved here from the
Alola region so he could be closer\lto work and would be able to\lcome home each night.

I brought along three Pokémon with
me that used to keep me company\lat night when I was lonely, but\lnow that my husband returns home\learlier, I’ve begun to neglect\lthem.

I want them to be happy, and the
best way for me to do that is to\lentrust them to a caring Trainer.

You seem the type, would you like
one of these Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: My husband is a very well known businessman from Cube Corp. We recently moved here from the Alola region so he could be closer to work and would be able to come home each night. I brought along three Pokémon with me that used to keep me company at night when I was lonely, but now that my husband returns home earlier, I’ve begun to neglect them. I want them to be happy, and the best way for me to do that is to entrust them to a caring Trainer. You seem the type, would you like one of these Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Mio marito è un uomo d{B4}affari molto
conosciuto della Cube Corp. Ci\lsiamo trasferiti qui di recente

dalla regione di Alola così che lui
potesse essere più vicino al lavoro\le tornare a casa ogni sera. Ho

portato con me tre Pokémon che una
volta mi tenevano compagnia la\lnotte quando mi sentivo sola, ma

ora che mio marito torna a casa
prima, ho iniziato a trascurarli.\lVoglio che siano felici, e il modo

migliore per farlo è affidarli a un
Allenatore premuroso. Sembri il\ltipo giusto, ti piacerebbe uno di

questi Pokémon?

entries.original:
"You came back! I’m so glad\.

Which of my Pokémon would you like
today?"
entries.translation_source: You came back! I’m so glad[game-token-1] Which of my Pokémon would you like today?
entries.translated:
Sei tornato! Sono così felice\. Quale
dei miei Pokémon vorresti oggi?

entries.original:
"Maybe you’re not as caring as I
thought."
entries.translation_source: Maybe you’re not as caring as I thought.
entries.translated:
Forse non sei premuroso quanto
pensassi.

entries.original:
"Before you hear my spiel, make some
room in your party for a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Before you hear my spiel, make some room in your party for a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Prima di ascoltare il mio discorso,
fai spazio nella tua squadra per un\lPokémon.

entries.original:
"I don’t want to give each away too
fast\.

Come again when you have [green][buffer1] Badges[red],
and I will give you another one."
entries.translation_source: I don’t want to give each away too fast[game-token-1] Come again when you have [color-green-2][buffer1-3] Badges[color-red-4], and I will give you another one.
entries.translated:
Non voglio distribuirle troppo in
fretta\. Torna quando avrai [green][buffer1]\lMedaglie[red], e te ne darò un{B4}altra.

entries.original:
"I hope you care well for those
Pokémon I entrusted to you!"
entries.translation_source: I hope you care well for those Pokémon I entrusted to you!
entries.translated:
Spero che tu abbia cura di quei
Pokémon che ti ho affidato!

entries.original: "[green]Rowlet"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Rowlet
entries.translated: [green]Rowlet

entries.original: "[lightgreen]Litten"
entries.translation_source: [color-lightgreen-1]Litten
entries.translated: [lightgreen]Litten

entries.original: "[blue]Popplio"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Popplio
entries.translated: [blue]Popplio

entries.original:
"My dream has always been to see the
ultimate Pumpkaboo.

Yes\.
One whose size rivals all others!

Do you have such a [green]Pumpkaboo[red]?"
entries.translation_source: My dream has always been to see the ultimate Pumpkaboo. Yes[game-token-1] One whose size rivals all others! Do you have such a [color-green-2]Pumpkaboo[color-red-3]?
entries.translated:
Il mio sogno è sempre stato quello
di vedere il Pumpkaboo definitivo.\lSì\. Uno le cui dimensioni

rivaleggiano con tutte le altre!
Hai per caso un [green]Pumpkaboo[red] così?

entries.original:
"I knew you would not be able to
show me such a Pumpkaboo\."
entries.translation_source: I knew you would not be able to show me such a Pumpkaboo[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sapevo che non saresti stato in
grado di mostrarmi un Pumpkaboo del\lgenere\.

entries.original:
"That won’t do.

Does that look like a Pumpkaboo
to you?"
entries.translation_source: That won’t do. Does that look like a Pumpkaboo to you?
entries.translated:
Non va bene. Ti sembra un
Pumpkaboo?

entries.original:
"Hmph.
It’s just [buffer2] inches.

The Pumpkaboo before was bigger.

It was [green][buffer3][red] inches, the
biggest Pumpkaboo you brought me."
entries.translation_source: Hmph. It’s just [buffer2-1] inches. The Pumpkaboo before was bigger. It was [color-green-2][buffer3-3][color-red-4] inches, the biggest Pumpkaboo you brought me.
entries.translated:
Tsk. Sono solo [buffer2] pollici. Il
Pumpkaboo di prima era più grande.\lEra [green][buffer3][red] pollici, il Pumpkaboo

più grande che mi hai portato.

entries.original:
"Woah!
It’s [buffer2] inches!

I’ve never seen anything like this!
You deserve a reward!"
entries.translation_source: Woah! It’s [buffer2-1] inches! I’ve never seen anything like this! You deserve a reward!
entries.translated:
Wow! Misura [buffer2] pollici! Non
ho mai visto niente di simile!\lMeriti una ricompensa!

entries.original:
"I still want to see a much [green]larger[red]
Pumpkaboo than that one.

I hope to someday fulfill my dream
of seeing the ultimate Pumpkaboo."
entries.translation_source: I still want to see a much [color-green-1]larger[color-red-2] Pumpkaboo than that one. I hope to someday fulfill my dream of seeing the ultimate Pumpkaboo.
entries.translated:
Vorrei ancora vedere un Pumpkaboo
molto [green]più grande[red] di quello. Spero\lun giorno di realizzare il mio

sogno di vedere il Pumpkaboo
definitivo.

entries.original:
"Huh? This [buffer2] measurement\.

It’s not anything new.
It’s the same as before."
entries.translation_source: Huh? This [buffer2-1] measurement[game-token-2] It’s not anything new. It’s the same as before.
entries.translated:
Eh? Questa misurazione [buffer2]\. Non
c{B4}è niente di nuovo. È la stessa di\lprima.

entries.original:
"I bought an [green]ADM[blue] from [green]Captain
Davy’s Shipyard[blue].

It was a little pricey, but I used
it to dig through walls in the [green]KBT\lExpressway[blue] and found one of these!"
entries.translation_source: I bought an [color-green-1]ADM[color-blue-2] from [color-green-3]Captain Davy’s Shipyard[color-blue-4]. It was a little pricey, but I used it to dig through walls in the [color-green-5]KBT Expressway[color-blue-6] and found one of these!
entries.translated:
Ho comprato un [green]ADM[blue] presso il
[green]Cantiere Navale di Captain Davy[blue]. È\lstato un po{B4} caro, ma l{B4}ho usato

per scavare attraverso i muri nella
[green]Superstrada KBT[blue] e ne ho trovato uno\ldi questi!

entries.original:
"Getting an [green]ADM[blue] from [green]Captain Davy[blue]
will let you smash through\lcollapsed doorways in the [green]KBT\lExpressway[blue].

Sometimes, you’ll even find rare
Pokémon behind them."
entries.translation_source: Getting an [color-green-1]ADM[color-blue-2] from [color-green-3]Captain Davy[color-blue-4] will let you smash through collapsed doorways in the [color-green-5]KBT Expressway[color-blue-6]. Sometimes, you’ll even find rare Pokémon behind them.
entries.translated:
Ottenere un [green]ADM[blue] da [green]Capitano Davy[blue] ti
permetterà di sfondare i passaggi\lcrollati nella [green]KBT Expressway[blue]. A

volte, dietro di essi troverai
persino Pokémon rari.

entries.original:
"Owners of residences like these
can’t often be found easily.

But in this building’s case, the
owner likes to sit downstairs.

He may even be willing to let you
rent an apartment if you ask."
entries.translation_source: Owners of residences like these can’t often be found easily. But in this building’s case, the owner likes to sit downstairs. He may even be willing to let you rent an apartment if you ask.
entries.translated:
I proprietari di abitazioni come
queste non si trovano spesso con\lfacilità. Ma in questo edificio, il

proprietario ama stare al piano di
sotto. Potrebbe perfino essere\ldisposto ad affittarti un

appartamento, se glielo chiedi.

entries.original:
"The owner of this residence likes
to sit downstairs.

He’s been quite chipper since a new
resident moved in."
entries.translation_source: The owner of this residence likes to sit downstairs. He’s been quite chipper since a new resident moved in.
entries.translated:
Il proprietario di questa residenza
ama stare seduto al piano di sotto.\lÈ stato piuttosto allegro da quando

si è trasferito un nuovo inquilino.

entries.original:
"[black]Her brain appears to be as
gelatinous as pudding."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Her brain appears to be as gelatinous as pudding.
entries.translated:
[black]Il suo cervello sembra essere
gelatinoso come il budino.

entries.original:
"Mmm\.
I love pudding!

My favourite is chocolate!"
entries.translation_source: Mmm[game-token-1] I love pudding! My favourite is chocolate!
entries.translated:
Mmm\. Adoro il budino! Il mio
preferito è quello al cioccolato!

entries.original:
"There is a tradition that when
two Pokémon from two different\lTrainers are bred together, the\loffspring has a higher chance of\lbeing born shiny.

This tradition has been passed down
for decades, and is said to have\lroots in the far eastern regions."
entries.translation_source: There is a tradition that when two Pokémon from two different Trainers are bred together, the offspring has a higher chance of being born shiny. This tradition has been passed down for decades, and is said to have roots in the far eastern regions.
entries.translated:
C{B4}è una tradizione secondo cui,
quando due Pokémon appartenenti a\ldue Allenatori diversi vengono

accoppiati, la prole ha maggiori
possibilità di nascere cromatica.\lQuesta tradizione è stata

tramandata per decenni, e si dice
che abbia origini nelle regioni\ldell{B4}estremo oriente.

entries.original:
"Teehee\. did you know the [green]Destiny
Knot[red] can be used during breeding?

Betcha didn’t!

But s’okay, if you show me a [green]girly[red]
Pokémon that knows Attract, I’ll\lgive you one to use!

Do you have a Pokémon you wanna
share with me?"
entries.translation_source: Teehee[game-token-1] did you know the [color-green-2]Destiny Knot[color-red-3] can be used during breeding? Betcha didn’t! But s’okay, if you show me a [color-green-4]girly[color-red-5] Pokémon that knows Attract, I’ll give you one to use! Do you have a Pokémon you wanna share with me?
entries.translated:
Teehee\. sapevi che il [green]Nodo Destino[red]
può essere usato durante\ll{B4}allevamento? Scommetto di no! Ma

va bene, se mi mostri un Pokémon
[green]femminile[red] che conosce Attrazione,\lte ne darò uno da usare! Hai un

Pokémon che vuoi condividere con
me?

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon is it?
I’m all excited now!"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon is it? I’m all excited now!
entries.translated:
Qual è il Pokémon? Adesso non sto
più nella pelle!

entries.original:
"Yay! That’s exactly what I was
looking for!

Take a [green]Destiny Knot[red] now!"
entries.translation_source: Yay! That’s exactly what I was looking for! Take a [color-green-1]Destiny Knot[color-red-2] now!
entries.translated:
Evviva! È esattamente quello che
stavo cercando! Prendi subito un\l[green]Nodo Destino[red]!

entries.original:
"When a Pokémon holds the [green]Destiny
Knot[red] while breeding, five\l[green]Individual Values[red] will be passed\ldown from the parents, instead\lof the usual three."
entries.translation_source: When a Pokémon holds the [color-green-1]Destiny Knot[color-red-2] while breeding, five [color-green-3]Individual Values[color-red-4] will be passed down from the parents, instead of the usual three.
entries.translated:
Quando un Pokémon tiene il [green]Nodo
Destino[red] durante l{B4}allevamento,\lcinque [green]Valori Individuali[red] verranno

trasmessi dai genitori, invece dei
soliti tre.

entries.original:
"Oh, boo.
I just wanted you to show me\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, boo. I just wanted you to show me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh, uffa. Volevo solo che me lo
mostrassi\.

entries.original:
"Teehee\. you silly Zangoose.
I’m not looking for an Egg!

I want to see a [green]girly[red] Pokémon that
knows [green]Attract[red]."
entries.translation_source: Teehee[game-token-1] you silly Zangoose. I’m not looking for an Egg! I want to see a [color-green-2]girly[color-red-3] Pokémon that knows [color-green-4]Attract[color-red-5].
entries.translated:
Teehee\. sciocco Zangoose. Non sto
cercando un Uovo! Voglio vedere un\lPokémon [green]femminile[red] che conosca

[green]Attrazione[red].

entries.original:
"Teehee\. you silly Zangoose.
That’s not what I’m looking for!

I want to see a [green]girly[red] Pokémon that
knows [green]Attract[red]."
entries.translation_source: Teehee[game-token-1] you silly Zangoose. That’s not what I’m looking for! I want to see a [color-green-2]girly[color-red-3] Pokémon that knows [color-green-4]Attract[color-red-5].
entries.translated:
Eheh\. che sciocco Zangoose. Non è
quello che sto cercando! Voglio\lvedere un Pokémon [green]femminile[red] che

conosca [green]Attrazione[red].

entries.original:
"You know that adorable electric
mouse Pokémon that everyone loves?

Yeah, you guessed it, I’m talking
about [green]Pichu[blue]!

Do you have one I could pet?"
entries.translation_source: You know that adorable electric mouse Pokémon that everyone loves? Yeah, you guessed it, I’m talking about [color-green-1]Pichu[color-blue-2]! Do you have one I could pet?
entries.translated:
Conosci quel tenero Pokémon topo
elettrico che piace a tutti? Sì,\lhai indovinato, sto parlando di

[green]Pichu[blue]! Ne hai uno che potrei
accarezzare?

entries.original:
"Oh, that’s great!
Can I see it?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, that’s great! Can I see it?
entries.translated: Oh, fantastico! Posso vederlo?

entries.original:
"It’s so soft and adorable!

Just like the one I picked up the
other day!

Although its ear is slightly
different\.

Say, you seem to be good with
Pichu.

Why don’t you take the one I found,
too?"
entries.translation_source: It’s so soft and adorable! Just like the one I picked up the other day! Although its ear is slightly different[game-token-1] Say, you seem to be good with Pichu. Why don’t you take the one I found, too?
entries.translated:
È così soffice e adorabile! Proprio
come quello che ho preso l{B4}altro\lgiorno! Anche se un orecchio è

leggermente diverso\. Sai, sembri
andare d{B4}accordo con Pichu. Perché\lnon prendi anche quello che ho

trovato?

entries.original:
"Your Pichu and my Pichu seem to be
getting along great!

I can tell you’re going to make a
great Trainer for it!"
entries.translation_source: Your Pichu and my Pichu seem to be getting along great! I can tell you’re going to make a great Trainer for it!
entries.translated:
Il tuo Pichu e il mio Pichu
sembrano andare d{B4}accordo alla\lgrande! Si vede che sarai un ottimo

Allenatore per lui!

entries.original:
"When you breed a [green]Pikachu[blue] while its
holding a [green]Light Ball[blue], the baby\lborn will know [green]Volt Tackle[blue]."
entries.translation_source: When you breed a [color-green-1]Pikachu[color-blue-2] while its holding a [color-green-3]Light Ball[color-blue-4], the baby born will know [color-green-5]Volt Tackle[color-blue-6].
entries.translated:
Quando fai allevare un [green]Pikachu[blue]
mentre tiene una [green]Palla Luce[blue], il\lpiccolo che nascerà conoscerà

[green]Locomovolt[blue].

entries.original:
"I get it. Not everyone carries a
Pichu around with them."
entries.translation_source: I get it. Not everyone carries a Pichu around with them.
entries.translated:
Capisco. Non tutti si portano in
giro un Pichu.

entries.original:
"I’m confused\.
Is that supposed to be a [green]Pichu[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: I’m confused[game-token-1] Is that supposed to be a [color-green-2]Pichu[color-blue-3]?
entries.translated:
Sono confuso\. Dovrebbe essere un
[green]Pichu[blue]?

entries.original:
"Oh, never mind!
You need space in your party first!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, never mind! You need space in your party first!
entries.translated:
Oh, lascia perdere! Prima devi fare
spazio nella tua squadra!

entries.original:
"Pokémon can learn special moves
called [green]Egg Moves[red] through breeding!

When either parent knows one of
these moves, be it the mother or\lthe father, the baby born will also\lknow the move!"
entries.translation_source: Pokémon can learn special moves called [color-green-1]Egg Moves[color-red-2] through breeding! When either parent knows one of these moves, be it the mother or the father, the baby born will also know the move!
entries.translated:
I Pokémon possono imparare mosse
speciali chiamate [green]Mosse Uovo[red]\ltramite l{B4}allevamento! Quando uno

dei genitori conosce una di queste
mosse, sia la madre che il padre,\lil piccolo nato conoscerà anch{B4}esso

la mossa!

entries.original:
"This is the [green]Pokémon Breeder’s
School[red].

A place where fledgling young
Trainers like yourself can learn\lto become great Pokémon Breeders."
entries.translation_source: This is the [color-green-1]Pokémon Breeder’s School[color-red-2]. A place where fledgling young Trainers like yourself can learn to become great Pokémon Breeders.
entries.translated:
Questa è la [green]Scuola per Allevatori
Pokémon[red]. Un luogo dove giovani\lAllenatori alle prime armi come te

possono imparare a diventare grandi
Allevatori Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Hi! I run a nursery service!

Would you like to me to raise one
of your Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! I run a nursery service! Would you like to me to raise one of your Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Salve! Gestisco un servizio asilo!
Vuoi che allevi uno dei tuoi\lPokémon?

entries.original: "Which Pokémon should I raise?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon should I raise?
entries.translated: Quale Pokémon dovrei allenare?

entries.original:
"Sure thing! I’ll look after your
[green][buffer1][red] for a while."
entries.translation_source: Sure thing! I’ll look after your [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] for a while.
entries.translated:
Certo! Terrò d{B4}occhio il tuo
[green][buffer1][red] per un po{B4}.

entries.original:
"Come see me in a while to check on
how your Pokémon has grown!"
entries.translation_source: Come see me in a while to check on how your Pokémon has grown!
entries.translated:
Torna a trovarmi tra un po{B4} per
vedere come è cresciuto il tuo\lPokémon!

entries.original:
"I’m sorry! I can’t take a Pokémon
if you only have one with you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry! I can’t take a Pokémon if you only have one with you!
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace! Non posso prendere un
Pokémon se ne hai solo uno con te!

entries.original:
"If you left me that Pokémon, what
would you battle with?"
entries.translation_source: If you left me that Pokémon, what would you battle with?
entries.translated:
Se mi lasciassi quel Pokémon, con
cosa combatteresti?

entries.original:
"You owe [green]$[buffer2][red] for the
return of this Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: You owe [color-green-1]$[buffer2-2][color-red-3] for the return of this Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Devi [green]$[buffer2][red] per la restituzione
di questo Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Thank you!
Here’s your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Thank you! Here’s your Pokémon.
entries.translated: Grazie! Ecco il tuo Pokémon.

entries.original:
"[black][player] got [green][buffer1][black] back
from the Nursery Lady."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] got [color-green-3][buffer1-4][color-black-5] back from the Nursery Lady.
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha riavuto [green][buffer1][black] dalla
Signora della Pensione.

entries.original:
"You’re back already?

Your [green][buffer1][red] needs to spend some
more time with me."
entries.translation_source: You’re back already? Your [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] needs to spend some more time with me.
entries.translated:
Sei già tornato? Il tuo [green][buffer1][red]
deve passare ancora un po{B4} di tempo\lcon me.

entries.original:
"Your [green][buffer1][red] has grown a lot!

Let’s see\.
By level, it’s grown by [green][buffer2][red]!

Aren’t I great at this?"
entries.translation_source: Your [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] has grown a lot! Let’s see[game-token-4] By level, it’s grown by [color-green-5][buffer2-6][color-red-7]! Aren’t I great at this?
entries.translated:
Il tuo [green][buffer1][red] è cresciuto molto!
Vediamo\. In base al livello, è\lcresciuto di [green][buffer2][red]! Non sono

bravo in questo?

entries.original:
"You can’t take your Pokémon if you
don’t have room for it."
entries.translation_source: You can’t take your Pokémon if you don’t have room for it.
entries.translated:
Non puoi prendere il tuo Pokémon se
non hai spazio per lui.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry!
You don’t have enough money!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry! You don’t have enough money!
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace! Non hai abbastanza
soldi!

entries.original: "Come back anytime you’d like!"
entries.translation_source: Come back anytime you’d like!
entries.translated: Torna quando vuoi!

entries.original: "Have a wonderful day!"
entries.translation_source: Have a wonderful day!
entries.translated:
Ti auguro una giornata
meravigliosa!

entries.original: "[green]Polololol."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Polololol.
entries.translated: [green]Polololol.

entries.original: "Flaming Body"
entries.translation_source: Flaming Body
entries.translated: Corpo Ardente

entries.original: "Armoured Magma"
entries.translation_source: Armoured Magma
entries.translated: Magma corazzato

entries.original: "Master Incubator"
entries.translation_source: Master Incubator
entries.translated: Incubatrice Master

entries.original:
"Let’s get cracking! It’s time to
hatch [buffer1] Eggs total!"
entries.translation_source: Let’s get cracking! It’s time to hatch [buffer1-1] Eggs total!
entries.translated:
Mettiamoci al lavoro! È ora di
schiudere in totale [buffer1] Uova!

entries.original:
"Things are starting to heat up!
Hatch [buffer1] Eggs total!"
entries.translation_source: Things are starting to heat up! Hatch [buffer1-1] Eggs total!
entries.translated:
Le cose si stanno scaldando!
Schiudi in totale [buffer1] uova!

entries.original:
"Can you prove you’re the master of
hatching? Hatch [buffer1] Eggs total!"
entries.translation_source: Can you prove you’re the master of hatching? Hatch [buffer1-1] Eggs total!
entries.translated:
Puoi dimostrare di essere il
maestro delle schiuse? Schiudi\l[buffer1] Uova in totale!

entries.original:
"Hatching Eggs and helping others
hatch them is my one purpose!

So, I’m going to give you a little
incentive to start hatching.

If you hatch at least [green][buffer1][blue] Eggs,
I’ll give you something nice.

Get out there and start hatching!"
entries.translation_source: Hatching Eggs and helping others hatch them is my one purpose! So, I’m going to give you a little incentive to start hatching. If you hatch at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] Eggs, I’ll give you something nice. Get out there and start hatching!
entries.translated:
Schiudere Uova e aiutare gli altri
a schiuderle è il mio unico scopo!\lQuindi, ti darò un piccolo

incentivo per cominciare a
schiudere. Se schiudi almeno\l[green][buffer1][blue] Uova, ti darò qualcosa di

carino. Vai là fuori e inizia a
schiudere!

entries.original:
"Looks like you’ve hatched a total
of [green][buffer2][blue] Eggs.

Seems good to me.
Take your reward!"
entries.translation_source: Looks like you’ve hatched a total of [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] Eggs. Seems good to me. Take your reward!
entries.translated:
Sembra che tu abbia schiuso un
totale di [green][buffer2][blue] Uova. Mi sembra\lottimo. Prendi la tua ricompensa!

entries.original:
"Since you did so great last time,
I’m going up the ante!

This time I want you to hatch at
least [green][buffer1][blue] Eggs!

Get hatching!"
entries.translation_source: Since you did so great last time, I’m going up the ante! This time I want you to hatch at least [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] Eggs! Get hatching!
entries.translated:
Dato che l{B4}ultima volta te la sei
cavata così bene, alzo la posta!\lQuesta volta voglio che fai

schiudere almeno [green][buffer1][blue] Uova!
Forza, a schiudere!

entries.original:
"This is it!
The final stretch!

Attempt to hatch [green][buffer1][blue] Eggs!

If you do that, the reward I give
you will be priceless."
entries.translation_source: This is it! The final stretch! Attempt to hatch [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] Eggs! If you do that, the reward I give you will be priceless.
entries.translated:
Ci siamo! L{B4}ultimo tratto! Cerca di
far schiudere [green][buffer1][blue] Uova! Se ci\lriesci, la ricompensa che ti darò

sarà inestimabile.

entries.original:
"Of all the people I met, you
truly shine out among them as\lthe Master Incubator."
entries.translation_source: Of all the people I met, you truly shine out among them as the Master Incubator.
entries.translated:
Tra tutte le persone che ho
incontrato, tu risplendi davvero\lcome il Maestro Incubatore.

entries.original:
"You’ve hatched a total of [green][buffer2][blue]
Eggs out of the [green][buffer1][blue] I requested.

Keep up the hatching!"
entries.translation_source: You’ve hatched a total of [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] Eggs out of the [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] I requested. Keep up the hatching!
entries.translated:
Hai schiuso un totale di [green][buffer2][blue]
Uova su [green][buffer1][blue] che ti ho\lrichiesto. Continua a schiudere!

entries.original:
"Looks like you need to get room in
your party if you want the reward."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you need to get room in your party if you want the reward.
entries.translated:
Sembra che tu debba fare spazio
nella tua squadra se vuoi il\lpremio.

entries.original: "Areivax"
entries.translation_source: Areivax
entries.translated: Areivax

entries.original:
"Aye!
Me name’s Cappin Davy!

Me boys here finished workin’ on an
advanced diggin’ an’ divin’ machine.

Only the highest members of society
can afford to purchase one, so I\lwon’t waste my time offerin’ it to\lye until ye prove yerself, first."
entries.translation_source: Aye! Me name’s Cappin Davy! Me boys here finished workin’ on an advanced diggin’ an’ divin’ machine. Only the highest members of society can afford to purchase one, so I won’t waste my time offerin’ it to ye until ye prove yerself, first.
entries.translated:
Aye! Me chiamo Cappin Davy! I miei
ragazzi qui hanno finito di\llavorare a una macchina avanzata

per scavare e immergersi. Solo i
membri più alti della società\lpossono permettersi di comprarne

una, quindi non perderò tempo a
offrirvela finché non vi sarete\lprima dimostrato.

entries.original:
"Aye!
Me name’s Cappin Davy!

Me boys here finished workin’ on an
advanced diggin’ an’ divin’ machine.

It’s a special item ye can strap on
to yer Pokémon to let ’em use any\lHM move, and it can even provide\lye with oxygen if ye get a Pokémon\lto take ye underwater!

Ye interested in buyin’?
It’ll cost ye $[green]250000[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Aye! Me name’s Cappin Davy! Me boys here finished workin’ on an advanced diggin’ an’ divin’ machine. It’s a special item ye can strap on to yer Pokémon to let ’em use any HM move, and it can even provide ye with oxygen if ye get a Pokémon to take ye underwater! Ye interested in buyin’? It’ll cost ye $[color-green-1]250000[color-blue-2].
entries.translated:
Ehilà! Mi chiamo Cappin Davy! I
miei ragazzi hanno finito di\llavorare su una macchina avanzata

per scavare e immergersi. È un
oggetto speciale che puoi\lagganciare al tuo Pokémon per

fargli usare qualsiasi mossa MN, e
può persino fornirti ossigeno se\lfai portare sott{B4}acqua un Pokémon!

Ti interessa comprarla? Costa
$[green]250000[blue].

entries.original:
"And to go along with it, lemme give
ye this, too."
entries.translation_source: And to go along with it, lemme give ye this, too.
entries.translated:
E, già che ci sono, lascia che ti
dia anche questo.

entries.original:
"Pleasure doin’ business with ye.

Now, listen here."
entries.translation_source: Pleasure doin’ business with ye. Now, listen here.
entries.translated:
Piacere di far affari con te. Ora,
ascolta bene.

entries.original:
"Not only can ye use the [green]ADM[blue] instead
of HMs, ye can also use it to mine\lfor treasure!

The walls of the [green]KBT Expressway[blue] and
[green]seafloor[blue] are lined with goodies\ljust waitin’ for ye to dig ’em out!

If yer in either of those places,
set yer [green]R-Button Mode[blue] to [green]Mining\lScan[blue] in the [green]Options Menu[blue], and\lpress \btn03.

If there are any spots around ye
where ye can dig for treasure,\lthe ADM will light ’em up!

Just hit \btn00 next to one of those
spots to start diggin’."
entries.translation_source: Not only can ye use the [color-green-1]ADM[color-blue-2] instead of HMs, ye can also use it to mine for treasure! The walls of the [color-green-3]KBT Expressway[color-blue-4] and [color-green-5]seafloor[color-blue-6] are lined with goodies just waitin’ for ye to dig ’em out! If yer in either of those places, set yer [color-green-7]R-Button Mode[color-blue-8] to [color-green-9]Mining Scan[color-blue-10] in the [color-green-11]Options Menu[color-blue-12], and press [button-icon-13]. If there are any spots around ye where ye can dig for treasure, the ADM will light ’em up! Just hit [button-icon-14] next to one of those spots to start diggin’.
entries.translated:
Non solo puoi usare il [green]ADM[blue] al posto
delle MN, ma puoi anche usarlo per\lestrarre tesori! Le pareti della

[green]KBT Expressway[blue] e del [green]fondale marino[blue]
sono piene di tesori che aspettano\lsolo che tu li scavi! Se ti trovi

in uno di questi posti, imposta la
[green]Modalità Pulsante R[blue] su [green]Scansione\lEstrazione[blue] nel [green]Menu Opzioni[blue] e premi

\btn03. Se ci sono punti intorno a te
dove puoi scavare per tesori, l{B4}ADM\lli illuminerà! Premi \btn00 vicino a uno

di questi punti per iniziare a
scavare.

entries.original:
"Arr\.
Not within yer price range?"
entries.translation_source: Arr[game-token-1] Not within yer price range?
entries.translated: Arr\. Non rientra nel tuo budget?

entries.original:
"Arr\.
Ye don’t have enough money."

entries.original:
"You see that big black ship?

That’s the prototype for a boat
called \qoThe Shadow\qc.

It was designed to be able to
traverse the ocean silently in\lthe dead of night.

A mysterious man who called himself
\qoZ\qc funded its construction."
entries.translation_source: You see that big black ship? That’s the prototype for a boat called [quote-open-1]The Shadow[quote-close-2]. It was designed to be able to traverse the ocean silently in the dead of night. A mysterious man who called himself [quote-open-3]Z[quote-close-4] funded its construction.
entries.translated:
Vedi quella grande nave nera? È il
prototipo di un{B4}imbarcazione\lchiamata \qoThe Shadow\qc. È stata

progettata per attraversare
l{B4}oceano in silenzio nel cuore\ldella notte. Un uomo misterioso che

si faceva chiamare \qoZ\qc ne ha
finanziato la costruzione.

entries.original:
"These ships are part of the
Seagallop Hi-Speed series.

They may be small, but they can
move over the ocean faster than\lany big ship!"
entries.translation_source: These ships are part of the Seagallop Hi-Speed series. They may be small, but they can move over the ocean faster than any big ship!
entries.translated:
Queste navi fanno parte della serie
Seagallop Hi-Speed. Possono essere\lpiccole, ma attraversano l{B4}oceano

più velocemente di qualsiasi nave
grande!

entries.original:
"Don’t you hate it when you’ve gotta
carry around one Pokémon to smash\lrocks, another to push boulders,\land another to cut down trees?

That’s where the [green]ADM[blue] comes in!

Not only can it do all those things
for you, you can even strap it to\lyour Pokémon like a jetpack, and\lit’ll become capable of using Fly!

Heck, you can even attach it like a
drill to your Pokémon, and use it\lto escape from caves!

Someday it’ll be available cheap on
the market, but for now, it’s still\la little expensive to buy."
entries.translation_source: Don’t you hate it when you’ve gotta carry around one Pokémon to smash rocks, another to push boulders, and another to cut down trees? That’s where the [color-green-1]ADM[color-blue-2] comes in! Not only can it do all those things for you, you can even strap it to your Pokémon like a jetpack, and it’ll become capable of using Fly! Heck, you can even attach it like a drill to your Pokémon, and use it to escape from caves! Someday it’ll be available cheap on the market, but for now, it’s still a little expensive to buy.
entries.translated:
Non odi quando devi portarti dietro
un Pokémon per rompere le rocce, un\laltro per spostare i massi, e un

altro ancora per abbattere gli
alberi? È qui che entra in gioco\ll{B4}[green]ADM[blue]! Non solo può fare tutte

queste cose per te, puoi persino
fissarlo al tuo Pokémon come un\ljetpack, e diventerà capace di

usare Volo! Diamine, puoi persino
agganciarlo come un trapano al tuo\lPokémon, e usarlo per fuggire dalle

caverne! Un giorno sarà disponibile
a poco prezzo sul mercato, ma per\lora è ancora un po{B4} caro da

comprare.

entries.original:
"If you have an ADM, you can use it
to mine for treasure!

There are three different places
you can mine in Borrius: the KBT\lExpressway, Underwater, or in a\lsingle room of Crystal Peak.

Mining in the KBT Expressway will
yield a good variety of items,\lwhile mining underwater will be\lmore likely to yield Fossils, and\lmining in Crystal Peak will be more\llikely to yield Gems."
entries.translation_source: If you have an ADM, you can use it to mine for treasure! There are three different places you can mine in Borrius: the KBT Expressway, Underwater, or in a single room of Crystal Peak. Mining in the KBT Expressway will yield a good variety of items, while mining underwater will be more likely to yield Fossils, and mining in Crystal Peak will be more likely to yield Gems.
entries.translated:
Se hai un ADM, puoi usarlo per
scavare alla ricerca di tesori! Ci\lsono tre posti diversi in cui puoi

scavare a Borrius: l{B4}autostrada
KBT, sott{B4}acqua, o in una singola\lstanza di Crystal Peak. Scavare

nell{B4}autostrada KBT darà una buona
varietà di oggetti, mentre scavare\lsott{B4}acqua avrà più probabilità di

dare Fossili, e scavare a Crystal
Peak avrà più probabilità di dare\lGemme.

and salts that litter the ocean\lfloor!

Allow me to convert them into a
rare item for you."
entries.translation_source: Oh! You found some of the shells and salts that litter the ocean floor! Allow me to convert them into a rare item for you.
entries.translated:
Oh! Hai trovato alcune delle
conchiglie e dei sali che ricoprono\lil fondale oceanico! Permettimi di

trasformarli in un oggetto raro per
te.
