"[black][player] handed over
4 [buffer1]s and 4 [buffer2]s."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over 4 [buffer1-3]s and 4 [buffer2-4]s.
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha consegnato 4 [buffer1] e
4 [buffer2].

entries.original:
"Each day, rare shells and salts
appear on the ocean floor.

If you can bring me [green]4[blue] of these [green]Sea
Shells[blue] and [green]4[blue] of these [green]Sea Salts[blue],\lI can convert them into a rare item\lfor you."
entries.translation_source: Each day, rare shells and salts appear on the ocean floor. If you can bring me [color-green-1]4[color-blue-2] of these [color-green-3]Sea Shells[color-blue-4] and [color-green-5]4[color-blue-6] of these [color-green-7]Sea Salts[color-blue-8], I can convert them into a rare item for you.
entries.translated:
Ogni giorno, rare conchiglie e sali
compaiono sul fondale oceanico. Se\lriesci a portarmi [green]4[blue] di queste

[green]Conchiglie di Mare[blue] e [green]4[blue] di questi
[green]Sali di Mare[blue], posso trasformarli in\lun oggetto raro per te.

entries.original:
"Do you know of the Creation Plates?

They’re said to have a strong
connection to the Pokémon known\las Arceus.

Many believe these plates can only
be found by digging them up, but I\lbelieve otherwise.

The different Shards that litter
the region bear a strong connection\lto the Creation Plates.

I wonder if I can form new
Creation Plates from Shards\."
entries.translation_source: Do you know of the Creation Plates? They’re said to have a strong connection to the Pokémon known as Arceus. Many believe these plates can only be found by digging them up, but I believe otherwise. The different Shards that litter the region bear a strong connection to the Creation Plates. I wonder if I can form new Creation Plates from Shards[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Conosci le Lastre della Creazione?
Si dice che abbiano un forte legame\lcon il Pokémon noto come Arceus.

Molti credono che queste lastre
possano essere trovate solo\lscavandole, ma io penso il

contrario. I diversi Frammenti
sparsi per la regione hanno un\lforte legame con le Lastre della

Creazione. Chissà se posso creare
nuove Lastre della Creazione dai\lFrammenti\.

entries.original:
"I have recently developed a
mechanism for converting Shards\linto copies of Creation Plates.

Would you like to trade some of
your Shards for these Plates?"
entries.translation_source: I have recently developed a mechanism for converting Shards into copies of Creation Plates. Would you like to trade some of your Shards for these Plates?
entries.translated:
Di recente ho sviluppato un
meccanismo per convertire i\lFrammenti in copie delle Lastre

della Creazione. Vuoi scambiare
alcuni dei tuoi Frammenti con\lqueste Lastre?

your Shards for these Plates?"

entries.translated:

Schegge per queste Lastre?

entries.translated:
La S.S. Marine ha attualmente
problemi al motore. Al momento non\lstiamo imbarcando passeggeri.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the S.S. Marine!

Your ticket is\. right there.
Do you want to board?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the S.S. Marine! Your ticket is[game-token-1] right there. Do you want to board?
entries.translated:
Benvenuto sulla S.S. Marine! Il tuo
biglietto è\. proprio lì. Vuoi salire\la bordo?

entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine leaves once a day
for a voyage between Seaport City\land Polder Town.

When the whistle blows five times,
it means the ship has arrived at\lits destination.

On the ship, the passenger cabins
are full of Trainers who love to\lbattle.

Items can’t be used in battles
against those Trainers, but if you\ldefeat all of the Trainers on board\lbefore the ship reaches its final\ldestination, we’ll give you a prize."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine leaves once a day for a voyage between Seaport City and Polder Town. When the whistle blows five times, it means the ship has arrived at its destination. On the ship, the passenger cabins are full of Trainers who love to battle. Items can’t be used in battles against those Trainers, but if you defeat all of the Trainers on board before the ship reaches its final destination, we’ll give you a prize.
entries.translated:
La S.S. Marine parte una volta al
giorno per un viaggio tra Seaport\lCity e Polder Town. Quando il

fischio suona cinque volte,
significa che la nave è arrivata a\ldestinazione. Sulla nave, le cabine

passeggeri sono piene di Allenatori
che amano lottare. Gli Strumenti\lnon possono essere usati nelle

lotte contro questi Allenatori, ma
se sconfiggi tutti gli Allenatori a\lbordo prima che la nave raggiunga

la sua destinazione finale, ti
daremo un premio.

entries.original: "Please board the ship."
entries.translation_source: Please board the ship.
entries.translated:
Si prega di salire a bordo della
nave.

entries.original:
"[blue]Congrats on beating all of the
Trainers on board!

Here’s what you get for winning."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Congrats on beating all of the Trainers on board! Here’s what you get for winning.
entries.translated:
[blue]Complimenti per aver battuto tutti
gli Allenatori a bordo! Ecco cosa\lricevi per la vittoria.

entries.original:
"Operating a ship every day can wear
you out! It’s not running today.

It leaves for Polder Town on
[green]Mondays[blue] and [green]Fridays[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Operating a ship every day can wear you out! It’s not running today. It leaves for Polder Town on [color-green-1]Mondays[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Fridays[color-blue-4]!
entries.translated:
Gestire una nave ogni giorno può
sfiancarti! Oggi non parte. Salpa\lper Polder Town [green]il lunedì[blue] e [green]il

venerdì[blue]!

entries.original:
"Operating a ship more than once a
day can wear you out!

It already sailed today."
entries.translation_source: Operating a ship more than once a day can wear you out! It already sailed today.
entries.translated:
Comandare una nave più di una volta
al giorno può sfiancarti! Oggi ha\lgià salpato.

entries.original: "Board"
entries.translation_source: Board
entries.translated: Tavola

entries.original:
"Okay!
You must be the last passenger."
entries.translation_source: Okay! You must be the last passenger.
entries.translated:
Okay! Devi essere l{B4}ultimo
passeggero.

entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine usually sets sail
on Mondays and Fridays to East\lBorrius.

But right now I hear it’s having
engine trouble."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine usually sets sail on Mondays and Fridays to East Borrius. But right now I hear it’s having engine trouble.
entries.translated:
La S.S. Marine di solito salpa il
lunedì e il venerdì per Est\lBorrius. Ma al momento sento che ha

problemi al motore.

entries.original:
"The S.S. Marine sets sail to East
Borrius every [green]Monday[blue] and [green]Friday[blue]."
entries.translation_source: The S.S. Marine sets sail to East Borrius every [color-green-1]Monday[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Friday[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
La S.S. Marine salpa per Est
Borrius ogni [green]lunedì[blue] e [green]venerdì[blue].

entries.original:
"What!?
Engine trouble!?

Sniff\. I just want to go back home
to Magnolia Town\."
entries.translation_source: What!? Engine trouble!? Sniff[game-token-1] I just want to go back home to Magnolia Town[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Cosa!? Guasto al motore!? Sniff\.
Voglio solo tornare a casa a Città\ldi Magnolia\.

entries.original:
"I came from overseas to learn more
about the legendary Pokémon\lrumoured to live in the [green]Cave of\lBeing[blue]."
entries.translation_source: I came from overseas to learn more about the legendary Pokémon rumoured to live in the [color-green-1]Cave of Being[color-blue-2].
entries.translated:
Sono venuto dall{B4}estero per saperne
di più sui Pokémon leggendari che\lsi dice vivano nella [green]Grotta

dell{B4}Essere[blue].

entries.original:
"I have plans to explore the
[green]Tomb of Borrius[blue] while I am here.

I hear many riches await those who
are brave enough to descend into\lits depths."
entries.translation_source: I have plans to explore the [color-green-1]Tomb of Borrius[color-blue-2] while I am here. I hear many riches await those who are brave enough to descend into its depths.
entries.translated:
Ho intenzione di esplorare il [green]Tomb
of Borrius[blue] mentre sono qui. Ho\lsentito che grandi ricchezze

attendono chi ha abbastanza
coraggio da scendere nelle sue\lprofondità.

entries.original:
"Psst\.

Listen up, Sparky.
I’ve got a sweet deal fo’ you.

In my hand is a ticket to a
special place.

Folks know it as [green]Glimmer Isle[blue].

I can sell it to ya, but it’s
gonna cost ya $[green]999999999[blue].

Whatcha say, Sparky?

You in on the deal of a lifetime?"
entries.translation_source: Psst[game-token-1] Listen up, Sparky. I’ve got a sweet deal fo’ you. In my hand is a ticket to a special place. Folks know it as [color-green-2]Glimmer Isle[color-blue-3]. I can sell it to ya, but it’s gonna cost ya $[color-green-4]999999999[color-blue-5]. Whatcha say, Sparky? You in on the deal of a lifetime?
entries.translated:
Psst\. Ascolta, Sparky. Ho una bella
offerta per te. In mano ho un\lbiglietto per un posto speciale. La

gente lo conosce come [green]Glimmer Isle[blue].
Posso vendertelo, ma ti costerà\l$[green]999999999[blue]. Che ne dici, Sparky? Ti

unisci all{B4}affare della vita?

entries.original:
"Come on, Sparky.
Don’t be pulling my leg.

I see you don’t have enough cash."
entries.translation_source: Come on, Sparky. Don’t be pulling my leg. I see you don’t have enough cash.
entries.translated:
Dai, Sparky. Non prendermi in giro.
Vedo che non hai abbastanza soldi.

entries.original: "See you around, Sparky\."
entries.translation_source: See you around, Sparky[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ci vediamo in giro, Sparky\.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!

To weather, or not to weather\.
What does this truly mean?

Only the weather will tell!"
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! To weather, or not to weather[game-token-1] What does this truly mean? Only the weather will tell!
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Resistere al
meteo, o non resistere al meteo\. Che\lcosa significa davvero? Solo il

meteo lo dirà!

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!
You found all us clowns!

To think, someone has found all of
us\. you must truly be a master\lof weather!

For that, you have my gratitude."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! You found all us clowns! To think, someone has found all of us[game-token-1] you must truly be a master of weather! For that, you have my gratitude.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Ci hai trovati
tutti, noi pagliacci! Pensare che\lqualcuno ci abbia trovati tutti\.

Devi essere davvero un maestro del
clima! Per questo, hai la mia\lgratitudine.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!

That [green]Castform[blue] is a rare Pokémon
indeed!

And like you, it is both master of
weather and friendship!

’Til your travels bringeth us
together again, I bid you adieu."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! That [color-green-1]Castform[color-blue-2] is a rare Pokémon indeed! And like you, it is both master of weather and friendship! ’Til your travels bringeth us together again, I bid you adieu.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Quel [green]Castform[blue] è
davvero un Pokémon raro! E come te,\lè sia padrone del tempo atmosferico

sia dell{B4}amicizia! Finché i tuoi
viaggi non ci riuniranno di nuovo,\lti saluto.

entries.original:
"Ooh hoo hoo hoo!

But first, make space in your
party."
entries.translation_source: Ooh hoo hoo hoo! But first, make space in your party.
entries.translated:
Ooh hoo hoo hoo! Ma prima, fai
spazio nella tua squadra.

entries.original:
"Good day.

Welcome to the Camomons Battle
House.

In this house, all Pokémon become
the same types as their first two\lmoves.

Feel free to battle any of the
Trainers here as many times as\lyou wish.

If you need an explanation of the
battle type here, please come and\lspeak with me."
entries.translation_source: Good day. Welcome to the Camomons Battle House. In this house, all Pokémon become the same types as their first two moves. Feel free to battle any of the Trainers here as many times as you wish. If you need an explanation of the battle type here, please come and speak with me.
entries.translated:
Buongiorno. Benvenuto alla Camomons
Battle House. In questa casa, tutti\li Pokémon assumono gli stessi tipi

delle loro prime due mosse. Sentiti
libero di sfidare tutti gli\lAllenatori qui tutte le volte che

vuoi. Se ti serve una spiegazione
di questo tipo di lotta, vieni pure\la parlarmi.

entries.original:
"Battles here are fought utilizing
the [green]Camomons[red] battle format.

In a Camomons battle, all Pokémon
become the same types as their\lfirst two moves.

For instance, if a Pokémon’s first
two moves are Ember and Water Gun,\lthen it will become a Fire- and\lWater-type."
entries.translation_source: Battles here are fought utilizing the [color-green-1]Camomons[color-red-2] battle format. In a Camomons battle, all Pokémon become the same types as their first two moves. For instance, if a Pokémon’s first two moves are Ember and Water Gun, then it will become a Fire- and Water-type.
entries.translated:
Le battaglie qui si svolgono usando
il formato di battaglia [green]Camomons[red].\lIn una battaglia Camomons, tutti i

Pokémon assumono gli stessi tipi
delle loro prime due mosse. Per\lesempio, se le prime due mosse di

un Pokémon sono Braciere e Pistola
ad Acqua, allora diventerà di tipo\lFuoco e Acqua.

entries.original:
"Woah! You spotted me behind this
tree! Impressive!"
entries.translation_source: Woah! You spotted me behind this tree! Impressive!
entries.translated:
Mi hai visto dietro questo albero!
Impressionante!

entries.original:
"What!?
This isn’t a good hiding place?"
entries.translation_source: What!? This isn’t a good hiding place?
entries.translated:
Cosa!? Questo non è un buon
nascondiglio?

entries.original:
"Listen, listen! Can you tell me
what kind of Pokémon you have?"
entries.translation_source: Listen, listen! Can you tell me what kind of Pokémon you have?
entries.translated:
Ascolta, ascolta! Sai dirmi che
tipo di Pokémon hai?

entries.original:
"You’re so tough.
I’m stunned\."
entries.translation_source: You’re so tough. I’m stunned[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sei tosto. Sono di stucco\.

entries.original:
"The [green]Timer Ball[red] may not be useful at
the start of battle, but it’s\lgreat for long, drawn out battles\lwith legendary Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Timer Ball[color-red-2] may not be useful at the start of battle, but it’s great for long, drawn out battles with legendary Pokémon.
entries.translated:
La [green]Timer Ball[red] potrebbe non essere
utile all{B4}inizio della lotta, ma è\lottima per le lotte lunghe e

interminabili contro i Pokémon
leggendari.

entries.original:
"Forget Timer Balls, the [green]Heavy Ball[blue]
is the ideal Ball for capturing\llegendary Pokémon!

Many of them are super heavy, and
the Heavy Ball winds up having a\lbetter chance to capture any of\lthem than a maxed Timer Ball.

Don’t believe me?

Just set your [green]Last Used Ball[blue] to
[green]Always Best Ball[blue] in the [green]Options\lMenu[blue] and see for yourself!

You can buy Heavy Balls out in the
[green]marketplace[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Forget Timer Balls, the [color-green-1]Heavy Ball[color-blue-2] is the ideal Ball for capturing legendary Pokémon! Many of them are super heavy, and the Heavy Ball winds up having a better chance to capture any of them than a maxed Timer Ball. Don’t believe me? Just set your [color-green-3]Last Used Ball[color-blue-4] to [color-green-5]Always Best Ball[color-blue-6] in the [color-green-7]Options Menu[color-blue-8] and see for yourself! You can buy Heavy Balls out in the [color-green-9]marketplace[color-blue-10].
entries.translated:
Dimentica le Timer Ball, la [green]Peso
Ball[blue] è la Ball ideale per catturare\li Pokémon leggendari! Molti di loro

sono super pesanti, e la Peso Ball
finisce per avere una probabilità\ldi cattura migliore di qualunque

Timer Ball al massimo. Non ci
credi? Imposta semplicemente la tua\l[green]Ultima Ball usata[blue] su [green]Sempre Miglior

Ball[blue] nel [green]Menu Opzioni[blue] e verifica tu
stesso! Puoi comprare le Peso Ball\lal [green]mercato[blue].

entries.original:
"Battling in the [green]Camomons
Battle House[blue] is a great way to\ltrain your Pokémon quickly.

But don’t forget to set the order
of your Pokémon’s moves before\lbattling there!"
entries.translation_source: Battling in the [color-green-1]Camomons Battle House[color-blue-2] is a great way to train your Pokémon quickly. But don’t forget to set the order of your Pokémon’s moves before battling there!
entries.translated:
Combattere nella [green]Camomons Battle
House[blue] è un ottimo modo per allenare\lrapidamente i tuoi Pokémon. Ma non

dimenticare di impostare l{B4}ordine
delle mosse dei tuoi Pokémon prima\ldi combattere lì!

entries.original:
"I hear one of the vendors in the
market sells special Poké Balls\limported all the way from Johto!"
entries.translation_source: I hear one of the vendors in the market sells special Poké Balls imported all the way from Johto!
entries.translated:
Ho sentito che uno dei venditori
del mercato vende speciali Poké\lBall importate fin da Johto!

entries.original:
"Some days I can hear a sad cry
reverberating across the crates."
entries.translation_source: Some days I can hear a sad cry reverberating across the crates.
entries.translated:
Alcuni giorni riesco a sentire un
grido triste riecheggiare tra le\lcasse.

entries.original:
"Do you hear that?

I’ve been hearing that Pokémon’s
cry all day.

It sounds very sad and lonely,
don’t you think?"
entries.translation_source: Do you hear that? I’ve been hearing that Pokémon’s cry all day. It sounds very sad and lonely, don’t you think?
entries.translated:
Senti? Ho sentito per tutto il
giorno il verso di quel Pokémon. Mi\lsembra molto triste e solitario,

non credi?

entries.original: "[green]Kyu! Kyu!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Kyu! Kyu!
entries.translated: [green]Kyu! Kyu!

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] ran off into the
warehouse."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] ran off into the warehouse.
entries.translated: [buffer1] è fuggito nel magazzino.

entries.original: "Shadow Base"
entries.translation_source: Shadow Base
entries.translated: Base Ombra

entries.original: "Emotional"
entries.translation_source: Emotional
entries.translated: Emotivo

entries.original:
"A mysterious hideout built into
the side of a mountain.
Who does it belong to?"
entries.translation_source: A mysterious hideout built into the side of a mountain. Who does it belong to?
entries.translated:
Un rifugio misterioso costruito nel
fianco di una montagna. A chi\lappartiene?

entries.original:
"The door requires a Key Card with
Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened."
entries.translation_source: The door requires a Key Card with Clearance Level: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3], to be opened.
entries.translated:
La porta richiede una Tessera
Chiave con livello di\lautorizzazione: [green][buffer1][black], per

essere aperta.

entries.original:
"The door requires a Key Card with
Clearance Level: [green][buffer1][black], to be opened.

Open it?"
entries.translation_source: The door requires a Key Card with Clearance Level: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3], to be opened. Open it?
entries.translated:
La porta richiede una Chiave con
livello di autorizzazione:\l[green][buffer1][black], per essere aperta.

Aprirla?

entries.original:
"Bingo!
The Key Card opened the door!"
entries.translation_source: Bingo! The Key Card opened the door!
entries.translated:
Bingo! La Cardchiave ha aperto la
porta!

entries.original: "The door is open\."
entries.translation_source: The door is open[game-token-1]
entries.translated: La porta è aperta\.

entries.original:
"The [buffer1] seems lonely.
Accept it onto your team?"
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] seems lonely. Accept it onto your team?
entries.translated:
Sembra che [buffer1] sia solo. Vuoi
aggiungerlo alla tua squadra?

entries.original: "The [buffer1] is sad."
entries.translation_source: The [buffer1-1] is sad.
entries.translated: Il [buffer1] è triste.

entries.original:
"Huh?

It looks like [green][buffer1][black] wants to
come out of its Poké Ball and walk\laround with you!

Let [green][buffer1][black] out?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? It looks like [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-black-3] wants to come out of its Poké Ball and walk around with you! Let [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-black-6] out?
entries.translated:
Eh? Sembra che [green][buffer1][black] voglia
uscire dalla sua Poké Ball e\lcamminare con te! Lascia uscire

[green][buffer1][black]?

entries.original:
"[buffer1] started walking behind
you!"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] started walking behind you!
entries.translated: [buffer1] ha iniziato a seguirti!

entries.original:
"[buffer1] will return to its
Poké Ball if you leave the room."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] will return to its Poké Ball if you leave the room.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] tornerà nella sua Poké
Ball se lasci la stanza.

entries.original:
"[buffer1] is happily following
behind you."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] is happily following behind you.
entries.translated:
[buffer1] ti segue allegramente
dietro di te.

entries.original:
"Oh? It looks like [buffer1] wants
you to have something it found."
entries.translation_source: Oh? It looks like [buffer1-1] wants you to have something it found.
entries.translated:
Oh? Sembra che [buffer1] voglia che
tu abbia qualcosa che ha trovato.

entries.original:
"That guy\. he just came out of
nowhere\."
entries.translation_source: That guy[game-token-1] he just came out of nowhere[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Quel tizio\. è sbucato dal nulla\.

entries.original: "Wiped out in an instant\."
entries.translation_source: Wiped out in an instant[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sconfitto all{B4}istante\.

entries.original:
"This guy with red hair just came
out of nowhere and knocked out all\lof my Pokémon before I even had a\lchance to react!

Now I can’t even stop you
from escaping\."
entries.translation_source: This guy with red hair just came out of nowhere and knocked out all of my Pokémon before I even had a chance to react! Now I can’t even stop you from escaping[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Questo tizio coi capelli rossi è
sbucato dal nulla e ha messo KO\ltutti i miei Pokémon prima ancora

che potessi reagire! Adesso non
riesco neanche a impedirti di\lscappare\.

entries.original:
"The door appears to have been
blown apart."
entries.translation_source: The door appears to have been blown apart.
entries.translated:
La porta sembra essere stata fatta
saltare in aria.

entries.original:
"Oh, sir!

Some guy with red hair blasted his
way in here!

I tried to stop him, but he just
shoved me aside."
entries.translation_source: Oh, sir! Some guy with red hair blasted his way in here! I tried to stop him, but he just shoved me aside.
entries.translated:
Oh, signore! Uno con i capelli
rossi si è fatto strada qui dentro\la forza! Ho provato a fermarlo, ma

mi ha semplicemente spinto via.

entries.original: "Which floor would you like, sir?"
entries.translation_source: Which floor would you like, sir?
entries.translated: Quale piano desidera, signore?

entries.original: "Which floor do you want?"
entries.translation_source: Which floor do you want?
entries.translated: Quale piano vuoi?

entries.original: "You’re already on this floor\."
entries.translation_source: You’re already on this floor[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Sei già su questo piano\.

entries.translation_source: 1F
entries.translated: 1F

entries.original: "B1F"
entries.translation_source: B1F
entries.translated: B1F

entries.original: "B2F"
entries.translation_source: B2F
entries.translated: B2F

entries.original: "B3F"
entries.translation_source: B3F
entries.translated: B3F

entries.original:
"Marlon, sir!

I know what it looks like, but I
promise, I’m not slacking off!

Zeph told me to watch the news and
keep an eye out for anyone who\llooks like they might belong to\lthe Light of Ruin."
entries.translation_source: Marlon, sir! I know what it looks like, but I promise, I’m not slacking off! Zeph told me to watch the news and keep an eye out for anyone who looks like they might belong to the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Marlon, signore! So come sembra, ma
ti assicuro che non sto\lbighellonando! Zeph mi ha detto di

guardare i notiziari e tenere
d{B4}occhio chiunque sembri poter\lappartenere alla Luce della Rovina.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry about the huge mess in
the base, sir.

When most of the grunts left to
join the Light of Ruin, they just\ldropped all of their things on\lthe floor.

I’m sure some of them even left
their [green]clearance cards[red] behind\."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry about the huge mess in the base, sir. When most of the grunts left to join the Light of Ruin, they just dropped all of their things on the floor. I’m sure some of them even left their [color-green-1]clearance cards[color-red-2] behind[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace per il gran disordine
nella base, signore. Quando la\lmaggior parte dei sottoposti è

partita per unirsi alla Luce della
Rovina, ha semplicemente lasciato\ltutte le proprie cose per terra.

Sono sicuro che alcuni di loro
abbiano persino lasciato qui le\lloro [green]tessere di accesso[red]\.

entries.original:
"Marlon, sir!

I heard rumours that you joined
the Light of Ruin, too.

I’m glad you’re still here.

Maybe now that you’re back, someone
will finally be able to keep Zeph\lfrom doing anything too rash\."
entries.translation_source: Marlon, sir! I heard rumours that you joined the Light of Ruin, too. I’m glad you’re still here. Maybe now that you’re back, someone will finally be able to keep Zeph from doing anything too rash[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Marlon, signore! Ho sentito delle
voci secondo cui anche lei si è\lunito alla Light of Ruin. Sono

contento che sia ancora qui. Forse
ora che è tornato, qualcuno\lriuscirà finalmente a impedire a

Zeph di fare qualcosa di troppo
avventato\.

entries.original:
"The base has been so quiet ever
since most of the grunts were\lordered to join the Light of Ruin.

To be honest, sir, I was ordered to
go, too, but I refused.

I didn’t join this organization
because I wanted money.

I joined because I believed in what
Zeph was trying to achieve\."
entries.translation_source: The base has been so quiet ever since most of the grunts were ordered to join the Light of Ruin. To be honest, sir, I was ordered to go, too, but I refused. I didn’t join this organization because I wanted money. I joined because I believed in what Zeph was trying to achieve[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
La base è così silenziosa da quando
alla maggior parte delle reclute è\lstato ordinato di unirsi alla Light

of Ruin. A dire il vero, signore,
anche a me era stato ordinato di\landare, ma ho rifiutato. Non mi

sono unito a questa organizzazione
perché volevo soldi. Mi sono unito\lperché credevo in ciò che Zeph

cercava di realizzare\.

entries.original:
"With most of the other grunts gone,
our manpower has become very\llimited.

So, it is essential that each of us
become as strong as possible.

Would you allow me the privilege of
battling with you, sir?"
entries.translation_source: With most of the other grunts gone, our manpower has become very limited. So, it is essential that each of us become as strong as possible. Would you allow me the privilege of battling with you, sir?
entries.translated:
Con la maggior parte degli altri
scagnozzi spariti, le nostre forze\lsono diventate molto limitate.

Quindi è essenziale che ognuno di
noi diventi il più forte possibile.\lMi concederebbe il privilegio di

combattere con lei, signore?

entries.original:
"Thank you for battling with me,
sir.

Now, we’re both more prepared for
the inevitable confrontation with\lthe Light of Ruin."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for battling with me, sir. Now, we’re both more prepared for the inevitable confrontation with the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Grazie per aver combattuto con me,
signore. Ora, siamo entrambi più\lpreparati per l{B4}inevitabile scontro

con la Luce della Rovina.

entries.original:
"Of course, sir.

I wouldn’t expect you to waste your
time on a grunt such as myself."
entries.translation_source: Of course, sir. I wouldn’t expect you to waste your time on a grunt such as myself.
entries.translated:
Certo, signore. Non mi aspetterei
che lei perda tempo con una recluta\lcome me.

entries.original:
"An obnoxiously loud episode of a
Unova Pokémon Musical is on.

Watch for too long and it might
fry your brain."
entries.translation_source: An obnoxiously loud episode of a Unova Pokémon Musical is on. Watch for too long and it might fry your brain.
entries.translated:
È in onda un episodio di un Musical
Pokémon di Unima assordante\lall{B4}eccesso. Guardalo troppo a

lungo e potrebbe friggere il tuo
cervello.

entries.original:
"Sir!

Zeph has ordered me to stop anyone
without the proper clearance from\lentering the lab.

However, I’m sure it’s fine if I
allow you in."
entries.translation_source: Sir! Zeph has ordered me to stop anyone without the proper clearance from entering the lab. However, I’m sure it’s fine if I allow you in.
entries.translated:
Signore! Zeph mi ha ordinato di
impedire a chiunque non abbia\ll{B4}autorizzazione adeguata di

entrare nel laboratorio. Tuttavia,
sono sicuro che va bene se ti\llascio entrare.

entries.original:
"Please feel free to enter the
lab, sir."
entries.translation_source: Please feel free to enter the lab, sir.
entries.translated:
Prego, si accomodi pure nel
laboratorio, signore.

entries.original:
"I’m using a complicated algorithm
to determine the approximate\llocation of the Light of Ruin HQ.

Once I have the results, Zeph plans
on using the information to take\lhis revenge on the Light of Ruin."
entries.translation_source: I’m using a complicated algorithm to determine the approximate location of the Light of Ruin HQ. Once I have the results, Zeph plans on using the information to take his revenge on the Light of Ruin.
entries.translated:
Sto usando un algoritmo complicato
per determinare la posizione\lapprossimativa del quartier

generale della Light of Ruin. Una
volta ottenuti i risultati, Zeph\lintende usare le informazioni per

vendicarsi della Light of Ruin.

entries.original:
"Oh, Marlon, sir!

I spent some time back at HQ with
the Science Society, and learned\labout a new way to make our\lPokémon stronger in battles!

Would you like to see it?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, Marlon, sir! I spent some time back at HQ with the Science Society, and learned about a new way to make our Pokémon stronger in battles! Would you like to see it?
entries.translated:
Oh, signor Marlon! Ho passato un
po{B4} di tempo al quartier generale\lcon la Società delle Scienze, e ho

imparato un nuovo modo per rendere
i nostri Pokémon più forti in\lbattaglia! Vuole vederlo?

entries.original:
"For spending your valuable time
battling me, I’d like to thank you\lby healing your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: For spending your valuable time battling me, I’d like to thank you by healing your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Per aver speso il tuo prezioso
tempo a combattere con me, vorrei\lringraziarti curando i tuoi

Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Of course, sir.

I’m sure you have much more
important business to attend to."
entries.translation_source: Of course, sir. I’m sure you have much more important business to attend to.
entries.translated:
Certamente, signore. Sono sicuro
che abbia affari molto più\limportanti a cui badare.

entries.original:
"Great care is being taken in
synthesizing this next batch of\lShadow Warriors.

These Shadow Warriors will be the
strongest we’ve ever created!

They’ll be invincible!

And the Light of Ruin will stand no
chance against them!"
entries.translation_source: Great care is being taken in synthesizing this next batch of Shadow Warriors. These Shadow Warriors will be the strongest we’ve ever created! They’ll be invincible! And the Light of Ruin will stand no chance against them!
entries.translated:
Si sta prestando grandissima
attenzione alla sintesi di questo\lprossimo lotto di Guerrieri Ombra.

Questi Guerrieri Ombra saranno i
più forti che abbiamo mai creato!\lSaranno invincibili! E la Luce

della Rovina non avrà alcuna
possibilità contro di loro!

entries.original:
"They wanted us to go back to HQ
and stop making Shadow Warriors.

STOP MAKING SHADOW WARRIORS!?

ARE YOU KIDDING ME!?

Creating Shadow Warriors is all I
live for!

I’m fortunate that Zeph still had a
use for more and allowed me to\lcontinue synthesizing them."
entries.translation_source: They wanted us to go back to HQ and stop making Shadow Warriors. STOP MAKING SHADOW WARRIORS!? ARE YOU KIDDING ME!? Creating Shadow Warriors is all I live for! I’m fortunate that Zeph still had a use for more and allowed me to continue synthesizing them.
entries.translated:
Volevano che tornassimo all{B4}HQ e
smettessimo di creare Shadow\lWarriors. SMETTERE DI CREARE SHADOW

WARRIORS!? STAI SCHERZANDO!? Creare
Shadow Warriors è l{B4}unica cosa per\lcui vivo! Sono fortunato che Zeph

avesse ancora bisogno di più
esemplari e mi abbia permesso di\lcontinuare a sintetizzarli.

entries.original:
"Something grotesque is being
synthesized in the tube."
entries.translation_source: Something grotesque is being synthesized in the tube.
entries.translated:
Qualcosa di grottesco viene
sintetizzato nel tubo.

entries.original: "The tube is empty."
entries.translation_source: The tube is empty.
entries.translated: Il tubo è vuoto.

entries.original: "The cage is empty."
entries.translation_source: The cage is empty.
entries.translated: La gabbia è vuota.

entries.original:
"Someone has been experimenting
today\."
entries.translation_source: Someone has been experimenting today[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Qualcuno si è dato agli esperimenti
oggi\.

entries.original:
"Ah, [player]\. it is good of you to
visit us.

I have been trying to live a more
honourable life since I was\lreleased from prison.

I owe my son, of course, every
effort to make sure this second\lchance does not go to waste.

Having toiled for years to see him
return to me, I plan to let the\lyounger generation guide the future\lfrom now on.

As for me, my only desire is to spend
what time I have with Zeph Jr.

Ah, yes\. would you care to spar with
me, if you have time?

My son seems to have grown rather
fond of Pokémon battles, after all."
entries.translation_source: Ah, [player-name-1][game-token-2] it is good of you to visit us. I have been trying to live a more honourable life since I was released from prison. I owe my son, of course, every effort to make sure this second chance does not go to waste. Having toiled for years to see him return to me, I plan to let the younger generation guide the future from now on. As for me, my only desire is to spend what time I have with Zeph Jr. Ah, yes[game-token-3] would you care to spar with me, if you have time? My son seems to have grown rather fond of Pokémon battles, after all.
entries.translated:
Ah, [player]\. è gentile da parte tua
farci visita. Da quando sono uscito\ldi prigione, ho cercato di vivere

una vita più onorevole. Devo a mio
figlio, naturalmente, ogni sforzo\lper assicurarmi che questa seconda

possibilità non vada sprecata. Dopo
aver faticato per anni per vederlo\ltornare da me, ho intenzione di

lasciare che la generazione più
giovane guidi il futuro d{B4}ora in\lpoi. Quanto a me, il mio unico

desiderio è passare il tempo che mi
resta con Zeph Jr. Ah, sì\. ti\landrebbe di fare una lotta con me,

se hai tempo? Mio figlio sembra
essersi affezionato parecchio alle\llotte Pokémon, dopotutto.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes\. would you care to spar with
me, if you have time?

My son seems to have grown rather
fond of Pokémon battles, after all."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes[game-token-1] would you care to spar with me, if you have time? My son seems to have grown rather fond of Pokémon battles, after all.
entries.translated:
Ah, sì\. Ti andrebbe di fare un po{B4}
di sparring con me, se hai tempo?\lMio figlio sembra essersi

affezionato parecchio alle lotte
Pokémon, dopotutto.

entries.original:
"I see\. yes, I suppose there’s not
much reason for us to be at each\lother’s throats\.

Peace may have returned to us, but
it needn’t be anything more than a\lfriendly competition.

If you change your mind, I would be
willing to take you on, anytime."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1] yes, I suppose there’s not much reason for us to be at each other’s throats[game-token-2] Peace may have returned to us, but it needn’t be anything more than a friendly competition. If you change your mind, I would be willing to take you on, anytime.
entries.translated:
Capisco\. sì, suppongo che non ci sia
molta ragione per stare alla gola\ll{B4}un l{B4}altro\. La pace potrebbe

essere tornata da noi, ma non deve
essere altro che una sana\lcompetizione. Se cambi idea, sarei

disposto a sfidarti, in qualsiasi
momento.

entries.original:
"Finally, a chance presents itself, to
fight with a clear conscience\.

Well, [player], don’t expect me to
hold back.

I have to put on a good showing for
my son, after all!"
entries.translation_source: Finally, a chance presents itself, to fight with a clear conscience[game-token-1] Well, [player-name-2], don’t expect me to hold back. I have to put on a good showing for my son, after all!
entries.translated:
Finalmente si presenta un{B4}occasione
per combattere con la coscienza\lpulita\. Beh, [player], non

aspettarti che mi trattenga.
Dopotutto devo fare una bella\lfigura davanti a mio figlio!

entries.original:
"I don’t think I’ve felt so satisfied
after a loss, in a good long time.

I should really thank you,
[player].

Your actions not only brought my son
back to me\.

But I should also be grateful you
took time from your busy life to\lkeep him amused.

Please, accept this gift from me."
entries.translation_source: I don’t think I’ve felt so satisfied after a loss, in a good long time. I should really thank you, [player-name-1]. "[black]Trainer Tips!

Don’t walk away from these signs
until you’ve read them completely!

Every single one contains important
information that will help you out\lduring your adventure.

Skipping text on these signs will
likely cost you!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Trainer Tips! Don’t walk away from these signs until you’ve read them completely! Every single one contains important information that will help you out during your adventure. Skipping text on these signs will likely cost you!
entries.translated:

allontanarti da questi cartelli\lfinché non li hai letti per intero!

Ognuno contiene informazioni
importanti che ti aiuteranno nella\ltua avventura. Saltare il testo su

questi cartelli probabilmente ti
costerà caro!

"[black]Trainer Tips!

Hold \btn01 to change the default
movement speed!

Press \btn02 to toggle auto-run!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Trainer Tips! Hold [button-icon-2] to change the default movement speed! Press [button-icon-3] to toggle auto-run!
entries.translated:
[black]Consigli per Allenatori! Tieni
