per attivare la corsa automatica!

entries.original:
"[black]Trainer Tips!

Open the [green]Options[black] Menu to enable
Save Prompts and Quick HMs!

If [green]Save Prompts[black] are turned on, you
will be asked if you’d like to save\lbefore or after important events!

If [green]Quick HMs[black] are turned on, Field
Moves can be used without needing\lconfirmation each use!

Additionally, \btn02 and \btn03 can be used
to scroll between pages of options!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Trainer Tips! Open the [color-green-2]Options[color-black-3] Menu to enable Save Prompts and Quick HMs! If [color-green-4]Save Prompts[color-black-5] are turned on, you will be asked if you’d like to save before or after important events! If [color-green-6]Quick HMs[color-black-7] are turned on, Field Moves can be used without needing confirmation each use! Additionally, [button-icon-8] and [button-icon-9] can be used to scroll between pages of options!
entries.translated:
[black]Suggerimenti per l{B4}Allenatore! Apri
il menu [green]Opzioni[black] per abilitare i\lpromemoria di salvataggio e le MN

rapide! Se [green]i promemoria di
salvataggio[black] sono attivi, ti verrà\lchiesto se desideri salvare prima o

dopo gli eventi importanti! Se [green]le
MN rapide[black] sono attive, le mosse sul\lcampo possono essere usate senza

bisogno di conferma ogni volta!
Inoltre, \btn02 e \btn03 possono essere usati\lper scorrere tra le pagine delle

opzioni!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Pokémon can gain Exp. Points by
battling other Pokémon.

Exp. Points help them grow
stronger.

And your Pokémon will still get
Exp. Points even if you catch a\lPokémon you are battling against!

But keep in mind, if your Pokémon
level up too much, other Trainers\lwill get stronger as well.

In order to prevent issues from
arising due to overleveling such\las increased difficulty, a hard\llevel cap may be enabled from the\l[green]Options Menu[black] by setting [green]Exp. Gain[black]\lto [green]Capped Exp. Share[black]."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Pokémon can gain Exp. Points by battling other Pokémon. Exp. Points help them grow stronger. And your Pokémon will still get Exp. Points even if you catch a Pokémon you are battling against! But keep in mind, if your Pokémon level up too much, other Trainers will get stronger as well. In order to prevent issues from arising due to overleveling such as increased difficulty, a hard level cap may be enabled from the [color-green-1]Options Menu[color-black-2] by setting [color-green-3]Exp. Gain[color-black-4] to [color-green-5]Capped Exp. Share[color-black-6].
entries.translated:
Consigli dell{B4}Allenatore! I Pokémon
possono ottenere Punti ESP lottando\lcontro altri Pokémon. I Punti ESP

li aiutano a diventare più forti. E
i tuoi Pokémon riceveranno comunque\lPunti ESP anche se catturi un

Pokémon con cui stai lottando! Ma
tieni presente che, se i tuoi\lPokémon salgono troppo di livello,

anche gli altri Allenatori
diventeranno più forti. Per evitare\lche sorgano problemi dovuti a un

eccessivo aumento di livello, come
una maggiore difficoltà, è\lpossibile attivare un limite di

livello massimo dal [green]Menu Opzioni[black]
impostando [green]Guadagno ESP[black] su\l[green]Condividi ESP con limite[black].

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

If you talk to this Chansey, your
Pokémon will be fully healed!

Whenever you lose a battle, you’ll
be returned to this point as well!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! If you talk to this Chansey, your Pokémon will be fully healed! Whenever you lose a battle, you’ll be returned to this point as well!
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Se parli
con questa Chansey, i tuoi Pokémon\lsaranno completamente curati! Ogni

volta che perdi una lotta, verrai
riportato anche qui!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Any Pokémon that participates in
battle receives full Exp. Points.

If the [green]Exp. Share[black] is enabled in
the [green]Options[black] Menu, any Pokémon\lthat didn’t participate will still\lreceive a portion of the Exp.\lPoints earned in battle."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Any Pokémon that participates in battle receives full Exp. Points. If the [color-green-1]Exp. Share[color-black-2] is enabled in the [color-green-3]Options[color-black-4] Menu, any Pokémon that didn’t participate will still receive a portion of the Exp. Points earned in battle.
entries.translated:
Consigli per gli Allenatori!
Qualsiasi Pokémon che partecipa\lalla lotta riceve tutti i Punti

Esperienza. Se la [green]Condiv. Exp.[black] è
attiva nel menu [green]Opzioni[black], qualsiasi\lPokémon che non ha partecipato

riceverà comunque una parte dei
Punti Esperienza guadagnati in\llotta.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

When selecting an attack in battle,
certain symbols may appear.

This is based on the move’s
effectiveness against the target.

A green [green]\au[black] indicates that the move
is super effective.

A yellow [orange]\ad[black] indicates the move is
not very effective.

A red [lightgreen]*[black] indicates that the move
doesn’t affect the target at all.

And a \+ symbol indicates the move
has the Same-Type-Attack-Bonus."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! When selecting an attack in battle, certain symbols may appear. This is based on the move’s effectiveness against the target. A green [color-green-1][game-token-2][color-black-3] indicates that the move is super effective. A yellow [color-orange-4][game-token-5][color-black-6] indicates the move is not very effective. A red [color-lightgreen-7]*[color-black-8] indicates that the move doesn’t affect the target at all. And a [game-token-9] symbol indicates the move has the Same-Type-Attack-Bonus.
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Quando
selezioni un attacco in lotta,\lpotrebbero apparire alcuni simboli.

Questo si basa sull{B4}efficacia della
mossa contro il bersaglio. Un [green]\au[black]\lverde indica che la mossa è

superefficace. Un [orange]\ad[black] giallo indica
che la mossa non è molto efficace.\lUn [lightgreen]*[black] rosso indica che la mossa non

ha alcun effetto sul bersaglio. E
il simbolo \+ indica che la mossa ha\lil Bonus di Tipo.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

The [green]Item Restrictions[black] option lets
you choose how many items you can\luse in battle!

If you choose [green]No Items[black], then no
Trainers will be able to use any\leither!

At minimum, [green]4 Items Only[black] must be
set for [green]Expert[black], and [green]No Items[black] must\lbe set for [green]Insane[black].

If you’re feeling extra ambitious,
setting it to [green]Enemy Trainer Only[black]\lwill allow your opponents to use\litems while preventing you!

This last choice works for any
difficulty."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! The [color-green-1]Item Restrictions[color-black-2] option lets you choose how many items you can use in battle! If you choose [color-green-3]No Items[color-black-4], then no Trainers will be able to use any either! At minimum, [color-green-5]4 Items Only[color-black-6] must be set for [color-green-7]Expert[color-black-8], and [color-green-9]No Items[color-black-10] must be set for [color-green-11]Insane[color-black-12]. If you’re feeling extra ambitious, setting it to [color-green-13]Enemy Trainer Only[color-black-14] will allow your opponents to use items while preventing you! This last choice works for any difficulty.
entries.translated:
Consigli per gli Allenatori!
L{B4}opzione [green]Restrizioni sugli\lStrumenti[black] ti permette di scegliere

quanti strumenti puoi usare in
battaglia! Se scegli [green]Nessun\lStrumento[black], allora nessun Allenatore

potrà usarne alcuno! Al minimo,
[green]Solo 4 Strumenti[black] deve essere\limpostato per [green]Esperto[black], e [green]Nessun

Strumento[black] deve essere impostato per
[green]Pazzo[black]. Se ti senti particolarmente\lambizioso, impostarlo su [green]Solo

Allenatore Avversario[black] permetterà ai
tuoi avversari di usare strumenti\lmentre impedirà a te! Quest{B4}ultima

scelta funziona per qualsiasi
difficoltà.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

\btn02 and \btn05 can be used to quick-
switch Pokémon in the Party List!

\btn02 will auto-select a Pokémon for
switching, and \btn05 will make the\lcurrent Pokémon the party lead!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! [button-icon-1] and [button-icon-2] can be used to quick- switch Pokémon in the Party List! [button-icon-3] will auto-select a Pokémon for switching, and [button-icon-4] will make the current Pokémon the party lead!
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! \btn02 e \btn05
possono essere usati per cambiare\lrapidamente Pokémon nella Lista

squadra! \btn02 selezionerà
automaticamente un Pokémon da\lsostituire, mentre \btn05 renderà il

Pokémon attuale il primo della
squadra!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

In a battle, you can check your
Pokémon’s moves for details like\lpower and accuracy ratings.

Just press \btn02 before selecting
a move!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! In a battle, you can check your Pokémon’s moves for details like power and accuracy ratings. Just press [button-icon-1] before selecting a move!
entries.translated:
Consigli per gli Allenatori! In
lotta, puoi controllare le mosse\ldel tuo Pokémon per vedere dettagli

come potenza e precisione. Ti basta
premere \btn02 prima di selezionare una\lmossa!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Talk to Lapras to ride it down
the waterfall!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Talk to Lapras to ride it down the waterfall!
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Parla con
Lapras per cavalcarla lungo la\lcascata!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

One-time use items are returned to
you after important battles, such\las against Gym Leaders.

Use them to help strengthen your
team and give yourself an edge!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! One-time use items are returned to you after important battles, such as against Gym Leaders. Use them to help strengthen your team and give yourself an edge!
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Gli
oggetti monouso ti vengono\lrestituiti dopo le lotte

importanti, come quelle contro i
Capipalestra. Usali per rafforzare\lla tua squadra e darti un

vantaggio!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Keep an eye out for trees with
a shady area between them!

These indicate [green]Hidden Grottos[black] can
be found there!

These special areas have been
appearing en masse ever since the\lmeteorite strike.

Simply interact with the trees and
prepare to face a tough Pokémon!

And in fact, if you use [green]Cut[black], you’ll
even find one on this route!

So earn the Vision Badge from the
Crater Town Gym, and then come\lback here to find it!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Keep an eye out for trees with a shady area between them! These indicate [color-green-1]Hidden Grottos[color-black-2] can be found there! These special areas have been appearing en masse ever since the meteorite strike. Simply interact with the trees and prepare to face a tough Pokémon! And in fact, if you use [color-green-3]Cut[color-black-4], you’ll even find one on this route! So earn the Vision Badge from the Crater Town Gym, and then come back here to find it!
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Tieni
d{B4}occhio gli alberi con un{B4}area\lombreggiata tra di loro! Questi

indicano che lì si possono trovare
[green]Grotte Segrete[black]! Queste aree\lspeciali sono apparse in massa dopo

la caduta del meteorite. Basta
interagire con gli alberi e\lpreparati ad affrontare un Pokémon

ostico! E infatti, se usi [green]Taglio[black],
ne troverai uno anche su questo\lpercorso! Quindi ottieni la

Medaglia Visione dalla Palestra di
Crater Town, e poi torna qui per\ltrovarlo!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

The button combination for running
quickly from wild battles can be\lset from the [green]Options Menu[black]!

By default, you can run quickly from
wild battles with \btn03!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! The button combination for running quickly from wild battles can be set from the [color-green-1]Options Menu[color-black-2]! By default, you can run quickly from wild battles with [button-icon-3]!
entries.translated:
Consigli Allenatore! La
combinazione di pulsanti per\lcorrere rapidamente dagli incontri

selvatici può essere impostata dal
[green]Menu Opzioni[black]! Per impostazione\lpredefinita, puoi correre

rapidamente dagli incontri
selvatici con \btn03!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Pressing \btn04 while viewing items
in the Cube lets you sort them!

Setting the [green]Auto Item Sort[black] option
in the [green]Options Menu[black] will sort the\lCube automatically each time you\lopen it!

Pressing \btn02 and \btn03 lets you scroll
through items in the Cube faster!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Pressing [button-icon-1] while viewing items in the Cube lets you sort them! Setting the [color-green-2]Auto Item Sort[color-black-3] option in the [color-green-4]Options Menu[color-black-5] will sort the Cube automatically each time you open it! Pressing [button-icon-6] and [button-icon-7] lets you scroll through items in the Cube faster!
entries.translated:
Consigli per gli Allenatori!
Premendo \btn04 mentre visualizzi gli\loggetti nel Cubo puoi ordinarli!

Impostando l{B4}opzione [green]Ordina oggetti
automaticamente[black] nel [green]Menu Opzioni[black] il\lCubo verrà ordinato automaticamente

ogni volta che lo apri! Premendo \btn02
e \btn03 puoi scorrere gli oggetti nel\lCubo più velocemente!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Different Pokémon appear at night
than during the day!

Visit the same places throughout
the day to catch more Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Different Pokémon appear at night than during the day! Visit the same places throughout the day to catch more Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Consigli per gli Allenatori!
Pokémon diversi appaiono di notte\lrispetto al giorno! Visita gli

stessi luoghi durante il giorno per
catturare più Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Wild Pokémon are less likely to
appear while riding a Motorcycle.

If you’re old enough to drive one,
it’s time to hop on!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Wild Pokémon are less likely to appear while riding a Motorcycle. If you’re old enough to drive one, it’s time to hop on!
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! I Pokémon
selvatici hanno meno probabilità di\lapparire mentre cavalchi una

motocicletta. Se sei abbastanza
grande per guidarne una, è ora di\lsalire in sella!

entries.original:
"[black]Trainer Tips!

The number of Exp. Points you get
after a battle is based on levels.

When your Pokémon is weaker than
its opponent, it will get more.

But if your Pokémon is stronger,
it won’t get as many."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Trainer Tips! The number of Exp. Points you get after a battle is based on levels. When your Pokémon is weaker than its opponent, it will get more. But if your Pokémon is stronger, it won’t get as many.
entries.translated:
[black]Consigli Allenatore! Il numero di
Punti Esperienza che ottieni dopo\luna lotta si basa sui livelli.

Quando il tuo Pokémon è più debole
del suo avversario, ne ottiene di\lpiù. Ma se il tuo Pokémon è più

forte, ne otterrà di meno.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Electric-type Pokémon are immune
to paralysis!

Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected
by powder and spore moves!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Electric-type Pokémon are immune to paralysis! Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected by powder and spore moves!
entries.translated:
Consigli Allenatore! I Pokémon di
tipo Elettro sono immuni alla\lparalisi! I Pokémon di tipo Erba

non subiscono le mosse polvere e
spora!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Pressing \btn05 will let you use
one of up to six registered items!

To register an item, select it in
the Key Items sector of your Cube,\land then choose [green]Register[black].

The item registered second can be
used quickly by pressing \btn02 when\lthe [green]L-Button Mode[black] option is set to\l[green]Reg Item 2[black]."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Pressing [button-icon-1] will let you use one of up to six registered items! To register an item, select it in the Key Items sector of your Cube, and then choose [color-green-2]Register[color-black-3]. The item registered second can be used quickly by pressing [button-icon-4] when the [color-green-5]L-Button Mode[color-black-6] option is set to [color-green-7]Reg Item 2[color-black-8].
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Premendo \btn05
potrai usare uno dei sei oggetti\lregistrati! Per registrare un

oggetto, selezionalo nella sezione
Strumenti Chiave del tuo Cube,\lquindi scegli [green]Register[black]. L{B4}oggetto

registrato al secondo posto può
essere usato rapidamente premendo \btn02\lquando l{B4}opzione [green]L-Button Mode[black] è

impostata su [green]Reg Item 2[black].

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Hop on the rocks to cross over
the water!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Hop on the rocks to cross over the water!
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Salta
sulle rocce per attraversare\ll{B4}acqua!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

When catching a Pokémon, sometimes
the Poké Ball you throw will rock\lonly once.

This is called a \qocritical capture\qc
and the more Pokémon you catch,\lthe more likely it will occur."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! When catching a Pokémon, sometimes the Poké Ball you throw will rock only once. This is called a [quote-open-1]critical capture[quote-close-2] and the more Pokémon you catch, the more likely it will occur.
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Quando
catturi un Pokémon, a volte la Poké\lBall che lanci oscillerà solo una

volta. Questo si chiama \qocattura
critica\qc e più Pokémon catturi, più\lè probabile che accada.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Never change the date on your
device to access more daily events!

If you do, all daily events may
cease to function properly,\lregardless of whether or not you\lattempted to access them more\lthan once.

If you’ve already done this
accidentally, hope is not lost.

If you can wait until the date you
changed to, it is recommended to\lwait, otherwise talk with a man in\lFrozen Heights.

Just once, he can reset your clock
to allow daily events to function\lonce more."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Never change the date on your device to access more daily events! If you do, all daily events may cease to function properly, regardless of whether or not you attempted to access them more than once. If you’ve already done this accidentally, hope is not lost. If you can wait until the date you changed to, it is recommended to wait, otherwise talk with a man in Frozen Heights. Just once, he can reset your clock to allow daily events to function once more.
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Non
cambiare mai la data sul tuo\ldispositivo per accedere a più

eventi giornalieri! Se lo fai,
tutti gli eventi giornalieri\lpotrebbero smettere di funzionare

correttamente, indipendentemente
dal fatto che tu abbia tentato di\laccedervi più di una volta. Se lo

hai già fatto accidentalmente, la
speranza non è perduta. Se puoi\laspettare fino alla data a cui hai

cambiato, è consigliato aspettare,
altrimenti parla con un uomo a\lFrozen Heights. Solo una volta, può

resettare il tuo orologio per far
sì che gli eventi giornalieri\lfunzionino di nuovo.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Use Strength to push the boulders
onto the pressure plates!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Use Strength to push the boulders onto the pressure plates!
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Usa Forza
per spingere i massi sulle piastre\la pressione!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

If you notice a heart symbol while
checking your Pokémon’s summary,\lthat means you’ve started bonding\lwith it!

The closer you are, the more full
the heart will become.

And a Pokémon with nearly a full
heart is ready to evolve if it\lrequires a [green]friendship Evolution[black]!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! If you notice a heart symbol while checking your Pokémon’s summary, that means you’ve started bonding with it! The closer you are, the more full the heart will become. And a Pokémon with nearly a full heart is ready to evolve if it requires a [color-green-1]friendship Evolution[color-black-2]!
entries.translated:
Consigli per gli Allenatori! Se
noti un simbolo a forma di cuore\lmentre controlli la scheda

riepilogativa del tuo Pokémon,
significa che hai iniziato a\llegarti a lui! Più il legame è

forte, più il cuore si riempirà. E
un Pokémon con un cuore quasi pieno\lè pronto a evolversi se richiede

un{B4}evoluzione per l{B4}[green]amicizia[black]!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

There’s [green]no limit[black] to how many times
you can use items such as [green]Protein[black]\land [green]Carbos[black] on your Pokémon!

Buy these vitamins in bulk at the
[green]Dehara Department Store[black]!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! There’s [color-green-1]no limit[color-black-2] to how many times you can use items such as [color-green-3]Protein[color-black-4] and [color-green-5]Carbos[color-black-6] on your Pokémon! Buy these vitamins in bulk at the [color-green-7]Dehara Department Store[color-black-8]!
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Non c{B4}è
[green]alcun limite[black] al numero di volte in\lcui puoi usare oggetti come

[green]Proteina[black] e [green]Carbos[black] sui tuoi Pokémon!
Compra queste vitamine in grandi\lquantità al [green]Centro Commerciale di

Dehara[black]!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Some Trainers may only battle you
after you’ve defeated every other\lTrainer in the area.

If you can defeat these Trainers,
you’ll be sure to earn a great\lreward!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Some Trainers may only battle you after you’ve defeated every other Trainer in the area. If you can defeat these Trainers, you’ll be sure to earn a great reward!
entries.translated:
Consigli per gli Allenatori! Alcuni
Allenatori potrebbero sfidarti solo\ldopo che avrai battuto tutti gli

altri Allenatori della zona. Se
riesci a sconfiggere questi\lAllenatori, sarai sicuro di

ottenere una grande ricompensa!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Dark spots in the ocean indicate
that a Pokémon can go underwater!

If you’ve purchased an [green]ADM[black] from
[green]Captain Davy’s Shipyard[black] in [green]Seaport\lCity[black], press \btn00 over the dark spot\lto submerge.

While underwater, if you find a
lighter area of the ground,\lpress \btn01 there to resurface."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Dark spots in the ocean indicate that a Pokémon can go underwater! If you’ve purchased an [color-green-1]ADM[color-black-2] from [color-green-3]Captain Davy’s Shipyard[color-black-4] in [color-green-5]Seaport City[color-black-6], press [button-icon-7] over the dark spot to submerge. While underwater, if you find a lighter area of the ground, press [button-icon-8] there to resurface.
entries.translated:
Suggerimenti Allenatore! Le zone
scure nell{B4}oceano indicano che un\lPokémon può andare sott{B4}acqua! Se

hai acquistato un [green]ADM[black] presso il
[green]Cantiere navale del Capitano Davy[black] a\l[green]Seaport City[black], premi \btn00 sopra la zona

scura per immergerti. Una volta
sott{B4}acqua, se trovi un{B4}area del\lterreno più chiara, premi \btn01 lì per

riemergere.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Certain Pokémon may only visit an
area on certain days of the week.

Be sure to search Borrius every
day for Pokémon like these."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Certain Pokémon may only visit an area on certain days of the week. Be sure to search Borrius every day for Pokémon like these.
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Alcuni
Pokémon possono visitare un{B4}area\lsolo in certi giorni della

settimana. Assicurati di esplorare
Borrius ogni giorno per trovare\lPokémon come questi.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Certain kinds of Hidden Items like
food items and Shards can be found\lmore than once!

The more often you visit areas with
Hidden Items like these, the higher\lthe chance of finding the Hidden\lItems again."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Certain kinds of Hidden Items like food items and Shards can be found more than once! The more often you visit areas with Hidden Items like these, the higher the chance of finding the Hidden Items again.
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Alcuni
tipi di Strumenti nascosti come gli\loggetti da mangiare e i Frammenti

si possono trovare più di una
volta! Più spesso visiti le aree\lcon Strumenti nascosti come questi,

maggiore è la probabilità di
ritrovare di nuovo gli Strumenti\lnascosti.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

If your Pokémon knows the move
[green]Sweet Scent[black], you can use it to\lencounter two wild Pokémon at once\lif the weather is clear!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! If your Pokémon knows the move [color-green-1]Sweet Scent[color-black-2], you can use it to encounter two wild Pokémon at once if the weather is clear!
entries.translated:
Consigli per gli Allenatori! Se il
tuo Pokémon conosce la mossa\l[green]Profumino[black], puoi usarla per

incontrare due Pokémon selvatici
alla volta se il tempo è sereno!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Hold \btn01 to Surf faster!

And when the [green]L-Button Mode[black] is set to
[green]Auto-Run[black], press \btn02 to toggle\lTurbo Surf!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Hold [button-icon-1] to Surf faster! And when the [color-green-2]L-Button Mode[color-black-3] is set to [color-green-4]Auto-Run[color-black-5], press [button-icon-6] to toggle Turbo Surf!
entries.translated:
Consigli per gli Allenatori! Tieni
premuto \btn01 per surfare più\lvelocemente! E quando la [green]Modalità

Pulsante L[black] è impostata su
[green]Auto-Corsa[black], premi \btn02 per\lattivare/disattivare Turbo Surf!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Press \btn05 when moving Pokémon
in the PC to activate multi-select.

This lets you move multiple
Pokémon at once by holding \btn00!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Press [button-icon-1] when moving Pokémon in the PC to activate multi-select. This lets you move multiple Pokémon at once by holding [button-icon-2]!
entries.translated:
Trucchi per Allenatori! Premi \btn05
quando sposti Pokémon nel PC per\lattivare la selezione multipla.

Così puoi spostare più Pokémon
insieme tenendo premuto \btn00!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Have a lot of requests recorded in
your Mission Log?

Use \btn0B to quickly scroll through
the list!

Or, try pressing \btn04 to sort
it alphabetically!

You can even press \btn05 to pin
Missions to the top of the list!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Have a lot of requests recorded in your Mission Log? Use [button-icon-1] to quickly scroll through the list! Or, try pressing [button-icon-2] to sort it alphabetically! You can even press [button-icon-3] to pin Missions to the top of the list!
entries.translated:
Consigli per gli Allenatori! Hai un
sacco di richieste registrate nel\ltuo Diario Missioni? Usa \btn0B per

scorrere rapidamente l{B4}elenco!
Oppure prova a premere \btn04 per\lordinarlo alfabeticamente! Puoi

persino premere \btn05 per fissare le
Missioni in cima all{B4}elenco!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

There are minimal places to heal
once you begin your ascent up\lVictory Road!

Don’t get caught off guard!

Buy healing items!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! There are minimal places to heal once you begin your ascent up Victory Road! Don’t get caught off guard! Buy healing items!
entries.translated:
Consigli Allenatore! Una volta
iniziata la salita lungo il\lPercorso Vittoria, ci sono pochi

posti in cui curarsi! Non farti
cogliere impreparato! Compra\lstrumenti curativi!

entries.original:
"[black]Trainer Tips!

Even on the [green]Vanilla[black] difficulty, the
Elite Four get stronger as you do!

Don’t be caught off guard and be
prepared for intense fights!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Trainer Tips! Even on the [color-green-2]Vanilla[color-black-3] difficulty, the Elite Four get stronger as you do! Don’t be caught off guard and be prepared for intense fights!
entries.translated:
[black]Suggerimento Allenatori! Anche alla
difficoltà [green]Vanilla[black], il Superquattro\ldiventa più forte man mano che

avanzi! Non farti cogliere di
sorpresa e preparati a\lcombattimenti intensi!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Press \btn00 to climb up the ladder!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Press [button-icon-1] to climb up the ladder!
entries.translated:
Consigli Allenatore! Premi \btn00 per
salire sulla scala!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Press \btn00 on the tree to the left of
the sign to enter a Hidden Grotto!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Press [button-icon-1] on the tree to the left of the sign to enter a Hidden Grotto!
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Premi \btn00
sull{B4}albero a sinistra del cartello\lper entrare in una Grotta Nascosta!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Press \btn04 in a Double Battle to
view your Pokémon’s HP as digits!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Press [button-icon-1] in a Double Battle to view your Pokémon’s HP as digits!
entries.translated:
Suggerimenti per Allenatori! Premi
\btn04 in una Lotta in Doppio per\lvisualizzare i PS del tuo Pokémon

in cifre!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Traveling together makes your
Pokémon grow friendlier!

Pokémon may even evolve when they
grow friendly enough!

And if you’ve entered into the
[green]Hall of Fame[black], these Pokémon may\lgain [green]extra Exp.[black] as well!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Traveling together makes your Pokémon grow friendlier! Pokémon may even evolve when they grow friendly enough! And if you’ve entered into the [color-green-1]Hall of Fame[color-black-2], these Pokémon may gain [color-green-3]extra Exp.[color-black-4] as well!
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Viaggiare
insieme rende i tuoi Pokémon più\laffezionati! I Pokémon possono

persino evolversi quando diventano
abbastanza amichevoli! E se sei\lentrato nella [green]Hall of Fame[black], questi

Pokémon possono anche ottenere
[green]Punti Esperienza extra[black]!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Once you enter the Hall of Fame,
you unlock the ability to [green]scroll\ltext automatically[black] by holding \btn03!

This feature also carries over to
New Game\+ and Sandbox Mode.

But please, never hold \btn03 when
reading Trainer Tips signs!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Once you enter the Hall of Fame, you unlock the ability to [color-green-1]scroll text automatically[color-black-2] by holding [button-icon-3]! This feature also carries over to New Game[game-token-4] and Sandbox Mode. But please, never hold [button-icon-5] when reading Trainer Tips signs!
entries.translated:
Suggerimenti per Allenatori! Una
volta entrato nella Hall of Fame,\lsblocchi la possibilità di [green]far

scorrere automaticamente il testo[black]
tenendo premuto \btn03! Questa funzione\lsi estende anche a New Game\+ e alla

Modalità Sandbox. Ma per favore,
non tenere mai premuto \btn03 quando\lleggi i cartelli dei Suggerimenti

per Allenatori!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

After the great Portal Boom, many
rare and powerful Pokémon have\lbegun to appear in Borrius!

If you accidentally defeat or run
away from one instead of capturing\lit, it will return if you re-enter\lthe Hall of Fame."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! After the great Portal Boom, many rare and powerful Pokémon have begun to appear in Borrius! If you accidentally defeat or run away from one instead of capturing it, it will return if you re-enter the Hall of Fame.
entries.translated:
Consigli per gli Allenatori! Dopo
il grande Boom dei Portali, molti\lPokémon rari e potenti hanno

iniziato ad apparire a Borrius! Se
per sbaglio li sconfiggi o scappi\linvece di catturarli, torneranno se

rientri nella Sala d{B4}Onore.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Avoid using standard Balls such as
Ultra Balls when attempting to\lcapture powerful Pokémon!

If you’re facing a very [green]heavy[black]
Pokémon, the [green]Heavy Ball[black] will be\lthe ideal Ball.

Otherwise if the battle has been
drawn out for over [green]10 turns[black],\lconsider using a [green]Timer Ball[black].

If the battle has been short, but
the opposing Pokémon has a [green]base\lSpeed stat[black] over [green]100[black], then consider\lusing a [green]Fast Ball[black].

But if the battle has been short and
the opposing Pokémon is slow, then\lattempt to catch the Pokémon at\l[green]night[black] using a [green]Dusk Ball[black].

These four Balls will be key in
capturing powerful Pokémon quickly!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Avoid using standard Balls such as Ultra Balls when attempting to capture powerful Pokémon! If you’re facing a very [color-green-1]heavy[color-black-2] Pokémon, the [color-green-3]Heavy Ball[color-black-4] will be the ideal Ball. Otherwise if the battle has been drawn out for over [color-green-5]10 turns[color-black-6], consider using a [color-green-7]Timer Ball[color-black-8]. If the battle has been short, but the opposing Pokémon has a [color-green-9]base Speed stat[color-black-10] over [color-green-11]100[color-black-12], then consider using a [color-green-13]Fast Ball[color-black-14]. But if the battle has been short and the opposing Pokémon is slow, then attempt to catch the Pokémon at [color-green-15]night[color-black-16] using a [color-green-17]Dusk Ball[color-black-18]. These four Balls will be key in capturing powerful Pokémon quickly!
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Evita di
usare Ball comuni come le Ultra\lBall quando cerchi di catturare

Pokémon potenti! Se affronti un
Pokémon molto [green]pesante[black], la [green]Peso Ball[black]\lsarà la Ball ideale. Altrimenti, se

la lotta si è protratta per oltre
[green]10 turni[black], considera di usare una\l[green]Timer Ball[black]. Se la lotta è stata

breve, ma il Pokémon avversario ha
una [green]Velocità base[black] superiore a [green]100[black],\lallora considera di usare una [green]Rapid

Ball[black]. Ma se la lotta è stata breve
e il Pokémon avversario è lento,\lallora prova a catturare il Pokémon

di [green]notte[black] usando una [green]Scuro Ball[black].
Queste quattro Ball saranno\lfondamentali per catturare

velocemente i Pokémon potenti!

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

Thanks to the advancements of modern
science, you can start a brand new\ladventure on [green]Sandbox Mode[black]!

While there will be no post-game
content, you’ll have the freedom to\lcapture and train any Pokémon you\lwish, in addition to being able to\lmodify all of their stats with ease!

Pokémon are nothing more than
numbers, after all!

\.

This tip is sponsored by Cube Corp."
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! Thanks to the advancements of modern science, you can start a brand new adventure on [color-green-1]Sandbox Mode[color-black-2]! While there will be no post-game content, you’ll have the freedom to capture and train any Pokémon you wish, in addition to being able to modify all of their stats with ease! Pokémon are nothing more than numbers, after all! [game-token-3] This tip is sponsored by Cube Corp.
entries.translated:
Consigli per Allenatori! Grazie ai
progressi della scienza moderna,\lpuoi iniziare una nuovissima

avventura in [green]Modalità Sandbox[black]!
Anche se non ci saranno contenuti\ldel dopogioco, avrai la libertà di

catturare e allenare tutti i
Pokémon che vuoi, oltre a poter\lmodificare facilmente tutte le loro

statistiche! I Pokémon non sono
altro che numeri, dopotutto! \.\lQuesto consiglio è sponsorizzato da

Cube Corp.

entries.original:
"Trainer Tips!

You can customize the music tracks
that play when exploring and\lwhile in battle from the [green]Audio\lOptions[black] page in the [green]Options Menu[black]!

You can even press \btn04 to quickly
reset the music to the default track!"
entries.translation_source: Trainer Tips! You can customize the music tracks that play when exploring and while in battle from the [color-green-1]Audio Options[color-black-2] page in the [color-green-3]Options Menu[color-black-4]! You can even press [button-icon-5] to quickly reset the music to the default track!
entries.translated:
Consigli Allenatore! Puoi
personalizzare le tracce musicali\lche vengono riprodotte durante

l{B4}esplorazione e in battaglia dalla
pagina [green]Opzioni audio[black] nel [green]Menu\lOpzioni[black]! Puoi perfino premere \btn04 per

ripristinare rapidamente la musica
alla traccia predefinita!

entries.original: "Continue"
entries.translation_source: Continue
entries.translated: Continua

entries.original: "Quit"
entries.translation_source: Quit
entries.translated: Esci

entries.original:
"The timer has stopped working!

This is likely a bug caused by
your emulator.

If you are using mGBA, ensure you
are using version [green]0.9.0[black] or higher.[pause]"
entries.translation_source: The timer has stopped working! This is likely a bug caused by your emulator. If you are using mGBA, ensure you are using version [color-green-1]0.9.0[color-black-2] or higher.[text-token-pause-3]
entries.translated:
Il timer ha smesso di funzionare!
Probabilmente è un bug causato dal\ltuo emulatore. Se usi mGBA,

assicurati di usare la versione
[green]0.9.0[black] o successiva.[pause]

entries.original: "SS Marine"
entries.translation_source: SS Marine
entries.translated: SS Marine

entries.original:
"Welcome aboard the S.S. Marine.

The number of Trainers aboard the
S.S. Marine today is [green][buffer1][blue].

Would you like to turn over your
Cube while you’re aboard in order\lto win five times the prizes?"
entries.translation_source: Welcome aboard the S.S. Marine. The number of Trainers aboard the S.S. Marine today is [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]. Would you like to turn over your Cube while you’re aboard in order to win five times the prizes?
entries.translated:
Benvenuto a bordo della S.S.
Marine. Il numero di Allenatori a\lbordo della S.S. Marine oggi è

[green][buffer1][blue]. Ti piacerebbe girare il
tuo Cube mentre sei a bordo per\lvincere premi cinque volte più

grandi?

entries.original:
"Got it, we’ll hold onto your Cube
then while you’re aboard."
entries.translation_source: Got it, we’ll hold onto your Cube then while you’re aboard.
entries.translated:
Capito, terremo la tua Cube mentre
sei a bordo.

entries.original: "Please enjoy yourself."
entries.translation_source: Please enjoy yourself.
entries.translated: Prego, divertiti.

entries.original:
"[blue]Thanks for sailing with us.

The ship’s about to arrive in
Polder Town."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Thanks for sailing with us. The ship’s about to arrive in Polder Town.
entries.translated:
[blue]Grazie per aver navigato con noi.
La nave sta per arrivare a Polder\lTown.

entries.original:
"[blue]Thanks for sailing with us.

The ship’s about to arrive in
Seaport City."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Thanks for sailing with us. The ship’s about to arrive in Seaport City.
entries.translated:
[blue]Grazie per aver navigato con noi.
La nave sta per arrivare a Seaport\lCity.

entries.original:
"The number of Trainers on the
S.S. Marine today is [green][buffer1][blue].

The ship is nearing the port.
Do you want to get off the ship?"
entries.translation_source: The number of Trainers on the S.S. Marine today is [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]. The ship is nearing the port. Do you want to get off the ship?
entries.translated:
Il numero di Allenatori sulla S.S.
Marine oggi è [green][buffer1][blue]. La nave sta\lper arrivare al porto. Vuoi

scendere dalla nave?

entries.original:
"The number of Trainers on the
S.S. Marine today is [green][buffer1][blue].\lAnd you’ve won against [green][buffer2][blue].

The ship is nearing the port.
Do you want to get off the ship?"
entries.translation_source: The number of Trainers on the S.S. Marine today is [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]. And you’ve won against [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]. The ship is nearing the port. Do you want to get off the ship?
entries.translated:
Il numero di Allenatori sulla S.S.
Marine oggi è [green][buffer1][blue]. E hai vinto\lcontro [green][buffer2][blue]. La nave si sta

avvicinando al porto. Vuoi scendere
dalla nave?

entries.original:
"The number of Trainers on the
S.S. Marine today is [green][buffer1][blue].\lYou\. Congratulations!

You’ve won against every Trainer
on the ship!

The ship is nearing the port.
Do you want to get off the ship?"
entries.translation_source: The number of Trainers on the S.S. Marine today is [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]. You[game-token-4] Congratulations! You’ve won against every Trainer on the ship! The ship is nearing the port. Do you want to get off the ship?
entries.translated:
Il numero di Allenatori sulla S.S.
Marine oggi è [green][buffer1][blue]. Tu\.\lCongratulazioni! Hai battuto ogni

Allenatore sulla nave! La nave si
sta avvicinando al porto. Vuoi\lscendere dalla nave?

entries.original: "Sure. Just wait a sec, please."
entries.translation_source: Sure. Just wait a sec, please.
entries.translated:
Certo. Aspetta un secondo, per
favore.

entries.original:
"Sure.
Please continue to enjoy the trip!"
entries.translation_source: Sure. Please continue to enjoy the trip!
entries.translated:
Certo. Continua pure a goderti il
viaggio!

entries.original:
"Whaddya think of the S.S. Marine?
Big old thing, ain’t she?

She’s so huge, you might be having a
spot of trouble finding other\lTrainers to battle!

If you want, fancy a hint as to
where you can find ’em?"
entries.translation_source: Whaddya think of the S.S. Marine? Big old thing, ain’t she? She’s so huge, you might be having a spot of trouble finding other Trainers to battle! If you want, fancy a hint as to where you can find ’em?
entries.translated:
Che ne pensi della S.S. Marine? È
un vecchio bestione, eh? È così\lgrande che potresti avere qualche

difficoltà a trovare altri
Allenatori con cui combattere! Se\lvuoi, ti va un indizio su dove puoi

trovarli?

entries.original:
"You want a tip about the Trainers
still on board the S.S. Marine?"
entries.translation_source: You want a tip about the Trainers still on board the S.S. Marine?
entries.translated:
Vuoi un consiglio sugli Allenatori
ancora a bordo della S.S. Marine?

entries.original:
"Today\.

Uh, in terms of people, we have
[green][buffer1][blue] on the port side, and\l[green][buffer2][blue] on the starboard side."
entries.translation_source: Today[game-token-1] Uh, in terms of people, we have [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] on the port side, and [color-green-5][buffer2-6][color-blue-7] on the starboard side.
entries.translated:
Oggi\. Eh, quanto alle persone,
abbiamo [green][buffer1][blue] sul lato di\lbabordo e [green][buffer2][blue] sul lato di

tribordo.

entries.original:
"Oh, well - I’ll be right here, if
ya change your mind.

Have fun exploring the S.S. Marine!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, well - I’ll be right here, if ya change your mind. Have fun exploring the S.S. Marine!
entries.translated:
Oh, beh - sarò qui, se cambi idea.
Divertiti a esplorare la S.S.\lMarine!

entries.original:
"So, I reckon the number of Trainers
in the cabins with [green][buffer2][blue] doors\ltoday is [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: So, I reckon the number of Trainers in the cabins with [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] doors today is [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6].
entries.translated:
Quindi, calcolo che il numero di
Allenatori nelle cabine con\l[green][buffer2][blue] porte oggi sia [green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Some of the guests joined the
cruise looking for company\.

But you’re in it for the battles,
aren’t ya?

Careful - they’ll talk your ear off
given half a chance, and they’ll\lonly stop when a whistle blows!"
entries.translation_source: Some of the guests joined the cruise looking for company[game-token-1] But you’re in it for the battles, aren’t ya? Careful - they’ll talk your ear off given half a chance, and they’ll only stop when a whistle blows!
entries.translated:
Alcuni ospiti si sono imbarcati
sulla crociera in cerca di\lcompagnia\. Ma tu sei qui per le

lotte, no? Attento - ti riempiranno
di chiacchiere se ne avranno mezza\loccasione, e smetteranno solo

quando suonerà un fischietto!

entries.original: "red"
entries.translation_source: red
entries.translated: rosso

entries.original: "blue"
entries.translation_source: blue
entries.translated: blu

entries.original:
"[black]All Trainers on board have been
defeated!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]All Trainers on board have been defeated!
entries.translated:
[black]Tutti gli Allenatori a bordo sono
stati sconfitti!

entries.original:
"I’m the captain of the S.S. Marine.
Captain Oppenheimer’s me name.

I moved from Alola, where I hoped
me ferry services could be put to\lbetter use.

An’ when I did, I took these
strange discs I got from some\lresearchers I knew with me.

They’re nothing I can use, so you
can have one, if ye want."
entries.translation_source: I’m the captain of the S.S. Marine. Captain Oppenheimer’s me name. I moved from Alola, where I hoped me ferry services could be put to better use. An’ when I did, I took these strange discs I got from some researchers I knew with me. They’re nothing I can use, so you can have one, if ye want.
entries.translated:
Sono il capitano della S.S. Marine.
Mi chiamo capitano Oppenheimer. Mi\lsono trasferito da Alola, dove

speravo che i miei servizi di
traghetto potessero essere messi a\lmiglior frutto. E quando l{B4}ho

fatto, ho portato con me questi
strani dischi che ho ricevuto da\lalcuni ricercatori che conoscevo.

Non me ne faccio nulla, quindi puoi
prenderne uno, se vuoi.

entries.original:
"I have to tell ye, the S.S. Marine’s
a lot smoother than the one I\lsailed with in Alola!

And I know that’s not just because
of the calmer water, either!"
entries.translation_source: I have to tell ye, the S.S. Marine’s a lot smoother than the one I sailed with in Alola! And I know that’s not just because of the calmer water, either!
entries.translated:
Devo dirti che la S.S. Marine è
molto più scorrevole di quella su\lcui ho navigato ad Alola! E so che

non è solo per via dell{B4}acqua più
calma, eh!

entries.original:
"AAAAAAAH! I’m terrified of ships!
Lemme off! Lemme off!"
entries.translation_source: AAAAAAAH! I’m terrified of ships! Lemme off! Lemme off!
entries.translated:
AAAAAAAH! Ho terrore delle navi!
Fatemi scendere! Fatemi scendere!

entries.original:
"I wanna nap in my room, but if I do,
I might miss my chance to battle\lall the other Trainers\."
entries.translation_source: I wanna nap in my room, but if I do, I might miss my chance to battle all the other Trainers[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Vorrei fare un pisolino nella mia
stanza, ma se lo faccio potrei\lperdermi l{B4}occasione di sfidare

tutti gli altri Allenatori\.

entries.original:
"What should I do - nap, or breach
yet another person’s privacy?"
entries.translation_source: What should I do - nap, or breach yet another person’s privacy?
entries.translated:
Cosa dovrei fare - fare un
sonnellino, o violare ancora la\lprivacy di qualcun altro?

entries.original:
"Well, battling or taking a nap are
both pretty nice\.

But where can I get a bite to eat?"
entries.translation_source: Well, battling or taking a nap are both pretty nice[game-token-1] But where can I get a bite to eat?
entries.translated:
Beh, combattere o fare un pisolino
sono entrambe cose piacevoli\. Ma\ldove posso mettere qualcosa sotto i

denti?

entries.original:
"I’m trying to see how many laps I
can manage before we arrive!"
entries.translation_source: I’m trying to see how many laps I can manage before we arrive!
entries.translated:
Sto cercando di vedere quanti giri
riesco a fare prima di arrivare!

entries.original:
"Pro tip - always go to the
bathroom before you board.

I didn’t, and the next thing I
knew, I really needed to go\.

I tried asking someone if I could
borrow their bathroom, but they\ljust wouldn’t stop talking\.

And then\. I’d, uh, rather not talk
about the rest."
entries.translation_source: Pro tip - always go to the bathroom before you board. I didn’t, and the next thing I knew, I really needed to go[game-token-1] I tried asking someone if I could borrow their bathroom, but they just wouldn’t stop talking[game-token-2] And then[game-token-3] I’d, uh, rather not talk about the rest.
entries.translated:
Consiglio da pro - vai sempre in
bagno prima di salire a bordo. Io\lnon l{B4}ho fatto, e la prima cosa che

seppi è che dovevo davvero andare\.
Ho provato a chiedere a qualcuno se\lpotevo usare il loro bagno, ma non

la smetteva proprio di parlare\. E
poi\. preferirei non parlare del\lresto.

entries.original:
"Almost every voyage, I see some
desperately lonely idiot looking\lfor someone to talk to.

We just call him the Shellder guy,
’cos like the Pokémon, he never\lwants to let anyone go."
entries.translation_source: Almost every voyage, I see some desperately lonely idiot looking for someone to talk to. We just call him the Shellder guy, ’cos like the Pokémon, he never wants to let anyone go.
entries.translated:
Quasi a ogni viaggio, vedo qualche
disgraziato disperatamente solo in\lcerca di qualcuno con cui parlare.

Noi lo chiamiamo il tizio di
Shellder, perché, come il Pokémon,\lnon vuole mai lasciar andare

nessuno.

entries.original:
"Sometimes, there’s a legendary
Trainer from the Kanto region who\lsails with this ship.

I wonder why - surely he’s got
better opponents to battle than us."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes, there’s a legendary Trainer from the Kanto region who sails with this ship. I wonder why - surely he’s got better opponents to battle than us.
entries.translated:
A volte, c{B4}è un Allenatore
leggendario della regione di Kanto\lche viaggia su questa nave. Chissà

perché - sicuramente ha avversari
migliori da affrontare di noi.

entries.original:
"As comfortable as the sailing is, I
take issue with its policy regarding\lprivacy, I must say.

I can only lock my door if I wish to
go to sleep?

I just wanted to journey to the
other destination in peace, not be\lchallenged by these oafs!"
entries.translation_source: As comfortable as the sailing is, I take issue with its policy regarding privacy, I must say. I can only lock my door if I wish to go to sleep? I just wanted to journey to the other destination in peace, not be challenged by these oafs!
entries.translated:
Per quanto il viaggio in nave sia
comodo, devo dire che ho qualche\lriserva sulla sua politica riguardo

alla privacy. Posso chiudere a
chiave la mia porta solo se voglio\ldormire? Io volevo solo andare

serenamente verso un{B4}altra
destinazione, non essere sfidato da\lquesti zoticoni!

entries.original:
"The first whistle means
\qoHello, nice to meet you!\qc

The second whistle means
\qoThe ocean’s lovely today!\qc

The third and fourth whistles mean
\qoAre you enjoying your sea\lvoyage?\qc

The fifth whistle means
\qoThanks, and see you again!\qc

Isn’t it a nice feeling to think
the ship talks like this?"
entries.translation_source: The first whistle means [quote-open-1]Hello, nice to meet you![quote-close-2] The second whistle means [quote-open-3]The ocean’s lovely today![quote-close-4] The third and fourth whistles mean [quote-open-5]Are you enjoying your sea voyage?[quote-close-6] The fifth whistle means [quote-open-7]Thanks, and see you again![quote-close-8] Isn’t it a nice feeling to think the ship talks like this?
entries.translated:
Il primo fischio significa \qoCiao,
piacere di conoscerti!\qc Il secondo\lfischio significa \qoOggi il mare è

splendido!\qc Il terzo e il quarto
fischio significano \qoTi sta\lpiacendo la traversata?\qc Il quinto

fischio significa \qoGrazie, e ci
vediamo ancora!\qc Non è una bella\lsensazione pensare che la nave

parli così?

entries.original:
"I’m gonna start my own gang one day,
once I think of a good name!

I was thinkin’ somethin’ like, \qoThe
Black Honchkrow!\qc

Huh? Honchkrows are already black?"
entries.translation_source: I’m gonna start my own gang one day, once I think of a good name! I was thinkin’ somethin’ like, [quote-open-1]The Black Honchkrow![quote-close-2] Huh? Honchkrows are already black?
entries.translated:
Un giorno inizierò la mia gang
personale, quando mi verrà in mente\lun bel nome! Pensavo a qualcosa

tipo, \qoIl Black Honchkrow!\qc Eh? Gli
Honchkrow sono già neri?

entries.original:
"Oh my gosh, it’s so BORING here!
I mean, seriously boring!

There’s nothing to do on this ship
except nap and battle Trainers!

Well, I’ll show them!
I’ll show all of them!

Let’s see how they like it when I’M
the one boring their pants off!

Like you - you came looking for
Trainers\. just like everyone else.

So, how about it?
Are ya sick of me already?

\.
\.

Gosh, I don’t think you’re listening
to me\. mission accomplished!"
entries.translation_source: Oh my gosh, it’s so BORING here! I mean, seriously boring! There’s nothing to do on this ship except nap and battle Trainers! Well, I’ll show them! I’ll show all of them! Let’s see how they like it when I’M the one boring their pants off! Like you - you came looking for Trainers[game-token-1] just like everyone else. So, how about it? Are ya sick of me already? [game-token-2] [game-token-3] Gosh, I don’t think you’re listening to me[game-token-4] mission accomplished!
entries.translated:
Oddio, è così NOIOSO qui! Voglio
dire, davvero noioso! Su questa\lnave non c{B4}è niente da fare, tranne

fare un pisolino e lottare con gli
Allenatori! Ebbene, gliela farò\lvedere! La farò vedere a tutti!

Vediamo se gli piace quando sono IO
quello che gli annoia a morte! Come\lte - sei venuto a cercare

Allenatori\. proprio come tutti gli
altri. Allora, che ne dici? Sei già\lstufo di me? \. \. Oddio, credo che tu

non mi stia ascoltando\. missione
compiuta!

entries.original:
"Yeah, I’m spiteful enough to waste a
Trainer’s time - but at least I\ladmit it."
entries.translation_source: Yeah, I’m spiteful enough to waste a Trainer’s time - but at least I admit it.
entries.translated:
Sì, sono abbastanza rancoroso da
far perdere tempo a un Allenatore,\lma almeno lo ammetto.

entries.original:
"Clamp attack!
Straight to the leg!

Ha ha ha ha!
You can’t shake me off that easily!

Everyone on this cruise ship quakes
in fear at the mention of my name-\lI’m the Shellder guy!

No matter if it’s your arm, leg, or
face, I’ll stay firmly glued to ya!

So while I’m clinging to your limb,
lemme tell ya about myself\.

\.

\.Ow!

Ow! Ow! Stop kicking my face - my
poor, personal space invading face!"
entries.translation_source: Clamp attack! Straight to the leg! Ha ha ha ha! You can’t shake me off that easily! Everyone on this cruise ship quakes in fear at the mention of my name- I’m the Shellder guy! No matter if it’s your arm, leg, or face, I’ll stay firmly glued to ya! So while I’m clinging to your limb, lemme tell ya about myself[game-token-1] [game-token-2] [game-token-3]Ow! Ow! Ow! Stop kicking my face - my poor, personal space invading face!
entries.translated:
Attacco a pinza! Dritto alla gamba!
Ah ah ah ah! Non riuscirai a\lscrollarmi di dosso così

facilmente! Tutti su questa nave da
crociera tremano al solo sentire il\lmio nome: sono il tipo del

Shellder! Che sia il tuo braccio,
la tua gamba o la tua faccia,\lresterò ben incollato a te! Quindi,

mentre mi aggrappo al tuo arto,
lasciami parlare di me\. \. \.Ahi! Ahi!\lAhi! Smettila di prendermi a calci

in faccia - la mia povera, faccia
invadente dello spazio personale!

entries.original:
"Oh\. that whistle was as sharp as the
spiked heel of your boot\.!"
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] that whistle was as sharp as the spiked heel of your boot[game-token-2]!
entries.translated:
Oh\. quel fischio era acuto come il
tacco borchiato del tuo stivale\.!

entries.original:
"Hello there. Look at your Pokémon.
Now look at me.

Now back to your Pokémon.
Now back to me.

Fortunately, your Pokémon isn’t me,
an old fart who likes wasting time.

Look down. Where are you?
Nope, you’re still here - psyche!

\.

Anything’s possible as an Expert!
I’m on a boat."
entries.translation_source: Hello there. Look at your Pokémon. Now look at me. Now back to your Pokémon. Now back to me. Fortunately, your Pokémon isn’t me, an old fart who likes wasting time. Look down. Where are you? Nope, you’re still here - psyche! [game-token-1] Anything’s possible as an Expert! I’m on a boat.
entries.translated:
Ciao. Guarda i tuoi Pokémon. Ora
guarda me. Ora torna ai tuoi\lPokémon. Ora torna a me. Per

fortuna, i tuoi Pokémon non sono
me, un vecchio rimbambito che ama\lperdere tempo. Guarda in basso.

Dove sei? Niente, sei ancora qui -
colpo di scena! \. Tutto è possibile\lda Esperto! Sono su una barca.

entries.original:
"My Expert speaking skills were too
POWERFUL to let that talk end!"
entries.translation_source: My Expert speaking skills were too POWERFUL to let that talk end!
entries.translated:
Le mie capacità oratorie da Esperto
erano troppo POTENTI per lasciar\lfinire quel discorso!

entries.original:
"Oof\. I think my hemorrhoids are
acting up again\.

Ah, yes, you there - would you be a
dear and listen to this old woman\lrant for just a little bit?

It’s my hemorrhoids, you see\.

Oh, they’re simply dreadful!
I feel like a pack of Voltorb just\ltook up residence in there\.

They just make sitting such a pain,
and the way they leave such awful\lstains in my clothes\.

Here, I’ve got photos!

Now, where did I put my doctor’s
latest shot of them\.

Yes, the one right up my -

\.

Oh dear\. you look a bit green.
Maybe that wasn’t a good idea\."
entries.translation_source: Oof[game-token-1] I think my hemorrhoids are acting up again[game-token-2] Ah, yes, you there - would you be a dear and listen to this old woman rant for just a little bit? It’s my hemorrhoids, you see[game-token-3] Oh, they’re simply dreadful! I feel like a pack of Voltorb just took up residence in there[game-token-4] They just make sitting such a pain, and the way they leave such awful stains in my clothes[game-token-5] Here, I’ve got photos! Now, where did I put my doctor’s latest shot of them[game-token-6] Yes, the one right up my - [game-token-7] Oh dear[game-token-8] you look a bit green. Maybe that wasn’t a good idea[game-token-9]
entries.translated:
Ahi\. credo che le mie emorroidi si
stiano facendo sentire di nuovo\. Ah,\lsì, tu lì: saresti così gentile da

ascoltare per un momento i lamenti
di questa vecchia signora? Sono le\lmie emorroidi, vedi\. Oh, sono

semplicemente terribili! Mi sembra
che un branco di Voltorb si sia\lpiazzato lì dentro\. Mi rendono stare

seduta un vero tormento, e poi
lasciano quelle orribili macchie\lsui miei vestiti\. Ecco, ho delle

foto! Ora, dove ho messo l{B4}ultimo
scatto del dottore\. Sì, quello\lproprio su per il mio - \. Oh cielo\.

hai un po{B4} l{B4}aria verdognola. Forse
non è stata una buona idea\.

entries.original:
"Oh, you were looking to battle?
For me, every day’s a battle!

A battle with my accursed
hemorrhoids, that is!\lOh, the humanity\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you were looking to battle? For me, every day’s a battle! A battle with my accursed hemorrhoids, that is! Oh, the humanity[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Oh, volevi lottare? Per me, ogni
giorno è una battaglia! Una\lbattaglia con le mie maledette

emorroidi, intendo! Oh, che umanità\.

entries.original:
"Ah! Hold up!
I think I know who you are!

Huh? You don’t know who I am?
Well, that’s no surprise!

I’m an ex-member of the Shadows,
so you probably never saw my face.

How are those guys doing, anyway?

Did Zeph get any close to building
the perfect living weapon?

Huh? He wasn’t trying to do that -
he was trying to revive his dead\lson all along?

Well, that’s a load of crock!

What’s the point in building an
invincible monster if you won’t use\lit to crush your enemies?

That stupid thought was exactly what
led me to quit, you know!

Oh well\. I wonder if the Science
Society is still hiring\.

\.

Ah, but I’m rambling!
Don’t worry, I’ll finish what Zeph\lstarted someday!"
entries.translation_source: Ah! Hold up! I think I know who you are! Huh? You don’t know who I am? Well, that’s no surprise! I’m an ex-member of the Shadows, so you probably never saw my face. How are those guys doing, anyway? Did Zeph get any close to building the perfect living weapon? Huh? He wasn’t trying to do that - he was trying to revive his dead son all along? Well, that’s a load of crock! What’s the point in building an invincible monster if you won’t use it to crush your enemies? That stupid thought was exactly what led me to quit, you know! Oh well[game-token-1] I wonder if the Science Society is still hiring[game-token-2] [game-token-3] Ah, but I’m rambling! Don’t worry, I’ll finish what Zeph started someday!
entries.translated:
Ah! Aspetta un attimo! Credo di
sapere chi sei! Eh? Tu non sai chi\lsono io? Beh, non c{B4}è da stupirsi!

Sono un ex membro degli Shadows,
quindi probabilmente non hai mai\lvisto la mia faccia. E quei tipi

come se la cavano, comunque? Zeph
si è avvicinato molto a costruire\ll{B4}arma vivente perfetta? Eh? Non

stava cercando di fare quello -
voleva fin dall{B4}inizio resuscitare\lsuo figlio morto? Ma questa è una

gran sciocchezza! A che serve
costruire un mostro invincibile se\lpoi non lo usi per schiacciare i

tuoi nemici? Quell{B4}idea idiota è
proprio ciò che mi ha spinto a\lmollare, sai! Vabbè\. chissà se la

Società Scientifica assume ancora\. \.
Ah, ma sto divagando! Non\lpreoccuparti, un giorno finirò ciò

che Zeph ha iniziato!

entries.original:
"The ship’s whistled already?
Man, I really ran my mouth there\.

Well, I’m pretty sure not even the
best Shadow Warrior could beat\lyou, anyway.

Sorry to bother you - have fun with
the other passengers."
entries.translation_source: The ship’s whistled already? Man, I really ran my mouth there[game-token-1] Well, I’m pretty sure not even the best Shadow Warrior could beat you, anyway. Sorry to bother you - have fun with the other passengers.
entries.translated:
Il piroscafo ha già fischiato?
Accidenti, ho davvero parlato\ltroppo\. Beh, sono praticamente certo

che nemmeno il miglior Shadow
Warrior potrebbe batterti,\lcomunque. Scusa se ti disturbo,

divertiti con gli altri passeggeri.

entries.original:
"Aha! You’re not getting away that
easily, you fool!

I have all sorts of stories!

\. Nah, it’s fine!
I actually AM here to battle!"
entries.translation_source: Aha! You’re not getting away that easily, you fool! I have all sorts of stories! [game-token-1] Nah, it’s fine! I actually AM here to battle!
entries.translated:
Ahah! Non te la cavi così
facilmente, sciocco! Ho un sacco di\lstorie! \. No, va bene! In realtà

sono qui per combattere!

entries.original:
"I know that was mean of me, but
c’mon\. I just had to."
entries.translation_source: I know that was mean of me, but c’mon[game-token-1] I just had to.
entries.translated: Dai\. dovevo proprio farlo.

entries.original:
"I hoped to see some rare Pokémon
by battling the passengers here\.

But no one wants to sail when
they’ve got bikes, or have Pokémon\lthat can fly, so it’s always the\lsame people\."
entries.translation_source: I hoped to see some rare Pokémon by battling the passengers here[game-token-1] But no one wants to sail when they’ve got bikes, or have Pokémon that can fly, so it’s always the same people[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Speravo di vedere qualche Pokémon
raro combattendo con i passeggeri\lqui\. Ma nessuno vuole prendere la

nave quando ha una bici o Pokémon
che sanno volare, quindi sono\lsempre le stesse persone\.

entries.original:
"I moved to Borrius, to try and
escape the crime back home\.

But guess what - I waltz right
into somewhere MORE crime-ridden\lthan before!

So, I’m gonna take out my
frustrations on you!"
entries.translation_source: I moved to Borrius, to try and escape the crime back home[game-token-1] But guess what - I waltz right into somewhere MORE crime-ridden than before! So, I’m gonna take out my frustrations on you!
entries.translated:
Mi sono trasferito a Borrius per
cercare di scappare dalla\lcriminalità di casa mia\. Ma indovina

un po{B4} - finisco dritto in un posto
ANCORA più malfamato di prima!\lQuindi, mi sfogherò su di te!

entries.original:
"Maybe I should move somewhere
else again\.

I heard good things about a region
called \qoOrre\qc - nothing bad ever\lhappens there, right?"
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should move somewhere else again[game-token-1] I heard good things about a region called [quote-open-2]Orre[quote-close-3] - nothing bad ever happens there, right?
entries.translated:
Forse dovrei trasferirmi di nuovo
da un{B4}altra parte\. Ho sentito\lparlare bene di una regione

chiamata \qoOrre\qc - lì non succede
mai nulla di brutto, vero?

entries.original:
"I moved to Borrius, to try and
escape the crime back home\.

But guess what - I waltz right
into somewhere MORE crime-ridden\lthan before!

So, I just wanna go home,
 before  anything bad happens\."
entries.translation_source: I moved to Borrius, to try and escape the crime back home[game-token-1] But guess what - I waltz right into somewhere MORE crime-ridden than before! So, I just wanna go home, before anything bad happens[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Mi sono trasferito a Borrius per
cercare di sfuggire alla\lcriminalità di casa mia\. Ma indovina

un po{B4} - sono finito dritto in un
posto ancora PIÙ pieno di crimini\ldi prima! Quindi voglio solo

tornare a casa, prima che succeda
qualcosa di brutto\.

entries.original:
"No matter where I go, there seem
to be Trainers who’ve found an\laltogether new - and perhaps\lunfair - way to battle.

Let me take you on, fair and square!"
entries.translation_source: No matter where I go, there seem to be Trainers who’ve found an altogether new - and perhaps unfair - way to battle. Let me take you on, fair and square!
entries.translated:
Ovunque vada, sembra che ci siano
Allenatori che hanno trovato un\lmodo del tutto nuovo - e forse

sleale - di combattere. Lasciami
sfidarti lealmente!

entries.original:
"Mega Stones, Z-Crystals, Dynamax\.

Lovely - have you ever thought
about those who aren’t so lucky?

Or so filthy stinkin’ rich?"
entries.translation_source: Mega Stones, Z-Crystals, Dynamax[game-token-1] Lovely - have you ever thought about those who aren’t so lucky? Or so filthy stinkin’ rich?
entries.translated:
Megapietre, Cristalli Z, Dynamax\.
Meraviglioso - hai mai pensato a\lchi non è così fortunato? O così

dannatamente ricco?

entries.original:
"All I want is a straightforward
battle, where everyone is equal.

That’s why, strange as it sounds, I
wanna try heading to Antisis City.

I’ve heard there’s a place that’ll
let me do exactly that."
entries.translation_source: All I want is a straightforward battle, where everyone is equal. That’s why, strange as it sounds, I wanna try heading to Antisis City. I’ve heard there’s a place that’ll let me do exactly that.
entries.translated:
Voglio solo una battaglia diretta,
in cui tutti siano alla pari. Per\lquesto, per quanto possa sembrare

strano, voglio provare ad andare a
Antisis City. Ho sentito che c{B4}è un\lposto che mi permetterà di fare

proprio questo.

entries.original:
"You want a battle? Sure, why not.

I’ve beaten everyone else on the
ship, and you’re all that’s left!"
entries.translation_source: You want a battle? Sure, why not. I’ve beaten everyone else on the ship, and you’re all that’s left!
entries.translated:
Vuoi una lotta? Certo, perché no.
Ho battuto tutti gli altri sulla\lnave, e siete gli ultimi rimasti!

entries.original:
"A strong Trainer’s always in the last
place I look\. how cliché\."
entries.translation_source: A strong Trainer’s always in the last place I look[game-token-1] how cliché[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Un Allenatore forte è sempre
nell{B4}ultimo posto in cui guardo\. che\lcliché\.

entries.original:
"Don’t you dare decide to never set
foot on this ship again!

I couldn’t bear the thought of losing
now, and never getting a rematch\lwith you again!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t you dare decide to never set foot on this ship again! I couldn’t bear the thought of losing now, and never getting a rematch with you again!
entries.translated:
Non osare decidere di non mettere
mai più piede su questa nave! Non\lsopporterei l{B4}idea di perdere

adesso, e di non avere mai più una
rivincita contro di te!

entries.original:
"Do you know anyone who always
seems to come second?

Because that describes me
perfectly\. sigh\.

I always lose in the final round,
no matter which competition I\lenter.

I’m taking a break right now to
clear my head, so battle me on the\lnext cruise, okay?"
entries.translation_source: Do you know anyone who always seems to come second? Because that describes me perfectly[game-token-1] sigh[game-token-2] I always lose in the final round, no matter which competition I enter. I’m taking a break right now to clear my head, so battle me on the next cruise, okay?
entries.translated:
Conosci qualcuno che sembra
arrivare sempre secondo? Perché mi\ldescrive perfettamente\. sospira\.

Perdo sempre nel round finale,
qualunque competizione io faccia.\lOra mi sto prendendo una pausa per

schiarirmi le idee, quindi sfidami
nella prossima crociera, va bene?

entries.original:
"Alright - this is a stick-up!
Fork over all your money!"
entries.translation_source: Alright - this is a stick-up! Fork over all your money!
entries.translated:
Bene - questa è una rapina!
Consegnami tutti i tuoi soldi!

entries.original:
"Pardon? Why would I try to rob a
passenger of their valuables?

Well, there’s two kinds of people,
you see\.

Those who want money, and those who
want just a little more money\."
entries.translation_source: Pardon? Why would I try to rob a passenger of their valuables? Well, there’s two kinds of people, you see[game-token-1] Those who want money, and those who want just a little more money[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Prego? Perché dovrei cercare di
rapinare un passeggero dei suoi\loggetti di valore? Beh, ci sono due

tipi di persone, vedi\. Quelle che
vogliono soldi, e quelle che ne\lvogliono ancora un po{B4} di più\.

entries.original:
"There’s nothing I wouldn’t do to
amass even more wealth!

Well, I suppose give up cruising on
this fine ship is an exception\.!"
entries.translation_source: There’s nothing I wouldn’t do to amass even more wealth! Well, I suppose give up cruising on this fine ship is an exception[game-token-1]!
entries.translated:
Non c{B4}è nulla che non farei per
accumulare ancora più ricchezza!\lBeh, suppongo che rinunciare a

navigare su questa splendida nave
sia un{B4}eccezione\.!

entries.original:
"Ditto!

Oops\. I mean: Goodness me!
Were you looking for a battle?

In that case, I certainly won’t hold
back, Ditto!"
entries.translation_source: Ditto! Oops[game-token-1] I mean: Goodness me! Were you looking for a battle? In that case, I certainly won’t hold back, Ditto!
entries.translated:
Ditto! Oops\. Voglio dire: Santo
cielo! Stavi cercando una lotta? In\ltal caso, di certo non mi tirerò

indietro, Ditto!

entries.original:
"No, I\. I can assure you, I’m very
much a real person!

I’m certainly not on the run from the
Science Society at all, Ditto!"
entries.translation_source: No, I[game-token-1] I can assure you, I’m very much a real person! I’m certainly not on the run from the Science Society at all, Ditto!
entries.translated:
No, io\. posso assicurarti che sono
davvero una persona reale! E di\lcerto non sto affatto fuggendo

dalla Science Society, Ditto!

entries.original:
"I don’t like East Borrius all that
much - it’s too humid and damp.

But, they do have the most amazing
café in Magnolia Town, which is\lworth the trip every time."
entries.translation_source: I don’t like East Borrius all that much - it’s too humid and damp. But, they do have the most amazing café in Magnolia Town, which is worth the trip every time.
entries.translated:
Non mi piace granché l{B4}Est di
Borrius: è troppo umido e afoso.\lPerò, a Magnolia Town c{B4}è il caffè

più fantastico di tutti, e vale il
viaggio ogni volta.

entries.original:
"So, you’ve come to challenge me
too, have you?

I give you due warning - I’m still
active at my age, because I’ve got\la solid strength to prop me up!"
entries.translation_source: So, you’ve come to challenge me too, have you? I give you due warning - I’m still active at my age, because I’ve got a solid strength to prop me up!
entries.translated:
Allora, sei venuto a sfidare anche
me, eh? Ti avverto per bene: alla\lmia età sono ancora in attività,

perché ho una solida forza che mi
sorregge!

entries.original:
"That was quite enlightening\.

I do wonder just how active you’ll
remain when you reach my age\.

Why, not even Arthur, the previous
Champion, was quite so full of vim\land vigor!"
entries.translation_source: That was quite enlightening[game-token-1] I do wonder just how active you’ll remain when you reach my age[game-token-2] Why, not even Arthur, the previous Champion, was quite so full of vim and vigor!
entries.translated:
È stato davvero illuminante\. Mi
chiedo quanto resterai attivo\lquando raggiungerai la mia età\.

Perbacco, nemmeno Arthur, il
precedente Campione, era così pieno\ldi ardore ed energia!

entries.original:
"I’m not in the mood to battle, but I
never tire of listening to the\lsounds of the battles happening\lnext to my own room.

I like to amuse myself by guessing
exactly what is happening!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not in the mood to battle, but I never tire of listening to the sounds of the battles happening next to my own room. I like to amuse myself by guessing exactly what is happening!
entries.translated:
Non ho voglia di combattere, ma non
mi stanco mai di ascoltare i suoni\ldelle battaglie che avvengono

accanto alla mia stanza. Mi diverto
a immaginare esattamente cosa stia\lsuccedendo!

entries.original:
"WHAT DID YOU SAY?
BATON? BATTER?

OH, \qoBATTLE\qc!
SORRY! I’M A BIT DEAF!

OF COURSE I’LL TAKE YOU ON!"
entries.translation_source: WHAT DID YOU SAY? BATON? BATTER? OH, [quote-open-1]BATTLE[quote-close-2]! SORRY! I’M A BIT DEAF! OF COURSE I’LL TAKE YOU ON!
entries.translated:
CHE COSA HAI DETTO? BASTONE?
IMPASTO? OH, \qoLOTTA\qc! SCUSA! SONO\lUN PO{B4} SORDO! CERTO CHE TI SFIDO!

entries.original: "OH, DEAR\. THAT WAS QUITE A SHOCK!"
entries.translation_source: OH, DEAR[game-token-1] THAT WAS QUITE A SHOCK!
entries.translated:
OH, CIELO\. QUELLO È STATO DAVVERO
UNO SHOCK!

entries.original:
"TRADERS? SORRY, I CAME HERE TO
BATTLE\.

OH, YOU SAID \qoTRAINERS\qc! SORRY!

NO, I DON’T KNOW HOW MANY OF US ARE
HERE - ASK THE CREW."
entries.translation_source: TRADERS? SORRY, I CAME HERE TO BATTLE[game-token-1] OH, YOU SAID [quote-open-2]TRAINERS[quote-close-3]! SORRY! NO, I DON’T KNOW HOW MANY OF US ARE HERE - ASK THE CREW.
entries.translated:
COMMERCIANTI? SCUSA, SONO VENUTO
QUI PER BATTAGLIARE\. OH, HAI DETTO\l\qoALLENATORI\qc! SCUSA! NO, NON SO

QUANTI DI NOI CI SIANO QUI - CHIEDI
ALL{B4}EQUIPAGGIO.

entries.original:
"SORRY? WHERE ARE THE OTHER WHAT?

TRAITORS? WE HAVE TRAITORS ON
BOARD THE SHIP?

OH, TRAINERS! SORRY - BIT DEAF!

I DON’T KNOW - ASK A CREW MEMBER!"
entries.translation_source: SORRY? WHERE ARE THE OTHER WHAT? TRAITORS? WE HAVE TRAITORS ON BOARD THE SHIP? OH, TRAINERS! SORRY - BIT DEAF! I DON’T KNOW - ASK A CREW MEMBER!
entries.translated:
SCUSA? DOVE SONO GLI ALTRI COSA?
TRADITORI? ABBIAMO DEI TRADITORI A\lBORDO DELLA NAVE? OH, ALLENATORI!

SCUSA - UN PO{B4} SORDO! NON LO SO -
