entries.original: "Tarmigan Town"
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town
entries.translated: Città di Tarmigan

entries.original: "Tarmigan Town D"
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town D
entries.translated: Città di Tarmigan D

entries.original: "Tarmigan Town N"
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town N
entries.translated: Città di Tarmigan N

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Town is located on the
\qoThundercap Highland\qc.

But if you came to see the
lightning storms, you’re out\lof luck.

Those only happen to the east of
here, by Epidimy Town."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town is located on the [quote-open-1]Thundercap Highland[quote-close-2]. But if you came to see the lightning storms, you’re out of luck. Those only happen to the east of here, by Epidimy Town.
entries.translated:
Tarmigan Town si trova
sull{B4}\qoAltopiano Thundercap\qc. Ma se\lsei venuto a vedere i temporali,

sei sfortunato. Succedono solo a
est di qui, vicino a Epidimy Town.

entries.original:
"I work at the facility over here
called the Dream Research Lab.

We do exactly as it sounds, we
research dreams.

My line of work is related to
harvesting a special kind of\lmist from the Pokémon Musharna.

Unfortunately, it isn’t going
so well.

So far, I’ve only managed to get
one capsule’s worth of mist.

Since a single capsule is useless
to me, you can have it."
entries.translation_source: I work at the facility over here called the Dream Research Lab. We do exactly as it sounds, we research dreams. My line of work is related to harvesting a special kind of mist from the Pokémon Musharna. Unfortunately, it isn’t going so well. So far, I’ve only managed to get one capsule’s worth of mist. Since a single capsule is useless to me, you can have it.
entries.translated:
Lavoro nella struttura qui vicino
chiamata Dream Research Lab.\lFacciamo esattamente quello che

sembra: studiamo i sogni. Il mio
lavoro consiste nel raccogliere un\ltipo speciale di nebbia dal Pokémon

Musharna. Purtroppo non sta andando
molto bene. Finora sono riuscito a\lottenere solo abbastanza nebbia per

una capsula. Dato che una sola
capsula per me è inutile, puoi\ltenerla tu.

entries.original:
"The [green]Dream Mist[blue] can be used to give
a Pokémon its Hidden Ability.

There is no going back once this
change is made.

I’d give you more if I could, but
our Musharna doesn’t seem to be\lproducing much anymore.

If you can find your own Musharna
to fight, it may release some Dream\lMist if you can defeat it."
entries.translation_source: The [color-green-1]Dream Mist[color-blue-2] can be used to give a Pokémon its Hidden Ability. There is no going back once this change is made. I’d give you more if I could, but our Musharna doesn’t seem to be producing much anymore. If you can find your own Musharna to fight, it may release some Dream Mist if you can defeat it.
entries.translated:
[green]Dream Mist[blue] può essere usata per
dare a un Pokémon la sua Abilità\lnascosta. Non si può più tornare

indietro una volta effettuata
questa modifica. Te ne darei di più\lse potessi, ma il nostro Musharna

non sembra produrne più molto. Se
riesci a trovare un tuo Musharna da\laffrontare, potrebbe rilasciare un

po{B4} di Dream Mist se lo sconfiggi.

entries.original:
"Ever since ancient times, the
mythical Pokémon Darkrai has\lhaunted this town.

If you look hard enough, you can
even see the spirits of the poor\lsouls haunted by Darkrai.

Be wary, child!
Don’t fall into the dark void!"
entries.translation_source: Ever since ancient times, the mythical Pokémon Darkrai has haunted this town. If you look hard enough, you can even see the spirits of the poor souls haunted by Darkrai. Be wary, child! Don’t fall into the dark void!
entries.translated:
Fin dall{B4}antichità, il mitico
Pokémon Darkrai ha infestato questa\lcittà. Se guardi abbastanza

attentamente, puoi persino vedere
gli spiriti delle povere anime\ltormentate da Darkrai. Stai in

guardia, bambino! Non cadere nel
vuoto oscuro!

entries.original:
"Tarmigan Town is so secluded in
the mountains; it doesn’t have its\lown entrance to the [green]KBT Expressway[red]!

If you wanna go down the mountain,
you’ll have to walk or ask the\lteleporter to send you down."
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Town is so secluded in the mountains; it doesn’t have its own entrance to the [color-green-1]KBT Expressway[color-red-2]! If you wanna go down the mountain, you’ll have to walk or ask the teleporter to send you down.
entries.translated:
Tarmigan Town è così isolata tra le
montagne; non ha un ingresso\lproprio per la [green]KBT Expressway[red]! Se

vuoi scendere dalla montagna,
dovrai andare a piedi o chiedere al\lteletrasportatore di mandarti giù.

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, a very thorough cleaning
of the mansion is being undertaken\lat the moment.

If you wish to challenge the
Successor, please come back later."
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, a very thorough cleaning of the mansion is being undertaken at the moment. If you wish to challenge the Successor, please come back later.
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace, in questo momento è in
corso una pulizia molto\lapprofondita della villa. Se vuoi

sfidare il Successore, torna più
tardi, per favore.

entries.original:
"My family has owned Tarmigan
Mansion for generations.

In fact, my ancestors were
responsible for the formation of\lTarmigan Town itself!

As such, I like to sit out here and
watch the town every now and then.

Don’t just sit around like me,
youngster.

Carpe diem, child!
Seize the day!"
entries.translation_source: My family has owned Tarmigan Mansion for generations. In fact, my ancestors were responsible for the formation of Tarmigan Town itself! As such, I like to sit out here and watch the town every now and then. Don’t just sit around like me, youngster. Carpe diem, child! Seize the day!
entries.translated:
La mia famiglia possiede Tarmigan
Mansion da generazioni. Anzi, i\lmiei antenati furono responsabili

della nascita stessa di Tarmigan
Town! Per questo mi piace stare\lseduto qui fuori e osservare la

città ogni tanto. Non startene
semplicemente lì a poltrire come\lme, ragazzino. Carpe diem, ragazzo!

Cogli l{B4}attimo!

entries.original:
"[black]The little girl vanished.

Was she even there to begin with?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The little girl vanished. Was she even there to begin with?
entries.translated:
[black]La bambina è sparita. C{B4}era davvero
fin dall{B4}inizio?

entries.original:
"Did you come up here to obtain the
power of [green]Mega Evolution[blue] from\l[green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]?

Most people who come here are
usually after it.

This town doesn’t have much to
offer otherwise, other than the\lhorrific nightmares, of course."
entries.translation_source: Did you come up here to obtain the power of [color-green-1]Mega Evolution[color-blue-2] from [color-green-3]Tarmigan Mansion[color-blue-4]? Most people who come here are usually after it. This town doesn’t have much to offer otherwise, other than the horrific nightmares, of course.
entries.translated:
Hai fatto tutta questa strada per
ottenere il potere della\l[green]Megaevoluzione[blue] da [green]Tarmigan Mansion[blue]?

Di solito la maggior parte di chi
viene qui cerca proprio quello.\lQuesta città non ha molto altro da

offrire, a parte gli incubi
terribili, naturalmente.

entries.original:
"So you got what you came for, eh?

Now that the power of Mega
Evolution is yours, what’s next?

Z-Moves?

I hear they like to use those a
lot in East Borrius.

But why wait until you get there?

Your [buffer1] can easily
activate Z-Moves as well!

So what are you waiting for?

Start collecting Z-Crystals
already!"
entries.translation_source: So you got what you came for, eh? Now that the power of Mega Evolution is yours, what’s next? Z-Moves? I hear they like to use those a lot in East Borrius. But why wait until you get there? Your [buffer1-1] can easily activate Z-Moves as well! So what are you waiting for? Start collecting Z-Crystals already!
entries.translated:
Quindi hai ottenuto ciò per cui eri
venuto, eh? Ora che il potere della\lMegaevoluzione è tuo, qual è il

prossimo passo? Mosse Z? Ho sentito
che a Est Borrius le usano molto.\lMa perché aspettare di arrivarci?

Il tuo [buffer1] può attivare
facilmente anche le Mosse Z! Allora\lche aspetti? Inizia già a

collezionare i Cristalli Z!

entries.original:
"You’ll never be able to beat my
super, rare, awesome, Sandslash!

I got it all the way up in this
hidden section of Icicle Cave!"
entries.translation_source: You’ll never be able to beat my super, rare, awesome, Sandslash! I got it all the way up in this hidden section of Icicle Cave!
entries.translated:
Non riuscirai mai a battere il mio
Sandslash super, raro, fantastico!\lL{B4}ho preso proprio in questa

sezione nascosta di Grotto
Ghiacciata!

entries.original:
"Oh yeah?

Well, my Miltank is super powerful,
too!

I got it in the Magnolia Fields!
You’re going down!"
entries.translation_source: Oh yeah? Well, my Miltank is super powerful, too! I got it in the Magnolia Fields! You’re going down!
entries.translated:
Ah sì? Ebbene, anche la mia Miltank
è fortissima! L{B4}ho presa nei\lMagnolia Fields! Ti batterò!

entries.original:
"There’s been this locked house
near [green]Tarmigan Mansion[red] for a\lreally long time.

I think it was once a small inn
for visitors of this town.

But it closed down after the
guests started suffering from\lhorrendous nightmares."
entries.translation_source: There’s been this locked house near [color-green-1]Tarmigan Mansion[color-red-2] for a really long time. I think it was once a small inn for visitors of this town. But it closed down after the guests started suffering from horrendous nightmares.
entries.translated:
C{B4}è stata per moltissimo tempo
questa casa chiusa vicino a\l[green]Tarmigan Mansion[red]. Penso che un

tempo fosse una piccola locanda per
i visitatori di questa città. Ma ha\lchiuso dopo che gli ospiti hanno

iniziato a soffrire di orrendi
incubi.

entries.original:
"There’s been this locked house
near Tarmigan Mansion for a\lreally long time.

But for some reason it’s open now\."
entries.translation_source: There’s been this locked house near Tarmigan Mansion for a really long time. But for some reason it’s open now[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
C{B4}è stata questa casa chiusa a
chiave vicino a Tarmigan Mansion\lper moltissimo tempo. Ma per

qualche motivo ora è aperta\.

entries.original:
"Hi!
Do you have a [green][buffer1][blue]?

Want to trade it for my
[green][buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Hi! Do you have a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]? Want to trade it for my [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]?
entries.translated:
Ciao! Hai per caso un [green][buffer1][blue]?
Vuoi barattarlo con il mio\l[green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.original:
"Sister, I’ve been rejected, yet
again."
entries.translation_source: Sister, I’ve been rejected, yet again.
entries.translated:
Sorella, sono stato rifiutato
ancora una volta.

entries.original:
"You should have just said no.

That’s very much not a [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: You should have just said no. That’s very much not a [buffer1-1].
entries.translated:
Avresti dovuto semplicemente dire
di no. Quello non è proprio un\l[buffer1].

entries.original:
"Thanks! Anyone ever tell you that
you’re a real pal?"
entries.translation_source: Thanks! Anyone ever tell you that you’re a real pal?
entries.translated:
Grazie! Ti ha mai detto nessuno che
sei un vero amico?

entries.original:
"How is my old [buffer2]?
My [buffer1] is doing great!

I’ve been feeding it lots and lots
of sweet Berries."
entries.translation_source: How is my old [buffer2-1]? My [buffer1-2] is doing great! I’ve been feeding it lots and lots of sweet Berries.
entries.translated:
Come sta il mio vecchio [buffer2]?
Il mio [buffer1] sta benissimo! Gli\lho dato un sacco e un sacco di

Bacche dolci.

entries.original:
"Listen up, youngster.

That swindler over there is
constantly extorting [green]Red Shards[blue]\lfrom youngsters, like yourself.

Here, I stole a couple from his
collection for you to enjoy."
entries.translation_source: Listen up, youngster. That swindler over there is constantly extorting [color-green-1]Red Shards[color-blue-2] from youngsters, like yourself. Here, I stole a couple from his collection for you to enjoy.
entries.translated:
Ascolta, ragazzino. Quel truffatore
laggiù estorce continuamente\l[green]Schegge Rosse[blue] ai ragazzini, proprio

come te. Tieni, gliene ho rubate un
paio dalla collezione perché tu\lpossa divertirti.

entries.original:
"I hold by the principle that it is
permitted to steal from thieves."
entries.translation_source: I hold by the principle that it is permitted to steal from thieves.
entries.translated:
Sostengo il principio che sia
permesso rubare ai ladri.

entries.original:
"Those are some hot hands ya got
there, fella!

You wannem to burn up with
fiery power?

I can teach your Pokémon [green]Fire
Punch[blue] for just [green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Those are some hot hands ya got there, fella! You wannem to burn up with fiery power? I can teach your Pokémon [color-green-1]Fire Punch[color-blue-2] for just [color-green-3][buffer2-4] [buffer1-5]s[color-blue-6]!
entries.translated:
Hai delle mani davvero bollenti,
amico! Vuoi bruciare con il potere\ldel fuoco? Posso insegnare al tuo

Pokémon [green]Pugno Fuoco[blue] per soli
[green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]!

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon is raring to fire up
their hands with [green]Fire Punch[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon is raring to fire up their hands with [color-green-1]Fire Punch[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Quale Pokémon non vede l{B4}ora di
scaldarsi le mani con [green]Fuocopugno[blue]?

entries.original: "Fire power!"
entries.translation_source: Fire power!
entries.translated: Potenza di fuoco!

entries.original:
"Fizzle\.
You don’t have enough [green][buffer1]s[blue].

I can’t burn up those hands
for nothing\."
entries.translation_source: Fizzle[game-token-1] You don’t have enough [color-green-2][buffer1-3]s[color-blue-4]. I can’t burn up those hands for nothing[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Fizzle\. Non hai abbastanza
[green][buffer1]s[blue]. Non posso bruciare\lquelle mani per niente\.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over
[buffer2] [buffer1][buffer3]."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over [buffer2-3] [buffer1-4][buffer3-5].
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha consegnato [buffer2]
[buffer1][buffer3].

entries.original:
"[blue]\.Welcome\.

\.
\.Kekeke\.

We’ve had a reservation for you.
We’ve held it for a long time\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1][game-token-2]Welcome[game-token-3] [game-token-4] [game-token-5]Kekeke[game-token-6] We’ve had a reservation for you. We’ve held it for a long time[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
[blue]\.Benvenuto\. \. \.Kekeke\. Abbiamo una
prenotazione per te. L{B4}abbiamo\ltenuta per molto tempo\.

entries.original:
"[player] lay down on the bed as if
bidden there."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] lay down on the bed as if bidden there.
entries.translated:
[player] si sdraiò sul letto come
se fosse stato invitato a farlo.

entries.original: "[player] awakened!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1] awakened!
entries.translated: [player] si è risvegliato!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon walking around this
lab all assist in the research.

They’re all special Pokémon known
for their connection to dreams."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon walking around this lab all assist in the research. They’re all special Pokémon known for their connection to dreams.
entries.translated:
I Pokémon che girano per questo
laboratorio aiutano tutti nella\lricerca. Sono tutti Pokémon

speciali noti per il loro legame
con i sogni.

entries.original:
"Oh, it’s the Champion!

We’re developing a special Poké
Ball, here at the Dream Research\lLab, and we’d be honoured if you’d\ltest it out for us!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, it’s the Champion! We’re developing a special Poké Ball, here at the Dream Research Lab, and we’d be honoured if you’d test it out for us!
entries.translated:
Oh, è il Campione! Stiamo
sviluppando una Poké Ball speciale\lqui, al Laboratorio di Ricerca dei

Sogni, e saremmo onorati se volessi
provarla per noi!

entries.original:
"Those are [green]Dream Balls[blue].

They’re better for capturing
Pokémon that are [green]asleep[blue].

Any Pokémon caught with them will
also have its [green]Hidden Ability[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Those are [color-green-1]Dream Balls[color-blue-2]. They’re better for capturing Pokémon that are [color-green-3]asleep[color-blue-4]. Any Pokémon caught with them will also have its [color-green-5]Hidden Ability[color-blue-6].
entries.translated:
Quelle sono le [green]Dream Balls[blue]. Sono
migliori per catturare Pokémon che\lsono [green]addormentati[blue]. Qualsiasi

Pokémon catturato con queste avrà
anche la sua [green]Abilità Nascosta[blue].

entries.original:
"In the Unova region, a scientist
named Fennel created a device that\lallows people to enter the dreams\lof their Pokémon.

We’re working on our own version of
the device for humans.

The goal is to allow people to go
back and relive their worst\lnightmare."
entries.translation_source: In the Unova region, a scientist named Fennel created a device that allows people to enter the dreams of their Pokémon. We’re working on our own version of the device for humans. The goal is to allow people to go back and relive their worst nightmare.
entries.translated:
Nella regione di Unima, una
scienziata di nome Fennel ha creato\lun dispositivo che permette alle

persone di entrare nei sogni dei
loro Pokémon. Stiamo lavorando a\luna nostra versione del dispositivo

per esseri umani. L{B4}obiettivo è
permettere alle persone di tornare\lindietro e rivivere il loro peggior

incubo.

entries.original:
"I’ve done it!

I’ve managed to create a device
capable of sending people back\linto their worst nightmare!

And I can tell\.

You were sent to a nightmarish
world of nothingness, where you\lencountered illusions of your\lfriends and family, yes?

And then you fought a giant Pokémon
that loved plunging your Pokémon\linto a deep sleep, over and again,\lyes?

\.It’s all in your eyes.

My machine can use that trauma
to send you there again!

\.Why would you want to go
back there?

Well, they say that confronting
your worst nightmare a second\ltime can show you a path to the\lheavens itself!

However, you will needs relics
connected to the heavens for this\lto work.

I believe people can dig such
relics up with the ADM\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve done it! I’ve managed to create a device capable of sending people back into their worst nightmare! And I can tell[game-token-1] You were sent to a nightmarish world of nothingness, where you encountered illusions of your friends and family, yes? And then you fought a giant Pokémon that loved plunging your Pokémon into a deep sleep, over and again, yes? [game-token-2]It’s all in your eyes. My machine can use that trauma to send you there again! [game-token-3]Why would you want to go back there? Well, they say that confronting your worst nightmare a second time can show you a path to the heavens itself! However, you will needs relics connected to the heavens for this to work. I believe people can dig such relics up with the ADM[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Ce l{B4}ho fatta! Sono riuscito a
creare un dispositivo in grado di\lmandare le persone indietro nel

loro peggior incubo! E posso dirti\.
Sei stato mandato in un mondo da\lincubo di nulla, dove hai

incontrato illusioni dei tuoi amici
e famiglia, vero? E poi hai\lcombattuto un Pokémon gigante che

amava immergere i tuoi Pokémon in
un sonno profondo, ancora e ancora,\lvero? \.È tutto nei tuoi occhi. La

mia macchina può usare quel trauma
per mandarti di nuovo lì! \.Perché\lvorresti tornarci? Beh, si dice che

affrontare il tuo peggior incubo
una seconda volta possa mostrarti\luna via verso i cieli stessi!

Tuttavia, avrai bisogno di reliquie
connesse ai cieli perché questo\lfunzioni. Credo che le persone

possano scavare tali reliquie con
l{B4}ADM\.

entries.original:
"Huh?

It seems my machine is reacting to
those Plates in your Cube!

Would you like me to activate my
machine and send you back into\lyour worst nightmare?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? It seems my machine is reacting to those Plates in your Cube! Would you like me to activate my machine and send you back into your worst nightmare?
entries.translated:
Eh? Sembra che la mia macchina stia
reagendo a quelle Lastre nel tuo\lCubo! Vuoi che attivi la mia

macchina e ti rispedisca nel tuo
peggior incubo?

entries.original:
"It seems my machine is reacting to
those Plates in your Cube!

Would you like me to activate my
machine and send you back into\lyour worst nightmare?"
entries.translation_source: It seems my machine is reacting to those Plates in your Cube! Would you like me to activate my machine and send you back into your worst nightmare?
entries.translated:
Sembra che la mia macchina stia
reagendo a quelle Lastre nel tuo\lCubo! Vuoi che attivi la mia

macchina e ti rimandi nel tuo
peggior incubo?

entries.original:
"B-but science!

Think of all the possibilities!"
entries.translation_source: B-but science! Think of all the possibilities!
entries.translated:
M-ma la scienza! Pensa a tutte le
possibilità!

entries.original:
"Okay, let me just flip this switch,
and\."
entries.translation_source: Okay, let me just flip this switch, and[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Okay, fammi solo azionare questo
interruttore, e\.

entries.original:
"The machine has been activated!

You’ll be entering a dream-like
state, any moment now.

I’ll try to hijack someone found
in your memory so I can keep tabs\lon you while you’re under.

Just come find me whenever you’re
ready to leave."
entries.translation_source: The machine has been activated! You’ll be entering a dream-like state, any moment now. I’ll try to hijack someone found in your memory so I can keep tabs on you while you’re under. Just come find me whenever you’re ready to leave.
entries.translated:
La macchina è stata attivata!
Entrerai in uno stato simile a un\lsogno da un momento all{B4}altro.

Cercherò di dirottare qualcuno che
si trovi nei tuoi ricordi così da\lpoterti tenere d{B4}occhio mentre sei

sotto. Vieni a cercarmi quando
sarai pronto a uscire.

entries.original:
"Are you ready to wake up and return
to Tarmigan Town?"
entries.translation_source: Are you ready to wake up and return to Tarmigan Town?
entries.translated:
Sei pronto a svegliarti e tornare a
Tarmigan Town?

entries.original:
"I’ll be using this body to keep
tabs on you.

Speak to it when you’re ready
to leave."
entries.translation_source: I’ll be using this body to keep tabs on you. Speak to it when you’re ready to leave.
entries.translated:
Userò questo corpo per tenerti
d{B4}occhio. Parlaci quando sarai\lpronto ad andartene.

entries.original:
"Did you enjoy reliving your
worst nightmare?

As long as you bring those Plates,
I can send you there, again!"
entries.translation_source: Did you enjoy reliving your worst nightmare? As long as you bring those Plates, I can send you there, again!
entries.translated:
Ti è piaciuto rivivere il tuo
peggior incubo? Finché porterai\lquelle Lastre, potrò rimandarti lì,

di nuovo!

entries.original:
"Huh?

My machine isn’t reacting to your
Cube anymore.

Did you take those Plates out
of it?"
entries.translation_source: Huh? My machine isn’t reacting to your Cube anymore. Did you take those Plates out of it?
entries.translated:
Eh? La mia macchina non reagisce
più al tuo Cube. Hai tolto quelle\lLastre?

entries.original:
"All of the Pokémon found in this
laboratory eat dreams.

They do this using the unique
[green]Dream Eater[red] move.

Your Pokémon are capable of
learning it, too!"
entries.translation_source: All of the Pokémon found in this laboratory eat dreams. They do this using the unique [color-green-1]Dream Eater[color-red-2] move. Your Pokémon are capable of learning it, too!
entries.translated:
Tutti i Pokémon trovati in questo
laboratorio si nutrono di sogni. Lo\lfanno usando la mossa unica

[green]Mangiasogni[red]. Anche i tuoi Pokémon
sono in grado di impararla!

entries.original:
"[green]Dream Eater[red] allows you to do damage
and restore HP at the same time!

But it only works if the target
is sleeping\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Dream Eater[color-red-2] allows you to do damage and restore HP at the same time! But it only works if the target is sleeping[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[green]Assorbisogni[red] ti permette di
infliggere danni e recuperare PS\lallo stesso tempo! Ma funziona solo

se il bersaglio dorme\.

entries.original: "[green]Naaa!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Naaa!
entries.translated: [green]Naaa!

entries.original: "[green]Mmm\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Mmm[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Mmm\.

entries.original: "[green]Gar!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Gar!
entries.translated: [green]Gar!

entries.original: "[green]Hyyyyyyyyypno\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Hyyyyyyyyypno[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Hyyyyyyyyypno\.

entries.original: "Tarmigan Mansion"
entries.translation_source: Tarmigan Mansion
entries.translated: Magione di Tarmigan

entries.original:
"An ancient mansion present in
Tarmigan Town since its founding.
Defeat the master of the mansion to
obtain the power of Mega Evolution!"
entries.translation_source: An ancient mansion present in Tarmigan Town since its founding. Defeat the master of the mansion to obtain the power of Mega Evolution!
entries.translated:
Un{B4}antica villa presente a Tarmigan
Town sin dalla sua fondazione.\lSconfiggi il padrone della villa

per ottenere il potere della
Megaevoluzione!

entries.original:
"Somewhere in this house resides
Successor Maxima.

If you find her, she’ll give you
something special."
entries.translation_source: Somewhere in this house resides Successor Maxima. If you find her, she’ll give you something special.
entries.translated:
Da qualche parte in questa casa si
trova la Successora Maxima. Se la\ltrovi, ti darà qualcosa di

speciale.

entries.original:
"A switch is hidden in one of the
statues in the mansion.

If you manage to find it, it will
open up a new passageway."
entries.translation_source: A switch is hidden in one of the statues in the mansion. If you manage to find it, it will open up a new passageway.
entries.translated:
Un interruttore è nascosto in una
delle statue nella villa. Se riesci\la trovarlo, aprirà un nuovo

passaggio.

entries.original:
"There are plenty of different
healing methods available to you\lin the mansion.

It’s honestly a little redundant\."
entries.translation_source: There are plenty of different healing methods available to you in the mansion. It’s honestly a little redundant[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Nella villa hai a disposizione
molti metodi diversi per curarti.\lOnestamente è un po{B4} ridondante\.

entries.original:
"As chefs, it is our sworn duty to
prepare the finest quality food for\lthe master of this mansion.

That being Successor Maxima,
of course."
entries.translation_source: As chefs, it is our sworn duty to prepare the finest quality food for the master of this mansion. That being Successor Maxima, of course.
entries.translated:
Come chef, è nostro dovere solenne
preparare il cibo della migliore\lqualità per il padrone di questa

villa. Ovviamente, questo padrone è
Successore Maxima.

entries.original:
"Some Berries like the [green]Occa Berry[blue]
and [green]Passho Berry[blue] reduce the amount\lof damage Pokémon receive from\l[green]super-effective[blue] moves.

Like all Berries, they’re [green]one-time
use[blue] only in regular battles.

But I hear stronger Pokémon in
[green]Hidden Grottos[blue] tend to drop them\lfrequently after battles\."
entries.translation_source: Some Berries like the [color-green-1]Occa Berry[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Passho Berry[color-blue-4] reduce the amount of damage Pokémon receive from [color-green-5]super-effective[color-blue-6] moves. Like all Berries, they’re [color-green-7]one-time use[color-blue-8] only in regular battles. But I hear stronger Pokémon in [color-green-9]Hidden Grottos[color-blue-10] tend to drop them frequently after battles[game-token-11]
entries.translated:
Alcune Bacche come la [green]Occa Berry[blue] e
la [green]Passho Berry[blue] riducono i danni\lche i Pokémon subiscono da mosse

[green]superefficaci[blue]. Come tutte le
Bacche, sono [green]monouso[blue] solo nelle\llotte normali. Ma ho sentito che i

Pokémon più forti nelle [green]Grotte
Nascoste[blue] tendono a lasciarle cadere\lspesso dopo le lotte\.

entries.original:
"There are some Berries like the
[green]Kee Berry[blue] and [green]Maranga Berry[blue] that\lare really hard to come by.

Whenever our master ingredient
gatherer happens to come across\lone, we make sure to cook it\linto a delectable meal."
entries.translation_source: There are some Berries like the [color-green-1]Kee Berry[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Maranga Berry[color-blue-4] that are really hard to come by. Whenever our master ingredient gatherer happens to come across one, we make sure to cook it into a delectable meal.
entries.translated:
Ci sono alcune bacche come la [green]Kee
Berry[blue] e la [green]Maranga Berry[blue] davvero\ldifficili da trovare. Ogni volta

che il nostro raccoglitore capo di
ingredienti ne trova una, ci\lassicuriamo di cucinarla in un

pasto delizioso.

entries.original:
"Berries like the [green]Liechi Berry[blue] and
[green]Salac Berry[blue] are only eaten by\lPokémon in a [green]pinch[blue]!

What’s a pinch?

That’s simple!

A [green]pinch[blue] is whenever the health bar
shows [lightgreen]red[blue].

But for Pokémon with the ability
[green]Gluttony[blue], a pinch is whenever the\lhealth bar shows [orange]yellow[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Berries like the [color-green-1]Liechi Berry[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Salac Berry[color-blue-4] are only eaten by Pokémon in a [color-green-5]pinch[color-blue-6]! What’s a pinch? That’s simple! A [color-green-7]pinch[color-blue-8] is whenever the health bar shows [color-lightgreen-9]red[color-blue-10]. But for Pokémon with the ability [color-green-11]Gluttony[color-blue-12], a pinch is whenever the health bar shows [color-orange-13]yellow[color-blue-14].
entries.translated:
Bacche come la [green]Bacca Liechi[blue] e la
[green]Bacca Salac[blue] vengono mangiate dai\lPokémon solo in una [green]situazione

critica[blue]! Cos{B4}è una situazione
critica? È semplice! Una [green]situazione\lcritica[blue] è quando la barra dei PS è

[lightgreen]rossa[blue]. Ma per i Pokémon con
l{B4}abilità [green]Voracità[blue], una situazione\lcritica è quando la barra dei PS è

[orange]gialla[blue].

entries.original:
"I got stuck on dishes duty\.
What a drag\.

Everyone else gets to cook and
talk about Berries\."
entries.translation_source: I got stuck on dishes duty[game-token-1] What a drag[game-token-2] Everyone else gets to cook and talk about Berries[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Mi hanno incastrato col turno dei
piatti\. Che seccatura\. Tutti gli\laltri possono cucinare e parlare di

Bacche\.

entries.original:
"Here, enjoy these fresh handpicked
ingredients from the garden."
entries.translation_source: Here, enjoy these fresh handpicked ingredients from the garden.
entries.translated:
Ecco, goditi questi ingredienti
freschi raccolti a mano dall{B4}orto.

entries.original:
"I’m responsible for gathering the
daily ingredients."
entries.translation_source: I’m responsible for gathering the daily ingredients.
entries.translated:
Mi occupo di raccogliere gli
ingredienti quotidiani.

entries.original: "Maxima"
entries.translation_source: Maxima
entries.translated: Maxima

entries.original:
"There’s a switch somewhere that
opens up a path to Maxima."
entries.translation_source: There’s a switch somewhere that opens up a path to Maxima.
entries.translated:
C{B4}è un interruttore da qualche
parte che apre un passaggio per\lMaxima.

entries.original:
"I probably won’t get anywhere if I
keep standing here."
entries.translation_source: I probably won’t get anywhere if I keep standing here.
entries.translated:
Probabilmente non arriverò da
nessuna parte se continuo a stare\lqui.

entries.original:
"I need to grow even stronger to
surpass the others."
entries.translation_source: I need to grow even stronger to surpass the others.
entries.translated:
Devo diventare ancora più forte per
superare gli altri.

entries.original: "Welcome to the top floor, kid."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the top floor, kid.
entries.translated:
Benvenuto all{B4}ultimo piano,
ragazzo.

entries.original: "You’re not even close to the end."
entries.translation_source: You’re not even close to the end.
entries.translated: Non sei nemmeno vicino alla fine.

entries.original:
"I’d say this point in the challenge
is around the mid-point."
entries.translation_source: I’d say this point in the challenge is around the mid-point.
entries.translated:
Direi che questo punto della sfida
è circa a metà.

entries.original:
"A statue with a switch?
Never heard of it."
entries.translation_source: A statue with a switch? Never heard of it.
entries.translated:
Una statua con un interruttore? Non
ne ho mai sentito parlare.

entries.original: "Super-de-duper-de-doo!"
entries.translation_source: Super-de-duper-de-doo!
entries.translated: Super-iper-super-duper!

entries.original:
"Unlike the other experts, I’m still
young and free!"
entries.translation_source: Unlike the other experts, I’m still young and free!
entries.translated:
A differenza degli altri esperti,
sono ancora giovane e libero!

entries.original: "Dragons can Mega Evolve, too!"
entries.translation_source: Dragons can Mega Evolve, too!
entries.translated:
Anche i Draghi possono
Megaevolvere!

entries.original: "Not just yet, though!"
entries.translation_source: Not just yet, though!
entries.translated: Ma non ancora!

entries.original:
"One day, my dragons will soar high
in their Mega Evolved forms!"
entries.translation_source: One day, my dragons will soar high in their Mega Evolved forms!
entries.translated:
Un giorno, i miei draghi voleranno
in alto nelle loro forme\lMegaevolute!

entries.original:
"If you can fight your way through
this mansion, you can learn the\lsacred art of Mega Evolution."
entries.translation_source: If you can fight your way through this mansion, you can learn the sacred art of Mega Evolution.
entries.translated:
Se riesci a farti strada
combattendo attraverso questa\lvilla, potrai apprendere l{B4}arte

sacra della Megaevoluzione.

entries.original:
"You’d better hope you have enough
healing items."
entries.translation_source: You’d better hope you have enough healing items.
entries.translated:
Faresti meglio a sperare di avere
abbastanza strumenti curativi.

entries.original: "The end is nigh."
entries.translation_source: The end is nigh.
entries.translated: La fine è vicina.

entries.original:
"Child, where do you think
you’re going?"
entries.translation_source: Child, where do you think you’re going?
entries.translated: Ragazzo, dove credi di andare?

entries.original:
"To obtain the power of
Mega Evolution?"
entries.translation_source: To obtain the power of Mega Evolution?
entries.translated:
Per ottenere il potere della
Megaevoluzione?

entries.original:
"Remember this: power corrupts, and
absolute power corrupts absolutely.

The same can be said about
Mega Evolution.

Be careful."
entries.translation_source: Remember this: power corrupts, and absolute power corrupts absolutely. The same can be said about Mega Evolution. Be careful.
entries.translated:
Ricorda questo: il potere corrompe,
e il potere assoluto corrompe in\lmodo assoluto. Lo stesso si può

dire della Megaevoluzione. Fai
attenzione.

entries.original:
"Whenever you’re ready to face
Maxima, just walk off the ledge.

Don’t worry, it won’t hurt."
entries.translation_source: Whenever you’re ready to face Maxima, just walk off the ledge. Don’t worry, it won’t hurt.
entries.translated:
Quando sei pronto a sfidare Maxima,
ti basta scendere dal bordo. Non\lpreoccuparti, non ti farà male.

entries.original:
"Hello there, Trainer.

I am the Mansion’s Successor,
Maxima.

If you’re here, then I should
congratulate you for navigating\lyour way to me.

I presume, like many others, you
have come here seeking the power\lof [green]Mega Evolution[red]?

\.

As I thought.

However, it is one thing to \qowant\qc.
It is quite another to \qodeserve\qc.

You see, Mega Evolution is only
possible when both Trainer and\lPokémon share a deep bond.

Yet, there are those who visit me,
focused only on what perceived\lpower can be achieved with\lMega Evolution.

And the bonds that make Mega
Evolution possible\.\CC0818 are not always\lbonds of friendship and love.

So, if I am to pass on such a
technique to someone, it must be\lsomeone of both skill, and a\lnatural love for Pokémon.

This shall be my final test."
entries.translation_source: Hello there, Trainer. I am the Mansion’s Successor, Maxima. If you’re here, then I should congratulate you for navigating your way to me. I presume, like many others, you have come here seeking the power of [color-green-1]Mega Evolution[color-red-2]? [game-token-3] As I thought. However, it is one thing to [quote-open-4]want[quote-close-5]. It is quite another to [quote-open-6]deserve[quote-close-7]. You see, Mega Evolution is only possible when both Trainer and Pokémon share a deep bond. Yet, there are those who visit me, focused only on what perceived power can be achieved with Mega Evolution. And the bonds that make Mega Evolution possible[game-token-8][control-code-9] are not always bonds of friendship and love. So, if I am to pass on such a technique to someone, it must be someone of both skill, and a natural love for Pokémon. This shall be my final test.
entries.translated:
Salve, Allenatore. Sono la
Successore della Magione, Maxima.\lSe sei qui, allora dovrei

congratularmi con te per essere
riuscito a trovarmi. Presumo, come\lmolti altri, tu sia venuto qui

cercando il potere della
[green]Megaevoluzione[red]? \. Come pensavo.\lTuttavia, una cosa è \qovolere\qc.

Un{B4}altra cosa è \qomeritare\qc. Vedi,
la Megaevoluzione è possibile solo\lquando sia Allenatore che Pokémon

condividono un profondo legame.
Tuttavia, ci sono coloro che mi\lvisitano, concentrati solo su quale

potere percepito possa essere
ottenuto con la Megaevoluzione. E i\llegami che rendono possibile la

Megaevoluzione\.\CC0818 non sono sempre
legami di amicizia e amore. Quindi,\lse devo trasmettere una tale

tecnica a qualcuno, deve essere
qualcuno con abilità e un amore\lnaturale per i Pokémon. Questo sarà

il mio test finale.

entries.original:
"Triumph over me, and show me you are
worthy of wielding my greatest gift!"
entries.translation_source: Triumph over me, and show me you are worthy of wielding my greatest gift!
entries.translated:
Trionfa su di me e dimostrami di
essere degno di impugnare il mio\ldono più grande!

entries.original:
"How amazing\.\CC0818 truly, you have shown
that you can be trusted to use\lthis power, responsibly and without\lreckless abandon.

I bestow upon you, then, your very
own Mega Keystone.

Yet before I do\.\CC0818 I’d like you to
choose a suitable vessel for it.

Fu fu fu\.\CC0818 not to worry.
They are functionally identical.

Just\.\CC0818 choose the one that
suits you best."
entries.translation_source: How amazing[game-token-1][control-code-2] truly, you have shown that you can be trusted to use this power, responsibly and without reckless abandon. I bestow upon you, then, your very own Mega Keystone. Yet before I do[game-token-3][control-code-4] I’d like you to choose a suitable vessel for it. Fu fu fu[game-token-5][control-code-6] not to worry. They are functionally identical. Just[game-token-7][control-code-8] choose the one that suits you best.
entries.translated:
Che meraviglia\.\CC0818 davvero, hai
dimostrato di poter essere degno di\lfiducia nell{B4}usare questo potere,

con responsabilità e senza
sconsideratezza. Ti conferisco,\lallora, la tua personale

Pietrachiave. Ma prima di farlo\.\CC0818
vorrei che scegliessi un supporto\ladatto per essa. Fu fu fu\.\CC0818 non

preoccuparti. Sono funzionalmente
identiche. Semplicemente\.\CC0818 scegli\lquella che ti si addice di più.

entries.original:
"Just\.\CC0818 choose the one that
suits you best."
entries.translation_source: Just[game-token-1][control-code-2] choose the one that suits you best.
entries.translated:
Semplicemente\.\CC0818 scegli quello che fa
per te.

entries.original:
"You would like the
[green][buffer1][red]?"
entries.translation_source: You would like the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3]?
entries.translated: Vorresti [green][buffer1][red]?

entries.original:
"I see.

Yes, I think you do carry that
[buffer1] very well, myself.

Anyway, you now have the power to
[green]Mega Evolve[red] your Pokémon.

For a Pokémon to be capable of
Mega Evolving in battle, it must\lbe holding its unique [green]Mega Stone[red].

You should see if that Pokémon can
Mega Evolve by the [green]Mega Symbol[red] in\lthe battle menu.

Should it appear, press \btn04
before you select your next\lattack.

Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve
and become more powerful.

Keep in mind, however, you can
only Mega Evolve a Pokémon [green]once[red]\lper battle, and it wears off if the\lbattle ends, or the Mega Evolved\lPokémon faints.

Now, take that power\.\CC0818 and use it
for the good of humanity.

I shall be counting on you to change
the world\.\CC0818 and make a real impact\."
entries.translation_source: I see. Yes, I think you do carry that [buffer1-1] very well, myself. Anyway, you now have the power to [color-green-2]Mega Evolve[color-red-3] your Pokémon. For a Pokémon to be capable of Mega Evolving in battle, it must be holding its unique [color-green-4]Mega Stone[color-red-5]. You should see if that Pokémon can Mega Evolve by the [color-green-6]Mega Symbol[color-red-7] in the battle menu. Should it appear, press [button-icon-8] before you select your next attack. Your Pokémon will then Mega Evolve and become more powerful. Keep in mind, however, you can only Mega Evolve a Pokémon [color-green-9]once[color-red-10] per battle, and it wears off if the battle ends, or the Mega Evolved Pokémon faints. Now, take that power[game-token-11][control-code-12] and use it for the good of humanity. I shall be counting on you to change the world[game-token-13][control-code-14] and make a real impact[game-token-15]
entries.translated:
Capisco. Sì, penso che tu porti
molto bene quel [buffer1]. Ad ogni\lmodo, ora hai il potere di far

[green]Megaevolvere[red] i tuoi Pokémon.
Affinché un Pokémon sia in grado di\lmegaevolversi in lotta, deve tenere

il suo [green]Mega-cerchio[red] unico. Dovresti
vedere se quel Pokémon può\lmegaevolversi dal [green]Simbolo Mega[red] nel

menu di lotta. Se appare, premi \btn04
prima di selezionare il tuo\lprossimo attacco. Il tuo Pokémon si

megaevolverà e diventerà più
potente. Tieni a mente, tuttavia,\lche puoi megaevolvere un Pokémon

solo [green]una volta[red] per lotta, e
l{B4}effetto svanisce se la lotta\lfinisce o se il Pokémon megaevoluto

va KO. Ora, prendi quel potere\.\CC0818 e
usalo per il bene dell{B4}umanità.\lConto su di te per cambiare il

mondo\.\CC0818 e avere un vero impatto\.

Affinché un Pokémon sia in grado di
megaevolversi in lotta, deve tenere\lil suo [green]Mega-cerchio[red] unico. Dovresti

vedere se quel Pokémon può
megaevolversi dal [green]Simbolo Mega[red] nel\lmenu di lotta. Se appare, premi \btn04

prima di selezionare il tuo
prossimo attacco. Il tuo Pokémon si\lmegaevolverà e diventerà più

potente. Tieni a mente, tuttavia,
che puoi megaevolvere un Pokémon\lsolo [green]una volta[red] per lotta, e

finisce o se il Pokémon megaevoluto\lva KO. Ora, prendi quel potere\.\CC0818 e

entries.original:
"Ah, yes. Of course.
It almost slipped my mind.

Take this Mega Stone, the same one
I use - for the Pokémon Altaria."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes. Of course. It almost slipped my mind. Take this Mega Stone, the same one I use - for the Pokémon Altaria.
entries.translated:
Ah, sì. Certo. Stava quasi per
sfuggirmi di mente. Prendi questa\lMegapietra, la stessa che uso io -

per il Pokémon Altaria.

entries.original: "Mega Ring"
entries.translation_source: Mega Ring
entries.translated: Megacerchio

entries.original: "Mega Bracelet"
entries.translation_source: Mega Bracelet
entries.translated: Megabracciale

entries.translation_source: Mega Cuff
entries.translated: Mega Cuff

entries.original: "Mega Charm"
entries.translation_source: Mega Charm
entries.translated: Mega Amuleto

entries.original: "It’s an ordinary statue."
entries.translation_source: It’s an ordinary statue.
entries.translated: È una statua normale.

entries.original:
"A secret switch!

Press it?"
entries.translation_source: A secret switch! Press it?
entries.translated: Un interruttore segreto! Premilo?

entries.original: "Who wouldn’t?"
entries.translation_source: Who wouldn’t?
entries.translated: Chi no?

entries.original: "Not quite yet!"
entries.translation_source: Not quite yet!
entries.translated: Non ancora!

entries.original:
"Mega Evolution was first discovered
in the Kalos Region by the renowned\lProfessor Sycamore.

Thanks to his research, Pokémon
are now able to Mega Evolve\lduring battle.

However, a large part of Mega
Evolution still remains a mystery."
entries.translation_source: Mega Evolution was first discovered in the Kalos Region by the renowned Professor Sycamore. Thanks to his research, Pokémon are now able to Mega Evolve during battle. However, a large part of Mega Evolution still remains a mystery.
entries.translated:
La Megaevoluzione fu scoperta per
la prima volta nella regione di\lKalos dal rinomato Professor

Platan. Grazie alle sue ricerche,
ora i Pokémon possono Megaevolversi\ldurante la lotta. Tuttavia, gran

parte della Megaevoluzione rimane
ancora un mistero.

entries.original:
"It’s a book on Mega Evolution
by Prof. Log!

It says Pokémon that Mega Evolve
during battle are granted higher\lstats for the rest of the battle.

The remainder of the book is empty.
Prof. Log only researches stats."
entries.translation_source: It’s a book on Mega Evolution by Prof. Log! It says Pokémon that Mega Evolve during battle are granted higher stats for the rest of the battle. The remainder of the book is empty. Prof. Log only researches stats.
entries.translated:
È un libro sulla Mega Evoluzione
del Prof. Log! Dice che i Pokémon\lche si MegaEvolvono durante la

lotta ottengono statistiche più
alte per il resto della lotta. Il\lresto del libro è vuoto. Il Prof.

Log studia solo le statistiche.

entries.original:
"The town has had a problem with
nightmares for the longest time.

I wish somebody would do something
about it already\."
entries.translation_source: The town has had a problem with nightmares for the longest time. I wish somebody would do something about it already[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
La città ha avuto un problema con
gli incubi da moltissimo tempo.\lVorrei che qualcuno facesse già

qualcosa al riguardo\.

entries.original:
"Is it true?

Has Tarmigan’s nightmare
really ended?

I’m ecstatic!
This is amazing!

I can finally sleep well again
at night!"
entries.translation_source: Is it true? Has Tarmigan’s nightmare really ended? I’m ecstatic! This is amazing! I can finally sleep well again at night!
entries.translated:
È vero? L{B4}incubo di Tarmigan è
davvero finito? Sono al settimo\lcielo! È incredibile! Finalmente

posso dormire bene la notte di
nuovo!

entries.original:
"Do you need a way back down
the mountain?

My Abra and I will be more than
happy to teleport you down.

What do you say?
Do you want to be teleported?"
entries.translation_source: Do you need a way back down the mountain? My Abra and I will be more than happy to teleport you down. What do you say? Do you want to be teleported?
entries.translated:
Ti serve un modo per tornare giù
dalla montagna? Io e il mio Abra\lsaremo più che felici di

teletrasportarti giù. Che ne dici?
Vuoi essere teletrasportato?

entries.original:
"Okay, then!

Abra, use Teleport!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, then! Abra, use Teleport!
entries.translated:
Va bene, allora! Abra, usa
Teletrasporto!

entries.original:
"If you change your mind,
come back.

We’ll be sitting here."
entries.translation_source: If you change your mind, come back. We’ll be sitting here.
entries.translated:
Se cambi idea, torna pure. Saremo
qui seduti.

entries.original: "[green]Braaaaa!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Braaaaa!
entries.translated: [green]Braaaaa!

entries.original:
"Items like [green]Mega Stones[red] and
[green]Z-Crystals[red] can’t be purchased.

The only way you can get them is by
finding them lying around, or by\lreceiving them as gifts."
entries.translation_source: Items like [color-green-1]Mega Stones[color-red-2] and [color-green-3]Z-Crystals[color-red-4] can’t be purchased. The only way you can get them is by finding them lying around, or by receiving them as gifts.
entries.translated:
Oggetti come [green]le Pietrechiave Mega[red] e
i [green]Cristalli Z[red] non possono essere\lacquistati. L{B4}unico modo per

ottenerli è trovarli in giro,
oppure riceverli in regalo.

entries.original:
"If only there were some way to give
a Pokémon a stat boost at the\lbeginning of battle without needing\lto use an item\.

I’m sure someone out there is
trying to figure that out.

Perhaps someone from the renowned
Science Society?"
entries.translation_source: If only there were some way to give a Pokémon a stat boost at the beginning of battle without needing to use an item[game-token-1] I’m sure someone out there is trying to figure that out. Perhaps someone from the renowned Science Society?
entries.translated:
Se solo ci fosse un modo per dare a
un Pokémon un aumento delle\lstatistiche all{B4}inizio della lotta

senza dover usare uno strumento\.
Sono sicuro che qualcuno là fuori\lstia cercando di capirlo. Forse

qualcuno della rinomata Società
Scientifica?

entries.original: "Tehl Town"
entries.translation_source: Tehl Town
entries.translated: Tehl Town

entries.original: "Tehl Town D"
entries.translation_source: Tehl Town D
entries.translated: Tehl Town D

entries.original: "Tehl Town N"
entries.translation_source: Tehl Town N
entries.translated: Tehl Town N

entries.original:
"[green]Route 10 [blue]has a cave that resembles
the [green]Lake Caves [blue]of [green]Sinnoh[blue].

I’ve never been in it myself, but
I’ve heard things\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Route 10 [color-blue-2]has a cave that resembles the [color-green-3]Lake Caves [color-blue-4]of [color-green-5]Sinnoh[color-blue-6]. I’ve never been in it myself, but I’ve heard things[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
[green]Percorso 10 [blue]ha una grotta che
somiglia alle [green]Grotte dei Laghi [blue]di\l[green]Sinnoh[blue]. Io non ci sono mai entrato

di persona, ma ne ho sentito
parlare\.

entries.original:
"One day, I’m gunna put Tehl Town
on t’ map.

If yeh ever see me statues aroun’
Borrius, yeh’ll know they’re good.

But I promise yeh, I’ll build t’
biggest, bestest one right here!"
entries.translation_source: One day, I’m gunna put Tehl Town on t’ map. If yeh ever see me statues aroun’ Borrius, yeh’ll know they’re good. But I promise yeh, I’ll build t’ biggest, bestest one right here!
entries.translated:
Un giorno metterò Tehl Town sulla
mappa. Se vedrai mai statue mie in\lgiro per Borrius, saprai che sono

buone. Ma te lo prometto, ne
costruirò una ancora più grande e\lmigliore proprio qui!

entries.original:
"I swear\.

Those weird guys have been blocking
off [green]Route 9[blue] for days\.

I wonder what they’re up to?"
entries.translation_source: I swear[game-token-1] Those weird guys have been blocking off [color-green-2]Route 9[color-blue-3] for days[game-token-4] I wonder what they’re up to?
entries.translated:
Lo giuro\. Quei tipi strani bloccano
[green]Percorso 9[blue] da giorni\. Mi chiedo cosa\lstiano combinando?

entries.original: "Here, take these!"
entries.translation_source: Here, take these!
entries.translated: Prendi questi!

entries.original:
"One of Professor Log’s Aides who
lives in Tehl Town will give you\la gift if you’ve captured\lenough Pokémon.

I hope those help you fill up
your Pokédex!"
entries.translation_source: One of Professor Log’s Aides who lives in Tehl Town will give you a gift if you’ve captured enough Pokémon. I hope those help you fill up your Pokédex!
entries.translated:
Uno degli Assistenti del Professor
Log che vive a Tehl Town ti farà un\lregalo se hai catturato abbastanza

Pokémon. Spero che ti aiutino a
riempire il Pokédex!

entries.original: "Statue of Regi"
entries.translation_source: Statue of Regi
entries.translated: Statua di Regi

entries.original:
"A man needs inspiration for his
final statue! Bring him the Pokémon
that sleeps under Bellin Town."
entries.translation_source: A man needs inspiration for his final statue! Bring him the Pokémon that sleeps under Bellin Town.
entries.translated:
Un uomo ha bisogno d{B4}ispirazione
per la sua statua finale! Portagli\lil Pokémon che dorme sotto Bellin

Town.

entries.original:
"’Scuse me, yeh couldn’ spare a
moment, could yeh?

Listen\. I was one o’ the best
statue builder’s ’n Borrius.

But lately, m’ skills got stagnant
- the ol’ muse dried up ’n all.

Thing is, aye\. heard stories
’bout an ancient king - a king\lstrong enough t’ tow countries\lw’ ropes.

Eons an’ eons old, it is.

Would yeh believe me if I said I
found it?

Under m’ home in Bellin.
Right there?

Would bring the big lump here
m’self, but it won’ budge.

No idea how t’ wake it up, either.

But, eh\. yeh look handy - couldn’
bring it here, could yeh?"
entries.translation_source: ’Scuse me, yeh couldn’ spare a moment, could yeh? Listen[game-token-1] I was one o’ the best statue builder’s ’n Borrius. But lately, m’ skills got stagnant - the ol’ muse dried up ’n all. Thing is, aye[game-token-2] heard stories ’bout an ancient king - a king strong enough t’ tow countries w’ ropes. Eons an’ eons old, it is. Would yeh believe me if I said I found it? Under m’ home in Bellin. Right there? Would bring the big lump here m’self, but it won’ budge. No idea how t’ wake it up, either. But, eh[game-token-3] yeh look handy - couldn’ bring it here, could yeh?
entries.translated:
Scusami, non avresti un momento,
vero? Ascolta\. Ero uno dei migliori\lscultori di statue di Borrius. Ma

ultimamente, le mie abilità si sono
arenate - la vecchia musa si è\lesaurita e tutto il resto. Il fatto

è, sì\. ho sentito storie su un
antico re - un re abbastanza forte\lda trainare paesi con delle corde.

Vecchio di eoni ed eoni, lo è. Mi
crederesti se ti dicessi che l{B4}ho\ltrovato? Sotto casa mia a Bellin.

Proprio lì? Porterei io stesso quel
grosso blocco qui, ma non si muove.\lNon ho idea nemmeno di come

svegliarlo. Ma, eh\. sembri in gamba
- non potresti portarlo qui, vero?

entries.original:
"Ne’er mind, then.

Didn’ expect yeh t’ know how,
anyway."
entries.translation_source: Ne’er mind, then. Didn’ expect yeh t’ know how, anyway.
entries.translated:
Lascia perdere, allora. Tanto non
m{B4}aspettavo mica che sapessi come\lfare.

entries.original:
"A’righ, yer a real champ.

So, yeh ever been into the bottom
o’ Bellin Town?

Yeh’ll see it there.

As I said, it jus’ sits there. It
don’ move, don’ attack, nuthin’.

Real myst’ry.

Sorry I can’ help yeh figurin’ out
how t’ get it movin’, but if yeh\lmanage, bring it here."
entries.translation_source: A’righ, yer a real champ. So, yeh ever been into the bottom o’ Bellin Town? Yeh’ll see it there. As I said, it jus’ sits there. It don’ move, don’ attack, nuthin’. Real myst’ry. Sorry I can’ help yeh figurin’ out how t’ get it movin’, but if yeh manage, bring it here.
entries.translated:
Va bene, sei proprio un campione.
Allora, sei mai stato nel fondo di\lBellin Town? La vedrai lì. Come

dicevo, sta solo lì. Non si muove,
non attacca, niente. Un vero\lmistero. Scusa se non ti posso

aiutare a capire come farla
muovere, ma se ci riesci, portala\lqui.

entries.original:
"That’s\.

Yeh did it! The livin’ statue\.
yeh really got it t’ move!

Awright, jus’ hold it nice an’
still - I’ll get t’ old hammer\land chisel out\."
entries.translation_source: That’s[game-token-1] Yeh did it! The livin’ statue[game-token-2] yeh really got it t’ move! Awright, jus’ hold it nice an’ still - I’ll get t’ old hammer and chisel out[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
È\. L{B4}hai fatto! La statua vivente\.
sei davvero riuscito a farla\lmuovere! Va bene, tienila bella

ferma - tirerò fuori il vecchio
martello e lo scalpello\.

entries.original:
"Whew\. well, that’s some o’ t’
best work I ever done."
entries.translation_source: Whew[game-token-1] well, that’s some o’ t’ best work I ever done.
entries.translated:
Uff\. beh, è uno dei migliori lavori
che abbia mai fatto.

entries.original:
"An’ w’ that\. I think it’s ’bout
time I pack it in.

Nuthin’ toppin’ this, I tell
yeh that.

Thank yeh kindly, [buffer1].
As a token o’ gratitude\.

Well, on t’ side,
I’m a pretty good blacksmith.

Was jus’ thinkin’ ’bout takin’ it
up as a proper job, actually\. not\lmuch call fer this statue business\lanymore.

Tell yeh what, yeh can be me first
customer! How ’bout it?

Now what could I do fer yeh?
Let’s see\.

Yeh got any o’ them Amulet Coins?

Jus’ as thanks, I’ll give it a
free upgrade."
entries.translation_source: An’ w’ that[game-token-1] I think it’s ’bout time I pack it in. Nuthin’ toppin’ this, I tell yeh that. Thank yeh kindly, [buffer1-2]. As a token o’ gratitude[game-token-3] Well, on t’ side, I’m a pretty good blacksmith. Was jus’ thinkin’ ’bout takin’ it up as a proper job, actually[game-token-4] not much call fer this statue business anymore. Tell yeh what, yeh can be me first customer! How ’bout it? "My mother suffers from horrible

entries.translation_source: My mother suffers from horrible separation anxiety. So much so, that when I moved away, she forced me to install a path between our houses. You’re welcome to use it, if you’d like. My mother lives on [color-green-1]Route 9[color-red-2].
entries.translated:
Mia madre soffre di una terribile
ansia da separazione. Tanto che,\lquando me ne sono andato, mi ha

costretto a realizzare un sentiero
tra le nostre case. Sei libero di\lusarlo, se ti va. Mia madre vive

sulla [green]Route 9[red].

entries.original:
"Despite it being private property,
some people have decided to camp\lout in our underground passageway,\land hold a contest daily.

entries.translation_source: Despite it being private property, some people have decided to camp out in our underground passageway, and hold a contest daily. I’m pretty sure it’s rigged though, since I’ve never heard of anyone without a super fast [color-green-1]Motorbike[color-blue-2] completing it.
entries.translated:
Nonostante sia una proprietà
privata, alcune persone hanno\ldeciso di accamparsi nel nostro

passaggio sotterraneo e organizzare
ogni giorno una gara. Sono quasi\lsicuro che sia truccata, però,

visto che non ho mai sentito di
qualcuno senza una [green]Moto[blue] super\lveloce che la completasse.

Nomi[blue] ufficiale! Vuoi che valuti i\lsoprannomi dei tuoi Pokémon?

I see?"

Il soprannome di quale Pokémon vuoi
vedere?

That is a gucci nickname!

a swag name?

How about it?"
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1], is it? That is a gucci nickname! But, would you like me to give it a swag name? How about it?
entries.translated:
[buffer1], eh? Che soprannome fico!

"Really?
That’s an Egg!"
entries.translation_source: Really? That’s an Egg!
entries.translated: Davvero? È un uovo!

entries.original:
"Uh huh.
Come back again."
entries.translation_source: Uh huh. Come back again.
entries.translated: Mh-mh. Torna di nuovo.

"Cool. Then, what should the new
nickname be?"
entries.translation_source: Cool. Then, what should the new nickname be?
entries.translated:
Bene. Allora, quale dovrebbe essere
il nuovo soprannome?

entries.translated:
Fatto! Da ora in poi, questo
Pokémon si chiamerà [buffer1]!\lSembra uguale a prima, ma è

comunque dieci volte più figo! Sei
fortunatissimo!

"Done! From now on, this Pokémon
will be called [buffer1]!

You’re so swag!"

entries.translated:
Fatto! D{B4}ora in poi, questo Pokémon
si chiamerà [buffer1]! È un nome\lmolto meglio di prima! Sei così

swag!

[buffer1][red] kinds of Pokémon?"

Grande! Hai catturato [green][buffer3][red]

\.Oh. Capisco. Quando ottieni Pokémon

City[red]? È uno strumento molto utile\lper trovare nuove specie di

Would you like to help me with
my research?"

entries.translated:
Saluti, [player]. Sono un
ricercatore che studia i cambi di\lforma stagionali dei Pokémon.

Poiché le stagioni non cambiano a
Borrius, sono molto interessato a\lscoprire come certi Pokémon

cambiano forma in questa regione.
Ti andrebbe di aiutarmi con la mia\lricerca?

entries.original:
"Splendid!

I am currently researching the
Pokémon known as [green][buffer1][blue].

To start off the research, I would
like to study a [green][buffer1][blue] in\lits [green][buffer2][blue] form."
entries.translation_source: Splendid! I am currently researching the Pokémon known as [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]. To start off the research, I would like to study a [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] in its [color-green-7][buffer2-8][color-blue-9] form.
entries.translated:
Splendido! Al momento sto studiando
il Pokémon conosciuto come\l[green][buffer1][blue]. Per iniziare la ricerca,

vorrei studiare un [green][buffer1][blue] nella
sua forma [green][buffer2][blue].

entries.original:
"No?

would still be invaluable."

entries.translated:
No? Se cambi idea, il tuo aiuto
sarebbe comunque inestimabile.

entries.original:
"Have you brought me a [green][buffer1][blue] in
its [green][buffer2][blue] form to study?

*Frisk* *Frisk*"
entries.translation_source: Have you brought me a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] in its [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6] form to study? *Frisk* *Frisk*
entries.translated:
Mi hai portato un [green][buffer1][blue] nella
sua forma [green][buffer2][blue] da studiare?\l*Frisk* *Frisk*

entries.original:
"Ah, it does not appear you have
brought one.

I would like to see a [green][buffer1][blue] in
its [green][buffer2][blue] form, please."
entries.translation_source: Ah, it does not appear you have brought one. I would like to see a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] in its [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6] form, please.
entries.translated:
Ah, pare che tu non ne abbia
portato uno. Vorrei vedere un\l[green][buffer1][blue] nella sua [green][buffer2][blue] forma,

per favore.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes, you have.

Please wait a moment while I
study it."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes, you have. Please wait a moment while I study it.
entries.translated:
Ah, sì, ce l{B4}hai davvero. Aspetta
un momento mentre lo studio.

entries.original:
"Interesting\.

I have added invaluable data
to my research.

Next, I would like to see a [green][buffer1][blue]
in its [green][buffer3][blue] form."
entries.translation_source: Interesting[game-token-1] I have added invaluable data to my research. Next, I would like to see a [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] in its [color-green-5][buffer3-6][color-blue-7] form.
entries.translated:
Interessante\. Ho aggiunto dati
preziosissimi alla mia ricerca. Ora\lvorrei vedere un [green][buffer1][blue] nella sua

forma [green][buffer3][blue].

entries.original:
"Interesting\.

It appears that for some reason the
Pokémon appearing in the area are\lnot what they are supposed to be\.

Was this your doing?

\.

In that case, this is more than
sufficient!

Who needs Deerling?

This phenomenon is far better for
me to study!"
entries.translation_source: Interesting[game-token-1] It appears that for some reason the Pokémon appearing in the area are not what they are supposed to be[game-token-2] Was this your doing? [game-token-3] In that case, this is more than sufficient! Who needs Deerling? This phenomenon is far better for me to study!
entries.translated:
Interessante\. Sembra che per qualche
motivo i Pokémon che appaiono\lnell{B4}area non siano quelli che

dovrebbero essere\. È opera tua? \. In
tal caso, questo è più che\lsufficiente! Chi ha bisogno di

Deerling? Questo fenomeno è molto
più interessante da studiare per\lme!

entries.original:
"Thank you so much!

You’ve been a great asset to my
research!

So, although Borrius’s climate
remains stable, Deerling and\lSawsbuck have different forms,\ldepending on their environment,\lrather than season\.

Ah yes, your reward."
entries.translation_source: Thank you so much! You’ve been a great asset to my research! So, although Borrius’s climate remains stable, Deerling and Sawsbuck have different forms, depending on their environment, rather than season[game-token-1] Ah yes, your reward.
entries.translated:
Grazie mille! Sei stato un grande
aiuto per la mia ricerca! Quindi,\lanche se il clima di Borrius resta

stabile, Deerling e Sawsbuck hanno
forme diverse a seconda\ldell{B4}ambiente in cui si trovano,

anziché della stagione\. Ah già, la
tua ricompensa.

"As my way of thanks, how about I
do something\.\CC0818 beneficial, for your\lPokémon?

You see, I have a device that can
change the [green]Nature[blue] of a Pokémon -\lchange how it grows.

I can perform the procedure on
your Pokémon, for free, just this\lone time.

Just be aware\.\CC0818 your Pokémon may not
enjoy it very much, and will come\lto hate you afterwards\."
entries.translation_source: As my way of thanks, how about I do something[game-token-1][control-code-2] beneficial, for your Pokémon? You see, I have a device that can change the [color-green-3]Nature[color-blue-4] of a Pokémon - change how it grows. I can perform the procedure on your Pokémon, for free, just this one time. Just be aware[game-token-5][control-code-6] your Pokémon may not enjoy it very much, and will come to hate you afterwards[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Come ringraziamento, che ne dici se
faccio qualcosa\.\CC0818 di utile, per il\ltuo Pokémon? Vedi, ho un

dispositivo che può cambiare la
[green]Natura[blue] di un Pokémon - cambiare il\lmodo in cui cresce. Posso eseguire

la procedura sul tuo Pokémon,
gratis, solo questa volta. Tieni\lpresente\.\CC0818 che al tuo Pokémon

potrebbe non piacere per niente, e
in seguito potrebbe iniziare a\lodiarti\.

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon’s Nature should
I change?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon’s Nature should I change?
entries.translated:
La natura di quale Pokémon dovrei
cambiare?

entries.original:
"Which Nature should I give
[buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Nature should I give [buffer1-1]?
entries.translated:
Quale Natura dovrei dare a
[buffer1]?

"Should I give [green][buffer1][blue]
the [green][buffer2][blue] Nature?"
entries.translation_source: Should I give [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] the [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6] Nature?
entries.translated:
Dovrei dare a [green][buffer1][blue] la Natura
[green][buffer2][blue]?

"Then, hold still, [buffer1]\.

It’s just a simple procedure\.
You won’t remember a thing\."
entries.translation_source: Then, hold still, [buffer1-1][game-token-2] It’s just a simple procedure[game-token-3] You won’t remember a thing[game-token-4]

Allora, stai fermo, [buffer1]\. È solo
una semplice procedura\. Non\lricorderai nulla\.

"Ah, we’ve finished.

I’ve restructured your [buffer1]’s
heart to the more optimal Nature.

Now it’s as if it’s an entirely
different Pokémon!

And fortunately, it seems to
remember nothing about what just\lhappened.

Thank you again for your
assistance!

And although I cannot continuously
afford to change Natures for you,\lif you are able to foot the bill,\lI will happy to change more."
entries.translation_source: Ah, we’ve finished. I’ve restructured your [buffer1-1]’s heart to the more optimal Nature. Now it’s as if it’s an entirely different Pokémon! And fortunately, it seems to remember nothing about what just happened. Thank you again for your assistance! And although I cannot continuously afford to change Natures for you, if you are able to foot the bill, I will happy to change more.
entries.translated:
Ah, abbiamo finito. Ho
ristrutturato il cuore del tuo\l[buffer1] per dargli la Natura più

ottimale. Ora è come se fosse un
Pokémon completamente diverso! E\lfortunatamente, sembra che non

ricordi nulla di ciò che è appena
successo. Grazie ancora per il tuo\laiuto! E anche se non posso

permettermi di cambiare
continuamente le Nature per te, se\lsei in grado di pagare il conto,

sarò felice di cambiarne altre.

entries.original:
"Of course, I can wait while you
decide on a Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Of course, I can wait while you decide on a Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Certo, posso aspettare mentre
decidi quale Pokémon scegliere.

entries.original:
"[green][buffer1][blue] already has that
Nature\."

Non posso cambiare la natura di un

Se puoi pagare di nuovo il conto,

Fino a poco tempo fa, questa città

9.

Faresti meglio a fare scorta di
[green]Rianima[red]! Riporta un Pokémon svenuto\la metà dei PS!

"Hey, there!

Ehi, tu! Ti prego, goditi questo

Ci sono alcuni Pokémon in

La salita su questa montagna è

Tutto pronto! Stai al sicuro là
fuori!

Il potere dell{B4}evoluzione\. Mi spinge

Un ragazzino si è perso nel

entries.translation_source: I’m Milo[game-token-1] I was catching Pokémon, and then I got lost[game-token-2] I’m so scared[game-token-3] Please! Please take me to the exit!

Sono Milo\. Stavo catturando Pokémon,

entries.original:
"Oh\.

[black][player] ha deciso di andare con
Milo!

entries.original:
"I’ll keep your Pokémon healthy

Terrò i tuoi Pokémon in salute
sempre!

Mi piacciono le mosse utili come

La montagna\. È così facile

[player], sei diventato così bravo
perché sei sempre con i tuoi\lPokémon? Sì! Deve essere per forza

così! Milo proverà a fare come te!

[black]Mentre sei in squadra con Milo, i
primi [green]3[black] Pokémon idonei nella tua\lsquadra saranno selezionati per la

lotta.

[player], bye-bye!

[blue]Oh! Ecco la scala! Voglio diventare

Grazie!

entries.original:
"I was standing outside, by Antisis
City, when I saw it\.

A yellow Pokémon I’d never seen
before, standing on a ledge,\lstaring down at me.

All my friends didn’t believe me
when I told them, so I came here\lto take a picture of it.

And I’m pretty sure if I dig
straight through this wall, I’ll\lreach that ledge where I saw\lthe Pokémon.

The only thing is, I don’t know how
long it’ll take to break through.

If only I had some sort of machine
that could do the digging for me\."
entries.translation_source: I was standing outside, by Antisis City, when I saw it[game-token-1] A yellow Pokémon I’d never seen before, standing on a ledge, staring down at me. All my friends didn’t believe me when I told them, so I came here to take a picture of it. And I’m pretty sure if I dig straight through this wall, I’ll reach that ledge where I saw the Pokémon. The only thing is, I don’t know how long it’ll take to break through. If only I had some sort of machine that could do the digging for me[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Ero fuori, vicino a Antisis City,
quando l{B4}ho visto\\. Un Pokémon\lgiallo che non avevo mai visto

prima, appollaiato su una
sporgenza, che mi fissava. Tutti i\lmiei amici non mi credevano quando

gliel{B4}ho detto, quindi sono venuto
qui per fargli una foto. E sono\labbastanza sicuro che se scavo

dritto attraverso questo muro,
raggiungerò quella sporgenza dove\lho visto il Pokémon. L{B4}unica cosa è

che non so quanto tempo ci vorrà
per sfondare. Se solo avessi una\lspecie di macchina che potesse

scavare per me\\.

entries.original:
"That digging machine in your Cube\.

It’s just what I need to dig
through the wall!

Please, let me borrow it for a sec."
entries.translation_source: That digging machine in your Cube[game-token-1] It’s just what I need to dig through the wall! Please, let me borrow it for a sec.
entries.translated:
Quella macchina da scavo nel tuo
Cube\. È proprio quello che mi serve\lper sfondare il muro! Ti prego,

fammela prendere in prestito per un
secondo.

entries.original: "Alright, just gimme a sec\."
entries.translation_source: Alright, just gimme a sec[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Va bene, dammi solo un secondo\.

entries.original:
"I did it!
I broke through the wall!

I knew there was a ledge on the
other side!

Now, if you’ll excuse me for just a
sec\."
entries.translation_source: I did it! I broke through the wall! I knew there was a ledge on the other side! Now, if you’ll excuse me for just a sec[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ce l{B4}ho fatta! Ho sfondato il muro!
Sapevo che dall{B4}altra parte c{B4}era\luna sporgenza! Ora, se vuoi

scusarmi per un secondo\.

entries.original:
"Well, that yellow Pokémon is
there, just as I thought.

I took the picture I wanted, and
now that I’ve done that, I’ll let\lyou go right ahead and capture it.

Thanks again for your help!"
entries.translation_source: Well, that yellow Pokémon is there, just as I thought. I took the picture I wanted, and now that I’ve done that, I’ll let you go right ahead and capture it. Thanks again for your help!
entries.translated:
Bene, quel Pokémon giallo è lì,
proprio come pensavo. Ho scattato\lla foto che volevo, e ora che l{B4}ho

fatto, ti lascerò andare avanti e
catturarlo. Grazie ancora per il\ltuo aiuto!

entries.original:
"But how will I break through the
wall without it?"
entries.translation_source: But how will I break through the wall without it?
entries.translated:
Ma come farò a sfondare il muro
senza?

[buffer1] è scomparso nella catena

entries.original: "It’s a challenge rock."

"For many years I have isolated

After all this time, I am now the
most powerful Trainer here.

Can you even hope to take the title
from me?"

Per molti anni mi sono isolato in
questa grotta. Dopo tutto questo\ltempo, ora sono l{B4}Allenatore più

forte qui. Puoi davvero sperare di
togliermi il titolo?

"What’s done is done.

I will never get those years of my
life back.

All I can hope to do now is move
forward.

I won’t be needing this anymore."
entries.translation_source: What’s done is done. I will never get those years of my life back. All I can hope to do now is move forward. I won’t be needing this anymore.

Ciò che è fatto è fatto. Non riavrò
mai indietro quegli anni della mia\lvita. Tutto ciò che posso sperare

di fare ora è andare avanti. Non mi
servirà più.

"That’s a Mega Stone for the

Questa è una Megapietra per il

Allenatore.

"For many years I have isolated

this title, defeat all of the other\lTrainers first."

Per molti anni mi sono isolato in
questa grotta. Dopo tutto questo\ltempo, sono ora l{B4}Allenatore più

questo titolo, sconfiggi prima\ltutti gli altri Allenatori.

"Zzzz\.

[black]She appears to have fallen asleep

Better go a different way."

Zzzz\. [black]Sembra che si sia addormentata

"No matter how fast you run, there

Non importa quanto corri veloce,
siamo in tanti e ti rallenteremo!

"Why are we after Zapdos?

\.

Beats me.
I just get paid to follow orders."

Perché siamo dietro a Zapdos? \. Boh.
Mi pagano solo per obbedire agli\lordini.

"This room\. It’s so hard to

entries.translated:
Questa stanza\. È così difficile
orientarsi al suo interno\.

"Seriously, this room is the reason it
took us so long to reach the peak\."

entries.translated:
Sul serio, questa stanza è il
motivo per cui ci abbiamo messo\lcosì tanto a raggiungere la cima\.

entries.original:
"Well, if I can’t slow you down, at
least this room will."
entries.translation_source: Well, if I can’t slow you down, at least this room will.
entries.translated:
Beh, se non posso rallentarti io,
almeno lo farà questa stanza.

Spero che nessun altro scagnozzo

Faresti meglio a sbrigarti,

"I can only imagine what the

\.

Don’t put me on Shadow Warrior

entries.translation_source: I can only imagine what the higher-ups will do to him[game-token-1] [game-token-2] Wait, I failed too, didn’t I? Ack! I’m sorry, Marlon, sir! Don’t put me on Shadow Warrior feeding duty! Please!

Posso solo immaginare cosa gli
faranno i piani alti\. \. Aspetta, ho\lfallito anch{B4}io, vero? Ah! Mi

dispiace, signor Marlon! Non
mettetemi al turno di dare da\lmangiare agli Shadow Warrior! Per

favore!

entries.original:
"The mountain’s got a pretty neat
view, don’t ya think?

Just a shame about the Pokémon
living here.

But that’s why we dealt with ’em!"
entries.translation_source: The mountain’s got a pretty neat view, don’t ya think? Just a shame about the Pokémon living here. But that’s why we dealt with ’em!
entries.translated:
La montagna ha una vista davvero
niente male, non credi? Peccato per\li Pokémon che vivono qui. Ma è per

questo che ci siamo occupati di
loro!

"Despite my rage, I’m still just a
Rattata in a cage\."
entries.translation_source: Despite my rage, I’m still just a Rattata in a cage[game-token-1]

Nonostante la mia furia, resto
comunque solo un Rattata in gabbia\.

"The Pokémon living here were getting

Hah! Like I’ll ever tell you!"
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon living here were getting in the way, so we rounded ’em up an locked ’em in an electric cage. How can you unlock it? Hah! Like I’ll ever tell you!
entries.translated:
I Pokémon che vivono qui ci
intralciavano, così li abbiamo\lradunati e rinchiusi in una gabbia

elettrica. Come fai a sbloccarla?
Ah! Come se te lo dicessi mai!

"Even if you keep going, I’ll never
tell you which of the Grunts has\lthe key to release the Pokémon!

\.Oh, shoot. I just blabbed about
the key\."
entries.translation_source: Even if you keep going, I’ll never tell you which of the Grunts has the key to release the Pokémon! [game-token-1]Oh, shoot. I just blabbed about the key[game-token-2]

Anche se continui, non ti dirò mai
quale delle Reclute ha la chiave\lper liberare i Pokémon! \.Accidenti.

Ho appena spifferato della chiave\.

"The stairs have been destroyed, so
nothing can interrupt Marlon while\lhe prepares to capture Zapdos."

Le scale sono state distrutte,
quindi nulla può interrompere\lMarlon mentre si prepara a

catturare Zapdos.

entries.original:
"

It’s nothing like Antisis City."
