"Maybe I should go back to
Antisis City.

I’m out of my depth in here."
entries.translation_source: Maybe I should go back to Antisis City. I’m out of my depth in here.
entries.translated:
Forse dovrei tornare ad Antisis
City. Qui sono fuori dalle mie\lcorde.

entries.original:
"Did you know?

The Dehara City Gym Leader
trains here regularly."
entries.translation_source: Did you know? The Dehara City Gym Leader trains here regularly.
entries.translated:
Lo sapevi? Il Capopalestra di
Dehara City si allena qui\lregolarmente.

entries.original:
"Wow, you’re strong!
Do you train here too?"
entries.translation_source: Wow, you’re strong! Do you train here too?
entries.translated:
Wow, sei forte! Ti alleni anche tu
qui?

entries.original:
"I guess I need to train more to
match that Gym Leader."
entries.translation_source: I guess I need to train more to match that Gym Leader.
entries.translated:
Credo che debba allenarmi di più
per essere all{B4}altezza di quel\lCapopalestra.

entries.original:
"My top speed went down when I got
trapped in that electric web!"
entries.translation_source: My top speed went down when I got trapped in that electric web!
entries.translated:
La mia velocità massima è calata
quando sono rimasto intrappolato in\lquella ragnatela elettrica!

entries.original:
"Hahhh!
I have no need for HM slaves!

I will keep smashing rocks with
my bare hands!"
entries.translation_source: Hahhh! I have no need for HM slaves! I will keep smashing rocks with my bare hands!
entries.translated:
Hahhh! Non ho bisogno di schiavi
delle MN! Continuerò a spaccare\lrocce a mani nude!

entries.original:
"My Pokémon evolved from the energy
in this cave!"
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon evolved from the energy in this cave!
entries.translated:
I miei Pokémon si sono evoluti
grazie all{B4}energia di questa\lgrotta!

entries.original:
"When I was your age, most of the
paths here didn’t exist.

I dug through the cave with my
trusty Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: When I was your age, most of the paths here didn’t exist. I dug through the cave with my trusty Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Alla tua età, la maggior parte dei
sentieri qui non esisteva. Ho\lscavato nella caverna con il mio

fidato Pokémon.

entries.original:
"When I was your age, we respected
our elders.

We didn’t mercilessly beat them."
entries.translation_source: When I was your age, we respected our elders. We didn’t mercilessly beat them.
entries.translated:
Quando avevo la tua età,
rispettavamo i nostri anziani. Non\lli massacravamo senza pietà.

entries.original:
"Youngsters like you\.
No respect for their elders."
entries.translation_source: Youngsters like you[game-token-1] No respect for their elders.
entries.translated:
Giovani come voi\. Nessun rispetto
per gli anziani.

entries.original:
"Your skill makes my rubber gear
seem useless.

Maybe I should invest in a more
expensive brand."
entries.translation_source: Your skill makes my rubber gear seem useless. Maybe I should invest in a more expensive brand.
entries.translated:
La tua abilità fa sembrare il mio
equipaggiamento di gomma inutile.\lForse dovrei investire in una marca

più costosa.

entries.original:
"It appears I need to spend more
time honing my clairvoyance."
entries.translation_source: It appears I need to spend more time honing my clairvoyance.
entries.translated:
Sembra che debba dedicare più tempo
a perfezionare la mia\lchiaroveggenza.

entries.original:
"Even though I lost, I’m still
very happy!

The cavern is glowing with the
fires of passion!"
entries.translation_source: Even though I lost, I’m still very happy! The cavern is glowing with the fires of passion!
entries.translated:
Anche se ho perso, sono comunque
felicissima! La caverna risplende\ldei fuochi della passione!

entries.original:
"Ho ho ho!
Gee golly, it’s a mountain!"
entries.translation_source: Ho ho ho! Gee golly, it’s a mountain!
entries.translated: Oh oh oh! Perbacco, è una montagna!

entries.original:
"What a fun battle!

You got my blood flowing during my
long climb."
entries.translation_source: What a fun battle! You got my blood flowing during my long climb.
entries.translated:
Che bella lotta! Mi hai fatto
salire l{B4}adrenalina durante la mia\llunga scalata.

entries.original:
"Be careful when climbing the rock
walls, the fall can be treacherous."
entries.translation_source: Be careful when climbing the rock walls, the fall can be treacherous.
entries.translated:
Fai attenzione quando arrampichi
sulle pareti di roccia: la caduta\lpuò essere pericolosa.

entries.original: "and Surf!"
entries.translation_source: and Surf!
entries.translated: e Surf!

entries.original:
"In order to disengage the electric
barrier in this room, you should\lstart with the boulders on the\lright side of this room.

You’ll need Surf to get over there,
though."
entries.translation_source: In order to disengage the electric barrier in this room, you should start with the boulders on the right side of this room. You’ll need Surf to get over there, though.
entries.translated:
Per disattivare la barriera
elettrica in questa stanza,\ldovresti iniziare dai massi sul

lato destro di questa stanza. Però
ti servirà Surf per arrivarci.

entries.original:
"Surprisingly, you can’t catch any
[green]Voltorb[blue] here.

They’re only found daily in one of
the Gyms."
entries.translation_source: Surprisingly, you can’t catch any [color-green-1]Voltorb[color-blue-2] here. They’re only found daily in one of the Gyms.
entries.translated:
Sorprendentemente, qui non puoi
catturare nessun [green]Voltorb[blue]. Si\ltrovano solo ogni giorno in una

delle Palestre.

entries.original:
"Now I can’t get back up the ladder,
no matter how hard I try."
entries.translation_source: Now I can’t get back up the ladder, no matter how hard I try.
entries.translated:
Adesso non riesco più a risalire la
scala, per quanto ci provi.

entries.original:
"Have your Pokémon been acting
funny lately?"
entries.translation_source: Have your Pokémon been acting funny lately?
entries.translated:
I tuoi Pokémon si stanno
comportando in modo strano\lultimamente?

entries.original:
"Hmm\.
Clearly not\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] Clearly not[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Mmh\. Chiaramente no\.

entries.original:
"I could’ve sworn my Electric-types
were acting funny until they were\lknocked out\."
entries.translation_source: I could’ve sworn my Electric-types were acting funny until they were knocked out[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Giurerei che i miei Pokémon di tipo
Elettro si comportassero in modo\lstrano finché non venivano messi KO\.

entries.original:
"People assume just because I’m a
Super Nerd, I’m required to do\lnerdy things.

I can study rocks if I want to!

Nobody can tell me who I have
to be!"
entries.translation_source: People assume just because I’m a Super Nerd, I’m required to do nerdy things. I can study rocks if I want to! Nobody can tell me who I have to be!
entries.translated:
Le persone danno per scontato che,
solo perché sono un Super Nerd,\ldebba fare cose da nerd. Posso

studiare le rocce se voglio!
Nessuno può dirmi chi devo essere!

entries.original:
"Me? No, I’m not lost.
I live here!"
entries.translation_source: Me? No, I’m not lost. I live here!
entries.translated:
Io? No, non mi sono perso. Abito
qui!

entries.original:
"I hear there’s a Pokémon that has
mushrooms growing on its back.

Not around here, though.
I wonder if they taste any good?"
entries.translation_source: I hear there’s a Pokémon that has mushrooms growing on its back. Not around here, though. I wonder if they taste any good?
entries.translated:
Ho sentito dire che esiste un
Pokémon con dei funghi che crescono\lsulla schiena. Non qui intorno,

però. Chissà se sono buoni da
mangiare?

entries.original:
"Huh? Are you lost too?
No? It doesn’t matter.

Let’s have a quick Pokémon
battle!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? Are you lost too? No? It doesn’t matter. Let’s have a quick Pokémon battle!
entries.translated:
Eh? Anche tu ti sei perso? No? Non
importa. Facciamo una rapida lotta\lPokémon!

entries.original:
"Lost?

There’s nothing lost about this kid!"
entries.translation_source: Lost? There’s nothing lost about this kid!
entries.translated:
Perso? Questo ragazzino non è
affatto perso!

entries.original:
"I got separated from my friends\.

I’ve got my Pokémon with me so
I’m okay, but\."
entries.translation_source: I got separated from my friends[game-token-1] I’ve got my Pokémon with me so I’m okay, but[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Mi sono separato dai miei amici\. Ho
con me i miei Pokémon, quindi sto\lbene, ma\.

entries.original:
" You’re lost, aren’t you?
I’ll guide you if you can beat me."
entries.translation_source: You’re lost, aren’t you? I’ll guide you if you can beat me.
entries.translated: Ti sei perso, vero? Ti guiderò se riesci a battermi.

entries.original:
"I’m not lost, I tell you!
I’m camping! That’s my story!"
entries.translation_source: I’m not lost, I tell you! I’m camping! That’s my story!
entries.translated:
Non mi sono perso, te lo dico io!
Sto campeggiando! E questa è la mia\lstoria!

entries.original: "a start, right?"
entries.translation_source: a start, right?
entries.translated: un inizio, giusto?

entries.original:
"I just wanted to have a picnic in
Thundercap Mt.

I didn’t think I would get lost
in a place like this\."
entries.translation_source: I just wanted to have a picnic in Thundercap Mt. I didn’t think I would get lost in a place like this[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Volevo solo fare un picnic sul
Thundercap Mt. Non pensavo di\lperdermi in un posto come questo\.

entries.original:
"Why have a picnic here?
I don’t know.

There’s no deep meaning to it."
entries.translation_source: Why have a picnic here? I don’t know. There’s no deep meaning to it.
entries.translated:
Perché fare un picnic qui? Non lo
so. Non c{B4}è alcun significato\lprofondo.

entries.original:
"Did you come to play, too?
Wanna play battle with me?"
entries.translation_source: Did you come to play, too? Wanna play battle with me?
entries.translated:
Sei venuto anche tu a giocare? Vuoi
fare una lotta con me?

entries.original: "You were just toying with me!"
entries.translation_source: You were just toying with me!
entries.translated: Stavi solo giocando con me!

entries.original:
"I’m playing hide-and-seek here.
I like some underground tag, too."
entries.translation_source: I’m playing hide-and-seek here. I like some underground tag, too.
entries.translated:
Sto giocando a nascondino qui. Mi
piace anche un po{B4} l{B4}acchiapparella\lsottoterra.

entries.original: " to take care of you!"
entries.translation_source: to take care of you!
entries.translated: per occuparmi di te!

entries.original:
"Speaking of crying, I’m positive I
heard before\."
entries.translation_source: Speaking of crying, I’m positive I heard before[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
A proposito di piangere, sono certo
di averlo sentito prima\.

entries.original:
"Sometimes I walk over to Epidimy
Town and terrorize ’em for fun.

But then that white-haired Gym
Leader always chases me away.

I hope I give him such a headache\."
entries.translation_source: Sometimes I walk over to Epidimy Town and terrorize ’em for fun. But then that white-haired Gym Leader always chases me away. I hope I give him such a headache[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
A volte vado a piedi fino a Epidimy
Town e li terrorizzo per\ldivertimento. Ma poi quel

Capopalestra dai capelli bianchi mi
caccia sempre via. Spero di dargli\lun bel mal di testa\.

entries.original:
"I trained like a madman, and my
Pokémon trained even more!"
entries.translation_source: I trained like a madman, and my Pokémon trained even more!
entries.translated:
Mi sono allenato come un pazzo, e i
miei Pokémon si sono allenati\lancora di più!

entries.original:
"Yeah, yeah!
Even though I lost, I’m energetic!"
entries.translation_source: Yeah, yeah! Even though I lost, I’m energetic!
entries.translated:
Sì, sì! Anche se ho perso, sono
pieno di energia!

entries.original:
"For someone as mad as you, your
training has clearly paid off!

And madness born from a drive for
strength must be rewarded!

Trainer!

Have you any of those [green]Power Items[blue]?

They may not look it, but my hands
are both for crafting and punching!

So, allow me to improve all of your
Power Items so they may strengthen\lyour Pokémon even quicker!

All I need are stars - [green][buffer1]s[blue]
to be exact!

You can collect one [buffer1] per
day by smashing the [green]Challenge Rock[blue].

This imposing rock, right here.

Bring a [green]Fighting[blue]-type Pokémon and
smash your way through!"
entries.translation_source: For someone as mad as you, your training has clearly paid off! And madness born from a drive for strength must be rewarded! Trainer! Have you any of those [color-green-1]Power Items[color-blue-2]? They may not look it, but my hands are both for crafting and punching! So, allow me to improve all of your Power Items so they may strengthen your Pokémon even quicker! All I need are stars - [color-green-3][buffer1-4]s[color-blue-5] to be exact! You can collect one [buffer1-6] per day by smashing the [color-green-7]Challenge Rock[color-blue-8]. This imposing rock, right here. Bring a [color-green-9]Fighting[color-blue-10]-type Pokémon and smash your way through!
entries.translated:
Per qualcuno pazzo come te, il tuo
allenamento ha chiaramente dato i\lsuoi frutti! E la follia nata da

una brama di forza deve essere
ricompensata! Allenatore! Hai\lqualcuno di quei [green]Strumenti Potenti[blue]?

Potrebbero non sembrarlo, ma le mie
mani sono sia per creare che per\lcolpire! Quindi, permettimi di

migliorare tutti i tuoi Strumenti
Potenti così che possano potenziare\li tuoi Pokémon ancora più

velocemente! Tutto ciò di cui ho
bisogno sono stelle - [green][buffer1]s[blue] per\ll{B4}esattezza! Puoi raccoglierne uno

[buffer1] al giorno spaccando la
[green]Roccia della Sfida[blue]. Questa roccia\limponente, proprio qui. Porta un

Pokémon di tipo [green]Lotta[blue] e spacca
tutto!

entries.original:
"Greetings, mad one among madmen!

If you wish, pay me [green][buffer3] [buffer1][blue]
and I will upgrade all of your\l[green]Power Items[blue] to [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue]!"
entries.translation_source: Greetings, mad one among madmen! If you wish, pay me [color-green-1][buffer3-2] [buffer1-3][color-blue-4] and I will upgrade all of your [color-green-5]Power Items[color-blue-6] to [color-green-7][game-token-8] [buffer2-9][color-blue-10]!
entries.translated:
Saluti, folle tra i folli! Se vuoi,
pagami [green][buffer3] [buffer1][blue] e\lpotenzierò tutti i tuoi [green]Power Items[blue]

a [green]\Lv [buffer2][blue]!

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over
[buffer2] [buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over [buffer2-3] [buffer1-4].
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha consegnato [buffer2]
[buffer1].

entries.original:
"[black]The Power Item level has been
increased to \Lv [buffer2]!

Pokémon will now gain an additional
[green]\\0C[black] Effort Values when one is held."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Power Item level has been increased to [game-token-2] [buffer2-3]! Pokémon will now gain an additional [color-green-4][raw-escape-5][color-black-6] Effort Values when one is held.
entries.translated:
[black]Il livello dello Strumento Vigore è
stato aumentato a \Lv [buffer2]! I\lPokémon otterranno ora un ulteriore

[green]\\0C[black] Punti Base quando ne tengono uno.

entries.original:
"Gather the stars around Borrius
and come again!"
entries.translation_source: Gather the stars around Borrius and come again!
entries.translated:
Raduna le stelle attorno a Borrius
e torna ancora!

entries.original:
"Alas, you lack the [green][buffer3] [buffer1][blue]
to upgrade your Power Items.

Obtain more stars to your name
and come again!"
entries.translation_source: Alas, you lack the [color-green-1][buffer3-2] [buffer1-3][color-blue-4] to upgrade your Power Items. Obtain more stars to your name and come again!
entries.translated:
Ahimè, ti mancano [green][buffer3] [buffer1][blue]
per migliorare i tuoi Power Item.\lOttieni altre stelle a tuo nome e

torna a trovarmi!

entries.original:
"With your Power Items at their max
level, your Pokémon will gain an\ladditional [green]\\0C[blue] Effort Values when\lone is held!

Tell me that’s not mad, mad one
among madmen!"
entries.translation_source: With your Power Items at their max level, your Pokémon will gain an additional [color-green-1][raw-escape-2][color-blue-3] Effort Values when one is held! Tell me that’s not mad, mad one among madmen!
entries.translated:
Con i tuoi Power Item al livello
massimo, i tuoi Pokémon otterranno\l[green]\\0C[blue] Punti Allenamento in più quando

ne tieni uno equipaggiato! Dimmi
che non è da pazzo, pazzo tra i\lpazzi!

entries.original: "\btn0CMove \btn00Grab \btn01Quit"
entries.translation_source: [button-icon-1]Move [button-icon-2]Grab [button-icon-3]Quit
entries.translated: \btn0CMuovi \btn00Raccogli \btn01Esci

entries.original: "\btn0CMove \btn00Drop \btn01Cancel"
entries.translation_source: [button-icon-1]Move [button-icon-2]Drop [button-icon-3]Cancel
entries.translated: \btn0CSposta \btn00Lascia \btn01Annulla

entries.original: "\btn0CMove \btn00Slide \btn01Quit"
entries.translation_source: [button-icon-1]Move [button-icon-2]Slide [button-icon-3]Quit
entries.translated: \btn0CMuovi \btn00Scorri \btn01Esci

entries.original:
"This image must be recreated
to proceed![pause]"
entries.translation_source: This image must be recreated to proceed![text-token-pause-1]
entries.translated:
Questa immagine deve essere
ricreata per proseguire![pause]

entries.original: "Give up solving the puzzle?"
entries.translation_source: Give up solving the puzzle?
entries.translated:
Vuoi rinunciare a risolvere il
puzzle?

entries.original: "Tomb of Borrius"
entries.translation_source: Tomb of Borrius
entries.translated: Tomba di Borrius

entries.original:
"An ancient tomb said to be the
resting place of King Borrius III.
Immense wealth is said to wait for
anyone who can reach the burial
chamber."
entries.translation_source: An ancient tomb said to be the resting place of King Borrius III. Immense wealth is said to wait for anyone who can reach the burial chamber.
entries.translated:
Una tomba antica che si dice sia il
luogo di riposo di Re Borrius III.\lSi racconta che immense ricchezze

attendano chiunque riesca a
raggiungere la camera funeraria.

entries.original: "Tomb Raider"
entries.translation_source: Tomb Raider
entries.translated: Saccheggiatombe

entries.original:
"A hole has opened up into the
depths of a tomb! Explore it and
solve its mysteries."
entries.translation_source: A hole has opened up into the depths of a tomb! Explore it and solve its mysteries.
entries.translated:
Si è aperto un varco nelle
profondità di una tomba! Esploralo\le svela i suoi misteri.

entries.original: "Fred"
entries.translation_source: Fred
entries.translated: Fred

entries.original:
"This piece goes here\.

And that piece goes there\."
entries.translation_source: This piece goes here[game-token-1] And that piece goes there[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Questo pezzo va qui\. E quest{B4}altro
va là\.

entries.original:
"Oh, a Trainer!

The name’s Fred.

My colleagues and I have been here
for weeks trying to learn more\labout this ancient tomb.

Unfortunately, this puzzle here has
us stumped.

If you think you’ll have a better
chance at solving it than we did,\lthen be my guest."
entries.translation_source: Oh, a Trainer! The name’s Fred. My colleagues and I have been here for weeks trying to learn more about this ancient tomb. Unfortunately, this puzzle here has us stumped. If you think you’ll have a better chance at solving it than we did, then be my guest.
entries.translated:
Oh, un Allenatore! Mi chiamo Fred.
I miei colleghi ed io siamo qui da\lsettimane a cercare di saperne di

più su questa antica tomba.
Purtroppo, questo enigma qui ci ha\llasciati perplessi. Se pensi di

avere più possibilità di risolverlo
di quante ne abbiamo avute noi,\lallora fai pure.

entries.original:
"This puzzle here has had us stumped
for weeks!

It’s simply too hard to complete\."
entries.translation_source: This puzzle here has had us stumped for weeks! It’s simply too hard to complete[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Questo puzzle qui ci ha lasciati
perplessi per settimane! È\lsemplicemente troppo difficile da

completare\.

entries.original:
"Come on, Fred!
You can do it!

\.Wait, what are you doing!?

That piece doesn’t go there!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, Fred! You can do it! [game-token-1]Wait, what are you doing!? That piece doesn’t go there!
entries.translated:
Forza, Fred! Ce la puoi fare! \.
Aspetta, che stai facendo!? Quel\lpezzo non va lì!

entries.original:
"This tomb was designed by the
ancient people of Borrius to keep\lout intruders like us.

The puzzle on this floor must only
be the first in a series of traps\lbefore the burial chamber\."
entries.translation_source: This tomb was designed by the ancient people of Borrius to keep out intruders like us. The puzzle on this floor must only be the first in a series of traps before the burial chamber[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Questa tomba è stata progettata
dagli antichi abitanti di Borrius\lper tenere fuori intrusi come noi.

L{B4}enigma di questo piano deve
essere solo il primo di una serie\ldi trappole prima della camera

funeraria\.

entries.original:
"This tomb was designed by the
ancient people of Borrius to keep\lout intruders like us.

The puzzle on this floor must only
be the first in a series of traps\lbefore the burial chamber\.

Best of luck down there."
entries.translation_source: This tomb was designed by the ancient people of Borrius to keep out intruders like us. The puzzle on this floor must only be the first in a series of traps before the burial chamber[game-token-1] Best of luck down there.
entries.translated:
Questa tomba fu progettata dagli
antichi abitanti di Borrius per\ltenere fuori intrusi come noi. Il

puzzle su questo piano deve essere
solo il primo di una serie di\ltrappole prima della camera

sepolcrale\. Ti auguro buona fortuna
laggiù.

entries.original:
"This door is the passageway to the
burial chamber!

I can feel it in my bones!"
entries.translation_source: This door is the passageway to the burial chamber! I can feel it in my bones!
entries.translated:
Questa porta conduce alla camera
sepolcrale! Lo sento nelle ossa!

entries.original:
"This door is the passageway to the
burial chamber!

I can feel it in my bones!

Maybe something you’ll discover
down below will provide the key\lto unlocking it\."
entries.translation_source: This door is the passageway to the burial chamber! I can feel it in my bones! Maybe something you’ll discover down below will provide the key to unlocking it[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Questa porta è il passaggio per la
camera sepolcrale! Lo sento nelle\lossa! Forse qualcosa che scoprirai

laggiù fornirà la chiave per
sbloccarla\.

entries.original:
"Hey, kid!

You okay down there?

That looked like a nasty fall!

\.

\.I’m sure you’ll shrug it off!

Hang on\.
Let me throw down a ladder."
entries.translation_source: Hey, kid! You okay down there? That looked like a nasty fall! [game-token-1] [game-token-2]I’m sure you’ll shrug it off! Hang on[game-token-3] Let me throw down a ladder.
entries.translated:
Ehi, ragazzo! Stai bene laggiù?
Sembra sia stata una brutta caduta!\l\. \.Sono sicuro che la supererai senza

problemi! Aspetta\. Lasciami buttare
giù una scala.

entries.original:
"Wow, kid, looks like you found a
way into the tomb!

I’m impressed!

Not even the greatest minds in the
Archeology Society could crack\lthat puzzle!

You’re a natural archeologist, kid!

In fact, why don’t you take the
lead on exploring this place?

They say great riches are waiting
for anyone who can find the burial\lchamber.

A whiz like you should have no
problem finding it."
entries.translation_source: Wow, kid, looks like you found a way into the tomb! I’m impressed! Not even the greatest minds in the Archeology Society could crack that puzzle! You’re a natural archeologist, kid! In fact, why don’t you take the lead on exploring this place? They say great riches are waiting for anyone who can find the burial chamber. A whiz like you should have no problem finding it.
entries.translated:
Wow, ragazzo, sembra che tu abbia
trovato un modo per entrare nella\ltomba! Sono impressionato! Nemmeno

le più grandi menti della Società
Archeologica sono riuscite a\lrisolvere quel puzzle! Sei un

archeologo naturale, ragazzo! In
effetti, perché non prendi il\lcomando nell{B4}esplorare questo

posto? Dicono che grandi ricchezze
aspettano chiunque trovi la camera\lfuneraria. Un genio come te non

dovrebbe avere problemi a trovarla.

entries.original:
"Keep your eye out for hidden
treasure as you explore the tomb.

I doubt the ancient civilization
left much treasure just lying\laround\."
entries.translation_source: Keep your eye out for hidden treasure as you explore the tomb. I doubt the ancient civilization left much treasure just lying around[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Tieni gli occhi aperti per scoprire
tesori nascosti mentre esplori la\ltomba. Dubito che l{B4}antica civiltà

abbia lasciato in giro molti tesori\.

entries.original: "[green]Booooooooo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Booooooooo!
entries.translated: [green]Booooooooo!

entries.original:
"\.A volcano\.?

How in the world did they get a
volcano in this tomb\.?

\.Oh, well.
No point in dwelling on it.

It looks like we’re too high up to
ride on a Pokémon across the lava,\lso you just keep finding us a way\lthrough the tomb."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]A volcano[game-token-2]? How in the world did they get a volcano in this tomb[game-token-3]? [game-token-4]Oh, well. No point in dwelling on it. It looks like we’re too high up to ride on a Pokémon across the lava, so you just keep finding us a way through the tomb.
entries.translated:
\.Un vulcano\.? Come diavolo hanno
fatto a mettere un vulcano in\lquesta tomba\.? \.Oh, beh. Non c{B4}è

motivo di rimuginarci sopra. Sembra
che siamo troppo in alto per\lattraversare la lava in sella a un

Pokémon, quindi continua pure a
trovarci un modo per attraversare\lla tomba.

entries.original:
"Be careful when hopping on those
rocks!

One wrong step and you’ll fall to
a fiery doom\.

So stay safe, and keep an eye out
for any hidden switches that might\llead us to the next floor."
entries.translation_source: Be careful when hopping on those rocks! One wrong step and you’ll fall to a fiery doom[game-token-1] So stay safe, and keep an eye out for any hidden switches that might lead us to the next floor.
entries.translated:
Fai attenzione quando salti su
quegli scogli! Un passo falso e\lcadrai in una fine infuocata\. Quindi

stai attento e tieni d{B4}occhio
eventuali interruttori nascosti che\lpotrebbero condurci al piano

successivo.

entries.original: "The rock reacted to your touch!"
entries.translation_source: The rock reacted to your touch!
entries.translated: La roccia ha reagito al tuo tocco!

entries.original:
"Ohhh\. Trainer\.
I don’t feel so good\.

The Dusknoir must be messing with
the space in our dimension\.

The more I move, the fuzzier
it gets\.

So be careful\.
And don’t let them spot youuuu\."
entries.translation_source: Ohhh[game-token-1] Trainer[game-token-2] I don’t feel so good[game-token-3] The Dusknoir must be messing with the space in our dimension[game-token-4] The more I move, the fuzzier it gets[game-token-5] So be careful[game-token-6] And don’t let them spot youuuu[game-token-7]
entries.translated:
Ohhh\. Allenatore\. Non mi sento tanto
bene\. Il Dusknoir deve star\lalterando lo spazio nella nostra

dimensione\. Più mi muovo, più tutto
diventa sfocato\. Quindi fai\lattenzione\. E non lasciarti vedere

da loro, uuuu\.

entries.original:
"The Dusknoir must be messing with
the space in our dimension\.

Be careful\.
And don’t let them spot youuuu\."
entries.translation_source: The Dusknoir must be messing with the space in our dimension[game-token-1] Be careful[game-token-2] And don’t let them spot youuuu[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Il Dusknoir deve star pasticciando
con lo spazio nella nostra\ldimensione\. Stai attento\. E non

lasciarti vedereeeee\.

entries.original:
"Phew\.

Am I ever glad I got through that
in one piece!"
entries.translation_source: Phew[game-token-1] Am I ever glad I got through that in one piece!
entries.translated:
Fiu\. Sono proprio contento di
esserne uscito in un unico pezzo!

entries.original:
"Uh oh.

Looks like one wrong step on this
floor and you’ll plummet back down\lto the floor below.

But there has to be some way to get
across the floor, right?

Maybe if you can reach a certain
speed?"
entries.translation_source: Uh oh. Looks like one wrong step on this floor and you’ll plummet back down to the floor below. But there has to be some way to get across the floor, right? Maybe if you can reach a certain speed?
entries.translated:
Uh oh. Sembra che un passo falso su
questo piano ti farà precipitare\lgiù fino a quello sottostante. Ma

deve esserci un modo per
attraversarlo, no? Forse se riesci\la raggiungere una certa velocità?

entries.original:
"I’d wager that if you can find a
way to move quickly across the\lfloor, you’ll be able to avoid\lfalling through the holes."
entries.translation_source: I’d wager that if you can find a way to move quickly across the floor, you’ll be able to avoid falling through the holes.
entries.translated:
Scommetterei che, se riesci a
muoverti velocemente sul pavimento,\lriuscirai a evitare di cadere nei

buchi.

entries.original:
"This is it\.
The burial chamber!

And look!

That must be where the ancient king
of Borrius is buried.

Now that we’ve made it, let’s
gather up as much treasure as we\lcan, then get out of here.

And just in case there are still
traps waiting to be sprung, let me\luse the last of my healing items on\lyour Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: This is it[game-token-1] The burial chamber! And look! That must be where the ancient king of Borrius is buried. Now that we’ve made it, let’s gather up as much treasure as we can, then get out of here. And just in case there are still traps waiting to be sprung, let me use the last of my healing items on your Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Ci siamo\. La camera funeraria! E
guarda! Deve essere lì che è\lsepolto l{B4}antico re di Borrius. Ora

che ce l{B4}abbiamo fatta, raccogliamo
più tesori possibile, poi\landiamocene da qui. E nel caso ci

siano ancora trappole pronte a
scattare, lasciami usare gli ultimi\loggetti curativi sui tuoi Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Gather up as much treasure as
you can.

When you’ve done that, I’d wager
there’s even more hiding inside\lthat coffin\."
entries.translation_source: Gather up as much treasure as you can. When you’ve done that, I’d wager there’s even more hiding inside that coffin[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Raccogli tutto il tesoro che
riesci. Quando avrai finito,\lscommetto che ce n{B4}è ancora di più

nascosto dentro quella bara\.

entries.original: "The coffin feels cold to the touch\."
entries.translation_source: The coffin feels cold to the touch[game-token-1]
entries.translated: La bara è fredda al tatto\.

entries.original:
"[red]WARNING! WARNING! WARNING!

INTRUDER DETECTED!

THE AUTOMATED DEFENSE SYSTEM HAS
BEEN ENGAGED!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]WARNING! WARNING! WARNING! INTRUDER DETECTED! THE AUTOMATED DEFENSE SYSTEM HAS BEEN ENGAGED!
entries.translated:
[red]ATTENZIONE! ATTENZIONE! ATTENZIONE!
INTRUSO RILEVATO! IL SISTEMA DI\lDIFESA AUTOMATIZZATO È STATO

ATTIVATO!

entries.original:
"I knew there’d be some other trap!

I was smart to keep my distance
from this coffin until now.

It’s a good thing I let you take
the lead on the exploration!"
entries.translation_source: I knew there’d be some other trap! I was smart to keep my distance from this coffin until now. It’s a good thing I let you take the lead on the exploration!
entries.translated:
Sapevo che ci sarebbe stata
un{B4}altra trappola! Sono stato\lsaggio a tenere le distanze da

questa bara fino ad ora. È una
fortuna che ti abbia lasciato fare\lda apripista nell{B4}esplorazione!

entries.original:
"It seems your fight with that
ancient Pokémon unlocked the\lseal on the door.

Looks like my colleague was right
about that door leading to the\lburial chamber, after all.

Well, I’d best report back to the
Archeology Society with the\ltreasure and knowledge I gathered.

But before I go, I picked this up
while we were making our way\lthrough the tomb.

At first glance, I thought it was
ancient treasure, but it’s just one\lof those Z-Crystals all the kids\lare into these days.

Here, you can have it."
entries.translation_source: It seems your fight with that ancient Pokémon unlocked the seal on the door. Looks like my colleague was right about that door leading to the burial chamber, after all. Well, I’d best report back to the Archeology Society with the treasure and knowledge I gathered. But before I go, I picked this up while we were making our way through the tomb. At first glance, I thought it was ancient treasure, but it’s just one of those Z-Crystals all the kids are into these days. Here, you can have it.
entries.translated:
Sembra che il tuo scontro con quel
Pokémon antico abbia sbloccato il\lsigillo sulla porta. A quanto pare

la mia collega aveva ragione sul
fatto che quella porta conducesse\lalla camera sepolcrale, dopotutto.

Bene, è meglio che riferisca alla
Società di Archeologia il tesoro e\lle conoscenze che ho raccolto. Ma

prima di andare, ho raccolto questa
cosa mentre ci facevamo strada\lattraverso la tomba. A prima vista,

pensavo fosse un tesoro antico, ma
è solo uno di quei Cristalli Z di\lcui i ragazzi sono tanto

appassionati in questi giorni.
Tieni, puoi averlo.

fare! Buona fortuna!

You want to find some hidden items,
and then compare?"
entries.translation_source: You can find so much cool stuff in the most random of places. Take this Great Ball I found in my neighbour’s mailbox, for example[game-token-1] Or even this half-eaten hot dog I found in my garbage can. You want to find some hidden items, and then compare?
entries.translated:
Si trovano un sacco di cose
interessanti nei posti più\limpensabili. Prendi questa Bis Ball

che ho trovato nella cassetta della
posta del mio vicino, per esempio\. O\lperfino questo hot dog mezzo

mangiato che ho trovato nel bidone
della spazzatura. Vuoi trovare\ldegli oggetti nascosti e poi

confrontarli?

entries.original:
"Awesome!

Once you find [green][buffer1][blue] discarded items,
come back and we’ll compare.

I bet you can’t find anything as
sweet as my haul here!"
entries.translation_source: Awesome! Once you find [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] discarded items, come back and we’ll compare. I bet you can’t find anything as sweet as my haul here!
entries.translated:
Fantastico! Una volta che avrai
trovato [green][buffer1][blue] oggetti scartati,\ltorna qui e faremo il confronto.

Scommetto che non riuscirai a
trovare nulla di così bello come il\lmio bottino qui!

entries.original:
"That’s cool, I’ll find other people
to compare with."
entries.translation_source: That’s cool, I’ll find other people to compare with.
entries.translated:
Va bene, troverò altre persone con
cui confrontarmi.

entries.original:
"So far you’ve found [green][buffer2][blue] hidden
item\\07.

I think you can find some more
in this tunnel.

Come back when you’ve found [green][buffer1][blue]."
entries.translation_source: So far you’ve found [color-green-1][buffer2-2][color-blue-3] hidden item[raw-escape-4]. I think you can find some more in this tunnel. Come back when you’ve found [color-green-5][buffer1-6][color-blue-7].
entries.translated:
Finora hai trovato [green][buffer2][blue] oggetto
nascosto\\07. Credo che tu possa\ltrovarne altri in questo tunnel.

Torna quando avrai trovato
[green][buffer1][blue].

entries.original:
"Okay, let’s see what you got\.

Wow!

Where did you find this mint
condition barbecue chip shaped\llike a Ditto?

Or that limited edition Nanab
Berry peel - that’s vintage!

Hold on, I’ll trade you for ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Okay, let’s see what you got[game-token-1] Wow! Where did you find this mint condition barbecue chip shaped like a Ditto? Or that limited edition Nanab Berry peel - that’s vintage! Hold on, I’ll trade you for ’em!
entries.translated:
Allora, vediamo cosa hai\. Wow! Dove
hai trovato questa patatina\lbarbecue in perfette condizioni a

forma di Ditto? O quella buccia di
Baccananas in edizione limitata - è\lda collezione! Aspetta, te li

scambio!

entries.original:
"Remember to check between couch
cushions for secret treasures."
entries.translation_source: Remember to check between couch cushions for secret treasures.
entries.translated:
Ricorda di controllare tra i
cuscini del divano per trovare\ltesori segreti.

entries.original:
"[black]Toxapex pumped itself full of
poisonous fluids to increase\lits size!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Toxapex pumped itself full of poisonous fluids to increase its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Toxapex si è riempito di fluidi
velenosi per aumentare le sue\ldimensioni!

entries.original: "[black]Toxapex receded into the sand."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Toxapex receded into the sand.
entries.translated: [black]Toxapex si è ritirato nella sabbia.

entries.original:
"DEFEATING
THE TOXAPEX
IS THE KEY."
entries.translation_source: DEFEATING THE TOXAPEX IS THE KEY.
entries.translated: ELIMINARE TOXAPEX È LA CHIAVE.

entries.original: "[black][player] found a rare Egg!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] found a rare Egg!
entries.translated: [black][player] ha trovato un Uovo raro!

entries.original: "The Sharpedo is angry!"
entries.translation_source: The Sharpedo is angry!
entries.translated: Lo Sharpedo è arrabbiato!

entries.original: "The Sharpedo are angry!"
entries.translation_source: The Sharpedo are angry!
entries.translated: Gli Sharpedo sono arrabbiati!

entries.original: "The Sharpedo attacked!"
entries.translation_source: The Sharpedo attacked!
entries.translated: Sharpedo ha attaccato!

entries.original:
"The Sharpedo is eyeing you
curiously."
entries.translation_source: The Sharpedo is eyeing you curiously.
entries.translated: Sharpedo ti osserva con curiosità.

entries.original: "Valley Cave"
entries.translation_source: Valley Cave
entries.translated: Grotta della Valle

entries.original:
"A seemingly plain tunnel that
connects Crater Town to Route 6.
The ocean has recently started
flooding in."
entries.translation_source: A seemingly plain tunnel that connects Crater Town to Route 6. The ocean has recently started flooding in.
entries.translated:
Un tunnel apparentemente ordinario
che collega Crater Town alla Route\l6. Di recente l{B4}oceano ha iniziato

a invaderlo.

entries.original:
"The inscription on the tablet
appears to have eroded away."
entries.translation_source: The inscription on the tablet appears to have eroded away.
entries.translated:
L{B4}iscrizione sulla tavoletta sembra
essersi erosa col tempo.

entries.original:
"There appears to be an ancient
button embedded in the rock!

Press it?"
entries.translation_source: There appears to be an ancient button embedded in the rock! Press it?
entries.translated:
Sembra ci sia un antico pulsante
incastonato nella roccia! Premilo?

entries.original: "Nothing happened\."
entries.translation_source: Nothing happened[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non è successo niente\.

entries.original:
"A life of gambling is a life of
no regrets."
entries.translation_source: A life of gambling is a life of no regrets.
entries.translated:
Una vita dedicata al gioco
d{B4}azzardo è una vita senza\lrimpianti.

entries.original:
"I train myself every day by running
barefoot across these stones."
entries.translation_source: I train myself every day by running barefoot across these stones.
entries.translated:
Mi alleno ogni giorno correndo a
piedi nudi su queste pietre.

entries.original:
"Rare herbs grow in this cave.
It is my job to protect them."
entries.translation_source: Rare herbs grow in this cave. It is my job to protect them.
entries.translated:
In questa grotta crescono erbe
rare. È mio compito proteggerle.

entries.original: "My job is important."
entries.translation_source: My job is important.
entries.translated: Il mio lavoro è importante.

entries.original:
"If a Pokémon eats one of the
rare herbs that grow here, its\laffection for you will decrease."
entries.translation_source: If a Pokémon eats one of the rare herbs that grow here, its affection for you will decrease.
entries.translated:
Se un Pokémon mangia una delle rare
erbe che crescono qui, la sua\lamicizia per te diminuirà.

entries.original:
"Long ago, there was a readable
inscription on the tablet below.

However, it appears it has long
since eroded away.

From what I remember, I believe it
said something along the lines of:

PRESSING THE SWITCH WITH INSECT
IS THE KEY.

What ever could that mean?"
entries.translation_source: Long ago, there was a readable inscription on the tablet below. However, it appears it has long since eroded away. From what I remember, I believe it said something along the lines of: PRESSING THE SWITCH WITH INSECT IS THE KEY. What ever could that mean?
entries.translated:
Molto tempo fa, sulla tavoletta qui
sotto c{B4}era un{B4}iscrizione\lleggibile. Tuttavia, sembra che sia

stata erosa da tempo. Per quanto
ricordo, credo che dicesse più o\lmeno: PREMERE L{B4}INTERRUTTORE CON UN

COLEOTTERO È LA CHIAVE. Che cosa
potrebbe mai significare?

entries.original:
"It seems that the long-standing
tablet has finally been destroyed.

Were you responsible for removing
that piece of history?"
entries.translation_source: It seems that the long-standing tablet has finally been destroyed. Were you responsible for removing that piece of history?
entries.translated:
Sembra che la tavoletta di lunga
data sia stata finalmente\ldistrutta. Sei stato tu a rimuovere

quel pezzo di storia?

entries.original: "Victory Road"
entries.translation_source: Victory Road
entries.translated: Via Vittoria

entries.original:
"The last and toughest of trials
leading up to the Pokémon League.
Trainers seeking to become the best
arrive here after enduring a long
and grueling journey."
entries.translation_source: The last and toughest of trials leading up to the Pokémon League. Trainers seeking to become the best arrive here after enduring a long and grueling journey.
entries.translated:
L{B4}ultima e più difficile delle
prove che portano alla Lega\lPokémon. Gli Allenatori che

vogliono diventare i migliori
arrivano qui dopo aver sopportato\lun lungo e faticoso viaggio.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

Welcome, Trainer.

This final area of Victory Road is
known as the \qotorture chamber\qc.

All that remains between here and
the Pokémon League is this one\licy area.

But hey, I get it.

Not everyone wants to spend their
time sliding around looking for\lthe exit.

So, let’s cut a deal.

If you pay me $[green]200000[blue], I’ll send
you to the other side.

You won’t even have to get your
feet wet.

What do you say?
It’s only a measly $[green]200000[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh[game-token-1] Welcome, Trainer. This final area of Victory Road is known as the [quote-open-2]torture chamber[quote-close-3]. All that remains between here and the Pokémon League is this one icy area. But hey, I get it. Not everyone wants to spend their time sliding around looking for the exit. So, let’s cut a deal. If you pay me $[color-green-4]200000[color-blue-5], I’ll send you to the other side. You won’t even have to get your feet wet. What do you say? It’s only a measly $[color-green-6]200000[color-blue-7][game-token-8]
entries.translated:
Eheh, eheh, eheh\. Benvenuto,
Allenatore. Quest{B4}ultima area di\lVia Vittoria è conosciuta come la

\qocamera di tortura\qc. Tutto ciò che
rimane tra qui e la Lega Pokémon è\lquesta unica area ghiacciata. Ma

ehi, lo capisco. Non tutti vogliono
passare il tempo a scivolare in\lgiro cercando l{B4}uscita. Allora,

facciamo un patto. Se mi paghi
$[green]200000[blue], ti manderò dall{B4}altra\lparte. Non dovrai nemmeno bagnarti

i piedi. Che ne dici? Sono solo
miseri $[green]200000[blue]\.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

Welcome, Trainer.

This final area of Victory Road is
known as the \qotorture chamber\qc.

All that remains between here and
the Pokémon League is this one\licy area.

But hey, I get it.

Not everyone wants to spend their
time sliding around looking for\lthe exit.

So, let’s cut a deal.

If you pay me $[green]45000[blue], I’ll send
you to the other side.

You won’t even have to get your
feet wet.

What do you say?
It’s only a measly $[green]45000[blue]\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh[game-token-1] Welcome, Trainer. This final area of Victory Road is known as the [quote-open-2]torture chamber[quote-close-3]. All that remains between here and the Pokémon League is this one icy area. But hey, I get it. Not everyone wants to spend their time sliding around looking for the exit. So, let’s cut a deal. If you pay me $[color-green-4]45000[color-blue-5], I’ll send you to the other side. You won’t even have to get your feet wet. What do you say? It’s only a measly $[color-green-6]45000[color-blue-7][game-token-8]
entries.translated:
Heh, heh, heh\. Benvenuto,
Allenatore. Quest{B4}ultima area della\lVia Vittoria è conosciuta come la

\qocamera delle torture\qc. Tutto ciò
che resta tra qui e la Lega Pokémon\lè questa unica zona ghiacciata. Ma

ehi, capisco. Non tutti vogliono
passare il tempo a scivolare in\lcerca dell{B4}uscita. Quindi, facciamo

un patto. Se mi paghi $[green]45000[blue], ti
mando dall{B4}altra parte. Non dovrai\lnemmeno bagnarti i piedi. Che ne

dici? Sono solo miseri $[green]45000[blue]\.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

Pleasure doing business with you,
Trainer\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh[game-token-1] Pleasure doing business with you, Trainer[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Eh, eh, eh\. È stato un piacere fare
affari con te, Allenatore\.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

Good luck on the ice, Trainer\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh[game-token-1] Good luck on the ice, Trainer[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Heh, heh, heh\. Buona fortuna sul
ghiaccio, Allenatore\.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, huh?

You don’t have enough coin to
employ my services\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, huh? You don’t have enough coin to employ my services[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Eh, eh, huh? Non hai abbastanza
monete per ingaggiare i miei\lservizi\.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh\.

If you’ve made it this far, Insane
Trainer, then you can make it a\llittle farther on your own.

Just slide onto the ice and dive
deep into insanity\."
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh[game-token-1] If you’ve made it this far, Insane Trainer, then you can make it a little farther on your own. Just slide onto the ice and dive deep into insanity[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Eh, eh, eh\. Se sei arrivato fin qui,
Allenatore Folle, allora puoi\lspingerti un po{B4} più oltre da solo.

Basta scivolare sul ghiaccio e
tuffarti in profondità nella follia\.

entries.original:
"It’s an ingenious design, really.

To test Trainers’ strength, the
designers of Victory Road set up\la puzzle that must be solved in\lorder to progress any further.

That way, those lacking conviction
are forced to turn back."
entries.translation_source: It’s an ingenious design, really. To test Trainers’ strength, the designers of Victory Road set up a puzzle that must be solved in order to progress any further. That way, those lacking conviction are forced to turn back.
entries.translated:
È un progetto davvero ingegnoso.
Per mettere alla prova la forza\ldegli Allenatori, i progettisti di

Via Vittoria hanno ideato un enigma
che deve essere risolto per poter\lproseguire oltre. In questo modo,

chi manca di convinzione è
costretto a tornare indietro.

entries.original:
"Life is all about overcoming
hurdles!

Could you be a hurdle for me?"
entries.translation_source: Life is all about overcoming hurdles! Could you be a hurdle for me?
entries.translated:
La vita è tutta una questione di
superare gli ostacoli! Potresti\lessere un ostacolo per me?

entries.original:
"I couldn’t overcome the hurdle you
presented to me\."
entries.translation_source: I couldn’t overcome the hurdle you presented to me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Non sono riuscito a superare
l{B4}ostacolo che mi hai posto\.

entries.original:
"If you can’t overcome a hurdle, you
can always just go around it.

Keep going, and you’ll find the
greatest hurdle for Trainers:\lthe Pokémon League."
entries.translation_source: If you can’t overcome a hurdle, you can always just go around it. Keep going, and you’ll find the greatest hurdle for Trainers: the Pokémon League.
entries.translated:
Se non riesci a superare un
ostacolo, puoi sempre aggirarlo.\lContinua ad andare avanti e

troverai il più grande ostacolo per
gli Allenatori: la Lega Pokémon.

entries.original:
"There actually wasn’t any need to
prove how strong we are.

I already know how capable my
Pokémon and I are!"
entries.translation_source: There actually wasn’t any need to prove how strong we are. I already know how capable my Pokémon and I are!
entries.translated:
In realtà non c{B4}era bisogno di
dimostrare quanto siamo forti. So\lgià quanto siamo capaci io e i miei

Pokémon!

entries.original:
"You know what I think?

All people know what they can do
alone, but\.

There are a lot of things you can
only do with Pokémon, too!"
entries.translation_source: You know what I think? All people know what they can do alone, but[game-token-1] There are a lot of things you can only do with Pokémon, too!
entries.translated:
Sai cosa penso? Tutti sanno cosa
possono fare da soli, ma\. ci sono\lanche un sacco di cose che puoi

fare solo con i Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Do you aim to be the very best?

The very best Trainers know how to
use their Pokémon’s muscles to\lmove boulders around!"
entries.translation_source: Do you aim to be the very best? The very best Trainers know how to use their Pokémon’s muscles to move boulders around!
entries.translated:
Vuoi puntare a essere il migliore
in assoluto? I migliori Allenatori\lsanno usare i muscoli dei loro

Pokémon per spostare massi!

entries.original:
"I see no end to the endless battles
in front of me.

Even if you defeat me, which you
won’t, I’ll never stop!"
entries.translation_source: I see no end to the endless battles in front of me. Even if you defeat me, which you won’t, I’ll never stop!
entries.translated:
Non vedo alcuna fine alle battaglie
senza fine davanti a me. Anche se\lmi sconfiggerai, cosa che non

farai, non mi fermerò mai!

entries.original:
"Well, that didn’t go the way I
wanted it to!"
entries.translation_source: Well, that didn’t go the way I wanted it to!
entries.translated: Beh, non è andata come volevo!

entries.original:
"How do you stop me from fighting
you?

Push that boulder onto the pressure
plate, and I will no longer have a\lreason to fight."
entries.translation_source: How do you stop me from fighting you? Push that boulder onto the pressure plate, and I will no longer have a reason to fight.
entries.translated:
Come fai a impedirmi di
combatterti? Spingi quella roccia\lsulla piastra a pressione e non

avrò più alcun motivo per
combattere.

entries.original:
"The puzzle in this room isn’t part
of the Victory Road puzzle.

It has been around for much, much
longer.

Who could have set it up, I wonder?"
entries.translation_source: The puzzle in this room isn’t part of the Victory Road puzzle. It has been around for much, much longer. Who could have set it up, I wonder?
entries.translated:
L{B4}enigma in questa stanza non fa
parte dell{B4}enigma di Victory Road.\lEsiste da molto, moltissimo più

tempo. Chissà chi l{B4}avrà messo lì?

entries.original:
"I’d love to brag about my Pokémon,
but nature’s calling!"
entries.translation_source: I’d love to brag about my Pokémon, but nature’s calling!
entries.translated:
Mi piacerebbe vantarmi dei miei
Pokémon, ma devo andare in bagno!

entries.original:
"Two Tamers\.

One of Dragons, and the other
of\.

Wait\.

What exactly do I tame, again?"
entries.translation_source: Two Tamers[game-token-1] One of Dragons, and the other of[game-token-2] Wait[game-token-3] What exactly do I tame, again?
entries.translated:
Due Domatori\. Uno dei Draghi, e
l{B4}altro di\. Aspetta\. Cosa domo,\lesattamente?

entries.original:
"If I knew what I tamed, we wouldn’t
have lost."
entries.translation_source: If I knew what I tamed, we wouldn’t have lost.
entries.translated:
Se sapessi cosa ho addomesticato,
non avremmo perso.

entries.original:
"I teamed up with this Dragon Tamer
to help gain clarity into what\lexactly I tame."
entries.translation_source: I teamed up with this Dragon Tamer to help gain clarity into what exactly I tame.
entries.translated:
Mi sono alleato con questo
Domadraghi per fare chiarezza su\lciò che addomestico davvero.

entries.original:
"Two Tamers\.

If you want to battle us, you’ll
need more Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Two Tamers[game-token-1] If you want to battle us, you’ll need more Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Due Domatori\. Se vuoi sfidarci, ti
serviranno più Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Druddigon is the Cave Pokémon!

I caught mine right here in the
caves of Victory Road!"
entries.translation_source: Druddigon is the Cave Pokémon! I caught mine right here in the caves of Victory Road!
entries.translated:
Druddigon è il Pokémon Caverna! Io
ho catturato il mio proprio qui,\lnelle grotte della Via Vittoria!

entries.original:
"No!
My Cave Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: No! My Cave Pokémon!
entries.translated: No! I miei Pokémon della caverna!

entries.original:
"Gabite is also known as the Cave
Pokémon, but unlike Gabite,\lDruddigon is a pure Dragon-type."
entries.translation_source: Gabite is also known as the Cave Pokémon, but unlike Gabite, Druddigon is a pure Dragon-type.
entries.translated:
Gabite è noto anche come Pokémon
della Grotta, ma a differenza di\lGabite, Druddigon è di puro tipo

Drago.

entries.original:
"Bring more Pokémon if you want to
fight my wonderful Cave Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Bring more Pokémon if you want to fight my wonderful Cave Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Porta più Pokémon se vuoi sfidare i
miei fantastici Pokémon delle\lgrotte!

entries.original:
"My cousin and I came out here
because I accidentally burned all\lof his bugs."
entries.translation_source: My cousin and I came out here because I accidentally burned all of his bugs.
entries.translated:
Mio cugino e io siamo venuti qui
perché ho bruciato per sbaglio\ltutti i suoi insetti.

entries.original: "Don’t worry, his bugs are fine."
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry, his bugs are fine.
entries.translated:
Non preoccuparti, i suoi insetti
stanno bene.

entries.original:
"I convinced my cousin that the
best Bug-type could be found in\lthis area of Victory Road.

I didn’t realize the only Bug-type
around here is Durant."
entries.translation_source: I convinced my cousin that the best Bug-type could be found in this area of Victory Road. I didn’t realize the only Bug-type around here is Durant.
entries.translated:
Ho convinto mio cugino che il
miglior Pokémon di tipo Coleottero\lsi potesse trovare in quest{B4}area

della Via Vittoria. Non mi rendevo
conto che l{B4}unico tipo Coleottero\lda queste parti è Durant.

entries.original:
"I brought my cousin here to look
for Bug-type Pokémon.

Maybe if you had more Pokémon, we
would take a break and battle you."
entries.translation_source: I brought my cousin here to look for Bug-type Pokémon. Maybe if you had more Pokémon, we would take a break and battle you.
entries.translated:
Ho portato qui mio cugino per
cercare Pokémon di tipo Coleottero.\lForse se avessi più Pokémon, ci

fermeremmo a combattere contro di
te.

entries.original:
"Why is the only Bug-type Pokémon
here Durant?

My cousin promised me there were
great Bug-type Pokémon here!"
entries.translation_source: Why is the only Bug-type Pokémon here Durant? My cousin promised me there were great Bug-type Pokémon here!
entries.translated:
Perché l{B4}unico Pokémon di tipo
Coleottero qui è Durant? Mio cugino\lmi ha promesso che qui c{B4}erano

grandi Pokémon di tipo Coleottero!

entries.original:
"Cousin!

Your Heatmor’s trying to eat my
Durant again!"
entries.translation_source: Cousin! Your Heatmor’s trying to eat my Durant again!
entries.translated:
Cugino! Il tuo Heatmor cerca di
mangiare di nuovo il mio Durant!

entries.original:
"My cousin’s Heatmor is always
trying to eat the Durant I caught."
entries.translation_source: My cousin’s Heatmor is always trying to eat the Durant I caught.
entries.translated:
Il Heatmor di mio cugino cerca
sempre di mangiarsi il Durant che\lho catturato.

entries.original:
"We’re out here looking for bugs.
But all I can find is Durant!

If you had more Pokémon, I’d fight
you to express my frustration."
entries.translation_source: We’re out here looking for bugs. But all I can find is Durant! If you had more Pokémon, I’d fight you to express my frustration.
entries.translated:
Siamo qui a cercare insetti. Ma
tutto quello che riesco a trovare è\lDurant! Se avessi più Pokémon,

combatterei contro di te per
sfogare la mia frustrazione.

entries.original:
"Have a little taste of our
mother-daughter fighting style!"
entries.translation_source: Have a little taste of our mother-daughter fighting style!
entries.translated:
Assaggia un po{B4} il nostro stile di
lotta madre-figlia!

entries.original:
"Our mother-daughter combination has
seen better fights."
entries.translation_source: Our mother-daughter combination has seen better fights.
entries.translated:
La nostra combinazione madre-figlia
ha visto lotte migliori.

entries.original:
"My daughter looks up to Arabella
of the Elite Four.

Ever since she could speak, all she
could talk about was Arabella."
entries.translation_source: My daughter looks up to Arabella of the Elite Four. Ever since she could speak, all she could talk about was Arabella.
entries.translated:
Mia figlia ammira Arabella del
Superquattro. Da quando ha imparato\la parlare, non faceva che parlare

di Arabella.

entries.original:
"If you want to see some beautiful
mother-daughter power, bring more\lPokémon to battle with."
entries.translation_source: If you want to see some beautiful mother-daughter power, bring more Pokémon to battle with.
entries.translated:
Se vuoi vedere la splendida forza
di madre e figlia, porta più\lPokémon con cui combattere.

entries.original:
"Me and Mommy are super strong
when we fight together!"
entries.translation_source: Me and Mommy are super strong when we fight together!
entries.translated:
Io e la mamma siamo fortissimi
quando combattiamo insieme!

entries.original: "Me and Mommy\. we lost?"
entries.translation_source: Me and Mommy[game-token-1] we lost?
entries.translated: Io e la mamma\. abbiamo perso?

entries.original:
"I wanna be just like Arabella!

Super adorable and super powerful!"
entries.translation_source: I wanna be just like Arabella! Super adorable and super powerful!
entries.translated:
Voglio essere proprio come
Arabella! Super adorabile e super\lpotente!

entries.original:
"I wanna be just like Arabella!
She fights with two Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: I wanna be just like Arabella! She fights with two Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Voglio essere proprio come
Arabella! Lei lotta con due\lPokémon!

entries.original:
"I am a Pokémon Ranger!

If the hedges are in danger\.
Let me see your Pokémon in battle!"
entries.translation_source: I am a Pokémon Ranger! If the hedges are in danger[game-token-1] Let me see your Pokémon in battle!
entries.translated:
Sono un Pokémon Ranger! Se le siepi
sono in pericolo\. lasciami vedere i\ltuoi Pokémon in lotta!

entries.original:
"Your strength is fathomless!
I am deeply impressed."
entries.translation_source: Your strength is fathomless! I am deeply impressed.
entries.translated:
La tua forza è insondabile! Sono
profondamente impressionato.

entries.original:
"I aim to be the best Pokémon
Ranger in the world!

But my first step is to take care
of these hedges."
entries.translation_source: I aim to be the best Pokémon Ranger in the world! But my first step is to take care of these hedges.
entries.translated:
Punto a diventare il miglior
Pokémon Ranger del mondo! Ma il mio\lprimo passo è occuparmi di queste

siepi.

entries.original:
"It’s not enough for me just to be
together with Pokémon!

I want to win!

But I do know that some people feel
at ease just by being with their\lPokémon."
entries.translation_source: It’s not enough for me just to be together with Pokémon! I want to win! But I do know that some people feel at ease just by being with their Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Non mi basta stare semplicemente
insieme ai Pokémon! Io voglio\lvincere! Però so bene che alcune

persone si sentono a loro agio solo
stando con i propri Pokémon.

entries.original:
"My Pokémon was once injured badly
in a fight.

I’m just so grateful that we’re
still together after all that."
entries.translation_source: My Pokémon was once injured badly in a fight. I’m just so grateful that we’re still together after all that.
entries.translated:
Il mio Pokémon è rimasto gravemente
ferito in una lotta una volta. Sono\lcosì grato che siamo ancora insieme

dopo tutto questo.

entries.original:
"You are the wind.

A supple and comforting wind
blowing through Victory Road!"
entries.translation_source: You are the wind. A supple and comforting wind blowing through Victory Road!
entries.translated:
Tu sei il vento. Un vento morbido e
confortante che soffia attraverso\lVia Vittoria!

entries.original:
"A heated battle is good, but get
too hot and you might end up\lgetting burned!"
entries.translation_source: A heated battle is good, but get too hot and you might end up getting burned!
entries.translated:
Una lotta accesa è una bella cosa,
ma se ti scaldi troppo potresti\lfinire bruciato!

entries.original:
"Amazing\.
I think I got a bit singed."
entries.translation_source: Amazing[game-token-1] I think I got a bit singed.
entries.translated:
Fantastico\. Credo di essermi un po{B4}
scottato.

entries.original:
"Burning competitiveness and cool
logic\.

You’ll need both if you’re going to
go up against the Pokémon League."
entries.translation_source: Burning competitiveness and cool logic[game-token-1] You’ll need both if you’re going to go up against the Pokémon League.
entries.translated:
Competitività ardente e logica
fredda\. Ti serviranno entrambe se\lvuoi affrontare la Lega Pokémon.

entries.original:
"A fighting style overflowing with
power or a strategy that excels\ltechnically\.

It depends on the Pokémon, see!"
entries.translation_source: A fighting style overflowing with power or a strategy that excels technically[game-token-1] It depends on the Pokémon, see!
entries.translated:
Uno stile di combattimento che
trabocca di potenza o una strategia\lche eccelle tecnicamente\. Dipende

dal Pokémon, capisci!

entries.original:
"All I want are powerful Pokémon!

Only a Pokémon that understands
that can become one of my partners!"
entries.translation_source: All I want are powerful Pokémon! Only a Pokémon that understands that can become one of my partners!
entries.translated:
Tutto ciò che voglio sono Pokémon
forti! Solo un Pokémon che capisca\lquesto può diventare uno dei miei

compagni!

entries.original:
"Are you sure you want to seriously
take on someone like me, who\lseriously fights with her Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: Are you sure you want to seriously take on someone like me, who seriously fights with her Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Sei sicuro di voler affrontare sul
serio una come me, che combatte sul\lserio con i suoi Pokémon?

entries.original:
"This is the pain that comes from
seriously facing someone head-on\."
entries.translation_source: This is the pain that comes from seriously facing someone head-on[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Questo è il dolore che nasce dal
fronteggiare davvero qualcuno a\ltesta alta\.

entries.original:
"I battle seriously because I am
after serious strength.

There’s nothing worse than a
halfhearted opponent."
entries.translation_source: I battle seriously because I am after serious strength. There’s nothing worse than a halfhearted opponent.
entries.translated:
Combatto sul serio perché punto
alla forza vera. Non c{B4}è niente di\lpeggio di un avversario che ci

mette poco impegno.

entries.original:
"Not wanting to admit my own limits,
I am continuing to battle on\.

That is right!
At least I am persistent!"
entries.translation_source: Not wanting to admit my own limits, I am continuing to battle on[game-token-1] That is right! At least I am persistent!
entries.translated:
Non volendo ammettere i miei stessi
limiti, continuo a combattere\.\lEsatto! Almeno sono tenace!

entries.original:
"The people who pass by here have
such different moods!

It is enjoyable to watch, and even
more enjoyable to fight against\lthose people!"
entries.translation_source: The people who pass by here have such different moods! It is enjoyable to watch, and even more enjoyable to fight against those people!
entries.translated:
Le persone che passano di qui hanno
stati d{B4}animo così diversi! È\ldivertente osservarle, e ancora più

divertente combattere contro quelle
persone!

entries.original:
"Mwahaha!
It is fun!"
entries.translation_source: Mwahaha! It is fun!
entries.translated: Mwahaha! È divertente!

entries.original:
"Your Pokémon was in a really good
mood the moment that you won!

However\.

Your mood will worsen as you see
what is on the other side of this\lentryway\."
entries.translation_source: Your Pokémon was in a really good mood the moment that you won! However[game-token-1] Your mood will worsen as you see what is on the other side of this entryway[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Il tuo Pokémon era di ottimo umore
proprio nel momento in cui hai\lvinto! Tuttavia\. Il tuo umore

peggiorerà quando vedrai cosa c{B4}è
dall{B4}altra parte di questo\lpassaggio\.

"People around here used to be
afraid to leave their homes because\lof some cloaked gang that invaded\lour town."
entries.translation_source: People around here used to be afraid to leave their homes because of some cloaked gang that invaded our town.
entries.translated:
Da queste parti la gente aveva
paura a uscire di casa per colpa di\luna banda incappucciata che ha

invaso la nostra città.

entries.original:
"When the cloaked gang left town,
the sun started shining, and the\lflowers started blooming again!

I’m so happy, I want to share my
joy with you!"
entries.translation_source: When the cloaked gang left town, the sun started shining, and the flowers started blooming again! I’m so happy, I want to share my joy with you!
entries.translated:
Quando la banda incappucciata ha
lasciato la città, il sole ha\lricominciato a splendere e i fiori

hanno ripreso a sbocciare! Sono
così felice che voglio condividere\lcon te la mia gioia!

entries.original:
"It still rains here every now and
again, but at least it’s never an\leternal rain like when that cloaked\lgang was here.

What did they do to get the weather
to act like that?"
entries.translation_source: It still rains here every now and again, but at least it’s never an eternal rain like when that cloaked gang was here. What did they do to get the weather to act like that?
entries.translated:
Qui piove ancora ogni tanto, ma
almeno non è mai una pioggia eterna\lcome quando quella banda

incappucciata era qui. Cosa hanno
fatto per far impazzire il meteo\lcosì?

entries.translated:
[player]{B4}s Blue Orb ha iniziato a
brillare all{B4}improvviso!

"Munch munch\.

You like chewing on seeds, pal?

Chew ’em hard enough, and you can
garner some explosive fire power!

I’d even be willing to teach a
Pokémon how to do this with\lthe move [green]Seed Bomb[blue] for a measly\l[green][buffer2] [buffer1]s[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Munch munch[game-token-1] You like chewing on seeds, pal? Chew ’em hard enough, and you can garner some explosive fire power! I’d even be willing to teach a Pokémon how to do this with the move [color-green-2]Seed Bomb[color-blue-3] for a measly [color-green-4][buffer2-5] [buffer1-6]s[color-blue-7].
entries.translated:
Mastica, mastica\. Ti piace
sgranocchiare semi, amico?\lMasticane abbastanza forte, e

potrai ricavarne un po{B4} di potere
di fuoco esplosivo! Sarei persino\ldisposto a insegnare a un Pokémon

come fare con la mossa [green]Semebomba[blue]
per la misera somma di [green][buffer2]\l[buffer1]s[blue].

entries.original:
"Which Pokémon wants to learn how
to shoot explosive seeds from their\lmouth with [green]Seed Bomb[blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Which Pokémon wants to learn how to shoot explosive seeds from their mouth with [color-green-1]Seed Bomb[color-blue-2]?
entries.translated:
Quale Pokémon vuole imparare a
sparare semi esplosivi dalla bocca\lcon [green]Semebomba[blue]?

entries.original: "Kaboom!"
entries.translation_source: Kaboom!
entries.translated: Boom!

"You can chew on seeds, but that’s
about all you can do with the\lamount of [green][buffer1]s[blue] you have\."
entries.translation_source: You can chew on seeds, but that’s about all you can do with the amount of [color-green-1][buffer1-2]s[color-blue-3] you have[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Puoi masticare dei semi, ma è più o
meno tutto quello che puoi fare con\lla quantità di [green][buffer1]s[blue] che hai\.

entries.translated:
Niente fortuna neanche stavolta,
eh?

Pokémon [buffer1]!

[buffer1]! Non quello!

"Aww, sweet!
Fungus is now among us!"
entries.translation_source: Aww, sweet! Fungus is now among us!
entries.translated:
Aww, che dolce! Fungus è tra noi
ora!

"How do you like your new mushroom
Pokémon?

I know mushrooms are delicious,
but try to hold yourself back\lfrom eating it!"
entries.translation_source: How do you like your new mushroom Pokémon? I know mushrooms are delicious, but try to hold yourself back from eating it!
entries.translated:
Che ne pensi del tuo nuovo Pokémon
fungo? So che i funghi sono\ldeliziosi, ma cerca di resistere

alla tentazione di mangiarlo!

entries.original: "Trader Traitor"
entries.translation_source: Trader Traitor
entries.translated: Il mercante traditore

entries.original:
"Are Pokémon just property? Trade
Pokémon with Borrians to find out!"
entries.translation_source: Are Pokémon just property? Trade Pokémon with Borrians to find out!
entries.translated:
I Pokémon sono solo proprietà?
Scambia Pokémon con i Borrians per\lscoprirlo!

entries.original:
"My sister Mindy and I have
recently been engaged in a heated\ldebate on whether Pokémon are\lcompanions or property.

On one hand, they have feelings,
but on the other hand, they can be\ltraded or sold.

Can you help me make my point by
trading many Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: My sister Mindy and I have recently been engaged in a heated debate on whether Pokémon are companions or property. On one hand, they have feelings, but on the other hand, they can be traded or sold. Can you help me make my point by trading many Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Mia sorella Mindy ed io siamo
recentemente stati coinvolti in un\lacceso dibattito sul fatto che i

Pokémon siano compagni o proprietà.
Da un lato, hanno dei sentimenti,\lma dall{B4}altro, possono essere

scambiati o venduti. Puoi aiutarmi
a dimostrare il mio punto\lscambiando molti Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Thank you.

To make my point, I will need you
to trade with every person in\lBorrius that is willing."
entries.translation_source: Thank you. To make my point, I will need you to trade with every person in Borrius that is willing.
entries.translated:
Grazie. Per dimostrare il mio
punto, avrò bisogno che tu faccia\lscambio con ogni persona di Borrius

che sia disposta.

entries.original:
"Great work.

By trading Pokémon, you have
proven they are just property that\lcan be reduced to a series of\lnumbers and sent over a cable.

For helping me prove my point,
take this."
entries.translation_source: Great work. By trading Pokémon, you have proven they are just property that can be reduced to a series of numbers and sent over a cable. For helping me prove my point, take this.
entries.translated:
Ottimo lavoro. Scambiando Pokémon,
hai dimostrato che sono solo\lproprietà che possono essere

ridotti a una serie di numeri e
inviati tramite un cavo. Per avermi\laiutato a dimostrare il mio punto,

prendi questo.

entries.original:
"It looks like there are still
residents of Borrius that are\lwilling to trade.

Trade with all of them, and then
I’ll give you a nice reward."
entries.translation_source: It looks like there are still residents of Borrius that are willing to trade. Trade with all of them, and then I’ll give you a nice reward.
entries.translated:
Sembra che ci siano ancora abitanti
di Borrius disposti a scambiare.\lFai scambi con tutti loro, e poi ti

darò una bella ricompensa.

entries.original:
"So, you think Pokémon are just
companions, huh?

Well, I’m sure if someone offered
you a good enough trade you would\loblige them."
entries.translation_source: So, you think Pokémon are just companions, huh? Well, I’m sure if someone offered you a good enough trade you would oblige them.
entries.translated:
Quindi pensi che i Pokémon siano
solo compagni, eh? Beh, sono sicuro\lche se qualcuno ti offrisse uno

scambio abbastanza conveniente,
accetteresti.

entries.original:
"When you catch a Pokémon, it’s
yours to sell and trade as you\lplease."
entries.translation_source: When you catch a Pokémon, it’s yours to sell and trade as you please.
entries.translated:
Quando catturi un Pokémon, è tuo e
puoi venderlo e scambiarlo come\lpreferisci.
