"I’m very particular about the
[green][buffer1][blue] of Pokémon!

That’s why I’m wondering if you
have any Pokémon with a [green][buffer1][blue]\lof [green][buffer2][blue] or greater with you!"
entries.translation_source: I’m very particular about the [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] of Pokémon! That’s why I’m wondering if you have any Pokémon with a [color-green-4][buffer1-5][color-blue-6] of [color-green-7][buffer2-8][color-blue-9] or greater with you!
entries.translated:
Sono molto pignolo riguardo al
[green][buffer1][blue] dei Pokémon! Ecco perché\lmi chiedo se hai con te qualche

Pokémon con un [green][buffer1][blue] di [green][buffer2][blue]
o superiore!

entries.original:
"Well, which of your Pokémon has a
[green][buffer1][blue] of [green][buffer2][blue] or greater?"
entries.translation_source: Well, which of your Pokémon has a [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] of [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6] or greater?
entries.translated:
Allora, quale dei tuoi Pokémon ha
un [green][buffer1][blue] di [green][buffer2][blue] o\lsuperiore?

entries.original:
"Your [buffer1] is [buffer2]!
Just like I like them!

That makes me really happy,
so I’ll give you this!"
entries.translation_source: Your [buffer1-1] is [buffer2-2]! Just like I like them! That makes me really happy, so I’ll give you this!
entries.translated:
Il tuo [buffer1] è [buffer2]! Proprio
come piacciono a me! Questo mi\lrende davvero felice, quindi ti

darò questo!

entries.original:
"Don’t worry! There’s more to
Pokémon than [buffer1].

But, today, I’d sure like to see a
Pokémon with [green][buffer1][blue] of [green][buffer2][blue]\lor greater!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry! There’s more to Pokémon than [buffer1-1]. But, today, I’d sure like to see a Pokémon with [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] of [color-green-5][buffer2-6][color-blue-7] or greater!
entries.translated:
Non preoccuparti! Nei Pokémon c{B4}è
molto di più di [buffer1]. Ma, oggi,\lmi piacerebbe proprio vedere un

Pokémon con [green][buffer1][blue] di [green][buffer2][blue] o
superiore!

entries.original:
"That Pokémon’s [buffer1] isn’t
high enough!

Today, I’d sure like to see a
Pokémon with [green][buffer1][blue] of [green][buffer2][blue]\lor greater!"
entries.translation_source: That Pokémon’s [buffer1-1] isn’t high enough! Today, I’d sure like to see a Pokémon with [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-blue-4] of [color-green-5][buffer2-6][color-blue-7] or greater!
entries.translated:
Il [buffer1] di quel Pokémon non è
abbastanza alto! Oggi vorrei\lproprio vedere un Pokémon con

[green][buffer1][blue] di [green][buffer2][blue] o superiore!

entries.original:
"There are many different Pokémon
with many different stats!

If you’d like, please come visit me
again tomorrow, okay?"
entries.translation_source: There are many different Pokémon with many different stats! If you’d like, please come visit me again tomorrow, okay?
entries.translated:
Ci sono molti Pokémon diversi con
statistiche diverse! Se vuoi, torna\la trovarmi domani, d{B4}accordo?

entries.original: "strong"
entries.translation_source: strong
entries.translated: forte

entries.original: "tough"
entries.translation_source: tough
entries.translated: tenace

entries.original: "fast"
entries.translation_source: fast
entries.translated: veloce

entries.original:
"My brother caught his Pokémon by
talking to a Poké Ball hidden\lunder a tree top in Vivill Woods.

Different Trainers encounter
different Pokémon by doing that,\lI’ve heard."
entries.translation_source: My brother caught his Pokémon by talking to a Poké Ball hidden under a tree top in Vivill Woods. Different Trainers encounter different Pokémon by doing that, I’ve heard.
entries.translated:
Mio fratello ha catturato il suo
Pokémon parlando a una Poké Ball\lnascosta sotto la cima di un albero

nei Vivill Woods. Ho sentito che
facendo così Allenatori diversi\lincontrano Pokémon diversi.

entries.original:
"Ever since the warehouse on the
hill was abandoned by the cloaked\lgang, I’ve heard a sad cry\lemanating from deep beneath the\locean waves.

It almost sounds prehistoric\."
entries.translation_source: Ever since the warehouse on the hill was abandoned by the cloaked gang, I’ve heard a sad cry emanating from deep beneath the ocean waves. It almost sounds prehistoric[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Da quando il magazzino sulla
collina è stato abbandonato dalla\lbanda incappucciata, sento un

lamento triste provenire dalle
profondità sotto le onde\ldell{B4}oceano. Sembra quasi

preistorico\.

entries.original:
"The sad cry I was hearing from the
warehouse has stopped.

I wonder, was the cry of a Pokémon
who was taken from its home by\lthe cloaked gang?

I suppose we will never know for
sure, now."
entries.translation_source: The sad cry I was hearing from the warehouse has stopped. I wonder, was the cry of a Pokémon who was taken from its home by the cloaked gang? I suppose we will never know for sure, now.
entries.translated:
Il verso triste che sentivo
provenire dal magazzino è cessato.\lChissà, era il lamento di un

Pokémon che era stato portato via
da casa sua dalla banda\lincappucciata? Suppongo che non lo

sapremo mai con certezza, ormai.

entries.original:
"When those strange thugs marched
into town not too long ago, we were\lall sure to lock our doors quickly.

If we hadn’t, I bet they would have
barged in here just like you and\ltaken all our valuables for\lwhatever their nefarious plot was."
entries.translation_source: When those strange thugs marched into town not too long ago, we were all sure to lock our doors quickly. If we hadn’t, I bet they would have barged in here just like you and taken all our valuables for whatever their nefarious plot was.
entries.translated:
Quando quegli strani teppisti sono
entrati in città non molto tempo\lfa, ci siamo tutti affrettati a

chiudere a chiave le porte. Se non
l{B4}avessimo fatto, scommetto che\lsarebbero entrati qui dentro

proprio come hai fatto tu e
avrebbero portato via tutti i\lnostri oggetti di valore, qualunque

fosse il loro piano malvagio.

entries.original: "Vivill Warehouse"
entries.translation_source: Vivill Warehouse
entries.translated: Magazzino di Vivill

entries.original:
"An abandoned warehouse overlooking
the ocean in Vivill Town.
Sightings of strange cloaked figures
have been reported there recently."
entries.translation_source: An abandoned warehouse overlooking the ocean in Vivill Town. Sightings of strange cloaked figures have been reported there recently.
entries.translated:
Un magazzino abbandonato che domina
l{B4}oceano a Vivill Town. Di recente\lsono stati segnalati avvistamenti

di strane figure incappucciate.

entries.original:
"[black]Yowch!
That’s hot!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Yowch! That’s hot!
entries.translated: [black]Ahi! È bollente!

entries.original:
"[blue]How could you betray us,
Billy?

The Shadows made you into the man
you are!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]How could you betray us, Billy? The Shadows made you into the man you are!
entries.translated:
[blue]Come hai potuto tradirci, Billy? Le
Ombre ti hanno reso l{B4}uomo che sei!

entries.original:
"[blue]Me!?

You’re the one who betrayed us!

We got paid to follow orders,
not ask questions, Ronald!

And since Aklove’s our new leader,
you should be on our side!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Me!? You’re the one who betrayed us! We got paid to follow orders, not ask questions, Ronald! And since Aklove’s our new leader, you should be on our side!
entries.translated:
[blue]Io!? Sei tu quello che ci ha
traditi! Siamo stati pagati per\leseguire ordini, non per fare

domande, Ronald! E visto che Aklove
è il nostro nuovo leader, dovresti\lstare dalla nostra parte!

entries.original:
"[red]Just join us!

What’s the point in still working
for Zeph?"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Just join us! What’s the point in still working for Zeph?
entries.translated:
[red]Unisciti a noi e basta! Che senso
ha continuare a lavorare per Zeph?

entries.original:
"[red]He hired me himself!

I don’t care what the Science Society
tells you to do\.

I’m sticking with him!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]He hired me himself! I don’t care what the Science Society tells you to do[game-token-2] I’m sticking with him!
entries.translated:
[red]Mi ha assunto lui in persona! Non
mi importa di quello che la Società\lScientifica ti dice di fare\. Resto

con lui!

entries.original: "Stop right there, Shadow!"
entries.translation_source: Stop right there, Shadow!
entries.translated: Fermati subito, Shadow!

entries.original: "Wait\. you’re not a Shadow grunt\."
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1] you’re not a Shadow grunt[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Aspetta\. non sei una recluta del
Team Ombra\.

entries.original:
"It’s dangerous for a little Trainer
to be wandering around right now.

Don’t you know?

Those creatures roaming around lash
out at anything they see."
entries.translation_source: It’s dangerous for a little Trainer to be wandering around right now. Don’t you know? Those creatures roaming around lash out at anything they see.
entries.translated:
È pericoloso per un giovane
Allenatore girovagare in giro\ladesso. Non lo sai? Quelle creature

che vagano in giro attaccano
qualsiasi cosa vedano.

entries.original: "Floette"
entries.translation_source: Floette
entries.translated: Floette

entries.original: "Floette! Use Dazzle Gleam!"
entries.translation_source: Floette! Use Dazzle Gleam!
entries.translated: Floette! Usa Magibrillio!

entries.original: "[blue]Flo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Flo!
entries.translated: [blue]Flo!

entries.original: "[lightgreen]Flo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-lightgreen-1]Flo!
entries.translated: [lightgreen]Flo!

entries.original: "[orange]Flo!"
entries.translation_source: [color-orange-1]Flo!
entries.translated: [orange]Flo!

entries.original:
"[black]The Shadow Warrior is currently in
battle with a Floette.

Remove its cloak?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Shadow Warrior is currently in battle with a Floette. Remove its cloak?
entries.translated:
[black]Il Guerriero dell{B4}Ombra è
attualmente in lotta con una\lFloette. Vuoi rimuovere il suo

mantello?

entries.original: "[black][player] tugged on the cloak."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] tugged on the cloak.
entries.translated: [black][player] ha tirato il mantello.

entries.original: "[black]The Shadow Warrior is furious!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Shadow Warrior is furious!
entries.translated: [black]Il Guerriero Ombra è furioso!

entries.original:
"If I can’t beat you, there’s no way
I could beat a Shadow Warrior!

But maybe our Admin could\.

If only I could get to her\.

Unfortunately, I only know that one
of the letters of the Command\lCentre’s password is [green]A[blue].

I’ll need more than that to get
in there, though."
entries.translation_source: If I can’t beat you, there’s no way I could beat a Shadow Warrior! But maybe our Admin could[game-token-1] If only I could get to her[game-token-2] Unfortunately, I only know that one of the letters of the Command Centre’s password is [color-green-3]A[color-blue-4]. I’ll need more than that to get in there, though.
entries.translated:
Se non riesco a batterti, non c{B4}è
modo che io possa battere un\lGuerriero Ombra! Però magari la

nostra Admin potrebbe\. Se solo
potessi arrivare da lei\. Purtroppo\lso soltanto che una delle lettere

della password del Centro di
Comando è [green]A[blue]. Mi servirà\lqualcos{B4}altro per entrare lì, però.

entries.original:
"If I can’t beat you, there’s no way
I could beat a Shadow Warrior!

But maybe our Admin could\.

If only I could get to her\.

Unfortunately, I only know that the
Command Centre’s password starts\lwith [green]A[blue].

I’ll need more than that to get
in there, though."
entries.translation_source: If I can’t beat you, there’s no way I could beat a Shadow Warrior! But maybe our Admin could[game-token-1] If only I could get to her[game-token-2] Unfortunately, I only know that the Command Centre’s password starts with [color-green-3]A[color-blue-4]. I’ll need more than that to get in there, though.
entries.translated:
Se non riesco a batterti, non c{B4}è
modo che possa sconfiggere un\lGuerriero Ombra! Ma forse potrebbe

farcela il nostro Admin\. Se solo
riuscissi a raggiungerla\. Purtroppo\lso solo che la password del Centro

Comando inizia con [green]A[blue]. Però mi
servirà qualcosa di più per entrare\llà dentro.

entries.original:
"[blue]I just saw you tug on that Shadow
Warrior’s cloak!

The only way you could know they’re
weak to light is if you’re in\lleague with the traitor Shadows!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]I just saw you tug on that Shadow Warrior’s cloak! The only way you could know they’re weak to light is if you’re in league with the traitor Shadows!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ti ho appena visto tirare il
mantello di quel Guerriero Ombra!\lL{B4}unico modo in cui potresti sapere

che sono deboli alla luce è se sei
in combutta con le Ombre\ltraditrici!

entries.original:
"[blue]And if you’re in league with the
Shadows, then I must defeat you!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]And if you’re in league with the Shadows, then I must defeat you!
entries.translated:
[blue]E se sei in combutta con le Ombre,
allora dovrò sconfiggerti!

entries.original:
"[blue]Why don’t you do what you came to
do then, huh?

Go fight our Admin, but just leave
the rest of us alone!

One of the letters for the password
to the Command Centre is [green]K[blue]!

That’s where she is, so go!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Why don’t you do what you came to do then, huh? Go fight our Admin, but just leave the rest of us alone! One of the letters for the password to the Command Centre is [color-green-2]K[color-blue-3]! That’s where she is, so go!
entries.translated:
[blue]Perché non fai quello che sei
venuto a fare, eh? Vai a combattere\lcontro il nostro Admin, ma lasciaci

in pace noi altri! Una delle
lettere della password per il\lCentro Comando è [green]K[blue]! È lì che si

trova, quindi vai!

entries.original:
"[red]You’re one of them, aren’t you?

You came to attack our base!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]You’re one of them, aren’t you? You came to attack our base!
entries.translated:
[red]Sei uno di loro, vero? Sei venuto
ad attaccare la nostra base!

entries.original: "[red]I won’t let you destroy it!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I won’t let you destroy it!
entries.translated: [red]Non ti lascerò distruggerlo!

entries.original:
"Please don’t destroy this base!
It’s the only home I have\."
entries.translation_source: Please don’t destroy this base! It’s the only home I have[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Per favore, non distruggere questa
base! È l{B4}unica casa che ho\.

entries.original:
"[red]Fine! I’ll tell you one of the
letters of the Command Centre’s\lpassword!

One of the letters is [green]L[red]!

Just please, stop attacking
our base!

If you refuse to leave, then at
least leave the power grid alone!

If it goes down, we’ll all be
trapped forever\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Fine! I’ll tell you one of the letters of the Command Centre’s password! One of the letters is [color-green-2]L[color-red-3]! Just please, stop attacking our base! If you refuse to leave, then at least leave the power grid alone! If it goes down, we’ll all be trapped forever[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[red]Va bene! Ti dirò una delle lettere
della password del Centro Comando!\lUna delle lettere è [green]L[red]! Ti prego,

smettila di attaccare la nostra
base! Se rifiuti di andartene,\lallora almeno lascia stare la rete

elettrica! Se va giù, saremo tutti
intrappolati per sempre\.

entries.original:
"Oh!

You just saved me from that
Shadow Warrior!

How did you know how to do that?"
entries.translation_source: Oh! You just saved me from that Shadow Warrior! How did you know how to do that?
entries.translated:
Oh! Mi hai appena salvato da quel
Guerriero Ombra! Come facevi a\lsapere come farlo?

entries.original:
"Oh, you must be with the Shadows.

But it’s alright, I won’t attack
you.

You can’t be all bad if you got
rid of one of your own.

Besides, I’m grateful for your
help."
entries.translation_source: Oh, you must be with the Shadows. But it’s alright, I won’t attack you. You can’t be all bad if you got rid of one of your own. Besides, I’m grateful for your help.
entries.translated:
Oh, devi essere con le Ombre. Ma va
bene, non ti attaccherò. Non puoi\lessere del tutto cattivo se vi

siete liberati di uno dei vostri.
Inoltre, sono grato per il vostro\laiuto.

entries.original:
"I assume you’re trying to reach our
Admin in the Command Centre?

I can’t help much with that, but I
can at least let you know that one\lof the letters of the Command\lCentre’s password is [green]O[red].

If you need anything else from me,
please feel free to ask."
entries.translation_source: I assume you’re trying to reach our Admin in the Command Centre? I can’t help much with that, but I can at least let you know that one of the letters of the Command Centre’s password is [color-green-1]O[color-red-2]. If you need anything else from me, please feel free to ask.
entries.translated:
Immagino che tu stia cercando di
raggiungere il nostro Admin nel\lCommand Centre? Non posso aiutarti

molto, ma posso almeno dirti che
una delle lettere della password\ldel Command Centre è [green]O[red]. Se hai

bisogno di altro da me, sentiti
libero di chiedere.

entries.original:
"If you need anything from me,
please feel free to ask."
entries.translation_source: If you need anything from me, please feel free to ask.
entries.translated:
Se hai bisogno di qualcosa da me,
chiedi pure.

entries.original:
"Sure, I can heal your Pokémon.

Please lie down on one of these
beds, first."
entries.translation_source: Sure, I can heal your Pokémon. Please lie down on one of these beds, first.
entries.translated:
Certo, posso curare il tuo Pokémon.
Per favore, sdraiati prima su uno\ldi questi letti.

entries.original:
"Did your Pokémon get hurt?

Please, lie down on one of these
beds so I can heal them."
entries.translation_source: Did your Pokémon get hurt? Please, lie down on one of these beds so I can heal them.
entries.translated:
I tuoi Pokémon si sono fatti male?
Per favore, sdraiati su uno di\lquesti letti così posso curarli.

entries.original:
"All set!

You and your Pokémon are
all rested up."
entries.translation_source: All set! You and your Pokémon are all rested up.
entries.translated:
Tutto a posto! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon
siete completamente riposati.

entries.original:
"Oh, did you forget which letter
I gave you?

One of the letters of the Command
Centre’s password is [green]O[red]."
entries.translation_source: Oh, did you forget which letter I gave you? One of the letters of the Command Centre’s password is [color-green-1]O[color-red-2].
entries.translated:
Oh, hai dimenticato quale lettera
ti ho dato? Una delle lettere della\lpassword del Centro Comando è [green]O[red].

entries.original:
"The base is split into eight
different sections.

The main areas are the Power Grid,
Break Room, Cafeteria, Rest Room,\land Research Lab.

Other smaller areas include the
storage areas, the living spaces,\land the Command Centre.

The living spaces and the Command
Centre can only be accessed via\lthe Research Lab.

But with the Research Lab now
underwater, the living spaces, as\lwell as some storage areas have\lbeen completely cut off.

However, for some reason, the
Command Centre is still accessible."
entries.translation_source: The base is split into eight different sections. The main areas are the Power Grid, Break Room, Cafeteria, Rest Room, and Research Lab. Other smaller areas include the storage areas, the living spaces, and the Command Centre. The living spaces and the Command Centre can only be accessed via the Research Lab. But with the Research Lab now underwater, the living spaces, as well as some storage areas have been completely cut off. However, for some reason, the Command Centre is still accessible.
entries.translated:
La base è divisa in otto sezioni
diverse. Le aree principali sono la\lRete Elettrica, la Sala Pausa, la

Mensa, il Bagno e il Laboratorio di
Ricerca. Altre aree più piccole\lincludono le aree di stoccaggio,

gli spazi abitativi e il Centro di
Comando. Gli spazi abitativi e il\lCentro di Comando possono essere

raggiunti solo attraverso il
Laboratorio di Ricerca. Ma con il\lLaboratorio di Ricerca ora

sott{B4}acqua, gli spazi abitativi,
così come alcune aree di\lstoccaggio, sono stati

completamente isolati. Tuttavia,
per qualche motivo, il Centro di\lComando è ancora accessibile.

entries.original: "Heal Pokémon"
entries.translation_source: Heal Pokémon
entries.translated: Cura Pokémon

entries.original: "Password"
entries.translation_source: Password
entries.translated: Password

entries.original:
"Oh, non, non, non!

If ze Shadow Warrior gets to ze
food, it’s all over for my belly!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, non, non, non! If ze Shadow Warrior gets to ze food, it’s all over for my belly!
entries.translated:
Oh, no, no, no! Se lo Shadow
Warrior arriva al cibo, per il mio\lpancino è finita!

entries.original:
"When I was a chef for ze Shadows,
they made me feed every single one\lof ze Shadow Warriors.

Zey have quite the appetite!

Who knew undead creatures needed
so much energy to survive?"
entries.translation_source: When I was a chef for ze Shadows, they made me feed every single one of ze Shadow Warriors. Zey have quite the appetite! Who knew undead creatures needed so much energy to survive?
entries.translated:
Quando ero cuoco per ze Shadows, mi
facevano dare da mangiare a ogni\lsingolo Shadow Warrior. Hanno

davvero un bell{B4}appetito! Chi
avrebbe mai detto che delle\lcreature non morte avessero bisogno

di così tanta energia per
sopravvivere?

entries.original:
"This warehouse used to be our
Science Society headquarters\lbefore we moved out east.

So naturally, only we know how to
maintain the power grid.

If it were to go offline, all of
the warp panels would stop working."
entries.translation_source: This warehouse used to be our Science Society headquarters before we moved out east. So naturally, only we know how to maintain the power grid. If it were to go offline, all of the warp panels would stop working.
entries.translated:
Questo magazzino era il quartier
generale della nostra Società\lScientifica prima che ci

trasferissimo a est. Quindi,
naturalmente, solo noi sappiamo\lcome mantenere la rete elettrica.

Se dovesse andare offline, tutti i
pannelli warp smetterebbero di\lfunzionare.

entries.original:
"I just don’t understand!

I thought we ended the Shadow
Warrior project when we became\lthe Light of Ruin!

We achieved our Chief Scientist’s
goal and everything!

So why\.\CC0820 why are there more of
them!?"
entries.translation_source: I just don’t understand! I thought we ended the Shadow Warrior project when we became the Light of Ruin! We achieved our Chief Scientist’s goal and everything! So why[game-token-1][control-code-2] why are there more of them!?
entries.translated:
Non capisco proprio! Pensavo che
avessimo concluso il progetto\lShadow Warrior quando siamo

diventati la Light of Ruin! Abbiamo
raggiunto l{B4}obiettivo del nostro\lCapo Scienziato e tutto il resto!

Allora perché\.\CC0820 perché ce ne sono
altri!?

entries.original: "You’re no Shadow Warrior\."
entries.translation_source: You’re no Shadow Warrior[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Non sei un Guerriero Ombra\.

entries.original: "If only our Admin was here to help\."
entries.translation_source: If only our Admin was here to help[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Se solo il nostro Admin fosse qui
ad aiutare\.

entries.original:
"If you’re looking for our Admin,
she’s in the [green]Command Centre[blue].

You can get there by taking the
warp panel in the [green]Research Lab[blue]."
entries.translation_source: If you’re looking for our Admin, she’s in the [color-green-1]Command Centre[color-blue-2]. You can get there by taking the warp panel in the [color-green-3]Research Lab[color-blue-4].
entries.translated:
Se stai cercando la nostra
Amministratrice, si trova nel\l[green]Centro di Comando[blue]. Puoi

raggiungerlo prendendo il pannello
di teletrasporto nel [green]Laboratorio di\lRicerca[blue].

entries.original: "No\.\CC0818 get away from me!"
entries.translation_source: No[game-token-1][control-code-2] get away from me!
entries.translated: No\.\CC0818 Allontanati da me!

entries.original:
"You! This is your fault!

If you and your friend hadn’t wiped
out my Granbull, I’d be able to\ldefend myself!"
entries.translation_source: You! This is your fault! If you and your friend hadn’t wiped out my Granbull, I’d be able to defend myself!
entries.translated:
Tu! È tutta colpa tua! Se tu e il
tuo amico non aveste fatto fuori il\lmio Granbull, sarei in grado di

difendermi!

entries.original:
"Serves you right.

But I guess I do actually owe you
and your friend.

If he hadn’t knocked me out
earlier, I could’ve been attacked\llike all those other grunts\."
entries.translation_source: Serves you right. But I guess I do actually owe you and your friend. If he hadn’t knocked me out earlier, I could’ve been attacked like all those other grunts[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Te sta bene. Però immagino di
dovervi davvero qualcosa, a te e al\ltuo amico. Se non mi avesse messo

KO prima, avrei potuto essere
attaccato come tutti quegli altri\lscagnozzi\.

entries.original:
"I don’t know much, but I can tell
you that one of the letters of\lthe Command Centre’s password is [green]V[blue].

Now we’re even."
entries.translation_source: I don’t know much, but I can tell you that one of the letters of the Command Centre’s password is [color-green-1]V[color-blue-2]. Now we’re even.
entries.translated:
Non so molto, ma posso dirti che
una delle lettere della password\ldel Centro Comando è [green]V[blue]. Ora siamo

pari.

entries.original:
"[player], I’m glad you followed
through and made it out here.

Keep an eye out for the new Shadow
Warriors we sent to keep the Light\lof Ruin distracted.

They’ll attack you on the spot if
you’re not careful.

But don’t feel bad about taking
any out.

We did promise your father we’d
destroy them eventually."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], I’m glad you followed through and made it out here. Keep an eye out for the new Shadow Warriors we sent to keep the Light of Ruin distracted. They’ll attack you on the spot if you’re not careful. But don’t feel bad about taking any out. We did promise your father we’d destroy them eventually.
entries.translated:
[player], sono contento che tu
abbia mantenuto la parola e sia\lvenuto fin qui. Tieni d{B4}occhio i

nuovi Shadow Warriors che abbiamo
mandato per tenere distratto il\lLight of Ruin. Ti attaccheranno sul

posto se non fai attenzione. Ma non
sentirti in colpa se ne elimini\lqualcuno. Abbiamo promesso a tuo

padre che prima o poi li avremmo
distrutti.

entries.original:
"Get that door open, scientist!

I’m not paying you to just
stand around!"
entries.translation_source: Get that door open, scientist! I’m not paying you to just stand around!
entries.translated:
Apri quella porta, scienziato! Non
ti pago per startene lì a non fare\lniente!

entries.original:
"So, you made it after all, [buffer1].

If you’re here to help, assist that
scientist with opening the door.

At least one of [green]Aklove[blue]’s cronies
must know the password."
entries.translation_source: So, you made it after all, [buffer1-1]. If you’re here to help, assist that scientist with opening the door. At least one of [color-green-2]Aklove[color-blue-3]’s cronies must know the password.
entries.translated:
Quindi, alla fine ce l{B4}hai fatta,
[buffer1]. Se sei qui per aiutarci,\ldai una mano a quello scienziato ad

aprire la porta. Almeno uno dei
tirapiedi di [green]Aklove[blue] deve conoscere\lla password.

entries.original:
"[black]The Shadow Warrior is standing
motionless."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Shadow Warrior is standing motionless.
entries.translated: [black]Il Guerriero Ombra è immobile.

entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Meep!

entries.translated: [green]Ahi ahi ahi!

entries.translated: [green]Prass!

entries.translated:
[black]Il [buffer1] è sgattaiolato nel
bosco.

I’ve almost made it to Gurun Town."
entries.translation_source: Phew[game-token-1] I’ve almost made it to Gurun Town.
entries.translated:
Fiu\. sono quasi arrivato a Gurun
Town.

entries.original: "It’s a good thing I can heal soon."
entries.translation_source: It’s a good thing I can heal soon.
entries.translated:
È una fortuna che potrò guarire
presto.

"I came from Vivill Town.

For some reason, it has been
raining a lot lately."
entries.translation_source: I came from Vivill Town. For some reason, it has been raining a lot lately.
entries.translated:
Vengo da Vivill Town. Per qualche
motivo, ultimamente piove molto.

entries.original: "How do I get out of here?"
entries.translation_source: How do I get out of here?
entries.translated: Come faccio a uscire di qui?

entries.original:
"Rare items can be found if you
search mushrooms!"
entries.translation_source: Rare items can be found if you search mushrooms!
entries.translated:
Si possono trovare oggetti rari se
cerchi nei funghi!

entries.original:
"Some Pokémon hide in mushrooms,
too!"
entries.translation_source: Some Pokémon hide in mushrooms, too!
entries.translated:
Alcuni Pokémon si nascondono anche
nei funghi!

entries.original:
"Both Pokémon and items can be found
in the mushrooms on the ground."
entries.translation_source: Both Pokémon and items can be found in the mushrooms on the ground.
entries.translated:
Nei funghi a terra si possono
trovare sia Pokémon che oggetti.

entries.original:
"Why are there no Ghost Pokémon
in these woods?"
entries.translation_source: Why are there no Ghost Pokémon in these woods?
entries.translated:
Perché non ci sono Pokémon Spettro
in questi boschi?

entries.original: "Time to face my swarm!"
entries.translation_source: Time to face my swarm!
entries.translated: È ora di affrontare il mio sciame!

entries.original:
"The swarm\.
No!"
entries.translation_source: The swarm[game-token-1] No!
entries.translated: Lo sciame\. No!

entries.original:
"I thought I had the ultimate
swarm\."
entries.translation_source: I thought I had the ultimate swarm[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Pensavo di avere lo sciame
definitivo\.

entries.original: "The Powerhouse of the Cell"
entries.translation_source: The Powerhouse of the Cell
entries.translated:
La centrale energetica della
cellula

entries.original:
"Collect the mysterious green cells
that are appearing around Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Collect the mysterious green cells that are appearing around Borrius!
entries.translated:
Raccogli le misteriose cellule
verdi che stanno comparendo in giro\lper Borrius!

entries.original:
"Thank you for coming with me.

\.

What’s that?

It’s not like you really had a
choice?

Such nonsense.

I don’t know what you’re talking
about.

Let’s get down to business."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for coming with me. [game-token-1] What’s that? It’s not like you really had a choice? Such nonsense. I don’t know what you’re talking about. Let’s get down to business.
entries.translated:
Grazie per essere venuto con me. \.
Come dici? Non è che avessi davvero\lscelta? Che sciocchezze. Non so di

cosa tu stia parlando. Passiamo
agli affari.

entries.original:
"[red]Recently, pieces of a Pokémon known
as Zygarde have been appearing all\lover Borrius.

However, these pieces can only be
seen if you have a Super Cube with\la special component installed."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Recently, pieces of a Pokémon known as Zygarde have been appearing all over Borrius. However, these pieces can only be seen if you have a Super Cube with a special component installed.
entries.translated:
[red]Recentemente, frammenti di un
Pokémon noto come Zygarde stanno\lcomparendo in tutto Borrius.

Tuttavia, questi frammenti possono
essere visti solo se hai un Cubo\lSuper con un componente speciale

installato.

entries.original:
"Zygarde is a Pokémon from Kalos
that appears when the ecosystem is\lin danger.

Why it’s appearing here and now
is a mystery to us.

We’re trying to find the answer to
this, but we need someone to go\land collect all of the individual\l\qocells\qc and \qocores\qc of Zygarde."
entries.translation_source: Zygarde is a Pokémon from Kalos that appears when the ecosystem is in danger. Why it’s appearing here and now is a mystery to us. We’re trying to find the answer to this, but we need someone to go and collect all of the individual [quote-open-1]cells[quote-close-2] and [quote-open-3]cores[quote-close-4] of Zygarde.
entries.translated:
Zygarde è un Pokémon di Kalos che
appare quando l{B4}ecosistema è in\lpericolo. Perché stia comparendo

qui e ora è per noi un mistero.
Stiamo cercando di trovare la\lrisposta, ma abbiamo bisogno che

qualcuno vada a raccogliere tutte
le singole \qocellule\qc e \qonuclei\qc di\lZygarde.

entries.original:
"[red]Do you think you’d be able to help
us with our research?

We need a Trainer who plans on
travelling to several different\llocations within Borrius."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Do you think you’d be able to help us with our research? We need a Trainer who plans on travelling to several different locations within Borrius.
entries.translated:
[red]Pensi di poterci aiutare con la
nostra ricerca? Abbiamo bisogno di\lun Allenatore che abbia in

programma di viaggiare in diverse
località all{B4}interno di Borrius.

entries.original:
"[red]That’s a shame, but we can’t force
you to do it, unfortunately."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]That’s a shame, but we can’t force you to do it, unfortunately.
entries.translated:
[red]È un peccato, ma purtroppo non
possiamo costringerti a farlo.

entries.original:
"Great!

Thank you for agreeing to help!

If you could please give me your
Cube for a second\.

\.

Okay!

Your Super Cube has been updated to
allow you to see and collect the\lZygarde Cells that litter both West\land East Borrius.

Once you’ve collected at least [green]10[blue]
percent, please come see my wife.

For now, good luck!"
entries.translation_source: Great! Thank you for agreeing to help! If you could please give me your Cube for a second[game-token-1] [game-token-2] Okay! Your Super Cube has been updated to allow you to see and collect the Zygarde Cells that litter both West and East Borrius. Once you’ve collected at least [color-green-3]10[color-blue-4] percent, please come see my wife. For now, good luck!
entries.translated:
Fantastico! Grazie per aver
accettato di aiutarmi! Se potessi\ldarmi il tuo Cube per un secondo\. \.

Va bene! Il tuo Super Cube è stato
aggiornato per permetterti di\lvedere e raccogliere le Celle di

Zygarde sparse sia in Borrius Ovest
che in Borrius Est. Una volta che\lavrai raccolto almeno [green]10[blue] percento,

vieni a trovare mia moglie. Per
ora, in bocca al lupo!

entries.original: "Zygfried"
entries.translation_source: Zygfried
entries.translated: Zygfried

entries.original:
"A Trainer!

Thank you so much for coming to
our home!

My name is Zygfried.

My wife, Zygardia, and I would like
to discuss something very important."
entries.translation_source: A Trainer! Thank you so much for coming to our home! My name is Zygfried. My wife, Zygardia, and I would like to discuss something very important.
entries.translated:
Un Allenatore! Grazie mille per
essere venuto a casa nostra! Mi\lchiamo Zygfried. Mia moglie,

Zygardia, ed io vorremmo discutere
di qualcosa di molto importante.

entries.original:
"When you have collected at least
[green]10[blue] percent of the cells, please\lreport back to my wife."
entries.translation_source: When you have collected at least [color-green-1]10[color-blue-2] percent of the cells, please report back to my wife.
entries.translated:
Quando avrai raccolto almeno il [green]10[blue]
percento delle cellule, riferiscilo\la mia moglie.

"It looks like you’ve collected at
least [green]10[blue] percent of the cells.

Good work!

If you haven’t already, please talk
to my wife."
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected at least [color-green-1]10[color-blue-2] percent of the cells. Good work! If you haven’t already, please talk to my wife.
entries.translated:
Sembra che tu abbia raccolto almeno
il [green]10[blue] percento delle cellule. Bel\llavoro! Se non l{B4}hai ancora fatto,

parla con mia moglie.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected at
least [green]50[blue] percent of the cells.

You’re half way there!

If you haven’t already, please talk
to my wife."
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected at least [color-green-1]50[color-blue-2] percent of the cells. You’re half way there! If you haven’t already, please talk to my wife.
entries.translated:
Sembra che tu abbia raccolto almeno
[green]50[blue] percento delle celle. Sei a metà\lstrada! Se non l{B4}hai già fatto,

parla con mia moglie.

entries.original:
"You’ve collected all of the cells!

This is a major help to our
research!

Thank you so much!

Please speak to my wife to assemble
your permanent Zygarde."
entries.translation_source: You’ve collected all of the cells! This is a major help to our research! Thank you so much! Please speak to my wife to assemble your permanent Zygarde.
entries.translated:
Hai raccolto tutte le cellule!
Questo è di grande aiuto per la\lnostra ricerca! Grazie mille! Per

favore, parla con mia moglie per
assemblare il tuo Zygarde\lpermanente.

"Now that you have a permanent
Zygarde, I can teach it special\lmoves or even change its Ability!

What would you like to do?"
entries.translation_source: Now that you have a permanent Zygarde, I can teach it special moves or even change its Ability! What would you like to do?
entries.translated:
Ora che hai uno Zygarde permanente,
posso insegnargli mosse speciali o\lpersino cambiarne l{B4}Abilità! Cosa

vorresti fare?

entries.original: "What would you like to do?"
entries.translation_source: What would you like to do?
entries.translated: Cosa vuoi fare?

entries.original:
"Oh, you’re happy as is?

If you’d ever like to add
enhancements to your Zygarde,\lplease let me know!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, you’re happy as is? If you’d ever like to add enhancements to your Zygarde, please let me know!
entries.translated:
Oh, sei soddisfatto così? Se mai
volessi aggiungere potenziamenti al\ltuo Zygarde, fammelo sapere!

entries.original:
"If you’d ever like to add more
enhancements to your Zygarde,\lplease let me know!"
entries.translation_source: If you’d ever like to add more enhancements to your Zygarde, please let me know!
entries.translated:
Se mai volessi aggiungere altri
potenziamenti al tuo Zygarde,\lfammelo sapere!

entries.original: "Which move should I teach?"
entries.translation_source: Which move should I teach?
entries.translated: Quale mossa dovrei insegnare?

entries.original: "Which Zygarde should I teach it to?"
entries.translation_source: Which Zygarde should I teach it to?
entries.translated:
A quale Zygarde dovrei
insegnarglielo?

entries.original:
"Which Zygarde’s Ability should
I change?"
entries.translation_source: Which Zygarde’s Ability should I change?
entries.translated:
Quale Abilità di Zygarde dovrei
cambiare?

entries.original:
"Should I change [green][buffer1][blue]’s
Ability to [green][buffer2][blue]?"
entries.translation_source: Should I change [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]’s Ability to [color-green-4][buffer2-5][color-blue-6]?
entries.translated:
Devo cambiare l{B4}abilità di [green][buffer1][blue]
in [green][buffer2][blue]?

entries.translation_source: That Pokémon’s not a Zygarde[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Quel Pokémon non è uno Zygarde\.

entries.translation_source: That’s an Egg, not a Zygarde!
entries.translated: Quello è un Uovo, non un Zygarde!

entries.original:
"Done! [buffer1]’s Ability has
changed to [buffer2].

If you’d ever like to add more
enhancements to your Zygarde,\lplease let me know!"
entries.translation_source: Done! [buffer1-1]’s Ability has changed to [buffer2-2]. If you’d ever like to add more enhancements to your Zygarde, please let me know!
entries.translated:
Fatto! L{B4}Abilità di [buffer1] è
cambiata in [buffer2]. Se vuoi\laggiungere altri miglioramenti al

tuo Zygarde, fammelo sapere!

entries.translated: Insegna mosse a Zygarde

entries.translation_source: Change Zygarde Ability
entries.translated: Cambia abilità di Zygarde

entries.translated: Imposizione del nucleo

entries.translation_source: Zygardia
entries.translated: Zygardia

entries.original:
"Hmm\.

There have been numerous reports of
cells being spotted, lately\.

What could this mean\."
entries.translation_source: Hmm[game-token-1] There have been numerous reports of cells being spotted, lately[game-token-2] What could this mean[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Mmh\. Ultimamente sono state
segnalate numerose apparizioni di\lcellule\. Che cosa potrebbe

significare\.

entries.original:
"Please report back to me when
you’ve collected at least\l[green]10[red] percent of the cells."
entries.translation_source: Please report back to me when you’ve collected at least [color-green-1]10[color-red-2] percent of the cells.
entries.translated:
Per favore, aggiornami quando avrai
raccolto almeno [green]10[red] percento delle\lcellule.

entries.original:
"It looks like you’ve collected
[green][buffer1][red] cells so far.

Would you like to assemble these
cells into a [green]temporary[red] construct?"
entries.translation_source: It looks like you’ve collected [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-red-3] cells so far. Would you like to assemble these cells into a [color-green-4]temporary[color-red-5] construct?
entries.translated:
Mi pare che finora tu abbia
raccolto [green][buffer1][red] cellule. Vuoi\lassemblare queste cellule in un

costrutto [green]temporaneo[red]?

entries.original:
"You’ve collected all of the
Zygarde cells!

Amazing!

Would you like to assemble these
cells into a [green]permanent[red] construct?"
entries.translation_source: You’ve collected all of the Zygarde cells! Amazing! Would you like to assemble these cells into a [color-green-1]permanent[color-red-2] construct?
entries.translated:
Hai raccolto tutte le cellule di
Zygarde! Incredibile! Vuoi\lassemblare queste cellule in una

struttura [green]permanente[red]?

entries.original:
"Would you like to disassemble your
temporary Zygarde construct?"
entries.translation_source: Would you like to disassemble your temporary Zygarde construct?
entries.translated:
Vuoi smontare il tuo costrutto
temporaneo di Zygarde?

entries.original:
"I can only assemble the cells if
you have space for it.

Come back once you’ve made space."
entries.translation_source: I can only assemble the cells if you have space for it. Come back once you’ve made space.
entries.translated:
Posso assemblare le cellule solo se
hai spazio per farlo. Torna quando\lavrai fatto spazio.

entries.original:
"Please be aware that this Zygarde
is only a temporary construct, and\lany stat changes will be lost when\lit is disassembled."
entries.translation_source: Please be aware that this Zygarde is only a temporary construct, and any stat changes will be lost when it is disassembled.
entries.translated:
Tieni presente che questo Zygarde è
solo una struttura temporanea e che\leventuali cambiamenti alle

statistiche andranno persi quando
verrà smontato.

entries.original:
"That’s it!
The final version of Zygarde!

From here on out, disassembly is
no longer possible.

However, the form of this Zygarde
can easily be changed at will.

Simply speak to me and I will
change it for you.

You may also speak with my husband
in order to enhance your Zygarde\lin other ways.

Enjoy your new Zygarde!"
entries.translation_source: That’s it! The final version of Zygarde! From here on out, disassembly is no longer possible. However, the form of this Zygarde can easily be changed at will. Simply speak to me and I will change it for you. You may also speak with my husband in order to enhance your Zygarde in other ways. Enjoy your new Zygarde!
entries.translated:
Ecco fatto! La versione finale di
Zygarde! Da questo momento in poi,\llo smembramento non è più

possibile. Tuttavia, la forma di
questo Zygarde può essere cambiata\lfacilmente a piacimento. Parlami

semplicemente e la cambierò per te.
Puoi anche parlare con mio marito\lper potenziare il tuo Zygarde in

altri modi. Goditi il tuo nuovo
Zygarde!

entries.original:
"I can’t disassemble that Zygarde if
it’s your only living Pokémon!

What would you fight with?"
entries.translation_source: I can’t disassemble that Zygarde if it’s your only living Pokémon! What would you fight with?
entries.translated:
Non posso smontare quel Zygarde se
è il tuo unico Pokémon vivo! Con\lcosa combatteresti?

entries.original:
"I can only disassemble the [green]Zygarde[red]
I assembled for you with the [green]cells\lyou gathered[red].

That Pokémon is, unfortunately,
not what I am referring to."
entries.translation_source: I can only disassemble the [color-green-1]Zygarde[color-red-2] I assembled for you with the [color-green-3]cells you gathered[color-red-4]. That Pokémon is, unfortunately, not what I am referring to.
entries.translated:
Posso smontare solo lo [green]Zygarde[red] che
ho assemblato per te con le [green]celle\lche hai raccolto[red]. Quel Pokémon,

purtroppo, non è quello a cui mi
riferisco.

entries.original:
"Zygarde has been disassembled into
its cells.

If it was holding an item, it will
now be back in your Cube."
entries.translation_source: Zygarde has been disassembled into its cells. If it was holding an item, it will now be back in your Cube.
entries.translated:
Zygarde è stato smontato nelle sue
cellule. Se teneva uno strumento,\lora tornerà nel tuo Cubo.

entries.original:
"Best of luck collecting the
remaining cells."
entries.translation_source: Best of luck collecting the remaining cells.
entries.translated:
In bocca al lupo per raccogliere le
celle rimanenti.

entries.original:
"Hurry back!

You’ll want to assemble your
permanent construct as soon\las possible!"
entries.translation_source: Hurry back! You’ll want to assemble your permanent construct as soon as possible!
entries.translated:
Torna presto! Vorrai assemblare il
tuo costrutto permanente il prima\lpossibile!

"Would you like to change the form
of your Zygarde?"

entries.translated:
Vuoi cambiare la forma del tuo
Zygarde?

entries.original: "Please choose the [green]Zygarde[red]."
entries.translation_source: Please choose the [color-green-1]Zygarde[color-red-2].

"I can only change a [green]Zygarde[red]’s
form.

not what I am referring to."
entries.translation_source: I can only change a [color-green-1]Zygarde[color-red-2]’s form. That Pokémon is, unfortunately, not what I am referring to.
entries.translated:
Posso solo cambiare la forma di un
[green]Zygarde[red]. Quel Pokémon, purtroppo,\lnon è quello a cui mi riferisco.

entries.original:
"Done!

The form of your Zygarde has
been changed!"
entries.translation_source: Done! The form of your Zygarde has been changed!
entries.translated:
Fatto! La forma del tuo Zygarde è
stata cambiata!

entries.original:
"If you would ever like to change
the form of your Zygarde, please\lspeak with me."
entries.translation_source: If you would ever like to change the form of your Zygarde, please speak with me.
entries.translated:
Se mai volessi cambiare la forma
del tuo Zygarde, parla pure con me.

entries.translated:
Questa Cellula di Zygarde è stata
trovata dietro la casa della\lvecchia coppia.

"The Zygarde Cell was found just
south of the ice on the open road."
entries.translation_source: The Zygarde Cell was found just south of the ice on the open road.
entries.translated:
La Cellula di Zygarde è stata
trovata appena a sud del ghiaccio\lsulla strada aperta.

Scalaroccia.

Questa Cellula di Zygarde è stata

entries.original:
"This Zygarde Cell was found on the
beach after exiting Icicle Cave."

entries.original:
"The Battle Circus is a facility for
Single, Double, and Multi Battle\lchallenges.

Once begun, your challenge lasts

In Single Battle format, you have a

In Double Battle format, you have a
choice of entering with four or six\lPokémon.

The battles are held in the main
arena.

Before each battle, the Ringmaster
will activate a random effect for\lthe duration of the battle.

This effect is permanent and cannot
be removed or overridden.

These effects may also increase in
intensity and begin to stack the\lhigher your streak becomes.

For every Trainer you defeat, you
will earn [green]Battle Points[blue] ([green]BP[blue]).

If you want to interrupt your
challenge, your progress will be\lrecorded for when you wish to\lcontinue.

If at any point you leave without
saving, you will be disqualified\lfrom your challenge.

Please be aware of that!"
entries.translation_source: The Battle Circus is a facility for Single, Double, and Multi Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you defeat the Circus Ringmaster, or you choose to rest. In Single Battle format, you have a choice of entering with three or six Pokémon. In Double Battle format, you have a choice of entering with four or six Pokémon. The battles are held in the main arena. Before each battle, the Ringmaster will activate a random effect for the duration of the battle. This effect is permanent and cannot be removed or overridden. These effects may also increase in intensity and begin to stack the higher your streak becomes. For every Trainer you defeat, you will earn [color-green-1]Battle Points[color-blue-2] ([color-green-3]BP[color-blue-4]). If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Please be aware of that!

entries.translation_source: The Battle Circus is a facility for Single, Double, and Multi Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you defeat the Circus Ringmaster, or you choose to rest. The Battle Circus’ Multi Battle show is for Multi Battles with a partner. To enter, join another Trainer and compete with two or three Pokémon each. Underneath the circus is a room named the Battle Salon where you can meet other Trainers. There you can find a Trainer to act as your partner in the Multi Battles. You can also partner up with a friend using a Link Cable. Once you have partnered up, you will be shown to the main arena. In the arena, tag teams will challenge you. Before each battle, the Ringmaster will activate a random effect for the duration of the battle. This effect is permanent and cannot be removed or overridden. These effects may also increase in intensity and begin to stack the higher your streak becomes. If you manage to defeat each team, you will earn Battle Points (BP). If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Also, if you are in a tag team with a friend, you may not interrupt your challenge. Please be aware of that!

saving, you will be disqualified\lfrom your challenge.

Please be aware of that!"
entries.translation_source: The Battle Mine is a facility for special challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you defeat the Mine Excavator, or you choose to rest. On each level you descend in the mine, a Trainer awaits you. The format you choose determines which tier they can be battled in, and your depth determines other battle settings, such as Single or Double, level, party size, Inverse Battles, and Dynamax. For a list of tiers, please see my [quote-open-1][color-green-2]Battle Tiers[color-blue-3][quote-close-4] section. For every Trainer you defeat, you will earn [color-green-5]Battle Points[color-blue-6] ([color-green-7]BP[color-blue-8]). Additionally, upon defeat, some Trainers may drop the items they were mining, for you to collect. If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Please be aware of that!

"The Battle Sands is a facility for

As this Trainer wins battles,
[green]Battle Points[blue] ([green]BP[blue]) will be acrued.

You may choose to stop the battles
at any point, but know that once\lyou do, that’s it for the streak.

Whether the Trainer loses a battle
or you decide to retire, you will\lreceive the BP acrued as winnings.

Additionally, leaving at any point
without saving will cause any BP\lacrued to be lost.

Just be aware of that.

Oh, I forgot to mention that one
Pokémon on each side of the field\lwill gain a random stat boost at\lthe beginning of the battle.

Keep that in mind when choosing
your Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: The Battle Sands is a facility for Single and Double Battles. In Single Battles, two Pokémon must be entered. In Double Battles, three Pokémon must be entered. Here’s the catch for this facility: you’re not actually battling. Pokémon you enter in this facility will be taken by a volunteer and used to fight for you. You’ll be given the choice of whether you want your Pokémon to attack or switch out, but the final decision will be up to the Trainer controlling your Pokémon. As this Trainer wins battles, [color-green-1]Battle Points[color-blue-2] ([color-green-3]BP[color-blue-4]) will be acrued. You may choose to stop the battles at any point, but know that once you do, that’s it for the streak. Whether the Trainer loses a battle or you decide to retire, you will receive the BP acrued as winnings. Additionally, leaving at any point without saving will cause any BP acrued to be lost. Just be aware of that. Oh, I forgot to mention that one Pokémon on each side of the field will gain a random stat boost at the beginning of the battle. Keep that in mind when choosing your Pokémon.

Battle Sands è un{B4}area per Lotte in

statistiche all{B4}inizio della lotta.
Tienilo a mente quando scegli i\ltuoi Pokémon.

entries.original:
"The Battle Tower is a facility for
Single, Double, Multi, and\lMetronome Battle challenges.

Once begun, your challenge lasts
until you defeat the Tower Tycoon,\lor you choose to rest.

In Single Battle format, you have a

In Double Battle format, you have a
choice of entering with four or\lsix Pokémon.

Rooms of which there are many in\lthe tower.

Trainers await your challenge.

For every Trainer you defeat, you
will earn [green]Battle Points[blue] ([green]BP[blue]).

If at any point you leave without
saving, you will be disqualified\lfrom your challenge.

entries.translation_source: The Battle Tower is a facility for Single, Double, Multi, and Metronome Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you defeat the Tower Tycoon, or you choose to rest. In Single Battle format, you have a choice of entering with three or six Pokémon. In Double Battle format, you have a choice of entering with four or six Pokémon. The battles are held in Battle Rooms of which there are many in the tower. In each of the Battle Rooms, Trainers await your challenge. For every Trainer you defeat, you will earn [color-green-1]Battle Points[color-blue-2] ([color-green-3]BP[color-blue-4]). If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Please be aware of that!

entries.original:
"The Battle Tower is a facility for

until you defeat the Tower Tycoon,\lor you choose to rest.

There, you can find a Trainer to

will be shown to a battle room.

In the Multi Battle Room, tag
teams await your challenge.

If you manage to defeat each team,
you will earn [green]Battle Points[red] ([green]BP[red]).

If you want to interrupt your
challenge, your progress will be\lrecorded for when you wish to\lcontinue.

If at any point you leave without
saving, you will be disqualified\lfrom your challenge.

Also, if you are in a tag team
with a friend, you may not\linterrupt your challenge.

Please be aware of that!"
entries.translation_source: The Battle Tower is a facility for Single, Double, Multi, and Metronome Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you defeat the Tower Tycoon, or you choose to rest. The Battle Tower’s Multi Battle Rooms are for Multi Battles with a partner. To enter, join another Trainer and compete with two or three Pokémon each. Inside the tower is a room named the Battle Salon where you can meet other Trainers. There, you can find a Trainer to act as your partner in the Multi Battles. You can also partner up with a friend using a Link Cable. Once you have partnered up, you will be shown to a battle room. In the Multi Battle Room, tag teams await your challenge. If you manage to defeat each team, you will earn [color-green-1]Battle Points[color-red-2] ([color-green-3]BP[color-red-4]). If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Also, if you are in a tag team with a friend, you may not interrupt your challenge. Please be aware of that!

"In Single Battles, you may battle
with 3 or 6 Pokémon on your team.

In Double Battles, you may battle
with 4 or 6 Pokémon on your team.

In Multi Battles, you may battle
with 2 or 3 Pokémon on your team.

If you choose to battle with 6
Pokémon and are not participating\lin a Random Battle, you will be\lshown the opposing team before\lbattles and will be allowed to\lchoose a lead.

If you choose to battle with 4 or
less Pokémon on your team and are\lparticipating in a Random Battle,\lyou will be allowed to choose\lwhich random Pokémon you would\llike to battle with.

Each battle for 10 battles this
random Pokémon selection will be\lcomprised of your previous team\land your opponent’s previous team."
entries.translation_source: In Single Battles, you may battle with 3 or 6 Pokémon on your team. In Double Battles, you may battle with 4 or 6 Pokémon on your team. In Multi Battles, you may battle with 2 or 3 Pokémon on your team. If you choose to battle with 6 Pokémon and are not participating in a Random Battle, you will be shown the opposing team before battles and will be allowed to choose a lead. If you choose to battle with 4 or less Pokémon on your team and are participating in a Random Battle, you will be allowed to choose which random Pokémon you would like to battle with. Each battle for 10 battles this random Pokémon selection will be comprised of your previous team and your opponent’s previous team.

entries.original:
"The Battle Frontier has four
facilities dedicated to battling.

At the Battle Tower, the objective
is to beat many Trainers in a row.

At the Battle Sands, other Trainers
battle with your Pokémon.

At the Battle Circus, random
effects are present every battle.

And finally, at the Battle Mine,
you must use a team of six Pokémon\lthat can handle many different\lbattle formats."
entries.translation_source: The Battle Frontier has four facilities dedicated to battling. At the Battle Tower, the objective is to beat many Trainers in a row. At the Battle Sands, other Trainers battle with your Pokémon. At the Battle Circus, random effects are present every battle. And finally, at the Battle Mine, you must use a team of six Pokémon that can handle many different battle formats.
entries.translated:
La Frontiera Lotta ha quattro
strutture dedicate alla lotta. Alla\lTorre Lotta, l{B4}obiettivo è

sconfiggere molti Allenatori di
fila. Alla Sabbia della Lotta,\laltri Allenatori lottano con i tuoi

Pokémon. Al Circo della Lotta,
effetti casuali sono presenti in\logni lotta. E infine, alla Miniera

della Lotta, devi usare una squadra
di sei Pokémon che possa gestire\lmolti diversi formati di lotta.

entries.original:
"The battles at the four Battle
Frontier facilities are held under\lspecial rules.

First and foremost, no Exp. Points
can be earned.

Consequently, the Pokémon battling
here will not level up.

When choosing a level to battle at,
all Pokémon on your team will be\ladjusted to that level for the\lduration of the battles."
entries.translation_source: The battles at the four Battle Frontier facilities are held under special rules. First and foremost, no Exp. Points can be earned. Consequently, the Pokémon battling here will not level up. When choosing a level to battle at, all Pokémon on your team will be adjusted to that level for the duration of the battles.
entries.translated:
Le lotte nei quattro impianti della
Lotta Area si svolgono secondo\lregole speciali. Prima di tutto,

non si possono guadagnare Punti
Esperienza. Di conseguenza, i\lPokémon che combattono qui non

saliranno di livello. Quando scegli
un livello a cui combattere, tutti\li Pokémon della tua squadra

verranno portati a quel livello per
la durata delle lotte.

entries.original:
"Battle Points are usually referred
to as BP.

BP are points that are used only in
the Battle Frontier.

BP are awarded for meeting certain
performance goals at the various\lBattle Frontier facilities.

BP can be exchanged for prizes at
Exchange Service Corners."
entries.translation_source: Battle Points are usually referred to as BP. BP are points that are used only in the Battle Frontier. BP are awarded for meeting certain performance goals at the various Battle Frontier facilities. BP can be exchanged for prizes at Exchange Service Corners.
entries.translated:
I Punti Lotta sono di solito
chiamati BP. I BP sono punti usati\lsolo nella Frontiera Lotta. I BP

vengono assegnati per aver
raggiunto determinati obiettivi di\lrendimento nelle varie strutture

della Frontiera Lotta. I BP possono
essere scambiati per premi agli\lSportelli del Servizio Scambi.

entries.original:
"Exchange Service Corners can be
found in booths dotted around the\lBattle Frontier, or in the Battle\lTower itself.

There, you may exchange your BP for
a wide variety of services and\lprizes.

Please do visit them!"
entries.translation_source: Exchange Service Corners can be found in booths dotted around the Battle Frontier, or in the Battle Tower itself. There, you may exchange your BP for a wide variety of services and prizes. Please do visit them!
entries.translated:
Gli Angoli del Servizio di Scambio
si trovano in stand sparsi per la\lFrontiera Lotta, oppure nella Torre

Lotta stessa. Lì puoi scambiare i
tuoi BP per un{B4}ampia varietà di\lservizi e premi. Vieni a trovarli!

entries.original:
"The Performance Monitor shows
Trainer data, such as the current\lrecords and the best records to\ldate.

You will find one near the
reception counter in each facility."
entries.translation_source: The Performance Monitor shows Trainer data, such as the current records and the best records to date. You will find one near the reception counter in each facility.
entries.translated:
Il Monitor delle prestazioni mostra
i dati degli Allenatori, come i\lrecord attuali e i record migliori

ottenuti finora. Ne troverai uno
vicino al bancone della reception\lin ogni struttura.

entries.original:
"[green]Mega Evolution[black] is a temporary
evolution that can be initiated in\lbattle if a Pokémon is holding a\l[green]Mega Stone[black] for their species.

To activate Mega Evolution, press
\btn04 while selecting an attack\lto use.

Only one Pokémon per team can Mega
Evolve, and after the battle is\lover, Mega Pokémon return to their\loriginal forms."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Mega Evolution[color-black-2] is a temporary evolution that can be initiated in battle if a Pokémon is holding a [color-green-3]Mega Stone[color-black-4] for their species. To activate Mega Evolution, press [button-icon-5] while selecting an attack to use. Only one Pokémon per team can Mega Evolve, and after the battle is over, Mega Pokémon return to their original forms.
entries.translated:
[green]La Megaevoluzione[black] è un{B4}evoluzione
temporanea che può essere attivata\lin battaglia se un Pokémon tiene

una [green]Megapietra[black] della sua specie.
Per attivare la Megaevoluzione,\lpremi \btn04 mentre selezioni una mossa

da usare. Solo un Pokémon per
squadra può megaevolversi e, dopo\lla fine della lotta, i Pokémon

megaevoluti tornano alla loro forma
originale.

entries.original:
"A [green]Z-Move[black] is a special type of move
in which a Trainer and their\lPokémon’s wishes combine to\lunleash a very powerful attack\lonce per battle.

If one of these moves are
available, it can be activated by\lpressing \btn04 and then \btn00 while\lselecting an attack to use.

In order for a Pokémon to use a
Z-Move, it must hold a special type\lof item called a [green]Z-Crystal[black].

Most Z-Crystals correspond to a
certain type of move, but some are\lalso species specific."
entries.translation_source: A [color-green-1]Z-Move[color-black-2] is a special type of move in which a Trainer and their Pokémon’s wishes combine to unleash a very powerful attack once per battle. If one of these moves are available, it can be activated by pressing [button-icon-3] and then [button-icon-4] while selecting an attack to use. In order for a Pokémon to use a Z-Move, it must hold a special type of item called a [color-green-5]Z-Crystal[color-black-6]. Most Z-Crystals correspond to a certain type of move, but some are also species specific.
entries.translated:
Una [green]Mossa Z[black] è un tipo speciale di
mossa in cui il desiderio di un\lAllenatore e quello del suo Pokémon

si uniscono per scatenare un
attacco molto potente una volta per\llotta. Se una di queste mosse è

disponibile, può essere attivata
premendo \btn04 e poi \btn00 mentre si\lseleziona un attacco da usare.

Affinché un Pokémon possa usare una
Mossa Z, deve tenere un oggetto\lspeciale chiamato [green]Cristallo Z[black]. La

maggior parte dei Cristalli Z
corrisponde a un certo tipo di\lmossa, ma alcuni sono specifici di

una specie.

entries.original:
"[green]Dynamax[black] is a temporary
transformation where a Pokémon\ldistorts space to change its size.

When a Pokémon Dynamaxes, for
three turns its HP is increased and\lall of its moves are powered up\linto special [green]Max Moves[black].

Each Max Move has a unique effect,
that varies based on the type of\lthe original move.

If a Pokémon has the Gigantamax
Factor, it can undergo Gigantamax.

This is a special kind of Dynamax
that results in a different\lappearance to its regular form, in\laddition to being larger.

Each Gigantamax Pokémon has an
exclusive Max Move known as a\lG-Max Move.

To activate Dynamax, press
\btn04 while selecting an attack\lto use."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Dynamax[color-black-2] is a temporary transformation where a Pokémon distorts space to change its size. When a Pokémon Dynamaxes, for three turns its HP is increased and all of its moves are powered up into special [color-green-3]Max Moves[color-black-4]. Each Max Move has a unique effect, that varies based on the type of the original move. If a Pokémon has the Gigantamax Factor, it can undergo Gigantamax. This is a special kind of Dynamax that results in a different appearance to its regular form, in addition to being larger. Each Gigantamax Pokémon has an exclusive Max Move known as a G-Max Move. To activate Dynamax, press [button-icon-5] while selecting an attack to use.
entries.translated:
[green]Dynamax[black] è una trasformazione
temporanea in cui un Pokémon\ldistorce lo spazio per cambiare le

proprie dimensioni. Quando un
Pokémon usa il Dynamax, per tre\lturni i suoi PS aumentano e tutte

le sue mosse vengono potenziate in
speciali [green]Maxmosse[black]. Ogni Maxmossa ha\lun effetto unico che varia in base

al tipo della mossa originale. Se
un Pokémon possiede il Fattore\lGigantamax, può Gigantamaxarsi. Si

tratta di un tipo speciale di
Dynamax che porta a un aspetto\ldiverso rispetto alla forma

regolare, oltre a essere più
grande. Ogni Pokémon Gigantamax ha\luna Maxmossa esclusiva nota come

Mossa G-Max. Per attivare il
Dynamax, premi \btn04 mentre selezioni\lun attacco da usare.

entries.original:
"When selecting an attack in battle,
certain symbols may appear.

This is based on the move’s
effectiveness against the target.

A green [green]\au[black] indicates that the move
is super effective.

A yellow [orange]\ad[black] indicates the move is
not very effective.

A red [lightgreen]*[black] indicates that the move
doesn’t affect the target at all.

And a \+ symbol indicates the move
has the Same-Type-Attack-Bonus."
entries.translation_source: When selecting an attack in battle, certain symbols may appear. This is based on the move’s effectiveness against the target. A green [color-green-1][game-token-2][color-black-3] indicates that the move is super effective. A yellow [color-orange-4][game-token-5][color-black-6] indicates the move is not very effective. A red [color-lightgreen-7]*[color-black-8] indicates that the move doesn’t affect the target at all. And a [game-token-9] symbol indicates the move has the Same-Type-Attack-Bonus.
entries.translated:
Quando si seleziona una mossa in
battaglia, possono apparire alcuni\lsimboli. Ciò dipende dall{B4}efficacia

della mossa contro il bersaglio. Un
[green]\au[black] verde indica che la mossa è\lsuperefficace. Un [orange]\ad[black] giallo indica

che la mossa non è molto efficace.
Un [lightgreen]*[black] rosso indica che la mossa non\lha effetto sul bersaglio. E un

simbolo \+ indica che la mossa ha il
bonus di stesso tipo.

entries.original:
"Of all the battles I’ve taken part
in, one stands out above the rest.

The day was sweltering, the
pressure intense.

My opponent had just sent out her
Rotom-Fan holding an Air Balloon.

Up until that point I had barely
been holding on, but upon seeing\lthat redundant freak of nature,\lI couldn’t take it anymore.

I fainted in disbelief and lost
the battle.

Never underestimate the power of
a [green]Rotom-Fan[red] holding an [green]Air Balloon[red]!"
entries.translation_source: Of all the battles I’ve taken part in, one stands out above the rest. The day was sweltering, the pressure intense. My opponent had just sent out her Rotom-Fan holding an Air Balloon. Up until that point I had barely been holding on, but upon seeing that redundant freak of nature, I couldn’t take it anymore. I fainted in disbelief and lost the battle. Never underestimate the power of a [color-green-1]Rotom-Fan[color-red-2] holding an [color-green-3]Air Balloon[color-red-4]!
entries.translated:
Di tutte le battaglie a cui ho
preso parte, una si distingue sopra\lle altre. La giornata era

soffocante, la pressione intensa.
La mia avversaria aveva appena\lmandato in campo il suo

Rotom-Vortice che teneva una
Mongolfiera. Fino a quel momento\lero riuscito a malapena a

resistere, ma vedendo quell{B4}abnorme
aberrazione della natura, non ce\ll{B4}ho più fatta. Sono svenuto

dall{B4}incredulità e ho perso la
battaglia. Non sottovalutare mai il\lpotere di un [green]Rotom-Vortice[red] che

tiene una [green]Mongolfiera[red]!

entries.translation_source: As you can clearly see, the Battle Frontier is a great place to test your skills. Apparently, Cube Corp. has similar facilities for battling.
entries.translated:
Come puoi vedere chiaramente, la
Frontiera Lotta è un ottimo posto\lper mettere alla prova le tue

abilità. A quanto pare, Cube Corp.
ha strutture simili per le lotte.

entries.original:
"If you’re fighting a random battle
with a team of 3 or 4 Pokémon,\lyou’ll be given a choice of which\lrandom Pokémon you want to fight\lwith before each battle.

And if you win a battle, you’ll be
able to pick from a mix of your\land your opponent’s previous teams!

This’ll only last each 10 battles,
however.

After that point you’ll be offered
a brand new random team.

Oh, and you should keep in mind
that you’ll always be offered a\lteam choice before random Multi\lbattles, since you’ll never be able\lto pick a full team of 6."
entries.translation_source: If you’re fighting a random battle with a team of 3 or 4 Pokémon, you’ll be given a choice of which random Pokémon you want to fight with before each battle. And if you win a battle, you’ll be able to pick from a mix of your and your opponent’s previous teams! This’ll only last each 10 battles, however. After that point you’ll be offered a brand new random team. Oh, and you should keep in mind that you’ll always be offered a team choice before random Multi battles, since you’ll never be able to pick a full team of 6.
entries.translated:
Se stai affrontando una lotta
casuale con una squadra di 3 o 4\lPokémon, ti verrà data una scelta

di quale Pokémon casuale vuoi usare
prima di ogni lotta. E se vinci una\llotta, potrai scegliere tra un

misto delle tue squadre precedenti
e di quelle del tuo avversario!\lTuttavia, questo durerà solo per 10

lotte per volta. Dopo di che, ti
verrà offerta una squadra casuale\lcompletamente nuova. Oh, e tieni a

mente che ti verrà sempre offerta
una scelta della squadra prima\ldelle lotte Multi casuali, poiché

non potrai mai selezionare una
squadra completa di 6 Pokémon.

entries.original:
"Take a look, at the Science
Society’s latest breakthrough\.\l[green]Nature changing[red]!

They called us mad, said we were
\qoharming Pokémon\qc\.

Fools! Fools, I say, deserving to
rot at the bottom of the earth!

Ahem\. anyway\.

Were you, perchance, looking to have
a Pokémon’s [green]Nature[red] changed?

It will cost you [green][buffer1][red] BP.
You currently have [green][buffer2][red] BP."

They called us mad, said we were [quote-open-4]harming Pokémon[quote-close-5][game-token-6] Fools! Fools, I say, deserving to rot at the bottom of the earth! Ahem[game-token-7] anyway[game-token-8] Were you, perchance, looking to have a Pokémon’s [color-green-9]Nature[color-red-10] changed? It will cost you [color-green-11][buffer1-12][color-red-13] BP. You currently have [color-green-14][buffer2-15][color-red-16] BP.

Dai un{B4}occhiata all{B4}ultima scoperta
della Società Scientifica\\. [green]Cambio\ldi Natura[red]! Ci hanno dato dei pazzi,

hanno detto che stavamo
\qodanneggiando i Pokémon\qc\\. Folli!\lFolli, dico io, che meritano di

marcire in fondo alla terra! Ahem\\.
comunque\\. Volevi, per caso,\lcambiare la [green]Natura[red] di un Pokémon?

Ti costerà [green][buffer1][red] BP. Al momento
hai [green][buffer2][red] BP.

Vuoi assegnare a [green][buffer1][red] la Natura
[green][buffer2][red]?

entries.original:
"Then, let the grand experiment on
[buffer1] begin!

Let me see into your heart\.\CC0818 ah, this
looks like a painful memory\."
entries.translation_source: Then, let the grand experiment on [buffer1-1] begin! Let me see into your heart[game-token-2][control-code-3] ah, this looks like a painful memory[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Allora, che il grande esperimento
su [buffer1] abbia inizio! Lasciami\lscrutare nel tuo cuore\.\CC0818 ah, questo

sembra un ricordo doloroso\.

"[black][buffer1]’s eyes look blank.

It’s as if it no longer recognizes
you\."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][buffer1-2]’s eyes look blank. It’s as if it no longer recognizes you[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
[black][buffer1]Gli occhi di [buffer1] sono
vacui. È come se non ti\lriconoscesse più\.

entries.original:
"And we’re done!

Your [buffer1]’s heart was rebuilt to
have a more suitable Nature.

Fortunately, it seems to remember
nothing about the procedure."
entries.translation_source: And we’re done! Your [buffer1-1]’s heart was rebuilt to have a more suitable Nature. Fortunately, it seems to remember nothing about the procedure.
entries.translated:
E abbiamo finito! Il cuore del tuo
[buffer1] è stato ricostruito per\lavere un{B4}Indole più adatta.

Fortunatamente, sembra non
ricordare nulla della procedura.

"I’m sorry!

You don’t have enough BP for your
Pokémon to undergo the procedure!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry! You don’t have enough BP for your Pokémon to undergo the procedure!
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace! Non hai abbastanza BP
perché il tuo Pokémon possa\lsottoporsi alla procedura!

entries.original:
"I wouldn’t get on my bad side, if I
were you!

You wouldn’t want to make an enemy
of the Science Society\."
entries.translation_source: I wouldn’t get on my bad side, if I were you! You wouldn’t want to make an enemy of the Science Society[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Non ti conviene metterti contro di
me, se fossi in te! Non vorresti\lfarti nemica la Società Scientifica\.

entries.original:
"You want your free daily machine,
homie?"

Vuoi la tua macchina giornaliera
gratuita, amico?

"Fine, fine, now pick the Pokémon I
should teach the move to."

entries.translated:
Va bene, va bene, ora scegli il
Pokémon a cui dovrei insegnare la\lmossa.

entries.original: "You don’t have enough BP."
