entries.original: "You already own that item."
entries.translation_source: You already own that item.
entries.translated: Possiedi già quell{B4}oggetto.

entries.original: "You already own that TM."
entries.translation_source: You already own that TM.
entries.translated: Hai già questa MT.

entries.original:
"Looks like you already own all of
these machines, homie."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you already own all of these machines, homie.
entries.translated:
A quanto pare possiedi già tutte
queste macchine, amico.

entries.original:
"C’mon, homie. I already gave you a
machine today. Ask again tomorrow."
entries.translation_source: C’mon, homie. I already gave you a machine today. Ask again tomorrow.
entries.translated:
Su, amico. Ti ho già dato una
macchina oggi. Chiedimelo domani.

entries.original:
"Oh? That Pokémon already knows
[buffer1]."
entries.translation_source: Oh? That Pokémon already knows [buffer1-1].
entries.translated:
Oh? Quel Pokémon conosce già
[buffer1].

entries.original:
"I see\.
I like your sense of adventure.

However, none of the Pokémon with
you now can learn the move."
entries.translation_source: I see[game-token-1] I like your sense of adventure. However, none of the Pokémon with you now can learn the move.
entries.translated:
Capisco\. Mi piace il tuo spirito
d{B4}avventura. Tuttavia, nessuno dei\lPokémon con te adesso può imparare

la mossa.

entries.original:
"Sorry to disappoint you\.
That Pokémon can’t learn the move."
entries.translation_source: Sorry to disappoint you[game-token-1] That Pokémon can’t learn the move.
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace deluderti\. Quel Pokémon
non può imparare la mossa.

entries.original:
"Sorry to disappoint you\.

That Pokémon you have can learn
this move, but it hasn’t come to\ltrust you fully yet\.

Until then, I can’t make it learn
this move."
entries.translation_source: Sorry to disappoint you[game-token-1] That Pokémon you have can learn this move, but it hasn’t come to trust you fully yet[game-token-2] Until then, I can’t make it learn this move.
entries.translated:
Mi spiace deluderti\. Quel Pokémon
che hai può imparare questa mossa,\lma non si fida ancora completamente

di te\. Finché non accadrà, non posso
fargli imparare questa mossa.

entries.original:
"Hmmmm\.

Teaching a move to an Egg is a
challenge that’s beyond me."
entries.translation_source: Hmmmm[game-token-1] Teaching a move to an Egg is a challenge that’s beyond me.
entries.translated:
Mmh\. Insegnare una mossa a un Uovo è
una sfida che va oltre le mie\lcapacità.

entries.original:
"Please come back any time you
want!"
entries.translation_source: Please come back any time you want!
entries.translated: Torna quando vuoi!

entries.original:
"Cool, cool.
Come back again, ya hear?"
entries.translation_source: Cool, cool. Come back again, ya hear?
entries.translated:
Va bene, va bene. Tornate a
trovarci, chiaro?

entries.original:
"Well then!
Until next time!"
entries.translation_source: Well then! Until next time!
entries.translated: Bene allora! Alla prossima!

entries.original:
"Well then!
See you next time!"
entries.translation_source: Well then! See you next time!
entries.translated:
Bene allora! Ci vediamo la prossima
volta!

entries.original:
"Until next time!

Come back whenever you’ve got
Battle Points to spend!"
entries.translation_source: Until next time! Come back whenever you’ve got Battle Points to spend!
entries.translated:
Alla prossima! Torna quando vuoi,
quando avrai Punti Lotta da\lspendere!

entries.original:
"See you next time!

Come back whenever you’ve got
Battle Points to spend!"
entries.translation_source: See you next time! Come back whenever you’ve got Battle Points to spend!
entries.translated:
Ci vediamo alla prossima! Torna
quando vuoi, quando hai dei Punti\lLotta da spendere!

entries.original:
"I see. You have no interest.
That is fine."
entries.translation_source: I see. You have no interest. That is fine.
entries.translated:
Capisco. Non sei interessato. Va
bene.

entries.original:
"Well, perhaps if you change your
mind, do come back."
entries.translation_source: Well, perhaps if you change your mind, do come back.
entries.translated: Beh, se cambi idea, torna pure.

"Draco Meteor’s destructive power is
awe inspiring.

However, using it will also lower
the Pokémon’s Special Attack."

Dragobolide è impressionante.\lTuttavia, usarla abbasserà anche

l{B4}Attacco Speciale del Pokémon.

entries.original:
"The Antisis Gym is a unique battle
facility only for Single Battle\lchallenges.

Once begun, your challenge lasts
until you choose to rest.

To begin your challenge, you must
enter with three Pokémon.

Each Pokémon will be set to Level
50 for the challenge.

Duplicate species or items may not
be used.

Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, Dynamax,
Focus Sashes, exploding moves,\lDestiny Bond, and Perish Song may\lnot be used.

Regigigas with the Ability Stall in
addition to Pokémon banned in the\l[green]Standard[blue] tier may not be used."
entries.translation_source: The Antisis Gym is a unique battle facility only for Single Battle challenges. Once begun, your challenge lasts until you choose to rest. To begin your challenge, you must enter with three Pokémon. Each Pokémon will be set to Level 50 for the challenge. Duplicate species or items may not be used. Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, Dynamax, Focus Sashes, exploding moves, Destiny Bond, and Perish Song may not be used. Regigigas with the Ability Stall in addition to Pokémon banned in the [color-green-1]Standard[color-blue-2] tier may not be used.
entries.translated:
La Palestra di Antisis è una
struttura di lotta unica solo per\lle sfide in Lotta Singola. Una

volta iniziata, la tua sfida dura
finché non scegli di riposare. Per\liniziare la tua sfida, devi entrare

con tre Pokémon. Ogni Pokémon sarà
portato al Livello 50 per la sfida.\lSpecie o strumenti duplicati non

possono essere usati. Mega
Evoluzione, Z-Mosse, Dynamax, Focus\lSash, mosse autodistruttive,

Destino Bivio e Ultracanto non
possono essere usati. Regigigas con\ll{B4}abilità Lentezza, in aggiunta ai

Pokémon banditi nella categoria
[green]Standard[blue], non possono essere usati.

entries.original:
"Before each battle, your opponent’s
team will be revealed to you.

Additionally, in each battle, a
certain move type may not be used.

This will be revealed as well.

Regarding moves that change types,
the type they change into is taken\linto account.

It is at that point you must choose
a single Pokémon to fight against\lone of theirs.

For every Trainer you defeat, you
will earn [green]Battle Points[blue] ([green]BP[blue]).

However, do note that since this
battle facility is not part of the\lBattle Frontier, you will not earn\lany prints for your Frontier Card.

If you want to interrupt your
challenge, your progress will be\lrecorded for when you wish to\lcontinue.

If at any point you leave without
saving, you will be disqualified\lfrom your challenge.

Please be aware of that!"
entries.translation_source: Before each battle, your opponent’s team will be revealed to you. Additionally, in each battle, a certain move type may not be used. This will be revealed as well. Regarding moves that change types, the type they change into is taken into account. It is at that point you must choose a single Pokémon to fight against one of theirs. For every Trainer you defeat, you will earn [color-green-1]Battle Points[color-blue-2] ([color-green-3]BP[color-blue-4]). However, do note that since this battle facility is not part of the Battle Frontier, you will not earn any prints for your Frontier Card. If you want to interrupt your challenge, your progress will be recorded for when you wish to continue. If at any point you leave without saving, you will be disqualified from your challenge. Please be aware of that!
entries.translated:
Prima di ogni lotta, la squadra del
tuo avversario ti verrà rivelata.\lInoltre, in ogni lotta, un certo

tipo di mossa potrebbe non essere
utilizzabile. Anche questo verrà\lrivelato. Per quanto riguarda le

mosse che cambiano tipo, viene
considerato il tipo in cui si\ltrasformano. È a quel punto che

devi scegliere un singolo Pokémon
per combattere contro uno dei loro.\lPer ogni Allenatore che sconfiggi,

otterrai [green]Punti Lotta[blue] ([green]PL[blue]).
Tuttavia, tieni presente che poiché\lquesta struttura lotta non fa parte

della Frontiera Lotta, non otterrai
alcun timbro per la tua Tessera\lFrontiera. Se vuoi interrompere la

tua sfida, i tuoi progressi
verranno registrati in modo che tu\lpossa continuare quando desideri.

Se in qualsiasi momento esci senza
salvare, verrai squalificato dalla\ltua sfida. Ti prego di tenerlo a

mente!

entries.translation_source: Ha ha ha ha! So, you’re the challenger on a hot streak in the Ring Challenge? Should’ve known it was gonna be you, [player-name-1]! I revamped the whole Gym, hopin’ some of the strongest in Borrius would show up[game-token-2] And now, here ya are, starin’ down the kingpin one more time. But make no mistake - I don’t intend to give an inch now! This is my turf - I’m just lettin’ ya stay here! So, let’s see if ya still got the mettle to take on the kingpin!
entries.translated:
Ah ah ah ah! Allora, sei tu lo
sfidante con una striscia vincente\lnella Sfida dell{B4}Anello? Avrei

dovuto immaginare che saresti stato
tu, [player]! Ho rinnovato l{B4}intera\lPalestra, sperando che alcuni dei

più forti di Borrius si sarebbero
presentati\. E ora, eccoti qui, che\lfissi il kingpin un{B4}altra volta. Ma

non commettere errori - non intendo
cedere di un millimetro ora! Questo\lè il mio territorio - ti sto solo

lasciando stare qui! Allora,
vediamo se hai ancora il coraggio\ldi affrontare il kingpin!

entries.original:

Must be pretty devoted, huh?

I like that - all it means is that
you’re just like me\.

Ya ain’t the type who’s gonna be
happy until you’ve proven yerself\lto be the king!

Well, that just means I gotta double
down twice as hard this time!

So come on, [player]!

The kingpin’s ending your run of
glory, right here, right now!"
entries.translation_source: So, ya got this far, didja, [player-name-1]? Ha ha ha ha! Must be pretty devoted, huh? I like that - all it means is that you’re just like me[game-token-2] Ya ain’t the type who’s gonna be happy until you’ve proven yerself to be the king! Well, that just means I gotta double down twice as hard this time! So come on, [player-name-3]! The kingpin’s ending your run of glory, right here, right now!

ah! Bene, un patto è un patto! Ti

[player]! Quando saprò che hai [green]99\lvittorie consecutive[blue], allora\. Ah ah

"Pardon me?

"Okay\.

\.

Tutto qui? Nah, ti resta un{B4}opzione
sola: levati di torno! Questo è il\lnostro posto, il Black Emboar. Non

abbiamo nessun altro posto dove
andare, e non vogliamo che nessuno\lci intralci.

entries.original:
"Gwa ha ha ha! Bring it!
You’ve got your share of guts, kid!

I’ll show you what the guy who
holds the Black Emboar together\lcan really do!"
entries.translation_source: Gwa ha ha ha! Bring it! You’ve got your share of guts, kid! I’ll show you what the guy who holds the Black Emboar together can really do!
entries.translated:
Gwa ha ha ha! Vieni pure! Hai il
tuo bel coraggio, ragazzo! Ti\lmostrerò cosa sa fare davvero

quello che tiene insieme il Black
Emboar!

entries.original:
"You ain’t half bad, kid\.
I like ya.

Get a loaf of this\.

From now on, our team’s name is
gonna be the Black [player]!

Yeah! We’re takin’ on your
rough and tough name!

It’s a wilder name for a
wilder team!

The Black [player]!
Gwa ha ha ha! That’s awesome!"
entries.translation_source: You ain’t half bad, kid[game-token-1] I like ya. Get a loaf of this[game-token-2] From now on, our team’s name is gonna be the Black [player-name-3]! Yeah! We’re takin’ on your rough and tough name! It’s a wilder name for a wilder team! The Black [player-name-4]! Gwa ha ha ha! That’s awesome!
entries.translated:
Non sei affatto male, ragazzino\. Mi
piaci. Ascolta un po{B4}\. Da ora in\lpoi, il nome della nostra squadra

sarà il Black [player]! Sì! Ci
prendiamo il tuo nome rude e tosto!\lÈ un nome più selvaggio per una

squadra più selvaggia! Il Black
[player]! Gwa ha ha ha! È\lfantastico!

entries.original:
"What, you want somethin’ else, kid?

\.

My bro?

Geez, that punk never quits.

Alright, as a favour to you for
beatin’ me, I’ll go with you."
entries.translation_source: What, you want somethin’ else, kid? [game-token-1] My bro? Geez, that punk never quits. Alright, as a favour to you for beatin’ me, I’ll go with you.
entries.translated:
Eh, vuoi qualcos{B4}altro, ragazzo? \.
Il mio bro? Mamma mia, quel punk\lnon molla mai. Va bene, per fare un

favore a te che mi hai battuto,
vengo con te.

entries.original:
"I’ve told you time and time again,
bro, quit tryin’ to mess with\lthe Black Emboar!"
entries.translation_source: I’ve told you time and time again, bro, quit tryin’ to mess with the Black Emboar!
entries.translated:
Te l{B4}ho già detto un sacco di
volte, fratello, smettila di\lcercare guai con il Black Emboar!

entries.original:
"I can’t, James.
You’re my brother.

You mean everything to me.

And I can’t let you go down this
path any longer!"
entries.translation_source: I can’t, James. You’re my brother. You mean everything to me. And I can’t let you go down this path any longer!
entries.translated:
Non posso, James. Sei mio fratello.
Per me sei tutto. E non posso\llasciare che tu continui a

percorrere questa strada!

entries.original:
"You claim you care about me, but
you really ain’t got no guts, bro.

You keep sendin’ these Trainers to
harass me ’cause you’re too scared\lto get your own hands dirty."
entries.translation_source: You claim you care about me, but you really ain’t got no guts, bro. You keep sendin’ these Trainers to harass me ’cause you’re too scared to get your own hands dirty.
entries.translated:
Dici di volermi bene, ma in realtà
non hai proprio fegato, fratello.\lContinui a mandare questi

Allenatori a darmi fastidio perché
hai troppa paura di sporcarti le\lmani di persona.

entries.original: "This kid, [player]’s got guts!"
entries.translation_source: This kid, [player-name-1]’s got guts!
entries.translated:
Questo ragazzino, [player], ha
fegato!

entries.original:
"Let me tell ya!

No one has ever wrecked me as good
as [buffer2] did!

I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar
to the Black [player], after [buffer1]!

So it’s time for a fresh start.

The Black [player] and I are movin’
to Antisis City!

I hear the old gang that used to
run that joint got ran outta town.

Terror Granbull, somethin’
or other\.

Now that city is ripe for the
pickin’ by the Black [player]!

Gwa ha ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Let me tell ya! No one has ever wrecked me as good as [buffer2-1] did! I’ve even renamed the Black Emboar to the Black [player-name-2], after [buffer1-3]! So it’s time for a fresh start. The Black [player-name-4] and I are movin’ to Antisis City! I hear the old gang that used to run that joint got ran outta town. Terror Granbull, somethin’ or other[game-token-5] Now that city is ripe for the pickin’ by the Black [player-name-6]! Gwa ha ha ha!
entries.translated:
Lascia che te lo dica! Nessuno mi
ha mai spaccato come ha fatto\l[buffer2]! Ho persino rinominato

Emboar Nero in Nero [player], in
onore di [buffer1]! Allora è ora di\lricominciare da capo. Il Nero

[player] e io ci trasferiamo ad
Antisis City! Ho sentito che la\lvecchia banda che gestiva quel

posto è stata cacciata dalla città.
Terror Granbull, o qualcosa del\lgenere\. Ora quella città è pronta

per essere presa dal Nero [player]!
Gwa ha ha ha!

entries.original:
"But James, you can’t just
leave me all alone!"
entries.translation_source: But James, you can’t just leave me all alone!
entries.translated:
Ma James, non puoi lasciarmi qui
tutta sola!

entries.original:
"I thought about makin’ you one of
us too, but I can’t have someone\lwho’s so weak in my squad!

Instead, I’ve decided to let [player]
join our ranks."
entries.translation_source: I thought about makin’ you one of us too, but I can’t have someone who’s so weak in my squad! Instead, I’ve decided to let [player-name-1] join our ranks.
entries.translated:
Avevo pensato di fare anche di te
uno di noi, ma non posso avere\lqualcuno così debole nella mia

squadra! Invece, ho deciso di far
entrare [player] nelle nostre fila.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Black [player], kid!

All members gotta have a Bike,
so take this."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Black [player-name-1], kid! All members gotta have a Bike, so take this.
entries.translated:
Benvenuto nel Black [player],
ragazzino! Tutti i membri devono\lavere una Bici, quindi prendi

questa.

entries.original:
"That’s a powerful Motorbike all
members of the Black [player] own!

You can press \btn02 to activate the
turbo boost, or you can take it\leasy and pedal.

Look us up if you ever come
by Antisis City.

We’ll welcome you with open arms."
entries.translation_source: That’s a powerful Motorbike all members of the Black [player-name-1] own! You can press [button-icon-2] to activate the turbo boost, or you can take it easy and pedal. Look us up if you ever come by Antisis City. We’ll welcome you with open arms.
entries.translated:
Quella è una potente Moto di tutti
i membri del Nero [player]! Puoi\lpremere \btn02 per attivare il turbo,

oppure puoi andare piano e
pedalare. Vieni a trovarci se passi\lmai da Antisis City. Ti

accoglieremo a braccia aperte.

entries.original:
"Welcome to the Black [player], kid!

Look us up if you ever come
by Antisis City.

We’ll welcome you with open arms."
entries.translation_source: Welcome to the Black [player-name-1], kid! Look us up if you ever come by Antisis City. We’ll welcome you with open arms.
entries.translated:
Benvenuto nel Black [player],
ragazzino! Vieni a trovarci se\lpassi mai da Antisis City. Ti

accoglieremo a braccia aperte.

entries.original:
"Sorry you got caught up in
all of that.

I may have lied when I told you I
hadn’t heard from my brother.

In truth, I knew he was the leader
of the Black Emboar.

I just thought you wouldn’t have
wanted to help if you knew you’d\lbe going up against their leader.

But now he’s gone for good, and
I’m left all alone\.

I feel so sheepish about this\.

Anyway, thank you for helping me.

Please take this TM for your time."
entries.translation_source: Sorry you got caught up in all of that. I may have lied when I told you I hadn’t heard from my brother. In truth, I knew he was the leader of the Black Emboar. I just thought you wouldn’t have wanted to help if you knew you’d be going up against their leader. But now he’s gone for good, and I’m left all alone[game-token-1] I feel so sheepish about this[game-token-2] Anyway, thank you for helping me. Please take this TM for your time.
entries.translated:
Mi dispiace che tu sia rimasto
coinvolto in tutto questo. Potrei\laverti mentito quando ti ho detto

che non avevo notizie da mio
fratello. In realtà, sapevo che era\lil capo dei Black Emboar. Pensavo

solo che non avresti voluto aiutare
se avessi saputo che ti saresti\lscontrato con il loro capo. Ma ora

lui se n{B4}è andato per sempre, e io
sono rimasto tutto solo\. Mi sento\lcosì imbarazzato per questo\.

Comunque, grazie per avermi
aiutato. Per il tuo tempo, prendi\lquesta MT.

entries.original:
"Hey!
Yeah, you, the little brat there!

Get over here!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! Yeah, you, the little brat there! Get over here!
entries.translated:
Ehi! Sì, tu, marmocchio laggiù!
Vieni qui!

entries.original:
"Hey!
Who said ya can pass through here?

This place belongs to us, the
Black Emboar!

It’s like our Gym, kid!

So scram! Toddle off home to your
ma, ya little goody-two-shoes punk!"
entries.translation_source: Hey! Who said ya can pass through here? This place belongs to us, the Black Emboar! It’s like our Gym, kid! So scram! Toddle off home to your ma, ya little goody-two-shoes punk!
entries.translated:
Ehi! Chi ha detto che puoi passare
di qui? Questo posto appartiene a\lnoi, i Black Emboar! È come la

nostra Palestra, ragazzino! Quindi
sparisci! Tornatene a casa da\lmammina, piccolo bravo ragazzo

impiccione!

entries.original:
"Ha! Fine!

Brats like you with a future
so bright\.

Just go on back home, and be nice
to your parents.

Don’t forget your baby bottle!"
entries.translation_source: Ha! Fine! Brats like you with a future so bright[game-token-1] Just go on back home, and be nice to your parents. Don’t forget your baby bottle!
entries.translated:
Ah! Bene! Marmocchi come te, con un
futuro così luminoso\. Tornate pure a\lcasa, e siate gentili con i vostri

genitori. Non dimenticate il
biberon!

entries.original:
"What didja say, ya little creep?

I’ll teach ya to take the Black
Emboar seriously!

I’ll pummel your pretty Pokémon
right down to the ground!

With relish!"
entries.translation_source: What didja say, ya little creep? I’ll teach ya to take the Black Emboar seriously! I’ll pummel your pretty Pokémon right down to the ground! With relish!
entries.translated:
Che hai detto, eh, piccolo viscido?
Ti insegnerò a prendere sul serio\lil Black Emboar! Ti spedirò i tuoi

graziosi Pokémon dritti al tappeto!
Con gusto!

entries.original:
"Don’t get all high and mighty
because you beat me!

If you really want to pick a fight
with the Black Emboar, go duke\lit out with our leader!

He’s somewhere in this tunnel!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t get all high and mighty because you beat me! If you really want to pick a fight with the Black Emboar, go duke it out with our leader! He’s somewhere in this tunnel!
entries.translated:
Non montarti la testa solo perché
mi hai battuto! Se vuoi davvero\lmenare le mani con il Black Emboar,

vai a scontrarti con il nostro
capo! È da qualche parte in questo\ltunnel!

entries.original:
"[blue]Hey! Who said ya can pass
through here?

This is Black Emboar territory!

Go back to where you came from!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hey! Who said ya can pass through here? This is Black Emboar territory! Go back to where you came from!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ehi! Chi ti ha detto che puoi
passare di qui? Questa è zona dei\lBlack Emboar! Torna da dove sei

venuto!

entries.original: "Get lost, punk."
entries.translation_source: Get lost, punk.
entries.translated: Sparisci, teppista.

entries.original: "We’re the Black Emboar, you litch!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Emboar, you litch!
entries.translated: Siamo gli Emboar Neri, litch!

entries.original:
"The Black Emboar won’t fall
so easily!"
entries.translation_source: The Black Emboar won’t fall so easily!
entries.translated:
L{B4}Emboar Nero non cadrà così
facilmente!

entries.original:
"Hey, hey, kid!
It’s dangerous!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, hey, kid! It’s dangerous!
entries.translated: Ehi, ehi, ragazzo! È pericoloso!

entries.original:
"The Black Emboar!
Never stop, and never look back!"
entries.translation_source: The Black Emboar! Never stop, and never look back!
entries.translated:
L{B4}Emboar Nero! Non fermarti mai e
non guardarti mai indietro!

entries.original:
"Whad’ya want kid?

We’re busy!"
entries.translation_source: Whad’ya want kid? We’re busy!
entries.translated:
Che vuoi, ragazzino? Siamo
occupati!

entries.original:
"[player]!

You made it!
Welcome to the Black [player] HQ!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! You made it! Welcome to the Black [player-name-2] HQ!
entries.translated:
[player]! Ce l{B4}hai fatta! Benvenuto
al Black [player] HQ!

entries.original:
"It don’t look like much right now,
but I’m tellin’ you, once we take\lout those Black Ferrothorns, we’ll\lfix the place right up.

Of course, we’d be happy if you
stuck around and helped us deal\lwith those losers.

I’m busy comin’ up with a foolproof
strategy for our attack, so in the\lmeantime, why don’t you help your\lfellow Black [player] out?"
entries.translation_source: It don’t look like much right now, but I’m tellin’ you, once we take out those Black Ferrothorns, we’ll fix the place right up. Of course, we’d be happy if you stuck around and helped us deal with those losers. I’m busy comin’ up with a foolproof strategy for our attack, so in the meantime, why don’t you help your fellow Black [player-name-1] out?
entries.translated:
Adesso non sembra granché, ma ti
dico che, una volta sistemati quei\lBlack Ferrothorn, rimetteremo a

posto il posto in un attimo.
Naturalmente saremmo felici se\lrestassi a darci una mano contro

quegli sfigati. Sono impegnato a
mettere a punto una strategia\linfallibile per il nostro attacco,

quindi nel frattempo perché non
aiuti il tuo compagno Black\l[player]?

entries.original:
"You’re just in time, [player].

We figured out how we’re gonna take
down those Black Ferrothorns.

We’re gonna pull a gutsy move and
attack from the sewers.

Gwa ha ha ha!

Those arrogant loaves of meat won’t
know what hit em’!"
entries.translation_source: You’re just in time, [player-name-1]. We figured out how we’re gonna take down those Black Ferrothorns. We’re gonna pull a gutsy move and attack from the sewers. Gwa ha ha ha! Those arrogant loaves of meat won’t know what hit em’!
entries.translated:
Sei arrivato giusto in tempo,
[player]. Abbiamo capito come\labbatteremo quei Black Ferrothorn.

Faremo una mossa audace e
attaccheremo dalle fogne. Gwa ha ha\lha! Quei pani di carne arroganti

non capiranno nemmeno cosa li ha
colpiti!

entries.original:
"Boys! Mount your bikes!
We’re goin’ to the sewers!"
entries.translation_source: Boys! Mount your bikes! We’re goin’ to the sewers!
entries.translated:
Ragazzi! Salite in sella alle bici!
Andiamo nelle fogne!

entries.original:
"I’m busy comin’ up with a foolproof
strategy for our attack against the\lBlack Ferrothorns.

In the meantime, why don’t you
help your fellow Black [player]\lout?"
entries.translation_source: I’m busy comin’ up with a foolproof strategy for our attack against the Black Ferrothorns. In the meantime, why don’t you help your fellow Black [player-name-1] out?
entries.translated:
Sono occupato a escogitare una
strategia infallibile per il nostro\lattacco contro i Black Ferrothorns.

Nel frattempo, perché non aiuti il
tuo compagno Black [player]?

entries.original:
"Before we moved in, this base
belonged to the old gang that used\lto run Antisis City.

After the Black Ferrothorn kicked
’em out, they left this base\lripe for the takin’.

We fixed it up real nice since we
got here, and we even replaced the\lplugged up hole to the sewers with\lactual stairs!"
entries.translation_source: Before we moved in, this base belonged to the old gang that used to run Antisis City. After the Black Ferrothorn kicked ’em out, they left this base ripe for the takin’. We fixed it up real nice since we got here, and we even replaced the plugged up hole to the sewers with actual stairs!
entries.translated:
Prima che ci trasferissimo, questa
base apparteneva alla vecchia gang\lche una volta controllava Antisis

City. Dopo che il Black Ferrothorn
li ha cacciati, hanno lasciato\lquesta base lì pronta per essere

presa. L{B4}abbiamo sistemata davvero
bene da quando siamo arrivati, e\labbiamo persino sostituito il buco

ostruito che portava alle fogne con
vere scale!

entries.original:
"We’re comin’ up with a strategy to
take down the Black Ferrothorn."
entries.translation_source: We’re comin’ up with a strategy to take down the Black Ferrothorn.
entries.translated:
Stiamo ideando una strategia per
abbattere il Black Ferrothorn.

entries.original:
"When we get rid of those Black
Ferrothorns, I’m gonna take one of\ltheir couches for myself.

I bet they have a boatload in that
fancy base of theirs!"
entries.translation_source: When we get rid of those Black Ferrothorns, I’m gonna take one of their couches for myself. I bet they have a boatload in that fancy base of theirs!
entries.translated:
Quando ci saremo liberati di quei
Black Ferrothorns, mi prenderò uno\ldei loro divani per me. Scommetto

che ne hanno un sacco nella loro
base così elegante!

entries.original: "Flushed Away"
entries.translation_source: Flushed Away
entries.translated: Trascinato via

entries.original:
"Someone’s havin’ toilet troubles!
Help your fellow Black [player] by
retrievin’ his socks from the sewer."
entries.translation_source: Someone’s havin’ toilet troubles! Help your fellow Black [player-name-1] by retrievin’ his socks from the sewer.
entries.translated:
Qualcuno ha problemi di toilette!
Aiuta il tuo compagno Black\l[player] recuperando i suoi calzini

dalla fogna.

entries.original:
"Hey, [player], buddy, how’s
it hangin’?

Listen, [player], the other day
I\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 accidentally flushed my\lfavourite pair of socks down the\ldrain.

I went down to the sewers to go
look for ’em, but I just couldn’t\lfind ’em for the life of me.

Now, I know what you must be
thinkin’.

Why were my socks in the toilet
in the first place?

Well\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 that doesn’t really
matter so much\.

So, I was thinkin’, maybe you could
have a go at searchin’ for me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player-name-1], buddy, how’s it hangin’? Listen, [player-name-2], the other day I[game-token-3][control-code-4] uh[game-token-5][control-code-6] accidentally flushed my favourite pair of socks down the drain. I went down to the sewers to go look for ’em, but I just couldn’t find ’em for the life of me. Now, I know what you must be thinkin’. Why were my socks in the toilet in the first place? Well[game-token-7][control-code-8] uh[game-token-9][control-code-10] that doesn’t really matter so much[game-token-11] So, I was thinkin’, maybe you could have a go at searchin’ for me?
entries.translated:
Ehi, [player], amico, come butta?
Ascolta, [player], l{B4}altro giorno\lio\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 per sbaglio ho buttato il mio

paio di calzini preferito nello
scarico. Sono andato giù nelle\lfogne a cercarli, ma non riuscivo

proprio a trovarli. Ora, so cosa
starai pensando. Perché mai avevo i\lcalzini nel water, per cominciare?

Beh\.\CC0818 uh\.\CC0818 non ha molta importanza\.
Quindi stavo pensando, magari\lpotresti provare a cercarli tu per

me?

entries.original:
"Thanks, [player].
I knew I could count on you.

You can use the staircase that leads
down in the corner, or you can just\luse the main entrance outside."
entries.translation_source: Thanks, [player-name-1]. I knew I could count on you. You can use the staircase that leads down in the corner, or you can just use the main entrance outside.
entries.translated:
Grazie, [player]. Sapevo di poter
contare su di te. Puoi usare le\lscale che scendono nell{B4}angolo,

oppure puoi semplicemente usare
l{B4}ingresso principale all{B4}esterno.

entries.original:
"You found ’em!

But oh man, do they reek!"
entries.translation_source: You found ’em! But oh man, do they reek!
entries.translated:
Li hai trovati! Ma accidenti, che
puzza!

entries.original:
"Uh\.\CC0818 oh, yeah\.

I should probably give you
somethin’ for your trouble.

I wiped that grime off of my socks,
but I don’t know where to get rid\lof it.

I’m sure you can find a better
place for it than I could."
entries.translation_source: Uh[game-token-1][control-code-2] oh, yeah[game-token-3] I should probably give you somethin’ for your trouble. I wiped that grime off of my socks, but I don’t know where to get rid of it. I’m sure you can find a better place for it than I could.
entries.translated:
Uh\.\CC0818 oh, sì\. Dovrei probabilmente
darti qualcosa per il disturbo. Ho\ltolto quella sporcizia dai miei

calzini, ma non so dove buttarla.
Sono sicuro che tu possa trovargli\lun posto migliore di me.

entries.original:
"I need you to find my socks,
[player]!

They’re probably covered in grime
’cause you know, they’re in the\lsewers.

I betcha they won’t be easy to spot
just by lookin’.

You can use the staircase that
leads down to the sewers in the\lcorner, or you can just use the\lmain entrance outside."
entries.translation_source: I need you to find my socks, [player-name-1]! They’re probably covered in grime ’cause you know, they’re in the sewers. I betcha they won’t be easy to spot just by lookin’. You can use the staircase that leads down to the sewers in the corner, or you can just use the main entrance outside.
entries.translated:
Ho bisogno che tu trovi i miei
calzini, [player]! Probabilmente\lsono coperti di sporcizia perché,

sai, sono nelle fogne. Scommetto
che non saranno facili da\lindividuare solo guardandoti

intorno. Puoi usare la scala che
scende nelle fogne nell{B4}angolo,\loppure puoi semplicemente usare

l{B4}ingresso principale all{B4}esterno.

entries.original:
"I don’t blame you, [player].
No hard feelin’s.

I’ll just have to live without
my favourite pair of socks from\lnow on\.

Sniff\."
entries.translation_source: I don’t blame you, [player-name-1]. No hard feelin’s. I’ll just have to live without my favourite pair of socks from now on[game-token-2] Sniff[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Non ti biasimo, [player]. Nessun
rancore. Dovrò solo vivere senza il\lmio paio di calzini preferito da

ora in poi\. Sniff\.

entries.original:
"I put my socks right on without
even washin’ ’em!

That’s how excited I am to have
’em back."
entries.translation_source: I put my socks right on without even washin’ ’em! That’s how excited I am to have ’em back.
entries.translated:
Mi sono infilato i calzini subito,
senza nemmeno lavarli! Tanto sono\lcontento di riaverli.

entries.original: "A Minor Scrap"
entries.translation_source: A Minor Scrap
entries.translated: Una piccola scaramuccia

entries.original:
"The Black Ferrothorn are a menace!
Knock around some of their goons to
expand the Black [player]’s turf."
entries.translation_source: The Black Ferrothorn are a menace! Knock around some of their goons to expand the Black [player-name-1]’s turf.
entries.translated:
I Black Ferrothorn sono una
minaccia! Fai fuori un po{B4} dei loro\lscagnozzi per espandere il

territorio del Black [player].

entries.original:
"Hey, [player], you wanna help out
with a little problem I’m havin’\lwith them Black Ferrothorn?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, [player-name-1], you wanna help out with a little problem I’m havin’ with them Black Ferrothorn?
entries.translated:
Ehi, [player], ti va di darmi una
mano con un piccolo problema che ho\lcon quei Black Ferrothorn?

entries.original:
"Here’s the low down.

I was fightin’ these goons to
expand our turf a while back,\lbut they totally wrecked me.

I dunno how they pulled it off, but
I was beatin’ ’em the whole time\.\luntil suddenly, I wasn’t.

I really wanna put ’em in their
place and expand our turf, but I\ljust ain’t strong enough.

You think you can take ’em both
out for me?"
entries.translation_source: Here’s the low down. I was fightin’ these goons to expand our turf a while back, but they totally wrecked me. I dunno how they pulled it off, but I was beatin’ ’em the whole time[game-token-1] until suddenly, I wasn’t. I really wanna put ’em in their place and expand our turf, but I just ain’t strong enough. You think you can take ’em both out for me?
entries.translated:
Ecco come stanno le cose. Qualche
tempo fa stavo combattendo questi\ltipi per espandere il nostro

territorio, ma mi hanno asfaltato
di brutto. Non so come abbiano\lfatto, ma li stavo battendo per

tutto il tempo\. finché,
all{B4}improvviso, non è più stato\lcosì. Voglio davvero metterli al

loro posto ed espandere il nostro
territorio, ma non sono abbastanza\lforte. Pensi di poterli eliminare

entrambi per me?

entries.original:
"You’re gutsy, [player].

I’ll take you to ’em now.

Hope you’re ready!"
entries.translation_source: You’re gutsy, [player-name-1]. I’ll take you to ’em now. Hope you’re ready!
entries.translated:
Hai fegato, [player]. Ti porterò da
loro adesso. Spero che tu sia\lpronto!

entries.original:
"Hmph.

Where’s those \qoguts\qc James keeps
goin’ on about?"
entries.translation_source: Hmph. Where’s those [quote-open-1]guts[quote-close-2] James keeps goin’ on about?
entries.translated:
Tsk. Dov{B4}è quel \qoguts\qc di cui James
non fa che parlare?

entries.original:
"Bein’ the lowlives they are,
they’re probably gonna team up\lon you.

You should get a least two Pokémon
ready to fight, just in case they\ldo."
entries.translation_source: Bein’ the lowlives they are, they’re probably gonna team up on you. You should get a least two Pokémon ready to fight, just in case they do.
entries.translated:
Essendo dei farabutti,
probabilmente ti si accaniranno\lcontro in gruppo. Faresti bene a

tenere pronti almeno due Pokémon
per combattere, nel caso lo\lfacciano.

entries.original:
"You ready to give it another shot,
[player]?

Those goons need to be put in
their place."
entries.translation_source: You ready to give it another shot, [player-name-1]? Those goons need to be put in their place.
entries.translated:
Sei pronto a riprovarci, [player]?
Quei farabutti vanno messi al loro\lposto.

entries.original:
"You really showed those Black
Ferrothorn goons, [player].

The bridge outside our base is now
totally under our control.

You’ve done it, [player].

Thanks to you, I’ve expanded our
turf just a little more.

You really are the gutsiest Trainer
I know."
entries.translation_source: You really showed those Black Ferrothorn goons, [player-name-1]. The bridge outside our base is now totally under our control. You’ve done it, [player-name-2]. Thanks to you, I’ve expanded our turf just a little more. You really are the gutsiest Trainer I know.
entries.translated:
Hai proprio sistemato quegli
scagnozzi dei Black Ferrothorn,\l[player]. Il ponte fuori dalla

nostra base è ora completamente
sotto il nostro controllo. Ce l{B4}hai\lfatta, [player]. Grazie a te, ho

ampliato il nostro territorio
ancora un po{B4}. Sei davvero\ll{B4}Allenatore più coraggioso che

conosca.

entries.original:
"[green]Power Items[blue] are essential for any
gutsy Trainer.

They make trainin’ your Pokémon to
be strong a lot easier."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Power Items[color-blue-2] are essential for any gutsy Trainer. They make trainin’ your Pokémon to be strong a lot easier.
entries.translated:
[green]Gli Strumenti Potenza[blue] sono
essenziali per qualsiasi Allenatore\lcoraggioso. Rendono molto più

facile allenare i tuoi Pokémon a
diventare forti.

entries.original:
"Those goons’ll be leavin’ that
bridge alone for a while now.

Thanks, [player]."
entries.translation_source: Those goons’ll be leavin’ that bridge alone for a while now. Thanks, [player-name-1].
entries.translated:
Quegli scagnozzi lasceranno in pace
quel ponte per un po{B4} adesso.\lGrazie, [player].

entries.original: "Rory"
entries.translation_source: Rory
entries.translated: Rory

entries.original: "Chad"
entries.translation_source: Chad
entries.translated: Chad

entries.original:
"Hey, Black Ferrothorn bozos!
I’m here for a rematch!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, Black Ferrothorn bozos! I’m here for a rematch!
entries.translated:
Ehi, stupidi Black Ferrothorn! Sono
qui per una rivincita!

entries.original:
"You hear that, Chad?

This weak punk honestly thinks he
can beat us!

Does he not remember the beatin’
we gave him last time?"
entries.translation_source: You hear that, Chad? This weak punk honestly thinks he can beat us! Does he not remember the beatin’ we gave him last time?
entries.translated:
Hai sentito, Chad? Questo debole
ragazzino pensa davvero di poterci\lbattere! Si è forse dimenticato

della batosta che gli abbiamo dato
l{B4}ultima volta?

entries.original:
"Oh, I aint gonna be doin’ any
fightin’.

My pal, [player], here, is gonna
destroy youse guys for me!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, I aint gonna be doin’ any fightin’. My pal, [player-name-1], here, is gonna destroy youse guys for me!
entries.translated:
Oh, io non combatterò. Il mio
amico, [player], qui, vi spazzerà\lvia lui al posto mio!

entries.original:
"Is that so?

Well, then we’re just gonna have to
pummel [buffer1] into the ground!"
entries.translation_source: Is that so? Well, then we’re just gonna have to pummel [buffer1-1] into the ground!
entries.translated:
Davvero? Allora dovremo soltanto
ridurre [buffer1] al tappeto!

entries.original:
"Chad! Gimme your Pokémon!

I’m gonna take [buffer1] down with our
combined might!"
entries.translation_source: Chad! Gimme your Pokémon! I’m gonna take [buffer1-1] down with our combined might!
entries.translated:
Chad! Dammi i tuoi Pokémon!
Abbatterò [buffer1] con la nostra\lforza combinata!

entries.original:
"Go do this, man!

Rock their socks off, and toss ’em
down the drain!"
entries.translation_source: Go do this, man! Rock their socks off, and toss ’em down the drain!
entries.translated:
Vai a fare questa cosa, amico!
Mandali al tappeto e buttali giù\lnello scarico!

entries.original:
"We’re the Black Ferrothorn!

You think you got what it takes to
mess with both our Pokémon?"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Ferrothorn! You think you got what it takes to mess with both our Pokémon?
entries.translated:
Noi siamo il Black Ferrothorn!
Pensi di avere quello che serve per\lmetterti contro entrambi i nostri

Pokémon?

entries.original:
"This stuff we got off those
scientists is friggin’ useless!"
entries.translation_source: This stuff we got off those scientists is friggin’ useless!
entries.translated:
Sta roba che abbiamo preso a quegli
scienziati è dannatamente inutile!

entries.original:
"Come on, man!
How could this happen?"
entries.translation_source: Come on, man! How could this happen?
entries.translated:
Andiamo, amico! Com{B4}è potuto
succedere?

entries.original:
"Wha\.\CC0820 you shouldn’t be able
to beat the Black Ferrothorn!

Our hides are iron thick!"
entries.translation_source: Wha[game-token-1][control-code-2] you shouldn’t be able to beat the Black Ferrothorn! Our hides are iron thick!
entries.translated:
Che\.\CC0820 non dovresti essere in grado di
battere il Black Ferrothorn! La\lnostra pelle è dura come il ferro!

entries.original:
"Chad! Take your dumb Pokémon
back!

We’re gonna use those enhancers we
got off those dumb scientists."
entries.translation_source: Chad! Take your dumb Pokémon back! We’re gonna use those enhancers we got off those dumb scientists.
entries.translated:
Chad! Riprenditi il tuo Pokémon
scemo! Useremo quei potenziatori\lche abbiamo preso a quei scemi di

scienziati.

entries.original:
"You didn’t stand a chance before,
so you definitely don’t stand a\lchance now!

We’re gonna teach you what Pokémon
belongin’ to us Black Ferrothorn\lare really capable of!"
entries.translation_source: You didn’t stand a chance before, so you definitely don’t stand a chance now! We’re gonna teach you what Pokémon belongin’ to us Black Ferrothorn are really capable of!
entries.translated:
Prima non avevi alcuna possibilità,
quindi adesso non ne hai\lsicuramente! Ti insegneremo di cosa

sono davvero capaci i Pokémon che
appartengono a noi Black\lFerrothorn!

entries.original:
"Now you see who’s the real toughest
gang around here!

Your hides aren’t thick, they’re as
soft as a Smoochum!

Now, get out of here before I sic
[player] on you, again!"
entries.translation_source: Now you see who’s the real toughest gang around here! Your hides aren’t thick, they’re as soft as a Smoochum! Now, get out of here before I sic [player-name-1] on you, again!
entries.translated:
Adesso hai visto chi è la vera
banda più tosta qui intorno! La\lvostra pelle non è spessa, è

morbida come quella di uno
Smoochum! Ora sparite di qui prima\lche vi mandi [player] addosso, di

nuovo!

entries.original: "Barbs’ll make you all pay for this!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs’ll make you all pay for this!
entries.translated: Barbs ve la farà pagare per questo!

entries.original:
"You’re one gutsy Trainer,
[player]!

I dunno anyone else who woulda had
the guts to take on two Trainers\lwith pumped up Pokémon at once!

Ya know what\. come back to the
base an’ I’ll give you a little\lsomethin’ for your help."
entries.translation_source: You’re one gutsy Trainer, [player-name-1]! I dunno anyone else who woulda had the guts to take on two Trainers with pumped up Pokémon at once! Ya know what[game-token-2] come back to the base an’ I’ll give you a little somethin’ for your help.
entries.translated:
Sei un Allenatore davvero
coraggioso, [player]! Non conosco\lnessun altro che avrebbe avuto il

fegato di sfidare due Allenatori
con Pokémon potenziati tutti\linsieme! Sai una cosa\. torna alla

base e ti darò una piccola
ricompensa per il tuo aiuto.

entries.original:
"Back for more, wimps?

Then, let’s pummel you into the
ground another time!"
entries.translation_source: Back for more, wimps? Then, let’s pummel you into the ground another time!
entries.translated:
Tornati per prenderne ancora,
fifoni? Allora vi sbatteremo a\lterra un{B4}altra volta!

entries.original: "Odd Odd Docks"
entries.translation_source: Odd Odd Docks
entries.translated: Darsene Strambe

entries.original:
"It pays to look innocent. Help a
fellow Black [player] smuggle some
goods off the port after 8 PM."
entries.translation_source: It pays to look innocent. Help a fellow Black [player-name-1] smuggle some goods off the port after 8 PM.
entries.translated:
Conviene sembrare innocenti. Aiuta
un altro Black [player] a far\luscire di nascosto della merce dal

porto dopo le 20.

entries.original:
"Find the Oddish Leaves hidden on
west side of the Antisis Port and
smuggle them back to the city."
entries.translation_source: Find the Oddish Leaves hidden on west side of the Antisis Port and smuggle them back to the city.
entries.translated:
Trova le Foglie di Oddish nascoste
sul lato ovest del Porto Antisis e\lcontrabbandale di nuovo in città.

entries.original:
"[player], my [buffer1]!

I got a shipment of uh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense
comin’ in to the [green]Antisis Port[blue] one\lof these nights.

But it’s too hard for me to sneak
’em off the port on my own.

That’s where you come in.

You’re gonna meet me at the docks,
pick up the shipment, and smuggle\lit back to the base.

Capisce?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1], my [buffer1-2]! I got a shipment of uh[game-token-3][control-code-4] Rose Incense comin’ in to the [color-green-5]Antisis Port[color-blue-6] one of these nights. But it’s too hard for me to sneak ’em off the port on my own. That’s where you come in. You’re gonna meet me at the docks, pick up the shipment, and smuggle it back to the base. Capisce?
entries.translated:
[player], mio [buffer1]! Mi deve
arrivare una spedizione di ehm\. \CC0818\lIncenso Rosa al [green]Porto di Antisis[blue]

una di queste notti. Ma per me è
troppo difficile sgattaiolare via\ldal porto con loro da solo. È qui

che entri in gioco tu. Mi
incontrerai ai moli, prenderai la\lspedizione e la contrabbanderai

fino alla base. Capisci?

entries.original:
"Aww\.

Why you gotta be like that,
[player]?

I thought we’re like family now!"
entries.translation_source: Aww[game-token-1] Why you gotta be like that, [player-name-2]? I thought we’re like family now!
entries.translated:
Aww\. Perché devi fare così,
[player]? Pensavo che ormai fossimo\lcome una famiglia!

entries.original:
"Perfecto.

Meet me down at the docks sometime
between [green]8 PM[blue] and [green]12 AM[blue] tonight.

Come any later than midnight, and
my shipment will be sold elsewhere.

Can’t have that, can we?"
entries.translation_source: Perfecto. Meet me down at the docks sometime between [color-green-1]8 PM[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]12 AM[color-blue-4] tonight. Come any later than midnight, and my shipment will be sold elsewhere. Can’t have that, can we?
entries.translated:
Perfetto. Incontrami ai moli da
qualche parte tra le [green]8 PM[blue] e le [green]12\lAM[blue] stanotte. Se arrivi anche solo

un po{B4} più tardi della mezzanotte,
la mia spedizione verrà venduta\laltrove. Non possiamo avere questo,

vero?

entries.original:
"\.What?

You don’t wanna wait until tonight?

Then just change your clock’s hour
or somethin’, my [buffer1].

I won’t tell if you won’t.

But make sure you don’t change
the date!

Just the hour, otherwise who knows
what’d get messed up."
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]What? You don’t wanna wait until tonight? Then just change your clock’s hour or somethin’, my [buffer1-2]. I won’t tell if you won’t. But make sure you don’t change the date! Just the hour, otherwise who knows what’d get messed up.
entries.translated:
\.Cosa? Non vuoi aspettare fino a
stasera? Allora cambia l{B4}ora\ldell{B4}orologio o qualcosa del

genere, [buffer1]. Non lo dirò a
nessuno se non lo fai tu. Ma\lassicurati di non cambiare la data!

Solo l{B4}ora, altrimenti chissà cosa
si romperebbe.

entries.original:
"What are we still doing here,
[player]?

We better get going to the [green]docks[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: What are we still doing here, [player-name-1]? We better get going to the [color-green-2]docks[color-blue-3]!
entries.translated:
Che ci facciamo ancora qui,
[player]? Faremmo meglio ad andare\lai [green]docks[blue]!

entries.original:
"I stashed the Oddish Leaves in
between some crates on the [green]west[blue]\lside of the port.

Use one of dem fancy [green]Dowsing
Machines[blue] or somethin’ to find ’em.

Oh, and the spot I hid ’em in ain’t
ever gonna be blocked off by a\lbarrier, so don’t bother lookin’\lanywhere that can be blocked off.

Capisce?"
entries.translation_source: I stashed the Oddish Leaves in between some crates on the [color-green-1]west[color-blue-2] side of the port. Use one of dem fancy [color-green-3]Dowsing Machines[color-blue-4] or somethin’ to find ’em. Oh, and the spot I hid ’em in ain’t ever gonna be blocked off by a barrier, so don’t bother lookin’ anywhere that can be blocked off. Capisce?
entries.translated:
Ho nascosto le Foglie di Oddish tra
alcune casse sul lato [green]ovest[blue] del\lporto. Usa una di quelle

[green]Ricercaoggetti[blue] sofisticate o
qualcosa del genere per trovarle.\lAh, e il posto in cui le ho

nascoste non verrà mai bloccato da
una barriera, quindi non perdere\ltempo a cercare da qualche parte

che possa essere bloccata. Capito?

entries.original:
"Ha ha ha!

I knew if anyone could do it,
you could!

Now hand over dem Oddish Leaves."
entries.translation_source: Ha ha ha! I knew if anyone could do it, you could! Now hand over dem Oddish Leaves.
entries.translated:
Ah ah ah! Sapevo che, se qualcuno
poteva farcela, eri tu! Ora\lconsegnami quelle Oddish Leaves.

entries.original:
"Whoa\.

Sniffin’ on those leaves really
clears the mind\."
entries.translation_source: Whoa[game-token-1] Sniffin’ on those leaves really clears the mind[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Wow\. Annusare quelle foglie
schiarisce davvero la mente\.

entries.original: "[black]The goon is feeling tougher!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The goon is feeling tougher!
entries.translated: [black]Il teppista si sente più forte!

entries.original:
"You know what?
I know a guy up in Dresco Town.

He’s able to turn these Oddish
Leaves into a fine kind of mist.

Hows about I share some with you
for your effort?"
entries.translation_source: You know what? I know a guy up in Dresco Town. He’s able to turn these Oddish Leaves into a fine kind of mist. Hows about I share some with you for your effort?
entries.translated:
Sai una cosa? Conosco uno a Dresco
Town. È in grado di trasformare\lqueste Oddish Leaves in una nebbia

finissima. Che ne dici se te ne do
un po{B4} per il tuo impegno?

entries.original:
"My guy up in [green]Dresco Town[blue] can turn
Oddish Leaves into more of that\l[green]Dream Mist[blue].

Bring him some [green]Oddish[blue], and he’ll
happily do it for ya."
entries.translation_source: My guy up in [color-green-1]Dresco Town[color-blue-2] can turn Oddish Leaves into more of that [color-green-3]Dream Mist[color-blue-4]. Bring him some [color-green-5]Oddish[color-blue-6], and he’ll happily do it for ya.
entries.translated:
Il mio tipo a [green]Dresco Town[blue] può
trasformare le foglie di Oddish in\laltra [green]Dream Mist[blue]. Portagli un po{B4}

di [green]Oddish[blue], e lo farà volentieri per
te.

entries.original: "Goon C"
entries.translation_source: Goon C
entries.translated: Scagnozzo C

entries.original: "Black [player] Goon"
entries.translation_source: Black [player-name-1] Goon
entries.translated: Scagnozzo nero [player]

entries.original:
"Right on time, [player].

The shipment just arrived."
entries.translation_source: Right on time, [player-name-1]. The shipment just arrived.
entries.translated:
Proprio in tempo, [player]. La
spedizione è appena arrivata.

entries.original:
"Hey, duuuuuuude\.

How’z it hangin’?

I’ve gotta special shipment of
uh\.\CC0818 Rose Incense, here\.

Are you the dude that ordered
these?"
entries.translation_source: Hey, duuuuuuude[game-token-1] How’z it hangin’? I’ve gotta special shipment of uh[game-token-2][control-code-3] Rose Incense, here[game-token-4] Are you the dude that ordered these?
entries.translated:
Ehi, duuuuuuude\. Come va? Ho una
spedizione speciale di uh\.\CC0818 Incenso\lRosa, qui\. Sei tu quello che l{B4}ha

ordinato?

entries.original:
"Yup. That’d be me.
Lemme take ’em off your hands."
entries.translation_source: Yup. That’d be me. Lemme take ’em off your hands.
entries.translated:
Già. Sono io. Lascia che li prenda
io.

entries.original: "Enjoy ’em, duuuuuuude\."
entries.translation_source: Enjoy ’em, duuuuuuude[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Goditeli, duuuuuuude\.

entries.original:
"Now all you need to do is smuggle
’em back to the base, and then\."
entries.translation_source: Now all you need to do is smuggle ’em back to the base, and then[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Ora tutto quello che devi fare è
contrabbandarli alla base, e poi\.

entries.original: "Haw haw haw!"
entries.translation_source: Haw haw haw!
entries.translated: Ah ah ah!

entries.original: "Did someone mention Rose Incense?"
entries.translation_source: Did someone mention Rose Incense?
entries.translated:
Qualcuno ha menzionato l{B4}Incenso
Rosa?

entries.original:
"Haw haw haw!
We ain’t dumb!

We know das jus’ a codename fo’
Oddish Leaves!

Now fork ’em over or we’ll have ta
tell dem police\.

Haw haw haw!"
entries.translation_source: Haw haw haw! We ain’t dumb! We know das jus’ a codename fo’ Oddish Leaves! Now fork ’em over or we’ll have ta tell dem police[game-token-1] Haw haw haw!
entries.translated:
Eh eh eh! Non siamo mica stupidi!
Sappiamo che è solo un nome in\lcodice per Foglie di Oddish! Ora

sganciatele o diremo tutto alla
polizia\. Eh eh eh!

entries.original:
"Tauros waste.

We’ll have to deal with these Black
Ferrothorn goons before we can get\loff the port.

You keep ’em busy while I stash the
Oddish Leaves somewhere."
entries.translation_source: Tauros waste. We’ll have to deal with these Black Ferrothorn goons before we can get off the port. You keep ’em busy while I stash the Oddish Leaves somewhere.
entries.translated:
Che schifo di Tauros. Dovremo
occuparci di questi scagnozzi di\lBlack Ferrothorn prima di poter

lasciare il porto. Tu tienili
occupati mentre nascondo le Foglie\ldi Oddish da qualche parte.

entries.original:
"He ain’t gonna get far!

Dem coppers are gonna squash ’im
’cause of dem Oddish Leaves!

Like we gonna squash you!"
entries.translation_source: He ain’t gonna get far! Dem coppers are gonna squash ’im ’cause of dem Oddish Leaves! Like we gonna squash you!
entries.translated:
Non andrà lontano! Quei poliziotti
lo schiacceranno per colpa di\lquelle Foglie di Oddish! Come

schiacceremo te!

entries.original:
"You don’t stand a chance
against me!

I’m an elite member of the
Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: You don’t stand a chance against me! I’m an elite member of the Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated:
Non hai alcuna possibilità contro
di me! Sono un membro d{B4}élite dei\lBlack Ferrothorn!

entries.original:
"I knews we shoulda gone
after dat other guy\."
entries.translation_source: I knews we shoulda gone after dat other guy[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Lo sapevo che dovevamo inseguire
quell{B4}altro tipo\.

entries.original: "Over there, officer!"
entries.translation_source: Over there, officer!
entries.translated: Di là, agente!

entries.original:
"This distinguished citizen has
informed me that you two are\lattempting to smuggle Oddish\lLeaves off of the port.

What do you have to say
for yourselves?"
entries.translation_source: This distinguished citizen has informed me that you two are attempting to smuggle Oddish Leaves off of the port. What do you have to say for yourselves?
entries.translated:
Questo distinto cittadino mi ha
informato che voi due state\lcercando di contrabbandare Foglie

di Oddish fuori dal porto. Cosa
avete da dire in vostra discolpa?

entries.original:
"Us!?

It’s these two who are trying to
do that!

We just came to stop ’em!"
entries.translation_source: Us!? It’s these two who are trying to do that! We just came to stop ’em!
entries.translated:
Noi!? Sono loro due che stanno
cercando di farlo! Siamo venuti\lsolo a fermarli!

entries.original:
"Nonsense.

If that were the case, you would
have called for me immediately.

However, as I see it, since you
did not request my help, then you\ltwo are the most obvious suspects.

You’re both under arrest.

It’s time for you to come with me."
entries.translation_source: Nonsense. If that were the case, you would have called for me immediately. However, as I see it, since you did not request my help, then you two are the most obvious suspects. You’re both under arrest. It’s time for you to come with me.
entries.translated:
Sciocchezze. Se fosse stato così,
avresti chiamato subito me.\lTuttavia, per come la vedo io,

visto che non hai chiesto il mio
aiuto, siete voi due i sospetti più\lovvi. Siete entrambi in arresto. È

ora che veniate con me.

entries.original:
"That was a close one.

Now all that’s left is for you to
find the [green]Oddish Leaves[blue] I stashed\laway, and bring ’em back to our\lbase."
entries.translation_source: That was a close one. Now all that’s left is for you to find the [color-green-1]Oddish Leaves[color-blue-2] I stashed away, and bring ’em back to our base.
entries.translated:
Quello è stato un bello scampato
pericolo. Ora ti resta solo trovare\lle [green]Foglie di Oddish[blue] che ho

nascosto, e riportarle alla nostra
base.

entries.original:
"Where are they?

I dunno, I stashed ’em in between
some crates on the [green]west[blue] side of\lthe port.

Use one of them fancy [green]Dowsing
Machines[blue] or somethin’ to find ’em.

Meet me back at the [green]base[blue] when
you’ve found ’em."
entries.translation_source: Where are they? I dunno, I stashed ’em in between some crates on the [color-green-1]west[color-blue-2] side of the port. Use one of them fancy [color-green-3]Dowsing Machines[color-blue-4] or somethin’ to find ’em. Meet me back at the [color-green-5]base[color-blue-6] when you’ve found ’em.
entries.translated:
Dove sono? Boh, li ho nascosti in
mezzo ad alcune casse sul lato\l[green]ovest[blue] del porto. Usa una di quelle

eleganti [green]Cercasfere[blue] o qualcosa del
genere per trovarli. Incontrami di\lnuovo alla [green]base[blue] quando li avrai

trovati.

entries.original:
"Come on, [buffer1]!

I said between [green]8 PM[blue] and [green]12 AM[blue]!
Ya missed the shipment!

We’ll just have to try again
another night."
entries.translation_source: Come on, [buffer1-1]! I said between [color-green-2]8 PM[color-blue-3] and [color-green-4]12 AM[color-blue-5]! Ya missed the shipment! We’ll just have to try again another night.
entries.translated:
Forza, [buffer1]! Ho detto tra [green]8 PM[blue]
e [green]12 AM[blue]! Hai perso la spedizione!\lDovremo riprovare un{B4}altra notte.

entries.original:
"Halt!

Are you carrying any illegal
merchandise?

Any Slowpoke Tails or Oddish
Leaves?

\.

Nope, you appear to be clean.
Proceed."
entries.translation_source: Halt! Are you carrying any illegal merchandise? Any Slowpoke Tails or Oddish Leaves? [game-token-1] Nope, you appear to be clean. Proceed.
entries.translated:
Fermo! Stai trasportando della
merce illegale? Code di Slowpoke o\lFoglie di Oddish? \. No, sembri a

posto. Avanti pure.

entries.original:
"Halt!

Show some valid identification if
you wish to pass."
entries.translation_source: Halt! Show some valid identification if you wish to pass.
entries.translated:
Alt! Mostra un documento valido se
vuoi passare.

entries.original:
"[black]You flashed your Trainer Card for
the guard."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]You flashed your Trainer Card for the guard.
entries.translated:
[black]Hai mostrato la tua Carta
Allenatore alla guardia.

entries.original:
"Your ID checks out.
Proceed."
entries.translation_source: Your ID checks out. Proceed.
entries.translated: Il tuo ID è valido. Procedi.

entries.original:
"Oh! You’re a very high ranking
Trainer.

[player], is it?

I’ll remember that from now on.

Feel free to come and go as
you please."
entries.translation_source: Oh! You’re a very high ranking Trainer. [player-name-1], is it? I’ll remember that from now on. Feel free to come and go as you please.
entries.translated:
Oh! Sei un Allenatore di altissimo
livello. [player], vero? Me lo\lricorderò da ora in poi. Sentiti

libero di entrare e uscire quando
vuoi.

entries.original:
"Halt!

Are you carrying any illegal
merchandise?

Any Slowpoke Tails or Oddish
Leaves?

\.

Hmm\.

You reek of Oddish Leaves\."
entries.translation_source: Halt! Are you carrying any illegal merchandise? Any Slowpoke Tails or Oddish Leaves? [game-token-1] Hmm[game-token-2] You reek of Oddish Leaves[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Alt! Stai trasportando merce
illegale? Code di Slowpoke o Foglie\ldi Oddish? \. Mmh\. Puzzi di Foglie di

Oddish\.

entries.original:
"It is most likely nothing\.
You are just a kid, after all.

I would hope someone as young as
you would not be involved with\lhorrible contraband like that\.

You are good to go.
Proceed."
entries.translation_source: It is most likely nothing[game-token-1] You are just a kid, after all. I would hope someone as young as you would not be involved with horrible contraband like that[game-token-2] You are good to go. Proceed.
entries.translated:
Molto probabilmente non è nulla\. Sei
solo un ragazzino, dopotutto. Mi\lauguro che qualcuno giovane come te

non sia coinvolto in un
contrabbando orribile come quello\.\lPuoi andare. Procedi.

entries.original: "Supply and Demand"
entries.translation_source: Supply and Demand
entries.translated: Offerta e domanda

entries.original:
"Hit the Black Ferrothorn where it
hurts by cutting off the supplies
they receive from a scientist."
entries.translation_source: Hit the Black Ferrothorn where it hurts by cutting off the supplies they receive from a scientist.
entries.translated:
Colpisci il Black Ferrothorn nel
punto dolente tagliando loro i\lrifornimenti che ricevono da uno

scienziato.

entries.original:
"[player]! My [buffer1]!

Come ’ere and ’elp me, why doncha?

Listen ’ere, pal.

Those Black Ferrothorns, see, they
gots all this good stuff.

They gots all the connections in
high places to get their Pokémon\lpumped up big an’ strong.

If we’re gonna take ’em out, we’re
gonna need to cut off their supply,\lya ’ear?

Good news is, I know where exactly
they’re gettin’ their goods from.

Ya see, there’s this scientist -
she lives not too far from ’ere.

She’s been gettin’ them all the
latest in enhancers the Science\lSociety ’as been puttin’ out on\lthe black market.

I’m too chicken to take ’er on
alone, but with you\.

That’d be a whole ’nother story,
ya ’ear?

So whaddya say, you in, my [buffer1]?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! My [buffer1-2]! Come ’ere and ’elp me, why doncha? Listen ’ere, pal. Those Black Ferrothorns, see, they gots all this good stuff. They gots all the connections in high places to get their Pokémon pumped up big an’ strong. If we’re gonna take ’em out, we’re gonna need to cut off their supply, ya ’ear? Good news is, I know where exactly they’re gettin’ their goods from. Ya see, there’s this scientist - she lives not too far from ’ere. She’s been gettin’ them all the latest in enhancers the Science Society ’as been puttin’ out on the black market. I’m too chicken to take ’er on alone, but with you[game-token-3] That’d be a whole ’nother story, ya ’ear? So whaddya say, you in, my [buffer1-4]?
entries.translated:
[player]! Mio [buffer1]! Vieni qua e
aiutami, che dici? Senti, amico.\lQuei Black Ferrothorns, vedi, hanno

tutta questa roba buona. Hanno
tutti i contatti nei posti giusti\lper rendere i loro Pokémon forti e

robusti. Se vogliamo farli fuori,
dobbiamo tagliare la loro\lfornitura, capito? La buona notizia

è che so esattamente dove prendono
la merce. Vedi, c{B4}è questa\lscienziata - vive non molto lontano

da qui. Ha fornito loro tutti gli
ultimi potenziamenti che la Science\lSociety ha messo sul mercato nero.

Sono troppo fifone per affrontarla
da solo, ma con te\. Sarebbe tutta\lun{B4}altra storia, capito? Allora,

che dici, ci stai, mio [buffer1]?

entries.original:
"Really, my [buffer1]?

I can’t believe what I’m ’earin’!"
entries.translation_source: Really, my [buffer1-1]? I can’t believe what I’m ’earin’!
entries.translated:
Davvero, il mio [buffer1]? Non
riesco a credere a quello che\lsento!

entries.original:
"Sweet, my [buffer1]!

We’re gonna gets our Pokémon
pumped up all big and strong,\lya ’ear?

Let’s do this thing!

That scientist lives in the ’ouse
right next to the Pokémon Center.

I’ll go on ahead and meet you
there, my [buffer1]!"
entries.translation_source: Sweet, my [buffer1-1]! We’re gonna gets our Pokémon pumped up all big and strong, ya ’ear? Let’s do this thing! That scientist lives in the ’ouse right next to the Pokémon Center. I’ll go on ahead and meet you there, my [buffer1-2]!
entries.translated:
Fantastico, il mio [buffer1]! Faremo
pompare i nostri Pokémon, grandi e\lforti, capito? Facciamolo davvero!

Quello scienziato vive nella casa
proprio accanto al Centro Pokémon.\lVado avanti e ci vediamo lì, il mio

[buffer1]!

entries.original:
"’ey! My [buffer1]!

Thanks to your ’elp, we’ve now
got a great way to pump up our\lPokémon before we fight them\lBlack Ferrothorns!

That Pokémon I nabbed from that
scientist was what she was usin’\lto create the serum that them\lBlack Ferrothorns ’ave been usin’,\lya ’ear?

No idea ’ow she was doin’ it,
though.

It must’ve been some weird power
of alchemy.

That don’t really matter, though,
since James knows ’ow to do it for\lus, too, ya ’ear?

Oh, yeah, I almost forgot, my [buffer1].
James wanted you to ’ave this."
entries.translation_source: ’ey! My [buffer1-1]! Thanks to your ’elp, we’ve now got a great way to pump up our Pokémon before we fight them Black Ferrothorns! That Pokémon I nabbed from that scientist was what she was usin’ to create the serum that them Black Ferrothorns ’ave been usin’, ya ’ear? No idea ’ow she was doin’ it, though. It must’ve been some weird power of alchemy. That don’t really matter, though, since James knows ’ow to do it for us, too, ya ’ear? Oh, yeah, I almost forgot, my [buffer1-2]. James wanted you to ’ave this.
entries.translated:
{B4}ey! Mio [buffer1]! Grazie al tuo
{B4}aiuto, ora abbiamo un ottimo modo\lper potenziare i nostri Pokémon

prima di affrontare quelle Black
Ferrothorn! Quel Pokémon che ho\lfregato a quello scienziato era

quello che lei usava per creare il
siero che quelle Black Ferrothorn\lhanno usato, hai capito? Però non

ho idea di come facesse. Deve
essere stato qualche strano potere\ldell{B4}alchimia. Comunque non importa

davvero, visto che James sa come
farlo anche per noi, hai capito?\lOh, già, quasi dimenticavo, mio

[buffer1]. James voleva che tu
avessi questo.

entries.original: "You received an Egg from the goon!"
entries.translation_source: You received an Egg from the goon!
entries.translated: Hai ricevuto un Uovo dal teppista!

entries.original:
"[player]! My [buffer1]!

I ’ave something from James to give
you, but you need more space in\lyour party if you want me to fork\lit over, ya ’ear?"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! My [buffer1-2]! I ’ave something from James to give you, but you need more space in your party if you want me to fork it over, ya ’ear?
entries.translated:
[player]! Mio [buffer1]! Ho qualcosa
da darti da parte di James, ma ti\lserve più spazio in squadra se vuoi

che te lo consegni, hai capito?

entries.original:
"[player]! My [buffer1]!

Can you feel it?

It’s almost time to take down them
Black Ferrothorns, ya ’ear?

Now that they ain’t got any more
supply of that stat pumper, they\lain’t gonna stand a chance against\lus Black [player]!"
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1]! My [buffer1-2]! Can you feel it? It’s almost time to take down them Black Ferrothorns, ya ’ear? Now that they ain’t got any more supply of that stat pumper, they ain’t gonna stand a chance against us Black [player-name-3]!
entries.translated:
[player]! Mio [buffer1]! Lo senti? È
quasi ora di abbattere quei Black\lFerrothorn, eh? Ora che non hanno

più quella roba che aumenta le
statistiche, non avranno alcuna\lchance contro di noi Black

[player]!

entries.original: "’ey, you, scientist lady!"
entries.translation_source: ’ey, you, scientist lady!
entries.translated: Ehi, tu, signora scienziata!

entries.original:
"Yeah, you!
Listen, ’ere!

I’m a proud member of the Black
[player], ya ’ear?

And we Black [player] know you’ve
been givin’ those lousy Black\lFerrothorns some good deals on\lsome ’igh end products.

So, I’m gonna say this only once!

’and over the product, ya ’ear?

And maybe we’ll let you get away
with the rest of your belongin’s\."
entries.translation_source: Yeah, you! Listen, ’ere! I’m a proud member of the Black [player-name-1], ya ’ear? And we Black [player-name-2] know you’ve been givin’ those lousy Black Ferrothorns some good deals on some ’igh end products. So, I’m gonna say this only once! ’and over the product, ya ’ear? And maybe we’ll let you get away with the rest of your belongin’s[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Ehi, tu! Ascolta, {B4}ere! Sono un
fiero membro dei Black [player],\lcapisci? E noi Black [player]

sappiamo che hai fatto degli ottimi
affari con quei miseri Black\lFerrothorns su alcuni prodotti di

fascia alta. Quindi, lo dirò una
sola volta! Consegnaci il prodotto,\lcapisci? E magari lasceremo perdere

il resto delle tue cose\.

entries.original:
"[red]You think I’m afraid of you scum?

The Science Society has given me
all the tools I need to defend\lmyself from thugs like you.

Home security system!

Activate all defenses!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]You think I’m afraid of you scum? The Science Society has given me all the tools I need to defend myself from thugs like you. Home security system! Activate all defenses!
entries.translated:
[red]Pensi che io abbia paura di voi
feccia? La Società Scientifica mi\lha dato tutti gli strumenti di cui

ho bisogno per difendermi da
delinquenti come voi. Sistema di\lsicurezza domestico! Attivate tutte

le difese!

entries.original: "Why, you, I oughta\."
entries.translation_source: Why, you, I oughta[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Tu, ti sistemo io\.

entries.original: "Ugh\."
entries.translation_source: Ugh[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Ugh\.

entries.original:
"[red]I’d advise you to stay away from
me, young [buffer1]!

I’ve been forced to take drastic
measures to defend my home!

And I’m not above hurting scum
to defend my property!

So, leave this instant if you know
what’s good for you!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’d advise you to stay away from me, young [buffer1-2]! I’ve been forced to take drastic measures to defend my home! And I’m not above hurting scum to defend my property! So, leave this instant if you know what’s good for you!
entries.translated:
[red]Ti consiglierei di stare lontano da
me, giovane [buffer1]! Sono stato\lcostretto a prendere misure

drastiche per difendere casa mia! E
non sono certo sopra il ferire\ldella feccia per difendere la mia

proprietà! Quindi vattene
all{B4}istante se tieni alla pelle!

entries.original: "Man"
entries.translation_source: Man
entries.translated: Uomo

entries.original:
"Oh, no!
There’s an Electrode underfoot!"
entries.translation_source: Oh, no! There’s an Electrode underfoot!
entries.translated:
Oh, no! C{B4}è un Electrode sotto i
piedi!

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 you\.

How did you make it through
my trap?

No matter!

You may have avoided all of the
explosions on the floor, but can\lyou avoid all of these?"
entries.translation_source: You[game-token-1][control-code-2] you[game-token-3] How did you make it through my trap? No matter! You may have avoided all of the explosions on the floor, but can you avoid all of these?
entries.translated:
Tu\.\CC0820 tu\. Come hai fatto a superare la
mia trappola? Non importa! Potresti\laver evitato tutte le esplosioni

sul pavimento, ma riuscirai a
evitare anche tutte queste?

entries.original:
"No! I knew I should have taught
them more than just Explosion!"
entries.translation_source: No! I knew I should have taught them more than just Explosion!
entries.translated:
No! Sapevo che avrei dovuto
insegnare loro più di una sola\lEsplosione!

entries.original:
"You\. you\.

You just wait!

I have plenty more Electrode on
the floor to use against you!"
entries.translation_source: You[game-token-1] you[game-token-2] You just wait! I have plenty more Electrode on the floor to use against you!
entries.translated:
Tu\. tu\. Aspetta e vedrai! Ho ancora
un sacco di Electrode al piano di\lsotto da usare contro di te!

entries.original: "Serves you right, you mug."
entries.translation_source: Serves you right, you mug.
entries.translated: Te la sei cercata, idiota.

entries.original:
"Looks like she’s out cold,
my [buffer1].

Let’s get searchin’ and find out
where she ’id all of them stat\lenhancers she used to power up\lall them Electrode."
entries.translation_source: Looks like she’s out cold, my [buffer1-1]. Let’s get searchin’ and find out where she ’id all of them stat enhancers she used to power up all them Electrode.
entries.translated:
Sembra che sia KO, mio [buffer1].
Mettiamoci a cercare e scopriamo\ldove ha messo tutti quei

potenziatori delle statistiche che
ha usato per potenziare tutti\lquegli Electrode.

entries.original:
"Let’s get searchin’ and find out
where that scientist ’id those\lstat enhancers she used to power\lup all them Electrode."
entries.translation_source: Let’s get searchin’ and find out where that scientist ’id those stat enhancers she used to power up all them Electrode.
entries.translated:
Diamoci da fare e scopriamo dove
quella scienziata ha nascosto quei\lpotenziatori di statistiche che ha

usato per potenziare tutti quegli
Electrode.

entries.original:
"I was stationed here by the Science
Society to help sell our\. er\.\lproducts in this decrepit part of\lthe region.

Unfortunately for you, I’m carrying
highly volatile goods, too unstable\lfor children to handle.

I’m sorry, but I cannot sell any
to you."
entries.translation_source: I was stationed here by the Science Society to help sell our[game-token-1] er[game-token-2] products in this decrepit part of the region. Unfortunately for you, I’m carrying highly volatile goods, too unstable for children to handle. I’m sorry, but I cannot sell any to you.
entries.translated:
Sono stato assegnato qui dalla
Science Society per aiutare a\lvendere i nostri\. eh\. prodotti in

questa decrepita zona della
regione. Sfortunatamente per te,\lsto trasportando merci altamente

instabili, troppo pericolose perché
dei bambini possano maneggiarle. Mi\ldispiace, ma non posso vendertene

nessuna.

entries.original: "[black]The scientist is out cold."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The scientist is out cold.
entries.translated: [black]Lo scienziato è svenuto.

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 you fiend!

Not only did you get away with the
goods I was supposed to supply to\lthe Black Ferrothorn, you also got\laway with the Pokémon I need to\lproduce those goods quickly!

Get out of my house this instant,
or I will let loose the Electrode\lon you!"
entries.translation_source: You[game-token-1][control-code-2] you fiend! Not only did you get away with the goods I was supposed to supply to the Black Ferrothorn, you also got away with the Pokémon I need to produce those goods quickly! Get out of my house this instant, or I will let loose the Electrode on you!
entries.translated:
Tu\.\CC0820 malvagio! Non solo sei scappato
con la merce che avrei dovuto\lconsegnare al Black Ferrothorn, ma

sei anche scappato con i Pokémon
che mi servono per produrre quella\lmerce in fretta! Fuori di casa mia,

subito, oppure lascerò scatenare
gli Electrode contro di te!

entries.original:
"[black]It’s a Poké Ball belonging to
the scientist.

Which Pokémon could it contain?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]It’s a Poké Ball belonging to the scientist. Which Pokémon could it contain?
entries.translated:
[black]È una Poké Ball appartenente allo
scienziato. Quale Pokémon potrebbe\lcontenere?

entries.original:
"[black]Something is balanced carefully on
the windowsill."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Something is balanced carefully on the windowsill.
entries.translated:
[black]C{B4}è qualcosa posato con cura sul
davanzale.

entries.original:
"You found ’em!

Them stat enhancers!

Good find, my [buffer1]!

Now, ’and ’em over so I can get ’em
back to James pronto."
entries.translation_source: You found ’em! Them stat enhancers! Good find, my [buffer1-1]! Now, ’and ’em over so I can get ’em back to James pronto.
entries.translated:
Li hai trovati! Quei potenziatori
di statistiche! Bel colpo,\l[buffer1]! Ora, passameli così posso

riportarli a James al più presto.

entries.original:
"[black][player] handed over the stat
enhancers."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] handed over the stat enhancers.
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha consegnato i
potenziatori di statistiche.

entries.original:
"And since that scientist lady is
out, let me just grab ’er Pokémon,\ltoo, ya ’ear?"
entries.translation_source: And since that scientist lady is out, let me just grab ’er Pokémon, too, ya ’ear?
entries.translated:
E visto che quella scienziata è
fuori, lasciami prendere anche i\lsuoi Pokémon, capisci?

entries.original:
"Ya see now, my [buffer1]?

We got them stat enhancers, and we
can use this Pokémon ’ere to ’elp\lmake some more of our own!

It’s a win-win!

I’ll see you back at the base once
I’ve got this all sorted out with\lJames, ya ’ear?"
entries.translation_source: Ya see now, my [buffer1-1]? We got them stat enhancers, and we can use this Pokémon ’ere to ’elp make some more of our own! It’s a win-win! I’ll see you back at the base once I’ve got this all sorted out with James, ya ’ear?
entries.translated:
Senti un po{B4}, [buffer1]? Abbiamo
quei potenziatori delle\lstatistiche, e possiamo usare

questo Pokémon qui per aiutarci a
farne altri da soli! È una\lsituazione vantaggiosa per tutti!

Ti aspetto alla base appena avrò
sistemato tutto con James, mi\lsenti?

entries.translation_source: Ferrothorn Turf

[player] down in the sewers."

Sconfiggi Barbs, il capo dei Black

callin’ us the Terror [player]!"

Bene, ragazzi! È il momento della
resa dei conti! Appena la bomba\lesplode, dategliene ai Black

Ferrothorn! Fate sì che si
spaventino così tanto da cominciare\la chiamarci il Terrore [player]!

entries.original:
"The bomb’s ready to blow!

Cover your freakin’ ears, unless ya
wanna lose em!"
entries.translation_source: The bomb’s ready to blow! Cover your freakin’ ears, unless ya wanna lose em!
entries.translated:
La bomba sta per esplodere!
Copritevi quelle dannate orecchie,\la meno che non vogliate perderle!

entries.original:
"Let’s go, boys!
Jump up through the hole!"
