entries.translation_source: Let’s go, boys! Jump up through the hole!
entries.translated:
Andiamo, ragazzi! Saltate su
attraverso il buco!

entries.original: "Jump up through the hole?"
entries.translation_source: Jump up through the hole?
entries.translated: Saltare su attraverso il buco?

entries.original:
"Come on, [player]!
Let ’em have it!

While James is busy dealin’ with
their leader on the [green]top floor[blue], we\lgotta wreak havoc!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player-name-1]! Let ’em have it! While James is busy dealin’ with their leader on the [color-green-2]top floor[color-blue-3], we gotta wreak havoc!
entries.translated:
Dai, [player]! Dagli dentro! Mentre
James è occupato a occuparsi del\lloro capo al [green]piano superiore[blue], noi

dobbiamo fare un macello!

entries.original:
"It’s over for you bozos, ya ’ear?

We ain’t gonna let any of you bozos
escape until you Black Ferrothorns\lare through and through!"
entries.translation_source: It’s over for you bozos, ya ’ear? We ain’t gonna let any of you bozos escape until you Black Ferrothorns are through and through!
entries.translated:
Per voi è finita, idioti, capito?
Non lasceremo scappare nessuno di\lvoi idioti finché i Black

Ferrothorn non saranno
completamente sistemati!

entries.original:
"What’s your problem, man?

I’m just tryin’ to watch some TV
in peace, here!"
entries.translation_source: What’s your problem, man? I’m just tryin’ to watch some TV in peace, here!
entries.translated:
Qual è il tuo problema, amico? Sto
solo cercando di guardare un po{B4} di\lTV in pace, qui!

entries.original:
"Hey, man, I was here first!

This is my couch!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, man, I was here first! This is my couch!
entries.translated:
Ehi, amico, ero qui prima io!
Questo è il mio divano!

entries.original:
"Hey, man, quit shovin’!

Or they’ll notice we’re fightin’
amongst ourselves!

There’s more than enough room for
the both of us!"
entries.translation_source: Hey, man, quit shovin’! Or they’ll notice we’re fightin’ amongst ourselves! There’s more than enough room for the both of us!
entries.translated:
Ehi, amico, smettila di spingere!
Altrimenti si accorgeranno che\lstiamo litigando tra di noi! C{B4}è

spazio più che sufficiente per
entrambi!

entries.original:
"I remember you!

You’re one of them knuckleheads who
threw my socks down the drain!

Get a whiff of ’em now!"
entries.translation_source: I remember you! You’re one of them knuckleheads who threw my socks down the drain! Get a whiff of ’em now!
entries.translated:
Ti ricordo! Sei uno di quei
cerebrolesi che hanno gettato le\lmie calze nello scarico! Adesso

sentine il tanfo!

entries.original:
"Ugh\. geez, man!

Get those out of my face!
They reek!"
entries.translation_source: Ugh[game-token-1] geez, man! Get those out of my face! They reek!
entries.translated:
Ugh\. cavolo, amico! Toglili dalla
mia faccia! Puzzano!

entries.original:
"Remember me?

You and your pal tried to interfere
with my business down at the docks!

Not so tough without your buddy,
are you, now?"
entries.translation_source: Remember me? You and your pal tried to interfere with my business down at the docks! Not so tough without your buddy, are you, now?
entries.translated:
Ti ricordi di me? Tu e il tuo amico
avete provato a intralciare i miei\laffari al molo! Non fai più tanto

il duro senza il tuo compare, eh,
adesso?

entries.original:
"You’re comin’ at me on a bike!

What do you want me to say?

That I’m tough enough to go toe to
toe with someone on a motorcycle?

Well, I am!"
entries.translation_source: You’re comin’ at me on a bike! What do you want me to say? That I’m tough enough to go toe to toe with someone on a motorcycle? Well, I am!
entries.translated:
Mi vieni addosso in bici! Che vuoi
che dica? Che sono abbastanza tosto\lda affrontare alla pari qualcuno su

una moto? Ebbene, lo sono!

entries.original:
"I couldn’t imagine life without
the Shadows.

But when the Boss found us and gave
us a new purpose, we joined right\laway!"
entries.translation_source: I couldn’t imagine life without the Shadows. But when the Boss found us and gave us a new purpose, we joined right away!
entries.translated:
Non riuscivo a immaginare la vita
senza gli Shadows. Ma quando il\lBoss ci ha trovati e ci ha dato un

nuovo scopo, ci siamo uniti subito!

entries.original:
"We’re the Black Horizon!

The Terror Granbull joined forces
with the Black [player], so now our\lgang’s bigger an’ better!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Horizon! The Terror Granbull joined forces with the Black [player-name-1], so now our gang’s bigger an’ better!
entries.translated:
Siamo la Black Horizon! Il Terrore
Granbull si è unito al Black\l[player], così adesso la nostra

banda è più grande e più forte!

entries.original: "Get out of here, punk!"
entries.translation_source: Get out of here, punk!
entries.translated: Vattene da qui, teppista!

entries.original:
"Maybe this is a good time for me to
be done with this whole Light of\lRuin thing\."
entries.translation_source: Maybe this is a good time for me to be done with this whole Light of Ruin thing[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Forse è il momento giusto per
chiudere con tutta questa faccenda\ldella Light of Ruin\.

entries.original: "View the sequence again?"
entries.translation_source: View the sequence again?
entries.translated: Rivedere la sequenza?

entries.original:
"Green lights are flashing on
and off."
entries.translation_source: Green lights are flashing on and off.
entries.translated:
Luci verdi lampeggiano a
intermittenza.

entries.original:
"Good luck invadin’ more than just
the lower floors!

We have a top of the line security
system installed by none another\lthan a bunch of nerds!

Can’t get any better than that!

Those nerds really know what
they’re doin’, I tell ya!

Bwa ha ha!"
entries.translation_source: Good luck invadin’ more than just the lower floors! We have a top of the line security system installed by none another than a bunch of nerds! Can’t get any better than that! Those nerds really know what they’re doin’, I tell ya! Bwa ha ha!
entries.translated:
Buona fortuna a invadere più dei
piani inferiori! Abbiamo installato\lun sistema di sicurezza di

prim{B4}ordine, messo su da nientemeno
che da un gruppo di nerd! Non si\lpuò chiedere di meglio! Quei nerd

sanno davvero il fatto loro, te lo
dico io! Bwa ha ha!

entries.original:
"How did a kid Trainer get past our
top of the line security system?

Eh, it don’t matter.

We still have the old fashioned
brute force security system, too!"
entries.translation_source: How did a kid Trainer get past our top of the line security system? Eh, it don’t matter. We still have the old fashioned brute force security system, too!
entries.translated:
Come ha fatto un giovane Allenatore
a superare il nostro sistema di\lsicurezza all{B4}avanguardia? Eh, non

importa. Abbiamo ancora anche il
vecchio sistema di sicurezza a\lforza bruta, però!

entries.original:
"Our top of the line security system
only gets harder to crack once you\lgo higher up!

You think your puny brain is big
enough to handle it?"
entries.translation_source: Our top of the line security system only gets harder to crack once you go higher up! You think your puny brain is big enough to handle it?
entries.translated:
Il nostro sistema di sicurezza di
prim{B4}ordine diventa ancora più\ldifficile da violare man mano che

sali! Pensi che il tuo cervellino
sia abbastanza grande da reggerlo?

entries.original:
"You think you’re so smart crackin’
those codes below, doncha?

But are you smart enough to crack
the code to this door?

Chaw ha, I doubt it!

Those Science Society nerds who
built the security system, made\lthis one extra tough to crack!"
entries.translation_source: You think you’re so smart crackin’ those codes below, doncha? But are you smart enough to crack the code to this door? Chaw ha, I doubt it! Those Science Society nerds who built the security system, made this one extra tough to crack!
entries.translated:
Pensi di essere così furbo a
decifrare quei codici laggiù, eh?\lMa sei abbastanza furbo da

decifrare il codice di questa
porta? Chaw ha, ne dubito! Quei\lsecchioni della Science Society che

hanno costruito il sistema di
sicurezza l{B4}hanno resa ancora più\ldifficile da decifrare!

entries.original:
"Chaw ha!

You think I’m goin’ to let a little
punk like you actually crack the\lcode?

Just ’cause you’re smart enough to
get this far in, it don’t mean it’s\lgonna be all easy gettin’ to Barbs!

I’m gonna keep you so busy, you’re
gonna forget the code and have to\lstart all over again!"
entries.translation_source: Chaw ha! You think I’m goin’ to let a little punk like you actually crack the code? Just ’cause you’re smart enough to get this far in, it don’t mean it’s gonna be all easy gettin’ to Barbs! I’m gonna keep you so busy, you’re gonna forget the code and have to start all over again!
entries.translated:
Chaw ha! Pensi davvero che lascerò
a un pivello come te scoprire il\lcodice? Solo perché sei stato

abbastanza furbo da arrivare fin
qui, non significa che raggiungere\lBarbs sarà una passeggiata! Ti

terrò così occupato che ti
dimenticherai il codice e dovrai\lricominciare da capo!

entries.original:
"Next, go left!

No, go up!

Now, go right!

Actually, go left!

Now, spin around!

Chaw ha ha!

Good luck gettin’ to Barbs now!"
entries.translation_source: Next, go left! No, go up! Now, go right! Actually, go left! Now, spin around! Chaw ha ha! Good luck gettin’ to Barbs now!
entries.translated:
Poi, vai a sinistra! No, vai su!
Ora, vai a destra! Anzi, vai a\lsinistra! Ora, girati su te stesso!

Chaw ha ha! Buona fortuna ad
arrivare da Barbs adesso!

entries.original: "Urgh\.\CC0818 no\.\CC0818 way\."
entries.translation_source: Urgh[game-token-1][control-code-2] no[game-token-3][control-code-4] way[game-token-5]
entries.translated: Ugh\.\CC0818 no\.\CC0818 niente affatto\.

entries.original:
"Chaw ha ha ha!

Wait, was that serious?

I didn’t think the brains behind
the Black [player] was so wimpy!

\.wait. You WERE serious.

You really thought ya’d actually
beat Barbs.

Well, lemme tell ya somethin’,
ya stupid nobody.

I lead the Black Ferrothorn.

I AM the Black Ferrothorn.

And I got a reputation to uphold,
see?

So if ya seriously thought ya
could just steal our turf and\lsupplies, trash our digs, and\lbeat down my boys\.

Well, that would just give other
gangs the same stupid idea, ya\lget me?

So, now that you’re finished,
know what I’m gonna do?

By now, my boys have already
crushed yours and taken their\lPokémon.

So\.\CC0818 I’m gonna take your worthless
carcass, string ya up with the\lrest of ’em\.

And you’re gonna see that a
Ferrothorn’s spikes aren’t just\lfor show!"
entries.translation_source: Chaw ha ha ha! Wait, was that serious? I didn’t think the brains behind the Black [player-name-1] was so wimpy! [game-token-2]wait. You WERE serious. You really thought ya’d actually beat Barbs. Well, lemme tell ya somethin’, ya stupid nobody. I lead the Black Ferrothorn. I AM the Black Ferrothorn. And I got a reputation to uphold, see? So if ya seriously thought ya could just steal our turf and supplies, trash our digs, and beat down my boys[game-token-3] Well, that would just give other gangs the same stupid idea, ya get me? So, now that you’re finished, know what I’m gonna do? By now, my boys have already crushed yours and taken their Pokémon. So[game-token-4][control-code-5] I’m gonna take your worthless carcass, string ya up with the rest of ’em[game-token-6] And you’re gonna see that a Ferrothorn’s spikes aren’t just for show!
entries.translated:
Chaw ha ha ha! Aspetta, eri serio?
Non pensavo che la mente dietro il\l[player] Nero fosse così debole!

\.aspetta. ERI serio. Pensavi davvero
di battere Barbs. Beh, lascia che\lti dica una cosa, stupido nessuno.

Io guido i Ferrothorn Neri. IO SONO
il Ferrothorn Nero. E ho una\lreputazione da mantenere, capisci?

Quindi, se pensavi seriamente di
poter rubare il nostro territorio e\lle nostre provviste, distruggere i

nostri covi e picchiare i miei
ragazzi\. Beh, questo darebbe solo ad\laltre gang la stessa stupida idea,

capisci? Quindi, ora che hai
finito, sai cosa farò? Ormai, i\lmiei ragazzi hanno già schiacciato

i tuoi e preso i loro Pokémon.
Quindi\.\CC0818 prenderò la tua carcassa\lsenza valore, ti appenderò insieme

al resto di loro\. E vedrai che gli
aculei di un Ferrothorn non sono\lsolo per bellezza!

entries.original:
"Urgh!

[player]\.!"
entries.translation_source: Urgh! [player-name-1][game-token-2]!
entries.translated: Grr! [player]\.!

entries.original:
"What, [player]?

The guy you stooges are named
after?"
entries.translation_source: What, [player-name-1]? The guy you stooges are named after?
entries.translated:
Cosa, [player]? Quello da cui voi
scagnozzi avete preso il nome?

entries.original:
"That’s right! You’d\.\CC0818 better run!

Cos there’s no one bigger\.\CC0818 badder\.

Or\.\CC0818 urgh\.\CC0818 stronger than [player]!

[buffer3]’s gonna mop the floor with
all of ya!"
entries.translation_source: That’s right! You’d[game-token-1][control-code-2] better run! Cos there’s no one bigger[game-token-3][control-code-4] badder[game-token-5] Or[game-token-6][control-code-7] urgh[game-token-8][control-code-9] stronger than [player-name-10]! [buffer3-11]’s gonna mop the floor with all of ya!
entries.translated:
È così! Faresti meglio a scappare\.\CC0818
Perché non c{B4}è nessuno più grosso\.\CC0818\lpiù cattivo\. O\.\CC0818 urgh\.\CC0818 più forte di

[player]! [buffer3] vi spazzerà via
tutti!

entries.original:
"Chaw ha ha ha! In the flesh, huh?
What an honour!

C’mon, this kid?

[buffer3] don’t look like a rough n’
tough gangster at all!

Listen, [player].

I know ya might have been part of
this failure of a raid\.

But I’m pretty sure you’re just
some dumb kid who got in the gang\llife \qobecause it looked cool\qc.

So I’ll do ya a favour, and give
ya a chance.

I’ll take ya, one on one.

You win, I’ll let these chumps
go\.\CC0818 if they swear never to come\lback here again.

You lose, and sure, you get to go
free, but as for the rest of ’em\.

I’ll even be nice, and I won’t
totally wreck ya with the best\lPokémon I’ve got.

Whaddya say?"
entries.translation_source: Chaw ha ha ha! In the flesh, huh? What an honour! C’mon, this kid? [buffer3-1] don’t look like a rough n’ tough gangster at all! Listen, [player-name-2]. I know ya might have been part of this failure of a raid[game-token-3] But I’m pretty sure you’re just some dumb kid who got in the gang life [quote-open-4]because it looked cool[quote-close-5]. So I’ll do ya a favour, and give ya a chance. I’ll take ya, one on one. You win, I’ll let these chumps go[game-token-6][control-code-7] if they swear never to come back here again. You lose, and sure, you get to go free, but as for the rest of ’em[game-token-8] I’ll even be nice, and I won’t totally wreck ya with the best Pokémon I’ve got. Whaddya say?
entries.translated:
Chaw ha ha ha! In carne ed ossa,
eh? Che onore! Avanti, questo\lragazzino? [buffer3] non sembra

affatto un gangster duro e puro!
Ascolta, [player]. So che potresti\laver fatto parte di questo

fallimentare raid\. Ma sono
abbastanza sicuro che tu sia solo\lun ragazzino stupido che è entrato

nel giro delle gang \qoperché
sembrava figo\qc. Quindi ti farò un\lfavore e ti darò una possibilità.

Ti affronterò, uno contro uno. Se
vinci, lascerò andare questi\limbecilli\.\CC0818 a patto che giurino di

non tornare mai più qui. Se perdi,
certo, te ne andrai libero, ma per\lquanto riguarda gli altri\. Sarò

anche gentile e non ti distruggerò
completamente con i migliori\lPokémon che ho. Che ne dici?

entries.original:
"[player]\.\CC0818 careful\.\CC0818 Barbs ain’t
above cheatin’\.

Here.

He was usin’ this weird stuff on
his Pokémon when I fought him, but\.

He ain’t the only one\.\CC0818 so lemme\.\CC0818
jazz up your Pokémon a bit\."
entries.translation_source: [player-name-1][game-token-2][control-code-3] careful[game-token-4][control-code-5] Barbs ain’t above cheatin’[game-token-6] Here. He was usin’ this weird stuff on his Pokémon when I fought him, but[game-token-7] He ain’t the only one[game-token-8][control-code-9] so lemme[game-token-10][control-code-11] jazz up your Pokémon a bit[game-token-12]
entries.translated:
[player]\.\CC0818 fai attenzione\.\CC0818 Barbs non è
affatto uno che bara\. Ecco. Stava\lusando questa roba strana sui suoi

Pokémon quando l{B4}ho affrontato, ma\.
Non è l{B4}unico\.\CC0818 quindi lasciami\.\CC0818 dare\luna sistemata ai tuoi Pokémon un

po{B4}\.

entries.original:
"Enough posturin’!

Prepare for a real beatin’, from
the realest gang in Antisis!"
entries.translation_source: Enough posturin’! Prepare for a real beatin’, from the realest gang in Antisis!
entries.translated:
Basta mettersi in mostra! Preparati
a una vera pestata, da parte della\lbanda più tosta di Antisis!

entries.original:
"Well, ain’t that somethin’.

You’re actually not bad at all,
[player].

But yer still only one kid.

By now, the rest of my boys
downstairs\."
entries.translation_source: Well, ain’t that somethin’. You’re actually not bad at all, [player-name-1]. But yer still only one kid. By now, the rest of my boys downstairs[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Beh, accidenti, guarda un po{B4}. In
realtà non sei affatto male,\l[player]. Ma sei comunque solo un

ragazzino. Ormai, il resto dei miei
ragazzi è di sotto\.

entries.original:
"’Ey boss!

We utterly totalled those
Black Bozos!

Ain’t nothin’ left from ’em ’cept
a pile of broken dreams!"
entries.translation_source: ’Ey boss! We utterly totalled those Black Bozos! Ain’t nothin’ left from ’em ’cept a pile of broken dreams!
entries.translated:
{B4}Ey capo! Abbiamo fatto a pezzi
quei Black Bozos! Non è rimasto\lniente di loro, a parte un mucchio

di sogni infranti!

entries.original:
"Chaw ha ha ha!

Ya see, James?
Ya never stood a chance!

All that plannin’ meant jack,
cos ya didn’t have the manpower\lfor the job!"
entries.translation_source: Chaw ha ha ha! Ya see, James? Ya never stood a chance! All that plannin’ meant jack, cos ya didn’t have the manpower for the job!
entries.translated:
Chaw ah ah ah! Hai visto, James?
Non hai mai avuto una chance! Tutta\lquella pianificazione non valeva

niente, perché non avevi abbastanza
uomini per il lavoro!

entries.original:
"Good job, man.

Now throw ’em out on their rears.

No need to be gentle with ’em."
entries.translation_source: Good job, man. Now throw ’em out on their rears. No need to be gentle with ’em.
entries.translated:
Bel lavoro, amico. Ora buttagli
fuori di lì a calci nel sedere. Non\lc{B4}è bisogno di andarci piano con

loro.

entries.original:
"Wha\.\CC0818 we’re just lettin’ ’em go,
boss!?"
entries.translation_source: Wha[game-token-1][control-code-2] we’re just lettin’ ’em go, boss!?
entries.translated:
Cosa\.\CC0818 li stiamo solo lasciando
andare, capo!?

entries.original:
"We got better things to do today.
’Sides, they won’t come back."
entries.translation_source: We got better things to do today. ’Sides, they won’t come back.
entries.translated:
Oggi abbiamo cose più importanti da
fare. E poi, non torneranno.

entries.original:
"Well, [player], looks like this
is it for us.

Ya put up a good fight, kid.
Ya made us proud ’til the end.

But it’s time for the Black
[player] to move on.

We ain’t got no place in this town
anymore."
entries.translation_source: Well, [player-name-1], looks like this is it for us. Ya put up a good fight, kid. Ya made us proud ’til the end. But it’s time for the Black [player-name-2] to move on. We ain’t got no place in this town anymore.
entries.translated:
Beh, [player], sembra che per noi
sia finita. Hai combattuto bene,\lragazzino. Ci hai resi orgogliosi

fino alla fine. Ma è ora che il
Black [player] vada avanti. Non\labbiamo più posto in questa città.

entries.original:
"[blue]Maybe we’ll run into each other
somewhere down the line, kid.

I look forward to that day."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Maybe we’ll run into each other somewhere down the line, kid. I look forward to that day.
entries.translated:
[blue]Forse ci incontreremo da qualche
parte lungo la strada, ragazzo.\lAspetto con impazienza quel giorno.

entries.original:
"Now, then, [player], I’ve been real
nice to ya, but I think you’ve\loverstayed yer welcome.

I don’t care what ya do around
Antisis anymore, but don’t let me\lcatch ya around our turf again.

Now get out.

OUT!"
entries.translation_source: Now, then, [player-name-1], I’ve been real nice to ya, but I think you’ve overstayed yer welcome. I don’t care what ya do around Antisis anymore, but don’t let me catch ya around our turf again. Now get out. OUT!
entries.translated:
Allora, [player], sono stato
proprio gentile con te, ma credo\lche tu abbia tirato troppo la

corda. Non mi importa più di quello
che fai in giro per Antisis, ma non\lfarti più beccare dalle nostre

parti. Adesso levati di torno.
FUORI!

entries.original:
"Come on, [player]!
Show him how tough you are!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, [player-name-1]! Show him how tough you are!
entries.translated:
Avanti, [player]! Mostragli quanto
sei forte!

entries.original:
"[black]There’s a note attached!

[blue]\qo[player], you did good, kid.

You fought hard, but looks like the
rest of us weren’t tough enough to\ltake down those bozos.

You’re now all that’s left of the
Black [player].

Be strong, and keep your fightin’
spirit alive!

-James\qc"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]There’s a note attached! [color-blue-2][quote-open-3][player-name-4], you did good, kid. You fought hard, but looks like the rest of us weren’t tough enough to take down those bozos. You’re now all that’s left of the Black [player-name-5]. Be strong, and keep your fightin’ spirit alive! -James[quote-close-6]
entries.translated:
[black]C{B4}è un biglietto allegato!
[blue]\qo[player], hai fatto bene,\lragazzino. Hai combattuto con

coraggio, ma sembra che il resto di
noi non sia stato abbastanza tosto\lda sconfiggere quegli idioti.

Adesso sei tutto ciò che resta del
Black [player]. Sii forte, e tieni\lvivo il tuo spirito combattivo!

-James\qc

entries.original: " The Endless Nightmare"
entries.translation_source: The Endless Nightmare
entries.translated: L{B4}incubo senza fine

entries.original:
"A small boy is having a nightmare!
Find a way to wake him up."
entries.translation_source: A small boy is having a nightmare! Find a way to wake him up.
entries.translated:
Un bambino piccolo sta avendo un
incubo! Trova un modo per\lsvegliarlo.

entries.original:
"A small boy is having a nightmare!
Maybe a scientist at the Dream
Research Lab can wake him up."
entries.translation_source: A small boy is having a nightmare! Maybe a scientist at the Dream Research Lab can wake him up.
entries.translated:
Un bambino piccolo ha un incubo!
Forse uno scienziato del\lLaboratorio di Ricerca sui Sogni

può svegliarlo.

entries.original:
"A small boy is having a nightmare!
Speak to the boy’s father in
Tarmigan Town."
entries.translation_source: A small boy is having a nightmare! Speak to the boy’s father in Tarmigan Town.
entries.translated:
Un bambino piccolo sta facendo un
incubo! Parla con il padre del\lbambino a Tarmigan Town.

entries.original:
"A small boy is having a nightmare!
Board a boat to Fullmoon Island
and retrieve the Lunar Wing."
entries.translation_source: A small boy is having a nightmare! Board a boat to Fullmoon Island and retrieve the Lunar Wing.
entries.translated:
Un bambino piccolo ha un incubo!
Prendi una barca per Isola\lLunapiena e recupera l{B4}Ala Lunare.

entries.original:
"A small boy is having a nightmare!
Return to Tarmigan Town with the
Lunar Wing to wake up him."
entries.translation_source: A small boy is having a nightmare! Return to Tarmigan Town with the Lunar Wing to wake up him.
entries.translated:
Un ragazzino sta facendo un incubo!
Torna a Tarmigan Town con la\lPiumaluna per svegliarlo.

entries.original: "Eldon"
entries.translation_source: Eldon
entries.translated: Eldon

entries.original:
"I’ve lost my love of sailing since
my son fell into this horrid\lnightmare\.

If only there was someone who knew
how to heal him.

Maybe a scientist at the [green]Dream
Research Lab[blue] would know\."
entries.translation_source: I’ve lost my love of sailing since my son fell into this horrid nightmare[game-token-1] If only there was someone who knew how to heal him. Maybe a scientist at the [color-green-2]Dream Research Lab[color-blue-3] would know[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Ho perso la voglia di navigare da
quando mio figlio è caduto in\lquesto orribile incubo\. Se solo ci

fosse qualcuno che sapesse come
guarirlo. Forse uno scienziato del\l[green]Laboratorio di Ricerca dei Sogni[blue] lo

saprebbe\.

entries.original:
"That scientist said we need the
[green]Lunar Wing[blue] from [green]Fullmoon Island[blue]\lto heal my son.

Would you go to [green]Fullmoon Island[blue]
for me?

If not for me, then for my son?"
entries.translation_source: That scientist said we need the [color-green-1]Lunar Wing[color-blue-2] from [color-green-3]Fullmoon Island[color-blue-4] to heal my son. Would you go to [color-green-5]Fullmoon Island[color-blue-6] for me? If not for me, then for my son?
entries.translated:
Quel scienziato ha detto che ci
serve l{B4}[green]Ala Lunare[blue] di [green]Fullmoon\lIsland[blue] per guarire mio figlio.

Potresti andare a [green]Fullmoon Island[blue]
per me? Se non per me, allora per\lmio figlio?

entries.original:
"Great, thanks!
We’re both counting on you!

Only you can awaken my son from his
awful nightmare\.

Please, I need the Lunar Wing from
Fullmoon Island to awaken him!

When you’re ready to go, I have a
boat in Fallshore City that can\ltake us there."
entries.translation_source: Great, thanks! We’re both counting on you! Only you can awaken my son from his awful nightmare[game-token-1] Please, I need the Lunar Wing from Fullmoon Island to awaken him! When you’re ready to go, I have a boat in Fallshore City that can take us there.
entries.translated:
Perfetto, grazie! Contiamo entrambi
su di te! Solo tu puoi risvegliare\lmio figlio dal suo terribile incubo\.

Per favore, ho bisogno dell{B4}Ala
Lunare dell{B4}Isola Plenilunio per\lsvegliarlo! Quando sarai pronto a

partire, ho una barca a Fallshore
City che può portarci laggiù.

entries.original:
"Please, I need the Lunar Wing from
Fullmoon Island to awaken him!"
entries.translation_source: Please, I need the Lunar Wing from Fullmoon Island to awaken him!
entries.translated:
Per favore, ho bisogno dell{B4}Ala
Lunare di Fullmoon Island per\lsvegliarlo!

entries.original: "Do you wanna set sail?"
entries.translation_source: Do you wanna set sail?
entries.translated: Vuoi salpare?

entries.original:
"\.You\.

You’re ready to go to Fullmoon
Island for us?"
entries.translation_source: [game-token-1]You[game-token-2] You’re ready to go to Fullmoon Island for us?
entries.translated:
\.Tu\. Sei pronto ad andare a Isola
Lunapiena per noi?

entries.original: "Anchors aweigh!"
entries.translation_source: Anchors aweigh!
entries.translated: Salpate le ancore!

entries.original:
"That Pokémon you met was the
Lunar Pokémon\.

I’ve heard tales of it flying from
place to place throughout Borrius.

Oh! That sparkle\.
So that’s the Lunar Wing\.

Thank you\. That should wake my son
from the nightmare\."
entries.translation_source: That Pokémon you met was the Lunar Pokémon[game-token-1] I’ve heard tales of it flying from place to place throughout Borrius. Oh! That sparkle[game-token-2] So that’s the Lunar Wing[game-token-3] Thank you[game-token-4] That should wake my son from the nightmare[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Quel Pokémon che hai incontrato era
il Pokémon Lunare\. Ho sentito storie\ldi lui che volava da un luogo

all{B4}altro in tutto Borrius. Oh!
Quel bagliore\. Quindi quella è l{B4}Ala\lLunare\. Grazie\. Questo dovrebbe

svegliare mio figlio dall{B4}incubo\.

entries.original: "Should we sail back to Fallshore?"
entries.translation_source: Should we sail back to Fallshore?
entries.translated:
Dovremmo tornare a Fallshore in
nave?

entries.original:
"[blue]Now that we have the Lunar Wing,
I’m going to return to Tarmigan.

Please hurry and meet me at
my home."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Now that we have the Lunar Wing, I’m going to return to Tarmigan. Please hurry and meet me at my home.
entries.translated:
[blue]Ora che abbiamo l{B4}Ala Lunare,
tornerò a Tarmigan. Sbrigati e\lraggiungimi a casa mia.

entries.original:
"Please bring the Lunar Wing to
my son."
entries.translation_source: Please bring the Lunar Wing to my son.
entries.translated:
Per favore, porta l{B4}Ala Lunare a
mio figlio.

entries.original: "You’re awake!"
entries.translation_source: You’re awake!
entries.translated: Ti sei svegliato!

entries.original:
"As soon as you came near my son,
the Lunar Wing began to glow.

He woke up not long after, but it
seemed like you fell into a trance.

Now, seeing you and my son back to
normal makes me feel great!

I don’t have much that I can give
you in the way of thanks, but\lmaybe this can serve you more\lpurpose than it does me."
entries.translation_source: As soon as you came near my son, the Lunar Wing began to glow. He woke up not long after, but it seemed like you fell into a trance. Now, seeing you and my son back to normal makes me feel great! I don’t have much that I can give you in the way of thanks, but maybe this can serve you more purpose than it does me.
entries.translated:
Non appena ti sei avvicinato a mio
figlio, l{B4}Ala Lunare ha iniziato a\lbrillare. Si è svegliato poco dopo,

ma sembrava che tu fossi entrato in
trance. Ora, vederti e vedere mio\lfiglio tornati alla normalità mi fa

stare benissimo! Non ho molto da
darti come ringraziamento, ma forse\lquesto può esserti più utile di

quanto lo sia per me.

entries.original:
"Thank you!
We’ll never forget you!

I’ll be by the docks in Fallshore
City if you ever need to set sail."
entries.translation_source: Thank you! We’ll never forget you! I’ll be by the docks in Fallshore City if you ever need to set sail.
entries.translated:
Grazie! Non ti dimenticheremo mai!
Sarò ai moli di Fallshore City se\lavrai mai bisogno di salpare.

entries.original:
"I’m currently researching new ways
of waking Pokémon up from the\lSleep status condition.

These could have many applications
in modern-day life, so please,\ldo not disturb me."
entries.translation_source: I’m currently researching new ways of waking Pokémon up from the Sleep status condition. These could have many applications in modern-day life, so please, do not disturb me.
entries.translated:
Sto attualmente ricercando nuovi
modi per svegliare i Pokémon dallo\lstato di sonno. Questi potrebbero

avere molte applicazioni nella vita
moderna, quindi per favore, non\ldisturbarmi.

entries.original:
"Oh, hello there.
Do you need something?

\.

\.

A small boy won’t wake up from a
horrible nightmare?

And the father is in need of some
assistance to cure him?

This seems to be close enough to my
area of research.

I’ll go take a look."
entries.translation_source: Oh, hello there. Do you need something? [game-token-1] [game-token-2] A small boy won’t wake up from a horrible nightmare? And the father is in need of some assistance to cure him? This seems to be close enough to my area of research. I’ll go take a look.
entries.translated:
Oh, salve. Ti serve qualcosa? \. \. Un
bambino piccolo non si sveglia da\lun terribile incubo? E il padre ha

bisogno di aiuto per curarlo? Mi
sembra abbastanza vicino al mio\lcampo di ricerca. Vado a dare

un{B4}occhiata.

entries.original:
"I don’t know how much good it did,
but I hope I was able to help\lin some way. "
entries.translation_source: I don’t know how much good it did, but I hope I was able to help in some way.
entries.translated:
Non so quanto sia servito, ma spero
di essere riuscito ad aiutare in\lqualche modo.

entries.original:
"I heard you were able to heal that
boy after all!

I’m glad I was able to help."
entries.translation_source: I heard you were able to heal that boy after all! I’m glad I was able to help.
entries.translated:
Ho sentito che alla fine sei
riuscito a guarire quel ragazzo!\lSono felice di essere stata

d{B4}aiuto.

entries.original:
"[black]The little boy is thrashing about
in his sleep.

He appears to be in torment\.
He is muttering something\.

\qo[blue]Dar\.
Dark\. is watching\. me\. [black]\qc"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The little boy is thrashing about in his sleep. He appears to be in torment[game-token-2] He is muttering something[game-token-3] [quote-open-4][color-blue-5]Dar[game-token-6] Dark[game-token-7] is watching[game-token-8] me[game-token-9] [color-black-10][quote-close-11]
entries.translated:
[black]Il bambino si dimena nel sonno.
Sembra essere in preda al tormento\.\lSta borbottando qualcosa\. \qo[blue]Dar\. Dark\.

mi sta osservando\. me\. [black]\qc

entries.original:
"I’m going to be a Sailor like
my daddy!

He’s a real man among men!
Even the sea doesn’t scare him!"
entries.translation_source: I’m going to be a Sailor like my daddy! He’s a real man among men! Even the sea doesn’t scare him!
entries.translated:
Diventerò un Marinaio come il mio
papà! È un vero uomo tra gli\luomini! Nemmeno il mare lo

spaventa!

entries.original:
"[black]The little boy is thrashing about
in his sleep.

[player]’s Lunar Wing began to
glow\.

The boy’s sleeping face became
untroubled and serene!

The little boy woke up!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The little boy is thrashing about in his sleep. [player-name-2]’s Lunar Wing began to glow[game-token-3] The boy’s sleeping face became untroubled and serene! The little boy woke up!
entries.translated:
[black]Il ragazzino si agita nel sonno.
L{B4}Ala Lunare di [player] ha\liniziato a brillare\. Il volto

addormentato del ragazzo è
diventato sereno e privo di\lturbamento! Il ragazzino si è

svegliato!

entries.original:
"I never thought our boy would fall
into this endless nightmare\.

It’s happened in the past
in Tarmigan\.

There were people who never woke up
from their nightmares\."
entries.translation_source: I never thought our boy would fall into this endless nightmare[game-token-1] It’s happened in the past in Tarmigan[game-token-2] There were people who never woke up from their nightmares[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Non avrei mai pensato che il nostro
ragazzo sarebbe caduto in questo\lincubo infinito\. È già successo in

passato a Tarmigan\. C{B4}era gente che
non si svegliava mai dai propri\lincubi\.

entries.original:
"Our boy has too much energy!
\.That’s the best way to be!"
entries.translation_source: Our boy has too much energy! [game-token-1]That’s the best way to be!
entries.translated:
Il nostro ragazzo ha troppa
energia! \.È il modo migliore per\lessere!

entries.original: "[red]Hmm\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Hmm[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [red]Hmm\.

entries.original:
"[red]From what I can gather, a horrible
Pokémon has locked him in an\lendless nightmare.

I’m uncertain if he’ll ever be able
to wake up from it\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]From what I can gather, a horrible Pokémon has locked him in an endless nightmare. I’m uncertain if he’ll ever be able to wake up from it[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[red]Da quello che posso capire, un
terribile Pokémon lo ha\lintrappolato in un incubo senza

fine. Non so se riuscirà mai a
svegliarsi\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Please!

There has to be something you
can do.

Don’t you scientists get funding
for this kind of thing?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Please! There has to be something you can do. Don’t you scientists get funding for this kind of thing?
entries.translated:
[blue]Per favore! Deve esserci qualcosa
che possiate fare. Non ricevete\lfinanziamenti voi scienziati per

cose del genere?

entries.original:
"[red]Hmm\.

Upon closer examination, there may
be a way to heal him after all.

We don’t get funding for situations
like these, but there is something\lyou can do that might help.

Go to Fullmoon Island.

It is there you’ll find a Pokémon
that can heal your son\.

But that’s all I can say.
Best of luck."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Hmm[game-token-2] Upon closer examination, there may be a way to heal him after all. We don’t get funding for situations like these, but there is something you can do that might help. Go to Fullmoon Island. It is there you’ll find a Pokémon that can heal your son[game-token-3] But that’s all I can say. Best of luck.
entries.translated:
[red]Mh\.. Dopo un esame più attento,
forse c{B4}è comunque un modo per\lguarirlo. Non riceviamo fondi per

situazioni come questa, ma c{B4}è
qualcosa che puoi fare che potrebbe\laiutare. Vai a Isola Lunanuova. Lì

troverai un Pokémon in grado di
guarire tuo figlio\.. Ma è tutto ciò\lche posso dire. Ti auguro buona

fortuna.

entries.original: "[blue]What a waste of my tax money\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]What a waste of my tax money[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[blue]Che spreco dei miei soldi delle
tasse\.

entries.original:
"[black]He’s unconscious.
Better leave him alone for now."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]He’s unconscious. Better leave him alone for now.
entries.translated:
[black]È incosciente. Meglio lasciarlo
stare per ora.

entries.original:
"Staraptor!

Let’s get out of here!"
entries.translation_source: Staraptor! Let’s get out of here!
entries.translated: Staraptor! Andiamocene di qui!

entries.original:
"Ho ho ho!

Where’s my package?"
entries.translation_source: Ho ho ho! Where’s my package?
entries.translated: Ho ho ho! Dov{B4}è il mio pacco?

entries.original:
"Why\.?

Why would you do this to me\.?

Take away the one thing I have left
to live for\.

My children\.

Now, I’ll make sure you pay for
all eternity\."
entries.translation_source: Why[game-token-1]? Why would you do this to me[game-token-2]? Take away the one thing I have left to live for[game-token-3] My children[game-token-4] Now, I’ll make sure you pay for all eternity[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Perché\.? Perché mi hai fatto questo\.?
Mi hai tolto l{B4}unica cosa per cui\lmi restava da vivere\. I miei figli\.

Ora, mi assicurerò che tu paghi per
l{B4}eternità\.

entries.original:
"Welcome home, dear!

Welcome home, dear!

Welcome home, dear!

Welcome home, dear!

Welcome home, dear!

Welcome to your new home, dear!"
entries.translation_source: Welcome home, dear! Welcome home, dear! Welcome home, dear! Welcome home, dear! Welcome home, dear! Welcome to your new home, dear!
entries.translated:
Bentornato a casa, caro! Bentornato
a casa, caro! Bentornato a casa,\lcaro! Bentornato a casa, caro!

Bentornato a casa, caro! Benvenuto
nella tua nuova casa, caro!

entries.original:
"[black]The little boy is thrashing about
in his sleep.

He appears to be in torment\.
He is muttering something\.

\qo[blue]You\.
You’re doomed\.[black]\qc"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The little boy is thrashing about in his sleep. He appears to be in torment[game-token-2] He is muttering something[game-token-3] [quote-open-4][color-blue-5]You[game-token-6] You’re doomed[game-token-7][color-black-8][quote-close-9]
entries.translated:
[black]Il bambino si dimena nel sonno.
Sembra essere in tormento\. Sta\lmormorando qualcosa\. \qo[blue]Tu\. Sei

condannato\.[black]\qc

entries.original:
"It’s all your fault\.

My son\.

He’ll never wake up now\.

What have you done\.

WHAT HAVE YOU DONE!?"
entries.translation_source: It’s all your fault[game-token-1] My son[game-token-2] He’ll never wake up now[game-token-3] What have you done[game-token-4] WHAT HAVE YOU DONE!?
entries.translated:
È tutta colpa tua\. Mio figlio\. Non si
sveglierà mai più\. Che cosa hai\lfatto\. CHE COSA HAI FATTO!?

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon stares at you with
cold dead eyes\."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Pokémon stares at you with cold dead eyes[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[black]Il Pokémon ti fissa con occhi
freddi e morti\.

entries.original:
"[black]The Pokémon used the power of the
nightmare to increase its size!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Pokémon used the power of the nightmare to increase its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Il Pokémon ha usato il potere
dell{B4}incubo per aumentare le sue\ldimensioni!

entries.original: "The Food Thief"
entries.translation_source: The Food Thief
entries.translated: Il ladro di cibo

entries.original:
"A mysterious icy Pokémon has been
stealing food! Hunt it down and
recover what was stolen."
entries.translation_source: A mysterious icy Pokémon has been stealing food! Hunt it down and recover what was stolen.
entries.translated:
Un misterioso Pokémon di ghiaccio
sta rubando il cibo! Rintraccialo e\lrecupera ciò che è stato rubato.

entries.original:
"I just don’t know what to do.

Every few days, this horrible
Pokémon has been coming into my\lhouse and stealing my food.

If I had a [green]Pokédex[blue], I could know
what it was and how to stop it\.

If you get a [green]Pokédex[blue], would you
come back and help me?"
entries.translation_source: I just don’t know what to do. Every few days, this horrible Pokémon has been coming into my house and stealing my food. If I had a [color-green-1]Pokédex[color-blue-2], I could know what it was and how to stop it[game-token-3] If you get a [color-green-4]Pokédex[color-blue-5], would you come back and help me?
entries.translated:
Non so proprio cosa fare. Ogni
pochi giorni, questo terribile\lPokémon entra in casa mia e mi ruba

il cibo. Se avessi un [green]Pokédex[blue],
potrei sapere che cos{B4}è e come\lfermarlo\. Se ottieni un [green]Pokédex[blue],

torneresti ad aiutarmi?

entries.original:
"I just don’t know what to do.

Every few days, this horrible
Pokémon has been coming into my\lhouse and stealing my food.

I could stop it if I had a Pokémon
of my own, but unfortunately I\lhave none.

Oh!
I just had an idea!

Would you be able to\."
entries.translation_source: I just don’t know what to do. Every few days, this horrible Pokémon has been coming into my house and stealing my food. I could stop it if I had a Pokémon of my own, but unfortunately I have none. Oh! I just had an idea! Would you be able to[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Non so proprio che fare. Ogni pochi
giorni, questo orribile Pokémon\lentra in casa mia e mi ruba il

cibo. Potrei fermarlo se avessi un
Pokémon tutto mio, ma purtroppo non\lne ho nessuno. Oh! Mi è venuta

un{B4}idea! Riusciresti a\.

entries.original:
"Ahh!

There it is again!

It’s come to steal more food!"
entries.translation_source: Ahh! There it is again! It’s come to steal more food!
entries.translated:
Ahh! Eccolo di nuovo! È venuto a
rubare altro cibo!

entries.original: "No! Get away from my fridge!"
entries.translation_source: No! Get away from my fridge!
entries.translated:
No! Allontanati dal mio
frigorifero!

entries.original: "[red]I’ll stop it from leaving, Daddy!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]I’ll stop it from leaving, Daddy!
entries.translated: [red]Non lo lascerò andare, papà!

entries.original:
"[red]Waaaah!

Daddy! It hurt me!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Waaaah! Daddy! It hurt me!
entries.translated: [red]Waaaah! Papà! Mi ha fatto male!

entries.original:
"It’s alright sweetie\.

Daddy’s not going to let that
Pokémon hurt you anymore."
entries.translation_source: It’s alright sweetie[game-token-1] Daddy’s not going to let that Pokémon hurt you anymore.
entries.translated:
Va tutto bene, tesoro\. Papà non
lascerà che quel Pokémon ti faccia\lancora del male.

entries.original:
"If you can help me out and get my
food back from that Pokémon, I’d\lbe extremely grateful!

There might be a little something
in it for you as well\."
entries.translation_source: If you can help me out and get my food back from that Pokémon, I’d be extremely grateful! There might be a little something in it for you as well[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Se puoi darmi una mano e farmi
riavere il cibo da quel Pokémon, te\lne sarei estremamente grato!

Potrebbe esserci anche una piccola
ricompensa per te\.

entries.original:
"I’m extremely grateful for your
help!

I’m going to train my new Pokémon,
and if you’re lucky, maybe you’ll\lbe able to battle me someday."
entries.translation_source: I’m extremely grateful for your help! I’m going to train my new Pokémon, and if you’re lucky, maybe you’ll be able to battle me someday.
entries.translated:
Sono estremamente grato per il tuo
aiuto! Mi allenerò con il mio nuovo\lPokémon e, se sei fortunato, magari

un giorno potrai sfidarmi.

entries.original:
"Hey! It’s you again! Thanks again
for your help!

Now, how would you like to battle
my Pokémon and me?"
entries.translation_source: Hey! It’s you again! Thanks again for your help! Now, how would you like to battle my Pokémon and me?
entries.translated:
Ehi! Sei di nuovo tu! Grazie ancora
per il tuo aiuto! Allora, che ne\ldici di lottare contro me e i miei

Pokémon?

entries.original:
"Alright!

Just wait and see how strong my
Sandslash has become!"
entries.translation_source: Alright! Just wait and see how strong my Sandslash has become!
entries.translated:
D{B4}accordo! Aspetta e vedrai quanto
è diventato forte il mio Sandslash!

entries.original:
"I guess even my rare Pokémon
couldn’t stand up to you!"
entries.translation_source: I guess even my rare Pokémon couldn’t stand up to you!
entries.translated:
Immagino che persino i miei Pokémon
rari non siano riusciti a reggere\lil confronto con te!

entries.original:
"Thanks for the battle!

Feel free to come back tomorrow and
battle me again."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for the battle! Feel free to come back tomorrow and battle me again.
entries.translated:
Grazie per la lotta! Sentiti libero
di tornare domani e sfidarmi di\lnuovo.

entries.original:
"Feel free to come back anytime for
a battle."
entries.translation_source: Feel free to come back anytime for a battle.
entries.translated:
Torna pure quando vuoi per una
sfida.

entries.original:
"I wish we had our own Pokémon.

I’m always so bored at home."
entries.translation_source: I wish we had our own Pokémon. I’m always so bored at home.
entries.translated:
Vorrei che avessimo dei Pokémon
tutti nostri. A casa mi annoio\lsempre tantissimo.

entries.original:
"My daddy trained our Pokémon a lot!
It’s really strong now!"
entries.translation_source: My daddy trained our Pokémon a lot! It’s really strong now!
entries.translated:
Papà ha allenato tanto i nostri
Pokémon! Ora è davvero forte!

entries.original:
"Wahh!

Daddy! That Pokémon hurt me!"
entries.translation_source: Wahh! Daddy! That Pokémon hurt me!
entries.translated:
Wahh! Papà! Quel Pokémon mi ha
fatto male!

entries.original:
"It should be packed with all kinds
of delicious things to eat\.

But it’s empty now!"
entries.translation_source: It should be packed with all kinds of delicious things to eat[game-token-1] But it’s empty now!
entries.translated:
Dovrebbe essere pieno di ogni sorta
di cose deliziose da mangiare\. Ma\lora è vuoto!

entries.original:
"The Pokémon appears to be heading
towards [green]Icicle Cave[black]."
entries.translation_source: The Pokémon appears to be heading towards [color-green-1]Icicle Cave[color-black-2].
entries.translated:
Sembra che il Pokémon si stia
dirigendo verso [green]Grotta di Ghiaccio[black].

entries.original: "Would you look at that\."
entries.translation_source: Would you look at that[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Guarda un po{B4}\.

entries.original: "[green]Slash!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Slash!
entries.translated: [green]Slash!

entries.original:
"Aha!

I’ve cornered you!

After that battle, you’re too weak
to escape!

Now, return the food you stole!"
entries.translation_source: Aha! I’ve cornered you! After that battle, you’re too weak to escape! Now, return the food you stole!
entries.translated:
Ahah! Ti ho messo alle strette!
Dopo quella lotta, sei troppo\ldebole per scappare! Ora,

restituisci il cibo che hai rubato!

entries.original:
"Huh, what’s this?

Have you been stealing my food for
your friends and family?"
entries.translation_source: Huh, what’s this? Have you been stealing my food for your friends and family?
entries.translated:
Eh, cos{B4}è questo? Hai rubato il mio
cibo per i tuoi amici e la tua\lfamiglia?

entries.original:
"That cry\.

I’ve heard it somewhere before\.

Ah!

You must be one of those rare Ice-
type Sandslash that live up here!

Have the Pokémon Rangers stopped
coming to feed you?

Now that I mention it, I haven’t
seen them around in a while\."
entries.translation_source: That cry[game-token-1] I’ve heard it somewhere before[game-token-2] Ah! You must be one of those rare Ice- type Sandslash that live up here! Have the Pokémon Rangers stopped coming to feed you? Now that I mention it, I haven’t seen them around in a while[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Quel verso\. L{B4}ho sentito da qualche
parte prima\. Ah! Devi essere uno di\lquei rari Sandslash di tipo

Ghiaccio che vivono quassù! I
Ranger Pokémon hanno smesso di\lvenire a sfamarti? Ora che ci

penso, è da un po{B4} che non li vedo
in giro\.

entries.original:
"Then I was right.

You’ve been hungry because your
food supply stopped coming.

Let me make you a deal then,
Sandslash.

If you become my Pokémon and help
me make an income through battling,\lI will support you, your friends,\land your family through the money\lwe make.

Does that work for you?"
entries.translation_source: Then I was right. You’ve been hungry because your food supply stopped coming. Let me make you a deal then, Sandslash. If you become my Pokémon and help me make an income through battling, I will support you, your friends, and your family through the money we make. Does that work for you?
entries.translated:
Allora avevo ragione. Avevi fame
perché la tua scorta di cibo ha\lsmesso di arrivare. Lascia che ti

faccia una proposta, Sandslash. Se
diventi il mio Pokémon e mi aiuti a\lguadagnare attraverso le lotte,

sosterrò te, i tuoi amici e la tua
famiglia con i soldi che\lguadagneremo. Ti va bene?

entries.original: "Then it’s settled, let’s go."
entries.translation_source: Then it’s settled, let’s go.
entries.translated: Allora è deciso, andiamo.

entries.original:
"Thanks for helping track down the
food thief!

As promised, here’s your little
something."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for helping track down the food thief! As promised, here’s your little something.
entries.translated:
Grazie per aver aiutato a
rintracciare il ladro di cibo! Come\lpromesso, ecco un pensierino per

te.

entries.original:
"That TM contains [green]Hone Claws[blue].

If you plan on challenging the
[green]Dresco Gym[blue], it’ll help you a lot.

It’s very foggy and hard to see in
there\."
entries.translation_source: That TM contains [color-green-1]Hone Claws[color-blue-2]. If you plan on challenging the [color-green-3]Dresco Gym[color-blue-4], it’ll help you a lot. It’s very foggy and hard to see in there[game-token-5]
entries.translated:
Quella MT contiene [green]Hone Claws[blue]. Se
hai intenzione di sfidare la\l[green]Palestra di Dresco[blue], ti sarà di

grande aiuto. Là dentro c{B4}è molta
nebbia ed è difficile vedere\.

entries.original: "Guardians of the Lake"
entries.translation_source: Guardians of the Lake
entries.translated: Guardiani del Lago

entries.original:
"Help a scientist uncover the
mysteries of the Cave of Being!"
entries.translation_source: Help a scientist uncover the mysteries of the Cave of Being!
entries.translated:
Aiuta uno scienziato a svelare i
misteri della Grotta dell{B4}Essere!

entries.original:
"Go to the Cave of Being to begin
studying its mysteries!"
entries.translation_source: Go to the Cave of Being to begin studying its mysteries!
entries.translated:
Vai alla Grotta dell{B4}Essere per
iniziare a studiarne i misteri!

entries.original:
"Scour Borrius and capture the
remaining 3 Pokémon that flew off
from the Cave of Being."
entries.translation_source: Scour Borrius and capture the remaining 3 Pokémon that flew off from the Cave of Being.
entries.translated:
Setaccia Borrius e cattura i
restanti 3 Pokémon che sono volati\lvia dalla Cave of Being.

entries.original:
"Scour Borrius and capture the
remaining 2 Pokémon that flew off
from the Cave of Being."
entries.translation_source: Scour Borrius and capture the remaining 2 Pokémon that flew off from the Cave of Being.
entries.translated:
Setaccia Borrius e cattura i
restanti 2 Pokémon che sono volati\lvia dalla Cave of Being.

entries.original:
"Scour Borrius and capture the
remaining Pokémon that flew off
from the Cave of Being."
entries.translation_source: Scour Borrius and capture the remaining Pokémon that flew off from the Cave of Being.
entries.translated:
Perlustra Borrius e cattura i
Pokémon rimanenti che sono volati\lvia dalla Grotta dell{B4}Essere.

entries.original:
"Return to the Cave of Being with
Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf in tow."
entries.translation_source: Return to the Cave of Being with Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf in tow.
entries.translated:
Torna alla Grotta dell{B4}Essere con
Uxie, Mesprit e Azelf al seguito.

entries.original: "Researcher"
entries.translation_source: Researcher
entries.translated: Ricercatore

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of the
great lakes of Sinnoh?

Rumour is they’re associated with
some powerful Pokémon.

My research is centred around
these Pokémon.

I’m looking for a research
assistant, but someone a little\lstronger than yourself."
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of the great lakes of Sinnoh? Rumour is they’re associated with some powerful Pokémon. My research is centred around these Pokémon. I’m looking for a research assistant, but someone a little stronger than yourself.
entries.translated:
Hai mai sentito parlare dei grandi
laghi di Sinnoh? Si dice che siano\lassociati ad alcuni potenti

Pokémon. La mia ricerca è
incentrata su questi Pokémon. Sto\lcercando un assistente di ricerca,

ma qualcuno un po{B4} più forte di te.

entries.original:
"Have you ever heard of the
great lakes of Sinnoh?

Rumour is they’re associated with
some powerful Pokémon.

My research is centred around
these Pokémon.

I’m looking for a research
assistant to aid me.

Would you be willing to assist me
in my research?"
entries.translation_source: Have you ever heard of the great lakes of Sinnoh? Rumour is they’re associated with some powerful Pokémon. My research is centred around these Pokémon. I’m looking for a research assistant to aid me. Would you be willing to assist me in my research?
entries.translated:
Hai mai sentito parlare dei grandi
laghi di Sinnoh? Si dice che siano\lassociati ad alcuni potenti

Pokémon. Le mie ricerche si
concentrano su questi Pokémon. Sto\lcercando un assistente di ricerca

che mi aiuti. Saresti disposto ad
assistermi nelle mie ricerche?

entries.original:
"Where’s that Trainer curiousity you
should have?"
entries.translation_source: Where’s that Trainer curiousity you should have?
entries.translated:
Dov{B4}è la curiosità da Allenatore
che dovresti avere?

entries.original:
"Wonderful!

Please meet me in the [green]Cave of Being[red]
on [green]Route 10[red].

We will start our research by
scanning the area to find any clues\lof Pokémon that might inhabit the\lCave of Being."
entries.translation_source: Wonderful! Please meet me in the [color-green-1]Cave of Being[color-red-2] on [color-green-3]Route 10[color-red-4]. We will start our research by scanning the area to find any clues of Pokémon that might inhabit the Cave of Being.
entries.translated:
Meraviglioso! Ti prego, incontrami
nella [green]Grotta dell{B4}Essere[red] sul\l[green]Percorso 10[red]. Inizieremo la nostra

ricerca scansionando l{B4}area per
trovare eventuali indizi su Pokémon\lche potrebbero abitare la Grotta

dell{B4}Essere.

entries.original:
"This space\.

It’s hard to put into words, but it
feels full of something\.

And something feels odd about the
centre of that puddle\."
entries.translation_source: This space[game-token-1] It’s hard to put into words, but it feels full of something[game-token-2] And something feels odd about the centre of that puddle[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Questo spazio\. È difficile da
esprimere a parole, ma sembra pieno\ldi qualcosa\. E qualcosa mi sembra

strano al centro di quella pozza\.

entries.original: "A mysterious presence can be felt!"
entries.translation_source: A mysterious presence can be felt!
entries.translated:
Si percepisce una presenza
misteriosa!

entries.original: "[red]Uxie!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Uxie!
entries.translated: [red]Uxie!

entries.original: "[red]Mesprit\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Mesprit[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [red]Mesprit\.

entries.original: "[red]And Azelf!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]And Azelf!
entries.translated: [red]E Azelf!

entries.original: "[buffer1] went flying off somewhere\."
entries.translation_source: [buffer1-1] went flying off somewhere[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[buffer1] è volato via da qualche
parte\.

entries.original:
"[red]Those three are Uxie, Mesprit,
and Azelf.

They’re thought to be the Pokémon
that gave us knowledge, emotion,\land willpower.

Still, I wonder where those three
went\.

Hey, assistant!

Look all over the Borrius region,
and try to find them!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Those three are Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf. They’re thought to be the Pokémon that gave us knowledge, emotion, and willpower. Still, I wonder where those three went[game-token-2] Hey, assistant! Look all over the Borrius region, and try to find them!
entries.translated:
[red]Quelli sono Uxie, Mesprit e Azelf.
Si ritiene che siano i Pokémon che\lci hanno donato conoscenza,

emozione e volontà. Eppure, mi
chiedo dove siano finiti quei tre\.\lEhi, assistente! Cerca in tutta la

regione di Borrius e prova a
trovarli!

entries.original:
"I wonder where those three
Pokémon flew off to?

Uxie is a Pokémon that symbolizes
knowledge\.

If you mention a place in Borrius
where knowledge is gathered, the\lfirst thing that comes to mind is\lthe [green]Dream Research Lab[red]\.

Mesprit is a Pokémon that presides
over emotion, right?

Maybe someplace where you [green]heard[red]
something that stirred your\lemotions?

And Azelf is willpower\.

The desire to [green]see something
through[red]\.

What place could represent that?"
entries.translation_source: I wonder where those three Pokémon flew off to? Uxie is a Pokémon that symbolizes knowledge[game-token-1] If you mention a place in Borrius where knowledge is gathered, the first thing that comes to mind is the [color-green-2]Dream Research Lab[color-red-3][game-token-4] Mesprit is a Pokémon that presides over emotion, right? Maybe someplace where you [color-green-5]heard[color-red-6] something that stirred your emotions? And Azelf is willpower[game-token-7] The desire to [color-green-8]see something through[color-red-9][game-token-10] What place could represent that?
entries.translated:
Mi chiedo dove quei tre Pokémon
siano volati via? Uxie è un Pokémon\lche simboleggia la conoscenza\. Se

menzioni un posto a Borrius dove la
conoscenza è raccolta, la prima\lcosa che viene in mente è il

[green]Laboratorio di Ricerca dei Sogni[red]\.
Mesprit è un Pokémon che presiede\lle emozioni, vero? Forse un posto

dove hai [green]sentito[red] qualcosa che ha
suscitato le tue emozioni? E Azelf\lè forza di volontà\. Il desiderio di

[green]portare a termine qualcosa[red]\. Quale
posto potrebbe rappresentarlo?

entries.original:
"I have this feeling that you caught
the three Pokémon that flew off.

Can you bring them here for me
to see?"
entries.translation_source: I have this feeling that you caught the three Pokémon that flew off. Can you bring them here for me to see?
entries.translated:
Ho la sensazione che tu abbia
catturato i tre Pokémon che sono\lvolati via. Puoi portarli qui così

li vedo?

entries.original:
"Good work on the capture of the
three Pokémon, assistant.

Now, do you feel it?

The space\.
It feels full again\."
entries.translation_source: Good work on the capture of the three Pokémon, assistant. Now, do you feel it? The space[game-token-1] It feels full again[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Bel lavoro con la cattura dei tre
Pokémon, assistente. Ora, lo senti?\lLo spazio\. Sembra di nuovo pieno\.

entries.original:
"Astounding!
Simply astounding!

It appears your three Pokémon have
allowed Dialga, the master of time\lto begin crossing over into our\ldimension!

It is well known that these
Pokémon share a unique bond, but\lI did not expect this to happen!

Although, take note that Dialga
lacks a reflection.

That must mean it is waiting for
you to capture it before it can\lcompletely enter our dimension.

My colleagues at the Science
Society will be most pleased with\lmy findings\.

And as a reward for your assistance,
please take this rare orb that\lseems to resonate with Dialga."
entries.translation_source: Astounding! Simply astounding! It appears your three Pokémon have allowed Dialga, the master of time to begin crossing over into our dimension! It is well known that these Pokémon share a unique bond, but I did not expect this to happen! Although, take note that Dialga lacks a reflection. That must mean it is waiting for you to capture it before it can completely enter our dimension. My colleagues at the Science Society will be most pleased with my findings[game-token-1] And as a reward for your assistance, please take this rare orb that seems to resonate with Dialga.
entries.translated:
Sbalorditivo! Proprio sbalorditivo!
Sembra che i tuoi tre Pokémon\labbiano permesso a Dialga, il

signore del tempo, di iniziare a
varcare la nostra dimensione! È\lrisaputo che questi Pokémon

condividono un legame unico, ma non
mi aspettavo che accadesse!\lTuttavia, nota che Dialga non ha un

riflesso. Ciò deve significare che
sta aspettando che tu lo catturi\lper poter entrare completamente

nella nostra dimensione. I miei
colleghi della Società Scientifica\lsaranno molto soddisfatti delle mie

scoperte\. E come ricompensa per il
tuo aiuto, per favore prendi questa\lrara sfera che sembra risuonare con

Dialga.

entries.original: "May we meet again, assistant."
entries.translation_source: May we meet again, assistant.
entries.translated:
Spero che ci incontreremo di nuovo,
assistente.

entries.original:
"A mysterious presence can be felt
here! Check the surrounding area?"
entries.translation_source: A mysterious presence can be felt here! Check the surrounding area?
entries.translated:
Si percepisce una presenza
misteriosa qui! Controllare i\ldintorni?

entries.original: "[green]Kyouuun!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Kyouuun!
entries.translated: [green]Kyouuun!

entries.original: "[green]Kyuun!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Kyuun!
entries.translated: [green]Kyuun!

entries.original: "[green]Kyauun!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Kyauun!
entries.translated: [green]Kyauun!

entries.original: "[green]Gugyugubah!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Gugyugubah!
entries.translated: [green]Gugyugubah!

entries.original: "Dialga disappeared into time."
entries.translation_source: Dialga disappeared into time.
entries.translated: Dialga è scomparso nel tempo.

entries.original: "Herd But Not Seen"
entries.translation_source: Herd But Not Seen
entries.translated: Branco ma non visto

entries.original:
"Rescue Miltank kidnapped by the
Terror Granbull in Magnolia Fields!"
entries.translation_source: Rescue Miltank kidnapped by the Terror Granbull in Magnolia Fields!
entries.translated:
Salva Miltank rapita da Terror
Granbull nei Campi Magnolia!

entries.original: "Bessy"
entries.translation_source: Bessy
entries.translated: Bessy

entries.original: "Clarabelle"
entries.translation_source: Clarabelle
entries.translated: Clarabelle

entries.original: "Dottie"
entries.translation_source: Dottie
entries.translated: Dottie

entries.original:
"This Miltank was found in the woods
on the northern side of the route."
entries.translation_source: This Miltank was found in the woods on the northern side of the route.
entries.translated:
Questo Miltank è stato trovato nei
boschi sul lato nord del percorso.

entries.original:
"This Miltank was found near the
ocean on the northern side of the
route."
entries.translation_source: This Miltank was found near the ocean on the northern side of the route.
entries.translated:
Questo Miltank è stato trovato
vicino all{B4}oceano nella parte nord\ldel Percorso.

entries.original:
"This Miltank was found near the
Skinny Trees on the southern side
of the route."
entries.translation_source: This Miltank was found near the Skinny Trees on the southern side of the route.
entries.translated:
Questo Miltank è stato trovato
vicino agli alberi sottili sul lato\lmeridionale del percorso.

entries.original:
"Our Miltank are our pride and joy!

It’d be an awful shame if something
happened to them.

There’d go our livelihood!"
entries.translation_source: Our Miltank are our pride and joy! It’d be an awful shame if something happened to them. There’d go our livelihood!
entries.translated:
Le nostre Miltank sono il nostro
orgoglio e la nostra gioia! Sarebbe\lun peccato terribile se succedesse

loro qualcosa. Addio al nostro
sostentamento!

entries.original:
"Oh, dear me!

The Miltank, our pride and joy\.
They’ve been stolen!

Some thugs callin’ themselves the
\qoTerror Granbull\qc or somethin’ or\lother came and nabbed our Miltank!

How are we gonna survive without
’em?

\.

That’s it!

You’re Borrius’ new Champion,
aren’t you?

Won’t you help us get our Miltank
back?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear me! The Miltank, our pride and joy[game-token-1] They’ve been stolen! Some thugs callin’ themselves the [quote-open-2]Terror Granbull[quote-close-3] or somethin’ or other came and nabbed our Miltank! How are we gonna survive without ’em? [game-token-4] That’s it! You’re Borrius’ new Champion, aren’t you? Won’t you help us get our Miltank back?
entries.translated:
Oh, cielo! Le Miltank, il nostro
orgoglio e la nostra gioia\. Ce le\lhanno rubate! Dei teppisti che si

fanno chiamare \qoTerror Granbull\qc o
qualcosa del genere sono venuti e\lci hanno portato via le Miltank!

Come faremo a sopravvivere senza di
loro? \. Ecco! Tu sei il nuovo\lCampione di Borrius, vero? Non

vorresti aiutarci a riprenderci le
Miltank?

entries.original:
"Thanks, hon, you’re a real
life saver.

Those thugs can’t have gotten far.

I’d wager they’re in the [green]Magnolia
Fields[red] as we speak."
entries.translation_source: Thanks, hon, you’re a real life saver. Those thugs can’t have gotten far. I’d wager they’re in the [color-green-1]Magnolia Fields[color-red-2] as we speak.
entries.translated:
Grazie, tesoro, sei davvero un
salvavita. Quei teppisti non\lpossono essere andati lontano.

Scommetterei che si trovano nei
[green]Magnolia Fields[red] proprio mentre\lparliamo.

entries.original:
"Our Miltank ain’t the brightest
of cattle.

If you approach any in the [green]Magnolia
Fields[red], they’ll prolly run away\lfrom you until they hit a wall.

If you can get ’em to run back to
town, then we’ll take it from there."
entries.translation_source: Our Miltank ain’t the brightest of cattle. If you approach any in the [color-green-1]Magnolia Fields[color-red-2], they’ll prolly run away from you until they hit a wall. If you can get ’em to run back to town, then we’ll take it from there.
entries.translated:
La nostra Miltank non è la più
sveglia del bestiame. Se ti\lavvicini a una qualsiasi nel

[green]Magnolia Fields[red], probabilmente
scapperanno da te finché non urtano\lun muro. Se riesci a farle tornare

di corsa in città, poi penseremo
noi al resto.

entries.original:
"Some of our pride and joy, the
Miltank have returned to the farm!

But there are still some out in the
[green]Magnolia Fields[red], I reckon."
entries.translation_source: Some of our pride and joy, the Miltank have returned to the farm! But there are still some out in the [color-green-1]Magnolia Fields[color-red-2], I reckon.
entries.translated:
Alcuni dei nostri fiori
all{B4}occhiello, i Miltank, sono\ltornati alla fattoria! Ma ce ne

sono ancora alcuni là fuori in
[green]Magnolia Fields[red], credo.

entries.original:
"Oh, dear me!

If the Champion can’t help me,
then who can?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, dear me! If the Champion can’t help me, then who can?
entries.translated:
Oh cielo! Se il Campione non può
aiutarmi, allora chi potrà?

entries.original:
"Our pride and joy, the Miltank
have returned to the farm!

I can’t thank you enough for
this, hon.

You gotta take this year’s supply
of Moomoo Milk as my thanks."
entries.translation_source: Our pride and joy, the Miltank have returned to the farm! I can’t thank you enough for this, hon. You gotta take this year’s supply of Moomoo Milk as my thanks.
entries.translated:
Le nostre Miltank, il nostro
orgoglio e la nostra gioia, sono\ltornate alla fattoria! Non ti

ringrazierò mai abbastanza per
questo, tesoro. Devi accettare la\lscorta di Moomoo Milk di quest{B4}anno

come ringraziamento.

entries.original:
"Thanks to you, we have our
livelihood back.

And business ain’t never been
better!"
entries.translation_source: Thanks to you, we have our livelihood back. And business ain’t never been better!
entries.translated:
Grazie a te, abbiamo riavuto il
nostro lavoro. E gli affari non\lsono mai andati meglio!

entries.original: "Miltank"
entries.translation_source: Miltank
entries.translated: Miltank

entries.original:
"Arright, boys!

You all messed up big time in
Cootes Bog, but this here is our\lbig score!

Hahaha!

These Miltank are gonna make us
rich!

We’re gonna milk ’em dry for
everything they have!"
entries.translation_source: Arright, boys! You all messed up big time in Cootes Bog, but this here is our big score! Hahaha! These Miltank are gonna make us rich! We’re gonna milk ’em dry for everything they have!
entries.translated:
Bene, ragazzi! Avete combinato un
bel pasticcio nella Palude di\lCootes, ma questo qui è il nostro

grande colpo! Hahaha! Queste
Miltank ci renderanno ricchi! Le\lmungeremo fino all{B4}ultima goccia

per prendere tutto quello che
hanno!

entries.original:
"Come on, you stupid cow!

Give milk!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, you stupid cow! Give milk!
entries.translated:
Forza, stupida mucca! Dammi il
latte!

entries.original: "[green]Mooooo\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Mooooo[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Muuuuu\.

entries.original:
"I know you stupid cows produce over
five gallons of milk a day, so come\lon, fork it over!"
entries.translation_source: I know you stupid cows produce over five gallons of milk a day, so come on, fork it over!
entries.translated:
So che voi stupide mucche producete
oltre cinque galloni di latte al\lgiorno, quindi forza, sganciatelo!

entries.original:
"This just ain’t workin’ like I’d
hoped, boys.

Any of you got any bright ideas?"
entries.translation_source: This just ain’t workin’ like I’d hoped, boys. Any of you got any bright ideas?
entries.translated:
Non sta proprio funzionando come
speravo, ragazzi. Qualcuno di voi\lha qualche idea brillante?

entries.original:
"Get back here you stupid cows!
I wasn’t done milkin’ ya!"
entries.translation_source: Get back here you stupid cows! I wasn’t done milkin’ ya!
entries.translated:
Tornate qui, vacche stupide! Non
avevo ancora finito di mungerle!

entries.original:
"Huh?

It’s some punk kid!

Let’s rough [buffer2] up and snatch\."
entries.translation_source: Huh? It’s some punk kid! Let’s rough [buffer2-1] up and snatch[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Eh? È solo un moccioso! Mettiamo
[buffer2] al suo posto e fregiamolo\.

entries.original:
"Hold up, boys!
That kid looks awfully familiar\.

Wait, I know you\.\CC0820 you’re that little
punk who got all up in our business\lback at Route 10!

And from what I heard, you went
and messed with my boys back in\lCootes Bog too, didn’t ya?

And here ya are again.

Seriously, what’s the deal with
ya, punk!?

Boys! Watch yourself around
that punk kid!

Don’t underestimate [buffer2], or your
butts’ll be handed to ya faster\lthan you can say \qoGranbull\qc!"
entries.translation_source: Hold up, boys! That kid looks awfully familiar[game-token-1] Wait, I know you[game-token-2][control-code-3] you’re that little punk who got all up in our business back at Route 10! And from what I heard, you went and messed with my boys back in Cootes Bog too, didn’t ya? And here ya are again. Seriously, what’s the deal with ya, punk!? Boys! Watch yourself around that punk kid! Don’t underestimate [buffer2-4], or your butts’ll be handed to ya faster than you can say [quote-open-5]Granbull[quote-close-6]!
entries.translated:
Fermi, ragazzi! Quel ragazzo sembra
terribilmente familiare\. Aspetta, ti\lconosco\.\CC0820 sei quel piccolo teppista

che si è immischiato nei nostri
affari sul Percorso 10! E da quello\lche ho sentito, sei andato a

disturbare i miei ragazzi nella
Palude di Cootes, vero? Ed eccoti\ldi nuovo qui. Seriamente, qual è il

problema con te, teppista!?
Ragazzi! State attenti a quel\lragazzo teppista! Non sottovalutate

[buffer2], o il vostro didietro vi
verrà consegnato più velocemente di\lquanto possiate dire \qoGranbull\qc!

entries.original:
"Don’t worry about a thing, Boss!

I’m gonna beat [buffer1] so hard, [buffer2]’s
gonna cry for [buffer3] momma!"
entries.translation_source: Don’t worry about a thing, Boss! I’m gonna beat [buffer1-1] so hard, [buffer2-2]’s gonna cry for [buffer3-3] momma!
entries.translated:
Non preoccuparti di niente, Boss!
Batterò [buffer1] così forte che\l[buffer2] piangerà per la mamma di

[buffer3]!

entries.original:
"You dumbo!

You can’t use your Granbull like
that!

Move over, and lemme show you how
to really use Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: You dumbo! You can’t use your Granbull like that! Move over, and lemme show you how to really use Granbull!
entries.translated:
Sei un cretino! Non puoi usare così
il tuo Granbull! Fatti da parte, e\llascia che ti mostri come si usa

davvero Granbull!

entries.original:
"Gah! Ya stupid ding dongs!

I told ya NOT to underestimate
[buffer1]!

But what didja go ahead and do?
You underestimated [buffer1]!

Seriously, of all the goons, why’d
I get stuck with the dumbest ones?

I could throw schmuck after schmuck
at this kid, but I’m pretty sure\leven a thousand wouldn’t make a\ldifference!

Does that mean the Terror Granbull’s
stuck bein’ the losers forever\.?"
entries.translation_source: Gah! Ya stupid ding dongs! I told ya NOT to underestimate [buffer1-1]! But what didja go ahead and do? You underestimated [buffer1-2]! Seriously, of all the goons, why’d I get stuck with the dumbest ones? I could throw schmuck after schmuck at this kid, but I’m pretty sure even a thousand wouldn’t make a difference! Does that mean the Terror Granbull’s stuck bein’ the losers forever[game-token-3]?
entries.translated:
Gah! Stupidi idioti! Vi ho detto di
NON sottovalutare [buffer1]! Ma cosa\lavete fatto? Avete sottovalutato

[buffer1]! Seriamente, di tutti gli
scagnozzi, perché sono finito con i\lpiù stupidi? Potrei lanciare idiota

dopo idiota contro questo ragazzo,
ma sono abbastanza sicuro che anche\lun migliaio non farebbe differenza!

Questo significa che il Terror
Granbull è condannato a essere i\lperdenti per sempre\.?

entries.original:
"It doesn’t have to be that way,
Gruff."
entries.translation_source: It doesn’t have to be that way, Gruff.
entries.translated:
Non deve per forza andare così,
Gruff.

entries.original: "And who do ya think you are?"
entries.translation_source: And who do ya think you are?
entries.translated: E tu chi credi di essere?

entries.original:
"The name’s James.

I used to be in charge of the
roughest and toughest gang around,\lthe Black [player]!

But those Black Ferrothorns did the
same thing they did to you, to us.

They kicked us right outta
Antisis City!

Me and the Black [player] were
lost until the Boss found us.

She gave us a new purpose.

We’re now proudly known as the
Black Horizon.

You and your boys should join us,
Gruff.

We got enough goons now to take
down an entire army!

The Black Ferrothorn don’t stand
a chance anymore!"
entries.translation_source: The name’s James. I used to be in charge of the roughest and toughest gang around, the Black [player-name-1]! But those Black Ferrothorns did the same thing they did to you, to us. They kicked us right outta Antisis City! Me and the Black [player-name-2] were lost until the Boss found us. She gave us a new purpose. We’re now proudly known as the Black Horizon. You and your boys should join us, Gruff. We got enough goons now to take down an entire army! The Black Ferrothorn don’t stand a chance anymore!
entries.translated:
Mi chiamo James. Ero a capo della
banda più dura e tosta in\lcircolazione, i Black [player]! Ma

quei Black Ferrothorns hanno fatto
a noi la stessa cosa che hanno\lfatto a te. Ci hanno cacciati via

da Antisis City! Io e i Black
[player] eravamo persi finché il\lBoss non ci ha trovati. Lei ci ha

dato un nuovo scopo. Ora siamo
conosciuti con orgoglio come i\lBlack Horizon. Tu e i tuoi ragazzi

dovreste unirvi a noi, Gruff.
Abbiamo abbastanza scagnozzi ora\lper abbattere un intero esercito! I

Black Ferrothorn non hanno più
possibilità!

entries.original:
"The Black Horizon, huh?

I kinda like the sound of that\.

But say we join up with you chumps,
what happens to our Granbull?

None of us could imagine our lives
without ’em."
entries.translation_source: The Black Horizon, huh? I kinda like the sound of that[game-token-1] But say we join up with you chumps, what happens to our Granbull? None of us could imagine our lives without ’em.
entries.translated:
Il Black Horizon, eh? Mi piace il
suono che ha\. Però se ci alleiamo\lcon voi buoni a nulla, che ne sarà

del nostro Granbull? Nessuno di noi
potrebbe immaginare la propria vita\lsenza di lui.

entries.original:
"The Boss isn’t too big on forcin’
everyone to use the same kind of\lPokémon.

So you can keep ’em."
entries.translation_source: The Boss isn’t too big on forcin’ everyone to use the same kind of Pokémon. So you can keep ’em.
entries.translated:
Il Boss non è molto per imporre a
tutti di usare lo stesso tipo di\lPokémon. Quindi puoi tenerli.

entries.original: "Then we’re sold."
entries.translation_source: Then we’re sold.
entries.translated: Allora ci siamo.

entries.original:
"Come on, boys!
We’re goin’ to the Black Horizon!

Those Black Ferrothorns are gonna
feel terror that not even the\lTerror Granbull alone could whip up!"
entries.translation_source: Come on, boys! We’re goin’ to the Black Horizon! Those Black Ferrothorns are gonna feel terror that not even the Terror Granbull alone could whip up!
entries.translated:
Forza, ragazzi! Andiamo al Black
Horizon! Quei Black Ferrothorn\lsentiranno una paura che nemmeno il

solo Terror Granbull potrebbe
scatenare!

entries.original:
"It’s been a minute, [player].

How’ve ya been without the Black
[player] keepin’ ya on the\lstraight and narrow?

\.

So you became Champion, huh?

I always knew I had the eye for
great talent!

You sure got your share of guts,
kid.

It’s a shame the Boss doesn’t want
you joinin’ the Black Horizon.

Something about having \qospecial
plans\qc for you.

Anyway, [player], keep on bein’
the gutsiest Trainer I know!"
entries.translation_source: It’s been a minute, [player-name-1]. How’ve ya been without the Black [player-name-2] keepin’ ya on the straight and narrow? [game-token-3] So you became Champion, huh?
