I always knew I had the eye for great talent! You sure got your share of guts, kid. It’s a shame the Boss doesn’t want you joinin’ the Black Horizon. Something about having [quote-open-4]special plans[quote-close-5] for you. Anyway, [player-name-6], keep on bein’ the gutsiest Trainer I know!
entries.translated:
È passato un po{B4}, [player]. Come te
la sei passata senza il Black\l[player] che ti tiene sulla retta

via? \. Quindi sei diventato
Campione, eh? Ho sempre saputo di\lavere occhio per il grande talento!

Hai di certo il tuo bel coraggio,
ragazzo. È un peccato che il Boss\lnon voglia che ti unisca ai Black

Horizon. Qualcosa a proposito di
avere \qopiani speciali\qc per te.\lComunque, [player], continua a

essere l{B4}Allenatore più audace che
conosca!

entries.original: "her"
entries.translation_source: her
entries.translated: di lei

entries.original:
"[black]The Miltank returned home to
Moomoo Farm."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Miltank returned home to Moomoo Farm.
entries.translated:
[black]La Miltank è tornata a casa alla
Fattoria Muu Muu.

entries.original: "Home for a Hobo"
entries.translation_source: Home for a Hobo
entries.translated: Casa per un vagabondo

entries.original: "Rich Man"
entries.translation_source: Rich Man
entries.translated: Uomo ricco

entries.original: "Biker"
entries.translation_source: Biker
entries.translated: Motociclista

entries.original: "Swizer"
entries.translation_source: Swizer
entries.translated: Swizer

entries.original:
"A poor old man needs a new home!
Search Borrius for any and all
indoor homes available."
entries.translation_source: A poor old man needs a new home! Search Borrius for any and all indoor homes available.
entries.translated:
Un povero vecchio ha bisogno di una
nuova casa! Cerca in tutto Borrius\ltutte le case disponibili al

chiuso.

entries.original:
"A rich businessman’s Pokémon has
gone missing! Help him reunite with
his precious friend."
entries.translation_source: A rich businessman’s Pokémon has gone missing! Help him reunite with his precious friend.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon di un ricco uomo
d{B4}affari è scomparso! Aiutalo a\lriunirsi con il suo prezioso amico.

entries.original:
"Return the rich man home safely
before something nasty happens\."
entries.translation_source: Return the rich man home safely before something nasty happens[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Riporta l{B4}uomo ricco a casa sano e
salvo prima che succeda qualcosa di\lbrutto\.

entries.original:
"Bring only Ice- and Fairy-types to
rescue a rich businessman from some
goons in the western warehouse."
entries.translation_source: Bring only Ice- and Fairy-types to rescue a rich businessman from some goons in the western warehouse.
entries.translated:
Porta con te solo Pokémon di tipo
Ghiaccio e Folletto per salvare un\lricco uomo d{B4}affari da alcuni

scagnozzi nel magazzino
occidentale.

entries.original:
"The rich businessman has returned
home safely! Head to his home in
Seaport City to collect a reward."
entries.translation_source: The rich businessman has returned home safely! Head to his home in Seaport City to collect a reward.
entries.translated:
Il ricco uomo d{B4}affari è tornato a
casa sano e salvo! Vai a casa sua a\lSeaport City per ritirare una

ricompensa.

entries.original:
"Return to Epidimy Town and inform
the old man that he has permission
to move to Seaport City."
entries.translation_source: Return to Epidimy Town and inform the old man that he has permission to move to Seaport City.
entries.translated:
Torna a Epidimy Town e informa il
vecchio che ha il permesso di\ltrasferirsi a Seaport City.

entries.original:
"Head to Seaport City to pick up
your reward."
entries.translation_source: Head to Seaport City to pick up your reward.
entries.translated:
Dirigiti a Seaport City per
ritirare la tua ricompensa.

entries.original:
"He’s sleeping peacefully on
the bench.

Better leave him alone."
entries.translation_source: He’s sleeping peacefully on the bench. Better leave him alone.
entries.translated:
Sta dormendo serenamente sulla
panchina. Meglio lasciarlo stare.

entries.original:
"Hello, child.

In my later years of life, I
managed to gamble away all of my\lmoney and belongings.

As such, every night, rain or
shine, I sleep on a bench.

It would be nice to have a place to
call home once again\.

Say\.

You seem full of spunk.

Would you like to find me a home?
It looks great on a résumé."
entries.translation_source: Hello, child. In my later years of life, I managed to gamble away all of my money and belongings. As such, every night, rain or shine, I sleep on a bench. It would be nice to have a place to call home once again[game-token-1] Say[game-token-2] You seem full of spunk. Would you like to find me a home? It looks great on a résumé.
entries.translated:
Ciao, ragazzo. Negli anni più
avanzati della mia vita, sono\lriuscito a sperperare tutti i miei

soldi e i miei averi. Perciò, ogni
notte, con il sole o con la\lpioggia, dormo su una panchina.

Sarebbe bello avere di nuovo un
posto da chiamare casa\. Sai\. Sembri\lpieno di grinta. Ti andrebbe di

trovarmi una casa? Fa un figurone
su un curriculum.

entries.original:
"You are a blessed child.

I shall await your return."
entries.translation_source: You are a blessed child. I shall await your return.
entries.translated:
Sei un bambino benedetto. Attenderò
il tuo ritorno.

entries.original:
"Clearly, I misjudged you.

No caring child would turn down
such a request from an old man."
entries.translation_source: Clearly, I misjudged you. No caring child would turn down such a request from an old man.
entries.translated:
Chiaramente ti ho sottovalutato.
Nessun bambino premuroso\lrifiuterebbe una richiesta simile

da parte di un vecchio.

entries.original:
"Where should you look for a home?

Anywhere will do, as long as
it is indoors."
entries.translation_source: Where should you look for a home? Anywhere will do, as long as it is indoors.
entries.translated:
Dove dovresti cercare una casa? Va
bene ovunque, purché sia al chiuso.

entries.original:
"That look on your face\.

You’ve found a home, haven’t you?

Where is it located?

Seaport City?

I’ll head there right away.

Meet me there to make sure I get
settled in alright."
entries.translation_source: That look on your face[game-token-1] You’ve found a home, haven’t you? Where is it located? Seaport City? I’ll head there right away. Meet me there to make sure I get settled in alright.
entries.translated:
Quell{B4}espressione sul tuo viso\. Hai
trovato una casa, vero? Dov{B4}è? A\lSeaport City? Partirò subito.

Incontrami lì per assicurarti che
mi sistemi bene.

entries.original:
"Hello again, child.

I have settled in quite nicely,
thanks to your efforts.

Please, I want you to take this
rare crystal as my thanks."
entries.translation_source: Hello again, child. I have settled in quite nicely, thanks to your efforts. Please, I want you to take this rare crystal as my thanks.
entries.translated:
Salve di nuovo, ragazzo. Mi sono
sistemato piuttosto bene, grazie ai\ltuoi sforzi. Per favore, vorrei che

accettassi questo raro cristallo
come ringraziamento.

entries.original:
"Hello again, child.

You are very kind coming to visit
this kindly old man."
entries.translation_source: Hello again, child. You are very kind coming to visit this kindly old man.
entries.translated:
Ciao di nuovo, bambino. Sei molto
gentile a venire a far visita a\lquesto vecchio gentile.

entries.original:
"I own many residences in Seaport
City.

My Skitty and I are known around
here as the king and queen of real\lestate!"
entries.translation_source: I own many residences in Seaport City. My Skitty and I are known around here as the king and queen of real estate!
entries.translated:
Possiedo molte residenze a Seaport
City. Io e la mia Skitty siamo noti\lda queste parti come il re e la

regina del mercato immobiliare!

entries.original:
"What’s that, young [buffer1]?

You’re looking for a place to put
up a kindly older gentleman?

Unfortunately, I am not in the mood
to discuss business at the present\lmoment.

You see\. my dear real estate queen
ran away from me!

We had a horrible fight, and she
just took off to the streets!

Oh\. what am I to do\.?
I cannot think without her!"
entries.translation_source: What’s that, young [buffer1-1]? You’re looking for a place to put up a kindly older gentleman? Unfortunately, I am not in the mood to discuss business at the present moment. You see[game-token-2] my dear real estate queen ran away from me! We had a horrible fight, and she just took off to the streets! Oh[game-token-3] what am I to do[game-token-4]? I cannot think without her!
entries.translated:
Che c{B4}è, giovane [buffer1]? Stai
cercando un posto dove sistemare un\lgentile anziano signore? Purtroppo,

non ho voglia di discutere di
affari al momento. Vedi\. la mia cara\lregina del settore immobiliare è

scappata via da me! Abbiamo avuto
un litigio terribile, e se n{B4}è\landata per le strade! Oh\. cosa devo

fare\.? Non posso pensare senza di
lei!

entries.original:
"Aha! An idea has firmly taken
root in my cranium!

Would you allow me to accompany you
in an attempt to locate my queen?

Knowing her, there is little chance
she ran far."
entries.translation_source: Aha! An idea has firmly taken root in my cranium! Would you allow me to accompany you in an attempt to locate my queen? Knowing her, there is little chance she ran far.
entries.translated:
Ahah! Un{B4}idea ha messo radici ben
salde nel mio cranio! Mi\lpermetteresti di accompagnarti nel

tentativo di localizzare la mia
regina? Conoscendola, c{B4}è ben poca\lpossibilità che si sia allontanata

molto.

entries.original:
"Splendid!
Let us begin our search.

She must be somewhere in Seaport
City.

She’s small and pink\. you can’t
miss her!"
entries.translation_source: Splendid! Let us begin our search. She must be somewhere in Seaport City. She’s small and pink[game-token-1] you can’t miss her!
entries.translated:
Splendido! Iniziamo la nostra
ricerca. Deve essere da qualche\lparte a Seaport City. È piccola e

rosa\. non puoi non notarla!

entries.original:
"Well, then.

I have no further business to
discuss with you.

Hrmph."
entries.translation_source: Well, then. I have no further business to discuss with you. Hrmph.
entries.translated:
Ebbene. Non ho altro di cui
discutere con te. Hrmph.

entries.original:
"My queen must be somewhere in
Seaport City.

If you see something small and
pink\. well\. that’s my queen!"
entries.translation_source: My queen must be somewhere in Seaport City. If you see something small and pink[game-token-1] well[game-token-2] that’s my queen!
entries.translated:
La mia regina dev{B4}essere da qualche
parte a Seaport City. Se vedi\lqualcosa di piccolo e rosa\. beh\.,

quella è la mia regina!

entries.original:
"A job well done, young [buffer1].

Now, let us return to my place of
residence so I may confer upon you\la handsome reward."
entries.translation_source: A job well done, young [buffer1-1]. Now, let us return to my place of residence so I may confer upon you a handsome reward.
entries.translated:
Lavoro ben fatto, giovane [buffer1].
Ora, torniamo alla mia dimora così\lpotrò conferirti una ricca

ricompensa.

entries.original:
"Ohhhh\.
You found me\.

Those ruffians, no, those hooligans
just abducted us out of nowhere!

And now I have no idea where we
are\.

My queen and I are so scared\.

Let’s go home\.
But truly this time\."
entries.translation_source: Ohhhh[game-token-1] You found me[game-token-2] Those ruffians, no, those hooligans just abducted us out of nowhere! And now I have no idea where we are[game-token-3] My queen and I are so scared[game-token-4] Let’s go home[game-token-5] But truly this time[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
Ohhhh\. Mi hai trovato\. Quei
malviventi, anzi quei teppisti ci\lhanno appena rapiti dal nulla! E

ora non ho idea di dove siamo\. Io e
la mia regina siamo così spaventati\.\lAndiamo a casa\. Ma veramente questa

volta\.

entries.original:
"Please take my queen and me home
safely\."
entries.translation_source: Please take my queen and me home safely[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Per favore, portate a casa sani e
salvi la mia regina e me\.

entries.original:
"Ah, yes.

I believe you mentioned something
earlier about needing a home for\lan older gentleman?

In that case, to thank you, feel
free to let him know he may move\lin upstairs, free of charge."
entries.translation_source: Ah, yes. I believe you mentioned something earlier about needing a home for an older gentleman? In that case, to thank you, feel free to let him know he may move in upstairs, free of charge.
entries.translated:
Ah, sì. Credo che prima tu abbia
menzionato qualcosa riguardo a un\lalloggio per un anziano? In tal

caso, per ringraziarti, sentiti
libero di dirgli che può\ltrasferirsi al piano di sopra,

gratis.

entries.original:
"Feel free to let your friend know
he may move in upstairs, free of\lcharge."
entries.translation_source: Feel free to let your friend know he may move in upstairs, free of charge.
entries.translated:
Sentiti libero di far sapere al tuo
amico che può trasferirsi di sopra,\lgratuitamente.

entries.original:
"The fellow who moved in at your
request is quite the likable\ltenant.

He causes no disturbances
whatsoever, and has even agreed to\lkeep an eye on my queen whenever I\lgo away!

What a gentleman!"
entries.translation_source: The fellow who moved in at your request is quite the likable tenant. He causes no disturbances whatsoever, and has even agreed to keep an eye on my queen whenever I go away! What a gentleman!
entries.translated:
Il tizio che si è trasferito su tua
richiesta è un inquilino davvero\lsimpatico. Non crea alcun disturbo,

e ha persino accettato di tenere
d{B4}occhio la mia regina ogni volta\lche me ne vado! Che gentiluomo!

entries.original:
"I do not believe my queen would
have wandered in that direction.

Let us try searching somewhere
else."
entries.translation_source: I do not believe my queen would have wandered in that direction. Let us try searching somewhere else.
entries.translated:
Non credo che la mia regina si
sarebbe allontanata in quella\ldirezione. Proviamo a cercare

altrove.

entries.original:
"[blue]Heh, heh, heh\.
Seems we’ve found quite a catch!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Heh, heh, heh[game-token-2] Seems we’ve found quite a catch!
entries.translated:
[blue]Heh, heh, heh\. Sembra che abbiamo
pescato proprio un bel boccone!

entries.original:
"[blue]Come on, man\.
Hurry up and catch it already!

A Skitty like that’ll go for big
bucks on the Black Market!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Come on, man[game-token-2] Hurry up and catch it already! A Skitty like that’ll go for big bucks on the Black Market!
entries.translated:
[blue]Su, uomo\. Sbrigati a catturarlo e
basta! Una Skitty come quella\lfrutterà un sacco di soldi al

Mercato Nero!

entries.original:
"[blue]Nooooooooo!
You ruffians! Leave my queen alone!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Nooooooooo! You ruffians! Leave my queen alone!
entries.translated:
[blue]Nooooooooo! Brutti ruffiani!
Lasciate stare la mia regina!

entries.original:
"[blue]Huh? Wazzat you kid?

You think you can interfere with
our business?"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Huh? Wazzat you kid? You think you can interfere with our business?
entries.translated:
[blue]Eh? E tu chi sei, ragazzino? Pensi
di poterti intromettere nei nostri\laffari?

entries.original:
"[blue]Somebody ought to teach a kid
like you to mind your manners!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Somebody ought to teach a kid like you to mind your manners!
entries.translated:
[blue]Qualcuno dovrebbe insegnare a un
moccioso come te le buone maniere!

entries.original:
"I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry,
I’m sorry!"
entries.translation_source: I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry!
entries.translated: Scusa, scusa, scusa, scusa!

entries.original:
"Wait\.
That shout didn’t come from you\."
entries.translation_source: Wait[game-token-1] That shout didn’t come from you[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Aspetta\. Quel grido non veniva da te\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Bullo, you oaf!
Quit messing around!

Just lemee ’em take out for you."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Bullo, you oaf! Quit messing around! Just lemee ’em take out for you.
entries.translated:
[blue]Bullo, pezzo d{B4}asino! Smettila di
fare lo scemo! Lascia che te li\ltolga io.

entries.original:
"[blue]We ain’t gonna let you get away
with this, fat man!

Just you wait\. you and your Skitty
will regret this!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]We ain’t gonna let you get away with this, fat man! Just you wait[game-token-2] you and your Skitty will regret this!
entries.translated:
[blue]Non ce la faremo passare liscia,
grassone! Aspetta e vedrai\. tu e la\ltua Skitty ve ne pentirete!

entries.original:
"[blue]There, there, Queenie\.
It’s okay now\.

Those bad men are gone\.
I’m sorry we fought earlier\.

Kingy promises to be better to you
from now on\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]There, there, Queenie[game-token-2] It’s okay now[game-token-3] Those bad men are gone[game-token-4] I’m sorry we fought earlier[game-token-5] Kingy promises to be better to you from now on[game-token-6]
entries.translated:
[blue]Su, su, Queenie\. Va tutto bene ora\.
Quei cattivi se ne sono andati\. Mi\ldispiace per aver litigato prima\.

Kingy promette di essere più bravo
con te da ora in poi\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Thank you for your assistance in
locating my queen!

I’ll be willing to talk business
with you once I arrive home safely."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Thank you for your assistance in locating my queen! I’ll be willing to talk business with you once I arrive home safely.
entries.translated:
[blue]Grazie per il tuo aiuto nel trovare
la mia regina! Sarò disposto a\lparlare di affari con te una volta

che sarò arrivato a casa sano e
salvo.

entries.original:
"It appears we have returned home
without further incident.

Now, let us\."
entries.translation_source: It appears we have returned home without further incident. Now, let us[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sembra che siamo tornati a casa
senza altri incidenti. Ora, andiamo\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Serves you and him right.

If you ever wanna see that snobby
man again, come alone to the\l[green]western warehouse[blue].

And don’t bring any Pokémon that
aren’t [green]Ice[blue]- or [green]Fairy[blue]-types!

We’re gonna teach you a lesson you
won’t forget!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Serves you and him right. If you ever wanna see that snobby man again, come alone to the [color-green-2]western warehouse[color-blue-3]. And don’t bring any Pokémon that aren’t [color-green-4]Ice[color-blue-5]- or [color-green-6]Fairy[color-blue-7]-types! We’re gonna teach you a lesson you won’t forget!
entries.translated:
[blue]Ve la siete meritata, tu e lui. Se
vuoi rivedere quel tizio snob,\lvieni da solo al [green]magazzino

occidentale[blue]. E non portare Pokémon
che non siano di tipo [green]Ghiaccio[blue] o\l[green]Folletto[blue]! Vi daremo una lezione che

non dimenticherete mai!

entries.original:
"That is not the way to my home.
Let us go in a different direction."
entries.translation_source: That is not the way to my home. Let us go in a different direction.
entries.translated:
Quella non è la strada per casa
mia. Andiamo in un{B4}altra direzione.

entries.original:
"You decided to take me up on my
offer, huh?

Did you come with only Ice- and
Fairy-types like I said?

\."
entries.translation_source: You decided to take me up on my offer, huh? Did you come with only Ice- and Fairy-types like I said? [game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Hai deciso di accettare la mia
proposta, eh? Sei venuto con soli\lPokémon di tipo Ghiaccio e

Folletto, come ho detto? \.

entries.original:
"Looks like you did.
Alright, then.

You can head down the stairs behind
me to try to rescue the fat man.

Good luck.
You’re going to need it\."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you did. Alright, then. You can head down the stairs behind me to try to rescue the fat man. Good luck. You’re going to need it[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sembra di sì. Va bene, allora. Puoi
scendere le scale dietro di me per\lcercare di salvare il grassone.

Buona fortuna. Ne avrai bisogno\.

entries.original:
"Done already?
This is no joke, kid.

That fat man is gonna stay down
there until someone rescues him."
entries.translation_source: Done already? This is no joke, kid. That fat man is gonna stay down there until someone rescues him.
entries.translated:
Finito già? Non scherzare,
ragazzino. Quel grassone resterà\llaggiù finché qualcuno non lo

salverà.

entries.original:
"You think this is a joke, kid?

I said only bring [green]Ice[blue]- and [green]Fairy[blue]-
types!

If you wanna rescue the fat man,
you’ll need to do as I say."
entries.translation_source: You think this is a joke, kid? I said only bring [color-green-1]Ice[color-blue-2]- and [color-green-3]Fairy[color-blue-4]- types! If you wanna rescue the fat man, you’ll need to do as I say.
entries.translated:
Credi che sia uno scherzo,
ragazzino? Ho detto di portare solo\ltipi [green]Ghiaccio[blue] e [green]Folletto[blue]! Se vuoi

salvare il ciccione, dovrai fare
come dico io.

entries.original:
"[blue]Hmph.

I thought the limitations placed on
you would mean the fat man would\lstay our prisoner forever.

Guess we have no choice, then.

Time for you to face our new
and improved teams!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Hmph. I thought the limitations placed on you would mean the fat man would stay our prisoner forever. Guess we have no choice, then. Time for you to face our new and improved teams!
entries.translated:
[blue]Tsk. Pensavo che le limitazioni
imposte a te avrebbero significato\lche il grassone sarebbe rimasto

nostro prigioniero per sempre.
Suppongo allora che non abbiamo\lscelta. È ora che tu affronti le

nostre nuove e migliorate squadre!

entries.original:
"Gah\.

I knew nabbin’ that Skitty was a
bad idea."
entries.translation_source: Gah[game-token-1] I knew nabbin’ that Skitty was a bad idea.
entries.translated:
Argh\. Sapevo che rapire quel Skitty
era una cattiva idea.

entries.original:
"Bullo, you oaf!
Quit messing around!

Just let my team handle it."
entries.translation_source: Bullo, you oaf! Quit messing around! Just let my team handle it.
entries.translated:
Bullo, idiota! Smettila di fare il
cretino! Lascia fare alla mia\lsquadra.

entries.original:
"I give, kid.
You win again.

But the fat man sure learned his
lesson for mouthing off.

And as long as being at a
disadvantage was difficult for\lyou, you did too\."
entries.translation_source: I give, kid. You win again. But the fat man sure learned his lesson for mouthing off. And as long as being at a disadvantage was difficult for you, you did too[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Mi arrendo, ragazzo. Hai vinto di
nuovo. Ma quell{B4}uomo grasso ha\lsicuramente imparato la lezione per

aver parlato a sproposito. E visto
che stare in svantaggio era\ldifficile per te, l{B4}hai fatto anche

tu\.

entries.original:
"Ah\.
My queen and I have returned home.

And this time, there does not appear
to be a hooligan in sight!

Thank you very much, young [buffer1].

Please meet me inside to discuss
your reward."
entries.translation_source: Ah[game-token-1] My queen and I have returned home. And this time, there does not appear to be a hooligan in sight! Thank you very much, young [buffer1-2]. Please meet me inside to discuss your reward.
entries.translated:
Ah\. La mia regina e io siamo tornati
a casa. E questa volta non sembra\lesserci in giro nessun teppista!

Grazie mille, giovane [buffer1].
Vieni a trovarmi dentro per parlare\ldella tua ricompensa.

entries.original:
"Swizer called us in to help teach
you a lesson.

Don’t think you’ll get away with
messing with us!"
entries.translation_source: Swizer called us in to help teach you a lesson. Don’t think you’ll get away with messing with us!
entries.translated:
Swizer ci ha chiamati per aiutarti
a darti una lezione. Non pensare di\lfarla franca se ti metti contro di

noi!

entries.original: "There’s still more to come!"
entries.translation_source: There’s still more to come!
entries.translated: C{B4}è ancora altro in arrivo!

entries.original:
"Swizer’s prepared for this!
You won’t outsmart him!"
entries.translation_source: Swizer’s prepared for this! You won’t outsmart him!
entries.translated:
Swizer è pronto per questo! Non
riuscirai a ingannarlo!

entries.original:
"The Seaport Burglar Society controls
crime in Seaport City."
entries.translation_source: The Seaport Burglar Society controls crime in Seaport City.
entries.translated:
La Seaport Burglar Society
controlla la criminalità a Seaport\lCity.

entries.original:
"One of these days the Seaport
Burglar Society will be known to all!"
entries.translation_source: One of these days the Seaport Burglar Society will be known to all!
entries.translated:
Un giorno la Società dei Ladri del
Porto sarà conosciuta da tutti!

entries.original:
"Our leader is El-Scamo!

He likes to scam people!"
entries.translation_source: Our leader is El-Scamo! He likes to scam people!
entries.translated:
Il nostro capo è El-Scamo! Gli
piace truffare la gente!

entries.original: "El-Scamo is gonna be upset!"
entries.translation_source: El-Scamo is gonna be upset!
entries.translated: El-Scamo si arrabbierà!

entries.original:
"El-Scamo is a master thief.

No one knows what he truly looks
like!"
entries.translation_source: El-Scamo is a master thief. No one knows what he truly looks like!
entries.translated:
El-Scamo è un ladro abilissimo.
Nessuno sa davvero che aspetto\labbia!

entries.original:
"We’ll slow you down!
The Black Ferrothorn rule!"
entries.translation_source: We’ll slow you down! The Black Ferrothorn rule!
entries.translated:
Ti rallenteremo! La regola del
Ferrothorn Nero!

entries.original:
"We’re the Black Ferrothorn!
We’ll rule the Seaport underworld!"
entries.translation_source: We’re the Black Ferrothorn! We’ll rule the Seaport underworld!
entries.translated:
Siamo i Ferrothorn Neri! Domineremo
la malavita di Seaport!

entries.original:
"We control crime here, now!
Us, the Black Ferrothorn!"
entries.translation_source: We control crime here, now! Us, the Black Ferrothorn!
entries.translated:
Noi controlliamo il crimine qui,
adesso! Noi, i Black Ferrothorn!

entries.original:
"Barbs rules the Black Ferrothorn
with an iron fist!"
entries.translation_source: Barbs rules the Black Ferrothorn with an iron fist!
entries.translated:
Barbs comanda il Black Ferrothorn
con il pugno di ferro!

entries.original: "Island Saviour"
entries.translation_source: Island Saviour
entries.translated: Salvatore dell{B4}isola

entries.original:
"A Hiker needs your help getting off
an island! Bring a Pokémon with
Dig to help him escape."
entries.translation_source: A Hiker needs your help getting off an island! Bring a Pokémon with Dig to help him escape.
entries.translated:
Un Escursionista ha bisogno del tuo
aiuto per andarsene da un{B4}isola!\lPorta un Pokémon con Fossa per

aiutarlo a scappare.

entries.original:
"Hoo boy, Trainer!

I’m in a bit of a pickle, and I’m
wondering if you can help me out.

I got to this island by digging
up from a hidden tunnel, but my\lGraveler forgot Dig when it\llearned a new move.

Now I’m stuck here with no way off
this island.

Can you help me get back home?"
entries.translation_source: Hoo boy, Trainer! I’m in a bit of a pickle, and I’m wondering if you can help me out. I got to this island by digging up from a hidden tunnel, but my Graveler forgot Dig when it learned a new move. Now I’m stuck here with no way off this island. Can you help me get back home?
entries.translated:
Oh accidenti, Allenatore! Sono un
po{B4} nei guai e mi chiedevo se puoi\ldarmi una mano. Sono arrivato su

quest{B4}isola scavando da un tunnel
segreto, ma il mio Graveler ha\ldimenticato Fossa quando ha

imparato una nuova mossa. Adesso
sono bloccato qui senza modo di\llasciare quest{B4}isola. Puoi aiutarmi

a tornare a casa?

entries.original:
"Awesome!

All you need is a Pokémon that
knows [green]Dig[blue].

Do you have one with you?"
entries.translation_source: Awesome! All you need is a Pokémon that knows [color-green-1]Dig[color-blue-2]. Do you have one with you?
entries.translated:
Fantastico! Tutto ciò che ti serve
è un Pokémon che conosca [green]Fossa[blue]. Ne\lhai uno con te?

entries.original:
"Amazing!

The last thing I’ll ask is if you’re
ready to go into the tunnel.

There is no going back until you
reach the other exit."
entries.translation_source: Amazing! The last thing I’ll ask is if you’re ready to go into the tunnel. There is no going back until you reach the other exit.
entries.translated:
Fantastico! L{B4}ultima cosa che ti
chiederò è se sei pronto a entrare\lnel tunnel. Non si torna indietro

finché non raggiungi l{B4}altra
uscita.

entries.original:
"I’m going to challenge you to a
battle before we go.

I need to be sure you’re strong
enough to survive down there."
entries.translation_source: I’m going to challenge you to a battle before we go. I need to be sure you’re strong enough to survive down there.
entries.translated:
Ti sfiderò a una lotta prima di
andare. Devo essere sicuro che tu\lsia abbastanza forte per

sopravvivere laggiù.

entries.original: "I think you’re ready!"
entries.translation_source: I think you’re ready!
entries.translated: Credo che tu sia pronto!

entries.original:
"Alrighty, let’s go!
Use Dig!"
entries.translation_source: Alrighty, let’s go! Use Dig!
entries.translated: Bene, andiamo! Usa Scavo!

entries.original:
"What are you getting at?
None of your Pokémon know [green]Dig[blue]!"
entries.translation_source: What are you getting at? None of your Pokémon know [color-green-1]Dig[color-blue-2]!
entries.translated:
Che vuoi dire? Nessuno dei tuoi
Pokémon conosce [green]Scavo[blue]!

entries.original:
"No?

Well I hope the rising tide won’t
drown me\."
entries.translation_source: No? Well I hope the rising tide won’t drown me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
No? Beh, spero che l{B4}alta marea non
mi faccia annegare\.

entries.original:
"No?

[green]Sandshrew[blue] and [green]Sandslash[blue] in the
[green]Great Desert[blue] usually know Dig."
entries.translation_source: No? [color-green-1]Sandshrew[color-blue-2] and [color-green-3]Sandslash[color-blue-4] in the [color-green-5]Great Desert[color-blue-6] usually know Dig.
entries.translated:
No? [green]Sandshrew[blue] e [green]Sandslash[blue] nel
[green]Grande Deserto[blue] di solito conoscono\lFossa.

entries.original:
"It’s just a tunnel, what’s there
to be scared about?"
entries.translation_source: It’s just a tunnel, what’s there to be scared about?
entries.translated:
È solo un tunnel, cosa c{B4}è da
temere?

entries.original:
"Well, we’re here!
The Lost Tunnel\.

It’s rather dank in here\.
It’s also really dark.

I don’t think even a Pokémon could
light it up.

Well, we’d better get going!

There’s a ladder up, somewhere
around here."
entries.translation_source: Well, we’re here! The Lost Tunnel[game-token-1] It’s rather dank in here[game-token-2] It’s also really dark. I don’t think even a Pokémon could light it up. Well, we’d better get going! There’s a ladder up, somewhere around here.
entries.translated:
Bene, siamo arrivati! Il Tunnel
Perduto\. È piuttosto umido qui\ldentro\. È anche davvero buio. Non

penso che perfino un Pokémon
riuscirebbe a illuminarlo. Meglio\landare! C{B4}è una scala che sale, da

qualche parte qui intorno.

entries.original:
"I’m sure there is a ladder
somewhere around here\."
entries.translation_source: I’m sure there is a ladder somewhere around here[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sono sicuro che c{B4}è una scala da
qualche parte qui attorno\.

entries.original:
"Whew, I’m lost already!

I hope you know where you’re
going."
entries.translation_source: Whew, I’m lost already! I hope you know where you’re going.
entries.translated:
Uff, mi sono già perso! Spero che
tu sappia dove stai andando.

entries.original:
"Have I ever mentioned how much I
hate Diglett?"
entries.translation_source: Have I ever mentioned how much I hate Diglett?
entries.translated:
Ti ho mai detto quanto odio
Diglett?

entries.original:
"What was that!?

Oh\. just a shadow\."
entries.translation_source: What was that!? Oh[game-token-1] just a shadow[game-token-2]
entries.translated: Che cos{B4}era!? Oh\. solo un{B4}ombra\.

entries.original:
"You’re surprisingly brave for a
young Trainer, you know?"
entries.translation_source: You’re surprisingly brave for a young Trainer, you know?
entries.translated:
Sei sorprendentemente coraggioso
per un giovane Allenatore, lo sai?

entries.original:
"What?
An earthquake? Now?"
entries.translation_source: What? An earthquake? Now?
entries.translated: Cosa? Un terremoto? Adesso?

entries.original:
"Wow, you wiped the floor with
that Diglett!

Have you ever wondered what a
Diglett’s feet look like?"
entries.translation_source: Wow, you wiped the floor with that Diglett! Have you ever wondered what a Diglett’s feet look like?
entries.translated:
Wow, hai asfaltato quel Diglett! Ti
sei mai chiesto come siano fatti i\lpiedi di un Diglett?

entries.original:
"Again?
I hope no rocks fall on me\."
entries.translation_source: Again? I hope no rocks fall on me[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Di nuovo? Spero che non mi cadano
addosso dei massi\.

entries.original:
"That was a tough Golem!

I wonder if it would get along
with my Graveler\."
entries.translation_source: That was a tough Golem! I wonder if it would get along with my Graveler[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Che Golem tosto! Chissà se andrebbe
d{B4}accordo con il mio Graveler\.

entries.original:
"A third time?
This can’t be a coincidence!"
entries.translation_source: A third time? This can’t be a coincidence!
entries.translated:
Una terza volta? Non può essere una
coincidenza!

entries.original:
"Phew, that was a tough battle!
I’m tired just from watching!

But now that you took out that
Dugtrio, the tremors should stop."
entries.translation_source: Phew, that was a tough battle! I’m tired just from watching! But now that you took out that Dugtrio, the tremors should stop.
entries.translated:
Uff, che battaglia dura! Sono
stanco solo ad aver guardato! Ma\lora che hai eliminato quel Dugtrio,

le scosse dovrebbero cessare.

entries.original:
"There’s the ladder!

I thought we would be stuck here
forever\.

Let’s get out of here."
entries.translation_source: There’s the ladder! I thought we would be stuck here forever[game-token-1] Let’s get out of here.
entries.translated:
C{B4}è la scala! Pensavo saremmo
rimasti bloccati qui per sempre\.\lAndiamo via di qui.

entries.original:
"What? A dead end!

I’m sure there’s a way out of
here\."
entries.translation_source: What? A dead end! I’m sure there’s a way out of here[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Cosa? Un vicolo cieco! Sono sicuro
che ci sia un modo per uscire di\lqui\.

entries.original: "Let me see\."
entries.translation_source: Let me see[game-token-1]
entries.translated: Fammi vedere\.

entries.original:
"Aha! Found it!

A weak spot in the wall, right
here."
entries.translation_source: Aha! Found it! A weak spot in the wall, right here.
entries.translated:
Ahah! Trovato! Un punto debole nel
muro, proprio qui.

entries.original: "Graveler, use Rock Smash!"
entries.translation_source: Graveler, use Rock Smash!
entries.translated: Graveler, usa Spaccaroccia!

entries.original: "[green]Rarrrarrr!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Rarrrarrr!
entries.translated: [green]Rarrrarrr!

entries.original:
"Thanks for all your help!
Here, take this TM.

I forgot I had it this whole time."
entries.translation_source: Thanks for all your help! Here, take this TM. I forgot I had it this whole time.
entries.translated:
Grazie di tutto il tuo aiuto!
Tieni, prendi questa MT. Mi ero\ldimenticato di averla da sempre.

entries.original:
"TM28 contains [green]Dig[blue].

We should have just used it right
away, eh?"
entries.translation_source: TM28 contains [color-green-1]Dig[color-blue-2]. We should have just used it right away, eh?
entries.translated:
La MT28 contiene [green]Fossa[blue]. Avremmo
dovuto usarla subito, eh?

entries.original: "Nine Tails of Snow"
entries.translation_source: Nine Tails of Snow
entries.translated: Nove code di neve

entries.original:
"An idol can’t perform without her
precious Pokémon! Track down the
burglar that stole her Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: An idol can’t perform without her precious Pokémon! Track down the burglar that stole her Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Una diva non può esibirsi senza i
suoi preziosi Pokémon! Scova il\lladro che le ha rubato i Pokémon.

entries.original: "Burglar"
entries.translation_source: Burglar
entries.translated: Ladro

entries.original:
"Whatever will I do\.

My beloved baby was taken from me
by some\. some\. crook!

How can I perform on stage
without her?

Please, help me get my baby back!"
entries.translation_source: Whatever will I do[game-token-1] My beloved baby was taken from me by some[game-token-2] some[game-token-3] crook! How can I perform on stage without her? Please, help me get my baby back!
entries.translated:
Che farò\.. La mia amata bambina mi è
stata portata via da qualche\..\lqualche\.. delinquente! Come posso

esibirmi sul palco senza di lei? Ti
prego, aiutami a riavere la mia\lbambina!

entries.original:
"Oh, thank you!

Thank you, thank you!

I know that my baby was taken by a
man dressed in gray.

But that’s all I know\.
I wish I knew where he went\."
entries.translation_source: Oh, thank you! Thank you, thank you! I know that my baby was taken by a man dressed in gray. But that’s all I know[game-token-1] I wish I knew where he went[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Oh, grazie! Grazie, grazie! So che
il mio bambino è stato preso da un\luomo vestito di grigio. Ma è tutto

quello che so\. Vorrei sapere dove
sia andato\.

entries.original:
"I know that my baby was taken by a
man dressed in gray.

But that’s all I know\.
I wish I knew where he went\."
entries.translation_source: I know that my baby was taken by a man dressed in gray. But that’s all I know[game-token-1] I wish I knew where he went[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
So che il mio bambino è stato preso
da un uomo vestito di grigio. Ma\lquesto è tutto ciò che so\. Vorrei

sapere dove sia andato\.

entries.original:
"Oh no, no, no\.

I hope I can find someone to help
me before it’s too late\."
entries.translation_source: Oh no, no, no[game-token-1] I hope I can find someone to help me before it’s too late[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
Oh no, no, no\. Spero di trovare
qualcuno che mi aiuti prima che sia\ltroppo tardi\.

entries.original:
"It’s you again!

The burglar who stole my baby came
back and returned her to me!

I can now perform again!
Thank you, thank you, thank you!

Please, take this [green]Egg[red] she laid!
It’s the least I can do."

Swampert is supposed to keep the delicate balance of this unique ecosytem, but without it, there’s nothin’ settlin’ down these goons! I need to stop their shenanigans and find my Swampert, so balance can be restored to the swamp. But, you see, I can’t take out all these goons alone. So, what do ya say, down for an adventure with ol’ Tessy?

questo ecosistema unico, ma senza\ldi lui, non c{B4}è niente che tenga a

bada questi scagnozzi! Devo fermare
i loro pasticci e trovare il mio\lSwampert, così l{B4}equilibrio potrà

essere ripristinato nella palude.
Ma, vedi, non posso affrontare\ltutti questi scagnozzi da sola.

Allora, che ne dici, pronto per
un{B4}avventura con la vecchia Tessy?

Polder Town and make it the seat\lof our new enterprise!

Gruff’ll be so proud of all
us Terror Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Once these two finish gettin’ quashed by our ultimate Feraligatr, no one’ll be able to stand in our way as we claim a new home for us Terror Granbull! We’re gonna march unopposed into Polder Town and make it the seat of our new enterprise! Who needs Antisis City? Gruff’ll be so proud of all us Terror Granbull!
entries.translated:
[blue]Una volta che questi due avranno
finito di farsi schiacciare dal\lnostro Feraligatr supremo, nessuno

potrà più mettersi sulla nostra
strada mentre rivendichiamo una\lnuova casa per noi Terror Granbull!

Marceremo indisturbati in Polder
Town e la renderemo la sede della\lnostra nuova impresa! Chi ha

bisogno di Antisis City? Gruff sarà
così orgoglioso di tutti noi Terror\lGranbull!

entries.original: "[green]Gaaaaatoooor\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Gaaaaatoooor[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Gaaaaatoooor\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Grrr\.
Arr\.

You may have defeated Feraligatr,
but without Swampert, the swamp is\lstill in chaos.

More contenders will arise, and
we’ll take the strong ones for\lourselves.

Soon we’ll be able to call Polder
Town our home, and there’s nothin’\lyou’ll be able to do to stop us!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Grrr[game-token-2] Arr[game-token-3] You may have defeated Feraligatr, but without Swampert, the swamp is still in chaos. More contenders will arise, and we’ll take the strong ones for ourselves. Soon we’ll be able to call Polder Town our home, and there’s nothin’ you’ll be able to do to stop us!
entries.translated:
[blue]Grrr\. Arr\. Potresti aver sconfitto
Feraligatr, ma senza Swampert la\lpalude è ancora nel caos. Ne

sorgeranno altri, e prenderemo per
noi i più forti. Presto potremo\lchiamare Polder Town casa nostra, e

non ci sarà niente che tu possa
fare per fermarci!

entries.original:
"[blue]Ahhh!
Swampert escaped!

I knew we shouldn’t have bought
those discount Poké-restraints!

Scatter, boys!

SCATTER!"
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Ahhh! Swampert escaped! I knew we shouldn’t have bought those discount Poké-restraints! Scatter, boys! SCATTER!
entries.translated:
[blue]Aahh! Swampert è scappato! Lo
sapevo che non avremmo dovuto\lcomprare quei dispositivi di

contenimento Poké scontati!
Disperdetevi, ragazzi!\lDISPERDETEVI!

entries.original:
"[red]Ah, Swampert, dear, it’s nice to
have ya back.

I hope them Terror Granbull didn’t
hurt ya too badly.

\.

Yes, I know those hoodlums need to
be punished, but I need ya to\lstay here in the bog so ya can\lrestore the balance.

Don’t ya worry, I’ll keep a
closer eye on the swamp from\lnow on.

If those hoodlums set one foot in
here, I’ll let ’em have it!"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Ah, Swampert, dear, it’s nice to have ya back. I hope them Terror Granbull didn’t hurt ya too badly. [game-token-2] Yes, I know those hoodlums need to be punished, but I need ya to stay here in the bog so ya can restore the balance. Don’t ya worry, I’ll keep a closer eye on the swamp from now on. If those hoodlums set one foot in here, I’ll let ’em have it!
entries.translated:
[red]Ah, Swampert, caro, è bello
riaverti. Spero che quei Terror\lGranbull non ti abbiano fatto

troppo male. \. Sì, lo so che quei
teppisti devono essere puniti, ma\lho bisogno che tu stia qui nella

palude così che tu possa
ripristinare l{B4}equilibrio. Non\lpreoccuparti, terrò d{B4}occhio la

palude più attentamente d{B4}ora in
poi. Se quei teppisti mettono un\lpiede qui, gliele suono!

entries.original:
"[red]Thank you, [player], for your help
in fixin’ the swamp and beatin’\lthose nasty varmints.

I am truly indebted to ya.

Here’s a little parcel of my
gratitude for ya service."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Thank you, [player-name-2], for your help in fixin’ the swamp and beatin’ those nasty varmints. I am truly indebted to ya. Here’s a little parcel of my gratitude for ya service.
entries.translated:
[red]Grazie, [player], per il tuo aiuto
nel sistemare la palude e nello\lsconfiggere quei bruti meschini. Ti

sono davvero debitore. Ecco un
piccolo pacco per ringraziarti del\ltuo servizio.

entries.original:
"[red]Thanks again, [player].

Me, Swampert, and the swamp are
obliged to ya."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Thanks again, [player-name-2]. Me, Swampert, and the swamp are obliged to ya.
entries.translated:
[red]Grazie ancora, [player]. Io,
Swampert e la palude ti siamo\ldebitori.

entries.original:
"This swamp is full of powerful
Pokémon.

We’re gonna see who among ’em is
the strongest!"
entries.translation_source: This swamp is full of powerful Pokémon. We’re gonna see who among ’em is the strongest!
entries.translated:
Questa palude è piena di Pokémon
potenti. Vedremo chi tra loro è il\lpiù forte!

entries.original:
"You’re strong, but are you really
the strongest?"
entries.translation_source: You’re strong, but are you really the strongest?
entries.translated:
Sei forte, ma sei davvero il più
forte?

entries.original:
"If you wanna find the strong, you
gotta first weed out the weak."
entries.translation_source: If you wanna find the strong, you gotta first weed out the weak.
entries.translated:
Se vuoi trovare i forti, devi prima
eliminare i deboli.

entries.original:
"Betcha believed me!

Haw haw!"
entries.translation_source: Betcha believed me! Haw haw!
entries.translated:
Scommetto che ci hai creduto! Ah
ah!

entries.original:
"Would you mind beatin’ the other
guys quickly so we can spring our\ltrap?"
entries.translation_source: Would you mind beatin’ the other guys quickly so we can spring our trap?
entries.translated:
Ti dispiacerebbe battere in fretta
gli altri, così possiamo far\lscattare la trappola?

entries.original:
"With Swampert gone, the Pokémon
here are all tryin’ to gain power."
entries.translation_source: With Swampert gone, the Pokémon here are all tryin’ to gain power.
entries.translated:
Con Swampert sparito, qui i Pokémon
stanno tutti cercando di ottenere\lpotere.

entries.original:
"Who? What? How?
I’m ready for duty, boss!"
entries.translation_source: Who? What? How? I’m ready for duty, boss!
entries.translated:
Chi? Cosa? Come? Sono pronto per il
servizio, capo!

entries.original:
"Okay, boss, maybe I did just do a
quick little sample."
entries.translation_source: Okay, boss, maybe I did just do a quick little sample.
entries.translated:
Va bene, capo, magari ho solo fatto
un piccolo assaggio.

entries.original:
"My job is to hold our box here, and
not lick it\.

Well\. I tried."
entries.translation_source: My job is to hold our box here, and not lick it[game-token-1] Well[game-token-2] I tried.
entries.translated:
Il mio lavoro è tenere qui la
nostra scatola, e non leccarla\. Beh\.\lCi ho provato.

entries.original:
"The strongest Pokémon is necessary
for our plan to get a new home."
entries.translation_source: The strongest Pokémon is necessary for our plan to get a new home.
entries.translated:
Il Pokémon più forte è necessario
per il nostro piano per ottenere\luna nuova casa.

entries.original:
"Ain’t there somethin’ tranquil
about watchin’ two Pokémon thrash\lat each other until one faints?"
entries.translation_source: Ain’t there somethin’ tranquil about watchin’ two Pokémon thrash at each other until one faints?
entries.translated:
Non c{B4}è qualcosa di tranquillo nel
guardare due Pokémon che si\lscatenano l{B4}uno contro l{B4}altro

finché uno sviene?

entries.original:
"I hope the Feraligatr wins, I have
a $10000 bet on it."
entries.translation_source: I hope the Feraligatr wins, I have a $10000 bet on it.
entries.translated:
Spero che vinca Feraligatr, ci ho
scommesso 10000 $.

entries.original: "A Rift in Space"
entries.translation_source: A Rift in Space
entries.translated: Una frattura nello

entries.original:
"A little girl has gone missing in
Rift Cave! Find her, and bring her
home to her worried parents."
entries.translation_source: A little girl has gone missing in Rift Cave! Find her, and bring her home to her worried parents.
entries.translated:
Una bambina è scomparsa nella
Grotta Rift! Trovala e riportala a\lcasa dai suoi genitori preoccupati.

entries.original:
"My daughter tried venturing into
Rift Cave all by herself.

She was very lucky that someone
stopped her.

If she had gone in there\.

I shudder every time I think of
what could have happened!"
entries.translation_source: My daughter tried venturing into Rift Cave all by herself. She was very lucky that someone stopped her. If she had gone in there[game-token-1] I shudder every time I think of what could have happened!
entries.translated:
Mia figlia ha provato a inoltrarsi
nella Rift Cave da sola. È stata\lmolto fortunata che qualcuno

l{B4}abbia fermata. Se fosse entrata
lì\. Rabbrividisco ogni volta che\lpenso a ciò che sarebbe potuto

accadere!

entries.original:
"Good heavens!
My daughter!

She ran off to [green]Rift Cave[blue]!

I’ve told her time and time again
to stay away from that dangerous\lplace, but she never listens to me!

Please, Champion!
Bring her home!"
entries.translation_source: Good heavens! My daughter! She ran off to [color-green-1]Rift Cave[color-blue-2]! I’ve told her time and time again to stay away from that dangerous place, but she never listens to me! Please, Champion! Bring her home!
entries.translated:
Santo cielo! Mia figlia! È scappata
a [green]Rift Cave[blue]! Le ho detto e ripetuto\ldi stare alla larga da quel posto

pericoloso, ma non mi ascolta mai!
Per favore, Campione! Riportala a\lcasa!

entries.original:
"Thank you, Champion!

Take great care while searching
for her\.

[green]Rift Cave[blue] is known for not always
obeying the laws of our world\."
entries.translation_source: Thank you, Champion! Take great care while searching for her[game-token-1] [color-green-2]Rift Cave[color-blue-3] is known for not always obeying the laws of our world[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Grazie, Campione! Fai molta
attenzione mentre la cerchi\. [green]Rift\lCave[blue] è nota per non obbedire sempre

alle leggi del nostro mondo\.

entries.original:
"Oh, heavens\.

If the Champion is too afraid to do
it, who would?"
entries.translation_source: Oh, heavens[game-token-1] If the Champion is too afraid to do it, who would?
entries.translated:
Oh, cieli\. Se il Campione ha troppa
paura per farlo, chi lo farebbe?

entries.original:
"Take great care while searching
[green]Rift Cave[blue] for my daughter.

It is known for not always obeying
the natural laws of our world\."
entries.translation_source: Take great care while searching [color-green-1]Rift Cave[color-blue-2] for my daughter. It is known for not always obeying the natural laws of our world[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Fai molta attenzione mentre cerchi
[green]Rift Cave[blue] per mia figlia. È nota\lper non obbedire sempre alle leggi

naturali del nostro mondo\.

entries.original:
"Champion!

My daughter arrived home without a
scratch on her!

I am in your debt!

Please, accept this rare gem stone
from my collection."
entries.translation_source: Champion! My daughter arrived home without a scratch on her! I am in your debt! Please, accept this rare gem stone from my collection.
entries.translated:
Campione! Mia figlia è tornata a
casa senza un graffio! Ti devo\lmolto! Per favore, accetta questa

rara gemma dalla mia collezione.

entries.original:
"My daughter has been severely
punished for inconveniencing you\lby running off to Rift Cave.

I will make sure that she never
leaves the corner again."
entries.translation_source: My daughter has been severely punished for inconveniencing you by running off to Rift Cave. I will make sure that she never leaves the corner again.
entries.translated:
Mia figlia è stata severamente
punita per averti causato dei\lproblemi scappando verso Rift Cave.

Farò in modo che resti sempre
all{B4}angolo.

entries.original:
"My parents put me in the corner
because I tried to go to Rift Cave."
entries.translation_source: My parents put me in the corner because I tried to go to Rift Cave.
entries.translated:
I miei genitori mi hanno messo in
punizione perché ho provato ad\landare alla Rift Cave.

entries.original:
"Ohhh\.

I ran away from home to play in
Rift Cave, but every time I try to\lleave, I end up back in this room\.

Please, nice Trainer!
Take me home!"
entries.translation_source: Ohhh[game-token-1] I ran away from home to play in Rift Cave, but every time I try to leave, I end up back in this room[game-token-2] Please, nice Trainer! Take me home!
entries.translated:
Ohhh\. Sono scappato di casa per
giocare nella Grotta Rift, ma ogni\lvolta che provo a uscire, finisco

di nuovo in questa stanza\. Per
favore, gentile Allenatore! Portami\la casa!

entries.original:
"Wahhhh!
That Pokémon is scary!

Trainer!
Protect me!"
entries.translation_source: Wahhhh! That Pokémon is scary! Trainer! Protect me!
entries.translated:
Uaaaa! Quel Pokémon fa paura!
Allenatore! Proteggimi!

entries.original: "[black]The little girl disappeared."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The little girl disappeared.
entries.translated: [black]La bambina è scomparsa.

entries.original:
"Ohhh\.

That scary Pokémon dragged me
down here\.

I’m so scared\.

Wahhh!
I wanna go home!"
entries.translation_source: Ohhh[game-token-1] That scary Pokémon dragged me down here[game-token-2] I’m so scared[game-token-3] Wahhh! I wanna go home!
entries.translated:
Ohhh\. Quel Pokémon spaventoso mi ha
trascinato quaggiù\. Ho così paura\.\lWaahh! Voglio tornare a casa!

entries.original:
"Wahhhh!
The scary Pokémon came back!

Trainer, please don’t let it
hurt me!"
entries.translation_source: Wahhhh! The scary Pokémon came back! Trainer, please don’t let it hurt me!
entries.translated:
Wahhhh! Il Pokémon spaventoso è
tornato! Allenatore, ti prego, non\llasciare che mi faccia del male!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

That Pokémon was really scary.
Thank you for beating it up!

Can you take me home, please?
I’ve played enough for today."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] That Pokémon was really scary. Thank you for beating it up! Can you take me home, please? I’ve played enough for today.
entries.translated:
Sniff\. Quel Pokémon era davvero
spaventoso. Grazie per averlo\lbattuto! Puoi portarmi a casa, per

favore? Ho già giocato abbastanza
per oggi.

entries.original:
"[black][player] decided to go with the
little girl!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1][player-name-2] decided to go with the little girl!
entries.translated:
[black][player] ha deciso di andare con la
bambina!

entries.original:
"Are you a strong Trainer or
something?

You must be if you fought that
Pokémon!"
entries.translation_source: Are you a strong Trainer or something? You must be if you fought that Pokémon!
entries.translated:
Sei un Allenatore forte o qualcosa
del genere? Devi esserlo, se hai\lcombattuto quel Pokémon!

entries.original:
"Sniff\.

I wanna go home.
I’ve played enough for today."
entries.translation_source: Sniff[game-token-1] I wanna go home. I’ve played enough for today.
entries.translated:
Sniff\. Voglio andare a casa. Per
oggi ho giocato abbastanza.

"That Pokémon before was really
scary!

Why is it so mean?
Is this its home?"
entries.translation_source: That Pokémon before was really scary! Why is it so mean? Is this its home?
entries.translated:
Quel Pokémon di prima era davvero
spaventoso! Perché è così cattivo?\lÈ casa sua?

entries.original:
"We made it out!
Thank you, Trainer!

I know how to get home from here."

entries.translated:
Ce l{B4}abbiamo fatta! Grazie,
Allenatore! So come tornare a casa\lda qui.

entries.original:
"My parents put me in the corner
because I went into Rift Cave."
entries.translation_source: My parents put me in the corner because I went into Rift Cave.
entries.translated:
I miei genitori mi hanno messo in
punizione perché sono entrato nella\lRift Cave.

"There are stories of people never
returning from Rift Cave.

They say that whole groups who have
gone down there have never been\lseen again."
entries.translation_source: There are stories of people never returning from Rift Cave. They say that whole groups who have gone down there have never been seen again.
entries.translated:
Si racconta di persone che non sono
mai tornate da Rift Cave. Si dice\lche interi gruppi scesi laggiù non

siano mai più stati visti.

entries.original:
"I fear the worst.

Our daughter may wind up being
added to the list of people who’ve\lnever returned from Rift Cave\."
entries.translation_source: I fear the worst. Our daughter may wind up being added to the list of people who’ve never returned from Rift Cave[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Temo il peggio. Nostra figlia
potrebbe finire per essere aggiunta\lalla lista delle persone che non

sono mai tornate dalla Rift Cave\.

entries.original:
"There are stories of people never
returning from Rift Cave.

They say that whole groups who have
gone down there have never been\lseen again.

It’s a good thing you saved our
daughter, Champion.

I shudder to think what could have
happened to her."
entries.translation_source: There are stories of people never returning from Rift Cave. They say that whole groups who have gone down there have never been seen again. It’s a good thing you saved our daughter, Champion. I shudder to think what could have happened to her.
entries.translated:
Si racconta di persone che non sono
mai tornate da Rift Cave. Dicono\lche interi gruppi che sono scesi

laggiù non siano mai stati rivisti.
Meno male che hai salvato nostra\lfiglia, Campione. Mi vengono i

brividi al pensiero di cosa le
sarebbe potuto succedere.

entries.original: "[green]Gagyagyaah!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Gagyagyaah!
entries.translated: [green]Gagyagyaah!

entries.original:
"[black]Palkia began to warp the space
around it to increase it’s size!"

entries.translated:
[black]Palkia ha iniziato a deformare lo
spazio intorno a sé per aumentarne\lle dimensioni!

"[black][buffer1] warped space to
disappear\."

entries.translated:
[black][buffer1] ha distorto lo spazio per
scomparire\.

entries.translated: L{B4}Electivire ribelle

L{B4}Electivire di un nerd è andato

L{B4}Electivire di un nerd si è

"Return to Epidimy Town to

Torna a Epidimy Town per ricevere

"A nerd’s Electivire has been

L{B4}Electivire di un secchione è

"The Science Society scientist has

Lo scienziato della Società
Scientifica è stato sconfitto!\lRiporta Electivire a Epidimy Town

"No\. Electivire\. please!

No\. Electivire\. per favore! Perché ti

"Electivire\. why don’t you go

Yes\. come on, now\. return!"
entries.translation_source: Electivire[game-token-1] why don’t you go back in your Poké Ball? Yes[game-token-2] come on, now[game-token-3] return!
entries.translated:
Electivire\. perché non torni nella
tua Poké Ball? Sì\. dai, adesso\.\ltorna!

entries.original:
"Oh\. come on, Electivire\.
don’t knock your ball away\."
entries.translation_source: Oh[game-token-1] come on, Electivire[game-token-2] don’t knock your ball away[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Oh\. avanti, Electivire\. non buttare
via la tua palla\.

entries.original:
"Electivire\. that could’ve
seriously injured me!"

entries.translated:
Electivire\. avrei potuto farmi
seriamente male!

entries.original:
"Help!

Somebody help me!

My Electivire’s gone rogue!"
entries.translation_source: Help! Somebody help me! My Electivire’s gone rogue!
entries.translated:
Aiuto! Qualcuno mi aiuti! Il mio
Electivire si è ribellato!

entries.original: "[black]Protect the nerd?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Protect the nerd?
entries.translated: [black]Proteggere il nerd?

entries.original:
"Thank you!
Thank you for protecting me!

Now, please, battle my Electivire
and bring it back to its senses!"
entries.translation_source: Thank you! Thank you for protecting me! Now, please, battle my Electivire and bring it back to its senses!
entries.translated:
Grazie! Grazie per avermi protetto!
Ora, per favore, combatti contro il\lmio Electivire e fallo tornare in

sé!

entries.original:
"Electivire!
Come back!"
entries.translation_source: Electivire! Come back!
entries.translated: Electivire! Torna qui!

entries.original: "[blue]And he’s gone\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]And he’s gone[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [blue]Ed è sparito\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Please\. you were kind enough to
protect me\. so please, chase after\lmy Electivire!

He’s the only friend I have\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Please[game-token-2] you were kind enough to protect me[game-token-3] so please, chase after my Electivire! He’s the only friend I have[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[blue]Per favore\. sei stato così gentile

"Electivire\. please\. just listen

entries.translated:
Electivire\. per favore\. ascoltami\.
Torna nella tua Poké Ball!

"I owe you one for helping
my Electivire.

I can’t give you anything here, so
meet me in the [green]Epidimy Town\lPokémon Center[blue] if you want a\lreward for your help."
