entries.translated:
Ti devo un favore per aver aiutato
il mio Electivire. Qui non posso\ldarti niente, quindi vieni a

trovarmi al [green]Centro Pokémon di
Epidimy Town[blue] se vuoi una ricompensa\lper il tuo aiuto.

entries.original:
"[red]Epidimy Town, you say\.

Then I must head there\. for the
sake of the Science Society\."
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Epidimy Town, you say[game-token-2] Then I must head there[game-token-3] for the sake of the Science Society[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[red]Epidimy Town, dici\. Allora devo
andare lì\. per il bene della Società\lScientifica\.

entries.original:
"[blue]Sniff\.

My Electivire\.

This scientist came by and asked
to take a look at him, but when I\lhanded her his Poké Ball, she\ltook off!

Now my only friend is gone\."
entries.translation_source: [color-blue-1]Sniff[game-token-2] My Electivire[game-token-3] This scientist came by and asked to take a look at him, but when I handed her his Poké Ball, she took off! Now my only friend is gone[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
[blue]Sniff\. Il mio Electivire\. Questa
scienziata è passata e mi ha\lchiesto di dargli un{B4}occhiata, ma

quando le ho consegnato la sua Poké
Ball, è scappata! Ora il mio unico\lamico se n{B4}è andato\.

entries.original:
"I know I promised I’d give you a
reward when you got here, but can\lyou wait just a little longer?

I want to wait until I’m reunited
with my Electivire for good.

If you bring him back, I’ll throw
in something extra."
entries.translation_source: I know I promised I’d give you a reward when you got here, but can you wait just a little longer? I want to wait until I’m reunited with my Electivire for good. If you bring him back, I’ll throw in something extra.
entries.translated:
So che ti avevo promesso una
ricompensa quando saresti arrivato\lfin qui, ma puoi aspettare ancora

un po{B4}? Voglio aspettare finché non
sarò finalmente riunito con il mio\lElectivire. Se me lo riporti, ti

darò qualcosa in più.

entries.original:
"That’s a relief.

For a moment, I thought I’d never
see my friend again\."
entries.translation_source: That’s a relief. For a moment, I thought I’d never see my friend again[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
È un sollievo. Per un momento ho
pensato che non avrei mai più\lrivisto il mio amico\.

entries.original:
"Now I’ll never see my friend
again\."
entries.translation_source: Now I’ll never see my friend again[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Adesso non rivedrò mai più il mio
amico\.

entries.original:
"Do I have any clue where
Electivire could be?

I heard that scientist say
something about heading to [green]Seaport\lCity[blue] to run experiments\.

But that’s all I can say."
entries.translation_source: Do I have any clue where Electivire could be? I heard that scientist say something about heading to [color-green-1]Seaport City[color-blue-2] to run experiments[game-token-3] But that’s all I can say.
entries.translated:
Ho qualche idea su dove potrebbe
essere Electivire? Ho sentito\lquello scienziato dire qualcosa sul

recarsi a [green]Seaport City[blue] per fare
degli esperimenti\. Ma è tutto quello\lche posso dire.

entries.original:
"You say you saved my Electivire
from the scientist?

Well, then please bring him back
to me!"
entries.translation_source: You say you saved my Electivire from the scientist? Well, then please bring him back to me!
entries.translated:
Dici di aver salvato il mio
Electivire dallo scienziato? Allora\lti prego riportamelo!

entries.original:
"The door requires a passcode to
unlock."
entries.translation_source: The door requires a passcode to unlock.
entries.translated:
La porta richiede un codice di
accesso per sbloccarsi.

entries.original:
"This looks like a great place to
write a secret passcode\."
entries.translation_source: This looks like a great place to write a secret passcode[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sembra un ottimo posto per scrivere
un codice segreto\.

entries.original:
"There appear to be some numbers
scrawled on the back of the crate.

They read: [green][buffer1][blue]"
entries.translation_source: There appear to be some numbers scrawled on the back of the crate. They read: [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3]
entries.translated:
Ci sono dei numeri scarabocchiati
sul retro della cassa. Recitano:\l[green][buffer1][blue]

entries.original:
"The door requires a passcode to
unlock.

Enter the passcode?"
entries.translation_source: The door requires a passcode to unlock. Enter the passcode?
entries.translated:
La porta richiede un codice di
accesso per sbloccarsi. Inserire il\lcodice?

entries.original:
"The passcode was incorrect.
The door remains locked.

Maybe the passcode is written
somewhere close by?"
entries.translation_source: The passcode was incorrect. The door remains locked. Maybe the passcode is written somewhere close by?
entries.translated:
Il codice di accesso era errato. La
porta rimane chiusa. Forse il\lcodice di accesso è scritto da

qualche parte qui vicino?

entries.original: "The door is already open."
entries.translation_source: The door is already open.
entries.translated: La porta è già aperta.

entries.original: "And now, one last injection\."
entries.translation_source: And now, one last injection[game-token-1]
entries.translated: E ora, un{B4}ultima iniezione\.

entries.original:
"You\.\CC0820 You’re the same Trainer that
stopped this Electivire before!

Heh\.

Heh, heh, heh, heh, hah!

You see, I wanted you to follow
me here.

I even let this Electivire’s
Trainer know where I was going!

For you see, now I can use you to
fight my experiments and aid me in\lmy research!

Heh, heh, hah, hah, hah!

You see, now?"
entries.translation_source: You[game-token-1][control-code-2] You’re the same Trainer that stopped this Electivire before! Heh[game-token-3] Heh, heh, heh, heh, hah! You see, I wanted you to follow me here. I even let this Electivire’s Trainer know where I was going! For you see, now I can use you to fight my experiments and aid me in my research! Heh, heh, hah, hah, hah! You see, now?
entries.translated:
Tu\.\CC0820 Sei lo stesso Allenatore che ha
fermato questo Electivire prima!\lEhehe\. Eheh, eheh, eheh, eheh, hah!

Vedi, volevo che mi seguissi fin
qui. Ho perfino detto\lall{B4}Allenatore di questo Electivire

dove stavo andando! Perché vedi,
ora posso usare te per combattere i\lmiei esperimenti e aiutarmi nelle

mie ricerche! Ehehe, eheh, hah,
hah, hah! Vedi, ora?

entries.original:
"Electivire!
Attack this Trainer!"
entries.translation_source: Electivire! Attack this Trainer!
entries.translated:
Electivire! Attacca questo
Allenatore!

entries.original: "[green]Vire!"
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Vire!
entries.translated: [green]Vire!

entries.original: "[green]Vire\."
entries.translation_source: [color-green-1]Vire[game-token-2]
entries.translated: [green]Vire\.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, heh, urk\.

I am disappointed my experiment
could not hold up.

However\.

There is always a contingency plan!

Heh, heh, heh, hah, hah!"
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, heh, urk[game-token-1] I am disappointed my experiment could not hold up. However[game-token-2] There is always a contingency plan! Heh, heh, heh, hah, hah!
entries.translated:
Eh, eh, eh, urk\. Sono deluso che il
mio esperimento non abbia retto.\lTuttavia\. C{B4}è sempre un piano di

contingenza! Eh, eh, eh, ah, ah!

entries.original:
"Electivire!
It’s time for round two!

Can you feel it?

I’ve filled the air with the power
I harnessed!

The power of the Hidden Grottos!

Use it to attack this Trainer!"
entries.translation_source: Electivire! It’s time for round two! Can you feel it? I’ve filled the air with the power I harnessed! The power of the Hidden Grottos! Use it to attack this Trainer!
entries.translated:
Electivire! È tempo del secondo
round! Lo senti? Ho riempito l{B4}aria\lcon il potere che ho canalizzato!

Il potere delle Grotte Nascoste!
Usalo per attaccare questo\lAllenatore!

entries.original:
"[black]Do you need an explanation of the
Dynamax phenomenon?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Do you need an explanation of the Dynamax phenomenon?
entries.translated:
[black]Hai bisogno di una spiegazione del
fenomeno Dynamax?

entries.original:
"[black]Dynamax is a unique phenomenon that
a Pokémon can only undergo in\lspecial areas, such as Hidden\lGrottos.

Almost any Pokémon can Dynamax,
but if a Pokémon holds a Mega\lStone or Z-Crystal, it won’t be\lable to.

To Dynamax a Pokémon, press \btn04
when you see the red Dynamax\lsymbol appear.

If you choose to Dynamax your
Pokémon, the effect will last\lfor three turns.

During this time period, each of
your Pokémon’s moves will be\lpowered up into special variants\lknown as [green]Max Moves[black].

These Max Moves are much more
powerful than regular attacks."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Dynamax is a unique phenomenon that a Pokémon can only undergo in special areas, such as Hidden Grottos. Almost any Pokémon can Dynamax, but if a Pokémon holds a Mega Stone or Z-Crystal, it won’t be able to. To Dynamax a Pokémon, press [button-icon-2] when you see the red Dynamax symbol appear. If you choose to Dynamax your Pokémon, the effect will last for three turns. During this time period, each of your Pokémon’s moves will be powered up into special variants known as [color-green-3]Max Moves[color-black-4]. These Max Moves are much more powerful than regular attacks.
entries.translated:
[black]Dynamax è un fenomeno unico che un
Pokémon può sperimentare solo in\laree speciali, come le Grotte

Nascoste. Quasi tutti i Pokémon
possono usare Dynamax, ma se un\lPokémon tiene una Megapietra o un

Cristallo Z, non sarà in grado di
farlo. Per usare Dynamax su un\lPokémon, premi \btn04 quando vedi

apparire il simbolo rosso di
Dynamax. Se scegli di far usare\lDynamax al tuo Pokémon, l{B4}effetto

durerà per tre turni. Durante
questo periodo, ogni mossa del tuo\lPokémon verrà potenziata in

varianti speciali note come [green]Mosse
Max[black]. Queste Mosse Max sono molto\lpiù potenti degli attacchi normali.

entries.original:
"Heh, heh, urk\.

It seems this is a failed
experiment.

Perhaps my formula was not as
potent as I thought\.

However\.

It’s time for my final contingency
plan!

Electivire!
Out of my way!"
entries.translation_source: Heh, heh, urk[game-token-1] It seems this is a failed experiment. Perhaps my formula was not as potent as I thought[game-token-2] However[game-token-3] It’s time for my final contingency plan! Electivire! Out of my way!
entries.translated:
Eh, eh, urk\. Sembra che questo sia
un esperimento fallito. Forse la\lmia formula non era potente quanto

pensavo\. Tuttavia\. È ora del mio
piano di riserva finale!\lElectivire! Fatti da parte!

entries.original:
"I’ll come at you using my very
first test subjects!"
entries.translation_source: I’ll come at you using my very first test subjects!
entries.translated:
Ti attaccherò usando i miei
primissimi soggetti di prova!

entries.original:
"Urk\.

The Science Society will be
extremely disappointed when they\llearn of my failed endeavors.

However\. I still managed to harness
the power of the Hidden Grottos, so\lthis may not be a complete loss\.

Goodbye, for now, Trainer.

One day in the future, I will show
you the true power of science!"
entries.translation_source: Urk[game-token-1] The Science Society will be extremely disappointed when they learn of my failed endeavors. However[game-token-2] I still managed to harness the power of the Hidden Grottos, so this may not be a complete loss[game-token-3] Goodbye, for now, Trainer. One day in the future, I will show you the true power of science!
entries.translated:
Ahi\. La Società delle Scienze sarà
estremamente delusa quando verrà a\lsapere dei miei tentativi falliti.

Tuttavia\. sono comunque riuscito a
sfruttare il potere delle Grotte\lNascoste, quindi non è stata una

perdita completa\. Addio, per ora,
Allenatore. Un giorno, in futuro,\lti mostrerò il vero potere della

scienza!

entries.original:
"[black]The Electivire seems to want to go
with you back to Epidimy Town!

Take it there?"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Electivire seems to want to go with you back to Epidimy Town! Take it there?
entries.translated:
[black]Sembra che l{B4}Electivire voglia
tornare con te a Epidimy Town!\lPortarlo lì?

entries.original:
"[black]The Electivire seems to want to go
with you back to Epidimy Town!

But it can’t go while there’s someone
following you\."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The Electivire seems to want to go with you back to Epidimy Town! But it can’t go while there’s someone following you[game-token-2]
entries.translated:
[black]L{B4}Electivire sembra voler tornare
con te a Epidimy Town! Ma non può\landare via finché qualcuno ti segue\.

entries.original:
"My Electivire came back to me!

It must have been because of your
efforts!

Now, as promised, here are your
rewards.

They’re the least I can give you
after all the time you spent\lchasing down my Electivire."
entries.translation_source: My Electivire came back to me! It must have been because of your efforts! Now, as promised, here are your rewards. They’re the least I can give you after all the time you spent chasing down my Electivire.
entries.translated:
Il mio Electivire è tornato da me!
Dev{B4}essere stato grazie ai tuoi\lsforzi! Ora, come promesso, ecco le

tue ricompense. Sono il minimo che
possa darti dopo tutto il tempo che\lhai passato a dare la caccia al mio

Electivire.

entries.original: "Take this Egg, too."
entries.translation_source: Take this Egg, too.
entries.translated: Prendi anche quest{B4}Uovo.

entries.original: "You received an Egg from the nerd!"
entries.translation_source: You received an Egg from the nerd!
entries.translated: Hai ricevuto un Uovo dal secchione!

entries.original:
"Looks like you’ll need to make
space in your Cube before I can\lgive you this Electirizer."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you’ll need to make space in your Cube before I can give you this Electirizer.
entries.translated:
Sembra che tu debba fare spazio nel
tuo Cube prima che io possa darti\lquesto Electirizer.

entries.original:
"Looks like you’ll need to make
space in your party before I can\lgive you your reward."
entries.translation_source: Looks like you’ll need to make space in your party before I can give you your reward.
entries.translated:
Sembra che tu debba liberare spazio
nella tua squadra prima che possa\ldarti la ricompensa.

entries.original:
"Use the [green]Electirizer[blue] on an [green]Electabuzz[blue]
to evolve it."
entries.translation_source: Use the [color-green-1]Electirizer[color-blue-2] on an [color-green-3]Electabuzz[color-blue-4] to evolve it.
entries.translated:
Usa l{B4}[green]Elettritore[blue] su un [green]Electabuzz[blue]
per farlo evolvere.

entries.original: "Swords of Justice"
entries.translation_source: Swords of Justice
entries.translated: Spade della Giustizia

entries.original:
"The Swords of Justice have made
their way over from Unova! Track
them down and capture them."
entries.translation_source: The Swords of Justice have made their way over from Unova! Track them down and capture them.
entries.translated:
Le Spade della Giustizia sono
arrivate da Unima! Rintracciale e\lcatturale.

entries.original:
"The Swords of Justice are hiding in
Victory Road! Capture and bring
them back to Fallshore City."
entries.translation_source: The Swords of Justice are hiding in Victory Road! Capture and bring them back to Fallshore City.
entries.translated:
Le Spade della Giustizia si
nascondono in Via Vittoria!\lCatturale e riportale a Fallshore

City.

entries.original:
"Bring the three Swords of Justice
to Route 17 to uncover one last
mystery."
entries.translation_source: Bring the three Swords of Justice to Route 17 to uncover one last mystery.
entries.translated:
Porta le tre Spade della Giustizia
sul Percorso 17 per svelare un\lultimo mistero.

entries.original:
"The Swords of Justice of the
Unova region\.

Why would they be here?

They’re not!

Not yet at least\.

In time, things may change\."
entries.translation_source: The Swords of Justice of the Unova region[game-token-1] Why would they be here? They’re not! Not yet at least[game-token-2] In time, things may change[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Le Spade della Giustizia della
regione di Unima\. Perché dovrebbero\lessere qui? Non lo sono! Almeno non

ancora\. Col tempo, le cose
potrebbero cambiare\.

entries.original:
"The Swords of Justice of the Unova
region have appeared!

Why would they be here?

The great Portal Boom, that’s why!

Will you capture them and show
them to me?"
entries.translation_source: The Swords of Justice of the Unova region have appeared! Why would they be here? The great Portal Boom, that’s why! Will you capture them and show them to me?
entries.translated:
Le Spade della Giustizia della
regione di Unima sono apparse!\lPerché dovrebbero essere qui? Per

via del grande Boom dei Portali,
ovvio! Riuscirai a catturarle e a\lmostrarmele?

entries.original:
"The Swords of Justice are waiting
for a Trainer like the Champion\lto come and find them!

If you don’t find them soon,
someone else just might!"
entries.translation_source: The Swords of Justice are waiting for a Trainer like the Champion to come and find them! If you don’t find them soon, someone else just might!
entries.translated:
Le Spade della Giustizia aspettano
un Allenatore come il Campione che\lvenga a trovarle! Se non le trovi

presto, qualcun altro potrebbe
farlo!

entries.original:
"Ahaha, I knew I could count
on you!

Word has it the Pokémon have been
spotted around [green]Victory Road[blue]."
entries.translation_source: Ahaha, I knew I could count on you! Word has it the Pokémon have been spotted around [color-green-1]Victory Road[color-blue-2].
entries.translated:
Ahaha, sapevo di poter contare su
di te! Si dice che i Pokémon siano\lstati avvistati nei dintorni di

[green]Victory Road[blue].

entries.original:
"Capture the Swords of Justice and
bring them here!

Word has it they’ve been spotted
around [green]Victory Road[blue].

They’re quite apprehensive of
humans, so they may only feel\lsecure when they’re together.

If you accidentally defeat one,
don’t worry!

Like most legendary Pokémon, they
will reappear if you enter the\lHall of Fame again."
entries.translation_source: Capture the Swords of Justice and bring them here! Word has it they’ve been spotted around [color-green-1]Victory Road[color-blue-2]. They’re quite apprehensive of humans, so they may only feel secure when they’re together. If you accidentally defeat one, don’t worry! Like most legendary Pokémon, they will reappear if you enter the Hall of Fame again.
entries.translated:
Cattura le Spade della Giustizia e
portale qui! Si dice che siano\lstate avvistate nei dintorni di [green]Via

Vittoria[blue]. Diffidano molto degli
esseri umani, quindi potrebbero\lsentirsi al sicuro solo quando sono

insieme. Se ne sconfiggi una per
sbaglio, non preoccuparti! Come la\lmaggior parte dei Pokémon

leggendari, riappariranno se entri
di nuovo nella Hall of Fame.

entries.original:
"Trainer!

You have done well capturing the
Swords of Justice.

Now, follow me and bring them to
[green]Route 17[blue].

I have a suspicion about them\."
entries.translation_source: Trainer! You have done well capturing the Swords of Justice. Now, follow me and bring them to [color-green-1]Route 17[color-blue-2]. I have a suspicion about them[game-token-3]
entries.translated:
Allenatore! Hai fatto bene a
catturare le Spade della Giustizia.\lOra seguimi e portale a [green]Route 17[blue].

Ho un sospetto su di loro\.

entries.original:
"Trainer!

Bring the Swords of Justice you
captured earlier.

I have a suspicion about this
rock face\."
entries.translation_source: Trainer! Bring the Swords of Justice you captured earlier. I have a suspicion about this rock face[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Allenatore! Porta le Spade della
Giustizia che hai catturato prima.\lHo un sospetto su questa parete di

roccia\.

entries.original:
"Trainer!

I believe this rock face before me
is somehow linked to the Swords of\lJustice.

Please allow them out of their
Poké Balls, so we can see if they\lreact to the wall."
entries.translation_source: Trainer! I believe this rock face before me is somehow linked to the Swords of Justice. Please allow them out of their Poké Balls, so we can see if they react to the wall.
entries.translated:
Allenatore! Credo che questa parete
rocciosa davanti a me sia in\lqualche modo collegata ai Swords of

Justice. Ti prego di farli uscire
dalle loro Poké Ball, così potremo\lvedere se reagiscono alla parete.

entries.original:
"[black]Your Pokémon are shaking in their
Poké Balls!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Your Pokémon are shaking in their Poké Balls!
entries.translated:
[black]I tuoi Pokémon stanno tremando
nelle Poké Ball!

entries.original:
"Ahaha!
My suspicions were confirmed!

Despite the Swords of Justice not
originating in Borrius, they still\lbear a strong connection with\lwhatever is hiding behind this\lrock face.

If I am correct, you’ll need these
in your fight against it."
entries.translation_source: Ahaha! My suspicions were confirmed! Despite the Swords of Justice not originating in Borrius, they still bear a strong connection with whatever is hiding behind this rock face. If I am correct, you’ll need these in your fight against it.
entries.translated:
Ahaha! I miei sospetti erano
fondati! Nonostante i Giustizieri\lnon abbiano origine in Borrius,

conservano comunque un forte legame
con qualunque cosa si stia\lnascondendo dietro questa parete di

roccia. Se ho ragione, ti
serviranno questi nella tua lotta\lcontro di essa.

entries.original:
"May the swords be with you, young
Trainer."
entries.translation_source: May the swords be with you, young Trainer.
entries.translated:
Che le spade siano con te, giovane
Allenatore.

entries.original:
"[black]Keldeo boosted its aura and
increased its size!"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Keldeo boosted its aura and increased its size!
entries.translated:
[black]Keldeo ha potenziato la sua aura e
aumentato le sue dimensioni!

entries.original: "The Terror Granbull"
entries.translation_source: The Terror Granbull
entries.translated: Il terribile Granbull

entries.original:
"The Terror Granbull are causing
havoc on Route 10! Assist the local
authorities in rounding them up."
entries.translation_source: The Terror Granbull are causing havoc on Route 10! Assist the local authorities in rounding them up.
entries.translated:
I Granbull del Terrore stanno
seminando il caos sul Percorso 10!\lAiuta le autorità locali a

catturarli.

entries.original:
"The Terror Granbull have run away
to the Auburn Waterway! Help the
local authorities arrest 5 of them."
entries.translation_source: The Terror Granbull have run away to the Auburn Waterway! Help the local authorities arrest 5 of them.
entries.translated:
I Terror Granbull sono fuggiti al
Auburn Waterway! Aiuta le autorità\llocali ad arrestarne 5.

entries.original:
"The Terror Granbull have run away
to the Auburn Waterway! Help the
local authorities arrest 4 of them."
entries.translation_source: The Terror Granbull have run away to the Auburn Waterway! Help the local authorities arrest 4 of them.
entries.translated:
I Terror Granbull sono fuggiti al
Auburn Waterway! Aiuta le autorità\llocali ad arrestarne 4.

entries.original:
"The Terror Granbull have run away
to the Auburn Waterway! Help the
local authorities arrest 3 of them."
entries.translation_source: The Terror Granbull have run away to the Auburn Waterway! Help the local authorities arrest 3 of them.
entries.translated:
I Terror Granbull sono fuggiti al
Auburn Waterway! Aiuta le autorità\llocali ad arrestarne 3.

entries.original:
"The Terror Granbull have run away
to the Auburn Waterway! Help the
local authorities arrest 2 of them."
entries.translation_source: The Terror Granbull have run away to the Auburn Waterway! Help the local authorities arrest 2 of them.
entries.translated:
I Terror Granbull sono fuggiti
all{B4}Auburn Waterway! Aiuta le\lautorità locali ad arrestarne 2.

entries.original:
"Only the Terror Granbull’s leader
remains to be captured! Reconvene
on Route 10 to discuss the plan."
entries.translation_source: Only the Terror Granbull’s leader remains to be captured! Reconvene on Route 10 to discuss the plan.
entries.translated:
Resta da catturare solo il capo dei
Terror Granbull! Ritroviamoci sul\lPercorso 10 per discutere il piano.

entries.original: "Goon"
entries.translation_source: Goon
entries.translated: Scagnozzo

entries.original: "Goon A"
entries.translation_source: Goon A
entries.translated: Teppista A

entries.original: "Goon B"
entries.translation_source: Goon B
entries.translated: Recluta B

entries.original: "Officer"
entries.translation_source: Officer
entries.translated: Agente

entries.original: "Gruff"
entries.translation_source: Gruff
entries.translated: Gruff

entries.original: "Hello, good citizen!"
entries.translation_source: Hello, good citizen!
entries.translated: Salve, buon cittadino!

entries.original:
"Oh, I remember you!

You’re that [buffer1] who assisted us in
the Dresco Town Gym!

For that, you can have these
five Revives."
entries.translation_source: Oh, I remember you! You’re that [buffer1-1] who assisted us in the Dresco Town Gym! For that, you can have these five Revives.
entries.translated:
Oh, mi ricordo di te! Sei quel
[buffer1] che ci ha aiutati nella\lPalestra di Dresco Town! Per

questo, puoi avere questi cinque
Rianimatori.

entries.original:
"Say, would you like to help out by
assisting the police again?"
entries.translation_source: Say, would you like to help out by assisting the police again?
entries.translated:
Senti, ti andrebbe di dare una mano
assistendo di nuovo la polizia?

entries.original:
"Ah\. those Badges mean that you’re
probably strong enough\.

Would you be willing to lend a
hand to the local police force?"
entries.translation_source: Ah[game-token-1] those Badges mean that you’re probably strong enough[game-token-2] Would you be willing to lend a hand to the local police force?
entries.translated:
Ah\. quei Distintivi significano che
probabilmente sei abbastanza forte\.\lSaresti disposto a dare una mano

alla polizia locale?

entries.original:
"Ah, good, good.

Then, as you know, Borrius’ crime
problem mostly relates to the\lgangs that were confined together\lin [green]Antisis City[blue].

Recently, however, the gang that
used to dominate the most\lterritories there, the so-called\l\qoTerror Granbull\qc, vacated their\lold base.

On top of that, there’s been reports
that several members of the gang\lhave been congregating and causing\ltrouble in various locations.

With our police force spread so thin,
we need a strong Trainer such as\lyourself to help in rounding up\lthose goons."
entries.translation_source: Ah, good, good. Then, as you know, Borrius’ crime problem mostly relates to the gangs that were confined together in [color-green-1]Antisis City[color-blue-2]. Recently, however, the gang that used to dominate the most territories there, the so-called [quote-open-3]Terror Granbull[quote-close-4], vacated their old base. On top of that, there’s been reports that several members of the gang have been congregating and causing trouble in various locations. With our police force spread so thin, we need a strong Trainer such as yourself to help in rounding up those goons.
entries.translated:
Ah, bene, bene. Allora, come sai,
il problema della criminalità di\lBorrius è principalmente legato

alle gang che sono state confinate
insieme in [green]Antisis City[blue].\lRecentemente, però, la gang che un

tempo dominava la maggior parte dei
territori lì, la cosiddetta \qoTerror\lGranbull\qc, ha abbandonato la sua

vecchia base. Inoltre, ci sono
state segnalazioni che diversi\lmembri della gang si sono radunati

e hanno causato problemi in varie
località. Con le nostre forze di\lpolizia così ridotte, abbiamo

bisogno di un Allenatore forte come
te per aiutare a radunare quei\lteppisti.

entries.original:
"Ah, thank you for your assistance.

When you are prepared, meet me on
the east side of [green]Route 10[blue], just up\lthe first set of stairs you see.

I recommend making sure your
Pokémon are healed up."
entries.translation_source: Ah, thank you for your assistance. When you are prepared, meet me on the east side of [color-green-1]Route 10[color-blue-2], just up the first set of stairs you see. I recommend making sure your Pokémon are healed up.
entries.translated:
Ah, grazie per il tuo aiuto. Quando
sei pronto, incontrami sul lato est\ldi [green]Percorso 10[blue], subito dopo la

prima scalinata che vedi. Ti
consiglio di assicurarti che i tuoi\lPokémon siano guariti.

entries.original:
"Our forces will be spread thin for
the foreseeable future.

If you would like to lend a hand,
it will always be appreciated."
entries.translation_source: Our forces will be spread thin for the foreseeable future. If you would like to lend a hand, it will always be appreciated.
entries.translated:
Le nostre forze saranno sparse su
troppi fronti per il futuro\lprevedibile. Se vuoi darci una

mano, sarà sempre apprezzata.

entries.original:
"Huh?
It’s some punk kid!

Man, who just walks up to a big gang
of people without protection, huh?

Let’s rough [buffer2] up and snatch
all [buffer1] cash!"
entries.translation_source: Huh? It’s some punk kid! Man, who just walks up to a big gang of people without protection, huh? Let’s rough [buffer2-1] up and snatch all [buffer1-2] cash!
entries.translated:
Eh? È solo un ragazzino teppista!
Accidenti, chi va dritto verso un\lgrosso gruppo di persone senza

protezione, eh? Prendiamoci a botte
[buffer2] e arraffiamo tutto il\l[buffer1] denaro!

entries.original:
"That’s right! There’s no one to blame
but yourself, punk!"
entries.translation_source: That’s right! There’s no one to blame but yourself, punk!
entries.translated:
Esatto! Non c{B4}è nessuno da
incolpare oltre a te, teppista!

entries.original:
"Didn’t your mommy ever tell you not
to follow strangers anywhere?

Well, we’re about to show ya why\.
the hard way!

So c’mon then - lemme hear ya
squeal, ya brat!

Beg for mercy from the
[green]Terror Granbull[green]!"
entries.translation_source: Didn’t your mommy ever tell you not to follow strangers anywhere? Well, we’re about to show ya why[game-token-1] the hard way! So c’mon then - lemme hear ya squeal, ya brat! Beg for mercy from the [color-green-2]Terror Granbull[color-green-3]!
entries.translated:
I tuoi genitori non ti hanno mai
detto di non seguire gli\lsconosciuti da nessuna parte? Beh,

stiamo per mostrarti perché\. nel
modo più duro! Allora avanti, fammi\lsentire le tue urla, razza di

moccioso! Implora pietà dal [green]Terror
Granbull[green]!

entries.original:
"Hold it right there!

I’m arresting you, in the name of
the Fallshore City Police!"
entries.translation_source: Hold it right there! I’m arresting you, in the name of the Fallshore City Police!
entries.translated:
Fermo lì! Ti arresto in nome della
Polizia di Fallshore City!

entries.original:
"Uh oh - it’s the cops!

Scatter, boys!"
entries.translation_source: Uh oh - it’s the cops! Scatter, boys!
entries.translated:
Oh oh - sono i poliziotti!
Scappate, ragazzi!

entries.original:
"What!? Get back here, you cowardly
wusses!

You outnumber these jokers, easily!

Gah\. just you wait - you’ll be sorry
you ever got in our way!"
entries.translation_source: What!? Get back here, you cowardly wusses! You outnumber these jokers, easily! Gah[game-token-1] just you wait - you’ll be sorry you ever got in our way!
entries.translated:
Cosa!? Tornate qui, codardi
vigliacchi! Voi li superate di\lnumero, di gran lunga! Gah\.

aspettate e vedrete - vi pentirete
di esservi messi sulla nostra\lstrada!

entries.original:
"Darn\. they got away\.

Still, all this water means that
there aren’t too many places to\lescape from us.

They can’t have gone that far.
Let’s split up and look for them."
entries.translation_source: Darn[game-token-1] they got away[game-token-2] Still, all this water means that there aren’t too many places to escape from us. They can’t have gone that far. Let’s split up and look for them.
entries.translated:
Accidenti\. sono scappati\. Comunque,
tutta quest{B4}acqua significa che non\lci sono troppi posti da cui possano

sfuggirci. Non possono essersi
allontanati così tanto. Dividiamoci\le cerchiamoli.

entries.original:
"And that’s you finished, I’m afraid!
You’re under arrest!

Now don’t cause any trouble, and
just come along quietly."
entries.translation_source: And that’s you finished, I’m afraid! You’re under arrest! Now don’t cause any trouble, and just come along quietly.
entries.translated:
E per te è finita, temo! Sei in
arresto! Adesso non creare problemi\le vieni con noi senza fare storie.

entries.original:
"Good work, [player].

Thanks to your efforts, there’s one
less criminal on the loose.

Only [buffer1] are left now.

Keep searching, while I take this man
down to the station."
entries.translation_source: Good work, [player-name-1]. Thanks to your efforts, there’s one less criminal on the loose. Only [buffer1-2] are left now. Keep searching, while I take this man down to the station.
entries.translated:
Bel lavoro, [player]. Grazie ai
tuoi sforzi, c{B4}è un criminale in\lfuga in meno. Ora ne restano solo

[buffer1]. Continua a cercare,
mentre porto quest{B4}uomo alla\lcentrale.

entries.original:
"Great job, [player]!
That should be most of them now!

Only their leader remains at large,
so\.

Let’s regroup on [green]Route 10[blue] by the
stairs to determine his location."
entries.translation_source: Great job, [player-name-1]! That should be most of them now! Only their leader remains at large, so[game-token-2] Let’s regroup on [color-green-3]Route 10[color-blue-4] by the stairs to determine his location.
entries.translated:
Ottimo lavoro, [player]! Ora
dovrebbe essere rimasto per lo più\lsolo loro! Rimane in fuga solo il

loro capo, quindi\. Riuniamoci su
[green]Route 10[blue] vicino alle scale per\ldeterminarne la posizione.

entries.original:
"It’s you - you’re the little brat
from earlier!

You thought you were so tough with
that cop backin’ you up?

Without him, you’re just some
pathetic wimp!

And pathetic wimps ain’t good for
anythin’ but crying!"
entries.translation_source: It’s you - you’re the little brat from earlier! You thought you were so tough with that cop backin’ you up? Without him, you’re just some pathetic wimp! And pathetic wimps ain’t good for anythin’ but crying!
entries.translated:
Sei tu - sei il moccioso di prima!
Credevi di essere così forte con\lquel poliziotto a coprirti le

spalle? Senza di lui, sei solo un
patetico fifone! E i fifoni\lpatetici non servono a niente se

non a piangere!

entries.original:
"Ngh\. so the kid’s decided to play
detective, huh?

Fine! I’ll teach you no second-rate
brat can just go mess with the\lTerror Granbull!"
entries.translation_source: Ngh[game-token-1] so the kid’s decided to play detective, huh? Fine! I’ll teach you no second-rate brat can just go mess with the Terror Granbull!
entries.translated:
Ngh\\. quindi il ragazzino ha deciso
di fare il detective, eh? Va bene!\lTi insegnerò che un marmocchio di

seconda categoria non può
semplicemente mettersi a dare\lfastidio al Granbull del Terrore!

entries.original:
"Gah! How’d this little snot find me
hiding here!?

Grr\. well then, I guess you don’t
leave me any choice!

I’m gonna teach a punk like you a
lesson in pain!"
entries.translation_source: Gah! How’d this little snot find me hiding here!? Grr[game-token-1] well then, I guess you don’t leave me any choice! I’m gonna teach a punk like you a lesson in pain!
entries.translated:
Ugh! Come ha fatto questo moccioso
a trovarmi qui nascosto!? Grr\. beh\lallora, immagino che non mi lasci

altra scelta! Darò a un teppistello
come te una lezione di dolore!

entries.original:
"Tch\. so this punk kid found me\.

Fine! Taste the terrible terror of
the Terror Granbull!

\.

That sounded way better in my head\."
entries.translation_source: Tch[game-token-1] so this punk kid found me[game-token-2] Fine! Taste the terrible terror of the Terror Granbull! [game-token-3] That sounded way better in my head[game-token-4]
entries.translated:
Tsk\. quindi questo moccioso mi ha
trovato\. Bene! Assaggia il terribile\lterrore del Terror Granbull! \.

Suonava molto meglio nella mia
testa\.

entries.original:
"There you are, [player].

I must commend you on your valiant
efforts in rounding up those four\lcowardly goons.

As for the leader of the pack,
however, who remains at large\.

I haven’t seen him.

Has he returned to Antisis City,
perhaps?"
entries.translation_source: There you are, [player-name-1]. I must commend you on your valiant efforts in rounding up those four cowardly goons. As for the leader of the pack, however, who remains at large[game-token-2] I haven’t seen him. Has he returned to Antisis City, perhaps?
entries.translated:
Eccoti, [player]. Devo
congratularmi con te per i tuoi\lvalorosi sforzi nel rintracciare

quei quattro codardi. Quanto al
capo della banda, però, è ancora a\lpiede libero\. Non l{B4}ho visto. Sarà

forse tornato a Antisis City?

entries.original:
"Hahahaha! As if I would!

The mighty Gruff, leader of the
Terror Granbull, doesn’t just let a\lchance to beat down a do-gooder\lslip on by!"
entries.translation_source: Hahahaha! As if I would! The mighty Gruff, leader of the Terror Granbull, doesn’t just let a chance to beat down a do-gooder slip on by!
entries.translated:
Hahahaha! Come se lo facessi! Il
possente Gruff, capo dei Terror\lGranbull, non lascia certo sfuggire

l{B4}occasione di mettere sotto un
giustiziere!

entries.original:
"Stop right there, criminal scum!

I’m taking you in for the various
felonies and disturbances you’ve\lcaused across Borrius!"
entries.translation_source: Stop right there, criminal scum! I’m taking you in for the various felonies and disturbances you’ve caused across Borrius!
entries.translated:
Fermati subito, feccia criminale!
Ti sto portando dentro per i vari\lreati e disordini che hai causato

in tutto Borrius!

entries.original:
"Hah! I’d love to see ya try!

As for you, kid\. \CC0818 sure, you didn’t
do too bad, beatin’ my goons the\lway ya did\.

But those cowards fled from an
easy beatin’ - it was no surprise\lya won over those saps.

But you’re gonna find I ain’t such
an easy target, capice?

I’ll be a real man, and see just
how good ya really are.

Get ready, ya wannabe hero, ’cos
Gruff only knows how to play rough!"
entries.translation_source: Hah! I’d love to see ya try! As for you, kid[game-token-1] [control-code-2] sure, you didn’t do too bad, beatin’ my goons the way ya did[game-token-3] But those cowards fled from an easy beatin’ - it was no surprise ya won over those saps. But you’re gonna find I ain’t such an easy target, capice? I’ll be a real man, and see just how good ya really are. Get ready, ya wannabe hero, ’cos Gruff only knows how to play rough!
entries.translated:
Ahah! Mi piacerebbe proprio vederti
provare! E per quanto riguarda te,\lragazzino\. \CC0818 certo, non hai fatto poi

così male, mettendo al tappeto i
miei scagnozzi come hai fatto\. Ma\lquei codardi sono fuggiti da una

facile pestata - non c{B4}è da
stupirsi che tu abbia battuto quei\ltizi. Però scoprirai che non sono

un bersaglio così facile, capisci?
Farò il vero uomo, e vedremo\ldavvero quanto vali. Preparati,

aspirante eroe, perché Gruff sa
solo menare le mani!

entries.original:
"Heh\. awright, I get it - ya got me,
fair and square!

But don’t go thinkin’ that I’m turning
myself in, ya hear?

I’m hoppin’ on a boat to East
Borrius, and me and the boys’ll\lmake a fresh start there!

Smell ya later, copper!

And next time, remember to
confiscate my bike!"
entries.translation_source: Heh[game-token-1] awright, I get it - ya got me, fair and square! But don’t go thinkin’ that I’m turning myself in, ya hear? I’m hoppin’ on a boat to East Borrius, and me and the boys’ll make a fresh start there! Smell ya later, copper! And next time, remember to confiscate my bike!
entries.translated:
Heh\. va bene, ho capito - mi hai
beccato, pulito e tondo! Ma non\lpensare che mi consegni, chiaro?

Sto salendo su una barca per Est
Borrius, e io e i ragazzi\lricominceremo da capo laggiù! Ci si

vede, sbirro! E la prossima volta,
ricordati di confiscarmi la bici!

entries.original:
"Gah\.! I can’t believe it never
occurred to me to do that\.

Sigh\. but still, that was fine work
there, [player].

I’ll radio my colleagues in Seaport
City, to intercept him at the port.

There’s nothing more we can do here,
so for now, please take this.

Consider it a reward for doing your
bit to help the community."
entries.translation_source: Gah[game-token-1]! I can’t believe it never occurred to me to do that[game-token-2] Sigh[game-token-3] but still, that was fine work there, [player-name-4]. I’ll radio my colleagues in Seaport City, to intercept him at the port. There’s nothing more we can do here, so for now, please take this. Consider it a reward for doing your bit to help the community.
entries.translated:
Accidenti\.! Non posso credere che
non mi sia mai venuto in mente di\lfarlo\. Sigh\. ma comunque, è stato un

ottimo lavoro lì, [player].
Chiamerò i miei colleghi a Seaport\lCity, per intercettarlo al porto.

Non c{B4}è altro che possiamo fare
qui, quindi per ora, prendi questo.\lConsideralo una ricompensa per aver

fatto la tua parte ad aiutare la
comunità.

entries.original:
"Maybe another time\.

I could ask for your help in
solving another case.

Until then, stay safe, and stay
vigilant."
entries.translation_source: Maybe another time[game-token-1] I could ask for your help in solving another case. Until then, stay safe, and stay vigilant.
entries.translated:
Forse un{B4}altra volta\. Potrei
chiederti aiuto per risolvere un\laltro caso. Fino ad allora, stai al

sicuro e resta vigile.

entries.original: "Too Much TV"
entries.translation_source: Too Much TV
entries.translated: Troppa TV

entries.original:
"Watching too much TV is bad for
your brain! Help cure children who
have had their brains fried by TV."
entries.translation_source: Watching too much TV is bad for your brain! Help cure children who have had their brains fried by TV.
entries.translated:
Guardare troppa TV fa male al
cervello! Aiuta a curare i bambini\la cui la TV ha fritto il cervello.

entries.original:
"Find a scientist who studies brain
activity to help wake a little girl
up from her coma."
entries.translation_source: Find a scientist who studies brain activity to help wake a little girl up from her coma.
entries.translated:
Trova uno scienziato che studia
l{B4}attività cerebrale per aiutare a\lrisvegliare una bambina dal coma.

entries.original:
"Find children in Borrius watching
TV and scan their brains.
Remaining: 4"
entries.translation_source: Find children in Borrius watching TV and scan their brains. Remaining: 4
entries.translated:
Trova i bambini di Borrius che
guardano la TV e scansiona i loro\lcervelli. Rimanenti: 4

entries.original:
"Find children in Borrius watching
TV and scan their brains.
Remaining: 3"
entries.translation_source: Find children in Borrius watching TV and scan their brains. Remaining: 3
entries.translated:
Trova i bambini di Borrius che
guardano la TV e scansiona i loro\lcervelli. Rimanenti: 3

entries.original:
"Find children in Borrius watching
TV and scan their brains.
Remaining: 2"
entries.translation_source: Find children in Borrius watching TV and scan their brains. Remaining: 2
entries.translated:
Trova i bambini di Borrius che
guardano la TV e scansiona i loro\lcervelli. Rimanenti: 2

entries.original:
"Find children in Borrius watching
TV and scan their brains.
Remaining: 1"
entries.translation_source: Find children in Borrius watching TV and scan their brains. Remaining: 1
entries.translated:
Trova i bambini di Borrius che
guardano la TV e scansiona i loro\lcervelli. Rimanenti: 1

entries.original:
"Report back to the scientist at the
Dream Research lab with the data
gathered from the TV children."
entries.translation_source: Report back to the scientist at the Dream Research lab with the data gathered from the TV children.
entries.translated:
Riferisci allo scienziato nel
laboratorio di ricerca sui sogni\lcon i dati raccolti dai bambini

della TV.

entries.original:
"This boy was found watching TV in
the southwest house.
His eyes were glued to the TV."
entries.translation_source: This boy was found watching TV in the southwest house. His eyes were glued to the TV.
entries.translated:
Questo ragazzo è stato trovato a
guardare la TV nella casa a\lsud-ovest. Aveva gli occhi

incollati alla TV.

entries.original:
"This girl was found watching TV in
the Swarm family house.
Her brain seemed normal."
entries.translation_source: This girl was found watching TV in the Swarm family house. Her brain seemed normal.
entries.translated:
Questa ragazza è stata trovata a
guardare la TV nella casa della\lfamiglia Swarm. Il suo cervello

sembrava normale.

entries.original:
"This boy was found watching TV in
the northeast house.
His brain seemed fried."
entries.translation_source: This boy was found watching TV in the northeast house. His brain seemed fried.
entries.translated:
Questo ragazzo è stato trovato a
guardare la TV nella casa a\lnord-est. Il suo cervello sembrava

fritto.

entries.original:
"This girl was found watching TV in
the house north of the market.
Her brain seemed gelatinous."
entries.translation_source: This girl was found watching TV in the house north of the market. Her brain seemed gelatinous.
entries.translated:
Questa ragazza è stata trovata a
guardare la TV nella casa a nord\ldel mercato. Il suo cervello

sembrava gelatinoso.

entries.original: "[red]New Mission:[black]"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]New Mission:[color-black-2]
entries.translated: [red]Nuova missione:[black]

entries.original: "[red]Mission Objective Updated:[black]"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Mission Objective Updated:[color-black-2]
entries.translated: [red]Obiettivo della missione aggiornato:[black]

entries.original: "[red]Mission Complete:[black]"
entries.translation_source: [color-red-1]Mission Complete:[color-black-2]
entries.translated: [red]Missione completata:[black]

entries.original: "[black]Missions Completed: [green][buffer1]"
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]Missions Completed: [color-green-2][buffer1-3]
entries.translated: [black]Missioni completate: [green][buffer1]

entries.original:
"My\.\CC0820 my daughter\.

She’s fallen into a deep coma\.

It’s because she\.\CC0820 she watched
too much television!

If only there were someone out
there who could help her\.

You seem like a well-traveled
Trainer.

Perhaps you know someone who
could help?"
entries.translation_source: My[game-token-1][control-code-2] my daughter[game-token-3] She’s fallen into a deep coma[game-token-4] It’s because she[game-token-5][control-code-6] she watched too much television! If only there were someone out there who could help her[game-token-7] You seem like a well-traveled Trainer. Perhaps you know someone who could help?
entries.translated:
Mia\.\CC0820 mia figlia\. È caduta in un coma
profondo\. È perché lei\.\CC0820 ha guardato\ltroppa televisione! Se solo ci

fosse qualcuno là fuori che potesse
aiutarla\. Sembri un Allenatore con\lmolta esperienza in giro per il

mondo. Forse conosci qualcuno che
potrebbe aiutarla?

entries.original:
"I knew I was right to ask you!
Oh, thank you!

Please find someone to restore my
daughter’s consciousness.

Perhaps a scientist of some sort?

I’m sure there’s some institute out
there that researches the brain\."
entries.translation_source: I knew I was right to ask you! Oh, thank you! Please find someone to restore my daughter’s consciousness. Perhaps a scientist of some sort? I’m sure there’s some institute out there that researches the brain[game-token-1]
entries.translated:
Sapevo di aver fatto bene a
chiedere a te! Oh, grazie! Ti\lprego, trova qualcuno che possa

ripristinare la coscienza di mia
figlia. Forse uno scienziato o\lqualcosa del genere? Sono sicuro

che da qualche parte ci sia un
istituto che fa ricerche sul\lcervello\.

entries.original:
"If not you, this Trainer I
don’t even know, then who?"
entries.translation_source: If not you, this Trainer I don’t even know, then who?
entries.translated:
Se non tu, questo Allenatore che
non conosco nemmeno, allora chi?

entries.original:
"Ah, Trainer, it’s you again!

The scientist you sent was able to
heal my daughter!

My gratitude knows no bounds.

This mischievous Pokémon emerged
from my daughter during the\lhealing process.

I want you to have it."
entries.translation_source: Ah, Trainer, it’s you again! The scientist you sent was able to heal my daughter! My gratitude knows no bounds. This mischievous Pokémon emerged from my daughter during the healing process. I want you to have it.
entries.translated:
Ah, Allenatore, sei di nuovo tu! Lo
scienziato che hai mandato è\lriuscito a curare mia figlia! La

mia gratitudine non ha limiti.
Questo Pokémon dispettoso è emerso\lda mia figlia durante il processo

di guarigione. Voglio che sia tuo.

entries.original:
"But first you’ll need to make space
in your party for it."
entries.translation_source: But first you’ll need to make space in your party for it.
entries.translated:
Ma prima dovrai fare spazio nella
tua squadra per aggiungerlo.

entries.original:
"Because of you, not only is my
daughter back to normal, but she\ldoesn’t even remember the concept\lof a television!

It’s truly a miracle."
entries.translation_source: Because of you, not only is my daughter back to normal, but she doesn’t even remember the concept of a television! It’s truly a miracle.
entries.translated:
Grazie a te, non solo mia figlia è
tornata normale, ma non ricorda\lnemmeno il concetto di televisione!

È davvero un miracolo.

entries.original:
"[black]She’s in a dream-like state.

This is what happens when you
watch too much TV."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]She’s in a dream-like state. This is what happens when you watch too much TV.
entries.translated:
[black]È in uno stato onirico. Questo è
ciò che succede quando guardi\ltroppa TV.

entries.original:
"Thank you for helping me get
better, Trainer!

I heard I was sick, but my Daddy
won’t tell me why."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for helping me get better, Trainer! I heard I was sick, but my Daddy won’t tell me why.
entries.translated:
Grazie per avermi aiutato a stare
meglio, Allenatore! Ho sentito che\lero malato, ma il mio papà non mi

dice perché.

entries.original:
"Here at the Dream Research Lab,
we study the dreams of Pokémon."
entries.translation_source: Here at the Dream Research Lab, we study the dreams of Pokémon.
entries.translated:
Qui al Laboratorio di Ricerca sui
Sogni studiamo i sogni dei Pokémon.

entries.original:
"What did you say?

A child in Polder Town has fallen
into a coma due to watching too\lmuch television?

Then it must be worse than I
feared\.

I’ve been getting reports from all
across the region of children\lunable to divert their attention\lfrom that horrendous device.

In order to help this child, I must
have data on all of the children\lin Borrius locked into this\l\qotelevision\qc frenzy.

Trainer!

It’s up to you to get this data
for me.

By my count, there are [buffer1] children
total.

My scans indicate there are two in
snowy areas, one in a city on the\lcoast, and another in a somber and\lsad town.

You’ve found one, so that just
leaves [green][buffer2][blue] more.

When you encounter another, scan
them with your Super Cube and\lsend me the data."
entries.translation_source: What did you say? A child in Polder Town has fallen into a coma due to watching too much television? Then it must be worse than I feared[game-token-1] I’ve been getting reports from all across the region of children unable to divert their attention from that horrendous device. In order to help this child, I must have data on all of the children in Borrius locked into this [quote-open-2]television[quote-close-3] frenzy. Trainer! It’s up to you to get this data for me. By my count, there are [buffer1-4] children total. My scans indicate there are two in snowy areas, one in a city on the coast, and another in a somber and sad town. You’ve found one, so that just leaves [color-green-5][buffer2-6][color-blue-7] more. When you encounter another, scan them with your Super Cube and send me the data.
entries.translated:
Che cosa hai detto? Un bambino a
Polder Town è caduto in coma per\laver guardato troppa televisione?

Allora deve essere peggio di quanto
temessi\. Ho ricevuto segnalazioni da\ltutta la regione di bambini

incapaci di distogliere
l{B4}attenzione da quel terribile\lapparecchio. Per aiutare questo

bambino, devo avere dati su tutti i
bambini di Borrius coinvolti in\lquesta frenesia \qotelevisione\qc.

Allenatore! Sta a te procurarmi
questi dati. Secondo i miei\lcalcoli, ci sono [buffer1] bambini

in totale. Le mie scansioni
indicano che ce ne sono due in zone\linnevate, uno in una città sulla

costa, e un altro in una città cupa
e triste. Ne hai trovato uno,\lquindi ne rimangono solo [green][buffer2][blue].

Quando ne incontri un altro,
scannerizzalo con il tuo Super Cube\le inviami i dati.

entries.original:
"You still have yet to gather data
on [green][buffer1][blue] of the children locked in a\l\qotelevision frenzy\qc.

My scans indicate there are two in
snowy areas, one in a city on the\lcoast, and another in a somber and\lsad town.

When you encounter one, scan them
with your Super Cube and send me\lthe data."
entries.translation_source: You still have yet to gather data on [color-green-1][buffer1-2][color-blue-3] of the children locked in a [quote-open-4]television frenzy[quote-close-5]. My scans indicate there are two in snowy areas, one in a city on the coast, and another in a somber and sad town. When you encounter one, scan them with your Super Cube and send me the data.
entries.translated:
Hai ancora da raccogliere dati su
[green][buffer1][blue] dei bambini intrappolati\lin una \qofrenesia televisiva\qc. Le

mie scansioni indicano che ce ne
sono due nelle zone innevate, uno\lin una città sulla costa e un altro

in una cittadina cupa e triste.
Quando ne incontri uno, scansionalo\lcon il tuo Super Cube e mandami i

dati.

entries.original:
"It appears I have all the data I
need to cure this \qotelevision\lfrenzy\qc.

I will be back momentarily."
entries.translation_source: It appears I have all the data I need to cure this [quote-open-1]television frenzy[quote-close-2]. I will be back momentarily.
entries.translated:
Pare che abbia tutti i dati di cui
ho bisogno per curare questa\l\qofrenesia televisiva\qc. Tornerò a

momenti.

entries.original:
"Thank you for waiting.

I have visited each home and cured
the children of their illnesses.

However, during the healing
process, a strange Pokémon\lemerged from each of their bodies.

As a result, they no longer
understand the concept of\lwatching television.

I believe these children will now
be able to lead productive lives."
entries.translation_source: Thank you for waiting. I have visited each home and cured the children of their illnesses. However, during the healing process, a strange Pokémon emerged from each of their bodies. As a result, they no longer understand the concept of watching television. I believe these children will now be able to lead productive lives.
entries.translated:
Grazie per aver aspettato. Sono
andato in ogni casa e ho guarito i\lbambini dalle loro malattie.

Tuttavia, durante il processo di
guarigione, uno strano Pokémon è\lemerso dal corpo di ciascuno di

loro. Di conseguenza, non
comprendono più il concetto di\lguardare la televisione. Credo che

questi bambini ora saranno in grado
di condurre una vita produttiva.

entries.original:
"All of the children have been cured
of the \qotelevision frenzy\qc.

You should return to Polder Town to
claim your reward."
entries.translation_source: All of the children have been cured of the [quote-open-1]television frenzy[quote-close-2]. You should return to Polder Town to claim your reward.
entries.translated:
Tutti i bambini sono stati curati
dalla \qofrenesia televisiva\qc.\lDovresti tornare a Polder Town per

reclamare la tua ricompensa.

entries.original:
"[black]The child was scanned using the
Cube.

Data was sent to the scientist at
the Dream Research Lab.

Children remaining: [green][buffer1][black]."
entries.translation_source: [color-black-1]The child was scanned using the Cube. Data was sent to the scientist at the Dream Research Lab. Children remaining: [color-green-2][buffer1-3][color-black-4].
entries.translated:
[black]Il bambino è stato scansionato
usando il Cube. I dati sono stati\linviati allo scienziato del Dream

Research Lab. Bambini rimanenti:
[green][buffer1][black].

entries.original: "May "
entries.translation_source: May
entries.translated: Vera

entries.original: "appear."
entries.translation_source: appear.
entries.translated: appaia.

entries.original: " appear."
entries.translation_source: appear.
entries.translated: appaia.

entries.original:
"An extremely powerful attack.
However, if the user is hit before
using the move, they will flinch."
entries.translation_source: An extremely powerful attack. However, if the user is hit before using the move, they will flinch.
entries.translated:
Un attacco estremamente potente.
Tuttavia, se l{B4}utilizzatore viene
colpito prima di usare la mossa, tentenna.

entries.original:
"Sharp, huge claws hook and slash
the foe quickly and with great
power."
entries.translation_source: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash the foe quickly and with great power.
entries.translated:
Artigli affilati e enormi
ghermiscono e squarciano
rapidamente il nemico con grande potenza.

entries.original:
"The foe is hit with a pulsing blast
of water. It may also confuse the
target."
entries.translation_source: The foe is hit with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the target.
entries.translated:
Una raffica pulsante d{B4}acqua
colpisce il nemico. Può anche
confondere il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The user calms its spirit and
focuses its mind to raise its
Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats."
entries.translation_source: The user calms its spirit and focuses its mind to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore calma il proprio
spirito e concentra la mente per
aumentare Att. Sp. e Dif. Sp.

entries.original:
"A savage roar that causes the foe
to switch out of battle. In the
wild, ROAR ends the battle."
entries.translation_source: A savage roar that causes the foe to switch out of battle. In the wild, ROAR ends the battle.
entries.translated:
Un ruggito selvaggio che costringe il
bersaglio a ritirarsi dal
combattimento. In natura, BOATO pone fine alla lotta.

entries.original:
"A move that leaves the foe badly
poisoned. Its poison damage worsens
every turn."
entries.translation_source: A move that leaves the foe badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
entries.translated:
Una mossa che avvelena gravemente
il nemico. Il danno da veleno
aumenta a ogni turno.

entries.original:
"Summons a hailstorm that lasts for
five turns. The hailstorm damages
all types except the ICE type."
entries.translation_source: Summons a hailstorm that lasts for five turns. The hailstorm damages all types except the ICE type.
entries.translated:
Invoca una tempesta di grandine che dura
cinque turni. La tempesta di grandine
danneggia tutti i tipi tranne il tipo Ghiaccio.

entries.original:
"The user tightens all its muscles
and bulks up, boosting both its
Attack and Defense stats."
entries.translation_source: The user tightens all its muscles and bulks up, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore tende tutti i
muscoli e si irrobustisce,
aumentando sia l{B4}Attacco che la Difesa.

entries.original:
"The user shoots seeds at the foe
in rapid succession. Two to five
seeds are shot at once."
entries.translation_source: The user shoots seeds at the foe in rapid succession. Two to five seeds are shot at once.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore spara semi al
bersaglio in rapida successione.
Vengono sparati da due a cinque semi alla volta.

entries.original:
"A variable move that changes type
and power depending on the Pokémon
using it."
entries.translation_source: A variable move that changes type and power depending on the Pokémon using it.
entries.translated:
Una mossa variabile che cambia
tipo e potenza a seconda del
Pokémon che la usa.

entries.original:
"The weather is turned sunny for
five turns. Over that time, FIRE-
type moves are powered up."
entries.translation_source: The weather is turned sunny for five turns. Over that time, FIRE- type moves are powered up.
entries.translated:
Il tempo diventa soleggiato per
cinque turni. In questo periodo, le
mosse di tipo FUOCO sono potenziate.

entries.original:
"A taunted foe may become enraged.
It will then only be able to use
attack moves."
entries.translation_source: A taunted foe may become enraged. It will then only be able to use attack moves.
entries.translated:
Un nemico provocato può
infuriarsi. Potrà quindi usare
solo mosse d{B4}attacco.

entries.original:
"An icy-cold beam is shot at the
foe. It may leave the target
frozen."
entries.translation_source: An icy-cold beam is shot at the foe. It may leave the target frozen.
entries.translated:
Un raggio gelido viene scagliato
contro il nemico. Può lasciare il
bersaglio congelato.

entries.original:
"A vicious snow-and-wind attack that
strikes all foes in battle. It may
cause freezing."
entries.translation_source: A vicious snow-and-wind attack that strikes all foes in battle. It may cause freezing.
entries.translated:
Un violento attacco di neve e
vento che colpisce tutti i nemici
in lotta. Può anche congelarli.

entries.original:
"A harsh attack that inflicts severe
damage on the foe. However, the
user must rest the next turn."
entries.translation_source: A harsh attack that inflicts severe damage on the foe. However, the user must rest the next turn.
entries.translated:
Un attacco violento che infligge danni
ingenti al bersaglio. Tuttavia,
l{B4}utilizzatore deve riposarsi nel turno successivo.

entries.original:
"A wall of light is created over
five turns. It reduces damage from
Sp. Atk attacks."
entries.translation_source: A wall of light is created over five turns. It reduces damage from Sp. Atk attacks.
entries.translated:
Per cinque turni viene creata una
barriera di luce. Riduce i danni
subiti dagli attacchi di Att. Sp.

entries.original:
"The user is completely protected
from attack in the turn it is used.
It may fail if used in succession."
entries.translation_source: The user is completely protected from attack in the turn it is used. It may fail if used in succession.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore è completamente protetto
dagli attacchi nel turno in cui viene
usata. Può fallire se usata consecutivamente.

entries.original:
"A heavy rain is summoned for five
turns. Over that time, WATER-type
moves are powered up."
entries.translation_source: A heavy rain is summoned for five turns. Over that time, WATER-type moves are powered up.
entries.translated:
Viene evocata una forte pioggia per
cinque turni. In questo periodo, le
mosse di tipo ACQUA sono potenziate.

entries.original:
"The user strikes the foe with
tentacles or roots, stealing the
target’s HP and healing itself."
entries.translation_source: The user strikes the foe with tentacles or roots, stealing the target’s HP and healing itself.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore colpisce il
bersaglio con tentacoli o radici,
sottraendo PS al bersaglio e curandosi.

entries.original:
"Protects the party with a shield
against all status problems over
five turns."
entries.translation_source: Protects the party with a shield against all status problems over five turns.
entries.translated:
Protegge il gruppo con uno scudo
da ogni problema di stato per
cinque turni.

entries.original:
"This attack move grows more
powerful the more the Pokémon
dislikes its Trainer."
entries.translation_source: This attack move grows more powerful the more the Pokémon dislikes its Trainer.
entries.translated:
Questa mossa d{B4}attacco diventa più
potente quanto più il Pokémon non
sopporta il suo Allenatore.

entries.original:
"A 2-turn attack that uses the first
turn for absorbing sunlight, then
blasting the foe in the next turn."
entries.translation_source: A 2-turn attack that uses the first turn for absorbing sunlight, then blasting the foe in the next turn.
entries.translated:
Un attacco in 2 turni che usa il primo
turno per assorbire la luce solare, poi
colpisce il nemico nel turno successivo.

entries.original:
"The foe is slammed with a sturdy
tail of steel. It may lower the
target’s Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The foe is slammed with a sturdy tail of steel. It may lower the target’s Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito con una
robusta coda d{B4}acciaio. Può
ridurre la Difesa del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"A massive jolt of electricity is
launched at the foe. It may cause
paralysis."
entries.translation_source: A massive jolt of electricity is launched at the foe. It may cause paralysis.
entries.translated:
Un{B4}enorme scarica di elettricità
viene lanciata contro il nemico.
Può causare paralisi.

entries.original:
"Strikes the foe with a huge
thunderbolt. It may cause
paralysis."
entries.translation_source: Strikes the foe with a huge thunderbolt. It may cause paralysis.
entries.translated:
Colpisce il nemico con un enorme
fulmine. Può causare paralisi.

entries.original:
"Causes an earthquake that strikes
all Pokémon in battle, excluding
the user."
entries.translation_source: Causes an earthquake that strikes all Pokémon in battle, excluding the user.
entries.translated:
Provoca un terremoto che colpisce
tutti i Pokémon in lotta, tranne
l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"This attack move grows more
powerful the more the Pokémon
likes its Trainer."
entries.translation_source: This attack move grows more powerful the more the Pokémon likes its Trainer.
entries.translated:
Questa mossa d{B4}attacco diventa più
potente quanto più il Pokémon
vuole bene al suo Allenatore.

entries.original:
"A 2-turn attack in which the user
digs underground, then strikes.
It can be used to exit dungeons."
entries.translation_source: A 2-turn attack in which the user digs underground, then strikes. It can be used to exit dungeons.
entries.translated:
Un attacco in 2 turni in cui
l{B4}utilizzatore si sotterra, poi
colpisce. Può essere usata per uscire dalle grotte.

entries.original:
"A powerful blast of telekinetic
energy strikes the foe. It may
lower the target’s Sp. Def stat."
entries.translation_source: A powerful blast of telekinetic energy strikes the foe. It may lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
entries.translated:
Un potente colpo di energia
telecinetica colpisce il bersaglio.
Può abbassare la Dif. Sp. del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"The foe is attacked with a shadowy
lump. It may lower the target’s
Sp. Def stat."
entries.translation_source: The foe is attacked with a shadowy lump. It may lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito da una
massa d{B4}ombra. Può anche ridurne
la Dif. Sp.

entries.original:
"Strikes the foe with a rock-hard
fist, etc. It shatters barriers such
as REFLECT and LIGHT SCREEN."
entries.translation_source: Strikes the foe with a rock-hard fist, etc. It shatters barriers such as REFLECT and LIGHT SCREEN.
entries.translated:
Colpisce il bersaglio con un pugno
duro come la roccia, ecc. Frantuma
barriere come RIFLESSO e SCHERMOLUCE.

entries.original:
"The user begins moving so quickly
that it creates illusory copies to
raise its evasiveness."
entries.translation_source: The user begins moving so quickly that it creates illusory copies to raise its evasiveness.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore inizia a muoversi
così rapidamente da creare copie
illusorie per aumentare la sua elusività.

entries.original:
"A tough barrier is put up over five
turns. It reduces damage from
physical attacks over that time."
entries.translation_source: A tough barrier is put up over five turns. It reduces damage from physical attacks over that time.
entries.translated:
Viene eretta una barriera resistente
per cinque turni. Riduce i danni degli
attacchi fisici per tutto questo tempo.

entries.original:
"A rapid jolt of electricity strikes
the foe. This attack is impossible
to evade."
entries.translation_source: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes the foe. This attack is impossible to evade.
entries.translated:
Una rapida scarica elettrica
colpisce il nemico. Questo attacco
è impossibile da schivare.

entries.original:
"The foe is roasted with a heavy
blast of fire. It may leave the
target with a burn."
entries.translation_source: The foe is roasted with a heavy blast of fire. It may leave the target with a burn.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene arrostito da una
pesante fiammata. Può anche
lasciarlo bruciato.

entries.original:
"Toxic sludge is hurled at the foe
with great force. It may also
poison the target."
entries.translation_source: Toxic sludge is hurled at the foe with great force. It may also poison the target.
entries.translated:
Fango tossico viene scagliato
contro il nemico con grande forza.
Può anche avvelenare il bersaglio.

entries.original:
"Summons a sandstorm that lasts for
five turns. It damages all types
except ROCK, GROUND, and STEEL."
entries.translation_source: Summons a sandstorm that lasts for five turns. It damages all types except ROCK, GROUND, and STEEL.
entries.translated:
Viene evocata una tempesta di sabbia
che dura cinque turni. Danneggia tutti
i tipi tranne ROCCIA, TERRA e ACCIAIO.

entries.original:
"The foe is incinerated with an
intense flame. It may leave the
target with a burn."
entries.translation_source: The foe is incinerated with an intense flame. It may leave the target with a burn.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene incenerito da
un{B4}intensa fiammata. Può anche
lasciarlo bruciato.

entries.original:
"Boulders are hurled at the foe.
It also lowers the target’s Speed
stat if it hits."
entries.translation_source: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat if it hits.
entries.translated:
Vengono scagliati dei massi contro
il nemico. Se colpisce, riduce
anche la Velocità del bersaglio.

entries.original:
"An extremely fast attack against
one target. It is impossible to
evade."
entries.translation_source: An extremely fast attack against one target. It is impossible to evade.
entries.translated:
Un attacco estremamente rapido
contro un singolo bersaglio. È
impossibile da schivare.

entries.original:
"If enraged by this move, the target
becomes incapable of using the same
move twice in a row."
entries.translation_source: If enraged by this move, the target becomes incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
entries.translated:
Se il bersaglio viene infuriato da
questa mossa, non può usare la
stessa mossa due volte di fila.

entries.original:
"An attack move that becomes very
powerful if the user is poisoned,
burned, or paralyzed."
entries.translation_source: An attack move that becomes very powerful if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.
entries.translated:
Una mossa d{B4}attacco che diventa
molto potente se l{B4}utilizzatore è
avvelenato, bruciato o paralizzato.

entries.original:
"An attack move that may have an
additional effect depending on the
battle terrain."
entries.translation_source: An attack move that may have an additional effect depending on the battle terrain.
entries.translated:
Una mossa d{B4}attacco che può avere
un effetto aggiuntivo a seconda
del terreno di lotta.

entries.original:
"A move that makes the user fall
asleep over two turns to restore HP
and heal any status problems."
entries.translation_source: A move that makes the user fall asleep over two turns to restore HP and heal any status problems.
entries.translated:
Una mossa che fa addormentare
l{B4}utilizzatore per due turni per
ripristinare PS e guarire da ogni problema di stato.

entries.original:
"The foe, if it is the opposite
gender as the user, becomes
infatuated and may not attack."
entries.translation_source: The foe, if it is the opposite gender as the user, becomes infatuated and may not attack.
entries.translated:
Il bersaglio, se è di sesso
opposto a quello
dell{B4}utilizzatore, si innamora e può non attaccare.

entries.original:
"An attack that gives the user an
opportunity to steal the foe’s hold
item."
entries.translation_source: An attack that gives the user an opportunity to steal the foe’s hold item.
entries.translated:
Un attacco che dà all{B4}utilizzatore
l{B4}opportunità di rubare lo
strumento tenuto dal nemico.

entries.original:
"The foe is struck with steel-hard
wings. It may also raise the user’s
Defense stat."
entries.translation_source: The foe is struck with steel-hard wings. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.
entries.translated:
Il nemico viene colpito con ali
dure come l{B4}acciaio. Può anche
aumentare la Difesa dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"A special power is transmitted to
the foe, causing it to switch
abilities with the user."
entries.translation_source: A special power is transmitted to the foe, causing it to switch abilities with the user.
entries.translated:
Un potere speciale viene trasmesso
al nemico, facendogli scambiare le
abilità con l{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"A move that steals the effects of
any status-changing or healing move
that the foe tries to use."
entries.translation_source: A move that steals the effects of any status-changing or healing move that the foe tries to use.
entries.translated:
Una mossa che ruba gli effetti di
qualunque mossa di cambiamento di stato o
di guarigione che il bersaglio tenta di usare.

entries.original:
"A maximum-power attack of great
ferocity, but one that also sharply
reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat."
entries.translation_source: A maximum-power attack of great ferocity, but one that also sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
entries.translated:
Una mossa di potenza massima e di grande
ferocia, ma che riduce drasticamente la
statistica Att. Sp. dell{B4}utilizzatore.

entries.original:
"Attacks the foe with sharp blades
or claws. It can also cut down thin
trees and grass outside of battle."
entries.translation_source: Attacks the foe with sharp blades or claws. It can also cut down thin trees and grass outside of battle.
entries.translated:
Attacca il nemico con lame o artigli
affilati. Può anche abbattere alberi
sottili e l{B4}erba fuori dalla lotta.

entries.original:
"The user flies up on the first turn,
then attacks next turn. It can be
used to fly to any known town."
entries.translation_source: The user flies up on the first turn, then attacks next turn. It can be used to fly to any known town.
entries.translated:
L{B4}utilizzatore si libra in volo nel primo turno,
poi attacca nel turno successivo. Può essere usata
per volare verso qualsiasi città già conosciuta.

entries.original:
"Creates a huge wave, then crashes
it down on the foe. It can be used
